Ha ka boodin qiyaasta daawada ama ha joojin siinta dawada xitaa haddii uu Mateo billaabo inuu dareemo fiicnaan, ilaa uu dhakhtarku ku faro mooyee. Cuntada: Ku dhiiri geli Mateo inuu cabbo cabitaanno badan maalinta oo dhan, sida biyaha, dareeraha fuuq-celinta afka (sida Pedialyte), ama casiirka miraha oo la qasay. Iska ilaali cabitaannada sonkorta leh sida soodhada iyo cabitaannada loo cabbo isboortiga. Si tartiib tartiib ah u baro cuntooyinka jilicsan sida loogu dulqaadan karo, sida mooska, bariiska, tufaax, iyo rootiga (cuntada BRAT). Iska ilaali cuntooyinka budooyinka lagu daray, dufanka leh, ama shiilan ilaa caloosha Mateo ay degto. Haddii Mateo uu naas nuujinayo ama caano uu wax ku quudinayo, sii wad sidii caadiga ahayd haddii aan si kale la farin. Nadaafadda: Si fiican ugu dhaq gacmaha saabbuun iyo biyo kaddib markaad isticmaasho musqusha ama beddesho xafaayadda, iyo ka hor inta aanad diyaarin ama cunin cuntada. Ku dhiiri geli Mateo inuu sidoo kale gacmihiisa dhaqo marar badan. Kormeerka: Hayso diiwaanka astaamaha Mateo, oo ay ku jiraan inta jeer ee la diiwaangeliyey saxarada, joogteynta saxarada, dhacdooyinka matagga, iyo qandhada. La xiriir dhakhtarka haddii Mateo la kulmo calool xanuun daran, dhiig saxarada ku jira, matag joogto ah, calaamadaha fuuqbaxa (af qallayl, ilmo la'aan markuu ooyo, indho godan), ama qandho sare. Dabagalka: Jadwal u samee ballan dabagal ah sida uu ku taliyey dhakhtarku si loola socdo horumarka Mateo. Xusuusnoow: Joogteynta ayaa muhiim ah. Ku dheggidda jadwalka daaweynta iyo talooyinka cuntada waxaay ka caawin doontaa Mateo inuu si dhakhso ah u bogsado. Haddii aad qabto wax su'aallo ah ama walaac ah, ha ka gabanin inaad wacdo xafiiska dhakhtarka.
en: Here is a draft focusing on general adherence principles for gastrointestinal issues, using a fictional patient name: Adherence Plan for Mateo Hernandez This plan outlines the steps we discussed to help Mateo feel better. Following these instructions carefully is important for managing his symptoms. Medication: Give the prescribed medication exactly as directed on the bottle. Do not skip doses or stop giving the medication even if Mateo starts feeling better, unless instructed by the doctor. Diet: Encourage Mateo to drink plenty of fluids throughout the day, such as water, oral rehydration solutions (like Pedialyte), or diluted fruit juice. Avoid sugary drinks like soda and sports drinks. Introduce bland foods gradually as tolerated, such as bananas, rice, applesauce, and toast (BRAT diet). Avoid spicy, greasy, or fried foods until Mateo's stomach settles. If Mateo is breastfeeding or formula-feeding, continue as usual unless otherwise directed. Hygiene: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and water after using the bathroom or changing diapers, and before preparing or eating food. Encourage Mateo to wash his hands frequently as well. Monitoring: Keep a record of Mateo's symptoms, including frequency of bowel movements, consistency of stool, vomiting episodes, and fever. Contact the doctor if Mateo experiences severe abdominal pain, blood in stool, persistent vomiting, signs of dehydration (dry mouth, no tears when crying, sunken eyes), or high fever. Follow-up: Schedule a follow-up appointment as recommended by the doctor to monitor Mateo's progress. Remember: Consistency is key. Sticking to the medication schedule and dietary recommendations will help Mateo recover faster. If you have any questions or concerns, don't hesitate to call the doctor's office.

so: Sababta Booqashada: Isha midig oo cas, bararsan Faahfaahin: Elara Sterling waxaay timid rugta daryeelka degdega ah iyadoo ka cabanaysa il midig oo cas, cuncun na leh. Waxaay tiri waxaa ay ku toostay iyadoo dareemaysa xaani loo shubay camal ayna u eg yihiin dhiig cas, laakiin ma sheegin wax dhaawac la yaqaan ama soo-gaarista waxyaabaha cuncunka keena. Waan ka yara wareeganeysaa markii wax laga weydiiyay hawlaheeda maalintii hore, iyadoo si fudud u sheegtay in ay "hawlaheeda caadiga iska qabsaneysay". Baaritaankeeda isha wuxuu muujinayaa duritaanka isha iyo dheecaan yar oo khafiif ah, taasoo la jaanqaadaysa cudurka isha cas, laakiin diidmadeeda bixinta faahfaahi dheeri waa mid xusid mudan. Waxaa loo qoray daawada isha lagu shubo ee antibiyootiga waxaana lagula taliyay inay soo noqoto haddii astaamaha ay ka sii daraan.
en: Reason for Visit: Red, inflamed right eye Description: Elara Sterling presents to the urgent care clinic complaining of a red, irritated right eye. She says she woke up with it feeling gritty and looking bloodshot, but denies any known injury or exposure to irritants. She's a bit evasive when asked about her activities the previous day, simply stating she was "out and about." Her eye exam reveals conjunctival injection and some mild discharge, consistent with conjunctivitis, but her reluctance to provide details is notable. She's prescribed antibiotic drops and advised to return if symptoms worsen.

so: Rugta daryeelka degdegga ah maahan meel ku habboon qaliinka cudurka thoracic outlet syndrome (TOS), kaas oo ah nidaam adag oo u baahan qalab gaar ah iyo qol qalliin ee isbitaalka. Sidaa darteed, sharraxaadda qaliinka TOS ee lagu sameeyo xaalad daryeel degdeg ah waxaay noqon kartaa mid caafimaad ahaan aan sax ahayn. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, haweenay da'yar oo rugta daryeelka degdegga ah ugu tagta wax *ku saabsan* TOS waa xaalad macquul ah. Waa kan sharraxaadda taas: Elara Vance, oo ah naqshadeeye garaafikada oo 24-jir ah, ayaa timid rugta daryeelka degdegga ah iyadoo ka cabanaysa xanuun sii xumaanaya, kabuubyo, iyo xiirid garabkeeda midig iyo gacanteeda, astaamo la jaan qaadaya bararka suurtagalka ah ama xaalad caafimaad oo la xiriira cudurka (TOS) horey looga helay. Iyadoo qalliinka laftiisa aan lagu samayn doonin xaruntan, Elara waxaay raadisay qiimayn degdeg oo ah maareynta xanuunka iyo gudbinta takhasuska si ay uga wada hadlaan faragelinta qalliinka ee suurtagalka ah, marka la eego darnaanta sii kordhaysa ee astaamaheeda saameynaya awooddeeda shaqo. Dhakhtarka daryeelka degdegga ah ayaa qiimeeyay xaaladdeeda neurovascular wuxuuna siiyay nasasho ku meel gaar ah isagoo fududeynaya la tashiga dhakhtarka xididdada dhiigga ama dhakhtar qalliinka dhuunta si loo sammeeyo qiimaeyn dheeri ah iyo qorsheynta qalliinka.
en: An urgent care clinic is not the appropriate setting for thoracic outlet syndrome (TOS) surgery, which is a complex procedure requiring specialized equipment and a hospital operating room. Therefore, a description of TOS surgery being performed in an urgent care setting would be medically inaccurate. However, a young woman presenting to an urgent care clinic *regarding* TOS is a plausible scenario. Here is a description of that: Elara Vance, a 24-year-old graphic designer, presented to the urgent care clinic with complaints of worsening pain, numbness, and tingling in her right arm and hand, symptoms consistent with a potential flare-up or complication related to her previously diagnosed thoracic outlet syndrome. While surgery itself would not be performed at this facility, Elara sought immediate evaluation for pain management and referral to a specialist to discuss potential surgical intervention, given the escalating severity of her symptoms affecting her ability to work. The urgent care physician assessed her neurovascular status and provided temporary relief while facilitating a consultation with a vascular or thoracic surgeon for further evaluation and surgical planning.

so: Ma aamini karo inay meeshan soo gaartay. Halkan ayaan fadhiyaa, anigoo isku dayaya inaan helo caawimaad, waxaan maqlayaa oo keliya canugeyga, Ichiro, oo qeylo madaxiisa la dillaacayo. Waxaan ula jeedaa, waan jeclahay canuga, laakiin hadda waxaan rabaa inaan iskaga fogaado. Wuxuu garaacayaa kuraasta, wuxuu jiidayaa shaadhkayga, isagoo dalbanaya daryeel uusan iga heli karin. Madaxaygu wuu gaarcmayaa, gacmahaygu way gariirayaan, qaylo kasta oo ka timaadda Ichiro na waxaay u egtahay sida mindi dhegtayda ku jirta. Ma aha kaliya buuqa, ee waa... wax walba. Waxaan dareemayaa inaan ka soo guurguuranayo maqaarkayga. Wax walba aad bay u dhalaalayaan, aad bay u qaylinayaan, aad u badan. Ma iska fadhi karo, lugahaygu way boodboodayaan, waxaanan dareemayaa inaan bukoonayo. Iyo wallaca... Ilaahayow, wallaca. Waa sida xanuun jireed, gaajo aan baabi'in. Waan ogahay inaan u baahanahay inaan joojiyo, waan ogahay inay i dileyso, laakiin hadda waxa kaliya aan rabo waa un cabitaan. Ama kaniini. Wax kasta oo lagu joojiyo. Waxaa intaa dheer Ichiro. Waa canug iska miskiin ah. Ma fahmayo waxa socda. Wuxuu kaliya ogyahay in aabihiis uusan saxneyn oo wax qaldan yihiin. Wuuna cabsanayaa. Indhihiisa waan ka arki karaa. Taasina waxaay i dareensiisaa xitaa in ka sii daro. Sida in aan ahay aabaha ugu xun adduunka. Waa inaan ilaaliyaa, daryeelaa, laakiin taa beddelkeeda, waxaan ku jiidayaa jahawareerka. Waxaan isku dayaa inaan aamusiyo, si aan u dejiyo, laakiin codkaygu wuxuu u soo baxaa mid qallafsan oo gariiraya. Taasi na oohinta ayay uga sii dareysaa. Dadku way la yaaban yihiin, oo xamanayaan. Waxaan dareemi karaa waxaay ka aaminsan yihiin, dareenkooda naxariis. Waxaan rabaa un kaliya inaan dafo Ichiro oo aan ordo. Inaan ka cararo meeshan, naftayda, wax kasta. Laakiin waan ogahay inaanan awoodin. Waxaan u baahanahay caawimo. Waxaan u baahanahay inaan fiicnaado. Ichiro ayaan sidaa u rabaa. Naftayda ayaan sidaa u rabaa. Laakiin hadda waxaay u egtahay mid aan suurtogal ahayn. Sida fuulista buur adigoo lug ku jaban tahay. Ichiro qayladiisu na waa baraf sugaya inuu i aaso.
en: I can't believe it's come to this. I'm sitting here, trying to get help, and all I can hear is my kid, Ichiro, screaming his head off. I mean, I love the kid, but right now, I just want to disappear. He's knocking over chairs, pulling at my sleeve, demanding attention I just don't have to give. My head's pounding, my hands are shaking, and every screech from Ichiro feels like a knife in my ear. It's not just the noise, it's the... everything. I feel like I'm crawling out of my skin. Everything's too bright, too loud, too much. I can't sit still, my legs are jumping, and I feel like I'm going to be sick. And the cravings... God, the cravings. It's like a physical ache, a hunger that won't go away. I know I need to stop, I know it's killing me, but right now, all I want is a drink. Or a pill. Anything to make it stop. And then there's Ichiro. Poor kid. He doesn't understand what's going on. He just knows his dad's not right, that something's wrong. And he's scared. I can see it in his eyes. And that makes me feel even worse. Like the worst father in the world. I should be protecting him, taking care of him, but instead, I'm dragging him into this mess. I try to shush him, to calm him down, but my voice comes out harsh and shaky. He just cries harder. People are staring, whispering. I can feel their judgment, their pity. I just want to grab Ichiro and run. Run away from this place, from myself, from everything. But I know I can't. I need help. I need to get better. For Ichiro. For myself. But right now, it feels impossible. Like climbing a mountain with a broken leg. And Ichiro's screams are the avalanche waiting to bury me.

so: Waxaan si dhib yar ugu wareegaa kursiga balaastiga ah, anigoo dusha sare ee siman ee qaboow lugahayga saaraya. Calaacasheydu waa qoyaan dhidid. ah, taasoo jeemiskeyga ku reebeysa calaamado markaan tirtirayo marar badan. Xafiiska Dikt. Adewale ka soo shiiraya wax yar oo jeermis dile ah iyo qaxwo, caraf nadiif ah haddana yaab leh raaxo u leh. Waxaan jalleecayaa saacadda gidaarka, gacanta labaad oo si tartiib ah xanuun dartii u tikaameysa. "Mr. Gonzalez," ayuu yiri Dikt. Adewale, isagoo kor ka eegaya qoraaladiisa. Codkiisu waa deggan yahay, joogto ah, aad uga duwan laxanka qalbigayga. "Waxaan arkaa inaad qaadaneysay daawada laguu qoray ee welwelkaaga. Sideed dareemeysay?" Neef dheer ayaan qaadanayaa, anigoo isku dayaya inaan codkayga dejiyo. "Si wanaagsan," ayaan leeyahay, ereyga oo dhuuntayda ku qabtay. "Weerarada argagaxa ma aha kuwa soo noqnoqda, waxaanan seexdaa xoogaa wax badan." "Waa wax lagu farxo in sidaa tahay," Dr. Adewale oo madaxa ruxaya, isagoo wax wax qoraya. "Miisaankaagu ka warran? Ma jiraan wax isbeddel ah?" Waan ka labalabeynayaa, anigoo indhaha hoos aadinaya. "Maya runtii," ayaa ku guuxayaa. "Waxaan isku dayaa inaan cuno cunno caafimaad qabta, laakiin mararka qaarkood... way adag tahay." Dikt. Adewale wax yar ayuu hore u soo tiirsaday, hadalkiisu naxariis laakiin adag. "Lakshmi, waan ka wada hadalnay arrintan. Daawadu waxaay sababi kartaa miisaan korodh oo ah saameyn taban, laakiin waxaa muhiim ah in la joogteeyo cunto dheellitiran oo jimicsi joogto ah la sammeeyo. Waxaay muhiim u tahay caafimaadkaaga guud, maskaxda iyo jirka labadaba." Madaxa ayaan ruxay, anigoo dareemaya mowjad ceeb ah oo igu soo qulqulaysa. Waan ogahay inuu saxan yahay. Waan ogahay inay tahay inaan wax badan sammeeyo. Laakin mararka qaar, walwalka ayaa aad iiga batay oo waxaan samayn kara kaliya waa in aan ku soo laabto qolka fadhiga aniga oo wata bac jibsi ah oo aan miciin bado bandhig TV oo aan micno lahayn. "Waan ogahay," ayaan si aamusan u iri. "Si ka adag ayaan isugu dayi doonaa." "Kuma saabsana in si adag la isugu dayo, Lakshmi," Dikt. Adewale ayaa si tartiib ah u yiri. "Waxaay ku saabsan tahay sameynta isbeddello yaryar oo waara. Waxaa laga yaabaa in aad billowdo in aad maalin walba socod gaaban qaadato, ama aad cabitaannada sonkorta leh ku beddesho biyo. Wax yar kasta wuu ku caawinayaa." Waxa uu ii dhiibayaa buug-yaraha ku saabsan cunto-cunista caafimaadka leh iyo jimicsiga, indhihiisa oo kuweyga kala kulmey muuqaal dhiirigelin leh. "Oo xusuusnow, keligaa kuma tihid hawshaan. Halkan waxaan u joognaa inaan ku taageerno." Buug-yaraha ayaan qaadanayaa, anigoo dareemaya rajo bidhaamaysa oo igu dhex shidmeysa. Hashaan waan sammeyn karaa. Laga yaabaa inaan xakameyn karo caafimaadkayga, hal tallaabo oo yar markiiba. "Waad ku mahadsan tahay, Dikt. Adewale," ayaan leeyahay, iyadoo dhoola caddeyn dhab ah oo taabanaya bushimahayga markii ugu horeysay tan iyo markii aan soo galay xafiiskiisa. "waan ka mahadnaqayaa." Markaan ka sii baxayo xafiiska, miisaanka walaacaygu wuxuu dareemayaa inuu yara fudud yahay, oo lagu beddelay go'aan cusub. Waxaa laga yaabaa in aan si buuxda u fiicneyn, laakiin waan isku dayayaa. Hadda se, taasi way igu filan tahay.
en: I shift uncomfortably in the plastic chair, the smooth surface cold against my legs. My palms are damp with sweat, leaving smudges on my jeans as I wipe them repeatedly. Dr. Adewale's office smells faintly of antiseptic and coffee, a sterile yet strangely comforting scent. I glance at the clock on the wall, the second hand ticking away with agonizing slowness. "Mr. Gonzalez," Dr. Adewale says, looking up from his notes. His voice is calm, steady, a stark contrast to the frantic rhythm of my heart. "I see you've been taking the prescribed medication for your anxiety. How have you been feeling?" I take a deep breath, trying to steady my voice. "Better," I say, the word catching in my throat. "The panic attacks aren't as frequent, and I'm sleeping a bit more." "That's good to hear," Dr. Adewale nods, jotting something down. "And your weight? Any changes there?" I hesitate, my gaze dropping to my lap. "Not really," I mumble. "I try to eat healthy, but sometimes... it's hard." Dr. Adewale leans forward slightly, his expression kind but firm. "Lakshmi, we discussed this. The medication can cause weight gain as a side effect, but it's important to maintain a balanced diet and exercise regularly. It's crucial for your overall health, both mental and physical." I nod, feeling a wave of shame wash over me. I know he's right. I know I should be doing more. But sometimes, the anxiety is so overwhelming that all I can do is curl up on the couch with a bag of chips and escape into a mindless TV show. "I know," I say quietly. "I'll try harder." "It's not about trying harder, Lakshmi," Dr. Adewale says gently. "It's about making small, sustainable changes. Maybe start by taking a short walk every day, or swapping out sugary drinks for water. Every little bit helps." He hands me a pamphlet about healthy eating and exercise, his eyes meeting mine with a look of encouragement. "And remember, you're not alone in this. We're here to support you." I take the pamphlet, feeling a flicker of hope ignite within me. Maybe I can do this. Maybe I can take control of my health, one small step at a time. "Thank you, Dr. Adewale," I say, a genuine smile touching my lips for the first time since I walked into his office. "I appreciate it." As I leave the office, the weight of my anxiety feels a little lighter, replaced by a newfound determination. I may not be perfect, but I'm trying. And for now, that's enough.

so: Dikt. Ferreira: Halloow, waxaan ahay Dikt. Ferreira. Waxaan dareemaya inaad ka walaacsan tahay taariikhda qoyskaaga ee cillad difaaca jirka oo daran, sax ma tahay? Kai Tanaka: Haa, waa sax. Ina-adeerkey baa qaba, waxaana ka walwalsanahay inaan anigana qabo. Runtii aad baan u daallanaa beryahan dambe, aad ayaana u xanuunsanayay. Waxaa intaa dheer, dhidid baa iga qubanaya, xitaa marka aanan jimicsi sameyneyn. Dikt. Ferreira: Waan arkaa. Hagaag, bal aan eegno taariikhdaada caafimaad oo aan sameyno baaritaan jireed. Wax dheeri ah iiga sheeg dhididkan. Ma mar kastaa, mise waa marka aad dhaq-dhaqaaq sameyso oo keliya? Kai Tanaka: Inta badan waa marka aan firfircoonahay, laakiin xitaa socodka oo keliya ayaa dhidid iga keenaya. Oo ma aha waxyar oo dhidid ah, waxaan ka hadlayaa in dharkayga uu qoyo. Dikt. Ferreira: Hmm, taasi waa wax aan caadi ahayn. Oo waxaad sheegtay inaad aad u xanuunsato. Waa maxay nooca jirrada kugu dhacay dhowaan? Kai Tanaka: Kaliya hergab iyo wax la mid ah, inta badan. Laakiin waxaay u muuqdaan inay sii jiitamayaan weligood, waxaana dareemayaa in aan dhammaaday mar walba. Dikt. Ferreira: Hagaag. Aynu eegno waxyaabaha muhiimka ah. Heerkulkaagu wuu yara sarreeyaa, 100.4 darajo. Heerka wadno garaacaaga sidoo kale wuu sarreeyaa. Kai Tanaka: Haa, waxaan dareemayey xoogaa qandho dhowaanahan. Dr. Ferreira: Waa hagaag, Kai, iyadoo lagu saleynayo astaamahaaga iyo baaritaanka jireed, kuma qanacsani in SCID ay tahay waxa aan halkan uga shakisannahay. In kasta oo ay run tahay inaad leedahay taariikh qoyska qabo jirradan, haddana waxa aan kaa arko si fiican uma sharraxayo sawirka caadiga ah. SCID badanaa waxaay ka soo muuqataa dhallaanka, iyadoo leh caabuqyo daran iyo ku guuldareysiga inay koraan. Waxaad tahay qof weyn, waxaadna u muuqataa inaad qaab fiican ku jirto guud ahaan, marka laga reebo dhididka iyo daalka. Kai Tanaka: Markaa maxaad u malaynaysaa inay noqon karto? Dr. Ferreira: Waxaa jira dhowr suurtogalnimo oo kale oo ay tahay inaan tixgelinno. Hyperthyroidism (siideynta hormonno xad-dhaaf oo tayroodh ah), tusaale ahaan, waxay keeni kartaa dhidid badan, daal, iyo garaaca wadnaha oo degdeg ah. Ama laga yaabee caabuq hoose sida tiibishada ama mononucleosis. Waxaan u baahan doonnaa inaan sameyno baaritaanno si aan meesha uga saarno suurtagalnimada kuwaas. Kai Tanaka: Hagaag, wax alla wixii aad u malaynayso inay ugu fiican yihiin. Kaliya waxaan rabaa inaan ogaado waxa socda oo aan roonaado. Dikt. Ferreira: Dhab ahaantii. Waxaan gaari doonnaa gunta hoose ee arrintan. Si aan u billowno waxaan qaadi doonnaa shaqada dhiigaaga iyo laga yaabee raajada xabadka. Hadda se, isku day inaad biyo cabtid oo nasato intii aad awoodid. Kai Tanaka: Mahadsanid, Dikt. Ferreira. Waan kaaga mahadcelinayaa caawintaada. Dikt. Ferreira: Soo dhowoow, Kai. Waan ku dedaaleynaa in aad mardhaw roonaato.
en: Dr. Ferreira: Hello there, I'm Dr. Ferreira. I understand you're concerned about your family history of severe combined immunodeficiency, is that right? Kai Tanaka: Yeah, that's right. My cousin has it, and I'm worried I might have it too. I've been feeling really tired lately, and I've been getting sick a lot. Plus, I'm sweating buckets, even when I'm not working out. Dr. Ferreira: I see. Well, let's take a look at your history and do a physical exam. Tell me more about this sweating. Is it all the time, or just when you exert yourself? Kai Tanaka: It's mostly when I'm active, but even just walking around makes me break out in a sweat. And it's not just a little bit of sweat, I'm talking about soaking through my clothes. Dr. Ferreira: Hmm, that is unusual. And you mentioned getting sick a lot. What kind of illnesses have you had recently? Kai Tanaka: Just colds and stuff, mostly. But they seem to drag on forever, and I feel wiped out all the time. Dr. Ferreira: Okay. Let's check your vitals. Your temperature is a bit high, 100.4 degrees. And your heart rate is elevated too. Kai Tanaka: Yeah, I've been feeling a bit feverish lately. Dr. Ferreira: Well, Kai, based on your symptoms and physical exam, I'm not convinced that SCID is the culprit here. While it's true that you have a family history, your presentation doesn't quite fit the typical picture. SCID usually presents in infancy with severe infections and failure to thrive. You're an adult, and you seem to be in good shape overall, aside from the sweating and fatigue. Kai Tanaka: So what do you think it could be then? Dr. Ferreira: There are a few other possibilities we should consider. Hyperthyroidism, for example, can cause excessive sweating, fatigue, and rapid heart rate. Or perhaps an underlying infection like tuberculosis or mononucleosis. We'll need to run some tests to rule those out. Kai Tanaka: Okay, whatever you think is best. I just want to figure out what's going on and get better. Dr. Ferreira: Absolutely. We'll get to the bottom of this. I'll order some blood work and maybe a chest X-ray to start. And in the meantime, try to stay hydrated and rest as much as you can. Kai Tanaka: Thanks, Dr. Ferreira. I appreciate your help. Dr. Ferreira: You're welcome, Kai. We'll get you feeling better soon.

so: Marwo qaali, Marisol Hernandez, Intii aan maanta booqashada ku jirnay, waxaan ogaaday inaad la kulantay in yar oo xiiq ah. Tani mararka qaarkood way dhici kartaa marka heerka tayroodhkaagu sarreeyo, maadaama ay saammeyn ku yeelan karto neefsashadaada. Waa muhiim in arrintan wax laga qabto si ay kaaga caawiso inaad yar roonaato.. Waa kuwan waxyaabihi aan ka wada hadalnay oo ku caawin kara: Sii wad qaadashada daaweynta tayroodhkaaga sida laguugu qoray: Tani waxaay kaa caawin doontaa inaad dib u soo celiso heerarka tayroodhkaaga, taasoo hagaajinaysa neefsashadaada muddo ka dib. Isticmaal daawada neefta sida loogu baahdo: Haddii laguu qoray daawada neefta ee xiiqda, u isticmaal sida uu dhakhtarkaagu ku farayo. Tani waxaay kaa caawin kartaa furitaanka marin-haweedkaaga oo sahleysa neefsashada. Nasasho iyo deganaan: Isku day inaad hesho nasasho badan oo iska ilaali hawlaha culus ee ka sii dari kara xiiqdaada. Deegaankaaga nadiifi: Boorka iyo xasaasiyadaha kale waxay kicin karaan xiiq, markaa isku day inaad gurigaaga nadiifiso oo aad boor la'aan ka dhigto inta suurtogal ah. La soco astaamahaaga: U fiirso neefsashadaada iyo calaamadaha kale ee laga yaabo inaad la kulanto. Haddii xiiqdaadu ka sii darto ama ay dhibaato kaa haysato neefsashada, fadlan isla markiiba la xidhiidh dhakhtarkaaga. Waxaan sidoo kale ka hadalnay isbeddellada qaab nololeedka qaarkood oo kaa caawin kara maareynta tayroodhkaaga sare iyo hagaajinta caafimaadkaaga guud: Cun cunto caafimaad leh: Diiradda saar cunista miro badan, khudaarta, iyo haruurka. Iska ilaali cuntooyinka warshadaysan, cabitaannada sonkorta leh, iyo kafeega xad-dhaafka ah. Maaree walbahaarka: Walbahaarka ayaa ka sii dari kara astaamaha tayroodhka sare, marka raadi habab caafimaad qaba oo lagu maareeyo walbahaarka, sida yoga, ka niyad-dejinta, ama waqti ku qaadashada goobaha dabiiciga. Samee jimicsi joogto ah: jimicsi dhexdhexaad ah ayaa kaa caawin kara hagaajinta heerarka tamartaada iyo caafimaadka guud. Kala hadal dhakhtarkaaga ka hor inta aanad billaabin barnaamij jimicsi oo cusub. Waan ogahay maareynta xaalad caafimaad in ay adkaan karto, laakiin fadlan ogow inaan halkan u joogo inaan ku taageero. Haddii aad qabto wax su'aallo ah ama walaac ah, fadlan ha ka gabanin inaad nala soo xiriirto. Si daacadnimo, Kalkaaliye Alejandro
en: Dear Ms. Marisol Hernandez, During our visit today, I noted that you were experiencing some wheezing. This can sometimes happen when your thyroid levels are high, as it can affect your breathing. It's important to address this to help you feel more comfortable. Here are some things we discussed that can help: Continue taking your hyperthyroidism medication as prescribed: This will help bring your thyroid levels back into balance, which should improve your breathing over time. Use your inhaler as needed: If you have been prescribed an inhaler for wheezing, use it as directed by your doctor. This can help open up your airways and make breathing easier. Rest and relax: Try to get plenty of rest and avoid strenuous activities that might make your wheezing worse. Keep your environment clean: Dust and other allergens can trigger wheezing, so try to keep your home as clean and dust-free as possible. Monitor your symptoms: Pay attention to your breathing and any other symptoms you may be experiencing. If your wheezing gets worse or you have trouble breathing, please contact your doctor immediately. We also talked about some lifestyle changes that can help manage your hyperthyroidism and improve your overall health: Eat a healthy diet: Focus on eating plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains. Avoid processed foods, sugary drinks, and excessive caffeine. Manage stress: Stress can worsen hyperthyroidism symptoms, so find healthy ways to manage stress, such as yoga, meditation, or spending time in nature. Get regular exercise: moderate exercise can help improve your energy levels and overall health. Talk to your doctor before starting any new exercise program. I know managing a health condition can be challenging, but please know that I am here to support you. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out. Sincerely, Nurse Alejandro

so: Dhakhtarka: "Hagaag haye, Wanjiku! Daqiiqad ayaan ka soo dhaahay, miyaanay ahayn? Kaalay gudaha, soo na dhawoow. Sideed ahayd tan iyo markii aan is aragnay?" Bukaanka: "Sidee tahay, Dhakhtar. Daacadnimo markaan u hadlo, arrimuhu ma fiicnayn. jirridda wali aad bay i dhibaysaa, xanuunkuna wax badan iskama dhimin." Dhakhtarka: "Oh, aad baan uga xummahay inaan maqlo taas, Wanjiku. Taasi waa mid aad u adag in la maqlo. Aan eegno, ma yeelnaa? Wax dheeri ah iiga sheeg waxa ku haya. Ma xanuun joogto ah baa, mise waa mid imanayaa oo tagaya?" Bukaanka: "Waa wax joogto ah, Dhakhtar. Sida xanuun caajis ah oo mararka qaarkood lugta kor ugu qaada. Bararkuna sidoo kale wax badan hoos uma dhicin." Dhakhtarka: "Hmm, waayahay. Taasi xaqiiqdii waa wax walaac leh. Aan si tartiib ah u baarno aagga. Ii sheeg haddii aad wax xanuun ah dareento, sax?" Bukaanka: "Haye." Dhakhtarka: "Hagaag, waan arkaa waxa aad kala jeedo bararka. Waxay u egtahay in yar oo bararsan. Ma awooday in aad kor u qaaddo oo aad yar jilciso inta suurtogalka ah?" Bukaanka: "Waan isku dayay, Dhakhtar, laakiin maaddaama ilmaha soo socdaan iyo waxyaabo kale oo nolosheyda ka socda, way adkeyd in aan gebi ahaanba ku istaago cagahayga." Dhakhtarka: "Waan fahmay, Wanjiku. Hawlo badan ayaa ku yaalla. Laakiin in lugtaada aad siiso waqti ay ku bogsato runtii hadda waa muhiim. Ma dooneyno wax dhibaato ah, gaar ahaan midda yar ee waddada ku soo jirta. Ma aragtay astaamo kale, sida qandho ama casaan faafaya?" Bukaanka: "Qandho ma jirto, laakiin waxaan dareemaa diirimaad markaan taabto mararka qaarkood. Sidoo kale wax yar oo casaan ayaa isku arkaa oo ka badan sidii caadiga ahayd." Dhakhtarka: "Hagaag, way fiican tahay inaan ogaado. Xaqiiqdii waxaan dooneynaa inaan taas isha ku hayno. Waxaay u egtahay inuu jiri karo xoogaa caabuq ah ama laga yaabaa in aad la kulmeyso cuncun neerfaha ah. Waxaan kiu qori doonaa xoogaa antibiyootik ka hortag ahaan, iyo sidoo kale daawo xanuunka u qaadato. Sidee bay taasi kula tahay?" Bukaanka: "Haa, taasi waxaayila tahay mid fiican, Dhakhtar. Aan sameyno wax kasta oo ka dhigi kara in tani ay aad ii sii xanuunjinin ." Dhakhtarka: "Waxaan ku dedaali doonnaa inaad roonaato, Wanjiku. Xasuusnowna, ha ka gabanin inaad wacdo haddii arrimuhu ka sii daraan ama haddii aad qabto wax kale oo walaac ah. Waxaan halkaan u joognaa in aan ku garab istaagno tallaabo kasta oo qaadeyso ah." Bukaanka: "Mahadsanid, Dhakhtar. Waan ka mahadcelinayaa." Dhakhtarka: "Dabcan, Wanjiku. Iska ilaali naftaada iyo kan yar, okey? Halkan ayaan kugu arki doonnaa dhowaan si laguu baaro."
en: Doctor: "Well hello there, Wanjiku! It's been a minute, hasn't it? Come on in, make yourself comfortable. How have you been holding up since we last saw each other?" Patient: "Hey, Doc. Honestly, things haven't been great. The stump is still really bothering me, and the pain hasn't let up much." Doctor: "Oh, I'm so sorry to hear that, Wanjiku. That sounds really tough. Let's take a look, shall we? Tell me more about what's going on. Is it constant pain, or does it come and go?" Patient: "It's pretty constant, Doc. Like a dull ache that sometimes shoots up my leg. And the swelling hasn't gone down much either." Doctor: "Hmm, okay. That's definitely concerning. Let me examine the area gently. Just let me know if anything hurts too much, alright?" Patient: "Okay." Doctor: "Alright, I see what you mean about the swelling. It does look a bit inflamed. Have you been able to keep it elevated and rest it as much as possible?" Patient: "I've tried, Doc, but with the baby coming and everything else going on, it's been hard to stay off my feet completely." Doctor: "I understand, Wanjiku. It's a lot to juggle. But giving your leg time to heal is really important right now. We don't want any complications, especially with the little one on the way. Have you noticed any other symptoms, like fever or redness spreading?" Patient: "No fever, but it does feel warm to the touch sometimes. And maybe a little redder than usual." Doctor: "Okay, good to know. We'll definitely want to keep an eye on that. It sounds like there might be a bit of infection or maybe some nerve irritation going on. I'm going to prescribe some antibiotics just to be safe, and maybe something for the pain too. How does that sound?" Patient: "Yeah, that sounds good, Doc. Anything to make this stop hurting so much." Doctor: "We'll do our best to get you feeling better, Wanjiku. And remember, don't hesitate to call if things get worse or if you have any other concerns. We're here for you every step of the way." Patient: "Thanks, Doc. I appreciate it." Doctor: "Of course, Wanjiku. Take care of yourself and that little one, okay? We'll see you back here soon for a check-up."

so: Saaka waxaan la soo kacay xanuun aan caadi ahayn oo daankayga ah, sida anigoo habeenkii oo dhan dhagxaan calaanjinayey. Kadibna, waaba kan xabadkeyga oo aan ciriiri ka dareemayo, sida qof aad ii tuujinaya oo kale. Waxaan isku dayay inaan iska indhatiro, laga yaabee inaan si khaldan u seexday ama wax la mid ah, laakiin tuujintu ayaa ka sii dareysa, iyadoo u sii gudbeysa gacantayda bidix sida xanuun caajis ah. Kaddib, waxaan billaabay inaan dhidido, inkasta oo aanan kuleyl jirin. Oo waxaan dareemay mowjaddan lalabbo ah oo i dhex martay, sida in aan matagi rabo oo kale. Waxaan isku dayay inaan istaago, laakiin waxaan dareemay wareer, sida qolku in uu wareegayo oo kale. Waxaan ku qasbanaaday inaan dib u fadhiisto oo aan neefta qaato. Waxa ay u ekayd in aanan heli karin hawo igu filan, si kasta oo aan si aad ah ugu eefsado. Waxaan isku dayay inaan waco xaaskeyga, laakiin gacmahaygu aad bay u gariirayeen oo xitaa lambarka ma garaaci karin. Halkaa unbaan un iska fadhiyey, anigoo isku dayaya inaan isdejiyo, anigoo rajeynaya inay un idhaafi doonto. Laakin may dhicin. Xanuunkii iyo lalabadii way ka sii darayeen. Waxaan aakhirkii ku guulaystay inaan waco 911, oo halkan ayaan joogaa. Weligeey wax sidan oo kale ah ma dareemin. Waa sida jirkaygu oo ikhiyaameynayo.
en: This morning, I woke up with this incredible ache in my jaw, like I'd been chewing on rocks all night. Then, there was this tightness in my chest, like someone was squeezing me real hard. I tried to brush it off, maybe just slept wrong or something, but the squeezing got worse, radiating down my left arm like a dull ache. Then, I started sweating, even though it wasn't hot. And I felt this wave of nausea wash over me, like I was gonna throw up. I tried to stand up, but I felt dizzy, like the room was spinning. I had to sit back down and catch my breath. It felt like I couldn't get enough air, no matter how deeply I breathed. I tried to call my wife, but my hands were shaking so bad I couldn't even dial the number. I just sat there, trying to calm down, hoping it would pass. But it didn't. The pain and the nausea just kept getting worse. I finally managed to call 911, and here I am. I've never felt anything like this before. It's like my body is betraying me.

so: Dr. Priya Kapoor: Subax wanaagsan, Mudane Aris Thorne. Sidee ayaad ahayd tan iyo qalliinkaagii? Aris Thorne: Ma fiicni, Dhakhtar. Waxaan dareemayay dawakhaad iyo wareer waayadan dambe, gaar ahaan markaan istaago. Mararka qaar waxaan dareemaa xitaa inaan suuxayo. Dikt. Kapoor: Waan ka xummahay inaan taas maqlo. Dawakhaad iyo wareer ayaa noqon kara wax caadi ah qalliin kaddib, laakiin aan sii baarno si aan u fahanno waxa keeni kara kiiskaaga. Ma u sharrixi kartaa dhacdooyinkan si faahfaahsan? Ma waxaay dhacdaa waqtiyo cayiman ama markaad qabato hawlo gaar ah? Aris Thorne: Badanaa waxaay dhacdaa markaan si dhakhso ah uga kaco fadhiga ama jiifka. Waxaan dareemaa dawakhaad degdeg ah, aragtidayda ayaa yara xumaata, waxaana dareemaa daciifnimo. Caadi ahaan waan ka roonaadaa daqiiqad kaddib haddii aan dib u fariisto ama meel qabsado. Diktr. Kapoor: Taasi waxaay u egtahay orthostatic hypotension, oo ah hoos u dhac degdeg ah oo ku yimaada cadaadiska dhiigga markaad taagan tahay. Waxaa keeni kara fuuq-bax, dhibaatooyinka la xiriira daawada, ama si fudud jirka oo la qabsanaya qalliinka kaddib. Ma cabbeysay dareere kugu filan? Aris Thorne: Waan isku dayaa, laakiin laga yaabaa inaysan ahayn intii la rabay. Rabitaankayga cuntada sidoo kale ma fiicnayn. Dikt. Kapoor: Fuuq-baxa ayaa hubaal wuxuu ka mid noqon karaa astaamahan. Waa muhiim in jirkaaga biyo badan qaato, gaar ahaan inta lagu jiro bogsashada. Wax daawooyin ah ma qaadataa hadda? Aris Thorne: Kaliya daawada xanuunka aad ii qortay iyo qaar antibiyootik ah. Dikt. Kapoor: Qaar ka mid ah daawooyinka xanuunka ayaa hoos u dhigi kara dhiig karka, oo laga yaabo in uu yahay waxyaabaha kuu keenaya. Waxaan dib u eegi karnaa liiska daawooyinkaaga oo aan arki karnaa haddii wax isbeddel ah loo baahan yahay. Sidoo kale waxaan eegi doonnaa dhiig karkaaga adigoo jiifa iyo adigoo taagan labaduba si loo xaqiijiyo in uu jiro orthostatic hypotension (dhiig karka madax-wareerka keena) Aris Thorne: Waayahay, taasi waa macquul. Ma jiraan wax kale oo aan sameeyo? Dikt. Kapoor: Ka sokoow inaad jirkaaga biyo siiso, isku day inaad si tartiib ah u istaagto oo jirkaaga siiso waqti uu kula qabsado. Sidoo kale waxaad isku dayi kartaa inaad xirato sharabaado cadaadis si ay uga caawiyaan hagaajinta wareegga dhiigga. Haddii dawakhaadku sii jiro ama ka sii daro, fadlan noo soo sheeg isla markiiba. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaan u baahanno inaan sameyno baaritaanno dhiig si aan meesha uga saarno sababaha kale sida dhiig-yaraan ama dheelitir la'aanta elektrolytka. Aris Thorne: Waad mahadsan tahay, Dhakhtar. Waxaan isku dayi doonaa inaan cabbo biyo badan oo aan taxaddar dheeraad ah yeesho markaan kacayo. Dikt. Kapoor: Adigaa mudan, Mr. Thorne. Bogsashadu waqti ayay qaadataa, waxaana halkan u joognaa inaan ku taageerno. Aan kuu qabanno ballan dabagal ah toddobaad gudihiis si aan u aragno sidaad tahay. Inta ka horreysa, ha ka gabanin inaad nala soo xiriirto haddii aad qabto wax walaac ah.
en: Dr. Priya Kapoor: Good morning, Mr. Aris Thorne. How have you been since your surgery? Aris Thorne: Not the best, Doctor. I've been feeling quite dizzy and lightheaded lately, especially when I stand up. Sometimes I even feel like I'm going to faint. Dr. Kapoor: I'm sorry to hear that. Dizziness and lightheadedness can be common after surgery, but let's investigate further to understand what might be causing it in your case. Could you describe these episodes in more detail? Do they happen at specific times or with certain activities? Aris Thorne: It mostly happens when I stand up quickly from sitting or lying down. I get this rush of dizziness, my vision blurs a bit, and I feel weak. It usually passes after a minute or so if I sit back down or hold onto something. Dr. Kapoor: That sounds like orthostatic hypotension, which is a sudden drop in blood pressure when standing up. It can be caused by dehydration, medication side effects, or simply the body adjusting after surgery. Have you been drinking enough fluids? Aris Thorne: I try to, but maybe not as much as I should. My appetite hasn't been great either. Dr. Kapoor: Dehydration can certainly contribute to these symptoms. It's crucial to stay hydrated, especially during recovery. Are you taking any medications currently? Aris Thorne: Just the pain medication you prescribed and some antibiotics. Dr. Kapoor: Some pain medications can lower blood pressure, which might be a factor. We can review your medication list and see if any adjustments are needed. I'll also check your blood pressure both lying down and standing up to confirm orthostatic hypotension. Aris Thorne: Okay, that makes sense. Is there anything else I should be doing? Dr. Kapoor: Besides staying hydrated, try to stand up slowly and give your body time to adjust. You can also try wearing compression stockings to help improve blood flow. If the dizziness persists or worsens, please let us know immediately. We might need to run some blood tests to rule out other causes like anemia or electrolyte imbalances. Aris Thorne: Thank you, Doctor. I'll try to drink more water and be more careful when getting up. Dr. Kapoor: You're welcome, Mr. Thorne. Recovery takes time, and we're here to support you. Let's schedule a follow-up appointment in a week to see how you're doing. In the meantime, don't hesitate to contact us if you have any concerns.

so: Mrs. Beatrice Finch, oo ah qof dumar oo caato ah oo indhaheeda u eg yihiin guduud sii libdhaya, ayaa taagan miiska farmashiyaha. Laabatooyinkeeda faraha ayaa cad iyadoo sii qabsanaysa geeska miiska, codkeeduna wuu gariirayaa markaay sharraxayso, " Aragaygu wuxuu ka xumaaday dhinacyada, qaali. "Sida in aan god ka eegayo." Farmashiistaha, oo ah gabadh da'yar oo lagu magacaabo Elara oo leh dhoola cadeyn diirran iyo gacmo dabacsan, ayaa si taxadar leh u dhagaysanaysa, sunniyaheedana kor u qaadaysa iyada oo walaacsan. Waxaay waydiineysaa su'aallo xaqiijin ah oo ku saabsan astaamaha ay leedahay Mrs. Finch, taariikhdeeda caafimaad ee dhowaan, iyo dawooyin kale oo laga yaabo inay qaadanayso. Codka Elara waa mid degan oo rajo gelinaya, oo u ah dajin walwalka Mrs. Finch. Waxaay sharraxaysaa in luminta aragtida durugsan ay yeelan karto sababo kala duwan waxayna ku talinaysaa in Mrs. Finch ay u tagto dhakhtar indho si loo helo ogaanshaha saxda ah. Waxay xitaa u soo bandhigaysaa inay ka caawiso Mrs. Finch inay samaysato ballan, iyadoo naxariisteeduna ay u ifaysaa sida nalka hagaha oo kale ku soo dhex muuqanaya ceeryaamo hubanti la'aanta.
en: Mrs. Beatrice Finch, a wisp of a woman with eyes like faded violets, stands at the pharmacy counter. Her knuckles are white as she grips the edge, her voice trembling slightly as she explains, "My vision's gone fuzzy around the edges, dear. Like looking through a tunnel." The pharmacist, a young woman named Elara with a warm smile and gentle hands, listens intently, her brow furrowed in concern. She asks clarifying questions about Mrs. Finch's symptoms, her recent health history, and any other medications she might be taking. Elara's voice is calm and reassuring, a balm to Mrs. Finch's anxiety. She explains that peripheral vision loss can have various causes and recommends that Mrs. Finch see an eye doctor for a proper diagnosis. She even offers to help Mrs. Finch make an appointment, her kindness shining through like a beacon in the fog of uncertainty.

so: Soo dhaweeyaha: Iska warran, sidee tahay. Waxaad u egtahay qof yara dhibban, ma kaa ma wax caawimaad ah ayay u raadineysaa?? Qof Waayeel ah: Haa, iska warran. Waxaan u imid gabadhayda aan ayeeyada u ahay, waxay qabtaa oof wareenka ilmaha dhasha. Anigu... Ma hubo haddii ay tani meeshii saxda ahayd tahay. Soo dhaweeyaha: Meeshi saxda ahayd baad joogtaa. Halkan waxaan ku daweynaa dhammaan cudurrada neefsiga, oo uu ku jiro oof wareenka ilmaha dhasha. Waxaan leennahay dhakhaatiirta carruurta oo gabadha aad ayeyda u tahay caawin kara. Qof Waayeel ah: Waa Alle mahaddii. Aad baan u walaacsanaa. Aad ayay u yar tahay, aad bay na ugu dhibtooneysaa in ay neefsato. Soo dhaweeyaha: Waan fahmay walaacaaga. Oof wareenku waa cabsi, gaar ahaan ilmaha hadda dhashay. Laakiin fadlan ogow inaan leennahay koox dhakhaatiir iyo kalkaaliyeyaal khibrad leh kuwaas oo u heellan inay bixiyaan daryeelka ugu wanaagsan ee suurtogalka ah ee ku habboon gabadha ayeyda u tahay. Qof Waayeel ah: Taasi waa mid dhiirigelin leh. Mahadsanid. Ma kula tahay... ma kula tahay inay fiicnaan doonto? Soo dhaweeyaha: Inkastoo aanan ballan qaadi karin, waxaan kuu sheegi karaa in badi dhallaanka qaba oof wareenka ilmaha dhasha ay si buuxda u bogsadaan marka daaweyn habboon la siiyo. Shaqaalaheenna waxaay sameyn doonaan wax walba oo ay awoodaan si ay uga caawiyaan inay fiicnaato. Qof Waayeel ah: Mahadsanid. Aad baad u mahadsan tahay. Hadda xoogaa deganaan ayaan dareemayaa.. Soo dhaweeyaha: Adigaa mudan. Fadlan fariiso. Qof ayaa dhowaan kuu imaan doona si loo diiwaangeliyo gabadha ayeyda u tahay. Qof Waayeel ah: Mahadsanid.
en: Receptionist: Hello there. You look a little uncomfortable, can I help you find something? Elderly Person: Yes, hello. I'm here for my granddaughter, she has neonatal pneumonia. I'm... I'm not sure if this is the right place. Receptionist: You're in the right place. We treat all kinds of respiratory illnesses here, including neonatal pneumonia. We have pediatric specialists who can help your granddaughter. Elderly Person: Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried. She's so small, and she's having such a hard time breathing. Receptionist: I understand your concern. Pneumonia can be scary, especially in newborns. But please know that we have a team of experienced doctors and nurses who are dedicated to providing the best possible care for your granddaughter. Elderly Person: That's very reassuring. Thank you. Do you think... do you think she'll be okay? Receptionist: While I can't make any promises, I can tell you that most babies with neonatal pneumonia recover fully with proper treatment. Our team will do everything they can to help her get better. Elderly Person: Thank you. Thank you so much. I feel a little better now. Receptionist: You're welcome. Please have a seat, and someone will be with you shortly to get your granddaughter checked in. Elderly Person: Thank you.

so: Paulo Gomes: Subax wanaagsan, ku soo dhawaada rugta caafimaad oo bilaashka ah. Waa Dikt. Gomes. Maxaan maanta kaa caawin karaa? Sofia Martins: Sidee tahay, Dikt. Gomes. Anigu waxaan ahay Sofia Martins. Waayadan waxaa i haayey laab xanuun iyo neef yari. Paulo Gomes: Waan ka xummahay inaan taas maqlo, Sofia. Aad ayaan ugu dedaali doonnaa in aan ogaanno waxa ku haya. Marka hore, aan ku baro inta kale ee kooxdeenna. Tani waa Kalkaalisada San, kani waa shaqaalaheenna bulshada, Mudane Pratama. Sofia Martins: Waan ku faraxsanahay inaan kulanno labadiinnaba. San: Haa, Sofia. Baaritaanno jirka ayaan kugu sameyn doonaa, waxaana ku weydiin doonaa su'aallo ku saabsan taariikhdaada caafimaad. Mr. Pratama: Waxaan halkan u joogaa inaan kaa caawiyo wixii walaac bulsho ama dhaqaale ee aad qabtid oo saameyn ku yeelan kara caafimaadkaaga. Paulo Gomes: Hagaag. Marka, Sofia, waxyar oo dheeri ah ma nooga sheegi kartaa xanuunkaaga laabta? Goorma ayuu lbilaabmay? Ma jiraa wax u roon ama sii kordhinaya xanuunka? Sofia Martins: Waxa uu bilaabmay dhowr toddobaad ka hor. Badanaa waxaan dareemaa marka uu jirkeyga shaqeynayo, sida marka aan jaranjarada fuulayo ama qaado raashinka. Nasashada ayaa xoogaa i yar caawisa. Paulo Gomes: Hagaag, taasi waa xog muhiim ah. San, fadlan ma cabbiri kartaa heerka dhiig karka Sofia oo ma dhegaysan kartaa wadnihiisa iyo sambabada? San: Haa, aad iyo aad, Dikt.. Gomes. Mr. Pratama: Inta uu San taas samaynayo, Sofia, ma qabtaa wax walaac ah oo ku saabsan bixinta daawada ama ballamaha dabagalka? Sofia Martins: Si daacad ah hadaan u hadlo, kharashka ayaa hadda nagu yar. Caymis ma lihi. Mr. Pratama: Ha werwerin, Sofia. Waanu kaa caawin karnaa inaad codsato barnaamijyada kaalmada maaliyadeed, waxaanan kugu xidhi karnaa ilaha daawaynta ee la awoodi karo. Paulo Gomes: Taasi waa mid aad u fiican, Mr. Pratama. Sofia, iyadoo lagu saleynayo calaamadahaaga iyo baaritaanka ay qaadeyso San, waxaan ila tahay inaan sameyno baaritaanno si aan u hubinno shaqada wadnahaaga. Waxaan EKG ku samayn karnaa halkan rugta caafimaadka. Sofia Martins: Hagaag, taasi waxaay u egtahay mid wanaagsan. Paulo Gomes: Marka aan helno natiijooyinka, waxaan ka wada hadli karnaa qorshaha daaweynta. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay ku lug yeelato dawo, isbeddel qaab nololeed, ama u gudbinta khibradle caafimaad. Sofia Martins: Waad mahadsan tihiin dhammaantiin. Runtii waan idiin kaga mahadcelinayaa kaalmadiina. Paulo Gomes: Soo dhowoow, Sofia. Waxaan halkaan u joognaa inaan u wada shaqeyno koox ahaan si aan u horumarinno caafimaadkaaga.
en: Paulo Gomes: Good morning, welcome to the free clinic. I'm Dr. Gomes. How can we help you today? Sofia Martins: Hi, Dr. Gomes. I'm Sofia Martins. I've been having some chest pain and shortness of breath lately. Paulo Gomes: I'm sorry to hear that, Sofia. We'll do our best to figure out what's going on. First, let me introduce you to the rest of our team. This is Nurse San, and this is our social worker, Mr. Pratama. Sofia Martins: Nice to meet you both. San: Hi, Sofia. I'll be taking your vitals and asking you some questions about your medical history. Mr. Pratama: And I'm here to help with any social or financial concerns you might have that could affect your health. Paulo Gomes: Great. So, Sofia, can you tell us a little more about your chest pain? When did it start? Does anything make it better or worse? Sofia Martins: It started a few weeks ago. It usually happens when I'm active, like walking up stairs or carrying groceries. Resting seems to help a bit. Paulo Gomes: Okay, that's helpful information. San, can you please take Sofia's blood pressure and listen to his heart and lungs? San: Sure thing, Dr. Gomes. Mr. Pratama: While San is doing that, Sofia, do you have any concerns about paying for medication or follow-up appointments? Sofia Martins: To be honest, money is tight right now. I don't have insurance. Mr. Pratama: Don't worry, Sofia. We can help you apply for financial assistance programs and connect you with resources for affordable medication. Paulo Gomes: That's excellent, Mr. Pratama. Sofia, based on your symptoms and San's examination, I think we should run some tests to check your heart function. We can do an EKG right here in the clinic. Sofia Martins: Okay, that sounds good. Paulo Gomes: Once we have the results, we can discuss a treatment plan. It might involve medication, lifestyle changes, or a referral to a specialist. Sofia Martins: Thank you, everyone. I really appreciate your help. Paulo Gomes: You're welcome, Sofia. We're here to work together as a team to improve your health.

so: Magacaygu waa Elias Thorne, waxaana jiraa 43 sano. Waxaa la igu sammeeyay qalliinka xanuunka loo yaqaano 'pilonidal cyst' shan maalmood ka hor, maalintii Talaadada ahayd. Aagga qaliinka lagu sameeyey ayaa la duubay, waxaana beddelayay faashadda maalin kasta sida la i faray. Maanta, hase yeeshee, waxaan dareemay casaan ku sii kordhaya agagaarka meesha la jeexay, kaas oo ku fiday ilaa laba inji oo dibadda ah. Waxaan dareemayaa kulayl marka la taabto waana mid aad u xanuun badan, dareen garaacid ah halkii aan ka dareemayay xanuunkii aan hore u qabay. Waxa kale oo aan ku arkayaa dheecaan huruud ah faashadda dhexdeeda, kuwaa oo aan shalay jirin. Ma aanan cabbirin heer-kulkayga, laakiin waxaan dareemayaa qandho yar iyo qarqaryo. Waxaan ka walwalsanahay caabuq, waxaana rabaa inaan ogaado inaan aadi karo qolka gargaarka degdegga ah ama aan sugo ilaa Isniinta si aan u arko dhakhtarkayga qaliinka.
en: My name is Elias Thorne, and I'm 43 years old. I had a pilonidal cyst surgery five days ago, on Tuesday. The area was packed, and I've been changing the dressing daily as instructed. Today, however, I've noticed increasing redness around the incision site, extending about two inches outwards. It feels warm to the touch and is becoming more painful, a throbbing sensation rather than the soreness I had before. I also see some yellowish discharge on the dressing, which wasn't there yesterday. I haven't taken my temperature, but I feel a bit feverish and chilled. I'm worried about infection and wanted to know if I should go to the emergency room or wait until Monday to see my surgeon.

so: Sidee tahay, dhakhtar. Sababta aan ku soo wacayo ayaa ah in aan dareemay xanuun caloosha ah oo aad u daran, waxaana ka walwalayaa inay la xiriirto kelyahayga. Waxaay u egtahay xanuun khafiif ah, laakiin mararka qaarkood wuu sii kordhaa oo wuxuu u gudbaa dhabarkayga. Sidoo kale waxaan dareemayey lallabbo badan, cunnada sidaa uma xiiseyneyn waayadan dambe. Waxaan arkay in kaadidaydu u muuqato midab madow oo aan caadi ahayn, ku dhawaad sida shaaha, waxaana dareemayey daal mar kasta. Tani ma noqon kartaa calaamad muujineysa wax halis ah oo kelyahayga ku saabsan? Runtii aad ayaan u baqayaa.
en: Hi, doctor. I'm calling because I've been having some really bad stomach pain, and I'm worried it might be related to my kidneys. It feels like a dull ache, but sometimes it gets sharp and spreads to my back. I've also been feeling really nauseous and haven't had much of an appetite lately. I've noticed my urine looks darker than usual, almost like tea, and I've been feeling tired all the time. Could this be a sign of something serious with my kidneys? I'm really scared.

so: Warqaddan adiga ayaa laguugu talagalay, Ms. Elara Vance. Waan ku faraxsanahay inaad noo ogolaatay inaan guriga kugu soo booqanno. Waan ognahay inaad la il-darantahay xanuun dhabarka, feeraha, iyo sinta ah. Waxaan rabnaa inaan kaa caawino inaad fiicnaato. Waa muhiim inaad daacad noo ahaato oo aad si furan noogala hadashid astaamahaaga iyo sidaad dareemaysid. Kuma caawin karno haddaan ogaan waxa socda. Mararka qaar dadku waxaay dareemaan ineysan rabin iney na dhibaan, ama waxay ka welwelaan waxaan ogaan karno. Laakiin fadlan ogow inaan halkaan u joogno inaan ku caawinno, oo aan rabno inaan hubinno inaad heshid daryeelka aad u baahantahay. Xanuunka lafaha sida kan aad la kulmayso waxaa sababi kara dhowr waxyaabood, oo ay ku jiraan: Osteoporosis: Tani waa xaalad ay lafahaagu noqdaan kuwo daciif ah oo jilicsan. Waxay ku badan tahay dadka waaweyn, gaar ahaan haweenka. Arthritis: Tani waa caabuq ku dhaca kala-goysyada. Waxay keeni kartaa xanuun, qallafsanaan, iyo barar. Jab: Lafaha jabay waxay keeni karaan xanuun daran. Xaalado caafimaad oo kale: Xaaladaha caafimaad qaarkood ayaa sidoo kale keeni kara xanuun lafaha. Waxaan u baahan doonnaa inaan sameyno baaritaanno si aan u ogaanno waxa sababaya xanuunkaaga. Tani waxaa ku jiri kara raajooyin, baaritaan dhiig, ama baaritaanno kale oo ku saabsan raajo. Markaan ogaanno waxa socda, waxaan diyaarin karnaa qorshe daaweyn oo adiga kugu habboon. Hadda se, waxaa jira waxyaabo aad sameyn kartid si aad u maareyso xanuunkaaga: Nasasho: Hel nasasho kugu filan, gaar ahaan markaad xanuun dareemaysid. Baraf ama kulayl: Inaad baraf ama kulayl saartid aagga xanuunka leh waxaay kaa caawin kartaa yareynta bararka iyo xanuunka. Xanuun baabi'iyayaal aan dhakhtar qorin: Qaadashada xanuun baabi'iyayaal aan dhakhtar qorin sida acetaminophen ama ibuprofen ayaa kaa caawin kara yareynta xanuunka. Hase yeeshee, waa muhiim inaad la hadashid dhakhtarkaaga kahor intaadan qaadan wax dawo ah. Jimicsi fudud: Jimicsi fudud, sida socodka ama dabaasha, ayaa kaa caawin kara in kala-goysyadaadu dhaqaaqaan oo xanuunka yareeyaan. Fadlan ha ka gabanin inaad na weydiiso wixii su'aallo ah oo aad qabtid. Waxaan halkan u joognaa inaan ku taageerno.
en: This handout is for you, Ms. Elara Vance. We're glad you're letting us check in on you at home. We know you've been having some pain in your back, ribs, and hips. We want to help you feel better. It's important to be open and honest with us about your symptoms and how you're feeling. We can't help you if we don't know what's going on. Sometimes people feel like they don't want to bother us, or they're worried about what we might find. But please know that we're here to help you, and we want to make sure you get the care you need. Bone pain like you're experiencing can be caused by a number of things, including: Osteoporosis: This is a condition where your bones become weak and brittle. It's common in older adults, especially women. Arthritis: This is inflammation of the joints. It can cause pain, stiffness, and swelling. Fractures: Broken bones can cause severe pain. Other medical conditions: Some medical conditions can also cause bone pain. We'll need to do some tests to figure out what's causing your pain. This might include X-rays, blood tests, or other imaging tests. Once we know what's going on, we can develop a treatment plan that's right for you. In the meantime, there are some things you can do to help manage your pain: Rest: Get plenty of rest, especially when you're in pain. Ice or heat: Applying ice or heat to the painful area can help reduce inflammation and pain. Over-the-counter pain relievers: Taking over-the-counter pain relievers like acetaminophen or ibuprofen can help reduce pain. However, it is important to talk to your doctor before taking any medication. Gentle exercise: Gentle exercise, such as walking or swimming, can help keep your joints moving and reduce pain. Please don't hesitate to ask us any questions you have. We're here to support you.

so: Markii ugu horreysay ee aan maqlay bukaanka hiinraagaya ee rugta caafimaadka oo laga daweynayo PTSD, waan la yara yaabay. PTSD badanaa waxaay ku lug leedahay arrimaha caafimaadka dhimirka, ma aha astaamaha jireed sida hiinraag. Marka, waxaan la yaabay waxa keeni kara dhibaatooyinka neefsashadeeda. Ma waxaay la xiriirtay PTSD-geeda, mise waxaay ahayd wax gebi ahaanba ka duwan? Waxaan ka codsaday rugta daryeelka degdegga ah macluumaad dheeri ah, sida haddii ay taariikh u leedahay neef ama xasaasiyad. Waxaay ii sheegeen in magaceedu yahay Elara Sterling oo aysan lahayn wax taariikh ah oo ku saabsan arrimaha neefsashada. Tani waxaay igu sii dhalisay su'aallo badan. Hiinraageedu miyuu noqon karaa falcelin jireed oo ka dhan ah walbahaarka ama murugada la xiriira PTSD-geeda? Waxaan go'aansaday inaan sammeeyo baaritaan. Waxaa soo baxday in mararka qaarkood walbahaarka xad dhaafka ah uu sababi karo astaamo jireed sida neefta oo ku yaraata ama hiinraag, gaar ahaan xilliga weerarada argagaxa. Laakin hiinraagta Elara waxaay u muuqatay inay ka sii adkaysi badan tahay intii lagu jiray weerarrada argagaxa. Markaa, waxaan u malaynayey inay laga yaabo in ay xasaasiyad ka qaadday rugta caafimaadka, ama laga yaabaa inay yeelatay neef iyada oo aan dareemin. Waxaan u soo jeediyay dhakhtarka daryeelka degdega ah, Dr. Orion Thorne, inuu hubiyo xasaasiyadda ama kiciyeyaasha neefta. Dr. Thorne wuu ogolaaday wuxuuna go'aansaday inuu sammeeyo baaritaanno. Inta aan sugayey natiijada, waxaan sidoo kale tixgeliyey haddii wax daawooyin ah oo ay u qaadaneysay PTSD ay keeni karaan waxyeellooyin sida hiinraag. Daawooyinka qaarkood waxaay yeelan karaan waxyeellooyin xagga neefsashada ah, in kasta oo ay naadir tahay. Markii ay soo baxeen natiijada baaritaanka, waxaay muujiyeen in Elara ay ku dhacday neefta dadka waaweyn, oo laga yaabo inay kicisay walbahaarka. Waxaay ahayd natiijo la yaab leh, laakiin waxaay sharraxday hiinraagteeda. Dr. Thorne waxa uu u qoray daawada neefsashada waxaana uu ku taliyay farsamooyinka maareynta walbahaarka oo ay barbar socdaan daaweynta PTSD. Ugu dambayntii, waxa ay ahayd xasuusin in caafimaadka maskaxda iyo jidhku ay si dhow isugu xiran yihiin, mararka qaarkoodna calaamadaha meel ka mid ah ay siyaabo lama filaan ah ugu muuqan karaan meel kale. Kiiska Elara waxa uu iftiimiyay muhiimadda ay leedahay qiimeyn dhamaystiran iyo in la tixgeliyo dhammaan waxyaabaha dhici kara marka la ogaanayo bukaannada qaba xaaladaha adag sida PTSD.
en: When I first heard about the wheezing patient at the clinic being treated for PTSD, I was a bit puzzled. PTSD usually involves mental health issues, not physical symptoms like wheezing. So, I wondered what might be causing her breathing problems. Was it related to her PTSD, or was it something completely different? I asked the urgent care clinic for more information, like if she had a history of asthma or allergies. They told me her name was Elara Sterling and she had no history of respiratory issues. This made me even more curious. Could her wheezing be a physical reaction to stress or anxiety related to her PTSD? I decided to do some research. It turns out that sometimes, extreme stress can cause physical symptoms like shortness of breath or wheezing, especially during panic attacks. But Elara's wheezing seemed to be more persistent than just during panic attacks. So, I thought maybe she was having an allergic reaction to something at the clinic, or perhaps she had developed asthma without realizing it. I suggested to the urgent care doctor, Dr. Orion Thorne, to check for allergies or asthma triggers. Dr. Thorne agreed and decided to run some tests. While waiting for the results, I also considered if any medications she was taking for PTSD could be causing side effects like wheezing. Some medications can have respiratory side effects, although it's rare. When the test results came back, they showed that Elara had developed adult-onset asthma, possibly triggered by stress. It was a surprising finding, but it explained her wheezing. Dr. Thorne prescribed her an inhaler and recommended stress management techniques alongside her PTSD treatment. In the end, it was a reminder that mental and physical health are closely connected, and sometimes symptoms in one area can manifest in unexpected ways in another. Elara's case highlighted the importance of thorough evaluation and considering all possibilities when diagnosing patients with complex conditions like PTSD.

so: Halkan waxaa ah wadahadal suurtogal tahay in uu faa'iiddo iyo sharraxaad leeyaha oo loogu talagalay bukaan da'da dhexe ah oo booqanaya xarun caafimaad oo bilaash ah oo bulshada ah oo loogu talagalay macluumaadka daryeelka caafimaadka: Soo dhaweeyahay bukaanka: Subax wanaagsan, Mr. Tshibangu. Ku soo dhawoow rugta caafimaadka bilaashka ah ee bulshada. Sideen kuu caawin karaa maanta? Mr. Tshibangu: Waad salaaman tahay, waxaan u imid baaritaankeyga sannadlaha ah. Waxaan sidoo kale qabaa su'aallo ku saabsan diiwaannada caafimaadkeyga. Soo dhaweeyaha bukaanka: Hubaal. Aan ku diiwaan geliyo. Xaruntaan horay ma u timid? Mr. Tshibangu: Haa, sannadkii hore ayaan u imid tallaalka hergabka. Qaabilaha: Hagaag, aadoo weyn. Aan soo saaro faylkaaga. Waxaan halkan ku arkayaa in aad leedahay taariikh dhiig karka. Sideed taas ula tacaaleysay? Mr. Tshibangu: Waxaan qaadanayey daawadeyda, laakiin ma hubo inay shaqeyneyso. Waxaan sidoo kale rabay in aan wax kaa weydiiyo helitaanka natiijooyinka shaybaarkayga oo onlayn ah. Soo dhaweeyahay bukaanka: Taasi waa su'aal aad u fiican. Waxaan leennahay websayt bukaanka kaas oo kuu ogolaanaya in aad aragto natiijooyinkaaga baaritaanka, ballan qabsato, oo aad xitaa farriin u dirto dhakhtarkaaga. Ma jeceshahay inaan kaa caawiyo furashada akoon? Mr. Tshibangu: Haa, fadlan. Taasi waa mid aad waxtar iigu leh. Soo dhaweeyaha bukaanka: Hagaag, aan billowno. Marka hore, waxaan u baahannahay inaad xaqiijiso cinwaankaaga iimaylka. Mr. Tshibangu: Hubaal. Soo dhaweeyaha bukaanka: Si wanaagsan. Waxaan kuu soo diray link-ga aad ku furan lahayd cinwaanka. Markaad gujiso, waxaad awoodi doontaa inaad sameysato furo sireed, kaddibna aad gasho. Mr. Tshibangu: Mahadsanid. Hadda aan ka hadalno dhiig karkeyga... Soo dhaweeyahay bukaanka: Waxaan kuu qaban karaa ballan aad ku aragto Dikt. Tesfay. Waxaay ku takhasustay maareynta dhiig karka. Mr. Tshibangu: Taasi waa arrin aad u fiican. Goormay la helayaa? Soo dhaweeyahay bukaanka: Waxaay fursad leedahay berri subax saacadu markay tahay 10:00-ka subaxnimo. Taasi ma kuu shaqaynaysaa? Mr. Tshibangu: Haa, waa waqti aad iigu habboon. Soo dhaweeyaha bukaanka: Hagaag, wax walbo waa diyaar. Ma jiraan wax kale oo aan kaa caawin karo maanta? Mr. Tshibangu: Maya, waa un intaa. Waad ku mahadsan tahay caawinaadaada. Soo dhaweeyahay bukaanka: Soo dhawoow, Mr. Tshibangu. Maalin wanaagsan ayaan ku rajeynayaa.
en: Here is a possible educational and illustrative dialogue for a middle-aged patient visiting a community free clinic for healthcare informatics: Receptionist: Good morning, Mr. Tshibangu. Welcome to the community free clinic. How can I help you today? Mr. Tshibangu: Hi, I'm here for my annual checkup. I also have some questions about my health records. Receptionist: Certainly. Let me get you checked in. Have you been here before? Mr. Tshibangu: Yes, I came last year for a flu shot. Receptionist: Okay, great. Let me pull up your file. I see here that you have a history of high blood pressure. How have you been managing that? Mr. Tshibangu: I've been taking my medication, but I'm not sure if it's working. I also wanted to ask about accessing my lab results online. Receptionist: That's a great question. We have a patient portal that allows you to view your test results, schedule appointments, and even message your doctor. Would you like me to help you set up an account? Mr. Tshibangu: Yes, please. That would be very helpful. Receptionist: Okay, let's get started. First, I'll need you to verify your email address. Mr. Tshibangu: Sure. Receptionist: Perfect. I've sent you an activation link. Once you click on it, you'll be able to create a password and log in. Mr. Tshibangu: Thank you. Now, about my blood pressure... Receptionist: I can schedule an appointment for you to see Dr. Tesfay. She specializes in hypertension management. Mr. Tshibangu: That would be great. When is she available? Receptionist: She has an opening tomorrow morning at 10:00 am. Does that work for you? Mr. Tshibangu: Yes, that's perfect. Receptionist: Okay, you're all set. Is there anything else I can help you with today? Mr. Tshibangu: No, that's all. Thank you for your help. Receptionist: You're welcome, Mr. Tshibangu. Have a good day.

so: Dikt. Anya Petrova: Subax wanaagsan, Mudane Thaddeus Finch. Waxaan ahay Dr. Petrova, waxaanan kuu noqon doonaa dhakhtarkaaga qalliinka ee fundoplication (qalliinka gaaska caloosha). Waxaan fahamsanahay inaad dhib kala kulantay cunnada laabjeex iyo dib u soo celin, sax? Mr. Finch: (xiiqsan) Haa, dhakhtar. Aad ayay u xumayd. Ma seexan karo, waxba ma cuni karo iyada oo aan dareemin in dab laabta iga soo kacayo. Dikt. Petrova: Waan arkaa. Oo waxaad isku dayday daawooyin iyo isbedel qaab nololeed weli na aadan helin nafis badan? Mr. Finch: Dhammaantood waan isku dayay, dhakhtar. Wax shaqaynaya ma jiraan. Xitaa miisaankeyga aan dhimay wax weyn igama caawin. Dikt. Petrova: Hagaag, Mudane Finch, qalliinka Nissen fundoplication waa hab aad wax ku ool u ah daaweynta GERD (gaaska daran ee caloosha). Waxaan asal ahaan ku duuduubi doonaa qaybta sare ee calooshaada agagaarka hunguriga hoose si aan u xoojinno waalka oo aan uga hortagno in ay aashitada dib u soo noqoto. Mr. Finch: Waxaay u egtahay mid cakiran. Qallinka ma yahay mid aan dhib ka soo gaareyn dadka da'da weyn sideyda oo kale? Dr. Petrova: Waa qalliin weyn, Mudane Finch, laakiin waxaan qaadi doonnaa taxaddar kasta. Miisaankaaga iyo da'daadu wax yar ayay kordhinayaan khatarta, laakiin si dhow ayaan kuula socon doonnaa inta uu socdo qalliinka iyo soo kabashada. Mr. Finch: Hagaag, dhakhtar. Waxaan doonayaa in aad mar un iga saarto gubashadan, fadlan. Dr. Petrova: Waan dedaali doonnaa inta karaankeenna, Mr. Finch. Aan hadda kuu diyaarinno qalliinka.
en: Dr. Anya Petrova: Good morning, Mr. Thaddeus Finch. I'm Dr. Petrova, and I'll be your surgeon for the fundoplication. I understand you've been having some trouble with heartburn and regurgitation? Mr. Finch: (wheezing) Yes, doctor. It's been dreadful. Can't sleep, can't eat anything without feeling like fire's rising up my chest. Dr. Petrova: I see. And you've tried medications and lifestyle changes without much relief? Mr. Finch: Tried 'em all, doc. Nothing works. Even losing a few pounds didn't seem to help much. Dr. Petrova: Well, Mr. Finch, the Nissen fundoplication is a very effective procedure for treating GERD. We'll essentially wrap the top part of your stomach around the lower esophagus to strengthen the valve and prevent acid from flowing back up. Mr. Finch: Sounds complicated. Is it safe for an old fellow like me? Dr. Petrova: It is a major surgery, Mr. Finch, but we'll take every precaution. Your weight and age do increase the risks slightly, but we'll monitor you closely throughout the procedure and recovery. Mr. Finch: Alright, doc. I trust you. Just get rid of this burning, please. Dr. Petrova: We'll do our best, Mr. Finch. Now, let's get you prepped for surgery.

so: Waxbaridda Bukaanka: Laab Ciriiriga Qaliin Kadib Laab ciriiri ah waa dareen caadi ah qaliinka kaddib. Waxaa sababi kara dhowr arrimood, oo ay kamid yihiin: Xanuun jeexitaan: Jeexitaanka qalliinka laftiisa ayaa aagga xabadka. ku keeni kara xanuun iyo raaxo la'aan. Murqo xanuun: Murqaha xabadka ayaa laga yaabaa in ay xanuun ku dareemaan fidsanaanta ama marka lala falgalo inta lagu jiro qaliinka. Gaas: Gaas ku xayiran caloosha ama godka xabadka ayaa sababi kara cadaadis iyo raaxo la'aan. Murugo: Walbahaarka iyo Murugada ayaa gacan ka geysan kara laab ciriiriga. Maareynta Laab Ciriiriga: Daawada xanuun baab'iyaha: Qaado daawada xanuunka sida uu dakhtarkaagu kuugu qoray. Sammeynta neefsashada qoto dheer: Ku celcelinta jimicsiga neefsashada qoto dheer si ay kaaga caawiso ballaarinta sambabadaada iyo yaraynta xiisadda xanuunka. Dhaqdhaqaaqa: Dhaqdhaqaaq tartiib tartiib ah iyo socodka ayaa kaa caawin kara ka hortagga qallafsanaanta iyo kor u qaadidda wareegga dhiigga. Nasasho: Hel nasasho badan si aad ugu ogolaato jirkaaga inuu bogsado. Farsamooyinka nasashada: Isku day farsamooyinka nasashada sida xalqeynta kalinnimada ama sawirka la hago si loo yareeyo welwelka. Goorta Ay Tahay In La Waco Dhakhtarkaaga: Isla markiiba wac dhakhtarkaaga haddii aad isku aragto: Xabad xanuun daran oo aan daawada kaa yareyneyn Neefsashada oo ku dhibta Qandho ama qarqaryo Casaan, barar, ama dheecaan ku yimaada goobta la jeexay Macluumaadka Nagala Soo Xiriirayo: Dikt. Olumide Adeyemi
en: Patient Education: Chest Tightness After Surgery Chest tightness is a common sensation after surgery. It can be caused by several factors, including: Incision pain: The surgical incision itself can cause pain and discomfort in the chest area. Muscle soreness: The muscles in the chest may be sore from being stretched or manipulated during surgery. Gas: Gas trapped in the abdomen or chest cavity can cause pressure and discomfort. Anxiety: Stress and anxiety can contribute to chest tightness. Managing Chest Tightness: Pain medication: Take pain medication as prescribed by your doctor. Deep breathing exercises: Practice deep breathing exercises to help expand your lungs and relieve tension. Movement: Gentle movement and walking can help prevent stiffness and promote circulation. Rest: Get plenty of rest to allow your body to heal. Relaxation techniques: Try relaxation techniques such as meditation or guided imagery to reduce anxiety. When to Call Your Doctor: Call your doctor immediately if you experience: Severe chest pain that is not relieved by medication Shortness of breath Fever or chills Redness, swelling, or drainage from your incision Contact Information: Dr. Olumide Adeyemi

so: Waxaan qadka taleefanka igula jira Mthokozisi Dube, oo ah 17-jir nin ah, kaas oo la kulmay kaadi joogto ah maalmihii la soo dhaafay. Wuu ka walwalsan yahay sababtoo ah wuxuu sidoo kale dareemayaa xoogaa raaxo darro ah, sida dareen gubasho ah marka uu kaadinayo. Waxa uu sheegay in uu qabin wax qandho ah ama dhabar xanuun ah, balse waxa hubaal ah in uu ka walaacsan yahay astaamahan cusub. Waxa uu sheegay in uu dhawaan galmo la sammeeyay lammaane cusub, inkastoo uu isticmaalay ka hortag, haddana waxa uu ka walaacsan yahay suurtagalnimada caabuq. Waxa kale oo uu xusay in uu cabbayey biyo badan dhawaanahan, isaga oo isku dayaya in uu jirkiisa waraabiyo maaddaama uu ciaarayaha ciyaaro. laakiin soo noqnoqshadan ayaa u muuqato mid xad dhaaf ah xitaa jir warabintan kaddib. Sida kale waa nin caafimaad qabaa mana laha taariikh caafimaad darro oo u baahan in la tixgeliyo. Waxaan kula taliyay inuu la socdo heerkulkiisa oo uu noo yimaado haddii astaamaha ay ka sii daraan ama haddii uu qandho isku arko, laakiin hadda, wuxuu raadinayaa xoogaa niyad-dhis iyo hagitaan ku saabsan waxa la xiga ee uu sammeyn karo. Wuxuu u muuqday nin ku nafisay inuu qof la hadlo, laakiin hubaal weli wax yar baa ka dhimman.
en: I have Mthokozisi Dube on the line, a 17-year-old male who's been experiencing frequent urination for the past couple of days. He's anxious about it because he's also noticing some discomfort, like a burning sensation when he goes. He says he hasn't had any fever or back pain, but he's definitely worried about these new symptoms. He mentioned being sexually active recently with a new partner, and although he used protection, he's concerned about the possibility of an infection. He also mentioned he's been drinking more water lately, trying to stay hydrated for his sports practice, but the frequency seems excessive even with that. He's otherwise healthy with no significant medical history. I've advised him to monitor his temperature and to come in if his symptoms worsen or if he develops a fever, but for now, he's just looking for some reassurance and guidance on what to do next. He seemed relieved to talk to someone, but definitely still a bit on edge.

so: Halkan ayaan fadhiyaa, qolkan yar ee xasilloon, anigoo isku dayaya inaan fahmo waxa igu dhacaya beryahan dambe. Dhakhtarka, Dr. Aravind Venkat, waa nin naxariis badan, laakiin waxaan walaaca ka arki karaa indhihiisa. Wuxuu i weydiinayaa neefsashadayda, cunahayga... waa sida in buro ku dheggan tahay halkaa, ma garatay? Sida in aanan hawo igu filan heli karin. Waxaay billaabatay kaddib shilkii goobta dhismaha, markii birtaas soo dhacday... wax badan ma xasuusto, kaliya inaan isbitaalka ka soo toosay, anigoo dareemaya sidii gaari xamuul igu dhacay. Codkeyga... waa xabeeb, daciif ah. Mararka qaarkood wuu go'aa gabi ahaanba. Liqitaanku na... waa sida cunto xoog loogu riixayo tuubo yar. Way xanuunaysaa, aadna waan u qufacaa, gaar ahaan markaan wax cunayo ama cabbayo. Dr. Venkat wuxuu ka hadlayaa tracheostomy, tuubo dhuunta la iga gelinayo si ay iiga caawiso neefsashada. Waa wax cabsi leh in la sheego, laakiin... waxaa laga yaabaa inay caawiso in aan sheego? Kaliya waxaan rabaa inaan dareemo sidii aan ahaan jiray, oo aanan la dhibtoon neef kasta. Wuxuu sharraxayaa qalliinka, khataraha... waxaan isku dayayaa inaan dhageysto, laakiin maskaxdaydu waxaay dib ugu noqoneysaa shilkii, cabsida, xanuunka. Waan cabsanayaa. Ka cabsanayaa qalliinka, ka cabsanayaa waxa imaan doona ee xiga. Laakiin sidoo kale waan rajo qabaa. Rajo ah in tani noqon doonto tallaabada ugu horreysa ee soo kabashada, oo aan mar kale ku gaarayo neefasasho aan ku dhibtoon. Kaliya waxaan rabaa inaan guriga tago, arko qoyskeyga, oo aanan dareemin culeys mar dambe. Waxaa laga yaabaa in tracheostomy-gan yahay xalka. Laga yaabaa.
en: I'm sitting here, in this small, quiet room, trying to make sense of what's been happening to me lately. The doctor, Dr. Aravind Venkat, he's kind, but I can see the concern in his eyes. He's asking me about my breathing, my throat... it feels like a lump is stuck there, you know? Like I can't quite get enough air in. It started after that accident at the construction site, when that beam fell... I don't remember much, just waking up in the hospital, feeling like I'd been hit by a truck. My voice... it's raspy, weak. Sometimes it just gives out completely. And swallowing... it's like trying to force food down a narrow pipe. It hurts, and I cough a lot, especially when I eat or drink. Dr. Venkat is talking about a tracheostomy, a tube in my throat to help me breathe. It sounds scary, but... maybe it'll help? I just want to feel like myself again, not like I'm struggling for every breath. He's explaining the procedure, the risks... I'm trying to listen, but my mind keeps drifting back to the accident, the fear, the pain. I'm scared. Scared of the surgery, scared of what comes after. But I'm also hopeful. Hopeful that this will be the first step towards getting better, towards breathing easy again. I just want to go home, to see my family, to not feel like a burden anymore. Maybe this tracheostomy is the answer. Maybe.

so: Wakiilka: Halloow, kan waa Michel oo kaa soo wacaya xafiiska Dikt. Kinyanjui. Ma la hadli karaa Mr. Mado Mulumba? Bukaanka: Haa, waxaan ahay Mado. Wakiilka: Haye Mado, waxaan ku soo wacayaa wax ku saabsan natiijada baaritaannadii shaybaarka ee dhaawaca gubashadaada. Diyaar ma u tahay inaad hadda ka hadasho natiijooyinkan? Bukaanka: Haa, waan ahay. Wakiilka: Hagaag. Dhaqanka dhaawaca gubashada ee gacantaada bidix ayaa muujiyay jiritaanka Staphylococcus aureus. Kani waa nooc bakteeriya ah oo sababi kara caabuq. Iyadoo lagu saleynayo tijaabada dareenka, bakteeriyada waxaay u nugushahay cephalexin. Bukaanka: Hagaag, maxaay taasi uga dhigan tahay daaweyntayda? Wakiilka: Dr. Kinyanjui wuxuu kuu qoray koorso kaniinka cephalexin ah, 500mg oo la qaadanayo afar jeer maalintii muddo 10 maalmood ah. Waa muhiim inaad dhammaystirto koorsada oo dhan ee antibiyootiga sida laguu qoray, xitaa haddii aad dareento fiicnaan ka hor intaadan dhammayn daawada. Bukaanka: Waan fahmay. Ma jiraan wax kale oo aan u baahanahay inaan sammeeyo? Wakiilka: Haa, sii wad nidaamka daryeelka dhaawacaaga hadda sida lagu faray. Meesha nadiifi oo qallaji, oo beddel faashadda maalin kasta. La soco dhaawaca wixii calaamado oo ah caabuq sii xummaanaya, sida casaanka oo kordha, barar, diirimaad, ama malax. Haddii aad aragto mid ka mid ah calaamadahan, ama haddii aad qandho yeelato, fadlan la soo xiriir xafiiskeenna isla markaaba. Bukaanka: Hagaag, waan yeeli doonaa. Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad ii sheegto. Wakiilka: Adaa mudan, Mado. Ma qabtaa su'aallo kale wakhtigan? Bukaanka: Maya, waxaan u malaynayaa inay intaasi igu filan tahay. Mahadsanid. Wakiilka: Adaa mudan. Fadlan ha ka gabanin inaad na soo wacdo haddii aad qabto wax walaac ah. Maalin wanaagsan. Bukaanka: Sidoo kale. Nabadgelyo.
en: Representative: Hello, this is Michel calling from Dr. Kinyanjui's office. May I speak with Mr. Mado Mulumba? Patient: Yes, this is Mado. Representative: Hi Mado, I'm calling regarding the results of your recent lab work for your burn injury. Are you available to discuss these results now? Patient: Yes, I am. Representative: Great. The culture from the burn wound on your left arm showed the presence of Staphylococcus aureus. This is a type of bacteria that can cause infection. Based on the sensitivity testing, the bacteria is susceptible to cephalexin. Patient: Okay, what does that mean for my treatment? Representative: Dr. Kinyanjui has prescribed a course of cephalexin, 500mg to be taken four times a day for 10 days. It's important to complete the entire course of antibiotics as prescribed, even if you start feeling better before you've finished the medication. Patient: Understood. Is there anything else I need to do? Representative: Yes, continue with your current wound care regimen as instructed. Keep the area clean and dry, and change the dressing daily. Monitor the wound for any signs of worsening infection, such as increased redness, swelling, warmth, or pus. If you notice any of these signs, or if you develop a fever, please contact our office immediately. Patient: Okay, I will. Thank you for letting me know. Representative: You're welcome, Mado. Do you have any other questions at this time? Patient: No, I think that covers it. Thank you. Representative: You're welcome. Please don't hesitate to call us if you have any concerns. Have a good day. Patient: You too. Goodbye.

so: Bukaanka, oo ah 16-jir magaciisu yahay Ben, ayaa soo gaaraya xarunta daryeelka degdega ah isaga oo u muuqda mid welwelsan. Wuxuu leeyahay taariikh neef daran, cystic fibrosis, iyo xanuunka walwalka, taasoo u baahan daaweyn oksijiin joogto ah. Ben wuxuu sitaa boombalo yar oo uu jecelyahay oo uu mar walba la socdo, wuxuuna si joogto ah u hubinayaa heerarka oksijiintiisa iyadoo la adeegsanayo cabbiraha garaaca wadnaha ee gacanta lagu qaato. Diiwaankiisa caafimaadka ayaa muujinaya inuu marar badan isbitaal galay iyo qorshe daaweyn xoogan oo ku lug leh dawooyin neefsashada, mashiinnada neefsashada, iyo dawooyinka afka laga qaato. Waxaa la socota hooyadiis, oo sidoo kale u muuqata mid welwelsa, waxaayna sidataa fayl ay ka buuxaan dukumentiyo caafimaad. Neefta Ben waa xawaare ah oo gaaban, si joogto ah ayuuna u qufacayaa, waxaana ka imaanaya xab adag. Wuxuu cabsi ka muujinayaa dhibaatada neefsashadiisa hadda iyo suurtagalnimada inuu u baahdo inuu mar kale isbitaal galo.
en: The patient, a 16-year-old named Ben, arrives at the urgent care center visibly anxious. He has a history of severe asthma, cystic fibrosis, and anxiety disorder, requiring regular oxygen therapy. Ben is clutching a well-worn teddy bear and constantly checking his oxygen saturation levels with a portable pulse oximeter. His medical records indicate numerous hospitalizations and a complex medication regimen involving multiple inhalers, nebulizers, and oral medications. He is accompanied by his mother, who appears equally concerned and carries a binder full of medical documents. Ben's breathing is rapid and shallow, and he frequently coughs, producing thick mucus. He expresses fear about his current breathing difficulty and the possibility of needing another hospitalization.

so: Kalkaaliye Caafimaad: Haye, subax wanaagsan, Ms. Barbosa. Waxaan arkaa inaad u diyaar garoobeyso inaad guriga aaddo ka dib daaweynta shucaaca. Sidee dareemaysaa maanta? Ms. Barbosa: Waxaan dareemayaa daal yar, laakiin guud ahaan waan fiicanahay. Waxaan diyaar u ahay inaan aado sariirteyda, run ahaantii. Kalkaaliye Caafimaad: Shaki iigama jiro taa! Had iyo jeer way wanaagsan tahay in dib loogu noqdo deegaan la yaqaan. Kahor intaadan bixin, waxaan kaliya u baahannahay inaan ka wada hadalno waxyaabo yar si aan u hubiyo inaad diyaar u tahay in aad ku soo kabsato guriga. Ma ii xaqiijin kartaa magacaaga oo buuxa iyo taariikhda dhalashadaada, fadlan? Ms. Barbosa: Haa, waa Xiaoli Roberts, taariikhda dhalashadaydu na waa March 12-keedii, 1965. Kalkaaliye Caafimaad: Waa sidi la rabay, mahadsanid. Hadda, markaan eegno tilmaamahaaga bixitaanka, wuxuu dhigayaa in aad qaadatay daaweynta shucaaca ee kansarka naasaha. Ma sax baa?
