Ms. Barbosa: Haa, waa sidaa. Kalkaaliye Caafimaad: Haye. Sideese u maareyneysaa xanuun kasta ama raaxo la'aan? Ms. Barbosa: Xanuunka waa mid la maareyn karo daawada ay i siiyeen. Waxaan u qaadanayey sidii la i faray. Kalkaaliye Caafimaad: Waa wax lagu farxo in la maqlo. Xusuusnoow inaad isdajiso maalmaha soo socda oo dhegeyso jirkaaga. Haddii aad isku aragto wax astaamo cusub ah ama ka sii daraya, fadlan ha ka gabanin inaad wacdo dhakhtarkaaga. Ms. Barbosa: Waan sammeyn doonaa, mahadsanid. Kalkaaliye Caafimaad: Sidoo kale, ma haysataa qof guriga jooga oo ku yara caawiya? Ms. Barbosa: Haa, ninkeyga ayaa ila joogi doona. Wuxuu dhawr maalmood oo fasax ah ka qaadanayaa shaqada. Kalkaaliye Caafimaad: Waa wax aad u fiican. In taageero la helo waa muhiim. Ma jiraa wax su'aallo ah oo aad i weydiineyso intaadan bixin? Ms. Barbosa: Maya, waxaan u maleynayaa inaanan wax su'aal ah qabin hadda. Tilmaamuhu waxaay u muuqdaan kuwo cad. Kalkaaliye Caafimaad: Hagaag haddaba. Waan soo gabagabeyn doonnaa waraaqahaaga bixitaanka oo mardhaw waan ku fasixi doonnaa. Is ilaali, Ms. Barbosa. Ms. Barbosa: Mahadsanid, kalkaaliye. Adiguna sidoo kale.
en: Nurse: Hi, good morning, Ms. Barbosa. I see you're getting ready to head home after your radiation therapy. How are you feeling today? Ms. Barbosa: I'm feeling a bit tired, but okay overall. Ready to be in my own bed, that's for sure. Nurse: I bet! It's always nice to get back to familiar surroundings. Before you go, I just need to go over a few things with you to make sure you're all set for your recovery at home. Can you confirm your full name and date of birth for me, please? Ms. Barbosa: Sure, it's Xiaoli Roberts, and my date of birth is March 12th, 1965. Nurse: Perfect, thank you. Now, looking at your discharge instructions, it says you had radiation therapy for breast cancer. Is that correct? Ms. Barbosa: Yes, that's right. Nurse: Okay. And how are you managing any pain or discomfort? Ms. Barbosa: The pain is manageable with the medication they gave me. I've been taking it as directed. Nurse: Good to hear. Remember to take it easy for the next few days and listen to your body. If you experience any new or worsening symptoms, please don't hesitate to call your doctor. Ms. Barbosa: I will, thank you. Nurse: Also, do you have someone at home to help you out for a bit? Ms. Barbosa: Yes, my husband will be there. He's taking a few days off work. Nurse: That's great. Having support is important. Do you have any questions for me before you leave? Ms. Barbosa: No, I think I'm good. The instructions seem pretty clear. Nurse: Alright then. We'll get your discharge paperwork finalized and you'll be on your way shortly. Take care, Ms. Barbosa. Ms. Barbosa: Thank you, nurse. You too.

so: Cilladaha godadku waa koox xididada dhiigga ah oo aan caadi ahayn oo ku jira maskaxda ama laf dhabarta, kuwaas oo u eg raspberries (timirta beeriga). Waxaay la qaadi karaa marka la dhasho ama waxay soo bixi karaan qaybta dambe ee nolosha. In kasta oo dad badan aanay waligood la kulmin astaamo, dadka qaar waxa laga yaabaa in ay yeeshaan qalal, madax-xanuun, ama cillad xagga neerfayaasha ah. Qalliinkii ugu dambeeyay wuxuu ujeedkiisu ahaa in la saaro ama la yareeyo xajmiga cilladaha si loo yareeyo calaamadahan looga na hortago dhibaatooyinka mustaqbalka. Qalliinka ka dib, waqtiyada soo kabashada way kala duwan yihiin. Bukaannada qaarkood waxaa laga yaabaa inay la kulmaan isbeddello dhanka neerfayaasha ku meel gaar ah, sida daciifnimo ama dhib dhanka hadalka, kuwaas oo sida caadiga ah soo roonaada waqti kaddib. Daawooyin ayaa loo qori karaa si loo maareeyo qalalka ama astaamaha kale. Ballamaha dabagalka joogtada ah ee takhasuskaaga ayaa muhiim u ah in lala socdo horumarkaaga waxna laga qabto wixii walaac ah. Waa muhiim in la fahmo in cilladaha godadku ay mararka qaarkood soo noqon karaan ama kuwa cusub sameysmi karaan. Dabagalka joogtada ah iyadoo la isticmaalayo raajada ayaa badanaa lagu taliyaa. In kasta oo la noolaanshaha xaaladdan ay noqon karto mid adag, dad badan ayaa u horseeda nolol guul leh haddii la helo maareyn iyo taageero habboon. Ha ka gabanin inaad waydiiso su'aallo ama aad raadsato caddayn ku saabsan xaaladaada gaarka ah inta lagu jiro ballamahaaga.
en: Cavernous malformations are clusters of abnormal blood vessels in the brain or spinal cord, resembling raspberries. They can be present from birth or develop later in life. While many people never experience symptoms, others may have seizures, headaches, or neurological deficits. The recent surgery aimed to remove or reduce the size of the malformation to alleviate these symptoms and prevent future complications. Following surgery, recovery times vary. Some patients may experience temporary neurological changes, such as weakness or difficulty speaking, which typically improve over time. Medications may be prescribed to manage seizures or other symptoms. Regular follow-up appointments with your specialist are crucial to monitor your progress and address any concerns. It's important to understand that cavernous malformations can sometimes reoccur or new ones may form. Ongoing monitoring with MRI scans is often recommended. While living with this condition can be challenging, many people lead fulfilling lives with proper management and support. Don't hesitate to ask questions or seek clarification about your specific situation during your appointments.

so: TILMAAMAHA LOOGU TALAGALAY BUKAANKA: 1. La Soco Astaamaha: Si dhow u la soco astaamo kasta oo ka sii daraya ama kuwo cusub, oo ay ku jiraan: * Madax xanuun daran, gaar ahaan kuwa qufac ama dhibid ka sii dara. * Xanuun qoorta ah ama qoor adayg. * Dhibaatooyinka dheelitirnaanka ama isku xirnaanta. * Isbeddellada aragga ama hadalka. * Tabar yari ama kabuubyo gacmaha ama lugaha. * Dhib dhanka cunno liqidda. 2. Naso oo Ka Fogoow Hawlaha Tamar Badan Kaaga Baahan: Iska fududee oo iska ilaali hawlaha kordhin kara cadaadiska madaxa ama qoorta, sida qaadista walxaha culus, jimicsiga daran, ama ciyaaraha la is taabto. 3. Maaree Xanuunka: Isticmaal xanuun baabi'iyaha aan dhakhtar qorin sida acetaminophen (Tylenol) ama ibuprofen (Advil) sida loogu talagalay madax xanuunka ama qoor xanuunka. Haddii xanuunka sii jiro ama ka sii daro, la xiriir dhakhtarkaaga. 4. Raadso Daryeel Caafimaad oo Degdeg ah: Tag qolka gargaarka degdegga ah ee kuugu dhow ama wac 911 haddii aad isku aragto: * Miyir beelid. * Mantag daran, oo joogto ah. * Si lama filaan ah u bilawda madax xanuun daran. * Neefsashada oo ku dhibta. * Isbeddellada ku yimaada saxarada ama kaadi heysta. 5. Ballan Dabagal: Ballan ka qabso Dikt. Margaux Caron, Dhakhtarka neerfaha ee Carruurta, sida ugu dhaqsaha badan si qiimeyn dheeri loo sammeeyo loona maareeyo. Nambarka xafiiskeedu waa 555-0198. 6. Hayso Diiwaan Astaamo: Xusuusnow waqtiga, muddada, iyo darnaanta astaamo kasta, iyo sidoo kale wax kasta oo kiciya ama yareeya. La imoow diiwaankan waqtiga ballantaada. Macluumaad Dheeraad ah: * Biyo-siinta jirka: Cab cabitaanno badan si aad u ahaato mid jirkaaga biyo u helo. * Hurddada: Hel nasasho iyo hurdo kugu filan. * Cuntada: Joogtee cunto caafimaad leh. Fadlan kala xiriir xafiiska Dikt.. Caron 555-0198 haddii aad qabto wax su'aallo ah ama walaac ah kahor ballantaada.
en: INSTRUCTIONS FOR PATIENT: 1. Monitor Symptoms: Closely watch for any worsening or new symptoms, including: * Severe headaches, especially those worsened by coughing or straining. * Neck pain or stiffness. * Balance or coordination problems. * Changes in vision or speech. * Weakness or numbness in the arms or legs. * Difficulty swallowing. 2. Rest and Avoid Strenuous Activity: Take it easy and avoid activities that could increase pressure in the head or neck, such as heavy lifting, intense exercise, or contact sports. 3. Manage Pain: Use over-the-counter pain relievers like acetaminophen (Tylenol) or ibuprofen (Advil) as directed for headaches or neck pain. If pain persists or worsens, contact your doctor. 4. Seek Immediate Medical Attention: Go to the nearest emergency room or call 911 if you experience: * Loss of consciousness. * Severe, persistent vomiting. * Sudden onset of severe headache. * Difficulty breathing. * Changes in bowel or bladder control. 5. Follow-up Appointment: Schedule an appointment with Dr. Margaux Caron, Pediatric Neurologist, as soon as possible for further evaluation and management. Her office number is 555-0198. 6. Keep a Symptom Log: Note the time, duration, and severity of any symptoms, as well as any triggers or relieving factors. Bring this log to your appointment. Additional Information: * Hydration: Drink plenty of fluids to stay hydrated. * Sleep: Get adequate rest and sleep. * Diet: Maintain a healthy diet. Please contact Dr. Caron's office at 555-0198 if you have any questions or concerns before your appointment.

so: Adeeg bixiyahaa: Galab wanaagsan. Waxaan ahay Dikt. Chen. Maxaa maanta ku keenay halkan? Bukaanka: Sidee tahay, Dikt. Chen. Waxaan u imid baaritaanka awoodda dhalmada. Xaaskeyga iyo aniga waxaan isku dayeynay inaan uur yeelanno muddo sanad ah iyadoo aan ku guulaysan, waxaana bilaabay inaan yara walwalo. Bixiyaha Adeegga: Waan fahmay walwalkaaga. Ma ahan wax aan caadi ahayn in lammaaneyaashu ay wajahaan caqabado la xiriira bacriminta. Ma ii sheegi kartaa wax yar oo dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan taariikhda caafimaadkaaga iyo wixi arrimo nololeed ah oo laga yaabo inay habboon yihiin? Bukaanka: Hagaag, waxaan ahay shaqaale fayadhowrka, marka waxaan shaqada kala kulmaa kiimikooyin badan oo kala duwan iyo qiiq. Waxaan sidoo kale dhowaananahan dareemayay walwal badan, oo iiga imaanaya shaqada iyo maaddaama aynsan noo suurtogelin inaan uur helno. Bixiyaha Adeegga: Hagaag, intaasi waa faahfaahin muhiim ah. Bey'ada aad ku hawlgasho iyo walwalka waxaay saameyn ku yeelan karaan awoodda dhalmada. Hubaal waan tixgelin doonaa kuwaas markaan u gudbeyno baaritaanka. Bukaanka: Waa maxay nooca baaritaannada aan u baahan doono inaan sameeyo? Bixiyaha Adeegga: Waxaan ku billaabi doonnaa baaritaan jireed iyo falanqaynta shahwada. Tani waxaay na siin doontaa faham aasaasi ah oo ku saabsan tirada shahwadaada iyo dhaqdhaqaaqeeda. Iyadoo ku xiran jawaabaha baaritaanka, waxaa laga yaabaa inaan kugula talinno baaritaanno dheeri ah, sida baaritaan dhanka shaqadahiigga si loo hubiyo heerarka hoormoonka ama baaritaanka hidde-sideyaasha. Bukaanka: Taasi waxaay u muuqataa mid macquul ah. Ma jiraa wax aan sameyn karo xilligan oo aan kor ugu qaadi karo fursadaheyga? Bixiyaha Adeegga: Haa, aad iyo aad. Joogteynta hab-nololeed caafimaad mar walba waa mid faa'iido leh. Cunista cunto isku dheellitiran, jimicsi joogto ah, iyo maareynta walwalka dhammaantood waxaay gacan ka geysan karaan helidda caafimaad guud oo wanaagsan, kaas oo si togan u saameyn kara awoodda dhalmo. Haddii aad sigaar cabto ama aad si xad dhaaf ah u cabto khamriga, in aad yareyso ama joojiso ayaa sidoo kale isbaddel keeni kara. Bukaanka: Waad ku mahadsan tahay talada, Dikt. Chen. Hubaal waxaan isku dayi doonaa inaan nolosheyda wax ka baddello. Bixiya Adeegga: Adigaa mudan. Waxaan ka wada hadli doonnaa natiijooyinka baaritaannadaada marka ay diyaar yihiin waxaana samayn doonnaa qorshe shakhsiyeed si aan adiga iyo xaaskaaga uga caawinno inaad gaartaan yoolkiina ah inaad bilowdaan qoys. Ha ka gaban inaad weydiiso su'aal kasta oo aad qabto inta lagu guda jiro hawshan. Bukaanka: Waad ku mahadsan tahay, dhakhtar. Waan kaaga mahadcelinayaa caawimaaddaada.
en: Provider: Good afternoon. I'm Dr. Chen. What brings you in today? Patient: Hi, Dr. Chen. I'm here for fertility testing. My wife and I have been trying to conceive for a year without success, and I'm getting a little worried. Provider: I understand your concern. It's not uncommon for couples to face challenges with fertility. Can you tell me a little more about your medical history and any lifestyle factors that might be relevant? Patient: Well, I'm a sanitation worker, so I'm exposed to a lot of different chemicals and fumes on the job. I've also been feeling pretty stressed lately, both at work and because we haven't been able to get pregnant. Provider: Okay, those are important details. Environmental exposures and stress can potentially impact fertility. We'll definitely take those into consideration as we move forward with testing. Patient: What kind of tests will I need to do? Provider: We'll start with a physical exam and a semen analysis. This will give us a baseline understanding of your sperm count and motility. Depending on the results, we may recommend additional tests, such as blood work to check hormone levels or genetic testing. Patient: That sounds reasonable. Is there anything I can do in the meantime to improve my chances? Provider: Absolutely. Maintaining a healthy lifestyle is always beneficial. Eating a balanced diet, exercising regularly, and managing stress can all contribute to better overall health, which can positively impact fertility. If you smoke or drink alcohol excessively, cutting back or quitting can also make a difference. Patient: Thanks for the advice, Dr. Chen. I'll definitely try to make some changes. Provider: You're welcome. We'll discuss the results of your tests once they're available and develop a personalized plan to help you and your wife achieve your goal of starting a family. Don't hesitate to ask any questions you may have along the way. Patient: Thank you, doctor. I appreciate your help.

so: Tilmaamaha Kahor Qalliinka ee Daawaynta Dhididka Xad-Dhaafka ah Waxaad u baahan doontaa inaad joojiso qaadashada dawooyinka dhiigga khafiifiya, sida asbiriin ama ibuprofen, toddobaad kahor qaliinkaaga. Fadlan qorshee qof kugu soo celiya guriga ballantaada kaddib, maadaama laga yaabo in lagu siiyo daawo hurdisiin ah. Xidho dhar dabacsan oo raaxo leh maalinta qalliinkaaga, gaar ahaan shaati ay fududahay in la iska bixiyo. Ha marsan wax ka hortagga dhididka, caraf udgoon, kareem, ama budo kilkilooyinkaaga maalinta daawayntaada. Waxaad cuni kartaa cunto fudud ka hor intaadan soo gelin, laakiin iska ilaali cuntooyinka culus ama dufanka leh. Fadlan imoow 15 daqiiqo kahor si aad u buuxiso wixii waraaqo ah ee lagama maarmaanka ah. Haddii aad la kulanto wax jirro ah, sida hergab ama qandho, oo ballantaada kahor, fadlan soo wac xafiiskayaga si dib ballan laguugu qabto. Qalliinka kaddib, waxaad filan kartaa xoogaa barar iyo nabar, kuwaasi oo lagu maareyn karo baraf iyo daawada xanuunka ee farmashiyaha laga qaato sida uu dhakhtarkaagu ku farayo. Iska ilaali jimicsiga adag iyo qaadista culeys dhowr maalmood daaweynta kaddib. Meesha lagaa daaweeyay nadiifi oo qallaji, iska na ilaali xiirashada ama isticmaalka saabuun adag ugu yaraan 24 saacadood. Haddii aad dareento wax calaamado ah oo caabuq ah, sida casaan kordhay, diirimaad, ama dheecaan, la xiriir xafiiskayaga isla markiiba. Waxaan jadwal u samayn doonaa ballan dabagal ah si aan ula socono horumarkaaga oo aan u hubinno natiijooyinka ugu fiican. Xor ayaad u tahay inaad waydiiso su'aal kasta oo aad qabtid inta lagu jiro la tashigaaga ama adigoo soo wacaya xafiiskayaga. Waxaan rajeyneynaa inaan kaa caawinno inaad ka nafisto dhididka xad dhaafka ah.
en: Pre-Operative Instructions for Excessive Sweating Treatment You will need to stop taking blood thinners, such as aspirin or ibuprofen, one week before your procedure. Please arrange for someone to drive you home after your appointment, as you may receive medication that can make you drowsy. Wear loose-fitting, comfortable clothing on the day of your procedure, specifically a shirt that is easy to remove. Do not apply any antiperspirant, deodorant, lotion, or powder to your underarms on the day of your treatment. You may eat a light meal before coming in, but avoid heavy or greasy foods. Please arrive 15 minutes early to complete any necessary paperwork. If you experience any illness, such as a cold or fever, leading up to your appointment, please call our office to reschedule. After the procedure, you can expect some swelling and bruising, which can be managed with ice packs and over-the-counter pain medication as directed by your doctor. Avoid strenuous exercise and heavy lifting for a few days following the treatment. Keep the treated area clean and dry, and avoid shaving or using harsh soaps for at least 24 hours. If you notice any signs of infection, such as increased redness, warmth, or drainage, contact our office immediately. We will schedule a follow-up appointment to monitor your progress and ensure optimal results. Please feel free to ask any questions you may have during your consultation or by calling our office. We look forward to helping you achieve relief from excessive sweating.

so: Dikt. Adebayo: Wax dhib malahan, Sophie. Waxaan arkaa in qalliin jilibka lagaa sameeyay dhowr usbuuc kahor. Sidee ayaad dareemaysaa? Bukaanka: Waan roonahay, mahadsanid. Xanuunka xaqiiqdii wuu ka fiican yahay sidii uu ahaa qalliinka kaddib, laakiin weli wuu jiraa, gaar ahaan marka aan isku dayo inaan wax badan sosocdo. Dr. Adebayo: Taasi waa wax la fahmi karo. Xanuunka qalliinka ka dib mararka qaarkood way adkaan kartaa in la maareeyo. Ma u qaadaneysay wax daawo ah? Bukaanka: Haa, waxaan qaadanayay xoogaa ibuprofen, laakiin ma jecli inaan aad ugu tiirsanaado kaniiniyada. Taasina waa sababta dhakhtarkaygu u soo jeediyay acupuncture. Dr. Adebayo: Taasi macno ayey samaynaysaa. Acupuncture wuxuu noqon karaa ikhtiyaar weyn oo lagu maareeyo xanuunka iyada oo aan lagu tiirsanaan daawada oo keliya. Waligaa horey (daaweynta isticmaalka cirbadaha) ma u samaysay acupuncture? Bukaanka: Maya, waligeed. Waxaan ka yara walwalsanahay irbadaha, run ahaantii Dr. Adebayo: Ha walwalin, Sophie. Irbadaha aad bay u dhuuban yihiin dadka badankood na si dhib leh ayay u dareemaan. Intaa waxaa dheer, acupuncture waxaa lagu yaqaanaa inay tahay nidaam nasiinno lagu dareemo. Waxaay kaa caawin kartaa xanuunka iyo ka soo kabashada walbaharaarka. Bukaanka: Taasi waxaay u muuqataa arrin fiican. Haddaba, sidee bay u shaqeysaa dhab ahaantii? Dikt. Adebayo: Hagaag, acupuncture waxaay ku lug leedahay gelinta irbado dhuuban goobo qaar ah oo jirka ah. Goobahan waxay u dhigmaan waddooyin tamar oo kala duwan, ama marinno. Marka aan kicinno goobahan, waxaan kaa caawin karnaa inaan dheellitirno qulqulka tamarta oo aan kor u qaadno bogsashada. Xanuunka jilibkaaga na, waxaan diiradda saari doonaa dhibcaha agagaarka jilibka iyo sidoo kale qaar ka mid ah goobaha kale ee kaa caawin kara joojinta xanuunka iyo bararka. Bukaanka: Waayahay, waa wax macquul ah . Immisa kulan ayaan u baahan doonaa? Dikt. Adebayo: Runtii waxaay ku xiran tahay sida jirkaaga uga falceliyo daaweynta. Dadka qaar ayaa dareema nafis hal kulan kaddib, halka kuwa kalena laga yaabo inay u baahdaan dhowr kulamo. Waxaan ku bilaabi doonnaa dhowr kalfadhi kaddibna aan aragno sidaad dareemeyso. Bukaanka: Waxaay u egtahay qorshe fiican. Goorma ayaan billaabi karnaa? Dikt. Adebayo: Hadda ayaan billaabi karnaa haddii aad diyaar tahay. Kaliya ku fadhiiso miiska waana billaabi doonnaa. Bukaanka: Waayahay, si fiican. Mahadsanid, Dikt. Adebayo. Dikt. Adebayo: Adaa mudan, Sophie. Aan kaa caawinno in aad fiicnaato.
en: Dr. Adebayo: No problem at all, Sophie. I see you had surgery on your knee a few weeks ago. How are you feeling? Patient: I'm doing okay, thanks. The pain is definitely better than it was right after surgery, but it's still there, especially when I try to move around too much. Dr. Adebayo: That's understandable. Post-operative pain can be tricky to manage sometimes. Have you been taking any medication for it? Patient: Yeah, I've been taking some ibuprofen, but I don't like relying on pills too much. That's why my doctor suggested acupuncture. Dr. Adebayo: That makes sense. Acupuncture can be a great option for managing pain without relying solely on medication. Have you ever had acupuncture before? Patient: No, never. I'm a little nervous about the needles, to be honest. Dr. Adebayo: Don't worry, Sophie. The needles are very thin and most people barely feel them. Plus, acupuncture is known for being very relaxing. It can help with both the pain and the stress of recovery. Patient: That sounds good. So, how does it work exactly? Dr. Adebayo: Well, acupuncture involves inserting thin needles into specific points on the body. These points correspond to different energy pathways, or meridians. By stimulating these points, we can help to balance the flow of energy and promote healing. For your knee pain, we'll focus on points around the knee as well as some other points that can help with pain relief and inflammation. Patient: Okay, that makes sense. How many sessions will I need? Dr. Adebayo: It really depends on how you respond to the treatment. Some people feel relief after just one session, while others may need a few more. We'll start with a few sessions and see how you're feeling. Patient: Sounds like a plan. When can we start? Dr. Adebayo: We can start right now if you're ready. Just have a seat on the table and we'll get started. Patient: Okay, great. Thanks, Dr. Adebayo. Dr. Adebayo: You're welcome, Sophie. Let's get you feeling better.

so: Dikt. Ncube: Galab wanaagsan, Mr. Novikov. Waxaan fahamsannahay inaad la kulanto xoogaa dhib caloosha ah maanta. Wax yar ma iiga sheegi kartaa waxa ku haya? Mr. Novikov: (Oo caloosha haya) Haa, dhakhtar, in muddo ah ayay i dhibaysay hadda. Kaliya waxaan dareemayaa xanuun joogto ah, badiyaa dhinacyada iyo dhabarka. Waxaana dareemayey runtii daal badan dhawaanahan, tamar ma leh gebi ahaanba. Dikt. Ncube: Waan arkaa. Oo ma dareentay wax isbeddel ah oo ku yimid caadooyinkaaga kaadida? Sida inaad u baahan tahay inaad tagto marar badan, ama wax xanuun ah ama dareen gubasho ah? Mr. Novikov: Hagaag, maaddaama aad xustay, waxaan dhowr jeer habeenkii si ku kacayey kaadi. Mararka qaarkoodna anqawyadaydu xoogaa way bararaan, gaar qaybaha dambe ee maalinta. Dr. Ncube: Hagaag, waa faahfaahin muhiim ah. Ma laguugu arkay xaalado caafimaad oo kale dhawaan, Mr. Novikov? Mr. Novikov: Kaliya dhiig karka, dhakhtar. Dhakhtarkayga caadiga ah ayaa ii qoray kiniinno dhawr sano ka hor. Laakiin kuma fiicnayn inaan si joogto ah u qaato, run ahaantii. Dr. Ncube: Fahamka taariikhdaada caafimaad waa mid muhiim ah. Cudurka kelyaha ee raagga badanaa waxaa loo qaadaa si aamusnaan ah illaa in muddo, dhiig karka aan la xakamaynina wuxuu noqon karaa waxa ugu weyn ee keena. Marka la eego astaamahaaga iyo taariikhdaada caafimaad, waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan dalbado baaritaannada dhiigga iyo kaadida si aan u hubinno shaqada kelyahaaga. Waxaan sidoo kale doonaynaa inaan si dhow ula soconno dhiig karkaaga. Mr. Novikov: Baaritaanno? Taasi miyey ka dhigan tahay inay wax ka qaldan yihiin kelyaheyga? Dr. Ncube: Ma aha daruuri, Mr. Novikov. Laakiin in la ogaado waqti hore iyo maareynta ayaa muuhim u ah ka hortagga dhaawac kale. Waxaan ka wada shaqeyn doonnaa si aan u horumarinno qorshe adiga kugu habboon, kaasoo ku lug yeelan kara isbeddel qaab nololeedka, hagaajinta daawada, iyo kormeer joogto ah. Mr. Novikov: Waa hagaag, dhakhtar. Wax kasta oo aad u malayneyso in ay ugu fiican yihiin. Kaliya waxaan rabaa inaan dareemo fiicnaan oo aan ku noqdo naftayda caadiga ahayd. Dikt. Ncube: Taasi ayaa yoolkeenna ah, Mr. Novikov. Waxaan gaari doonnaa gunta arrintan oo waxaan kaa caawin doonnaa inaad si wax ku ool ah u maareyso caafimaadka kelyahaaga. Aan dalbanno baaritaannadaas oo aan jadwalka u sameyno ballan dabagal ah si aan uga wada hadalno natiijooyinka.
en: Dr. Ncube: Good afternoon, Mr. Novikov. I understand you're experiencing some abdominal discomfort today. Can you tell me a bit more about what's going on? Mr. Novikov: (Clutching stomach) Yeah, Doc, it's been bothering me for a while now. Just feels like a constant ache, mostly on my sides and back. And I've been feeling really tired lately, no energy at all. Dr. Ncube: I see. And have you noticed any changes in your urination habits? Like needing to go more often, or any pain or burning sensation? Mr. Novikov: Well, now that you mention it, I have been getting up a few times at night to pee. And sometimes my ankles get a bit swollen, especially by the end of the day. Dr. Ncube: Okay, those are important details. Have you been diagnosed with any other health conditions recently, Mr. Novikov? Mr. Novikov: Just high blood pressure, Doc. My regular doctor put me on some pills for it a few years back. But I haven't been the best at taking them regularly, to be honest. Dr. Ncube: Understanding your medical history is crucial. Chronic kidney disease often develops silently over time, and uncontrolled high blood pressure can be a significant contributing factor. Given your symptoms and history, I'd like to order some blood and urine tests to check your kidney function. We'll also want to monitor your blood pressure closely. Mr. Novikov: Tests? Does that mean something's seriously wrong with my kidneys? Dr. Ncube: Not necessarily, Mr. Novikov. But early detection and management are key to preventing further damage. We'll work together to develop a plan that's right for you, which may involve lifestyle changes, medication adjustments, and regular monitoring. Mr. Novikov: Alright, Doc. Whatever you think is best. I just want to feel better and get back to my normal self. Dr. Ncube: That's our goal, Mr. Novikov. We'll get to the bottom of this and help you manage your kidney health effectively. Let's get those tests ordered and schedule a follow-up appointment to discuss the results.

so: "Waayahay, Mr. Durand, aan eegno qaniinyadaas," ayuu yiri kalkaaliyaha caafimaadka, isagoo u sii fidinaya muraayadda weynaysa. "Xaggee ayay khaasatan ku xanuunjinayaan?" "Inta badan garbaheyga iyo qoortayda," ayuu yiri Mr. Durand, isagoo laalaabaya gacmihiisa si uu u muujiyo dhowr baro oo casaan ah oo bararsan. "Waxaay u cuncunaan si waali ah, qaarkoodna waxaay dareemaan kuleyl marka la taabto." "Waan arkaa," ayuu yidhi kalkaalisada, isagoo si dhow u baaraya qaniinyada. "Waxaay u egtahay in aad la kulantay xoogaa dhuunyeer ah ama laga yaabee geesaha. Ma isku aragtay astaamo kale oo aan ka ahayn cuncunka iyo bararka? wax dhib ah ma kala kulantaa neefsashada, dawakhaadka, ama lallabbo?" "Maya, kaliya cuncunka iyo bararka," ayuu yiri Mr. Durand, isagoo mid ka mid ah qaniinyada xoqaya. "Laakiin dhab ahaantii waxaay billaabayaan inay i dhibaan, gaar ahaan marka aan jimisi ku sameynayo qorraxda." "Waa la fahmi karaa," kalkaaliyaha ayaa si naxariis leh madaxa u ruxay. "Qaniinyada cayayaanka waxaay noqon karaan kuwo aan raaxo lahayn, gaar ahaan kulaylkan. Maaddaama tani ay tahay DOT-gaaga jireed, waxaan u baahannahay inaan hubinno inaanay faragelin awooddaada aad si badbaado leh gaari u wadi karto. Ma u qaadataa wax daawooyin ah?" "kaliya qaar ka mid ah daawada antihistamines-ka ee farmashiyaha laga iibsado," ayuu Mr. Durand ku jawaabay. "Oo baraf ayaan saarayay markaan guriga tago." "Taasi waa wanaagsan tahay," ayuu yiri kalkaaliyaha. "Antihistamine-nada waxay kaa caawin karaan cuncunka, barafkana wuxuu dhimi karaa bararka. Waxaan kuu qorayaa daawada antihistamine oo kuwaan hadda ka xoog badan oo aad habeenkii qaadato, si ay kaaga caawiso inaad si fiican u seexato. Haddii bararku aanu hoos u dhicin dhowr maalmood gudahood na, ama haddii aad billowdo inaad la kulanto astaamo kale, soo noqo oo i arag isla markaaba." "Hagaag, mahadsanid," ayuu yiri Mr. Durand, isagoo u muuqda mid nafis dareemay. "Waan ka mahadnaqayaa." "Dhib ma leh," ayuu yiri kaalkaaliyaha oo dhoola caddeynaya. "Kaliya si fudud u qaado halkaa, oo isku day inaad iska ilaaliso in mar kale lagu qaniino haddii aad karto." "Waan sameyn doonaa," ayuu yiri Mr. Durand, isagoo alaabtiisa urursanaya. "Mar kale waad mahadsan tahay."
en: "Alright, Mr. Durand, let's take a look at those bites," the nurse practitioner said, reaching for a magnifying glass. "Where exactly are they bothering you?" "Mostly on my arms and neck," Mr. Durand replied, rolling up his sleeves to reveal several red, swollen welts. "They itch like crazy, and some of them feel hot to the touch." "I see," the nurse practitioner murmured, examining the bites closely. "It looks like you've had a run-in with some wasps or maybe hornets. Have you noticed any other symptoms besides the itching and swelling? Any trouble breathing, dizziness, or nausea?" "No, just the itching and the swelling," Mr. Durand said, scratching absentmindedly at one of the bites. "But they're really starting to bug me, especially when I'm working out in the sun." "Understandable," the nurse practitioner nodded sympathetically. "Insect bites can be quite uncomfortable, especially in this heat. Since this is for your DOT physical, we need to make sure they're not interfering with your ability to drive safely. Are you taking any medications for them?" " just some over-the-counter antihistamines," Mr. Durand replied. "And I've been putting ice on them when I get home." "That's good," the nurse practitioner said. "Antihistamines can help with the itching, and ice can reduce the swelling. I'm going to prescribe you a stronger antihistamine to take at night, just to help you sleep better. And if the swelling doesn't go down in a few days, or if you start to experience any other symptoms, come back and see me right away." "Okay, thanks," Mr. Durand said, looking relieved. "I appreciate it." "No problem," the nurse practitioner smiled. "Just take it easy out there, and try to avoid getting stung again if you can help it." "Will do," Mr. Durand said, gathering his things. "Thanks again."

so: Markaa, waa 3dii Habeenimo, sax? Waxaa qaybta gargaarka degdegga iigu jooga shaqaalaha duullimaadka, Lei, iyo ninkeeda, Funmilayo. Labaduba aad bay u daalan yihiin. Sida muuqata, Lei Google ayay maclumaad ka raadineysay waqtiga dambe ee habeenkii, waxayna ku qanacsan tahay inay qabto xanuun hiddeside naadir ah. Waxaay rabtaa in loo gudbiyo dhakhtarkan takhasuska leh oo ay internetka ka heshay, Dikt. X, kaas oo la sheegay inuu ku takhasusay waxan ay raadineyso. Funmilayo waa mid naftiisa ku mashquulsan, hore iyo gadaalba u socda, oo u eg in aanu seexan maalmo. Waxaan isku dayayaa inaan helo taariikhda caafimaad, laakiin Lei ayaa hadalka soo dhex galeyso iyo isticmaaleyso erey bixin caafimaadka oo ay si cad mardhaw u baratay. Funmilayo ayaa sidoo kale la soo dhexgalaya astaamo aan kala sooc lahayn oo uu dareemay dhowrkii toddobaad ee la soo dhaafay. Way yara qasan tahay, ugu yaraan waxa la tilmaami karo. Waxaan isku dayayaa inaan u xaqiijiyo inaan sameyn karno baaritaanno oo aan ogaanno waxa socda, laakiin waxaay ku dheggan yihiin takhasuslahan. Waxaan u sharraxay inaan marka hore u baahannahay inaan meesha ka saarno waxyaabaha caadiga ah, laakiin ma aqbalayaan. Waxaay noqon doontaa habeen dheer. Kaliya waxaan rajeynayaa inaan ku guuleysto in aan dejiyo si aan dhab ahaantii shaqadooda u qabto. Waxaa laga yaabaa in koob bun ah arrintaa iga caawin doono. Ama laga yaabee daawada dejiyaha ah. Aniga ayaa taa u baahan, iyaga maaha. Kaliya waan kaftamayaa. Kaftan camal.
en: So, it's 3 AM, right? I've got this flight attendant, Lei, and her husband, Funmilayo, in the ED. They're both super frazzled. Apparently, Lei's been doing some late-night Googling and is convinced she has some rare genetic disorder. She wants a referral to this specialist she found online, Dr. X, who supposedly specializes in this exact thing. Funmilayo is beside himself, pacing back and forth, looking like he hasn't slept in days. I'm trying to get a history, but Lei keeps interrupting with medical jargon she's clearly just learned. Funmilayo is chiming in with random symptoms he's noticed over the last few weeks. It's a bit chaotic, to say the least. I'm trying to reassure them that we can run some tests and figure out what's going on, but they're fixated on this specialist. I explained that we need to rule out the more common stuff first, but they're not having it. It's going to be a long night. I just hope I can get them to calm down enough to actually get some work done. Maybe a cup of coffee will help. Or maybe a sedative. For me, not them. Just kidding. Kind of.

so: Waxaan u maleynayaa in aad sababta halkan u timid tahay inaad kuftay oo aad dareemayso raaxo la'aan. Fadlan ogow waxaan kuu daryeeli doonaa adiga iyo ilmahaaga sida ugu wanaagsan ee suurtogalka ah. Marka hore, waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaad u jiifsato miiska imtixaanka dhankaaga bidix haddii aad awoodid; waa meesha ugu fiican ee socodka dhiigga adiga iyo ilmaha. Ii sheeg haddii ay taasi aad u xanuun badan tahay ama adag tahay, si aan u toosinno. Waxaan hubin doonaa dhiig karkaaga oo waxaan dhageysan doonnaa wadnahaaga iyo sambabadaada, iyo sidoo kale garaaca wadnaha ilmaha. Kaddib, waxaan u baahan doonaa inaan si tartiib ah u baarno halka iska dhaawacday si aan u fahamno heerka dhaawacaaga. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaan u baahanno inaan sammeyno baaritaanno, sida raajo ama shaqada dhiigga, si aan u hubinno in wax walba ay hagaagsan yihiin. Fadlan ii sheeg haddii aad dareemayso wax xanuun ah, dawakhaad, ama ciriiri. Sidoo kale, ii sheeg haddii aad dareentay wax isbeddel ah oo ku yimid dhaqdhaqaaqa ilmaha intaa aad kuftay kaddib. Ma qabtaa wax su'aallo ah ama walaac ah hadda? Waxaan sammeyn doonnaa wax kasta oo aan awoodno si aan labadiinnaba idiinku ilaalinno oo deganaan u dareentaan. Ku kalsoonow, waxaad ku jirtaa gacmo wanaagsan.
en: I understand you're here because you fell and are feeling quite uncomfortable. Please know we're going to take the best possible care of you and your baby. First, I'd like you to lie down on the exam table on your left side if you can; it's the best position for blood flow to you and the baby. Let me know if that's too painful or difficult, and we can adjust. I'm going to check your blood pressure and listen to your heart and lungs, as well as the baby's heartbeat. Then, we'll need to gently examine where you hurt yourself to understand the extent of your injury. We may need to do some tests, like an ultrasound or blood work, to make sure everything is okay. Please tell me if you're feeling any pain, dizziness, or contractions. Also, let me know if you've noticed any changes in the baby's movements since the fall. Do you have any questions or concerns right now? We'll do everything we can to keep you both safe and comfortable. Rest assured, you're in good hands.

so: Bukaanka ayaa soo bandhigay dhaawac shaqo oo kasoo gaaray shaqada. Bukaanku waxaa uu hayaa calooshiisa oo u muuqda inuu xanuun hayo. Lammaanahiisa ayaa jooga waxayna u muuqataa mid welwelsan. Bukaanku ma soo sheegin taariikh hore oo dhibaatooyin wadnaha ah. Baaritaanka jireed ma muujinayo calaamado cad oo ah ciriiri wadnaha.Cabbirka dhiiggu waa 120/80 mmHg, garaaca wadnaha waa 72 bpm, heerka neefsashaduna waa 16 neefsasho daqiiqaddii. EKG waxay muujinaysaa shanqarta sanka caadiga ah. Raajada laabta waa mid aan lahayn wax jirro daran oo la xiriira wadnaha iyo sambabada degdegga ah. Bukaanka waxaa lagula talinayaa inuu nasto oo uu qaato daawooyinka xanuunka ee farmashiyaha laga iibsado haddii loo baahdo. Ballanta daba-galka ah ayaa loo qorsheeyay hal usbuuc gudaheed. Ogaanshaha Cillad kala Duwanaansho: Cadaadiska muruqa caloosha Dhibaatada caloosha iyo mindhicirka Dhaawaca muruqyada lafaha Qorshaha: Nasasho Daawooyinka xanuunka ee farmashiyaha laga iibsado (ibuprofen ama acetaminophen) haddii loo baahdo Ballanta la socoshada hal usbuuc gudaheed si dib loogu qiimeeyo astaamaha
en: Patient presents with a workplace injury sustained on the job. Patient is clutching their abdomen and appears to be in pain. Spouse is present and appears anxious. Patient reports no prior history of heart problems. Physical examination reveals no obvious signs of cardiac distress. Blood pressure is 120/80 mmHg, pulse is 72 bpm, and respiratory rate is 16 breaths per minute. EKG shows normal sinus rhythm. Chest X-ray is negative for acute cardiopulmonary process. Patient is advised to rest and take over-the-counter pain medication as needed. Follow-up appointment scheduled in one week. Differential Diagnosis: Abdominal muscle strain Gastrointestinal distress Musculoskeletal injury Plan: Rest Over-the-counter pain medication (ibuprofen or acetaminophen) as needed Follow-up appointment in one week to reassess symptoms

so: Tilmaamaha Loogu Talogalay Bukaanka Dabagal: Ku soo noqo rugta caafimaadka 2 toddobaad gudahood si dib-u-eegis daawo iyo qiimeyn dheeraad ah laguugu sameeyo. Haddii aad isku aragto wax wareer, kacsanaan, ama isbeddello hab-dhaqan oo sii kordhaya kahor inta aan la gaarin wakhtigaas, fadlan soo wac xafiiskeenna isla markaaba. Cuntada: Joogtee cunto isku dheelitiran oo ay ku jiraan miro, khudaar, iyo badar. Xaddid cuntooyinka warshadaysan iyo cabitaannada sonkorta leh. Waraabi jirkaaga adigoo cabbaya biyo badan maalintii oo dhan. Dhaqdhaqaaqa: Ka qaybqaado dhaqdhaqaaq jireed oo joogto ah inta aad awooddo, sida socodka ama beerta oo looga shaqeeyo si fudud. Iska ilaali hawlaha culus ee keeni kara daal ama kordhin kara wareerka. Daawooyinka: Qaado Donepezil 10mg maalin kasta wakhtiga hurdada. Haddii aad seegto qiyaas, qaado isla markaad xasuusato, laakiin ha labalaabin qiyaasta. Badbaadada: Hubi in gurigaagu yahay mid ammaan ah oo ka madax bannaan khataraha. Ka saar roogagga jilcay, ku rakib baararka lagu qubeysado musqusha, oo nadiifi waddooyinka lagu socdo. Tixgeli isticmaalka nidaamka digniinta caafimaadka. Taageerada: La xiriir kooxaha taageerada maxalliga ah ama ururrada dadka qaba asaasaqa iyo daryeelayaashooda. Waxyaabahan ayaad ka heli kartaa macluumaad qiimo leh iyo taageero shucuureed. Xaaladda Degdegga ah: Haddii aad isku aragto xanuun laabta ah oo degdeg ah, neefsashada oo kugu adkaata, ama miyir-beel, wac 911 isla markaaba.
en: Patient Instructions Follow Up: Return to the clinic in 2 weeks for a medication review and further evaluation. If you experience any worsening confusion, agitation, or behavioral changes before then, please call our office immediately. Diet: Maintain a balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains. Limit processed foods and sugary drinks. Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water throughout the day. Activity: Engage in regular physical activity as tolerated, such as walking or light gardening. Avoid strenuous activities that may cause fatigue or increase confusion. Medications: Take Donepezil 10mg daily at bedtime. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, but do not double up on doses. Safety: Ensure your home environment is safe and free of hazards. Remove loose rugs, install grab bars in the bathroom, and keep walkways clear. Consider using a medical alert system. Support: Connect with local support groups or organizations for individuals with dementia and their caregivers. These resources can provide valuable information and emotional support. Emergency: If you experience sudden chest pain, difficulty breathing, or loss of consciousness, call 911 immediately.

so: Halloow mar kale, Mr. Molnar. Waxaan arkaa inaad soo laabatay sababtoo ah astaamahaaga ma fiicnaanin. Aan ka hadalno tallaabooyinka xiga. Waxaan u baahannahay inaan baaritaan dheeri ah sammeyno si aan u fahanno sababta aanad u soo roonaanin. Waxaan dalbanayaa tijaabooyin dhiig oo isxig-xiga si aan u hubinno shaqada xubnahaaga iyo inaan raadinno wixii infekshanno hoose ah ama waxyaabo kaa maqan. Fadlan ballan u sameyso tijaabooyinkan sida ugu dhaqsaha badan. Intaa waxaa dheer, waxaan kugula talinayaa inaan ballan la-talin kaaga qabto takhasusle, sida dhakhtarka dadka da'da ama dhakhtarka gudaha, si aan u helno qiimeyn ballaaran oo ku saabsan caafimaadkaaga guud. Waxaan ku siin karaa liiska takhsusleyaasha. Dhanka kale, sii wad qaadashada daawooyinka laguu qoray sida laguu faray. Hubi inaad heleyso nasasho iyo nafaqo kugu filan. Haddii aad la kulanto wax astaamo cusub ama ka sii daraya, fadlan ha ka gababnin inaad isla markiiba la soo xiriirto xafiiskayga ama raadso daryeel degdeg ah. Waxaan qorsheyn doonnaa ballan daba-gal ah marka aan helno natiijooyinka tijaabooyinkaaga iyo warbixinta takhasuslaha. Markaas ayaan ka wada hadli doonnaa natiijooyinka, waxaana go'aamin doonnaa habka ugu fiican ee daaweynta horey loogu socdo. Fadlan xusuusnow inaad keento liiska dhammaan daawooyinkaaga hadda iyo wixii su'aallo ah oo aad qabtid ballanta xigta. Waad ku mahadsan tahay dulqaadkaaga iyo iskaashigaaga. Waan gaari doonnaa gunta arrintan.
en: Hello again, Mr. Molnar. I see you're back because your symptoms haven't improved. Let's discuss the next steps. We need to investigate further to understand why you're not feeling better. I'm going to order a series of blood tests to check your organ function and look for any underlying infections or deficiencies. Please schedule an appointment for these tests at your earliest convenience. Additionally, I recommend we schedule a consultation with a specialist, perhaps a geriatrician or an internist, to get a more comprehensive evaluation of your overall health. I can provide you with a referral list. In the meantime, continue taking your prescribed medications as directed. Ensure you're getting adequate rest and nutrition. If you experience any new or worsening symptoms, please don't hesitate to contact my office immediately or seek emergency care. We'll schedule a follow-up appointment once we have the results of your tests and the specialist's report. We'll then discuss the findings and determine the best course of treatment moving forward. Please remember to bring a list of all your current medications and any questions you may have to our next appointment. Thank you for your patience and cooperation. We'll get to the bottom of this.

so: Dhakhtarka: Subax wanaagsan, Mr. Teixeira. Sidee tahay maanta? Bukaanka: Subax wanaagsan, Dhakhtar. Run ahaantii, ma fiicni. Waxaa i haysatay dhibaato, gaar ahaan xubinteyda taranka. Way i xanuunaysaa markaan kaadinayo. Dhakhtarka: Waan ka xumahay inaan maqlo taas. Waxyar ma ii sii sharrixi kartaa xanuunka? Ma gubasho baa, mise xanuun kugu taagan, mise wax kale? Bukaanka: Haa, badanaa waa gubasho, Dhakhtar. Markasta oo aan doono tago, waa sida... dab ka kacaya halkaas. Waxaan dareemayaa in aan mar kasta rabo in aan tago, xitaa haddii wax yar iga imaadaan. Dhakhtarka: Taasi waxaay u muuqataa mid dhib badan. Ma isku aragtay astaamo kale oo la socda kaadida xanuunka leh? Wax dhiig ma ku jiraa kaadidaada, mise laga yaabaa in ay ur xun leedahay? Bukaanka: Ma jiro dhiig aan isku arkay, waa Alle mahaddii. Laakiin waxaa jirta ur yar oo la yaab leh mararka qaarkood. Oo, oo, dhawaanahan aad baan u dhididayey in ka badan intii caadiga ahayd, gaar ahaan habeenkii. Mararka qaarkood ayaan soo toosaa anigoo wada qoyaan ah. Dhakhtarka: Waan arkaa. Dhididka badan mararka qaarkood wuxuu calaamad u noqon karaa caabuq ama arrimo kale oo hoose. Ma leedahay qandho ama ma qandheysneyd dhowaanahan? Bukaanka: Waxaa laga yaabaa inaan yar diirranahay mararka qaarkood, laakiin ma aanan cabbirin heerkulkayga. Kaliya waxaan dareemayaa guud ahaan hoos u dhac, ma garanaysaa? Tamar badan ma haysto sidii caadiga ahayd. Dhakhtarka: Waan fahmay. Ma ku sameysay wax isbeddel ah daawadaada dhowaan ama ma jiraan walaacyo caafimaad oo cusub oo ay tahay in aan ka warqabno? Bukaanka: Run ahaantii maya, Dhakhtar. Kaliya waxa ihaya waa un waxyaalaha caadiga ah ee dhiig karkayga iyo kolestaroolka. Dhowaan ma aanan billaabin wax cusub. Dhakhtarka: Hagaag, Mr. Teixeira. Iyadoo lagu saleynayo waxaad ii sheegtay, waxaay u muuqataa inaad qabto caabuqa kaadi mareenka, laakiin waxaan u baahannahay inaan sameyno baaritaano si aan u hubinno. Waxaan u baahanahay inaan qaado muunad kaadi ah, iyo laga yaabee xoogaa shaqo dhiig ah si loo eego calaamadaha caabuqa ama arrimo kale. Caadi ma kula tahay taasi? Bukaanka: Wax kasta oo aad u maleyneyso inay fiican yihiin. Kaliya waxaan rabaa inaan xal u helo xanuunkan. Dhowr maalmood ayay i dhibaysay hadda. Dhakhtarka: Dabcan. Waan ogaan doonnaa waxa ay salka ku heyso. Inta ka horreysa, hubi inaad cabto biyo badan si ay u caawiyaan nadiifinta nidaamkaaga kaadida. Isku day inaad iska ilaaliso walxaha wata kafeynka iyo aalkolada, maadaama ay sii kicin karaan kaadi haysta. Bukaanka: Waan sameyn doonaa, Dhakhtar. Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad i aragtay maanta. Dhakhtarka: Adaa mudan, Mr. Teixeira. Waxaanaad ugu dedaali doonnaa inaan sida ugu dhaqsaha ugu soo roonaato. Aan billaabno baaritaannadaasi, sow ma aha?
en: Doctor: Good morning, Mr. Teixeira. How are you feeling today? Patient: Morning, Doctor. To be honest, not great. I've been having some trouble, especially with my, uh, private area. It's been quite painful when I have to urinate. Doctor: I'm sorry to hear that. Can you describe the pain a bit more for me? Is it a burning sensation, a sharp pain, or something else? Patient: Yeah, it's more of a burning feeling, Doc. Every time I have to go, it's like... fire down there. And I feel like I have to go all the time, even if just a little comes out. Doctor: That sounds uncomfortable. Have you noticed any other symptoms along with the painful urination? Any blood in your urine, or perhaps a foul smell? Patient: No blood that I've seen, thankfully. But there is a bit of a strange smell sometimes. And, uh, I've been sweating a lot more than usual lately, especially at night. Waking up drenched sometimes. Doctor: I see. Increased sweating can sometimes be a sign of infection or other underlying issues. Have you had a fever or felt feverish recently? Patient: Maybe a little warm sometimes, but I haven't taken my temperature. Just feeling generally run down, you know? Not as much energy as usual. Doctor: Understood. And have you had any recent changes in your medication or any new health concerns that we should be aware of? Patient: Not really, Doc. Just the usual stuff for my blood pressure and cholesterol. Haven't started anything new lately. Doctor: Alright, Mr. Teixeira. Based on what you've told me, it sounds like you might have a urinary tract infection, but we'll need to run some tests to be sure. I'll need a urine sample from you, and possibly some blood work to check for signs of infection or other issues. Does that sound okay to you? Patient: Whatever you think is best, Doctor. Just want to get this sorted out. It's been bothering me for a few days now. Doctor: Of course. We'll get to the bottom of it. In the meantime, make sure you're drinking plenty of water to help flush out your system. And try to avoid caffeine and alcohol, as they can irritate the bladder further. Patient: Will do, Doc. Thanks for seeing me today. Doctor: You're welcome, Mr. Teixeira. We'll do our best to get you feeling better soon. Let's get those tests started, shall we?

so: Fahamidda Madax-xanuunkaaga Dhanjafka iyo Natiijooyinka Sheybaarka Waxa Aan Ogaannay Dhiigagii dhowaan lagaa qaaday ayaa muujinaya in wax walba ay ku jiraan heerar caadi ah, taas oo ah war wanaagsan. Tani waxaay ka dhigan tahay inaanan helin wax xaalado caafimaad oo qotodheer, sida dhibaatooyinka tayroodhka ama infekshannada, kuwaas oo sababi kara dhanjafkaaga. Waxa ayTani Ka Dhigan Tahay Dhanjafka waa cudur madax-xanuun oo aasaasi ah. Tani waxaay ka dhigan tahay in madax-xanuunka laftiisu uu yahay arrinta ugu weyn, ee aanu ahayn calaamad cudur kale. Inkastoo ay noqon karto mid niyad jab leh in aan laga helin "xal" fudud baaritaanka dhiigga, waxaay naga caawineysaa inaan si toos ah diiradda u saarno maareynta dhanjafka. Qorshaagaha Dhanjafka Maadaama aan meesha ka saarnay sababaha kale, diiraddayadu waaxay noqon doontaa: Ogaanshaha Waxyaabaha Kiciya: Waxaan si wadajir ah u shaqayn doonaa si aan u ogaano waxa kicin kara dhanjafkaaga. Waxyaabaha caadiga ah ee kiciya dadka da'da ah waxaa ka mid ah isbeddello ku yimaadda hurdada, fuuqbaxa, daawooyinka qaarkood, ama xitaa in aad cunnada mar mar un cuntid . Isbeddelada Hab-nololeedka: Isbeddello fudud sida joogteynta biyo cabidda, ilaalinta jadwal hurdo oo joogto ah, iyo jimicsi fudud ayaa keeni kara isbaddel weyn. Maaraynta Daawooyinka: Waxaan dib u eegi doonnaa daawooyinkaaga aad hadda isticmaasho si aan u hubinno inay kuu yihiin kuwa ugu habboon, annagoo tixgelineyna wixii xaalado caafimaad oo kale ee aad qabto. Mararka qaarkood, daawooyinka jirrooyinka kale waxaay kicin karaan dhanjafka, ama waxaa laga yaabaa inaan u baahanno inaan hagaajinno daaweynta dhanjafkaaga si ay u noqoto mid ammaan ah oo waxtar badan u leh dadka sidaada oo kale da'da. Tallaabooyinka Xiga Heyso buug xusuus qor ah oo aad ku qorto goorta madax-xanuunkaagu billowdo, inta uu socdo, iyo waxa aad samayneysay ama cuneysay ka hor xanuunka. La imoow buuggan xusuus qorka ah ballantaada xigta oo ah 4 toddobaad gudahood. Wac xafiiska haddii madax-xanuunkaagu si weyn isu baddelo, noqdo mid soo noqnoqda, ama haddii aad isku aragto calaamado cusub sida isbeddelka aragga ama daciifnimo. Xusuusnow Dhanjafku wuu isbeddeli karaa inta sii gaboobeyno. Waxaa laga yaabaa inuu noqdo mid aan sidaa u darnayn laakiin soo noqnoqda, ama calaamaduhu ayaa sidoo kale is isbeddeli kara. Markaan si wadajir ah u shaqayno oo aan la soconno calaamadahaaga, waxaan heli karnaa habka ugu wanaagsan ee loo maareeyo dhanjafkaaga loona hagaajiyo tayada noloshaada. Fadlan ii soo sheeg haddii aad qabto wax su'aallo ah. Halkan waxaan u joognaa inaan ku taageerno.
en: Understanding Your Migraine and Lab Results What We Found Your recent blood tests show that everything is within normal ranges, which is good news. This means we haven't found any underlying medical conditions, like thyroid problems or infections, that could be causing your migraines. What This Means Migraines are a primary headache disorder. This means the headaches themselves are the main issue, not a symptom of another disease. While it can be frustrating not to have a simple "fix" from a blood test, it helps us focus on managing the migraines directly. Your Migraine Plan Since we've ruled out other causes, our focus will be on: Identifying Triggers: We'll work together to figure out what might set off your migraines. Common triggers for older adults include changes in sleep, dehydration, certain medications, or even skipping meals. Lifestyle Adjustments: Simple changes like staying hydrated, maintaining a regular sleep schedule, and gentle exercise can make a big difference. Medication Management: We'll review your current medications to ensure they are the best fit for you, considering any other health conditions you may have. Sometimes, medications for other conditions can trigger migraines, or we might need to adjust your migraine treatment to be safer and more effective for your age group. Next Steps Keep a headache diary noting when your headaches start, how long they last, and what you were doing or eating beforehand. Bring this diary to your next appointment in 4 weeks. Call the office if your headaches change significantly, become more frequent, or if you experience new symptoms like vision changes or weakness. Remember Migraines can change as we age. They might become less severe but more frequent, or the symptoms might shift. By working together and monitoring your symptoms, we can find the best way to manage your migraines and improve your quality of life. Please let me know if you have any questions. We are here to support you.

so: Dikt. Wairimu: Subax wanaagsan, Mr. Ramirez. Waa Dikt. Wairimu. Waxaan arkaa inaad xoogaa dhib ah ku qabto neefsashada. Wax yar ma iiga sheegi kartaa waxa ku haya? Mr. Ramirez: Haa, dhakhtar. Waxaan leeyahay taariikhda xanuun oo COPD ah, dhawaanahan na, waxaan dareemayey in neeftu aad iigu xirmiyso in ka badan inta caadiga ah, gaar ahaan marka aan socdo. Waa sida in aanan neef qaadan karin. Dikt. Wairimu: Waa hagaag, waan fahmay. Ma leedahay wax astaamo kale, sida qufac, qandho, ama xabad xanuun? Mr. Ramirez: Waxaan lahaa qufac yar, laakiin waa mid qalalan. Qandho ama xabad xanuun ma lahey laakiin.. Dikt. Wairimu: Waa hagaag. Miyaad si joogto ah u isticmaaleysaa dawooyinkaaga neefta? Mr. Ramirez: Haa, waan isticmaalaa daawooyinkeyga neefta badbaadinta marka aan u baahdo, waxaanan qaataa daawadeyda ilaalinta neefta subax kasta. Dikt. Wairimu: Taasi waa wax wanaagsan. Hadda waxaan dhageysanayaa sambabadaada. Fadlan neef qoto dheer ii qaado? Mr. Ramirez: Haye. (Qaado neef qoto dheer) Dikt. Wairimu: (Oo ku dhageysaneysa sambabada qalabka dhageysiga) Waa hagaag, waxaan xiiq ka maqlayaa laba dhinacba. Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan sammeeyo raajada xabadka si aan u arko haddii uu jiro infekshan ama dheecaan ku jira sambabadaada. Waxaan sidoo kale sammeyn doonaa baaritaanno dhiig si aan u hubinno heerarka oksijiinka oo aan u eegno in uu jiro caabuq. Mr. Ramirez: Waa hagaag, taasi waa wax fiican. Dikt. Wairimu: Inta aan sugayno natiijooyinka, waxaan ku siinayaa daaweynta neefsashada si ay kaaga caawiso furitaanka marinnada neefta. Waa in aad ku yar roonaataa. Mr. Ramirez: Waad ku mahadsan tahay, dhakhtar. Waan kaaga mahadnaqayaa.
en: Dr. Wairimu: Good morning, Mr. Ramirez. I'm Dr. Wairimu. I see you've been having some trouble with your breathing. Could you tell me a little more about that? Mr. Ramirez: Yes, doctor. I have a history of COPD, and lately, I've been feeling more short of breath than usual, especially when I'm walking around. It feels like I just can't catch my breath. Dr. Wairimu: Okay, I understand. Have you had any other symptoms, like a cough, fever, or chest pain? Mr. Ramirez: I've had a bit of a cough, but it's dry. No fever or chest pain, though. Dr. Wairimu: Alright. And have you been using your inhalers regularly? Mr. Ramirez: Yes, I use my rescue inhaler when I need it, and I take my maintenance inhaler every morning. Dr. Wairimu: That's good. I'm going to listen to your lungs now. Can you please take a deep breath for me? Mr. Ramirez: Sure. (Takes a deep breath) Dr. Wairimu: (Listens to lungs with stethoscope) Okay, I hear some wheezing on both sides. I'd like to get a chest X-ray to see if there's any infection or fluid in your lungs. We'll also do some blood work to check your oxygen levels and see if there's any inflammation. Mr. Ramirez: Okay, that sounds fine. Dr. Wairimu: While we wait for the results, I'm going to give you a nebulizer treatment to help open up your airways. It should make you feel a bit better. Mr. Ramirez: Thank you, doctor. I appreciate it.

so: Dikt. Martinez: Subax wanaagsan, Mr. Park. Waan arkaa inaad maanta u joogto tallaaladaada ku jadwaleysan. Mr. Park: Haa, sidaa ayay ila tahay. Run ahaantii, , Dhakhtar, runtii kuma qanacsani tan. Waxaan maqlay sheekooyin badan oo ku saabsan dhakhaatiirta oo ku dhiriigelinaya daaweyn aan loo baahnayn kaliya si ay lacag uga sammeeyaan. Dr. Martinez: Waan fahmay walaacaaga, Mr. Park. Waa wax iska caadi ah in su'aallo la qabo, gaar ahaan dhammaan macluumaadka jira. Ma iiga sheegi kartaa wax dheeri ah oo ku saabsan waxyaabaha gaarka ah ee kaa dhigaya inaad ka digtoonaato? Mr. Park: Hagaag, waxaay la mid tahay mar kasta oo aan soo jeesto, waxaa jira kaniini cusub ama irbad ay isku dayayaan inay naga iibiyaan. Wakhtiga badhkiis, waxaay ogaadaan mardambe inay dhibaato ka badan inta ay xalineyso keento. Way adag tahay in la ogaado cid la aamino. Dr. Martinez: Taasi waa qodob sax ah. Aqoonta caafimaadku mar walba way horumareysaa, mararka qaarkoodna talooyinku way is beddelaan markaan wax badan baranno. Hase yeeshee, tallaaladu waxaay maraan tijaabooyin adag iyo kormeer si loo hubiyo badbaadadooda iyo waxtarkooda. Mr. Park: Waxaa laga yaabaa inay sidaas tahay, laakiin waxaan sidoo kale akhriyey waxyeellooyin aanay kuu sheegin. Ka warran saameynta muddada dheer ee ay leedahay? Runtii ma naqaanno waxa arrintani nagu sammeyneyso mustaqbalka. Dr. Martinez: Waxaan si dhab ah u qaadannaa waxyeellada taban ee ay leeyihiin daawooyinka, waana la liis gareeyey oo laga hadlay. Marka la eego waxyeellooyinka muddada dheer, tallaalo badan ayaa loo isticmaalay tobanaan sano iyadoo leh diiwaanno badbaado oo aad u wanaagsan. Laakiin ugu dambeyntii, go'aanka adigaa leh. Waxaan halkan u joogaa inaan bixiyo macluumaad oo aan ka jawaabo wixii su'aallo ah ee aad qabto si aad u sammeyso doorasho xog-ogaalnimo ku saleysan oo ku saabsan caafimaadkaaga. Mr. Park: Waan kaaga mahadnaqayaa taas, Dhakhtar. Kaliya waxaan rabaa inaan hubiyo inaan la i khiyaameyn. Dr. Martinez: Dabcan. Aan waqti ku qaadanno si aan u eegno tallaallada gaarka ah ee laguugu la taliyey maanta, ka doodno faa'iidooyinka iyo khataraha mid kasta, aanna wax ka qabanno wixii walaac gaar ah ee aad qabto. Waxaan qaadi karnaa hal tallaabo markiiba. Mr. Park: Hagaag, taasi ma xuma. Aan aragno waxa aad hayso.
en: Dr. Martinez: Good morning, Mr. Park. I see you're here for your scheduled vaccinations today. Mr. Park: Yeah, I guess. To be honest, Doc, I'm not really comfortable with this. I've heard a lot of stories about doctors pushing unnecessary treatments just to make a buck. Dr. Martinez: I understand your concerns, Mr. Park. It's completely normal to have questions, especially with all the information out there. Can you tell me more about what specific things make you wary? Mr. Park: Well, it just feels like every time I turn around, there's a new pill or shot they're trying to sell us. And half the time, they find out later it causes more problems than it solves. It's hard to know who to trust. Dr. Martinez: That's a valid point. Medical knowledge is always evolving, and sometimes recommendations do change as we learn more. However, vaccines undergo rigorous testing and monitoring to ensure their safety and effectiveness. Mr. Park: Maybe so, but I've also read about side effects they don't tell you about. And what about the long-term effects? We don't really know what this stuff does to us down the line. Dr. Martinez: We do take potential side effects very seriously, and they are listed and discussed. As for long-term effects, many vaccines have been used for decades with excellent safety records. But ultimately, the decision is yours. I'm here to provide information and answer any questions you have so you can make an informed choice for your health. Mr. Park: I appreciate that, Doc. I just want to make sure I'm not being taken for a ride. Dr. Martinez: Of course. Let's take some time to go through the specific vaccinations recommended for you today, discuss the benefits and risks of each, and address any specific worries you might have. We can take this one step at a time. Mr. Park: Alright, that sounds fair. Let's see what you've got.

so: Ka soo kabashada balwadda opioid-ka waa safar geesinnimo leh, ka bixitaankaaga isbitaalka na waxaay billoow u tahay tallaabo muhiim ah oo aad horay u qaadday. Xusuusnoow in dib-u-dhacu uu qayb ka yahay geedi-socodka soo kabashada. Marka samir oo u naxariiso naftaada inta aad wajaheyso wejigaan cusub ee noloshaada. Waxaan kugu la talineynaa in aad la xiriirto koox taageero sida Narcotics Anonymous ama sahmiso daaweynta shakhsi ahaaneed si loo dhiso nidaam taageero oo xoog leh, loola na yimaado habab la qabsi oo caafimaad leh. Waxaa kale oo muhiim ah in la aqoonsado waxyaabaha kugu kicinaya ficilladan isla markaana la sammeeyo qorshe si wax ku ool ah loogu maareeyo, haddii ay tahay jimicsiga maskaxda, tagidda goobaha bandhigyada hal-abuurka ama la xidhiidhidda saaxib la aamini karo ama xubin qoyska ka tirsan. Ka taxaddar caafimaadkaaga jirka adigoo cunaya cunnooyin nafaqo leh, helaya hurdo kugu filan kana qayb qaadanaya dhaqdhaqaaqa jireed ee joogtada ah. Haddii aad isku aragto damac ama calaamado ka ka noqosho safarkani ah, ha ka gabanin in aad caawimo weydiisato. Waxaa jira ilo diyaar u ah in ay kaa taageeraan tallaabo kasta oo aad qaadeyso. Xusuusnoow inaadan kaligaa ku ahayn safarkan. Haddii aad dedaasho aadna taageero hesho waxaad dhisi kartaa nolol dhammeystiran oo ka xor ah maandooriye. Markaad horay u socoto dirradda saar yoolal yar yar oo la gaari karo, oo u dabbaal deg guulahaaga si kasta oo ay u yar yihiin. Dhisidda qaab nololeed caafimaad leh waxaay qaadataa waqti iyo dedaal laakiin faa'iidoooyinka soo kabashada waa mid aan la qiyaasi karin. La saaxib dad nololshaada wax ka baddelaya, raadso na hawlo kuu keenaya farxad iyo raynrayn. Waad leedahay awood iyo adkeysi aad uga gudubto caqabaddan oo aad naftaada ugu abuurto mustaqbal ifaya.
en: Recovering from an opioid addiction is a courageous journey, and your discharge from the hospital marks an important step forward. Remember that setbacks are part of the recovery process, so be patient and compassionate with yourself as you navigate this new chapter. We recommend connecting with a support group like Narcotics Anonymous or exploring individual therapy to build a strong support system and develop healthy coping mechanisms. It's also crucial to identify your triggers and create a plan to manage them effectively, whether it's through mindfulness exercises, creative outlets, or reaching out to a trusted friend or family member. Be mindful of your physical health by eating nutritious meals, getting enough sleep, and engaging in regular physical activity. If you experience cravings or withdrawal symptoms, don't hesitate to reach out for help; there are resources available to support you every step of the way. Remember, you are not alone in this journey, and with dedication and support, you can build a fulfilling and substance-free life. As you move forward, focus on small, achievable goals and celebrate your successes, no matter how small they may seem. Building a healthy lifestyle takes time and effort, but the rewards of recovery are immeasurable. Surround yourself with positive influences and seek out activities that bring you joy and fulfillment. You have the strength and resilience to overcome this challenge and create a brighter future for yourself.

so: Lammaanaha: Kaliya gariir ma ahan, Sunita! Gacantaadu saaka way isku laaban tahay gebi ahaanba. Xataa ma qabsan kartid koobkaaga bunka! Bukaanka: Xoogaa way adkaatay, waa un intaa. Waxyar kaddib way furfurantay. Lammaanaha: Maxayse yihiin casiraadaha lugta? Habeenkii siqda dhexe ayaad soo kacdaa adigoo qeylinaya. Bukaanka: Haye, haye, mararka qaar waxaan helaa casiraadaha lugta (charley horse). Qof kastaa way ku dhacaan. Kalkaaliyaha: Subax wanaagsan, waxaan ahay Kalkaaliye Miller. Maxaay maanta dhibaatada laga yaabo in ay idiin heysato? Lammaanaha: Wuxuu lahaa casiraad dhanka muruqyada, kalkaaliye. Kuwo xun. Bukaanka: Wax weyn ma aha runtii. Xaaskaygu aad bay u welwelsan tahay. Kalkaaliyaha: Hagaag, aan eegno, diyaar miyaa? Ma ii sharrixi kartaa casiraadaha, Sunita? Goorme ayaad isku aragtaa? Intee in le'eg ayay kugu raagaan? Bukaanka: Inta badan gacantayda midig, mararka qaarkood bidixdeyda. Iyo kubbadayda. Badanaa waxaan isku arkaa markaan muddo dheer fadhiyo, sida marka aan koombuyuutarka aadka u isticmaalayo. Waxaay raagaan dhowr daqiiqadood, ka dibna way tagaan. Kalkaaliyaha: Iyo xanuunka? Ku qiyaas 1 ilaa 10? Bukaanka: Malaha 3 ama 4? Waa wax laga xumaado marka laga tago xanuunka badan. Lammaanaha: Wuu dhayalsanayaa! Xalay wuxuu ku sigtay inuu ilmeeyo! Bukaanka: Lei, fadlan... Kalkaaliyaha: Waa hagaag. Waxaan qaadi doonnaa baaritaanno waxaana arki doonaa waxa socda. Hadda se, isku day inaad ka nasato kombiyuutarkaaga saacad kasta ama wax ka badan si aad isku kala bixiso. Sidoo kale cab biyo badan. Bukaanka: Ma aragtaa? Waxaan kuu sheegay inaysan wax halis ahayn. Kaliya waxaad u baahan tahay inaad cabto biyo badan. Lammaanaha: Waan arki doonnaa waxa dhakhtarku yiraahdo. Kaliya waxaan rabaa inaan hubiyo inaad fiican tahay. Bukaanka: Waan fiicanahay, macaanto. Runtii.
en: Spouse: It's not just twitching, Sunita! Your hand was completely curled up this morning. You couldn't even hold your coffee mug! Patient: It was a little stiff, that's all. It loosened up after a while. Spouse: And what about the leg cramps? You've been waking up screaming in the middle of the night! Patient: Okay, okay, so I get a charley horse sometimes. Everyone gets those. Nurse: Good morning, I'm Nurse Miller. What seems to be the trouble today? Spouse: He's been having muscle spasms and cramps, nurse. Bad ones. Patient: It's really not a big deal. My wife just worries too much. Nurse: Well, let's take a look, shall we? Can you describe the spasms for me, Sunita? When do they happen? How long do they last? Patient: Mostly in my right hand, sometimes my left. And my calves. They usually happen when I've been sitting for a long time, like when I'm coding. They last a few minutes, then go away. Nurse: And the pain? On a scale of 1 to 10? Patient: Maybe a 3 or 4? It's annoying more than painful. Spouse: He's downplaying it! Last night he was practically in tears! Patient: Lei, please... Nurse: It's alright. We'll run some tests and see what's going on. In the meantime, try to take breaks from your computer every hour or so to stretch. And drink plenty of water. Patient: See? I told you it was nothing serious. Just need to drink more water. Spouse: We'll see what the doctor says. I just want to make sure you're okay. Patient: I'm fine, honey. Really.

so: Bixiyaha adeegga: Subax wanaagsan. Waxaan dareemayaa inaad halkan u joogto baaritaan tijaabada caafimaad ee nidaamka irbad-turidda dhuunta. Magacaygu waa Dikt. Martin. Bukaanka: Haa, taasi waa sax. Waxaan ahay Xamiid. Kani waa ninkayga, Pierre. Bixiyaha adeegga: Waan ku faraxsanahay inaan idin la kulmo labadiinnaba. Xamiid, ma ii sheegi kartaa wax yar oo ku saabsan waxa maanta halkaan ku keenay? Xamiid: Waa hagaag, waxaan isku arkay buro qoortayda ah dhowr toddobaad kahor. Dhakhtarkaygu wuxuu igula taliyay in la baaro, wuxuuna ii sheegay tijaabadan. Bixiyaha adeegga: Waan arkaa. Pierre, sidee ayay kula tahay waxaa oo dhan? Pierre: Run ahaantii, aad baan u werwersanahay. Waa uun... lama filaan, ma ogtahay? Bixiyaha adeegga: gebi ahaanba waa wax la fahmi karo inaad dareento walaac, Pierre. Waxaan halkan u joognaa inaan kula socodsiinno wax walba oo aan xaqiijinno inaad hesho dhammaan macluumaadka aad u baahan tahay. Xamiid, ma ku aragtay wax kale oo isbedel ah ama astaamo dhowaanahan? Xamiid: Maya runtii, kaliya burada. Wax xanuun ah malaha ama wax kale. Bixiyaha adeegga: Hagaag. Kahor intaanan sii wadin baaritaanka, waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan wax yar sharraxo habka nidaamka irbad-duridda dhuunta iyo waxa tijaabada caafimaad ay ku saabsan yahay. Taasi caadi ma kula tahay? Xamiid: Haa, fadlan. Bixiyaha adeegga: Waa diyaar. Marka, FNA waa nidaam caadi ah oo loo isticmaalo in lagu baadho burooyinka ama cufka. Waxaay ku lug leedahay isticmaalka irbad dhuuban si looga soo saaro saambal unugyada burooyinka si loo baaro. Tijaabada bukaan-socodka ayaa ujeedadeedu tahay in la qiimeeyo farsamo cusub oo lagu samaynayo FNA taas oo laga yaabo inay wanaajiso saxnaanta iyo raaxada bukaanka. Pierre: Ma xanuun baa? Bixiyaha adeegga: Bukaannada badankoodu waxaay soo sheegaan raaxo la'aan yar, oo la mid ah dhiig qaadista. Waxaan isticmaalnaa suuxinta maxaliga ah si aan u kabuubinno aagga nidaamka kahor. Xamiid: Waa maxay khataraha marka? Bixiyaha adeegga: Sida nidaam kasta oo caafimaad, waxaa jira khatarro ku lug leh, sida dhiig-bax ama caabuq, laakiin waa dhif. Waxaan si faahfaahsan uga gudbi doonnaa foomka ogolaanshaha si qoto-dheer si aad uga warqabto wax walba ka hor intaadan go'aan gaarin. Pierre: Hagaag, taasi waxaay u egtahay mid macquul ah. Bixiyaha adeegga: Xamiid, wax su'aallo ah ama walaac ah ma qabtaa ilaa hadda? Xamiid: Hadda maya. Waxaan u maleynayaa inaan u gudbo inaan sii wado baaritaanka. Bixiyaha adeegga: Hagaag, aan billowno marka. Waxaan u baahanahay inaan baaro burada oo aan ku weydiiyo dhowr su'aalood oo dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan taariikhdaada caafimaad. Pierre, xor u noqo inaad waydiiso su'aallo kasta oo laga yaabo in aad qabto inta uu nidaamka socdo. Waxaan halkan u joognaa inaan labadiinnaba idiin ka taageerno nidaamkan.
en: Provider: Good morning. I understand you're here for the clinical trial screening for the fine-needle aspiration procedure. My name is Dr. Martin. Patient: Yes, that's correct. I'm Hamid. This is my husband, Pierre. Provider: Nice to meet you both. Hamid, could you tell me a bit about what brings you here today? Hamid: Well, I found a lump in my neck a few weeks ago. My doctor recommended getting it checked out, and mentioned this trial. Provider: I see. Pierre, how are you feeling about all of this? Pierre: Honestly, I'm pretty worried. It's just... unexpected, you know? Provider: It's completely understandable to feel anxious, Pierre. We're here to walk you through everything and make sure you have all the information you need. Hamid, have you noticed any other changes or symptoms recently? Hamid: Not really, just the lump. It doesn't hurt or anything. Provider: Okay. Before we proceed with the screening, I'd like to explain a bit about the fine-needle aspiration procedure and what the clinical trial involves. Would that be alright? Hamid: Yes, please. Provider: Great. So, FNA is a common procedure used to investigate lumps or masses. It involves using a thin needle to extract a sample of cells from the lump for examination. The clinical trial aims to evaluate a new technique for performing FNA that may improve accuracy and patient comfort. Pierre: Is it painful? Provider: Most patients report only mild discomfort, similar to a blood draw. We use local anesthesia to numb the area beforehand. Hamid: And what are the risks? Provider: As with any medical procedure, there are some risks involved, such as bleeding or infection, but they are rare. We'll go over the consent form in detail so you're fully aware of everything before making a decision. Pierre: Okay, that sounds reasonable. Provider: Hamid, do you have any questions or concerns at this point? Hamid: Not right now. I think I'm ready to proceed with the screening. Provider: Alright then. Let's get started. I'll need to examine the lump and ask you a few more questions about your medical history. Pierre, feel free to ask any questions you may have along the way. We're here to support both of you through this process.
