so: Turku waa magaaladda Finland ugu da'ada weyn waana dalka magaalo madaxdiisii hore.
en: Turku is the oldest city of Finland and the former capital of the country.

so: Turku waxay ku taalaa gobolka Varsinais-Suomi waana magaalo madaxda gobolka Galbeedka.Finland (Länsi-Suomi)
en: Turku is located in the region of Southwest Finland and it is the capital of the Province of Western Finland.

so: Turku waa magaalo si sharciyeysan laba af loogaga hadlo, dadka deggana ilaa 5% ayaa ku hadla af iswidhishka.
en: Turku is officially a bilingual city and roughly 5% of its inhabitants speak Swedish as their mother tongue.

so: Turku waxaa deggan qowmiyaddo kala duduwan ooka kala yimid ilaa iyo 130 dal oo kala duwan.
en: There are 130 different nationalities living in Turku.

so: Kooxaha jinsiyadaha ee ugu waaweyn ee Turku deggani waa Ruush, Istooniyaan, Ciraaq, Iiraan, Soomaali iyo Iswidhish.
en: The biggest ethnic groups in Turku are Russian, Estonian, Iraqi, Iranian, Somali and Swedish communities.

so: Sooyaalka magaaladda inta badan waxaa laga bilaabaa xaanshidii uu baadarigga Gregorius IX siiyey ogolaansha in uu Turku agagaarkeeda ku wareejinayo kanniisadda fadhigga biishobkan hadda.
en: Many consider that the history of the city begins with a letter, in which Pope Gregory IX gave the permission to move the bishopric to what we nowadays know as Turku.

so: Turku waxay aheyd magaaladda Finland ugu weyn sidoo kalena boqortooyadda iswidhishka magaalooyinka ugu waaweyn uguna muhiimsan.
en: Turku was the biggest city of Finland and it was also one of the largest and most important medieval cities of the whole Swedish kingdom.

so: Ereyggaturku waxay ka timid ereygga qadiimi ah oo ruushka ah ee tǔrgǔ, kaas oo looga jeedosuuq.
en: The word turku comes from tǔrgǔ, a word in Ancient Russian which means ”market place” i.e. tori in Finnish.

so: Gaaddiidka wanaagsan ee isgag dhex goosh awgeed ayaa magaaladda waxaa u soo guurey dad badan, khaas ahaan baayac mushtari.
en: Thanks to the good transport connections many people and specially merchants moved to Turku.

so: Tartiibtartiib ayey magaaladdii u kortey una taajirtey.
en: Little by little the city grew bigger and became wealthier.

so: Badhtamaha magaaladda turku waxay ku wareegsaneyd kanniisada (tuomiokirkko).
en: In those days the city centre was located around the Turku Cathedral.

so: Inta ugu badan guryaha iyo dhismayaashaba waxaa laga dhisey qoryo sababtaas ayuuna u badnaa dabku ama gubshada guryuhu.
en: Most houses and buildings were built from wood and therefore there were also many fires.

so: Magaaladda agteeda qasrigga Turku (Turun linna) oo muhiim u ahaa awoodda ugu muhiimsan ee saldhigga u ah Finland agagaarkeeda.
en: The Turku Castle, which was located near the city, was one of the most important strongholds of secular power on Finnish soil.

so: Difaac siinta qasrigaasi isagoo jiraa xataa magaaladdu marar badan waxay noqotey goob dagaal.
en: Despite the cover given by the castle, the city ended up being the main stage for many wars in the Middle Ages.

so: Tusaale ahaan dawladda hoose laga asaasey Turku sanadkii 1617 oo markii ugu horeysey maxkamadda rafcaanka ee Finland la furey sanadkii 1623 kii.
en: For example, the provincial governement was established in Turku in 1617, and Finland's first court of appeal, the Turun hovioikeus, was founded in 1623.

so: Boqoradda iswidhishka ayaa amartey in laga aasaaso Turku Finland markii ugu horeysey jaamacad, akademiyada Turku, sanadkii 1640 kii.
en: In 1640, the Queen of Sweden ordered the first university in Finland, the Royal Academy of Turku, to be established in Turku.

so: Sanadihii 1808-1809 waxaa lala dagaalamey Iswidhan iyo Ruushka, kaas oo kalifey in ay Finland ka soo wareegto Iswidhan una soo wareegto oo ay hoos timaado xukunka ruushka.
en: In the years 1808-1809, Sweden and Russia fought a war as a result of which Finland was ceded to Russia.

so: Finnishka waxaa xukunkiisa qabsadey boqor Ruush ah finnishkuna waxay noqdeen bulsho ruush ah
en: Thus the Russian Emperor became the ruler of Finland and Finns became Russian citizens.

so: Turku waxay noqotey sanadkii 1809 kii gobolka ugu ballaadhan ee ammiradda goobta ku sii simidda dowladda Finland ujeedauna tahay magaalo madaxda Finland.
en: In 1809, Turku became the capital of an autonomous Finland and the central government of the Grand Duchy was placed in the city.

so: Turku waxay aheyd goob taariikhi ah sababtoo ah xafiisyadii muiimka ahaa ee ku yaaley.
en: Because of its historical status, there were already important offices in Turku.

so: Fadhigii kanniisadaha biishobka iyadoo uu jiro xataa xunbnaha dowladda dhexe iyo akedemiyadii Turku ugu dambeyntii waxaa loo wareejiyey magaalo madaxdii cusbeyd sanadkii 1827 gubashadii ay Turku gubatey ka dib.
en: Except for the seat of the Archbishop, all the other institutions of central government and the Royal Academy of Turku were moved to the new capital after the Great Fire of Turku in 1827.

so: Wadamadda galbeedka taariikhdoodii oo baaba'adey gubashadii magaaladda ka dib waxaa u dajiyey saldhig kanal oo cusubTurku Carl Ludvig Engel.
en: After the Great Fire, which was the most disastrous in the history of Nordic countries, the new city plan was designed by the architect Carl Ludwig Engel.

so: Qarnigii- 1820 Finland oo dhami waxay aheyd ilaa hal milyan. Turku waxaa xilligaa deganaa 12 000.
en: In the 1820's, there were approximately one million people living in Finland and 12 000 in Turku.

so: Turku waxay ilaa 1840 aheyd weli magaaladda Finland ugu weyn.
en: Turku was the biggest city in Finland until the 1840's.

so: Turku waxaa ka shaqeeya shabakadda gaadiidka maxaligga ah waxayna Turku ku taalaa meel gaadiidkeeda looga gooshi karo meel kasta oo Finlana ah.
en: Turku has an efficient network of public transport and the city is well connected to other parts of Finland.

so: Gaadiika dadweynaha ee Turku iyo nawaaxigeeda, Föli ayaad ka heli kartaa warbixinta jidadka Turku iyo Turku nawaaxigeedda.
en: Using the Turku region public transport service, Föli, you can search for information on travel routes in Turku and in the Turku Region.

so: Adeegga ayaa kuu soo bandhigaya, sidaad meel walba iskaga gudbi laheyd gaadiidka dadweynaha.
en: The service helps you to find your way from one place to another by using public buses.

so: Waxaad gaadiidka daweynaha ku bixin kartaa kaash ama kaadhka baska. Kaadhka baska waxaad ka iibsan kartaa xafiiska adeegga.
en: When travelling on public buses, you can pay by cash or by a travel card, which you can buy at a service counter.

so: Kaadhka baska waxaad ka buuxsan kartaa xafiiska ama baska dhexdiisa.
en: You can load your travel card at a service counter or on the bus.

so: Wixii warbixin dheeraad ah ee la xidhiidha iibka- goobta buuxinta waxaad ka heleysaa bogga internetka ee Föli.
en: For more information on sales offices and loading your travel card visit the Föli website.

so: Warbixinta xafiiska adeegga gaadiidka dadweynahu waa:
en: Contact information for the public transport service office:

so: Turku waxaa ku yaala wadooyin- iyo gaadiid xidhiidh ah oo aad u wanaagsan dhinac kasta oo Finland ah, khaas ahaan magaalo madaxda nawaaxigeeda iyo Helsinki.
en: Turku is well connected by road and public transport, and it is easy to travel from Turku to different parts of Finland and specially to the capital region and Helsinki.

so: Sidoo kale Turku waxaa ku yaala gego dayuuradeed oo dalka iyo dibadaba looga dhoofo.
en: Turku also has an airport that operates domestic and international flights.

so: Gaadiidka Finland waa midigle.
en: In Finland, traffic drives on the right.

so: Xusuusnow in aad xilligga mugdigga isticmaashid bidhaanta, kaas kaa caawinaya in lagu arko markaad socoto.
en: During the dark seasons, remember to use a reflector, which will help you to be seen in traffic.

so: Wadayaashu kuwa bidhaanta isticmaalaya waxay arkaan saddex laab in ka fog kuwa aan bidhaanta xidhneyn.
en: Motorists can distinguish someone using a reflector from three times further away than someone without one.

so: Baaskiilka markaad wadatid isticmaal koofiyadda adan ee madaxa ka difaacda jugta.
en: When riding a bicycle, you should use a helmet.

so: Warbixinta badbaadadda jidadka ee Finland iyo- habdhaqankoodaba waxaad ka heleysaa bogga badbaadadda gaadiidka.
en: You can find information about Finnish traffic safety and behaviour at the traffic safety website of Liikenneturva

so: Turku waxaa ka howlgala bulshooyin diimo kala gedisan leh. Turku waxaa ku yaala meelo badan oo lagu caabudo diimaha kala gedisa iyo xarumo waxqabad.
en: There are many different active religious communities and temples as well as several activity centres of different religions in Turku.

so: Warbixinta diimaha Finland- adeeggooda waxaad ka raadin kartaa bulshooyin diimeedyada iyo hadba degmadda deegaankaagga.
en: For information on religious communities in different regions visit the website of The Religions in Finland Project.

so: Akhriso kuwaana: Dhaqamada iyo diimaha ka jira Finland
en: For more information: Cultures and religions in Finland

so: Waxaana ka tirsan 67 xubnood, kuwaas oo ka kala wakiil ah kooxo siyaasadeed oo kala duduwan, golaha waxaa lagu doortaa doorashada golaha deegaanka afartii sanaba mar.
en: The highest decision-making authority in terms of the city's operations is the City Council, which has a total of 67 Council members representing different political groups.

so: Bogaa magaaladda ayaad wixii warbixin ah ka heli kartaa golaha deegaanka ee magaaladda iyo goa'aan qaadashadooda xafiiskooda gurigga magaaladda ee cinwaankiisu yahay Aurakatu 2.
en: The Council is elected in municipal elections that take place every four years. For more information on the City Council and its decisions made in the town hall at Aurakatu 2 go to the website of the City of Turku.

so: Qoraaladda laga soo ururiyo shirarka waa la tusaa dadweynaha maalinta shirka usbuuca ku xiga khamiistiisaba kooxda maamulka ee goobta Turku. Qoraalka waxaa sidoo kale laga helaa bogga internetka ee magaaladda Turku.
en: The protocols made on the meetings are held on public display at the City Administration's Turku-piste service point usually on the Thursday following the week when the meeting was held.

so: Nuorten ideat.fi –boggiisa waxaad ku sheegi kaetaa fikiradaadda adiga arrimaha ku khuseeya, kuwa la xidhiidha deegaanka degmadaadda.Nuorten ideat.fi waa bog internet ah, kaas oo dhallinyaraddu ay ku sameyn karaan aragtiyo nidaam wax hagaajin ah ayna sidoo kale komment ka siin karaan kuwa kale fikradohooda.
en: On the Nuortenideat.fi website, you can express your opinions on issues that concern you and are related to your own home municipality. Nuortenideat.fi is an Internet website where young people can make various suggestions for improvements and comment on ideas presented by others.

so: Boggan waxaad ka heleysaa warbixinno wakhti qaadashadda xilliyadda fasaxa ah ee Turku.
en: This page contains information on leisure time activities in Turku.

so: Wixii kale ee warbixin muhiim ah ee arrintan la xidhiidha waxaad ka heleysaaboggan Waqtiyada firaaqada
en: For more important information on the topic see the page Leisure.

so: Carruurta iyo dhallinyaraddu waxay xiiseeyaan ee ay ku madadaashaan
en: Hobbies for children and young people

so: Luuppi - Ururka dhaqamadda kala duduwan ee waxbarashada dadka waaweyn/työväenopisto
en: The Loupe - a multicultural team at Turku's adult education centres

so: Wadashaqeynta ururadda - dhaqamadda kala duduwan
en: Associations - multiculture in cooperation

so: Turku muuqaalkeeda, xowligga ah iyo waayoarragnimadeedda dhaqan waxay fidisaa doorashooyin fara badan oo noocyo badan
en: Turku's vibrant, eventful, and high-class cultural life offers alternatives for all tastes.

so: Xilliyadda guga- iyo deyrta waxaausbuuc walba la qorsheeyaa sinfonia-, kamarimuusig- iyo ruwaayaddo lagu madadaasho.
en: In the spring and autumn seasons, symphony, chamber music and popular music concerts are held almost weekly.

so: Riwaayaddo bilaash ah waxaad ka daawan kartaa internetka kuwo lagu keydiyey shabakadda ama kuwo toos loo bandhigayo
en: Free internet concerts can be watched online either recorded or live.

so: Orkestarigga filharmonigga Turku waa kan Finland ugu da'ada weyn.
en: The Turku Philharmonic Orchestra is Finland's oldest orchestra.

so: Jiridoodu waxay ka soo alkunmeen sanadkii 1790 ki.
en: Its roots date back to 1790.

so: Orkestarigga goobtiisa riwaayadaha ee ugu weyn waxaa la diyaariyey sanadkii 1952 dii waanagurigga riwaayadaha ee Turku.
en: Its main place of performance has been Turku Concert Hall, since it was built in 1952.

so: Tigidhadda riwaayadaha Turku filharmoni orkestarigeedda waxaa lagu iibiyaa barta tigidhadda iyo gurigga riwaayadaha ee ku yaalaa Ars Musica- dukaanka dhaqanka.
en: Tickets to concerts by the Turku Philharmonic Orchestra are sold by Lippupiste the Ars Musica cultural shop located in the Concert Hall.

so: Sidoo kale tigidhka waxaad ka iibsan kartaa albaabka saacad ka hor inteynan riwaayaddu bilaabanin.
en: Tickets can also be bought at the door one hour before the concert.

so: Musiyamka Wäinö Aaltonen tallaada kasta iyo Sibelius- musiyamkiisa waxaa laga tumaa riwaayadahoodda oo xidhiidha iyo arbaca kasta.
en: Concerts are also held at the Wäinö Aaltonen Museum on Tuesdays and the Sibelius Museum holds its own series of concerts on Wednesdays.

so: Kanniisadaha iyo Vanha Raatihuone ga waxaa lagu diyaariyaa riwaayaddo fara badan.
en: Many more concerts are held in churches and at Vanha Raatihuone.

so: Diyaarinta muusigga fudud waxaa ka masuul ah kilabyo badan iyo waxyaalaha
en: Numerous clubs and other event organisers are responsible for the light music offering.

so: Tiyaatarka, tiyaataradda qoob ka ciyaarka iyo filimadda/ shaneemooyinka
en: Theatre, dance theatre and movies

so: Tiyaatarka waa la soo daawan kartaa sida.Tiyaatarka magaaladda, tiyaatarka Åbo Svenska Teatern, Linnateatteri iyo Tehdasteatteri iyo sidoo kale xagaa kasta tiyaatarradda xagaagga.
en: Theatrical performances can be viewed at, for example, the City Theatre, Åbo Svenska Teater, Linnateatteri, Tehdasteatteri and, in summer, the Summer Theatre.

so: Tiyaatarka qoob ka ciyaarku wuxuu diyaariyaa Aurinkobaletti ja Tanssiteatteri Eri.
en: Dance theatre is offered by Aurinkobaletti and Dance Theatre Eri.

so: Sidoo kale Turku waxaa jira kuwa sida firfircoon u xiiseeya boombalooyinka/ madaamadaha- tiyaatarkooda wax qabadka .
en: Turku also has active puppet theatre and amateur dramatics.

so: Turku waxaa kaloo jira tiyaatarka shaneemooyinka ee Finnkino iyo kooxo shaneemooyin kala duduwan.
en: Turku also has the Finnkino Cinema and a range of film clubs.

so: Turku waxaa jira muusiyamyo aad u xiiso badan, kuwaas oo aad ku baran kartid taariikhda Finland, finnishka caadooyin dhaqmeedkoodii, hidahoodii iyo farshaxanadoodii iyo sidoo kale dabiicigga Finland.
en: Turku has many museums where you can learn about Finnish history, Finnish customs, folk traditions and art as well as Finnish nature.

so: Sidoo kale arrimahan ereyadda udubka u ah.
en: At the same time, you can learn the key vocabulary of the subjects.

so: Farshaxanka waxaad uga bogi doontaa Wäinö Aaltonen muusiyamka, Muusiyamka farshaxanka Turku waa, Ars Novassa ja galleriyadda.
en: Art can be admired at Wäinö Aaltonen Museum, Turku Art Museum, Ars Nova and in galleries.

so: Turku muusiyamkiisa bayolajigu waxaad ku baran karyaa muusiyamka iyo haddii aad booqatid dabiiciigga Finlandmuuqaalkiisa dabiiciigga ee noocyadda badan iyo xayawaanka kala duduwan.
en: The Turku Biological Museum acquaints its visitors with Finnish nature, key types of landscape and different species of fauna.

so: Carwooyinka waxaa kale oo dheer muusiyanyada waxaa jooga hanuuniyayaal aad u badan oo kala duduwan, goobo shaqooyin lagu sameeyo iyo dhacdooyinno da'a kastaba leh.
en: In addition to exhibitions, the museums offer several different kinds of events, guided tours and workshops for all ages.

so: Kuralan Kylämäki waa meel qoyska oo dhani ay dhaqan ahaan ugu dalxiisi karaan.
en: Kuralan Kylämäki is an area of recreational culture for the whole family.

so: Kurala agagaarkeedda waxaa lagu lugeyn karaa xilliyadda sanadka oo dhan waxaana loogu wakhti qaadan karaa maalinjoog ahaan ama la soo barbaran karaa xoolaha beerta jooga.
en: You can visit the area of Kurala all year round, have a picnic there or get to know the animals on the farm.

so: Xagaagii iyo xilligga dhacdooyinka Kurala waxaad ku barbaran kartaa qarnigii 1950 kii nolol maalmeedka beeraleydu siduu ahaa iyadoo hanuuniye ku hagayso, si aad ula socotid bandhigyada shaqooyinka iyo la tijaabiyo xirfadaha wixii gacanta laga qabanayo.
en: In summer, and during events, you can learn about life on a 1950s farm on a guided tour, watch displays of work and try out your own handicraft skills.

so: Kurala shaqooyinkeeda tijaabada ah waxay diyaariyaan shaqo barasho iyo koorsooyin xilliyadda sanadka oo dhan.
en: Kurala's experimental workshop organises workshops and courses all year round.

so: Cinwaanadda muusiyamka, xilliyadda ay furran yihiiniyo qiimaha tigidhadaba waxaad ka heleysaa muusiyamyada bogagoodda internetka.
en: The addresses, opening hours and ticket prices are listed on the museums' web pages.

so: Logomo waa goobti hore ee VR:ta barashadda mishiinadooda imikana waa xarunta dhexe ee dhaqanka.
en: Logomo is a former workshop of Finnish Railways and now a culture centre.

so: Halkaas waxaa lagu diyaariyaa dhacdooyi fara badan oo kala duduwan, sida carwooyinka farshaxanadda, riwaayadaha iyo dhacdooyin dhaqameedyo kala duduwan.
en: It hosts many different kinds of events such as art exhibitions, concerts and other cultural functions.

so: Tiyaataradda magaaladda Turku carwooyinkooda waxaa lagu soo bandhigaa Logomo sanadihii u dhexeeyey 2014-2016, sababtoo ah dhismihii tiyaatarka ayaa dib u habeyn lagu sameynayaa.
en: The performances of the Turku City Theatre are being held at Logomo from 2014 to 2016, as the theatre's own building is undergoing renovation.

so: Laybererigu waa buugaagta, dhaqanka iyo dadku meelaha ay ku kulmaan.
en: Libraries are the meeting places of books, cultures and people.

so: Laybererigga magaaladda Turku waxaa kale oo hoos yimaada leybereeriyaal oo dhowr ah oo ku kala yaal dhinacyada magaaladda kan ugu weynise wuxuu ku yaalaa magaaladda badhtameheedda.
en: Several branch libraries all over Turku are a part of the Turku City Library, as is the main library in the city centre.

so: Sidoo kale gaadiidka leybareigga ayaa wareegga magaaladda oo dhan.
en: In addition to this, mobile libraries travel around the city.

so: Akhrisan kartaa bugaagta iyo jaraa'idka finnishka ah iy kuwa afafka ajnabiga ku qoranba
en: read books and magazines in Finnish and other languages

so: Isticmaali kartaa combuyuutarka iyo internetkaba
en: use a computer and the Internet

so: Kaga akhrisan kartaa barnaamijka- PressDisplay jaraa'idka adduunka oo dhan
en: Read international newspapers using the PressDisplay program

so: Kaga qeyngeli kartaa dhacdooyinka iyo wax qabadyada kaleba
en: participate in various events and lectures

so: Wax ku baran kartaa wakhtina ku qaadan kartaa
en: Study and hang out.

so: Booqashada leybarerigga, ka soo deynsashada buugaagta iyo isticmaalka combuyuutarkuba waa lacag la'aan.
en: Visiting a library, borrowing books and using its computers are free of charge.

so: Qofkasta oo haysta kaadhka leybarerigu, wuu u deynsan karaa gurigiisa buugaag, muusig, filimaan iyo waxyaalo kaleba waana lacag la'aan.
en: Everyone who has a library card can borrow books, CDs, DVDs and other material free of charge.

so: Turku kaadhka leybarerigga waxaad ku heleysaa oo kale kaadhka adeegga dhaqamadda, kaas oo e-mailkaagga laguugu soo dirayo warbixinnadda dhacdooyinka xilligaas taagan ee magaalada Turku dhaqamadda ay qorsheyneyso iyo qiimayaasha is bedbdelaya oo aad u fara badan.
en: In Turku you can also add the Culture Card feature to your library card and by so doing you will receive e-mail updates about Turku's abundant cultural offerings and ever-changing range of benefits and offers.

so: Leybarerigu wax kale oo uu kireeyaa qolol shir oo kala waaweyn-, dhacdooyin-, iyo meelo carwooyinka lagu soo ban dhiggo.
en: The library can also be hired for meetings, events and exhibitions of different sizes.

so: Warbixinta leybarerigga weyn ee Turku waa:
en: Contact information of the Turku City Library:

so: Turku waxay diyaarisaa fursado jimicsiyo oo aad u wanaagsan xilliyadda sanadka oo dhan.
en: Turku has an abundance of different sports services to offer all year-round.

so: Magaaladda hareeraheedda oo dhan waxaa ku yaala garoomo lagu ciyaaro, goobaha jidh dhiska, goobaha dabaasha, meelaha banaanka ee lagu lugeeyo jidhkana lagu dhiso, goobaha dabiicigga ee lagu lugeeyo, jidadka baaskiiladda iyo xilligga jiilaalka meelaha kabaha seefta ah lagu socdo iyo meelaha hiihtada lagu sameeyo
en: Turku has playing fields, gymnasiums, public swimming pools, fitness tracks, nature trails, cycling trails and, in winter, ice rinks and ski trails.

so: Magaaladda Turkuhoolalkeeda dabaasha iyo kuwa banaanadda waxay u diyaariyaan jimicsiyada biyaha dadka xiiseynaya fursado badan oo jaban.
en: The City of Turku's indoor and outdoor swimming pools offer a wide range of reasonably-priced possibilities to engage in water sports.

so: Hoolka dabaasha ee Impivaara wuxuu fidiyaa sidoo kale dhaqdhaqaaqyo badan oo la hagayo, jimicsiga boodboodka biyaha, iskuulladda dabaasha iyo dabaasha dhallaanka- iyo qoysaska.
en: Impivaara Swimming Pool also arranges guided activity, water aerobics, swimming lessons, baby swimming and family swimming.

so: Petrelius wuxuu fidiyaa sidoo kale boodboodka biyaha toogooyimka dumarka iyo haweenka.
en: Pool offers water aerobics, among other things, as well as special slimming times for men and women.

so: Dabaalaha banaanka ee magaaladda iyo xeebuhu waxay fidiyaan xagaagii fursado dabaalo ah oo heer sare ah.
en: The city's outdoor swimming pools and beaches offer wonderful swimming opportunities in the summer.

so: Turku waxaa ku yaala meelo dhowr ah kubbadda/ banoonigga laliska ah-, kubadda koleygga ah-, tenniska- iyo garoomo kale oo kubbado ah.
en: Turku has many volleyball-, basketball- and tennis courts and pitches for other ball games.

so: Garoomadaas qaarkood isticmaalkoodu dadka oo dhan wey u furran yihiin, xagga garoomadaas qaarkoodna loo ogolaado toogooyin lacag la'aan ah iyo kuwo lacag la bixiyaba.
en: The use of some courts and pitches is open to all, whilst for others you must book times that are either chargeable or free of charge.

so: Turku waxa ku yaala goobaha jidh dhiska oo aad u badan oo ku kala yaala meelo badan oo magaaladda ah.
en: Turku also has many fitness centres all over town.

so: Goobaha jidh dhisyada waxaa lagu diyaariyaa sidoo kale wax qabadyo lagu hagayo iyo goobaha jidh dhisyada oo lagu barbarto koorsooyinka ABC, kuwaas oo lagu baranayo aasaaska.
en: The centres also organise activity with an instructor and ABC courses for fitness centre training, in which the basics of training can be learned.

so: Barxadaha ciyaaraha ee magaaladda badhtamaheeda ku yaala waxay u fidiyaan qof kasta qaabab aad u wanwanaagsan oo ciyaaraha guud ah, jidh dhiska iyo frisbee golofta.
en: The Sports Park in the city centre offers everyone a great setting for athletics, exercise and disc golf.

so: Jiilaalkii qof kasta wuxuu ku socon karaa kabaha safeexadda ah garoomadda barafka ee dabiicigga ah, goobaha la barafeeyo ama Impivaara iyo Varisuo hoolkooda la barafeeyo toogooyinkooda guud ahaaneed.
en: In winter, everyone may skate on natural ice rinks, artificial ice tracks or at public sessions at the Impivaara and Varissuo ice halls.

so: Badhtanmaha magaaladda deeggaanka webigga Aura dhinaciisa waxaa ku yaala noocyo kala duduwan oo loo sameeyey marinadda dhaqamadda jidh dhiska.
en: In the city centre around the banks of the River Aura are cultural fitness trails on different themes.

so: Magaaladda waxaad baran kartaa taalooyinka kalgaceylka, naqshadeynta iyo dhinaca sheekooyinka magaaladda.
en: You can get to know the city through romance, statues, architecture and stories about the city.

so: Khariidadaha waxaad ka heleysaa leybarerigga iyo sidoo kale internetka.
en: You can get maps from the library and the internet.

so: Magaaladda agagaarkeeda waxaa sidoo kale ku yaala goobaha badbaadinta dabiicigga, kuwaas si xor ah loogu leugeyn karo.jidadko Paavo waa kuwo lagu astaameeyey dhulka, kuwaas oo lagu barbarto dabiicigga agtaada ah iyo magaaladda hareeraheeda meelo faro badan oo Turku ah.
en: In the area of the city, there are also many conservation areas in which you can move around freely. 'The Paths of Paavo' are trails marked on the terrain, which introduce people to local nature and the urban environment in different parts of Turku.

so: Marinadaasi waxay muujinayaan dhulka geedaha iyo dhagaxaanta oo buluug loogu midabeeyey orodkana loogu astaameeyey iyo astaamaha baaskiilladda.
en: The trails are marked on trees and rocks with painted blue runner symbols and round signs.

so: Qalabka jimicsigga kireysashadiisa iyo amaahashadiisa
en: The lending and rental of sports equipment

so: Lauste, Varissuon, Pansio iyo Runosmäki goobahooda dhallinyarada waxaad ku deynsan kartaa jimicsigga- iyo qalabka ciyaaraha kaadhka dhallinyarada.
en: From the youth spaces at Lauste, Varissuo, Pansio and Runosmäki , you can borrow sports equipment using a youth card.

so: Kabaha safeexadda waxaad ka kireysan kartaa garoonka Parkki ga, kabaha safeexadda iyo kabaha shaagagga marinka lagu ciyaaro kabah safeexadda ee Kupittaa, Kuwa hiihtada lagu sameeyo ee Impivaara dhulkeeda lagu hiihteeyo iyo sidoo kale jimicsigga- iyo ciyaaraha qalabkooda xarunta adeegga ee jimicsigga adeegooda macaamissha.
en: You can rent skates at the Parkki field, states and rollerskates at Kupittaa skating track, skis at Impivaara skating centre and other sports equipment from Customer Service at the Sports Service Centre.

so: Magaaladda Turku waxay leedahay adeegyo jimicsi lacag la'aan ah iyo kuwo jaban oo loogu talogalay dhammaan kuwa xiiseeya jimicsigga oo dhan.
en: The City of Turku has free-of-charge and reasonably priced sports services for people of all ages.

so: Da'aha kala duduwan goobahooda adeegga jimicsiggu waa kuwo loogu talogaley kuwa sida yar ama marmarka uun jimicsada.
en: The dedicated services for people of different ages are especially meant for those who exercise little or occasionally.

so: Dumarka, ragga dadka waaweyn iyo kooxaha khaaska ahiba waxay helayaan adeegyadda kooxahooda.
en: There are dedicated groups and services for women, men, senior citizens and special groups.

so: Dhinacoogaas ayaadan si fudud uga tijaabin kartaa noocyo jimicsi oo kala duduwan aanad ka heli kartaa mid aad xiiseyso.
en: Through them, you can easily try out different sports and find the hobby you like best.

so: Adeegaagga jimicsigga waxaad sidoo kale ka heleysaa jimicsigga aad u baahan tahay ee kugu haboon.
en: There are also dedicated sports services suitable for those needing exercise.

so: Caawimaadda jimicsigga aad xiiseyneysid si aad u hesho waxaad weydiin kartaa adeegga hagidda jimicsigga ee lacag la'aanta ah.
en: You can also ask for help in finding your own sports hobby from the free-of-charge sports guidance service.

so: Jijinta gacanta lagu xidho ee dadka waaweyn iyo jijinta-Kimmoke waxaa lagu sameyn karaa jimicsi jaban oo aad iskaa ugu sameysaneysid jidh dhisyada iyo hoolalka dabaasha ee magaaladd waxaa kale oo aad sidoo kale ku raaxeysan kartid dhaqanka xarumaha dhaqamadda ee magaaladda, Jijinta dadka waaweyn waxaa iibsan kara 65 sano cidii buuxisey.
en: Those with a senior citizen's wristband or a Kimmoke wristband can engage in independent exercise at a reasonable price at the city's fitness centres and swimming pools, and can also enjoy culture at the city's cultural establishments. Senior citizen's wristband can be purchased by anyone of 65 and over.

so: Jijinta- Kimmoke waxaa loogu talogaley dadka qaata kaalmadda aasaasigga ah iyo kaalmooyinka qaarkood Kela ka qaata.
en: A Kimmoke wristband is meant for those who are receiving basic income support and certain Kela benefits.

so: Turku waxaa ka shaqeeya sidoo kale in ka badan 300 oo naadi oo diyaariya jimicsiyada iyo ururo.
en: Turku has more than 300 clubs and societies organising sport.

so: Carruurta iyo dhallinyarada waxaa loo diyaarieye kooxo jimicsiyo kala duduwan oo dhaqamadda kala duduwan ah, kuwaas oo si fudud loogu biiri karo.
en: There are different multicultural sports clubs available to children and young people that are easy to join.

so: Kooxahaan waxaa loogu talogaley reer Turku oo dhan.Dadka waawey waxaa si gooni ah loogu diyaariyey goobo jidh dhis- iyo dabaal gaar u kala ah ragga iyo dumarka.
en: The clubs are meant for all Turku residents. For adults, there are separate fitness centre and swimming times available for women and men.

so: Adeegyadda jimicsiyadda waxaa kale oo dheer oo dadka dalka u soo guurey loo fidiyaa kooxo jimicsi oo kala duduwan xilliyada sanadka oo dhan sida. dhaqdhaqaaqyada jidh dhiska, kooxaha kubbadaha, hiihto, ku socoshada kabaha safeexadda iyo qoob ka ciyaarka oo lagu hagayo sidoo kale koorsooyin kooxo tijaabo ah oo kala duduwan iyo bannaan u baxyo.
en: In addition to general support services, there are also different seasonal sports groups available for immigrants such as fitness centre activity, ball games, skiing, skating, dance, courses for trying out different sports and hiking.

so: Magaaladda ayaa u qorsheysa carruurta iyo dhallinyaradda koorsooyin-, kullamo-, iyo waxqabad kooxeedyo.
en: The city organises many different kinds of courses, club and group activity for children and young people.

so: Sidoo kale waxaa loo diyaariyaa kullamo joogto ah tiyaataro, farshaxanno iyo ku madadaalasho jimicsi oo kooxo ah iyo sidoo kale waxqabadyo furran oo cidii rabtaa ay ka soo qeybgali karto.
en: On offer are, among other things, theatre, music, handicraft and sports groups that convene regularly, as well as open activity in which anyone can participate.

so: Fursadaha ku madadaalashada farshaxanka iyo barashada farshaxanka waxaa sidoo kale diyaariya iskuullada sida gaarka ah loo leeyahay ee farshaxanka lagu barto iyo- ururadda.
en: Many private art schools and societies also teach art and offer opportunities to engage in it.

en: You can get information about courses from the study programme, which is published in mid-August and in December.

so: Turku waxaa ka howlgala shaqooyinka dhaqamadda kala gedisan iyo kuwa caalamigga ah hay'adaha sameeya, naadiyo saaxiibtinnimo ah, jaalliyadaha dadka dalka u soo guurey iyo ururo kale.

so: Waxayna diyaariyaan waxqabadyo dhimnacyo badan iyo sidoo kale adeegyo kala duduwanoo dadka dalka u soo guurey iyo finnishkaba loogu talogaley.

en: Each large immigrant organisation has its own association, which acts as a cooperative body and supervisor of interests for the community.

en: The associations organise many different kinds of cultural and sporting activity, as well as events and clubs aimed at maintaining their own culture.

en: Through these associations, it is possible to contact experts of each culture and also their different representative groups.

en: Outreach Youth Work helps young people between the ages of 18 and 29 who face challenges in their life, for example unemployment, homelessness or loneliness.

en: Through this number you can book appointments and receive advice and guidance.

so: Daryeelka caafimaadka afku waxay daryeelaan dadkareer Turku caafimaadkooda ilkaha iyo afka.
en: Oral and Dental Health Care is responsible for the teeth and oral health of Turku residents.

so: Daryeelka caafimaadka afka iyo ilkaha waxaa laga bixiyaa 14 goobood oo caafimaadka ilkaha iyo afka lagu daryeelo.
en: Oral and dental care is provided at 14 dental surgeries.

so: Goobahaas daryeelku waxay ku dhex yaalaan inta badan goobaha caafimaadka.
en: The surgeries are often located at health centres.

so: Wixii da'adoodu ka yar tahay da'ada iskuulka daryeelka ilkahooda waxaad warbixinta ka heleysaa xanaanada dhallaanka.
en: You can get information about dental care for children under school age at your children's clinic.

so: Carruurta da'adoodu iskuulka gaadhey daryeelka caafimaadkooda ilkaha waxaa looga diyaariyaa iskuulkaa.
en: Dental care for school-age children is organised through the school.

so: Waxaad daryeelka caafimaadka ilkaha kula xaajoon kartaa adigoo ballan ka qabsada adeegga elektarooniga ah, telifoon ama farriin ahaan.
en: You can contact the appointment booking of Oral Health Care through the electronic service, by phone or by text message (SMS).

so: Adeegga elektarooniga ah hadda in muddo ah ballan lagama qabsan karo ballanta marka ugu horeysa.
en: It is not yet possible to book the first new appointment through the electronic service.

so: Ballan qabsashada daryeelka caafimaadka ilkaha:
en: Oral healthcare appointment booking:

so: Xilliyada kale la xidhiidh goobta heeganka ee magaaladda Turku iyo agagaarkeeda si aad u hesho daryeel- hagitaan:
en: At other times, contact Turku Region General Accident & Emergency for treatment instructions:

so: Heeganka Qaabilaadda ee daryeelka caafimaadka afka
en: Oral Health Care Emergency Services

so: Sidoo kale Turku waxaa ku yaala dhakhaatiir caafimaadka ilkaha ah oo gaar loo leeyahay.
en: Turku also has many private dental surgeons.

so: Dhakhaatiirta ilkaha ee sida gaarka ah loo leeyahay waad tagi kartaa,xataa adigoon xaq
en: You may visit a private dental surgeon even if you are not entitled to public healthcare services.

so: Dhakhaatiirta ilkaha ee sida gaarka ah loo leeyahay waxaad warbixintooda ka heli kartaa mishiin dalabkainternetka ama- adeegga
en: You can seek information about private dental surgeons using an Internet search engine or at

so: Turku goobtaada caafimaadka ayaa ah goobta ugu horeysa ee aad kala xidhiidheysid dhibaatooyinka caafimaadka maskaxda.
en: In Turku, your own health centre is always the primary place for treating problems with mental health.

so: Goobta caafimaadkaaga ayaa ka masuul ah in ay daryeesho dhibaatooyinka caafimaadka maskaxda iyo ka hortagaba, iney dareemaan calaamada sidoo kalena ay daryeelaan dhibaatooyinka caafimaadka maskaxda ee caadiga ah iyo kuwa dhimirkaba sida isku buuqista, argagaxa gariirka leh iyo dhibaatooyinka noloshaba .
en: Health centres are responsible for taking care of the prevention of mental health problems, recognising symptoms and treating more common and mild psychiatric disorders such as depression, panic attack and life crises.

so: Goobaha caafimaadka dhakhaatiirtooda guud ayaad ka qabsan kartaa ballan badhitaanada caafimaadka xubnaha dhalmada ee dumarka ama xubnaha taranka ee raggaba.Waxaad sidoo kale ballan ka qabsan kartaa dhakhtarka, haddii aad u baahan tahay in laguu qoro waxyaalaha uurka la isaga ilaaliyo ama aad ka fikireysid in aad ilmo iska soo disho/rido.
en: You can book an appointment with a general practitioner at a health centre for a gynaecological or urological examination. You can also book an appointment with a doctor if you need a prescription for contraception or you are considering an abortion.

so: Xanaanadda ka hortagga dhalmadu waxay u adeegtaa wixii 25-jir ka yar ee reer Turku ah.
en: The Contraception Clinic serves Turku residents under the age of 25 in matters concerning contraception.

so: Intaa wixii ka weyni waxay la xidhiidhi karaan dhakhtarka xanaanada ka hortagga dhalmada, kalkaalisada caafimaadka ama inuu soo gudbiyo shaqaalaha arrimaha bulshadu.Xanaanadaka hor tagaa dhalmada sidoo kale waad la xidhiidhi kartaa, haddii aad ka fikireysid in aad uurka iska soo ridid.
en: People older than this may visit the Contraception Clinic on a referral by a doctor, nurse or social worker. You may also visit the Contraception Clinic if you are considering a termination of pregnancy.

so: Xanaanaddaka hortagga dhalmadu waxay ku taalaa Xarunta weyn ee goobta caafimaadka Mäntymäki.
en: The Contraception Clinic is located at the main health centre in Mäntymäki.

so: Haddii aad ka shikisan tahay, in aad qabto cudurada galmadalagu kala qaado, la xidhiidh goobta caafimaadka ee xaafadaada.
en: If you suspect that you have a sexually transmitted disease, contact your own health centre.

so: Markaad og tahay inaad uur leedahay, la xidhiidh xanaanada hooyooyinka uurka leh.
en: When you know that you are expecting a baby, contact a maternity clinic.

so: Xanaanadaadu waxay u qoondeysan tahay cinwaanka gurigaaga.
en: Your maternity clinic is determined by your home address.

so: Xanaanada hooyada uurka lihi waxay kuu fidineysaa qaabilaadda kullamada kalkaalisooyinka caafimaadka iyo dhakhaatiirta sidoo kale kombiyuutaradda- iyo kuwa lagu baadhayo caafimaadka ilmaha uurka ku jira.
en: The maternity clinic offers you visits to a nurse and doctor, as well as ultrasound scans and fetal screening.

so: Lumbarka sida wadarta ah ugu adeegga xanaanooyinku waa 02 266 2223.
en: The joint service number for the clinics: 02 266 2223.

so: Halkaas ayaa ballanta ugu horeysa laga qabsadaa markaad xanaanada tagtidna waxaad ka heli doontaa wixii hagitaan aad u baahato.
en: At that number you can book your first appointment and receive the necessary instructions.

so: Kaalmooyinka-Kelada si aad u heshid waa in kullanka xanaanadahooyooyinkauurka leh ee ugu horeeyaa uu ahaado inta ka horeysa markuu uurkaagu yahay 16 todobaad ela-etuuksien saamiseksi.
en: In order to receive Kela benefits, the first clinic visit must be before the 16th week of pregnancy.

so: Ka akhriso kaalmooyinka Kela ay siiso qoyska bogga InfoFinlandi Kaalmaynta hooyada uurka leh
en: Read about Kela financial support for families at the InfoFinland website Support for pregnant women.

so: Dhalmada Turku iyo nawaaxigeeda waxaa lagu daryeelaa cisbitaalka dhexe ee jaamacadda Turku, TYKSi.
en: In the Turku region, births are carried out at Turku University Hospital (TYKS).

so: Haddii aad dareemeysid in si khaldan laguula dhaqmey adigoo ka daneysanaya goobtaada caafimaadka, isku dey marka hore inaad ka xallisid goobtaada caafimaadka.
en: If you feel that you have been treated wrongly in health services, first try to solve the issue at your own place of treatment.

so: Haddii arrintu ay halkaas ka xalismi weydo waxaad la xidhiidheysaa qareen bukaanka u adeegga.
en: If the issue cannot be solved, contact the Patient Ombudsman.

so: Haddii aad ka tirsan tahay giraanta caymiska caafimaadka, waxaad ka dalban kartaa Kelada lacagta maalmaha aad xanuunsan tahay/ jiran tahay inta adiga kugu soo aadeysa mooyee inta kale.
en: If you are covered by Finnish National Health Insurance, you can apply for sickness allowance from Kela after the qualifying period for benefit.

so: Adeegyada naafada la siiyo
en: Special Services for the Disabled

so: Dadka naafada ahi waxay xaq u leeyihiin adeegyo iyo taageerooyin deegaanka ah si ay u dabartaan nolol maalmeedka howlaha la xidhiidha.
en: Disabled persons are entitled to receive special services and support for living and coping with daily life.

so: Adeegyada loo baahan yahay iyo taageerooyinka deegaanka ee sahlaaya nolol maalmeedka waxaa loo qofka loo dajiyaa qorshaha adeegga.
en: In order to establish the required services and support, a service plan is drawn up for the person.

so: Qorshahaas adeegga waxaa dejiya shaqaalaha arrimaha bulshada ee xafiiska naafada oo uu weheliyo qofka naafada ah laftiisa iyo haddii loo baahdo qofka naafada ah masuulkiisa ama qofkiisa.
en: The plan is drawn up by a social worker from the office of Disability Services together with the disabled person and, if necessary, his/her carer and relatives.

so: Adeegga naafada taageerooyinka ama adeegyada khuseeya foomka codsigooda waxaa loo diyaariyaa qoraal ahaan.
en: An application for support or service from Disability Services must be submitted in writing.

so: Foomka waxaa lagu lifaaqaa dhakhtarka xaafadaaddu cadeynta qoraalka ah ee uu qoro iyo sidoo kale haddii loo baahdo qoraalo ay khubaro kale qoraan iyo cadeymo kaleba.
en: The application should also include a statement from a health centre doctor and, if necessary, other expert statements and reports.

so: Warbixinta xafiiska dadka naafada ah:
en: Contact information of the Office for Disability Services:

so: Magaaladda waxaa laga helaa kaalmooyin iyo adeegyo badan oo kala duduwan looguna talogalay carruurta iyo dhallinyarada kaalmada khaaska ah u baahan iyo sidoo kale qoysaskoodaba.
en: The city has available many different kinds of support and services for children and young people needing special support, as well as for their families.

so: Xanaano maalmeedka iyo iskuulladaba waxaa loogu qorsheeyaa kaalmooyin iyo dib u carbin carruurta baahidooda waafaqsan.
en: Support and rehabilitation are organised in day care centres and schools.

so: Turku waxaa ku yaala iskuulo khaas ah oo loogu talogaley carruuraha u baahan kaalmooyinka khaaska ah.
en: Turku has special schools for children who require special support.

so: Kaalmadaas si uu u helo ilmahu waxaa xaaladiisa lagu sameeyaa qiimeyn loona dejiyaa qorshe, kaas oo uu ku helayo kaalmada uu u baahan yahay iyo sida waxbarashadiisa loogu qorsheynayo.
en: In order to receive support, a child's situation is assessed and a plan is made for him/her concerning the support that he/she needs and how his/her teaching will be organised.

so: Dadka waaweyn iyo dadka ku dhasha jirooyinka ama naafada ahna waxaa loo qorsheeyey howlo maalmeed- iyo shaqooyin, kuwaas oo lagu hirgeliyo xarumaha howlaha waxqabadka ee ay magaaladdu leedahay ama adeeg keenis ahaan.
en: Daytime and work activities are organised for people with mental disabilities, which are carried out in the city's own activity centres and day centres or as an outsourced service.

so: Ka kaalmeynta howlaha waxqabadka iyo ka kaalmeynta shaqooyinka waxaa lagu hirgeliyaa goobaha shaqada iyadoo la siinayo kaalmadda shaqo u tababaridda.
en: Supported work activities and supported work are also provided at normal work places under the guidance of a trainer.

so: Naafada, xanuunada mudadda dheer ama isticmaalka qalabka la gargaarsado kama hor istaagayaan in uu qofku sameeyo wax kasta oo uu ku maararoobayo, sababtaas ayey magaaladdu u qorsheysey sidoo kale goobo jimicsi- iyo howlo dhaqameedyo ku haboon da'a kasta, iyo kuwa kaalmadda khaaska ah u baahanba.
en: A disability, long-term illness or the use of aids are no barrier to taking part in hobbies, as the city also organises a suitable range of sporting and cultural pursuits for people of all ages in need of special support.

so: Dadka naafada ah adeegyada ku wajahan ee magaaladda oo la ururiey:
en: A summary of municipal services targeted at the disabled can be found at:

so: Haddii uugurigga kuu joogo qofkaagii oo waayeel ah, jiran ama naafa ahi, xaq waxaad u leedahay kaalmada qofka qofkiisa gurigga ku haysta.
en: If you are taking care of an old, sick or disabled relative at home, you may be entitled to Support for Relatives of People requiring care.

so: Haddii uu qofkaaga aad gurigga ku heysaa ka yar yahay 65-jir, kaalmada waxaad ka dalban kartaa xafiiska arrimaha bulshada ee naafada qaabilsan. Warbixinta waxaad ka heleysaa bogga magaaladda Turku.
en: If the person requiring care is under 65 years old, you can apply for support from the Social Services for People with Disabilities, whose contact information is on the website of the City of Turku.

so: Haddii uu qofkaaga aad gurigga ku heysaa ka weyn yahay 65-jir, kaalmada waxaad ka dalban kartaa waaxda arrimaha bulshada ee adeegga dadka waayeelka ah. Warbixinta waxaad ka heleysaa bogga magaaladda Turku.
en: If the person requiring care is over 65 years, you can apply for support from the Social Services for Elderly People, whose contact information is on the website of the City of Turku.

so: Foomka dalbo kaalmada, kaas oo aad ka heleysid bogga magaalada Turku.
en: For the application you will need to fill in a form that you can find on the website of the City of Turku.

so: Kaalmada dhaqaale ee dadka naafada ah
en: Financial support for disabled persons

so: Boggan waxaad ka heleysaawixii warbixin ah ee la xidhiidha iskuullada carruurta iyo sidoo kale waxbarashada dadka waaweyn ee Turku.
en: This page contains information on child and adult education in Turku.

so: Wixii kale ee warbixin muhiim ahna waxaad ka heleysaa bogga Waxbarashada.
en: Other important information can be found at the page Education.

so: Waxbarashada xirfadaha u diyaarinta waxbarashada iyo waxbarashada afka hooyo ee dadka dalka u soo guurey
en: Preparatory teaching for vocational studies and teaching for immigrants in their own mother tongue

so: Fursadaha kale ee waxbarasho
en: Other opportunities for study

so: Magaaladda Turku waxay diyaarisaa bilow waxbarasho oo finnish- iyo iswidhish ah.
en: Both Finnish- and Swedish-language preschool education is available in Turku.

so: Bilowga ama horraadka waxbarashada waxaa loogu talogaley dhammaan carruurta oo dhami iney ka qeyb galaan sanad inteynan iskuulka bilaabin.
en: Preschool education is intended for all children a year before they start to attend school.

so: Kooxda bilowga waxbarashadu waxay ku howlgalaan xanaano maalmeedyada iyo iskuullada.
en: Both daycare centres and schools operate preschool groups.

so: Horraadka waxbarashadu waxay bilaabantaa bisha ogoosto, xiliggana dalbashaduna waa bisha janaayo.
en: Preschool begins in August, and the time for application is in January.

so: Waxaa bilowga waxbarashada la isku diiwaan geliyaa si elektarooni ahaan ah ama in foomka is diiwaangelinta lagu soo caliyo xanaano maalmeedka uu ilmuhu bilaabayo ama uu ka bilaabi doono bilowga waxbarashada.
en: Preschool can be registered for either electronically or by returning the registration form to the daycare that you want your child to attend.

so: Wixii warbixin dheeraad ah ee la xidhiidha horraadka waxbarashada waxaad ka heleysaa bogga shabakada ee magaaladda.
en: You can find additional information about preschool on the City of Turku website.

so: Wixiii warbixin dheeraad ah ee la xidhiidha sidoo kale waxaad weydiin kartaa maamulka xanaano maalmeedka.
en: You can also ask daycare directors for information.

so: Intaas waxaa dheer oo magaaladda Turku ku yaala iskuulka normaali ee Turku iyo iskuulka- Steiner ee Turku.
en: In addition to the municipal schools, there is also Turku Normal School and Turku Steiner School.

so: Waxaa kale oo Turku ku yaala iskuulo ay carruurtu ka heli karaan waxbarashada afafka ruushka, jarmalka, faransiiska iyo ingiriisiga.
en: Turku also has schools where children can receive part of their education in Russian, German, French and English.

so: Ardeyga iskuulka uu tagayo waxaa loogu qoondeeyaa cinwaanka ardeyga xaafadiisu ku taalo, ilmuhuna sida qaalibka ah wuxuu bilaabaa iskuulka u dhow gurigiisa.
en: The school that the pupil attends is determined by his/her home address, and children usually attend the school closest to their home.

so: Ilmaha fasalkiisa koobaad ee waxbarashadiisa aasaasiga ah waxaa foomka loogu buuxiyaa elektarooni ahaan.Xilliga dalbashadu waxay bilaabantaa sanad walba bishiisa koobaad ee janaayo.
en: A child may be registered for the first grade of basic school on an electronic form. The application period begins in January each year.

so: Sidoo kale waxaa ilmaha loo diiwaan gelin karaa barashada afkiisa hooyo.
en: At the same time, children may be registered for teaching in their own mother tongue.

so: U diiwaan gelinta fasalada kale waxay u dhacdaa si toos ah iskuulka maamulihiisa ama hogaankiisa.
en: Registration for other classes takes place directly to the school's headteacher or director.

so: Markuu ilmuhu dalka dibadiisa uga soo guuro Finland ee uunan aqoonin afka finnishka, wuxuu marka hore baranayaa u diyaarinta waxbarashada.
en: When a child moves to Finland from abroad and cannot speak Finnish, he/she first studies in preparatory teaching.

so: Ilmuhu wuxuu bilaabi karaa u diyaarinta waxbarashada isla markauu Turku u soo guuraba
en: A child may begin preparatory teaching as soon as he/she has moved to Turku.

so: Carruurta afafka qalaad ku hadlaa waxbarashada aasaasiga ah markey ku jiraan afka finnishka ama kan iswidhishkaba waxay u bartaan afkii labaad ahaan.
en: At basic school, foreign-language pupils study Finnish or Swedish as a second language.

so: Intaas waxaa dheer oo ay baran karaan usbuucii laba saacadood oo afkooda hooyo ah.
en: In addition to this, they may also study their own mother tongue for two hours a week.

so: Magaalada Turku waxbarashada afafka hooyo waxay fidiyaan in ka badan 20 af.
en: In Turku, mother tongue teaching is provided in more than 20 languages.

so: Iskuullada waxaa laga heli karaa sidoo kale waxbarasha afkaaga hooyo iyo kaalmooyin waxbarasho oo finnish ah iyo/ ama afkaaga hooyo.
en: At school, children may also receive mother-tongue teaching and many kinds of support teaching in Finnish and/or their own mother tongue.

so: Wixii warbixin dheeraad ah iyo caawimaadba waxaad toos uga heleysaa iskuullada hoose dhexe oo dhan.
en: You can obtain additional information and assistance directly from all the basic schools.

so: Qoysaska u soo guurey Finnland ee aan weli baranin afka finnishku, waxay toos ula xidhiidhi karaan qorsheeyaha xafiiska gudoonka waxbarashada- iyo korriinka ee barshada dhaqamadda kala duduwan:
en: Families that move to Finland and whose children do not yet speak Finnish may directly contact the planner for multicultural education at the Education Department:

so: Waxbarashada aasaasiga ah ee dhallinyarada iyo dadka waaweyn
en: Basic education for young people and adults

so: Haddii uu qofka dhallinyarada ah ama qofka weynu uunan horey iskuul u soo dhiganin ama uunan dhameysanin dugsigii hoose dhexe, wuxuu waxbarashadiisa ku dhameysan karaa dugsi hoose dhexe ahaan.
en: If a young person or adult has either not attended or failed to complete his/her basic schooling, he/she may take basic education at school.

so: Haddii uu qofka dhallinyarada ahi u soo guuro Finland 14–16- sano jir, wuxuu ka qeybgali karaa kooxda u diyaarinta barashada dugsi hoose dhexe.
en: If a young person moves to Finland between the ages of 14 and 16, he/she may attend a preparatory teaching group for basic education.

so: Dhallinyarada da'adoodu dhaaftey xilligii ay waxbarashada dugsiga hoose dhexe waajibka ku aheyd waxay dalban karaan waxbarashada aasaasiga ah ee dadka waaweyn bilowga- ama xilliga gabagabada waxbarashada ama waxay sameyn karaan qeyb waxbarashada ka mid ah.Sidoo kale waxbarashada aasaasiga ah waxaa ku gudo jira barista xirfada akhriska- iyo qoraalka.
en: Young people and adults who have passed the age of compulsory education may apply for courses at the beginning or end of basic education, or may take some of the courses. Basic education may also include teaching in reading and writing skills.

so: Haddii uu yahay 17-sano qof da'adiisu ka yar tahay ama qof dhallinyaro ah oo aanan aqoonin afka finnishku, wuxuu marka hore bilaabayaa u diyaarinta waxbarashada.
en: If a child or young person under the age of 17 cannot speak Finnish, he/she first attends preparatory teaching.

so: U diyaarinta waxbarashada wuxuu ku baranayaa koox yar ahaan afka finnishka iyo duruus kale muddo ilaa iyo sanad ah.
en: In preparatory teaching, he/she studies Finnish and other subjects in a small group for about one year.

so: Kooxaha u diyaarinta waxbarashada Turku waa dhowr iskuul uun,
en: Several schools in Turku have preparatory teaching groups.

so: Dhallinyarada asalkoodii hore ah dadka dalka u soo guurey wixii warbixin dheeraad ah ee ku saabsan waxbarashadooda waxaad ka heleysaa ammatti-institiiga Turku.
en: Further information about the teaching of young people from immigrant backgrounds is available from Turku Vocational Institute.

so: Iskuullada u tababaridda barashada xirfadaha
en: Preparatory education for vocational training

so: Waxbarashada aasaasiga ah ee xirfaduhu waxay kugu hogaamin karaan u tababaridda iskuullada xirfadaha.
en: Vocational basic education may be preceded by preparatory education for vocational education.

so: Waxbarashadaa waxaa laga dalbadaa dhinaca raad raaca (opintopolku) waxbarashada.
en: Such education is applied for through the Opintopolku service.

so: Hadafka u tababaridda waxbarashadu waa in la hagaajiyo fursadaha ardeyga si uu u helo waxbarashada- xidhiidhka ah.
en: The aim of preparatory education is to improve a student's chances of qualifying for further education.

so: Xilligga waxbarashadu ay socoto waxaa lagu hagaajinayaa ardeyga- iyo xirfadda noloshiisa, xirfadda luqadiisa, inuu ka fikiro wuxuu baranayo uuna barbarto xirfaddo kala duduwan.
en: During the education, the student may improve his/her study-, life- and language skills, consider what field he/she likes, and learn different professions.

so: Ardeyga waxaa loo sameynayaa qorshe aqoontiisa shakhsi ahaaneed si loo kobciyo (HOKS).
en: A personal competence development plan (HOKS) is drawn up for each student.

so: Ardeyda waxbarashadani ku jiraa waxay xaq u leeyihiin kaalmada waxbarashada ee caadiga ah iyo kaalmadda kharashka ku baxaya safarada iskuulka.
en: Students are entitled to normal study benefit and school travel allowance.

so: Waxbarashada u diyaarinta xirfadaha ee Turku waxaa diyaariya ammatti-instituutiga Turku iyo sidoo kale xarunta dhexe ee iskuullada dadka waaweyn ee Turku.
en: Preparatory training in Turku is organised by the Turku Vocational Institute and Adult Education Centre Turku.

so: Wixii warbixin dheeraad ah ee Turku iyo nawaaxigeeda diyaarinta iskuuladda xirfadaha ee tababaridda iskuullada waxaad ka heleysaa xubinta tusaha hagitaanka (Nivelvaiheopas).
en: Further information about preparatory education for vocational training in the Turku region is available in the Nivelvaihe (transitional phase) guide.

so: Waxbarashada aasaasiga ah ee xirfadaha waxaa lagu diyaariyaa machadyada xirfadaha iyo iskuul tababar ku barasho ah.
en: Basic vocational education is organised at vocational institutes and as apprenticeship training.

so: Takhasusyadaasi waa kuwo ku saleysan waxbarashada aasaasiga ah, laakiin sidoo kalena waxoogaa ku saleysan takhasus dugsi sare ahaaneed.
en: Qualifications are usually based on basic education, but there are also some upper secondary school-type qualifications.

so: Waxbarashadu waa mid aad ugu dhow wax qabadka.
en: Study is very practical.

so: Iskuulkaa u diyaarinaya goobta shaqada inta uu ardeygu waxbarashada ku jirana wuxuu ka shaqeynaya xirfadii uu baranayey wuxuuna baranayaa sidoo kale nolol maalmeedka shaqada.
en: During on-the-job training, students attend an actual place of work and get to know about everyday working life.

so: Takhasusuka aasaasiga ah ee xirfad barashada baaxadeedu waa 180 osp (dhibco aqooneed) oo dhameyntiisu ay qaadato caadi ahaan saddex sanadood.
en: A basic vocational qualification comprises 180 credits and normally takes three years to complete.

so: Takhasuskaas xilliga lagu gudanayaa wey is bedbedashaa waxayna ku xidhan tahay marba sida uu ardeygu u gudanayo waxbarashada, aqoontiisa hore iyo khibradiisa shaqo.
en: The time needed to complete the qualification varies depending on the pace of progress of the student, previous studies and work experience.

so: Sharciga-iyo arrimaha dhalashada/ jinsiyada
en: Residence permit and citizenship

so: Shaqo nololeedka iyo arrimaha- ogolaanshaha shaqada
en: Work and work permits

so: Dhibaatooyinka dhaqaalaha iyo badbaadadda bulshada
en: Financial problems and social security

so: Buuxbuuxinta macluumaadka iyo foomamka
en: Documents and filling in forms

so: Infotorigu12 luqadood oo kala duwan ayuu ku talo bixiyaa maalin walba ama jadwalkiisa u gaarka ahi sida uu dhigayo.
en: Infotori provides information and counselling in 12 different languages every day or according to a separate schedule.

so: Markaad isku diiwaan gelisid shaqo la'aan shaqo raadis ah, waxaa laguu sameynayaa sahamin bilow ah iyo qorshaha dal la qabsiga waxaana kuu dejinaya xafiiska Shaqada- iyo maareynta nolosha ee Varsinais-Suomi.
en: Once you have registered as an unemployed job-seeker, an initial assessment and integration plan will be made for you at the Southwest Finland Employment and Economic Development Office.

so: Warbixinta xafiiska Turku ee Shaqada- iyo maareynta nolosha Varsinais-Suomi:
en: Contact information for the Turku office of the Southwest Finland Employment and Economic Development Office.

so: Xafiiska ajnabigu wuxuu u adeegaa dadka qaxootiga ah ee dalka u soo guurey iyo qoysaskooda si ay dalka ula qabsadaan muddo ilaa iyo saddex sano ah laga bilaabo markey dalka soo galeen.
en: The Immigrant Office supports immigrants from a refugee background and their families to integrate within about three years of their immigration.

so: Adeeg bixiyayaasha xafiiska dadka dalka u soo guurey waa:
en: The services of the immigrant office are:

so: Adeegyada qaabilaadda iyo bilowga sahaminta
en: Reception services and initial assessment

so: Marxalada qaabilaadda daryeelka caafimaadka
en: Health care during the reception stage

so: Hagidda iyo talobixinta dal la qabsiga
en: Counselling and guidance on integration

so: Intaa waxaa dheer xafiiska ajnabiga howlihiisa dad la qabsigu (KOTO -toiminta) wuxuu u diyaariyaa hooyooyinka gurijoogta ah iyo dadka waayeelka ah barashada luqada finnishka iyo dhexgalka bulshada iyo howlo kooxeedyo lagu kobcinaya dal la qabsiga.
en: The Immigration Office's KOTO function also organises group activity that provides teaching of the Finnish language and society and promoting integration for full-time mothers and the elderly, amongst others.

so: Haddii aanad ku hadlin afafka finnishka ama iswidhishka, waxaad adeegsan kartaa turjubaan markaad danahaaga ka xallisaneysid masuuliyiinta dawladda.
en: If you don't speak Finnish or Swedish, you may use an interpreter to handle matters with the authorities.

so: Xaaladaha qaarkood turjubaanka waxaad ka heli kartaa masuuliyiinta dawladda xagooda.
en: In some cases, you have the right to an interpreter provided by the authorities.

so: Markaasna turjumaaddu waa kuu bilaash.
en: In such cases, the interpretation is free of charge for you.

so: Turjubaanka waxaad ka sii codsan kartaa masuulka dowladda ee danahaaga ka dhameysaneysid oo aad u sheegeysaa inaad turjubaan u baahan tahay.
en: You can ask about interpretation in advance from the appropriate authority.

so: Turjubaanka waad adeegsan kartaa markasta oo aad u baahan tahay, haddii aad adigu bixineysid kharashkiisa oo aad adigu dalbaneysid turjubaanka.
en: You can use an interpreter whenever you want, as long as you pay the costs and order the interpreter yourself.

so: Magaaladda Turku adeegyada turjubaanka- iyo turjumidda macluumaadka waxaa fidiya tusaale ahaan:
en: In Turku, interpreting and translation services are provided by, for example:

so: Isku diiwaangelinta inaad deggan tahay
en: Registration as a resident

so: Xafiiska laanta socdaalka ayaa xalliya dhamaan arrimaha sharciyada oo dhan, isku diiwaangelinta jinsiyadda midowga Yurubta iyo dalbashada jinsiyadaha.
en: The Finnish Immigration Service handles all residence permit matters, the registration of EU citizens and citizenship applications.

so: Xafiiska laanta socdaalku wuxuu ku yaalaa Helsinki, laakiin baro/ goobo u adeegga ayaa meelo badan oo Finland ah ku kala yaala.
en: The head office of the Finnish Immigration Service is situated in Helsinki, but it has service points all over Finland.

so: Barta adeegga xafiiska laanta socdaalka ee kuugu dhowi waxay ku taalaa Raisio.
en: The nearest service point is in Raisio.

so: Barta adeegga ee xafiiska laanta socdaalka:
en: Finnish Immigration Service Point:

so: Waxaa habboon inaad markasta ballan ka soo qabsatid xafiiska laanta socdaalka adeegiisa.
en: It is always worth booking an appointment at the service point in advance, through the office's appointment booking service. Book an appointment in advance online.

so: Codsiyada sharciga lagu dalbanayo iyo kuwa la isugu diiwaan gelinayo EU da waxaad ka xallisan kartaa sidoo kale shabakada adeegga- Enter Finland:
en: You can also take care of residence permit applications and EU registration online at the Enter Finland service:

so: Markaad si rasmi ah ugu soo guurtid Turku, iska diiwaangeli xafiiska diiwaangelinta Lounais-Suomi inaad deggane degmada deggan tahay.
en: When you move to live permanently in Turku, register yourself as a resident of the municipality at the Local Register Office of Southwest Finland.

so: Warbinaha dheeraadka ahee qofka ajnabiga ah is diiwaangelintiisa waxaad ka heleysaa Lounais-Suomi bogga shabakada ee xafiiska diiwaangelinta.
en: Further information about the registration of foreigners is available at the website of the Local Register Office of Southwest Finland.

so: Isku diiwaangelinta inaad deggane tahay
en: Registering as a resident

so: Markaad Turku uga soo guureysid meel kale oo Finland ah amaba Turku gudaheeda guri aad ka guureysid una guureysid guri kale, waa in aad ka sameysid wargelinta guurista xafiiska diiwaangelinta ama boostada.
en: When you move to Turku from elsewhere in Finland or within Turku permanently to another dwelling, you must submit a notification of change of address to the Local Register Office or Post Office.

so: Wargelinta guurista waxaad ka sameyn kartaa internetka si elektarooni ahaan ah adeegga macmiilka:
en: This notification can be submitted online at the electronic service:

so: Wargelinta guurista waxaad sidoo kale ku sameyn kartaa foom ahaan, foomkaas oo aad ka heleysid kana soo qaadan kartid boostada ama xafiiska diiwaangelinta.
en: The notification may also be submitted on a form that you can obtain from the Post Office or Local Register Office.

so: Wargelinta guurista xafiiska diiwaangelinta:
en: Local Register Office notification of change of address:

so: Vantaa iyo dhammaan agagaarka caasimadda waxaa ka jira iskuxir gaadiid wannaagsan.
en: Vantaa and the entire metropolitan area boast good public transport connections.

so: dhinaca wadada weyn iyo tan Martinlaakso waxaa ku yaal maxado tareen oo dhawr ah.
en: There are several stations along the main railway line and the Martinlaakso line.

so: Magaalada waxaa dhex mara wadooyin badan oo ay basasku maraan.
en: Many bus routes run through the city.

so: Vantaa waxay ka mid tahay isku-xirka gaadiidka degmooyinka ee agagaarka Helsinki (Helsingin seudun liikenne -kuntayhtymä HSL), taas oo gaadiidka dadweynaha ka qabanqaabisa agagaarka caasimadda.
en: Vantaa is part of Helsinki Region Transport, HRT (Helsingin seudun liikenne, HSL), a joint municipal authority that organises public transport in the metropolitan area.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga HSL.
en: More information is available on HRT's website.

so: Adeegga hagaha wadooyinka (Reittiopas) waxaad ka raadsan kartaa wadooyinka mara agagaarka caasimadda.
en: You can use the Journey Planner (Reittiopas) service to search for information on routes in the metropolitan area.

so: Adeeggu wuxuu kaala talinayaa sida aad u raaceyso gaadiidka dadweynaha.
en: The service provides suggestions on how to get from one place to another using public transport.

so: Gaadiidka dadweynaha waxaa tikidkiisa ku bixin kartaa kaash ama kaarka safarka.
en: You can use cash or a travel card to pay on public transport.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale telefoonka ku iibsan kartaa tigidka moobaylka ama tigid hal mar ah ayaad ka iibsan kartaa mashiinka tigidhada.
en: You can also buy a mobile ticket with your mobile phone or a single ticket from a ticket vending machine.

so: Kaarka safarka (matkakortti) in lagu safraa waxay ka jaban tahay kaashka.
en: It is cheaper to travel by Travel Card (matkakortti) than if you buy a single ticket with cash.

so: Kaarka safarku wuxuu ku shaqeeyaa ama lagula safri karaa basaska magaalada, tareenada xaafadaha, basaska, merooga, taraamka iyo doonta Suomenlinna.
en: Travel Card is accepted on the local service's buses, commuter trains, the metro, trams and the Suomenlinna ferry.

so: Kaararka safarku waa laba nooc.
en: There are two kinds of travel cards.

so: Kaar shaqsi (henkilökohtainen kortti) waxaa loola jeedaa kaarka uu qofka milkida u leh oo kaliya uu ku safri karo.
en: A personal Travel Card (henkilökohtainen kortti) can only be used by the card's owner.

so: Waa habka ugu fiican ee lagu safro.
en: It is the cheapest way to travel.

so: Kaarka qofka heysta (haltijakohtainen kortti) waxaa loola jeedaa kaarka ay dad badan isticmaali karaan.
en: Multi-user Travel Cards (haltijakohtainen kortti) can be used by more than one person.

so: Kahor inta aadan qaadan kaarka shaqsiga, waxaa qasab kugu ah inaad magaalo uun hoostimaada soonaha deegaanka tikidka ee HSL aad isaga diiwaangeliso sidii degane rasmi ah.
en: Before you buy a personal Travel Card, you must register as a permanent resident in one of the cities covered by the HSL regional tickets.

so: Goobuhu waxay ku yaallaan dacallada kala gedisan ee caasimadda iyo agagaarkeeda.
en: They are located in different parts of the Helsinki Metropolitan Area.

so: Kaarka safarka ee shakhsiyanka ah waxaa laga iibsan karaa goobta adeegga.
en: You can buy a personal Travel Card at a service point.

so: Haddii aad iibsaneysid kaarka safarka ee shakhsiyanka ah, horay u sii qaado waraaqahaaga aqoonsiga.
en: If you want to buy a personal Travel Card, bring your identification.

so: Sidoo kale kaarka safarka ee shakhsiyanka ah waxaad ka iibsan kartaa bogga internetka ee HSL:ka, haddii aad leedahay aqoonsiga finniska ee xagga internetka looga galo xisaabta bankiga.
en: You can also buy a personal Travel Card from the HRT website if you have Finnish online banking credentials.

so: Waad ku safri kartaa kaarka safarka marka aad ku shubato waqti (kausi) ama qiimo (arvo).
en: The Travel Card can be used after you have loaded either a season (kausi) or value (arvo) to it.

so: Waqti waxaa loola jeedaa: tusaale ahaan hal bil.
en: A season refers to time: for example, one month.

so: Qiimo waxaa loola jeedaa lacag.
en: Value refers to money value.

so: Haddii aad inta badan ku safarto gaadiidka dadweynaha waxaa kuu wannaagsan inaad kaarka ku cabeysato waqti.
en: If you use public transport often, it is worth loading a season to your card.

so: Kaarka safarka waxaad ka cabeysan kartaa meel kasta oo ah oo goobta cabeynta kaarka safarka (matkakortin latauspiste).
en: You can load your Travel Card in any Travel Card loading point (matkakortin latauspiste).

so: Faahfaahin dheeri waxaad ka heleysaa bogga shabakada HSL.
en: More information is available on the HRT website.

so: Marinka ugu haboon baaskiil wadashada iyo socodka waxaad ka heleysaa adeegga hagaha wadooyinka (reittiopas), haddii aad dooneysid inaad Vantaa socod ama baaskiil ku martid.
en: If you want to travel on foot or by bike in Vantaa, you can search for a suitable route in the Journey Planner for Cycling and Walking.

so: Kaartada waraaqda ah ee wadiiqooyinka baaskiilada waxaa ka soo doonan dkartaa barta macuulaadka ee Vantaa (Vantaa-info).
en: You can get a printed cycling map of Vantaa at Vantaa Info.

so: Garoonka diyaaraduhu wuxuu leeyahay isku xir gaadiid oo wanaagsan, waxaana lagu tegi karaa gaari, bas iyo tareen.
en: The airport has good traffic connections by car, bus and train.

so: Saldhigyada tareemada intooda badan waxaa suurto gal ah in baarkinadooda gaariga la dhigto dabadeedna safarka lagu sii wato gaadiidka dadweynaha.
en: Many metro and railway stations offer free car parks for commuters who wish to continue their journey using public transport.

so: Jadwalka basaska iyo tareemada waxaad si sahlan uga heleysaa adeegga hagaha wadooyinka.
en: You can easily find bus and train timetables in the Journey Planner.

so: Waxay ka kooban yihiin 67 xubnood, kuwaas oo kala metela kooxo-siyaasadeedyo kala duduwan.
en: It has 67 members, who represent the different political groups.

so: Golaha waxaa lagu soo doortaa afartii sanaba mar doorashooyinka degmada (kunnallisvaalit).
en: The Council is elected every four years in a municipal election (kunnallisvaalit).

so: Dadka deggan Vantaa waxay habab badan saameyn ugu yeelaan go'aan sameynta iyo diyaarinta arrimaha.
en: Residents of Vantaa can affect the making and preparation of decisions in many ways.

so: Kanaalka Vantaa waxaad kala socon kartaa shirarka golaha deegaanka islamarkaasna ka heli kartaa macluumaad ku saabsan go'aan sameynta.
en: You can watch councel meetings and find more information on decision-making on the Vantaa channel.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogagga shabakadda magaalada Vantaa.
en: Find out more on the City of Vantaa website.

so: Vantaa waxaa ka jiri ururo siyaasadeedyo badan, ururo ay leeyihiin dadka dalka u soo guuray iyo ururo kale oo aad u soo mari karto saameyn ku yeelashada go'aan sameynta.
en: There are political associations, immigrant associations and other organisations in Vantaa through which you can affect decision-making.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan ururada waxaad ka heleysaa boggaga vantaalla.info.
en: More information is available on the Vantaalla.info website.

so: Vantaa iyo Helsinki waxaa ka hawlgala bulsho diimeedyo badan.
en: There are many religious communities in Vantaa and Helsinki.

so: Adeegga Uskonnot Suomessa waxaad ka raadsan kartaa macluumaad ku saabsan bulsho-diimeedyada iyo degmooyinka ay ka jiraan.
en: The Religions in Finland service provides you with the opportunity to search for information according to religious community or municipality.

so: Kaniisadda efangeli-luteerigu waxay Vantaa ku leedahay lix waax kaniisadeed oo ku hadasha luqada Finnishka iyo hal mid oo ku hadasha luqada Isiwidishka.
en: The Evangelical Lutheran Church has six Finnish and one Swedish parish in Vantaa.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ka sii aqri bogagga shabakadda ee isutaga kaniisadda ee Vantaa.
en: Find out more on the website of Vantaa Association of Parishes.

so: Tikkurila waxaa ku yaal kaniisadda ortodoksiga.
en: An Orthodox church is located in Tikkurila.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan waxqabadyada kaniisadda ortodoksiga ee Vantaa waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga kaniisadda Ortodoksiga ee Helsinki.
en: More information on the activities of the Orthodox parish in Vantaa is available on the website of the Orthodox parish of Helsinki.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Dhaqamada iyo diimaha Finland
en: Read more: Cultures and religions in Finland

so: Vantaa waa mid kamid ah afarta degmo ee agagaarka caasimadda.
en: Vantaa is one of the four municipalities in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area.

so: Waxay ku taalaa dhinacyada Espoo iyo Helsinki.
en: It is located next to Espoo and Helsinki.

so: Vantaa waxaa deggan wax ka badan 205,000 oo qofood.
en: Vantaa has more than 205,000 inhabitants.

so: 2,8 % oo ka mid ah dadkaas waxay ku hadlaan luqada Isiwidishka, 11 % waxay sidii af-hooyo ugu hadlaan luqado oo kale oo aan aheyn Finnish iyo Isiwidish.
en: About 2.8% of them speak Swedish, and 11% a language other than Finnish or Swedish.

so: Ballaca dhulka waa qiyaastii 240 km2, kaas oo 2 km2 ay biyo yihiin.
en: Vantaa covers an area of approximately 240 km2, of which 2 km2 is water.

so: Deegaanka Vantaa waxaa la deganaa waqti dheer.
en: The Vantaa region has been inhabited for a very long time.

so: Vantaa hadda jirta waxay ka dhalatay deegaankii Helsinki.
en: The current Vantaa came into being in the area of the former Helsinge Parish.

so: Wadooyinka muhiimka ah, sida Wadada Turku ka timaada ee Helsinki sii marta kadibna Viipuri u sii gudubta iyo wadada tareenka ee Helsinki ka soo baxda waqooyigana aada waxay dhexmaraan Vantaa.
en: Important routes, such as the road from Turku to Vyborg through Helsinki and later the railway north from Helsinki, have run through Vantaa.

so: Wadooyinka iyo jidka tareenka dhinacyadooda waxaa ka abuurmay warshado iyo deegaano la dego.
en: Industry and residential areas have sprung up around the roads and railways.

so: Vantaa waa mid weli muhiim u ah gaadiidka.
en: Vantaa is still an important traffic hub.

so: Tusaale ahaan garoonka diyaaradaha ah ee Helsinki-Vantaa wuxuu ku yaalaa Vantaa.
en: For example, Helsinki-Vantaa Airport is located in Vantaa.

so: Hiwaayadaha dadka da'da ah
en: Hobbies for the elderly

so: Machadka dadka waaweyn ee Vantaa (Vantaan Aikuisopisto) waxaa lagu hiwaayadeyn karaa tusaale ahaan farshaxanka, shaqo gacmeedka, cunto karinta iyo qoob ka ciyaarka.
en: Vantaa Adult Education Centre (Vantaan Aikuisopisto) provides opportunities for arts, crafts, cooking and dance, for instance.

so: Meeshaas sidoo kale waxaa lagu baran karaa luqadaha.
en: You can also study languages there.

so: Vantaa waxaa ku yaal laba guri dhaqameed: guriga riwaayadda ama konjeertada ee Martinus iyo guriga Myyrmäki ee xarunta waxqabadyada badan.
en: There are two cultural facilities in Vantaa: Martinus Concert Hall and the multipurpose centre Myyrmäki House.

so: Intaas waxaa dheer guriga xarunta waxqabadyada badan ee LUMO wuxuu qabanqaabiyaa dhacdooyin badan.
en: In addition, Multipurpose Centre LUMO organises a wealth of events.

so: Guriga dhaqanka ee dhalinyarada iyo carruurta Vernissa, Daarta farshaxanka Pessi iyo Daarta farshaxanka Toteemi waxay carruurta u qabanqaabiyaan dhacdooyin badan.
en: The Vernissa cultural centre for children and young people, the Pessi children's art centre and the Toteemi children's art centre hold cultural events for children.

so: Maktabada waxaad ka amaahan kartaa buugaag, jaraaid, muusik, filimo, geymam iyo waxyaabo kale oo faro badan.
en: You can borrow books, magazines, music, films, games and much more from libraries.

so: Buugaagta iyo materiaalka kale waa luuqado kala gedisan.
en: There are books and other materials in several languages.

so: Maktabadaha qaarkood waxaa sidoo kale dadka wadanka u soo guurey loogu abaabulaa naadiyo ku wada sheekaysiga luuqada Finnishka.
en: You can also use computers at libraries. Some libraries also organise Finnish discussion groups for immigrants..

so: Maktabadaha Vantaa waxay qeyb ka yihiin maktabadaha HelMet ee agagaarka caasimadda.
en: Vantaa's libraries are part of the HelMet library service of the metropolitan area.

so: Taas waxaa loola jeedaa in isla kaarka maktabadda aad ku isticmaali kartid dhammaan maktabadaha magaalooyinka ee ku yaal Vantaa, Espoo, Helsinki iyo Kauniainen.
en: This means that you can use the same library card at the city libraries of Vantaa, Espoo, Kaunianen and Helsinki.

so: Maktabadda weyn ee Helsinki ee Pasila waa maktabad luqado badan.
en: The main library of Helsinki in Pasila is a Multilingual Library.

so: Waxa halkaas laga helaa buugaag ku qoran in ka badan 60 luqadood.
en: It features books in over 60 languages.

so: Haddii aad heysato kaarka HelMet ee maktabadda waad soo amaahan kartaa buugaagta maktabadda Luqadaha badan.
en: If you have a HelMet library card, you can also borrow books from the Multilingual Library.

so: Vantaa waxaa ku yaal shan hool oo lagu dabbaasho oo ay degmadu leedahay.
en: There are five municipal indoor swimming pools in Vantaa.

so: Hoolka dabbaasha ee Korso waxay naagaha iyo gabdhaha dalka u soo guuray ku bixisaa waqti dabbaaleed u gaar ah.
en: The indoor swimming pool in Korso also offers a separate swimming session for immigrant women and girls.

so: Vantaa waxaa ku yaal dhawr hoolal isboorti, garoono isboorti iyo goobo jimicsiyeedyo kale oo loogu talagalay majalado kala duduwan.
en: Vantaa has several sports halls and fields, as well as other locations and facilities for various sports.

so: Xilliga xagaaga waxaad ku ordi kartaa tubta jimicsiga halka xilliga barafkana aad loox-barafeedka kula ordi karto.
en: On the exercise trails, you can run in the summer and ski in the winter.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Jimicsiga
en: Read more: Sports and exercise.

so: Vantaa waxaa ku yaala wadiiqooyin iyo tubab bey'adeed fara badan oo la maro marka duurka dhaqdhaqaaqa loo aadayo.
en: Vantaa has a lot of hiking paths and nature trails.

so: Bey'adda waa lagu socon karaa xitaa aagga nashaadaadka ee Petiko.
en: You can also enjoy nature at the Petikko recreational area.

so: Waxaad ka kalluumeysan kartaa agagaarka kalluumeysiga magaalada Vantaa Vantaanjoki, Keravanjoki iyo Suomenlahti.
en: You can fish in the fishing areas of the city of Vantaa on the Vantaanjoki and Keravanjoki rivers and on the Gulf of Finland.

so: Vantaa waxaa ku yaal dhawr tiyaataro xirafadeed iyo hiwaayado.
en: Vantaa boasts numerous professional and amateur theatres.

so: Vantaa waxaa ku yaal afar shaneemo oo filimada lagu daawado.
en: There are four cinemas in Vantaa.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan filimada waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga shaneemada.
en: More information on the films shown is available on the websites of the cinemas.

so: Taas waxaa dheer in magaalada Vantaa ay qabanqaabiso bandhigyo filimeedyo.
en: In addition, the City of Vantaa holds film screenings.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Tiyaatar iyo shaneemo
en: Read more: Theatre and cinema.

so: Vantaa waxaa ku yaal dhawr madxaf.
en: There are several museums in Vantaa.

so: Madxafka magaalada Vantaa wuxuu soo bandhigaa taariikhda Vantaa.
en: The City Museum presents the history of Vantaa.

so: Madxafka farshaxanka ee Vantaa waxaa lagu qabanqaabiyaa bandhigyada casriga ah ee dalka iyo dibadda oo kala duduwan.
en: Vantaa Art Museum hosts varying exhibitions of domestic and foreign contemporary art.

so: Macluumaadyada kale ee ku saabsan madxafyada kale waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga magaalada Vantaa.
en: Information on other museums is available on the City of Vantaa website.

so: Vantaa waxaa ku yaal qeybo waxbarasheed badan oo dhiga tacliinta aasaasiga ah ee farshaxanka, kuwaas oo si gaar ah loogu talagalay dhalinyarada iyo carruurta.
en: Vantaa is home to many educational institutes that provide basic art education to children and young people.

so: Majaladaha kala duduwan ee farshxanku waa muusikada, sawir-farshaxaneedka, qoob ka ciyaarka, tiyaatarka iyo sirkuska, eray farshaxaneedka, shaqo gacmeedka iyo arkitekjarka.
en: The various forms of art covered include music, visual arts, dance, theatre circus, literary arts, crafts and architecture.

so: Goobaha dhalinyarada ee magaaladu waxay u furan yihiin dhammaan da'yarta u dhexeysa 10–17ka sano.
en: The city's youth facilities are open to all young people between 10 and 17 years of age.

so: Mashruuca-dhammaan Sportti (Sporttia kaikille –hanke) wuxuu carruurta iyo dhalinyarda dadka wadanka u soo guurey u abaabulaa naadiyo dhaq dhaqaaqey iyo duur u baxaayo.
en: The Sports for Everyone project (Sporttia kaikille -hanke) organises sports clubs, tournaments and camps for children and young people with immigrant background.

so: Ururada iyo iyo jimciyadaha isboortigu waxay dhalinyarada u qabanqaabiyaan waxqabadyo badan.
en: Associations and sports clubs organise plenty of activities for young people.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga magaalada Vantaa.
en: More information is provided on the website of the City of Vantaa.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Hiwaayadaha carruurta iyo dhalinyarada
en: Read more: Hobbies for children and young people.

so: Haddii aad gaartey da'da 70 sano oo aad guri degmo kuu yahay Vantaa, waxaad lacag la'aan isticmaali kartaa waaskada daabasha iyo jiimka ee magaalada Vantaa.
en: If you are 70 years old or over and Vantaa is your municipality of residence, you can use the city's swimming pools and gyms free of charge with a Sports Card (Sporttikortti).

so: Kaarka ciyaaraha waxaad ka heleysaa lacag la'aan Vantaa-info.
en: You can apply for the card free of charge at Vantaa Info.

so: Markii aad codsaneyso kaarka, horey isii qaado aqoonsi iyo sawir.
