en: Take along an identity document and a photo when applying.

so: La talinta dadka da'da ah (seniorineuvonta) waxaad ka heleysaa macluulaad la xiriira adeegyada hiwaayadaha ay ururada, shirkadaha iyo magaaladuba siiyaan dadka da'da ah
en: Counselling for senior citizens (seniorineuvonta) provides information about the activities and services for senior citizens offered by associations, companies and the city.

so: La talinta dadka da'da ah
en: Counselling for senior citizens

so: Vantaa waxaa ka jiro ururo badan, tusaale ahaan ururo dhaqameedyo iyo kuwo isboorti.
en: A variety of associations focusing on areas such as culture and sports operate in Vantaa.

so: Dhibaatooyinka maandooriyaha iyo caadeysiga geymamka
en: Intoxicant abuse and gambling addiction

so: Haddii aad u baahantahay boolis, ciidanka dabdamiska ama ambalaas deg deg ah, wac lambarka xaaladaha deg degta ah 112.
en: If you need urgent help from the police, fire services or an ambulance, call the emergency number 112.

so: Lambarka xaalahada deg degta ah waxaa la wici karaa oo kaliya markii ay jirto xaalad deg deg ah, markii ay khtatar ku jiraan nafta, caafimaadka, hantida ama bay'addu.
en: Only call the emergency number in case of emergencies where life, health, property or the environment is in danger.

so: Waxaad wici kartaa heeganka sooshalka- iyo xasaradaha (Sosiaali- ja kriisipäivystys) ee Vantaa, haddii ay ku soo foodsaarto xaalad xasaradeed oo deg deg ah, tusaale ahaan geerida ehelka ama jirdil.
en: You can call Vantaa's Social and Crisis Emergency Services (sosiaali- ja kriisipäivystys) if you experience a sudden crisis situation, such as the death of someone close to you or domestic violence.

so: Sidoo kale cawinaad waad u raadin kartaa qof qoyskaaga ka mid ah ama saaxiibkaa.
en: You can also seek help on behalf of a family member or friend.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Xaaladaha dhibka
en: Read more: Problem situations.

so: Haddii dhib kaa heysto ama mugdi kaaga jiro ogolaanshaha joogitaanka ama sharciga, la xiriir Xafiiska dal u soo guurista (Maahanmuuttovirasto).
en: If you have problems or questions regarding your residence permit, contact the Finnish Immigration Service (Maahanmuuttovirasto).

so: Waxaad sidoo kale talooyin weydiin kartaa adeegyada la-talinta ee loogu talagalay dadka dalka u soo guuray.
en: You can also request help from health counselling services for immigrants.

so: Macluumaadka adeegyada la-talinta waxay ku jiraan bogga Ajnabi ku ahaashaha Vantaa.
en: Information on the services is provided on the page As an immigrant in Vantaa.

so: Xafiiska dal u soo guurista goobtiisa adeegga ee ugu dhaw waxay ku taalaa Helsinki:
en: The closest service point of the Finnish Immigration Service is in Helsinki:

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Dhibaatooyinka ogolaanshaha joogista.
en: Read more: Residence permit problems

so: Daryeelka caafimaadka dadka aan dukumentigada laheyn
en: Health care for undocumented migrants

so: Helsinki waxaa ku shaqeeya Global Clinic oo dadka Finland sharci la'aanta ku joogaa ka heli karaan caawimaad iyo talo siinta dhaqtarka ama kalkaalisada caafimaadka.
en: Helsinki-based Global Clinic provides basic health care for immigrants who are residing in Finland without a permit.

so: Macaamilka waa u lacag la'aan adeegyada Global Clinic.
en: Services provided by Global Clinic are free-of-charge to the clients.

so: Global Clinic macaamiishooda ma ogeysiiso booliska ama saraakiisha kale.
en: Global Clinic does not report its clients to the police or any other authorities.

so: Si loo badbaadiyo macaamiisha meesha ay ku taal kilinikada iyo waqtiyada ay furan tahay lama shaaciyo.
en: For the protection of the clients, the location and opening hours of the clinic are not announced publically.

so: Nambarka telefoonka ee Global Clinic Helsinki waa 044 977 4547.
en: The telephone number to the Helsinki Global Clinic is 044 977 4547.

so: Telefoonka waxaa ka jawaabaya kalkaaliso caafimaad ama dhakhtar.
en: A nurse or a doctor will answer the call.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Dhibaatooyinka ogolaanshaha joogitaanka
en: Read more: Residence permit problems.

so: Ogeysiiska dembiga (rikosilmoitus) waxaad ku sameyn kartaa telefoonka ama adigoo shakhsi ahaan tagaya saldhiga booliska.
en: You can report a crime (rikosilmoitus) by telephone or in person at a police station.

so: Ogeysiiska dembiga waxaad kaloo ka sameyn kartaa internetka, haddii dembigu yahay mid fudud oo aadan si deg deg ah ugu baahnayn cawinaadka booliska.
en: You can also report a crime on the Internet if it is a minor crime and you do not urgently need the police.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale sharciyaqaano gaar ah ka raadsan kartaa tusaale ahaan, bogagga Ururka Garyaqaanada Finland (Suomen Asianajajaliitto).
en: You can also look for information on private lawyers on the website of the Finnish Bar Association (Suomen Asianajanaliitto), for example.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Sharciyaqaan ma u baahan tahay?
en: Read more: Do you need a lawyer?

so: Xaaladaha deg degta ah wac lambarka ah 112.
en: In an emergency, call the emergency number 112.

so: Xaaladaha qalalaasuhu waxaa ku caawinaya heeganka sooshalka- iyo xasaradaha (sosiaali- ja kriisipäivystys) ee magaalada Vantaa, waxay furanyihiin waqti kasta.
en: In crisis situations, you can get help from the City of Vantaa's Social and Crisis Emergency Services (sosiaali- ja kriisipäivystys), which are always open.

so: Haddii ruux kamid ah qoyskaagu adiga kuu geysto jirdil ama uu kuugu hanjabo jirdil, waxaad wici kartaa aqalka badbaadada (turvakoti).
en: If a member of your family uses violence against you or threatens to do so, you can contact a shelter (turvakoti).

so: Aqalada badbaada waxaa mar walba jooga heegan.
en: Shelters always have a helpline open.

so: Aqalka badbaadada ee Mona (Turvakoti Mona) waa aqal badbaado oo loogu talogalay dumarka dadka dalka u soo guurey iyo carruurtooda.
en: The Mona Shelter (Turvakoti Mona) is a shelter for immigrant women and their children.

so: Caawinaada dumarka dadka dalka u soo guurey
en: Help for immigrant women

so: Ururka isbahaysiga Monika-Naiset (Monika-Naiset Liitto) wuxuu dumarka dadka dalka u soo guurey siiyaa la talin iyo caawinaad.
en: MONIKA – Multicultural Women's Association (Monika-Naiset Liitto) gives advice and support to immigrant women.

so: Isbahaysigu wuxuu Vaanta ku leeyahay xarun quwadeyn, taas oo laga helo caawinaad iyo talooyin.
en: The association has a resource centre in Vantaa where you can get support and advice.

so: Ragga jirdilka kula kacay qoyskooda xubno ka tirsan ama aygu ah dhibanayaal qoyska xubno ka mid ahi ay wax yeeleeyeen, waxay caawinaad ka heli karaan hawsha-Jussi ee Vantaa (Vantaan Jussi-työ).
en: Men who have used violence against family members or who have themselves experienced violence in their family can get help at Vantaa's Jussi activities (Vantaan Jussi-työ).

so: Khadka ninka (Miehen Linja) wuxuu caawiyaa ragga dadka dalka u soo guurey, kuwaas oo dhibaato jirdil qaba.
en: Miehen linja is a service that helps immigrant men who have problems with violent behaviour.

so: Aqalka badbaadada dhalinyarda ee laanqayrta cas ee Finland (Suomen Punaisen Ristin Nuorten turvatalo) wuxuu caawinaaad iyo karab istaag siiyaa dhalinyarada da'doodu u dhaxayso 12-19 sano oo xasaraduhu qabsadaan.
en: The Emergency Youth Shelter of the Finnish Red Cross (Suomen Punaisen Ristin Nuorten turvatalo) helps and supports 12–19-year-olds in crisis situations.

so: Lammanaha leh ilmo da'doodu ay ka yar yahay 13 sano, waxay dhibaatada ka soo foodsaarta guurka iyo wada noolaanshada cawinaad uga helayaan xafiiska la talinta qoyska (perheneuvola).
en: Couples with children under the age of 13 years can get help for problems in marriage and relationships from family counselling (perheneuvola).

so: Macluumaadka waxaa laga helayaa bogga internetka ee Vantaa.
en: You can find the contact information on the Vantaa website.

so: Adeegyada xafiiska la talinta qoysku waa sir, waana bilaash.
en: Family counselling services are confidential and free of charge.

so: Xaaladaha xasaradaha deg degta ah ee qoyska, waxaad la xiriiri kartaa heeganka sooshalka -iyo xasaradaha (sosiaali- ja kriisipäivystys), kaas oo maalin kasta furan.
en: In sudden family crisis situations, you can contact the Social and Crisis Emergency Services (sosiaali- ja kriisipäivystys), which are always open..

so: Dhibaatooyinka lammaanaha iyo qoyska soo food saara waxaa sidoo kale kaa cawinaya la talinta qoyska ee kaniisada Vantaa.
en: The family guidance of the Vantaa Parish Union also helps with relationship and family issues.

so: War dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Dhibaatooyinka isqabida iyo xiriirka lammaanaha
en: To read more, go to: Problems in marriage and relationships

so: Rugaha la-talinta carruurta (lastenneuvola) iyo la-talinta qoyska (perheneuvola) waxay talo ka bixiyaan su'aalaha la xiriira caafimaadka cunugga koriinshaha iyo horumarkiisa.
en: Child health clinics (lastenneuvola) and family counselling centres (perheneuvola) provide advice on questions related to the health or growth and development of children.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Dhibaatooyinka carruurta iyo dhallinyarada
en: Read more: Children's and young people's problems

so: Xarunta dhalinyarada ee Nuppi (nuortenkeskus Nuppi) waxay caawiyaa carruurta iyo dhalinyarada da'doodu u dhaxayso 13–21-sano iyo qoyskooda.
en: Young people aged 13–21 and their parents can get help from the Nuppi Support and Intervention Unit for the Young (Nuortenkeskus Nuppi).

so: Haddii aad ka weyn tahay 21 sano, waxaad Nuppi ka heleysaa la talin waqti gaaban ah.
en: If you are over 21 years old, you can get short-term guidance at Nuppi.

so: Nuppi waxaad caawinaad uga heli kareysaa cawinaad tusaale ahaan dhibaatooyinka caafimaadka dhimirka iyo mukhaadaraadka.
en: Nuppi can help with mental health and substance abuse problems, for example.

so: Haddii da'daadu ay 30-sano ka hooseyso, waxaad adeega Ohjaamada ka heli kartaa la talin iyo hagid.
en: If you are under 30 years old, you can get advice and guidance from the Ohjaamo service.

so: Shaqaalaha Ohjaamo ayaa ku caawinaya, haddii aadan haysan shaqo ama goob waxbarasho.
en: Ohjaamo staff help people who do not have a job or study place.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale wax ka weydiin kartaa arimaha kale tusaale ahaan degaanka iyo isticmaalka lacagta.
en: You can also ask about other things, such as housing or money matters.

so: La talinta sooshalka (sosiaalineuvonta) waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad la xiriira kaalmada lacagta noloshaiyo kaalmooyinka kale, haddii ay ku haystaan dhibaatooyin dhaqaale.
en: Social counselling (sosiaalineuvonta) provides information about income support and other forms of support if you have financial problems.

so: Lacagta nolosha (toimeentulotuki) waxaa loogu talo galay inay noqoto badbaadada ugu dambeysa, markii aaney jirin dakhliyo ama hanti kale, ama ay aad u yar yihiin.
en: Income support (toimeentulotuki) is meant to be the last refuge when you have no other income or assets, or very little of them.

so: Waxaad lacagta nolosha heli kartaa, haddii aadan shaqadada ka heleyn dakhli kugu filan oo aad ku noolaato ama aadan meel kale masruuf ka helin ama si kale aan dakhli kuu soo gelin.
en: You can receive income support if you cannot get enough income from your own work, from the care of others or in other ways.

so: Waxaad talooyinka la xiriira codsashada lacagta nolosha weydiin kartaa adeegga telefoonka oo loo cayimay
en: You can ask for advice about applying for income support at the centralised telephone service

so: Dhaqaale- iyo la talinta deymaha
en: Financial and debt counselling

so: Haddii aadan awoodin inaad bixiso biilashaada ama deymahaaga markii la gaaaro waqtii la bixin lahaa, la xiriir la talinta deymaha (velkaneuvontaan).
en: If you are unable to pay your bills or debts when they fall due, contact debt counselling (velkaneuvonta).

so: Haddii aad tahay mid dakhli yari uu soo galo, hantida lahayn isla markaasna ay kugu adagtahay inaad deyn hesho, waxaad deyn ka codsan kartaa amaahinta sooshalka (sosiaalinen luototus).
en: If you have a low income and little money and find it difficult to get a loan, you can apply for a loan from social credit (sosiaalinen luototus).

so: Lambarka telefoonka ee la talin macaamiisha iyo waqti qabsashadu waa (09) 8392 0173.
en: The customer information and appointment booking number is 09 8392 0173.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Dhibaatooyinka dhaqaale
en: Read more: Financial problems.

so: Haddii aad dhib ku qabto aalkolada ama muqaadaraadka, waxaad caawimaad ka raadsan kartaa rugaha caafimaadka (terveysasema) ama, xarumaha sooshaalka (sosiaaliasema), A-kilinikada (A-klinikka) ama kilinikada daryeelka muqaadaraadka (huumehoitoklinikka) (H-klinikka).
en: If you have problems with alcohol or drugs, you can seek help from the health stations (terveysasema) or the social service centres (sosiaaliasema), A Clinic (A-klinikka) or the drug treatment clinic, i.e. the H Clinic (huumehoitoklinikka, H-klinikka).

so: H-kilinika waxay sidoo kale goobo shaqo ku leedahay rugaha caafimaadka ee Tikkurila iyo Myyrmäki.
en: The H Clinic also has units in the health stations of Tikkurila and Myyrmäki.

so: Haddii ay dhibaato kaa haysato ciyaarida faraha badan ee geymamka, waxaad cawinaad ka codsan kartaa Klinikada-geymamka (Peliklinikka), kuwaas oo ku yaala bartama Helsinki.
en: If you have a gambling problem, you can seek help at the Gambling Clinic (Peliklinikka), which is located in Helsinki city centre.

so: Xarunta dhalinyarada ee Nuppi (Nuortenkeskus Nuppi) waxay caawisaa dhalinyarada ay haystaan dhibaatooyinka la xiriira isticmaalka mukhaadaraadku, isticmaalka faraha badan ee internetka, geymamku.
en: Nuppi Support and Intervention Unit for the Young (Nuortenkeskus Nuppi) helps young people who have problems with substance abuse, Internet addiction and gambling.

so: Nuppi waxay sidoo kale caawisaa dhalinyarada aad uga welwelsan ehelkooda isticmaasha mukhaadaraadka.
en: Nuppi also supports young people who are worried about a loved one's substance abuse.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Dhibaatooyinka maandooriyaha
en: Read more: Intoxicant abuse.

so: Vantaa waxaa ku yaala afar dhul-qabuurood, kuwaas oo ay leedahay kaniisada evankeliluuterigu.
en: Vantaa has four cemeteries, which belong of the Evangelical Lutheran parishes.

so: Intaas waxaa dheer qabuuraha Honkkanummi ee ku yaala Vaantaa kuwaas oo ay wada leeyiniin Vantaa iyo Helsinki, qabuurahan waxaa lagu duugi karaa meydadka aan diimaha midkoodna ka tirsaneyn.
en: There is also a joint cemetery of Vantaa and Helsinki in Honkanummi, Vantaa, for persons who did not belong to any religion.

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira xabaalida waxaad ka heleysaa xafiiska qabuuraha ee kaniisadaha Vantaa (Vantaan seurakuntien hautatoimisto) iyo xaafiisyada qabuuraha oo gaarka loo leeyahay.
en: For more information about burial, contact the funeral home of the Vantaa Parish Union (Vantaan seurakuntien hautatoimisto)and private funeral homes (hautaustoimisto).

so: Xafiiska qabuuraha kaniisadaha Vantaa
en: Funeral home of the Vantaa Parish Union

so: Hasdii qof qaraabadaada ahi uu si lama filaan ah u geeriyoodo, waxaad kaalmo iyo garab istaag la xiriira ka bogsiga naxdinta kula soo deristay ka heli kartaa heeganka sooshalka- iyo xasaradaha (sosiaali- ja kriisipäivystys).
en: If someone close to you dies suddenly, you can get help for recovering from the difficult experience and support with coping with the loss from Vantaa's Social and Crisis Emergency Services (sosiaali- ja kriisipäivystys).

so: Heeganku wuxuu furan yahay waqti walba.
en: The helpline is always open.

so: Dhibaatooyinka qoyska dhexdiisa ah
en: Problems in the family

so: Kahor guurka waa inaad codsataa baaritaanka waxyaabaha guurka hor-istaaga (avioliiton esteiden tutkiminen).
en: Before getting married, you must request in writing an examination of the possible impediments to your marriage (avioliiton esteiden tutkiminen).

so: Codsiga baaritaanka waxaad ka sameyn kartaa rejistareeshin kasta.
en: You can submit the examination request to any of the offices.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga rejsitareeshinka.
en: More information is available on the local register office's website.

so: Nikaaxa ama guurka shacabku wuxuu sidoo kale ka dhacaa rejistareeshinka.
en: Civil marriages are also performed at the local register office.

so: Naagta ama ninku waxay codsiga furiinka geysan karaan xafiiska maxkamada degmada Vantaa.
en: Women and men can file for divorce at the office of the District Court of Vantaa.

so: Lamaanuhu furiinka wadajir ama mid mid ayeey u codsan karaan.
en: You can file for divorce independently or together with your spouse.

so: Codsiga waxaa la geyn karaa xafiiska maxkamadda ama waxaa loogu diri karaa xafiiska qaab boosto, fakis ama emayl ah.
en: You can take the application to the District Court office or send it there by post, fax or e-mail.

so: Haddii aad carruur leedahay islamarkaasna aad qorsheyneyso furiin la xiriir sarkaalka ilaaliya danaha carruurta (lastenvalvoja) ee magaalada Vantaa.
en: If you have children and you decide to file for a divorce, please contact a child welfare supervisor (lastenvalvoja) of the City of Vantaa.

so: Shaqada sooshaalku waxay xoojisaa heshiiska deegaanka carruurta, daryeelka, xuquuqda la kulanka iyo masruufka.
en: The social services verify the agreement regarding the housing and care of the children as well as access rights and child support.

so: Ilaaliyayaasha danaha carruurtu waxay sidoo kale la talin karaan waalidka is-furaya.
en: Child welfare supervisors also advise divorcing parents.

so: Ilaaliyeyaasha danaha carruurta macluumaadkooda waxaad ka heli kartaa bogga internetka ee magaalada Vantaa.
en: You can find the contact information of child welfare supervisors on the City of Vantaa's website.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Carruurta iyo furiinka
en: Read more: Children in a divorce.

so: Macluumaadka dhalashada cunugga waxaa isbitaalka looga soo dirayaa nidaamka diiwaanka dadka ee Finland.
en: Information regarding a child's birth is sent from the hospital to the Finnish Population Information System.

so: Waa in aad magacyada cunugga, afkiisa hooyo iyo macluumaadka kale ee loo baahan yahay ku soo ogeysiisaa Rajistareeshinka (Maistraatti) foom gaar ah oo guriga laguugu soo diraayo.
en: You have to inform the Local Register Office (Maistraatti) about the child's names, native language and other necessary information on a separate form that will be sent to your home.

so: Diiwaangelinta dhalashada cunugga, caddeynta aabanimada iyo mas'uuliyadda warar dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan waxaad ka aqrin kartaa bogga InfoFinlandi: Finland markii uu ilmuhu dhaso.
en: You can read more about the registration of a child's birth, recognition of paternity and custody on the InfoFinland page: When a child is born in Finland.

so: Bogga InfoFinland ee Waxbarashada Vantaa waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad la xiriira xanaano maalmeedka carruurta ee Vantaa.
en: You can find information about children's day care in Vantaa on the InfoFinland page Education in Vantaa.

so: Kaalmada guri ku xanaaneynta ilmaha
en: Child home care allowance

so: Haddii aad ilmo 3 sano ka yar guriga ku xanaaneyneysid, waxaad heli kartaa kaalmada guri ku xanaaneynta ilmaha (kotihoidon tuki).
en: If you are taking care of a child under the age of 3 years at home, you can receive child home care allowance (kotihoidon tuki).

so: Kaalmada waxaa laga dalbadaa Kelada.
en: Apply for the allowance from Kela.

so: Intaas waxaa dheer in magaalada Vantaa ay bixiso kaalmada guri ku xannaneynta ilmaha ka sokow kaalmo degmo oo dheeri ah oo la siiyo waalidka guriga ku xanaaneeya ilmaha da'doodu ay ka yar tahay 1,5 sano.
en: In addition, the City of Vantaa pays a municipal supplement to child home care allowance to parents taking care of a child under the age of 1.5 years at home

so: Looma baahna indaad kaalmada si gooni ah u codsatid, balse Kelada ayaan ku daraysa gunada Vantaa (Vantaa-lisä) tan guri ku xanaaneynta ilmaha.
en: You do not need to apply separately for the supplement; Kela will add theVantaa supplement (Vantaa-lisä) to the child home care allowance.

so: Xanaano maalmeedka furan iyo jardiinooyinka dadka deegaanka
en: Open day-care centres and residents' parks

so: Xaanaano maalmeedka furan (Avoin päiväkoti) waxaa loogu talogalay ilmaha da'da iskuulka ka yar iyo waalidiinta ama dadka kale oo iyaga guriga ku xanaaneeya.
en: Open day-care centres (avoin päiväkoti) are meant for children under the school-age and their parents or carers taking care of them at home.

so: Jardiinada dadka deegaanka (asukaspuisto) waxaa loogu talogalay carruurta da'da walba ah iyo waalidiintooda ama dadka kale oo xanaaneeya.
en: Residents' parks (asukaspuisto) are meant for children of all ages and they parents or carers.

so: Carruurta yar yari waxay wax qabadka jardiinada kala qayb qaadan karaan waalidkooda ama dadka kale oo markaas iyaga xanaaneynaya.
en: Very young children can participate in activities with their parent or carer.

so: Xanaano maalmeedka furan iyo jardiinooyinka dadka deegaanka hawshoodu waa lacag la'aan, umana baahna inaad horay isaga sii diiwaan geliso.
en: The activities of open day-care centres and residents' parks are free of charge and do not require advance registration.

so: Hawlaha waxaa ku jira ciyaar iyo waxqabad la hagayo, tusaale ahaan muusik, jimicsi iyo wixii la mid ah, duur aadid.
en: The activities include games and guided activities, such as music, sports and trips.

so: Magaalada Vantaa waxay naadiyo (kerho) u qaban-qaabisaa carruurta ay da'doodu u dhaxayso 2,5-5- sano, kuwaas oo guriga lagu xannaaneeyo.
en: The City of Vantaa organises clubs (kerho) for children aged 2.5–5 years who are in home care.

so: Naadiyadu waa lacag la'aan.
en: Clubs are free of charge.

so: Naadiga ilmuhu wuxuu ku baranayaa luuqada Finnishka, wuxuu ku baranayaa koox la shaqaynta sidoo kale wuxuu la kulmayaa carruur kale.
en: At clubs, children learn Finnish, how to act in a group and meet other children.

so: Nadiga waxaa la codsadaa marka la samaynayo codsiga barbaarinta hore (varhaiskasvatushakemus), kaas oo sidoo kale lagu codsado xanaano maalmeedka.
en: Apply to clubs with the same early education application (varhaiskasvatushakemus) that you use to apply for day care.

so: Adeega kaalmada xanaanada carruurta
en: Child care help service

so: Haddii aad ilmo guriga ku xanaaneysid oo aad u baahato meel ilmaha si ku meel gaar ah lagugu sii simo tusaale ahaan inta hawl cayiman ka soo qabsaneysid, vaxaad la xiriiri kartaa adeega kaalmada xanaanada (hoitoapupalvelu).
en: If you are taking care of a child at home and temporarily need a carer for the child, for example to run errands, you can contact the child care help service (hoitoapupalvelu).

so: Cawinaada xanaaneyntu waa lacag.
en: The child care help is subject to a fee.

so: Haddii aad dooneysid si ku meelgaar ah inaad gurigaaga ugu yeeratid qof carruurta kuu xanaaneysa, waxaad la xiriiri kartaa isbahaysiga badbaadada carruurta ee Mannerheim ama isbahaysiga dad dhigida.Cawinaada xanaaneynta carruurta ee ku meelgaarka ahi waa lacag.
en: If you need a temporary childminder at home, you can contact the Mannerheim League for Child Welfare or Väestöliitto, the Family Federation of Finland. Temporary child care help is subject to a fee.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Daryeelka caruurta
en: Read more: Taking care of a child

so: Haddii aad ka shakiso in ilmo ama qof dhlinyara ahi uu u baahanyhay cawinaadda badbaadada caruurta (lastensuojelu), la soo xiriir shaqaalaha sooshalka.
en: If you suspect that a child or young person needs help from Child Welfare (lastensuojelu), contact a social worker.

so: Bogga InfoFinland Xaaladaha dhibku jiro iyo Vantaa waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad la xiriira, meesha Vantaa dhexdeeda cawinaada looga heli karo dhibaatooyinka carruurta iyo dhalinyarda.
en: You can find information about where you can find help for the problems of children and young people in Vantaa on the InfoFinland page Problem situations in Vantaa.

so: Bogga InfoFinland waxaa sidoo kale laga heli karaa macluumaad ku saabsan dhibaatooyinka caruurta iyo dhalinyarada Dhibaatooyinka carruurta iyo dhallinyarada iyo Xagee caawimaad looga helaa dhibaatooyinka carruurta iyo dhalinyarada?
en: There is also information about the problems of children and young people on the InfoFinland pages Children's and young people's problems and Child welfare.

so: Bogga InfoFinland ee Dhibaatooyinka isqabida iyo xiriirka lammaanaha waxaa ku jira macluumaad la xiriira, xagee cawinaad looga heli karaa dhibaatooyinka xiriirka lamaanaha.
en: The InfoFinland page Problems in marriage and relationships provides information on where you can get help with relationship issues.

so: Vantaa waxaa ku yaal adeegyo si gooni ah loogu talagalay dadka da'da ah.
en: Vantaa has services especially designed for elderly persons.

so: Macluumaadkooda waxaad ka heleysaa talibixinta duqeytida.
en: For more information about them, contact the Counselling for senior citizens.

so: Marka aad guriga ku daryeeleysid ehelkaaga
en: If you care for a family member at home

so: Haddii qof qoyskaaga ka mid ah uu cawinaad joogto ah u baahan yahay oo daryeelku adiga ku xayiraya islamarkaasna adag, waxaa suurtagala ah inaad daryeelistiisa uga hesho degmada lacagta daryeelka ehelka.
en: If a family member needs constant care and the care is demanding and requires much commitment from you, it is possible to receive informal care support from the municipality.

so: Qiimeynta taageeridda ehel daryeelista ee qofka waayeelka ah waxaa lagu sameynayaa talo-bixinta duqeytida.
en: The assessment of an elderly person's informal care support is handled by Counselling for Senior Citizens.

so: Ka sii aqri warar dheeraad ah: Dadka da'da ah.
en: To read more, go to: Elderly.

so: Marka aad uur leedahay Curyaan
en: When you are expecting a baby

so: Waxaad sidoo kale adeega weydiin kartaa hagid ku saabsan sida cudurada loo daaweeyo.
en: You can also ask for care instructions for specific illnesses at this number.

so: Waxaad ku hadli kartaa Finnish, Iswidish ama Ingiriis.
en: The service is available in Finnish, Swedish and English.

so: Haddii magaalada aad degentahay ay tahay Vantaa magaalada aad degentahay ay tahay Vantaa, waxaad istimaali kartaa adeegyada guud ee caafimaadka.
en: If you have a municipality of residence in Vantaa, you can use the public health services.

so: Adegyada guud ee caafimaadku tusaale ahaan waa rugaha caafimaadka, dhakhtarka ilkaha, xarumaha hooyada iyo dhallaanka iyo isbitaalada.
en: Public health services include, for example, health centres, dental clinics, maternity and child health clinics and hospitals.

so: Haddii aad si lama filaan ah u xanuunsatid ama uu shil kugu dhaco, waxaad heleysaa gargaar deg deg ah, xitaa haddii aadan degeneyn Vantaa.
en: If you fall ill suddenly or are hurt in an accident, you will be given emergency treatment even if Vantaa is not your municipality of residence.

so: Vantaa waxay leedahay todobo rug caafimaad (terveysasema), kuwaas oo bixiya adeeyo caafimaad oo guud oo caafimaad.
en: Vantaa has seven health centres (terveysasema), which offer public health services.

so: waxaad rugaha caafimaadka kala xiriiri kartaa, markii aad wacdid rugaha caafimaadka lambarkooda ama lambarka la talinta caafimaadka tel. (09) 839 10023 markaasna waxaad dooranaysaa oo qaraacaysaa lambarka rugtaada caafimaadka.
en: To contact a health centre, you can call the health centre's own number or the health advice number, tel. 09 839 10023; select your health centre with the number keys.

so: Haddii aad u baahantahay isla maalintaas inaad hesho daryeel caafimaad oo deg deg ah, wac rugta caafimaadka marka la furo
en: If you need urgent treatment on the same day, call the health centre as soon as it opens in the morning.

so: Macaluumaadka saxda ah ka fiiri boggooda internetka ee u gaarka ah rugaha caafimaadka.
en: For more information, visit the websites of the individual health stations.

so: Vantaa waxaa ka hawlgalaa rugo dhakhaatiir oo dhawr ah, kuwaas oo aad ka heli kartid adeeyo caafimaad oo gooni loo leeyahay.
en: There are several private clinics in Vantaa that offer private health services.

so: Waad aadi kartaa rugaha dhakhaatiirta, xitaa haddii aadan xaq u lahayn isticmaalka adeegyada guud ee caafimaadka ee Finland.
en: You can go to a private clinic even if you do not have the right to use public health services in Finland.

so: Kharashka rugaha dhakhaatiirta ee gaarka loo leeyahay waa inaad idigu iska bixiso.
en: However, at private clinics you have to pay the costs yourself.

so: Kela xoogaa magdhaw ah ayeey ka bixisa kharashka ku baxa daryeelka caafimaadka.
en: In some cases, Kela may compensate a small part of private medical costs.

so: Macaluumaadka la xiriira iibsiga daawooyinka waxaad ka heleysaa bogga internetka ee InfoFinland Daawooyinka.
en: You can learn more about buying medication on the InfoFinland page Medication.

so: Daryeelka caafimaadka ee dadka aan sharciga lahayn
en: Health care of undocumented persons

so: Waxaa Helsinki ka hawlgala Global Clinic, halkaas oo dadka sharci la'aanta ku jooga Finland ay ka heli karaan daryeelka caafimaadka aasaasiga ah.
en: Global Clinic in Helsinki provides basic health care to people who are in Finland without permits.

so: Adeegyada Global Clinic waa u bilaash macaamiisha.
en: The services of Global Clinic are free of charge to the clients.

so: Global Clinic macaamiisheeda ma ogeysiiso booliska ama hawlwadeenada kale ee dawlada.
en: Global Clinic does not report its clients to the police or other authorities.

so: Si loo xafido macaamiisha klinikada meesha ay ku taalo iyo waqtiyada ay furan tahay si guud looma ogeysiiyo.
en: In order to protect the clients, the clinic's location or opening hours are not announced publicly.

so: Telefoonka waxaa ka jawaabaya kalkaaliye caafimaad ama dhakhtar.
en: A nurse or doctor answers the telephone.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Adeega caafimaadka ee Finland.
en: Read more: Health services in Finland

so: Galbihii, dhammaadka usbuuca iyo maalmaha fasaxa, rugaha caafimaadku waa xiran yihiin.
en: Health centres are closed in the evenings and on weekends and holidays

so: Waqtiyadaas xanuunada kadiska ah iyo shilalka waxaa lagu daryeelaa heeganka (päivystys).
en: At those times, urgent illnesses and accidents are treated at the emergency health centre (päivystys).

so: Heeganka Vantaa waa isbitaalka Peijas.
en: In Vantaa, the emergency health centre is at Peijas Hospital.

so: Haddii aad si kadis ah u xanuunsato, waxaad sidoo kale aadi kartaa baraha heeganka ee magaalooyinka kale.
en: If you fall ill suddenly, you can also go to other emergency health centre units in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeri ah oo la xiriira baraha heeganka waxaad ka heli kartaa bogga internetka ee adeegyada caafimaadka Vantaa.
en: You can learn more about emergency health centre units on the website of Vantaa Health Services.

so: War dheeraad ah ka sii akhri: Adeega caafimaadka ee Finland.
en: To read more, go to: Health services in Finland

so: Ilmaha da'da iskuulka ka hooseeya daryeelka caafimaadka waxaa ka caawiya rugaha hooyada iyo dhallaanka (neuvola).
en: Maternity and child health clinics (neuvola) help with the health care of children under the school age.

so: Rugta hooyada iyo dhallaanka waxaad weydiin kartaa inay ku siiyaan talo iyo kaalmo ku toosan waalidnimada iyo barbaarinta ilmaha.
en: You can ask the clinic for advice and support for parenting and child-raising.

so: Rugta hooyada iyo dhallaanka waxaa lagula socdaa caafimaadka ilmaha, koritaanka iyo horumarka isla markaasna waxaa lagu siiyaa tallaalo.
en: The clinic monitors children's health, growth and development and gives vaccinations.

so: Macluumaadka rugaha hooyada iyo dhallaanka waxaad ka heleysaa bogga internetka ee Vantaa.
en: You can find clinics' contact information on the Vantaa website.

so: Adeega telefoonka ee rugaha hooyada iyo dhallaanka ayaad waqti uga qabsan kartaa rugta hooyada iyo dhallaanka, waxaadna su'aalo la xiriirka arimaha uurka ama caafimaadka ilmaha ku weydiin kartaa kalkaaliyaha caafimaadka.
en: You can call the clinics' telephone service to make an appointment and to ask a nurse questions about pregnancy or children's health.

so: Ilmaha da'da iskuulka gaarey caafimaadkooda waxaa ka taxadaraya daryeelka caafimaadka ee iskuulka.
en: School health care looks after the health of school-age children.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogga internetka ee Vantaa.
en: You can find more information on the City of Vantaa website.

so: Haddii uu ilmuhu si kadis ah u xanuunsado, la xiriir rugta caafimaadka ama heeganka.
en: If a child falls ill suddenly, contact a health centre or emergency health centre.

so: Dadka da'da ah waxay isticmaalaan adeegyo caafimaad oo la mid ah kuwa ay dadka kale isticmaalaan.
en: Elderly people use the same health services as everyone else.

so: Intaas waxaa dheer Vantaa waxay leedahay adeegyo gooni ah oo loogu talogalay dadka da'da ah, kuwaas oo aad macluumaadkooda ka heleysid la talinta arimaha dadka gabowga ah (seniorineuvonta).
en: Vantaa also has services especially for the elderly; you can find more information on them from counselling for senior citizens (seniorineuvonta).

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah oo la xiriira adeegyada dadka da'da ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogga internetka ee Vantaa.
en: You can find more information about services for the elderly on the City of Vantaa website.

so: Ka sii aqri warar dheeraad ah: Caafimaadka dadka da'da ah iyo Dadka da'da ah.
en: Read more: Health of the elderly and Elderly.

so: Qiimeynta kaalmada ee xigto daryeelista dadka gabowga ah waxaa lagu sameeyaa rugta latalinta dadka gabowga ah.
en: The assessment of the need for informal care support for the elderly is done at counselling for senior citizens.

so: Qiimeynta kaalmada xigto daryeelista ee dadka 65 sano kayar waxaa lagu sameeyaa rugta latalinta cuuryaamiinta.
en: The assessment of the need for informal care support for people under 65 years of age is done at counselling for the disabled.

so: Daryeelka ilkaha (hammashoito) ee Vantaa, lambarka waqti qabsashadu waa (09) 8393 5300.
en: Vantaa's dental care (hammashoito) appointment number is 09 8393 5300.

so: Waqti qabsashada waxaad wici kartaa:
en: You can call and make an appointment:

so: Haddii arintaadu aysan deg deg ahayn, wac 10 kadib.
en: If your matter is not urgent, call after 10 am.

so: Waxaad u reebi kartaa codsi in dib laguu soo waco, haddii adeegu uu mashquul yahay.
en: You can leave a callback request if the service is busy.

so: Haddii aad maalin shaqo si deg deg ah ugu baahato daryeelka dhakhtarka ilkaha, wac haddiiba waqti qabsashada markii ay furanto.
en: If you urgently need dental care on a weekday, call the appointment number as soon as it opens in the morning.

so: Galbihii iyo dhammaadka usbuuca heeganka daryeelka ilkuhu (hammashoidon päivystys) waa isbitaalka Haartman ee Helsinki.
en: In the evenings and on weekends, emergency dental care (hammashoidon päivystys) is provided at the Haartman Hospital in Helsinki.

so: Heeganka habeenimo ee daryeelka ilkuhu (hammashoidon yöpäivystys) waa isbitaalka Töölö qaybta shilalka.
en: Night-time emergency dental care (hammashoidon yöpäivystys) is provided at the Töölö Hospital's emergency department.

so: Isbitaalka Töölö qaybta shilalka, Heeganka qaybta qalliinka afka iyo daamanka.
en: Töölö Hospital Emergency Department, Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery Emergency Department

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira daryeelka ilkaha ee carruurta da'da iskuulka ka hooseysa waxaad ka heleysaa la talinta rugta hooyada iyo dhallaanka (lastenneuvola) iyo xarumaha daryeelka ilkaha (hammashoitola).
en: You can get information about the dental care of children under the school age at the child health clinic (lastenneuvola) and (dental clinics) hammashoitola.

so: Carruurta ka yar 17-sano waxaa loogu yeeraa baaritaanka daryeelka ilkaha qiyaastii labadii sanadoodba hal mar.
en: Children under the age of 17 years are invited to the dental clinic for a dental examination approximately once every two years.

so: Sidoo kale Vantaa waxaa ka hawlgala rugo dhakhaatiirta ilkaha ee gaar loo leeyahay.
en: There are also private dentists in Vantaa.

so: Waad aadi kartaa rugaha dhakhaatiirta ilkaha ee gaarka loo leeyahay, xitaa haddii aadan xaq u lahayn isticmaaka adeegyada guud ee daryeelka caafimaadka.
en: If you are not entitled to use public health services, you can go to a private dentist.

so: Kharashka rugaha dhakhaatiirta ilkaha ee gaarka loo leeyahay waa inaad adigu iska bixiso.
en: However, at private dentists you have to pay the costs yourself.

so: Xaaladaha qaarkood Kela xoogaa magdhaw ah ayeey ka bixisa kharashka ku baxa daryeelka caafimaadka.
en: In some cases, Kela may compensate a small part of private dental care costs.

so: Haddii aad u baaahan tahay cawinaad iyo garab istaagid xagga dhimirka ah, la xiriir rugtaada caafimaadka (terveysasema).
en: If you need mental help and support, contact your health centre (terveysasema).

so: Rugta caafimaadka waxaa lagu daryeelaa dhibaatooyinka caafimaadka dhimirka oo iska caadiga ah.
en: The health centre treats the most common mental health problems.

so: Rugta caafimaadku waxay kuu sameynaysaa hagitaan ay horay kuugu sii gudbineyso tusaale ahaan daryeeleyaasha murugada.
en: The health centre can refer you to a psychiatric nurse specialised in depression, for example.

so: Haddii rugtaada caafimaadku aysan furneyn oo ay xaaladuna deg deg tahay, la xiriir isbitaalka guud ee Peijas heegankiisa (Peijaksen sairaalan yhteispäivystys).
en: If the health centre is not open and the situation is urgent, please contact the Peijas Hospital's joint emergency unit (Peijaksen sairaalan yhteispäivystys).

so: Haddii aad si dhaqso ah u baahantahay cawinaad mushkiladeed, waxaad sidoo kale wici kartaa sooshalka –iyo heeganka mushkiladaha.
en: If you need immediate crisis help, you can also call the Social and Crisis Emergency Services.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri:
en: Read more: Mental health.

so: Haddii aad dooneysid inaad hesho macluumaad la xiriira, ka hortaga uurka, ilmo iska soo ridid, caafimaadka dhinaca galmada iyo cudurada xubnaha taranka, waxaad la xiriiri kartaa qaybta xarunta hooyada iyo dhallaanka u qaabilsan ka hortaga iyo qorshaynta qoyska (ehkäisy- ja perhesuunnitteluneuvola).
en: If you want to know more about pregnancy prevention, abortion, sexual health and sexually transmitted diseases, you can contact the contraception and family planning clinic (ehkäisy- ja perhesuunnitteluneuvola).

so: La talin ka kortaga iyo qorshaynta qoysku waxay u adeegtaa rag iyo dumar da' walba isugu jira.
en: Contraception and family planning clinics help women and men of all ages.

so: Xarumaha la talintu waxay ku shaqeeyaan waqti qabsasho.
en: The clinics work by appointment.

so: Tagitaanku waa u bilaash dhammaan.
en: Visits are free of charge for the clients.

so: Macluumaadkooda ka fiiri bogga internetka ee magaalada Vantaa.
en: You can find the contact information on the City of Vantaa website.

so: Waqti ka qabso dhakhtarka ama kalkaalisada caafimaad la talinta ka hortaga, haddii aad u baahan tahay ka hortagga uurka (raskauden ehkäisy) ama aad ka fakareysid ilmo iska soo ridid (abortti).
en: Make an appointment with a contraception clinic doctor or nurse if you need contraception (raskauden ehkäisy) or are thinking of an abortion (abortti).

so: Waqti ka qabso dhakhtarka guud ee rugta caafimaadka, haddii tusaale ahaan ay ku haysato dhibaato dareer ama uu jiro wax xuun ah caloosha qaybteeda hoose.
en: Make an appointment with a general practitioner at a health centre if you have menstrual flow problems or abdominal pains.

so: Waxaa sidoo kale rugta caafimaadka lagu daweeyaa cudurada xubnaha taranka (sukupuolitauti).
en: Health centres also treat sexually transmitted diseases (sukupuolitauti).

so: Dadka reer Vantaa waxay sidoo kale aadi karaan poliklinikada cudurada xubnaha taranka ee Helsinki.
en: Vantaa residents can also go Venereal Diseases Outpatient Clinic in Helsinki.

so: Caafimaadka galmada, Ka-hortaga uurka
en: Read more: Sexual health, Contraception.

so: Rugta hooyada iyo dhallaanka (äitiysneuvola) ayaa laga soconayaa caafimaadka hooyada, cunuga iyo kan qoyska oo idil inta ilmuhu uu uurka ku jiro oo dhan.
en: The maternity health clinic (äitiysneuvola) monitors the health of the mother, the baby and the whole family during pregnancy.

so: La xiriir rugta hooyada iyo dhallaanka, haddii aad dareento inaad uur leedahay.
en: Contact a clinic when you notice that you are pregnant.

so: Adeega teleefanaha rugaha hooyada iyo dhallaanka waxaad waqti uga qabsan kartaa rugta hooyada iyo dhallaanka waxaadna kalkaalisada caafimaadka telefoon ku weydiin kartaa arimaha la xiriira uurka ama dhalmada.
en: You can call the clinics' telephone service to make an appointment and to ask a public health nurse questions about pregnancy or childbirth.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo la xiriira uurka iyo dhalmada waxaad ka heli kartaa netka hooyada iyo dhallaanka (nettineuvola) ee magaalada Vantaa.
en: You can find more information about pregnancy and childbirth at the City of Vantaa's Online Clinic (Nettineuvola).

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri Marka aad uur leedahay
en: Read more: When you are expecting a baby.

so: Waxaad isbitaal dhalmo u dooran kartaa mid ka mid ah isbitaalada xanydaabka darleelka bukaanka ee Helsinki iyo uudenmaa (Helsingin ja Uudenmaan sairaanhoitopiiri HUS), kuwaas oo tusaale ahaan ah isbitaalka Jorvi (Jorvin sairaala) iyo Klinikada dumarka (Naistenklinikka).
en: You can choose to give birth at any hospital of the Hospital District of Helsinki and Uusimaa (HUS), such as the Jorvi Hospital and the Women's Hospital (Naistenklinikka).

so: Adeegyada cuuryaamiinta waad heli kartaa haddii adiga ama ehelkaadu uu qabo naafo ama jiro, taas oo sababeysa wakhti dheer in ay si gaar ah u adkaato ka soo bixista nolosha guriga iyo guriga banaankiisaba.
en: You may use disability services if you or someone close to you has a disability or illness that causes special long-term difficulties in coping at home and in life outside home.

so: Adeegyada cuuryaamiintu tusaale ahaan waa caawimaad shakhsi ah, deegaan adeeg leh, adeegga gaadiidka iyo shaqada wax ka beddelista dhismaha.
en: Disability services include personal assistance, service housing, transport service and home alteration work.

so: La xiriir rugta latalinta cuuryaamiinta, halkaas oo iyadoo xaaladdaada lagu saleynayo lagu baarayo baahida kaalmada, hagitaanka iyo adeegyada.
en: Contact counselling for the disabled for the examination of the need for support, guidance and services in your situation.

so: Ka sii aqri warar dheeraad ah: Dadka naafada ah.
en: Read more: Disabled persons.

so: Caafimaadka galmada iyo ka hortagga uurka
en: Sexual health and contraception

so: Lambarka guud ee xaaladaha degdegga ah waa 112.
en: The general emergency number is 112.

so: Wac lambarka xaaladaha degdegga ah, haddii ay jirto xaalad degdeg ah oo kaliya, tusaale ahaan jirro degdeg ah.
en: Only call the emergency number in case of an emergency, such as a stroke.

so: Haddii aad guriga degmo ku leedahay Vantaa, waxaad isticmaali kartaa adeegyada caafimaadka dadweynaha.
en: If you have a municipality of residence in Vantaa, you can use the city's public health services.

so: Haddii aadan xaq u laheyn in aad isticmaasho adeegyada caafimaadka dadweynaha, waxaad ballan ka qabsan kartaa xarumaha dhakhaatiirka gaarka ah.
en: If you are not entitled to use public health services, you can make an appointment at a private clinic.

so: Lambarka wadajirka ah ee telefoonka adeegga ee rugaha caafimaadka Vantaa waa 09 839 50 000 .
en: The number for the shared telephone service of Vantaa health centres is 09 839 50 000.

so: Waad wici kartaa, haddii aad u baahantahay talo ku saabsan daryeel jiro ama aad dooneyso in aad ballan baajiso ama dhakhtarka wakhti ka qabsato.
en: You can call if you need advice about treating an illness or want to make or cancel a doctor's appointment.

so: Vantaa waxay leedahay todobo rug caafimaad, kuwaas oo bixiya adeeyo caafimaad oo guud oo caafimaad.
en: Vantaa has seven health centres, which offer public health services.

so: Rugaha caafimaadka waxaa qaabilaad ku sameeya dhakhtar, kalkaaye caafaimaad iyo fayadhawre caafimaad.
en: The health centres have doctor's, nurse's and public health nurse's practices.

so: Haddii aad degdeg u jirto, rug kasta oo caafimaad ayaad aadi kartaa.
en: If you fall ill suddenly, you can go directly to any health centre.

so: Waxaa wanaagsan in subaxdi la aado rugta caafimaadka.
en: It is a good idea to go to the health centre in the early morning.

so: Haddii aad degdeg u jirato ama u dhaawacanto islamarkaasna aadan sugi kari furitaanka rugta caafimaadka, la xiriir heeganka.
en: If you fall ill or are injured suddenly and cannot wait for the health centre to open, contact the emergency clinic.

so: Lambarka telefoonka ee rugaha latalinta Vantaa waa 09 8392 5900.
en: Vantaa's maternity and child health clinic appointment number is 09 8392 5900.

so: Ballan ayaad ka qabsan kartaa rugta latalinta ama waxaad talo ka weydiin kartaa arrimaha la xiriira caafimaadka cunugga.
en: You can make an appointment for the clinic or ask for advice in matters connected to your child's health.

so: Haddii uu cunuggu degdeg u jirao, la xiriir rugta caafimaadka.
en: When a child suddenly falls ill, contact a health centre.

so: Haddii ay rugta caafimaadku xirantahay, la xiriir heeganka Isbitaalka carruurta.
en: When health centres are closed, contact the emergency clinic at the Children's Hospital.

so: Heeganka waxaa lagu daaweeyaa carruurta u baahan daryeel degdeg ah oo kaliya.
en: The emergency clinic only treats children who are in need of urgent medical assistance.

so: Lambarka telefoonka ee heeganku waa 116 117.
en: The telephone number of the emergency clinic is 116 117.

so: Waxaa sidoo kale cunugga geyn kartaa xarunta dhakhaatiirka gaarka ah.
en: You can also take your children to a private medical centre.

so: Vantaa waxaa ku yaal xarumo dhakhtareedyo badan oo gaar ah, kuwaas oo carruurta daaweeya.
en: There are numerous private clinics that treat children in Vantaa.

so: Haddii aad degdeg ugu baahantahay daryeelka dhakhtarka ilkaha, wac qabsashada wakhtiga islamarka la furo saacadda 7.30.
en: If you urgently need dental care, call the appointment number as soon as it opens at 7:30 pm.

so: Haddii aad u baahantahay kahortagga uurka, iska soo ridista uurma ama aad ka shakiso in aad qabto cudur galmada ah, waxaad la xiriiri kartaa rugta latalinta ee kahortagga uurka iyo qorsheynta qoyska.
en: If you need contraception or an abortion or suspect that you have a sexually transmitted disease, you can contact a contraception and family planning clinic.

so: Telefoonka ayaad ballan ku qasan kartaa.
en: Appointments can be made by telephone.

so: Haddii aad qabto cudur galmada ah, waxaad sii kale aad kartaa bolikiliinikada cudurada galmada ee Helsinki ama rugta caafimaadka.
en: If you have a sexually transmitted disease, you can also go to the Venereal Diseases Outpatient Clinic in Helsinki or to a health centre.

so: Vantaa waxay kahortagga uurka oo lacag la'aan ah siisaa dadka kayar 20 sano.
en: Vantaa offers free contraception for persons under 20 years old.

so: Dadka kayar 24 sano xittaa waa heli karaan kahortagga uurka, haddii ay isticmaalayaan qalabka uurka looga hortago oo wakhti dheer ahm sida gariiradda ama kaabsalka kahortagga uurka.
en: Persons under 24 years old can also get free contraception if they use long-term contraceptives, such as an intra-uterine device or a contraceptive implant.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Caafimaadka galmada iyo ka hortagga uurka.
en: To read more, go to: Sexual health and contraception.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Uurka iyo dhalmada iyo Finland markii uu ilmuhu dhaso.
en: To read more, go to: Pregnancy and childbirth and When a child is born in Finland.

so: Kaalmeyn iyo hagitaan dhalinyarada
en: Support and guidance for young people

so: Vantaa waxaa ku yaal xannaano-maalmeedyo ay degmadu leedahay iyo kuwa gaar loo leeyahay.
en: Vantaa has city-owned and private day-care centres.

so: Xannaano-maalmeedyada gaarka loo leeyahay xitaa magaaladu waa ilaalisaa.
en: Private day-care is also supervised by the city.

so: Vantaa waxaa laga helaa xannaano-maalmeedyado ku baxa luqada Finnishka, Iswidishka, Ruushka iyo Ingiriiska.
en: Day care in Finnish, Swedish, Russian and English is available in Vantaa.

so: Xannaano-maalmeedka waxaa kale oo luqada finnishka looga bixiyaa finnishka oo sidii luqad labaad ah.
en: Day care also provides teaching in Finnish as a second language.

so: Xannaano-maalmeedka waxaa kale oo lagu bixiyaa xannaano-maalmeedka qoyska iyo kooxda xannaano-maalmeedka qoyska.
en: Day care may also be organised as family day care and as group family day care.

so: Booska xannaanada magaalada waxaad ku codsan kartaa internetka ama foomka warqadda ah.
en: You can apply for a city day-care position online or on a paper form.

so: Codsiga internetka sameyntiisa dartiis waxaad u baahan tahay aqoonsi banki oo gaar ah ama aqoonsiga internetka.
en: For the electronic application, you need personal online banking credentials or an electronic identity card.

so: Foomamka warqadda ah waxaad ka heleysaa tusaale ahaan Vantaa-info iyo xannaano-maalmeedka.
en: Paper forms are available at Vantaa Infos and day-care centres.

so: Xannaano-maalmeedyada gaarka loo leeyahay waxaa toos looga codsanayaa booska xannaanada.
en: Private day care positions are applied for directly from the day-care centre.

so: Wixii xaanaano maalmeedka carruurta iyo dalabka booska xanaanada la xiira waxaad weydiin kartaa maamulaha xanaanada carruurta ama waxaa e-mail ahaan ugu diri kartaa cinwaanka ah varhaiskasvatus (at)vantaa.fi
en: You can ask about day care and how to apply for a day-care place from the day-care centre director or by e-mail at varhaiskasvatus(at)vantaa.fi.

so: Booska xannaano-maalmeedka waxaa inta badan laga codsadaa degmada aad deggan tahay.
en: You normally apply for day-care positions from you own municipality.

so: Haddii qoysku deggan yahay meel u dhow xuduuda Helsinki ama Espoo waad ka codsan kartaa booska xannaano-maalmeedka sidoo kale degmooyinka deriska ah.
en: If your family lives near the border of Helsinki or Espoo, you can also apply for a day-care position from the neighbouring municipality.

so: Si kastoo ay ahaataba codsiga dhig markasta degmadaada.
en: However, you should always submit the application to a location within your municipality.

so: Warar dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa adeegga Helsinginseutu.fi.
en: You can obtain more information from the Helsinginseutu.fi service.

so: Waxbarasho- horaadyada (esiopetus) waxaa lagu qabanqaabiyaa xannaano-maalmeedyada magaalada iyo xannaanooyin gaar loo leeyahay iyo waxbarsho-horaadyda ku shaqeeya gudaha iskuulaadka.
en: Pre-school education (esiopetus) is provided in city-owned day-care centres, private day-care centres and in pre-school education units operating in school premises.

so: Vantaa waa suurtagal in waxbarasho-horaad looga helo luqada Finnishka, Iswidishka iyo Ingiriiska.
en: In Vantaa, pre-school education is available in Finnish, Swedish and English.

so: Waxbarasho-horaadka waa in la codsadaa.
en: You must apply for pre-school education.

so: Codsiga waxaa lagu sameyn karaa bogagga magaalada ee internetka ama foomka warqadda ah.
en: The application can be submitted electronically through the city's website or on a paper form.

so: Waqtiga codsigu waa Janaayo, laakiin waa la codsan karaa waqtiyada kale haddii tusaale ahaan uu qoysku sanadka dhexdiisa u soo guuro Vantaa.
en: The application period is in January, but you can also submit applications at other times if your family moves to Vantaa in the middle of the year, for example.

so: Cunugga dalka u soo guuray ee aan heysan aqoon luqada Finnishka ah ee ku filan gelitaanka waxbarasho-horaadka waxaa loo fidinayaa waxbarasho diyaarin ah.
en: Preparatory education is available for immigrant children whose Finnish is not good enough for pre-school education.

so: Xannaano-maalmeedka ayaa looga hagaa waxbarashada diyaarinta ah marka la codsanayo waxbarasho-horaadka.
en: It is organised in pre-school education groups. Children are guided to preparatory education in day care when they apply for pre-school education.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan waxbarasho-horaadka, codsashada waxbarasho-horaadka iyo waxbarashada diyaarinta ah iyo weliba codsashadooda waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga magaalada Vantaa (Vantaan kaupunki).
en: More information on pre-school education, how to apply to pre-school education, and preparatory education is available on the website of the City of Vantaa (Vantaan kaupunki).

so: Waxaad sidoo kale weydiin kartaa faahfaahin dheeraad xannaano-maalmeedka.
en: You can also request more information from day-care centres.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Waxbarasho-horaadka
en: Read more: Pre-school education

so: Vantaa waxaa ka jira iskuulo aasaasi ah (peruskoulu) oo ku baxa luqada Finnishka ama Iswidishka.
en: Vantaa has Finnish and Swedish comprehensive schools (peruskoulu).

so: Vantaa waxaa sidoo kale ka shaqeeya iskuul caalami ah oo ku baran karto waxbarashada aasaasiga ah luqada Ingiriiska.
en: There is also an international school in Vantaa, where you can complete comprehensive school in English.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan iskuulada Vantaa waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga magaalada Vantaa (Vantaan kaupunki).
en: More information about schools in Vantaa is available on the website of the City of Vantaa (Vantaan kaupunki).

so: Iskuulka waa in horay la isaga diiwaangeliyaa waqtiga is diiwaangelintu sida caadiga ah waa Janaayo.
en: You must enrol for school in advance. The enrolment time is usually in January.

so: Bogagga shabakadda magaalada waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaadyada xiriirka ee iskuulaadka iyo iska diinwaagelintooda.
en: The contact information for schools and additional information about registration can be found on the website of the City of Vantaa.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Waxbarashada aasaasiga ah
en: To read more, go to: Comprehensive education

so: Waxbarashada u diyaarinta waxbarashada aasaasiga ah
en: Preparatory education for comprehensive school

so: Haddii ilmaha aqoontiisa luuqada Finnishku aysan aad ugu filnayn inuu waxbarashada aasaasiga ah ku dhigto luuqada Finnishka, wuxuu heli karaa waxbarasho u diyaarin ah (valmistava opetus).
en: If a child does not have good enough Finnish language skills to study at a Finnish-language comprehensive school, he or she can receive preparatory education (valmistava opetus).

so: Waxbarashada u diyaarinta ah waxaa lagu bartaa luuqada Finniska iyo maadooyinka dugsiyada aasaasiga ah lagu barto.
en: In preparatory education, children study Finnish and comprehensive school subjects.

so: Waxbarashadu waxay inta badan qaadataa hal sano.
en: It usually lasts for one year.

so: Haddii aad waqti yar ka hor aad timid dalka Finland oo aadan lahayn carruur da'da iskuulka gaartay, la xiriir isku xiraha aagga aad degan tahay (aluekoordinaattori).
en: If you have recently arrived in Finland and have school-age children, contact the regional coordinator (aluekoordinaattori) of your residential area.

so: Isku xiraha aaggu wuxuu dadka talo ka siiyaa qabanqaabada sidoo kale wuxuu dadka ka caawiyaa arimaha la xiriira iskuul dhigashada carruurta.
en: The regional coordinator will instruct and help you in arrangements and matters regarding your child's schooling.

so: Waxbarashada aasaasiga ah ee dhalinyarda dalka u soo guurtay
en: Comprehensive education for young immigrants

so: Dadka dalka u soo guurey ee dagan Vantaa da'dooduna u dhaxayso 17-24 sano waxay shahaadada waxbarashada aasaasiga ah ka qaadan karaan Machadka dadka waaweyn ee Vantaa (Vantaan aikuisopisto).
en: At the Vantaa Adult Education Centre (Vantaan aikuisopisto), 17–24 year-old immigrants living in Vantaa can obtain the comprehensive school leaving certificate.

so: Haddii aad dhex u joojisay dugsiga hoose-dhexe, waxaad ka dhameystiran kartaa dugsiga sare ee dadka waaweyn ee Eira (Eiran aikuislukio).
en: If you have not finished comprehensive school, you can also complete it at the Eira High School for Adults (Eiran aikuislukio).

so: Waxaad codsan kartaa waxbarasho ka dheeraad ah waxbarashada aasaasiga ama fasalka tobnaad (kymppiluokka), haddii aad qaadatay shahaadada waxbarashada aasaasiga ah isla sanadkaan ama kii ka horeeyey, laakiin aadan helin goob aad ku qaadato waxbarashda heerka labaad.
en: You can also apply for additional education in comprehensive education, or tenth grade (kymppiluokka), if you have received your comprehensive school leaving certificate during the same or previous year, but have not received an upper secondary-level study place.

so: Fasalka tobnaad waxaad sare ugu qaadi kartaa darajadii aad ka qaadatay dhamaadkii waxabarsha aasaasiga ah, sidoo kale waxaa laguu sameyn karaa qorshe la xiiriira sii wadashada waxbarashada.
en: In tenth grade, you can improve your comprehensive school grades and make plans for further education.

so: Fasalada tobnaadka ee Vantaa waxay ku yaalaan Bariga-Vantaa iyo Galbeedk- Vantaa ee xarumo hawleedka Varia iyo dugsida sare ee Lumio (Lumon lukio).
en: Vantaa's tenth grades are in East and West Vantaa at Varia units and Lumo Upper Secondary School (Lumon lukio).

so: Dadka dalka u soo guurey iyo dugsiga hoose-dhexe
en: Immigrants and comprehensive school

so: Dugsiyada hoose-dhexe ee Vantaa waxay intooda badan leeyihiin barashada afkaaga hooyo oo ku baxaya luuqado kala duwan.
en: The comprehensive schools in Vantaa provide native language education in many languages.

so: Sidoo kale ardayda afkooda hooyo uu yahay luuqad kale oo aan eheen Finnish, Iswidish ama saame ahayn oo heerka luuqadooda Finnishku aysan ahayn heerka afka hooyo oo kale, waxaa dugsiyada hoose-dhexe lagu siiyaa barashada Finniska sida luuqad labaad (suomi toisena kielenä).
en: The schools also provide education in Finnish as a second language (suomi toisena kielenä) to students whose native language is something other than Finnish, Swedish or Sami and whose Finnish skills are not at a native level.

so: Markii aad iskuulka iska diiwaan gelisid waxaad sidoo kale iska diiwaan gelin kartaa barashada afkaaga hooyo iyo barashada diinta.
en: When you enrol for school, you can also enrol for native language education and education in your own religion.

so: Waxbarashada waxaad sidoo kale isaga diiwaan gelin kartaa adoo buuxinaya foom, foomkaas oo aad ka heli kartid iskuulkaaga.
en: You can also enrol for the education by filling in a form that you can get from your school.

so: Foomka waxaa loo soo celinayaa iskuulka.
en: Return the form to your school.

so: Waxbarashada diinta waxaa la abaabuli karaa haddii kooxda arayda ahi ay ugu yaraan dhan yihiin sadex.
en: Education in your own religion can be organised if there are at least three pupils or students in the group.

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira barashda afkaaga hooyo iyo diintaada waxaad ka heleysaa bogga internetka ee magaalaga iyo isku xireyaasha aagga (aluekoodinaattori).
en: You can learn more about native language education and education in your own religion from the city's website and from the regional coordinators (aluekoordinaattorit)

so: Waxbarasho xirfadeedka waxaa Vantaa ka qabanqaabiya Machadka xirfadda ee Vantaa Varia, qeybta waxbarashada ganacsiga ee MERCURIA iyo TTS ururka Työtehoseura ry qeybtiisa shaqada ee Vantaa.
en: Vocational education in Vantaa is organised by Vantaa Vocational College Varia, MERCURIA Business College and the Vantaa unit of the TTS Työtehoseura association.

so: Varia waxay sidoo kale qaban qaabisaa waxbarashooyin xagga luuqada Ingiriiska ah sidoo kale waxay bixisaa duruus xirfadeed luuqada
en: Education in English and vocational studies in Finnish aimed especially at immigrants are also organised at Varia.

so: Edupoli waxayqabanqaabiyaan waxbarasho xirfadeed dadka waaweyn.
en: Edupoli provides vocational education for adults.

so: Vantaa waxaa kale oo ku yaal Avia College ee Finavia, taas oo qabanqaabisa waxbarashada xirfadaha duulimaadka ama hawada.
en: Vantaa is also home to Finavia's Avia College, which provides education for professions in the field of aviation.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Waxbarasho xirfadeed
en: Read more: Vocational education.

so: Waxbarashada u diyaargarowga iskuulka farsamada (VALMA)
en: Preparatory vocational education (VALMA)

so: Waxbarashada aasaasiga u diyaargarowga iskuulka farsamada VALMA (ammatilliseen peruskoulutukseen valmentava koulutus) waxaa loogu talogaley, kuwa doonaya iney helaan shahaado sanco-yaqaanimo aasaasiya.
en: Preparatory vocational education (ammatilliseen peruskoulutukseen valmentava koulutus) or VALMA is intended for persons who would like to take a degree programme leading to a vocational upper secondary qualification.

so: Waxbarashada VALMA waxaad ka heleysaa xog iyo sancaba, taasoo kaa caawin doonta hadhow barashada xirfadaha.
en: VALMA education provides you with knowledge and skills that will help you later in your vocational studies.

so: Waad horumarin kartaa aqoontaada luuqadeed. Sidoo kale waad kordhinkartaa dhibaca shahaada dugsiga dhexe.
en: You can also improve your language skills and your comprehensive school grades.

so: Waxbarashada VALMA ee Vantaa waxay qabanqaabshaan Varia.
en: In Vantaa, VALMA education is provided by Varia.

so: Ka aqri dheeri waxbarashada VALMA bogga InfoFinlandi Waxbarashada u diyaargarowga iskuulka farsamada.
en: Read more on VALMA education on the InfoFinland page Preparatory vocational education.

so: Vantaa waxaad dugsiga (lukio) sare wax uga baran kartaa af Finnish, Iswidhish ama Ingiriis.
en: Vantaa also has an upper secondary school for adults.In Vantaa, you can study at upper secondary school (lukio) in Finnish, Swedish or English.

so: Waxbarashada ku baxeysa afka Ingiriiska waxaa bixiya dugsiga sare ee Tikkurila laynka IB.
en: Instruction in English is provided in the IB programme at Tikkurila Upper Secondary School.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale Vantaa ku yaal dugsiga sare ee dadka waaweyn.
en: Vantaa also has an upper secondary school for adults.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Dugsiga sare
en: Read more: Upper secondary school.

so: Waxbarashada u diyaarinta dugsiga sare (LUVA)
en: Preparatory education for upper secondary school (LUVA)

so: Haddaad rabto inaad kordhiso aqoonta luuqadaada finnishka ama iswiidhishka intaadan codsan dugsiga sare, waxaad codsan kartaa waxbarashada u diyaarinta dugsiga sare, waxaa loogu talogaley ajaanibta waxaana loosoo gaabiyaa LUVA.
en: If you wish to strengthen your skills in the Finnish or Swedish language before applying to an upper secondary school, you can apply for preparatory education for upper secondary school (lukioon valmistava koulutus), which is intended for immigrants. The abbreviation LUVA is also used.

so: Waxbarashada LUVA ee Vantaa waxay qabanqaabshaan iskuulka sare ee Lumo.
en: In Vantaa, LUVA education is provided by Lumon lukio (Lumo Upper Secondary School).

so: Ka aqri dheeri waxbarashada VALMA bogga InfoFinlandi Waxbarashada u diyaargarowga iskuulka dugsiga sare.
en: Read more on LUVA education on the InfoFinland page Preparatory education for upper secondary school.

so: Haddaad ka yar tahay 30-jir waxaad talo iyo hagitaanba ka heleysaa adeega-Ohjaamo Shaqaalaha Ohjaamo ayaa ku caawinaya, haddii aadan helin meel waxbarasho ama – shaqo.
en: If you are under 30 years of age, you can get advice and guidance from the Ohjaamo service.

so: Haddii aad tahay reer Vantaa oo aadna ka yar tahay 29 sano islamarkaasna aadan heysan meel aad wax ka barato ama ka shaqeysato waxaad talobixin iyo hagitaan ka heleysaa Kipinä.
en: If you are a Vantaa resident, under 29 years old and do not have a study place or a job, you can receive guidance and advice at Kipinä.

so: Wac oo ballan horay uga sii qabso.
en: Call and make an appointment in advance.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga shabakadda.
en: More information is available on the Kipinä website.

so: Vantaa waxaa ku yaal labo iskuul xirfadeedka sare (ammattikorkeakoulu), Laurea iyo Metropolia.
en: There are two universities of applied sciences (ammattikorkeakoulu) in Vantaa, Laurea and Metropolia.

so: Waxay majalado badan ka bixiyaan waxbarasho.
en: They provide education in many fields.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan barnaamijka waxbarashada iyo codsashada bogagga shabakadda qeybaha waxbarashada.
en: For information on the study programmes and application, visit the websites of the institutes.

so: Vantaa waxaa kale oo ku yaal goobaha shaqada jamaacadda furan (avoin yliopisto) ee Jaamacadda Helsinki, kuwaas oo bixiya tacliinta sare iyo waxbarashada dhameystirka.
en: Open university (avoin yliopisto) units of the University of Helsinki also operate in Vantaa providing university-level and continuing education.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Waxbarashada tacliinta sare
en: Read more: Higher education.

so: Machadka dadka waaweyn ee Vantaa (Vantaan aikuisopisto) waxaad ku baran kartaa tusaale ahaan luqadaha, shaqo gacmeedka iyo cunto karinta, ama waxaad kaga qeybgeli kartaa jimicsi la hagayo.
en: At the Vantaa Adult Education Centre (Vantaan aikuisopisto), you can study, for example, languages, crafts and cooking, or take part in guided sports activities.

so: Koorasyadu waa lacag, waxaana la qabanqaabiyaa maalinta iyo habeenka.
en: The courses are subject to a fee, and are held during the daytime and in the evening.

so: Machadka dadka waaweyn wuxuu sidoo kale dadka dalka u soo guuray u qabanqaabiyaa koorasyo.
en: The adult education centre also holds courses for immigrants.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri Fursadaha kale ee waxbarasho
en: Read more: Other study opportunities.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Iskuul xirfadeedka sare, Jaamacadaha.
en: Read more: Universities of applied sciences, Universities.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri Waxbarashada hiwaayadda ah.
en: Read more: Studying as a hobby.

so: Deganaanshada xaalada dhibku jirto
en: Accommodation in a crisis situation

so: Inta badan guryaha kirada ah ee ku yaalla magaalo madaxda iyo agagaarkeeda, qiimaha ijaarkoodu aad ayuu u sareyaa.
en: The prices for rental housing in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area are high.

so: Adigaa ayaa ka mas'uul ah inaad raadsato guri.
en: You are responsible for finding a dwelling for yourself.

so: Magaalada ama ijaar bixiyeyaasha kale midkoodna waajibaad kama saarna inay guri ku siiyaan.
en: The city or other lessors are not obliged to offer you housing.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Guri kiro
en: To read more, go to: Rental dwelling

so: Vantaa waxaa ku yaalla guryo badan oo kiro ah oo gaar loo leeyahay, kuwaas oo kuwa ugu waaweyn ay ka mid yihiin VVO, Sato iyo Avara.
en: There are many private lessors in Vantaa; the biggest are VVO, Sato and Avara.

so: Kiro bixiyeyaasha gaarka ah waxaa guri looga heli karaa si dhaqso ah.
en: It is possible to get housing quickly from a private lessor.

so: Haddii aad tahay arday, waxaad guri kiro ah ka dalban kartaa Ururka guryaha-ardayda ee agagaarka magaalada Helsinki (Helsingin seudun Opiskelija-asuntosäätiö) ayadoo loo marayo HOAS.
en: If you are a student, you may be able to rent a dwelling through HOAS, the Foundation for Student Housing in the Helsinki Region (Helsingin seudun opiskelija-asuntosäätiö).

so: Haddii aad ka yar tahay 30-sano, waxaad dalban kartaa guryaha Isbahaysiga guryaha dhalinyarada (Nuorisoasuntoliitto) iyo guryaha Ururka dhalinyarada (Nuorisosäätiö).
en: If you are under 30 years old, you can apply for housing from the Finnish Youth Housing Association NAL (Nuorisoasuntoliitto) and Nuorisosäätiö.

so: Guryaha kirada ee magaaladu si caadiga ah way ka jaban yihiin guryha kirada ee ay bixiyaan shirkadaha iyo dadka shakhsiyaadka ah.
en: Housing rented out by the cities is usually more affordable than housing rented out by companies and private persons.

so: Si kastaba ah ahaatee waxaa laga yaabaa inuu waqti dheer ku qaato helitaanka guryaha kirada ee magaaladu ama ay helaan in yar oo ka mid ah dadka dalbada guryahaas.
en: However, the wait may be long, and only a fraction of all applicants get a dwelling.

so: Guryaha kirada ee magaalada Vantaa waxaa leh oo kireeya VAV Asunnot Oy.
en: The rental dwellings of the City of Vantaa are owned and rented out by VAV Asunnot Oy.

so: Dalabku wuxuu shaqaynayaa afar bilood, waqtigaas ka bacdi codsiga waa in la cusbooneysiyaa.
en: An application is valid for four months; after that you need to do it again.

so: Markii guryaha kirada ee magaalada dadka loo xulayo, waxaa safka ugu hooreeya ku jira dadka sida deg degta ah guriga ugu baahan, sababtoo ah guryaha waxaa loogu talo galay dadka dakhliga yar leh.
en: When residents are selected for city-owned rental dwellings, those who urgently need housing are put first. The applicant's income is also considered because the dwellings are mostly meant for people on low income.

so: Haddii gurigaagu uu ku waxyeeloobay tusaale ahaan gubasho ama waxyeelo biyo ku furmay, caymiska guriga ayaa laga yabaa inuu xaaladaha qaarkood magdhaw ka bixiyo kharashka dheeraadka ah ee ku baxaya degaanka.
en: If your dwelling is damaged due to fire or water, for example, home insurance may in some cases cover some extra costs of living.

so: Markii ay waxyeelo dhacdo dhaqso ula xiriir shirkadaada caymiska guriga.
en: Contact your insurance company immediately after the damage has occurred.

so: Xaalada dhibku jiro waxaa ku caawinaya heeganka sooshalka- iyo xasaradaha ee magaalada Vantaa, kaas oo furan waqti walba.
en: In crisis situations, you can get help from the City of Vantaa's Social and Crisis Emergency Services, which are always open.

so: Telefoonka heeganka sooshalka- iyo xasaraduhu waa 09) 8392 4005.
en: The Social and Crisis Emergency Services number is 09 8392 4005.

so: Aqalka badbaadada ee Mona waa aqal badbaado oo loogu talo galay dumarka dadka waddanka u soo guurey iyo carruurtooda.
en: The Mona Shelter is a shelter for immigrant women and their children.

so: Sidoo kale waxaad aadi kartaa aqalada badbaadada ee Vantaa ama aqalada badbaadada ee ku yaalla magaalo madaxda iyo agagaarkeeda.
en: You can also go to the Vantaa Shelter or the Helsinki Shelter

so: Haddii aad guri la'aan noqotid, la xiriir xarunta sooshka ee degaankaaga.
en: If you find yourself without a home, please contact the local Social Welfare Office.

so: Macluumaadka lagala xiriirayo waxaad ka heleysaa bogga internetka ee magaalada Vantaa.
en: You can find their contact information on the City of Vantaa's website.

so: Haddii degmada aad degan tahay ay tahay Vantaa, waxaa guri ka heli kartaa Sininauha
en: If Vantaa is your municipality of residence, you can find a home through Sininauha

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Guri la'aanta
en: To read more, go to: Homelessness

so: Magaaladu waxay guriyeynta caawinta iyo adeega leh u sameysaa, tusaale ahaan dadka da'da ah iyo dadka naafada ah, kuwaas oo ay ku adag tahay inay cawinaad la'aan ayagu iska dabaraan arimaha la xiriira nolol maalmeedka.
en: The city organises housing services, for example, for elderly or disabled persons who have difficulties managing day-to-day life without help.

so: Dadka da'da ah iyo kuwa naafada ah oo aan awoodin in ay si xor ah kaligood u deganaadaan, waxay deganaan karaan aqalada adeega leh (palvelutalo) ama xarumaha lagu daryeelo dadka da'da ah iyo kuwa naafada ah (laitos).
en: Elderly or disabled persons who are unable to live independently can live in a service flat (palvelutalo) or nursing home (laitos).

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah oo la xiriira adeegyada waxaad weydiin kartaa qaybta shaqada sooshalka (sosiaalityön yksikkö) ee ku yaalla degaankaaga.
en: You can get more information about the services at your area's social work unit (sosiaalityön yksikkö).

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Guriyeynta caawinta iyo adeegga
en: Read more: Supported and service housing.

so: Bogga kierrätys.info waxaad ka heleysaa meesha ay ku taalo barta weelka alaabada dib-u-isticmaalida (kierrätyspiste) ee kuugu dhaw.
en: You can find the nearest recycling station (kierrätyspiste) on the Kierrätys.info website.

so: Daryeelka qashinka iyo dib-u-isticmaalida
en: Read more: Waste management and recycling.

so: Adigoo kaalmeysanaya Finnishcourses.fi waxaad kooras luqada Finnishka ah oo kugu haboon ka raadsan kartaa Helsinki, Vantaa, Espoo ama Kauniainen.
en: Through the finnishcourses.fi service, you can find the Finnish course that suits you best in Helsinki, Vantaa, Espoo or Kauniainen.

so: Koorsayda luqada Iswidishka waxaa laga helaa isku-xirka ku yaal bogga hore ee adeegga.
en: The best way to find Swedish-language courses is to use the link on the front page of the service.

so: Koorsayada adeegga Finnishcourses.fi waa kuwa u furan dadka oo dhan.
en: The courses available through the Finnishcourses.fi service are open to all.

so: Vantaa waxaa koorasyada dadka dalka u soo guuray loogu talagalay ka qabanqaabiya machadka dadka waaweyn ee Vantaa (Vantaan aikuisopisto).
en: In Vantaa, Finnish and Swedish courses for immigrants are organised by the Vantaa Adult Education Centre (Vantaan aikuisopisto).

so: Koorsyada machadku waa kuwa u furan dadka oo dhan.
en: The courses are open to all.

so: Machadka dadka waaweyn wuxuu ku yaalaa Tikkurila, laakiin koorsayada waxaa lagu qabanqaabiyaa qeybo kala duduwan oo Vantaa ku yaal.
en: The adult education centre is located in Tikkurila, but the courses are held all over Vantaa.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan koorsayada iyo iska-diiwaangelinta waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga Vantaan Aikuisopisto iyo tusaha waxbarashada.
en: More information on the courses and registration is available on the website and study guide of the Vantaa Adult Education Centre.

so: Tusaha Waxbarashada waxaa laga helaa tusaale ahaan maktabadaha, Vantaa-info iyo sidoo kale bogagga magaalada Vantaa isagoo qaab internet ah.
en: The study guide is available at, for example, libraries and Vantaa Infos as well as electronically on the website of the City of Vantaa.

so: Xafiiska shaqada ayaa dadka dalka u soo guuray ku haga koorasyada luqada Finnishka, kuwaas oo la xiriira la-qabsashada.
en: The Employment and Economic Development Office directs immigrants to Finnish courses related to integration.

so: Marka laguu sameeyo qorshaha la-qabsashada ama shaqaaloobidda, sidoo kale waxaa boos lagaaga qaban karaa goobta barashada luqada Finnishka ama waxaa lagu gelin karaa safka goobta waxbarasho.
en: In connection to the preparation of your integration or employment plan, a position for studying Finnish can be reserved for you or you can be put in line for one.

so: Warar dheeraad ah weydii xafiiska shaqada.
en: For more information, contact the Employment and Economic Development Office.

so: Maktabada Vantaa waxaa lagu qabtaa kafeteriyooyinka luuqada (kielikahvila), halkaas oo tababar dhanka ku hadalka luuqada Finnishka ah lagu qaato.
en: Vantaa libraries organise language cafés (kielikahvila), where people practise speaking Finnish.

so: Waxaa loogu talogalay dhammaan, dadka doonaya inay ku hadlaan Finnishka.
en: They are meant for everyone who wants to learn to speak Finnish.

so: Kafeteeriyooyinka luuqada wxaa lugu waada hadlaa Finnish, sidaas darteed waa fiican tahay haddii aad ku hadasho wax yar oo finnish ah.
en: At language cafés, people talk in Finnish, so it is good to know some Finnish already.

so: Kafeteriyooyinka luuqadu waa lacag la'aan.
en: Language cafés are free of charge.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan kafeteriyooyinka luuqada waxaad weydiin kartaa maktabadaha.
en: You can ask libraries for more information about language cafés.

so: Naadiyda kuwada sheekaysiga luuqada Finnishka waxaa Vaantaa looga qabtaa sidoo kale xarunta waxqabadka ee Silkinportti (Silkinportin toimintakeskus) sidoo kale Kafnet iyo hoolalka dadka dhimaha degen ka dhexeeya ee Myyringi (Kafnetin ja Myyringin asukastilat).
en: Finnish language discussion groups in Vantaa are also organised at the Silkinportti Activity Centre (Silkinportin toimintakeskus) and Kafnet and Myyrinki residents' spaces (Kafnetin ja Myyringin asukastilat).

so: Waxaa jardiinooyinka dadka degaanka (asukaspuito) iyo xanaano maalmeedyada furan (avoin päiväkoti) lagu qabtaa naadiyo luuqada Finnishka ah oo loogu talo galay waalidiinta ilmaha guriga ku xanaaneeya.
en: There are Finnish language clubs for parents taking care of a child at home at residents' parks (asukaspuisto) and open day-care centres (avoin päiväkoti).

so: Naadiyada wada sheekaysigu waa lacag la'aan.
en: The discussion clubs are free of charge.

so: Shabakada aan wax wada akhrino (luetaan yhdessä-verkosto) waxay dumarka dadka wadanka u soo guurey bartaa akhriska iyo barashada luuqada Finnishka.
en: The Let's Read Together Network (Luetaan yhdessä -verkosto) offers lessons in reading and Finnish to immigrant women.

so: Dhan kaska oo Vantaa ka mid ah waxaa ka jira dhawr kooxo oo kala gedisan oo ah kooxada aan Wax wada akhrino.
en: There are several different Let's Read Together groups in different parts of Vantaa.

so: Ka qaybgalka guruubku waa lacag la'aan.
en: The groups are free of charge.

so: Waad sameyn kartaa imtixaanka guud ee luqada Finishka ama Iswidishka.
en: You can obtain the National Certificate of Language Proficiency in Finnish or Swedish.

so: Bogagga shabakadda Maamulka Waxbarashada (Opetushallitus) waxaa laga helaa mashiinka wax raadiya oo aad ka hubsan karto meelaha aad ku geli karto iyo waqtiyada.Vantaa waxaa imtixaanada luqada ka qabanqaabiyaa tusaale ahaan Machadka dadka waaweyn ee Vantaa (Vantaan aikuisopisto).
en: The website of the Finnish National Board of Education (Opetushallitus) features a search engine that you can use to check where and when you can obtain the certificate. In Vantaa, certification examinations are held by the Vantaa Adult Education Centre (Vantaan aikuisopisto), for example.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Shahaadada rasmiga ah ee aqoonta luqada
en: Read more: Official certificate of language proficiency

so: Halkee laga heli karaa shaqo?
en: Where to find work?

so: Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada (TE-toimisto) ayaa kaa caawinaya shaqo raadinta.
en: The TE Office (TE-toimisto) can help you look for work.

so: Haddii aad tahay shaqo la'aan goob shaqo raadina, isaga diiwaangeli shaqoraadiye ahaan xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada.
en: If you are unemployed and looking for a job, you need to register as a job-seeker at the TE Office.

so: Waxaad iska diiwaan gelin kartaa bogga adeegga internetka ama si shakhsiyan ayaad u tageysaa xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada.
en: You can register through the online service or in person at the TE Office.

so: Dadka u dhashay wadamada EU'da, Norway, Island, Liechtenstein iyo Swizerland waxay shaqo raadiye ahaan isaga diiwaangelin karaan ayagoo iscmaalaya adeegga shabakada internetka ee xafiiska iyo xoogsashada.
en: Citizens of the EU member countries, Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein and Switzerland can register as job-seekers through the TE Office's online service.

so: Dadka wadamada kale u dhashay waa inay si shakhsiyan ah isaga diiwaangeliyaan xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada.
en: Citizens of other countries must register in person at the TE Office.
