so: Horay u sii qaado waraaqaha aqoonsiga iyo ruqsada deganaanshada.
en: Please take along your ID card and residence permit.

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira adeegyada xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Haddii aad shaqo la'aan noqotid.
en: You can find information about TE Office services on the InfoFinland page If you become unemployed.

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira shaqo ka raadinta dalka Finland waxaad ka heli kartaa bogga InfoFinlandi Halkee laga heli karaa shaqo?
en: You can find information about looking for work in Finland on the InfoFinland page: Where to find work?

so: Adeegyada magaalada ee loogu talagalay dadka shaqo la'aanta ah
en: City services for job-seekers

so: Magaalada Vantaa waxey dadka shaqo la'aanta ah siisaa adeegyo kala duduwan oo ka caawiya barashada nolosha shaqada iyo helitaanka shaqada.
en: The City of Vantaa provides various services for job-seekers to help them become familiar with working life and find work.

so: Waxaa sidoo kale Vantaa lagu qabanqaabiyaa dhacdooyin shaqa-qoris ah oo ay shaqo-bixiyayaashu shaqaale ku raadinayaan.
en: There are also many recruitment events in Vantaa where employers seek employees.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan adeegyada magaalada waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga magaalada Vantaa.
en: For more information on city services, please visit the City of Vantaa website.

so: Haddii aad caawimaad u dooneyso shaqo raadinta ama helitaanka waxbarasho, waxaad la xiriir kartaa ururka caalamiga ah ee Hakunila talobixiyayaashooda mashruuca Tsemppari.
en: If you want help with finding a job or a study place, you can contact advisers of the Tsemppari project of Hakunilan kansainvälinen yhdistys international organisation.

so: Xarunta laqabsashada Monika waxey dumarka dalka u soo guuray ee shaqo la'aanta ah ka caawisaa sidii ay ku heli lahaayeen boos shaqo.
en: Integration Center Monika assists unemployed immigrant women in finding work.

so: Waxaad caawimaad u heli kartaa sameynta qoraalka qof ka waranka ama CV iyo codsiga shaqada, waxaad baran kartaa finnishka nololmaalmeedka loo isticmaalo iyo xirfadaha dhijitaalka.
en: You can receive assistance in writing a CV or job application, study everyday Finnish and digital skills.

so: Luckan Integration waa adeeg la talin ah, kaas oo la talin shakhsiyadeed siiya dadka waddanka u soo guurey, wuxuuna qabtaa munaasabado la xiriida shaqo codsiga iyo guruubo shaqo codsi ah.
en: Luckan Integration is a service that offers individual counselling for immigrants and organises events and groups connected to job-seeking, for example. The events are in English.

so: Shaqo ku hagida uu bixiyo ururka isbahaysiga dadku, waxaa loogu talogalay dadka waddanka u soo guuray oo horay waxbarashada u lahaa.
en: The work career mentoring of Väestöliitto, the Family Federation of Finland is meant for educated immigrants.

so: Dariiqadan awgeed waxaad heli kartaa qof ku haga, kaas oo kaa caawinaya codsiga shaqada iyo kan waxbarashada ama sameynta shirkad ganacsi.
en: You can get a mentor who will support you with looking for a job or study place or starting a business.

so: Hawshan waxaa lagu qabanayaa luuqada Finnishka.
en: The activities are in Finnish.

so: Shaqaalaha Ohjaamo ayaa ku caawinaya, haddii aad shaqo la'aan tahay ama aadan haysan goob waxbarasho.
en: Ohjaamo staff can help you if you do not have a job or study place.

so: Urur dhalinyarada dadka waddanka u soo guurey waa urur, arimaha dhalinyarada wax ka caawiya, cawinaadaas oo la xiriirta xagga waxbarashada iyo shaqada.
en: The immigrant youth support association helps young people with things connected to education and employment.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogga internetka ururka.
en: You can find more information on the association's website.

so: Haddii aad shirkad ku leedahay Vantaa waxaad xubin ka noqon kartaa Vantaan Yrittäjät ry.
en: If you have a business in Vantaa, you can become a member of the Vantaan Yrittäjät association.

so: Ururka Vantaan Yrittäjät ry waa urur ilaaliya danaha shirkadahda, kaas oo xubnihiisa u fidiya tusaale ahaan tababaro iyo la-talin.
en: Vantaan Yrittäjät ry is a lobbying organisation for entrepreneurs, which provides its members with training and advice, among other services.

so: Warar dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga shabakadda ururka.
en: More information is available on the association's website.

so: NewCo Helsinki wuxuu talooyin iyo cawinaad ka siiyaa dadka sameynyta shirkadaha, wuxuuna ku bixiyaa afafka kala ah finnish, swidish, ingiriis, ruush, carabi, viro, jarmal iyo talyaani.
en: NewCo Helsinki offers advice and help with starting a business in Finnish, Swedish, English, Russian, Arabic, Estonian, German and Italian.

so: NewCo Helsinki wuxuu dadka waddanka u soo guurey u qabtaa munaasabado uu macluumaad kaga siinayo sida loo aasaaso shirkadaha, waxaana lagu siiyaa af Finnish, Ingriis, Ruush, Carabi iyo Viro.
en: NewCo Helsinki organises information sessions for immigrants about starting a business in Finnish, English, Russian, Arabic and Estonian.

so: Munaasabadaha macluumaadku waa bilaash.
en: The information sessions are free of charge.

so: NewCo Helsinki wuxuu qabtaa koorsooyinka ganacsiga oo ku baxaya af Finnish, Ingiriis iyo Ruush.
en: NewCo Helsinki organises entrepreneurship training in Finnish, English and Russian.

so: Koorsooyinka qaarkood waxaa loogu talo galay dadka shirkada aasaasaya, amna kuwa horay u lahaa shirkadaha.
en: Some of the courses are intended for people starting a business and some are for people who already have a business.

so: Koorsooyinka waxaa lagu dhigaa af Finnish, Ingiriis iyo Ruushka.
en: The courses are held in Finnish, English and Russian.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeri ah iyo is diiwaangelitaba waxaad ka heleysaa bogga internetka ee NewCo Helsinki.
en: You can find more information and enrol on a course on the NewCo Helsinki website.

so: Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada (TE-toimisto) ee Uudenmaa wuxuu adeegyo dhinacyo badan leh siiyaa dadka ku fakaraya ama bilaabay ganacsiga.
en: Uusimaa TE Office (TE-toimisto) provides many different services for new entrepreneurs or people who are considering entrepreneurship.

so: Tusaale ahaan waxaad ka qayb geli kartaa koorsooyinka ganacsiga ee uu biyo xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada ee Uudenmaa, waxaadna dalban kartaa lacagta gansi bilaabida samaynta shirkadda awgeed.
en: At the Uusimaa TE Office, you can take an entrepreneurship training course and apply for a start-up grant to start a business, for example.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Samaynta shirkad ganacsi
en: To read more, go to: Starting a business

so: Xafiiska canshuurta ee soonaha Caasimaddu wuxuu ku yaalaa bartamaha Helsinki.
en: The customer service of the Metropolitan Area tax office is in Helsinki city centre.

so: Dadka muhaajiriinta ah waxey sidoo kale ka daneysan karaan goobta adeegga ee International House Helsinki.
en: Immigrants can also use the International House Helsinki service point.

so: Khuburada Kelada iyo Maamulka canshuuruhu waxey talo ka siiyaan muhaajiriinta Finland shaqo u imaanaya arrimaha la xiriira canshuuraha iyo ammaanka bulshada.
en: At the service point, experts from Kela and the Tax Administration provide guidance for immigrants coming to work in Finland in matters concerning taxation and social security.

so: Macluumaadka xiriirka ee goobta adeegga ee International House Helsinki:
en: Contact information of the International House Helsinki service point:

so: La-qabsashada iyo la-talinta dadka dalka u soo guuray
en: Immigrant guidance and integration

so: Adeegyada dadka waddanka u soo guurey ee Vantaa waxaa ka mid ah
en: Vantaa Immigrant Services include:

so: Adeegyada dadka waddanka u soo guurey ee Vantaa (Vantaan maahanmuuttajapalvelu) waxaad ka heleysaa la talinta la-qabsashada waddanka, adeegyada arimaha bulshada iyo caafimaadka iyo adeegyada ay bixiyaan ururada magaaladu.
en: Vantaa Immigrant Services (Vantaan maahanmuuttajapalvelut) give advice about integration, social and healthcare services and the services provided by the city and organisations.

so: Waxaad macaamiil ka noqon kartaa adeegyada, haddii aad Finland ku timid habka xiriirka qoyska, tahay qaxooti, tahay dhibane xagga ka ganacsiga dadka ama aad xaq u leedahay waraysiga bilowga ee xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada.
en: You can become a client if you moved to Finland based on a family bond, are a refugee or victim of human trafficking, or have the right to an initial assessment.

so: Xarunta waxqabadka ee Silkinportti (Silkinportin toimintakeskus) waxay talo sii saa dadka waddanka u soo guurey waxayna u abaabushaa waxqabadyo kala duwan.
en: Silkinportti Activity Centre (Silkinportin toimintakeskus) advises immigrants and organises many types of activities.

so: Vantaa-info waxaad ka heleysaa xog magaalada Vantaa iyo adeegyada dowlad.
en: Vantaa Infos provide infomation about the services of the City of Vantaa and the state.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah iyo waqtiyada ay furan yihiin waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga magaalada Vantaa.
en: Additional information and opening hours are listed on the website of the City of Vantaa.

so: Rugta la-talinta ee ururka caalamiga ah ee Hakunila (Hakunilan kansainvälisen yhdistys) waxay u adeegtaa dadka dalka u soo guuray ee ku nool Hakunila, Koivukylä iyo deegaanada kale ee Vantaa, kuwaas oo raba inay wax ka ogaadaan tusaale ahaan waxbarashada, koorsyada luqada, shaqada, waxqabadyada hiwaayadaha, xaaladaha dhibku jiro iyo arrimaha sharciga.
en: The information and help desk of the Hakunila International Organisation (Hakunilan kansainvälinen yhdistys) provides information to immigrants living in Hakunila, Koivukylä and other Vantaa districts on matters regarding studies, language courses, work, recreational activities, crisis situations and legal affairs.

so: Rugta la-talinta dadka dalka u soo guuray ee isku-xirka ururka Vantaa (Vantaan Järjestörinki ry:n Maahanmuuttajien neuvontapiste) waxaad weydiin kartaa arrimaha la xiriirka tusaale ahaan nolosha shaqada, ammaanka bulshada, caafimaadka, waxbarashada iyo ogolaanshaha joogitaanka.
en: At the Vantaan Järjestörinki association's immigrant information point (Vantaan Järjestörinki ry:n Maahanmuuttajien neuvontapiste), you can ask about matters related to working, social security, health, education and residence permits.

so: Haddii aad dhowaan u soo guurtay soonaha caasimadda, waxaad International House Helsinki hal booqasho uga heli kartaa talo-bixin iyo adeegyada dowladeed.
en: If you have recently moved into the Helsinki metropolitan area, you can receive guidance and public services in one place at International House Helsinki (IHH).

so: Kaartaynta hore (Alkukartoitus) waxay kaa caawinaysaa in aad magaalada aad degantahay ka hesho adeegyo kugu haboon.
en: Initial assessment (alkukartoitus) helps you find suitable services in your home city.

so: Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada ee magaalada Vantaa ama Uudenmaan wuxuu qof walba oo ka mid ah dadka waddanka u soo guurey oo Vantaa degan u qabanqaabiyaa kaartaynta hore.
en: The City of Vantaa or the Uusimaa TE Office organises an initial assessment for every new immigrant who moves to Vantaa.

so: Waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad heshid kaartaynta hore, haddii
en: You have the right to get an initial assessment, if

so: degmada aad degantahay ay tahay Vantaa
en: Vantaa is your municipality of residence

so: aad Vantaa dalka dibadiisa ama meel kale oo Finland ka mid ah ka soo guurtay
en: you moved to Vantaa from abroad or elsewhere in Finland

so: aan horay laguugu samayn kaartaynta hore
en: you have not received an initial assessment before

so: aad Finland deganayd ugu badnaan sadex sano.
en: you have had a municipality of residence in Finland for no more than three years.

so: Kaartaynta hore waxaad ku heleysaa macluumaad la xiriira barashda luuqada Finnishka iyo Iswidishka, shaqo raadinta, waxbarashada iyo adeegyada Vantaa.
en: During the initial assessment, you receive information about studying Finnish or Swedish, looking for work, education and services in Vantaa.

so: Wada sheekaysiga kaartaynta hore waxaa loo isticmaalayaa turjubaan haddii loo baahdo.
en: The initial assessment can be done with an interpreter, if needed.

so: Kaartaynta hore waa lacag la'aan.
en: The initial assessment is free of charge.

so: Kaartaynta hore waxaad ku dalban kartaa e-mail ama adigoo telefoon waqti ku qabsada.
en: You can ask for an initial assessment by e-mail or make an appointment by telephone.

en: It is located next to Helsinki, on its western side.

so: Kuwaas waxaa dheer oo ay Espoo leedahay goobo la deggan yahay oo yaryar, miyi iyo dabiicad keymeed.
en: In addition, it features smaller urban areas, countryside and natural forests.

so: Espoo waxaa deggan qiyaastii 280 000 oo qofood.
en: Espoo has a population of about 280,000.

so: Dadka deggan badankood luqadoodu waa Finnish.
en: The majority of the residents speak Finnish.

en: Some 7% of the population speak Swedish, and roughly 16% speak foreign languages.

so: Ballaca dhulka Espoo waa qiyaastii 528 km2, kuwaas oo 216 km2, oo kamid ah ay biyo yihiin.
en: Espoo covers an area of approximately 528 km2, of which 216 km2 is water.

so: Koonfurta Espoo waxay markaas aheyd bad.
en: Southern Espoo was covered by sea at the time.

en: Large manors were built in Espoo, which had great significance in terms of the development of the city.

so: Markii ay Finland noqotay qeyb kamid ah Ruushka waxaa caasimadda laga dhigay Helsinki sanadkii 1812.
en: When Finland was annexed to Russia, Helsinki became the capital in 1812.

so: Inkastoo ay Helsinki u kortay degdeg, Espoo waxay mudo dheer aheyd dhul deggan oo maamul miyi leh.
en: Although Helsinki grew at a rapid pace, Espoo remained a quiet town in the countryside for quite some time.

so: U soo guurista Espoo waxay badatay sanadkii 1940kii iyo wixii ka dambeeyay.
en: Population influx to Espoo accelerated in the 1940s and thereafter.

en: Espoo received city status in 1972.

en: There are plenty of opportunities for hobbies and recreation in Espoo.

en: Nurses at the child health clinic can give advice about issues related to the health and development of young children.

so: Waqti ka qabsashada xarumaha hooyada iyo dhallaanka iyo la talinta
en: Child health care clinic appointments and information service

so: Dhibaatooyinka ilmaha da'da iskuulka gaaray waxaa caawiya tusaale ahaan kalkaalisada caafimaadka iskuulka.
en: If your child is of school age, you can ask help from the school nurse.

so: Haddii aad dooneysid inaad talo ka weydiiso arimo, la xiriira xagga koritaanka maskaxda ilamaha, waxaad waqti ka qabsan kartaa la talinta qoyska.
en: If you would like advice on matters related to the mental development of a child, you can make an appointment at the family counselling centre (perheneuvola).

so: Ururka isbahaysiga dad dhigidu wuxuu qoysaka dadka wadanka u soo guuray kala taliyaa arrimaha la xiriira barbaarinka carruurta iyo wanaag ku noolaanshada qoyska.
en: The Family Federation of Finland (Väestöliitto) helps immigrant families in matters connected to raising children and the well-being of families.

so: Dhallinyaradu waxay dhibaatada kala hadli karaan iskuulkooda ama kalkaalisada caafimaadka ee goobta iskuulka.
en: Young people can share their problems with the nurse (terveydenhoitaja) at their school or educational institute.

so: Sidoo kale cawinaad waxaa laga heli karaa meelo kale.
en: Help is also available from other sources.

so: Qofka dhallinyarada ah ee da'diisu u dhaxayso 13–22 wuxuu cawinaad ka heli karaa Poliklinikada dhallinyarada ee Nupoli (Nuorisopoliklinikka Nupoli), haddii ay haystaan dhibaatooyin ah tusaale ahaan xagga caafimaadka dhimirka, isticmaalka maandooriyaha, ciyaarida geymamka ama isticmaalka waqtiga firaaqada.
en: Young people aged 13 to 22 can also turn to Nuorisopoliklinikka Nupoli with problems that relate to mental health, intoxicant abuse, gambling or the use of free time.

so: Tegitaanka Nupoli waa bilaash, waana sir aan la faafin karin.
en: Visits to Nupoli are free of charge and confidential.

so: Haddii qofka dhallinyarada ah uusan gurigiisa ku ahayn ammaan, wuxuu la xiriiri karaa Aqalka badbaada dhallinyarada (turvatalo) ee hay'adda laan qayrta cas ee Finland (Suomen Punainen Risti).
en: If a young person feels it is not safe to be at home, they can contact the Youth Emergency Shelter of the Finnish Red Cross.

so: Aqalka badbaadadu wuxuu ku yaalaa Leppävaara.
en: The shelter is located in Leppävaara.

so: Haddii dhibaatooyin xagga dhaqaalaha ahi ku haystaan, waxaad talo weydiin kartaa shaqaalaha sooshalka ee degmada.
en: If you have financial problems, you can ask a social worker of the municipality for advice.

so: Hadii dakhliga ama hantida adiga iyo qoyskaagu aysan ku filnayn daboolida kharashaadka nolol maalmeedka nolosha ee daruuriga ah, waxaad Kelada ka dalban kartaa lacagta kaalmada nolosha ee aasaasiga ah.
en: If your or your family's income and assets are not enough to cover necessary daily expenses, you can apply for basic income support from Kela.

so: Haddii aad qabto dhibaatooyin dhinaca deymha ah, la xiriir la talinta xagga dhaqaalaha iyo deymaha ee xafiiska caawimaadda arrimaha sharciga.
en: If you have problems with debts, contact the Legal Aid Office's financial and debt counselling unit (oikeusaputoimiston talous- ja velkaneuvonta).

so: Adeeggu waa lacag la'aan.
en: The service is free of charge.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ka akhriso: Dhibaatooyinka dhaqaale.
en: Read more: Financial problems

so: Klinikada caafimaadka dhimirka iyo maandooriyaha (Mielenterveys- ja päihdeklinikka) oo marka la soo gaabsho la yiraahdo MTP-klinikka waxay dadka waaweyn ee reer espoo cawinaad iyo daryeel ka siisaa dhibaatooyinka la xiriira xagga caafimaadka dhimirka iyo maandooriyaha.
en: The mental health and intoxicant treatment clinic (MTP-klinikka) helps adults who are living in Espoo and suffering from problems relating to mental health or substance abuse.

so: Dhallinyarada ah ee da'doodu u dhaxayso 13–22 oo ay haystaan dhibaatooyin xagga maandooriyaha ah waxay cawinaad ka heli karaan Poliklinikada dhalinyarada ee Nupoli
en: Young people aged 13 to 22 years with substance abuse problems can get help at Nuorisopoliklinikka Nupoli.

so: Wixii dheeraad ah ka akhriso: Dhibaatooyinka mukhaadaraadka.
en: Read more: Intoxicant abuse

so: Xaafiisyada duugitaanka ayaa kaa caawinaaya isku dubaridka qaabka duugitaanka.
en: Funeral homes help with the practicalities of burials.

so: Xafiisyada duugitaanka waxaad ka raadin kartaa tusaale ahaan bogga internetka ee ururka isbahaysiga xafiisyada duugitaanka ee Finland.
en: You can search for funeral homes on the website of the Finnish Association for Funeral Homes, for example.

so: Espoo waxaa ku yaal shan qabuurood oo dadka Krishtaanka ah lagu duugo.
en: Espoo has five Christian cemeteries.

so: Qabuuraha Kellonummi waxaa ku yaal aag aan calaamad diineed lahayn.
en: Kellonummi Cemetery features a non-denominational section.

so: Halkaas waxaa lagu duugi karaa dadka diimaha kale ka soo jeeda ama aan wax diin ah haysan.
en: People who practise other religions or no religion at all can be buried there.

so: Haddii qof xigtadaada ahi uu si lama filaan ah u geeriyoodo oo aad u baahato cawinaad, la xiriir heeganka xafiiska sooshalka iyo xasaradaha ee Espoo, telefoon (09) 816 42439.
en: If a person close to you dies suddenly and you need support, you can contact Espoo Social and Crisis Emergency Services (Espoon sosiaali- ja kriisipäivystys), Tel. (09) 816 42439.

so: Beeraha ama jardiinooyinka degaanka iyo naadiyo
en: Resident playgrounds and clubs

so: Naagta ama ninku waxay codsiga furiinka geysan karaan xafiiska maxkamada Galbeedka Uusimaa.
en: Women and men can file for divorce at the office of the District Court of Länsi-Uusimaa.

so: Furiinka waxaa sidoo kale codsan kara qof kali ah ogolaanshiyo la'aanta lamaanaha.
en: You can also file for divorce alone, without the consent of your spouse.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale codsigaaga ugu diri kartaa xafiiska maxkamadda degmada qaab boosto, fakis ama emayl ah.
en: Applications can be sent to the District Court office by post, fax or e-mail.

so: Haddii aad leedahay carruur ka yar 13 sano islamarkaasna aad qorsheyneyso furiin, la xiriir rugta la-talinta qoyska (perheneuvola).
en: If you have children under 13 years of age and you are planning a divorce, please contact a family counselling centre (perheneuvola).

so: Rugta la-talinta qoyska shaqaalaha jooga waxaad kala sheekeysan kartaa xaaladda qoyska.
en: At the family counselling centre, you can discuss the situation of your family with professionals.

so: Macluumaadka xiriirka rugaha la-talinta qoyska waxay ku jiraan bogagga magaalada Espoo.
en: The contact information for the family counselling centres can be found on the City of Espoo website.

so: Haddii aad qorsheyneyso furiin waxaad la xiriiri kartaa sidoo kale sarkaalka danaha carruurta (lastenvalvoja) ee qeybta arrimaha qoyska.
en: If you are contemplating divorce, you can also contact the child welfare supervisor (lastenvalvoja) of the family affairs unit.

so: Sarkaalka ilaaliya danaha carruurta waa suurtagal in laga sheekeysto furiinka iyo mustaqbalka carruurta.
en: With the child welfare supervisor, you can discuss the divorce and the future of your children.

so: Deegaanka carruurta, xuquuqda la kulanta iyo kaalmada nolosha waa in lagu sameeyaa wadajireed lamaanaha u dhexeeya.
en: The spouses must reach a mutual agreement on where the children will live as well as on meeting rights and child support.

so: Ilaaliyahaasha danaha carruurtu waxay xoojiyaan heshiiska.
en: The child welfare supervisors affirm the agreement.

so: Macluumaadyada xiriirka ilaaliyayaasha danaha carruurtu waxay ku jiraan bogagga magaalada Espoo.
en: The contact information for the child welfare supervisors can be found on the City of Espoo website.

so: Magaalada Espoo waxay leedahay telefoon la-talinta oo aad su'aali karto talooyin la xiriira arrimaha carruurta marka ay waalidku is-furaan.
en: The City of Espoo has a telephone helpline that provides assistance in matters regarding children of divorcing parents.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Carruurta iyo furiinka.
en: Read more: Children in a divorce

so: Warbixin ku saabsan daryeelka caruurta ee degmada Espoo waxaad ka heli kartaa bogga internetka ee InfoFinland Waxbarashada Espoo.
en: Information on the day care of children in Espoo is available on the InfoFinland page Education in Espoo.

so: Caruurta waxaad geyn kartaa daryeel ku meelgaar ah ee beerta ama jardiinada ciyaarta oo ay joogaan daryeelayaal.
en: You can take your child to park aunties for temporary childcare.

so: Waxaana loola jeedaa waqti gaaban oo caruurta yar-yar ah (2-3 saacadood markiiba) oo daryeel, taasoo ka dhici doonta bannaanka beerta ama jardiinada ciyaarta.
en: This is short-term care of children (2-3 hours at a time), which takes place outside at a playground.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo dhinaca telefoonka ah waxaad ka heleysaaa daryeelayaasha goobta jooga.
en: You can get more information on park aunties by phone.

so: Lambarada telefoonada waxaad ke heleysaa bogga internetka ee degmada Espoo.
en: Telephone numbers can be found on the website of the City of Espoo.

so: Haddii aad gurigaaga uga baahan tahay daryeelka caruurta ee ku meelgaarka ah, waxaad kala xiriiri kartaa ururka Mannerheim ee badbaadada caruurta iyo ururka Väestoliitto.
en: If you need a temporary nanny in your home you can contact the Mannerheim League for Child Welfare (Mannerheimin lastensuojeluliitto) or Väestöliitto.

so: Magaalada Espoo ayaa siineysa dheeraadka ay Espoo ku darto qoyskasaska ilmaha ka yar 3 sano ku xannaaneeya guriga.
en: The City of Espoo pays an additional Espoo supplement to families who care for a child under 3 years of age at home.

so: Dheeraad Espoo waa la codan karaa haddii waalidku uu guriga ku hayo dhammaan carruurta qoyska ee ka yar da'da iskuulka.
en: Parents who care for all under-school-age children of the family are entitled to apply for the Espoo supplement.

so: Magaalada Espoo waxay waalidiinta carruurtooda guriga ku xannaaneeya u qabanqaabisaa waxqabadyo badan. Waxyaabaha loo fidiyo waxaa kamid ah tusaale ahaan jardiinooyinka deegaanka, xannaano-maalmeedyo furan iyo naadiyo.
en: The City of Espoo organises plenty of activities for parents who care for their children at home, including resident playgrounds, open day-care centres and playgroups.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Kaalmada guri ku xanaaneynta ilmaha
en: Read more: Benefits for looking after a child at home

so: Bogga internetka InfoFinlandi ee Xaaladaha dhibku jiro iyo Espoo waxaad ka heli kartaa warbixinta ku saabsan, halka aad degmada Espoo ka heli karto caawimaada la xiriirta dhibaatooyinka qoysaska, caruurta iyo dhalinyarada.
en: Information on where to get help in Espoo for problems related to children, young people and families is available on the InfoFinland page Problem situations in Espoo.

so: Sidoo kale dhibaatooyinka caruurta iyo dhalinyarada warbxin ku saabsan ayaad ka heli kartaa bogga internetka InfoFinlandi ee ah dhibaatooyinka caruurta iyo dhalinyarada iyo Xaggee caawimaad looga helaa dhibaatooyinka caruurta iyo dhalinyarada?
en: There is also information on children's and young people's problems on the InfoFinland pages Children's and young people's problems and Where to find help for children's and young people's problems?

so: Bogga internetka InfoFinlandi ee Dhibaatooyinka isqabidda iyo xiriirka lammaanaha, Waxaad ka heleysaa warbixin la xiriirta halka aad ka hei karto caawimaad la xiriirta dhibaatooyinka xiriirka lammaanaha.
en: Information on where to get help for problems in a relationship is available on the InfoFinland page Problems in marriage and relationships.

so: Dadka da'da ah waxay isticmaali karaan adeegyada rugaha caafimaadka ee caadiga ah.
en: Elderly people can use the services of regular health stations.

so: Intaas waxaa sii dheer oo dadka da'da ah ee Espoo loo fidiyaa adeegyo u gaar ah, tusaale ahaan adeegyada daryeelka guriga.
en: In addition, Espoo provides specialised elderly services, such as home care services.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso macluumaad ku saabsan adeegyada dadka da'ada ah, la xiriir rugta la-talinta dadka da'da ah (seniorineuvonta).
en: If you would like more information on elderly services, contact Guidance for Elderly Citizens (Seniorineuvonta).

so: Haddii aad guriga ku daryeeleysid qof ehelkaaga ah waayeelnimo, xanuun ama naafanimo awgeed, si uu qofkaasi guriga ugu noolaado, waxaa laga yaabaa inaad xaq u leedahay kaalmada daryeelka ehelka.
en: If you are taking care of an elderly, ill or disabled family member at home, you may be entitled to informal care allowance.

so: Adeegyada caafimaadka ee Espoo
en: Health services in Espoo

so: Caafimaadka dadka da'da ah
en: Health of the elderly

so: Wac lambarka gargaarga deg degga ah tusaale ahaan markii, uu dhaco shil khatar ah ama uu xanuun lama filaan ahi ku soo boodo qof dadka ka mid ah.
en: The emergency number should be dialled in case of an accident or a seizure, for example.

so: Ha wicin lambarka gargaarka deg degga ah haddii aysan xaaladu ahayn mid khatar ah.
en: Do not call the emergency number if the matter is not urgent.

so: Haddii aad guri ka degan tahay, waxaad isticmaali kartaa adeegyada caafimaadka ee shacabka.
en: If your municipality of residence is Espoo, you are entitled to use public health services.

so: Adeegyada caafimaadka ee shacabka waxaa fidiya rugaha caafimaadka, gobaha daryeelka ilkaha, rugaha la-talinta iyo cusbitaalada.
en: Public health services are provided by health stations, dental clinics, maternity and child health clinics and hospitals.

so: Haddii aadan xaq u leheen isticmaalka adeegyada caafimaadka shacabka, waxaad gargaar caafimaad ka raadsan kartaa tusaale ahaan rugaha caafimaadka ee gaarka loo leeyahay.
en: If you are not entitled to use public health care services, you can seek help at a private medical clinic, for example.

so: Dhammaan qarashka ku baxaya rugaha caafimaadka ee gaarka loo leeyahay waa inaad adigu iska bixisaa.
en: At private clinics, you will have to cover all expenses yourself.

so: Adeegyada caafimaadka ee shacabka waxaa fidiya rugaha caafimaadka (terveysasema).
en: In Espoo, health services are provided by health stations (terveysasema).

so: Sida caadiga ah waxaa rugaha caafimaadka jooga dhaqtar, kalkaaliyayaal caafimaad iyo qaabilaadyo daryeel caafimaadeed.
en: Health stations normally provide appointments to see doctors, nurses or public health nurses.

so: Bogagga magaalada Espoo waxaa ku jira macluumaadka xiriirka rugaha caafimaadka iyo nambarada telefoonada.
en: The contact information and phone numbers of the health stations can be found on the City of Espoo website.

so: Marka aad wacdo rugta caafimaadka, telefoonkaada horay loogama jawaabo.
en: Your call to a health station may not be answered right away.

so: Laakiin nambarkaadu wuxuu ku keydsamaa awtomaatiiga, wax yar kadibna waa laguugu soo celinayaa ama dib ayaa laguu soo wacayaa.
en: However, your number will be recorded by the system, and the health station staff will contact you shortly.

so: Haddii aad degdeg ugu baahdo gargaar caafimaad, waad imaan kartaa rugta caafimaad ballan la'aan.
en: You can seek urgent first aid care at a health station without an appointment.

so: Rugta caafimaadka ee gaarka ah waxaa aadi kara qof kasta.
en: Anyone can go to a private medical centre.

so: Rugta caafimaadka ee gaarka ahi waxay sidoo kale ku haaboon qofka aan xaq u leeyahay adeegyada caafimaadka shacabka ee Finland.
en: Private medical centres are also suitable for people who are not entitled to public health care in Finland.

so: Dhammaan qarashka ku baxaya rugta caafimaadka gaarka ah macaamilku waa inuu iskiis isaga bixiyaa.
en: At private clinics, customers will have to cover all expenses.

so: Espoo waxaa ku yaal rugo caafimaadyo badan oo gaar loo leeyahay.
en: There are several private medical clinics in Espoo.

so: Macluumaadka xiriirka dhaqaatiirta gaarka ah waxaad ka heleysaa tusaale ahaan internetka.
en: The contact information for private doctors can be found online, for example.

so: Macluumaad la xiriira iibsiga dawooyinka waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Dawooyinka
en: Read more about buying medication on InfoFinland page Medication.

so: Habeenkii iyo maalmaha dhammaadka todobaadka rugta caafimaadku waa xiran tahay.
en: The health station is closed in the evenings and at weekends.

so: Markaas waxaa jirooyinka degdega ah iyo shilalkaba lagu daryeelayaa heeganka (päivystys).
en: At these times, acute cases and accidents are treated at emergency clinics (päivystys).

so: Heegaanka dadka waaweyn waa cusbitaalka Jorvi ee Espoo.
en: The nearest emergency clinic for adults is at Jorvi Hospital in Espoo.

so: Ka hor inta aadan imaan heeganka, wac adeegga lacag la'aanta ah ee Caawimaadda heeganka, tel. 116 117.
en: Call the free-of-charge medical helpline, tel. 116 117, before coming to the emergency health centre.

so: Heegaanka dadka ka yar 16 sano wuxuu ku yaal Jorvi iyo Lastenklinikka ee Helsinki.
en: An emergency clinic for children under 16 years of age is located in Jorvi and at the Children's Hospital in Helsinki.

so: Heeganka in ballan loo qabsado looma baahna.
en: Appointments are not necessary for emergency clinics.

so: Daryeelka caafimaadka carruurta ee u dhexeysa da'da 1- 6 sano waxaa dadka ka caawiya kalkaalisada caafimaadka ee rugta la-talinta (neuvola) iyo dhaqtarka.
en: Nurses and doctors of the maternity and child health clinic (neuvola) will help you with the health care of children between 1 and 6 years of age.

so: Waxaad weydiisan kartaa iyaga talooyinka iyo kaalmada waalidnimada iyo koriinshaha cunugga.
en: You can ask them for advice and support with raising a child.

so: Rugta la-talinta waxaa lagula socdaa cafimaadka cunugga iyo koriinshihiisa.
en: The child health clinic monitors the health and proper development of your child.

so: Dhinacyo kala duduwan oo ka mid ah magaalada Espoo waxaa ku yaal rugo la-talineedyo badan.
en: In Espoo, there are numerous child health clinics throughout the city.

so: Macluumaadka xiriiryada rugaha la-talinta waxay ku jiraan bogga shabakadda magaalada Espoo.
en: The contact information for the clinics can be found on the website of the City of Espoo.

so: Rugaha la-talinta oo dhan telefoon isku mid ah ayaad ballan uga qabsan kartaa.
en: You can make appointments for all child health clinics through the same number.

so: Haddii cunug jirado islamarkaasna uu degdeg ugu baahan yahay daryeel caafimaad, la xiriir rugta caafimaadka (terveysasema).
en: If your child falls ill and requires urgent treatment, contact the health station (terveysasema).

so: Caruurta da'da iskuulka waxaa caafimaadkooda daryeela kalkaalisada ama kalkaaliyaha caafimaadka ee iskuulka.
en: School nurses take care of the health of school-age children.

so: Habeenkii iyo maalmaha dhammaadka todobaadka heeganka carruurta ka yar 16ka sano waa Jorvi iyo Lastenklinikka ee Helsinki.
en: In the evenings and at weekends, there is an emergency clinic for children under 16 years of age at Jorvi Hospital and the Children's Hospital in Helsinki.

so: Ka sii aqri warar dheeraad ah: Caafimaadka dadka da'da ah, Dadka da'da ah
en: Read more: Health of the elderly, Elderly

so: Waad isticmaali kartaa adeegyada degmo ee dhaqtarka ilkaha haddii aad Guri degmo ku leedahay Espoo.
en: Municipal dental care services are available to you if your municipality of residence is Espoo.

so: Haddii ay tahay inaad gargaar deg-deg ah u baahan tahay, waad adeegsan kartaa adeega degmada, xitaa haddaadan aheyn reer Espoo.
en: In case of emergency, you can use municipal services even if your municipality of residence is not Espoo.

so: Ballan ayaad nambarka wadajirka ah ee rugaha daryeelka Espoo uga qasban kartaa dhaqtarka ilkaha.
en: You can make a dentist's appointment through the joint number.

so: Nambarka waxaa la wici karaa maalmaha shaqada.
en: You can call the number on weekdays.

so: Haddii aad dhaqtarka ilkaha degdeg ugu baahan tahay, la xiriir rugta caafimaadka iyo sooshaalka ee Kilo.
en: If you require urgent dental care, please contact the Kilo Social Welfare and Health Centre.

so: Rugta caafimaadka iyo sooshaalka ee Kilo
en: Kilo Social Welfare and Health Centre

so: Ballanta waqtiga ee maalmaha shaqada.
en: Appointments can be made on weekdays.

so: Haddii aad dhaqtarka ilkaha degdeg ugu baahan tahay habeenkii ama dhammaadka toddoobaadka, la xiriir cusbitaalka Haartman ee Helsinki ku yaal.
en: If you need a dentist urgently in the evening or during the weekend, please contact Haartman Hospital in Helsinki.

so: Espoo waxaa kale oo laga helaa dhaqaatiirta ilkaha oo gaar ah.
en: There are also private dental clinics in Espoo.

so: Dhaqaatiirta ilkaha ee gaarka ah waad aadi kartaa, haddii xitaa aadan xaq u laheyn adeegyada daryeelka caafimaadka shacabka.
en: You can visit a private dentist even if you are not entitled to public health care services.

so: Daryeelka ilkaha bareefadka ah wey ka qaalisan yihiin adeega daryeelka ilkaha dadweynaha loogu talogaley.
en: Private dental care is more expensive than the public one.

so: Haddii ad u baahantahay caawimaad ama garabsiin la xidhiidha caafimaadka nafsiga ah ama arrimaha balwadaha la xidhiidha, waxad balan ka qabsataa kalkaalisada cilminafsiga ah.
en: If you require help or support with issues related to mental health and/or substance abuse, you can make an appointment to see a psychiatric nurse.

so: Kalkaalisooyinka cilmi nafsiga ah waxa ay dadka ku qaabilaan xarumaha caafimaadka.
en: Consultation with a psychiatric nurse is available at health centres.

so: Dhalinyarada waxa lagu qaabilaa Nupoli.
en: Consultation for young people is available at the Nupoli Youth Clinic.

so: Wuu furan yahay maalin kasta afar iyo labaatanka saac.
en: Open every day around the clock.

so: Rugaha la-talinta ka hortaga uurka (ehkäisyneuvola) ee goobaha caafimaadka waxaad ka heleysaa caawimaad dhinaca ka-hortaga uurka iyo qorsheynta qoyska.
en: The contraception and family planning clinics (ehkäisyneuvola) of health stations provide assistance in preventing pregnancy and planning a family.

so: Dhalinyaradu waxay caafimaadka galmada kala sheekeysan karaan kalkaalisada caafimaadka ee iskuulkooda.
en: Young people can discuss matters related to sexual health with their school nurse.

so: Haddii aad u baahan tahay baaritaanka caafimaadka dumarka, la xiriir rugta caafimaadka.
en: If you need a gynaecological examination, please contact the health station.

so: Ballan waad ka qabsan kartaa sidoo kale dhaqtarka haddii aad u baahan tahay in laguu qoro warqada daawada ka hortaga uurka darteed ama haddii aad ka fekereyso inaad ilmo iska soo rido.
en: You can also make an appointment at the health station if you require a prescription for contraception or you are contemplating abortion.

so: Macluumaadka xiriirka rugaha caafimaadka ee Espoo waxay ku jiraan bogga shabakadda magaalada Espoo.
en: The contact information for the health stations can be found on the City of Espoo website.

so: Cudurada ku dhaca hab-dhiska taranka ama galmada waxaa lagu daaweeyaa Kilinikada cudurada hab-dhiska taranka ee Helsinki.
en: Sexually transmitted diseases in the Metropolitan Area are treated at the sexually transmitted disease clinic of Helsinki.

so: La xiriir rugta la-talinta (neuvola) haddii aad dareento inaad uur leedahay.
en: Please contact the maternity and child health clinic (neuvola) when you find out you are expecting a baby.

so: Rugta la-talinta waxaa lagula socdaa hooyada, cunugga uurka ku jira iyo caafimaadka guud ee qoyska waqtiga uurka.

so: Sida caadiga ah waqtiga codsashadu waa Janaayo.

so: Waqtiga is-diiwaangelintu waa inta bisha Janaayo.

en: Omnia provides preparatory education to immigrants for vocational studies.

so: Waxbarashada diyaarinta waxaa loogu talagalay dhalinyarada iyo dadka waaweyn ee xiiseynaya in ay helaan xirfado waxbarasho, islamarkaana doonaya in ay kor u qaadaan xirfadooda luqadda finishka.
en: Preparatory education is intended for young people and adults who are interested in vocational studies and wish to improve their Finnish skills. More information on vocational education is available on Omnia's website.

en: In addition, young immigrants can study Finnish or complete comprehensive school studies.

en: The education is intended for young people who wish to study in an upper secondary school but whose language proficiency is not yet sufficient for upper secondary school studies.

so: Espoo waxaa ku sameyn kartaa imtixaanka guud ee luqada (yleinen kielitutkinto) Finishka ama Iswidishka.
en: Espoo provides the opportunity to obtain the National Certificate of Language Proficiency (yleinen kielitutkinto) in Finnish or Swedish.

so: Espoo waxaa imtixaanada luqadaha ka qabanqaabiya Axxell iyo Machadka dadka shaqeeya ee Espoo.
en: In Espoo, the certificate exams are held by Axxell and Espoo Adult Education Centre.

so: Bogagga shabakadda Maamulka Waxbarashada (Opetushallitus) waxaa laga helaa mashiinka raadiya imtixaanka luqadaha.
en: The website of the Finnish National Board of Education (Opetushallitus) features a search engine for certificate exams.

so: Mashiinka wax-raadinta waxaad ka hubsan kartaa meelaha aad ku geli karto iyo waqtiyada.
en: You can use it to check where and when you can obtain the certificate.

so: Cawinaad xagga codsiga shaqada
en: Help with finding work

so: Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada ee Uudenmaa ayaa kaa caawinaya codisiga shaqada.
en: TE Office can assist you in finding work.

so: Xafiiska Espoo wuxuu ku yaalaa Leppävaara.
en: The Espoo office is located in Leppävaara.

so: Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashadu wuxuu adeegaydiisa ku bixiyaa xagga bogga shabakada interneka ee Qabsashada arimahaaga (Oma asiointi).
en: TE Office online services are available through their E-Services (Oma asiointi) website.

so: Si aad u gasho boggaan waxaad u baahan tahay inaad haysato lambarada sirta ah ee shabakada internetka looga galo bangiga.
en: You need online banking credentials to log in to the service.

so: Dadka u dhashay wadamada midowga urub, Norway, Island, Liechtenstein iyo Swizerland waxay ogeysiiska shaqo raadinta ka sameyn karaan bogga internetka ee xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada oo magac baxay Qabsashada arimahaaga.
en: Citizens of EU member countries, Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein and Switzerland can register as job-seekers through the TE Office online service.

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira adeegyada xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashadu waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinland Haddii aad shaqo la'aan noqotid.
en: Read more about TE Office services on InfoFinland page If you become unemployed.

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira shaqo raadinta waxaad ka heli kartaa boggga InfoFinland Halkee laga heli karaa shaqo?
en: Read more about looking for work in Finland on InfoFinland page Where to find work?

so: Shaqooyinka ka banaan magaalada Espoo waxaa ka heleysaa bogga internetka magaalada.
en: The vacancies for the City of Espoo can be found on the city website.

so: Seure (Seure) waa shirkad xagga adeegga kireynta shaqaalaha qabata, oo bixisa shaqooyinka tuur tuurashada ah ee magaalooyinka Helsinki, Vantaa, Espoo iyo Kauniainen.
en: Seure is an HR services company providing short-term jobs in the employment of the cities of Helsinki, Vantaa, Espoo and Kauniainen.

so: Shaqooyinka ay bixiso Seure tusaale ahaan waa shaqada iskuulada, xanaanada carruurta iyo isbitaalada.
en: The jobs are at schools, day-care centres and hospitals, for example.

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira codsiga kaalmada shaqo laawaha waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinland Gargaarka shaqo la'aanta.
en: Read more about applying for unemployment benefit on InfoFinland page Unemployment benefit.

so: Haddii aad dooneysid inaad shirkad ganacsi samaysato, waxaa cawinaad ka heli kartaa YritysEspoo.
en: If you would like to set up your own business, you can receive assistance from YritysEspoo.

so: Waxay kaa caawinayaan horumarinta fikrada ay ku salaysan tahay shirkada ganacsigaagu ama qorshaynta waxqabadka ganacsiga.
en: They can assist in business idea development or business planning.

so: NewCo Yritys Helsinki waxay bixisaa la talin shakhsiyan ah oo ku saabsan samaynta shirkad ganacsi, waxay qabataa munaasabado ay ku bixinayso macluumaad ganacsi iyo waxbarid ganacsade oo ku baxaysa luuqado kala gedisan.
en: NewCo Yritys Helsinki offers personal business startup counselling, organises information events and provides entrepreneur coaching in many languages.

so: Ganacsatada reer Espoo waxaa sidoo kale caawiya ururka ganacsatada Espoo (Espoon Yrittäjät ry).
en: Entrepreneurs in Espoo can also get support from Espoon Yrittäjät ry.

so: Waa urur ay shirkadu wada leeyihiin, kaas oo xubnihiisa siiya tusaale ahaan waxbarasho xagga ganacsiga ah, wada shaqayn iyo la talin.
en: It is a lobbying organisation for entrepreneurs, offering its members training, co-operation and advice, for example.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale booqan kartaa barta la talinta ee In To Finland oo ku taala Helsinki Kampi.
en: You can also visit In To Finland information point in Kamppi, Helsinki.

so: Barta la talinta ee ka dhexaysa Kelada iyo xafiiska canshuurahu waxay caawisaa dadka wadanka u soo guurey, kuwaas qaba su'aalo la xiriira xagga canshuuraha ama lacagta badbaada sooshalka.
en: The information point is a joint effort of The Social Insurance Institution of Finland (Kela) and the Tax Office, and offers advice for immigrants who have questions regarding taxation or social security.

so: Halkaas waxaad ka soo qaadan kartaa kaarka canshuurta iyo lambarka canshuuraha oo qasabka ku ah shaqada dhismaha.
en: You can get your tax card or the tax number required in the construction business from the info point.

so: Intaas waxaa dheer shaqaalaha ajnabiga ah oo sida ku meel gaarka ah shaqada ugu imaanaya Finland, waxay si ku meel gaar ah u heli karaan lambarada aqoonsiga ee Finnishka ayaga oo aan si gooni ah u aadin xafiiska dad-dhigida.
en: Foreign workers who have temporary employment in Finland can also get a Finnish personal ID from the info point, which means they don't need another visit to the local register office.

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira habka canshuurida Finland waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinland Canshuurid.
en: Read more about taxation in Finland on InfoFinland page Taxation.

so: Goobaha daneysashada waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaadyada adeegyada magaalada.
en: Information on Espoo's services is available from the Service Points (Asiointipiste) of the City of Espoo.

so: Goobaha daneysashadu waxay magaalada uga yaalaan goobo badan.
en: The Service Points are located throughout the city.

so: Macluumaadka xiriirka rasmiga ah ee goobahaas waxay ku jiraan bogga shabakadda magaalada Espoo.
en: More detailed contact information can be found on the website of the City of Espoo.

so: Nambarka telefoonka ee ka dhexeeya goobaha daneysashadu waa: (09) 816 57070 iyo emailka info(at)espoo.fi.
en: The shared phone number for the Service Points is: 09 816 57070 and e-mail: info(at)espoo.fi.

so: Goobta deganaayasha Kivenkolo waxaa ku yaalla qol fadhi ah oo dadkoo dhan u furan , halkaasoo aad ka heli karto la talain iyo hagis lagu bixinayo luqado kala duwan.
en: The Kivenkolo Community Centre is an active "living room" open to everyone, where you can receive advice and guidance in various languages.

so: Goobta billowga ee dhallinyarada qaangaarka ah
en: Starttipiste for young adults

so: Goobta kulanka ee caalamiga ah ee Trapesa waxey fidisaa adeeg latalineed.
en: The international meeting point Trapesa offers counselling services.

so: Horay waqti uga qabso.
en: Book an appointment in advance.

so: Ururku wuxuu sidoo kale leeyahay qol fadhi ah iska furan, koox ku sheekeysta luqada finnishka iyo dhacdooyin kala duduwna.
en: The association also has an open living room and organises Finnish language discussion groups and diverse events.

so: Adeegga la-talinta waxaa ka heleysaa talo iyo hagis ballan la'aan.
en: The information service provides advice and guidance without having to make an appointment.

so: La-talinta waxaa lagu bixiyaa luqado badan.
en: Guidance is given in several different languages.

so: Adeegga waxaa qeyb ka ah Helsinki-info, Xafiiska diiwaangelinta Uusimaa, Maamulka canshuurta iyo adeegga In To Finland ee Kelada, Xafiiska shaqada ee Uusimaa, Xarunta ammaanka hawlgabka iyo Rugta Ganacisga soonaha Helsinki.
en: The service includes Helsinki-info, the Local Register Office of Uusimaa, the In To Finland service by the Tax Administration and Kela, the Uusimaa TE Office, the Finnish Centre for Pensions and the Helsinki Region Chamber of Commerce.

so: Sahan-horaadka waxaa lagu sameeyaa adeegyada dadka dalka u soo guuray ee Espoo, ama waaxda arimaha bulshada ee dadka waaweyn.
en: The initial assessment is conducted by Espoo Immigrant Services or the adult social work office.

so: Adeegyada dadka dalka u soo guuray waxay sidoo kale dadka dalka u soo guuray ku caawiyaan arrimo kale oo la xiriira nolosha Finland.
en: Espoo Immigrant Services also assist immigrants in other matters related to living in Finland.

so: Shaqaalaha xafiiska shaqada iyo shaqaaleynta ayaa kula sameynaya qiimeyn lagu qiimeynayo heerkaaga aqoomeed iyo qorsheynta la-qabsashada, markaad iska diiwaangeliso inaad tahay shaqo doone .
en: When you register as a job seeker, an employee of the Employment and Economic Development Office will complete an initial assessment with you and prepare an integration plan.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: La-qabsashada Finland
en: Read more: Integration into Finland

so: Haddii aadan aqoonin Finnish ama Iswiidish waxaad isticmaali kartaa turjubaan marka aad ka daneysaneyso shaqaalaha dowlada.
en: If you do not speak Finnish or Swedish, you can use an interpreter when dealing with the authorities.

so: Markaa turjubaanku waa kuu lacag la'aan.
en: If so, the interpreting services will not cost you anything.

so: Sarkaal waxaa loola jeedaa tusaale ahaan booliska, kelada, Xafiiska shaqada ama sarkaalka magaalada Espoo.
en: “Authorities” here refers to the police, Kela, the Employment and Economic Development Office or an official of the City of Espoo, among others.

so: Si kastoo ay ahaataba sarkaalku mar walba ma bixinayo turjubaanka.
en: However, authorities do not always pay for the interpreter.

so: Haddii sarkaalku uusan kaa bixineyn turjubaanka, iskaa ayaad u dalban kartaa. Markaasna waa in aad adigu iska bixisaa.
en: You can employ the services of an interpreter at any time if you pay the costs and book one yourself.

so: Waxaad si hubaal ah u weydiin kartaa deegyada turjubaanada adeegyada dadka dalka u soo guuray ee magaalada Espoo.
en: You can request more information on interpreting services from Espoo Immigrant Services, for example.

so: Adeegga waxaa qeyb ka ah Helsinki-info, Magaalada Espoo, Xafiiska diiwaangelinta Uusimaa, Hoggaanka socdaalka, Maamulka canshuuraha, Kelada, Xafiiska shaqada ee Uusimaa, Xarunta ammaanka hawlgabka, Rugta Ganacisga soonaha Helsinki iyo Ururka Midowga Iskaashatooyinka xirfadleyda Finland SAK.
en: The service includes Helsinki-info, City of Espoo, the Local Register Office of Uusimaa, the Finnish Immigration Service, the Tax Administration, Kela, the Uusimaa TE Office, the Finnish Centre for Pensions, the Helsinki Region Chamber of Commerce and the Central Organisation of Finnish Trade Unions, SAK.

so: U soo guurista Finland.
en: Read more: Moving to Finland.

so: Haddii aad si joogto ah ugu soo guurto Espoo si aad u deganaato waa inaad degmada isaga diwaangelisaa sidii qof degane ah.
en: If you are moving to Espoo permanently, you must register as a resident of the municipality.

so: Waxaad iska diiwanagelin kartaa Xafiiska diwaangelinta Uudenmaaga, waaxda Helsinki
en: You can register at the Local Register Office of Uusimaa, Helsinki unit.

so: Ogsoonoow, in warqadaha dibadda laga keenay ay ahaadaan kuwa la sharciyeeyay. iyo kuwo ku turjuman afka finnishka,-iswidhiska ama -ingiriiska.
en: Please note that all foreign documents must be legalised and translated into Finnish, Swedish or English.

so: Waaxda diiwaangelinta (Maistraatti) waad ka dalban kartaa summada qofka (henkilötunnus).
en: You can also apply for a Finnish personal identity code (henkilötunnus) at the Local Register Office.

so: Warar kale ka sii aqri: Isu-diiwaangelinta sidii qof degane ah, Degmada Finland ku taal.
en: Read more: Registering as a resident, Municipality of residence in Finland

so: Deegaanka Helsinki wuxuu leeyahay isku xir gaadiid aad u wannaagsan.
en: The Metropolitan Area boasts good public transport connections.

so: Deegaanka Helsinki waxaad kula dhex safri kartaa bas, tareen, taraam, metro iyo doonta Qalqcadda Finland.
en: The transport network of Helsinki includes trains, buses, trams, metros and the Suomenlinna ferry.

so: Adeegga hagaha wadada (Reittiopas) waxaad ka raadsan kartaa macluumaadka wadooyinka soonaha caasimadda.
en: You can use the Journey Planner (Reittiopas-palvelu) service to search for information on routes in the Metropolitan Area.

so: Gaadiidka dadweynaha waxaad kula safri kartaa kaarka safarka (matkakortti) ama waxaad kaash ku iibsan kartaa tikid hal mar lagu safro.
en: You can use cash or a travel card (matkakortti) to pay on public transport.

so: Helsinki waxaa ku yaal wadooyin baaskiil oo badan.
en: Helsinki features a lot of bicycles routes.

so: Hagaha wadada gaadiidka fudud waxaad ka raadsan kartaa wado kugu haboon haddii aad dooneyso inaad socoto ama ku safarto baaskiil.
en: If you want to reach a destination on foot or by bike, you can find a suitable route with the journey planner for pedestrians and cyclists.

so: Maxadooyin badan oo metrooga iyo tareenka laga raaco waxaa suurtagal ah in laga helo boosas baabuurta la dhigto oo lacag la'aan ah kadibna lagu sii safro gaadiidka dadweynaha.
en: Many metro and railway stations provide the opportunity to park your car free of charge and continue on public transport.

so: Helsinki waxay xiriir wacan oo wadooyinka dhinaca dhulka ah la leedahay dhinacyo badan oo Finland ku yaal.
en: Helsinki has good highway connections to all parts of Finland.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Gaadiidka.
en: Read more: Traffic in Finland.

so: Xubnaheedu waxey metelaan kooxo siyaasadeed kala duduwan.
en: Its members represent various political groups.

so: Shirarka golaha waxaad kala socon kartaa islamarkaasna macluumaad dheeraadka ah oo ku saabsan go'aan gaarista ka heli kartaa kanaalka Helsinki ama bogagga shabakadda magaalada.
en: You can watch council meetings and find more information about decision-making on the Helsinki channel or the city's website.

so: Duqa magaalada iyo dadka magaalada ka shaqeeya waxey dadka magaalada deggan ee jooga dhinacyo badan oo magaalada Helsinki dhexdeeda ah ugu qabanqaabiyaan fiidadka deganayaasha, kuwaas lagu sheego loogana sheekeysto arrimaha magaalada.
en: The mayor and city officials organise residents' evenings in different parts of Helsinki where residents are informed of city matters and can discuss them.

so: Adigu xittaa waxaad saameyn ku yeelan kartaa go'aan gaarista.
en: You can also influence decision-making yourself.

so: Doorashooyinka degmada oo laga codeeyaa waa hab muhiim ah oo saameyn lagula yeesho.
en: Voting in municipal elections is an important way of influencing things.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale ka qeybqaadan kartaa horumarinta magaalada adigoo isticmaalaya kanaalo elekterikaal ah oo kala duduwan.
en: You can also take part in the city's development through various online channels.

so: Tusaale ahaan bogagga magaalada Helsinki waxaa ku jira foom diyaar nidaam aragti- celineed (palautejärjestelmä).
en: For example, Helsinki's website has a ready-made form, the feedback system (palautejärjestelmä).

so: Waxaad magaalada ugu soo diri kartaa su'aalo iyo soo jeedinno ama waxaad ku dhiiban kartaa aragti-celin.
en: You can use it to send the city questions and suggestions or give feedback.

so: Waxaa intaas dheer oo agagaarka aad deggan tahay ka shaqeeya qofka magaalada lagala xiriiro oo ah hagaha magaalada (stadiluotsi), oo kaa caawin kara horay u sii gudbinta talo soo jeedinnadaada.
en: Your neighbourhood also has a city contact person or borough liaison (stadiluotsi), who can help you promote your suggestion.

so: Hagaha magaaladu wuxuu heegan ku yimaadaa maktabadda agagaarkaada maalmo iyo saacado cayiman.
en: You can find the borough liaison in your local library at specific times and days of the week.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan hagayaasha magaalada iyo macluumaadka xiriirkooda waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga shabakadda ee magaalada Helsinki.
en: For more information about borough liaisons and their contact information, please visit the City of Helsinki website.

so: Helsinki iyo soonaha Helsinki waxaa ka shaqeeya jimciyado diimeedyo kala duduwan.
en: There are a large number of religious communities in Helsinki and the surrounding region.

so: Helsinki waxaa ku yaal meelo lagu cibaadeysto oo ay kala leeyihiin kooxo diimeedyo kala duduwan, waxaa kale oo intaas dheer xarumo waxqabad.
en: Helsinki boasts many shrines of different religious denominations, along with a variety of activity centres.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Dhaqamada iyo diimaha Finland.
en: Read more: Cultures and religions in Finland.

so: Helsinki waa caasimadda Finland.
en: Helsinki is the capital of Finland.

so: Waxay ku taalaa koonfurta Finland dhinaca xeebta Gacanka Finland.
en: It is located in southern Finland on the shore of the Gulf of Finland.

so: Helsinki waa xarunta maamulka Finland: halkaas waxaa isugu yimaadaa baarlamaanka Finland, waxaana halkaas sidoo kale ku yaala wasaaradaha.
en: Helsinki is the administrative centre of the country: it is where the Parliament of Finland convenes and where the ministries are located.

so: Helsinki waa sidoo kale xarun muhiim u ah dhaqanka iyo ganacsiga.
en: Helsinki is also an important hub of business and culture.

so: Helsinki waxaa deggan qiyaastii 600 000 oo qofood.
en: The population of Helsinki is approximately 600,000.

so: 83 % waxay sidii afkooda hooyo oo kale ugu hadlaan luqada Finnishka halka 6 % ay sidii afkooda hooyo oo kale ugu hadlaan luqada Iswidishka.
en: 83 % of the residents speak Finnish as their native language, while 6 % speak Swedish.

so: 11 % waxay sidii af hooyo oo kale ugu hadlaan luqado kale.
en: 11 % speak some other language.

so: Finland markaas waxay qeyb ka aheyd Sweden.
en: At the time, Finland belonged to Sweden.

so: Kustaa Vaasa wuxuu rabay in Helsinki uu ka dhigo magaalo madax la tartanta Tallinna, waxaa halkaas sidoo kale u guuray ganacsato Jarmal iyo Holland u dhashay.
en: Gustav I wanted to make Helsinki into a trade town to compete with Tallinn, which is why Dutch and German merchants, too, moved there.

so: Sanadkii 1640kii waxaa Helsinki loo wareejiyay meesha ay hadda ku taal ee bayga Estonia.
en: In 1640, Helsinki was moved to its current location in Vironniemi.

so: Dagaalkii Salka ballaarnaa intii lagu jiray sanadkii 1710 cudur saf mar ah ayaa dilay saddex marka loo qeybiyo labo qeybood dadkii deganaa Helsinki.
en: During the Great Northern War in 1710, the plague killed two-thirds of the population of Helsinki.

so: Sanadkii 1748dii jasiiradda saaran Helsinki ayaa la bilaabay in laga dhiso Viapori (Iswidishka Sveaborg, "Qalcadda Sweden") qalcado badeed, meesha hadda loo yaqaan Qalcadda Finland.
en: In 1748, the construction of the Viapori sea fortress (Sveaborg in Swedish, “The Castle of Sweden), which is currently known as Suomenlinna, began on the islands just off the coast of Helsinki.

so: Dhisidi qalcadda ayaa waxay magaaladi yareyd keentay dadka dheeraad ah oo dega, sidoo kale imaanshaha magaaladu ayaa batay.
en: The building of the fortress brought more people to the small town and invigorated commerce.

so: Dagaalkii dhacay sanadihii 1808−1809 waxay Ruushku Iswidishka ka qabsadeen dalkii qeybtiisa Bari.
en: Sweden lost the eastern part of the country to Russia in the war fought between 1808 and 1809.

so: Ruushku waxay Viapori iyo Helsinki qabsadeen sanadkii 1808, waqtigii dagaalkana magaaladu waa gubatay.
en: The Russians conquered Helsinki and Viapori in 1808, and the town burned down during the war.

so: Ruushku dhulkii ay qabsadeen waxay ka sameeyeen Duukigii Weynaa ee ismaamulka Finland.
en: Russia made the conquered area into the sovereign Grand Duchy of Finland.

so: Sanadkii 1812 Boqor Aleksanteri I ayaa wuxuu Helsinki u dalacsiiyay caasimadda Finland.
en: In 1812, Emperor Alexander I elevated Helsinki to the status of the capital of Finland.

so: Sidoo kale waxaa la bilaabay in la dhiso bartamaha Helsinki ee qaabka boqortooyada oo kale ah, dhismayaashaas oo hay'addihii muhiimka ah Duuka cusub ay ku yaaleen.
en: At the same time, the construction of Helsinki's Empire style city centre commenced, and the new buildings were to hold the most important institutions of the new Grand Duchy.

so: Sidoo kale Jaamacadda waxaa sanadkii 1828dii laga soo wareejiyay Turku loona soo wareejiyay Helsinki.
en: The university was also moved from Turku to Helsinki in 1828.

so: Markii ay Finland xorowday sanadkii 1917kii, Helsinki waxay noqotay Caasimadda Jamhuuriyadda Finland.
en: When Finland gained its independence in 1917, Helsinki became the capital of the republic.

so: Janaanyo 1918 Helsinki waxaa qabsaday ilaaladii casaanka ee meteleysay dabaqada shaqaalaha.
en: In January 1918, the Red Guard, which represented the working population, seized power in Helsinki.

so: isla waqtigaas ciidamadi burjuwaasiyiinta ama dabaqada dhexe iyo beeraleydi waxay isku qabanqaabinayeen Pohjanmaa, waxaana bilowday dagaal sokeeye.
en: At the same time, the White Guard, which represented the wealthy middle class and the peasants, began to organise in Ostrobothnia, and a civil war erupted.

so: Abriil ciidamadii Jarmalki ee Finland yimid waxay Helsinki u qabteen cadaanki.
en: In April, the German troops that had arrived in Finland took Helsinki for the Whites.

so: Dagaalkii labaad ee adduunka intii lagu jiray, sanadihii u dhexeeyay 1939–1944 Midowgi Soofiyeeti ayaa wuxuu duqeeyay Helsinki, laakiin difaacii cirka ee wanaagsanaan dartiis magaalada waxaa soo gaaray burbur fudud.
en: During World War II between 1939 and 1944, the Soviet Union bombed Helsinki, but the city sustained only minor damage thanks to good air defences.

so: Sanadkii 1946 Helsinki waxaa lagu biiriyay deegaano cusub, dhulki ay magaaladu ku fadhisayna wuxuu kordhay ku dhowaad sideed jibaar.
en: In 1946, new areas were annexed to Helsinki, and the city area grew to nearly eight times its former size.

so: Dadka magaaladu waxay u bateen si degdeg ah soonayaashii magaalada lagu darayna waxaa la bilaabay in sanadihii 1950−1980 laga dhiso magaalo-horaadyo cusub.
en: The population of the city increased rapidly and many new suburbs were constructed in the annexed areas between the 1950s and the 1980s.

so: dhinacyo kala duduwan oo Helsinki ku yaal ayaa waxaa markaas lagu qabtaa dhacdooyin kala duduwan.
en: A variety of events take place on that day throughout Helsinki.

so: 78 % waxay sidii afkooda hooyo oo kale ugu hadlaan luqada Finnishka halka 6 % ay sidii afkooda hooyo oo kale ugu hadlaan luqada Iswidishka.
en: 78 % of the residents speak Finnish as their native language, while 6 % speak Swedish.

so: 16 % waxay sidii af hooyo oo kale ugu hadlaan luqado kale.
en: 16 % speak some other language.

so: Helsinki dhaxdeeda waxaa ku yaalla maktabado faro badan oo kala gedisan.
en: Helsinki has many libraries in different parts of the city.

so: Intaas waxaa dheer labo gawaarida maktabadda ah oo ku wareega magaalada Helsinki.
en: There are also two mobile libraries that drive around the city.

so: Maktabaha-HelMet waxaa sidoo kale ka tirsan maktabadaha Espoo, Vantaa iyo wuwa Kauniainen.
en: The libraries of Espoo, Vantaa and Kauniainen are also part of the HelMet library.

so: Maktabadaha-HelMet waxay leeyihinn adeeg xagga shabaka internetka ah oo ka dhaxaysa.
en: The HelMet libraries have a joint online service.

so: Adeega shabakada internetka wax ayaad ka raadin kartaa ama ka qabsan kartaa.
en: Through the online service, you can search for and reserve material.

so: Ugu dhawaan dhamman adeegyada maktbadu waa kuwa lacag la'aan ah.
en: Almost all the library services are free of charge.

so: Si aad u isticmaashid adeegyada maktabada, waxaad u baahantahay kaarka maktabada.
en: To be able to use the services, you need a library card.

so: Kaarka maktabada waxaad ka qaadan kartaa meelkasta oo ka mid ah maktabadaha-HelMet.
en: You can apply for a library card at any of the HelMet libraries. Please take along your ID card.

so: Soo qaado waraaqahaaga aqoonsiga Kaarka maktabada waxaa la siiyaa qof degan Finland.
en: Library cards are only granted to people who have an address in Finland.

so: Haddii aadan lahayn afarta lambar ee aqoonsiga, kaarka maktabadu wuxuu shaqaynayaa sannad markiiba.
en: If you do not have a Finnish personal ID code, your library card will be valid for a year at a time.

so: Maktabadaha Helsinki buugaagta ugu badan waxay ku qoran yhiin luuqada Finnishka iyo Iswidishka, laakiin waxaad sidoo kale amaahan kartaa buugaagtaas oo ku qoran luuqado kale oo aad u faro badan.
en: Most of the books in Helsinki libraries are in Finnish or Swedish, but you can also borrow books in many other languages.

so: Maktabado badan waxaad ka heleysaa buugaag ku qoran Ingiriis, Jarmal, Faransiis, Talyaani, Ispanish, Viro iyo Ruush.
en: Many libraries have books in English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Estonian and Russian.

so: Maktabada weyn ee Pasila waxay ku dhex taalla maktabada luuqadaha badan (Monikielinen kirjasto).
en: The Multilingual Library (Monikielinen kirjasto) is located at the main library in Pasila.

so: Halkaas waxaa yaalla buugaag ku qoran in ka badan 60 luuqadood oo kala duwan.
en: It has books in over 60 different languages.

so: Waxaa dalban kartaa in buugaagta laguugu soo wareejiyo maktabadaha kale.
en: You can also order books to be sent to other libraries.

so: Haddii aad leedahay kaarka maktabada, waxaad sidoo kale akhrisan kartaa buugaagta ama jariidadaha elektronikda ah, waxaadna komputerkaaga, tabletkaaga ama telefoonkaaga smartiga ka daawan kartaa filimaanta.
en: If you have a library card, you can read e-books or e-magazines and watch films on your own computer, tablet or smartphone.

so: Sidoo kale Helsinki waxaa ku yaal maktabado kale, tusaale ahaan kuwa jaamacada iyo macaahidda sare.
en: There are also other libraries in Helsinki, for example, in universities.

so: Waxaad hiwaayad ka dhigan kartaa noocyo badan oo isboorti ah oo ku yaalla Helsinki dacaladeeda.
en: You can do many different kinds of sport all around Helsinki.

so: Helsinki waxaa ku yaalla hoolal badan oo lagu dabaasho, meelo lagu jimicsado, garoomo isborti iyo wadiiqooyin lagu lugeeyo ama lagu ordo.
en: Helsinki has many public swimming pools, gyms, sports fields and running paths.

so: Magaalada Helsinki waxay koorsooyin isboorti u qabataa dadka waaweyn ee magaalada degan.
en: The City of Helsinki organises sports and exercise courses for city residents.

so: Xilliga xagaaga xadiiqooyinka magaalada dacaladeeda ku yaal waxaa lagu qabtaa isboorti jimicsi qoob ka ciyaar oo kale ah.
en: In the summer, free fitness classes are organised in parks around the city.

so: Helsinki bii'adu waa dhowdahay.
en: Nature is always near in Helsinki.

so: Jardiinooyinka, xeebaha badda, keynta iyo soonaha bii'ada ee dhowran waad u socon kartaa, baaskiil u wadan kartaa ama waxaad ugu safri kartaa metrooga, basaska, tareenka, taraamka ama doonta.
en: You can walk, cycle or take a metro train, bus, conventional train, tram or ferry to a park, seashore, forest or nature reserve.

so: Bogagga magaalada Helsinki waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad ku saabsan keynta Helsinki iyo soonaha Helsinki u dhow ku taal.
en: The city website contains information forests in and near Helsinki.

so: Helsinki waxaa sidoo kale ku yaal jasiirado loo socod tago, kuwaas oo lagu tegi karo doomo.
en: There are also islands intended for outdoor recreation in Helsinki, which are accessible by shuttle boat.

so: Suomenlinna iyo jasiiradda Harakka waa meelaha loo daawashada tago ee taariikhiga ah.
en: Suomenlinna and the Harakka Island are also historical sights.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan jasiiradaha loo socodka tago iyo gaadiidka biyaha waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga magaalada Helsinki.
en: More information on the islands and boat traffic is available on the City of Helsinki website.

so: Bogagga waxaa sidoo kale ku jira macluumaadyada doon ku wadista Helsinki.
en: The site also includes information about boating in Helsinki.

so: Waxaad ku kaloomeysan kartaa maqaalinta, barafka hoostiisana waad ka soo jilaaban kartaa kalluunka adigoo aan heysan ruqsad gaar ah.
en: You can freely angle and ice-fish without a separate permit.

so: Kalluumeysashada kale waxaad ugu baahan tahay ruqsad lacag ah.
en: A chargeable permit is required for other types of fishing.

so: Bogagga magaalada Helsinki waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan meesha aad ka iibsan karto ruqsadaha kalluumeysiga.
en: The City of Helsinki website features more information about where to purchase fishing permits.

so: Laymanka kalluumeysiga iyo haraayada kale ee kalluumeysiga bay'ada loogama tegi karo.
en: Lines and other fishing waste must not be discarded in the environment.

so: Waxay dhib badan u geysan karaan shimbiraha iyo xayawaanada kale.
en: They can seriously harm birds and other animals.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri:
en: Read more: Recreation in nature

so: Helsinki waxaa ku yaal tiyaataro badan.
en: There are many theatres in Helsinki.

so: Bandhigyada badankooda waa kuwa luqada Finnishka lagu sameeyo.
en: Most of the performances are in Finnish.

so: Helsinki waxaa sidoo kale ku yaal tiyaataro badan oo luqada Iswidishka ku looga hadlo.
en: There are also Swedish-speaking theatres in Helsinki.

so: Bandhigyada tiyaatarada waxaad ka raadsan kartaa kalantarka dhacdooyinka, bogagga helsinki.fi iyo stadissa.fi.
en: You can search for specific performance from the event calendar provided on the Helsinki.fi and stadissa.fi sites.

so: Helsinki waxaa ku yaal arkistada filimka iyo tiyaataro filimeedyo badan.
en: Helsinki has a film archive and several cinemas.

so: Kalantarka dhacdooyinka waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaadyada festifaalka filimada ee gudaha Helsinki.
en: Information about the films being screened is available on the websites of the respective cinemas. The event calendars provide information about film festivals in Helsinki.

so: Helsinki waxaa ku yaalla matxafyo faro badan.
en: There are many museums in Helsinki.

so: Macluumaadka ku saabsan matxafyada waxaad weydiin kartaa la talinta dalxiiska ee Helsinki.
en: You can ask Helsinki Tourist Information for information about museums.

so: Xarunta farshaxanka ee Annantalo waa aqal farshaxan oo ku yaal bartamaha Helsinki looguna talogalay carruurta iyo dhalinyarada.
en: Annantalo Arts Centre is an arts centre for children, young people and families in Helsinki city centre.

so: Annantalo waxaa ka dhaca barashada farshaxanka, bandhigyo, bandhig qoob ka ciyaar ah iyo bandhigyo masraxiyadeed.
en: Annantalo is a place for art education, exhibitions and dance and theatre performances.

so: Sidoo kale Helsinki aqaladeeda kale ee dhaqamada waxaa carruurta iyo dhalinyarada loogu qabtaa dhacdooyin xagga dhaqamada ah.
en: There are also other culture centres in Helsinki that offer cultural events for children and young people.

so: Xarunta dhaqanka caruurta ee Musikantit waa xarun hawleed, lagu qabto dhacooyinka qoysaska, riwaayadaha caruurta, bandhigyo iyo tiyaatar.
en: Children's Culture Centre Musikantit is an activity centre that organises family events, children's concerts, exhibitions and theatre.

so: Xarunta carruurtu waxay ku barankaraan muusikada, jilitaanka, farshaxanka iyo qoob kaciyaadka luuqado ka gedisan ah.
en: At the centre, children can study music, theatre, visual art and dance in different languages.

so: Sidoo kale caruurta waxaa fursad loo siiyaa hiwaaydo badan oo jimicsi ah.
en: There are also many sports hobbies available for children.

so: Tusaale ahaan magaalada Helsinki waxay caruurta u qabataa jimicsiga jumpada, barashada dabaasha iyo jimicsiyaal badan oo kale.
en: The City of Helsinki organises fitness classes, swimming lessons and lots of other sports for children.

so: Sidoo kale shirkado badan oo gaar loo leeyahay ayaa carruurta u sameeeya hiwaayadaha jimicsiga.
en: Many private companies also offer sports hobbies for children.

so: Xarunta arimaha dhalinyarada (Nuorisoasiainkeskus) waxay carruurta iyo dhalinyarada ay da'doodu u dhaxayso 9-18 sano siisaa fursado hiwaayadeed oo faro badan.
en: The Youth Department (Nuorisoasiainkeskus) offers many recreational opportunities for 9–18-year-old children and young people.

so: Bogga internetka ee munstadi.fi waxay dhalinyadara looga helayaa wax qabadyo faro badan iyo hiwaayado.
en: The Munstadi.fi website lists many activities and hobbies for young people.

so: Sidoo kale adeegga waxaa laga helayaa Ruuti, oo isku soo aruuyiya fikradaha iyo soo jeedinta dhalinyarada.
en: The service also includes Ruuti, which collects young people's own ideas and initiatives.

so: Sidoo kale Helsinki waxaa ku yaalla aqalo faro badan oo dhalinyarada, kuwaas oo dhalinyaradu ay ku qaadan karaan waqtiyada firaaqada.
en: There are also many youth centres in Helsinki where young people can spend their free time.

so: Helsinki waxaa ka hawlga ururo kala duwan oo aycadaddoodu ay aad u badan tahay, tusaale ahaan ururo dhaqamo iyo ururo jimicsi.
en: There are many different associations in Helsinki, such as cultural associations or sports associations.

so: Sidoo kale Helsinki waxa ku yaalla ururo badan oo ay leeyihiin dadka waddanka u soo guurey.
en: There are also many immigrants' associations in Helsinki.

so: Fiidiyowga fursadaha kala duwan ee jimicsiga
en: Video about sports options

so: Bandhigyada tiyaatarada waxaad ka raadsan kartaa kalantarka dhacdooyinka, bogagga myhelsinki.fi iyo stadissa.fi.
en: You can search for specific performance from the event calendar provided on the MyHelsinki.fi and stadissa.fi sites.

so: Sooshalka heeganka ah (Sosiaalipäivystys) wuxuu caawiyaa galabihii iyo dhammaadka usbuucyada haddii aad si deg deg ah ugu baahato cawinaada shaqaala sooshalka.
en: Emergency Social Services (sosiaalipäivystys) helps in the evenings and on weekends if you urgently need help from a social worker.

so: Heeganka xasaradaha (Kriisipäivystys) waxaad ka heli kartaa gargaar nafsiyan ah oo
en: Crisis Emergency Support (Kriisipäivystys) can provide mental help and support if you find yourself in a sudden crisis.

so: Waqti walba waxaad ayaad wici kartaa heeganka xasaradaha.
en: You can call Crisis Emergency Support at any hour.

so: Heeganka sooshalka iyo heeganka xasaraduhu waxay teleefanka ugu adeegaan luuqadaha Finniska, Iswidishka iyo sidoo kale haddii markaas suurtogal tahay luuqada Ingiriiska.
en: Emergency Social Services and Crisis Emergency Support can help on the telephone in Finnish and Swedish and, where possible, in English.

so: Kulamada waxaan u isticmaali karnaa turjubaano.
en: An interpreter can be used for meetings.

so: Wixii dheeraad ah ka akhriso: Xaaladaha dhibka.
en: To read more, go to: Problem situations.

so: Haddii dhib kaa heysto ama mugdi kaaga jiro ogolaanshaha joogitaanka ama sharciga, waxaad la xiriiri kartaa Xafiiska dal u soo guurista.
en: If you have problems or there is some confusion about your residence permit, you can contact the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale talo weydiin kartaa goobta adeegga Helsinki-info.
en: You can also ask for advice at the Helsinki-info service point.

so: Qaxootiga iyo dadka magangalyodoonka ah iyo weliba ajaanibta kale waxay wixii cawinaad ama talooyin ah oo la xiriira ruqsada degenaanshda waydiisan karaan Ururka la talinta qaxootiga.
en: Refugees, asylum seekers and other foreigners can seek help and advice in residence permit matters at the Refugee Advice Centre.

so: Wixii dheeraad ah ka akhriso: Dhibaatooyinka Ogolaansha deganaanshaha.
en: To read more, go to: Residence permit problems.

so: Haddii xaalad deg deg ah awgeed aad u baahato cawinaada booliska, wac lambarka xaalada deg degta ah 112.
en: If you need urgent police assistance in an emergency, call the emergency number 112.

so: Ha wicin lambarka xaalaha deg dega ah, haddii arintun aysan ahayn xaalad deg deg ah.
en: Do not call the emergency number if it is not an emergency.

so: Saldhiga booliska ayaad ka dacwoon kartaa oo dhigi kartaa ogeysiiska dembiga.
en: You can report a crime at the police station.

so: Haddii dembigu uusan ahayn mid sidaas u sii weyn, waxaad dacwada ogeysiiska dembiga ku diri kartaa e-mailka adoo isticmaalaya bogga internetka ee booliska.
en: If the crime is not serious, you can also report it online on the police website.

so: Wixii dheeraad ah ka akhriso: Dembiyada.
en: To read more, go to: Crimes.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale adigu qareen gooni ah ka raadsan kartaa bogga internetka ee Ururka qareenada Finland.
en: You can also find a private lawyer through the Finnish Bar Association website.

so: Wixii dheeraad ah ka akhriso: Ma u baahan tahay qareen?
en: To read more, go to: Do you need a lawyer?

so: Haddii aad la kulantay qalalaase ama wax hanjabaad, waxaad cawinaad iyo kaalmo ka heleysaa Xarunta xasaradda ee Monika.
en: If you have experienced violence or threats, you can get help and support at Crisis Center Monika.

so: Horay ayaad ballan uga sii qabsan kartaa adigoo soo wacaya telefoonka caawimaadda ama adigoo goobta yimaada.
en: You can make an appointment beforehand by calling the helpline or you can just turn up.

so: Adeeggu waa mid gebi ahaanba kalsooni ah, mana u baahnid in xittaa aad magacaada sheegto.
en: The service is completely confidential and you do not have to give your name.

so: Waxaad cawinaad ku heli kartaa dhawr luuqadood oo kala duwan.
en: You can get help in many different languages.

so: Haddii ruux kamid ah qoyskaagu adiga kuu geysto jirdil ama uu kuugu hanjabo jirdil, waxaad aadi kartaa aqalka badbaadada (turvakoti).
en: If a member of your family uses violence against you or threatens to do so, you can go to a shelter (turvakoti).

so: Waxaad aadi kartaa aqalka badbaadada, haddii gurigaaga joogitaankiisu uu khatar kugu noqdo jirdil awgiis.
en: You can go to the shelter if home is dangerous because of violence.

so: Cinwaanka aqalka badbaadadu waa sir.
en: The shelter's address is secret.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale aadi kartaa aqalada badbaadada ee Caasimada.
en: You can also go to the Helsinki Shelter.

so: Khadka ninka (Miehen Linja) waa adeeg, caawiya ragga xaasaskooda jirdilka u geysta.
en: Miehen linja is a service that helps immigrant men who have used violence against their wife.

so: Adeega waxaa loogu talogalay ragga dadka dalka u soo guuray ee Finland ku nool, ayaddon loo eegeyn meesha uu markaas degen yahay.
en: The service is meant for all men who have moved to Finland regardless of where they live.

so: Khadka ninka waxaad kula sheekaysan kartaa Finnish, Iswidish, Ingiriis, Faransiis, Giriig ama ayadoo la isticmaalayo turjubaan afkaaga hooyo.
en: At Miehen Linja, you can talk in Finnish, Swedish, English, French and Greek, or in your native language through an interpreter.

so: Wixii dheeraad ah ka akhriso: Dagaalka.
en: To read more, go to: Violence.

so: Mashruuca Duo ee Naadiga qoysku wuxuu la talin xagga xiriika ah u sameeyaa lamaanaha labada dhaqan kala wata, waxaana la isticmaalaa luuqadaha Finnishka iyo Ingiriiska.
en: Familia's Duo Project offers relationship counselling for intercultural couples in Finnish and English.

so: Ururka isbahaysiga dad dhigidu wuxuu luuqadaha Finnishka iyo Ingiriiska ku bixiyaa la talin xagga xiriirka qoyska ah iyo terapia.
en: Väestöliitto, the Family Federation of Finland provides relationship counselling and couples therapy in Finnish and English.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ka akhriso: Dhibaatooyinka isqabida iyo xiriirka lammaanaha.
en: To read more, go to: Problems in marriage and relationships.

so: Kalkaalisada caafimaadka ee xarunta hooyada iyo dhallaanku waxay la talin ka bixisaa suaalaha la xiriira caafimaadka ama koritaanka iyo horumarka ilmaha yar.
en: Nurses at the child health clinic can give advice about issues connected to young children's health or growth and development.

so: Haddii aad doonaysid inaad wax talo ka weydiiso arimaha la xiriira koritaanka ama horumarka ilmaha, waxaad waqti ka qabsan kartaa xarunta hooyada iyo dhallaanka (perheneuvolasta).
en: If you want to ask for advice about issues connected to raising children or their development, you can make an appointment for family counselling (perheneuvola).

so: Xarunta hooyada iyo dhallaanku waxay u adeegtaa ilmaha da'doodu ay ka yar tahay 18 sano iyo waalidiintooda.
en: Family counselling helps children under the age of 18 years and their parents.

so: Ururka isbahaysiga dad dhigidu wuxuu qoysaka dadka dalka u soo guuray kala taliyaa arrimaha la xiriira barbaarinka carruurta iyo wanaag ku noolaanshada qoyska.
en: Väestöliitto, the Family Federation of Finland helps immigrant families in matters connected to raising children and the well-being of families.

so: La talin luuqado kala duwan ah:
en: Counselling in different languages:

so: Saldhiga dhalinyada ee Helsinki (Helsingin nuorisoasema) wuxuu cawinaad siiyaa dhalinyarada reer Helsinki ee da'doodu u dhaxayso 13–23 sano.
