en: Helsinki Youth Station (Helsingin nuorisoasema) provides help to young people aged 13–23 years living in Helsinki.

so: Cawinaada laga heli karo waxay tusaale ahaan noqon kartaa mid xagga dhibaatooyinka dhimirka ah la xiriirta ama joojinta isticmaalka maandooriyaha ama ciyaaraha.
en: Help is given for mental health problems or with stopping substance abuse or gambling, for example.

so: Sidoo kale waalidiinta dhalinyaradu waxay la soo xiriiri karaan saldhiga dhalinyarada.
en: The parents of a young person can also contact the youth station.

so: Gabdhuhu waxay cawinaad iyo la talin ka heli karaan aqalka gabdhaha (Tyttöjen talo) sidoo kale wiilashuna aqalka wiilasha (Poikien talo)
en: Girls can receive support and advice at the Girls' House (tyttöjen talo) and boys at the Boys's House (Poikien talo).

so: Hay'adda istilaabta cas waxay leedahay aqal badbaado oo loogu talogalay dhalinyarada da'doodu u dhaxayso 12–19 sano.
en: The Red Cross has a shelter for young people aged 12–19 years.

so: Aqalka badbaadada dhalinyarada waxaa laga heli karaa cawinaad wada sheekeysi iyo hoy kumeel gaar ah.
en: At the Emergency Youth Shelter, you can talk to someone and get a temporary place to stay and sleep.

so: Macluumaadka aqalka badbaadada dhalinyarada:
en: Contact information for the Emergency Youth Shelter:

so: Haddii aad qabto dhibaatooyin dhinaca dhaqaalaha ah waxaad talo weydiin kartaa shaqaalaha sooshaalka ee degmadaada ama Kelada.
en: If you have financial problems, you can ask a social worker of your municipality or Kela for advice.

so: Marxaladaha qaarkood marka aad ku jirto waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad codsato kaalmada nolosha (toimeentulotuki).
en: In some situations, you may have the right to apply for income support.

so: Lacagta kaalmada nolosha waxaad ka codsan kartaa Kelada.
en: Income support is applied from Kela.

so: Haddii aad dooneysid cawinaad xagga dhibaatooyin maandooriyaha awgood ah (sida khamriga ama isticmaalka daroogada) la xiriir rugtaada caafimaadka.
en: If you need help with a substance abuse problem (such as alcohol or drug abuse), contact your health centre.

so: Waxaad kaloo la xiriiri kartaa A-klinikada.
en: You can also contact the A-Clinic.

so: 13–23 dhalinyarada da'doodu tahay, oo ay haystaan dhibaatooyin xagga maandooriyaha ah, waxay cawinaad ka heli karaan saldhiga dhalinyarada.
en: Young people aged 13–23 years with substance abuse problems can get help at the youth station.

so: Helsinki waxaa ku yaal dhaw qabuuro.
en: Helsinki has several cemeteries.

so: Kaniisada Evankelisluterianka ayaa qabuuraha inta badan maamusha.
en: The Evangelical Lutheran Church maintains most of them.

so: Intaas waxaa dheer qabuuraha Hietaniemi oo ay ku yaalaan qabuuraha ortodoksiga ee Helsinki, qabuuraha yuhuuda ee Helsinki iyo qabuuraha islaamka ee tataarta Helsinki.
en: There are also the Orthodox Christian Cemetery of Helsinki, the Jewish Cemetery of Helsinki and the Islamic Cemetery for Tatars of Helsinki; they are in Hietaniemi.

so: Muslimiinta Helsinki waxay qabuuro ku leeyihiin qabuuraha Honkanummi ee ku yaala Vantaa.
en: The Muslims of Helsinki have a special burial section at the Honkanummi Cemetery in Vantaa.

so: Qabuuraha hokanummi waxay leeyihiin qayb aan astaan lahay oo lagu duugi karo maydadka aan diimaha jira midna ka tirsanayn.
en: Honkanummi Cemetery also has a non-denominational area for burying those who did not belong to any religion.

so: Haddii qof qaraabadaada ahi uu geeriyoodo oo aad u baahato ciwinaad nafsiyan ah, waxaa wici kartaa heeganka xasaradaha (kriisipäivystys).
en: If someone close to your has died and you need mental support, you can call the Crisis Emergency Support (kriisipäivystys).

so: Waxaad wici kartaa waqti walba.
en: You can call at any hour.

so: Dhibaatooyinka ka jira qoyska dhexdiisa
en: Problems in a family

so: Inta aan guurka la sameynin waa in qofku uu codsadaa ama sameeyaa baaritaanka lagu ogaanayo in ay jiraan waxyaabo kaa xannibi kara ama kaa horistaagi kara guurka (avioliiton esteiden tutkinta).
en: Before getting married you must request, in writing, an examination of possible impediments to your marriage.

so: Codsigaasi lagu soo baarayo waxyaabaha guurka kaa xannibi kara waa in aad waqti fiican hore u sameysaa, kahor maalinka xafladda arooska.
en: You must request the examination well in advance of the wedding.

so: Nikaaxa madaniga ama shacbiga ah waxaa lagu sameeyaa xafiiska diiwaangeinta.
en: Civil marriages are performed at a Local Register Office.

so: Ballan waqti ah ka qabso xafiiska diiwaangelinta
en: Book a time for the ceremony at a Local Register Office.

so: Ninka ama haweeneyduba waxaa ay codsigooda ku saabsan furiinka u gudbin karaan xogheynta maxakamadda Helsinki.
en: Women and men can file for divorce at the office of the District Court of Helsinki.

so: Waxaad codsiga furiinka ugu diri kartaa xogheynta maxkamadda adigoo boostada u marinaaya ama qaab iimeyl ahaan ah ugu diraaya.
en: Applications can be sent to the District Court office by post or e-mail.

so: Hadii aad caawimaad uga baahan tahay arinka ku saabsan sidii aad lammaanahaaga wax isula meeldhigi laheydeen, waxaad codsan kartaa arinka ah dhexdhexaadinta arimaha qoyska (perheasioiden sovittelu).
en: If you need help negotiating matters with your spouse, you can get help from family mediation (perheasioiden sovittelu).

so: Haddii aad adiga iyo lammaanahaagu ilmo isu leedihiin xilliga furiinka, waxaad waqti ballan ka qabsataa dhowrayaasha ama ilaaliyayaasha danaha caruurta (lastenvalvoja).
en: If you and your spouse have children, make an appointment to see a child supervisor (lastenvalvoja).

so: Ilaaliyaha danaha caruurtu waxaa uu xaqiijinayaa heshiiska halka uu ilmihu ku noolaanaayo, daryeelkiisa, xuquuqda la kulanka caruurta iyo kaalmada masruufka ilmaha
en: The child supervisor will confirm an agreement on living arrangements, custody, visitation rights and child maintenance support.

so: Adeega talo siinta ee ilaaliyayaasha danaha ilmaha:
en: Guidance on child supervisor services:

so: Hadii aad caawimaad uga baahan tahay arinka ku saabsan heshiis ka gaarista arimaha ilmaha, waxaad codsan kartaa arinka ah dhexdhexaadinta arimaha qoyska.
en: If you need help agreeing matters related to your children, you can apply for family mediation.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii akhriso qeybta: Caruurta waalidiintoodu is-fureen.
en: Further information: Children in a divorce.

so: Bogga internetka InfoFinlandi qeybtiisa Waxbarashada Helsinki ayaad ka heleysaa warbixin la xirirta xannaano-meelmeedka Helsinki.
en: You can find information on the day care of children in Helsinki on the InfoFinland page Education in Helsinki.

so: Waxaa daryeelayaashaas ay bixiyaan daryeel xannaano ku meelgaar ah xilliga subaxnimada.
en: Park aunties provide temporary childcare in the mornings.

so: Waxaa ay ilaalinayaan oo hagayaan ilmaha ku ciyaaraya beerta ama jardiinada ciyaarta ee ilmaha.
en: Park aunties supervise and guide children who play at a playground.

so: Daryeelka ilmaha ee xannaaneeyayaashaas waa mid lacag ah.
en: Childcare provided by park aunties is subject to a fee.

so: Haddii aad gurigaaga uga baahan tahay daryeele ilmaha oo ku meelgaar ah, waxaad arinkaas kala xiriiri kartaa ururka badbaadada caruurta ee Mannerheim (Mannerheimin lastensuojeluliitto) ama ururuka ka shaqeeya wadajirka qoyska ee la yiraahdo (Väestöliitto).
en: If you need a temporary nanny in your home, you can contact the Mannerheim League for Child Welfare (Mannerheimin lastensuojeluliitto) or Väestöliitto.

so: Haddii aad guriga ku daryeeshid ilmo ka yar da'da 3 sano, waxaad heli kartaa kaalmada dhaqaale ee guriheynta (kotihoidon tuki).
en: If you care for your child under 3 years of age at home, you can claim child home care allowance (kotihoidon tuki).

so: Waxaa kaalmadaas laga dalbadaa xafiiska Kelada.
en: You can claim the allowance from Kela.

so: Waxaa intaa dheer in degmada Helsinki ay bixiso kaalmo dheeri ah oo ku saabsan tan guri ku heynta ilmaha, taasoo ay siiso qoysaska guriga ku daryeela ilmo da'doodu ka yar tahay 3 sano.
en: In addition, the City of Helsinki pays a municipal care allowance supplement for families who care for a child under 3 years of age at home.

so: Helsinki waxaa ku yaalla beero/jardiinooyin ciyaarta iyo guryo qoyseed, kuwaaso howlo waxqabad loogu diyaariyo caruurta iyo waalidka ilmahooda ku haaya guriga.
en: There are playgrounds and family houses in Helsinki in which activities are organised for children and parents who care for children at home.

so: Howlahaasi waxqabad waxaa ay tusaale ahaan noqon karaan isboorti, heeso wax isku rakibid, kuwaaso dhammaan laga hagi doono sida loo sameynaayo.
en: Activities can include sports, singing and arts and crafts.

so: Iskuulka waxbarashada dadka waaweyn ee Stadin ayaa wuxuu ka qabanqaabiyaa koorasyo luqadda finishka ah beeraha ama jardiinooyinka ciyaarta iyo guryo qoyseedka qaarkood, kuwaasoo loogu talagalay waalidiinta ajaanibta ah ee waddankan u soo guurey.
en: Helsinki Vocational College organises Finnish courses for immigrant parents at some playgrounds and family houses.

so: Beeraha ama jardiinooyinka ciyaarta iyo guryo qoyseedkuba waxaa ay caruurta u diyaariyaan cid daryeesha inta kooraska luqaddu uu socdo.
en: Playgrounds and family houses arrange childcare for the duration of the course.

so: Xannaanooyinka, guryo qoyseedka iyo beeraha ama jardiinooyinka ciyaartaba waxaa laga qabanqaabiyaa naadiyo waqtiyada qaarkood ah oo loogu talagalay caruurta da'doodu u dhaxeyso 2-5 sano jir, kuwaasoo aan dhigan wax xannaano ah.
en: Part-time clubs for children between the age of 2 and 5 who do not attend childcare are organised at day care centres, family houses and playgrounds.

so: Sidoo kale kaniisadaha Helsinki waxaa ay qabanqaabiyaan naadiyo.
en: Parishes in Helsinki also organise clubs.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi ee cinwaankiisu yahay Xaaladaha dhibku jiro iyo Helsinki ayaad ka heleysaa warbixin la xiriirta halka aad ka heli kartid caawimaada Helsinki ee arimaha dhibaatooyinka caruurta, dhalinyarada iyo qoysaska ka dhex taagan.
en: You can find information on where to get help in Helsinki for problems related to children, young people and families on the InfoFinland page Problem situations in Helsinki.

so: Warbixinta la xiriirta dhibaatooyinka caruurta iyo dhalinyarada ayaad sidoo kale waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Dhibaatooyinka caruurta iyo dhallinyarada.
en: There is also information on problems with children and young people on the InfoFinland page Children's and young people's problems.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi qeybtiisa Dhibaatooyinka isqabida iyo xiriirka lammaanaha, waxaad ka heleysaa warbixin la xiriirta, xaggee laga helaa caawimaadda dhibaatada ka dhex taagan xiriirka lammaanah.
en: Information on getting help for problems related to a relationship is available on the InfoFinland page Problems in marriage and relationships.

so: Fiidiyowga waxqabadka jardiinada ciyaarta
en: Video about playground activities

so: Degmada Helsinki waxaa ay leedahay adeega la yiraahdo Seniori-info (oo ah warbixin loogu tala galay dadka waaweyn), kuwaasoo ka tala bixiya arimaha la xiriira adeegyada dadka waaweyn ee Helsinki.
en: Senior Info service is provided by the City of Helsinki and offers guidance on services for the elderly in Helsinki.

so: Dadka waayeelka ee reer Helsinki iyo ehelkooduba waa ay la xiriri karaan Seniori-info.
en: Senior Info is intended for elderly people who live in Helsinki, and their relatives.

so: Seniori-info waxaa ay adeegyadeeda ku bixisaa luqadaha finishka iyo iswiidishka.
en: Senior Info provides services in Finnish and Swedish.

so: Marka aad qof ehelkaaga ah guriga ku xannaaneyso
en: When you take care of your disabled family member at home

so: Waxaa intaa dheer in degmada Helsinki ay bixiso kaalmo dheeri ah oo ku saabsan tan guri ku heynta ilmaha, taasoo ay siiso qoysaska guriga ku daryeela ilmo da'doodu ka yar tahay 2 sano.
en: In addition, the City of Helsinki pays a municipal care allowance supplement for families who care for a child under 2 years of age at home.

so: InfoFinland waa shabakad xagga internetka ah oo luuqado badan ku qoran, taas oo lagu soo aruuriyo maacluumaad badan oo muhiim u ah dadka qorshaynaya inay Finland u soo guuraan ama kuwa halkan horay u deganaa.
en: InfoFinland is a multi-language website providing vital information to people planning to move to Finland and to immigrants already living in the country.

so: Boggu wuxuu sidoo kale u adeegaa ka caawiyaa hawlwadeenada hay'adaha dawliga ah dhanka macluumaad siinta luuqadaha badan.
en: The website also helps authorities with multi-language communications.

so: Isticmaalaha InfoFinlandi wuxuu helayaa macluumaad la aamini karo oo luuqadiisa ku qoran kuna saabsan u soo guuridda Finland, shaqada, waxbarashada, degaanka, tacliinta, caafimaadka, qoyska, xaaladaha dhibku jiro iyo waqtiyada firaaqada.
en: InfoFinland offers users reliable information in their own language about moving to Finland, work, studying, housing, education, health, family, problem situations and leisure activities.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi waa jawaab celiye.
en: The InfoFinland website is responsive.

so: Waa sahal inaad u isticmaasho aaladaha kala gedisan, sida telefoonada smartiga ah iyo kombuyuuterada yar yar ee tabletiyada ah.
en: It is easy to use with various devices, such as smartphones and tablets.

so: Luuqadaha adeeggu waa, Iswidish, Ingiriis, Ruush, Viro, Faransiis, Soomaali, Ispanish, Turkki, Jayniis, Bershia iyo Carabi.
en: The languages of the service are Finnish, Swedish, English, Russian, Estonian, French, Somali, Spanish, Turkish, Chinese, Persian and Arabic.

so: Nuqulada luuqadu waa is shabahaan.
en: The language versions are identical in content.

so: Xafiiska turjumidda ayaa u xil saaran turjubaanidda.
en: A translation agency is responsible for the translations.

so: Intaas waxaa dheer in InfoFinlandi uu leeyahay xiriir ama wadiiqo kugu ridaysa qoraalo ama walxo lagu daabacay luuqado kale.
en: InfoFinland also has links to materials that have been published in other languages.

so: Macluumaad la xiriira adeegyada degaankaaga
en: Information about local services

so: InfoFinlandi waxaa laga helayaa macluumaad la xiira adeegyada degmooyin dhawr ah.
en: InfoFinland contains information about the services of several municipalities.

so: Xariirka (linkki) bogga degmada waxaad ka heleysaa qoraalka saxda ah adigoo isticmaalaya doorashada magaalooyinka.
en: You can find links to the municipal websites under Cities in the column on the right.

so: Markii isticmaaluhu uu galo bogga internetka ee degmada, waxaa la tusayaa xiriir ama wadiiqo ku xireysa macluumaadka aasaasiga ah ee mawduuca.
en: When users enter the municipal website, they are shown links to basic information about the subject.

so: Bogga Magaalooyinka waxaad ka heleysaa kaartada degmooyinka ee InfoFinlandi.
en: The Cities page shows the InfoFinland municipalities on the map.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi waxaa maamula magaalada Helsinki.
en: The InfoFinland website is maintained by the City of Helsinki.

so: InfoFinlandi wuxuu u xilsaaran yahay soo saaridda iyo cusbooneysiinta macluumadka qaybaha kala ah U soo guuridda Finland, Nolosha Finland, Macluumaadka ku saabsan Finland iyo Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa iyo Kauniainen.
en: The InfoFinland editorial team is in charge of updating the sections Moving to Finland, Living in Finland and Information about Finland as well as the information on Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa and Kauniainen.

so: Magaalooyinka kale ee xubnaha ka ah InfoFinlandi iyagaa u xil saaran maamulidda iyo cusbooneysiinta bogga degmadooda.
en: The editorial teams of the other member municipalities are responsible for maintaining their own municipal websites.

so: Dalbashada koorsooyinka luuqadaha Finnishka iyo Iswidishka Finnishcourses.fi waa qayb ka mid ah adeegga InfoFinlandi.
en: The Finnishcourses.fi service for finding Finnish and Swedish language courses is a part of the InfoFinland service.

so: InfoFinlandi waxaa maalgeliya dawladda dhexe iyo degmooyinka wadashaqayntu ay ka dhexayso.
en: InfoFinland is funded by the state and partner municipalities.

so: Madaxa wararka iyo u xilsaaranaha waradka ee InfoFinlandi waa Eija Kyllönen-Saarnio.
en: InfoFinland's Editor-in-Chief is Eija Kyllönen-Saarnio.

so: Magaca adeegga shabakadda nfoFinland wuxuu horay u ahaan Infopankki.
en: The name of the InfoFinland online service used to be Infopankki.

so: Magaca waxaa la beddelayaa Nofeembar 2018.
en: The name was changed in November 2018.

so: Bogga adeegga ee Infopankki.fi waxaa la soo saaray sannadkii 2003 ayadoo ay iska kaashadeen Xarunta dhaqamada caalamiga ah ee Caisa iyo Maktabadda magaalada Helsinki wuxuuna ka hawlgalayey Xarunta dhaqamada ee Helsinki dhexdeeda.
en: The Infopankki.fi online service was published in 2003 jointly by the Caisa international cultural centre and Helsinki City Library at the City of Helsinki Cultural Office.

so: Hadda InfoFinland wuxuu ku shaqeeyaa qeybta warfaafinta ee ee xafiiska magaalada Helsinki.
en: Today, InfoFinland operates at the City of Helsinki Executive Office's Communications unit.

so: Hadddi ay dhacdo ama ay taagan tahay xaalad deg-deg ah, waxaad wacdaa lambarka 112.
en: In urgent matters, call the emergency number 112.

so: Lambarkaas deg-dega ama emerjensiga ah waxaa wici kartaa tusaale ahaan, haddii uu dhaco shil aad u khatar ah ama qof uu xanuun ku soo boodo.
en: Call the emergency number in the event of serious accident or if someone is having a seizure, for example.

so: Haddii xaaladdu aanay ahayn mid deg-deg ah, ha wicin lambarka deg-dega am emerjensiga.
en: Do not call the emergency number for non-urgent matters.

so: Haddii aad Guri degmo ku leedahay Helsinki waxaad isticmaali kartaa adeegyada caafimaadka shacabka.
en: If your municipality of residence is Helsinki, you are entitled to use public health services.

so: Haddii aadan xaq u laheyn isticmaalka adeegyada daryeelka caafimaadka ee dadweynaha, waxaad caawimaad ka raadsan kartaa rugaha dhaqaatiirta ee gaarka ah.
en: If you are not entitled to use public health care services, you can seek help at a private medical clinic.

so: Rugaha dhaqaatiirta ee gaarka loo leeyahay kharashka kaaga baxa waa inaad adigu kaligaa iska bixiso.
en: At private clinics, you will have to pay all the expenses yourself.

so: Haddii aad u baahan macluumaadka adeegyada caafimaadka waxaad wici kartaa la-talinta caafimaadka: (09) 310 100 23.
en: If you require information on health services, you can call the telephone health service: (09) 310 100 23.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale weydiin kartaa adeegga hagista daryeelka jirada.
en: You can also contact the service to request advice on how to treat illnesses.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Adeega caafimaadka ee Finland.
en: Read more: Health services in Finland.

so: Markaad la xiriirto rugta caafimaadka (terveysasema), kalkaalisada caafimaadka ayaa marka ugu horeysa qiimeyn ku sameyn doonta xaaladdaada.
en: When you contact a health station (terveysasema), a nurse will first assess your situation.

so: Lyadoo lagu saleynaayo qiimeyntaas ayaa ballan lagaaga qaban doonaa dhakhtarka ama kalkaalisada caafimaadka iyo daryeelaha caafimaadka.
en: On the basis of the assessment you will be referred to a doctor, a public health nurse or a nurse.

so: Rugaha caafimaadka waxaa ay furan yihiin isniinta-Jimcaha inta u dhaxeysa saacadaha 8.00-16:00.
en: Health stations are open on weekdays from 8.00 to 16.00.

so: Haddii aad u baahan tahay daryeel islamaalinkaas ah, waa in aad wacdaa rugta caafimaadka subaxnimada hore, islamarkaa la furo rugta caafimaadka.
en: If you require treatment the same day please contact the health station as soon as it opens in the morning.

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira rugaha caafimaadka waxaad ka heli kartaa bogaga internetka ee degmada Helsinki.
en: The contact information for health stations is available on the website of the City of Helsinki.

so: Rugaha caafimaadka ee gaarka loo leeyahay waad aadi kartaa, xitaa haddii aadan xaq u laheyn adeegyada guud ee caafimaadka ee dalkan Finland.
en: You can visit a private clinic even if you are not entitled to public health care services in Finland.

so: Rugaha caafimaadka ee gaarka loo leeyahay wixii kharash ah ee kugu baxa oo dhan waa inaad adigu nafasad ahaantaada iska bixisaa.
en: At private clinics you will have to cover all the expenses yourself.

so: Macluumaadka ku saabsan soo iibsashada daawada waxaad ka heli kartaa bogga internetka ee InfoFinlandi qeybtiisa Daawooyinka.
en: Information on buying medication is available on InfoFinland page Medication.

so: Sharci la'aan waxaa loola jeedaa, qofka wadana u soo guurey ee aan ogolaanshaha deganaanta /ciqaamad heysan, ama qofka wadanka u soo guurey ee aan ku jirin ceymiska caafimaadka.
en: An undocumented migrant refers to an immigrant who does not have a residence permit or an immigrant who does not have health insurance.

so: Degmada Helsinki gudaheeda dadka wadanka u soo guurey ee aan sharciga laheyn waxaa ay xaq u leeyihiin in ay helaan daryeelka caafimaad ee xaaladaha deg-dega ah ama lagama maarmaanka ah ee adeegyada guud ee caafimaadka.
en: In Helsinki, undocumented migrants are entitled to receive urgent and necessary treatment from public health services.

so: Ilmaha wixii ka yar da'da 18 sano iyo haweenka uurka lehba waxaa ay xaq u leeyihiin in ay helaan dhammaan adeegyada caafimaadka, si lamid sida dadka kale ee reer Helsinki ah.
en: Anyone under the age of 18 and pregnant women are entitled to receive the same health services as other residents in Helsinki.

so: Helsinki waxaa ka howlgala Global Clinic, kaasoo ay dadka sharci la'aanta ah ee jooga Finland ay ka heli karaan adeegyada asaasiga ah ee caafimaadka.
en: The Global Clinic operates in Helsinki and provides basic health services to people who are staying in Finland without a permit.

so: Adeega Global Clinic qofka macmiilka ah waa u bilaash ama lacag la'aan.
en: Services provided by the Global Clinic are free of charge to the clients.

so: Global Clinic uma sheegayaan macaamiishooda booliska iyo howl-wadeenada kale ee dowladaba.
en: The Global Clinic will not report its customers to the police or other authorities.

so: Si loo badbaadiyo macaamiisha, meesha ay ku taal rugtan caafimaadka iyo waqtiyada ay furan tahay lama shaaciyo.
en: In order to protect its customers, the location and opening hours of the clinic are not listed publicly.

so: Waqtiyada habeenkii iyo dhammaadka usbuuca ee maalmaha Sabtida iyo Axadda xarumaha caafimaadku waa ay xiran yihiin.
en: In the evenings and at weekends, health stations are closed.

so: Haddii aad u baahan tahay daryeel deg-deg ah xilliga habeenkii ama dhammaadka usbuuca, waxaad la xiriiri kartaa heeganka (päivystys).
en: If you need urgent treatment in the evening or at a weekend, please contact the emergency services (päivystys).

so: Haddii aad degan tahay Bariga Helisnki, Koonfur-Bari Helsinki, Waqooyi-Bari ama Waqooyiga Helsinki, rugta caafimaadka ee heeganka leh waa tan ku dhex taalla isbitaalka Malmi.
en: If you reside in East, Northeast, Southeast or North Helsinki, your emergency health centre is located in Malmi Hospital.

so: Haddii aad degan tahay Koonfurta-Helsinki, Bartamaha-Helsinki ama Galbeedka-Helsinki, rugta caafimaadka ee heeganka leh, waa tan ku dhex taalla isbitaalka Haartmanin.
en: If you live in South Helsinki, Central Helsinki or West Helsinki, emergency health centre services are provided at Haartman Hospital.

so: Caafimaadka iyo korriinka carruurta aan da'doodu gaarin iskuulka, waxaa lagala socdaa xarunta daryeelka dhallaanka iyo hooyada (neuvola).
en: The health and development of children under school age is monitored at a maternity and child health clinic (neuvola).

so: Neefolada Helsinki waxaad ka noqon kartaa macmiil, haddii aad heysato kaarka caafimaadka ee Kela (Kela-kortti).
en: In Helsinki, you are entitled to the services of the clinics if you have a Kela card.

so: Ballanka neefolada waxaad ka qabsan kartaa rugtaada caafimaadka.
en: You can make an appointment for a maternity and child health clinic at your own health station.

so: Carruurta da'doodu gaartay iskuulka, waxaa caafimaadkooda daryeesha kalkaalisada caafimaadka ee iskuulka.
en: School nurses take care of the health of children who attend school.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa iskuulka.
en: More information can be obtained from the respective schools.

so: Haddii ilmuhu uu si kedis ah u xanuunsado, waxaad wacdaa oo la xiriirtaa rugtaada caafimaadka.
en: When a child suddenly falls ill please contact your local health station.

so: Islamarkiiba wac subaxnimada hore rugta caafimaadka.
en: Call the health station first thing in the morning as soon as it opens.

so: Markii rugta caafimaadku ay xiran tahay, la xiriir oo wac heeganka Isbitaalka carruurta.
en: When health stations are closed please contact the emergency clinic at the Children's Hospital.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale carruurta geyn kartaa xarumaha caafimaadka ee sida gaarka ah loo leeyahay.
en: You can also take your child to a private clinic.

so: Helsinki waxaa sidoo kale ku yaalla xarumo caafimaad badan oo si gaar ah loo leeyahay, kuwaasoo sidoo kale carruurta daryeela.
en: There are numerous private clinics that treat children in Helsinki.

so: Waxaa intaa u dheer oo ay ka daneysan karaan daryeelada khaaska ah ee loogu talagaley adeega caafimaadka ee u khaaska ah waayeellada.
en: In some cases you can also receive services specifically intended for the elderly.

so: Lambarka telefoonka laga ballansado daryeelka ilkaha Helsinki waa (09) 310 51400.
en: The Helsinki dental care appointments telephone number is (09) 310 51400.

so: Haddii aad u baahan tahay daryeel deg-deg ah, waxaad wacdaa durbaba subaxnimada hore.
en: If you need emergency care call the number early in the morning.

so: Haddii aad habeenki ama dhammaadka toddobaadka degdeg ugu baahato takhtarka ilkaha, wac heeganka tel.
en: If you urgently need a dentist in the evening or at the weekend, call the emergency clinic on tel.

so: Heksinki waxaa sidoo kale ku yaalla dhakhaatiir badan oo daryeelka ilkaha oo gaar ama baraayfat ah.
en: There are also plenty of private dental clinics in Helsinki.

so: Daryeelka ilkaha ee baraayfatka ama gaarka ah waa ay ka qaalisan yihiin kan guud.
en: Private dental care is more expensive than public.

so: Haddii aad u baahan tahay caawimaad xagga arimaha maskaxda ku saabsan, waxaad la xiriiri kartaa xaruntaada ama rugtaada caafimaad (terveysasemai).
en: If you require help with mental issues please contact your local health station (terveysasema).

so: Haddii loo baahdo dhakhtarka rugta cafimaadka ayaa gudbin kuugu sameynaaya xarunta caafimaadka ee bukaansocodka arimaha maskaxda.
en: If necessary, a doctor will write a referral to a psychiatric outpatient clinic.

so: Ururka caafimaadka dhimirka ee Finland (Suomen Mielenterveysseura) waxaa ay leeyihiin qaabilaadda arimaha dhibaatada ama xasaradda ah ee heysta dadka wadanka u soo guurey, kuwaasoo ku nool Helsinki iyo agagaarkeeda.
en: The Finnish Association for Mental Health (Suomen Mielenterveysseura) has a crisis reception service for immigrants living in the Helsinki region.

so: Qaabilaadda arimaha dhibaatada ama xasaradda leh ee taagan ku saabsan waxaad ka heleysaa caawimaad la xiriirta xaaladda adag ee taagan.
en: The crisis reception provides support and assistance in difficult situations.

so: Waad wici kartaa oo ballan ka qabsan kartaa.
en: You can call and make an appointment.

so: Qaabilaadda arimaha dhibaatada ama xasarada leh waxaa laguugu adeegayaa luqadaha finishka, iswiidishka iyo ingiriiska, iyo waliba luqadaha kale iyadoo turjubaan la adeegsanaayo.
en: The crisis reception provides services in Finnish, Swedish and English, and other languages with the help of an interpreter.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso ka hortaga uurka ama aad ku fekereyso inaad ilmo iska soo rido, waxaad la xiriirtaa xaruntaada ama rugtaada caafimaad (terveysasema).
en: If you require a prescription for contraception or you are contemplating abortion please contact your local health station (terveysasema).

so: Haddii da'daadu ay ka yar tahay 16 sano jir, oo aad dooneyso ka hortaga uurka, waxaad la xiriirtaa kalkaalisada caafimaadka ee iskuulkaada.
en: If you are under the age of 16 and require a prescription for contraception please contact the public health nurse at your school.

so: Haddii aad ka shakisan tahay inaad qabto cudurada ku dhaca habdhiska taranka, laakiin aadan wax calaamado ah laheyn, la xiriir rugtaada caafimaadka.
en: If you suspect that you have a sexually transmitted disease but are exhibiting no symptoms please contact your own health station.

so: Xarunta daryeelka hooyada iyo dhallaanka (Äitiysneuvola) ayaa lagula socdaa hooyada, ilmaha uurka ku jira iyo caafimaadka guud ee qoyska waqtiga uurka.
en: The well-being of the mother, baby and the whole family is monitored at a maternity clinic (äitiysneuvola) during pregnancy.

so: Haddii aad heysato kaarka caafimaadka ee Kela, waxaad ka mid noqon kartaa macaamiisha xarunta daryeelka hooyada iyo dhallaanka.
en: You are entitled to the services of the clinics if you have a Kela card.

so: La xiriir neefolada ku taalla agagaarka xaafadaada, markii aad ogaato ama dareento inaad uur leedahay.
en: Please contact the maternity and child health clinic in your area as soon as you find out about your pregnancy.

so: Macluumaadyada isbitaaladaas ee halka aad kala xiriiri karto waxaad ka heleysaa bogaga internetka ee HUS.
en: Contact information can be found on the website of the Hospital District of Helsinki and Uusimaa.

so: Haddii aad dareensan tahay in si khaldan laguula dhaqmey inti ay socotey howsha adeegga caafimaadka, marka hore arrinta kala xaajood oo wax kaga qabo xaruntaada caafimaadka.
en: If you feel that you have been treated unfairly within the health services, first try to solve the matter at the place of treatment.

so: Haddii arrinta aysan waxba ka qabsoomin, la xiriir dhaqtarka sare ama kalkaalisada caafimaadka sare ee goobta daryeelka.
en: If the matter is not resolved, contact the chief physician or head nurse at your place of treatment.

so: Intaas kadib waxaad la xiriiri kartaa haddii loo baahdo qareenka bukaanka (potilasasiamies).
en: After this, you can contact the Patient Ombudsman (potilasasiamies) if necessary.

so: Magaalada Helsinki waxaa ay dadka naafada ah u qabanqaabisaa adeegyo, tusaale ahaan qalabka la kaalmeysto, adeegyada gaadiidka iyo waxqabad maalmeedyo.
en: The City of Helsinki organises various services for disabled people, such as aid equipment, transport services and daytime activities.

so: Sidoo kale caruurta naafada ah waxaa ay heli karaan adegyada naafada.
en: Services are also organised for disabled children.

so: Haddii aad naafo tahay, marka hore la xiriir xarunta caafimaadka (terveysasema).
en: If you have a disability please first contact your local health station (terveysasema).

so: Xarunta caafimaadka ayaa arinkaaga lagu qiimeynayaa.
en: Your situation will be assessed at the health station.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad oo la xiriirta adeegyayada naafada ee helsinki, waxaad ka heli kartaa shaqaalaha arimaha bulshada ama soohalka adeegyada naafada ee degmada Helsinki.
en: More information about services for disabled people can be obtained from the social workers of local disability services.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Naafada.
en: Read more: Disabled people.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Cunugga naafada ah.
en: Read more: Disabled child.

so: Fiidyow daryeelka caafimaadka afka
en: Video about oral health care

so: Caafimaadka galmada iyo ka hortagga uurka.
en: Read more: Sexual health and contraception.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Uurka iyo dhalmada iyo Finland markii uu ilmuhu dhaso.
en: Read more: Pregnancy and childbirth and When a child is born in Finland.

so: Waxqabadka galabti ee dugsileyda
en: Afternoon activities for schoolchildren

so: Helsinki waxaa jira xannaanoyin badan oo ay magaaladdu leedahay iyo kuwo shaqsiya.
en: Helsinki has numerous city-owned and private day-care centres (päiväkoti).

so: Xannaano-maalmeedyada magaaladda waxaa looga hadlaa afka finnishka ama iswidhishka.
en: Finnish or Swedish is spoken in city-owned day-care centres.

so: Intooda badan waxa lagaga hadlaa afka finnishka.
en: Most day-care centres are Finnish-speaking.

so: Haddii aad booska xannaanada ka codsaneyso xannaano-maalmeedka magaalada, Codsiga sameyso ugu yaraan afar bilood kahor billaabashada xannaaneynta.
en: If you are applying for a position in a city-owned day-care centre, submit your application at least four months before the beginning of the care period.

so: Magaalada waad ka codsan kartaa boos xannaano-maalmeed haddii qoysku uu cinwaanka ku leeyahay Helsinki.
en: You can apply for a day-care placement from the city if your family has an address in Helsinki.

so: Booska xannaanada ku codso internetka.
en: You can apply for a day-care placement online.

so: Marka aad isticmaaleyso foomka elekterikaalka ah waxaad u baahan aqoonsiyada bankiga ee Finnishka.
en: Finnish online banking credentials are required to use the electronic form.

so: Haddii aadan isticmaali karin foomamka elekterikaalka ah ka daabaco foomka codsiga bogagga shabakadda magaalada.
en: In addition, your child must have a Finnish personal identity code. If you cannot use the electronic form, print the application form from the city website.

so: Gee ama boostada ugu dir xannaano-maalmeedka aad ugu horey codsaneysid.
en: Take or post the filled form to the day-care provider you are primarily applying for.

so: Macluumaadyada xiriirka ee xannaano-maalmeedyada waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga shabakadda magaalada.
en: The contact information for day-care centres is available on the city website.

so: Haddii aad qabto su'aal ku saabsann xannaano-maaleedka ama codsashada booska xannaano-maalmeedka, waxaad wici karta lambarka talobixinta ee adeegyada barbaarin-horaadka ee magaalada:
en: If you have questions about day care or applying for a day-care placement, you can call the city's advice helpline for early childhood education services:

so: Waxaa sidoo kale Helsinki ku yaala xannaano-maalmeedyo gaar loo leeyahay oo luqadahoodu ay kala yihiin ingiriis, ruush, jarmal, faransiis ama isbaanish.
en: There are also private day-care centres in Helsinki where English, Russian, German, French or Spanish is spoken.

so: Helsinki waxaa sidoo kale ku yaal hal xannaano-maalmeedyo oo Islaami ah afka carabiga ku shaqeysa.
en: In Helsinki, there is also an Islamic day-care centre where Arabic is spoken.

so: Haddii aad codsanayso xannaano shaqsiyadeedka, si toos ah ula xidhidh xannaanada, hadii aad karabto boos.
en: If you are applying for a place for your child in a private day-care centre, contact the day-care centre of your choice directly.

so: Waxbarasho-horaadka (esiopetus) waxaa Helsinki ka bixiya xannaano-maalmeedyo iyo iskuulaad badan.
en: In Helsinki, pre-school education (esiopetus) is provided at many day-care centres and schools.

so: Bogagga shabakadda magaalada Helsinki waxaad ka heleysaa liiska xannaano-maalmeedyada iyo iskuulaadka bixiya waxbarasho-horaadka.
en: The City of Helsinki website features a list of day-care centres and schools that provide pre-school education.

so: Waxbarasho-horaadka waxaa lagu codsadaa foom elekterikaal ah.
en: You can apply for pre-school education with an electronic form.

so: Waxaa intaas dheer in cunugaadu uu u baahanyahay aqoonsiga qofka ee Finnishka.
en: In addition, your child must have a Finnish personal identity number.

so: Haddii aadan isticmaali karin foomamka elekterikaalka ah ka daabaco foomka codsiga bogagga shabakadda magaalada ama foomka ka soo qaado mid kamid ah xannaano-maalmeedyada magaalada.
en: If you cannot use the electronic form, print the application form from the city website or obtain a printed form from a city-owned day-care centre.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan waxbarasho-horaadka waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga shabakadda.
en: More information is available on the city website.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale faahfaahin dheeraad ah weydiin kartaa hogaamiyayaasha xannaano-maalmeedyada.
en: You can also request more information from the heads of the various day-care centres.

so: Waxbarasho-horaadku wuxuu bilowdaa Agoosto, xilliga codsigu waa Janaayo.
en: Pre-school education begins in August, and the application period is in January.

so: Helsinki waxaa ku yaal iskuulaad aasaasi ah (peruskoulu) oo badan.
en: There are many comprehensive schools (peruskoulu) in Helsinki.

so: Iskuulaadka ay magaaladu leedahay ka sokoow Helsinki waxaa ku yaal iskuulaad gaar loo leeyahay iyo iskuulaad ay dowladdu leedahay.
en: In addition to the city schools, private and state-owned schools are available.

so: Waxbarashada iskuulaadka gaarka loo leeyahay waxay ahaan kartaa lacag.
en: Studying in a private school may be subject to a fee.

so: Iskuulada magaalada luqada wax lagu bartaa waa finnish iyo iswidhish, Helsinki waxa kale oo ay leedahay iskuulo shaqsiyadeed, kuwaasoo luqada waxlagu barto ay kamid yihiin ingiriis, jarmal ama ruush.
en: In city schools, the language of instruction is Finnish or Swedish. In Helsinki, there are also private schools whose language of instruction is, for example, English, German, French or Russian.

so: Haddii aqoonta luqada finnishka ee cunuggu aysan si fiican ugu filneyn waxbarashada dugsiga hoose dhexe, wuxuu heli karaa waxbarasho diyaarin ah.
en: If a pupil's Finnish language skills are not good enough for comprehensive school studies in a Finnish-speaking school, he/she may be provided with preparatory education.

so: Waxbarashada diyaarinta ah waxey cunugga u diyaarisaa waxbarashada hoose dhexe.
en: This education prepares the child for studies in a comprehensive school.

so: Waxbarashada diyaarinta ah waxaa lagu baraa luqada finnishka iyo maadooyinka dugsiga hoose dhexe.
en: The preparatory education teaches Finnish language and comprehensive school subjects.

so: Waxaad rugta adeegga ee Qeybta waxbarashada iyo tababarka wax ka weydiin kartaa waxbarashada aasaasiga ah iyo iskuulaadka.
en: You can ask about basic education and schools in Helsinki at the guidance and service point of the Education Sector.

so: Dugsiga sare ee dadka da'da ka baxay ee Helsinki (Helsingin Aikuislukio) waxa laga heli karaa qayb ku habboon dadka dal soo galeedka ah ee 17 sano gaadhay. Waxad ku baran kartaa iskuulkaas dugsiga waxbarashada dugsiga dhexe oo dhamaystiran ama qaybo kamid ah.
en: The Helsinki Upper Secondary School for Adults (Helsingin aikuislukio) has a study programme for over 17-year-old immigrants, which enables you to complete the entire comprehensive school curriculum or portions of it.

so: Macluumaad faahfaahsan waxad ka heli kartaa bogga internetka ee Helsingin Aikuislukio.
en: More information is available on the website of the Helsinki Upper Secondary School for Adults.

so: Dugsiyada sare ee dadka waaweyn oo kale waxaa sidoo kale laga helaa waxbarashada aasaasiga ah.
en: Other upper secondary schools for adults also provide comprehensive education for adults.

so: Macluumaadyada xiriirka ee dugsiyada sare ee dadka waaweyn waxaa laga helaa bogagga shabakadda ee magaalada Helsinki.
en: The contact information for the upper secondary schools for adults can be found on the City of Helsinki website.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Waxbarashada aasaasiga ah.
en: Read more: Basic education.

so: Magaalada Helsinki waxey dugsiga ka dib waxqabad gelinka dambe ah dugsiyada iyo jardiinooyinka ciyaarta ugu qabanqaabisaa ardayda fasallada 1aad iyo 2aad.
en: The City of Helsinki organises afternoon activities for 1st and 2nd graders at schools and playgrounds after the school day.

so: Waxqabadka galabti waxaa inta lagu jiro waqtiga sanad-dugsiyeedka la qabanqaabiyaa maalmaha shaqada ugu badnaan illaa iyo 5ta galabnimo.
en: The afternoon activities are arranged during the school year on weekdays no later than 5 pm.

so: Waxqabadka jardiinooyinka ciyaartu waa lacag la'aan waxeyna u furan yihiin dadka oo dhan.
en: The activities at the playgrounds are free-of-charge and open to all.

so: Waxaad cunuggaada foomka diiwaangelinta uga diiwaangelin kartaa waxqabadka galabti ee jardiinooyinka ciyaarta.
en: You can register your child for the afternoon activities at playgrounds with a registration form.

so: Geeya foomka jardiinada ciyaarta ee ugu horeyn aad dooneysaan aad iska diiwaangelisaan.
en: Return the form to the playground for which you primarily want to register.

so: Carruurta afkooda hooyo uu yahay wax ka duwan finnish ama iswidish waxey heli karaan barashada afkooda hooyo.
en: Children whose native language is not Finnish or Swedish may receive education in their native language.

so: Helsinki waxaa dadka dalka u soo guuray loogu fidiyaa barashada afkooda hooyo in ka badan 40 luqadood.
en: In Helsinki, native-language education is provided for immigrants in over 40 languages.

so: Macluumaadka ku saabsan barahada afkaada hooyo waxaad weydiin kartaa rugta adeegga iyo talo bixinta ee Qeybta waxbarashada iyo tababarka.
en: You can ask about native-language education from the guidance and service office of the Education Sector.

so: Machadka xirfadda ee Stadi (Stadin ammattiopisto) waxaa ku taal qeyb waxbarasho xirfadeeda oo ugu weyn Finland, taas oo lagu baran karo majalado kala duduwan.
en: Helsinki Vocational College is the largest vocational institute (ammatillinen oppilaitos) in Finland, where you can study a variety of fields.

so: Macluumaadyada xiriirka ee qeybta waxbarashada xirfadda Helsinki ee hagista codsashada waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga shabakadda hogaanka waxbarashada.
en: Apply for vocational education through the joint application process.

so: Qeybta waxbarashada xirfadda ee magaalada Helsinki waxaa dadka dalka u soo guuray loogu qabanqaabiyaa waxbarasho diyaarin ah oo lagu baranayo maadooyinka xirfadda.
en: Helsinki Vocational College organises training that prepares immigrants for vocational education.

so: Machadka xirfadda ee Stadi waxaa dadka dalka u soo guuray loogu qabanqaabiyaa waxbarashada diyaarinta barashada xirfadda.
en: The preparatory education is intended for young people and adults who are interested in vocational studies and wish to improve their Finnish-language skills.

so: Waxbarashada diyaarinta ah waxey qaadataa hal xilli-dugsiyeed ama hal sanad-dugisyeed.
en: The preparatory education lasts for one school term or year.

so: Macluumaadka waxbarashada diyaarinta ah waxaa laga heli karaa rugta adeegga iyo talo bixinta ee Qeybta waxbarashada iyo tababarka ama machadka xirfadda ee Stadi.
en: You can ask about the preparatory education from the guidance and service office of the Education Sector or Helsinki Vocational College.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Waxbaarsho xirfadeed, Waxbarashada diyaarinta ah ee barashada xrifadda.
en: Read more: Vocational education, Preparatory vocational education.

so: Helsinki waxaa ku yaal dugsi sare oo badan.
en: There are many upper secondary schools in Helsinki.

so: Helsinki waxaa kale oo ku yaal dugsi sare oo luqadaha wax looga bartaa ay yihiin wax ka bedelan Finnish ama Iswidish.
en: Helsinki also boasts numerous schools where languages other than Finnish or Swedish are spoken.

so: Dugsiyade sare ee dhalinyarada loogu talagalay ee maalintii la dhigto ka sokoow waxaa ku yaal saddex dugsi sare oo dadka waaweyn (aikuislukio).
en: In addition to the daytime upper secondary school for young people, Helsinki has three upper secondary schools for adults (aikuislukio).

so: Helsingi waxa lagu bixiyaa tacliin ku socota dadka dal soo galeedka ah oo qofka loogu diyaarinayo dugsi sare.
en: Helsinki organises education for immigrants to prepare them for upper secondary school.

so: Waxbarashada diyaarinta waxa loogu talo galay dhalinyarada iyo dadka waaweyn ee raba inay wax ka bartaan dugsi sare, laakiin aynan ku filnayn aqoontooda luqaddu.
en: The training lasts for one school year and prepares students for upper secondary school studies.Preparatory education is intended for young people and adults who wish to study at an upper secondary school but whose language skills are not good enough for upper secondary school studies.

so: Waxbarashada waxa lagu qabanqaabinayaa dugsiyada sare ee Vuosaari iyo Alppila.
en: The education is organised at the Vuosaari and Alppila upper secondary schools.

so: Waxbarista ku socota dadka waaweyn ee da'da ka baxay waxa lagu qabanqaabiyaa dugsiga sare ee dadka da'da ka baxay ee Helsinki.
en: Education intended for adults is organised at the Helsinki Upper Secondary School for Adults (Helsingin aikuislukio).

so: Macluumaadka waxbarashada diyaarinta ah waxaad ka heli kartaarugta adeegga iyo talo bixinta ee Qeybta waxbarashada iyo tababarka Hogaanka waxbarashada.
en: You can ask about preparatory education from the guidance and service office of the Education Department.

so: Helsinki waxaad majalado badan uga baran kartaa tacliinta iskuulaadka tacliinta sare.
en: In Helsinki, you can complete higher education studies in a variety of fields.

so: Helsinki waxaay leedahay jaamacad iyo iskuul xirfadeedka tacliinta sare.
en: There are both universities and universities of applied sciences in Helsinki.

so: Inta badan waxbarashada iskuulaadka tacliinta sare waxay ku baxdaa luqada Finnishka.
en: The majority of the higher education is provided in Finnish.

so: Ku dhowaad gebi ahaan iskuulaadka tacliinta waxaa kale oo laga bixiyaa waxbarasho ku baxeysa Ingiriis.
en: However, education in English is available in nearly all institutes of higher education.

so: Helsinki waxaa ku taal hal jaamacad oo luqada Iswidishka ku baxda iyo hal iskuul xirfadeedka tacliinta sare lagu barto oo ku baxa luqada Iswidishka.
en: There is one Swedish-language university and one Swedish-language university of applied sciences in Helsinki.

so: Macluumaadyada xiriirka ee iskuulaadka tacliinta sare waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga shabakadda magaalada Helsinki.
en: The contact information for the institutes of higher education can be found on the City of Helsinki website.

so: Hagista codsashada iyo macluumaadyada rasmiga ah ee barnaamijyada waxbarashada waxaa laga helaa bogagga shabakadda ee iskuulaadka tacliinta sare.
en: Application instructions and more detailed information on study programmes are available on the websites of the institutes themselves.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Jaamacadaha, Iskuul xirfadeedka sare.
en: Read more: Universities and Universities of applied sciences.

so: Helsinki waxaa ka jira fursado badan oo waxbarasho, kuwaas oo dadka oo dhan u furan.
en: Helsinki boasts a wealth of study opportunities that are available to everyone.

so: Waxbarashooyinkan inta badan waa lacag.
en: These studies are usually subject to a fee.

so: Jaamacadaha cidkasta ufuran iyo iskuulaadka xirfadaha tacliinta sare ee cidkasta ufuran waxaad ku dhigankartaa maadooyinka tacliinta sare, kuwaasoo aad ku dhigankarto waxkasta oo aad rabtid.
en: You can complete higher education studies at the Open University or at the open universities of applied sciences.

so: Jaamacadaha cidkasta ufuran iyo iskuulaadka xirfadaha tacliinta sare ee cidkasta ufuran waxaad ka helikartaa maadooyin badan sidoo kale ingiriisiya.
en: These studies are open for everyone. The Open University and the open universities of applied sciences offer plenty of courses in English, too.

so: Magaalada Helsini waxay leedahay xarun waxbarashada dadka waawayn oo lagu barto finishka iyo iswidhishkaba.
en: The City of Helsinki has a Finnish-language adult education centre (työväenopisto) and Swedish-language adult education centre.

so: Xarunta waxbarashada dadka waawayn waxa lagu bartaa tusaale ahaan luuqadaha, farsamadda gacanta iyo muusiga.
en: At the adult education centres, you can study languages, crafts and music, for example.

so: Waxaad ka helikartaa waxbarashooyin kale oo tayo leh, Inta badan xarunta waxbarashada dadka waaway madadaha waxa lagu bixinayaa afka finishka iyo iswidhishka.
en: The selection is extremely varied. The majority of the education in adult education centres is provided in Finnish or Swedish.

so: Xarunta dadka waawayn waxaa kaloo lagu diyaariyaa madado ku baxa afafka sida ingiriisi iyo ruushka.
en: In addition, the adult education centres organise courses in English and Russian.

so: Macluumaadka waxbarashada diyaarinta ah waxaa laga heli karaa Machadka xirfadda iyo dadka waaweyn ee Stadi.
en: You can ask about the preparatory education from the guidance and service office of Helsinki Vocational College.

so: Degista marka uu dhib jiro
en: Housing in a crisis situation

so: Guryaha kirada ah ee magaalada Helsinki waa qaali.
en: The rents are high in Helsinki.

so: Waa in aad sidoo kale u diyaar garowdaa oo xisaabta ku darsataa in codsiga gurigu uu qaadan karo muddo dheer.
en: You should also prepare for the fact that it may take a long time to find an apartment.

so: Guryaha kirada ama ijaarka ah ee Helsinki waxaa iska leh degmada Helsinki iyo shirkado kale oo guri kireeyayaal ah oo gaar loo leeyahay.
en: Rental housing in Helsinki is owned by the City of Helsinki and many private landlords.

so: Adigaa ayaa nafsad ahaantaada ka mas'uul ah raadsashada guriga.
en: You are responsible for finding housing for yourself.

so: Degmada iyo shirkadaha kaleba waajib kuma ahan in ay guri ku siiyaan.
en: The city or other landlords are not obliged to provide housing for you.

so: Guri markaad dalbaneyso waa inaad ka dalbataa goobo badan oo aadan soo xadidin meelaha aad ka dalbaneyso guriga.
en: You should look for housing in a large enough area.

so: Taasi waxaa ay keeneysaa fursado wanaagsan oo ah suuragalnimada inaad guri hesho.
en: In that way, you will have a better chance of finding housing.

so: Kirada guryaha ee magaalooyinka dersika la ah Helsinki (tusaale ahaan Vantaa, Espoo ama Kerava) waa ay ka guryo raqiisan yihiin kuwa Helsinki.
en: Prices for rental housing are slightly cheaper in the neighbouring municipalities (for example, Vantaa, Espoo or Kerava) than in Helsinki.

so: Helsinki waxaa ku yaalla shirkado gaar loo leeyahay oo guri kireeyayaal ah, kuwaasoo aad codsiga gurigaaga u dirsan karto.
en: There are many landlords in Helsinki to which you can submit a housing application.

so: Tusaale ahaan Sato, Vvo ja Avara waxaa ay guryo kiro ah ku leeyihiin Helsinki.
en: For example, Sato, Vvo and Avara own rental apartments in Helsinki.

so: Waxaa sidoo kale guryaha kireeya shirkadaha ceysmiska, bankiyada iyo dad badan oo shaqsiyaad gaar ah.
en: Also insurance companies, banks and many private persons offer rental housing.

so: Shakhsiyaadka gaarka ah iyaga si dhakhso ama deg-deg ah baa looga heli karaa guryaha kirada ah.
en: You can find housing quickly through a private landlord.

so: Haddii aad arday tahay, Waxaad guri kiro ah ka dalban kartaa shirkadda HOAS (waqafka guryaha ardeyda ee Helsinki iyo nawaaxigeeda).
en: If you are a student, you can apply for rental housing through HOAS, the Foundation for Student Housing in the Helsinki Region.

so: Haddii da'daadu ay ka yar tahay 30 jir, waxaad guryaha ka dalban kartaa shirkadaha kala ah Ururka guryaha dhalainyarada (Nuorisoasuntoliitto) iyo Waqafka dhalinyarada (Nuorisosäätiö).
en: If you are under 30 years old, you can apply for rental housing from the Finnish Youth Housing Association (Nuorisoasuntoliitto) and Nuorisosäätiö.

so: Guryaha kirada ee degmadu waa ay ka qiime hooseeyaan kuwa shirkadaha kale ee guryaha kireeya.
en: The rents of the city-owned rental housing are more affordable than those of private housing.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee guryaha degmada waxaa soo dalbada dad aad u fara badan, tiro yar oo codsayaashaas ka mid ah ayaana guryo hela.
en: However, there are a lot of applicants for city-owned rental housing and only a small number of applicants receive housing.

so: Si aad u codsato guryaha degmada, waa in aad heysataa ugu yaraan ciqaamad ama sharciga deganaanshaha dalkaan (oleskelulupa), kaasoo ugu yaraan sannad ah.
en: You must have a residence permit valid for at least a year to be able to apply for rental housing owned by the City of Helsinki.

so: Guryaha kirada ah ee degmada Helsinki waxaad ka dalban kartaa internetka , adeega cinwaankiisu yahay stadinasunnot.fi, waa haddii aad leedahay aqoonsiga Finland ee afarta lambar (henkilötunnus).
en: You can apply for rental housing owned by the City of Helsinki online through the stadinasunnot.fi service, if you have a Finnish personal identity code.

so: Waxaad kaloo codsiga dalabka ka sameyn kartaa xafiiska adeega.
en: You can also submit a housing application at a service point.

so: Waxaana goobtaasi adeega marka aad foomka buuxneyso ku caawinaya howl-wadeenada xafiiska.
en: A clerk will be present at the location to assist you in filling in the application.

so: Waxaana adeegaas caawinta ah laguugu qabanayaa luqadaha finishka iyo ingiriiska.
en: Service is available in Finnish and English.

so: Halka aad kala soo xirireyso xafiiska adeega:
en: Contact information for the service point:

so: Intaa dabadeed waa in la cusbooneysiiyaa.
en: After that you must reapply.

so: Guri kiro iyo Heshiiska kirada.
en: Rental home and Tenancy agreement.

so: Inta badan ama sida qaalibka ah guryaha Helsinki waa qaali, laakiin qiimaha guryuhu si aad ah ayay u kala duwan yihiin marka loo eego goobaha kala duwan ee ay ku yaallan.
en: In Helsinki, flats are usually expensive but prices vary significantly depending on the area.

so: Guryaha iibka ah waxaa ka heli kartaa qeybta internetka ee bogga codsiga guryaha.
en: You can find adverts for available housing on search websites.

so: Warbixinta la xiriirta guryaha sida gaarka ah loo leeyahay waxaad ka heli kartaa bogga internetka ee InfoFinlandi qeybtiisa Guri iibsasho.
en: Information on buying your own home is available on InfoFinland page Buying a home.

so: Waad codsankartaa guriga xuquuqda deganaansha la leeyahay (asumisoikeusasunto), Haddii aanad laheyn guri si gaar ah loo leeyahay, awood dhaqaale oo aad ku dalbatana aanad laheyn.
en: You can apply for a right-of-occupancy housing (asumisoikeusasunto), if you do not have an owner-occupied housing or the funds to purchase one.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso in aad guriga xuquuqda deganaanshaha la leeyahay ka dalbato Helsinki, Espoo iyo Vantaa, waxaa marka hore lagaa rabaa in aad raadsato lambarka safka (järjestysnumero).
en: You can apply for a right-of-occupancy housing in Helsinki, Espoo or Vantaa; first, obtain a queue number.

so: Waxaad lambarkaas ka dalban kartaa netka.
en: You can apply for the number online.

so: Sidoo kale foomka lagu codsado intaad soo daabacato ayaad gacanta ku buuxin kartaa.
en: You can also print the application form and fill it in by hand.

so: Marka aad hesho lambarka safka, weydii oo ka raadi guryaha bannaan, dadka iska leh guryaha iyo shirkadaha dhisayba.
en: Once you have obtained the queue number, available housing can be requested from owners and developers.

so: Meelaha aad kala xiriireyso waxaad ka heli kartaa bogaga internetka ee degmada Helsinki.
en: Contact information is available on the website of the City of Helsinki.

so: Iskumar ayaad meelo kala duwan oo badan ka codsan kartaa guriga.
en: You can apply for housing in multiple areas at the same time.

so: Haddii gurigaagii ay dhibaato soo gaartey, tusaale ahaan gubasho ama biyo ku furmey awgeed, Xaaladaha qaarkood shirkadda ceymiska guriga ayaa magdhabi karta wixii kharashaad dheeraad ah ee guriga ku baxay.
en: If your home has been damaged as a result of fire or water damage, for example, home insurance can, in some cases, cover part of the additional living expenses.

so: Sida ugu dhakhsaha badan ula xiriir shirkadaada ceymiska guriga, islamarkaa uu khasaaruhu soo gaaray gurigaba.
en: Contact your insurance company as soon as the damage occurs.

so: Guriga ammaanka Mona waa guri ammaan oo loogu talagalay dumarka ajnabiga ah iyo caruurtooda.
en: Shelter Mona is a shelter for immigrant women and their children.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale aadi kartaa guryaha ammaanka ee caasimadda (Pääkaupungin Turvakoti).
en: You can also go to the shelter in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area (Pääkaupungin Turvakoti).

so: Dhalinyarada da'oodu u dhaxeyso 12–19 jir, waxaa ay la xiriiri karaan ururka laanqeyrta case ee guryaha ammaanka dhalinyarada- (Nuorten turvatalo).
en: Young people between the age of 12 and 19 can contact the Youth Emergency Shelter of the Finnish Red Cross (Nuorten turvatalo).

so: Waxaad wici kartaa guryaha ammaanka xilli walba oo habeenka iyo maalinka ah.
en: You can call the shelter at any time.

so: Haddii guri la'aan kugu dhacdo, waxaad la xiriirtaa xafiiska adeegga sooshaalka ee xaafadaada.
en: If you become homeless, contact the social services office of your municipality of residence.

so: Shaqaalaha sooshaalka ayaa kaa caawin karaya sidii aad guri ku heli laheyd.
en: A social worker can help you find housing.

so: Xarunta adeegga ee dadka guryo la'aanta ah oo ku taalla wadada Hietaniemenkatu waxaa ay furan tahay maalin walba afar iyo labaatanka saacadood.
en: The service centre for the homeless on Hietaniemenkatu is open every day around the clock.

so: Haddii aad uga baahato halkaas habeen joog waad ku tagi kartaa.
en: You can spend the night there, if necessary.

so: Xaruntaas degaanku waxaa ay habeenkii boos siisaa, dadka dhibaatada maandooriyaha ama mukhaadaraadku heysato ee reer Helsinki, waa haddii aanay heysan meel kale oo ay habeenkaa aadaan.
en: The service centre offers a place to spend the night for residents of Helsinki with a substance abuse problem, if they have no other place to go.

so: Ururka guryaha joogtada ah ee (Vailla vakinaista asuntoa ry). Waa urur caawiya dadka guryo la'aanta ah.
en: No Fixed Abode NGO (Vailla vakinaista asuntoa) is an association that helps homeless people.

so: Ururuka guryaha joogtada ah ee Vailla waxaa uu leeyahay xarun habeenkii la joogo oo la yiraahdo Kalkkers, taasoo ah goob habeenkii siisa degaaan diiran dadka guryo la'aanta ah laga bilaabo deyrta illaa iyo gu'ga.
en: No Fixed Abode NGO maintains a night café called Kalkkers that offers a warm place for the homeless to spend the night from the autumn to the spring.

so: Kallkkers waad imaan kartaa xitaa haddii aanad laheyn ciqaamad ama sharciga dgenaanshaha dalka (oleskelulupa).
en: People without a residence permit can also come to Kalkkers.

so: Qaar ka mid ah dadka, tusaale ahaan dadka da'da ah iyo kuwa naafada ah, waa ay ku adag tahay in ay dhammeystaan caawimaad la'aan howlaha la xiriira nolol-maalmeedkooda.
en: Some people, such as the elderly and the disabled, have difficulty in dealing with everyday tasks without assistance.

so: Degmadu waxaa ay iyaga u diyaarisaa adeegyo ka caawinaya in ay si madax bannaani ah u noolaadaan.
en: The city organises services for them to help them live independently.

so: Dadka da'da ah iyo kuwa naafada ah ee aan awoodin in ay si madax bannaani ah u noolaadaan, waxaa ay degaan ahaan ku nolaan karaan guryaha adeegyada ama xeryaha.
en: The elderly and the disabled who are incapable of independent living can reside in sheltered housing or institutional care.

so: Faahfaahin dheerad ah oo la xiriirta adeegyadaan waxaad weydiin kartaa xarunta sooshaalka ama arimaha bulshada ee xaafadda aad degan tahay.
en: You can receive more information on the services from a local social services unit.

so: Bogga internetka InfoFinlandi ee daryeelka qashinka iyo dib u isticmaalidiidsa ayaad ka heleysaa warbixinta ku saabsan sida qashinka loo kala sooco.
en: You can find information on sorting waste on the InfoFinland page Waste management and recycling.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale aadi kartaa guryaha ammaanka ee caasimadda (Pääkaupungin Turvakoti ry).
en: You can also go to the shelter in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area (Pääkaupungin Turvakoti ry).

so: Adeegga waxaad ku isticmaali karaa Finnish, Ingiriis iyo Ruush.
en: The service is available in Finnish, English and Russian.

so: Iska diiwaangelinta koorasyada luqada waa sida guud 2-8 todobaad kahor billaabashada kooraska.
en: Registrations for the language courses usually take place 2–8 weeks before the beginning of the course.

so: Koorasyada qaarkood waxaa la isaga diiwaangelin karaa shabakadda.
en: Some of the courses require applications. You can enrol for some courses online.

so: Waxaad Finnishka iyo Iswidhishka ka baran kartaa koorasyada machadyada dadka waaweyn iyo marka aad waxbarashada xirfadda qaadaneyso.
en: You can study Finnish and Swedish on adult education centre courses or during vocational studies, for example.

so: Machadka waxbarashada dadka waaweyn ee afka Iswidhishka ee Helsinki Arbis wuxuu bixiyaa koorasyo badan oo afka Iswidhishka ah.
en: Swedish Adult Education Centre Arbis offers many Swedish language courses.

so: Cinwaanka Ilmonet.fi waxaad ka heleysaa dhammaan koorasyada ay bixiyaan machadyada waxbarashada dadka waaweyn iyo machadka aqoon-kororsiga dadka ee aagaha u dhow caasimadda.
en: You can find the entire course selection of all adult education centres in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area at the address Ilmonet.fi.

so: Koorasyada luqada Finnishka ama Iswidishka ee xafiiska shaqada (työ- ja elinkeinotoimisto) waxaa la codsadaa iyadoo la soo marayo xafiiska shaqada.
en: The language courses provided by the Employment and Economic Development Office (Työ- ja elinkeinotoimisto) are applied for through the office itself.

so: Maktabada akhrisa ee Helsinki waxay qabanqaabisaa ku wada shaahayn/ qaxwayn luuqada finishka ah, taasi oo loogu talogalay in lagu tabobarto ku hadalka luuqada finishka.Waxay u furan tahay dhamaan dadka raba inay bartaan ku hadalka luuqada finishka.
en: Libraries in Helsinki organise Language Cafés where you can practise speaking Finnish. They are intended for everyone who wishes to learn to speak Finnish.

so: Waxaan ku wada hadlaynaa luuqada finishka, way fiican tahay, hadii aad ku hadli karayso waxoogee finish ah.
en: Discussions at Language Cafés take place in Finnish, so it would be good if you know some Finnish.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad wayndiin kartaa maktabada.
en: You can obtain more information on Language Cafés from libraries.

so: Helsinki waxaad ku sameyn kartaa imtixaanka guud ee luqada (yleinen kielitutkinto) Finnishka ama Iswidishka.
en: Helsinki provides the opportunity to obtain the National Certificate of Language Proficiency (yleinen kielitutkinto) in Finnish or Swedish.

so: Bogagga shabakadda Maamulka Waxbarashada (Opetushallitus) waxaa laga helaa mashiin wax raadiya oo aad ku hubsan karto goobaha iyo waqtiyada aad sameyn karto imtixaanka.
en: The website of the Finnish National Board of Education (Opetushallitus) features a search engine that you can use to check where and when you can obtain the certificate.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: Shahaadada rasmiga ah ee aqoonta luqada.
en: Read more: Official certificate of language proficiency.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri Luqada Finnishka iyo Iswidishka.
en: Read more: Finnish and Swedish.

so: Xafiiska shaqadu wuxuu kaa caawinayaa adiga shaqo raadinta.
en: TE Offices will help you find work.

so: Hadii aad tahay shaqo la'aan oo aad raadinayso shaqo, ogaysii xafiiska shaqada inaad shaqo raadiye tahay.
en: If you are unemployed and looking for work, register as a job seeker at a TE Office.

so: Waxaad ogaysiinta ka samayn kartaa internetka dhexdiisa ama se waad booqan kartaa xafiiska shaqada.
en: You can register either online or by visiting a TE Office personally.

so: Dadka u dhashay wadamada yurubta, Norway, Island, Liechtenstein iyo Swiss waxay ka ogaysiin karaan xafiiska shaqada internetka shaqo raadiye ahaan.
en: Citizens of EU member states, Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein and Switzerland can register as job seekers through the online service of the TE Office.

so: Wadamada kale ee intaasi kasoo hadhay waa inay xafiiska shaqada iska soo diwaangeliyaan oo ay soo booqdaan xafiiska.
en: The citizens of other countries must register personally at a TE Office.

so: Waa inuu soo qaataa taysaro ama aqoonsi iyo sharciga daganaanshaha.
en: Bring along your identity card and residence permit.

so: Xogaha ku sahabsan xafiiska shaqada waxaad ka heli kartaa bogga InfoFinland Haddii aad shaqo la'aan noqotid.
en: For information on the services of the TE Office, see the InfoFinland page If you become unemployed.

so: Macluumaadka ku sahabsan shaqo raadinta waxaad ka heli kartaa bogga InfoFinland Halkee laga heli karaa shaqo?
en: You can find information on looking for work in Finland on the InfoFinland page Where to find work?

so: Helsinki waxaa ku yaala saddex xafiis shaqo.
en: There are three TE Offices in Helsinki.

so: Xogaha ku sahabsan kabka shaqo la'aanta waxaad ka helaysaa bogga InfoFinland Gargaarka shaqo la'aanta.
en: You can find information on applying for unemployment benefit on the InfoFinland page Unemployment benefit.

so: Magaalada Helsinki waxey dadka shaqo la'aanta ah ee reer Helsinki siisaa tageero si ay u helaan shaqo iyo waxbarasho.
en: The City of Helsinki offers unemployed Helsinki residents support for finding work and training.

so: Haddii aad shaqo helistaada ugu baahan tahay talo iyo taageero ama waxbarashada afka Finnishka, la xiriir adeegyada shaqaaloobista ee magaalada Helsinki.
en: If you need advice and support for finding work or Finnish language training, contact the City of Helsinki's employment services.

so: Luckan Integration waa adeeg la talineed kaasi oo bixiya adeeg la talineed oo ku waajahan shakhsiyaadka soogalootiga ah, iyo wuxuu qaban qaabiyaa iskumaatino la xidhiidha shaqo dalbashada. Sidoo kale wuxuu u qaban qaabayaa kooxo.
en: Luckan Integration is a guidance service that provides individual counselling for immigrants and organises, for example, events and group meetings related to finding work.

so: Luuqada lagu caawiyaa dadku waa ingiriisi.
en: Events are organised in English.

so: Väestöliiton waa shaqo ku tabobarida iyo la talinta dadka soogalootiga ah ee xirfado hore u soo lahaa ama bartay.
en: Career mentoring organised by Väestöliitto is intended for educated immigrants.

so: Arinkani dhexdiisa waxaad ka helaysaa shaqo, boos waxbarasho ama inaad aas aasto ganacsi.
en: A mentor will support you in finding work or a student position or starting a business.

so: Hadii aad ka yar yahay 30 jir, waxaad waydiin kartaa la talin ku sahabsan shaqo dalbashada ama raadinta.Ohjaamo waxaa loogu talo galay dhalinyarada qaan gaadhay.
en: If you are under the age of 30, you can ask for advice from Ohjaamo on finding work. Ohjaamo is an advice service targeted at young adults.

so: Xarunta aqoonta ee Stadi (Stadin osaamiskeskus) waxay suuqa shaqada u tababartaa dadka wadanka u soo guurey, waxayna sidoo kale ka caaawisaa helitaanka goobo shaqo oo ay ku bartaan shaqada.
en: Helsinki skills centre (Stadin osaamiskeskus) provides job market coaching for immigrants and helps with finding a job or an internship.

so: Xarunta aqoontu waxyaabaha ay macaamiisheeda siiso waxaa ka mid ah barashada luuqada Finnishka iyo waxbarasho xirfadeed.
en: The skills centre services include Finnish lessons and vocational training.

so: Si aad maacaamiil uga noqotid xarunta aqoonta waxaad codsi dhigi kartaa xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada ama adigoo codsiga soo marinaya dhanka xafiiska sooshalka iyo caafimaadka.
en: If you wish to use the skills centre services, register through the Public Employment and Business Services Office (TE-toimisto) or Department of Social Services and Health Care.

so: kuwaas oo ay da'doodu ka weyn tahay 17 sano iyo haystaa ruqsada daganaanshada wadanka.
en: The target group for the services are immigrants over 17 years of age who have a residence permit.

so: Waxaad ka heli kartaa adeeg la talineed oo kuu khaas ah adiga oo ku sahabsan aas aaska ganacsiga ama shirkada, afafka laguugu adeegayaa waa finish, iswidhish, ingiriisi, ruush, carabi, estooniyaan, jarmal ama talyaani.
en: You can obtain personal advice on starting a business in Finnish, Swedish, English, Russian, Arabic, Estonian, German, and Italian.

so: NewCo Helsinki waxay qaban qaabisaa kulamo macluumaadka ku sahabsan aas aaska shirkadaha lagu kala qaadanayo oo loogu talo galay soogalootiga.
en: NewCo Helsinki organises information sessions for immigrants on starting a business.

so: Kulamadaasi xog waranka ah afafka lagu qabtaayi waa finish, ingiriisi, ruusha, carabi iyo estooniyaan.
en: Information sessions are organised in Finnish, English, Russian, Arabic and Estonian.

so: Kulamadaasi waa bilaash oo lacag la iskama rabo.
en: Information sessions are free of charge.

so: Macluumaad dheeraada iyo isdiiwaangelintaba waxaad ka samayn kartaa bogta internetka ay ay ku leeyihiin NewCo Helsinki.
en: You can find more information and register on the NewCo Helsinki website.

so: NewCo Helsinki waxay qaban qaabisaa tabobaro loogu talo galay ganacsada, afafka lagu bixiyaa tabobaradaasi waa finish, ingiriisi iyo ruush.
en: NewCo Helsinki organises training for entrepreneurs in Finnish, English and Russian.

so: Qayb ka mida tabobaradaasi waxaa loogu talay kuwa imika aas aasaya shirkada, qaybta kalena waxaa loogu talo kuwa samaystayba shirkadaha.
en: Some of the courses are intended for people who are starting a business and some for those who already have a business.

so: Koorsooyinka waxaa lagu dhigaa finish, ingiriisi iyo ruush.
en: Courses are arranged in Finnish, English and Russian.

so: NewCo Helsinki sidoo kale waxay qaban qaabiyaan kulamo loogu abuuriyo shirkadaha cusub xidhiidho.
en: NewCo Helsinki organises networking events for entrepreneurs who have just started their business.

so: NewCo Helsingistä waxaad kaloo ka heli kartaa caawimo ku sahabsan horumarinta koritaanka shirkada.
en: NewCo Helsinki also offers assistance for developing growth companies.

so: Hadii aad shirkad ku leedahay Helsinki, waxaad xubin ka noqon kartaa ururka shirkadaha Helsinki.
en: If you have a business in Helsinki, you can become a member of Helsingin Yrittäjät, which is part of the Federation of Finnish Enterprises.

so: Ururka ay ku midoobeen shirkadaha Helsinki waa mid u adeega kor u qaadista danahooda, kaasi oo xubnihiisa u qaban qaabiya tabobaro, xidhiidho wax ku ool ah iyo waliba la talin.
en: Helsingin Yrittäjät is an interest and service organisation for entrepreneurs, which offers its members training, networks and counselling, for example.

so: Waxaad ka heli kartaa macluumaad dheeri ah boga internetka.
en: You can find more information on the organisation's website.

so: Ka akhri macluumaad dheeri ah: Samaynta shirkad ganacsi.
en: Read more: Starting a business.

so: Xafiiska cashuuruhu wuxuu goob adeed ku leeyahay bartamaha magaalada Helsinki.
en: The Tax Office has a service point in the centre of Helsinki.

so: Adeegyada kale ee xafiiska cashuuraha telefanadooda iyo macluumaadka la xidhiidhkooda waxaad ka heli kartaa bogooda internetka.
en: The contact information of other Tax Office service points and telephone service can be found on the website of the Tax Administration.

so: Ka akhri macluumaad dheeri ah: Shirkad ganacsi ku samaynta Finland.
en: Read more: Starting a business in Finland.

so: Helsinki-info waa goob talo bixineed oo aad ka heli kartid macluumaad ku saabsan adeegyada magaalada Helsinki, fursadaha deegaanka, shaqada iyo waxbarashada.
en: Helsinki-info is an advice service where you can get up-to-date information about Helsinki, city services, housing opportunities, work and studying.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale weydiisan kartaa caawimaad haddii aadan aqoon hay'adda ay tahay in aad la xiriirto.
en: You can also ask for help if you are uncertain as to which authority to contact.

so: Waxaa intaas dheer in Helsinki-info ay bixiso talo bixin dijitaal ah iyadoona sidoo kale kaa caawineysa adiga su'aalaha la xiriira imaanshaha dalka.
en: Helsinki-info also offers digital advice and helps with matters connected to entry into the country.

so: Helsinki-info waxey khadka telefoonka, fool ka fool ama elekterikaal ahaan ugu adeegtaa luqado badan oo kala duduwan.
en: Helsinki-info serves in several languages by phone, face to face or online.

so: Adeegga waxaa qeyb ka ah Helsinki-info, Xafiiska diiwaangelinta Uusimaa, Maamulka canshuuraha, Kelada, Xafiiska shaqada ee Uusimaa, Xarunta ammaanka hawlgabka iyo Rugta Ganacisga soonaha Helsinki.
en: The service includes Helsinki-info, the Local Register Office of Uusimaa, the Tax Administration, Kela, the Uusimaa TE Office, the Finnish Centre for Pensions and the Helsinki Region Chamber of Commerce.

so: Xafiisyada Shaqada iyo dhaqaalaha ee Pasila iyo Itäkeskus waxey sameynayaa sahan-horaad.
en: The Employment and Economic Development Offices of Itäkeskus and Pasila perform initial assesments.

so: Haddii aad geleyso sahan-horaadka, waa inaad cinwaanka te-palveluit.fi isaga diiwaangelisaa sidii qof shaqo doon ah.
en: In order to have an initial survey, you must register as a job seeker online at te-palvelut.fi.

so: Internetka ayaad isaga soo diiwaangelin kartaa haddii aad heysato aqoonsiyada bankiga ee finnishka.
en: You can register as a job seeker online if you have Finnish online banking credentials.

so: Sidoo kale, waxaad iska diiwaangelin kartaa Xafiiska shaqada.
en: You can also register for an initial assesment at an Employment and Economic Development Office.

so: Waaxda ajnabiga ee adeegyada caafimaadka iyo sooshalka magaalada Helsinki waxay ka caawisaa dadka qaxootiga ah ee dagan Helsinki la qabsiga.
en: The Immigration Unit of the City of Helsinki's Social Services and Health Care helps with the integration of refugees living in Helsinki.

so: Adeegyada ay bixiso qaybta Soogalootigu waxay yihiin sida hagida, la talinta iyo samaynta qaybta hore ee jihaynta.
en: Services provided by the Immigration Unit include guidance, counselling and initial assessments.

so: Qaybta Soogalootigu waxay sidoo kale caawisaa dhibanayaashii dadka ka ganacsada dadka.
en: The Immigration Unit also helps people who are victims of human trafficking.

so: Haddii aadan shaqo raadineyn, laakiin aad dooneyso in laguu sameeyo sahan-horaad iyo qorshaha laqabsashada, la xiriir Waaxda ajnabiga ee adeegyada caafimaadka iyo sooshalka ee magaalada Helsinki.
en: If you are not looking for a job, but would like to receive an initial assesment and integration plan, contact the Immigration Unit of the City of Helsinki's Social Services and Health Care.

so: Macluumaadyada xiririka ee Waaxda ajnabiga:
en: Contact information of the Immigration Unit:

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri: La-qabsashada Finland.
en: Read more: Integration into Finland.

so: Haddii aadan aqoonin Finnisha ama Iswidish waad isticmaali kartaa turjubaan marka aad arrimahaada ka fushaneysid saraakiisha xafiisyada.
en: If you do not know how to speak Finnish or Swedish, you can use an interpreter when dealing with the authorities.

so: Waxaad horay u sii weydiin kartaa sarkaalka arrinta qaabilsan ama talo-bixinta socdaalka ee magaalada Helsinki.
en: You can ask about the interpreting arrangements beforehand from the authority in question or receive guidance from the City of Helsinki's Immigration Information Centre.

so: Tusaale ahaan Kelada iyo Xafiiska dal u soo guuristu (Maahanmuuttovirasto) waxay turjubaan u dalbaan macaamiisha marka xaaladaha qaar lagu jiro.
en: Kela and the Finnish Immigration service (Maahanmuuttovirasto), for example, book interpreters for their customers in some cases.

so: Shirkado kale ayaa sidoo kale bixiya adeegga turjumista.
en: Many companies also provide interpretation services.

so: Shirkadahan waxaad ka heli kartaa tusaale ahaan mashiinka wax raadinta ee internetka.
en: You can search for such companies with an online search engine, for example.

so: Bogga Ururka turjubaanada Finland waxaa ku jira mashiin wax raadin kaas oo aad ku raadsan karto turjubaano.
en: The Finnish Association of Translators and Interpreters website hosts a search engine through which you can search for an interpreter or a translator.

so: Adeegyada xarunta turjubaanada soonaha Helsinki waxaa marka ugu horeysa loogu talogalay saraakiisha la shaqeeya dadka dalka u soo guuray.
en: The services of the Helsinki Region Community Interpreting Centre are primarily intended for authorities that work with immigrants.

so: diiwaangelinta xaqa joogitaanka dalka, haddii aad tahay muwaadin Midowga Yurub ah
en: registration of right of residence if you are a citizen of an EU country

so: Haddii aadan finnish ama iswidhish aqoonin, waxaad isticmaali kartaa turjubaan marka aad ka danaysanayso saraakiisha dowladda.
en: If you do not speak Finnish or Swedish, you can use an interpreter when attending to your affairs with the authorities.

so: Tusaale ahaan Kelada (Kela) iyo Xafiiska dal u soo guuristu (Maahanmuuttovirasto waxay macaamiishooda u dalbaan turjubaan marka xaaladaha qaarkood lagu jiro.
en: The Social Insurance Institution of Finland (Kela) and the Finnish Immigration service (Maahanmuuttovirasto), for example, book interpreters for their customers in some cases.

so: Uma baahnid markaas in aad adigu lacagta bixiso.
en: In that case you do not need to pay for it.

so: Markasta horay u sii weydii sarkaalka arrinta turjumista ama talo ka codso Helsinki-info.
en: Always ask about interpreting in advance from the authority in question or ask Helsinki-info for advice.

so: Haddii aad adigu dalbanaeyso turjubaan kharashkiisana aad iska bixinayso, waxaad isticmaali kartaa markasta oo aad dooneyso.
en: If you book an interpreter yourself and pay for it, you can use an interpreter whenever you want.

so: Shirkado badan ayaa Helsinki ka bixiya adeegyada turjumista.
en: Many companies in Helsinki provide interpreting services.

so: Shirkadahan waxaad ka raadsan kartaa tusaale ahaan internetka.
en: You can search for such companies on the Internet, for example.

so: Tusaale ahaan A-tulkkaus ayaa agagaarka Helsinki ka bixiya adeegyada turjubaannada soo danaysiga ee marka aad dano ka dhammaysanayo saraakiisha dowladda.
en: For example, A-tulkkaus provides public service interpreters for situations where you deal with public authorities.

so: Waxaad afnaqe ama turjubaan ka raadsan kartaa mashiinka xograadinta ee Ururka turjubaanada iyo afnaqayaasha Finland.
en: You can search for an interpreter or translator using the search engine on the website of The Finnish Association of Translators and Interpreters.

so: Haddii aad si joogto ah ugu soo guurto Helsinki si aad u deganaato waa inaad degmada isaga diwaangelisaa sidii qof degane ah.
en: If you are moving to Helsinki permanently, you must register as a resident of the municipality.

so: Waxaad iska diiwanagelin kartaa Rajiistareeshinka Helsinki.
