en: The website of the Tax Administration contains a wealth of information about taxation in Finland.

so: Marka aad u soo guurto Finland, waa in aad Hoggaanka socdaalka ka codsataa ogolaanshaha joogitaanka ama waa in aad diiwaangelisaa xuquuqdaada joogitaanka.
en: When you move to Finland, you must apply for a residence permit or register your right to reside at the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Baahida ogolaanshaha joogitaanku waxey ku xiran tahay wadanka aad jinsiyaddiisa wadato iyo sababta iyo mudada aad joogeyso Finland inta ay dhan tahay.
en: The need for a residence permit depends on your country of citizenship as well as your reasons for coming to Finland and the length of your stay.

so: Hoggaanka socdaalku (Maahanmuuttovirasto) wuxuu sidoo kale ka baaraandegaa codsiyada megan-gelyada iyo codsiyada dhalashada.
en: The Finnish Immigration Service (Maahanmuuttovirasto) also processes asylum applications and applications for citizenship.

so: Rajistareeshinadu waxay diiwaanka dadka ku keydiiyaan macluumaadka dadka deggan deegaankooda.
en: Local register offices record the population information of their own area into the population register.

so: Diiwaanka dadka waxaa lagu qoraa macluumaadka dadka deggan Finland.
en: The information of people who are living in Finland is entered into the population register.

so: Marka Finland loo soo guuro waa in rajistareeshinka la geeyaa ogeysiis.
en: A notification must be made to a local register office when moving to Finland.

so: Ogeysiinta waa in sidoo kale la sameeyaa marka Finland gudahadeeda meel laga guurayo oo meel kale loo guurayo iyo weliba marka Finland dibadda looga guurayo.
en: The notification must also be submitted when moving to another location in Finland or away from Finland.

so: Rajistareeshinadu waxay qabtaan sidoo kale shaqooyin kale oo badan.
en: The local register offices also have many other duties.

so: waxay sameeyaan nikaaxa shibilka ama shacabka iyo diiwaangelinta xiriirka lamaanaha,
en: handle civil marriages and registrations of partnership,

so: waxay nambarada aqoonsiyada shaqsiga ah siiyaan dadka deggan Finland,
en: provide personal identification numbers to people residing in Finland,

so: waxay siiyaan cadeynta booska guriga, dadka heysta cadeynta meesha ay degan yihiin.
en: provide certificates of domicile that can be used to prove your place of residence.

so: Safaaradaha iyo qunsuliyaduhu waa wakiilada dowladda ee dowlado kale jooga.
en: Embassies and consulates are diplomatic missions of a state in another country.

so: Wakiiladda Finland ee dibadda
en: Finnish diplomatic missions abroad

so: waxay qabtaan codsiyada ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka Finland
en: accept residence permit applications for Finland

so: waxay u adeegaan Finnishka dibadda deggan, marka ay qasab ku tahay inay arrimo ka sameystaan saraakiisha Finnishka ah, tusaale ahaan marka ay codsanayaan baasaboor cusub
en: serve Finns residing abroad when they need to take care of matters with Finnish authorities; apply for a new passport, for example

so: waxay caawiyaan muwaadiniinta Finnishka ah ee xaalad halis ah ku gala dibadda
en: assist Finnish citizens who have faced an emergency abroad

so: Bogagga wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda waxaa ku jira liiska wakiilada Finland ee dibadda.
en: The Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Finland has a list of Finnish diplomatic missions abroad.

so: Wakiilada ajnabiga ee Finland jooga
en: Foreign diplomatic missions in Finland

so: Macluumaadka iyo adeegyada wakiilada ajnabiga ee Finland jooga waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Safaaradaha Finland jooga.
en: Information about foreign diplomatic missions in Finland and their services is available on the InfoFinland page Embassies in Finland.

so: Wakiiladda sinnaanta u dooda waa masuul dowladeed howshiisuna tahay horumarinta sinnaanta cadaalad kana hortagaan takoorka.
en: The Non-Discrimination Ombudsman is an authority whose task is to advance equality in Finland and to prevent and tackle discrimination.

so: Wakiiladda u dooda sinnaanta waad la xiriiri kartaa tusaale ahaan haddii aad la kulantay adigu takoorid asalkaada la xiriirta ama aad ogaato in qof kale la takooray.
en: You can turn to the Non-Discrimination Ombudsman, for example, if you have experienced ethnic discrimination or have seen someone else being discriminated against.

so: Wakiiladda u dooda sinnaanta wuxuu bixin karaa talooyin, hagis iyo soo jeedin, waxaa kale oo uu gacan ka geysan karaa heshiis ka gaarista dhacdooyinka takoorka la xiriira.
en: The Non-Discrimination Ombudsman can provide instructions, advice and recommendations, and find resolution in cases regarding discrimination.

so: Waxaad xafiiska wakiiladda u dooda sinnaanta kala xiriiri kartaa:
en: You can contact the office of the Non-Discrimination Ombudsman:

so: Telefoonka waxaa laguugu adeegi karaa finnish, iswidish ama ingiriis.
en: Service is provided in Finnish, Swedish or English.

so: boostada xafiiska Wakiiladda u dooda sinnaanta, PL 24, 00023 Valtioneuvosto
en: by mail: Office of the Non-Discrimination Ombudsman, P.O. Box 24, 00023 Government

so: Ballanta waa inaad sii qabsataa wakhti munaasib ah.
en: Any appointments must be agreed in advance.

so: Adeega xafiisku waa lacag la'aan.
en: The services provided by the office are free-of-charge.

so: Haddii aadan aqoon afka finnishka, iswiidhishka ama ingiriiska, waad ku soo diri kartaa iimeylka ama dhambaalka luuqad kale.
en: If you cannot speak Finnish, Swedish or English, you can send e-mail or a letter in any other language.

so: Sinnaanta ka dhexeysa ragga iyo dumarka
en: Equality between men and women

so: Sida uu qeaxaayo sharciga dalkan Finland, ragga iyo dumarku waxaa ay leeyihiin isku xuquuq.
en: According to Finnish law, men and women have the same rights.

so: Xitaa dumarka la qabo waxaa ay leeyihiin xuquuq la mid ah tan ragga
en: Married women also have the same rights as men.

so: Finland waa arin iska caadi ah in dumarku ay shaqeeyaan, xitaa haddii ay caruur leeyihiin.
en: In Finland, it is common that women also work even though they have children.

so: Mas'uuliyadda caruurta iyo daryeelka gurigaba isku si ayay u saaran tahay ragga iyo dumarkaba.
en: The responsibility for taking care of children and the home belongs to both women and men.

so: Dumarku uma baahna in ay waalidkood ama ninkooda fasax ka heystaan si ay u shaqeeyaan ama iskuul u dhigtaan.
en: Women do not need permission to work or study from their spouse or parents.

so: Finland waa arin danbi ah in qofka lagu khasbo guur aanu raalli ka aheyn.
en: A forced marriage is a crime in Finland.

so: Tusaale ahaan waalidku xaq uma lahan in ay caruurtooda ku khasbaan ama cadaadis ku saaraan in ay gursadaan.
en: For example, parents do not have the right to force or pressure their child to marry.

so: Ragga iyo dumarkuba si isku mid a ayay xaq ugu leeyihiin in ay furiin dalbadaan.
en: Both women and men are entitled to file for a divorce.

so: Furiinkana waxaad heli kartaa, iyadoo aan wax ogolaansha ah laga heynin lammaanaha kale.
en: A divorce can also be granted without the consent of the other spouse.

so: Dagaalku waa arin danbi ah dalkan Finland.
en: Violence is always a crime in Finland.

so: Sidoo kale dagaalka ama gacan ka hadalka ka dhex dhaca qoyska sida garaacidda, iyo kufsiga ama faraxumeynta xagga jinsiga ah waa danbi.
en: Violence that occurs in a family and a relationship, such as physical and sexual violence, is always a crime.

so: Waxaad faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo arikaan ku saabsan ka akhrisaa bogga InfoFinlandi, qeybtiisa Dagaalka iyo Dagaal sharafeedka.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Violence and Honour related violence.

so: Goobaha shaqada waa in si isku mid ah loola dhaqmaa ragga iyo dumarkaba.
en: Women and men must be treated in the same way in working life.

so: Lama ogola in qofka la takooro, iyadoo loo eegaayo jinsiga uu yahay.
en: Discrimination on the basis of gender is prohibited.

so: Waxaa taa loola jeedaa in iyadoo loo eegaayo xagga jinsiga qofku uu yahay, in aan ragga la siin karin mushaar ka badan kan naagaha, ama aan haweeyneyda shaqada looga eryi karin sababtoo ah uur ayay leedahay.
en: This means, for example, that a higher salary must not be paid to a man compared to a woman on the basis of gender, or a woman employee cannot be discharged because she is pregnant.

so: Sharciga sinnaanta ayaa diidaya in qofka lagu takooro jinsiga uu ka soo jeedo awgeed.
en: The Act on Equality between Women and Men prohibits discrimination on the basis of gender.

so: Mas'uulka u xilsaaran sinnaanta, waa howl-wadeen dowladeed oo ilaalinaya sida loogu dhaqmo sharciga sinnaanta.
en: An Equality Ombudsman is an authority that monitors that the Act on Equality between Women and Men is observed.

so: Haddaad tuhunsan tahay in adiga goobta shaqada lagugu takooray jinsiga aad tahay awgeed, waxaad la xiriiri kartaa mas'uulka u xilsaaran arimaha sinnaanta (tasa-arvovaltuutettu) ama ururkaaga xirfadlayaasha ee u dooda xuquuqda dadka shaqeeya.
en: If you suspect that you have been discriminated against in working life due to gender, you can contact an Equality Ombudsman (tasa-arvovaltuutettu) or your trade union.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad a ka akhri bogga InfoFinlandi, qeybtiisa Sinnaan iyo cadaalad xaga shaqada ah.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Equality and equal opportunities in working life.

so: Sida waafaqsan dastuurka Finland waa in si sinnaan ah loo tixgeliyaa.
en: According to Finnish law, everyone is entitled to be treated equally.

so: Siduu sharciga Finland dhigayo qofna laguma takoori karo jiheyntiisa galmo awgeed.
en: Finnish law states that a people must not be discriminated against based on sexual orientation.

so: Sharciga ayaa sidoo kale mamnuucaya takoorista muujinta waxyaabaha galmada xiriir iyo aqoonsigooda jinsi dartood.
en: The law also prohibits discrimination based on gender identity or expression.

so: Finland waxaa laga codsan karaa megengelyo haddii meel kale lagula kulmo raacdeysasho jiheynta galmada ama muujinta jinsiga dartiis.
en: You can apply for asylum in Finland if you have experienced oppression elsewhere due to sexual orientation or gender identity.

so: Helista megengelyadu ma ahan wax iska cad ee waxaa si gaar ah loo baarayaa codsade kasta codsigiisa.
en: However, gaining asylum is not a given and every applicant's case is investigated.

so: Baaritaanka waxaa sida ugu macquulsan loogu cadeynayaa xaaladda codsadaha iyo wadanki uu ka soo tegay.
en: The investigation examines the situation of the applicant and his/her country of origin as thoroughly as possible.

so: Finland waxaa ka jira dhowr urur oo sekshuwaal iyo jinsi ahaan dadka laga tirada badan yahay u dooda.
en: Finland has many organisations for sexual and gender minorities.

so: Waxay isku dayaan inay hagaajiyaan derajada ay dadkan laga tirada badan yahay ku leeyihiin bulshada dhexeeda.
en: They aim to improve the status of these minorities in society.

so: Ururo badan waxay sidoo kale fidiyaan tababaro, talobixino iyo adeegyo kaalmo oo kala duduwan.
en: Many organisations also provide training, advice and various support services.

so: Dadka sinji-guuray, nimoow-naagyada, labeebyada iyo dadka kale ee jinsi ahaan laga tiro badan tahay waxay caawimaad ka heli karaan wakiilka isku qiimo ahaanshaha, haddii ay dareemaan takooris.
en: Transgender persons, transvestites, intergender persons and other gender diverse people can receive help from the Ombudsman for Equality if they are experiencing discrimination.

so: Sidoo kale dalka Finland dhexdiisa labo nin ama labo dumar ah way is guursan karaan.
en: In Finland, two men or two women can also get married.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ka akhriso bogga InfoFinland Guurka.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Marriage.

so: Bogga InfoFinland ee Waa maxey qoys?
en: The InfoFinland page What is a family?

so: Finland cunuggu wuxuu xaq u leeyahay xannaano iyo daryeel gaar ah.
en: In Finland, children have the right to special protection and care.

so: Cunuggu waxaa kale oo uu xaq u leeyahay in uu soo bandhigo fikirkiisa.
en: Children are also entitled to present their opinions.

so: Cunuggu wuxuu xaq u leeyahay in fikirkiisa ogaal loo yeesho marka arrimo isaga quseeya go'aan laga gaarayo.
en: Children have the right to have their opinion taken into account when decisions regarding them are being made.

so: Sida sharciga Finland uu qabo edbinta jireed ee carruurtu waa mamnuuc waxaana laga heli karaa ciqaab.
en: According to Finnish law, corporal punishment of children is prohibited and can lead to a penalty.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan xuquuqda carruurta ee Finland waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Carruuta.
en: More information on children's rights is available on the InfoFinland page Children.

so: Sida sharcigu qabo, qofka naafada ah lama takoori karo.
en: Finnish law states that a disabled person must not be discriminated against.

so: Qofka naafada ah wuxuu xaq u leeyahay nolol caadi ah in uu ku noolaado, tusaale ahaan in uu waxbarto, shaqo sameeyo qoysna aasaasto.
en: A disabled person has the right to live a normal life, for example, to study, work and start a family.

so: Sida uu qabo sharciga sinnaantu shaqo-bixiyayaasha iyo qabanqaabiyayaasha waxbarashadu waa inay hagaajiyaan fursadaha dadka naafada ah si ay shaqo iyo waxbarasho u helaan.
en: According to the Non-Discrimination Act, employers and organisers of education must improve the possibilities for disabled people to find employment and education.

so: Tusaale ahaan bii'ada shaqada waxaa loo bedeli karaa qaab ay qofka naafada ah ugu sahlanaato in uu ku dhaqdhaqaaqo.
en: For example, a working environment can be changed in such a way that makes it more accessible for a disabled person.

so: Macluumaadka adeegyada loogu talagalay dadka naafada ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Naafada.
en: More information on services for disabled people is available on the InfoFinland page Disabled persons.

so: Dhamaan dadka deggan Finland sida sharcigu qabo waxay leeyihiin xuquuq iyo waajibaad.
en: All those residing in Finland have statutory rights and obligations.

so: Ajaaniibta deggan Finland waxay heystaan xuquuq iyo waajibaad ku dhowaad lamid ah kuwa muwaadiniinta Finnishka.
en: Foreigners living in Finland have nearly the same rights and obligations as Finnish citizens.

so: Xuquuqyada iyo waajibaadyada soo socda waxay quseeyaan sidoo kale ajaaniibta deggan Finland.
en: The following rights and obligations also apply to foreigners living in Finland.

so: Dadkoo dhan waxay xaq u leeyihiin in si isku mid ah loola macaamilo.
en: Everyone has the right to equal treatment.

so: Cidna si dadka kale ka duwan loolama macaamilo karo tusaale ahaan jinsi, da', diin ama naafo dartood.
en: No one must be treated differently based on gender, age, religion or handicap, for example.

so: Qof kasta wuxuu si xornimo ah u sheegi karaa islamarkaasna u qori karaa fikirkiisa.
en: Everyone has the right to freely express their opinions verbally or in writing.

so: Dadku waxay qabanqaabsan karaan shirar iyo bannaanbaxyo waana sidoo kale ka qeybgeli karaan.
en: People are allowed to hold meetings and demonstrations and participate in them.

so: Bannaanbaxa waa in booliska horay loo sii ogeysiiyaa.
en: The police must be notified of all demonstrations in advance.

so: Qofna dil laguma xukumi karo lamana jirdili karo.
en: No one can be sentenced to death or tortured.

so: Dadka oo dhan waxay si xornimo ah u dooran karaan meesha ay ka degayaan Finland.
en: All people can choose their place of residence and freely travel within the country.

so: Qof kasta wuxuu xaq u leeyahay xafidaadiisa shaqsiyadeed.
en: Everyone has a right to the protection of their privacy.

so: Warqadaha qof kale lama aqrin karo sidoo kale telefoonka qof kale lama dhegeysan karo.
en: No one is allowed to read another person's letters or listen to someone else's phone calls.

so: Qof kastaa wuxuu dooran karaa diintiisa.
en: Everyone is free to choose their own religion.

so: Haddii uusan dooneyn loogama baahna in uu wax diin ah doorto.
en: Should you not want to, you do not need to choose any religion.

so: Dadka ajnabiga ah ee sida joogtada ah u deggan Finland islamarkaasna buuxiyay 18 sano waxay ka codeyn karaan doorashooyinka degmooyinka.
en: Those foreigners permanently residing in Finland who are over 18 have a right to vote in municipal elections.

so: Ajaaniibta xaqa u leh inay codkooda ka dhiibtaan doorashooyinka degmooyinka, waxay sidoo kale xaq u leeyihiin inay isu soo sharaxaan doorashooyinka degmooyinka.
en: Foreigners who have the right to vote in municipal elections are also entitled to stand in the municipal elections.

so: Muwadiniinta Midowga Yurub ee gur-degmo ku leh Finland waxay codkooda ka dhiiban karaan doorashooyinka baarlamaanka Yurub haddii ay iska diiwaangeliyeen rajistareeshinka codbixinta.
en: EU citizens with a municipality of residence in Finland can vote in the European Parliament elections in Finland if they have been registered in the voting register.

so: Muwaadiniinta Midowga Yurub ee rajistareeshinka codbixinta Finland kaga jira waxay isu soo sharixi karaan doorashooyinka baarlamaanka Yurub ee Finland.
en: Citizens of an EU country included in the Finnish voting register can also stand in the Finnish European Parliament elections.

so: Faahfaahinta dheeraadka ah ee xuquuqda codbixinta ajaaniibta ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Doorashooyinka iyo codeynta Finland.
en: Read more about foreigners' voting rights in Finland on the InfoFinland web page Elections and voting in Finland.

so: Dhamaan dadka deggan ama jooga Finland waa inay u hogaansamaan sharciga Finland.
en: All persons living or residing in Finland must adhere to Finnish legislation.

so: 7- 17 sano jiryada waxaa saaran waajib ah inay soo dhameystaan waxbarashada hoose-dhexe.
en: The obligation for compulsory education applies to persons between 7 and 17 years of age, i.e. they must complete the comprehensive school curriculum.

so: Inta badan dadka ka shaqeeya Finland waa inay canshuur ka siiyaan Finland mushaarkooda.
en: Often, those working in Finland must pay taxes to Finland from their salary.

so: Dadka oo dhan waxaa waajib ku ah inay cadaalada ka marqaati kacaan, haddii iyaga looga yeero halkaas.
en: Everyone is obligated to testify in court should they be summoned to do so.

so: Waalidka waxaa waajib ku ah inay daryeelaan carruurtooda.
en: Parents have the responsibility to take care of their children.

so: Dadka oo dhan waxaa waajib ku ah inay caawiyaan marka u shil dhaco.
en: Everyone is obliged to lend their aid in the event of an accident.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo canshuurista ku saabsan ka sii aqbri bogga InfoFinlandi Canshuurista.
en: Read more on taxation in Finland on the InfoFinland page Taxation.

so: Xuquuqda iyo waajibaadka muwaadiniinta Finnishka ah
en: The rights and obligations of Finnish citizens

so: Kuwaan waxaa dheer oo muwaadiniinta Finnishka saaran islamarkaasna ay leeyihiin xuquuqyo iyo waajibaadyo kale, kuwaas oo aan saarneyn ama aysan laheyn ajnabiga deggan Finland.
en: In addition to these, Finnish citizens have a number of rights and obligations that do not apply to foreigners living in Finland.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan xuquuqda iyo waajibaadka muwaadinka Finnishka ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Muwaadinka Finishka ah.
en: Read more on the rights and obligations of Finnish citizens on the InfoFinland page Finnish citizenship.

so: Bulshada Finnishka ah iyo waxqabadkeeda waxaa xeera shuruuc.
en: Finnish society and its workings are governed by laws.

so: Kan ugu muhiimsan kuwaan waa dastuurka (Perustuslaki).
en: The most important of these is the Constitution (perustuslaki).

so: Dhamaan dadka deggan Finland waa inay u hogaansamaan shrciyada Finland.
en: All persons living in Finland must adhere to Finnish legislation.

so: Saraakiishu xitaa waa inay u hogaansamaan sharciga.
en: Authorities must also observe the legislation.

so: Sharciga waxaa dejiya baarlamaanka.
en: The laws are enacted by Parliament.

so: Qof kasta ayaa u caban kara madaxa xafiiska cadaaladda (oikeuskansleri) ama sharciyaqaanka baarlamaanka (eduskunnan oikeusasiamies), haddii uu ka shakiyo in sarkaal uu sharciga jebiyay.
en: Anyone can lodge a complaint with the Chancellor of Justice (oikeuskansleri) or the Parliamentary Ombudsman (eduskunnan oikeusasiamies) if they suspect that an authority has broken the law.

so: Dadka Finnishka ah iyo dadka deggan Finland waa inay sidoo kale u hogaansamaan sharciyada Midowga Yurub.
en: Finland and persons residing in Finland must also abide by the laws of the European Union.

so: Dastuurku waa sharciga ugu muhiimsan Finland.
en: The Constitution is the most important piece of legislation in Finland.

so: Sharci kalena kama soo horjeedi karo isaga.
en: No other law must be in conflict with it.

so: Dastuurka waxaa lagu dejiyaa tusaale ahaan xuquuqda aasaasiga ah ee dadka deggan Finland iyo sida dowladda Finland ay u shaqeyneyso.
en: The Constitution governs the basic rights of Finnish residents and the operations of the Finnish state, for example.

so: Sharciga sinnaantu (Yhdenvertaisuuslaki) sida uu qabo qofna laguma takoori karo da', asal ama jinsiyad hore, dhalasho, luqad, diin, caqiido, fikir, xaalad caafimaad, naafo, nooc sekshiwaal ama wax kale oo qofka la xiriira.
en: According to the Non-Discrimination Act (yhdenvertaisuuslaki), no one can be discriminated based on ethnic or national origin, nationality, language, religion, beliefs, opinion, medical condition, disability, sexual orientation or other reason connected to a person.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan sinnaanta waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Sinnaanta iyo isku qiimo ahaanshada.
en: More information on non-discrimination is available on the InfoFinland page Equality and non-discrimination.

so: Sharciga isku qiimo ahaanshada (Tasa-arvolaki) ayaa mamnuucaya takoorista jinsiga qofka ku saleysan.
en: The Equality Act (tasa-arvolaki) prohibits discrimination based on gender.

so: Sida uu qabo sharci isku qiimo ahaanshuhu saraakiisha, shaqo-bixiyayaasha iyo qeybaha waxbarashadu waa inay horumariyaan isku qiimo ahaanshaha ragga iyo dumarka.
en: According to the Equality Act, authorities, employers and educational institutes must promote equality between men and women.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan isku qiimo ahaanshaha waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Sinnaanta iyo isku qiimo ahaanshada.
en: More information on equality is available on the InfoFinland page Equality and non-discrimination.

so: Sharciga badbaadada carruurta (Lastensuojelulaki) ayaa amraya in cunug kasta oo Finland deggan uu xaq u leeyahay daryeel iyo deegaan koriinshu oo nabad ah.
en: The Child Welfare Act (lastensuojelulaki) stipulates that children living in Finland are entitled to care and a safe growing environment.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan xuquuqda carruurta ee Finland waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Carruurta.
en: More information on children's rights in Finland is available on the InfoFinland page Children.

so: Qof kasta oo iibsada alaabo ama adeeg ayaa ah quute.
en: Anyone who buys goods or services is a consumer.

so: Waxaad adigu xaq u leedahay in aad hesho magdhaw tusaale ahaan marka, alaabta aad iibsatay ay cillad leedahay, cilladahaas oo aadan adigu sababin.
en: You are entitled to compensation, for example, when an item you have purchased has faults that you have not caused yourself.

so: Waxaad taas bedelkeeda tusaale ahaan heli kartaa alaab aan cillad laheyn ama lacagtaadi ayaad dib u heli kartaa.
en: You can receive a flawless item as a replacement or your money back, for example.

so: Haddii alaabta aad iibsatay aysan dhameyn, la xiriir marka hore qofkii alaabta kaa iibiyay.
en: If an item you have bought has shortcomings, contact the seller first.

so: Haddii aadan iibiyihii arrinta wax xal uga helin, la xiriir la-talinta quutaha.
en: If you cannot reach an agreement with the seller, contact the consumer advisory services.

so: Codeynta caadiga ah waxaa ruux walboo finnish ah, kaasoo buuxiyey da'da 18 jirka xaq u leeyahay inuu codeeyo.
en: Normally, all Finnish citizens who are at least 18 years of age have the right to vote.

so: Doorashada golaha deeggaanka iyo -baarlamaanka yurub waxaa codeyntooda iyaguna xaq u leh iney codeeyaan jinsiyadaha kala duwan, kuwaasoo ku nool Finland.
en: However, in municipal elections and European Parliament elections citizens of other countries who reside in Finland also have the right to vote.

so: Codeynta golaha baarlamaanka yurub waxaa sidoo kale iyaguna codeyn kara muwaadiniinta midowga yurub, kuwa isaka diiwaangeliyey diiwaangelinta inta xaqa u leh iney ka codeeyaan Finland.
en: In a European Parliament election, the citizens of other EU member states who have entered their names on Finland's voting register have the right to vote.

so: Codeynta doorashada golaha deeggaanka waxaa codeyn kara dhammaan bulshada jinsiyadaha kale haysta, kuwaasoo deeggaan ku ahaa degmooyinka ugu yaraan labo sanno degmadaas.
en: In a municipal election, citizens of other countries who have had a municipality of residence in Finland for at least two years have the right to vote.

so: Wargelinta codeynta doorashada waxaa laguugu soo dirayaa boostada gurigaaga qiyaastii bil kahor maalinta codeynta.
en: Notice of the right to vote (ilmoitus äänioikeudesta) will be posted to your home address approximately one month before the election day.

so: Wargelinta waxaa ku qoran halka aad ka codeyneyso.
en: This notice will specify your polling station.

so: Haddaad codeyneyso maalinta codeyska, waxaad ka codeyn kartaa oo keliya, goobta codeynta ee ku qoran kaarka.
en: If you vote on the election day, you will only be able to vote in the polling station specified in the notice.

so: Codeynta doorashooyinkoo dhan waad codeyn kartaa inta ka horeysa maalinta codeynta, xiliga sii codeynta.
en: In all elections, you can also vote before the actual election day, during the advance voting period.

so: Haddaad sii codeyneyso, waxaad ka codeyn kartaa guud ahaan goobaha loogu talogaley sii codeynta meel walbooy tahay Finland ama wadanka dibadiisaba.
en: If you vote in advance, you may do so at any of the general advance polling stations in Finland or abroad.

so: Haddii aadan helin wargelinta codenta waxaad la xiriirtaa degmada aad degan tahay waaxdiisa diiwaangelinta.
en: If you do not receive a notice of the right to vote, contact the Local Register Office (maistraatti) of your place of residence.

so: Markaad soo codeyneyso, waa inaad horey usii qaadataa aqoonsi, wargelinta codeyntana wey wanaagsan tahay inaad horey u sii qaadato.
en: You must take an identity document with you when you go to vote. You should also take along the notice of the right to vote.

so: Arrimaha muhiimka ah ee degmada waxaa go'aan ka gaara golaha degmada (kunnanvaltuusto).
en: The most important matters of a municipality are decided by the municipal council (kunnanvaltuusto).

so: Xubnaha golaha degmada waxaa lagu soo doortaa doorashooyinka degmada.
en: The members of the municipal council, i.e. the municipal councillors, are elected through the municipal election.

so: Doorashooyinka degmada waxaa la qabanqaabiyaa afartii sanaba mar.
en: The municipal election is held every four years.

so: Tirada wakiilada degmadu waxay ku xiran yihiin inta ay dhan yihiin dadka degmada deggan.
en: The number of municipal councillors depends on the population of the municipality.

so: Doorashooyinka degmooyinka waad ka codeyn kartaa haddii:
en: You can vote in the municipal election if:

so: aad tahay muwaadin Finland, dowlad kale oo Midowg Yurub ah, Norway ama Iceland u dhashay islamarkaasna aad tahay 18 sano jir ugu dambeyn maalinta doorashada.
en: you are a citizen of Finland, another EU country, Norway or Iceland and turn 18 on the election day, at the latest.

so: Intaas waxaa dheer, waxaa loo baahan yahay in degmada laga hadlayo lagu lahaado guri-degmo ugu dambeyntii maalinta 51aad kahor maalinta doorashada,
en: In addition, your municipality of residence must be the municipality in question 51 days prior to the election day, at the latest.

so: aad tahay 18 sano jir ugu dambeyntii maalinta doorashada wadan kasta ha ahaadoo muwaadinkaaaga.
en: you are a citizen of any other country and turn 18 on the election day, at the latest.

so: Waxaa kale oo lagaa doonayaa in aad guri-degmo ku laheyd Finland ugu yaraan labo sano oo xiriir ah.
en: You must also have had a municipality of residence in Finland for a continuous period of at least two years.

en: Candidates can be placed by

so: dad codbixin xaq u leh oo qof soo magacowday.
en: persons entitled to vote who have set up a constituency association.

so: Codbixiyayaashu waa inay ahaadaan ugu yaraan 10 xubnood.
en: A constituency association must have at least 10 members.

so: Musharuxu waa in uu ahaadaa qof,
en: A candidate must be a person

so: cod bixinta doorashooyinka degmada xaq u leh,
en: who has the right to vote in municipal elections,

so: ku leh guri-degmo degmada laga hadlayo,
en: whose municipality of residence is the municipality in question,

so: aan laga aheyn mas'uul
en: who is not under guardianship.

so: Baarlamaanku (Eduskunta) waa unugga go'aan sameynta ee ugu muhiimsan dowladda Finland.
en: Parliament (eduskunta) is the most important decision-making body of the Finnish state.

so: Xubnaha baarlamaanka, xildhibaanada waxaa lagu soo doortaa doorashooyinka baarlamaanka.
en: The Members of Parliament are elected through parliamentary elections.

so: Doorashooyinka baarlamaanka waxaa la qabanqaabiyaa afartii sanaba mar.
en: A parliamentary election is held every four years.

so: Doorashooyinka baarlamaanka marka lagu jiro dalka waxaa loo qeybiyay qeybo doorasho.
en: In the parliamentary election, the country is divided into electoral districts.

so: Qeyb doorasheed kasta waxaa laga soo doortaa tiro cayiman oo xildhibaano ah.
en: A certain number of members of parliament are selected from each district.

so: Tirada xildhibaanadu waxay ku xiran tahay tirada dadka ee deggan qeybta doorashada.
en: The number depends on the population of the electoral district.

so: Xildhibaanada la doortaa waa 200 wadajirkoodu.
en: A total number of 200 Members of Parliament are elected.

so: Waad ka codeyn kartaa doorashooyinka baarlamaanka haddii aad tahay muwaadin Finnish ah islamarkaasna aad buuxisay 18 sano ugu dambeyntii maalinta doorashada.
en: You can vote in the parliamentary election if you are a Finnish citizen and turn 18 on the election day, at the latest.

so: Xaqa codbixinta waxaa sidoo kale leh muwaadiniinta Finnishka ah ee deggan dibadda.
en: Finnish citizens who live abroad are also entitled to vote.

so: Codbixiyayaashu waa inay ahaadaan ugu yaraan 100 xubnood.
en: A constituency association must have at least 100 members.

so: Madaxweynuhu waa madaxa dowladda Finland.
en: The President is Finland's head of state.

so: Madaxweynaha waxaa lagu soo doortaa doorashooyinka madaxweynaha.
en: The President is elected through the presidential election.

so: Doorashooyinka madaxweynaha waxaa la qabanqaabiyaa lixdii sano mar.
en: The presidential election is held every six years.

so: Isla hal qof waxaa la dooran karaa ugu badnaan labo jeer.
en: The same person can be elected President no more than two times.

so: Doorashooyinka madaxweynaha sida caadiga waa laba qeybood.
en: The presidential elections normally have two phases.

so: Wareegaas labaad waxaa musharixiin ka ah labada musharax ee codadka ugu badan ka helay wareegii koowaad.
en: The two candidates who received the most votes in the first round enter the second round.

so: Qofka hela wareegga labaad codadka ugu badan ayaa loo doortaa madaxweyne.
en: The candidate who receives the most votes in the second round is elected President.

so: Waad ka codeyn kartaa doorashooyinka madaxweynaha haddii aad tahay muwaadin Finnish ah islamarkaasna aad buuxisay 18 sano ugu dambeyn maalinta doorashada.
en: You can vote in the presidential election if you are a Finnish citizen and you turn 18 on the election day, at the latest.

so: Waxaa musharixiinta madaxweynaha soo magacaabi kara
en: Presidential candidates can be placed by

so: xisbiyada baarlamaanka ku leh ugu yaraan hal xildhibaan,
en: parties that have at least one Member of Parliament,

so: Codbixiyayaashu waa inay ahaadaan ugu yaraan 20 000 xubnood.
en: A constituency association must have at least 20,000 members.

so: muwaadin ah islamarkaasna asal ahaan u dhashay Finland,
en: who is a native Finnish citizen,

so: xaq u leh codbixinta doorashooyinka madaxweynaha,

so: Baarlamaanka Yurub iyo Golaha Midowga Yurub oo wadajira waxay yihiin unugga sharci-dejinta Midowga Yurub ee ugu muhiimsan.
en: The European Parliament is, together with the Council of the European Union, the most important legislator in the European Union.

so: Golaha Midowga Yurub waxaa ku jira wakiilada xukuumada wadamada xubnaha ka ah.
en: The governments of the member states are represented in the Council of the European Union.

so: Baarlamaanka waxaa ku jira 754 xubnood, 13 kamid ahna waxaa laga soo doortaa Finland.
en: The Parliament has 754 members, 13 of whom have been elected from Finland.

so: Xubnaha baarlamaanka waxaa lagu doortaa doorshooyin.
en: The Members of Parliament are appointed through an election.

so: Doorashooyinka waxaa la qabanqaabiyaa shantii sano mar.
en: The election is held every five years.

so: Waad ka codeyn kartaa doorashooyinka baarlamaanka Yurub, haddii
en: You can vote in a European Parliament election if

so: aad tahay muwaadin Finnish ah islamarkaasna aad buuxisay 18 sano ugu dambeyntii maalinta doorashada,
en: you are a Finnish citizen and turn 18 on the election day, at the latest.

so: aad tahay muwaadin wadan kale oo Midowga Yurub ah islamarkaasna aad buuxisay 18 sano ugu dambeyntii maalinta doorashada.
en: you are a citizen of another EU country and turn 18 on the election day, at the latest.

so: Waa inaad sidoo kale guri-degmo ku lahaataa Finland maalinta 51aad maalinta doorashada kahor.
en: In addition, you must have a municipality of residence in Finland 51 days prior to the election day.

so: Waxaa intaas dheer inaad iska diiwaangelisaa rajistareeshinka codbixinta Finland.
en: You must be registered in the voting register in Finland.

so: Is-diiwaangelinta waa in rajistareeshinka laga sameeyaa ugu dambeyn maalinta 80aad maalinta doorashada kahor.
en: The registration must be submitted no later than 80 days prior to the election day.

so: Hal dal oo kali ah ayaad kaga codeyn kartaa doorashooyinka isku midka ah.
en: You can vote in the same election in one EU member state only.

so: Musharuxu waa in uu ahaadaa qof
en: A candidate must a person

so: heysta xaqa codbixinta doorashooyinka baarlamaanka Yurub,
en: who has the right to vote in the European Parliament elections,

so: Hay'adaha ugu sareeyaa waa baarlamaanka, madaxweynaha iyo golaha dowladda ama xukuumadda.
en: The highest organs of government in Finland are the Parliament of Finland, the President of the Republic and the Finnish Government.

so: Baarlaamka (Eduskunta) ayaa dejiya sharciyadda Finland islamarkaasna go'aamiya qiimeynta dhaqaalaha, miisaaniyadda.
en: Parliament (eduskunta) enacts laws and decides upon the state budget.

so: Baarlamaanku wuxuu sidoo kale ilaaliyaa shaqada xukuumadda.
en: Parliament also supervises the operations of the government.

so: Baarlamaanka waxaa ku jira 200 oo xildhibaan.
en: The parliament includes 200 Members of Parliament.

so: Xildhibaanada waxaa lagu soo doortaa doorasho xor ah afartii sanaba mar.
en: The Members of Parliament are appointed by election for four years at a time.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi Doorashooyinka iyo codeynta Finland waxaa ku jira macluumaad ku saabsan qofka doorashooyinka baarlamaanka ka codeyn kara.
en: The InfoFinland page Elections and voting in Finland provides information on who can vote in parliamentary elections.

so: Madaxa dowladda Finland waa madaxweynaha jamhuuriyadda (tasavallan presidentti).
en: The Finnish head of state is the President of the Republic (tasavallan presidentti).

so: Madaxweynaha waxaa lagu doortaa doorasho.
en: The President is appointed by election.

so: Xilliga uu xilka hayo madaxweynuhu waa lix sano.
en: The term of office of the President is six years.

so: Hal qof wuxuu madaxweyne noqon karaa ugu badnaan laba xilli madaxweyne oo isku xigta, waxaa loola jeedaa 12 sano.
en: The same person cannot serve as President for more than two consecutive terms, i.e. 12 years.

so: wuxuu magacaabaa saraakiisha sarsare,

en: leads foreign policy together with the government and

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi Doorashooyinka iyo codeynta Finland waxaa ku jira macluumaad ku saabsan qofka doorashooyinka madaxweynaha ka codeyn kara.
en: The InfoFinland page Elections and voting in Finland provides information on who can vote in presidential elections.

so: Xukuumadda (Hallitus) waxaa kamid ah ra'iisal wasaaraha iyo wasiirada kale.
en: The government (hallitus) includes the Prime Minister and other ministers.

so: Baarlamaanka ayaa dooranaya ra'iisal wasaare waxaana shaqada u magacaabaya madaxweynaha jamhuuriyadda.
en: Parliament selects the Prime Minister and the President appoints him/her to the task.

so: Wasiirada kale waxaa magacaabaya madaxweynaha ra'isal wasaaruhuna wuu soo jeedinayaa.
en: Other ministers are appointed by the President according to the suggestions of the Prime Minister.

so: Xukuumaddu waxay diyaarisaa islamarkaasna dhaqan-gelisaa go'aanada uu baarlamaanku sameeyay.
en: The government prepares and implements the decisions made by Parliament.

so: Xukuumaddu shaqo ahaan waxay wakiilka u tahay baarlamaanka, waxaa loola jeedaa wasiiradu waa inay heystaan kalsoonida baarlamaanka.
en: The government is responsible for its actions to the Parliament, which means that the ministers must have Parliament's confidence.

so: Wasiiradu waxay diyaariyaan arrimaha ay xukuumaddu go'aamiso.
en: The ministries prepare the matters that are decided by the government.

so: Wasiiradu waxay hogaamiyaan shaqada dowliga ah ee wasaaradaha.
en: The ministers lead the work of the ministry officials.

so: Wasaaradaha waxaa ka hoos shaqeeya hay'ado iyo qeybo kale.
en: Numerous agencies and departments operate under the ministries.

so: Tusaale ahaan Xafiiska dal u soo guuristu wuxuu hoostagaa wasaaradda arrimaha gudaha.
en: The Finnish Immigration Service, for example, is an agency operating under the Ministry of the Interior.

so: Maamul deegaameedka dowliga ah waxaa loola jeedaa hay'adaha ama saraakiisha qabta shaqooyinka dowladda.
en: Local state administration refers to those authorities that handle state duties in a particular area.

so: Hay'adaha soo socda ayaa kamid ah maamul deegaanka dowliga ah:
en: The following authorities are part of the local state administration:

so: Xafiisyada shaqada iyo ganacsiga,
en: Employment and Economic Development Offices

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan saraakiisha iyo shaqooyinka waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Saraakiisha muhiimka ah.
en: More information on authorities and their tasks is available on the InfoFinland page Important authorities.

so: Finland waxaa ku yaal lix hay'adood oo maamulka soonaha ah.
en: Finland has six Regional State Administrative Agencies.

so: Hay'adaha maamulka soonuhu waxay qaabilsan yihiin dhaqangelinta sharciga Finland iyo ilaalinta soonahooda.
en: The agencies handle the implementation and supervision of the law in their own regions.

so: Hay'aduhu waxay qaabilsan yihiin arrimaha soo socda
en: The Regional State Administrative Agencies are responsible for the following:

so: Adeegyada aasaasiga ah, ammaanka xaqeed iyo ruqsadaha
en: Basic public services, legal rights and permits

so: Waxqabadka badbaadinta iyo diyaargaroobista
en: Rescue services and readiness

so: Finland waxaa ku yaal 15 xarumood oo ELY.
en: Finland has 15 Centres for Economic Development, Transport and the Environment.

so: Shaqooyinkooda waxaa ka mid ah tusaale ahaan
en: Their tasks include the following:

so: Horumarinta la-qabsashada dadka dalka u soo guuray
en: Promoting the integration of immigrants

so: Finland waxay u qeybsan tahay degmooyin.
en: Finland is divided into municipalities.

so: Degmooyinku waxay leeyihiin is-maamul, waxaa loola jeedaa waxay go'aan ka gaari karaan arrrimahooda.
en: The municipalities are self-governing or, in other words, they can decide on their own matters.

so: Degmooyinku waxay leeyihiin xuquuq canshuureed, waa xaqa canshuur ka ururinta dadkeeda canshuurta degmada.
en: The municipalities have the power to levy taxes, which means that they can collect municipal tax from their residents.

so: Degmooyinka waxaa waajib ka saaran yahay inay dadkooda u qabanqaabiyaan adeegyo badan.
en: The municipalities are obliged to organise a variety of services for their residents.

so: Kuwaan waxaa kamid ah tusaale ahaan daryeelka caafimaadka, xannaano-maalmeedka carruurta iyo waxbarashada.
en: These include health care, child day-care and education.

so: Intaas waxaa dheer oo sidoo kale ay bixin karaan adeegyo kale oo dheeraad ah.
en: In addition, they can offer other services.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Guri-degmo ee Finland.
en: More information is available on the InfoFinland web page Municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Arrimaha degmada waxaa go'aan ka gaara golaha degmada.
en: Decisions regarding each municipality are made by the municipal council.

so: Xubnaha golaha degmada waxaa lagu doortaa dooorashooyinka degmooyinka ee la qabanqaabiyo afartii sanadba mar.
en: The members of the council are selected through a municipal election held every four years.

so: Golaha degmada ayaa waxay doortaan xubnaha maamulka golaha degmada, kuwaas oo ay shaqadoodu tahay diyaarinta go'aanada golaha degmada iyo dhaqangelintooda.
en: The council elects the members for the municipal board whose duty is to prepare council decisions and implement them.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi Doorashooyinka iyo codeynta Finland waxaa ku jira macluumaadka cidda ka codeyn karta doorashooyinka degmada.
en: The InfoFinland page Elections and voting in Finland provides information on who can vote in municipal elections.

so: Boggan waxa lagu soo koobay linkiyo bogag kale ku gaynaya oo ku baxayo luqado kale oo anan ku jiran luqadaha bogga InfoFinland.
en: This page contains links to other websites in languages that are not part of the language selection of InfoFinland.

so: InfoFinlandi waxa weeyaan adeeg internetka ah oo ku baxa 12 luqadood luqad kasta macluumaadka ku qorana ay lamid yihiin kuwa kale oo dhan.
en: InfoFinland is an online service available in 12 languages; all language versions are identical.

so: Adeegga luqadahiisa waxad ka dooran kartaa bogga halkiisa kore.
en: You can find the language selection of the service in the menu in the top bar.

so: Xaflad-ciideedyada Finland waxey badankood kasoo jeedaan diinta Kirishtanka.
en: The roots of many Finnish holidays lie in Christianity.

so: Qaar ka tirsan xafadlaha ciiddu, tusaale ahaan ciidul-masiixiga iyo pääsiäinen waa maalmaha fasaxa ee caadiga ah.
en: Some of the holidays, such as Christmas and Easter, are public holidays.

so: Markaas dukaamo iyo hay'adaha dowladduba waa xiran yihiin.
en: Many shops and offices are closed during these holidays.

so: Hal qaab oo loo xafladeeyo waa in calanka la suro birta calanka.
en: One way to mark a holiday is to fly the flag.

so: Maalmo cayiman oo ku qoran kalantarka ayaa Finland calanka la taagaa.
en: The flag of Finland is flown on certain days that are marked in the calendar.

so: Hay'adaha dowliga ah iyo dadka caadiga ah labaduba waa ka qeybqaataan maalmaha calanka la taago.
en: Both official instances and private persons fly the flag on flag days.

so: Calanku wuxuu Finland ka yahay arrin loo xafladeeyo.
en: The flag of Finland is considered a solemn item.

so: Boggan waxaa si kooban loogu sharraxayaa qaar ka tirsan xaflad ciideedyda Finnishka.
en: This page briefly describes some Finnish holidays.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan maalmaha calan taagista waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga xafiiska almanakka ee jaamacadda Helsinki.
en: More information on the flag days is available on the University of Helsinki Almanac Office website.

so: Macluumaadka xafladaha Kirishtaanka waxaad ka aqrisan kartaa bogga kaniisadda Efangelis-luteeriga.
en: Read more about Christian celebrations on the website of the Evangelical Lutheran Church of Finland.

so: Maalinta ka horeysa Sanadka cusub ee 31 Disembar oo maalinta sanadka u dambeyso.
en: New Year's Eve, 31 December, is the last day of the year.

so: Markaas waxaa la qabanqaabiyaa bulaleyro.
en: Firework displays are organised.

so: Dukaanka ayaa laga soo iibsan karaa gantaallada.
en: Rockets can also be purchased from shops.

so: Ganitaanka gantaallada waxaa loo qariray waqti cayiman.
en: Specific time limits have been set for firing rockets.

so: Markaas waxaa la xusaa saddex saadaaliye, kuwaas oo hadiyado u keenay Nabi Ciise oo dhallaan ah.
en: The holiday commemorates the three wise men who brought gifts to baby Jesus.

so: Johan Ludvig Runeberg (1804–1877) waa gabyaa Finnish ah islamarkaasna muhiim ah.
en: Johan Ludvig Runeberg (1804–1877) is a major figure of Finnish poetry.

so: Maalinta saaxiibka Finland loogama xuso si u weyn sida tusaale ahaan looga xuso Mareykanka.
en: Valentine's Day is not celebrated as prominently in Finland as it is in the United States, for example.

so: Ciidda billowga soonka Kirishtaanku waxey billowdaa diyaargarowga iistarka.
en: Shrovetide starts the preparation for Easter.

so: Finland waxaa Ciidda billowga soonka Kirishtaanka laga dhaadhacaa buurta waxaana la cunaa burka ciidda billowga soonka Kirirshtaanka, kaas oo ay ku jiraan waxyaabo ay ka mid yihiin burcad.
en: On Shrove Tuesday, Finns go sledding and eat shrove buns, which contain, among other things, whipped cream.

so: Iistarku waa xaflad Kirishtaan.
en: Easter is a Christian holiday.

so: Waqtiga uu soo galo waa isbeddelaa laakiin inta badan waxaa loo dabbaaldegaa iistarka Maarso ama Abriil.
en: Its exact time varies, but usually Easter is celebrated in March or April.

so: Iistarka ka hor waxaa soo gala Axadda geedtimirka.
en: Easter is preceded by Palm Sunday.

so: Waxaa iyaga inta badan la siiyaa hadiyo yar tusaale ahaan xoogaa nacnac ah.
en: It is customary to give them a small gift, such as some candy, in return.

so: Jimcaha dheer ee ka horreysay iistarka waxaa la xusaa dhimasha Nabi Ciise.
en: The death of Jesus is commemorated on Good Friday.

so: Axadda Iistarka waxaa la xusaa aadista samada ee Nabi Ciise.
en: Jesus' resurrection is celebrated on Easter Sunday.

so: Xafladda iistarku waxey sii socotaa axadda ka dib isniinta, yacni maalinta labaad ee iistarka.
en: After Sunday, celebrations continue on Easter Monday, or the second Easter Day.

so: Waxaa inta badan iistarka la cunaa hilibka idaha, ukumaha iistarka oo laga sameeyay shukulaato iyo macmcaan.
en: Lamb is a traditional Finnish Easter food, as are chocolate eggs and mämmi, a traditional Easter dessert.

so: Xuska samo u qaadista Masiixiga waxaa la xusaa 40 maalmood ka dib iistarka.
en: Ascension Day is celebrated 40 days after Easter.

so: Maalinta shaqaalaha siyaabo kala duduwan ayaa looga dabbaaldegaa Finland.
en: In Finland, May Day is celebrated in many different ways.

so: Dadku waxey isugu yimaadaan duurbax ama maalinjoog.
en: People gather for picnics.

so: Maalinta shaqaalaha waxaa la cunaa bur macaan waxaana la cabaa khamari, oo yara sharaabka lamid ah.
en: Doughnuts and sima, a drink similar to lemonade, are enjoyed on May Day.

so: Khamriga fiinadu waxey inta badan qeyb ka tahay xafladda.
en: Many also celebrate with sparkling wine.

so: Guryaha waxaa lagu sharrixi karaa buufinno iyo serbantiini.
en: Homes are decorated with balloons and streamers.

so: Ardayda dugsiyada sare ka baxday waxey inta badan madaxa soo saartaan koofida ardayga dugsiga sare.
en: It is customary for those who have graduated upper secondary school to wear their white caps.

so: Shaqaaluhu waxey qaban-qaabiyaan gaardiska maalinta shaqaalaha.
en: Labourers organise May Day marches.

so: Maalinta hooyada waxaa Finland laga xusaa axadda labaad ee bisha Maajo.
en: In Finland, Mother's Day is celebrated on the second Sunday of May.

so: Waxaa hooyooyinka lagu xusaa tusaale ahaan hadiyado iyo ubaxyo.
en: Mothers are treated by giving them gifts and flowers, for example.

so: Xuska bartamaha xagaaga waxaa la xusaa dhammaadka bisha Juun.
en: Midsummer is celebrated at the end of June.

so: Xuska bartamaha xagaagu waa xafladda bartamaha xagaaga.
en: Midsummer is the celebration of the middle of the summer.

so: Dad badan oo Finnish ah waxey xuskan jecelyihiin in ay ku qaataan cariishka xagaaga.
en: Many Finns prefer to spend midsummer at their holiday homes.

so: Shidista tubaal dabeed weyn waxey ka mid tahay soo jireenka xuska bartamaha xagaaga ee Finnishka.
en: Lighting Midsummer bonfires, or large fires, is a Finnish Midsummer tradition.

so: Koonfurta Finland waxaa dhici karta in laga taago baallaha xuska bartamaha xagaaga.
en: Midsummer poles, similar to maypoles, are sometimes also erected in Southern Finland.

so: Maalintan fasax diimeedka ah waxaa la qabtaa billowga Nofeembar.
en: All Saints' Day is celebrated at the beginning of November.

so: Waxaa markaas la xusaa dadka dhintey.
en: It is a day for commemorating the deceased.

so: Dadku waxey shumacyo geeyaan xabaalaha ehelkooda.
en: People bring candles to the graves of their loved ones.

so: Isla waqtiyadaas waxaa sidoo kale la xusaa Haloween.
en: Halloween is celebrated around the same time.

so: Si kastoo ay ahaatase maalintan fasax ciideedku ma ahan sida Haloweeniga oo kale ee waa xaflad qiimo leh islamarkaasna deggan.
en: However, All Saints' Day is not a carnival like Halloween; it is a solemn and quiet occasion.

so: Maalinta aabaha waxaa Finland laga xusaa axadda labaad ee Nofembar.
en: In Finland, Father's Day is celebrated on the second Sunday of November.

so: Waxaa aabaha lagu xusaa hadiyado kala duduwan.
en: Fathers are treated with all kinds of gifts.

so: Finland waxey xorowday sanadki 1917.
en: Finland gained its independence in 1917.

so: Markaas Finnish badan waxey telefishinka ka daawadaan xafladda maalinta xorriyadda ee madaxweynaha jamhuuriyadda.
en: Many Finns like to watch the President's Independence Day Reception from television.

so: Kirismasku waa xafladda ugu muhiimsan Finland.
en: Christmas is the most important Christian holiday celebrated in Finland.

so: Waxaa markaas la xusaa dhalashada Nabi Ciise.
en: It is a celebration of the birth of Jesus.

so: Dad badan waxey guryohooda keensadaan geedka kirismaska oo la qurxiyo.
en: It is customary to bring home a Christmas tree and decorate it.

so: Hadiyadaha kirismaska waxaa inta badan la qeybiyaa maalinta ka horeysa kirismaska.
en: Christmas gifts are usually exchanged on Christmas Eve.

so: Kirismaska Finnishka waxaa ku jira cunto-xafladeedyo badan, sida doofaarka kirismaska, ansalaato iyo xidid case, cuntooyin kala duduwan, tortiga kirismaska iyo doolshe.
en: Finnish Christmas includes many traditional foods such as Christmas ham, rosolli, which is a beetroot salad, different casseroles, mince pies and ginger bread.

so: Kirismaska waxaa wax badan la qaadaa heesaha kirismaska waxaana waqti lala qaataa qoyska iyo ehelka kale
en: At Christmas, Finns like to sing carols and spend time with family members and other loved ones.

so: Boggan waxaa ku jira macluumaad guud oo ku saabsan tababka Finnishka.
en: This page contains information on Finnish customs.

so: Macluumaadka dhaqanka shaqo ee Finnishka waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Dhaqanka ganacsi ee Finnishka.
en: More information on Finnish work culture is available on the InfoFinland page Finnish work culture.

so: Sinnaanta iyo caddaaladdu waa qayimyo Finnishka muhiim u ah.
en: Equality and fairness are important values for Finns.

so: Bulshada Finnishka dhexdeeda dadka oo dhan waa siman yihiin waana in dhammaan si cadaalad ah loola macaamilaa.
en: In Finnish society, everyone is equal and must be treated fairly.

so: Macluumaadka sinnaanta iyo mid ahaanshaha waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Sinnaanta iyo isku qiimo ahaanshaha.
en: Information on equality and non-discrimination is available on the InfoFinland page Equality and non-discrimination.

so: Sida uu sharciga Finland qabo dumarka iyo ragu waa siman yihiin.
en: According to the Finnish legislation, women and men are equal.

so: In dumarku ay shaqeeyaan Finland waa wax ka caadi ah, xittaa marka ay carruur heystaan.
en: It is common for Finnish women to work even if they have children.

so: Ninka iyo naagta labadooduba waxey mas'uul ka wada yihiin daryeelista carruurta iyo guriga.
en: Men and women are both responsible for the care of the children and the home.

so: Waa wax caam ah in Finnishku ay aaminaan dadka kale iyo saraakiisha dowladdaba.
en: It is common for Finns to trust other people and the authorities.

so: Waxaa sidoo kale Finland laga tixgeliyaa dimuquraadiyadda iyo xorriyadda hadalka.
en: Democracy and freedom of speech are also held in high regard in Finland.

so: Qof kasta wuxu xaq u leeyahay ka qeyqaadashada hawlaha bulshada.
en: Everyone has the right to participate in the activities of society.

so: Xorriyadda hadalka ayaa sidoo kale ka jirta Finland.
en: There is freedom of speech in Finland.

so: Dhaqanka Finland shaqsinimadu waxey uga muuqataa si ka badan dhaqamo kale oo badan.
en: Finnish culture places more value on individualism than many other cultures.

so: Xorriyadda shaqsi ahaan waxey aad uga muuqataa sharciga degsan ee Finland.
en: Freedom of the individual is strongly present in the Finnish legislation.

so: Finnishku waxaa kale oo ay qadariyaan gaar ahaanshaha iyo boog u gaar ah.
en: Finns also value their privacy and own space.

so: Tusaale ahaan waxaa dhallinyarada qaangaarka ah lagu dhiirigeliyaa in ay xoroobaan oo ay guri u gaar ah u guuraan.
en: For example, young people are encouraged to become independent and move into their own homes.

so: Daacadnimada ayaa Finland laga tixgeliyaa.
en: Honesty is appreciated in Finland.

so: Waa muhiim in ballanta la oofiyo runtana lagu hadlo.
en: It is important to keep your promises and tell the truth.

so: Waqtiga ku imaanshuhuna wuxuu sidoo kale muhiim u yahay Finnishka.
en: Also punctuality is important to Finns.

so: Marka aad kulan leedahay, imow goobta waqtiga lagu ballamay.
en: When you have a meeting, arrive at the agreed time.

so: Haddii aad tusaale ahaan ballan ka qabsaday sarkaa lama dhaqtar, waxaa muhiimad gaar ah in aad soo dhaqsato.
en: If you have made an appointment with an official or doctor, for example, it is especially important to be there on time.

so: Tusaale ahaan, haddii aad ballan qabsatay 12ka, imow meesha wax yar ka hor 12ka.
en: For example, if you have made an appointment for 12 o'clock, make sure you arrive a little before 12.

so: Haddii aad timaado 12ka iyo 10 daqiiqo waad soo daahday.
en: If you arrive at 12.10, you are late.

so: Finnish badan waxey qiimeeyaan isqaadqaadis la'aanta.
en: Many Finns esteem modesty highly.

so: Dadku kooxda iskama soo dhexmuujiyaan; cod weyn kuma hadlaan ama isma amaanaan.
en: People tend not to distinguish themselves in a group; they avoid talking in a loud voice and bragging.

so: Hab-dhaqanka wanaagsan ayaa looga arkaa Finland in dadka loo dhug lahaadlo lana dhegeyso.
en: In Finland, it is good manners to take others into account and listen to them.

so: Waxaa kale wax badan la qiimeeyaa shaqeynta iyo hawlkarnimada.
en: Working and diligence are also held in high regard.

so: Bay'adu waa arrin aad muhiim ugu ah Finnishka.
en: Nature is very important to Finns.

so: Dad badan oo Finnish ah waxey ka helaan bay'ada, tusaale ahaana socod ayeey u aadaan ama waxey ka gurtaan miraha.
en: Many Finns enjoy spending time in nature, for example by camping or picking berries.

so: Sida ay qabaan, qof kasta dadku waxey si xor ah ugu dhaqdhaqaaqi karaan bay'ada, dadka oo dhanna uma baahna in ay ruqsad weydiistaan milkiilaha dhulka.
en: According to them, people have free access rights in nature, and do not need the landowner's permission for all outdoor activities.

so: Faahfaahinta dheeraadka ah ee xuquuqda qof walba ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Ku raaxeysiga iyo ku socodka dabeecadda.
en: Read more about everyman's rights on the InfoFinland page Recreation and travel in nature.

so: Salaanta gacanta qaadka ah waa habka caamka ah ee laysku salaamo marka la joogo marxalad rasmi ah.
en: Handshaking is a common way of greeting in formal situations.

so: Ragga iyo dumarku xittaa gacan qaad ayeey isku salaamaan.
en: Men and women also shake hands with each other.

so: Waa suurtagal in saaxiibada isu dhow ama ehelku ay hab-siin isku salaamaan.
en: Friends or relatives may also greet each other by hugging.

so: Dhabanada oo la iska dhunkadaase ma ahan wax caam ah.
en: However, cheek kissing is not common.

so: Marka aad qof kale la hadleyso, fiiri indhihiisa.
en: When you talk to others, look them in the eye.

so: Indha ka fiirintu waxey Finland ka dhigantahay in aad qofka kale ula dhaqmeyso si toos ah islamarkaasna daacad ah.
en: In Finland, looking someone in the eye communicates that you are being frank and honest towards that person.

so: Waa caado in afka Finnishka qofku loogu yeero magac koowaad ahaan.
en: When speaking Finnish, it is common to be on first-name terms with other people.

so: Dadka martida ah xittaa waxaa loogu yeeraa magac koowaad, sidaas si lamid ahna saaxiibada.
en: First-name terms are also used among strangers and colleagues.

so: Ugu yeerista magaca koowaad waxey dhacdaa oo kaliya marka lagu jiro xaalado rasmi ah.
en: Addressing others formally is reserved only for highly formal occasions.

so: Hase-yeeshee, waxaa wanaagsan in dadka waayeelka ah lagu yeero hab ka rasmi ah ama ka xushmo badan.
en: It is, however, a good idea to address elderly people more formally.

so: Finnishku waxey jecel yihiin in ay wada-hadalka toos uga billaabaan arrinta.
en: Finns like to start a conversation by going straight to the point.

so: Qaabka ay Finnishku u hadlaan waa mid toos ah oo aan leexleex laheyn.
en: The Finnish style of speech is direct and straightforward.

so: Finland waxaa loo heystaa in waxa dadku ay sheegayaan ay dhab ka tahay.
en: In Finland, people are expected to truly mean what they say.

so: Waxa aad dhahdo waxaa loo qaadanayaa run adigana waxaa lagaa sugayaa in aad wax u qabato si waafaqsan hadalkaada.
en: People believe what you say and expect you to act accordingly.

so: Wada-hadalka Finnishka waxaa soo dhexgeli kara xilliyo aamusnaan ah.
en: There may be a certain amount of quiet moments in conversations with Finns.

so: Aamusnaantu ma ahan arrin xun, ee waxaa loo dareensan yahay wax iska dabiici ah.
en: Silence is not a negative thing, it feels natural to Finns.

so: Xilliyada aamusnaanta looma baahna in hadal lagu buuxiyo.
en: There is no need to fill quiet moments with speech.

so: Hadalka codka waaweyn leh waxaa loo qaadan karaa wax aan wanaagsaneyn ama handadaad.
en: Loud speech can be thought of as unpleasant or threatening.

so: Qof kale oo hadalka laga kala gooyaa waxaa Finland looga arkaa in ay tahay xushmad daro.
en: In Finland, it is considered rude to interrupt people when they are speaking.

so: Sida caadiga ah Finnishku wey sugaan inta qofka ay la sheekeysanayo uu dhameysto hadalkiisa ka hor inta aysan hadlin.
en: Finns normally wait for their discussion partners to finish before speaking themselves.

so: Wax caadi ah ma ahan in dareenka loo muujiyo si fagaare ah.
en: It is uncommon in Finland to show your emotions in public.

so: Marka la hadlayo waa xushmad daro in codka kor loo qaado, gaar ahaan marka la joogo goob dadka ka dhexeysa.
en: It is considered rude to raise your voice when speaking, especially in a public place.

so: Finnishku waxey cunaan cuntooyinka lagu yaqaan Yurubiyiinta, taas oo ah inta badan hilib, kalluun, baradho, bariis ama baasto.
en: Finns eat fairly common European food consisting mostly of meat, fish, potatoes, rice or pasta.

so: Cunista cuntooyinka khudaarta ah waxey noqotay mid la jecel yahay.
en: Vegetarian food has become increasingly popular.

so: Waa iska caadi in la cuno labo cunto oo kulul, qado iyo casho.
en: It is common to eat two warm meals a day, lunch and dinner.

so: Dadka waaweyn xittaa Finland waxey inta badan ka cabaan caanaha.
en: In Finland, adults, too, often drink milk.

so: Qadada waxaa Finland laga cunaa waqti ka horeeya waqtiyada wadamo kale laga cuno.
en: In Finland, lunch is eaten earlier than in many other countries.

so: Goobaha shaqada iyo dugsiyada qadadu waa inta badan 11-12.
en: At workplaces and schools, lunch is usually served between 11 and 12 am.

so: Finland waxaa inta badan sare loo qaadaa caafimaadka cuntada.
en: Healthiness of food is often stressed in Finland.

so: Waxyaabaha ay ka midka yihiin rootiga madow iyo mushaariyooyin kala duduwan waxey qeyb muhiim ah ka yihiin dhaqanka cuntada Finnishka.
en: Rye bread and different porridges, among other things, are an important part of the Finnish food culture. The food cultures of different Finnish regions vary from each other.

so: Tusaale ahaan Lapland waxaa laga cunaa hilibka deerada, halka dhulka xeebahana laga cuno kalluun.
en: For example, reindeer meat is an important part of the Lappish cuisine, whereas fish is consumed a lot on the coast.

so: Dhinaca kale dhaqanka cuntadu wuu isbeddelaa.
en: On the other hand, food culture also changes.

so: Tusaale ahaan baastada Talyaaniga iyo dhaqanka cuntada Aasiyaanku waxey ka muuqdaan Finland.
en: Italian pastas and Asian food cultures are visible also in Finland.

so: Xannaano-maalmeedyada iyo dugsiyada waxaa carruurta iyo dhallinyarada laga siiyaa cunto.
en: Children and young people are served meals at day care and school.

so: Dhammaantood cuntada dugsigu waa u lacag la'aan, mana loo baahna in cunto loo soo qaato dugsiga.
en: School meals are free of charge for all and there is no need to bring a packed lunch to school.

so: Finland waxaa laga cabaa kafee badan.
en: Finns drink a lot of coffee.

so: Tusaale ahaan xafladaha ku dhowaad markasta waxaa laga bixiyaa kafee.
en: Coffee is nearly always served at celebrations, for example.

so: Shirarka goobta shaqada waxaa inta badan lagu cabaa kafee.
en: People often drink coffee at workplace meetings.

so: Finland cabitaanada aalkoladu waa qaali, gadashadooda waxaa lagu xiray da' dadka dhallinyarada ah dartood.
en: Alcoholic drinks are fairly expensive in Finland and their purchase by young people has been limited with age restrictions.

so: Dukaanka cuntada waxaa laga iibsan karaa oo kaliya cabitaanada aan cusleyn.
en: Only milder alcoholic drinks can be purchased at grocery stores.

so: Cabitaanada aalkolada ee culus waxaa laga gataa dukaamada
en: Strong alcoholic beverages are bought from government regulated

so: Wadista baabuurka iyadoo khamri la cabsan yahay waxaa macmnuucaya sharciga, waxaana ka dhalan kara ciqaab daran.
en: Driving a car under the influence of alcohol is prohibited and can lead to a severe punishment.

so: Wax ka cunista maqaayadaha Finland mid inta badan ka qaalisan wadamo kale oo badan.
en: Eating out in a restaurant is often more expensive in Finland than in many other countries.

so: Cabitaanada aalkolada xittaa waa ka qaali maqaayadaha.
en: Alcoholic drinks are also costly at restaurants.

so: Lacagta cabitaanka looma baahna in laga tago ama siiyo, haddii aan la dooneyn in loo dhiibto mahadcelin gaar ah oo ka dhalatay adeeg wanaagsan.
en: You do not need to leave a tip unless you want to give thanks for particularly good service.

so: Sawnadu waa qeyb muhiim ah oo kamid ah dhaqanka Finnishka.
en: Sauna is an important part of the Finnish culture.

so: Sawnada waxaa loogu tagalay qubeysashada iyo nasasho, sababtaas ayeey aamsunaanta iyo deganaantu ula xariiraan.
en: Sauna is for having a wash and relaxing, which means that peace and quiet are viewed as parts of the experience.

so: Finnish badan waxey sawnada galaan todobaad kasta.
en: Many Finns go to sauna every week.

so: Sawnada waxaa lala galaa xubnaha qoyska, saaxiibada iyo dadka ganacsiga lala wadaago.
en: People go to sauna with family members, friends and business partners alike.

so: Dumarka iyo raggu waqtiyo kala duwan ayeey sawnada galaan.
en: Women and men go to sauna at separate times.

so: Sawnada waxaa inta badan la galaa dhar la'aan.
en: It is common to go to sauna without any clothes.

so: Waxaa inta badan kursiga sawnada lagula fariistaa geed yar oo lagu fariisto.
en: You usually sit on a small sauna towel placed on the sauna bench.

so: Marti ku ahaanshaha guri Finnish
en: As a guest at a Finnish home

so: Finland u martinta guriga qof kale waa in markasta horay looga sii ballamaa, haddii xittaa uu yahay saaxiib aad isku wanaagsan tihiin.
en: In Finland, you should always agree upon visits to other people's homes in advance, even with good friends.

so: Finnishku waxey si gaar ah u qiimeeyaan gaar ahaanshaha iyo deganaanshaha.
en: Finns value their privacy and peace.

so: Waa xushmad in kabaha la iska siibo marka aad soo geleyso guriga qof kale.
en: When visiting a Finnish home, take off your shoes or ask if you can keep them on.

so: Tirada dadka Finland waa qiyaas ahaan 5,5 malyan oo qofood.
en: The population of Finland is approximately 5.5 million.

so: Finland waa dal bannaan.
en: Finland is a very sparsely populated country.

so: Dadku waxey si gaar ah ugu soo aruureen magaalooyinka waa weyn iyo deegaamada.
en: The population is concentrated particularly in the large cities and urban areas.

so: Soonaha caasimadda waxaa deggan dad ka badan malyan.
en: More than a million people live in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area.

so: Finnishka iyo Iswidhishku waa luqadaha qaranka.
en: Finnish and Swedish are Finland's national languages.

so: Finnishka waxaa sidii afkooda hooyo ugu hadla wax in yar ka yar 4,9 malyan oo qofood, Iswidhishkana wax yara ka yar 300,000 oo qofood.
en: Finnish as a native language is spoken by nearly 4.9 million people while Swedish is the native language of just under 300,000 people.

so: Marka laga reebo Finnishka iyo Iswidhiska waxaa ugu badan ee lagu hadlaa Ruushka, Istooniya, Ingiriis, Soomaali iyo Carabi.
en: The most prominent languages after Finnish and Swedish are Russian, Estonian, English, Somali and Arabic.

so: Dadka Finnishka ah waxaa ku jira dad laga tiro badan yahay oo kala duduwan, kuwaas oo tusaale ahaan leh luqad, dhaqan ama diin ka duwan inta badan dadka kale ee Finnishka.
en: The population of Finland includes a variety of minorities with a different language, culture or religion from the majority of Finns.

so: Dadka Finnishka ah ee laga tirada badan yahay islamarkaasna soo jireenka ah waa tusaale ahaan Iswiidhiska-Finland, dadka Saamaha ah, Roomaaniyiinta, Istooniyaanka, dadka ka yimid wadamada Balkan, Soomaalida iyo Ciraaqiyiinta.
en: Traditional Finnish minorities include the Swedish-speaking Finns, Sami, Romani, Jews and Tatars. In addition, many immigrants have arrived in Finland from Russia, Estonia, the Balkans, Somalia and Iraq, for example.

so: Inta badan dadka Finnishka ah waa Kirishtaan.
en: Most Finns are Christians.

so: Madhabta ugu weyn waa Kaniisadda Efangelis-luteeriga oo ay ka mid yihiin qiyaas ahaan 70% bulshadu.
en: The largest religious community in Finland is the Evangelical Lutheran Church of Finland (Suomen evankelis-luterilainen kirkko), to which about 70% of the population belongs.

so: Kaniisadda Ortodoksiga ee Finland waa madhab diimeedka labaad ee ugu weyn.
en: The Orthodox Church of Finland is the second largest religious community.

so: Wax yara kayar 1% bulshada ayaa ka tirsan kaniisadda Ortodoksiga.
en: Slightly over 1% of the population belongs to the Orthodox Church.

so: Kaniisadda Efangelis-luteeriga iyo kaniisadda Ortodoksiga waxey Finland ku leeyihiin derajo gaar ah.
en: The Evangelical Lutheran Church and the Orthodox Church enjoy a special status in Finland.

so: Tusaale ahaan waxey xaq u leeyihiin in ay canshuur qaataan.
en: They are entitled to levy taxes, for example.

so: Tobaneeye kun oo Muslimiin ah ayaa deggan Finland.
en: Tens of thousands of Muslims live in Finland.

so: Si kastoo ay ahaatase qeyb iyaga ka mid ah oo kaliya ayaa ka tirsan jimciyadaha Islaamiga ah.
en: However, only a portion of them belong to Islamic communities.

so: Helsinki iyo Turku waxaa ka shaqeeya macbudka Sinagoogiga.
en: Synagogues operate in Helsinki and Turku.

so: Jimciyad-diimeedyada kale ee Finland ka jira waa tusaale ahaan Kaniisadda Katooliga ee Finland. Kaniisadda Helluntai, Kaniisadda Xorta ah, Kaniisadda Adventi, Kaniisadda Mormoriga iyo tan kuwa raacsan Jehova.
en: Other religious communities in Finland include the Catholic Church in Finland, the Pentecostal Church, the Evangelical Free Church of Finland, the Seventh-day Adventist Church in Finland, the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints and Jehovah's Witnesses.

so: Xornimada diinta iyo ku cibaadeysashada diintaada gudaha Finland
en: Freedom of religion and practising your religion in Finland

so: Finland waxaa ka jira xorriyadda diimeed.
en: Finland has freedom of religion.

so: Dhammaan dadka ku nool Finland waxey xaq u leeyihiin in ay diinta ay rabaan doortaan islamarkaasna ku cibaadeystaan.
en: All those living in Finland are entitled to choose their own religion and practise it.

so: Cidna qasab kuma ahan in uu ka qeybqaato cibaadeysi diimeed.
en: Furthermore, no one is forced to take part in practising a religion.

so: Ugu yaraan 20 qofood oo qaangaar ah waxey sameysan karaan urur diimeed.
en: A group of at least 20 adult persons can establish a religious community.

so: Qasab kuma ahan koox diimeedka in ay isu diiwaangeliyaan urur diimeed ee kooxdu waxey shaqeyn kartaa xittaa diiwaangelis la'aan.
en: Religious groups do not need to register as a community; they can also operate without registration.

so: Waalidka ayaa go'aaminaya diinta cunugga qaadanayo.
en: Parents decide their child's religion.

so: Haddii ay waalidku ku aragti duwan yihiin arrinta, hooyada ayaa kaligeed go'aan ka gaari karta diinta cunugga 1 sano ka yar.
en: If parents disagree on the matter, the mother can decide the religion of a child under 1 year of age by herself.

so: Cunuggu xaq ayuu u leeyahay in uu dugsiga ku barto afkiisa hooyo.
en: Children have the right to receive education in their own religion in school.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Waxbarashada aasaasiga ah.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Comprehensive education.

so: Qofka qaangaarka ah, yacni qofka buuxiyay 18 sano wuxuu iskiis u go'aansan karaa diintiisa.
en: Adults, or those who have turned 18 years of age, can make their own decision regarding their religion.

so: Finland saxaafadu waa xor, taasi waxaa looga jeedaa, in ayna dawladu cayimi karin waxa saxaafadu qorayso haday tahay jaraaidka, telefeshanka ama wabsaydada internetka.
en: There is freedom of the press in Finland. This means that the state cannot dictate what is said in the media, such as newspapers, television or websites.

so: Wararka iyo barnaamijyada telefeshanka ee internetka
en: News and television programmes online

so: Finland waxaa kasoo baxa jaraaido badan.
en: Plenty of newspapers are published in Finland.

so: Ka ugu wayni waa Jaraa'idka odhaahda Helsinki ( Helsingin sanomat).
en: Helsingin Sanomat is the largest subscription newspaper in Finland.

so: Badanaa jaraa'idadu waxay kusoo baxaan af finish.
en: Most newspapers are in Finnish.

so: Qaarkood kale oo maxaliga ahina waxay kusoo baxaan afka iswidishka.Sidoo kale waxaa finland kasoo baxa jaraa'id lagu daabaco afka ruushka oo la yidhaahdo jaraa'idka Spektr.
en: Some newspapers are also published in Swedish in some localities. In addition, Russian Spektr newspaper is issued in Finland.

en: If you have an old television set, you also need to have a digital set-top box in order to watch television programmes.

en: New televisions sold in Finland already include a digital receiver.

so: Intooda badan waxaad ka dhagaysan kartaa xataa internetka.

en: Yle's radio channel Mondo offers radio programmes in English and many other languages.

so: Gaadiidka dadweynuhu Finland si fiican ayuu uga shaqeeyaa.
en: Public transport works well in Finland.

so: Tareenada iyo basaska waxaad ugu safri kartaa ku dhowaad dhammaan gudaha Finland.
en: You can travel almost anywhere in Finland by train or bus.

so: Magaalooyin badan waxaad sidoo kale ku tegi kartaa diyaarad.
en: You can also reach many cities by air.

so: Magaalooyinka waaweyn iyo kuwa u dhow waxaa sidoo kale ka jira gaadiid deegaaneed si fiican u shaqeeya.
en: In addition, the largest cities and their neighbouring areas usually have well organised local public transport.

so: Gaadiidka deegaanku wuxuu inta badan ku shaqeeyaa basaska.
en: Buses are normally used for local transport.

so: Gaadiidka tareenada waxaa Finland gacanta ku haya VR.
en: The railway traffic in Finland is handled by VR.

so: Waxaad ka iibsan kartaa tikidhida tareenka shabakadda VR, saldhigyada tareenada iyo tareenada gudahooda.
en: You can purchase train tickets via VR's website, at railway stations and on trains.

so: Macluumaadka jadwalka tareenada waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga shabakadda VR ama saldhigyada tareenada.
en: Information on train timetables is available on VR's website and at railway stations.

so: Shirkadaha basaska ee gudaha Finland waa badan yihiin.
en: There are many bus companies in Finland.

so: Waxaad tikidhada baska ka iibsan kartaa goobaha shaqada ama bogagga shabakadda Matkahuolto (Adeegga safarka).
en: You can buy bus tickets at Matkahuolto offices or on the company's website.

so: Macluumaadka jadwalka basaska waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga shabakadda Matkahuolto ama goobaha shaqada ee Matkahuolto.
en: Information on bus timetables can be found on the Matkahuolto website and at Matkahuolto offices.

en: conscripts in military and civil service
