en: The website of the Finnish Transport Agency features the matka.fi service, which is a public transport route service for finding the most suitable route and mode of travel.

so: Finland waxaa ku yaalla 24 garoon diyaaradeed.
en: Finland has 24 airports.

so: Garoonka ugu weyn waa garoonka diyaaradaha ee Helsinki-Vantaa.
en: The largest is Helsinki-Vantaa Airport.

so: Shirkado diyaaradeed badan ayaa waxay fidiyaan duulimaadyo Finland ka baxaya oo dibadda aadaya.
en: Many airlines offer flights from Finland to foreign countries.

so: Inta badan diyaaradaha dibadda aadaya waxay ka baxaan garoonka diyaaradaha ee Helsinki-Vantaa.
en: Most of the foreign flights depart from Helsinki-Vantaa Airport.

so: Iibsashada iyo isticmaalka baabuurku waa mid yara qaali ah Finland.
en: Buying and operating a car in Finland is fairly expensive.

so: Baabuurta xaaladoodu wannagsan tahay waxay joogaan kumanaan yuuro.
en: Cars in good condition cost several thousands of euros.

so: Iibsashada iyo isticmaalka baabuurka waxaa sidoo kale la xiriira qarash badan sida, tusaale ahaan
en: Many expenses are related to the ownership and use of a car, such as

so: Haddii aad leedahay baabuur, waxaa qasab kugu ah inaad gasho caymiska gaadiidka (liikennevakuutus).
en: If you own a car, you must take out a motor insurance policy (liikennevakuutus).

so: Caymiska gaadiidka waxaad ka heleysaa shirkadaha caymiska.
en: A motor insurance policy can be obtained from an insurance company.

so: Finland baabuurka waa in la soo koontaroolaa islamarkaasna la rajistareeyaa.
en: In Finland, cars must be inspected and registered.

so: Koontaroolka baabuurta waxaa sameeya xarumaha koontaroolka.
en: Vehicle inspections are conducted by inspection stations.

so: Rajistareeshinka waxaa laga sameystaa sidoo kale xarumaha koontaroolka baabuurta, shirkadaha caymiska iyo goobaha lagu gado baabuurta.
en: Registrations are carried out at inspection stations, insurance companies and car dealerships, for example.

so: Internetkana waad ka sameysan kartaa rajistareeshinka.
en: You can also register a vehicle online.

so: Finland sharciga ayaa amraya in baabuurka ay ku jiraan lugaha jiilaalka ama barafka xilliga jiilaalka.
en: The Finnish law requires cars to have winter tyres in the winter.

so: Xilliga jiilaalka waxaad isticmaali kartaa lugaha leh biinanka ama kuwa kale nastada leh.
en: You can use either studded or snow tyres.

so: Baabuurka ay ku jiraan lugaha nasta waxaa sahlan in lagu koontaroolaa wadooyinka taraaraxa ah.
en: A car with studded tyres is easier to handle on a slippery road.

so: Si kastoo ay ahaataba lama isticmaali karo lugaha nasta xilliga xagaaga.
en: However, you cannot use studded tyres in the summer.

so: Finland waa in si dhab ah loogu hogaansamaa sharciga waadooyinka.
en: In Finland, traffic rules must be observed carefully.

so: Booliska ayaa ilaaliya u hogaansanaanta sharciga wadooyinka.
en: The police enforce adherence to the traffic rules.

so: Jebinta sharciyada wadooyinka waxaa laga heli karaa ganaax.
en: You can get fined for breaking the traffic rules.

so: Waditaanka gaadiidka kasta oo matoor leh waa dembi, haddii uu waduhu daroogeysan yahay (khamro ama daroogo).
en: Driving any motor vehicle is a crime if the driver is intoxicated (alcohol or drugs).

so: Si aad u wado baabuur waxaad u baahan tahay laysinka baabuurta.
en: You need a driving licence to drive a car.

so: Si aad u hesho kaarka ama laysinka baabuurta waa inaad ahaataa ugu yaraan 18 sano jir.
en: In order to qualify for the licence, you must be at least 18 years of age.

so: Kahor inta aadan helin laysinka baabuurta waa inaad ka qeyb-qaadataa waxbarashada wadista kadibna aad sameysaa imtixaanka wadaha.
en: Before gaining a driving licence, you must take part in driving training and take a driving test.

so: Barashada wadista waxaad ka heli kartaa iskuulka wadista.
en: Driving training is provided at driving schools.

so: Tusaale ahaan waxaa sidoo kale wadista ku bari kara qaraabo ama qof aad taqaano oo heysta laysinka islamarkaasna waayo-aragnimo u leh wadista baabuurta ah.
en: You can also be taught by a family member or friend, for example, who has a driving licence and experience.

so: Arrintan darteed, si kastaba ha ahaatee Trafi ayaa ogolaanshiyaha looga baahan yahay.
en: However, this requires a teaching permit from Trafi.

so: Waditaanka mootada waxaa loogu baahan yahay laysinka lagu wado mootada.
en: A motorcycle licence is required to ride a motorcycle.

so: Laysinka aad u baahan tahay wuxuu ku xiran yahay nooca mooto ee aad dooneyso inaad wado.
en: The type of the licence depends on the motorcycle you wish to ride.

so: Dhugdhuleyda ama mootada yar wadisteeda waxaad ugu baahan tahay laysinka mootada, haddii aadan heysan laysinka wadista. Kaarka
en: If you do not have a driving licence, riding a moped requires a moped licence.

so: Macluumaad ku saabsan kaarka wadista waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga shabakadda booliska iyo Hogaanka ammaanka wadooyinka (Liikenteen turvallisuusvirasto).
en: Information on the driving licences is available on the websites of the police and the Finnish Transport Safety Agency (Liikenteen turvallisuusvirasto).

so: Laysinka ajnabiga ee Finland lagu heysto
en: Foreign driving licences in Finland

so: Haddii aad haysatid kaarka gawaarida lagu wado oo laga bixiyey mid ka mid ah wadamada waqooyiga yurub, wadamada midowga yurub ama wadamada ETA, markaas sidoo kale leysinku wuu ka shaqaynayaa dalka Finland.
en: If you have a driving licence issued in a Nordic country, an EU member state or an EEA country, it is also valid in Finland.

so: Waxaad u badeli kartaa leysin Finnish ah, waa haddii aad si rasmi ah u degantahay Finland.
en: You can exchange it for a Finnish driving licence if you are residing in Finland permanently.

so: Haddii aad haysatid kaarka gawaarida lagu wado oo laga bixiyey wadan kale oo ku jira wadamada sixiixay heshiiska jidadka ee Geneva ama Wien, markaas waxaad leysinka gaari ku wadan kartaa dalka Finland gudihiisa ugu badnaan labo sano.
en: If you have a driving licence issued in a country that is party to the Geneva or Vienna Conventions on Road Traffic, the licence is valid in Finland for two years.

so: Waa inaad leysinka u badeshid kan Finnishka labo sano kadib laga soo bilaabo markii aad Finland u soo guurtay.
en: After this period, you must exchange your licence for a Finnish driving licence.

so: Haddii aad haysatid kaar laga bixiyey wadan aan ka mid ahayn wadamada sixiixay heshiiska jidadka ee Geneva ama Wien. Sannad ayaad ku wadan kartaa baabuur kaarkan marka adiga laguugu qoro diiwaanka dadka ee Finland.
en: If you have a driving licence from a country that is not party to the Geneva or Vienna Conventions on Road Traffic, the licence is valid in Finland for one year after you are entered into the Finnish population register.

so: Leysinkaada waxaad goobta adeegga ee Ajovarma ugu beddelan kartaa leysinka Finnishka.
en: You can exchange your driving licence for a Finnish driving licence at an Ajovarma service point.

so: Ballan ayaad horay uga sii qabsan kartaa bogagga shabakadda ee Ajovarma.
en: You can book an appointment in advance through the Ajovarma website.

so: Cimilada Finland way ka qabowdahay wadamo badan oo kale.
en: The Finnish climate is colder than in many other countries.

so: Sidaas oo ay tahay cimilada isbadbadal badan ayaa ku yimaada sanadka wakhtiyadiisa kala duwan.
en: However, the weather varies significantly in different seasons.

so: Wakhtiga jiilaalka Finland waa qabow waxana da'a baraf.
en: In the winter, the Finnish weather is cold with snowfalls.

so: Sida caadiga ah barafku dhulka ayuu yaalaa jiilaalka oo dhan.
en: Normally, the country is under a permanent snow cover throughout the winter.

so: Waqooyiga Finland cabirka selsiusku wuxuu gaadhi karaa illaa -30.
en: In Northern Finland, the temperature can be as low as -30°C.

so: Haddii dhulka ay mar wada yaallaan baraf iyo barafka dhalada noqda, dhulku waa sibiibix ama taraarax.
en: If the ground is covered with snow and ice, it is also slippery.

so: Wakhtiga jiilaalka waxa muhiimad gaar ah leh in uu qofku si dugsoon u labisto.
en: In the winter you need to dress warmly.

so: Taasi macnaheedu waxa weeyaan in uu qofku ugu yaraan xidho jaakeed ama koodh sare oo culus, funaanad culus, koofiyad, gacmo ama gloofis, maro uu qoorta ku duuduubto iyo in uu xidho kabo jiilaal oo culus.
en: This means that you should wear at least a padded jacket, a woolly jumper and a woolly hat, gloves, a scarf and warm winter shoes.

so: Wakhtiga cimiladu ay qabowdahay waxa muhiim ah in uu dhar badan iska dul xidho qofku.
en: You should wear several layers of clothing in cold weather.

so: Jiilaalka Finland waa wakhti aad u mugdi badan, sababta oo ah qoraxdu waxay soo baxdaa barqadii waxayna dhacdaa galabta horeba.
en: In Finland, it is often dark in the winter because the sun rises late in the morning and sets in the afternoon.

so: Waqooyiga Finland ayaa ka mugdi badan koonfurta Finland.
en: Winter days are darker in Northern Finland than in Southern Finland.

so: Finland qaybaheeda waqooyiga sare ah waxa yimaadda wakhti aynan qoraxdu sooba bixin muddo isbuucyo ah.
en: In the northernmost part of Finland, the sun does not rise at all for several weeks.

so: Caadiyen barafku waxa uu dhalaalaa bisha saddexaad ama bisha afraad.
en: The snow normally melts in March or April.

so: Gugu waxa uu koonfurta Finland bilowdaa dhamaadka bisha sadexaad, waqooyiga Finlandna waxa uu ku bilowdaa dhamaadka bisha afraad.
en: In Southern Finland, spring begins at the end of March whereas, in the north, spring comes at the end of April.

so: Caadiyen wakhtigaas cimiladu way qabowdahay wali, laakiin way ka diirantahay wakhtiga jiilaalka.
en: The spring weather is often cool, but warmer than in winter.

so: Wakhtiga guga dhirta iyo cimilada isbadal badan ayaa ku dhaca marka uu barafku dhalaalo, geeduhu ay caleemaha dib u soo baxsadaan dhirtuna ay dib u soo baxdo.
en: During the spring, the nature goes through a great deal of change as the snow and ice melt away, trees sprout leaves and plants begin to grow.

so: Koonfurta Finland wakhtigaas hawada kulaylkeedu waxay gaadhaa illaa 20 selsius waqooyiga Finlandna waxay gaadhaa illaa 15 selsius.
en: In Southern Finland, the average temperature in the summer is about 20°C while the temperature in the north is about 15°C.

so: Habeenkii iyo maalintiiba waa iftiin badan maadaama ay qoraxdu dhacdo wakhti dambe ayna soo baxdo wakhti hore.
en: Evenings and nights are bright in Finland during the summer, as the sun sets late and rises early.

so: Waqooyiga Finland ayaa ka iftiin badan koonfurta Finland.
en: Then, Northern Finland has more daylight hours than Southern Finland.

so: Markaas waxaa Finland laga xusaa Yuhanuska, habeenka aysan qoraxdu dhicin iyo bartamaha xagaaga.
en: In Finland, Midsummer, the night of the midnight sun, is celebrated in June.

so: Finland qaybaheeda ugu sareeya ee waqooyiga qoracdu bilowga xagaaga maba dhacdo.
en: In the northernmost part of Finland, the sun does not set at all in early summer.

so: Cimiladu badanaa way qabowdahay roobab iyo dabayllo badana way wadataa.
en: The weather is cool and often rainy and windy.

so: Wakhtigaas mugdiduna wuu soo bataa maadaama ay qoraxdu dhacdo wakhti ka horeysa wakhtiga ay dhici jirtay jiilaalka.
en: The Finnish autumn is also dark because the sun sets earlier than in the summer.

so: baraxka ugu horreeya waxa uu sida caadiga ah da'aa bisha Oktoobar ama Nofembar.
en: The first snowfall usually arrives in October or November.

so: Dadku way yimaadaan Finland
en: People arrive in Finland

so: Qiyaastii 10 000 oo sano kahor waxaa bilowday in Finland ay dadku u soo guuraan.
en: Approximately 10,000 years ago, people began to move to Finland.

so: Waxay ka yimaadeen dhinaca bari ee hadda ah soonaha Ruushka iyo koonfurta iyagoo soo maraya Baltika.
en: They came from the east from current Russia and from the south through the Baltic region.

so: Xididada luqada Finnishku waxay ka soo jeedaan Bartamaha Ruushka, laakiin waxaa luqada Finnishka ku milmay waxyaabo luqadaha Germaaniga iyo Baltika ka yimid.
en: The roots of the Finnish language are in Central Russia, but the language has elements of Baltic and Germanic languages, too.

so: Bulshada luqadeedu tahay Iswidishka waxay Finland ku sugnaayeen qiyaastii 800 oo sano.
en: Swedish-speaking people have lived in Finland for over 800 years.

so: Finland oo qeyb ka ah Sweden iyo Ruushka
en: Finland as part of Sweden and Russia

so: Intii waqtigan lagu jiray Sweden iyo Ruushka ayaa ku dagaalay saameyn awood ku yeelashada Finland.
en: During this time, Sweden and Russia fought frequently over their influence in Finland.

so: Ugu dambeyntii 1809kii guud ahaan Finland waxay u hoos wareegtay awooddii Ruushku, markii ay Ruushku ku guuleysteen dagaalkii ay Sweden la galeen.
en: Finally in 1809, Finland in its entirety came under Russian rule after Russia won its war against Sweden.

so: Finland waxay Ruushka ka mid ah aheyd 1809–1917.
en: Finland belonged to Russia from 1809 to 1917.

so: Waqtigaas waxay Finland heysatay is-maamul, Finnishkuna waxay awoodeen in arrimo badan ay si xor ah go'aan uga garaan.
en: During this period, Finland was autonomous, which meant that Finns could decide on many matters independently.

so: Si kastoo ay ahaataba markaas Finland waxaa xukumayay boqorka Ruushka.
en: However, the ruler of Finland was the Emperor of Russia.

so: Luqada Finnishka, dhaqanka Finnishka iyo dhaqaaluhu waxay wax badan horumareen waqtigii ay Finland kamid aheyd Ruushka.
en: The language, culture and economy of Finland developed greatly during the period under Russian rule.

so: Dhammaadkii dagaalkii koowaad ee adduunka Finland waxay ka ruqday Ruushka, kadib markii baarlamaanka Finland uu aqbalay ku dhawaaqista xornimada 6dii Disembar 1917kii.
en: In the final phases of World War I, Finland separated itself from Russia when the Parliament of Finland approved the declaration of independence on 6 December 1917.

so: Markaas waxay Finland noqotay wadan madaxbanaan, maalintana waxaa illaa iyo hadda loo xusaa maalinta xornimada Finland.
en: This made Finland an independent country, and the day is still celebrated as Finnish Independence Day.

so: Gu'gii 1918kii waxaa Finland ka dhacay dagaal sokeeye oo ay isaga soo horjeedeen casaankii metelayay dabqadda shaqaalaha iyo burjuwaasiyiinta iyo cadaankii metelayay milkiilayaasha dhulka.
en: In the spring of 1918, a civil war broke out in Finland in which the Reds representing the working people and the Whites representing the bourgeoisie and landowners fought one another.

so: Dagaalki wuxuu dhamaaday Maajo 1918 markii ay guuleysteen cadaankii.
en: The war ended in May 1918 with the Whites gaining victory over the Reds.

so: Xoroobisti kadib Finland waxay noqotay jamhuuriyad ay sharciga u dejiyaan baarlamaan ay dadku doorteen.
en: The independent Finland became a republic where laws are passed by a parliament elected by the people.

so: Madaxa dowladdu waa madaxweyne, ma ahan boqor ama amiir.
en: The head of state is the president, instead of an emperor or king.

so: Dagaalkii jiilaalka iyo dagaalkii sii-socday
en: Winter War and Continuation War

so: Dhammaadkii Nofembar 1939 ciidamaddii Midowgi Sofyeeti ayaa soo weeraray Finland.
en: At the end of November in 1939, the Soviet army attacked Finland.

so: Intii lagu jiray dagaalkii labaad ee adduunka Finland waxay labo dagaal la gashay Ruushka: dagaalkii jiilaalka ee 1939- 1940 kadibna dagaalkii sii-socday 1941- 1944.
en: During World War II, Finland fought two wars against the Soviet Union: first the Winter War from 1939 to 1940, followed by the Continuation War from 1941 to 1944.

so: Dagaaladan dartood Midowgi Sofiyeeti wuxuu dhul ka qabsaday Finland.
en: The wars caused Finland to lose areas to the Soviet Union.

so: In ka badan 400 000 oo Finnish ah ayaa waxay qaxooti ahaan uga soo tageen dhulka la qabsaday ama lumiyay iyagoo soo aaday gudaha Finland.
en: Over 400,000 Finns left the lost areas as refugees to escape to the Finland that still remained.

so: Dadka Finnishka ah arrinta ugu muhiimsan waxay aheyd in Finland ahaado wadan xor ah.
en: However, the most important thing to the Finns was that Finland maintained its independence.

so: Dagaaladi kadib Finnish badan ayaa waxay ka cabsanayeen in Midowga Sofiyeeti uu isku dayi doono in uu Finland ka dhigo dal shuuci ah, maxaa yeelay sidan waxay ku dhacday wadamo kale oo yurub ah islamarkaasna deris ah.
en: After the wars, many Finns feared that the Soviet Union would attempt to make Finland a socialist nation, as this had happened to other European neighbours of the Soviet Union.

so: Si kastoo ay ahaataba waxaa Finland u suurtagashay inay xiriiro wannaagsan la sameysto Sofiyeetigi, ay sii heysato nidaamkeedi dimuquraadiyadda ku saleysnaa iyo inay kordhiso ganacsigi kala dhexeeyay wadamada reer galbeedka ah.
en: However, Finland succeeded in forging good relations with the Soviet Union, maintaining its democratic system and increasing trade with Western countries. In terms of foreign policy, Finland was forced to balance between the Soviet Union and the West for a long time.

so: Dagaaladi kadib Finland waxay ka wareegtay dhaqaale dhuleedkii waxayna isu bedeshay wadan warshadeed.
en: After the wars, Finland transformed from an agricultural country into an industrial one.

so: Markii ay Finland warshadowday waxay Finnishku awoodeen inay dibadda u iib-geeyaan wax badan oo waxsoosaarka warshadaha ah.
en: With this industrialisation, Finns could sell more and more industrial products abroad.

so: Finland waxay dibadda si gaar ah ugu dhoofisay warqadaha iyo waxsoosaarada kale ee dhinaca dhirta.
en: Finland especially exported paper and other forestry products.

so: Arrima badan ayaa iska bedelay gudaha bulshada Finnishka ah.
en: Many things in Finnish society changed.

so: Dad badan ayaa baadiyaha ka soo guuray oo magaaloyinka u soo guuray, dumar badanna waxay billaabeen inay aadaan shaqooyin guryaha ka baxsan.
en: Plenty of people moved from the countryside to cities, and an increasing number of women began to work outside the home.

so: Adeegyada bulshada ayaa la billaabay in la horumariyo, sidan waxaa ku dhashay adeegga caafimaadka ee dadka, ammaanka bulshada iyo dugsiga dhexe.
en: The development of public services began, which led to public health care, social welfare and comprehensive school.

so: 1960kii boqolaal kun oo Finnish ah ayaa u guuray Sweden, sababtoo ah shaqo badan ayaa halkaas ka jirtay, mushaaraadkuna waa ka sareeyeen kuwa Finland.
en: In the 1960s, hundreds of thousands of Finns moved to Sweden as there was more work there and the pay was better.

so: Laga soo billaabo 1990 illaa iyo sanadkii labada kun
en: From the 1990s into the new millennium

so: Bilowgii 1990kii markii uu Midowgi Sofiyeeti uu burburay, Finland waxaa ku dhacey dhibaatoyin dhaqaale, sababtoo ah ganacsigii kala dhexeeyay Midowgii Sofiyeeti ayaa dhamaaday.
en: With the collapse of the Soviet Union in the early 1990s, Finland plunged into recesssion as the trade with the Soviets ceased.

so: Markaas shirkado badan ayaa kacay, arrintaasna waxaa laga dhaxlay shaqaale badan inay waayaan shaqadoodi.
en: At the time, numerous companies went bankrupt, which led to many people losing their jobs.

so: Dhaqaale daridaas kadib Finland waxaa u abuurmay shaqooyin badan oo teknolajiyada warshaqadaha sare ah.
en: After the recession, plenty of high-technology industry and related jobs were created in Finland.

so: Dad badan ayaa sidoo kale ka helay shaqooyin xirfadaha adeegyada ee kala duduwan.
en: More and more people were also working in various service sector professions.

so: 1990 waxaa bilowday in Finland wadamo kale uga soo guuraan dad badan.
en: In the 1990s, an increasing number of people began to move to Finland from other countries.

so: Qaxooti ayaa wadamo badan Finland uga yimid iyo weliba bulashadii Finnishka asal ahaan ka soo jeeday ee ka yimid Midowgii Sofiyeetigii hore.
en: Refugees arrived in Finland from many countries, along with people from the former Soviet Union who had a Finnish background.

so: Sidoo kale dad badan ayaa sidoo kale Finland ugu soo guuray waxbarasho, shaqo ama qoys dartiis.
en: Many also moved to Finland for studies, employment or family reasons.

so: Finland waxay xubin ka noqotay sanadkii 1995tii midowga Yurub (EU).
en: In 1995, Finland became a member of the European Union (EU).

so: Finland waxay sanadkii 2002 qaadatay lacagtii wadaagga aheyd ee ugu horeysay ee ay yeeshaan koox wadamada Midowga Yurub kamid ah, taas oo aheyd yuurada, sidaasna waxay uga hartay lacagteedi.
en: In 2002, Finland adopted the common EU currency, the euro, among the first EU countries, thereby relinquishing its own currency.

so: Dhisinta ladnaanta horumarka-Qarnigii Finland iyo reer Virtanen
en: Creating Finnish welfare: a century of Finland and the Virtanen family

so: Finland waxay mar walba aheyd goob yar oo waqooyiga ku taal una dhexeysa bariga iyo galbeedka.
en: Finland has always been a small, northern place between the East and the West.

so: Taariikhda Finland waa sheego ku saabsan marinno ganacsi, kulan-dhaqameedyo iyo nolol ku dhinac taal wadamo waaweyn oo deris ah.
en: Finnish history is a story of trading routes, clashes of cultures and life next to great neighbours.

so: Taariikhdi hore ee Finland -1323
en: Finnish prehistory to 1323

so: Soonaha Finland waa la deganaa laga soo billaabo xilliga barafka, qiyaas ahaan sannadki 8800 ka hor inta aan la billaabin tirinta taariikhda milaadiga ah.
en: People have lived in the region of Finland since the Ice Age, circa 8800 BCE.

so: Deegaanku wuxuu marki hore ku bullaalay hareeraha marin-biyoodka, waxaana markasta soonaha Finland dhexmari jiray ganacsi xooggan.
en: Habitation first settled along water routes, and since then busy trading traffic has always passed through the region.

so: Magaalada u qadiimsan Finland waa Turku, magaceedu wuxuu ka dhigan yahay goob ganacsi.
en: The name of Finland's oldest city, Turku, means 'place of trade'.

so: Markaas waxaa Finland lagu safarka mucatabka lagula daray dhulka uu xukumi jiray Baadariga Rooma iyo shabakadda ganacsatada Hansa ee xilligi dhexe.
en: Around that time, crusades brought Finland into the sphere of power of the Roman Pope and the medieval network of Hansa traders.

so: Kaniisadda Katooliga ayaa Finland uga soo fidday dhinaca Iswiidhan, kaniisadda Ortodhoksiguna waxay ka timid dhinaca bariga, Novgorod oo hadda ka tirsan dhulka Ruushka.
en: The Catholic Church spread to the region of Finland from Sweden, while the Orthodox Church did the same from Novgorod, currently Russia, in the East.

so: Dagaalki dhulka ka dhashay ee u dhexeeyay Novgorod iyo Iswiidhan wuxuu ku dhammaaday heshiiski Pähkinäsaari ee dhacay 1323.
en: The struggle for control of the region between Sweden and Novgorod ended with the Treaty of Nöteborg in 1323.

so: Heshiiskaas wuxuu keenay in ay Finland saldhigto diinta katooliga ah ee Galbeedka iyo diinta Ortodoksiga ah ee bariga.
en: With the treaty, the Catholic faith was established in western Finland and the Orthodox faith in eastern Finland.

so: Xadka diimahan u dhexeeya waa mid weli jirta, laakiin sifeynti diinta ayaa diinta Katooliga u beddeshay tan Luteeriga.
en: This religious boundary still exists, although the Reformation replaced Catholicism with Lutheranism.

so: Qeybta bari ee Iswidhan 1323-1809
en: Easternmost part of Sweden 1323–1809

so: Taariikhda Finland waa qiyaas ahaan 500 oo sannadood taariikhda Iswidhan.
en: For about 500 years, Finnish history is Swedish history.

so: Dhulka Finland wuxuu Iswidhan u ahaan jug-dhowraha ama difaaca bariga, xuduuduhuna marar badan oo dagaalo kala duduwan lagu jiray ayeey isbeddeleen.
en: The region of Finland was Sweden's buffer against the East, and the borders shifted many times in various wars.

so: Finnishku waxay isu heystaan in ay yihiin Yurubiinta Galbeedka, sababtoo ah mudadi ay kamid aheyd Boqortooyadi Iswidhan ayaa Finnishka si adag ugu xirtay dhaxalka dhaqanka Galbeedka.
en: Finns consider themselves Western Europeans because the time as a part of the Kingdom of Sweden strongly tied Finns to the Western cultural heritage.

so: Tusaale ahaan askarta Finnishku waxay dagaalki soddonka sannadood socda ee Bartamaha Yurub ka qeybgaleen iyagoo ku jira ciidamada Iswidhan.
en: For example, Finns fought in the Thirty Years' War with Swedish troops in Central Europe.

so: Isla-wakhtigaas waxaa jiray si kastaba ha ahaatee xiriir lala lahaa xarumaha ganacsiga bariga iyo kaniisadda Ortodoksi.
en: At the same time, however, there were also connections to eastern trade centres and the Orthodox Church.

so: 1523 waxaa Iswidhan boqor ka noqday Kustaa Vaasa wuxuu Iswidhan ka saarfan midowgi wadamada Waqooyiga Yurub ee xilligi dhexe
en: 1523 Gustav I becomes King of Sweden and withdraws Sweden from the medieval union of the Nordic countries

so: 1543 Finland waxaa ka soo baxay Aapinen ugu horeeyay oo ku qoran luqada Finnishka
en: 1543 The first ABC book written in Finnish is published in Finland

so: 1550 waxaa la aasaasay Helsinki si ay Tallin ugula tartanto ganacsiga Badda Baltiga
en: 1550 Helsinki is founded to compete with Tallinn for Baltic Sea trade

so: 1640 waxaa Turku laga asaasay jaamacaddi ugu horeysay ee Finlan
en: 1640 The first university in Finland is established in Turku

so: Finland oo ka mid ah boqortooyada Ruushka 1809-1917
en: Finland as a part of the Russian Empire 1809–1917

so: Boqor Ruushka Alexander I ayaa Finland siiyay derajada saldano weyn.
en: The Emperor of Russia, Alexander I gave Finland the status of a Grand Duchy.

so: Inta badan sharciyadi ka yimid wakhtigi Iswidhan waxay aheeyn kuwa sii shaqeynayay.
en: Most of the laws from the time of the Swedish rule remained in force.

so: Finland waxay isu-beddashay mudadi ay ku hoos-jirtay awooddi Ruushka dhul gaar ah oo lagu horumariyay amar ka soo baxay boqorki.
en: During the Russian rule, Finland became a special region developed by order of the Emperor.

so: Tusaale ahaan bartamaha Helsinki waxaa la dhisay inti uu Ruushka heystay.
en: For example, Helsinki city centre was built during Russian rule.

so: Ruushku wuxuu laga billaabo sannadki 1899 gacan adag ku qabaty saldanadi Finland.
en: Starting from 1899, Russia tightened its grip on the Grand Duchy of Finland.

so: Finland kama qeybqaadan dagaal koowaad ee adduunka, laakiin waddanimadu xittaa dhulka Finland waa saameysay.
en: Finland did not take part in World War I, but nationalism also had an influence on the region of Finland.

so: Finland waxaa loo ogolaaday baarlamaan u gaar ah sannadki 1906di doorashooyinki ugu horeeyayna waxaa la qabanqaabiyay 1907.
en: Finland was granted its own parliament in 1906, and the first elections were held in 1907.

so: 1812 Helsinki ayaa noqotay Caasimad
en: 1812 Helsinki becomes the capital

so: 1860 Finland waxaa laga billaabay isticmaal lacag u gaar ah, maarkaha
en: 1860 Finland adopts its own currency, the markka

so: 1906 Xaqa isku midka ah ee codeynta guud, dumarka xittaa waa la siiyay
en: 1906 Universal and equal right to vote, also for women

so: Marxaladihi hore ee xorriyadda 1917-1945
en: Early years of independence 1917–1945

so: Muddadi billowga xorriyadda, maqaamka Finland wuxuu ahaa mid daciif ah.
en: In the early years of independence, Finland's position was fragile.

so: Wax yar ka dib helitaanka xornimada waxaa Finland ka qarxay dagaal dhiig sokeeye oo dhiig ku daatay.
en: Soon after independence, a bloody civil war broke out in Finland.

so: Dagaalku wuxuu u dhexeeyay ciidamadi ururki shaqaalaha casaanka iyo xukuumaddi caddaanka.
en: The war was fought between the Reds or labour movement and the Whites or government troops.

so: Caddaanku waxay taageero ka heleen Jarmalka Casaankuna Ruushka.
en: The Whites received support from Germany and the Reds from Russia.

so: Dagaalki wuxuu ku dhamaaday guul ay caddaanki gaareen.
en: The war ended in the Whites' victory.

so: Finland waxay si aad ah ugu jirtay xeyndaabka uu Jarmalku saameynta ku lahaa, sababtoo ah Midowgi Sofiyeeti ayaa halis weyn ku noqday ammaanka dowladda.
en: Finland was strongly in the German sphere of influence because the Soviet Union became the biggest threat to the security of the state.

so: 1930kii aadki ururo badan oo midigta iyo midigta fog ah ayaa ahaa kuwa Finland laga jecelyahay sidi looga jeclaa wadamo kale oo Yurub ku yaal.
en: In the 1930s, many right-wing and far-right movements were popular in Finland, as in other parts of Europe.

so: Agoosto 1939 ayeey Naasiga Jarmalka iyo Midowgi Soofiyeeti ku heshiiyeen in Finland ay noqoto safka hore ee Midowga Soofiyeeti.
en: In August 1939, Nazi Germany and the Soviet Union agreed that Finland belonged in the Soviet Union's sphere of influence.

so: Finland waxay inti lagu jiray Dagaalki labaad ee Adduunka labo mar la dagaashay Midowgi Soofiyeeti iyadoo la safan Jarmalka.
en: During World War II, Finland fought on two occasions against the Soviet Union on the German side.

so: Finland labada dagaalba waa ku guuldareysatay, laakiin Midowgi Sofiyeeti marna ma uusan qabsan Finland.
en: Finland lost both wars, but the Soviet Union never occupied Finland.

so: 1918 Dagaalki sokeeye ee casaanka iyo caddaanka u dhexeeyay
en: 1918 Civil War between the Reds and Whites

so: 1921 Sharciga waajibka waxbarashada ayaa qasab uga dhigay dhammaan lix sano jiryada in ay galaan dugsiga ummadda
en: 1921 Act on compulsory education makes it mandatory to attend six years of elementary school

so: 1939-1940 Finland waxay qeyb ka noqotay dagaalki labaad ee adduunka, marki uu dagaalki jiilaalku ka dhex dhashay Finland iyo Midowgi Sofiyeeti
en: 1939–1940 Finland is thrust into World War II when the Winter War breaks out between Finland and the Soviet Union

so: 1941-1944 Dagaalki labaad ee adduunka ayaa isagoo dagaalki sii socday ah sii dhexmaray Finland iyo Midowgi Sofiyeeti
en: 1941–1944 World War II continues as Continuation War between Finland and the Soviet Union

so: Dibu-dhiski, warshadoobista iyo dagaalki qaboobaa 1945-1991
en: Rebuilding, industrialisation and the Cold War 1945–1991

so: Maadaama ay Finland ku guuldareysatay dagaalki waxaa qasab ku noqday in ay Midowgi Sofiyeeti u siiso magdhow dagaal oo alaab ahaan ah.
en: As a defeated party, Finland had to pay the Soviet Union heavy war reparations in the form of goods.

so: Magdhow dagaal ahaan waxaa loo bixiyay tusaale ahaan tareenno, maraakiib iyo alaab ceyriin.
en: The war reparations included, for example, trains, ships and raw materials.

so: Finland waxay dhismaha alaabta ku maalgelisay deyn iyo caawimaad.
en: Finland financed the building of the goods with loans and aid.

so: Soo saarista magdhowga dagaallku wuxuu Finland ka beddelay dalki ku tiirsanaa dhaqaalaha beeraha iyo xoolaha wuxuuna u beddalay wadan warshadeysan.
en: The production of the war reparations helped Finland evolve from an agrarian country into an industrialised country.

so: Warshadoobista ayaa sababtay dhaqdhaqaaq looga soo guuray baadiyaha oo loo soo guuray magaalooyinka.
en: The industrialisation started a migration from the countryside into the cities.

so: Finland iyo Midowgi Sofiyeeti waxay sannadki 1948 galeen heshiis dhigaya saaxiibtinimo, wadashaqeyn iyo iscaawin dhexdooda ah, kaas oo dhigayay in labada dowladood ay iska difaacaan halista bannaanka uga timaada.
en: In 1948, Finland and the Soviet Union signed an Agreement of Friendship, Cooperation, and Mutual Assistance, where the countries promised to defend each other against external treats.

so: Finland waxay aheyd inti uu socday dagaalki qaboobaa oo dhan qeyb ka mid ah safka hore ee Midowga Sofiyeeti, siyaasadda dalka ee dibadda iyo gudahana waxaa hageysay cabsidi Midowgi Sofiyeeti.
en: In practice, Finland was in the Soviet Union's sphere of influence throughout the Cold War, and the country's foreign and domestic policy were guided by fear of the Soviet Union.

so: 1948 Heshiiski YYA ee dhexmaray Finland iyo Midowgi Sofiyeeti
en: 1948 Agreement of Friendship, Cooperation, and Mutual Assistance between Finland and the Soviet Union

so: 1968 Hay'adda dugsiga hoose-dhexe ee Finland ayaa la aasaasay
en: 1968 Finnish comprehensive school institution founded

so: Ka mid noqoshadi Yurub 1991 - >
en: Part of Europe 1991 onwards

so: Dumista Midowga Sofiyeeti iyo korriinshihi dhaqaalaha ee deymihi 1980yadi ayaa Finland u keenay hoos u dhac dhaqaale 1990kii.
en: The collapse of the Soviet Union and loan-based economic growth in the 1980s caused a recession in Finland in the 1990s.

so: Wakhtiga ugu xumaa ee dhaqaale xumo waxay aheyd billowgi 1990, xilligaas oo ay Finland ay joogeen dad shaqo la'aan ah oo badan, shirkaduhu waa kaceen, lacagaha dowladdu waa yaraadeen.
en: The worst time of the recession was in the early 1990s; many Finnish people were unemployed, companies went bankrupt and the state had little money.

so: Qiyaasti billowga sannadki 1995 wixi ka dambeeyay ayaa waxaa Finland ka billowday koror-dhaqaale, kaas oo shirkaddi ugu muhiimsaneyd ay aheyd Nokia oo sameynaysay telefoonnada gacanta.
en: In about 1995, the Finnish economy started to grow, the most important company being mobile phone company Nokia.

so: Finland waxay xubin ka noqotay 1995 Midowga Yurub waxayna ku jirtaa wadamadi ugu horeeyay ee lacagta Yuurada qaata.
en: Finland joined the EU in 1995 and was one of the first countries to adopt the euro as its currency.

so: 1991 Xasaraddi dhaqaale ee ugu xumeyd Finland
en: 1991 Worst economic crisis in Finnish history

so: 1995 Finland waxay ku biirtay Midowga Yurub
en: 1995 Finland joins the European Union

so: 2000 Finland waxay heerka 1aad ka gashay baaritaanka akhris aqoonta ee PISA oo marki ugu horeysay la sameeyay
en: 2000 Finland takes 1st place in children's literacy in PISA studies

so: 2002 Yuurada ayaa Finland looga qaatay lacagta kaashka ah ee dalka
en: 2002 The euro is adopted as the cash currency in Finland

so: 2007 Nokia ayaa iibisay %40 telefoonnada gacanta ee dunida oo dhan
en: 2007 Nokia sells 40% of all mobile phones worldwide

so: Finland waa jamhuuriyad waxayna xubin ka tahay Midowga Yurub (EU).
en: Finland is a republic and a member of the European Union (EU).

so: Caasimadda Finland waa Helsinki.
en: The capital of Finland is Helsinki.

so: Finland waxay u qeybsantahay degmooyin leh is-maamul.
en: Finland is divided into self-governed municipalities.

so: Finland waxaa deggan 5,5 milyan oo qofood.
en: Finland has 5.5 million inhabitants.

so: Luqadaha rasmiga ah ee Finland waa Finnish iyo Iswidish (qiyaastii 5 % dadka Finnishka ah waxay sidii afkooda hooyo ugu hadlaan Iswidish).
en: The national languages are Finnish and Swedish (about 5% of Finns speak Swedish as their native language).

so: Finnishka badnaatooda waxay si fiican ugu hadlaan ingiriiska.
en: Many Finns speak fluent English.

so: Finland waxay ku taalaa Waqooyiga Yurub.
en: Finland is located in North Europe.

so: Wadamada deriska Finland la ah waa Ruushka (bariga), Norway (Waqooyiga), Sweden (galbeedka) iyo Estonia (koonfurta).
en: Finland's neighbouring countries are Russia (east), Norway (north), Sweden (west) and Estonia (south).

so: Ballaca Finland waa 338 432 km², waxaana ku jira dhulka Finland iyo gudaha biyaha.
en: The surface area of Finland is 338,432 km², which includes the land and inland water areas.

so: Lacagta Finland waa yuuro.
en: The currency of Finland is the euro.

so: Macluumaad ku saabsan Finland oo shabakado kale ku jira
en: Information about Finland in other online sources

so: Shaqada iskaa wax u qabsada ah waa hab fiican oo dadka lagu caawiyo, barto dad cusub islamarkaasna qeyb looga noqdo arrimaha adiga muhiimka kuu ah.
en: Volunteer work is a good way to help, meet new people and participate in something that is important to you.

so: shaqada iskaa wax u qabsada ah waa ka duwan shaqada caadiga ah ama shaqo ku tababarasahda.
en: Volunteer work is not the same as work or practical training.

so: Haddii waaya aragnimadaada shaqo ee Finland ay yartahay ama aad si fiican u aqoonin finnishka, shaqada iskaa ah ayaa ah hab wannaagsan oo lagu geli nolosha shaqada islamarkaasna lagu wanaajin karo aqoonta luqadeed.
en: If you have little work experience in Finland or your Finnish skills are inadequate, volunteer work is a good way to gain entry to working life and improve your language skills.

so: Shaqada iskaa ah mushaar lagama helo laakiin waaya aragnimada shaqado ayaa ahaan karta faa'iido u leedahay marka codsaneyso shaqo mushaar ah.
en: Volunteer work does not pay a salary, but the work experience may prove useful when you apply for paid work.

so: Toos ula xiriir ururka aad rabto inaad ka qabato shaqada mutadawacnimada ah.
en: Directly contact the organisation you would like to volunteer in.

so: Haddii aad qaadato lacagta ammaanka shaqo la'aanta, horay uga sii hubso Xafiiska shaqada in shaqada mutadawacnimadu ay saameyn ku leedahay helitaanka lacagta ammaanka shaqo la'aanta.
en: If you receive unemployment benefits, find out from your Employment and Economic Development Office whether volunteer work has an impact on your benefits.

so: Siyaabo qaarkood waxaad heli kartaa shaqada iskaa wax u qabsada iney noqoto qorshaha u fuddudeynta la qabsiga.
en: In some cases, volunteer work can be included in your integration plan.

so: Shaqada iskaa ama mutadawac waxaa sidoo kale laga heli karaa hiwaayad wanaagsan.
en: Volunteer work can also be an excellent hobby.

so: Inta badan adiga ayaa go'aansan kara waqtiga iyo inta jeer ee aad ka qeybqaadaneyso waxqabadka.
en: You can usually decide for yourself when and how often you would like to volunteer.

so: Shaqada mutadawaca waxaad kula kulmi kartaa dad sida xiiseeya arrimo lamid ah kuwa aad adigu xiiseyso waxaadna ku heli kartaa saaxiibo cusub.
en: In volunteer work, you can meet people with whom you share common interests and make new friends.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale nolosha shaqada uga faa'iideysan kartaa xiriirada aad ku sameysatay gudaha shaqada mutadawacnimada.
en: You may also be able to utilise the contacts you have made during volunteer work later on in your working life.

so: Finland markii loo fiiriyo bulshada ku nool waxaa ku yaala jaaliyado badan.
en: Compared to the number of citizens, the number of associations in Finland is high.

so: Sida waafaqsan dastuurka cid walba ayaa xaq u leh iney ku shaqeystaan urur ahaan.
en: According to the law, everyone has the right to participate in association activities.

so: Xorriyada iskutagu waxay sidoo kale taabanaysaa ajaanibta.
en: The freedom of association also applies to foreign citizens.

so: Ururku wuxuu tusaale ahaan noqon karaa koox isboorti, urur dhaqameed, urur saaxiibtinimo ama urur diimeed..
en: An association can be, for example, a sports club, cultural association, friendship association or a religious association.

so: Ururada la diiwaangeliyey waa ururo fikradeed oo wax gaar ah qiimeeya.
en: Registered associations are non-profit organisations.

so: Urur looma samayn karo ganacsi awgiis.
en: An association must not be established to conduct business.

so: Finland waxaa ku yaala ururo badan oo ajaanibtu sameysteen.
en: In Finland, there are also many associations founded by immigrants.

so: Urur ajnabi ama urur saaxiibtinimada wadankaaga wuxuu kaa caawin karaa inaad ilaashatid dhaqankaaga iyo inaad ku hormarisid dhaqankaaga bulshada cusub oo aad ku dhex nooshahay aadna wada shaqayn la sameeysid shaqaalaha dawlada iyo ururada kale.
en: An immigrant association or a friendship association in contact with your home country may help you to maintain and develop your native culture in the new society and collaborate with authorities and other organisations.

so: Adeegga shabakadda ururka (Yhdistysnetti) ee Maamulka laysinka iyo rasjitareeshinka waxaad ka raadsan kartaa ururo kala duduwan.
en: You can search for different associations at the Finnish Patent and Registration Office's AssociationNet service.

so: Ururada ajaanibta ee wadankoo dhan
en: National associations for immigrants

so: Sida caadiga ah aasaasida ururku waa saddex marxaladood:
en: In practice, the process of founding an association involves three phases:

so: Ururka waa in la diiwaangeliyo.
en: It is worthwhile to register an association.

so: Markaa ururku wuxuu yeelanayaa qof masuul ah, xubnaha ururkuna ma qaadayaan masuuliyad shaqsi ahaan howlaha ururka.
en: This makes the association a legal person whose members are not personally liable for its operations.

so: Diiwaangelinta ururkana waxaad codsan kartaa kaalmo, dhaqaale iyo weliba inaad wada shqeyn la sameyso ururada kale iyo masuuliyiin dowladeed.
en: A registered association may apply for funding and financial assistance and cooperate with other associations and authorities.

so: Ururka diiwaangelinteeda waa in la wargeliyo shati maamulka diiwaanka iyo shatiga (Patentti- ja rekisterihallitus)
en: An association can be registered by submitting a notice to the Finnish Patent and Registration Office.

so: Asaasida ururka markii aasaseyaashu ay yihiin dad ajaanib ah
en: Founding an Association When the Founders Are Foreigners

so: Sidoo kale ajaanibta ama dadka aan lahayn dhalashada Finnishku waxay aasaasi karaan urur diiwaangashan.
en: Foreigners – i.e. persons without Finnish citizenship – can also establish registered associations.

so: Arintu markay sidaas tahay, waa in gudoomiyaha gudiga ururka iyo ku xigeenkiisuba ay si rasmi ah dalka Finland u degen yihiin.
en: In this case, the chairman and deputy chairman must both reside in Finland.

so: Haddii gudoomiyaha iyo ku xigeenkiisa midkood uu dagan yahay dalka dibadiisa, ururku wuxuu ruqsad aan caadi ahayn ka codsan karaa Guddiga Qaranka Maamulka Diiwangelinta Shatiyada.
en: If the place of residence of the chairman or deputy chairman is in another country, the association can apply for an exemption from the Finnish Patent and Registration Office.

so: Ururku wuxuu shaqeeyaa sida badan hal sano.
en: Associations usually operate in one year periods.

so: Wuxuu qorsheeyaa hawlihiisa dhaqaalihiisa sannadka soo socda.
en: They plan their activities and finances one year at a time.

so: Arimaha dhaqaalaha iyo xisaabaadka waa in la hubiyaa dhammaadka sannad hawleedka.
en: The finances and bookkeeping must be audited at the end of each period.

so: Xubnaha ayaa awoodda ururka leh.
en: The members of an association hold all the power.

so: Go'aanda muhiimka ah waxaa lagu gaaraa shirarka ururka ee xubnaha oo dhan u furan.
en: The most important decisions are made in association meetings that are open to all members.

so: Ururka waxaa loo doortaa maamul lagu doorto shirka ururka, kaas ay looyeero dhamman xubnaha ururka.
en: The Board of Directors for an association is elected in a meeting to which all members of the association are invited.

so: Maamulku waa inuu ka koobnaado guddoomiye iyo labo xubnood.
en: The Board must include at least a chairperson and two members.

so: Qawaaniinta waxaan ku qeexi karnaa cadada guddiga maamulka.
en: The rules of the association can define the size of the Board.

so: Hawsha gudigu waa inay hawlaha ururka u maareeyaan sharciga iyo qawaaniinta ururka iyo weliba go'aamada ururka waafaqsan.
en: It is the duty of the Board to handle matters in compliance with the law and the rules and decisions of the association.

so: Ururku wuxuu burburayaa, ka dib markii xubnaha ururka intooda badan ay shir weynaha sidaas ku go'aansadaan.
en: An association is dissolved when the majority of its members make a decision to that effect in a meeting of the association.

so: Markii la sameeyo go'aanka burburinta, hantidana la wareejiyo, waxaa ogeysiiska bur-burinta loo sameeyaa qaybta diiwaangelinta ururada.
en: After the dissolution decision and the allocation of the funds, a notice of dissolution must be submitted to the Register of Associations.

so: Dalka Finland gudihiisa carruurta iyo dhallinyarada waxaa la siiyaa hawlo hiwaayadeed oo kala duwan.
en: In Finland, the range of hobby activities available to children and young people is very diverse.

so: Carruurta iyo dhallinyaradu waxay hiwaayad ka dhigan karaan tusaale ahaan, isboortiga, qoob ka ciyaarka, muusikada, wax sawirida ama tiyaatarka.
en: They can engage in sports, dance, music, visual arts or theatre, to name only a few examples.

so: Qayb ka mid ah hawlaha hiwaayadu waa lacag, laakiin hiwaayado lacag la'aan ah ayaa jira.
en: Some of the activities are subject to a fee, but completely free hobbies are also available.

so: Sidoo kale degmooyinku waxay carruurta iyo dhallinyarada u qaban-qaabiyaan hawlo hiwaayadeed ay hagaan degmooyinku.
en: In addition, municipalities organise guided activities for children and young people.

so: Jimicsiga cunugga yar uma baahna in la hago, balse waxaa ku filan ciyaar iska caadi ah iyo banaan aadista bay'adaha kala duduwan.
en: Exercise for young children does not necessarily have to be instructed, but normal playing and outdoor activities in different environments are enough.

so: Si kastoo ay ahaataba waxaa wanaagsanaan lahaa in cunugga yar uu helaa jimicsi dhinacyo badan, waayo waxaa ku horumaraya itaalkiisa jireed ama dhaqdhaqaaq caafimaadkiisa sida kale waa u faa'iido.
en: It is, however, good for young children to engage in as many different kinds of exercise as possible, as this will promote their motoric skills and health.

so: Helitaanka jimicsiga qeyb ahaan waxaa gacan ka heysta xannaano-maalmeedka inta badan ciyaaro jimicsi laga qabanqaabiyo.
en: Day-care centres provide some of the exercise that children need by organising games that feature moving around.

so: Intaas waxaa dheer in jimciyadaha isboortiga qaarkood ay qabanqaabiyaan jimicsi ama isboorti carruurta yaryar loogu talagalay.
en: Some sports clubs also organise exercise activities for young children.

so: Xannaano-maalmeedyada iyo iskuulaadku waxay ka qeybqaataan qabanqaabada jimcsiga laakiin ma ahan hawshooda rasmiga ah.
en: Day care centres and schools take part in organising sports activities but it is not their primary function.

so: Cunuggu jimcsi ku filan kama helayo ka qeybqaadashada xiisadda jimcsiga oo kali ah.
en: A child will not get enough exercise by only participating in the physical education classes.

so: Sidaas darteed ayeey muhiim u tahay in cunuggu uu waqtiyada ka baxsan xannaano-maalmeedka iyo iskuulka uu helo fursad uu in ku filan ku hiwaayadeyn karo.
en: Therefore, it is a good idea to provide children with the opportunities to engage in a sufficient amount of exercise outside the day care and school environments, as well.

so: Isboortiga waxaad hiwaayad ka dhigan kartaa adigoo koox ka mid noqonaaya, naadi ama kaligaa si xor ah.
en: Sports can be practiced in teams, clubs or individually.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ee la xiriira hiwaayadaha isboortiga waxaa ka heli kartaa bogga InfoFinland Jimicsiga.
en: Additional information on sports-related hobbies can be found on the Exercise pages of InfoFinland.

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira noocyada goonida ah iyo meelaha lagu sameyn karo waxaa habboon inaad waydiisid ururka uu hoos yimaado noocaas isaga ah.
en: For information on individual sports or on facilities where they can be practiced, contact the association for the sport you are interested in.

so: Waxaa kaloo dhallinyaradu heli karaan marka isboortiga laga reebo noocyo kala duwan oo hiwaayado xaga fankaa ah, tusaale ahaan sawri gacmeedka, muusikada ama tiyaatarka.
en: In addition to sports youngsters can engage in a variety of art hobbies, such as visual art, music and theatre.

so: Kuwaas waxaa tusaale ahaan bixiya macaahida shaqaalaha, iskuulada sawir gacmeedka, macaahida muusikada iyo degmooyinka hawlahooda dhallinyarada.
en: Related activities are organised by adult education centres, art schools, music schools and municipal youth services, for example.

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira fursadda hiwaayadaha, jadwalka iyo qiimaha waxaa habboon inaad toos u weydiiso qolada qabanqaabisa.
en: For information on hobby opportunities, schedules and prices, contact the organising party directly.

so: Adeegyada dhallinyarada ee degmooyinka waxaa loogu talogalay carruurta iyo dhallinyarada qaangaarka ah.
en: Municipal youth services are intended for children and young adults.

so: Adeegyada ugu caadisan waxaa ka mid ah naadiyada kala duwan iyo hawlaha dhammaan u furan ee lagu qabto xarumaha dhalinyarada.
en: The most common services include various clubs and open-to-all activities organised in youth centres.

so: Adeegyadu xoogaa way kala duwanaan karaan qaybaha kala duwan ee dalka.
en: The services may vary slightly in different parts of the country.

so: Macluumaad dheeri ah oo la xiriira hawlaha dhalinyarada ee degmadu qabato waxaad ka heli kartaa xafiiska hawlaha dhalinyarada ee agga aad adigu degan tahay.
en: Additional information on youth activities organised by your municipality can be obtained from your local youth services.

so: Sidoo kale ururo faro badan iyo kaniisadaha ayaa qabta hawlo la xiriira dhallinyarada.
en: Many organisations and parishes also take part in youth work.

so: Guriga dhallinyaradu waa meesha ay dhallinyadaru ku qaataan waqtiga firaaqada ah ayna hiwaayadahooda kala duwan ku qabsadaan.
en: A youth centre is a place where young people can spend time and engage in a variety of recreational activities.

so: Guryaha dhallinyarada waxaa kaloo lagu qabtaa dhacdooyin la hago.
en: Youth centres also organise guided activities.

so: Hawlaha lagu qabto guriga dhallinyarada intooda badan waa bilaash.
en: The youth centre activities are primarily free of charge.

so: Marka hawlaha la agaasimayo waxaa la tixgeliyaa waxyaabaha ay dhallinyaradu codsadaan, dhallinyaraduna waxay saameyn ku yeelan karaan waxyaabaha ay ka kooban yihiin waxa qabanayo iyo sida loo qabanayo intaba.
en: The activities are organised based on the wishes of the young people, who can also influence the content themselves.

so: Xarunta dhallinyarada waxaa mar walba goob joog ka ah qof qaan-gaar ah, sida badan qof shaqaalaha degmada ah ama hage dhallinyaro.
en: There is always an adult – normally a municipal youth worker or youth instructor – present at a youth centre.

so: Xadka da'da loo ogolyahay guriga dhaliyaradu way is bedeshaa.
en: The age limits for youth premises vary.

so: Dhallinyarada iyo ka qayb-galkooda bulshada
en: Young People and Social Involvement

so: Dhallinyaradu waxay leyihiin fursado badan oo ay wax ku saameyn karaan.
en: Young people have a wide range of opportunities for social involvement.

so: Tusaale ahaan ka qaybgalka hawlaha iskuulkaaga ama hawlaha ardayda ee goobta waxbarashadu waa habka ugu fudud ee lagu bilaabi karo saameynta.
en: An easy way to start is to participate in the student body activities of your own school or educational institute, for example.

so: Ka qayb galka hawlaha ardayda iyo shaqooyinka ururadu waa hab wanaagsan oo aad saameyn ugu yeelan kartid in la maqlo codka dhallinyarada, markii la gaarayo go'aamo khuseynaya nolosha dhallinyarada.
en: Taking part in the activities of a student body or organisation is a good way to ensure that the voice of the young people is heard especially when decisions affecting their living environment are being made.

so: Si loo horumariyo arrimo badan oo la xiriira bulshada, waxaa jira ururo qarameed faro badan oo arimahaas ku caanbaxay.
en: Specialised civic organisations have already been established for promoting numerous social issues.

so: Dhawr urur qarameed iyo ururada kale qaarkood waxay leeyihiin qaybo loogu talo galay arrimaha dhalinyarada, qaybahaas oo abaabula hawlo ku jiheysan arrimaha dhalinyarada.
en: Many of these organisations and associations have separate youth divisions that organise activities for younger members.

so: Taas dheeraadkeeda waxaa jira ururo ay ardaydu leeyihiin oo ah xagga dhalinyarada khaaska ah iyo dhallinyarada soo koreysa.
en: In addition, special organisations for young people, preadolescents and students are available.

so: Finland waxaa ka jira fursado farabadan oo muusikada hiwaad looga dhigan karo.
en: There are many opportunities to make music in Finland.

so: Waxaad baran kartaa tumida qalab ka mid ah qalabka muusikada, waxaad la heesi kartaa koox, waxaad aadi kartaa masraxyada iyo faystooyinka ama waxaad ka heesi kartaa karaokega.
en: You can study to play an instrument, sing in a choir, visit concerts and festivals – or sing karaoke, for example.

so: Fursadaha hiwaayadaha waxaa haysta dadka waaweyn, dhallinyarada iyo carruurta.
en: There are opportunities for adults, young people and children.

so: Degmooyin badan waxaa kun yaala macaahid qaran, kuwaas oo degmooyinku maamulaan.
en: Many areas have adult education centres maintained by the municipality.

so: Waxay abaabulaan barasho muusikada oo qiimaheedu jaban yahay.
en: They organise affordable music lessons.

so: Intaas waxaa dheer barashada muusikada oo ay bixiyaan iskuulada muusikada ee gaarka loo leeyahay iyo macaahidu.
en: Music lessons are also offered by private music schools and institutes.

so: Dadka oo dhan ayey u furan yihiin guruubada muusikada ee macaahida qaranku.
en: The music groups of adult education centres are open to everyone.

so: Macaahidaas waxay ardayda u qaataan inta badan hadba sida codsiyadddu u soo kala horeeyaan, waxayna ardayda qaataan xiliyada xagaaga iyo dayrta.
en: Students are usually accepted in the order of enrolment in the autumn and spring.

so: Macaahida muusikada waxaa lagu geli karaa codsi loo marayo hannaanka imtixaanka gelitaanka oo sannadkiiba mar la qabto.
en: You can apply to music institutes through an entrance exam once a year.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale xafiiska dhaqanka ee degmada weydiin kartaa suurtagalnimada inaad hesho hiwaayada muusikada.
en: You can ask the municipality's cultural office for more information about opportunities for music.

so: Hoolka masraxadaha, aqalka muusikada, xarumaha dhaqanka, musiikkitaloissa, macaahida dhexdooda, makhaayadaha, meelaha taariikhiga ah iyo kaniisadaha dhexdooda.
en: Concerts are organised in various places: concert halls, music halls, culture centres, schools, restaurants, historical sites and churches.

so: Masraxadaha qaarkood waa bilaash, laakiin inta badan masraxadaha waxaa lagu galaa lacag.
en: Some concerts are free of charge, but usually there is an entrance fee.

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira masraxadaha waxaad ka heleysaa joornaalada iyo bogga internetka ee magaalada aad degantahay.
en: You can find information about concerts in local newspapers and on the Internet.

so: Faystooyinka muusikada aad ayaa loo jecel yahay, gaar ahaan xilliga xagaaga.
en: Music festivals are popular, especially in the summer.

so: Faystooyinku waxay noqon karaan ooppera, klassik, rock-, pop-, jazz- ama muusikada dhaqanka.
en: Festivals may offer opera, classical music, rock, pop, jazz or folk music.

so: Kuwaan waxaa lagu qabtaa dhan kasta magaalooyinka dalka Finland iyo meeelaha magaalooyinka ka baxsan ee baadiyaha ah.
en: They are organised all over Finland in cities and in the countryside.

so: Faystooyinka inta badan waxaa lagu galaa lacag.
en: Festivals usually charge an entrance fee.

so: Dalka Finland waxaa ku yaal in kabadan ilaa kun matxaf, kuwaas oo ilaa 300 oo kamid ah ay si rasmi ah dadweynaha ugu furanyihiin.
en: There are approximately a thousand museums in Finland, some 300 of which are regularly open to public.

so: Inta soo hartay waxay furanyihiin oo kaliya xiliyada samarka ama jiilaalka waana madaaxif maxali ah.
en: The rest are primarily museums of local culture and history that are open during the summer.

so: Madaaxifta waxaa loogu talogalay dhammaan dadka oo dhan.
en: Museums are intended for everyone.

so: Waxay soo bandhigaan farshaxano kala gadisan, taariikh, dabeecada, qof caan ah ama wax qabad khaas ah.
en: They can be devoted to art, history, nature, a certain individual or a specialty field.

so: Matxafka dibada waxaa loo jeedaan matxaf dhul baaxad leh ku fadhiya, kaasoo ay kamid yihiin dhismeyaal kaamil ah.
en: Open-air museums are more expansive museum areas that include entire buildings.

so: Matxafku wuxuu tusaale ahaan noqon karaa xayndaabka uu ku fadhiyo guri dhaqameedkii hore ee Finnishka ama dhul kale oo laga dhigay matxaf.
en: An open-air museum can be, for example, a yard area of a traditional Finnish farm house or some other area that has been made into a museum.

so: Matxaf banaaneeyada Finnishka ee caanka ah waxaa tusaale ahaan ka mid ah Seurasaari oo ku yaal Helsinki iyo matxafka shaqo-gacmeedka ee Luotsarimäki oo ku yaal magaalada Turku.
en: Among well-known Finnish museums of this kind are the Seurasaari Open-Air Museum in Helsinki and the Luostarinmäki Handicrafts Museum in Turku.

so: Farshaxanka Finnishka waxaa soo bandhiga tusaale ahaan Galeeriyaha qaranka Dawlada ee Ateneum iyo matxafka casriga ah ee magaalada Espoo (EMMA).
en: Finnish art is exhibited, for example, in Ateneum, which is part of the Finnish National Gallery, and at the Espoo Museum of Modern Art (EMMA).

so: Taariikhada dhaqanka Finnishka waxaad ku arki kartaa meelo ay ka mid yihiin matxafka qaranka ee Finland oo ku yaala magaalada Helsinki.
en: The Finnish cultural history can be explored in the National Museum of Finland in Helsinki, among other locations.

so: Kuwaan waxaa dheer mataaxif faro badan oo ku yaala dhammaan magaaloyinka kala duwan ee dalka Finland iyo aagag matxaf ahaan loo aqoonsaday.
en: In addition to this, a large number of museums and museum areas are located all over Finland.

so: Waxyaabaha laga heli karo matxafyada qaarkood waxaad ka arki kartaa bogga Internetka.
en: The collections of some museums can even be viewed online.

so: Sidoo kale macluumaadka dheeriga ah la xiriira matxafyada iyo weliba bandhigyada kala duwan ee mataaxifta lagu qabto waxaa laga heli karaa bogga internetka ee Museot.fi ururka ay ku mideysan yihiin mataaxiftu.
en: The Museot.fi website contains additional information on museums and current exhibitions.

so: Inta badan matxafyadu waxay kaloo bixiyaan adeeg hagid ah oo ay dadka ugu sharaxayaan waxa ay soo bandhigeen, adeegaas oo ku baxaya luuqado kala duwan.
en: Museums also often arrange guided tours in different languages.

so: Dalka Finland waxaa ku yaal toddoba goobood oo ah meelaha dhaxalka adduunka ee Unesco.
en: There are seven UNESCO World Heritage Sites in Finland.

so: Waxayna kala yihiin Qalcadda Finnishka (Suomenlinna), Raumadii hore (Vanha Rauma), kaniisada duqda ah ee Petäjävesi (Petäjäveden vanha kirkko), warshada alwaax xogiga iyo kartoomada ee Verla (Verlan puuhiomo ja pahvitehdas), dalcada Sammallahti, (Sammallahdenmäki), jasiiradaha sil-silada ah ee lagu magacaabo Struve iyo hunguriga badda (Struven ketju ja Merenkurkun saaristo).
en: They are the Fortress of Suomenlinna, Old Rauma, Petäjävesi Old Church, Verla Groundwood and Board Mill, the Bronze Age Burial Site of Sammallahdenmäki, the Struve Geodetic Arc and the High Coast / Kvarken Archipelago.

so: Macluumaadka dheeriga ah ee la xiriira goobaha dhaxalka aduunka waxaad ka helaysaa bogga Internetka ee waaxda Matxafyada (Museovirasto).
en: More information on the World Heritage Sites is available on the website of the National Board of Antiquities.

so: Finland waxaa kaloo ku yaala qalcado dadweynaha u furan oo ay daawan karaan, tusaale ahaan qalcada lagu magacaabo Olavinlinna, Qalcada Turku (Turun Linna) iyo qalcada Häme (Hämeen linna).
en: Finland also boasts a number of castles that are open to public: for example, the Olavinlinna Castle, Turku Castle and Hämeenlinna Castle.

so: Kuwaani waa qalcado booqashooda ay dadku aad u xiiseeyaan gaar ahaan xiliyada samarka ama jiilaalka.
en: They are popular destinations, particularly during the summer.

so: Sidoo kale qalacadaha waxaa lameeyaa hagitaano la qorsheeyey oo dadka looga sheekaynayo taariikhda qalcada iyo qaab dhismeedyadeeda intaba.
en: Guided tours that present the history and architecture of the castles are also arranged.

so: Wixii macluumad ah oo ka faah-faahsan intaas lana xiriira qalcadaha iyo hagitaanadooda waxaad ka heli kartaa bogga Internetka ee waaxda Matxafyada.
en: More detailed information on the castles and guided tours is available on the website of the National Board of Antiquities.

so: Kharashka gelitaanka iyo qiimo dhimista
en: Entrance Fees and Discounts

so: Kharashka gelitaanka mataaxiftu way kala duwan yihiin.
en: Museum entrance fees vary.

so: Isku celcelintii qiimahoodu waa shan euro dadka waaweyn carruurtana waa laba euro.
en: The average fee is five euros for adults and two euros for children.

so: Mataaxif badan ayaa qiimo dhimis ku sameeya kharashka gelitaanka ee guruubo cayiman.
en: Many museums offer discounts for particular groups.

so: Guruubadaasi waxay noqon karaan tusaale ahaan dhallinyarada da'doodu ka yar tahay 18-sano, ardayda, shaqo la'aanta, hawlgabka.
en: These groups can include, for example, persons under 18 years of age, students, unemployed persons and pensioners.

so: Carruurta waxaa laga yaabaa inay bilaash ku galaan matxafyada qaarkood.
en: Children may be allowed into some museums free of charge.

so: Matxafyo badan ayaa qabanqaabiya maalmo gooni ah, kuwaas galitaanka matxafku uu yahay bilaash.
en: Many museums also host special days on which entry is free for everyone.

so: Bogga Internetka ee dalada ay ku midaysan yihiin matxafyada ayaad ka heli kartaa maalmaha matxafyada bilaashka lagu galo.
en: More information about the free entry days is provided on the Finnish Museums Association's website.

so: Dhawr matxaf ayaa mar kasta bilaash lagu galaa, tusaale ahaan matxafka magaalada Helsinki.
en: Some museums, such as the Helsinki City Museum, are always free of charge.

so: Magaalooyinka dalka Finland intooda badan waxaa ku yaal ugu yaraan hal tiyaatar (masrax).
en: Most Finnish cities have at least one theatre.

so: Tiyaatarada qaar ka mid ah waa xirqadlayaal, qaarna waa tiyaataro hiwaayadeed.
en: Some of them are professional theatres while some operate on an amateur basis.

so: Boggaga xarunta warfaafinta tiyaatarada (Teatterin tiedotuskeskus), waxaad ka raadin kartaa macluumaadka la xiriira tiyaatarada ku yaala degmooyinka kala duwan ee dalka waxuuna ku qoran yahay luuqadaha Finnishka.
en: On the Finnish Theatre Information Centre's website, you can search for theatres in different municipalities in Finnish.

so: Xaruntu waxay sidoo kale leedahay arkifiyo, taas oo laga deynsan karo riwaayadaha Finnishka ah oo luuqadaha kala duwan lagu turjumay.
en: The Centre also maintains an archive where you can borrow translations of Finnish plays into a variety of languages.

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira barnaamijyada tiyaatarada iyo helitaanka tigidhadooda iyo waliba qiimaha tigidhada tusaale ahaan waxaa laga heli karaa goobaha adeega tigidhada ama bogga Internetka lippupalvelu.fi iyo tiyaatarada.
en: Information on the theatre programmes, ticket availability and prices is available on the websites of ticket vendors, such as lippupalvelu.fi, and theatres.

so: Sidoo kale dalka Finland waxaa lagu qabtaa dabbaaldegyo farobadan oo ah xagga tiyaatarada.
en: Numerous theatre festivals are also held in Finland.

so: Kuwaas macluumaadkooda waxaa ka heli karaysaa boggaga xarunta warfaafinta tiyaatarada ayagoo ku qoran luuqada Finnishka, Swidishka iyo Ingiriiska.
en: Information on them is available in Finnish, Swedish and English on the website of the Finnish Theatre Information Centre.

so: Magaaloyinka intooda badan waxay leeyihiin shineemoyin.
en: There is a cinema in most Finnish cities.

so: Internetku waa habka ugu wanaagsan ee aad ku heli karto macluumaadka ku saabsan tiyaatarada shineemoyinka ku yaala aagga aad degen tahay barnaamijyadooda iyo qiimaha tigidhadooda.
en: The Internet is the best source of information on the cinemas in your area, their programmes and ticket prices.

so: Sida badan barnaamijka usbuuca ee shineemooyinka waxaa lagu daabacaa wargeysyada deegaanka.
en: In addition, a list of weekly film screenings is often published in the local paper.

so: Fiinnikko waa shineemada silsilada ah ee ugu wayn dalka Finland.
en: Finnkino is the largest chain of cinemas in Finland.

so: Finnikko boggeeda Internetka waxaad luuqadaha Finnishka iyo Ingiriiska adoo isticmaalaya ka raadin kartaa shineemoyinkeeda magaalooyinka kala duwan ku yaal, waxaad ka fiirin kartaa filimka la soo bandhigo.
en: On its website, you can search for cinema theatres – in Finnish or English – according to city and see which films are being screened.

so: Barnaamijka shineemoyinka kale waxaad si toos ah u weydiin kartaa shineemada ama waxaad macluumaadka ka raadin kartaa internetka iyo wargeysyada.
en: For information on the programmes of other cinemas, you can ask the theatres directly or look for information online or in newspapers or magazines.

so: Qiimaha tigidhada filimada ee Finland xoogaa way kala duwanyihiin.
en: The prices of cinema tickets vary slightly in Finland.

so: Qiimaha tigidhada ayaad horay ka eegi kartaa bogga internetka ee shineemada.
en: You can check the ticket prices in advance from the websites of the cinemas.

so: Dalka Finland filimaanta waxaa lagu dhigaa oo ay ku hadlaan luuqadii markii hore filimka lagu sameeyey.
en: In Finland, films are primarily screened in their original language.

so: Waxaa intaas dheer turjumaad qoraal ah oo ah luuqadaha Finnishka iyo Swidishka.
en: They are subtitled in Finnish and Swedish.

so: Waxaa sidaas ka bedelan filimaanta carruurta, kuwaas oo laga yaabo inay ku hadlaan luuqada Finnishka oo lagu kor duubay, xittaa haddii luuqadii hore ee filimku ka duwan yahay.
en: An exception to this rule are children's films, which can be dubbed into Finnish even though the original language may be different.

so: Arkiifiyada maqalka iyo muuqaalka ee qaranka waxay soo bandhigtaa filimaan cusub iyo kuwo hore oo lagu sameeyey aduunka dacaladiisa kala gadisan.
en: The National Audiovisual Archive screens new and old films from all around the world.

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira waqtiga filimka la dhigayo oo af Finnish ah waxaa laga heli karaa bogga Internetka arkiifiyada.
en: Information on the screenings is available in Finnish on the archive's website.

so: Filimka waxaa lagu dhigaa magaalooyin kala gedisan.
en: Screenings are held in several cities and municipalities.

so: Filimaanta ku hadasha luuqadaha qalaad sida badan waxaa qoraal ahaan lagu turjumaa luuqadaha Finnishka iyo Swidishka.
en: Foreign language films are usually subtitled in Finnish and Swedish.

so: Dalka Finland waxaa sannad walba lagu qabtaa dabbaaldegyada filimaan tayo leh, kuwaas oo ay ugu caansan yihiin dabbaaldegyada la qabto xilliga xagaaga ee magac baxay dabbaaldegga jacaylka iyo kala dambayn la'aanta iyo weliba kan xiliga samarka la qabto oo la magac baxay xaflada filimaanta ee Sodankylä.
en: High-quality film festivals are held annually in Finland. The most famous ones are the Helsinki International Film Festival, which is held in the autumn, and the Midnight Sun Film Festival, which is held in Sodankylä every summer.

so: Dabeecadda Finnishku waa kala duwan yahay.
en: The Finnish nature is diverse.

so: Ku raaxeysiga iyo socoshada dabeecaddu waa wax xiiso iyo nabadgelyo leh, haddii aad dooratid wado ku habboon awoodaada socod iyo xirfadaada isla markaasna aad ilaalisid tilmaamaha hagitaanka ee lagu siiyey.
en: Hiking and other recreation in nature is enjoyable and safe when you choose routes that suit your fitness and skill level, and when you observe the necessary guidelines and regulations.

so: Finland waxay leedahay sannadkii afar xilli oo aad u kala duwan.
en: Finland goes through four decidedly different seasons.

so: Macluumaad ka badan ee ku saabsan beya'dda Finland iyo xilliyada sannadka waxaad ka heli kartaa bogga Internetka InfoFinland Hawada Finland.
en: More information about Finnish seasons is available on the InfoFinland page Finnish Climate.

so: Iska socodka iyo safarada gaa-gaaban waa hiwaayado, ku haboon dhammaan xilliyada kala gedisan ee sannadka.
en: Hiking and trekking are hobbies that are suitable for all seasons.

so: Haddii aadn waayo aragnimo hore u lahayn Iska socodka ama safarada gaa-gaaban, waxaa wanaagsan inaad ku ku bilowdo safaro dhaw-dhaw iyo wadooyin sahlan, oo ku jaal agagaarka meel la dagen yahay.
en: If you have no prior experience, you should begin with short and easy routes located close to residential areas.

so: Safarada gaa-gaaban waxaad aadi kartaa adigoon haysan wax qalab gooni ah.
en: You can embark on short hiking trips without any special equipment.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee waxaa haboon inaad horay u qaadato cabitaan, telefoon iyo weliba maab.
en: However, you should bring along something to drink, a phone and a map.

so: Waxaa wanaagsan in safarada gaa-gaaban laga bilaabo goobo calaamadaysan.
en: It is advisable to start off with hiking on marked trails.

so: Maabyada safarada waxaa lagu iibiyaa tukaamada buugaagta iyo Internetka.
en: Hiking and trekking maps are sold in bookshops and online.

so: Safarada dhaadheer iyo iska socodku waxay u baahan yihiin qorshayn iyo qalab faro badan.
en: Longer hiking trips and treks require more planning and preparation.

so: Finland waxay ka mid tahay meelaha ugu wanaagsan ee laga arki karo iftiimada waqooyi (aurora borealis).
en: Finland is one of the best places in the world for spotting northern lights (aurora borealis).

so: Inta badan waxaa laga arki karaa Waqooyiga-Lapland, sidoo kale waxaa laga arki karaa Koonfurta Finland.
en: Most often you can see them in the skies of Northern Lapland between September and March.

so: Waxaa habboon inaad dhar diiran xirato, sababtoo ah inta badan waxaa jira qabow markii uu habeenku aad mugdi u yahay cirkuna uusan daruuro lahayn.
en: A clear and dark night away from the lights of population centres provides the optimal conditions for sightings. Remember to dress warmly as the night is often cold.

so: Xilliga xagaaga habeenadu aad ayey iftiin u yahiin, markaas way adag tahay in la arko iftiimada waqooyi.
en: In summer, the nights are too bright for viewing auroras.

so: Iskiigu waa nooca ugu xiisaha badan ciyaaraha xilliga barafka.
en: Cross-country skiing is one of the most popular winter sports in Finland.

so: Waa caafid iyo weliba waa nooc isboorti lacag la'aan ah.
en: It is a healthy and very inexpensive form of exercise.

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira koorsooyinka iskiiga, kireysiga lug gashiga iskiiga iyo jidka iskiiga lagu sameynaayo oo af Finnish ah waxaad ka heli kartaa tusaale ahaan bogga internetka ururka Latu ry ee Finland.
en: Information on skiing lessons, equipment rentals and ski trails is available, for example, on the website of the Finnish Central Association for Recreational Sports and Outdoor Activities, Suomen Latu ry, in Finnish.

so: Dadka Finnishku biyaha aad ayey ugu dhaq-dhaqaaqaan. Dalka
en: Paddling and sailing are also popular activities in Finland.

so: Marka biyaha lagu safraayo nabadgalyadu aad ayey muhiim u tahay.
en: Safety is extremely important when travelling on water.

so: La soco wararka cimilada iyo qaado jaakadaha badbaadada oo lambar kugu haboon ah.
en: Pay attention to weather forecasts, and always use a life jacket of the correct size.

so: Xilliga barafka inta badan dhul biyoodka Finnishka waxaa daboola baraf.
en: In winter, the majority of the Finnish water areas is covered in ice.

so: Barafka dhumudiisu aad u weyn tahay waxaa lagu wadi karaa mootooyinka barafka iyo gawaarida.
en: Especially thick ice is also strong enough for cars and snowmobiles.

so: Ku socdaalka barafka waxaa mar walba la xiriira khatar, sidaas darteed nabadgelyada in laga fakaro aad ayey muhiim u tahay.
en: There are always risks involved in travelling or spending time on ice, and safety is an important concern.

so: Liiska xasuusta ee ku socodka barafka:
en: Important reminders for safety on ice:

so: Markii biyuhu barafoobaan, markiiba ma noqdaan adeeg tayo leh
en: When water freezes into ice, the ice is not sufficiently strong right away.

so: Xooga barafku wuu is bedeli karaa xitaa safada meelaha isku dhaw dhaw
en: Ice hardness can vary even within short distances.

so: Xilliga guga qiyaasida barafka xoogiisu way adagtahay, waxaana habboon inaad ka fogaato ku socodka barafka dushiisa.
en: In the spring, ice strength is extremely difficult to estimate, which is why it is wise to stay off the ice.

so: Qofka barafka ku dul soconaysa qalabka ugu muhiimsan waa kabaha qodxaha leh.
en: Ice picks are the most important tool to have with you when travelling on ice.

so: Kuwaas la'aantood waa adag tahay in kor looga soo baxo godka barafka dumay.
en: Without them, it is very difficult to get out of the water if you fall through the ice.

so: Haddii aadan hubin adeyga tayo ee barafka, ha fuulin barafka dushiisa.
en: If you are not sure about the ice strength, do not go on ice.

so: Kaluun dabid (dixiriga-wax lagu dabo) iyo kaluumeysiga baraf dushiisa godka barfaka laga dalooliyo waxay ka mid yihiin kaluumeysiga ruqso la'aanta ah marka laga reebo xaalado gooni, loomana baahna in kaluumaysigaas dartiis loo dalbado ruqso kaluumeysi.
en: With a few exceptions, angling and ice fishing are covered by the everyman's rights, so they do not require a fishing permit.

so: Kaluumeysiga kale iyo dabida kaluunka aragoostada u eg waxaa loo baahan yahay:
en: For other types of fishing and crayfishing, a permit is needed:

so: Bixinta lacagta gobolka ee ku kaluumeysiga maqaalintu waa shakhsiyan, waana in la bixiyo intaan kaluumeysiga la bilaabin.
en: The provincial lure fishing fee is personal, and it must be paid before fishing.

so: Waxaa la bixin karaa sannadka oo dhan ama markiiba toddobo maalmood.
en: The fee can be paid for the entire calendar year or for seven days at a time.

so: Xaqa uu qof kasta leeyahay (jokamiehen oikeudet) waa qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah dhaqanka Finnishka iyo sharci-dejinta.
en: Everyman's rights (jokamiehen oikeudet) are an integral part of Finnish culture and legislation.

so: Xaqa uu qof kasta leeyahay oo koobaan
en: Everyman's rights in brief

so: ku dhaqaaqi kartaa lugaha, adigoo iskii gareynaya ama dabeecada baaskiil ku wadaya meelaha aan ahayn deydadka guryaha iyo meelaha aan ahayn dhul beereedka, balka dhexdiisa, abuurka dhexdiisa, kuwaas oo ku waxyeeloobi kara ku dul-socodka;
en: walk, ski or cycle freely in nature, except in yard areas and in such fields, meadows or plantations that could easily be damaged

en: stay temporarily in areas where roaming is allowed – you can, for example, set up camp relatively freely as long as you maintain a sufficient distance from people's homes

en: fish or hunt without the relevant permits

so: Jardiinooyinka qaranka iyo aagaga loo calaamadeeyey ilaalinta dabeecadda
en: National Parks and Conservation Areas

so: Finland waxaa ku yaala 40 jardiino qarameed.
en: There are 40 national parks in Finland.

so: Jardiinooyinka qaranka ujeedadooda koowaad waa xaqiijinta dhinacyada kala duwan ee dabeecada, isla markaasna waxay u furan yiihiin inay daawadaan dhammaan dadka oo dhan.
en: The primary function of national parks is to secure natural diversity, but they are also sights accessible to everyone.

so: Muuqaalka quruxda badan ee jardiinooyinka qaranku waxay ku haboon yihiin goobo dalxiis.
en: The beautiful landscapes of the national parks are excellent travel destinations.

so: Jardiinooyinka waaweyn waa lagu habeen dhixi karaa, waxaana dhexdooda lagu sameyn karaa safaro dhaa-dheer.
en: In the largest parks, it is possible to stay overnight and embark on longer treks.

so: Jardiinooyinka qaranka waxaa inta badan ku yaala xarun dabeecadeed oo uu gacanta ku hayo maamulka kaymaha, xaruntaas oo laga heli karo macluumaadkii ugu dambeeyey ee la xiriira dabeecada aagga iyo ku dhex socodkeeda.
en: National parks often include nature centres, which are maintained by the state-owned enterprise Metsähallitus and which provide up-to-date information on the local environment and travelling safely in it.

so: Waxaana haboon in booqashada laga bilaabo xarunta.
en: It is a good idea to start your visit there.

so: Jardiinooyinka qaranka waxaa gacanta ku haya maamulka kaymaha.
en: The national parks are maintained by Metsähallitus.

so: Dalka Finland dad badan ayaa hiwaayad ka dhigta jimicsiga, sidoo kale hiwaayada jimicsigu waxay kaa caawinaysaa inaad la kulantid dad iyo heshid saaxiibo cusub.
en: Finns are very active when it comes to sports, so related hobbies can help you to meet new people and gain friends.

so: Jimicsiga la hago inta badan waxaa qabta naadiyada isboortiga ee kala duwan, kuwaas oo inta badan ku shaqeeya si mutaddawacnimo ah.
en: Guided sports activities are organised by various, often volunteer-based, sports clubs, for example.

so: Jimicsiga fuddud way ahaan karaa jardiin ka shaqayn, xaaqis ama shaqo baraf, si kale haddii loo yiraahdo jimicsiga faa'iidada leh (hyötyliikunta).
en: Light exercise can be gardening, cleaning or clearing snow – in other words, so-called functional exercise (hyötyliikunta).

so: Socodka shaqo aadista ama dukaan aadista ama kan baaskiilku waa habka ugu sahlan dhaq-dhaqaaqa maalinta.
en: Walking or cycling to work or to the grocery shop is an easy way to get your daily dose of exercise.

so: Jimicsigu wuxuu faa'iido u leeyahay dadka waayeelka ah, waxay kor u heysaa itaalkooda waxqabad iyo caafimaadkooda jireed.
en: Exercise is also beneficial to the elderly as it maintains good physical condition and the ability to function.

so: Ciyaaraha sidoo kale aad bey muhiim ugu yihiin carruurta.
en: Exercise is also important for children.

so: Ka aqriso dheeri Hiwaayadaha carruuraha iyo dhalinyarada
en: Read more on the Infopankki page Hobbies for children and young people.

so: Jimcisiga la hago waxaa tusaale ahaan qabanqaabiya degmooyinka iyo jimciyadaha isboortiga.
en: Municipalities and sports clubs, among others, organise instructed sports activities.

so: Deegaanada qaarkood waxaa laga qabanqaabiyaa jimicsi la hago oo si gaar ah loogu talagalay dadka dalka u soo guuray, tusaale ahaan haweenku iney leeyihiin horimo u qaas ah ama inaad soo barato nuucyo cusub.
en: Some municipalities organise instructed sports activities especially aimed at immigrants, such as women-only groups or introduction to various types of sports.

so: Jimicsiga la hago waa mid dadka oo dhan u furan.
en: Organised sports are open to all.

so: Waxqabadyda jimciyadaha isboortiga dadka oo dhan ayaa ka qeybqaadan kara.
en: Everyone can participate in the activities of sports clubs.

so: Jimcsiga la hagaahi wuxuu noqon karaa tusaale ahaan yumbada ama socod, orod ama safar hiihto oo la hagayo.
en: Instructed sports can include activities such as exercise classes, guided walks, jogs or skiing trips.

so: Doorashada hiwaayada xagga dhaq-dhaqaaqa jirka ah
en: Selecting a Sport and a Group

so: Dalbashada horinta hiwaayada waxaa habboon inaad qiimeyn ku sameysid heerkaaga.
en: When selecting a sports group, bear in mind your own level.

so: Noocyada hiwaayadaha Finlanad badi la xiiseeyo waa sida dabaasha iyo kudul socodka barafka iskiinka oo loo qabanqaabiyo sidoo kale dadka qaangaarada.
en: Swimming and skiing are very popular in Finland, so beginner courses are also held for adults.

so: Markii aad barato aas-saaska labada hiwaayadoodba adiga ayaa keligaa wadan kara si qiimo jaban ama lacag la'aan ah.
en: After you grasp the basics, both of the above-mentioned sports can be practiced independently and at low cost or even free of charge.

so: Meelaha dhaq-dhaqaaqa isboortiga lagu sameeyo boqolkiiba 70 waxaa iska leh magaalada.
en: Approximately 70 per cent of the sports facilities in Finland are owned by municipalities.
