so: Meelahaas waxaa ka mid ah tusaale ahaan qaar badan oo ka mid ah garoomada isboortiga iyo hoolalka dabaasha iyo meelaha kale dhaq-dhaqaaqa jirkaagu sameeyo, tusaale ahaan garoomada kubadda cagta iyo waddooyinka iskeytinka lagu sameeyo.
en: These include, for example, sports arenas, indoor swimming pools and other facilities, such as football fields and skating rinks.

so: Goobaha isboortiga magaaladu waxay u furan yihiin isticmaalka dhammaan dadka.
en: The municipal sports facilities are available to all residents.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaa haboon inaad weydiiso waaxda magaaladaada u qaabilsan hawlaha isboortiga.
en: For additional information on the municipal facilities, contact the sports department of your municipality.

so: Magaalooyinka waaweyn waxaa ku yaala xarumo isboorti oo gaar loo leeyahay.
en: Larger cities also have privately-owned sports facilities.

so: Waxyaabaha ay bixiyaan iyo qiimahoodaba waxaad si toos ah u weydiin kartaa xarumahaas isboortiga.
en: Information on the available services and pricing can be obtained by contacting the facilities directly.

so: Ardayda iyo dadka shaqeeya waxaa habboon inay ogaadaan, in goobaha waxbarashada ama shaqadu ay ugu deeqayaan fursado isboorti.
en: Students and employed persons should find out whether their school or employer provides opportunities for sports.

so: Dhammaan magaalooyinka dalka Finland waxaa ku yaal maktabad ay degmadu ama magaaladu leedahay.
en: All Finnish cities and municipalities have a municipal or city library.

so: Maktabadu waa meel laga amaahan karo buugaagta, lagu akhrisan karo wargeysyada, lagu isticmaali karo kombuterka, wax lagu baran karo ama looga qayb geli karo dhacdooyinka ama nashaadaadka kala duwan.
en: At libraries you can borrow books, read magazines and newspapers, use a computer, study or participate in various events.

so: Maktabadda waxaa sidoo kale laga yaabaa in lagu qabto saacadaha sheeko-xariirta iyo geymam loogu talogalay caruurta.
en: Some libraries may also have childrens' games or host story hours.

so: Maktabadda dhexdeeda waxaa in badan ku yaal hoolka wax akhriska.
en: Most libraries usually have a reading room.

so: Hoolka wax akhrisku waa meel degan oo aan sawaxan lahayn oo ku habboon wax akhriska ama tusaale ahaan ka shaqaynta duruusta cod la'aanta ah.
en: This is a quiet space suitable for reading and doing your homework in silence, for example.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale heli kartaa hagitaan la xiriira xagga isticmaalma kombuterka, sidoo kalena maktabadaha qaarkood waxaa lagu qabtaa kafeteriyooyinka luuqadda oo af Finnish ah.
en: The library staff can also help you in using a computer, and some libraries host language cafés where you can practise speaking Finnish.

so: Macluumaadka maktabdaha waxaad ka heli kartaa adeegga shabakada Internetka ee kirjato.fi.
en: The contact information for the libraries can be found in the online service libraries.fi.

so: Finland waxaa ku yaal maktabado cilmiyeed, maktabado macaahiddu leedahay iyo sidoo kale maktabado kala duwan oo khaas ah.
en: There are also scientific libraries, libraries of educational institutes as well as various specialised libraries.

so: Kuwaas isticmaalkooda waxaa laga yaabaa inuu leeyahay xadidaadyo, laakiin inta badan dadka oo dhan ayey u furan yihiin.
en: They may impose some limitations on using their material, but usually they are open for everyone.

so: Amaahashada awgeed waxaad u baahantahay kaarka maktabadda.
en: You need a library card to borrow books.

so: Kaasna waxaad ka heli kartaa maktabadda.
en: You can apply for one at any library.

so: Xasuuso inaad horay u sii qaadatid waraaqaha aqoonsiga oo sawir leh.
en: Remember to have some form of identification (with a photograph) on hand.

so: Haddii aadan haysan waraaqaha aqoonsiga ee Finnishka, si kumeel gaar ah ayaad u heli kartaa kaarka maktabadda.
en: If you don't have a Finnish personal identity code, you can get a library card for a limited time period.

so: Kaarka maktabaddu waa bilaash.
en: The library card is free of charge.

so: Haddii aad lumiso, waxaa qasab kugu noqonaysa inaad kaarka cusub lacag ka bixiso.
en: If you lose your card, you can get a new one for a fee.

so: Markii aad guurtid, cinwaankaaga cusub ogeysii makatbadda.
en: When you move, let the library know your new address.

so: Haddii aad u guurtid degmo uusan kaarka maktabaddu ka shaqayneyn, waxaa kula gudboonaanaysa intaad kaar maktabadeed cusub ka dalbato magaaladaada cusub maktabaddeeda.
en: If you move to another municipality where your library card is not valid, you should obtain a new card from the library of your new home municipality.

so: Maktabadaha oo dhan waxay leeyihiin bogagga internetka, halkaas oo aad ka raadsan karto macluumaad la xiriira waxyaabaha yaala maktabadda, iska markaasna aad ka cusbooneysiisan kartid walxihii aad horay u amaahatay, isla markaasna aad ka qabsan karid buugaag ama walxo kale.
en: All libraries have a website you can use to search for information on the library collections, renew your loans and make reservations for items.

so: Haddii aad raadineysid buug gaar ah, waxaad cawinaad weydiisan kartaa shaqaalaha maktabadda.
en: If you are looking for a particular book, you can ask for help from the library staff.

so: Buugaagta waxaa sidoo kale laga amaahan karaa gaariga maktabadda ah.
en: Books can also be borrowed from mobile libraries.

so: Waqtiga amaahdu sida badan waa hal bil.
en: The loan period for library books is normally one month.

so: Amaahda lala soo daaho waxaad ku mutaysanaysaa inaad bixiso lacagta la soo daahista.
en: You will need to pay a penalty charge for any overdue loans.

so: Lacagta la bixinayo inta ay le'eg tahay waxay ku xiran tahay hadba tirada buugaagta aad la soo daahday amaahdooda iyo inta maalmood oo aad buugaagta la soo daahday.
en: The amount of the charge depends on the number of the overdue books and on how many days they are overdue.

so: Waxaad maktabadda ka amaahan kartaa buugaag akhriskoodu fudud yahay, kuwaas oo lagu qoray luqada finnishka oo fudud.
en: You can borrow from the library plain language books, which have been written in simple Finnish language.

so: Waxey sidoo kale ku haaboon yihiin barashada luqada finnishka.
en: They are also suitable for learning Finnish.

so: Maktabada waad ka amaahan kartaa sidoo kale wargeysyada, buugaagta netka, cajaladaha CD iyo DVD
en: You can also borrow magazines, e-books, CDs and DVDs from a library.

so: Maktabada luuqadaha badan buugaagteeda ama cajaladeheeda waxaa laga deyman karaa meel kasta oo ka mid ah Finland.
en: Items in the collection of the Multilingual Library can be taken out anywhere in Finland.

so: Waxaad shaqaalaha maktabadaada ka dalban kartaa inay kuu dalbaan walxaha ama buugaagta aad doonaysid.
en: You can ask the clerk at your local library to order the item you would like for you.

so: Macluudka dheeraadka ah ee la xiriira maktabadda luuqadaha badan buugaagta ama walxaha yaala waxaad ka heli kartaa bogagga maktabadda ee Helmet.fi ee Helsinki iyo agagaarkeeda.
en: More information about the Multilingual Library can be found in the Helsinki region online library service Helmet.fi.

so: Maktabaddda elektroniga ah (eKirjasto) waxaad ka heleysaa walxo elektronig ah, sida buugaagta, wargeysyada iyo filimaanta.
en: Through eLibrary you can use electronic material such as books, magazines and movies.

so: Qoyb ka mid ah walxaha maktabada elektrogigu waa walxo xor ah oo ku jira shabakadda internetka, qaarna waa kuwo akhriskoodu u baahan yahay isticmaalka kaarka maktabadda iyo PIN-koodka kaas la xiriira.
en: Some eLibrary items are freely available online, but some require a library card with a PIN code.

so: Adeegga weydii shaqaalaha maktabaddu wuxuu ka jawaabayaa su'aal kasta.
en: Through the Ask a Librarian service you can find an answer to any question.

so: Waxaad su'aalahaaga oo ah Finnish, Iswidish ama Ingiriis ku reebi kartaa foomka shabakadda internetka.
en: You can submit your question via an online form in Finnish, Swedish or English.

so: Jawaabta waxaa laguugu soo dirayaa e-mailkaaga, waxaana lagu soo daabacayaa adeegga shabakadda internetka.
en: The answer will be sent to your e-mail and it will be published on the service website.

so: Haddii qof ku dhinto meel ka baxsan isbitaalka, horay ka ogeysii arrinta booliska ama takhtar.
en: If a person dies outside the care of a hospital, immediately notify the police or a doctor.

so: Boolisku wuxuu ku dadaalayaa in sababta dhimashadu cadaato warka dhimashadana uu u sii gudbiyo Xarunta diiwaangelinta dadka (Väestörekisterikeskus).
en: The police will ensure that the cause of death is determined and convey information on it to the Population Register Centre (Väestörekisterikeskus).

so: Marka qofku ku dhinto isbitaalka, warka dhimashadu wuxuu toos ugu gudbayaa xarunta diiwaangelinta dadka, Hay'adda hawlgabka qaranka (Kela) iyo qeybaha hawlgabka.
en: When a person dies in a hospital, information on the death is automatically relayed to the Population Register Centre, the Social Insurance Institution of Finland (Kela) and to pension institutions.

so: Marka qof kaa dhinto waxaad murugadaada caawimaad uga heleysaa rugta caafimaadka (terveysasema), la-talinta qoyska (perheneuvola), Ururka caafimaadka maskaxda ee adeegga xasaradaha ajaaniibta Finland (Suomen Mielenterveysseuran ulkomaalaisten kriisipalvelu) iyo kaniisada.
en: When a person close to you dies, you can seek help and support for the grief from health stations (terveysasema), family counselling centres (perheneuvola), the crisis service for foreigners of the Finnish Association for Mental Health (Suomen Mielenterveysseuran ulkomaalaisten kriisipalvelu), and from parishes.

so: Caawimaadda waxaad ku heli kartaa afka Finnishka, Iswidishka iyo meelaha qaar oo Ingiriis aad ku heli karto.
en: Help is available in Finnish, Swedish and, in most places, in English too.

so: Haddii aad u baahan tahay waxaad sidoo kale isticmaali kartaa turjubaan.
en: If necessary, an interpreter can be requested.

so: Si loo aaso qofka dhintay waxaa loo baahan yahay shahaadada dhimashada (kuolintodistus), waxaana bixiya takhtar mar kasta.
en: In order to bury a deceased person, a death certificate (kuolintodistus) issued by a doctor is required.

so: Shahaadada dhimashada waxaa la heli karaa marka la cadeeyo sababta dhimashada kadib.
en: A death certificate can be obtained when the cause of death has been identified.

so: Haddii arrintu ay tahay dhimasho degdeg ah oo aan cadeyn, shil ama dembi waxaa la sameyn karaa si loo cadeeyo sababta dhimashada qaliinka jirka lagu furayo.
en: In the event of a sudden or unclear death, accident or crime, an autopsy can be conducted to determine the cause of death.

so: Boolisku xitaa waa baari karaa sababta dhimashada.
en: The police can also investigate the cause of death.

so: Dib ayeey u dhici kartaa aasidu sababtoo ah cadeynta sababta dhimashadu waqti dheer ayeey qaadan kartaa.
en: Burial may sometimes be delayed as identifying the cause of death may take some time.

so: Qaban-qaabada aaska waxaad kaalmo uga heli kartaa ururada diimaha.
en: You can receive help for organising a funeral from religious communities.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo arintan ku saabsan waxaad ka heli kartaa bogga kaniisadda efangeli-luuteriga ee Finland.
en: The website of the Evangelical Lutheran Church of Finland contains information on the church's services.

so: Waxaa kaloo suurtagal ah in la sameeyo aas shacab oo wax diin ku saabsan aysan ku jirin.
en: It is also possible to hold a civil funeral, which does not include religious ceremonies.

so: Aaska shacabka macluumaad ku saabsan waxaad ka heleysaa Kahor xuska (Pro-Seremoniat).
en: For more information on civil funerals, contact the Pro-Ceremonies (Pro-Seremoniat) service centres.

so: Adeegyada shirkadaha aasku waa lacag.
en: The services provided by funeral homes are subject to a fee.

so: Waxay sameeyaan qaban-qaabada aaska sida qaadista meydka.
en: These establishments take care of the funeral arrangements, such as the transport of the deceased.

so: Shirkadaha aasku waxay iibiyaan sanduuqyada meydka, haddii lagu heshiinaya waxaa kale oo ay qabtaan arrimaha kale ee la xiriira aaska ee ay dadka ehelka ahi ka dalbadaan.
en: Funeral homes also sell coffins and, upon agreement, handle all other funeral matters requested by the family.

so: Macluumaad ku saabsan shirkadaha aaska waxaad ka heleysaa tusaale ahaan; Ururka Shirkadaha Aaska ee Finland (Suomen Hautaustoimistojen Liitto).
en: Information on funeral homes can be obtained, for example, from the Finnish Association of Funeral Homes (Suomen Hautaustoimistojen Liitto).

so: Shirkadaha aaska qaar badan oo ka mid ah waxaa laguugu adeegayaa afka Ingiriiska.
en: Many funeral homes also provide their services in English.

so: Dhulka qabuuraha ee Finland intiisa badan waxaa iska leh kaniisadda, laakiin qabri waad heli kartaa inkastoo aadan ka tirsaneyn kaniisadda efangeliluuteriga.
en: Nearly all Finnish cemeteries are owned by Evangelical Lutheran parishes, but a grave can be obtained even if you do not belong to the Evangelical Lutheran Church.

so: Meelaha dadka lagu aaso waa lacag waxaadna su'aali kartaa kaniisadaha.
en: Graves are subject to a charge, and more information is available from the parishes.

so: Haddii qofku uusan ka tirsaneyn kaniisadda isla markaasna uusan dooneyn in aas diimeed loo sameeyo, looma sameynayo.
en: If the deceased person did not belong to a church and did not want a religious burial, such a ceremony will not be arranged.

so: Meydka sanduuq ayaa lagu aasayaa ama waa la gubayaa oo dambas ayaa laga dhigayaa.
en: Deceased persons can be buried in coffins or cremated.

so: Deegaano badan waxaa laga helaa meelo dadka lagu aaso oo ay leeyihiin diimaha kale dadka aaminsan.
en: Many municipalities also include cemeteries of other religions.

so: Tusaale ahaan magaalooyinka waa weyn waxaa laga helaa meelo lagu aaso dadka aaminsan ortodoksiga, islaamka iyo yuhuudda.
en: For example, Orthodox, Islamic and Jewish cemeteries are available in the largest cities.

so: Deegaano badan ayaa sidoo kale laga helaa meelo lagu aaso dadka aan wax diin ah heysan.
en: In addition, many municipalities have grave sites for deceased persons who did not belong to any religion.

so: Dambasta meydka waxaa lagu shubi karaa bii'ada ama biyaha haddii dhulkaas dadka iska leh ay ogolaadaan.
en: Cremated ashes can also be sprinkled on land or into a body of water if this is permitted by the land owner.

so: Qofka dhintay waxaa laga yaabaa mararka qaar in uu xaq u yeelan karo caawimaadda aaska (hautausavustus) shaqadii ugu dambeysay ee uu hayay ama xubinnimada ururka xirafdleyda dartood.
en: Sometimes the deceased is entitled to funeral allowance (hautausavustus) due to his or her final employment or to membership of a trade union.

so: Weydii meeshii ugu dambeysay ee uu ka shaqeynayay ama ururka xirfadleyda.
en: To find out more, contact the employer or the trade union.

so: Kharashka ku baxaya aaska qofka aan hanti heysan waxaa laga codsan karaan xafiiska bulshada (sosiaalitoimisto) ee degmada.
en: It is possible to apply for financial assistance with the social office (sosiaalitoimisto) of the place of domicile if the deceased was without financial means.

so: Hawlgabka qoyska (perhe-eläke) waxaa la siin karaan dhimashadiisa ka dib qofka laga dhintay iyo carruurtiisa.
en: Family pension (perhe-eläke) can be paid to the spouse or children of the deceased after his or her death.

so: Hawlgabka qoyska waxaa looga dan leeyahay in lagu sugo nolosha qofka laga dhintay iyo carruurta.
en: The purpose of the pension is to ensure the livelihood of the widow and children.

so: Finland waxaa ka jira laba nooc oo hawlgabka qoyska ah, hawlgabka qoyska ee Kelada iyo hawlgabka qoyska ee shaqada.
en: Two family pension schemes are in place in Finland: Kela's (the Social Insurance institution of Finland) family pension and the employment pension system's family pension.

so: Haddii qofka dhintay uu ka shaqeynayay ama shirkad ku lahaa Finland, qofka laga dhintay iyo carruurtuba wey heli karaan hawlgabka qoyska ee shaqada.
en: If the deceased persons was employed or ran a business in Finland, the widow and children may be eligible for a family pension provided by the employment pension system.

so: Labada hawlgab ee qoyska waxaad ka codsan kartaa Kelada.
en: Both pensions can be applied for at Kela.

so: Haddii qofka dhintay uu mudo dheer deganaa ama ka shaqeynayay dal kale ka hor intii uusan u soo guurin Finland, qofka laga dhintay iyo carruurtuba waxay xaq ugu yeelan karaan dalkaas hawlgabka qoyska.
en: If a person has lived or worked in another country for an extended period of time before moving to Finland, the spouse or children may also be entitled to receive a family pension from this country.

so: Sharciga ayaa sheegaya qofka dhaxlaya hantida qofka dhintay.
en: The law dictates who inherits the property of a deceased person.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale adigu saameyn ku yeelan kartaa dadka loo qeybinayo hantidadaa.
en: You can also influence to whom your property will be distributed.

so: Waxaad qori kartaa dardaaran (testamentti), ay sicad ugu qoran tahay qofka hantidaada dhaxlaya dhimashadaada ka dib.
en: You can prepare a will (testamentti), i.e. a written clarification on who will inherit your property after your death.

so: Marka aad sameyneyso dardaaranka waxaa wannaagsan in uu kaa caawiyo qareen si dardaaranku uu sharci u noqdo.
en: It is advisable to employ the services of a lawyer when preparing a will in order to ensure its legitimacy.

so: Qoraalka dhaxalku (perunkirjoitus) waa munaasabd lagu qorayo hantida qofka dhintay iyo deynka lagu leeyahay.
en: Estate inventory (perunkirjoitus) is an event where a written account of the deceased person's property, belongings and debts is prepared.

so: Qoraalka dhaxalka waa in laga soo bilaabo waqtiga dhimashada saddex bil gudahood lagu sameeyaa.
en: The inventory must be held within three months of the death.

so: Si loo sameeyo qoraalkaas waxaa loo baahan yahay cadeyn muujineysa dadka wax u ah dhalashadiisi ilaa iyo dhimashadiisi.
en: A detailed family history must be compiled from the birth of the deceased to his or her death.

so: Sidoo kale waxaa loo baahan yahay shahaadada sugnaanta (virkatodistus) oo laga bixiyo xafiiska diiwaangelinta ama xafiiska madaxa kaniisadda.
en: Extracts from the population register (virkatodistus), which can be obtained from the local registry or parish office, are also required.

so: Waxaa macluumaadkooda loo baahan yahay dadka dhaxalka qofka dhintay iska leh.
en: In addition, information is required on the estate beneficiaries, i.e.

so: Buugga dhaxalka (perukirja) waa in xafiiska canshuuraha la geeyaa ugu dambeyn bil gudaheed marka la sameeyo qoraalka dhaxalka.
en: An estate inventory document (perukirja) must be submitted to the tax office no later than one month from the reading of the will.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan qoraalka dhaxalka waxaad ka heli kartaa hay'adda cadaaladda iyo maamulka canshuuraha.
en: More information on estate inventory is available from the Judicial System and Tax Administration.

so: Qoraalka waxaa soo qabanqaabiyaa qofka ugu aqoonta badan qofka dhintay hantidiisa iyo deynka lagu leeyahay.
en: The estate inventory is arranged by the person who is most intimately familiar with the deceased person's property and debts.

so: Qoraalka dhaxalka waxaa saxiixa laba qofood oo qiimeyn ku sameeya hantida qofka dhintay.
en: The document is signed by two persons who evaluate the property.

so: Haddii aan qoraalka dhaxalka waqti hore la sameyn waxaa ka dhalan kara dhibaatooyin ay ka mid yihiin canshuurta dhaxalka oo sare loo kiciyo.
en: If the estate inventory is not completed in time, detrimental effects, such as raised inheritance tax, may result.

so: Haddii aad dhaxasho hantida qof dhintay waa in aad ka bixisaa hantidaas canshuurta dhaxalka (perintövero).
en: If you inherit the property of a deceased person, you are liable to pay inheritance tax (perintövero).

so: Cadadda canshuurtu waxay ku xiran tahay inta ay dhan tahay hantida aad qofka dhintay ka dhaxashay iyo dhalasho ahaan sida aad isugu dhowdihiin.
en: The amount of the tax depends on the amount of the property and how close a relative you are.

so: Dhaxalkii ka yar €20 000 looma baahna in canshuur laga bixiyo.
en: Tax does not need to be paid for inheritance totalling less than €20,000.

so: Dhibaatooyinka aalkolada iyo maandooriyaha waxaad caafimaad uga raadsan kartaa goobaha soo socda:
en: You can seek help with alcohol and drug problems in the following places:

so: Waxaad la xiriir kartaa rugta caafimaadka (terveysasema) ee kuugu dhow, haddii aad qabto dhibaatooyin la xiriira aalkolada iyo maandooriyaha.
en: You can contact the nearest health centre (terveysasema) if you have alcohol or drug problems.

so: Kiliinikooyinka A (A-klinikka) waa qeybo daryeel oo dadka la dhibaateysan dhibaatooyinka maandooriyaha iyo qabatinnada iyo ehelkoodu ay ka helaan taageero iyo caawimaad. Bogagga Mu'asasada A- kiliinig waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaadyada xiriirka A-kiliinikooyinka ee ku yaal dacallada kala duwan ee Finland.
en: A-Clinics (A-klinikka) are treatment units where those who suffer from problems with intoxicants and addiction as well as their family members and friends, can receive help and support The website of the A-Clinic Foundation lists the contact information of A-clinics throughout Finland.

so: A-kiliinig uma baahna in laguu soo gudbiyo ee adiga ayaa iskaa ballan uga qabsan kara.
en: A-Clinics do not require a referral; you can make an appointment yourself.

so: Kiliinikooyin badan xittaa waxey leeyihiin wakhtiyo heegan, markaas oo ballan la'aan la imaan karo daryeelka.
en: Several clinics also have on-call hours, during which treatment can be sought without an appointment.

so: Adeegyada A-kiliinikada degmada ku taal waa u lacag la'aan macaamiisha sida joogtada ah u deggan Finland. Daryeelka
en: The A-clinic services of your municipality of residence are free of charge if you are permanently residing in Finland.

so: A-kiliinig waa mid lagu kalsoonaan karo.
en: Treatment at an A-Clinic is confidential.

so: Adeegga shabakadda Päihdelinkki ee A-kiliinig waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad ku saabsan isticmaalka maandooriyaha iyo qabatimista.
en: The Päihdelinkki online service maintained by the A-Clinic Foundation contains information on intoxicant abuse and addictions.

so: Adeegyada Päihdelinkki qaarkood waxaa sidoo kale lagu helaa afka Iswidhishka, Ingiriiska iyo Ruushka.
en: Some of the AddictionLink services are also available in Swedish, English and Russian.

so: Aalkoliistayaasha aan magacooda la aqoon (Anonyymit Alkoholistit) AA, waa urur saaxiib oo ragga iyo dumarka ah, waxeyna halkaas ku wadaagaan waayo-aragnimadooda aalkoliistanimada waxeyna isku dayaan in ay iska caawiyaan sidi ay u bogsoon lahaayeen.
en: Alcoholics Anonymous (Anonyymit Alkoholistit), or AA, is a peer association for men and women to share experiences about alcoholism and to help each other recover.

so: Degmooyin badan waxaa ka shaqeeya kooxaha AA, magaalooyinka waaweynna waxaa xittaa laga helaa kooxo ku hadla afka ingiriiska.
en: AA groups meet in many different municipalities, and the largest cities also have English-speaking groups.

so: Al-Anon wuxuu taageero siiyaa ehelka dadka aalkoliistayaasha ah.
en: Al-Anon offers support to friends and families of alcoholics.

so: Kooxda afka Ingiriiska ku hadasha ee Al-Anon waxey isugu yimaadaan Helsinki.
en: There is an English-speaking Al-Anon group that meets in Helsinki.

so: Daroogiistayaasha magac la'aanta ah (Nimettömät narkomaanit)
en: Narcotics Anonymous (Nimettömät narkomaanit), or NA, offers support, information and group meetings.

so: Macluumaadka kulamada waxaad bogagga internetka uga raadsan kartaa af Finnish, Ingiriis iyo Iswidhish.
en: Information on the meetings is available on the website in Finnish, English and Swedish.

so: Ka ganacsiga dadku Finland wuxuu ka yahay dembi.
en: Human trafficking (ihmiskauppa) is a crime in Finland.

so: Ka ganacsiga dadku tusaale ahaan waa:
en: The following acts are regarded as human trafficking:

so: ku qasbidda shaqo laga bixinayo mushaar aad u yar ama aan gebi ahaanba mushaar laga bixineyn
en: forcing someone to work without pay or for too little pay

so: ku qasbidda iibinta galmada
en: forcing someone to sell sex

so: ku qasbidda dawarsashada ama dembi sameynta
en: forcing someone to beg or commit crimes

so: Nooca ugu badan ee ka ganacsiga dadku waa ku qasbidda qof kale shaqo mushaar la'aan ah ama ku shaqeynta duruufo xun.
en: The most common form of human trafficking is forcing someone to work without pay or under otherwise bad conditions.

so: Bogga InfoFinland Xuquuqda iyo waajibaadka shaqaalaha iyo Dhibaatooyinka nolosha shaqada waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad ku saabsan xuquuqda qofka shaqeeya ee Finland.
en: You can find information about the rights of employees in Finland on the InfoFinland pages Employee's rights and obligations and Problems in working life.

so: Miyaan ahay dhibbanaha ka ganacsiga dadka?
en: Are you a victim of human trafficking?

so: Waxaad noqon kartaa dhibbanaha ka ganacsiga dadka, haddii
en: You may be a victim of human trafficking, if

so: uu qofku kugu cadaadiyo in aad sameyso wax aadan dooneyn in aad sameyso
en: someone is pressuring you to do things you do not want to do

so: uu qofku adiga ama qoyskaada ugu hanjabo rabshad
en: someone is making threats of violence against you or your family

so: uu qof kuugu hanjabo in uu dowladda kuu sheegayo haddii aadan sameynin sida uu doonayo
en: someone is threatening to report you to authorities if you do not do as they want

so: uu qofku kaa celinayo ama uu ilaalinayo dhaqdhaqaaqaada
en: someone is preventing or controlling your movements

so: aadan si xor ah xaaladdaada ugu sheegi karin dadka kale
en: you are unable to freely discuss your situation with others

so: Dhibbanayaasha ka ganacisga dadku waxey noqon karaan dumar, rag ama carruur.
en: Victims of human trafficking can be women, men or children.

so: Dadka sameeyana waxey noqon karaan dembiilayaal xirfadeysan, laakiin waxaa kale oo ay noqon karaan dad ay dhibbanaha is-yaqaanaan, saaxiibo ama qaraabo.
en: Human traffickers can be professional criminals, but also acquaintances, friends or relatives of the victim.

so: Dhibbanayaasha ka ganacsiga dadku waxey heli karaan caawimaad.
en: Victims of human trafficking can get help.

so: Macluumaadyada xiriirka waxaad ka heleysaa bogga shabakadda ihmiskauppa.fi.
en: You can find the contact information on the ihmiskauppa.fi website.

so: Haddii laguugu qasbay iibinta galmada, waxaad caawimaad ka heli kartaa Pro-tukipiste.
en: If someone has forced you to sell sex, you can also get help from Pro-tukipiste.

so: Goobaha taageeradu waxey ku yaalaan Helsinki, Tampere iyo Turku.
en: There are services in Helsinki, Tampere and Turku.

so: Macluumaadyada xiriirka waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga shabakadda Goobta taageerada Pro.
en: You can find their contact information on the Pro-tukipiste website.

so: Dhibaatooyinka dugsiga ama waxbarashada
en: Problems at school or with studies

so: Haddii uu cunuggu ama da'yarku dhib ku qabo dugsiga ama waxbarashada, waa in lagala hadlaa arrinta hagaha waxbarashada ee dugsiga ama machadka.
en: If a child or young person has problems at school or with studies, the problems should be discussed with the student counsellor of the school or educational institute.

so: Waxaa sidoo kale dugsiga ka shaqeeya cilmu-naqsiyaqaan ama sooshalka dugsiga.
en: A psychologist or welfare officer (kuraattori) also works at the school.

so: Wuxuu caawiyaa ardayda uu dhibaato ku qaba dugsiga.
en: He or she helps students who are having difficulties at school.

so: Haddii cunugga ama da'yarka lagu dhibo dugsiga , waxaa dugsiga saaran waajib ah in uu wax ka qabtaan.
en: If a child or young person is being bullied at school, the school is obliged to intervene.

so: U sheeg dhibitaanka macaliimadda ama maamulaha dugsiga.
en: Report the bullying to a teacher and the headmaster.

so: Mararka qaar dhibistu waxey noqon kartaa sida sharcigu qabo dembi, kaas oo booliska lagu wargelin karo.
en: Occasionally, according to law, bullying can be a crime and can be reported to the police.

so: Tusaale ahaan dagaalka jir ahaaneed ama xatooyadu waa dembi.
en: For example, physical violence and stealing are crimes.

so: Haddii uu da'yarku qabo dhibaatooyinka aakolada, mukhaadaraadka ama ciyaarista, wuxuu caawimaad ka heli karaa xarunta dhallinyarada.
en: If a young person has problems with alcohol, drugs or gaming, he or she can seek help from a youth station.

so: Magaalooyin badan ayeey xarumaha dhallinyaradu ku yaalaan.
en: There are youth stations in many cities.

so: Xarunta dhallinyarada wuxuu da'yarku imaan karaa kaligiis ama isagoo ay waalidkiis la socdaan.
en: The young person can come to a youth station alone or together with the parents.

so: Ismaandhaafka dhaqamada u dhexeeya ee qoyska
en: Cultural conflicts in the family

so: Ismaandhaafyada dhaqameed ee qoyska dhexdiisa ka jira waxey mararka qaar dhibaato ka dhex-dhaliyaan carruurta iyo waalidka.
en: Occasionally, cultural conflicts cause problems between parents and children.

so: Dhibaatooyinku waxey ka dhalan karaan shukaansiga ama labisashada.
en: The problems can relate to, for example, dating or dressing.

so: Waalidku waxey gabdhaha ka filan karaan habdhaqan ka duwan kan wiilasha.
en: Parents may expect girls to behave differently from boys.

so: Waa muhiim in ismaandhaafka looga hadli karo qoyska dhexdiisa.
en: It is important that these conflicts can be discussed in the family.

so: Da'yarku wuxuu xaq u leeyahay in uu su'aalo sababta ay waalidku u doonayaan in uu u dhaqmo qaab gaar ah.
en: A young person has the right to ask why the parents want him or her to behave in a certain manner.

so: ma jiro dhaqan ama diin xadeyn karta xuquuqda aasaasiga ah ee carruurta iyo dhallinyarada.
en: No culture or religion may restrict the basic rights of children and youth.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan xuquuqda aasaasiga ah ka aqri bogga InfoFinland Xuquuqda iyo waajibaadka caruurta iyo dhalinyarada.
en: Read more on the basic rights on the InfoFinland page Children's and youths' rights and obligations.

so: Dhibaatooyinka waxaa loo codsan karaa caawimaad.
en: You can ask for help for your problems.

so: Gabdhaha dhallinyarada ah waxey caawimaad ka raadsan karaa Guryaha gabdhaha, kuwaas oo degmooyin badan ku yaal.
en: Young girls can seek help from Girls' Houses (Tyttöjen talo) which can be found in several municipalities.

so: Helsinki waxaa ka shaqeeya Shaqada Sopu Tampere:na Didar.
en: Sopu work operates in Helsinki and Didar operates in Tampere.

so: Waxey dhallinyarada iyo waalidiintaba ka caawiyaan khilaafka la xiriira sharafta.
en: They help young people and their parents in honour-related conflicts.

so: Dagaalka qoyska dhexdiisa ah
en: Violence in the family

so: Ciqaabista jireed ee carruurtu Finland waxey ka tahay dembi.
en: Physical punishment of children is a crime in Finland.

so: Waxaa loola jeedaa in aan tusaale ahaan aan cunugga la garaaci karin ama aan timaha laga jiidi karin, marka ay dhega-adkaadaan.
en: This means that it is not allowed to, for example, hit the children or pull their hair when they are disobedient.

so: Haddii ay waalidku dagaal u geystaan cunugga ama da'yarka, cunugga ama da'yarku wuxuu tusaale ahaan caawimaad ka raadsan karaa kalkaalisada caafimaadka ee dugsigiisa, rugta talosiinta qoyska ama guriga ammaanka dhallinyarada ee Laanqeyrta Cas ee Finland.
en: If the parents behave violently towards a child or a young person, the child or young person can seek help from the school nurse, a family counselling centre or a Youth Emergency Shelter of the Finnish Red Cross (SPR Nuorten turvatalo).

so: Bogga InfoFinland Barbaarinta ilmaha dalka Finland gudihiisa waxaa ku jira macluumaad ku saabsan sida carruurta Finland loogu barbaariyo.
en: You can find more information on how children are raised in Finland on the InfoFinland page Bringing up children in Finland.

so: Bogga InfoFinland Dagaalka waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad ku saabsan waxa aad sameyn karto haddii uu qoyska dhexdiisa dagaal ka jiro.
en: Information on what to do if there is violent behaviour in your family is available on the InfoFinland page Violence.

so: Cunugga kayar 15 sano looma ciqaabiyo dembigiisa.
en: A young person under 15 years of age will not be punished for his or her crime.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee sameynta dembiga waxey xittaa kuwa kayar 15 sano ku mutasytaan cawaaqib.
en: However, committing a crime also has consequences for those under 15 years of age.

so: Waxaa waajib ku ah in uu magdhabo khasaaraha uu isagu geystay.
en: The young person is obliged to compensate for the damage caused.

so: Boolsiku wuxuu ha'yadda badbaadada carruurta ku wargeliyaa dembiyada ay geystaan kuwa kayar 18 sano.
en: The police report crimes committed by persons under 18 years of age to child welfare authorities.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan badbaadada carruurta waxey ku jiraa bogga InfoFinland Badbaadada carruurta.
en: More information about child welfare is available on the InfoFinland page Child welfare.

so: Rugta talosiinta qoyska waxey carruurtu, dhallinyaradu iyo qosaskuba caawimaad uga helayaan dhibaatooyinka la xiriira barbaarinta iyo horumarinta carruurta.
en: In a family counselling centre, children, youth and families can get help for problems relating to bringing up children and their development.

so: Waxaad iskaa ula xiriiri kartaa islamarkaasna ballan ka qabsan kartaa rugta talosiinta qoyska.
en: You can contact a family counselling centre yourself and set up an appointment.

so: Rugaha talosiinta qoysku waxey ku yaalaan degmooyin badan.
en: There are family counselling centres in many municipalities.

so: Rugta talosiinta qoysku waa adeeg ay degmadu bixiso.
en: A family counselling centre is a municipal service.

so: Macluumaadyadooda xiriirka waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga shabakadda degmadaada.
en: You can find the relevant contact information on the website of your own municipality.

so: Ururka dadweynaha waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad ku saabsan waalidnimada.
en: The Family Federation provides information on parenting.

so: Waad la xiriir kartaa haddii aad ka fekereyso dhibaato ku saabsan xiriirka lamaanaha, barbaarinta carruurta ama furiin.
en: You can contact the federation when you are faced with relationship problems, parenting or divorce.

so: Xarunta xeeldheerayaasha dhaqamada kala duduwan ee Ururka dadweynuhu waxey taageertaa qoysaska wadanka u soo guuray.
en: The Family Federation's multicultural centre for expertise provides support for immigrant families.

so: Xarunta xeeldheerayaasha waxaad sidoo kale emaylka ama telefoonka uga heleysaa talobixin, haddii aad u baahan tahay in lagaala taliyo barbaarinta carruurta ama xiriirka dadka ee qoyska.
en: The centre for expertise also offers phone and e-mail counselling when you need to discuss issues related to parenting or family relationships.

so: Xarunta xeeldheerayaasha dhaqamada kala duduwan ee Ururka dadweynaha waxaad u soo qori kartaa qoraal ku qoran dari, kurdi (sorani), beershiyaan, finnish, ruush, ingriis ama iswidhish.
en: You can write to the multicultural centre for expertise in Dari, Kurdish (Sorani), Persian, Finnish, Russian, English or Swedish.

so: Macluumaadka xiriirka waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga internetka ee Ururka dadweynaha.
en: The contact information is available at the Family Federation's website.

so: Helsinki iyo Oulu waxaa dhallinyarada ugu yaal Guri wiilasha, halkaas oo ay wiilasho caawimaad raadsan karaan.
en: Helsinki and Oulu also have a Poikien talo, where boys can seek help.

so: Boolsiku wuxuu waalidka iyo ha'yadda badbaadada carruurta ku wargeliyaa dembiyada ay geystaan kuwa kayar 18 sano.
en: The police report crimes committed by persons under 18 years to their parents and to child welfare authorities.

so: Rugaha talosiinta qoysku ama xarumaha qoysasku waxey ku yaalaan degmooyin badan.
en: There are family counselling centres or family centres in many municipalities.

so: Ururka badbaadada carruurta ee Mannerheim wuxuu qoysaska carruurta leh deegaano kala duduwan oo Finland ku yaal ugu qabanqaabiyaa kafeteeriyada qoysaska iyo naadiyada carruurta.
en: Mannerheim League for Child Welfare organises family cafés for families with children and children's clubs at many Finnish localities.

so: Ururku wuxuu sidoo kale waaldiinta siiyaa talooyin ku saabsan barbaarinta.
en: MLL also offers advice to parents on raising children.

so: Xarunta shaqada dhaqamada kala duduwan ee Ururka dadweynuhu waxey taageertaa qoysaska wadanka u soo guuray.
en: The Family Federation's multicultural work provides support for immigrant families.

so: Ururka dadweynaha waxaad sidoo kale emaylka ama telefoonka uga heleysaa talobixin, haddii aad u baahan tahay in lagaala taliyo barbaarinta carruurta ama xiriirka dadka ee qoyska.
en: The Family Federation also offers phone and e-mail counselling when you need to discuss issues related to parenting or family relationships.

so: Ururka dadweynaha waxaad u soo qori kartaa qoraal ku qoran dari, kurdi (sorani), beershiyaan, finnish, ruush, ingriis ama iswidhish.
en: You can write to the Family Federation in Dari, Kurdish (Sorani), Persian, Finnish, Russian, English or Swedish.

so: Dhibaatooyinka xiriirka lamaanaha waxaa lagu falanqeyn karaa teraabiyada lammaanaha iyo qoyska.
en: Relationship problems can be dealt with in couple's therapy and family therapy.

so: Dhibaatooyinkaas waxaa ka mid ah xiriirka oo adkaada, is-aamin la'aan iyo maseyr ama cabsi uu qof ka qabo in uu qofka kale waayo.
en: Such problems can include communication difficulties, infidelity or jealousy, i.e.

so: Caawimaadda teraabiyada ee lamaanaha iyo qoyska waxaa bixiya la-talinta qoyska (perheneuvola) iyo dhexdhexaadiyaha arrimaha qoyska (perheasiain sovittelija), isbitaalada cudurada maskaxda, xarunta wadaxaajoodka arrimaha qoyska ee Kaniisadda (Kirkon perheasiain neuvottelukeskus) ee arrimaha qoyska iyo Ururka caafimaadka Maskaxda ee Finland (Suomen Mielenterveysseura).
en: the fear of losing your partner. Couple's therapy and family therapy are provided by family counselling centres (perheneuvola) and family mediators (perheasiain sovittelija), the Church Family Counselling Centre (Kirkon perheasiain neuvottelukeskus) and the Finnish Association for Mental Health (Suomen Mielenterveysseura).

so: Haddii aadan kaniisadda xubin ka aheyn xitaa xarunta wadaxaajoodka Kaniisadda ee arrimaha qoyska waxaad afafka Iswidishka iyo Ingiriiska ku heli kartaa caawimaad lacag la'aan ah.
en: The Church Family Counselling Centre provides free-of-charge assistance in English and Swedish even if you do not belong to the church.

so: Macluumaadka dgaalka ama rabshadda ee qoyska iyo xiriirka lamaanaha waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Rabshad.
en: More information on violence in the family or in a relationship is available on the InfoFinland web page Violence.

so: Furriinka iyo mas'uuliyadda carruurta
en: Divorce and custody of children

so: Codsiga furriinka waxaad geysan kartaa maxkamadda degmadaada ama degmada lammaanahaaga.
en: Divorce applications can be filed with the district court of your municipality of residence.

so: Furriinka waxaa la dalbadaa laba mar ama laba marxaladood ayuu maraa.
en: Divorce must be applied for twice, i.e. in two phases.

so: Marka aad codsiga furriinka maxkamadda geeyso waxaa bilaabanaya sanad barkiis (käräjäoikeus) oo waqtiga-fiirsashada la yiraahdo.
en: Upon the submission of the divorce application to the district court (käräjäoikeus), a six-month reconsideration period begins.

so: Marka waqtigaas uu dhamaado waa in lix bilood gudahood lagu codsadaa furriinka.
en: Once this period is over, divorce must be filed for within six months.

so: Furriinku wuxuu sharciyan rasmi noqonayaa marki codsiga labaad la aqbalo kadib.
en: The divorce will not become official until the second application has been approved.

so: Haddii carruur ka yar 18 sano ay idinka dhexeeyso adiga iyo lammaanahaaga, xaaladda carruurta waxaa laga tashanayaa marka furiinka la dalbanayo.
en: If you have children under 18 with your spouse, their situation can be resolved at the same time as applying for the divorce.

so: Waxaa laga heshiin karaa qofka carruurta mas'uul ka noqon doona, meesha ay carruurtu degeeyso iyo waqtiyada ay labada waalidba la kulmi karaan carruurta.
en: It can be agreed upon who will take custody of the children, where they will live and when each parent can see them.

so: Sidoo kale waxaa laga heshiin karaa caawimaadda nolosha, waa kaalmada dhaqaale ee labada waalid uu midkood bixiyo carruurta dartood.
en: At this time, you can also agree upon maintenance, i.e. financial support, paid by one of the parents for the child/children.

so: Arrimahaas waxaad ka heshiin kartaan lammaanahaaga ama waxaad u leexan kartaa xafiiska bulshada (sosiaalitoimisto) ee degmada.
en: You can settle the issues with your spouse or contact your local social office (sosiaalitoimisto).

so: Marka guurkaadi uu dhammaado waxaad u baahan kartaa caawimaad nafeed iyo mid sharci.
en: If your marriage ends, you may require both mental support and legal aid.

so: Caawimaadda sharciga waxaad weydiisan kartaa xafiiska caawimaadda sharciga (oikeusaputoimisto).
en: Legal aid can be requested at the Public Legal Aid Office (oikeusaputoimisto).

so: Caawimaadda nafsiga ah ee ku saabsan arrimaha furriinka waxaad ka heli kartaa meelo kala duduwan, tusaale ahaan kooxaha wax caawiya ee loogu talagalay dadka kala tegay ama is-furay.
en: Mental support can be received, for example, in various support groups intended for divorcees.

so: Arrimahaas waxaa qabanqaabiya kaniisadaha iyo ururada.
en: These activities are organised by parishes and various organisations, for example.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo la xiriirta arrimaha mas'uuliyadda carruurta waxaad ka akhrisan kartaa bogga InfoFinlandi Furiin, Qoyska hal waalid keli leh iyo Waa maxey qoys?.
en: More information on matters related to the custody of children is available on the InfoFinland pages Divorce, Single parent families and What is a family?.

so: Dagaalku wuxuu noqon karaa tusaale ahaan
en: Examples of violence include:

so: garaacid, laadis iyo kala tuurid
en: hitting, kicking and pushing

so: Finland dagaalku waa dembi.
en: In Finland, violence is a crime.

so: Dagaalka ka dhanka ah xubnaha qoysku xittaa waa dembi.
en: Violence against one's own family members is also a crime.

so: Ciqaabista jireed ee carruurta sida garaacidu waa dembi.
en: Physical punishment of children, such as hitting them, is also a crime.

so: Dhibbanaha iyo qofka dagaalka sameeyayba waxey heli karaan caawimaad.
en: Help can be obtained by both the victim and the offender.

so: galmo ka iibsashada qof ka yar 18 sano ama dhibbanaha ka ganacsiga dadka
en: Buying sex from persons under 18 years of age or victims of human trafficking

so: galmo lala sameeyo qof ka yar 16 sano
en: Sex with a person under 16 years of age

so: Dagaalka galmadu wuxuu xittaa ka dhici karaa xiriirka lammaanaha ama guurka.
en: Sexual violence can also occur in romantic relationships and marriage.

so: Dagaalka galmadu waa dembi mar kasta, xittaa kan guurka dhexdiisa ka dhaca.
en: Sexual violence is always an offence, even in marriage.

so: Dagaalka sharafta la xiriiraa waa dagaal looga danleeyahay in lagu difaaco sharafta qoyska ama reerka marka qof xubin ka ah looga shakiyo in uu dhaawacay ama dhaawacday sharafta qoyska.
en: Honour related violence is violence aimed at defending the family's honour when a member of the family is suspected of violating its honour.

so: Difaacinta sharafta qoyska ama reerku kama ahan Finland sabab la aqbali karo oo lagu geysto hanjabaad, cadaadin ama dagaal.
en: In Finland, defending the family's honour is not an acceptable reason for threats, pressurising or violence.

so: Dagaalka iyo hanjabaadu waa dembi aan loo eegeyn dhaqanka dhibbaha ama kan dagaalka sameeyay.
en: Violence and threats are regarded as crimes, irrespective of the victim's and offender's cultural background.

so: Dagaalka sharafta la xiriira wuxuu tusaale ahaan noqon karaa
en: Examples of honour related violence include:

so: xadeyn, tusaale ahaan labishada, faraha la gelidda shukaansiga iyo hiwaayadaha
en: restriction, for example, by prohibiting certain kinds of clothing, relationships and hobbies

so: hanjabaad, tusaale ahaan in lagu cabsi geliyo u dirista dalki hooyo.
en: threats of, for example, sending the person to his/her home country

so: ku qasbidda guurka ama ka hortegista furiinka.
en: forced marriages or prevention of divorce.

so: Marka aad u baahan tahay caawimaadda booliska oo aad ku jirto xaalad degdeg ah, wac lambarka guud ee xaaladaha degdegga ah 112.
en: When in need of police assistance, call the general emergency number 112.

so: Ha wicin lambarka xaaladaha degdegga ah haddii aysan xaaladdu aheyn mid degdeg ah.
en: Do not call the emergency number if it is not an urgent emergency.

so: macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan xaadaha degdegga ah waxey ku jiraan bogga Xaaladaha deg degta ah.
en: More information on emergencies is available on the page Emergencies.

so: Telefoonka dadka caawiya ee Xarunta xasaradda Monika waxaa loogu talagalay dumarka dalka u soo guuray.
en: Crisis Center Monika's helpline is intended for immigrant women.

so: Telefoonka wax caawiyaa wuxuu ku adeegaa luqado kala duduwan.
en: The helpline serves in many different languages.

so: Waad soo wici kartaa haddii aad qoyskaada dhexdiisa kala kulantay dagaal, dagaal galmo ama hanjbaad.
en: You can call if you have experienced violence, sexual violence or threats of violence.

so: Wicitaanku waa lacag la'aan.
en: Calling is free of charge.

so: Xarunta xasaradda Monika waxaad sidoo kale kula soo xiriiri kartaa chatka.
en: Crisis Center Monika can also be contacted through chat.

so: Chat wuxuu ku adeegaa Finnish, Ingiriis, Ruush iyo Carabi.
en: The chat serves in Finnish, English, Russian and Arabic.

so: Haddii lammaanahaadu ama xubin kale oo qoyskaada ka tirsan uu kuu adeegsado dagaal, waxaad aadi kartaa guriga ammaanka (turvakoti).
en: If your spouse or family member is violent towards you, you can go stay at a shelter (turvakoti).

so: Guriga waad ku nabadgeleysaa, waxaadna marka kasta jooga shaqaale.
en: You will be safe at the shelter – there is always staff there.

so: Waxaad ka heleysaa caawimaad dagaalku ku dhamaado iyo talooyin aad xaaladdaas uga badbaado.
en: You will get help with ending violence and advice for getting through the situation.

so: Joogista guriga ammaanku waa lacag la'aan.
en: Staying at a shelter is free of charge.

so: Guriga waxaad xittaa la xiriiri kartaa haddii xubin qoyska ka tirsan uu kuugu hanjabo dagaal.
en: You can also contact a shelter if a family member has threatened you with violence.

so: Guriga ammaanka ee Mona waxaa loogu talagalay dumarka dalka u soo guuray oo kaliya.
en: The Mona Shelter is only intended for immigrant women and their children.

so: Wac lambarkan heeganka 045 639 6274, haddii aad guriga ammaanka uga baahan tahay boos.
en: Call the number 045 639 6274 if you need a place at the shelter.

so: Caawimaadda loogu talagalay dagaalka galmada
en: Help with sexual violence

so: Tukinainen waa xarunta xasaradda kufsiga oo aad caawimaad iyo taageero kala heleyso haddii aad noqotay dhibane dagaal galmo.
en: Tukinainen is a rape crisis centre, which provides help and support to victims of sexual violence.

so: Caawimaadda waxaad ku heleysaa Finnish iyo Ingiriis.
en: Support is provided in Finnish and English.

so: Helsinki waxaa ku taal xarunta kaalmada ee SERI ee loogu talagalay dhibbanayaasha dagaalka galmada.
en: There is a SERI Support Center for victims of sexual violence in Helsinki.

so: Xarunata kaalmada ee SERI waxey caawisaa islamarkaasna la talisaa kuwa soo maray dagaal galmo.
en: SERI Support Center helps and gives advice to people who have experienced sexual violence.

so: Adeegyada xaruntu waa tusaale ahaan baaritaan caafimaad iyo caawimaad cilmi-nafsiyadeed.
en: The Support Center's services include medical examinations and counselling by a psychologist.

so: Xarunta kaalmada waxaa ka shaqeeya jinsiga oo dhan.
en: The Support Center helps people of all genders.

so: Toos ayaad u imaan kartaa xarunta kaalmada SERI, laakiin waxaa wanaagsan in horay loo sii waco.
en: You can come to SERI Support Center directly, though it is a good idea to call in advance

so: Waxaad sidoo kale markasta caawimaad ka raadsan kartaa xarunta caafimaadka ee degmadaada.
en: You can also seek help at your municipality's health centre.

so: Caawimaadda loogu talagalay murannada sharafta la xiriira
en: Help with honour related conflicts

so: Haddii aad qoyskaada kala kulantay dagaal la xiriira sharafta ama hanjabaad, waxaad la xiriiri kartaa shaqada Sopu.
en: If you have experienced honour related violence or threats in your family, you can contact Sopu work.

so: Macluumaadyada xiriirka waxaa laga helaa bogagga shabakadda Sopu.
en: You can find the contact information on the Sopu work website.

so: Caawimaadda loogu talagalay joojinta dagaalka
en: Help in stopping violent behaviour

so: Kulanka waxaad ku qabsan kartaa telefoonka, chatka ama emaylka.
en: You can make an appointment by telephone, chat or e-mail.

so: Miehen Linja wuxuu ku shaqeeyaa Finnish, Ingiriis, Iswidhish, Faransiis iyo Giriig.
en: Miehen Linja serves in Finnish, English, Swedish, French and Greek.

so: Waxaa intaas dheer in adeegga aad ku heli karto afkaada hooyo iyadoo turjubaan la isticmaalayo.
en: You can also be served in your native language via an interpreter.

so: Maria Akatemia waxey caawisaa dumarka isticmaalay ama ka baqaya in ay isticmaalaan dagaal ka dhan xubnaha qoyskooda.
en: Maria Akatemia helps women who have used violence against family members or afraid that they will do so.

so: Haddii qof kuu hanjabo ama uu si joogto ah kuu dhibayo oo aad dooneyso in lagaa badbaadiyo waxaad qofkaas u codsan kartaa mamnuucista u soo dhowaanshaha (lähestymiskielto).
en: If someone is continuously threatening or harassing you and you would like some protection, you can apply for a restraining order (lähestymiskielto).

so: Mamnuucista u soo dhowaanshaha waxaa loola jeedaa in qofkaas uusan kula soo xiriiri karin.
en: A restraining order means that the affected person is not allowed to contact you.

so: Waxaad mamnuucista u soo dhowaanshaha ka codsan kartaa booliska ama maxkamadda (käräjäoikeus).
en: You can apply for a restraining order at a police station or the district court (käräjäoikeus).

so: Haddii aad heysato cadeymo ku saabsan hanjabaadda waxaa haboon inaad keydsato.
en: If you have evidence of threats and harassment, keep the evidence in your possession.

so: Arrimaha sharciga la xiriira waxaad caawimaad uga heleysaa qareenka.
en: In legal matters, you can get help from a lawyer.

so: Qareenku wuu kula talinayaa wuxuuna ku dadaalayaa in xuquuqdaadu ay hirgasho.
en: He or she will advise you and ensure that your rights are secured.

so: Marka aad caawimaad ka raadsaneyso qareenka waxaa kuu wanaagsan in aad ogaato in qareenku uu aqoon gaar ah u leeyahay arrinta aad caawimaadda u raadsanyso.
en: When you seek help from a lawyer, you should find out whether they are competent in the matters that you need help with.

so: Shirkadaha iyo dadka bixiya caawimaadda arrimaha sharcigu ma ahan dhammaantood kuwa aqoon gaar ah leh.
en: Not all firms or people who offer help with legal matters are necessarily competent.

so: Adeegyada qareenku waa lacag, laakiin haddii uu dakhligaadu yar yahay ama uu dhexdhexaad yahay, waxaad xafiiska caawimaadda arrimaha sharciga (oikeusaputoimisto) ee dowladda ka heli kartaa caawimaad sharci oo lacag la'aan kuu ah ama aad qeyb ahaan ka bixineyso kharashka kugu baxaya.
en: The services of a lawyer are subject to a fee, but if your income is low or average, you may be eligible for free or partially reimbursed legal aid from the Public Legal Aid Office (oikeusaputoimisto).

so: Caawimaadda guud ee arrimaha sharciga waxaad ku heli kartaa xittaa af Ingiriis haddii loo baahdana waxaa la isticmaali karaa adeegyada turjumaadda.
en: Public legal aid is also provided in English and, if necessary, the services of an interpreter may be employed.

so: Caawimaaadda guud ee arrimaha sharciga waxaa laga codsadaa xafiiska caawimaadda arrimaha sharciga ee dowladda.
en: Public legal aid can be applied for at the Public Legal Aid Office.

so: Haddii aad heysato ceymiska xuuquda badbaadada (oikeusturvavakuutus) oo daboolaya kharashkaada, ma heleysid caawimaadda guud ee arrimaha sharciga.
en: If you have legal expenses insurance (oikeusturvavakuutus) to cover your legal costs, you are not eligible for public legal aid.

so: Inta badan ceymiska xuquuqda badbaadadu wuxuu ku jiraa ceymiska guriga.
en: Legal expenses insurance is often included in home insurance policies.

so: Qareennada iyo looyarada gaar ah
en: Private lawyers and attorneys

so: Qareen waxaad ka raadsan kartaa tusaale ahaan bogagga shabakadda ee Ururka qareennada Finland, adegga Etsi asianajaja.
en: You can search for a lawyer through the Finnish Bar Association's Etsi asianajaja service, for example.

so: Haddii aad arrimaha la xiriira sharciga degenaanshaha dalka ama dhalashada Finland uga baahan tahay qareen, waxaad la xiriiri kartaa Talobixinta qaxootiga oo ay ka shaqeeyaan qareeno ku takhasusay arrimaha ruqsadaha.
en: If you need a lawyer's help with an issue connected to residence permits or applying for Finnish citizenship, you can contact the Refugee Advice Centre, which employs lawyers who specialise in permit issues.

so: Talobixinta qaxootigu (Pakolaisneuvonta) waa talobixin sharciyeed lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dadka megangelyo-doonka ah, qaxootiga iyo dadka kale ee ajnabiga ah.
en: The Refugee Advice Centre (Pakolaisneuvonta) provides legal advice to asylum seekers, refugees and other foreigners free of charge.

so: Emayl ayaad sidoo kale u soo diri kartaa.
en: You can also send e-mail.

so: Bogga InfoFinland Dembiyada waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad ku saabsan waxa aad sameyn karto marka aad noqoto dhibbane dembi.
en: Information on what to do if you fall victim to an offence is available on the InfoFinland page Crimes.

so: Bogga InfoFinland Wac oo talo weydii waxaad ka heleysaa adeegyada talobixinta.
en: You can find more counselling services on the InfoFinland page Call and ask for advice.

so: Haddii aad noqoto dhibbane dembi
en: If you become a victim of crime

so: Haddii aad degdeg ugu baahan tahay caawimaadda booliska, wac lambarka halista guud 112.
en: If you need police assistance quickly, call the emergency number 112.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinland Xaaladaha deg degta ah.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Emergencies.

so: Qof kasta wuxuu xaq u leeyahay in uu booliska ku wargeliyo dembiga dhacay, yacni wargelinta dembiga.
en: Everyone is entitled to report a crime to the police.

so: Wargelinta dembiga waxaa laga sameyn karaa telefoonka, saldhigga booliska oo si shakhsi ah loo tago ama bogagga shabakadda booliska.
en: You can report a crime by telephone, at a police station in person or through the police website.

so: Sida ugu dhakhsaha badan u samee wargelinta dembiga.
en: Report the crime as soon as possible.

so: Haddii aad tahay dhibbane dembi waxaad taageero iyo talobixin ka heli kartaa Heeganka dhibbanaha dembiga.
en: If you are a victim of a crime, you can get support and advice from Victim Support Finland.

so: Heeganka dhibbanaha dembiga waxaad kula xiriiri kartaa telefoonka, chatinka ama waxaad imaan kartaa goobta adeegga.
en: You can contact Victim Support Finland by telephone or chat or visit a local service point.

so: Heeganka dhibbanaha dembigu wuxuu sidoo kale bixiyaa talobixin sharciyeed lacag la'aan ah.
en: Victim Support Finland also offers free legal advice.

so: Heeganka dhibbanaha dembigu wuxuu sidoo kale bixiyaa talobixin ka dhan ah takoorka.
en: Victim Support Finland also gives non-discrimination advice.

so: Waad la xiriiri kartaa talobixinta haddi aad ka shakiso in adiga lagu takooray.
en: You can contact an advice number if you suspect that you have been discriminated against.

so: Macluumaadyada xiriirka ee Heeganka dhibbanaha dembiga waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga shabakadda.
en: You can find the contact information of Victim Support Finland on the website.

so: Caawimaadda sharciga ee dhibbanaha dembiga
en: Legal aid to a victim of crime

so: Caawimaadda arrimaha sharciga waxaa loola jeedaa in aad heli karto qareen kharashkiisa ay dowladdu gebi ahaan ama qeyb ahaan kaa bixineyso.
en: Legal aid means that you can get an attorney for free or with the government paying part of the costs.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan caawimaadda sharciga waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinland Ma u baahan tahay qareen?
en: You can find more information on the InfoFinland page Do you need a lawyer?

so: Haddii adiga dembi lagaaga shakiyo
en: If you are suspected of a crime

so: Haddii uu boolisku kaaga shakiyo dembi, wuxuu kuugu yeerayaa taliska booliska si uu su'aalo kuu weydiiyo.
en: If the police suspect you of a crime, they will summon you to a police station for hearing.

so: Haddii uu dembigu yahay mid daran, boolisku waa qaban karaa qofka laga shakiyay waana xiri karaan.
en: In case of a serious crime, the police may also seize or arrest the suspect.

so: Qofka dembiga looga shakiyay xittaa wuxuu xaq u leeyahay caawimaad sharciyeed.
en: Suspects are also entitled to legal aid.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan caawimaadda sharciyeed waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinland Ma u baahan tahay qareen?
en: You can find more information about legal aid on the InfoFinland page Do you need a lawyer?

so: Nidaamka ka baaraandegista dacwad dembiyeedka ee Finland
en: Handling of criminal cases in Finland

so: Haddii uu boolisku ka shakiyo in dembi dhacay, wuxuu billaabayaa baaritaanka hore.
en: If the police suspect that there has been a crime, they start a pre-trial investigation.

so: Marka uu boolisku diyaariyana wuxuu kiiska dembigu u wareegayaa xeer-ilaaliyaha.
en: Once the police have completed the pre-trial investigation, the criminal case transfers to the prosecutor.

so: Xeer-ilaaliyaha ayaa ka fiirsanaya in uu dacwad soo oogo.
en: The prosecutor considers whether to prosecute.

so: Haddii uu xeer-ilaaliyuhu go'aansado in uu dacwad soo oogo kiiska dembigu wuxuu u wareegayaa dacwad qaadista maxkamadda.
en: If the prosecutor decides to prosecute, the criminal case moves to court.

so: Xeer-ilaaliyuhu wuxuu sidoo kale go'aansan karaa in uusan dacwad soo oogin.
en: The prosecutor may also decide not to prosecute.

so: Kiisaska dembiyada qaarkood qoraal ahaan ayaa looga baaraandegi karaa, markaasna looma baahna in fadhiga dacwadda laga qeyb-qaato.
en: Criminal cases can also be settled out of court if the victim and suspect agree to this.

so: Sida waafaqsan dastuurka Finland waa in dadka loo tixgeliyaa si sinnaan ah iyadoon loo eegeyn asalkiisa iyo jinsigiisa.
en: According to Finnish law, everyone is entitled to be treated equally regardless of their background or gender.

so: Takooristu waxaa looga jeedaa kala darejeyn tixgelin, taasoo qofna lagu xumeeyo qofna lagu wanaajiyo arrin isku mid ah.
en: Discrimination refers to unequal treatment, i.e. treating one person more poorly than another in the same situation.

so: Takoorkistu way ahaan kartaa tusaale mid lagu takooro qofka asalkiisa, jinsiyadiisa iyo diintiisa.
en: Discrimination can be based on ethnic group, nationality or religion etc.

so: Takooristu wey ahaan kartaa hanjabaad, cadowtinimada, yasitaanka ama bahdil ku sameynta.
en: Creating a threatening, hostile, disparaging or humiliating atmosphere can also be considered discrimination.

so: Takooristu wey ahaan kartaa in qof uu qof kale u amro ama u hago si takooris ah.
en: In addition, inciting or directing someone to perform discriminatory acts is regarded discrimination.

so: Takooristu waxay ahaan kartaa tusaale in, haddii aad ku weyso adeeg asalkaaga dartiis ama lagu xujeeyo warysiga dalbashada shaqo inaad u taqaaano afka finnishka si buuxd , iyadoon aheyn qabashada shaqada iney u baahan tahay aqoon luuqada ah.
en: Examples of discrimination include not getting service due to your ethnic origin, or being required to demonstrate perfect proficiency in Finnish at a job interview although the work itself does not require such skills.

so: In loola dhaqmo dadka si kala duwan, ma aha macnaheedu had iyo goor takooris.
en: Treating people differently is not always discrimination.

so: Dadka waa kala tixgelin duwanaan karaan, haddey jirto sabab macquul ah.
en: People can be treated differently if there are acceptable grounds.

so: Qodobka sinnaanta ayaa qeexaya, waa maxay takoorka.
en: The Non-Discrimination Act defines what is considered discrimination.

so: Qodobka sinnaanta ayaa diidaya ku takoorista da'da, asalka, jinsiyada, luuqada, diinta, cibaadadda, fikirka, howlaha siyaasinimo, howlaha ururka shaqaalaha, aalada qoyska, xaalad caafimaad, naafonimada, lagaroonimada ama waxyaalo kale oo shaqsi la xiriira.
en: The Act prohibits discrimination based on age, origin, nationality, language, religion, belief, opinion, political activity, trade union activity, family circumstances, health, disability, sexual orientation or other personal characteristics.

so: Qofna ma aha in laga dhigo inuu qof kale ka liito arrimahaas dartood.
en: No one must be put in a less favourable position due to these factors.

so: Qodobka sinnaanta ayaa diidaya ku takoorista jinsiga dartiis.
en: The Equality Act prohibits discrimination based on gender.

so: Cunsurinimada iyo denbiyada cunsuriyeenta
en: Racism and racist offences

so: Cunsuriyad (rasismi) waxaa loola jeedaa qolo qmq ruux ka tirsam meel in lagu tilmaamo inuu ka liito kuwo kale tusaale asalkiisa, midabkiisa jinsiyadiisa, dhaqankiisa, luuqadiisa ama diintiisa darteed.
en: Racism (rasismi) refers to regarding a group of people or a person belonging to that group as inferior on the grounds of, for example, ethnic origin, skin colour, nationality, culture, mother tongue or religion.

so: Denbiga cunsuriyeenta waxaa laga wadaa markuu geystaha falka markuu ugeysto falka si cunsurinimo leh.
en: A racist offence means a crime which the offender committed for a racist reason.

so: Denbiga cunsuruyeentu wuu ahaan karaa tusaale dagaal u geesasho, sharaf-dhac, takooris, hanjabaad, aflagaado ama waxyeeleyn.
en: Racist offences can be violence, defamation, discrimination, threats, harassment or vandalism.

so: Haddii laguu geysto dhib cunsuriyad ah wargeli arrinka booliiska.
en: Should you fall victim to a racist crime, contact the police.

so: Caawimaad loogu talagalay dhibanayaasha takoorka
en: Aid to a victim of discrimination

so: Haddii aad dareemeyso goobta shaqada takooris, la xariir marka hore maddaxa shaqadaada.
en: Should you experience discrimination at work, contact your superior.

so: Haddii arrinkii ku xalismi waayo goobtii shaqada la xiriir nawaaxigaaga badbaadadda shaqaalaha työsuojelupiiriin ama urrrurka shaqaalaha aad xubinta ka tahay.
en: If the issue cannot be resolved at the workplace, contact your local occupational safety district (työsuojelupiiri) or your trade union.

so: Haddii aad ka shakiso in lagu takooray, waxaad la xiriir kartaa talobixinta ka dhanka ah takoorista ee Heeganka dhibanaha dembiga.
en: If you suspect that you have been discriminated against, you can contact the non-discrimination advice of Victim Support Finland.

so: Talobixinta ka dhanka takoorku waxey ku shaqeysaa telefoonka.
en: Non-discrimination advice helps by telephone.

so: Macluumaadyada xiriirka ee talobixinta waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga shabakadda ee Heeganka dhibanaha dembiga.
en: You can find the contact information on the Victim Support Finland website.

so: Haddii aad kala kulanto takooris meelo kale oon aheyn goobta shaqada ama aad dareento takooris, waxaad la xiriirtaa u doodayaasha sinnaanta (yhdenvertaisuusvaltuutettu).
en: If you experience discrimination outside work or you have observed discrimination elsewhere, you can contact the Non-Discrimination Ombudsman (yhdenvertaisuusvaltuutettu).

so: Waad ula xiriiri kartaa xitaa dad kale ama horin kale adigoo matalaya.
en: You can also contact the authorities on behalf of a person or group.

so: U doodayaasha sinnaanta waa masuul maddax banaan, kaasoo howshiisu tahay horumarinta sinnaanta iyo inuu wax ka qabto wixii takooris ah.
en: The Non-Discrimination Ombudsman is an independent and autonomous authority whose task is to advance equality in Finland and to prevent and tackle discrimination.

so: U doodaha sinnaanta wuxuu sharxaad ka weydiin karaa inuu ka bixiyo takoorista ruuxa lagu tuhmayo.
en: If needed, the Ombudsman can request the person suspected of discrimination to provide a statement of the incident.

so: Waxaa intaa dheer oo la sameyn karaa in arrinkii la hor geeyo Gudigga u doodayaasha sinnaanta ama maxkamad.
en: The Ombudsman can also forward or help you take your case to the National Discrimination and Equality Tribunal or to court.

so: Macluumaadyada xiriirka waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga shabakadda Wakiiladda sinnaanta u dooda.
en: You can find the contact information on the National Non-Discrimination and Equality Tribunal website.

so: Gudigu waxay xaliyaan codsiyada la xiriira takoorista weyna kahortagaan takoorka.
en: The Tribunal considers petitions on discrimination and may prohibit discrimination.

so: Sidoo kale gudiggu waxay ansixin karaan heshiiska labada dhinac.
en: The Tribunal can also confirm a settlement between the parties.

so: Gudiggu howshooda ma aha takoorika arrimaha la xiriira goobaha shaqada.
en: The Tribunal does not handle cases of employment-related discrimination.

so: Haddey kula soo gudboonaato takooris ama cunsuriyeen, waxaad talosiin iyo caawinadba ka heli kartaa ururada ajaaniibta.
en: If you encounter discrimination or racism, you can also get help and advice from immigrant associations.

so: Xogta ururada ajaaniibta waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Ururada.
en: For contact details, see the InfoFinland page Associations.

so: Haddii aadan bixin karin biilkaada
en: If you cannot pay your bills

so: Haddii aad heysato biil aadan awoodin in aad bixiso, horay kala xiriir soo diraha biilka.
en: If you are unable to pay a bill, immediately contact its sender.

so: Inta badan biilka waxaad u heleysaa wakhti dheeraad ah oo aad ku bixiso.
en: You can often get an extension for the payment due date of the bill.

so: Markaas waxaa biilka lagu daraa inta badan dulsaarka soo daahista.
en: In such cases, a small late fee is usually added to the bill.

so: Haddii aadan biilka bixin ugu dambeynta maalinta ugu dambeysa ama aadan biilka u helin wakhtiga bixinta oo dheeraad ah waxaa qasab kugu noqoneysa in aad bixiso kharashka xusuusinta iyo deynta ka gudashada iyo weliba dulsaarka soo daahista.
en: If you have not paid a bill by its due date and have not agreed on an extension, you have to pay a reminder and collection fee as well as a late fee.

so: Haddii aadan biilka ku bixin maalinta ugu dambeysa waxaa laguu soo dirayaa biil xusuusin ah.
en: If you have not paid a bill by its due date, you will receive a reminder bill.

so: Hal ama labo xusuusin kaddibna biilku wuxuu u wareegi karaa xafiiska deyn ka qaadista.
en: After one or two reminders, the bill may transfer to a collection agency.

so: Xafiiska deyn ka qaadistu wuxuu kuu soo dirayaa dalabka bixinta.
en: The collection agency will send you a demand for payment.

so: Haddii aadan biilka horay ka bixin karin, la xiriir xafiiska deyn ka qaadista kaddibna kala heshii qorshe aad biilka ku bixinayso.
en: If you are unable to pay the bill immediately, contact the collection agency and arrange a payment plan for the bill.

so: Haddii aadan biilka bixin ama aadan gelin qorshe aad ku bixineyso, deyntu waxey u gudbi kartaa ugu dambeyn la wareegista (ulosotto).
en: If you do not pay the bill or arrange a payment plan, the debt may finally go into enforcement (ulosotto).

so: La wareegis waxaa loola jeedaa in dowladdu ay xaq u leedahay in ay qeyb ka qaadato dakhliga ku soo gala si deynta loo bixiyo.
en: Enforcement means that the authority will have the right to take some of your income to pay your debt.

so: Hay'adda la wareegistu xittaa waxey iibin kartaa hantidaada qiimaha leh si deynta loo bixiyo.
en: The enforcement authority can also sell your valuable possessions in order to pay the debt.

so: Inta badan la wareegistu waxey u baahan tahay go'aan maxkamadeed.
en: A decision of the district court is often required for enforcement.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee bixinta lacagaha qaarkood waxey toos u aadaan la wareegista.
en: However, some payments go into enforcement immediately.

so: Lacagahaas waxaana ka mid ah tusaale ahaan canshuuraha, lacagaha xarunta cafimaadka iyo lacagaha xannaano-maalmeedka.
en: Such payments include taxes, health centre fees and day-care fees, for example.

so: Haddii aadan bixin biilka ama deynta, waxaad rajistareeshinka macluumaadka buuxinta shuruudaha ka heleysaa calaamadda bixin weynta deynta (maksuhäiriömerkintä).
en: If you do not pay a bill or debt, you may get a non-payment record (maksuhäiriömerkintä) in the credit information register.

so: Dhibaatooyin badan ayeey arrintan sababtaa.
en: It causes many difficulties.

so: Kireeyayaasha guryaha iyo bangiyadu waxey inta badan hubiyaan macluumaadka buuxinta shuruudaha amaah-siinta.
en: Landlords and banks often check your credit information in the register.

so: Haddii aad leedahay calaamadda bixin weynta deynta ma heleysid guri kiro ah, deynta bangiga ama kaararka deynta ku gadashada.
en: If you have a non-payment record, you may not get a rental dwelling, bank loan or credit card.

so: Shaqo-bixiyaha ayaa sidoo kale kugu xiri kara shardi ah in shaqaaluhu uusan laheyn calaamadda bixin weynta deynta.
en: An employer may also demand that their employee not have any non-payment records.

so: Haddii aadan awoodin inaad kirada gurigaada bixiso
en: If you cannot pay your rent

so: Haddii aadan bixin kirada gurigaada, kaa kireeyaha gurigu wuxuu xaq u leeyahay in uu heshiiska ka baxo.
en: Your lessor is entitled to dissolve your rental agreement if you do not pay your rent.

so: Kireeyaha gurigu waa in uu ogeysiiyaa kan guriga laga kireeyay ka bixista heshiiska.
en: The lessor must notify the tenant of the dissolution of the rental agreement.

so: Marxaladdan marka lagu jiro waxaa weli suurtagal ah in sida caadiga ah in lagala heshiiyo guri kireeyaha bixinta lacagta kirada.
en: At this point it is usually still possible to reach an agreement with the lessor concerning the payment of due rent.

so: Haddii aadan bixin kiradaada, guri kireeyuhu wuxuu maxkamadda ka codsan karaa go'aanka guri ka saarista.
en: If you do not pay your rent, your lessor can ask a court for an eviction.

so: Waxaa loola jeedaa inay waajib kugu tahay inaad guriga ka guurto iyo inaad bixiso kirooyinka aadan horay u bixin.
en: This means that you will have to move out of the apartment and pay the rent you have neglected to pay.

so: Haddii aad dhib ku qabto bixinta kirada gurigaada, la xiriir kireeyaha guriga.
en: If you are having difficulties paying your rent, contact your lessor.

so: Isku day inaad kala heshiiso kireeyaha guriga waqti dheeraad ah oo aad ku bixiso kirada.
en: Ask your lessor to give you more time to make the payment.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale talo weydiin kartaa xafiiska sooshaalka ee degmadaada.
en: You can also ask for advice from your local social welfare office.

so: Hubso sidoo kale inaad tusaale ahaan xaq u leedahay kaalmada kirada ama kaalmada nolosha.
en: Also find out if you are entitled to receive, for example, housing allowance or income support.

so: Xaqaada kaalmada kirada iyo lacagta kaalmada nolosha waxaad ka ogaan kartaa Kelada.
en: You can ask Kela if you are eligible to receive housing allowance and income support.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi Kaalmada kirada waxaa ku jira macluumaadyo ku saabsan kaalmada kirada.
en: The InfoFinland web page Housing allowance contains information on housing allowance.

so: Hubi in aad codsatay dhammaan manfacyada bulshada ee aad helitaankooda xaq u leedahay.
en: Check that you have applied for all the social benefits you are entitled to receive.

so: Manfacyadaan waxey noqon karaan tusaale ahaan ammaanka shaqo la'aanta, taageerada ijaarka, taageerada waxbarashada iyo taageerooyinka dhaqaale ee loogu talagalay qoysaska carruurta leh.
en: They may include, for example, unemployment benefit, housing allowance, student financial aid and financial aid for families with children.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinland Ammaanka bulsho ee Finland.
en: You can find more information on the InfoFinland page Finnish social security.

so: Haddii dakhliga ama hantida adiga ama qoyskaagu aysan ku filnayn daboolida kharashaadka nolol maalmeedka ee daruuriga ah, waxaad Kelada ka dalban kartaa lacagta kaalmada nolosha ee aasaasiga ah (perustoimeentulotuki).
en: If your or your family's income and assets are not enough to cover necessary daily expenses, you can apply for basic income support (perustoimeentulotuki) from Kela.

so: Kharashaadka nolol maalmeedka ee daruuriga ah waxaa loola jeedaa tusaale ahaan kharashaadka la xiriira cuntada, dharka, daryeelka caafimaadka iyo degaanka.
en: The necessary daily expenses mean reasonable expenses on, for example, food, clothes, healthcare and housing.

so: Lacagta kaalmada nolosha ee aasaasiga ah waxay sidoo kale dabooshaa kharashaadka ku baxa hiwaayadda iyo hawlaha nashaadaadka, kharashka xanaanada carruurta iyo sidoo kale hawlaha waxqabadka subaxa iyo iyo kan galabnimo ee iskuuleyda iyo weliba kharashaadka guuritaanka daruuriga ah.
en: Basic income support also covers expenses on hobbies and recreational activities, children's day care, morning and afternoon activities for schoolchildren and necessary moving costs.

so: Bixinta lacagta kaalmada nolosha waxaa saameyn ku yeelanaya dhammaan dakhligaaga iyo hantidaada.
en: Your income support is affected by all your income and assets.

so: Waxaa ku jira oo lagu xisaabinayaa tusaale ahaan gunnooyinka sooshalka ee aad Kelada ka hesho, caymika hawlgabka shaqada ama lacagta qasnadda shaqo-la'aanta.
en: This also includes social welfare benefits from, for example, Kela, employment pension insurance or unemployment fund.

so: Kahor inta aadan dalban lacagta kaalmada nolosha, dalbo caawinaadahaan kale, ee aad xaq u leedahay (tusaale ahaan lacagta badbaadada shaqola'aanta, lacagta kaalmada kirada, lacagta hawlgabka, lacagta kaalmada waxbarashada, lacag maalmeedka waalidnimada, lacag maalmeedka jirada, lacagta guri ku daryeelka ama lacagta quudinta carruurta ee waalidka laga qaado).
en: Before applying for income support, apply for all the other benefits and allowances that you are entitled to (such as unemployment benefit, housing allowance, pension, study grant, parenthood allowance, sickness allowance, child home care allowance or child maintenance support).

so: Lacagta kaalmada nolosha waxaa loogu talo galay inay noqoto cawinaad ku meel gaar ah.
en: Income support is meant to be a temporary help.

so: Lacagta kaalmada nolosha waxaa la bixiyaa oo keliya, haddii aadan heli karin dakhliyaad kale ama kaalmooyin iyo haddii kaalmooyinka kale aysan dabooli karin kharashaadka daruuriga ah.
en: Income support is only paid if you cannot get any other income or benefits or if the other benefits do not cover the necessary expenses.

so: Haddii ay jiraan kharashaad ay sababaan baahiyo gooni ah oo adiga ama qoyskaaga u gaar ah, kuwaas oo aadan ku dabooli karin lacagta kaalmada nolosha ee aasaasiga ah, xafiiska sooshalka ee degmadaada ayaa ku siinaya lacagta kaalmada nolosha ee ah dhammeystirka iyo ka hortagga (täydentävä ja ehkäisevä toimeentulotuki).
en: If you or your family have expenses caused by special needs and you cannot get basic income support for those expenses, your municipality's social welfare office may grant supplementary and preventive income support (täydentävä ja ehkäisevä toimeentulotuki).

so: Lacagta kaalmada nolosha ee ah dhammeystirka waxaad ku heli kartaa tusaale ahaan badbaadada degaanka ama haddii xaaladdaada dhaqaaluhu ay si lama filaan ah isugu badesho mid liidata.
en: You can get income support, for example, to secure your housing situation or if your financial situation suddenly gets worse.

so: Lacagta kaalmada nolosha ee ah dhammeystirka iyo ka hortagga waxaa loogu talogalay horumarinta waxqabsiga qofka iyo ka hortegida gooni u bixidda.
en: The purpose of supplementary and preventive income support is to help people manage on their own and prevent social exclusion.

so: Lacagta kaalmada nolosha ee aasaasiga ah mar walba horay uga codso Kelada.
en: Always apply to Kela for basic income support first.

so: Sidoo kale isla foomka codsiga waxaad ku ogeysiin kartaa, haddii aad u baahantahay lacagta kaalmada nolosha ee ah dhammeystirka iyo ka hortagga.
en: If you need supplementary or preventive income support, you can mention it in the same application.

so: Kelada ayaa codsigaaga lacagta kaalmada nolosha ee ah dhammeystirka iyo ka hortagga u wareejin karta degmada si ay go'aan uga gaarto.
en: If you ask, Kela can transfer your application for supplementary and preventive income support to your municipality.

so: Haddii aad dooneysid, waxaad la talin xagga buuxinta codsiga lacagta kaalmada nolosha ah ka heli karaysaa Kelada, xafiiska sooshalka ee degmadaada ama barta la talin dadka waddanka u soo guurey.
en: If you need, you can get advice about applying for income support from Kela, your municipality's social welfare office or immigrants' information service point.

so: Talobixinta iyo caawimaadda arrimaha lacagta
en: Counselling and help with money problems

so: Haddii aad dhib ku qabto bixinta biilasha iyo deymaha, la xiriir talobixinta dhaqaalaha iyo deynta (talous- ja velkaneuvonta).
en: If you have problems with paying bills and debts, contact financial and debt counselling unit (talous- ja velkaneuvonta).

so: Talobixinta dhaqaalaha iyo deynta waxaa qabanqaabiya degmooyinka.
en: Financial and debt counselling is organised by municipalities.

so: Talobixintu waa lacag la'aan.
en: The counselling is free of charge.

so: Takuusäätiö waxaad bixinta deymaha uga heli kartaa caawimaad iyo talooyin.
en: Takuusäätiö can give help and advice for paying debts.

so: Mu'asasadu waxey kaa caawin kartaa isku xirka deymaha iyo hal deyn ka dhigistooda.
en: The foundation can help you combine your debts into a single loan.

so: Mu'asasada damaanadda waxaad ka codsan kartaa damaanadda deynta, haddii aad bangiga uga baahan tahay amaah aad deymaha ku bixiso.
en: You can apply for a loan guarantee from the Guarantee Foundation if you need a bank loan to pay your debts.

so: Mu'asasada damaanadda waxaad sidoo kale ka codsan kartaa amaah yar haddii aad u baahan tahay lacag aad wax ku iibsato halmar sida makiinadaha guriga, qalabka guryaha, dibaajiga kirada, dayactirka baabuurka ama muraayadaha aragga.
en: You can also apply to the Guarantee Foundation for a small loan if you need money for a non-recurring expense, such as a household appliance, furniture, rental deposit, car repair or eyeglasses.

so: Velkalinja waa telefoonka talobixinta lacag la'aanta ah ee Mu'asasada damaanadda.
en: Velkalinja is a free-of-charge telephone helpline maintained by the Guarantee Foundation.

so: Lambarka talobixinta 0800 9 8009 wuxuu ku shaqeeyaa af Finnish haddii loo baahdana af Ingiriis ama Iswidhish.
