en: The helpline at 0800 9 8009 provides its services in Finnish, and, if necessary, in English or Swedish.

so: Marka ay jirto xaalad degdeg ah oo aysan lacagtaadu kuugu filneyn tusaale ahaan cuntada, waxaad la xiriiri kartaa shaqaalaha adeegga bulshada ee kaniisadda.
en: In emergencies where you do not have enough money for food, for example, you can also contact a parish welfare worker (diakoniatyöntekijä).

so: Macluumaadka xiriirka waxaad ka heleysaa kaniisadaada.
en: The contact information can be obtained from the parish.

so: Haddii ay dhibaatooyinka dhaqaale ka dhalanayaan ciyaarta khamaarka, waa in aad caawimaad raadsataa.
en: If your financial problems are caused by your gambling problem, you should seek help.

so: Dhibaatooyinka ciyaaraha waxaad caawimaad uga heli kartaa A-kiliinikada (A-klinikka), xafiiska caafimaadka maskaxda (mielenterveystoimisto) iyo xarumaha caafimaadka (terveyskeskus).
en: You can seek help for gambling problems from A-clinics (A-klinikka), mental health clinics (mielenterveystoimisto) and health centres (terveyskeskus).

so: Deegaanada qaarkood xafiiska bulshada (sosiaalitoimisto) iyo kaniisadaha ku yaal ayaa ku caawin kara.
en: In some municipalities, social offices (sosiaalitoimisto) and parishes can also provide assistance.

so: Sidoo kale ehelka qofka ciyaarta khamaarka qabatimay waxay heli karaan caawimaad.
en: Help is also available to close relatives of gambling addicts.

so: Caawimaada dhibaatooyinka ciyaaraha khamaarka waxaad ka heli kartaa sidoo kale.
en: Help for gambling problems is also available from organisations.

so: Adeegga shabakadda Isku xirka-mukhaadaraadka (Päihdelinkki) ee luqadaha badan waxaa laga helaa macluumaad ku saabsan dhibaatoyinka ciyaaraha khamaarka.
en: The multi-language AddictionLink (Päihdelinkki) online service contains a wealth of information on gambling problems.

so: Khamaariiste (Peluuri) waa telefoon wax caawiya oo loogu talagalay dadka qaba dhibaatada ciyaarta khamaarka, ehelkooda iyo dadka kale ee la kulma dhibaatooyinka ciyaarta khamaarka.
en: Peluuri is a helpline for people with gambling problems, people close to them and other people who are facing gambling problems.

so: Wuxuu ku adeegaa af finnish, iswiidhish iyo sida loo helo ingiriisi.
en: It provides services in Finnish, Swedish and also in English, when possible.

so: Khamaariste wuxuu sidoo kale wax ku caawiyaa internetka.
en: Peluuri is also available online.

so: Haddii aad joogitaanka Finland dartiis ugu baahan tahay dal ku gal ama ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka laakiin aadan heysan waxaad Finland ku joogtaa sharci daro.
en: If you need a visa or residence permit for residence in Finland but do not have one, you are in Finland illegally.

so: Magangelyo doonka xaq ayeey u leeyihiin inay joogaan Finland ayagoo heysan dal ku gal ama ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka ilaa ka baaraandega codsigooda magangelyo doonku uu qaadanayo.
en: Asylum seekers have the right to stay in Finland without a visa or residence permit for the duration of the processing of their asylum application.

so: Inkastoo aad si sharci ah ku timid Finland, joogistaada Finland waxay isu bedeli kartaa sharci daro tusaale ahaan marka aad joogto dalka inkastoo aadan helin ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka ama dal ku gal ama uu dhamaaday waqtigi uu shaqeynayay ogolaanshiyahaada joogitaanku.
en: Even if you have arrived in Finland legally, your stay may become illegal if, for example, you remain in the country even though you have not received a residence permit or the validity of your visa or residence permit has expired.

so: Macluumaadka sida aad ku heli karto ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka Finland waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi U soo guurista Finland.
en: Information about how to obtain a residence permit for Finland is available on the InfoFinland page Moving to Finland.

so: Kaalmo cunto iyo deegaan
en: Food assistance and accommodation

so: Waxaad xaq u leedahay dejin degdeg ah iyo kaalmo cunto,haddii aadan heysan heysan lacag aad ku gadato cunto ama meel aad ku hoyato.
en: If you have no money for food or no place to stay the night, you are entitled to emergency accommodation and food assistance.

so: Deginta degdegga ah waxaa qabanqaabiya degmooyinka, kaniisadaha iyo ururada qaarjiid.
en: Emergency accommodation is organised by municipalities, parishes and some organisations.

so: Ururka la talinta qáxootiga ayaa la-talin sharci oo lacag la'aan ah siiya dadka dalka u soo guuray ee aan warqadaha laheyn.
en: The Refugee Advice Centre provides free legal advice to undocumented immigrants.

so: La-talinta waxaa bixinayaa sharciyaqaan.
en: The advice is provided by a lawyer.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga shabakadda ee la-talinta qaxootiga.
en: More information is available on the website of the Refugee Advice Centre.

so: Haddii aad jirrato ama aad dhaawacanto, waxaad xaq u leedahay in aad ka hesho daryeel caafimaad oo degdeg ah daryeelka caafimaadka dadweynaha, tusaale ahaan rugta caafimaadka ama isbitaalka.
en: If you fall ill or get injured, you are entitled to urgent medical care in public health care – for example, at a health centre or hospital.

so: Sida caadiga ah waa in aad adigu iska bixisaa qarashka daryeelka.
en: You usually need to pay the treatment costs yourself.

so: Carruurta iyo dumarka uurka leh waxey ka helaan Hdelsinki, Turku, Tampere iyo Espoo adeegyo caafimaad oo lamid ah kuwa ay helaan deganayaasha kale.
en: In Helsinki, Turku, Tampere and Espoo, children and pregnant women get all the same health services as other residents.

so: Waa in ay ka bixiyaan daryeelka lacag lamid ah kuwa ay deganayaasha kale bixiyaan.
en: They need to pay the same treatment fees as other residents.

so: Global Clinic waa kiliinikada, taasood ka heli kaaro caawimo iyo talosiin dhakhtar ama kalkaalisada caacimaadka, haddaad ku nooshahay Finland adoon u heysan wax ogolaansho ah.
en: If you are in Finland without a residence permit, you can get medical assistance and advice from the Global Clinic.

so: Kilinikada Global Clinic waad aadi kartaa haddii aadan xittaa u baahneyn daryeel bukaan oo degdeg ah.
en: You can go to the Global Clinic even if you do not need urgent medical care.

so: Adeegyada Global clinic waxaad ka heleysaa degmooyinkan
en: Global Clinic operates in the following cities:

so: Waad kula xiriiri kartaa teleefoon ama iimayl teleefonka waxaa qabanaya kalkaaliso caafimaad ama dhakhtarka, Warbixintooda waxaad ka heleysaa boga Global Clinic.
en: A nurse or a doctor will answer the call. You will find the contact information on the Global Clinic website.

so: Halka ay ku taalo kiliinikada iyo waqtiyadey furan tahay lama baahiyo.
en: The location and opening hours of the clinic are not listed publicly.

so: Kala laabashada ogolaanshaha joogitaanka
en: Cancellation of residence permit

so: Haddii aad dibadda u guurto
en: If you move abroad

so: Haddii guurku ama xiriirka lamaanaha diiwaangashay uu dhamaado
en: If your marriage or registered partnership ends

so: Haddii aad shaqada weyso
en: If you lose your job

so: Ogolaanshiyahaada joogitaanka waqtiga cayiman ama joogtada ah waa lagaa ceshan karaa, haddii
en: Your permanent or fixed-term residence permit will be cancelled if

so: aad Finland joogto uga guurto
en: you move away from Finland permanently,

so: aad dibadda si xariir ah u joogtay laba sano
en: you continuously reside abroad for two years.

so: Ogolaanshiyahaada joogitaanka waqtiga cayiman ama joogtada ah waa lagaa ceshan karaa xitaa, haddii
en: Your permanent or fixed-term residence permit can also be cancelled if

so: aad macluumaadyo been ah dhiibtay markii aad ogolaanshiyaha codsaneysay
en: you provided incorrect information when applying for the permit,

so: aad qarisay arrin ka hortagi laheyn ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka
en: you withheld a factor that could have prevented you from receiving the permit, or

so: ay dowlad kale oo Schengen ah Finland ka codsato in lagaa ceshado ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka ee lagu siiyay
en: another Schengen country requests Finland to revoke your residence permit.

so: Ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka ee waqtiga cayiman waa lala laaban karaa haddii sidoo kale sababihii lagu bixiyay aysan sii jirin.
en: A fixed-term residence permit can also be revoked if the grounds on which it was granted no longer exist.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso in aad dibadda Finland uga guurto mudo labo sano shaqo ama waxbarasho darteed waxaad Xafiiska dal u soo guurista ka codsan kartaa in ogolaanshiyahaada joogitaanka aan lagaala laaban.
en: If you intend to move away from Finland for two years due to, for example, work or studies, you can submit an application to the Finnish Immigration Service to prevent the cancellation of your residence permit.

so: Codsigu waa mid iska caadi ah laakiin waa in taariikh, saxiix iyo macluumaadkeeda shaqsiyadeed laga helaa.
en: The application can be free form but must include the date, along with your signature and personal information.

so: Sidoo kale waa inay ku cadahay mudada aad dibadda joogeyso iyo sababta aad u joogeyso.
en: It must also indicate the duration of and reason for your stay abroad.

so: Codsigaada sidoo kale ku sababee sababta aan lagaala laabaneyn ogolaanshiyahaada joogitaanka.
en: In addition, it must include justification for why your residence permit should not be cancelled.

so: Waa inaad sameysaa codsiga ka hor inta aadan dibadda joogin labo sano.
en: You must submit the application before residing abroad for two years.

so: Haddii shaqo bixiyahaada Finnishka ah uu dibadda kuu diro si aad uga soo shaqeyso, ma weyneysid ogolaanshiyahaada joogitaanka Finland haddii xitaa aad dibadda ka shaqeyneyso wax ka badan labo sano.
en: If your Finnish employer has assigned you to work abroad, you will not lose your residence permit for Finland even if your work forces you to reside abroad for more than two years.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan u guurista dibadda waxay ku jiraan bogga InfoFinlandi Dibadda uga guurista Finland.
en: More information on applying for a residence permit is available on the InfoFinland page Moving abroad from Finland.

so: Haddii ad haysato sharci muddadiisu cayimantahay oo ku salaysan qoysnimo, guur ama xidhiidh lamaane oo la diwaangaliyay, guurkaaga ama xidhiidhkaaga lammaane oo joogsadaa wuxuu saamayn karaa sharcigaaga.
en: If you have a fixed-term residence permit based on family ties, the end of your marriage or registered partnership may affect your residence permit.

so: Haddii qoysnimadu aynan jirin, waxa macquul ah sharciga qoysnimada lagu bixiyay in aan la sii wadin.
en: If the family tie no longer exists, a residence permit granted on that basis will not necessarily be extended.

so: Waxa sidoo kale macquul ah in sharciga lagaala noqdo.
en: It is also possible that your residence permit currently in force will be cancelled.

so: Hase ahaatee sharciga waa laguu sii wadi karaa, haddii xidhiidh adag ad ku leedahay Finland.
en: However, your residence permit can be extended if you continue to have strong ties to Finland.

so: Xidhiidhada adag ee la yeelan karo waxay kala yihiin:
en: Examples of such strong ties include:

so: Carruur ama xubno kale oo qoyskaaga ka tirsan oo jooga Finland
en: children or other family members in Finland

so: shaqo ama shirkad ad ku leedahay Finland
en: a job or a business in Finland

so: boos waxbarasho oo ad ku haysato Finland
en: a student position in Finland.

so: Haddii lammaanahaaga ad ku kala tagtaan iyada ama isaga oo ah qof kuu gacanqaada, sharcigaaga waa laguu wadi karaa xataa haddii ad kala tagtaan.
en: If you divorce your spouse because of his or her violent behaviour towards you, your residence permit can be extended despite the divorce.

so: Caddayn ka keen arrinkaas, tusaale ahaan caddayn dhakhtar ama warbixin ad ka keentay bayaanka rugta la-talinta qoyska.
en: You should present a clarifying document, such as a doctor's certificate or a statement from a family counselling centre.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad oo ku saabsan dhamaanshiyaha guurka ama xiriirka lamaanaha ee diiwaangashan waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Guurka.
en: More information on divorce and the termination of a registered partnership is available on the InfoFinland page Divorce.

so: Haddii aad heysato ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka ee shaqada oo quseysa oo kali ah u shaqeynta shaqo bixiya cayiman islamarkaasna aad shaqaadi weyso waa in aad gebi ahaanba ogolaanshiyaha joogitaan shaqaalaha oo cusub aad codsataa ama sababo kale aad ku codsataa ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka.
en: If you have a worker's residence permit, which only applies to working for a particular employer and you lose your job, you must apply for an entirely new worker's residence permit or base your permit application on other grounds.

so: Haddii Xafiiska dal u soo guurista uu horay kuu siiyay ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka shaqaalaha xiriirkaadi shaqana uu dhamaaday ka hor inta aysan dhicin ogolaanshiyahaada joogitaanka waa in adiga ama shaqo bixiyahaadu uu Xafiiska dal u soo guurista qoraal ku ogeysiiyaa in xiriirki shaqo uu dhamaaday.
en: If the Finnish Immigration Service has granted you a worker's residence permit and your employment ends before the permit, you or your employer must notify the Immigration Service in writing that employment will end.

so: Haddii ogolaanshiyaahada joogitaanka shaqaalaha uusan hal shaqo ku xadeysneyn islamarkaasna aadan hal shaqo bixiye ku koobneyn ee laguugu siiyay uun xirfad cayiman ogolaanshiyahaadina uu shaqeynayo waxaad bedelan kartaa meeshii aad ka shaqeyneysa adigoo isla xirfaddi ku dhex jira.
en: If your worker's residence permit has not been limited to working for a particular employer and instead applies to a specific professional field and is effective, you can switch jobs within the same field.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan shaqada iyo Finland uga shaqeynta sidii shirkadle oo kale waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Shaqada iyo ganacsiga.
en: More information on working and running a business in Finland is available on the InfoFinland page Employment and entrepreneurship.

so: Macluumaadka ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka shaqaalaha iyo shirkadlaha waxaad ka heleysaa bogga Shaqo u imaanshaha Finland iyo Finland shirkadle ahaan u imaansho.
en: Information on residence permits for employees and entrepreneurs can be found on the pages Work in Finland and Moving to Finland as an entrepreneur.

so: Haddii aad horay u heysatay ogolaanshaha joogitaanka Finland, laakiin aan laguu ogolaanin ogolaanshiyaha sii-socda, Hoggaanka socdaalka ayaa gaaraya go'aan masaafurin ah.
en: If you already have a residence permit in Finland but are not granted a residence permit extension, the Finnish Immigration Service makes a deportation decision.

so: Haddii aad dembi ku gasho Finland, iyadoo lagu saleynayo dembiga ayaa dalka lagaa masaafurin karaa.
en: If you commit crimes in Finland, you can also be deported based on the crimes.

so: Haddii dalka lagaa masaafuriyo, sharcigaaga laga yaabo in uu shaqeynayo wuu burayaa waana in aad dalka ka baxdaa.
en: If you are deported, any valid residence permit that you have will become void and you must leave the country.

so: Sida caadiga ah waxaa lagu siinayaa wakhti cayiman oo inta lagu jiro ay tahay in aad dalka uga baxdo.
en: You will usually be given a deadline by which you must leave Finland.

so: Haddii aadan dalka ugu bixin mudada cayiman ee lagu qabtay dhexdeeda, booliska ama Hay'adda ilaalada xuduudaha ayaa dalka kaa saaraya.
en: If you do not leave Finland before the deadline, the police or Border Guard will remove you from the country.

so: Sida uu sharcigu qabo dalka lagaama masaafurinayo haddi wadankaada aad kala kulmeyso ciqaab dil ah, jirdil, cadaadin ama habdhaqan kale oo bani'aadminimada ka baxsan ama qiimaha bani'aadmiga dhaawacaya.
en: According to the law, you will not be deported if you are in danger of the death penalty, torture, persecution or other inhumane or degrading treatment in your home country.

so: Haddii aad joogto Finland islamarkaasna aad Hay'adda socdaalka (Maahanmuuttovirasto) ka heshay go'aan diidmo ah, waa in aad dalka ka baxdaa ama aad racfaan ka qaadataa go'aanka.
en: If you are in Finland and receive a negative residence permit decision from the Finnish Immigration Service (Maahanmuuttovirasto), you must either leave Finland or appeal against the decision.

so: Waxaad Finland joogi kartaa illaa iyo inta uu baaraandegista racfaankaadu qaadanayo.
en: You may stay in Finland for as long as it takes to process your appeal.

so: Racfaanka waxaad sameyn kartaa xittaa haddii aad ogolaanshaha degitaanka ka codsatay dibadda.
en: You can also file an appeal if you have applied for a residence permit from abroad.

so: Markaasna waa in aad ka baaraandegista racfaanka ku sugtaa dibadda.
en: In that case, you must wait abroad for the processing of the appeal.

so: Haddii aad Finland u joogto megangelyo-doonnimo ama aad tahay dhibanaha ka ganacsiga dadka,w axaad xaq u leedahay in aad hesho kaalmada dib u laabashada aan qasabka aheyn (vapaaehtoisen paluun tuki), haddii aad go'aansato in aaad ku laabato dalkaada.
en: If you are in Finland as an asylum seeker or are a victim of human trafficking, you are entitled to receive assistance for voluntary return (vapaaehtoisen paluun tuki) if you decide to return to your home country.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri barta Kaalmada dib u noqoshada aan qasabka aheyn.
en: Read more under Assistance for voluntary return.

so: Racfaan ka qaadashada go'aanka ogolaanshaha degitaanka
en: Appealing against a residence permit decision

so: Tilmaamaha sameynta racfaanku wuxuu marwalba ku lifaaqan yahay go'aanka.
en: Instructions for filing an appeal are always enclosed with the decision.

so: Racfaanka waxaa ka baaraandegaya maxkamadda maamulka (hallinto-oikeus).
en: The appeal will be processed by the Administrative Court (hallinto-oikeus).

so: Maxkamadda maamulku wey diidi kartaa racfaanka ama waxey dib ugu celin karaan Hay'adda socdaalka si ay uga baaraandegto.
en: The Administrative Court may either reject the appeal or return the matter to the Finnish Immigration Service for reprocessing.

so: Diidista racfaanku waxey ka dhigan tahay, in go'aanki Hay'add socdaalka uu shaqeynayo.
en: If the appeal is rejected, the Finnish Immigration Service's decision remains in force.

so: Haddii ay maxkamdda maamulku diiddo racfaanka, waxaad xaaladaha qaarkood uga codsan kartaa ruqsad racfaan maxkamadda sare ee maamulka (korkein hallinto-oikeus).
en: If the appeal is rejected by the Administrative Court, you may in some cases apply for permission to appeal to the Supreme Administrative Court (korkein hallinto-oikeus).

so: Haddii ay maxkamadda sare ee maamulku bixiso ruqsadda racfaanka, iyaga ayaa ka baaraandegaya racfaanka.
en: If the Supreme Administrative Court grants you permission to appeal, it will process your appeal.

so: Waxaad sameynta racfaanka caawimaad uga heli kartaa qareen gaar ah, xafiiska caawimaadda sharciga ee dowladda (valtion oikeusaputoimisto) ama Ururka La-talinta qaxootiga (Pakolaisneuvonta).
en: You may receive help for filing an appeal from a private lawyer, State Legal Aid Offices (valtion oikeusaputoimisto) or the Refugee Advice Centre (Pakolaisneuvonta) (asylum seekers only).

so: waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan sida aad ugu heleyso arrimaha la xiriira arrimaha sharciga.
en: More information on getting legal help is available on the InfoFinland page Do you need a lawyer?

so: Waa in aad Finland ka baxdaa, haddii codsigaada magangalyada aad ka hesho go'aan diidmo ah ama racfaankaadi maxkamadda maamulka yaalay la diido.
en: You must leave Finland if your residence permit application is rejected or your appeal to the administrative court is dismissed.

so: Waxaa lagu siinayaa fursad aad si iskaa ah uga bixi karto Finland.
en: You will be given the opportunity to leave Finland voluntarily.

so: Wakhtiga cayiman inta badan 30 maalmood.
en: The deadline is usually after 30 days.

so: Haddii aadan dalka uga bixin wakhtiga cayiman gudihiisa, booliska ama Hay'adda ilaalada xuduudaha ayaa dalka kaa saareysa.
en: If you do not leave the country before the deadline, the police or Border Guard will remove you from the country.

so: Waxaa lagaa manuucayaa imaanshaha soonaha Schengen, haddii
en: You will get a Schengen entry ban if

so: aad jebisay sharciyada soo gelitaanka dalka codisgaagana la diiday, tusaale ahaan guur been ah dartiis
en: you have violated entry rules and your application has been rejected, for example due to a sham marriage

so: aad gashay dembi loona arko in aad halis ku tahay nidaamka guud ama ammaanka
en: you have committed crimes and are considered a danger to public order or safety

so: codsigaada magangalyada la diiday iyadoo la adeegsanayo nidaamka degdeg uga baaraandegista ah
en: your asylum application is dismissed in expedited processing

so: aadan wadanka iskaa uga bixin wakhtiga cayiman ee laguu qabtay
en: you do not leave the country voluntarily before the deadline

so: Inta lagu jiro mamnuucista imaanshaha dalka booqasho kuma imaan kartid Finland ama wadamada kale ee Schengen.
en: When you have an entry ban, you cannot visit Finland or other Schengen countries.

so: Kaalmada dib u laabashada aan qasabka aheyn
en: Assistance for voluntary return

so: Hadii aad rabtid inaad u noqotid wadankaaga, siyaabo qaarkood waxaad heli kartaa caawimaad aad dib ugu noqotid iskaa.
en: If you want to return to your home country, you may in some cases receive assistance for this purpose.

so: Caawinaadu waxay noqon kartaa lacag ama adeeg.
en: This assistance is either money or service.

so: Cadaada lacagtu waxay ku xiran tahay wadanka aad ulaabanaysid.
en: The amount of money depends on the country to which you are returning.

so: Adeegu wuxuu noqon karaa tusaale ahaan, inlagaa caawiyo sidaad ku heli lahayd hoy ama goob shaqo wadanka aad ku laabaneysid.
en: Examples of the service include assistance in looking for a home or a job in the country to which you are returning.

so: Caawimo waad heli kartaa haddii:
en: You can receive assistance if:

so: lagu siiyey go aan diidmo codsigaagii magangelyadoonka
en: you have received a negative decision on your asylum application

so: aad ka laabatay codsigaada magangalyada
en: you cancel your asylum application

so: aad tahay dhibane laga ganacsaday aadan ku ahayn deegaan finland.
en: you are a victim of human trafficking and do not have a municipality of residence in Finland

so: aad haysato sharci kumeelgaar ah, maadaama aan lagaasaari karin wadanka
en: you have been granted a temporary residence permit because you cannot be removed from the country

so: aad heshay magangelyo kumeelgaar ah
en: you have received temporary protection

so: lagaa ceshtay sharcigii badbaadada caalamiga ee Finland go aana lagu gaaray inlagaa saaro wadanka
en: your international protection status in Finland has been withdrawn or cancelled and a decision has been made to deport you

so: aad heshay badbaadin bani'aadminimo, laakiin ogolaanshaha joogitaankaadu uu dhamaanayo ama uu dhamaaday.
en: you have received humanitarian protection, but your residence permit is about to expire or has expired.

so: Haddii aad tahay macbiil xerada qoxootiga ku jira, waad ka codsan kartaa kaalmada dib u laabashada iskaa xeradaas aad ku jirtid.
en: If you are a customer of a reception centre, you can apply for assisted voluntary return through your own reception centre.

so: Haddii aadan ahayn macbiil ku jira xerada qaxootiga, waxaad ka codsan kartaa kaalmo hoggaanka socdaalka.
en: If you are not a customer of a reception centre, you can apply for assisted voluntary return through the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Talo-bixinta arrimaha la xiriira ogolaanshaha degitaanka dalka
en: Advice in residence permit issues

so: Haddii ay dhibaato kaa heysato dhinaca ogolaanshaha ama aysan kuu kala cadeynta arrimaha ogolaanshaha degitaanka dalku, waxaad talo weydiin kartaa goobaha soo socda:
en: If you have problems or there is some confusion about your residence permit, you can ask the following parties for advice:

so: La-taliyayaasha ajnabiga ee jooga degmadaada
en: your local immigrant advisors in Finland

so: Bogagga shabakadda Hay'adda socdalka waxaa ku jiraa macluumaadyo badan oo ku saabsan ogolaanshaha degitaanka dalka.
en: The Finnish Immigration Service website contains a lot of information on residence permits.

so: Talooyinka ruqsadaha u soo guurista dalka waxaa sidoo kale lagu bixiyaa qadka telefoonka.
en: The Finnish Immigration Service also provides telephone advice concerning permits.

so: Safaaradaha Finland ee dibadda ku yaal waxey u adeegaan codsadayaasha ogolaanshaha degitaanka ee dibadda jooga.
en: Finnish diplomatic missions abroad serve people applying for a residence permit from abroad.

so: Adeegyada la-talinta dadka dalka u soo guuray ayaa laga helaa magaalooyin badan, kuwaas oo ay ka shaqeeyaan la-taliyayaal ku takhasusay arrimaha u soo guurista dalka.
en: Many cities have immigrant information services that employ advisors specialised in immigration.

so: Rugta la-talinta qaxootigu waxey caawinaad sharci oo ku saabsan habsami-socodka megangeylada ka siisaa dadka megangeyo-doonka ah- Waxaa intaas dheer in Rugta la-talinta qaxootigu ay siiso ajnabiga kale talo-bixin guud.
en: The Refugee Advice Centre provides asylum seekers with legal aid during the asylum process. It also gives general legal advice to other foreigners.

so: Ogsoonow in hay'adda socdaalka oo kali ah ay gaari karto go'aannada la xiriira ogolaanshaha degitaanka dalka.
en: Please note that decisions concerning residence permits can only be made by the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Lambarka gurmadka deg degta ah (hätänumero) ee Finland waa 112.
en: The emergency number (hätänumero) in Finland is 112.

so: Lambarka gurmadka deg degta ah waxaad wici kartaa loo keliya markii ay jiraan xaaladaha deg degta ah, markii naf, caafimaad iyo hanti ama bey'adda ay la soo gudboonaato xaalad khatar ah.
en: Call the emergency number only in genuine emergency situations, when someone's life, health, property or the environment is in danger.

so: Marka aad xaalad degdeg ah ku jirto waxaad heleysaa daryeel haddii xitaa aadan guri degmo ku laheyn Finland.
en: In an emergency situation, you will be treated even if you do not have a municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Kharashka daryeelka dib ayaa laguugu soo dalacan karaa.
en: The medical costs can be collected from you afterwards.

so: Wac lambarka xaalada deg degta ah ee 112 tusaale ahaan xaaladaha:
en: Call the emergency number 112, for example, in the following situations:

so: markii aad gasho shil baabuur (auto-onnettomuus) ama aad aragtid shil
en: you have been in a car accident (auto-onnettomuus) or you have witnessed an accident

so: qof uu qof kale naftiisu ay ku jirto khatar (hengenvaara)
en: somebody's life is in danger (hengenvaara)

so: dareentid, in dab (tulipalo) kacay
en: you notice that a fire (tulipalo) has started

so: dareentid, in meel la jabsaday ama loo dhacay (murto)
en: you notice that there has been a break-in (murto) somewhere

so: Hawicin lambarka xaaladaha deg degta ah, haddii arintu aysan deg deg ahayn.
en: Please do not call the emergency number for non-urgent matters.

so: Lambarka xaaladaha degdegta ah ha u wicin xanuunada caadiga ah awgood.
en: Do not call the emergency number in an ordinary case of illness.

so: Sidoo kale ha wicin lambarka xaaladaha degdegta ah, haddii aad dooneysid inaad booliska (poliisi) weydiisid tusaale ahaan arimaha ruqsooyinka.
en: Also do not call the emergency number if you want to ask the police (poliisi), for example, about matters concerning permits.

so: Wicitaan macno daraan ah awgiis waxaa laga yaabaa in caawintu ay ka daahdo qof si dhab ah ugu baahan caawin oo ku jira xaalad oo khatar ah.
en: An unnecessary call may cause the arrival of help at a real emergency to be delayed with fatal consequences.

so: Haddii aad lambarka xaalada deg degta ah u isticmaashid si khalad ah, waxaad mutaysan kartaa ciqaab.
en: If you misuse the emergency number, it may lead to criminal penalties.

so: Telefoonka waxaa ka jawaabaya qof tababaran oo heegan ah.
en: An emergency call is answered by a trained Emergency Response Centre operator.

so: Wuxuu ku weydiinayaa su'aalo, wuxuuna qiimaynayaa baahida aad u qabtid caawinta.
en: The operator will help you by asking questions and will assess the need for assistance.

so: Qofka heeganka ah wuxuu ku siinayaa talooyin la xiriira waxa ay tahay inaad sameysid.
en: The operator will also give you advice on what to do.

so: Qofka heeganka ah xiriirin maayo teleefanka, sidaas awgeed su'aalaha uga jawaab si taxadar leh.
en: They will not put the call through to the police, for example, so the best thing to do is to answer the questions carefully.

so: Markii aad wacdid lambarka xaalada deg degta ah, waxaad ku hadli kartaa Finnish ama Swedish.
en: When you call the emergency number, you can speak either Finnish or Swedish.

so: Waxaad weydiin kartaa qofka heeganka ah inuu ku hadlo luuqada Ingiriiska, hubaal ma ahan, laakiin haddii ay lagama maarmaan tahay, xarunta gargaarka deg degta ah waxay ka caawinaysaa adeega turjumaada.
en: You can ask if the operator understands English, but this is not guaranteed. If necessary, the Emergency Response Centre will get help from interpreter services.

so: Lambarka xaalada degdegta ah waxaad bilaash uga wici kartaa teleefan kasta, uma baahnid koodka aaga ee lambarka laga hor mariyo.
en: The emergency number can be called free of charge from any phone. No area code is needed.

so: Xitaa haddii aad haysatid khad telefoon oo laga leeyahay dalka dibadiisa waad wici kartaa lambarka xaalada degdegta ah adigoon isticmaaleyn wax eeriya kood ah.
en: If you have a mobile phone subscription that is based abroad you can still call the emergency number without an area code.

so: Lambarka xaalada degdegta ah 112 wuxuu ka shaqaynayaa dhammaan wadamada Midowga Yurub oo dhan.
en: The emergency number 112 works in all EU countries.

so: Haddii aad nidaamka moobaylka ku habboon ee 112 Suomi oo lacagta la'aanta ah ku soo degsatay telefoonkaada uma baahnid in aad taqaano goobta aad joogto.
en: If you have installed the free-of-charge 112 Suomi mobile application on your phone, it might not be necessary to state your location.

so: Qofka heeganka ka ah xarunta xaaladda degdegga ah wuxuu arkayaa goobta aad joogto marka aad ka wacdo nidaamka telefoonka xaaladda degdegga ah.
en: The Emergency Response Centre operator will see your location automatically when you make the call through the application.

so: Waxaad nidaamkan dukaanka nidaamka uga soo degsan kartaa telefoonkaada.
en: You can download the application from the app store of your phone.

so: Markii aad wacaysid Lambarka xaalada degdegta ah 112:
en: When you call the emergency number 112:

so: sheeg cinwaanka oo sax ah iyo magaalada
en: give the municipality and the address as accurately as possible

so: ka jawaab su'aalaha uu ku weydiinayo qofka heeganka ka ah xarunta gargaarka degdega ah
en: answer the questions asked by the Emergency Response Centre's operator

so: raac talooyinka lagu siiyo
en: follow the instructions given

so: ha jarin teleefanka, inta ruqso laguu siinayo ka hor
en: do not hang up until you are told to do so

so: Macluumaadka dheeraadka ee la xiriira lambarka xaalada degdegta ah waxaad ka helaysaa bogga internetka ee xarunta hay'adda gargaarka degdega ah (Hätäkeskuslaitos).
en: You can find more information about the emergency number at the Emergency Response Centre (Hätäkeskuslaitos) website.

so: Haddii aad dooneysid macluumaad la xiriira arrimaha ruqsooyinka booliska, qawaaniinta gaadiidka ama sida baaritaanka dambigii hore u socdo, kala xiriir booliska lambaradooda waqtiga shaqada.
en: If you want information from the police about matters concerning permits, vehicle regulations or how the investigation of an old crime is progressing, please contact the police at their own numbers during office hours.

so: Haddii aad qof uga shakiso inuu sumoobay, waxaad talooyin weydiin kartaa xarunta dhexe macluumaadka sumowga (Myrkytystietokeskus).
en: If you suspect that someone has ingested poison, you can ask the Poison Information Centre (Myrkytystietokeskus) for advice.

so: Telefoonkeedu wuxuu furan yahay 24 saac.
en: Its telephone service is available 24 hours a day.

so: Degmooyinku waxay Finland dadka da'da ah ugu qabanqaabiyaan adeegyo, si nolol maalmeedku ay ugu fududaato islamarkaasna ay awoodi karoodaan inay mudo dheer deganaadaan guriga.
en: In Finland, municipalities organise many services for the elderly to make their lives easier and to enable them live in their own homes for as long as possible.

so: Haddii aad Guri degmo ee gudaha Finland waxaad xaq u leedahay adeegyada ay degmadu bixiso.
en: If you have a municipality of residence in Finland, you are entitled to receive the services that your municipality offers.

so: Waad deganaan kartaa guri haddii uu xitaa caafimaadku liito haddii qeybaha gurigu ay shaqeynayaan.
en: Even if your health is poor, you can live at home if your home functions well for you.

so: Guriga waxaa lagu sameyn isbedel fududeynaya deganaanshihiisa.
en: Alteration work can be done to your home to make living there easier.

so: Shaqada degmooyinku waa inay u qabanqaabiyaan degista adeegga leh iyo degista la kaalmeeyo dadka u baahan.
en: It is the duty of municipalities to organise service housing and support housing for those who need it.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Degista kaalmada iyo adeegga leh.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Support and service housing.

so: Dadka dalka u soo guuray ee waqti dheer oo ku filan deganaan Finland waxay shuruudo lamid ah shuruudaha dadka deggan Finland ku heli karaa hawlgabka da'da ama awoodis la'aanta shaqada darteed.
en: Immigrants who have lived in Finland long enough will receive an old age or work disability pension on the same grounds as all other people residing in Finland.

so: Cadada halwgabka waxaa sameyn ku leh waqtiga uu qofku deganaa ama ka shaqeynahyay Finland.
en: The amount of pension they receive is dependent on how long they have lived or worked in Finland.

so: Si kastoo ay ahaata damaanadqaadka hawlgabka ayaa sugaya kaalmada nolosha ee ugu yar saddex sano oo deganaansho ah kadib.
en: Guarantee pension, however, secures minimum livelihood for those who have lived in Finland for at least three years.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Hawlgab.
en: More information is available on the InfoFinland web page Pension.

so: Dhaqdhaqaaqista darteed waxaa suurtagal ah in amaah lagu helo qalabyo la kaalmeysto oo kala duduwan, tusaale ahaan usha socodka ama gaariga lugaha leh.
en: If you have trouble getting about, you can borrow various devices to help you, such as crutches or a walker.

so: Haddii aad u baahantahay qalabka la kaalmeysto marka hore la xiriir rugtaada caafimaadka.
en: If you need such devices, contact your own health centre first.

so: Rugta caafimaadka waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan qalabka la kaalmeysto.
en: The health centre will provide you with more information about these devices.

so: Sidabada xiliga qabowga banaanku waa sidib.
en: In the winter it is often slippery outside.

so: Kabatoleyaasha iyo qaar ka mid ah tukaamada waaweyn waxay iibiyaan sidib celiyeyaal (liukueste), kuwaas oo lagu xiri karo kabaha caadiga ah hoostooda.
en: Shoemakers and some large supermarkets sell anti-slip soles (liukueste) that can be attached to the bottom of ordinary shoes.

so: Sidoo kale waxaad tukaamada kabaha ka soo iibsan kartaa kabo qodxo leh (nastakengät), kuwaas oo ay sahlantahayn in lagula socdo jid sidib ah.
en: You can also buy studded shoes (nastakengät) from a shoe shop; these make walking on slippery streets easier.

so: Degmooyinku waxay dadka da'da ah u qabanqaabiyaan daryeel guri (kotihoito) oo ay ku jiraan caawimaadda meerto maalmeedka iyo guri ku daryeelista bukaanka.
en: Municipalities organise home care (kotihoito) for the elderly, which entails day-to-day assistance and nursing at home. Home care encompasses home services, home nursing and support services.

so: Adeegyada gurigu waa ka caawinta hawlmaalmeedyada sida qubeysasashada, labisashada dharka iyo cunteynta.
en: Home services are help with day-to-day activities, such as washing and dressing oneself and eating.

so: Guri ku daryeelista bukaanku waa daryeel caafimaad iyo baxnaano lagu sameeyo guriga.
en: Home nursing is nursing and rehabilitation that takes place at home.

so: Dhaqtarka ayaa qorayo gudbinta guri ku daryeelista bukaanka si loo helo.
en: A doctor writes a referral for home nursing.

so: Kuwaan waxaa dheer oo jira adeegyo guri, kuwaas oo ah tusaale ahaan cuntada, nadaafadda, dukaameysiga, adeegyada ammaanka iyo caawimaadda gaadiid ku qaadista.
en: In addition to this, support services are available, which include meal, cleaning, shopping, security and transport services.

so: Marka aad u baahantahay guri ku daryeelis, la xiriir qeybta daryeelka guriga ee degmadaada.
en: If you require home care, please contact the home care unit of your municipality.

so: Daryeelka guriga ee degmadu waa lacag.
en: Municipal home care is subject to a fee.

so: Marka daryeelka gurigu uu yahay joogto, daqliga lamaanahaada iyo adiga ayaa saameyn ku yeelanaya tirada lacageed ee daryeelka gurigu uu joogo.
en: When the home care is regular, your income and that of your spouse affect the cost of the home care.

so: Dadka oo dhan waxaa laga qaadaa qiimo isku mid ah marka daryeelka gurigu uu yahay mid ku meelgaar ah.
en: Temporary home care costs the same for everyone.

so: Degmadu waxeys sidoo kale ku siin kartaa jeega adeegga, oo aad adeeg uga iibsan karto bixiyaha adeegga ee ay degmadu aqbalsan tahay.
en: The municipality may also provide you with a service voucher you can use to purchase services from a service provider approved by the municipality.

so: Haddii aad Guri degmo ee gudaha Finland waxaad isticmaali kartaa adeegyada caafimaadka shacabka.
en: If you have a municipality of residence in Finland, you are entitled to use public health services.

so: Marka aad jirato, la xiriir rugta caafimaadka ee soonahaada.
en: If you fall ill, contact your local health centre.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Adeegyada caafimaadka ee Finland iyo Caafimaadka waayeelka.
en: More information is available on the InfoFinland pages Health services in Finland and Elderly persons' health.

so: Markaad ku xanaanaynayso guriga ehelkaaga
en: Taking care of a family member at home

so: Markuu u baahan yahay xubana qoyskaaga daryeel iyo caawimaad joogta ah daryeelkuna yahay mid joogta ah oon sahlaneyn, daryeelista suurtagal ahaan waxaad ku heli kartaa in lagaa kaalmeeyo xanaanayta ehelka.
en: When a family member needs help continuously and his/her care is binding and demanding, it is possible to get allowance for informal care (omaishoidontuki) for it.

so: Kaalmadaas waxaa loogu talagalay kuwa ku ah deegaanka Finland Guri degmo ee gudaha Finland.
en: This allowance is intended for people who have a municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Cadada kaalmo iyo sida lagu helayo waxaa laga yaabaa inay ku kala duwan yihiin degmooyinka qaar.
en: The amount of the allowance and the criteria for getting it may vary from one municipality to another.

so: Kaalmada waxaad ka codsan kartaa xafiiska arrimo bulshada degmadaada.
en: You can apply for the allowance at the Social Welfare Office (sosiaalitoimisto) of your own municipality.

so: Si aad uheshid kaalmada, waa inaad heshiis lagashaa xanaanaynta ehelkaaga degmadaada.
en: In order to qualify for this allowance, you must make an informal care agreement (omaishoitosopimus) with your municipality.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah xanaanaynta ehelka waxaa ka helaysaa xafiiska arrimaha bulshada ee deegaankaaga.
en: Your local Social Welfare Office will provide more information about the allowance for informal care.

so: Kaalmada dhaqaale waxa dheeriya ooy degmadu qabanqaabisaa adeeg yo kala duwan, taasoo lagu caawinayo ku xanaaneyaha guriga.
en: In addition to the remuneration, municipalities can organise various services in order to support informal care.

so: Degmada waxay sidoo kale u sameysaa dadka da'da ah howl-maalmeed.
en: Municipalities also arrange daytime activities (päivätoiminta) for the elderly.

so: Howl-maalmeedkaas waxaa ka mid ah gadiidkii qaadi lahaa, raashin, jimicsi ama howlo kale.
en: Daytime activities include transport, a meal, exercise, for example.

so: Weydii macluumaad dheeriya xafiiska arrimaha bulshada ee degmadaada.
en: Ask for more information at your local Social Welfare Office.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Adeegyada caafimaadka ee Finland.
en: More information is available on the InfoFinland page Health services in Finland.

so: Barbaarin-horaadka waxaa loogu galagalay carruurta ka yar da'da dugsiga lagu galo .
en: Early childhood education is intended for children under school age.

so: Finland, degmooyinka ayaa bixiya barbaarin-horaadyada, waxeyna ku bixiyaan meelaha ay ka midka yihiin xannaano-maaleedyada.
en: In Finland, municipalities offer municipal early childhood education at day-care centres, for example.

so: Waxaa intaas dheer oo jiro xannaano-maalmeedyo gaar loo leeyahay.
en: There are also private day-care centres.

so: Barbaarin-horaadku waa barbaarin, waxbaris iyo xannaano, taas oo qaab waxbarasho loo qorsheeyay yoolalkeedana si fiican looga fikiray.
en: Early childhood education is education, teaching and care that have been pedagogically planned, with carefully considered goals.

so: Barbaarin-horaadka waxaa ka shaqeeya macalimiinta barbaarin-horaadka iyo xannaaneeyayaal la tababaray.
en: Trained early education teachers and child nurses work in early education.

so: Haddaad ilmaha ku heyso guriga waqtigaas kadibna waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad shaqada ka gasho fasax xanaaneynta carruurta ilaa ilmihii ka gaarayo saddex sano.
en: If you also look after your child at home after the period of parental leave, you are entitled to leave from work for childcare purposes until the child's third birthday.

so: Faahfaahin dheeriya waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Fasaxyada qoyska.
en: You can find more information about leave on the InfoFinland page Family leave.

so: Waad ka codsan kartaa Kelada kaalmo dhaqaale guri ku xanaaneynta ilmaha.
en: You can apply for financial support for childcare at home from Kela.

so: Ka aqriso xog dheeriya bogga InfoFinlandi Kaalmada guri ku xanaaneynta ilmaha.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Benefits for looking after a child at home.

so: Haddii aad degaan ku tahay Deegaan Finland, waad u dalbi kartaa carruurtaada booska barbaarin-horaadka degmada markuu kaa dhamaado fasaxa waalidka.
en: If you have a municipality of residence in Finland, you can apply for a place in municipal early childhood education for your child after the period of parental leave.

so: Haddii aadan deegaan ku aheyn Finland, markaa waxaa laguu aqoonsan karaa inaad tahay ruux degaan ku ah magaalada aad degan tahay.
en: If you do not have an official municipality of residence in Finland, you are considered a resident of the municipality in which you reside.

so: Haddii labada waalid ay shaqeeyaan ilmuhu waxay xaq u leeyihiin inay helaan barbaarin hore maalintii oo dhan ah.
en: If both parents work, their child has the right to full-time early education.

so: Haddii labada waalid uu midkood guriga joogo, markaas xaq u yeelashada barbaarinta hore waxay ku xirnaanaysaa hadba degmada aad degen tahay.
en: If one parent is at home, the child's right to early education depends on their municipality of residence.

so: Degmooyinka qaarkood waxaa laga yaabaa in ilmuhu uu xaq u yeesho inuu helo barbaarinta hore oo maaalinta oo dhan ah, xitaa haddii labada waalid uu midkood guriga joogo.
en: In some municipalities, the child may have a right to full-time early education even if one parent is at home.

so: Degmooyinka qaarkood ilmuhu wuxuu xaq u leeyahay inuu helo barbaarinta hore 20 saaacadood usbuuciiba, haddii labada waalid uu midkood guriga joogo.
en: In other municipalities, the child has a right to 20 hours of early education per week if one parent is at home.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee qoysku wuxuu xaq u leeyahay inuu codsado barbaarinta hore oo maalintii oo dhan ah, haddii ilmuhu u baahan yahay taakuleyn gaag ah tusaale ahaan xagga barashada luuqada Finnishka ama xaalada qoyska oo adag awgeed.
en: However, the family can apply for a right to full-time early education if the child needs special support with learning Finnish or because of a difficult family situation.

so: Waad ka codsan kartaa booska
en: You can apply for a place in

so: Carruurtu waxey xannaano-maalmeedyada ku jiraan kooxo ka waaweyn kuwa kooxaha xannaano-maalmeedka qoyska.
en: At day-care centres, children are in larger groups than in group family day care.

so: Qoys xanaaneedka carruurta waxaa loola jeedaa in daryeelaha carruurta ku heynayo ilmihii gurigiisa.
en: Family day care involves a care provider looking after the children in his or her own home.

so: Qoys xanaaneedyada qaar waxay ku hayaan carruurta horin ahaan guryaha xanaanada carruurta.
en: Some family day care providers look after children in the children's home.

so: Ka dalbo booska babraarin-horaadka magaalada aad ku nooshahay ugu danbeyn afar bilood kahor xiliga aad u baahan tahay xanaaneynta ilmaha.
en: Apply for a municipal early childhood education place from your municipality at least four months before your child is due to start day care.

so: Booska waxaad ku heli kartaa labo isbuuc gudohood, haddii waalidku bilaabayo iskuul ama shaqo.
en: A place can be granted within two weeks if the parents get a job or a student position.

so: inta saacadood ee uu cunugga todobaadki ka qeybqaato barbaarin-horaadka.
en: how many hours a week your child will attend early childhood education.

so: Qiimo dhimis ayaa laga sameynayaa walaalaha.
en: A discount is granted for the day care fees of any siblings.

so: Haddii dakhliga qoysku uu aad u yar yahay, barbaarin-horaadku waxey qoyska u noqon kartaa lacag la'aan.
en: If the family has a very low income, early childhood education may be free of charge.

so: Weydii warar dheeraad adeegyada talobixinta ee degmadaada.
en: For further information, contact the advisory services of your own municipality.

so: Barbaarin-horaadka gaarka loo leeyahay
en: Private early childhood education

so: Barbaarin-horaadka gaarka loo leeyahay waxay ahaan kartaa
en: The different forms of private early childhood education include:

so: xanaanada carruurta ama horin qoys xanaaneedka carruurta
en: private day care centres or private group family day care centres

so: qoys xanaaneedka carruurta ama
en: family day care providers or

so: Booska barbaarin-horaadka waxaad toos u weydiisan kartaa xanaanada carruurta shaqsiyeedka ama horin xanaaneedka carruurta.
en: You can apply for early childhood education directly from a private day-care centre or a private group family day-care centre.

so: Sidoo kale xanaanada carruurta ee shaqsiyeedka waxaad ka raadsan kartaa, kuwa ku xanaaneeya carruurta guriga ama in xanaaneeyaha kuugu yimaado gurigaaga, markaasna waxaad noqoneysaa shaqo bixiye, waana inaad xil iska saartaa gudashada waajibaadka shaqo bixiyaha.
en: You can also seek a private family day care provider who will look after children in his or her own home, or hire a child carer to work in your home.

so: Degmada ayaa ilaalisa baraarin-horaadyada gaarka loo leeyahay.
en: The municipality supervises private early childhood education.

so: Qiimaha barbaarin-horaadyada sida gaarka ah loo leeyahay waa mid isbedbeddasha.
en: The costs of private early childhood education vary.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee Kelada ayaad kaalmo uga heli kartaa.
en: However, you can receive support for it from Kela.

so: Markaas qiimaheedu ma ahan mid aad uga badan kan barbaarin-horaadka degmada.
en: In such a case, private early childhood education does not necessarily cost much more than municipal early childhood education.

so: Haddii ilmuhu degaan ku yahay Deegaan Finland, waad ka codsan kartaa Kelada kaalmo.
en: If your child has a municipality of residence in Finland, you can apply for private day care allowance from Kela.

so: Xanaanada carruurtuna waa iney tahay mid degmadu aqbashey.
en: The child care provider must be approved by the municipality.

so: Waad codsan kartaa kaalmo kharashka xanaanada shaqsiyeedka (yksityisen hoidon tuki), haddii
en: You can apply for private day care allowance (yksityisen hoidon tuki) if

so: ilmo ka yar da'da iskuulka kugu jiraan xanaanada carruurta ee shaqsiyaadka; ama
en: your child is under school age and is placed in a private day care centre; or

so: ilmuhu ku jiro xanaano shaqsiyeed kale.
en: your child is looked after by another type of private day care provider.

so: Ma codsan kartid kaalmada xanaanada shaqsiyaadka, haddii xanaaneyuhu yahay xubin qoyska ama xanaaneyaha iyo ilmuhu ku wada nool yihiin isku guri.
en: You cannot apply for private day care allowance if the care provider is a family member of the child or if the child and the carer live in the same household.

so: Ma codsan kartid kaalmada xanaanada shaqsiyaadka haddii barbaarin-horaadkiisu yahay mida degmada.
en: Neither can you receive private day care allowance if your child is placed in municipal early childhood education.

so: Cadadda kaalmada hadba waxay ku xiran tahay daqliga reerka iyo degmada ay reerku ku nool yihiin.
en: The amount of allowance depends on the income of the child's family and on the municipality in which the family resides, among other things.

so: Kelada kaalmada waxay toos ugu shubeysaa xanaaneeyaha ama adeeg bixiyaha xanaanada carruurta.
en: Kela pays the allowance directly to the hired child carer or other child care provider.

so: Xanaanada carruurta shaqsiyaadku waa iney bixiyaan canshuur.
en: Private day care allowance is taxable income.

so: Kaalmadana ma aha mid lagu bixinayo wadanka dibadiisa.
en: This allowance is not paid abroad.

so: Aqri faahfaahin dheeriya kaalmada xanaanada shaqsiyaadka bogga Kelada.
en: Further information on private day care allowance is available on Kela's website.

so: Teleefonka adeega qoysaska ilmooleyda ee Kelada.
en: Kela offers a telephone service for families with children.

so: Daneysiga xafiiska Kelada waxaad ka heleysaa adeegyo luuqado kale oo laguu turjumayo.
en: Kela offices also provide services in other languages via interpreters.

so: Maxaa lagu qabtaa barbaarin-horaadka?
en: What takes place in early childhood education?

so: Howlaha lagu qabto barbaarin-horaadka waa noocyo badan tahay, tusaale ciyaar, jimicsiyo, banaan joog, muusik, alaab-alaabey iyo dalxiis.
en: Early childhood education includes a range of activities, for example games, sports, music, crafts and excursions.

so: Maalintana nasiino yar ayaa ku jirta.
en: Children can also take a nap or rest during the day.

so: Ujeedadda howlaha waxay tahay sidii lagu horumarin lahaa waxbarista iyo barbaarinta ilmaha.
en: The goal of these activities is to further the development of and learning among children.

so: Ilmuhu waxay sidoo kale ku baranayaan qabsashada waxyaabaha daruuriga.
en: Children also learn social skills.

so: Ilmaha waxaa lagu caawin oo dheeriya barashada afka finnishka iyo swiidhishka, haddii afkiisa hooyo yahay luuqad kale.
en: The child is supported in learning Finnish or Swedish if he or she has another mother tongue.

so: Haddii uu u baahanyahay cunuggu wuxuu heli karaa waxbarasho gaar ah.
en: The child may also receive special needs education, if necessary.

so: Xanaanada carruurtu ma aha iskuul.
en: However, the day care centre is not a school.

so: Carruurta lama barayo maadooyinka iskuulka, mana jirto xiisado ay galayaan.
en: Children do not study subjects or attend classes.

so: Carruurtu saddex jeer ayey inta maalinta lagu jiro cunayaan: quraac, khado iyo casiriye.
en: During the day, the children eat three meals: breakfast, lunch and a snack.

so: Haddii ilmahaagu cunin cuntooyinka qaarkood u sheeg macallimiinta barbaarin-horaadka.
en: If your child has a special diet, please inform the early childhood education teachers.

so: Barbaarin-horaadka waa loo qadarin diinta qoysku heystaan ama waxay aaminsan yihiin.
en: Your family's religious convictions or life philosophies will be taken into consideration in early childhood education.

so: Xanaanooyinka degmooyinka qaarkood waxaa suurogal ah in ay afaf kale oon aheyn finnish iyo swiidhis looga hadlo.
en: Some localities provide day care centres in which children and teachers speak a language other than Finnish or Swedish.

so: Inta badan maalmaha xannaano-maalmeedku waxay bilaabataa subaxii waxayna ku ektahay galabtii Xanaanooyin qaar ayaa furan habeen iyo maalinba, hadey waalidku shaqo ama iskuul ku maqan yihiin.
en: Days in early childhood education normally begin in the morning and end in the afternoon. However, some day-care centres and family day care providers are open around the clock due to the parents' studies or working hours.

so: Degmooyinka, hay'adaha iyo mowlacyada ayaa u qabanqaabiya carruurta naadi maalmeed.
en: Parishes, municipalities and organisations hold playgroups for children.

so: Saacadaha naadiga inta badan waa labo saacadood.
en: Playgroups usually last a couple of hours.

so: Naadiga waxaa u qorsheysan oo ciyaaro, heeso, alaabalaabey iyo barnaamijyada kaleba oo niddaamsan.
en: Playgroups provide organised play, singing, crafts and other activities.

so: Qoysasku waxay kaalmooyin kala duduwan u heli karaan nolosha.
en: Families can receive different benefits to cover their living expenses.

so: Helitaanka kaalmooyin badan waxaa ku xiran inaad ku jirto Ammaanka bulshada Finnishka ama aad Guri degmo ku leedahay Finland.
en: The prerequisite for receiving most benefits is that you are covered by Finnish social security or have a municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Qoyska uusan daklhigoodu ku filnayn inay kirada guriga iska bixiyaan ama guriga ay leeyihiin kharashaadkiisa, waxay kelada ka dalban karaan lacagta guud ee kaalmada ijaarka.
en: A family whose income is not sufficient to cover the rent for accommodation or the expenses of owner-occupied accommodation can apply for general housing allowance from Kela.

so: Qofka ilmaha haya iyo ku jira hawlgab, wuxuu Kelada ka codsan karaa lacag u kordhiya hawlgabka oo la xirrirta caruuta.
en: A child's guardian who is retired can apply for a child increase from Kela to supplement their pension.

so: Kelada ayaa bixinaysa lacagta kororka hawlgabka ilaa inta ilmuhu uu ka gaarayo 16 sano.
en: Kela continues to pay this child increase until the child turns 16.

so: Qoysku wuxuu dalban karaa lacagta nolol maalmeedka, haddii ay haysato xaalad dhibaato oo xagga dhaqaalaha ah, taasoo aysan si kale u maarayn karin.
en: A family may apply for income support if it has economic problems that it cannot otherwise cope with.

so: Lacagta nolol maalmeedka waxaa laga dalbadaa Kelada.
en: Income support is applied for from Kela.

so: Haddii aad gurigaada ku xannaaneyso xubin qoyskaada kamid ah oo qaba cudur dabo-dheeraaday, naafo ama waayeel ah, degmadaada ayaa ku siin karta kaalmada xannaaneynta ehelka ( omaishoitotuki).
en: If you are looking after a family member at home who has a chronic disease or is disabled or elderly, your home municipality might pay you family caregiver's support (omaishoidontuki).

so: Kaalmada xannaaneynta ehelka waxaad ka codsan kartaa xafiiska sooshalka ee degmadaada.
en: You can apply for family caregiver's support from your municipal social services office.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Cawinaada dhaqaale iyo bogga Dadka da'da ah qeybta Marka aad ehel guriga ku xannaaneyso.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Financial support and on the page Elderly under Taking care of a family member at home.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi ee Caawimaadda masruufka waxaa lagu sheegayaa kaalmooyin uu heli karo mas'uulka cunugga la deggan haddii aysan waalidku isla deganayn.
en: The InfoFinland web page Single parent families contains information on the kinds of benefits a guardian living with the child can receive if the parents do not live together.

so: Caawimaadda masuufku waa lacag uu waalidka meel kale deggan uga qeybqaato kharashka ku baxa cunugga.
en: Child maintenance support is a fee which a parent living outside the family home pays to participate in the child's expenses.

so: Waalidka aan la deganayn cunugga wuxuu caawimaadda masruufka siinayaa waalidka uu cunuggu la deggan yahay.
en: The parent who does not live with the child pays child maintenance support to the parent living with the child.

so: Kelada waxay ku bixisaa ilmo walba lacagta caruurta, kaasoo ku nool Finland kuna jira Caeyminta bulshada Finland.
en: For every child living in Finland and covered by Finnish social security, Kela pays child benefit.

so: Lacagta carruurta waxaa la helaa ilaa ilmuhu buuxiyo 17 jir.
en: Child benefit is paid until the child turns 17.

so: Waad ka codsan kartaa Kelada lacagta carruurta boga shabagada Kelada ama foomka warqada ah afafkana waa finnish iyo iswiidhish.
en: You can apply for child benefit from Kela either via Kela's website or by a paper form. The online service is available in Finnish and Swedish.

so: Sidoo kale waad la codsan kartaa lacagta dheeriga carruurta marka aad dalbaneyso lacagta hooyada.
en: You can apply for child benefit at the same time as you apply for maternity allowance.

so: Codso waqti hore oo munaasib ah lacagta carruurta, waxaana laguu soo celin ugu badnaan ilaa 6 bilood oo lasoo dhaafey.
en: Apply for child benefit in good time. It will only be paid retroactively for a period of 6 months.

so: Lacagta carruurta cadaddeedu waa ilmaha ugu horeeya 100 euro bishii.
en: The amount of child benefit for the first child is approximately EUR 100 per month.

so: Ilma labaadna xogaa ayaa ku kordhaya lacagta carruurta kii koowaad.
en: There will be a slightly raised child benefit for each following child.

so: Waalidka, kaasoo keli la nool ilmaha ama carruurta, wuxuu heli karaa lacagta carruurta la kordiyey.
en: A parent who lives alone with one or several children can get a single-parent supplement to the child benefit for each child.

so: Lacagta carruurta waxaa la soo shubaa bishii mar waxaana lagu soo shubaa akoonka hooyada ama aabaha ama daryeelaha kale.
en: The child benefit is paid monthly, usually to the mother's, father's or another guardian's bank account.

so: Lacagta carruurta lagama bixiyo canshuur.
en: No tax is paid on the child benefit.

so: Lacagta carruurta mararka qaar waa suurogal in loo shubo sidoo kale ilmihii oo wadanka dibadiisa jira, haddii uu ku jiro lamaanuhu midkood Caeyminta bulshada Finland.
en: In some cases, child benefit can also be paid abroad if you or your spouse are covered by Finnish social security.

so: Ka aqriso xog dheeri ah boga shabakada Kelada, kaalmo sidee ah ayaa la siinayaa reerka wadanka dibadiisa.
en: The Kela website contains further information on situations in which family benefits are paid abroad.

so: Fasaxa waalidka kadib ilmuhu waxay aadi karaan xannaanada ama labada waalid midkood ayaaku heyn kara ilmihii guriga.
en: After parental leave, the child can be placed in day care or either of the parents can look after the child at home.

so: Ka aqri faahfaahin dheeriya xannaanada bogga InfoFinlandi Xannaano maalmeedka.
en: Further information on day care is available on the InfoFinland page Day care.

so: Xannaaneeyahu wuu ahaan karaa xanaaneeye ama ruux ehelka ah.
en: The carer can be, for example, the child's guardian or a relative.

so: Ma heleysid kaalmada guri ku xannaaneynta haddaad wadanka dibadiisa joogto.
en: You cannot obtain child home care allowance if your child is in municipal day care.

so: Keladu waxay bixisaa kaalmada guri ku xannaaneyn haddii
en: Kela will pay child home care allowance if:

so: mid ama labada waalid ah Guri degmo ku leedahay Finland ama
en: one or both parents have a municipality of residence in Finland or

so: ugu yaraan labada waalid midkood uu ka shaqeeyo Finland islamarkaasna uu ku jiro shaqadaas darteed Ammaanka bulshada.
en: at least one of the parents is working in Finland and on the basis of this is covered by *innish social security.

so: Kaalmada guri ku xannaaneynta waxaa kamid ah lacagta xannaaneynta iyo dakhliga qoyska dheeraadka xannaaneynta ee ku xiran iyo weliba dheeraadka degmada oo suurtagal ah.
en: Child home care allowance consists of basic allowance and a supplement whose amount depends on the family's income and the municipal supplement, if your municipality pays one.

so: Weydii xafiiska sooshalka in degmadaada laga bixiyo dheeraadka degmada.
en: Check from your local social services office whether your municipality pays municipal supplement.

so: Lacagta xannaaneynta ee kaalmada guri ku xannaaneyhntu dadka oo dhan waa u siman yihiin, dakhliga qoysku saameyn kuma yeesho.
en: The basic allowance is the same for all and is not affected by the family's income.

so: Kaalmada guri ku xannaaneyntu waa dakhkli canshuur laga goynayo.
en: Child home care allowance is taxable income.

so: Kaalmada guri ku xannaaneynta waxaa xaaladaha qaarkood marka lagu jiro la siin karaan xubin kamid ah qoyska oo jooga wadan Midowga Yurub ama ETA ah.
en: In certain situations, child home care allowance can be also paid to family members residing in another EU or EEA member state.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah weydii Kelada.
en: Ask for more information at Kela.

so: Haddii aad ilmaha ku xannaaneyneyso guriga, waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad shaqada fasax mushaar la'aan ka gasho, ilaa ilmahaagu ka gaarayaan saddex sano.
en: If you look after your child at home, you can take unpaid child care leave (hoitovapaa) from your work until the child's third birthday.

so: Xiliga fasaxa xannaaneynta ilmaha waxaad Kelada ka codsan kartaa kaalmada ku xannaaneynta guriga.
en: You can apply for child home care allowance from Kela for the duration of the leave.

so: Fududdeynta iyo qeyb lacagta xannaaneynta.
en: Flexible and partial care allowance

so: Fasaxa xannaaneyntu wuxuu noqon karaa sidoo kale mid waqtiga barkiis ah.
en: Child care leave can also be part-time.

so: Markaas waxaad sameynaysaa waqti shaqo o ka gaaban kii hore, taas bedelkeedana waxaad heleysaa mushaar ka yar kii hore.
en: It means working shorter hours and being paid correspondingly less.

so: Kelada ayaad ka codsan kartaa lacagta fududdeynta xannaaneynta (joustava hoitoraha) xannaaneynta ilmaha ka yar 3 -jirka iyo lacagta u fududdeynta xannaaneynta barka ah (osittainen hoitoraha) iyo kan ku jira fasalka 1aad iyo 2aad xannaaneyntooda haddii aad Guri degmo ku leedahay Finland.
en: You can apply for flexible care allowance (joustava hoitoraha) from Kela to look after a child who is under the age of 3 and partial care allowance (osittainen hoitoraha) to look after a child who is at grades 1 or 2 at school if you have a municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Fududdeynta ama lacagta xannaaneynta barka ah laguma heli karo cunugga buuxiyay saddex sano laakiin aan weli ku jirin iskuul.
en: Flexible or partial care allowance is not granted for the care of a child who has turned three but is not yet in school.

so: Ilmaha ka yar 3 sano waad ku ahaan kartaa adigoo helaya fasaxa lacagta u fududdeynta barka ah wakhtiga qaar xannaaneynta xannaanooyinka degmada.
en: A child under 3 years of age can attend municipal day care part-time during a flexible child care leave.

so: Waad codsan kartaa fududdeynta ama lacagta xannaaneynta barka ah haddii aad waqtiga shaqadaada ee caadiga ah aad ugu badnaan ku gaabineyso 30 saacadood todobaadki xannaaneynta cunugga darteed.
en: You can apply for flexible or partial care allowance if you reduce your working hours from your normal hours to no more than 30 hours a week to look after your child.

so: Hooyada iyo aabuhu waxay isku waqti heli karaan fududdeynta ama lacagta xannaaneynta barka ah haddii ay labadoodu yareynayaan waqtiyada shaqadooda islamarkaasna ay cunugga xannaaneynayaa waqtiyo kala duduwan.
en: A mother and father can each receive flexible or partial care allowance at the same time if they both work shorter hours and take care of the child at different times.

so: Lacagta daryeelka waxaa markiiba laga bixiyaa hal cunug, waana lacag in la canshuuro mudan.
en: Care allowance is paid for one child at a time and it is taxable income.

so: Ma heli kartid fududdeynta ama lacagta xannaaneynta barka ah, haddii lagu siiyo lacagta waalidnimada ama gunnada guri ku-haynta caruurta, oo isla markaasna aad adigu ilmaha haysatid.
en: You cannot receive flexible or partial care allowance if you are receiving parental allowance and/or child home care allowance and you are looking after your children yourself.

so: Ilmuhu markey dhashaan kadib waxaa ku xanaaneeya guriga intii waqti ah waalidiinta midkood.
en: After the child is born, usually one of the parents will stay at home and take care of the baby for some time.

so: Keladuna waqtigaas waxay siisaa lacag-maalmeed waalidka (vanhempainpäiväraha).
en: Kela will pay him or her various types of parenthood allowances (vanhempainpäiväraha) for this period.

so: lacagta hooyada iyo lacagta qaaska ee hooyada
en: maternity allowance and special maternity allowance

so: Waxaa intaa dheer oo waalidka la siiyaa dheeraadka ilmaha (lapsilisä), ilaa ilmuhu 17 jirsado.
en: The guardian of the child will also be paid child benefit (lapsilisä), until the child turns 17.

so: Ka aqri faahfaahin dheeriya bogga InfoFinlandi Lacagta carruurta.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Child benefit.

so: Waad codsan kartaa lacag-maalmeedka haddii aad ku jirto Ceyminta bulshada Finland iyo inaad ku caymisan tahay Finlan, dowladaa kale midowga Yurub(EU) ama wadamada la daqliga ah Yurub (ETA) ama Swizerland ugu yaraan 180 maalmood oo xiriira inta ka horeysa waqtiga dhalmada laguu qabtey.
en: You can apply for parenthood allowance if you are covered by Finnish social security and you have been continuously covered by health insurance in Finland, another EU or EEA member state or Switzerland for at least 180 days before your due date.

so: Waxaad ka codsan kartaa lacag-maalmeedka waalidka boga shabakada Kelada.
en: You can apply for parenthood allowance via the Kela website.

so: Waxaad ku galeysaa lambariska aad ku gasho shabakada bankiga verkkopankkitunnus ama aqoonsiga moobeelka mobiilivarmenne.
en: Log in using your bank identifiers or a mobile certificate.

so: Waxaad ka heleysaa adeegaas xog sidaad u buuxin laheyd foomka.
en: The service provides advice on how to fill in the application form.

so: Isla ciiwaankaas ayaad ka arki kartaa hadba arrintaada xalkeedu meeshuu marayo.
en: At the same address you can also see how the processing of your application is proceeding.

so: Markii la gaaro go'aanka codsigaaga, waxaad arki kartaa cadadda kaalmada aad heleyso iyo waqtiga aad heleyso.
en: After your application has been processed, you can see at the same address the amount of benefit you will be paid and the payment date.

so: Adeegaas waxaad ku heleysaa afafka finnishka iyu iswiidhishka.
en: The online service is available in Finnish and Swedish.

so: Sidoo kale waad codsan kartaa lacag-maalmeedka adigoo buuxinaya foomka warqada ah kadibna boostada ayaad ku diri kartaa wixii lifaaqyo oo dhana waxaad geyneysaa xafiiska Kelada.
en: Alternatively, you can apply for parenthood allowance by filling in a paper form and posting it, along with its appendices to any Kela office.

so: Rugta dhalaanka iyo hooyooyinka ayaad ka heli kartaa caawimo buuxinta foomka.
en: You can get help in filling in the application at a maternity clinic.

so: Cadadda lacag-maalmeedka waalidka waxay ku xiran tahay hadba daqliga ku soo geli jirey.
en: The amount of parenthood allowance depends on the applicant's income.

so: Lacag-maalmeedka wey ka yar tahay mushaarka, inta badan waa 70 % daqligaaga.
en: Daily allowance is always less than wages, usually approximately 70% of the income.

so: Haddii uusan dakhli ku soo gelin, waxaad heleysaa lacag-maalmeedka waalidka ee ugu yar.
en: If you do not have any income, you will receive the minimum amount of parenthood allowance.

so: Sidoo kale waalidiinta shaqo la'aanta xaq bey u leeyihiin lacag-maalmeedka waalidka.
en: Unemployed parents are also entitled to parenthood allowance.

so: Haddii shaqo ku siiyahaagu ku siinayo mushaar xiliga lacag-maalmeedka waalidka Kelada ayaa waxay siineysaa shaqo ku siiyahaagii lacag-maalmeedkii.
en: If your employer pays you salary during your parenthood allowance period, Kela will pay the allowance to your employer.

so: Wargeli shaqo ku siiyahaaga fasaxaaga waalidnimo 2 billood kahor intaanu bilaaban fasaxa.
en: Notify your employer about your parental leave 2 months before it begins.

so: Haddii fasaxaagu qaadanayo 12 maalmood ama ka yar, wargeli shaqo ku siiyahaaga bil kahor.
en: If you take no more than 12 weekdays of leave, notify your employer one month beforehand.

so: Ka aqriso xog dheeriya boga InfoFinlandi Fasxyada qoyska.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Family leave.

so: lacag-maalmeedka waalidka waa in laga bixiyo canshuur, sidaa darteed waxaad u baahan tahay kaarka canshuurta (verokortti).
en: Parenthood allowances are taxable benefits for which you need to acquire a tax card (verokortti).

so: Ka aqriso xog dheeriya boga InfoFinlandi Canshuurid.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Taxation.

so: Lacagta hooyada dhalashada ilmaha kadib
en: Maternity allowance after the child is born

so: Lacagta hooyada waxay qaadan ilaa saddex billood.
en: The maternity allowance period continues for about three months.

so: Waxay u bilaaabataa 30 maalmo shaqo kahor xiliga dhalmada.
en: It usually begins 30 weekdays before the expected date of delivery.

so: Ka fiirso xog dheeri ah boga InfoFinlandi Kaalmaynta hooyada uurka leh.
en: Further information is available on the InfoFinland page Support for pregnant women.

so: Markuu dhamaado xiliga lacagta hooyada, ilmaha waalidiintiisa mid kamid ah ayaa qaadan kara fasaxa waalidka.
en: After the maternity allowance period has ended, either guardian can take a parental leave.

so: Markaa labada waalid midkood ayaa ilmihii guriga ku xanaaneenaya laguna siinayaa lacagta waalidka.
en: This means that either of the parents stays at home to look after the child and is paid parental allowance.

so: Waa inaad ka codsataa Kelada ugu danbeyn bil kahor inteysan dhamaan lacagta hooyada ama aan la gaarin xiliga lacagta waalidka.
en: It must be applied for from Kela at least a month before the end of the maternity allowance period and the beginning of the parental allowance period.

so: Hooyadu waa iney soo martaa baaritaan dhakhtar 5–12 isbuuc kadib xiligii ay dhashey keentaana shahaado dhakhtarka xafiiska Kelada.
en: A mother must have a medical examination 5–12 weeks from childbirth and deliver the medical certificate to Kela.

so: Haddii kale lama siin doono lacagta waalidka.
en: Otherwise parenthood allowance will not be paid.

so: Fasaxa waalidka waxaa qaadan kara waalidiinta mid kamid ah.
en: Either guardian can take parental leave.

so: Sidoo kale fasax wey ahaan karaan midba mar.
en: They can also take the leave in turns.

so: Waalidku wey shaqeyn karaan qeyb qeybta kalena xanaaneyn karaan ilmha midba gelin.
en: The parents can also work part time and each look after the child part time.

so: Keladuna markaa labada waalidba waxay siineysaa lacagta waalidka qeyb iyo qeyb.
en: For this period, Kela pays partial parental allowance to both.

so: Haddii labada waalid midkood doonayo inuu ku xanaaneeyo ilmih ii guriga xiliga lacagta waalidka kadib wuxuu heli karaa kaalmada ku xanaaneynta carruurta guriga.
en: If one of the parents wants to stay at home to take care of the child after the parental allowance period, he or she may receive child home care allowance.

so: Lacagta aabanimada (Isyysraha) waxaa loogu talagalay aabaha cunugga xannaaneynaya. Kelada
en: Paternity allowance (Isyysraha) is intended for a father taking care of a child.

so: (Kela) ayaa bixisa inta lagu jiro fasaxa aabanimada lacagta aabanimada.
en: Kela pays paternity allowance for the duration of paternity leave.

so: Lacagta aabanimada waad codsan kartaa xittaa haddii aad tahay tusaale ahaan ganacsade, shaqo la'aan ama arday.
en: You can also apply for paternity allowance if you are an entrepreneur, unemployed or a student.

so: Xilliga lacagta aabanimadu wuxuu qaataa 54 maalmaha shaqada ah, waa qiyaasti sagaal todobaad.
en: The paternity allowance period is 54 weekdays, i.e. approximately nine weeks.

so: Maalmahan looma wareejin karo hooyada si ay u qaadato.
en: These days cannot be transferred to the mother.

so: Waxaad adigu go'aansan kartaa in aad qaadaneyso dhammaan maalmaha lacagta aabanimada.
en: You can decide for yourself if you will use all the paternity allowance days or only some of them.

so: Waad heleysaa lacagta aabanimada haddii aadan xittaa la deganeyn cunugga hooyadiis.
en: You can get paternity allowance even if you do not live with the mother of the child.

so: Fasaxa aabanimada waxaad geli kartaa isla waqtiga ay hooyadu ku jirto fasaxa hooyada ama waalidka.
en: You can be on paternity leave at the same time the mother of your child is on maternity or parental leave.

so: Markaas waxaad qaadan kartaa ugu badnaan 18 maalmaha lacagta aabanimada ah.
en: In that case, you can take up to 18 paternity allowance days.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale si gaar ah u qaadan kartaa 54 maalmood ee lacagta aabanimada tusaale ahaan fasaxa waalidka kaddib.
en: You can also take all 54 paternity allowance days separately, for example, after the parental leave.

so: Waxaad fasaxa aabaha u qeybsan kartaa adigoo hooyada isku waqti la qaadanaya 1-18 maalmaha shaqada ah ugu badnaan afar xilli.
en: You can divide the 1–18 weekdays taken at the same time as the mother into up to four periods.

so: Fasaxa aabaha ee ka dambeeya xilliga lacagta waalidka waxaad u qeybin kartaa ugu badnaan labo xilli.
en: The paternity leave after the parental leave period can be divided into up to two periods.

so: Maalmaha lacagta aabanimada waxaad u isticmaali kartaa xannaaneynta cunugga 2 sano jirka ka yar oo kaliya.
en: You can only use your paternity allowance days to take care of a child who is under 2 years of age.

so: Marka uu cunuggu buuxiyo 2 sano, ma isticmaali kartid maalmaha lacagta aabanimada haddii xittaa ay wax kaaga harsan yihiin.
en: When your child turns 2, you can no longer use your paternity allowance days, even if you have some left.

so: Haddii aad Finland ku nooshahay waxaad xaq u yeelan kartaa baakadka hooyada uurka leh (äitiysavustus).
en: If you live in Finland, you may be eligible for a maternity grant (äitiysavustus).

so: Kaalmada hooyadu waa adiga hadba midaad doorato baakadka hooyada uurka leh (äitiyspakkaus) ama lacag caliman oo canshuur la'aan ah.
en: The maternity grant is according to your choice either of the baby box (äitiyspakkaus) or a fixed sum of money free of taxes.

so: Kartoonkaas hooyada la siinayo waxaa ku jira dharka ilmaha yar iyo waxyaalo wax lagu daryeelo.
en: The baby box consists of baby clothes and baby care articles.

so: Inta badan hooyadu waxay doorataa kartoonka, sababtoo ah waa ka qiimo badan yahay bedelka lacagta.
en: Most mothers choose the baby box because it is worth more financially.

so: Xaq waxaad u leedahay kaalmada hooyada, markii
en: You are entitled to maternity grant when

so: uurka yahay ilaa shan billood
en: your pregnancy has continued for five months

so: soo martey baaritaan dhakhtar intaadan dhameysan ama aadan buuxin afar billood
en: you have had a medical examination before the end of your fourth month of pregnancy and

so: ku jirtid Ceyminta bulshada Finland.
en: you are covered by Finnish social security.

so: Markaad uurka leedahay Kelada ayaa ku siineysa lacagta hooyonimada (äitiysraha).
en: When you are expecting a baby, Kela can pay you maternity allowance (äitiysraha).

so: Hooyadu waxay gashaa caadiyan fasaxa hooyanimo 30 maalmood ka hor waqtiga loo qabtey iney dhaleyso.
en: A mother starts her maternity leave usually 30 weekdays before the expected date of delivery.

so: Waqtigaasna hooyada waxaa la siiyaa lacagta hooyada. Isugeyn waxaa la siiyaa qiyaastii muddo 4 billood ah.
en: The mother then receives maternity allowance which is paid for a period of approximately 4 months in total.

so: Waad codsan kartaa lacagta hooyada, hadaad ku jirto Ceyminta bulshada Finland iyo inaad ku jirtey ceyminta jirada Finland, ama wadamada midowga Yurub (EU) ama wadamada ay isku daqliga yihiin Yurub (ETA) ama Swizerland ugu yaraan 180 maalmood kahor waqtiga laguu qabtey dhalmada.
en: You can apply for maternity allowance if you are covered by Finnish social security and you have been continuously covered by health insurance in Finland, another EU or EEA member state or Switzerland for at least 180 days before your due date.

so: Kelada waxay ku siineysaa lacagta hooyada waana isku sharuud sidoo kale ardeyda iyo shaqo laawayasha.
en: Kela also pays maternity allowance on these same terms to students and unemployed persons.

so: Kaalmada hooyada iyo codsashada lacagta hooyada
en: Applying for maternity grant and maternity allowance

so: Ka codso Kelada kaalmada hooyada iyo lacagta hooyada ugu danbeyn labo billood kahor waqtiga laguu qabtey inaad dhaleyso.
en: Apply for maternity grant and maternity allowance from Kela at least two months before your due date.

so: Waad ka codsan kartaa kaalamada hooyada iyo lacagta hooyada boga shabagada Kelada.
en: You can apply for maternity grant and maternity allowance via the Kela website.

so: Waxaad ku galeysaa lambariska aad ku gasho shabakada bankiga verkkopankkitunnus ama aqoonsiga moobeelka mobiilivarmenne Waxaad ka heleysaa adeegaas xog sidaad u buuxin laheyd foomka.
en: Log in using your bank identifiers or a mobile certificate. The service provides advice on how to fill in the application form.

so: Sidoo kale waad codsan kartaa kaalmada hooyada iyo lacagta hooyada adigoo buuxinaya foomka warqada ah kadibna boostada ayaad ku diri kartaa wixii lifaaqyo oo dhana waxaad geyneysaa xafiiska Kelada.
en: Alternatively, you can apply for maternity grant and maternity allowance by filling in a paper form and posting it, along with its appendices to any Kela office.

so: Xasuuso inaad wargeliso shaqo ku siiyahaaga fasaxa hooyanimo ugu danbeyn 2 billood intaadan gelin fasaxa.
en: Don't forget to notify your employer about your maternity leave 2 months before it begins.

so: Haddii hooyadu rabto wey geli kartaa fasaxa hooyada kahor waqtiga loo qabtey iney dhaleyso 31–50 maalmo shaqo.
en: If a mother-to-be so chooses, she can start her maternity leave 31–50 weekdays before the expected date of delivery.

so: Lacagta hooyaduna waxay u socon 4 billod laga soo billaabo maalintii loo bilaabey.
en: Maternity allowance is paid for a period of 4 months starting from the beginning of the maternity leave.

so: Haddii hooyadu ka shaqeyso meel hillaac sida raajada iyo walxaha kiimikada ama cudurada faafa, wey ka hari kartaa markaaba shaqada, markii lagu sheego uurka.
en: If you are exposed to radiation, chemical substances or contagious diseases in your work, you can stop working as soon as your pregnancy is established.

so: Waqtigaasna waxaa la siinayaa lacagta hooyonimada ee gaarka ah (erityisäitiysraha).
en: You will receive special maternity allowance (erityisäitiysraha) for this time.

so: Xasuuso inaad ka codsato lacagta hooyada gaarka ah afar billood kadib laga soo billaabo maalintaad shaqada ka hartey.
