en: Don't forget to apply for special maternity allowance from Kela within four months of the day you stop working.

so: Lacagta gaarka ee hooyada maba lasiiyo shaqo laawaha iyo siyaabo qaasa ardeyda.
en: Special maternity allowance is not paid to unemployed mothers at all and only in certain cases to students.

so: Boga shabakada Kelada waxaad ka ogaan kartaa dhammaan kaalmooyinka, taasooy Keladu siiso reeraha ilmooleyda.
en: You can find out about all the benefits Kela offers for families with children on Kela's website.

so: Caadiyan waa inaad ka mid tahay Ammaanka bulsho ee Finland ama waa inaad ku tahay Deegaan Finland, si aad u hesho kaalmada.
en: A prerequisite for most types of financial support is that you are covered by Finnish social security or that you have a Municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Jinsiyada carruurtu saameyn kuma laaha, inaad heleyso, balse waxaa saameyn ku yeelanaya nooca sharciga waalidku heystaan kaalmada ay heli karaan.
en: Your child's citizenship does not affect your entitlement to benefits. However, the parents' residence permit may affect the financial benefits that the family can obtain.

so: Waxaa laga yaabaa in aad xaq u leedahay in aad kaalmo ka hesho wadankaada.
en: You may have the right to receive benefits from your native country.

so: Haddaad ka mid tahay Ammaanka bulsho ee Finland degana wadanka dibadiisa, waxaad heli kartaa kaalmooyin qaarkood sida markaad Finland joogto.
en: If you are covered by Finnish social security while you are staying abroad, you may receive some of the same benefits which you would be entitled to in Finland.

so: Wadanka dibadiisa xitaa waad heleysaa kaalmada dheeriga carruurta lapsilisä, kaalmada hooyada iyo weliba lacagta maalmeedka waalidka.
en: Child benefit, maternity grant and parental allowances, for example, are also paid abroad.

so: Lacag maalmeedka hooyada ama - waalidka waxaa la siinayaa hooyada tusaale hadey xiliga lacag maalmeedka waalidka intey u socoto u guurtto wadamada EU/ETA ama Swizerland wax sanad ka yar.
en: For instance, if the mother moves to another EU/EEA member state or Switzerland for less than a year during the parental allowance period, she may continue to receive maternity and parental allowance.

so: Wergeli had iyo goor Kelada, hadaad u guureyso si rasmi ah wadanka dibadiisa ama aad u degenaaneyso muddo ka badan saddex billood.
en: Notify Kela in every case if you are moving abroad permanently or will reside abroad for more than three months.

so: Waxaad ka arki kartaa faahfaahin dheeriya bogga Kelada.
en: More information is available on Kela's website.

so: Cunug kasta wuxuu xaq u leeyahay carruurnimo wanaagsan oo nabadgelyo ah.
en: Every child has a right to a good and safe childhood.

so: Badbaadada carruurtu waa shaqaalaha sooshalka degmooyinka oo caawinaya carruurta iyo qoysaska marka ay xaalad dhibaato leh ay ku jiraan.
en: Child welfare means that municipal social workers help children and families in problem situations.

so: Waxaan ku dadaalnaa in dhibaatooyinka wax laga qabto ka hor inta aysan aad u weynaanin.
en: We try to solve problems before they grow too big.

so: Badbaadada carruurtu waa meesha ugu dambeysa.
en: Child welfare is always a last resort.

so: Taas waxey ka dhigan tahay in ka hor inta aan lala soo xiriirin badbaadada carruurta cunugga iyo qoyska lagu caawiyo tusaale ahaan dugsiga ama rugta la-talinta.
en: It means that before child welfare is contacted, the child and family are supported at school or a maternity and child health clinic, for example.

so: Xiriirka badbaadada carruurtu wuxuu ka billowdaa ogeysiiska badbaadada carruurta.
en: Contact with child welfare starts with a child welfare report. Families can ask child welfare authorities for help themselves.

so: Ogeysiiska badbaadada carruurta waxaa sameyn kara qof kasta oo ka welwelsan nolol-wanaagga ama hufnaanta qoyska.
en: Child welfare reports can also be submitted by anyone who is concerned for a family's well-being.

so: Tusaale ahaan macallinka/macallimadda cunugga ayaa la xiriiri karta saraakiisha badbaadada carruurta.
en: For example, a child's teacher can contact the child welfare authorities.

so: Mararka qaar waalidku ma awoodaan in ay daryeelaan nolol-wanaagga cunugga.
en: Sometimes, parents cannot ensure the child's well-being.

so: Bulshadu waa in ay markaas xaaladda soo faragelisaa.
en: In such cases, society must intervene in the family situation.

so: Danta cunugga ayaa ah waxa ugu muhiimsan ee looga shaqeeyo badbaadada carruurta.
en: In child welfare, the most important thing is the child's best interest.

so: Badbaadada carruurtu waxey taageertaa qoyska marka ay xaalad dhibaato leh ku jiraan
en: Child welfare supports families in problem situations

so: Toos ayaa badbaadada carruurta caawimaad looga codsan karaa tusaale ahaan haddii waalidku ay aad u daalaan ama qoysku uu ku jiro xaalad isbeddel nololeed oo adag.
en: You can ask child welfare for help, for example, if the parents are exhausted, or there is a difficult change in the family's life.

so: Badbaadada carruurtu waxaa ay sidoo kale caawisaa qoyska, haddii cunug ama dhallinyaro uu tusaale ahaan isticmaalo mukhaadaraad badan ama uu dembiyo galo.
en: Child welfare also supports families if a child or teenager, for example, abuses alcohol or drugs or commits crimes.

so: Badabaadada carrurtu waxey leedahay habab badan oo ay qoyska ku caawiso.
en: Child welfare has many methods for helping families.

so: Waxa ugu horreeya ee lagu dadaalayo waa daryeelka furan, yacni in cunuggu uu qoyskiisa la deganaado.
en: Above all, the goal is non-institutional care, where the child lives with their family.

so: Shaqaalaha sooshalka ayaa waxey qoyska u qabanqaabin karaan tusaale ahaan caawimaadda guriga ama qof caawiyo.
en: A social worker can arrange home help or a support person for the family.

so: Haddii ay qoyska ka jirto rabshad ama maandooriye si qaldan loo isticmaalo, sooshalka badbaadada carruurta ayaa xaaladda soo faragelin kara.
en: If there is violence or substance abuse in the family, a child welfare social worker will intervene.

so: Haddii uusan cunugga ku nabadgeleyn guriga ama haddii xaaladda cunuggu ay tahay mid aad u adag waxaa la go'aamin karaa in meel kale lagu meeleeyo ama lala wareego.
en: If the child is not safe at home or the situation with the child is very difficult, a decision can be made to put the child into placement or take them into care.

so: Laakiin mar walba waxaa lagu dadaalayaa in uu cunuggu gurigiisa deganaado.
en: However, the main aim is always to help the child so that they can continue living at home.

so: Badbaadada carruurtu waxey ku saleysan tahay sharci
en: Child welfare services and activities are founded in the law

so: Badbaadada carruurtu waxey ku saleysan tahay sharciga badbaadada carruurta iyo heshiisyada caalamiga ah.
en: Child welfare is founded on the Child Welfare Act and international conventions.

so: Sharciga badbaadada carruurtu wuxuu qabanayaa dhammaan carruurta deggan Finland.
en: The Child Welfare Act applies to all children who live in Finland.

so: Tani kuma xirna jinsiyaddooda, diintooda ama dhaqankooda.
en: The applicability is not dependent on their nationality, religion or culture.

so: Bulshada ayaa xuquda ilmaha ku xaqiijinaysa sharci iyo qawaaniin loogu talogalay ilaalinta ilmaha.
en: The society safeguards children's rights through acts and decrees.

so: Sida uu sharcigu qabo waalidiinta ama qofka ilmaha gacanta ku haya ayaa mas'uul ka ah barwaaqo ku noolaanshada iyo helitaanka horumar dheelis tiran inuu ilmuhu helo.
en: The law stipulates that parents or the child's guardians are primarily responsible for the child's well-being and balanced development.

so: Dalka Finland sharci ayaa lagu mamnuucay in ilamaha lagu anshaxiyo ciqaab xagga jirka (anshaxayn waxyeelo leh).
en: In Finland, punishing children physically (corporal punishment) is against the law.

so: Tusaale ahaan ilmaha lama garaaci karo sidoo kale timaha lagama jiidi karo.
en: For example, children must not be hit or pulled by the hair.

so: Bulashada Finnishka dhexdeeda waxaa aad muhiimad loo siiyaa sinnaanta.
en: Equality is emphasised in Finland.

so: Tusaale ahaan hooyada ilmaha yar leh waxay aadi kartaa shaqo, isla markaas waalidka kale ayaa ilmaha guriga ku xanaaneynaya.
en: A mother of a young child can, for example, go to work while the other parent stays at home to take care of the child.

so: Dalka Finland dumarka iyo raguba ilmaha ayey xanaaneeyaan oo barbaariyaan.
en: In Finland, both women and men look after and raise children.

so: Ilmaha waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay si xor ah u fikaraan.
en: Children are encouraged to independent thinking.

so: Tusaale ahaan ilmuhu wuxuu qabi karaa fikrad ka duwan tan waalidka.
en: A child is allowed, for example, to disagree with his or her parents.

so: Dalka Finland inta badan dhalinyaradu waxay guriga waalidka ka guuraan markii ay qaan-gaaraan, haddii ay waxbarasho aadaan ama shaqo aadaan.
en: Young people in Finland usually move away from home after coming of age when they begin studying or find a job.

so: Waa wax iska caadi ah, inay kali noolaadaan ama ay la noolaadaan arday kale ka hor inta aysan xaas noqon.
en: It is common for them to live either alone or with student friends before starting a family.

so: Dalka Finland waxaa laga qiimeeyaa waxbarashada, dhiirigelinta waalidka ee xagga waxbarashaduna waa muhiim.
en: Education and training is valued in Finland and parents' encouragement in schooling is important.

so: Noqo mid xiiseeya waxbarashda caruurta kana qayb-gal tusaale ahaan galbaha waalidiinta ee iskuuladu qaban-qaabiyaan.
en: Show an interest in your child's school attendance and take part, for example, in parents' meetings organised by the school.

so: Waxaa aad muhiim u ah in carruurta iyo dhallinyarada loo yeelo xad iyo qawaaniin qabta.
en: It is important to give children and young persons clear rules and boundaries.

so: Qawaaniinta wada jirka ah waxaa tusaale ahaan lagula heshiin karaa waalidinta kale.
en: Common rules can be agreed upon together with other parents, for example.

so: Waxaa habboon in la xasuusto in ilmaha da'doodu ka yar tahay 18-sano aan la siin karin sigaar ama khamri midna.
en: Don't forget that cigarettes and alcohol must not be given to a person who is under 18 years old.

so: Markii qofka dhalinyarada aahi uu buuxiyo 18-sano ayuu sharci ahaan noqonayaa qaan gaar.
en: When a youth turns 18 he or she is an adult under the law.

so: Markaas qofka dhalinyarada ahi wuxuu si buuxda xubin uga noqonayaa bulshada wuxuuna gaari karaa go'aamada la xiriira noloshiisa.
en: The youth is then a legally competent member of society and has the power of decision over his or her own life.

so: Sidoo kale qofka dhalinyarada ah ee da'diisu ka yartahay 18-sano wuxuu xaq u leeyahay inuu go'aan ka gaaro arimaha asaga khuseeya qaarkood.
en: In some issues, under 18-year-olds also have the right to make their own decisions.

so: Bogga internetka InfoFinlandi: Caruurta waxaa lagu sheegaa xuquuqda caruurta ayadoo hadba da'dooda loo eegaayo.
en: The InfoFinland web page Children provides information about children's rights according to their age.

so: Waxaa jira oo la heli karaa cawinaado iyo kaalmooyin farabadan oo la xiriira korinta iyo barbaarinta caruurta.
en: There is a lot of help and support available in matters concerning children's upbringing.

so: Haddii aad u baahan tihiin cawinaad ama aad ka walwalsan tihiin caruurtiina, waxaa haboon inaad goor hore la talin waydiisaataan tusaale ahaan adeegyada uu bixiyo xafiiska arimaha bulshada ee magaalada aad degen tihiin.
en: If you need support or you are worried about your child, you should ask, for example, the social services in your own municipality for advice in good time.

so: Wixii warar dheeraad ah ka akhriso bogga internetka InfoFinlandi: Dhibaatooyinka qoyska dhexdiisa ah.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Children's and young people's problems.

so: Ilmuhu waa inuu ka qeybqaataa waxbarasho u carbiyeenta.
en: A child must attend pre-primary education.

so: Ilmuhu waxbarashada waa ku billaabi karaa ogolaansho gaar.
en: A child can start school with special permission.

so: Iskuulka ayaa bilowda (waxbarashada qasabka ah).
en: School begins (compulsory education).

so: Haddii ay jiraan xaalado gaar ah iskuulku waqti dambe ayaa la bilaabi karaa.
en: In special cases, a child can start school later.

so: Lama badeli karo ilmaha magaciisa ama magaca qoyska ee ilmaha, ilaa laga helo ogolaanshada ilmaha.
en: A child's first or last name cannot be changed without his or her consent.

so: Ilmaha laguma dari karo koox diimeed ayadoon ilmaha ogolaansho laga haysan.
en: A child cannot be affiliated with a religion without his or her consent.

so: Sidoo kale ka bixitaanka diinta waxaa loo baahan yahay ruqsada ilmaha.
en: The child's permission is also required for leaving a religion.

so: Haddii ay waalidiintu kala tagaan ilmuhu wuxuu xaq u leeyahay inuu diido la kulanka mid ka mid ah waalidiinta.
en: The child of a divorced couple has the right to refuse to meet one of his or her parents.

so: Ilmaha lama adhabtigarayn (waalid kale sharci ahaan uma korsan) karo ilaa asiga ruqsad laga helayo.
en: A child cannot be adopted without his or her consent.

so: Haddii qoyska dhexdiisa ay dhibaato ka jirto, ilmuhu wuxuu codsan karaa in loo sameeyo daryeel ku meelgaar ah.
en: If there are problems in the family, a child can request for foster care themselves.

so: Daryeelka ku meelgaarka ah waxaa loola jeedaa, inuu ilmuhu daganaado meel aan ahaynn guriga waalidiintiisa.
en: Foster care means that a child does not live with his or her parents but elsewhere.

so: Ilmuhu baaskiil kuma wadi karo wadada ay dadku ku lugeeyaan.
en: A child can no longer ride a bicycle on the pavement.

so: Ilmuhu wuxuu qaban karaa shaqooyin fudud dhawr saacadood maalintii, haddii aysan wax dhibaato ah caafimaadkiisa u geysaneyn ama aaditaanka iskuulka.
en: A child can engage in light work for a few hours a day, if it does not hinder his or her health or school going.

so: Heshiiska shaqada waxaa loo baahan yahay inay sixiixaan waalidiintu.
en: A guardian's signature is required for the child's contract of employment.

so: Wuxuu geli karaa heshiiska shaqada.
en: A youth can enter into a contract of employment themselves.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee waalidiintu waxay burburin karaan heshiiska shaqada ee ilmaha da'doodu ka yar tahay 18 sano, haddii uusan ilmuhu waalidiinta waxba uga sheegin shaqada.
en: Parents can, however, dissolve the agreement of a youth under the age of 18, if the youth has not told them about the job.

so: Dhalinyaradu waxay xaq u leeyihiin inay furtaan koonto bangi ayna iyagu maamulaan hantida ay shaqadooda ku kasbadaan.
en: A youth has the right to open a bank account and to control the capital he or she has earned through working.

so: Markii uu da yarku dhameeyo waxbarashada qasabka ah, wuxuu samayn karaa shaqo maalintii oo dhan ah inta u dhaxaysa saacada 6.00 – 22.00.
en: After a youth has completed compulsory education, he or she may work full-time between the hours of 6:00 and 22:00.

so: Da yarku wuxuu qaadan karaa ruqsada waditaanka mootada yar yar, cagafka iyo weliba ruqsada waditaanka doomaha matoorka leh.
en: A youth can take a test that allows him or her to drive a moped, tractor or motorboat.

so: Da yarku wuxuu baaskiil ku wadi karaa ilmo da'diisu ka yartahay 10 sano.
en: A youth can carry a child under 10 years of age on a bicycle.

so: Da yarku wuxuu ku biiri karaa ama ka bixi karaa diin asagoo kaashanaya ruqsada qoraalka ah ee waalidiintiisa.
en: A youth can join a religion or leave one on his or her parents' written permission.

so: Qofka dhalinyarada ah wuxuu mas'uul ka yahay dambiyada uu sameeyo.
en: A youth is responsible for the crimes he or she has committed.

so: Haddii qofka dhalinyarada ah uu dambi galo, waxaa lagu soo oogi karaa laguna xukumi karaa dambiga uu galay.
en: If a youth commits a crime, he or she may be prosecuted and sentenced for it.

so: Xadka ilaalinta Ilmaha ee xagga galmadu waxuu ku eg yahay 16 sano.
en: Children's sexual age of consent is 16 years.

so: Tan macnaheedu waa, in camaliyada xaga galmada ah ee lala sameeyo ilmaha da'doodu ka yar tahay 16 sano ay tahay dambi lagu mutaysanayo ciqaab (tan waxaa ka baxsan xiriirka galmada ee dhexmara ilmaha da'doodu iyo koritaankoodu isku midka yahay).
en: This means that sexual activity with a person under the age of 16 is a punishable act (with the exception of the mutual sexual relationship of two youths who are at the same level of development).

so: Wuxuu xaq u leeyahay inuu qaato ruqsada waditaanka ee loo yaqaan kaarka-A ee mootooyinka fud-fudud lagu wado.
en: The right to take a test and, after passing, receive a Class A driving licence, which is required for driving a light motorcycle.

so: Wuxuu xaq u leeyahay inuu qaato kaarka caymiska shakhsiyadeed.
en: The right to their own personal health insurance card.

so: Tan macnaheedu waa, in ilmaha jira 16 sano laga caymiyey xaga waayeelnimada, shaqa la'aanta iyo in waliba in magdhawga caymiska jirada asaga loo soo shubayo, ee aan tusaale ahaan la siineyn waalidiinta.
en: This means that a 16-year-old youth is insured against old age, unemployment and incapacity for work and that any reimbursement under the health insurance is paid to the youth and not, for example, to the parents.

so: Waxbarashada khasabka aho ayaa dhamaanaysa, haddii aan horay loo dhamayn.
en: Compulsory education ends unless it has already been completed.

so: Xuquuqda lacagta gunada caruurtu way dhamaanaysaa.
en: The right to child benefit ends.

so: Dhalinyaraha wuxuu dalban karaa lacagta kaalmada waxbarashada ee Keladu bixiso.
en: A youth can apply for Kela's financial aid for students.

so: Dakhliga qofka ilmaha mas'uulka ka ah ayaa saamayn ku yeelanaya caddadka lacagta kaalmada waxbarashada iyo ogolaanshadeedaba.
en: Their guardian's income, however, affects the amount of this aid and whether it is granted in the first place.

so: Qaangaarku wuxuu xaq u leeyahay
en: A person of age has the right to

so: codayn karaa doorashooyinka dawliga ah iyo degmooyinka
en: vote in national and municipal elections

so: go'aan ka gaari karaa maamulitaanka isticmaalka hantida uu leeyahay.
en: have control over the use of their own possessions

so: Qaadan karaa leysinka gawaarida lagu wado (tusaale ahaan mootooyinka, gawaarida yar-yar)
en: acquire a driving licence (for example, motorcycle, car)

so: Heli karaa dhalashada (18-22 sano), haddii uu Finland degenaa mudo dheer.
en: gain citizenship (18-22 year old) if they have lived in Finland for an extended period.

so: raga waxaa saaran waajibaadka inay ku biiraan (ciidamada ama adeega shibilka)
en: men are subject to compulsory conscription (army or civil service)

so: Isbitaalka ayaa laga diiwaangeliyaa dhalashada ilmaha
en: A child's birth is registered at the hospital

so: Ku darida ilmaha habka diiwaanka xafiiska dad-dhigista bulshada
en: Child's registration in the Population Information System

so: Dhalashada wadankee ayuu ilmuhu qaadanayaa?
en: What citizenship does the child gain?

so: Haddii ilmuhu uusan qaadanayn dhalashada Finnishka
en: If the child is not granted Finnish citizenship

so: Ilmuhu waa inuu lahaado waalid ama xanaaneeye
en: A child must have a guardian

so: Markii uu ilmuhu dhasho, isbitaalaka dhexdiisa ayaa ilmaha laga diiwaangeliyaa habka diiwaanka xafiiska dad-dhigista bulshada, markaas ilmuhu wuxuu si ku meel gaar ah u helayaa lambarada aqoonsiga dhalashada.
en: When a child is born, the hospital registers the birth in the Finnish Population Information System and the child receives a temporary personal identity number.

so: Tan waxaa la sameeyaa haddii:
en: This is done if:

so: hooyada ilmaha dhashay ay sharciga deganaanshada Finland ku leedahay,
en: the child's mother has a right of residence in Finland.

so: hoohadu ay Guri degmo ee gudaha Finland iyo
en: the mother's municipality of residence is in Finland,

so: hooyadu ay leedahay lambarada aqoonsiga dalashada ee Finnishka.
en: and the mother has a Finnish personal identity number.

so: Haddii hooyadu aysan ka diiwaan gashaneyn Finland, isbitaalku ma diiwaangelin karo dhalashada ilmaha, hooyada looma soo dirayo foomka xafiiska dad-dhigista bulshada.
en: If the mother has not been registered in Finland, the hospital cannot register the birth and the local register office will not send the appropriate form to the mother.

so: Markaas la xiriir xafiiska dad-dhigista bulshada, kana codso talooyin la xiriira diiwaangelinta ilmaha.
en: If this is the case, please contact the local register office and ask for instructions on how to register your child.

so: Arimaha dheeraadka ah ee la xiriira diiwaangelinta hooyada waxaad ka akhrisan kartaa bogga InfoFinlandi
en: Read more about the mother's registration on the InfoFinland page Registering as a resident.

so: Xafiiska dad-dhigista bulshada (Maistraatti) ayaa hooyada guriga ugu soo diraya foomka laba usbuuc gudahood diiwaangelinta isbitaalka ee dhalashada ilmaha kadib.
en: The local register office will send a form to the mother's home within two weeks of the birth registration.

so: Foomkaan ayaad hay'adaha dawlada ku ogeysiin kartaa
en: This form is used to inform the authorities of the following:

so: ku darida ama ka diiwaangelinta ilmaha habka xafiiska dad-dhigista ee dalka Finland
en: the child's registration in the Population Information System

so: Foomka si taxadar leh u buuxi kadibna sixiix.
en: Please fill in the form carefully and sign it.

so: Haddii waalidku ay is qabaan, waa inay labada waalidba foomka sixiixaan.
en: If the child's parents are married, both parents must sign the form.

so: Foomka ugu celi xafiiska dad-dhigista bulshada laba bilood gudohood laga soo bilaabo markii uu ilmuhu dhashay.
en: Return the form to the local register office within two months of the child's birth.

so: Foomka waxaad ku diri kartaa boostada ama adiga ayaa si shakhsiyan ah ugu geyn kara xafiiska dad-dhigista bulshada ee degaankaaga.
en: You can send the form by post or take it to the local register office of your area of residence in person.

so: Markaas kadib ayaa ilmahaaga lagu darayaa habka diiwaanka ee xafiiska dad-dhigista bulshada.
en: You child will not be registered in the Population Information System before this.

so: Finland waxaa ka jira sharciga magaca. Sida uu qabana dhamman, dadka degmo degaankoodu uu yahay Finland, waa inay lahaadaan magaca qoyska iyo 1-4 magac.
en: Finland has a Names Act. According to the Act, all persons with a place of residence in Finland must have a last name and 1–4 first names.

so: Magacyada hore ee qoysku waa inay ahaadaan kuwo waafaqsan sharciga magaca ee dalka Finland.
en: The first names must be compliant with the Finnish Names Act.

so: Tusaale ahaan walaalaha looma bixin karo magacyo isku mid ah.
en: For example, siblings may not be given the same first name.

so: Cunuggu wuxuu magaca qoyska ka qaadanayaa waalidiintiisa.
en: A child receives the last name from his/her parents.

so: Marka ay labada waalid heystaan magac qoys oo isku mid ah, wuxuu naqanayaa magaca qoyska ee cunugga.
en: When the parents have a common last name, that becomes the child's last name.

so: Marka ay waalidiintu leeyihiin magac qoys oo kala duwan, magaca qoyska ee cunuggu wuxuu ku xiran yahay xaaladda.
en: If the parents have different last names, the child's last name will depend on the situation.

so: Haddii ay waalidiintu is qabaan, waxey cunuggooda u dooran karaan magaca qoyska ee labada lammaane kii ay doonaan.
en: If the parents are married, they can choose either spouse's last name for their child.

so: Haddii aysan waalidku is qabin, wuxuu cunuggu qaadan karaa magaca qoyska ee hooyada ama aabaha, haddii aabonimada la xaqiijiyay.
en: If the parents are not married, the child can have either the mother's last name, or father's last name if paternity has been confirmed.

so: Xaqiijinta aabanimada ka sii aqri boggan qeybtiisa Aqoonsiga aabonimada.
en: Read more about the confirmation of paternity in Section “Recognition of paternity” on this page.

so: Haddii ay waalidku magac qoys ahaan u leeyihiin magac qoys oo la isku xiray, cunuggana wuxuu u noqonayaa magaciisa qoyska.
en: If the parents' last name is a double last name formed by combining their last names, that becomes the child's last name.

so: Haddii ay waalidku leeyihiin carruur hore oo ay isu dhaleen, walaalaha aan qaangaarin waa in ay lahaadaan magac qoys oo isku mid ah.
en: If the parents have previous children together, the underage siblings must have the same last name.

so: Haddii ay labada waalid kala tageen, xannaaneeyaha ilmaha ayaa go'aan ka gaaraya magaca ilmaha.
en: If the parents are divorced, the child's guardian will decide the last name.

so: Haddii waalidiintu ay ku heshiin waayaan magaca qoyska ee loo bixinayo ilmaha, markaas ilmuhu wuxuu qaadanayaa magaca qoyska ee hooyada.
en: In the event that the parents fail to agree upon the child's last name, the child will receive the mother's last name.

so: Marka uu cunuggu dhasho waa in loo diiwaangeliyaa afkiisa hooyo.
en: When a child is born, a native language must be registered for him/her.

so: Diiwaangelinta luqadu waa khasab.
en: It is mandatory to register a native language.

so: Hal luqad oo kaliya ayaad u dooran kartaa afka hooyo ee cunugga.
en: You can choose only one language as your child's native language.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso waxaad gadaal ka beddeli kartaa luqada.
en: You can change the language later if you wish.

so: Waxaa wanaagsan in aad ka fikirto luqada aad dooneyso in aad u diiwaangeliso cunuggaada.
en: It is a good idea to think about what language you want to register for your child.

so: Waxey saameyn ku yeelan kartaa luqada laga yaabo in uu cunuggu dugsiga ku dhigto.
en: It may affect what language the child can study at school.

so: Carruurta afkooda hooyo uu yahay wax ka duwan Finnishka ama Iswidhishka waxey Finnishka ama Iswidhishka u baranayaan sidii luqada labaad oo kale, yacni waxbarashada S2. Waxaad taas dheer in cunuggaadu uu baran karo afkiisa hooyo, haddii afka hooyo ee loo diiwaangeliyay uu ka duwan yahay Finnish ama Iswidhish.
en: Children whose native language is something other than Finnish or Swedish will study Finnish or Swedish as a foreign language, i.e. S2 teaching. Your child can also study his/her native language if it is registered as something other than Finnish or Swedish.

so: Barashada afka hooyo waa mid aan khasab aheyn.
en: Studying the native language is voluntary.

so: Diinta ilmuhu waa arin qoyska gaar u ah.
en: The child's religion is a matter to be decided inside the family.

so: Adiga ayaan go'aan ka gaaraya diinta uu ilmuhu qaadanayo.
en: You have the right to decide the religion to which the child belongs.

so: Qasab ma ahan inaad diinta ogeysiisid.
en: Registering a religion is not mandatory.

so: Haddii labada waalid midkood uu kaligiis ilmaha xanaaneeyo oo mas'uul ka yahay, asaga ayaa go'aan ka gaaraya diinta uu ilmuhu qaadanayo.
en: If one of the parents is the child's sole guardian, he or she can decide the child's religion.

so: Dhalashada ilmuhu, waxay ku xiran tahay dhalashada ay leeyihiin waalidiintu.
en: The child's citizenship is dependent on the citizenship of the parents.

so: Markii uu ilmuhu dhasho wuxuu qaadanyaa dhalashada Finnishka, haddii:
en: A newborn child is granted Finnish citizenship if:

so: hooyada ilmuhu ay tahay muwaadin Finnish ah;
en: the child's mother is a Finnish citizen;

so: aabaha ilmuhu uu yahay muwaadin Finnish ah, ayna waalidiintu is qabaan;
en: the child's father is a Finnish citizen and the parents are married;

so: aabaha ilmuhu uu yahay muwaadin Finnish ah, ilmuhuna uu guur la'aan ku dhashay dalka Finland, ninka aabenimadiisana la xaqiijiyey;
en: the child's father is a Finnish citizen, the child is born in Finland out of wedlock, and the father's paternity is confirmed;

so: aabaha ilmuhu uu dhintay ka hor intii ilmuhu uusan dhalan, laakiin markii uu dhimanaayey uu ahaa muwaadin Finnish ah ayna is qabeen hooyada ilmaha dhashay; ama
en: the child's father has died before childbirth, but he was a Finnish citizen and married to the child's mother upon his death; or

so: aabaha ilmuhu uu dhintay ka hor intii ilmuhu uusan dhalan, ilmuhuna uu guur la'aan ku dhashay dalka Finland, ninka aabenimadiisana la xaqiijiyey.
en: the child's father has died before childbirth, the child is born in Finland out of wedlock, and the father's paternity has been confirmed;

so: Ilmuhu wuxuu sidoo kale helayaa dhalashada muwaadinnimada Finnishka, haddii uu Finland ku dhashay isla markaasna uusan waalidiintiisa ka helin dhalashada muwaadinnimada wadan kale.
en: The child will also be granted Finnish citizenship if he or she is born in Finland and does not gain the citizenship of any other state from the parents.

so: Markaas Xaafiiska dadka dalka u soo guurey ayaa cadeynaya muwaadinnimada ilmaha.
en: In these cases, the Finnish Immigration Service determines the child's citizenship.

so: Ilmuhu wuxuu si isku mid ah u yeelan karaa dhalashada Finland iyo tan wadan kale.
en: A child may be a Finnish citizen and the citizen of another country at the same time.

so: Tani waxay ku xiran tahay in sharciga wadanka kale uu ogol yahay in qofku uu qaadan karo dhalashada laba wadan.
en: This depends on whether or not the other country in question accepts multinationality.

so: Arinta wax ka weydii safaarada wadankaaga.
en: Ask the diplomatic mission of your country about the matter.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ee la xiriira dhalashada Finnishka ka akhriso bogga InfoFinlandi Dhalashada Finland.
en: Read more about Finnish citizenship on the InfoFinland page Finnish citizenship.

so: Haddii ilmuhu uusan qaadanayn dhalashada Finnishka, markii uu dhasho, baasaboor uga dalab safaaradda wadankaaga.
en: If your child is not granted Finnish citizenship upon birth, obtain a passport for him or her from the diplomatic mission of your native country.

so: Tan awgeed waxaad xafiiska dad-dhigista bulshada uga baahanaysaa shahaadada dhalashada ilmaha.
en: You will need the child's birth certificate from the local register office for this purpose.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi ee Safaaradaha Finland jooga waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad la xiriira safaaradaha wadamada kale ee Finland dhexdeeda ku yaala.
en: Read more about the diplomatic missions of other countries in Finland on the InfoFinland page Embassies in Finland.

so: Markaas ka ka dib ilmuhu wuxuu u baahanayaa ruqsada deganaanshda ama diiwaangelinta xuquuqda deganaanshda muwaadiniinta EU'da.
en: After this, your child will require a residence permit or registration of an EU citizen's right of residence.

so: Haddii uu ilmuhu uu qaadanayo dhalashada wadan ka mid ah EU'da. Xafiiska dadka waddanka u soo guurey uga dalab xuquuqda diiwaangelinta degenaanshada ee muwaadinka EU'da adigoo isticmaalaya adeegga elektroonigga ah ee Enter Finland ee uu bixiyo Xafiiska dadka waddanka u soo guurey ama si caadi ah uga dalab barta adeegga ee Xafiiska dadka waddanka u soo guurey.
en: If the child is granted the citizenship of an EU country, apply for a registration of an EU citizen's right of residence for him or her through the Finnish Immigration Service's digital Enter Finland service or by visiting a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Haddii uu ilmuhu qaadanayo dhalashada wadan kale, Xafiiska dadka waddanka u soo guurey uga dalab ruqsada degananshada adigoo isticmaalaya adeegga elektroonigga ah ee Enter Finland ee uu bixiyo Xafiiska dadka waddanka u soo guurey ama si caadi ah uga dalab barta adeegga ee Xafiiska dadka waddanka u soo guurey.
en: If the child is granted the citizenship of some other country, apply for a residence permit for him or her through the Finnish Immigration Service's digital Enter Finland service or by visiting a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Haddii ilmuhu uu ku jiro xayndaabka Ammaanka bulsho ee Finland, wuxuu helayaa kaarka Kelada ama kaarka caymiska jirada.
en: Children who are covered by Finnish social security will receive a Kela card, i.e. a national health insurance card.

so: Kelada ayaa kaarka guriga ugu soo direysa kadib marka, uu ilmuhu helo lambarada aqoonsiga dhalashada iyo magaca.
en: Kela will send the card to the child's home once he or she has been provided with a personal identity number and name.

so: Waa inaad adigu Kelada si gaar ah uga dalbato lacagaha kaalmada qoyska.
en: You must apply for family benefits from Kela separately.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ee la xiriira mawduucan ka akhriso bogga InfoFinlandi Kaalmaynta hooyada uurka leh iyo Kaalmada dhalashada ilmaha kadib.
en: Read more about the subject on the InfoFinland pages Support for pregnant women and Benefits for a family after a child is born.

so: Haddii waalidiinta ilmuhu isqabaan, looma baahna in aabenimada si gooni ah loo xaqiijiyo.
en: If the parents are married, paternity does not need to be separately recognised.

so: Haddii ilmaha hooyadiis iyo aabihiis aysan is qabin, isla markaasna aan aabaha la aqoonsan, markaas ilmuhu wuxuu si rasmi ah u noqonayaa aabo laawe.
en: If the child's mother and father are not married and paternity is not recognised, the child will be deemed fatherless for official purposes.

so: Xarunta hooyada iyo dhallaanka ayaa horay aabenimada looga xaqiijin karaa inta uu ilmuhu uurka ku jiro ama markii uu ilmuhu dhasho ka dib ayadoo loo booqanaayo xafiiska sarkaalka daryeelka cunugga ee dowladda hoose.
en: Fatherhood can be recognised during pregnancy at the maternity and child health clinic or after birth by visiting the municipal child welfare officer.

so: Haddii aabenimada la xaqiijiyo ka hor inta uusan ilmuhu dhalan, markaas falanqaynta arimaha aabenimadu waxay bilaabanayaan ka dib markii dhalashada ilmaha ay ka soo wareegto 30 maalmood.
en: If the paternity is recognised before birth, the processing of the matter will not begin until 30 days have passed from the child's birth.

so: Aqoonsiga aabenimada waxaa xaqiijinya xafiiska dad-dhigista bulshada (maistraatti).
en: The recognition of paternity will be confirmed by the local register office.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ee la xiriira mawduucaan ka akhriso bogga InfoFinlandi ee Wada deganaansho.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Common-law relationship.

so: Sida sharciga Finland uu qabo qofka da'diisu ay ka yar tahay 18-sano waa carruur.
en: In Finland, a person under the age of 18 is legally a child.

so: Ilmaha da'diisu ay ka yar tahay 18-sano waa inuu mar walba lahaado xanaaneeye oo mas'uul ka ah.
en: Persons under 18 years of age must always have at least one guardian.

so: Inta badan ilmaha waalidkood ayaa xannaaneeye u ah.
en: Usually, the child's parents are the guardians.

so: Ilmaha guurka ku dhashay labadooda waalid ayaa si wada jir ah mas'uul ama xanaaneeyeyaal ugu ah.
en: Both parents of a child born in wedlock are regarded as the guardians.

so: Haddii waalidiinta ilmuhu aysan is qabin, aabenimadana aan la aqoonsan, markaas ilmaha waxaa mas'uul ka ah hooyada, ayada kaligeed ayaa go'aan ka gaareysa dhammaan arimaha ilmaha.
en: If the parents are not married and paternity has not been recognised, the child's guardian is the mother, who is the sole decider of the child's affairs.

so: Tan macneheenu waa in hooyadu ay go'aan ka gaareyso arimaha ilmaha xittaa haddii labada waalid ay wada degan yihiin.
en: In other words, the mother makes the decisions regarding the child even if the parents live together.

so: Aabuhu wuxuu heli karaa mas'uulidda ilmaha haddii ay labada waalid ku heshiiyaan inay si wada jir ah ilmaha mas'uul uga wada noqdaan, isla markaasna la aqoonsaday aabenimada.
en: The father will be granted custody if the parents agree upon joint custody and the paternity has been recognised.

so: Heshiiska mas'uulnimada waxaa lagu sameyn karaa xarunta hooyada iyo dhallaanka kahor inta uusan ilmuhu dhalan ama markii uu ilmuhu dhasho kadib ayaa heshiiska lagu sameyn karaa xafiiska u qaybsanaha arimaha carruurta ee degmadaada.
en: The custody agreement is completed before the child's birth at the maternity and child health clinic or, after birth, by visiting the municipal child welfare officer.

so: Sida uu qabto sharciga dalka Finland qofka da'diisu ay ka yar tahay 18- sano waxaa loo arkaa inuusan qaan-gaar ahayn.
en: According to Finnish law, a person under 18 years of age is a child.

so: Qofka da'diisu ka yar yahay 18-sano waa inuu mar walba leeyahay ugu yaraan hal mas'uul.
en: Under 18-year-olds must always have at least one guardian.

so: Guud ahaan mas'uuliyiinta cunggu waa waalidkiisa.
en: Usually, the child's own parents are his or her guardians.

so: Markii uu qofku buuxiyo 18-sano ayuu noqonayaa qof qaangaar ah.
en: When a person turns 18, they come of age.

so: Sida uu qabo sharciga Finland caruurta oo dhan way siman yihiin ayadoon loo eegeyn jinsiyadooda iyo da'dooda toona.
en: According to Finnish law, all children are equal regardless of their background or age.

so: Waajibaadka iyo xuquuqda ku qoran dastuurka dalka Finland waxuu khuseeyaa dhammaan caruurta dalka Finland degen.
en: The rights and obligations stipulated by Finland's constitution apply to all children living in Finland.

so: Sida uu dastuurka qabo, caruurta waa in loola dhaqmaa si ay ku jirto sinnaan iyo cadaalad shakhsiyadeed, waana inay saameyn ku yeeshaan go'aamada iyaga khuseeya.
en: According to this constitution, children must be treated equally as individuals and they must be able to have an influence on the issues that concern themselves.

so: Sidoo kale fiiri bogga InfoFinlandi Kaalmada dhaqaale ee qoyska iyo Daryeelka caruurta.
en: Also have a look at the InfoFinland pages Financial support for families and Taking care of a child.

so: Guurka furan wuxuu dhamaadaa marka aysan lamaanuhu cinwaan isku mid ah deganayn.
en: A common-law relationship is dissolved when the spouses no longer live at the same address.

so: Dhamaanshaha guurka wuxuu saameyn ku yeelan karaa tusaale ahaan kaalmooyinka ay Kelada bixiso iyo kharashka xannaano-maalmeedka cunugga.
en: The termination of a common-law relationship may affect such things as Kela benefits and your child's day care fees.

so: Adiga ayeey waajib kugu tahay inaad ogeysiiso dhamaanshaha guurka furan.
en: You yourself are responsible for notifying authorities of the termination of your common-law relationship.

so: Haddii lamaanaha guurka furan ay leeyihiin carruurta wadajir ah oo 18 sano kayar, lamaanuhu waa inay wadajir uga gaareen go'aan arrimaha ilmaha, si lamid ah furiinka kadib.
en: If common-law spouses have children together and these children are under the age of 18, they must make decisions concerning them just as couples getting divorced do.

so: Sidoo kale lamaanaha furan waxay caawimaad ga heli karaan ka heshiinta arrimaha tusaale ahaan heshiisiinta arrimaha qoyska.
en: Common-law spouses may also receive help in making these decisions from for example family mediation.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Carruurta iyo furiinka.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Children in a divorce.

so: Lammaanayaasha wada deganaanshuhu waxey lahaan karaan magac qoys oo ka dhexeeya.
en: In common-law relationship, the spouses can have a common last name.

so: Haddii xiriirka wada deganaanshuhu dhamaado, saameyn kuma yeelanayo magaca qoyska.
en: If the common-law relationship ends, it does not affect the last name.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso inaad beddesho magaca qoyskaada, ka codso xafiiska diiwaangelinta dadka inay magaca kaa beddelaan.
en: If you want to change your last name, apply to the Local Register Office for a change of name.

so: Guurka furan labada dhinac ee lamaanuhu midkiiba hantidiisa wuu heysanayaa.
en: During a common-law relationship, each party maintains his or her own property.

so: Marka uu dhamaado guurka furan hantida waxaa loo qeybiyaa qaab waafaqsan qofba inta uu lahaa.
en: When a common-law relationship is terminated, property is usually divided in accordance with what belongs to whom.

so: Haddii ay hantida wadajir u yeelanayaan waa in iibsade loogu calaamadeeyaa labada dhinac islamarkaasna la keydiyaa warqada iibka.
en: If a common-law husband and wife acquire property together, both parties must be recorded as buyers and all the relevant receipts must be kept.

so: Markaas hantidaas waxaa loogu qeybinayaa labada dhinac si siman marka uu dhamaado guurka furan.
en: In such a case, this property is divided in half if the common-law relationship ends.

so: Haddiise labada lamaane midkood lagu calaamadeeyo iibsade hantida waxaa isaga ayaa iska leh marka uu dhamaado guurka furan.
en: If only one of the spouses is recorded as the buyer, this property will belong to him or her when the common-law relationship ends.

so: Lamaanaha furan waxay lahaan karaan hantida aan lahaanshaheeda si gaar ah looga heshiin.
en: Common-law spouses may also have property the ownership of which has not been discussed.

so: Markaas waxaa loo qaadanayaa in labaduba ay hantidaas si siman u wada leeyihiin waxaana loogu qeybinayaa si siman.
en: In this case, it is assumed that both parties own an equal share and the property in question is divided in half.

so: Haddii uu muran ka yimaado qeybinta hantida, lamaanaha furan waxay xaalada qaarkood marka lagu jiro maxkamadda ka codsan karaa hanti qeybiye kala saarista hantida darteed.
en: If common-law spouses cannot decide how to divide their property they can in some cases ask a District Court to provide them with an executor for division of property.

so: Hanti qeybiyaha waa la codsan karaa haddii guurka furan uu jiray ugu yaraan shan sano ama ay lamaanaha furan leeyihiin carruur wadajir ah.
en: You can only request a District Court to grant you an executor if your common-law marriage has lasted for at least five years or if you have children together.

so: Xaaladaha qaar marka lagu jiro lamaanaha furan wuxuu furiinka uga heli karaa magdhaw lamaanaha kale.
en: In some cases, one spouse may receive compensation from the other when they separate.

so: Lamaanha furan wuxuu heli karaa magdhaw haddii tusaale ahaan uu shaqo kula caawiyay lamaanaha kale kororsashada hantida islamarkaasna loo arko inaysan cadaalad aheyn in hantida loo qeybiyo qaab waafaqsan lahaansho oo kali ah.
en: A common-law spouse may receive compensation if he or she has, for example, worked for his or her spouse and thus enabled him or her to add to his or her property and thus division of property based solely on ownership would be unjust.

so: Haddii wada deganaanshadu ay ku dhamaato geerida mid ka mid ah lammaanaha wada noolaa awgeed. Lammaaneyaashu isma dhaxlayaan.
en: If a common-law relationship ends in one of the partner's death, the common-law husband and wife do not inherit from each other.

so: Tusaale ahaan lammaanaha laga geeriyooday xaq uma laha inuu sii degenaado gurigii ay wada deganaayeen, haddii gurigu uu yahay hanti uu lahaa lammaanihii geeriyooday.
en: A common-law husband and wife have no right, for example, to stay and live in the family's shared home if it is the property of the dead partner.

so: Dhaxalka lammaanihii geeriyooday waxaa leh ilmihiisa ama walaalkiis.
en: The inheritance goes to the children or siblings of the dead partner.

so: Lamaanaha furan waxay sameyn karaa dardaaran (testamentti) geerida darteed.
en: Common-law spouses may, however, make a will (testamentti) in case one of them dies.

so: Dardaaranka waxay ku cadeyn in hanti cayiman tusaale ahaan guri wadajir ay u leeyihiin in uu dhaxlayo lamaanaha kale.
en: By this will, they can ensure that certain property, for example a home they have purchased together, will go to the other spouse in the event of the other's death.

so: Lamaanaha guurka furan waxaa kale oo ay heshiis ka sameysan karaa furiinka dartiis qeybinta hantida.
en: Common-law spouses may also make a written contract on how their property is to be divided in case their relationship comes to an end.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso inaad sameyso dardaaran ama heshiis qeybinta hantida guurka furan dartiis, talo weydii tusaale ahaan xafiiska caawimaadda sharciga ama sharciyaqaanka.
en: If you would like to make a will or a contract on how your property is to be divided in case of separation, ask for advice from a legal aid office or a lawyer.

so: Wada deganaanshadu waa xiriir dhexmara lammaane, kaasoo ay meel iskula deganyihiin laakiin aysan is-qabin.
en: A common-law relationship is a relationship where spouses live together but are not married to each other.

so: Dalka Finland bilaabida xiriirka wada degida, xeerarka wada degida iyo joojinta xiriirka wada degida waa arin labada qof ee wada degen ka dhexaysa.
en: In Finland, beginning a common-law relationship, the rules of the relationship and ending the relationship, are each couple's own private affair.

so: Wada degida meelna lagama diiwaan geliyo.
en: Common-law relationships are not registered anywhere.

so: labada wada degen midna midka kale xil kama saarna mas'uuliyada masruuf-siinta
en: a common-law husband and wife have no maintenance liability to each other

so: Labada wada degan isma dhaxlayaan
en: they do not inherit from each other

so: Haddii uu mid ka mid ah geeriyoodo, kan kale ma qaadanayo lacagta hawlgabka ee kan geeriyooday
en: a common-law husband or wife cannot receive the surviving spouse's pension if their partner dies

so: Waad qaadan kartaa magac qoys oo wadajir ah, haddii
en: You can adopt a common last name if

so: aad leedihiin carruurta aad wada leedihiin ama
en: you have children together or

so: aad wada nooleydeen ugu yaraan shan sanadood.
en: you have lived together for at least five years

so: Haddii aad dooneysaan magac qoys oo wadajir ah, u dira codsiga beddelista magaca xafiiska diiwaangelinta dadka.
en: If you want to have a common last name, send an application for a change of name to the Local Registry Office.

so: Haddii aad si joogto ah wadajir u deggan tihiin hal guri waxaad tihiin iskudheri.
en: If you and your partner permanently live in the same accommodation, you belong to the same household.

so: Arrintan waxey macno leedahay haddii aad tusaale ahaan Kelada ka codsaneysaan kaalmada ijaarka.
en: This is significant, for example, when applying for housing allowance from Kela.

so: Wixii warar dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan lacagta kaalmada degaanka ee dadka isla degan laakin aan is-qabin ka akhriso bogga internetka InfoFinlandi ee: Kaalmada ijaarka.
en: Read more about housing allowance for unmarried cohabitants on the InfoFinland web page Housing allowance.

so: Xiriirka wada deganaanshada lamaanaha ee dalka dibadiisa lagu soo galay
en: A common-law relationship entered into abroad

so: Xiriirka wada degenaanshadu qodob la cuskado u noqon karaa helitaanka sharciga degenaanshada dalka.
en: A common-law relationship can be a basis for getting a residence permit.

so: Shaqaalaha xafiiska dawlada ayaa go'aan ka gaaraya bixinta sharciga degenaanshada ayagoo arin walba goonidiisa u fiirinaya.
en: The authorities always consider the granting of a residence permit case-specifically.

so: Ilmaha ku dhasha xiriirka wada degenaanshada lammaanaha
en: Children of parents who are in a common-law relationship

so: Haddii ad wada nooshihiin idinka oo an isqabin oo ilmo idiin dhasho, waa in la aqoonsadaa aabonimada.
en: If you are living in a common-law relationship and you have a child, the child's paternity must be acknowledged.

so: Haddii aabonimada la aqoonsan waayo ilmahaasi sida sharcigu dhigayo wuxuu ahaanayaa aabo la'aan waxana mas'uul ka ahaanaysa daryeelkiisa iyo masruufkiisa hooyadii, xataa haddii ad wada dagantihiin.
en: If paternity is not acknowledged, the child is officially fatherless and the mother is alone responsible for the child's maintenance and care, even if you live together.

so: Aabonimada wakhtiga uurka ayaa la aqoonsan karaa waxana lagu fulin karaa howshaas xarunta hooyooyinka iyo dhallaanka (äitiysneuvola).
en: A man can acknowledge his paternity during the pregnancy at a maternity clinic.

so: Markuu ilmuhu dhasho aabuhu wuxuu ku aqoonsan karaa ilmihiisa isaga oo u tagaya shaqaalaha ku qoran kormeerka caruurta (lastenvalvoja) ee degmada.
en: When the child is born, paternity can be acknowledged at your municipality's child welfare supervisor's office.

so: Aqoonsiga aabonimada waxa xaqiijinaya xafiiska diwaanka ee degmada (maistraatti).
en: Paternity is confirmed by the Local Register Office.

so: Markii aabenimada la xaqiiyo
en: When paternity has been confirmed

so: Ilmaha waxaa la siin karaa magaca qoyska ee aabaha
en: the child can be given the father's name

so: abuhu wuxuu noqonayaa daryeelaha ilmaha keligiis ama asaga iyo hooyada si wadajir ah.
en: the father can act as the child's guardian either together with the mother or alone.

so: Daryeelahu (huoltaja) waa qofka ilmaha mas'uul ka ah daryeelka ilmaha iyo bar-baarintiisa.
en: A guardian (huoltaja) is a person who is responsible for a child's care and upbringing.

so: aabaha waxaa saaran mas'uuliyada masruufka ilmaha
en: the father is obliged to participate in the child's maintenance

so: ilmuhu waxay xaq u leeyihiin dhaxalka aabahood iyo weliba dhaxalka qaraabada aabaha iyo bil caksi
en: the child has inheritance rights in relation to his or her father and paternal family and vice versa

so: Ilmuhu wuxuu xaq u leeyahay lacagta hawlgabka qoyska, haddii uu aabuhu geeriyoodo.
en: the child has a right to survivors' pension if the father dies

so: Haddii aabuhu uu diido aabenimada, hooyadu dacwad ayey ku soo googi kartaa, si loo xaqiijiyo aabenimada.
en: If the father does not acknowledge his paternity, the mother can bring suit against him for the confirmation of paternity.

so: Magaca qoyska cunugga ee wada deganaanshaha
en: Child's last name in a common-law relationship

so: Marka uu cunug ku dhasho wada deganaansho, wuxuu heli karaa
en: When a child is born in a common-law relationship, the child can have

so: magaca qoyska ee hooyadiis ama
en: the mother's last name, or

so: magaca qoyska ee aabihiis haddii aabonimada la xaqiijiyay ama
en: the father's last name if paternity has been confirmed, or

so: magaca qoyska ee waalidka ka dhexeeya ama
en: the parents' common last name, or

so: magaca qoyska ee isku xiran, kaas oo ka kooban magacyada qoyska ee waalidka.
en: a double last name formed by combining the parents' last names.

so: Haddii aysan waalidku laheyn magac qoys oo ka dhexeeya, laakiin ay leeyihiin carruur ka dhexeysa, cunuggu wuxuu qaadanayaa magac qoys la mid ah midka walaalaha.
en: If the parents do not have a common last name but they have children together, the child will have the same last name as his/her siblings.

so: Magac qoyska mideysan waad la codsan kartaa lammaanahaada aad wada degan tihiin haddii
en: You can apply for a common last name with your common-law spouse if

so: aad isla deganeedeen ugu yaraan shan sano ama
en: you have lived together for at least five years, or

so: aad wada dhasheen cunug.
en: you have a child together.

so: Haddii uu qoyska ku jiro cunug ka yar 18 sano guurkuna uu dhamaado waa in furiinka looga heshiiyaa arrimaha soo socda:
en: If your family includes children under the age of 18 and your marriage comes to an end, you need to agree on the following things during the divorce process:

so: halkaa uu cunuggu degayo
en: where will your child live

so: qofka ah mas'uulka cunugga
en: who will be the child's guardian

so: sidee xuquuqda kulamada loo qabanqaabinayaa
en: how will visitation rights be organised

so: Marka ay waalidku ka heshiiyaan deegaanka, daryeelka, xuquuqda la kulanka iyo kaalmada masruufka ee cunugga, xafiiska sooshaalka deegaanka ayaa xaqiijin kara heshiiska.
en: When the parents have agreed where their child is to live, who will be his or her guardian, what the visitation arrangements will be and who will pay what as child maintenance support, their local social services may confirm the agreement.

so: Marka uu sooshaalku xaqiijiyo heshiiska wuxuu rasmi u yahay sida go'aan maxkamadeed.
en: An agreement confirmed by social services is as official as a court decision.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa xafiiska sooshaalka ee degaankaada.
en: More information is available at your local social services.

so: Haddii aadan heshiin karin
en: If you are unable to reach an agreement

so: Haddii aadan ka heshiin karin degista, daryeelka, xuquuqda kulamada iyo kaalmada masruufka cunugga waxaad caawimaad ka raadsan kartaan heshiisiinta arrimaha qoyska (perheasioiden sovittelu).
en: If you are unable to reach an agreement concerning living arrangements, guardianship, visitation rights and child maintenance support, you can seek help from family mediation (perheasioiden sovittelu).

so: Haddii heshiisiinta aan heshiis lagu gaarin waa inaad xalka ka raadsataan maxkamadda.
en: If you cannot reach an agreement despite mediation, you must ask your District Court to give a ruling on the matter.

so: Maxkamaddu waxay xisaabta ku daraneysaa danta iyo waxyaabaha uu cunuggu rajeynayo.
en: The court will take into consideration the child's best interest and his or her own wishes.

so: Maxkamaddu waxaa ay sidoo kale baaritaan ama cadeyn weydiisan kartaa sooshaalka degmada.
en: The court will also ask the social services of your municipality to give a report on your situation.

so: Sooshaalka degmadaada weydii heshiisiinta arrimaha qoyska.
en: Ask more about family mediation from the social services of your municipality.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan adeegyada sharciyaqaanada iyo caawimaadda sharciga waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Sharciyaqaan u baahan tahay?.
en: More information on the services provided by lawyers and on legal aid is available on the InfoFinland web page Do you need a lawyer?

so: Marwalba maanka ku haya danta ilmaha marka aad go'aan ka gaareysaan degsita cunugga.
en: Always consider the child's best interest while making decisions on his or her living arrangements.

so: Si rasmi ah cunuggu wuxuu u deganaan karaa hal meel.
en: Officially a child can only live at one address.

so: Xaaladda furiinka marka lagu jiro waxaa laga heshiinayaa labada waalidka midka uu cinwaanka rasmiga ah ee cunuggu uu noqonayo.
en: During the divorce process, parents will agree which one of their homes will be the child's official home.

so: Sida dhacda cunuggu wuxuu qeyb kamid ah waqtiga la deganaan karaa waalidka kale.
en: In practice, however, the child can also live part-time at the other parent's home.

so: Dheeraadka ilmaha waxaa la siinayaa waalidka uu cunuggu sida rasmiga ah ula deggan yahay.
en: Child benefit will be paid to the parent officially living with the child.

so: Cinwaanka rasmiga ah ee cunuggu wuxuu sidoo kale saameyn ku yeelan karaa kaalmada kirada ee ay Keladu bixiso.
en: The child's official address also has an impact on Kela housing allowance, for example.

so: Mas'uuliyadda cunugga waxaa loola jeedaa
en: The guardianship of a child entails

so: qabashada arrimaha cunugga iyo go'aansashadooda
en: managing the child's affairs and making decisions concerning him or her.

so: Mas'uulka cunuggu wuxuu sidoo kale xaq u leeyahay in uu saraakiisha dowladda ka helo macluumaadka arrimaha cunugga.
en: The child's guardian is also entitled to receive information regarding the child from officials.

so: Marka uu guurku dhamaado waalidiinta ayaa go'aan ka gaaraya sida mas'uulnimada loo qabanqaabinayo.
en: When a marriage is dissolved, the parents of a child decide how guardianship will be arranged.

so: Waalidku waxay ku heshiin karaa mas'uulnimo wadajir ah ama mas'uuliyad kali ah ee waalidka kale.
en: Parents can agree to have joint custody of their child or that one of the parents will have sole custody.

so: Mas'uulinimadu kuma xirna qofka uu cunuggu la deggan yahay.
en: Guardianship is not automatically granted to the parent with whom the child lives.

so: Ka sii aqri faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan mas'uulinimada kali iyo wadajirka ah bogga InfoFinlandi Qoyska halka waalid.
en: Read more about joint and sole custody on the InfoFinland web page Single parent families.

so: Cunuggu wuxuu xaq u leeyahay in uu la xiriiro labada waalid furiinka kadib.
en: A child has the right to maintain contact with both of his or her parents after divorce.

so: Wuxuu sidoo kale xaq u leeyahay in uu lakulmo waalidka uusan la deganayn.
en: He or she also has the right to visit the parent with whom he or she does not live.

so: Xaqa lakulanka waxay noqon kartaa tusaale ahaan cunugga oo la deggan hal waalid balse la kulmaya waalidka kale labadii todobaad mar dhamaadyada todobaadka iyo weliba waqtiyo cayiman oo xilliyada fasaxa ah.
en: Visitation rights can entail, for example, that a child lives with one parent and visits the other parent every other weekend and on certain times during holidays.

so: Haddii uu cunuggu aad u yaryahay kulamadu waxay noqon karaa kulamo maalmeedyo.
en: If the child is very young, he or she can meet their other parent during day visits only.

so: Xaqa lakulanku wuxuu noqon karaa sidoo kale mid ballaaran oo uu cunuggu labada waalid la degayo waqti isla siman.
en: Visitation rights can also be so extensive that the child will spend an equal amount of time with each parent.

so: Rasmiyan cunuggu wuxuu yeelan karaa oo kali ah hal cinwaan.
en: Officially, however, a child can only have one address.

so: Marwalba oo aad go'aan gareysaan maanka ku haya danta cunugga.
en: Always consider your child's best interest while making decisions concerning him or her.

so: Marka aad isfuraysaan waxaad horay ugu sii heshiin kartaan inta jeer ee uu cunuggu la kulmayo waalidka meel kaledeggan.
en: When you separate, you can agree in advance how often your child will visit the parent living elsewhere.

so: Haddii aad dooneysaan waxaad heshiis qoraal ah ka sameyn kartaa nidaamka kulamada.
en: If you wish, you can also draw a written contract on visitation arrangements.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale go'aansan kartaa in aad kulamada marwalba si gaar ah uga heshiinaysaan.
en: You can also decide that you will agree on each visitation separately.

so: Haddii kulamada uu dhib la xiriiro
en: If you are having problems with visitation

so: Haddii heshiis ka gaarteen lakulmista, laakiin waalidka cunugga la deggan uusan dhowrin heshiiska, waalidka meel kale deggan wuxuu la xiriiri karaa ilaaliyaha danaha ilmaha ee deegaanka cunugga.
en: If you have made an agreement on visitation arrangements, but the parent living with the child does not abide by this agreement, you can contact a child welfare supervisor of the municipality in which the child lives.

so: Ilaaliyaha danaha ilmuhu wuxuu qabanqaabinayaa kulan u dhexeeya labada waalid.
en: The child welfare supervisor will then arrange a meeting with the parents.

so: Haddii aad ka shakiso in amaanka ama caafimaadka cunugga ay halis ku jiraan marka uu la kulmayo waalidka kale, u sheeg arrinta saraakiisha sooshaalka.
en: If you suspect that your child's health or safety is being compromised when he or she is visiting the other parent, share your concerns with social service staff.

so: Haddii shakigu uu sababo la cadeeyay uu leeyahay waxaa la amri karaa in kulamada ay goobjoog ka ahaadaan saraakiisha sooshaalku.
en: If there are grounds for your worries, a court can give a ruling stating that social services must be present when your child meets his or her other parent.

so: Labada waalid waxay mas'uul ka yihiin masruufka cunugga kayar 18 sano haddii aysan xitaa wada deganayn.
en: Both parents are responsible for the maintenance of their children under the age of 18, even if they no longer live together.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Qoyska halka waalid.
en: Read more about child maintenance support on the InfoFinland web page Single parent families.

so: Magaca qoyska ee cunugga marka uu furiin dhaco
en: Child's last name in a divorce

so: Magaca qoyska cunuggu sidiisi ayuu ahaanayaa, marka ay waalidku is furaan.
en: When the parents get a divorce, the child's last name remains the same.

so: Magaca qoyska xittaa waa la beddeli karaa.
en: The last name can also be changed.

so: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta dadka u dir codsiga magac beddelista.
en: Send an application for a change of name to the Local Registry Office.

so: Haddii uu cunuggu ka weyn yahay 12 sano, waa in isaga beddelista magaca qoyska loo weydiiyaa ogolaansho qoraal ah.
en: If the child is over 12 years old, he/she must be asked for a written permission to change his/her last name.

so: Waxaa sidoo kale wanaagsan in marka hore cunugga 12 sano jirka ah lagala hadlo beddelista magaca qoyska.
en: Even if the child is under 12 years old, it is a good idea to discuss the change of last name with the child beforehand.

so: Qafaalasho carruur waxaa la yiraahdaa marka
en: A child abduction involves

so: cunug 16 sano kayar oo deggan Finland dibadda loo kaxeeyo ayadoo fasax laga heysan qofka mas'uul ka ah
en: taking a child, who is residing in Finland and is under 16 years of age, abroad without the guardian's consent

so: cunuga dibadda loo kaxeeyay oo aan loo soo celin Finland marki lagu balamay in la soo celiyo.
en: not returning a child, who has been taken abroad, to Finland at the agreed time.

so: Dalka Finland qafaalashada carruurtu waa ka dembi.
en: Child abduction is a crime in Finland.

so: La xiriir booliska degmadaada.
en: Contact your local police.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah iyo talooyin waxaad ka heleysaa ururka Carruurta la afduubtay (Kaapatut Lapset ry).
en: Additional information is provided by the Finnish Association for Abducted Children (Kaapatut Lapset ry).

so: Marka uu guurku dhamaado, waad ka heshiin kartaa sida hantida loo qeybsanayo.
en: When a marriage ends in divorce, you and your spouse may agree how to divide your property.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale ka heshiin kartaan qofka labadiina sida ku meelgaarka ah u sii deganaanaya guriga wadajirka aad u leedihiin.
en: You may also agree which one of you will be allowed to live in the family home for the time being.

so: Haddii aad awoodina inaad ka heshiisaan sida loo qeybinayo hantida, labada lamaanood midkii doona ayaa dalban kara qeybinta hantida, qeybinta (ositus).
en: If you and your spouse are not able to agree on how to divide your property, either party can ask for a division of property (ositus).

so: Qeybinta waxaa la sameyn karaa islamarka codsiga furiinka ee ugu horeeya la dhigo.
en: Division of property can be done immediately after the first divorce application has been filed.

so: Looma baahna in la sugu dhamaanshiyaha lixda bilood ee waqtiga ka fiirsashada ah.
en: You do not need to wait for the six-month reconsideration period to pass.

so: Marka aad doonteen qeybinta, maxkamadda ayaa amraysa hanti qeybiye qeybinaya hantida.
en: After you have requested for division of property, the District Court will appoint an executor who will divide your property.

so: Hanti qeybiyaha waa shaqadan lacag laga siiyaa.
en: The executor will be paid for his or her work.

so: Bilowga qeybinta waa in lakeenaa cadeynta hantida iyo deynta labada lamaane ay qabaan ama ay leeyihiin.
en: At the beginning of the division process, an account on the property and debts of each spouse must be given.

so: Bogagga hagaha sharciga Finland waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaadka dukumentiyada aad qeybinta hantida darteed u baahantahay.
en: The website 'Guide to Finnish Law' contains information on the documents you will need for division of property.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan qeybinta waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga Wasaaradda cadaaladda (Oikeusministeriö).
en: More information on division of property is available on the Ministry of Justice website.

so: Hantida si siman miyaa loo qeybinayaa mise?
en: Will the property be divided equally or not?

so: Inta badan marka furiin lagu jiro hantida waxaa loo qeybiyaa si siman.
en: In divorce situations, property is usually divided equally among both spouses.

so: Xaalado gaar ah marka lgu jiro hantida si siman looma qeybiyo.
en: In exceptional cases property is not divided equally.

so: Markaas qeybinta waa laga wadaxaajoon karaa.
en: In these cases, division of property is often mediated.

so: Tan waxaa loola jeedaa in xaaladan marka lagu jiro maanka la gelanayo waxa ugu macquulsan.
en: This means that it is considered what is reasonable in the situation at hand.

so: Tusaale ahaan haddii uu guurku jiray wax kayar shan sano ma ahan wax qasab ah in hantida si siman loo qeybiyo.
en: For example, if the marriage has lasted less than five years, property is not necessarily divided equally.

so: Wadaxaajoodka qeybinta waxaa la sameyn karaa oo kali ah haddii labada lamaane uu midkood si gaar arrintaas u doonayo.
en: Division of property can only be mediated if one of the spouses so requests.

so: Haddii aad sameysayn heshiiska shuruudda guurka, heshiiskan wuxuu saameyn ku yeelanayaa sida loo qeybinayo hantida.
en: If you have signed a marital contract, this affects how your property will be divided in divorce.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan heshiiska shuruudda guurka waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Heshiiska shuruudda guurka.
en: More information on marital contracts is available on the InfoFinland web page Marital contract.

so: Haddii adiga ama lamaanahaadu uu deegaan guri ku leeyahay Finland, waxaad si waafqsan sharciga Finland ku codsan kartaa furiin.
en: If you or your spouse has a municipality of residence in Finland, you can file for a divorce in accordance with Finnish legislation.

so: Sidoo kale marxalado kale marka lagu jiro waxaad si waafaqsan sharciga Finland ku codsan kartaa furiin.
en: You can also file for a divorce according to Finnish legislation in some other cases.

so: Furiinka waxaa lagu qariray sharciga furiinka.
en: Divorce is enacted in the Marriage Act.

so: Furiinka mid ka mid ah lammaanaha ayaa kali ahaan u codsan kara ama lamaanuhu wadajir ayeey u codsan karaan.
en: Either spouse alone or both spouses together can file for a divorce.

so: Kaligaa ayaad codsan kartaa furiinka haddii uusan xitaa lamaanahaado furiin doonayn.
en: You can file for a divorce alone, even if your spouse does not wish to separate from you.

so: Furiinka maxkamadda ayaa laga codsadaa.
en: Divorce application is filed at a District Court.

so: Maxkamaddu ma baarto sababta furiinka loo codsaday.
en: The court will not investigate why you have filed for a divorce.

so: Xiriirka lamaanaha u dhexeeya sidoo kale isna lama baaro.
en: The relationship between the spouses will not be examined either.

so: Furiinka waa in lagu codsadaa codsi qoraal ah.
en: Divorce must be applied for by written application.

so: Codsiga furiinka waxaad dhigan kartaa xafiiska maxkamadda degmadaada ama degmada lamaanahaada.
en: You can submit an application for divorce at the District Court office of your own or your spouse's municipality.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale xafiiska maxkamadda codsiga boostada, telegraaamka ama emaylka.
en: Applications can also be sent to the District Court office by post or e-mail or as a telegram.

so: Codsiga furiinka waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga adeegga Suomi.fi.
en: Divorce application forms are available on the Suomi.fi website.

so: Furiinka labo marxaladood ayaa lagu codsadaa.
en: Divorce is applied for in two phases.

so: Marka hore waxaa la dhigtaa codsiga furiinka.
en: First you need to file an application for divorce.

so: Waqtiga ka fiirsashada kadib furiinka waa in marka kale la codsadaa.
en: After the reconsideration period is over, you must file for a divorce again.

so: Furiinka waxaa la xukumaa codsiga labaad kadib.
en: You will be granted a divorce only after the second application.

so: Furiinka waxaa la xukumayaa haddii uu xitaa lamaanaha kale ka soo horjeedo.
en: The divorce will be granted even if your spouse opposes it.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan codsashada furiinka waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga Wasaaradda cadaaladda.
en: More information on filing for a divorce is available on the Ministry of Justice website.

so: Marka codsiga furiinka ee ugu horeeya la dhigo, waxaa billaabanaya lix bilood oo waqtiga ka fiirsashada ah.
en: When the first divorce application has been filed, a six-month long reconsideration period begins.

so: Waqtiga ka fiirsashadu waa qasab haddii aad cinwaanka ka duwan kan lamaanahaada aad labo sano deganayn.
en: The reconsideration period is mandatory if you and your spouse have not lived in separate households for at least two years.

so: Haddii lamaanahaada aad si wadajir furiinka ula codsaneyso, waqtiga ka fiirsashadu wuxuu billaabanayaa islamarka codsiga wadajirka ah uu maxkamadda soo gaaro.
en: If you and your spouse are filing for divorce together, the reconsideration period begins as soon as your application is filed at a District Court.

so: Haddii lamaanaha kale uu kaliguus codsanayo furiin, waqtiga ka fiirsashadu wuxuu billaabanayaa marka lamaanaha kale la ogeysiiyo arrinta.
en: If one of the spouses is filing for divorce alone, the reconsideration period begins once the other spouse has been notified of the divorce application.

so: Maxkamadda ayaa u xilsaaran in lamaanaha kale uu ka warhelo codsiga
en: The District Court will make sure that the other spouse is notified of the application.

so: Waqtiga ka fiirsashada kadib
en: After the reconsideration period

so: Maxkamaddu waxay lamaanaha ku xukumeysaa furiin haddii:
en: The District Court will grant the spouses a divorce when:

so: lixda bilood ee waqtiga ka fiirsashadu uu dhamaado iyo
en: the six-month reconsideration period has passed and

so: haddii lamaanaha midkood ama labadoodu ay doonayaan in furiin lagu xukumo
en: one or both of the spouses asks to be granted a divorce.

so: Doonista in maxkamaddu lamaanaha ku xukunto furiin waqtiga ka fiirsashada kadib waxaa loo sameeyaa si lamid ah sida codsigi koowaad oo kale.
en: The application asking that the court grants spouses a divorce after the reconsideration period is over is filed in the same way as the first application.

so: Waa muhiim in la sameeyo doonista xukunka furiinka sanad gudihiis laga soo bilaabo marka uu waqtiga ka fiirsashadu bilowday.
en: It is important that you file the application to be granted a divorce within one year after the reconsideration period began.

so: Haddii kale arrinta furiinku way laalmeysaa.
en: If not, your divorce process will lapse.

so: Furiinka aan laheyn waqtiga ka fiirsashada
en: Divorce without a reconsideration period

so: Haddii adiga iyol amaanahaado aad labadii sano ee ugu dambeys aad si aan kala joogsi laheyn u kala deganaydeen labo cinwaan kahor codsashada furiinka, looma baahna waqtiga ka fiirsashada.
en: If you and your spouse have lived in different households without interruption for at least two years before filing for divorce, you will not need a reconsideration period.

so: Markaas maxkamaddu waxay islamarkiiba idinku xukumi kartaa furiin.
en: In this case, the court can grant you a divorce immediately.

so: Marka aad ka fiirsaneyso furiin islamarkaasna aad caawimaad ugu baahantahay ka xaajooshada arrinta waxaad codsan kartaa heshiisiinta arrimaha qoyska (perheasioden sovittelu).
en: If you are contemplating divorce and need help with negotiating various arrangements, you can apply for family mediation (perheasioiden sovittelu).

so: Heshiisiinta waxaa inta badan laga faa'iidi karaa in arrimaha laga heshiin karo maxkamad la'aaan.
en: Family mediation can often help you settle things without resorting to court proceedings.

so: Tusaale ahaan xaaladda ilmaha waxaa looga hadli karaa heshiisiinta.
en: Arrangements related to your children, for example, can be discussed in family mediation.

so: Sida caadiga ah heshiisiiyayaashu waa shaqaalaha xafiisyada sooshaalka, rugaha latalinta barbaarinta iyo rgaha latalinta qoyska.
en: The mediators are usually employees of social services, educational counselling centres or family counselling centres.

so: Si kalsooni leh ayaa iyaga ula sheekeysan kartaa.
en: You can discuss all matters with them confidentially.

so: Xafiiska sooshaalka ee deegaankaada weydii sida heshiisiinta arrimaha qoyska looga qabanqaabiyo deegaankaada.
en: Ask at the local social services office how family mediation is organised in your municipality.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan heshiisiinta arrimaha qoyska waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga Wasaaradda cadaaladda.
en: More information on family mediation is available on the Ministry of Justice website.

so: Dhibaatooyinka xiriirka lamaanaha waxaad caawimaad uga raadsan kartaa tusaale ahaan rugta latalinta qoyska ee deegaankaada ama rugta caafimaadka.
en: If you are having problems in your relationship, you can seek help for example at the family counselling centre of your municipality or your health centre.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Dhibaatooyinka guurka iyo xiriirka lamaanaha.
en: More information is available on the InfoFinland web page Marriage and relationship problems.

so: Marka lagu jiro xaalado dagaal faahfaahin dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Dagaal.
en: More information on what to do if you are in a violent relationship is available on the InfoFinland web page Violence.

so: Ururo badan iyo kaniisado ayaa waxay kaalmooyiinka kooxaha waxqabadka u qabanqaabiyaan kuwa isfuray.
en: Many organisations and parishes organise support group activities for divorced people.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa tusaale ahaan bogagga xarumaha wadaxaajoodka arrimaha qoyska ee Kaniisadda iyo Ururka dadweynaha.
en: More information is available for example on the websites of the Family Federation or the Family Counselling Centre of the Evangelical Lutheran Church of Finland.

so: Bogagga Ururka Midowga Qoysaska Halka Waalid (Yhden Vanhemman Perheiden Liitto ry) waxaad ka heleysaa macluumdyo iyo talooyin loogu talagalay waalidka ka fiirsanaya furiin.
en: The website of Yhden Vanhemman Perheiden Liitto ry (association for single parent families) contains information and advice for parents who are thinking about separating.

so: Ururka Miessakit (Miessakit ry) wuxuu ku dadaalaa in uu sare u qaado hagaagsanaanta ragga isagoo u fidinaya kaalmooyinka dhinaca la qabsashada bulshada ah.
en: The Miessakit Association (Miessakit ry) aims to promote welfare among men and provide social activities and support.

so: Wuxuu ka shaqeeyaa ururku Helsinki, Tampere iyo Lahti.
en: The association has operations in Helsinki, Tampere and Lahti.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku qoran afafka Finnishka, Ingiriiska iyo Iswidishka waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga internteka.
en: Additional information is available on the association's website in Finnish, English and Swedish.

so: Magaca qoyska marka la isfuro
en: Last name in a divorce

so: Haddii guurkaadu uu furriin ku dhamaado, magaca qoysku ma beddelmo.
en: If your marriage ends in a divorce, your last name does not change.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso, waxaad qaadan kartaa magac qoys oo cusub.
en: If you want, you can adopt a different last name.

so: Waxaad tusaale ahaan qaadan kartaa magac qoys kasta oo aad horay u heysatay.
en: For example, you can adopt any last name that you have had before.

so: Furiinka iyo ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka
en: Divorce and residence permit

so: Haddii aad heysato ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka ee waqtigiisa cayiman yahay oo laguugu siiyay xiriir qoys darteed, fruiinku wuxuu saameyn ku yeelan karaa ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka.
en: If you have a fixed-term residence permit that has been granted based on family ties, divorce may affect your residence permit.

so: Xaaladaha noocan oo kale ah marka lagu jiro waxaa marwalba laga fiirsadaa in la sii wadayo ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka furiinka kadib iyo in lala laabanayo.
en: In these situations, it is always considered case-by-case whether the residence permit is continued after the divorce or if it is cancelled.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Dhibaatooyinka Ogolaansha deganaanshaha.
en: More information is available on the InfoFinland web page Residence permit problems.

so: Macluumaadka qeybinta hantida marka furiinka lagu jiro waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Hantida iyo furiinka.
en: Information on how to divide your property if your marriage ends in divorce is available on the InfoFinland web page Property in divorce.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan carruurta iyo furiinka waxaa laga helayaa bogga InfoFinlandi Carruurta iyo furiinka.
en: More information on children in a divorce is available on the InfoFinland web page Children in a divorce.

so: Guurkoodana waa inay ka muuqato is aaminaad dhexdooda ah ayna si wada jir ah horumarka qoyska uga wada shaqeeyaan.
en: In marriage, they must show mutual trust and work together for the family's best.

so: Labada is-qabta mid walba wuxuu xaq u leeyahay inuu go'aan ka gaaro arrimihiisa, inuu shaqo tagayo ama ka qayb-galayo arrimaha mujtamaca iyo hawlo kale oo qoyska ka baxsan.
en: Each spouse has the right to decide themselves whether they want to work or participate in social or other activities outside the family.

so: Ka akhri wajibaadka waalidka xagga ilmaha ka saaran bogga internetka InfoFinlandi: Barbaarinta caruurta ee dalka Finland.
en: Read about parents' obligations towards their children on the InfoFinland web page Bringing up children in Finland.

so: Waajibaadka masruufka ee lammaaneyaasha
en: Maintenance liability of the spouses

so: Lammaanahu waa inuu intii tabartiisa ah ka qayb qaato dhaqaalaha qoyska iyo masruufka lammaanaha kale.
en: Each spouse must, according to their abilities, take part in the family's shared finances and the subsistence of the spouses.

so: Haddii labada lammaane midkood uusan shaqayn, lammaanaha dhaqaalaha roon waa inuu masruufa kan kale, tusaale ahaan inuu ka kaalmeeyo xaga cuntada iyo dharka.
en: If one of the spouses does not work outside the home, the wealthier spouse must cover, for example, food and clothes.

so: Marka naagta guurka ku jirta ama la qabo ay cunug dhasho, rajistareeshinka dadka waxaa ninka naagta qaba si toos ah loogu calaamadeynayaa aabaha cunugga.
en: When a married woman has a baby, her husband is automatically named as that child's father in the population register.

so: Labada waalid waxaa loo qorayaa mas'uuliyiinta cunugga.
en: Both parents will be registered as the child's guardians.

so: Lamaanaha isqaba waxay wadajir u soo korsan karaa cunug.
en: A married couple can adopt a child together.

so: Soo korsashada waxaa lagu qarariraa sharciga soo korsashada.
en: Adoption is enacted in the Adoption Act.

so: Haddii aad xiiseynayso soo korsasho, weydii macluumaad dheeraad ah xafiiska sooshaalka ee degmadaada.
en: If you are interested in adoption, ask the social services of your municipality for more information.

so: Handida uu lammaanuhu leeyahay, markuu guursanayo iyo mida uu helo markuu guursaday ka dib asaga ayaa iska leh.
en: The property which a spouse has when he or she marries, or which he or she acquires during the marriage, belongs to him or her.

so: Lammaanuhu waxay wada samaysan karaan hanti ay wada leeyihiin.
en: Spouses can also procure property for their joint ownership.

so: Lamaanayaasha isqaba waxay hantidooda u leeyihiin xuquuqda guurka.
en: A married couple has a marital right to each other's property.

so: Haddii uu guurku furiin ku dhamaado, dhamaan hantida la isku daray ee lamaanaha waxaa loogu qeybinayaa si siman.
en: If the marriage ends in divorce, the property of both spouses is calculated together and divided equally between the spouses.

so: Haddii guurku uu ku dhamaado geerida lamaanaha kale, hantida la isku xisaabiyay ee lamaanayaasha waxaa loo qeybinayaa kuwa leh dhaxalka lamaanaha geeriyooday iyo lamaanaha nool.
