en: If the marriage ends in the death of either spouse, the property of both spouses is calculated together and divided equally between the heirs of the deceased spouse, and the surviving spouse.

so: Dardaaran laguma burin karo xuquuqda guurka.
en: The marital right cannot be overturned by a will.

so: Haddii lamaanuhu ay sameeyeen shuruud guur, hantida waxaa lagu qeybinayaa marka ay taagantahay xaalad furiin iyo dhimashada lamaanaha kale si waafaqsan heshiiska shuruudda guurka.
en: If the spouses have entered into a marital contract, their property will, in the event of divorce or the death of either spouse, be divided according to their marital contract.

so: Wixii warar dheeraad ah ka akhri bogga internetka InfoFinlandi ee Liiska xasuusta, ee guurka dalka Finland iyo Heshiiska shuruudda guurka.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web pages Getting married in Finland, a checklist and Marital contract.

so: Lammaane kasta wuxuu mas'uul ka yahay daynta uu asagu qaatay guurka ka hor ama guurka dhexdiisa.
en: Each spouse is responsible alone for the debt they have acquired before or during the marriage.

so: Haddii mid ka mid ah lammaaneyaashu uu deyn u qaatay masruufinta qoyska awgeed, tusaale ahaan soo iibinta cuntada, markaas labada lammaano waxay mas'uul ka noqonayaan deynta cuntada.
en: If one of the spouses has incurred debt for the livelihood of the family, for example, for buying groceries, then both spouses are responsible for this debt.

so: Haddii ay doonayaan lamaanuhu si wadajir ah ayeey u qaadan karaan deyn, markaasna waxey si wadajir ah mas'uul uga yihiin bixinta deyntaas.
en: If they wish, spouses can take out debt together, in which case they are also jointly responsible for paying it back.

so: Guriga lawada leeyahay ama alaabada dhextaala lammaaneyaasha midkoodna ma iibin karo asagoon ruqsad ka haysan midka kale, siddo kale tusaale ahaan ma iibin karo qalabka guriga.
en: One spouse cannot sell the family's shared dwelling or the movables belonging to it, such as furniture, without the other one's permission.

so: Haddii aad qabto dhibaatooyin la xiriira xiriirka lamaanaha, waxaad caawimaad ka raadsan kartaa tusaale ahaan rugta latlinta qoyska ee degmadaada ama rugta caafimaadka.
en: If you have problems in your relationship, you can seek help from, for example, the family counselling centre of your municipality or your health centre.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Dhibaatooyinka guurka iyo xiriirka lamaanaha.
en: More information is available from the InfoFinland web page Marriage and relationship problems.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi Rabshad waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad ku saabsan waxa aad sameyn karto haddii lamaanahaadu uu rabshad isticmaalayo ama uu ku hanajabo in uu isticmaalo.
en: The InfoFinland web page Violence contains information on what you can do if your spouse behaves violently or threatens you with violence.

so: Mar marka qaarkood guurku wuxuu ku dhamaadaa furiin.
en: Sometimes marriages end in a divorce.

so: Mowduucaan arimaha la xiriira ka akhri bogga internetka InfoFinlandi ee Furiinka.
en: Read more about the subject on the InfoFinland web page Divorce.

so: Geerida xubin kamid ah qoyska
en: Death of a family member

so: Sidee wax loo qabanayaa iyo xagee caawinaad laga helayaa, markii uu geeriyoodo ruux ka mid ah qoysku?
en: What to do and where to get help when a family member dies?

so: Mawduucaan arimaha la xiriira ka akhri bogga internetka InfoFinlandi ee: Geerida.
en: Read more about the subject on the InfoFinland web page Death.

so: Isku mehrintu waxay u dhici kartaa
en: A marriage ceremony can take place

so: meher sifil ah oo ka dhaca xafiiska diiwaangelinta ama
en: as a civil marriage in a Local Register Office, or

so: Meherka guurku markuu dhacayo dadka is-guursanaya waa inay labaduuba goob joog ahaadaan isku mar.
en: Both the persons getting married must be present at the ceremony simultaneously.

so: Waxaa kaloo loo bahan yahay in ugu yaraan laba qof oo marqaati ah ay goobta joogaan.
en: There must also be at least two witnesses present.

so: Sharci ahaan meherka aan diinta ku salaysnayn waxaa samayn kara diiwaangeliye ka shaqeeya xafiiska diiwaangelinta (maistraatti) ama madaxa ka shaqeeya maxkamada rafcaanka (käräjäoikeus) ama garsoore maxkamadeed.
en: The law stipulates that a civil marriage can be performed by a registrar working at a Local Register Office (maistraatti) or a chief justice or local court judge working at a District Court (käräjäoikeus).

so: Meherka awgiis waqti hore ka sii qabso xafiiska diiwaangelinta ama maxkamada rafcaanka ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga arooska.
en: Book a time for the ceremony in good time before the wedding day at a Local Register Office or District Court.

so: Meherka aan diinta ku salaysnayn waa bilaash, haddii uu ka dhacayo gudaha xafiiska diiwaangelinta ama maxkamada waqtiga shaqada.
en: A civil marriage ceremony is free if it takes place during office hours in the premises of a Local Register Office or District Court.

so: Haddii la isku waafaqo meherka waxaa lagu qaban karaa meelo kale, tusaale ahaan guriga iyo goobaha xafladaha lagu qabto.
en: If agreed separately, the ceremony can also take place elsewhere, for example, at home or in a banqueting hall.

so: Markaas waxaa laga qaadayaa lacag gooni ah.
en: Then a separate charge is collected.

so: Qof walba waxay xaq u leedahay inay hesho meher aan diinta ku salaysnayn, xiraa kuwa ka tirsan diin kale.
en: Everyone is entitled to a civil marriage, including those who are members of a religion.

so: Bogga Internetka ee xafiiska diiwaangelinta waxaa wax looga sheegayaa macluumaadka asaasiga ah ee meherka aan diinta ku salaysnayn.
en: The website of the Local Register Office gives basic information about the ceremony.

so: Meherka kaniisada waxaa loo samayn karaa
en: A church wedding can take place

so: uru diimeed kale oo dalka Finland ka diiwaangashan
en: in some other religious community that is registered in Finland.

so: Koox diimeed kasta ayadaa qeexaysa shuruudaha la xiriira meherka iyo nooca ay noqonayso xaflada meherku.
en: Every religious community determines itself what stipulations are related to and what kind of an event the wedding ceremony is.

so: Haddii labada is mehersanaya aysan isku diin ahayn, meherka waxaa lagu samaynayaa xafiiska diiwaangelinta xaflada guurkana waxaa lagu duceyn karaa kaniisada.
en: If the spouses do not profess the same religion, the ceremony takes place at a Local Register Office and the marriage can be blessed in a church.

so: Kaniisada Luteeranka waxaa lagu mehrin karaa dadka haysata diinta kirishtanka, tusaale ahaan lutetianka iyo ortodoksiga.
en: Persons professing Christianity – for example, a Lutheran and an Orthodox – can be married in a Lutheran church.

so: Sidoo kale xafiiska diiwaangelinta waxaa lagu mehriyaa ajaanibta.
en: Local Register Offices also marry foreign citizens.

so: Dalka Finland baaritaanka caqabadaha guurka waxaa mar walba la sameeyaa intaan meherka la samayn.
en: In Finland, the examination of impediments is always performed before a marriage.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka helaysaa bogga internetka InfoFinlandi: Baritaanka caqabadaha guurka.
en: You can find more information on the InfoFinland web page Examination of the impediments to marriage.

so: Saamaynta ay ku leeyihiin guurka sharciga daganaanshada iyo jinsiyadu
en: The effect on residence permit and citizenship

so: Qofka Finishka ah ama ajnabiga ah ee Finland ku nool qofka la sameeya guur, xiriir wada noolaansho ama xiriir la diiwaangeliyey wuxuu heli karaa sharciga daganaanshada dalka Finland.
en: The wife or husband, or common-law wife or husband, or a registered partner of a Finnish citizen or a citizen of another country living in Finland may be granted a residence permit for Finland.

so: Daganaansho joogto ah waxaa lagu heli karaa, markii uu guurku gaaro shan sanadood.
en: They can get a permanent residence permit when the marriage has lasted five years.

so: Macaluumaadka la xiriira mawduucan waxaad ka helaysaa bogga internetka InfoFinlandi: Sharciga degenaanshaha Lamaanaha.
en: Read more about the subject on the InfoFinland web page Residence permit for a spouse.

so: Guur awgiis laguma qaadan karo dhalashada Finnishka.
en: Finnish citizenship cannot be gained through marriage.

so: Guurka dibada lagu soo sameeyey waxaa laga diiwaangeliyaa xafiiska diiwaangelinta
en: A marriage made abroad is registered at a Local Register Office

so: Guurka dibada lagu soo sameeyey wuxuu dalka Finland ka noqonaayaa guur rasmi ah, kadib markii Finland laga diiwaangeliyo.
en: A marriage entered into abroad is not official in Finland until it has been registered here.

so: Haddii guurka dibada lagu soo sameeyey, meherka waa in xafiiska diiwaangelinta la keeno, shahaado sharciyaysan lana turjumay si guurka loo diiwaangeliyo.
en: If the marriage has taken place abroad, a legalised and translated certificate of the marriage must be presented to a Local Register Office for registering.

so: Muwaadinka Finnishka ah ee ku nool dalka dibadiisa wuxuu soo diri karaa dukumintiyada meherka wuxuuna u dirayaa safaarada wadanka Finland oo ku taal wadanka uu degen yahay, safaaraduna waxay dukumintiyada u soo gudbineysaa xaafiiska diiwaangelinta ee dalka Finland.
en: A Finnish citizen living abroad can also send the marriage documents to the local Finnish Diplomatic Mission, which then supplies the documents to a Local Register Office in Finland.

so: Macluumaadka aasiga ah ee dadka Finland ku nool waxaa lagu daraa nidaamka diiwaangelinta dadweynaha.
en: Basic information about persons living in Finland is recorded in the Population Information System.

so: Macluumaadka la diiwaangelinayo waxaa ka mid ah magaca, waqtiga dhalashada, wadanka dhalashada, xiriirka qoyska iyo cinwaanka.
en: This information includes, for example, name, date of birth, citizenship, family relations and address.

so: Sida uu sharcigu qabo dadka ajaanibta ah waa inat diiwaangeliyaan macluumaad la mid ah kuwa ay muwaadiniinta Finnishku dhiibaan, haddii daganaanshadu ay ugu yaraan gaarto shan sano.
en: The law stipulates that a foreigner must present the same information for the register as Finnish citizens if their stay in Finland continues for at least a year.

so: Boggan waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad ku saabsan arrimaha ay tahay in aad qabato, haddii aad dooneyso in aad ku guursato Finland.
en: This page contains information on matters you must attend to if you wish to get married in Finland.

so: Guurka ka hor waa in la sameeyaa baaritaanka caqabadaha guurka (avioliiton esteiden tutkinta).
en: Before you can get married, an examination of impediments to marriage (avioliiton esteiden tutkinta) must be carried out.

so: Dadka xafiisyada haya ayaa waxay baaritaanka caqabadaha guurka ku ogaanayaan in ay jiraan sida uu sharciga Finland qabo waxyaabo guurka xannibaya.
en: In the examination of impediments, the authorities clarify whether there are impediments to the marriage according to Finnish law.

so: Baaritaanka waa in qoraal ahaan loo dalbadaa.
en: The examination must be requested in writing and in person.

so: Baaritaanku wuxuu qaataa qiyaas ahaan todobaad.
en: The examination takes approximately a week.

so: Baaritaanku marka uu diyaar noqdo waxaad ka helaysaa caddayn.
en: When it is ready, you will receive a certificate.

so: Caddayntu waxay shaqeynaysaa afar bilood.
en: It is valid for four months.

so: Caddaynta baaritaanka waa in la wataa marka lagu jiro madasha meherka.
en: The examination certificate has to be taken along to the marriage ceremony.

so: Xafiiska diiwaangelintu wuxuu marka uu baaritaanka caqabadaha guurka sameynayo ku saleynayaa macluumaadka lagu diiwaangeliyay nidaamka macluumaadka dadka ee Finlnad.
en: The Local Register Office examines any impediments to the marriage based on the information registered in the Finnish Population Information System.

so: Haddii macluumaadka xaaladdaada guurku uusan ku jirin nidaamka macluumaadka dadka ee Finland, waa in aad xafiiska diiwaangelinta u keentaa caddaynta xaaladda guurka (siviilisäätytodistus) , taas oo aad ka keenayso shaqaalaha dowladda ee dalkaada.
en: If there is no information about your marital status in the Finnish Population Information System, you must submit a marital status certificate (siviilisäätytodistus), provided by the authorities of your home country, to the Local Register Office.

so: Caddaynta waxaad sidoo kale ka soo qaadan kartaa safaraadda ama qunsuliyadda dalkaada ee Finland ku taal.
en: You can also obtain the certificate from the embassy or consulate of your home country in Finland.

so: Haddii aysan labada lammaane aheyn muwaadiniin Finnish ah islamarkaasna aysan deganeyn Finland, waa in caddaynta xaaladda guurka ka sokow ay xafiiska diiwaangelinta u keenaan sharraxaad ku saabsan in sharciga dalkoodu uu ogol yahay in ay isku guursadaan Finland.
en: If neither spouse is a Finnish citizen or lives in Finland, they must, in addition to the marital status certificates, submit to the Local Register Office a clarification on whether the legislation in their home country allows them to get married in Finland.

so: Ogsoonow in baaritaanka caqabaduhu uu qaadan karto todobaadyo badan, haddii caddaymo looga baahan yahay wadamo kale.
en: Please note that it may take several weeks to examine the impediments if certificates from other countries are required.

so: Sharciyeeynta iyo turjumidda caddaymaha
en: Legalisation and translation of certificates

so: Sida caadiga ah waa in caddaymaha wadamada shisheeye la sharciyeeyo loona turjumo luqadda Finnishka, Iswidhishka ama Ingiriiska.
en: Foreign certificates usually have to be legalised and translated into Finnish, Swedish or English.

so: Turjumaadda xittaa waa in la sharciyeeyaa.
en: The translation must also be legalised.

so: Haddii uu turjumaadda sameynayo turjubaan heysta ogolaanshaha Finland ama dowlad Midowga Yurub ka tirsan, looma baahna in turjumaadda la sharciyeeyo.
en: If the translation is done by a translator authorised by Finland or another EU state, the translation does not need to be legalised.

so: Caddaymaha uu bixiyay sarkaalka dowliga ah ee Waddamada Waqooyiga Yurub ama Midowga Yurub looma baahna in la sharciyeeyo.
en: Certificates provided by an authority of a Nordic or EU country do not need to be legalised.

so: Caddaynta ay bixiso safaarad ama qunsuliyad Finland ku taal xittaa uma baahna in la sharciyeeyo.
en: A certificate granted by an embassy or a consulate located in Finland does not need to be legalised, either.

so: Haddii uu bixiyay sarkaal ka tirsan wadan Midowga Yurub ah caddayn islamarkaasna lagu lifaaqay foomka EU 2016/1191, looma baahna in caddaynta la turjumo.
en: If the certificate has been granted by an authority of an EU country and is supplemented with the form EU 2016/1191, the certificate does not need to be translated.

so: Go'aan ka gaaridda magaca qoyska
en: Deciding on the family name

so: Finland marka ay lammaanayaashu is-guursanayaan waxay beddeli karaan magacooda qoyska.
en: In Finland, spouses can change their last name when they get married.

so: Marka aad guursaneyso waxaad
en: When you get married, you can

so: heysan kartaa magacaada qoyska ee aad hadda heysato
en: keep your current last name

so: qaadan kartaa magaca qoyska ee lammaanahaada ama
en: adopt your spouse's last name or

so: waxaad sameynsan kartaan magac qoys oo la isku daray.
en: combine your last names into a double last name.

so: Magaca qoyska ee la isku daray waxaa ka muuqanaya labada magac ee qoyska, tusaale ahaan Virttanen-Smith.
en: A double last name will show both of your last names, such as Virtanen-Smith.

so: Waxaa kale oo xittaa la kala qori karaa magacyada iyadoo aan la dhexgelinayn xariijinta dhexe.
en: The last names can also be written separately without a hyphen.

so: Laammanuhu waxay magacooda qoyska u codsan karaan magac gebi ahaanba cusub.
en: The spouses can also apply for a completely new name as their common last name.

so: Magaca qoyska ee cusub waa in xafiiska diiwaangelinta laga codsadaa.
en: The new last name must be applied for at the Local Register Office.

so: Magac qoys looma dooran karo magac uu labada lammaane midkood guur hore dartiis ku qaatay.
en: A last name which one of the spouses has gained in a previous marriage cannot be chosen.

so: Lammaanahaada la dooro magaca qoyska marka aad codsaneyso baaritaanka caqabadaha guurka.
en: Choose a last name with your spouse already before requesting an examination of the impediments to marriage.

so: Haddii aad dooneyo in aad beddesho magaca qoyskaada, ogeysii xafiiska diiwaangelinta.
en: If you wish to change your last name, notify the Local Register Office of the matter.

so: Foomka waxaa laga helaa xafiiska diiwaangelinta ama bogagga shabakadda xafiiska diiwaangelinta.
en: The form is available at Local Register Offices or the Local Register Office's website.

so: Haddii aadan ku wargelin in aad beddelayso magacaada qoyska, magaca qoyskaadu sidii hore ayuu sii ahaanayaa.
en: If you do not report that you wish to change your last name, your last name will stay as it is.

so: Heshiiska shuruudda guurku ma ahan wax qasab ah.
en: The marital contract is voluntary.

so: Heshiiska shruudda guurka waxaa qeyb ahaan ama gebi ahaan meesha looga saari karaa xaqa guurka ka dhasha ee uu lammaanaha kale u leeyahay hantida lammaanaha kale, marka ay is furaan ama uu labada lammaane midkood geeriyoodo ka dib.
en: With a marital contract, the marital right of each spouse to the other spouse's property can be excluded partly or entirely in case of divorce or the death of either spouse.

so: Heshiiska shuruudaha guurka waxaa la sameyn karaa guurka ka hor ama inta la isqabo.
en: A marital contract can be made before or during marriage.

so: Labad lammaane waa in ay saxiixaan heshiiska shuruudaha guurka labo markhaatina waa in ay caddeeyaan in saxiixyadu ay sax yihiin.
en: Both spouses must sign the marital contract, and two witnesses must verify that the signatures are correct.

so: Si heshiiska shuruudaha guurku uu dhaqangalo, waa in laga diiwaangeliyaa xafiiska diiwaangelinta.
en: The marital contract must be registered at the Local Register Office in order to enter into force.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan hantida lammaanayahaasha waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinland Xuquuqda iyo waajibaadyada lammaanayaasha is qaba.
en: More information on the spouses' property is available on the InfoFinland page Rights and obligations of spouses.

so: Meherka diinta ku saleysan wuxuu ka dhacaa kaniisadda ama jimciyad kale oo diini ah, taas oo xaq u leh sameynta meherka guurka.
en: Religious marriage ceremonies are performed in a church or other religious community that has the right to perform marriage ceremonies.

so: Madasha meherka waa qasab in ay labada lammaane joogaan.
en: Both spouses must be present at the marriage ceremony.

so: Waxaa kale oo qasab ah in ay goobta joogaan ugu yaraan labo markhaati oo da' ahaan 15 sano buuxiyay.
en: Furthermore, at least two witnesses who have reached 15 years of age must be present.

so: Meherka wakhti uga qabso xilli hore xafiiska diiwaangelinta ama maxkamadda ka hor inta aan la gaarin maalinta arooska.
en: Book a time for the ceremony at a Local Register Office or District Court well before the date of the marriage ceremony.

so: Meherka rayidku waa lacag la'aan, haddii wakhtiyada shaqada lagu sameynayo xarumaha xafiiska diiwaangelinta ama maxkamadda.
en: A civil marriage ceremony is free of charge if it takes place during office hours on the premises of a Local Register Office or District Court.

so: Meelo kale, tusaale ahaan guriga ama goobaha xafladaha ayaa lagu sameyn karaa meherka rayidka.
en: The ceremony can also be performed elsewhere, such as at home or in a banquet hall.

so: Markaas lacag ayaa laga qaadanayaa.
en: In this case, it is subject to a fee.

so: Jimciyad diimeed kasta iyadaa iskeed u go'aaminaysa shuruudaha meherka la xiriira iyo madasha meherku nooca ay tahay.
en: Every religious community determines for itself as to what stipulations are related to and what kind of an event the wedding ceremony is.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso meher diin ku saleysan, kala heshii jimciyad diimeedka laga hadlayo ee ka tirsan tahay.
en: If you wish to have a religious marriage ceremony, make the arrangements with the religious community in question.

so: Heshiiska shuruudaha guurka (avioehtosopimus) wuxuu saamayn ku yeelanayaa, sida loo qaybsano hantida marka ay is furaan labo is-qabay ama ay dhimasho timaado.
en: A marital contract (avioehtosopimus) affects the way the spouses' property is divided if the couple gets divorced or one of them dies.

so: Haddii lamaanuhu aysan sameyn heshiiska shuruudda guurka, hantida labadoodu ay leeyihiin waa la isku darayaa kadibna si siman loogu qeybinayaa.
en: If the spouses have not entered into a marital contract, the property of both of them is added together and divided equally between them.

so: Sida badan heshiiska shuruudaha guurku waxay qeexayaan, labada is-qabta midkoodna xaq uma lahan kan kale hantidiisa.
en: The most common marital contract establishes that neither partner is entitled to the other's property.

so: Waxaana loo baahan yahay inay aqbalaan labada qof oo is-qabta.
en: Both spouses' consent is required in making one.

so: Heshiiska shuruudaha guurka waxaa loo sameeyaa qoraal ahaan.
en: A marital contract is made in writing and it is dated and signed.

so: Heshiiska shuruudaha guurka waxaa loo diraa xafiiska diiwaangelinta si loo diiwaangeliyo.
en: Marital contracts are sent to a Local Register Office to be registered.

so: Samaynta heshiiska waxaa habboon in loo isticmaalo sharci yaqaan khabiir ah.
en: It is best to use an expert lawyer in making the contract.

so: Muwaadiniinta wadamada oo dhan waxay ku guursan karaan Finland.
en: Citizens of all countries may get married in Finland.

so: Waxaa guursan kara qof kasta oo:
en: Marriage can be entered into by anyone who:

so: jira ugu yaraan 18 sannadood
en: is at least 18 years old

so: aan horay ugu jirin guur ama xiriir lammaane oo diiwaangashan.
en: is not already married or in a registered partnership.

so: Lammaanaha isku jinsiga ah xittaa Finland way isku guursan karaan.
en: Marriages between two persons of the same sex are also allowed in Finland.

so: Sida uu qabo sharciga Finland, qaraabada isu dhow ma isguursan karaan.
en: According to Finnish law, close relatives are not allowed to get married.

so: Guurku mar walba waa doorasho aan qasab aheyn, qofna guur laguma cadaadin karo mana lagu qasbi karo.
en: Marriage is always a voluntary choice, and no one can be pressured or forced into it.

so: Tusaale ahaan waalidku carruurtooda kuma cadaadin karaan kumana qasbi karaan in ay guursadaan.
en: For example, parents are not allowed to pressure or force their child into marriage.

so: Qof kale oo guur lagu qasbay Finland waa ka dembi.
en: Forcing someone to marry is a crime in Finland.

so: Finland, dumarka iyo raggu iyaga ayaa go'aansan kara qofka ay isguursanayaan.
en: In Finland, women and men decide for themselves as to who they marry.

so: Looma baahna in tusaale ahaan qaraabada ogolaansho la weydiisto.
en: They are not required to ask for permission, for example, from relatives.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan ku guursashada Finland waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinland Liiska xasuusta, ee guurka dalka Finland.
en: More information on marriage in Finland is available on the InfoFinland page Getting married in Finland, a check list.

so: Guurka iyo sharciga degenaanshaha
en: Marriage and residence permit

so: Haddii lammaanahaadu uu joogto u deggan yahay Finland, waxaad heli kartaa sharciga degenaanshaha Finland oo guur ku saleysan.
en: If your spouse lives permanently in Finland, you may be eligible to receive a residence permit in Finland based on marriage.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee guurku ma sugayo sharciga degenaanshaha.
en: However, a marriage does not guarantee a residence permit.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinland Sharciga degenaanshaha Lammaanaha.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Residence permit for a spouse.

so: Guurka dibadda lagu soo galay
en: A marriage entered into abroad

so: Guurka dibadda lagu soo galay wuxuu Finland rasmi ka noqonayaa marka lagu diiwaangeliyo nidaamka macluumaadka dadka ee Finland.
en: A marriage entered into abroad is not official in Finland until it has been registered in the Finnish Population Information System.

so: Diiwaangelintu waxay kaaga baahan tahay in aad shahaadada nikaaxa ee asalka ah oo la sharciyeeyay aad geyso xafiiska diiwaangelinta (maistraatti) degmadaada.
en: For the registration, you have to submit your original and legalised certificate of marriage to the Local Register Office (maistraatti) of your municipality of residence.

so: Haddii shahaadadu aysan ku qorneyn luqada Finnishka, Ingiriiska ama Iswidhishka, waa in loo turjumaa luqadahan mid ka mid ah turjumaaddana waa in la sharciyeeyaa.
en: If the certificate is not in Finnish, English or Swedish, it must be translated into one of these languages and the translation must also be legalised.

so: Haddii turjumaadda uu sameeynayo turjubaan ogolaanshaha Finland heysta, looma baahna in turjumaadda la sharciyeeyo.
en: If the translation is done by a translator authorised in Finland, the translation does not need to be legalised.

so: Haddii uu caddayn bixiyay sarkaal ka tirsan wadan Midowga Yurub ah islamarkaasna lagu lifaaqay foomka EU 2016/1191, looma baahna in caddaynta la turjumo.
en: If the certificate has been provided by an authority of an EU country and is supplemented with the form EU 2016/1191, the certificate does not need to be translated.

so: Haddii Finland ay tahay meesha aad deggan tahay magaca qoyskaada waxaa go'aaminaya sharciga Finland.
en: If your place of residence is in Finland, your last name is determined according to Finnish law.

so: Sidan ayaa la sameynayaa haddii aadan xittaa aheyn muwaadin Finnish ah.
en: This is done even if you are not a Finnish citizen.

so: Marka aad guursaneysaan waa in aad go'aan ka gaartaan magaca qoyskiina.
en: When you get married, you and your spouse must decide your last name.

so: qaadan kartaa magac qoys oo wadajir ah ama
en: adopt a common last name, or

so: waxaad heysan kartaan magaciina qoyska ama
en: keep your own last names, or

so: Magac gebi ahaanba cusub ayaad u dooran kartaa magaca qoyska ee idinka dhexeeya.
en: You can also choose a completely new last name as your common last name.

so: Codsiga beddelista magaca ka codsada xafiiska diiwaangelinta dadka magaca qoyska ee cusub.
en: Apply for a new last name from the Local Registry Office with a change of name application.

so: Magac qoys looma dooran magac ay lammaanahaada ku heshay guurkeedi jore.
en: A family name which one of the spouses has gained in a previous marriage cannot be chosen.

so: Doorta magaciina qoyska marka aad codsaneysaan baaritaanka xannibka guurka.
en: Choose a last name before requesting the examination of the impediments to marriage.

so: Ku wargeliya arrinta xafiiska diiwaangelinta dadka.
en: Inform the Local Registry Office about it.

so: Foomka waxaa laga helaa xafiiska diiwaangelinta dadka ama bogagga shabakadda ee xafiiska diiwaangelinta dadka.
en: This form is available at Local Register Offices or the Local Register Office's website.

so: Beddelista magaca qoyska inta lagu jiro muddada guurka
en: Changing family name during the marriage

so: Haddii aad leedahay magac qoys oo isku xiran, tusaale ahaan Virtanen-Smith waxaad inta lagu jiro wakhtiga guurka ka noqon kartaa labada magac midkood.
en: If you have a double last name, such as Virtanen-Smith, you can relinquish either of these names during your marriage.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale qaadan kartaa magaca qoyska ee isku xiran inta lagu jiro wakhtiga guurka.
en: You can also adopt a double last name during your marriage.

so: Codsi qoraal ah oo arrintan ku saabsan u dir xafiiska diiwaangelinta dadka.
en: Submit a written application to the Local Registry Office.

so: Macluumaadka loo gudbinayo hay'adaha dowladdaada (muwaadin ajnabi ah)
en: Informing the authorities of your own country (foreign citizen)

so: Haddii uu magaca qoyskaadu isbeddelo waa in aad wakiilka dalkaada ogeysiisaa, si aad magacaada cusub ugu qaado baasaboor hay'adaha dowladduna ay u heystaan macluumaad isku mid ah.
en: If your surname changes, you must also inform your own country's Diplomatic Mission about it so that you can get a passport with your new name and the authorities in both countries have the same information.

so: Weydii macluumaad dheeraad ah wakiilka dalkaada.
en: Ask for more information at a Diplomatic Mission of your own country.

so: Macluumaadyada xiriirka ee safaaradaha waxaa laga helaa bogagga shabakadda ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibedda.
en: The contact information for Diplomatic Missions can be found on the website of the Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Finland.

so: Warar dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan magaca qoyska ee cunugga, ka eeg bogga Finland markii uu ilmuhu dhaso.
en: Read more about the child's last name on the page When a child is born in Finland.

so: Warar dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan magaca qoyska marka xaalad furiin lagu jiro, ka eeg bogga Furiinka.
en: Read more about the last name in case of divorce on the page Divorce.

so: Qoysaska halka waalid leh waa wax ku badan Finland.
en: Single parent families are common in Finland.

so: Cunuggu wuxuu ku dhalan karaa guur la'aan ama waalidka ayaa isfuray.
en: A child may be born out of wedlock or the child's parents have divorced.

so: Qoyska halka waalid leh, mid ka mid ah waalidiinta ayaa caruurta la degen lamaane la'aan.
en: In this case, the parent may be a single parent or joint custody parent.

so: Markaas waalidku wuxuu noqon karaa mas'uulka cunugga ee kaliga ah ama wadajirka ah.
en: A single parent bears the sole responsibility for their child's upbringing.

so: Kuwa ilmaha wada jirka masuulka uga ah (yhteishuoltaja) waxay markale si wada jir ah labada waalid uga heshiinayaan arrimaha la xiriira caruurta.
en: A joint custody parent agrees upon their child's affairs with the other parent.

so: Arimahaas waxaa ka mid ah caruurtamagacooda
en: In joint custody, parents decide on many things together, including the child's

so: Mas'uul ka wada ahaanshada caruurta waxaa shardi u ah inay waalidiintu si wada jir ah uga wada shaqayn karaan danaha caruurta sida ugu wanaag badan caruurta.
en: Joint custody requires that the parents are able to work together for the best interests of their child.

so: Tusaale ahaan dalabka baasaboorka waa in loo helo ogolaanshada labada waalid.
en: For example, a passport application must have both parents' consent.

so: Waalidka Kaligisa ah ayaa go'aan ka gaaraya arrimaha khuseeya caruurta.
en: A single parent makes all the decisions concerning the child themselves.

so: Masuuliyiinta dawlada, sida xanaanada caruurta, iskuulka waxay macluumaadka caruurta siinayaan kaligi daryeelaha caruurta oo kaliya.
en: Authorities, such as the day-care centre and school, only give information about the child to the guardian.

so: Si kastoo ay ahaataba waalidka kale ayaa go'aan ka gaaraya daryeelka iyo barbaarinta cunugga marka uu cunuggu isaga la deggan yahay.
en: The other parent can, however, make decisions regarding the care and upbringing of the child when the child is staying with him or her.

so: Guurka iyo wada daganaanshdaba waalidiintu waa inay go'aan ka gaaran cidda ilmaha mas'uul ka noqonaysa, lacagta kaalmada nolosha caruurta, degaanka iyo xaq u yeelashada la kulanka caruurta.
en: When parents get a divorce, whether they are married or in a common-law relationship, they must decide on their children's guardianship, maintenance, accommodation and visiting rights.

so: Wixii warar dheeraad ah ka akhriso bogga internetka InfoFinlandi Caruurta waalidiintoodu is-fureen.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Children in a divorce.

so: Caruurta waxaa la soo adabtigarayn karaa kali.
en: A child can also be adopted alone. Adoption is enacted in the Adoption Act.

so: Ururka qoysaska halka waalidka leh (Yhden Vanhemman Perheiden Liitto) wuxuu bixiyaa macluumaad isla markaasna wuxuu hawlo u qaban-qaabiyaa qoysaska halka waalid leh.
en: The Association of Single Parent Families (Yhden Vanhemman Perheiden Liitto) offers information and organises activities for single parent families.

so: Bogga Internetka ee Finlex ayaad ka akhrin kartaa sharciyada la xiriira daryeelka iyo xuquuqda la kulanka caruurta.
en: You can find out about the Child Custody and Right of Access Act on the Finlex website.

so: Ururka qoysaska yar yar waa urur qaran oo ay aasaaseen waalidiinta kaliggod caruurta haysta, kaas oo waxqabad u abaabula qoysaska xubnaha ka ah.
en: The Single Parents' Association is a civic organisation founded by single parents which offers activities for its member families.

so: Marka ay waalidku isfuraan waa inay ka heshiiyaan masruufka cunugga iyo kaalmada masruufka (elatusapu) ee suurtagalka ah.
en: When parents separate, they have to reach an agreement concerning the maintenance of their children and possible child maintenance support (elatusapu).

so: Tirada kaalmada masruufka waxaa loo xisaabayaa si waafaqasan baahida masruuf cunugga iyo awoodda masruuf bixin ee waalidka.
en: The amount of child maintenance support is calculated on the basis on the child's maintenance needs and the parents' maintenance capacity.

so: Baahida masruufka cunugga waxaa loola jeedaa tiro laca ah oo ku baxeysa nolosha cunugga bil kasta.
en: The child's maintenance needs refer to the sum of money that is needed to support the child on a monthly basis.

so: Waxaa ku jira tusaale ahaan kharashka ku baxa cuntada, dharka iyo kharashka ku baxda xannaano-maalmeedka ee suurtagalka ah.
en: It includes, for example, food and clothing costs and possible day care fees.

so: Masruufka uu cunuggu u baahanyahay waxaa waalidka loogu qeybiyaa hab waafaqsan awoodooda.
en: The child's maintenance needs are divided between the parents in accordance with their maintenance capacity.

so: Awoodista bixinta masruufka waxaa loo xisaabayaa iyadoo laga jarayo dakhliga marka hore canshuuraha, iyo kharashaadka kale ee qasabka ah.
en: Maintenance capacity is calculated by subtracting taxes and other obligatory costs from the parent's income.

so: Waxaad caawimaad dhinaca xisaabinta masruufka ah weydiisan kartaa ilaaliyaha danaha carruurta (lastenvalvoja) ee degmadaada.
en: You can ask your municipality's child welfare supervisor (lastenvalvoja) to help you calculate the amount of child maintenance support.

so: Kaalmada masruufka waxaa haboon in laga sameeyo heshiis qoraal ah, kaas oo ay gudoonka soohaalku xaqiijiyaan.
en: It is advisable to make a written agreement on child maintenance support and have the Social Welfare Board confirm this agreement.

so: Heshiiska sidan oo kale loo xaqiijiyay wuxuu rasmi ahaan lamid yahay go'aan maxkamadeed.
en: An agreement confirmed by the Social Welfare Board is just as official as a court decision.

so: Ka codso xaqiijinta ilaaliyaha danaha carruurta ee degmadaada.
en: Ask a child welfare supervisor of your municipality to provide you with the Social Welfare Board confirmation.

so: Haddii aysan waalidku ka heshiin kaalmada masruufka, waxay caawimaad ka heli karaan heshiisiinta arrimaha qoyska.
en: If parents cannot reach an agreement concerning child maintenance support, they can ask family mediation to help.

so: Marka ugu dambeysa waxaa arrinta xal looga gaarayaa maxkamadda.
en: Ultimately, the matter will be solved in a district court.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan heshiisiinta arrimaha qoyska waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Furiin.
en: More information on family mediation is available on the InfoFinland web page Divorce.

so: Xaaladaha qaarkood marka lagu jiro waalidka cunuggu la deggan wuxuu Kelada ka codsan karaa kaalmada masruufka (elatustuki).
en: In some situations, the parent who is living with the child can apply for child maintenance allowance (elatustuki) from Kela.

so: Kelada waxaa laga codsan karaa kaalmada lacagta nolosha caruurta, hadii
en: You can apply for child maintenance allowance from Kela if:

so: Hadddii waalidku uusan bixin lacagtii uu ogolaaday (Kelada ayaa dib uga jaranaysa).
en: a parent liable for maintenance has not paid the established child support (Kela will recover it from the person afterwards).

so: Haddii kaalmada nolosha caruurta loo ogolaaday wax yar, taasna ay sabab u tahay dhaqaalo xumida waalidka ay ku waajibtay bixinta lacagta kaalmada nolosha caruurtu.
en: child support has been established as smaller than child maintenance allowance due to the financial situation of a parent who is liable for the child's maintenance.

so: Kaalmada lacagta nolosha caruurta marna lama xukumin, xaalad dhaqaale xumo oo haysata waalidka ay ku waajibtay bixinteeda awgeed.
en: child support has not been established as payable at all due to the financial situation of the parent liable for maintenance.

so: Aad haysato ilmo aad korsanayso aadana lahayn wax lammaane ah.
en: you have adopted a child without a partner.

so: Aan la xaqiijin aabaha ilmaha meher la'aanta ku dhashay.
en: the paternity of a child born out of wedlock has not been confirmed.

so: Waad heli kartaa kaalmada masruufka haddii aad Finland ugu soo guurtay si rasmi ah si aad u deganaato.
en: You may also receive child maintenance allowance, if you have moved to Finland permanently.

so: Sidoo kale waad heli kartaa kaalmada masruufka haddii aad Finland shaqaale ahaan uga timid wadan kale oo Midowga Yurub ama wadan ETA ah iyo weliba Switzerland.
en: You may also receive child maintenance allowance if you have come to Finland to work from another EU or EEA member state or Switzerland.

so: Sidoo kale waa in cunugga lagu codsanayo kaalmada masruufka ahaadaa mid deggan Finland.
en: The child for whom child maintenance allowance is applied for must also reside in Finland.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad oo ku saabsan kaalmada masruufka waxaad ka helaysaa Kelada.
en: You can ask Kela for more information on child maintenance allowance.

so: Guurka ka hor waa inaad qoraal ahaan ku codsataan baritaanka caqabadaha guurka (esteiden tutkiminen).
en: Before getting married, you must request in writing an examination of the possible impediments to your marriage (esteiden tutkiminen).

so: Codsiga qoraalka ah waxaa loo gudbin karaa xafiis kasta oo sameeyo diiwaangelinta dadweynaha.
en: The written request can be made to any Local Register Office.

so: Baritaanka caqanaduhu waa bilaash.
en: The examination is free.

so: Haddii uu idinka mid ka mid ah haysto diinta kiristanka ee evanjelis-luteran ama uu yahay xubin ka mid ah kaniisada ortodokiska, waa inaad baaritaanka caqabadaha sidoo kale ka samayso kaniisadaada.
en: If one of you is a member of an Evangelical Lutheran or Orthodox Church, you can ask for an examination of impediments also from your own parish.

so: Baaritaanka caqabaduhu waa qasab, baaritaan la'aan meher lama samayn karo.
en: The examination is compulsory and without it the marriage cannot take place.

so: Baaritaanka caqabadaha waxaa tusaale ahaan ku cadaanaya, haddii labada qof mid ka mid ah uu qof kale wali ku mehersan yahay.
en: The examination reveals, for example, if someone is already married to someone else.

so: Dalka Finland baaritaanka caqabaduhu wuxuu qaataa qilaastii hal usbuuc.
en: In Finland, this examination takes approximately a week.

so: Haddii aan afarta bilood gudahooda meherka lagu samayn, waa in mar labaad la sameeyo codsiga baaritaanka caqabadaha.
en: If the marriage does not take place in that time, the examination has to be repeated.

so: Ku imaanshada Finland xaas ahaan
en: Coming to Finland as a spouse

so: Caqabadaha guurka waxaa loo baaraa si waafaqsan sharciga Finnishka, haddii aad tahay muwaadin Finnish ah ama aad dalka Finland si rasmi ah u degen tahay macluumaadkaagana laga heli karo xafiiska diiwaangelinta.
en: The impediments to marriage are investigated according to Finnish law, if you are a Finnish citizen or live permanently in Finland and your data is recorded in the population register.

so: Haddii lamaanaha ajnabiga ah aan macluumaadkiisa laga hubsan karin nidaamka macluumaadka dadka, waa in uu rajistareeshinka uga keenaa cadeyn baaritaanka xannibka guurka dartiis saraakiisha dalkiisa.
en: If a foreign person's information cannot be verified from the population register, he or she must provide the local register office with documentation from the officials of his or her native country for the examination of impediments to marriage.

so: Tana waxaa haboon waqti la siiyo, sababtoo hab-socodka wadamadu way kala duwan yihiin.
en: This may take some time because different countries have different conventions.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad oo ku saabsan cadeymaha la isaga baahanyahay waad weydiin kartaa rajistareeshinka.
en: You can ask for more information on the necessary documentation from your local register office.

so: Sidoo kale xaaska ajnabiga ah wuxuu u baahan yahay warqadaha aqoonsiga, shahaado ah xagga guurka ah (doob, wax furay/la furay, laga dhintay) iyo Shahaadada A-post. Shahaadada
en: In addition, a foreign partner will require an identity card, a certificate of marital status (unmarried, divorced, widow/widower) and an apostille certificate for the aforementioned documents.

so: A-postigu waxay cadaynaysaa in dukumintiga uu bixiyey shaqaale xafiis dowladeed ay tahay mid uu bixiyey qof awood sharciyadeed u leh inuu bixiyo shahaadadaas.
en: The apostille certificate proves that the document provided by an authority has been granted by an authorised person.

so: Labada wadanba oo sixiixay heshiiska dawladaha ee Haag waxay leeyihiin qof awood u leh inuu bixiyo Shahaadada A-post.
en: A list of the Convention countries can be found in English on the website of Hague Conference on Private International Law.

so: Xasuuso in wadanka shahaadada soo saaraya uu dukumintiga saaro shaabada rasmiga ah oo xaqiijinaysa, taas oo ay tahay in la weydiisto wasaarada arrimaha dibada ee dalka shahaadada soo saaray, intaas waxaa dheer cadaynta safaarada Finland ee wadanka shahaadada soo saaray.
en: This stamp has to be requested from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the country in question and, in addition, a Finnish Diplomatic Mission in the country.

so: Dalka Finland qoys waxaa noqonaya
en: A family in Finland is formed by

so: labo wada daganaan ku wada nool
en: common-law husband and wife

so: Ilmo aan guursan oo ka yar 18 sano ama caruur iyo qofka mas'uul ka ah oo degen Finland ama labada qof oo mas'uul ka ah
en: under 18-year-old unmarried child or children and their guardian or guardians living in Finland

so: Dalka Finland macnaha qoysku wuu kooban yahay marka loo eego wadamada kale.
en: The Finnish concept of a family is narrower than that of many other countries.

so: Finland qoys waxaa loo arkaa sida badan waalidka iyo caruurta.
en: In Finland, a family is most often considered to consist of the nuclear family, i.e. the parents and children.

so: Tusaale ahaan haddii ayeeyada, awoowaha iyo waalidiinta caruurtu ay hal guri wada dagan yihiin, sida rasmiga ah waxaa qoyska uga mid ah waalidiinta iyo caruurta oo kaliya.
en: For example, if grandparents, parents and children live together in the same home, officially only the parents and children form a family.

so: Ayeeyada iyo awoowuhu si gooni ah ayey qoys u noqonayaan.
en: The grandparents are a separate family of their own.

so: Qoysku wuxuu lahaan karaa carruur, ama lammaane aan carrur lahayn ayaa noqon kara qoys.
en: A family may include children or a childless couple can form a family.

so: Dadka waaweyn ee qoysku waxay noqon karaan kuwo kala jinsi ah ama isku jinsi ah.
en: The adults of a family can be of the opposite or same sex.

so: Qoys waxaa sidoo kale noqonaya hooyada ama aabaha oo kali ah iyo mas'uulka ka ah cunugeeda/cunugiisa.
en: A family can also consist of a single mother or father and his or her children.

so: Qoys cusub waa lamaane ay la deggan yihiin hal cunug ama wax ka badan oo lamaanaha guurkiisi/guurkeedi hore ka dhashay.
en: A stepfamily refers to a couple that has a child or several children from the couple's previous relationships living with them.

so: Waxaa intaas dheer in qoyska cusub ay ku jiri karaan carruur ay lamaanuhu isu dhaleen.
en: The couple may also have children together.

so: Haddii lagu furay, adigoo aan fasax ka qaadan lamaanahaadi hore ayaad guur cusub geli kartaa.
en: If you are divorced, you can remarry without the permission of your previous spouse.

so: Sida uu sharciga Finland qabo, laamanahaadi hore ugama baahnid fasax aad guur cusub ku gasho, haddii xittaa ay carruur idinka ka dhexeyso adiga iyo lamaanahaadi hore.
en: According to Finnish law, you do not need permission from your previous spouse to remarry even if you have had children together.

so: Qoysaska qaanso-roobeedku waa qoysaska waalidiinta qaniiska, qaniisadda iyo labeebka iyo carruurtooda.
en: Rainbow families are families of gay, lesbian, bisexual or transsexual parents and their children.

so: Kuwaan waa tusaale ahaan qoysaska lamaanaha ragga ah iyo lamaanaha dumarka ah iyo weliba qoysaska leh wax labo waalid ka badan.
en: They include, for example, families with same-sex parents and families that have more than two parents.

so: Haddii lamaane isku jinsi ah ay isqabaan waxey xaq u leeyihiin in ay korsadaan cunug ama in ay sameeyaan korsasho qoyska dhexdiisa ah.
en: If spouses of the same sex are married, they have the right to adopt a child or carry out an adoption inside the family.

so: Korsashada qoyska dhexdiisa ah waxaa loola jeedaa in lamaanahu uu korsanayo cunugga lamaanaha kale islamarkaasna uu noqonayo waalidka labaad ee cunugga oo rasmi ah.
en: Adoption inside the family means that a spouse adopts the child of his or her spouse and officially becomes the second parent of that child.

so: Dalka Finland cunuggu wuxuu lahaan karaa oo kaliya ugu badnaan labo waalid oo sharci ah.
en: In Finland, a child can have no more than two legal guardians.

so: Haddii aad qorsheyneyso korsasho qoyska dhexdiisa ah, la xiriir xafiiska sooshaalka ee degmadaada.
en: If you are planning an adoption inside your family, contact the social services office of your municipality.

so: Ururka qoysaska qaanso-roobeedku waa urur kaalmeeya, la taliya islamarkaasna waxqabadyo u qabanqaabiya qoysaska qaanso-roobeedka ah.
en: The Rainbow Families Association is an association that supports and advises rainbow families and organises activities for them.

so: Macluumaadyada xiriirka waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga shabakadda ururka.
en: Contact information can be found on the website of the association.

so: Sida uu qabo sharciga Finnishku waalidiinta waxaa waajib ku ah inay dhaqaale ahaan ka maareeyaan nolosha caruurtooda aan qaangaarin iyo labada is-qabta midba, midka kale.
en: According to Finnish law, parents are obliged to take financial care of their underage children and spouses of each other.

so: Waajibaadka ka taxadarida nolosha xubnaha qoyska kuma jiraan qaraabada kale, tusaale ahaan walaalaha qaan gaarka ah ama ayeeyada iyo awoowaha.
en: Maintenance liability for family members does not extend to other relatives, such as grown-up siblings or grandparents.

so: Dalaka Finland looma haysto in dadka caadiga ah inay dhaqaale ahaan maareeyaan nolosha qaraabadooda dhaqaale ahaan liita.
en: In Finland, private people are not expected to look after their relatives who are in a poorer financial situation than they are.

so: Cawinaadu waxay ka imaanaysaa bulshada sida xagga lacagaha badbaada bulshada.
en: The necessary support is given by the society in the form of social security.

so: Dadka si rasmi ah hal guri u wada degen waxay ka mid yihiin dadka dheriwadaaga ah.
en: People living permanently in the same dwelling together belong in the same household.

so: Si aad u hesho macluumaad dheeraad ah ee la xiriira mawduuca dheriwadaaga tag bogga internetka InfoFinlandi: Deganaanshada.
en: To find out more about households, go to the InfoFinland web page Accommodation.

so: Labada qof waxay kala dooran karaan inay ku wada noolaanayaan si wada noolaan ah ama guur ah.
en: A couple can choose whether they want to live together in a common-law relationship or in a marriage.

so: Waxaa haboon in la ogaado, qaabka ay labada qof u wada nool yihiin inuu saamayn ku yeelanayo xuquuqda iyo waajibaadka labada wada degen, hantida iyo dhaxalka, daryeelka caruurta, bixinta lacagta korinta caruurta iyo waliba korsashada caruurta aanay iyagu dhalin.
en: It is worth noting that the form of a relationship has an influence on the spouses' rights and obligations, property and inheritance issues, as well as the custody, maintenance and adoption of a child.

so: La talin xagga arimaha qoyska ah
en: Advice in family matters

so: Ururka guud dadweynahu wuxuu bixiyaa cawinaad wada sheekaysi ah oo ah xagga telefoonka iyo e-mailka haddii aad doonaysid inaad kala sheekaysato su'aalo la xiriira xaga arrimaha barbaarinta caruurta ama xiriirka qoyska.
en: The Family Federation offers phone and e-mail counselling when you need to discuss issues related to bringing up children or family relationships.

en: The phone services are available in the following languages:

en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Bringing up children in Finland.

so: Wixii warar dheeraad ah ka akhriso bogga internetka InfoFinlandi: Dhibaatooyinka qoyska.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Family problems.

so: Boggan waxaad ka heleysaa macluuaadyada ay tahay inaad sameysaa haddii aad dooneyso in ku guursato Finland.
en: This web page contains information on matters you must attend to if you wish to get married in Finland.

so: Kahor inta aan guurka la gelin waa in la sameeyaa baaritaanka xannibka guurka.
en: Before you can get married, an examination of impediments to marriage must be carried out.

so: Waxaa baaritaanka sameeya rajistareeshinka ama kaniisadda nikaaxinta sameynaysa.
en: The examination is done by either the local registry office or the local parish performing your marriage ceremony.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad oo ku saabsan baaritaanka ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Baaritaanka xannibka guurka.
en: Read more about the examination of impediments on the InfoFinland web page Examination of impediments to marriage.

so: Marka aad guursato waxaad lamaanaha la qaadan kartaa magac qoys oo wadajir ah.
en: When you get married, you and your spouse can share a family name.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale heysan kartaa magacaada qoyska ama waxaad qaadan karaa magaca isku xiran.
en: You can also keep your own family name or take a double-barrelled family name.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Go'aansashada magaca qoyska.
en: More information is available on the InfoFinland web page Deciding on the family name.

en: In Finland, you can get married

so: Kaalmada naafada ee dadka 16 sano jirka ka yar
en: Disability benefit for under 16-year-olds

so: Cunugga 16 sano ka yar wuxuu heli karaa kaalmada naafada, haddii uu naafadiisa ama jiradiisa darteed u baahanyahay daryeel, xannaano iyo baxnaanin joogto ah ugu yaraan muddo lix bilood.
en: A person who is younger than 16 can receive disability benefit (vammaistuki) if his/her disability or illness causes a need for regular care and rehabilitation for at least six months.

so: Kaalmada dadka 16 sano ka yar waxaa laga codsan karaa Kelada.
en: You can apply for disability benefit for a person younger than 16 from Kela.

so: Kaalmada waxaa inta badan la bixiyaa muddo cayiman.
en: The benefit is usually granted for a certain time period.

so: Marka uu dhamaado, sii wadista kaalmada waa la codsan karaa.
en: After the period has ended, you can apply for an extension.

so: Kelada waxaad ka heli kartaa lacagta daryeelka gaarka ah, haddii
en: You are eligible to receive special care allowance (erityishoitoraha) from Kela if

so: cunuggaada 16 sano ka yar uu isbitaal ku jiro ama
en: your child under 16 is in hospital care or

so: aad cunuggaada guriga ku daryeesho, guri ku daryeelistuna ay la xiriirta isbitaal ku daryeelista cunuggaada ama
en: you take care of your child at home and this home care is related to your child's hospital care or

so: kaalmadaada suuqa shaqadu ay si ku meelgaar ah u go'ayso, maadaama aadan ka qeybqaadan karin waxbqabadyada laqabsashada xannaaneynta cunuggaada darteed ama
en: your labour market subsidy has been temporarily suspended because you cannot participate in integration activities due to taking care of your child or

so: cunuggaadu uu tijaabinayo ku laabashada xannaano-maalmeedka ama dugsiga
en: your child restarts school or day care.

en: Rehabilitation for a child

so: Ilmaha leh laxaad la'ida adag waxa uu heli karaa daaweynta dib u soo celinta ee adag (vaativa lääkinnällinen kuntoutus).
en: A child with a severe disability may be eligible for medical rehabilitation for persons with severe disabilities (vaativa lääkinnällinen kuntoutus).

so: Kelada ayaa qabanqaabinaysa dib uu see celinta bixinaysana kharashkeeda.
en: Kela organises the rehabilitation and reimburses its costs.

so: Dib u soo celinta waxa ku jira waxqabadyo badan oo kala duwan.
en: Rehabilitation may include many kinds of activities.

so: Waxay noqon kartaa fisioterabi ama koorsooyin badan oo kala duwan oo lagu baranayo qaabka loola noolaan karo laxaad la'ida.
en: It can contain, for example, physiotherapy or various courses, which teach the child to live with their disability.

so: Sidoo kale Keladu dib u soo celinta waxay u qabanqaabin kartaa qaab ah dib u soo celin fiiro gaar ah (harkinnanvarainen kuntoutus).
en: Kela may also arrange rehabilitation in the form of discretionary rehabilitation (harkinnanvarainen kuntoutus).

so: Ujeedada baxnaaninta ka fiirsashada ku saleysan waa wanaajinta awoodda shaqo ama waxqbad.
en: The aim of discretionary rehabilitation is to improve working or functional capability.

so: Haddii ilmuhu uu heli waayo daaweynta dib u soo celinta ee adag waxa ay mas'uuliyadu ka saarantahay dib u soo celintiisa degmada.
en: If your child is not entitled to Kela's rehabilitation services for persons with severe disabilities, your municipality of residence is responsible for providing rehabilitation services for your child.

so: Waxbarasha iskuulka ee ilmaha laxaadka la'
en: A disabled child at school

so: Ilmaha laxaadka la' waxa uu xaq u leeyahay in uu tago iskuul ama iskuulka xaafadiisa.
en: A disabled child has the right to go to school in his or her local school.

so: Ilmaha laxaadka la' waxa uu heli karaa waxbarid xaaladiisa u khaas ah haadii laxaad la'idiisu ay ku adkaynayso fahamka waxbarashada.
en: A disabled child may be given special teaching if his or her disability makes learning difficult.

so: Sidoo kale ilmuhu waxa uu heli karaa caawiye iskuul (koulunkäyntiavustaja), haddii loo baahanyahay.
en: A child can also have a school assistant (koulunkäyntiavustaja) if necessary.

so: Keladu waxay bixin kartaa kharashka qalabka caawinta ah (apuvälineet) ee qaaliga ah ilmaha laxaadka la'na uu ugu baahanyahay waxbarashadiisa.
en: Kela can pay for expensive and demanding equipment (apuvälineet) that a disabled child needs for school.

so: Kuwaas waxa noqonaya kombiyuutarada iyo qalabka dheeraadka ah.
en: These can include, for example, computers and their accessories.

so: Qalabka caawinta waxa la heli karaa, haddii uunan ilmuhu waxbaran karin la'aantood ama waxbarashadu ay aad ugu adagtahay.
en: Such equipment can be given if a child cannot study without them or finds it very difficult.

so: Qalabka caawinta waxa la heli karaa ugu horrayn marka uu ilmuhu ku jiro dugsiga dhexe fasalkiisa todobaad ugu horrayn.
en: A child can have such aids at the earliest when he or she is in the seventh grade of comprehensive school.

so: Wakhtiga firaaqqada ah ee ilmaha laxaadka la'
en: Leisure activities for a disabled child

so: Waxad heli kartaa macluumaad ku saabsan fursadaha kala duwan ee waxqabadka waxkhtiga firaaqada ah ee dagmadaada qaybaheeda thaqaafada iyo jimicsiga.
en: You can find information on different hobbies in your neighbourhood, for example, at the Sports and Culture Department of your municipality.

so: Sidoo kale ururada laxaad la'aanta ayaa diyaaraya waxqabadyo kala duwan oo wakhtiga firaaqada ah.
en: Disability organisations also organise many hobbies and activities.

so: Tusaale ahaan Suomen vammaisurheilu ja -liikunta VAU ry waxay qabanqaabiyaan waxqabadyo kala duwan oo jimisiga iyo sbortiska ku saabsan.
en: The Finnish Sports Association for Persons with Disabilities (VAU), for example, organises different sports and exercise events.

so: Sida uu sharciga Finnishku qabo guurku (avioliitto) waa xiriir la sharciyeey oo dhexmara laba qof.
en: According to Finnish law, marriage (avioliitto) is a statutory relationship between two people.

so: Waa wax caam ah in lamaanuhu ay wada deganaansho ku noolaadaan guurka kahor.
en: It is common for couples to live together in a common-law relationship before they get married.

so: Inta aaney is guursan labada waxay ku balami karaan guur.
en: Before marrying, a couple may get engaged.

so: Taas macnaheedu waa inay ku balamaan inay is guursadaan.
en: This signifies a promise of marriage.

so: Balanta guurku waa mutadawacnimo, oo sharcigu ma dalbanayo sidaas.
en: Engagement is voluntary and not required by law.

so: Balanta guurku waxay ahaan kartaa mid sir ah ama waxaa loo sheegi karaa dadka kale.
en: Engagement can be kept as private information or it can be announced to others.

so: Finland waxaa ku guursan kara qof kasta oo
en: In Finland, marriage can be entered into by anyone

so: oo buuxisey 18 sano
en: who is 18 years old or more and

so: aan xaas aheyn, ama aan ahayn qof laga mas'uul yahay.
en: who is not married or under guardianship.

so: Qofka laga mas'uul yahay, ma awoodo inuu asagu arrimihiisa xalisto.
en: A person who is under guardianship is unable to take care of their own affairs.

so: Arrimihiisa waxaa xaliya qof kale oo asaga danahiisa ilaaliya.
en: A trustee takes care of their business.

so: Taarikhdaas wixii ka horeeyey waxaa keliya oo la sameyn karay xiriir lammaane oo la diiwaangeliyey.
en: Only registered partnerships were possible before this date.

so: Xiriir lammaane la diiwaangeliyey oo cusub mar dambe Finland lagama sameyn karo, laakiin kuwii hore sidoodii ayey ahaanayaan oo u shaqaynayaan.
en: New registered partnerhips can no longer be established in Finland, but the old ones remain in force.

so: Xiriirka lammaanaha la diiwaangeliyey waxaa guur loogu bedeli karaa xafiiska maistraatiga.
en: A registered partnership can be changed to a marriage at a Local Regsiter Office.

so: Guurka waxaa laga mamnuucay qaraabadaan soo socota dhexdooda:
en: Marriage is prohibited between the following near relatives:

so: ilmaha la korsaday iyo waalidka korsaday iyo weliba
en: adopted children and adoption parents, and

so: Labada xaaladood oo ugu dambeysa waxaa laga yaabaa in lagu fasaxo ruqso gaar ah oo laga helo wasaarada cadaalada.
en: In the two latter cases, a special permission may be granted by the Ministry of Justice.

so: Guurku waa arin markakasta ikhtiyaari ah, kaasoo aan qofna lagu qasbi karin.
en: Marriage is always a voluntary choice and nobody can be forced into it.

so: Markii ay buuxsamaan shuruudaha sharciga ah ee guurku, markaas labada qof way is guursan karaan.
en: When the legal provisions of marriage are fulfilled, a couple can marry.

so: Bogagga shabakadda wasaarada cadaalada waxaa si kooban loogu sharaxayaa guursiga iyo furiinka iyo weliba sharciyada ku saabsan waajibaadka iyo xuquuqda guurka.
en: The Ministry of Justice's website describes in short the regulations governing the contracting and dissolution of a marriage, as well as the legal effects of marriage.

so: Sharciga guurka oo dhamaystiran waxaa laga helayaa bogga Internetka ee Finlex.
en: The Marriage Act can be found in its entirety on the Finlex website.

so: Hadii aad leedahay laxaad la'aan ama xanuun, kaasi oo aanad ka shaqayn karayn ayaa waxaad heli kartaa hawlgabka karid la'aanta shaqada (työkyvyttömyyseläke).
en: If you cannot work because of your illness or disability, you may be entitled to disability pension (työkyvyttömyyseläke).

so: Hadii aad indho laadahay ama aanad dhaqaaqi karayn,ayaa waxaad helaysaa hawlgabka dhaqaaq la'aanta xataa adiga shaqo tagi kara.Lacagta hawlgabka shaqo karid la'aanta waxaa la siiyaa da'da u dhaxaysa 16-64 jir.
en: If you are blind or immobile without assistance, you are entitled to a disability pension even if you work. Disability pension is paid to persons between 16 and 64 years of age.

so: Helitaanka lacagta hawlgabka waxaa saamaysa inta aad dagan tahay Finland.
en: Whether you receive disability pension is affected by how long you have lived in Finland.

so: Waxaad ka dalban kartaa hawlgabka shaqo la'aanta kelada.
en: You can apply for disability pension from Kela.

so: Taageerada lacageed ee qofka laxaadka la' ee qaangaarka ah
en: Disability benefit for adults

so: Waxaad u baahan tahay shahaado ama cadayn dhakhtareed, si aad u heli karto lacagtaasi taageerada ah.
en: To receive disability benefit, you need a medical certificate.

so: Kaalmada dhaqaale ee dadka waaweyn waxaa la siiyaa 16-64 sano jiryada.
en: Disability benefit for adults is paid to persons between 16 and 64 years of age.

so: Helintaanka lacagta taageerada ah waxaa saamayn ku le, inta aad dagan tahay Finland.Sida caadiga ah lacagtani qofku wuxuu heli karaa markuu dagan yahay Finland mudo saddex sano ah.
en: Whether you receive the benefit is affected by how long you have lived in Finland. The usual requirement for getting disability benefit is that the applicant has lived in Finland for three years.

so: Xadiga lacagtan taageerada ahi waxay ku xidhan tahay hadba inta uu leeg tahay laxaad la'aantaadu.
en: The amount of the disability benefit depends on how severe your disability is.

so: Waxaad ka dalban kartaa lacagtan taageerada dad laxaadka la' kelada.
en: You can apply for disability benefit from Kela.

so: Taageerada lacageed ee lagu helo daryeelka qof qoyskaaga ka tirsan oo axaad la'
en: Support for taking care of a disabled family member

so: Haddii ad qof laxaad la' oo qoyskaaga ka tirsan ku daryeesho gurigaaga, degmadaadu waxay ku siin kartaa lacagta taakulaynta ee loogu talo galay qofka qof qoyskiisa ka tirsan oo laxaad la' ku haya guriga (omaishoidontuki).
en: If you take care of your disabled family member at home, your municipality of residence can pay you an allowance for informal care (omaishoidontuki).

so: Si ad taakuulayntaas u heshid waa inaad la samaysaa heshiis degmadaada.
en: In order to qualify for this allowance, you must make an informal care agreement with your municipality.

so: Dhaqaalaha lagu helo daryeelka qofka laxaadka la' ee ka tirsan qoyskaaga waxad ka dalban kartaa xafiiska sooshalka ee dagmadaada.
en: You can apply for the allowance at the social services office of your municipality of residence.

so: Taageerada lacageed ee ilmaha laxaadka la' iyo lacagta daryeelka ee nooca gaarka ah
en: Disability benefit for a child and special care allowance

so: Macluumaad dheeri ah oo ku saabsan taageerada lacageed ee ilmaha laxaadka la' iyo lacagta daryeelka ee nooca gaarka ah waxad ka akhridaa bogga InfoFinland qaybtiisa Caruurta naafada ah.
en: Read more on the disability benefit for a child and special care allowance on the InfoFinland page Disabled child.

so: Kabidda dhaqaale ee daryeelka qofka qaata lacagta howlgabka
en: Care allowance for pensioners

so: Waxad heli kartaa taakulaynta haddii laxaad la'aantaada ama xanuunkaaga daraadii ad ugu baahantahay caawimaad joogt ah.
en: You may receive the allowance if you need help constantly because of your disability or illness.

so: Lacagta taakulayntu inta ay leegtahay waxay ku xidhantahay caawimaada ad u baahantahay inta ay tahay.
en: The amount of the allowance depends on how much support you need.

so: Waxad Kelada ka dalban kartaa jabida dhaqaale ee daryeelka qofka qaata lacagta howlgabka.
en: You can apply for care allowance for pensioners from Kela.

so: Kabidda dhaqaale ee raashinka iyo dharka
en: Clothing and nutrition allowance

so: Haddii laxaad la'aantaadu ama xanuunkaagu uu kugu keeno kharashaad dheeri ah oo raashinkaaga iyo dharkaaga gala, waxad dalban kartaa kabidda dhaqaale ee raashinka iyo dharka (vaatetus- ja ravitsemustuki).
en: If your disability or illness incurs extra costs for you in food or clothing, you can apply for clothing and nutrition allowance (vaatetus- ja ravitsemustuki).

so: Kabidda dhaqaale waxad ka dalban kartaa xafiiska sooshalka ee degmadaada.
en: You can apply for this allowance at the social services office of your municipality of residence.

so: Degmooyinku waa in ay adeegyada gaarka ah ee aan laga maarmin u fidiyaan dadka naafada ah.
en: Municipalities are required to offer special services for disabled persons who need them.

so: Kuwaasi waa tusaale ahaan baabuur ku qaadista, guri u rarida iyo kalkaaliye khaas ah.
en: These special services include, for example, transport service, home alteration work or a personal assistant.

so: Ujeedooyinka adeegyadaasi waa caawinta dadka laxaadka la' si ay uga qayb galaan bulshada iyo inay u fududayso nolosha yagoo laxaad la'.
en: The purpose of these services is to help disabled persons to participate in the society's activities and facilitate life with a disability.

so: Hadii aad sharci iyo daganaansho aad ku leedahay wadanka Finland, waxaad xaq u yeelanaysaa adeegyadaasi ay bixiso dagmadu.
en: If you have a residence permit and a municipality of residence in Finland, you are entitled to the services that your municipality offers.

so: Ka akhri macluumaadka dheeraad ah ee ku sahabsan adeegyada aad xaqa u leedahay ee ay bixiso dagmada aad dagan tahay, boga bangiga macluumaadka Guri degmo ee gudaha Finland.
en: More information on the right to a municipality of residence is available on the InfoFinland page Municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Inta badan adeegyada naafada waxaa lagu helaa caddeyn dhakhtareed.
en: You often need a medical certificate to get services for the disabled.

so: Tusaale ahaan, u tag baaritaan dhakhtareed rugtaada caafimaadka.
en: Visit your local health centre, for example, for a medical examination.

so: Markaad haysato shahaado ama cadayn dhakhtareed, la xidhiidh xafiiska sooshiyaalka ee dagmadaada.
en: Once you have a doctor's certificate, contact the social services office of your municipality of residence.

so: Dagmooyinka waxaa jira shaqaale sooshiyaal oo u qaabilsan dadka laxaadka la'.
en: Municipalities have a social worker who is responsible for the services for disabled persons.

so: Shawaalahaasi wuxuu kaa caawin karaa hagida iyo dalbashada adeegyadaasi.
en: You can ask this person for guidance and advice in applying for services.

so: Ujeedada qorshaha adeegu wuxuu cadaynayaa, nooca adeeg ee laxaad la'aantaada khuseeya ee aad heli karto.
en: Its purpose is to find out what services for disabled persons you can obtain. A decision will be made on the services.

so: Helitaanka adeega go'aan baa laga soo saarayaa, kaasi oo aad dib u dalban karto hadii aanad ku qancin go'aanka helitaanka adeegyadaasi.
en: You can appeal against the decision if you are not happy with the services provided to you.

so: Xaruntaada caafimaadka iyo dhakhtarka sentralka ah ayaa bixinaya kharashka qalabka lagu bixiyo daaweeyn kobcin ah (lääkinnällinen kuntoutus).
en: Your health centre and central hospital will pay for aids, which are given as medical rehabilitation (lääkinnällinen kuntoutus).

so: Taasi micnaheedu waxa weeyaan inaanad ku khasbanayn inaad bixiso qalabka caawimaadda ah ee ad ugu baahantahay nololmaalmeedkaaga.Qalabkaasi lacag la'aanta ahi tusaale ahaan waa baaskiilada dadka naafada ah, sameecadaha maqalka, bakoorada iyo ey tabobaran.
en: This means that you do not have to pay anything for the aids and equipment that you need to manage in your daily life. Such free-of-charge aids include, for example, wheelchairs, hearing aids for the hearing impaired and white canes and guide dogs for the visually impaired.

so: Shaqaalaha sooshiyaalka ah ee u xil saaran dadka naafada ah ee degmaada ayaa qiimayn kula samaynaya, shaqaalahaasi baana qabanaya waxa laga badalayo gurigaaga.
en: The social worker of your municipality's Office for Disabled Services will estimate together with you whether your home needs alteration work.

so: Kelada ayaa bixin karta qalabkaasi taageerada kuu ah, ee aad ugu baahan tahay waxbarashada ama shaqada.
en: Kela may pay for aids that are required for working and studying.

so: Waad heli kartaa qalab taageero, hadii aanad shaqo ama wax dhigan karayn qalabkaasi la'aantii.
en: You may be provided with aids if you cannot manage work or studying without certain aids or if work or study without them would be very difficult.

so: Waydii keelada macluumaad dheeraada oo arinkaasi ku sahabsan iyo sida loo heli karaba qalabyadaasi.
en: You can ask at Kela how to get these aids.

so: Hadii aanad isticmaali karayn gaadiidka caadiga ah laxaad la'aantaa owgeed, waxaad xaq u yeelanaysaa in lagu wado ama lagu qaado (kuljetuspalvelu).
en: If you cannot use public transport because of your disability, you may be entitled to transport service (kuljetuspalvelu).

so: Waxaad ka dalban kartaa meel gaynta iyo caawiyahaba shaqaalaha sooshiyaalka degmadaada.Waxaad bixinaysaa lacag u dhiganta inta gaadiidka dadwaynaha aad ku bixisid.
en: You can apply for transport service from the social worker of your municipality's Office for Disabled Services. You will pay a public transport-based charge for the transport service.

so: Waxaad heli kartaa sidoo kale qiimo dhis tigidhada gaadiidka dad waynaha ah.
en: You may also be entitled to a discount on public transport ticket prices because of your disability.

so: Waydii macluumaad dheeri ah xafiiska sooshiyaalka ee degmadaada.
en: Ask about these at the social services office of your municipality of residence.

so: Hadii aad u baahan tahay caawimo badan laxaad la'aantaada darteed, waxaad heli kartaa kalkaaliye kuu khaas ah (henkilökohtainen avustaja).
en: If you require a great deal of help in dealing with your daily life due to your disability, you can be assigned a personal assistant (henkilökohtainen avustaja).

so: Kalkaaliyuhu wuxuu kaa caawin karaa adiga tusaale ahaan cunto karinta, tukaan kasoo adeegashada, shaqo gaynta, waxbarashada ama waxyaabaha aad xiisayso wakhtiga firaaqadaada ah.
en: The assistant can help you, for example, to cook, go to the shop, at your workplace, in studying or hobbies.

so: Degmadaada ayaa bixineysa mushaarka caawiyaha.
en: Your municipality of residence pays the assistant's wages.

so: Ka dalbo kalkaaliye xafiiska sooshiyaalka degmadaada.
en: You can apply for assistant services at the social services office of your municipality of residence.

so: Turjumaadda qofka naafada ah waa arrin ka duwan turjumaadda luqada lagu hadlo.
en: Interpreting for a disabled person is a different matter from interpreting spoken language.

so: Waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad isticmaasho adeega turjumaanta (tulkkauspalvelu) dadka laxaadka la', hadii leedahay
en: You are entitled to use the interpreter services for disabled persons if you have:

so: laxaad la'aanta maqalkakuulovamma tai
en: a hearing defect, or

so: laxaad la'aanta dhagaha iyo indhaha
en: hearing and sight defect, or

so: iyo hadii aad u baahan tahay turjumaan kuugu turjuma laxaad la'aantaada darteed
en: and if you need the help of an interpreter because of your disability

so: ka qayb galka bulshada
en: taking care of your affairs

so: waxyaabaha aad qabato wakhtiga firaaqada ama tamashlayn
en: participation in society leisure-time hobbies or recreation.

so: Waxaad ka dalban kartaa adeega turjumaanka kelada.
en: You can apply for interpreter services for disabled persons from Kela.

so: Hadii aanad fahmayn far-dhagoolayaasha luuqadaha finishka, iswidhishfinish waxaad sidoo kale u baahan tahay turjumaan kale.
en: If you do not understand Finnish or Finnish or Finland-Swedish sign language, you may also need another interpreter.

so: Turjumaanada dadka laxaadka la' u turjuma ee finishka ahi kuma hadlaan ( suul-dhabaaleeyaan) luuqado kale tooda mooyee.
en: Finnish interpreters for disabled persons do not necessarily know, for example, the signs used in the sign languages of other countries.

so: Keladu ma qabanqaabiso turjubaan kale.
en: Kela will not arrange another interpreter.

so: Xusuusnow in aad xaqiijiso marwalba baahida turjumaadda marka aad ka daneysaneyso shaqaalaha dowladda.
en: Always remember to ensure the need for an interpreter when dealing with the authorities.

so: Qabanqaabinta turjubaanka waxaa mas'uul ka ah shaqaalaha dowladda ee aad ka daneysaneyso.
en: The responsibility for arranging an interpreter belongs to the authority you are dealing with.

so: Haddii laguugu yeero daryeel caafimaad, xusuusnow in aad horay u sii sheegto in aad turjubaan u baahantahay.
en: If you are invited to a health clinic, don't forget to tell about your need for an interpreter in advance.

so: Haddii aad nafsad ahaantaada u tagto heeganka ama dhakhtar, waxaad turjubaan ka dalban kartaa Kelada.
en: If you visit the emergency clinic or doctor on your own initiative, you can book an interpreter from Kela.

so: Haddii aad qabto naafo adag ama jiro isla markaasna aad ka yar tahay 65 sano, Keladu waxay kuu qabanqaabin kartaa daaweyn baxnaano ah oo adag waxeyna kaa bixin kartaa kharashka ku baxaya baxnaanada.
en: If you have a severe disability or illness and are younger than 65, Kela can arrange medical rehabilitation for persons with severe disabilities (vaativa lääkinnällinen kuntoutus) for you and reimburse some of its costs.

so: Baxnaanin waxaad heli kartaa, haddii aad naafo ama jiro darteed qabto dhibaatooyin badan oo aadan kaga soo bixin karin nolol-maalmeedka guriga, shaqada ama dugsiga.
en: You can be given rehabilitation if you have a disability or illness that causes considerable difficulties in your everyday life at home, at your educational establishment or at work.

so: Daaweynta baxnaaninta ah waxa laguugu qabanqaabin karaa xarunta baxnaaninta ama teraabiyada furan, oo mudada ay socoto aad guriga deganaan karto.
en: Medical rehabilitation can be organised at a rehabilitation centre or as outpatient therapy, during which you can live at home.

so: Ujeedada baxnaanadu waa in aad sidan si ka fiican uga soo baxdo nolo-maalmeedka.
en: The aim of rehabilitation is to help you manage better in your everyday life.

so: Haddii anad heli karin daaweynta dib u soo celinta ee adag ee ay Keladu bixiso waxa waajib uu ka saaranyahay qabanqaabada dib u soo celinta degmadaada.
en: If you are not entitled to Kela's rehabilitation services for persons with severe disabilities, your municipality of residence is responsible for providing rehabilitation services for you.

so: Macluumaad dheeri ah ka akhri bogga bangiga macluumaadka qaybtiisa Baxnaanin.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Rehabilitation.

so: Dadka horumarka naafada ka ah adeegyadooda gaar ah
en: Special services for persons with mental disabilities

so: Dadka horumarka naafada ka ah adeegyadooda gaar ah waxaa ka mida
en: Special services for persons with mental disabilities include:

so: Waxqabadka shaqada iyo waxqabadka maalinlaha ah
en: work activities and daytime activities.

so: Adeega dajinta (Asumispalvelu) ujeediisu waa in qofka naafada ka ah xaga horumarku dagi guri , kaasi oo ka heli karo caawin iyo taageero kala duwan.
en: Housing services (asumispalvelu) means that persons with mental disabilities can live in an apartment where they can get various kinds of help and support.

so: Ka akhli macluumaad dheeraad ah bogga InfoFinland Caawin- iyo adeega dajinta.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Supported and service housing.

so: Kalkaaliye guri (Perhehoito) waxaa loola jeeda, in qofka la xanaaneeyo, la tarbiyadeeyo iyo la ilaaliyo markaa waxaa loo qaban qaabiyaa qof ka baxsan gurigooda oo ka yimi guri kale.Qofka qaba laxaad la'aanta horumarka ee u baahan xanaanayntu wuxuu daganaan karaa guri reerkooda.
en: Care in family surroundings (perhehoito) means that the person's treatment, education, upbringing and care take place in a private home outside his/her own home. This is a very suitable form of housing for a person with mental disabilities who requires treatment.

so: Guriga reerkooda sidoo kale wuxuu u daganaan karaa si ku meel gaadh ah.
en: This can be either a temporary or a more permanent arrangement.

so: Kalkaaliye guri waxaa looga qaban qaabin karaa qof guriga laga heshiiyey.
en: Care in family surroundings can also be provided in the home of the person who requires treatment.

so: Hadii qofka qaba naafada horumarku uu u baahan yahay wakhti walba cid xanaanaysa, uu waayo cid ku xanaanaysa gurigiisa ama deegaanka adeega, wuxuu dagi karaa xarunta dadkaasi loogu talo galay.
en: If a person with mental disabilities requires care at all times and cannot be given it at home or in a service apartment, he/she can also live in an institution (laitos).

so: xarunta wuxuu daganaan karaa sidoo kale wakhtiyo gaaban.
en: Living in an institution can also be temporary.

so: Degmooyinku waxay qaban qaabiyaan wax qabadka shaqada iyo wax qabadka maalinlaha ah ee dadka laxaadka la'.
en: Municipalities organise work activities and daytime activities for disabled persons.

so: Waxqabadka shaqadu(Työtoiminta) waxay fududaysaa shaqada.
en: Work activities (työtoiminta) include light work.

so: Wax-qabadka maalinlaha ah (Päivätoiminta) waxaa loogu talo galay dadka laxaadka la' kuwooda ad adag, ee aan ka qayb galin wax qabadka shaqada.Wax qabadka maalinlaha ah waxaa ku jiri kara cunto karin, wada-sheekaysi iyo lugayn.
en: Daytime activities (päivätoiminta) are intended for severely disabled persons who cannot participate in work activities. They may include cooking, exercise, discussion and making excursions.

so: Internetka waxaad ka heli kartaa bangiga macluumaadka sida loo xaneeneeyo dadka laxaad la'aanta horumarka qaba (Kehitysvammahuollon tietopankki), Halkaasi oo aad ka heli karto macluumaad faa'iido badan u le dadka qaba laxaad la'aanta horumarka iyo sidoo kale adeegyo loogu talo galay dadka laxaadka la'.
en: The Databank for the Care of the Mentally Disabled (Kehitysvammahuollon tietopankki) on the internet contains a great deal of useful information about mental disabilities and services for the disabled.

so: Adeegu waa luuqada finishka.
en: This service is provided in Finnish.

so: Sida uu sharciga Finland qabo, qofna looma faquuqi karo naafo darteed.
en: Finnish law states that a disabled person must not be discriminated against because of his or her disability.

so: Finland waxaa ay sidoo kale qawl-qaaday in ay u hoggaansameyso heshiiska naafada ee QM.
en: Finland is also committed to the UN treaty on the rights of persons with disabilities.

so: Waxaa laga yaabaa in qofka naafada ah ay ku adag tahay in uu ka soo baxo nolol-maalmeedka maalin kasta ah naafo ama jiro darteed.
en: A disabled person may have difficulties in managing matters of everyday life due to his or her ability or illness.

so: Degmooyinku waa in ay adeegyada aan laga maarmin u qabanqaabiyaan dadka naafada ah.
en: Municipalities are required to offer services for disabled persons who need them.

so: Adeegyadaan tusaale ahaan waa adeegga gaadiid ku qaadista iyo caawiyaha.
en: These services include, for example, transport and assistant services.

so: Haddii aad heysato ogolaanshaha joogitaan islamarkaasna aad ka tirsan tahay degmo Finland ku taal, waxaad xaq u leedahay adeegyada naafada ee degmada.
