en: If you have a residence permit and a municipality of residence in Finland, you are entitled to the disability services offered by your municipality.

so: Wararka dheeraadka ah ee adeegyada naafada iyo codsashadooda ka sii aqri bogagga InfoFinlandi Adeegga dadka laxaadka la'.
en: Read more on the services for disabled persons and how to apply for them on the InfoFinland page Services for disabled persons.

so: Finland waxaa ka jira ururo badan oo yoolkuudu yahay in ay hagaajiyaan derajada dadka naafada ah ay bulshada dhexdeeda ku leeyihiin.
en: There are several organisations in Finland which strive to improve the status of the disabled in society.

so: Ururadan waxaad talo iyo caawimaad uga heli kartaa tusaale ahaan codsashada adeegyada.
en: These organisations can provide you with advice and assistance on, for example, how to apply for services.

so: Ururo badan ayaa waxey sidoo kale bixiyaan xilliyada firaaqada waxqabadyo iyo taageerada jaalka oo loogu tagalay dadka oo dhan da' kasta oo ay jiraan.
en: They also often provide leisure time activities and peer support to persons of all ages.

so: Macluumaadyada xiriirka ee ururada waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga Golaha naafada.
en: Contact information for these organisations is available on the Vammaisfoorumi disability forum website.

so: Finland waxaa sidoo kale ka shaqeeyaa xarunta kaalmada Hilma ee naafada dadka dalka u soo guuray, taas oo naafada dalka u soo guurtay iyo kuwa mudada dheer jiran u fidisa hagitaan adeeg iyo talobixin.
en: Hilma, the Support Centre for Immigrant Persons with Disabilities, also operates in Finland. It provides service coordination and counselling for disabled immigrants and persons with chronic diseases.

so: Haddii aad tahay indhoole ama aragaadu uu liito waxaad heli kartaa adeegyada loogu talagalay dadka aragga naafo ka ah.
en: If you are blind or partially sighted, you are eligible for services for visually impaired persons.

so: Haddii aad u baahan tahay qalabka caawimaadda, marka hore baaritaan dhakhtareed u tag rugtaada caafimaadka.
en: If you need aids and equipment (apuvälineet), visit your local health centre first for a medical examination.

so: Dhakhtarka ayaa qiimeynaya naafada aragaada kaddibna waxaad qaab baxnaano daawo ah u heli kartaa qalabka caawimaadda.
en: Once a doctor has assessed your visual impairment, you may be given aids and equipment to help you in your medical rehabilitation.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Adeegga dadka laxaadka la'.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Services for disabled persons.

so: Haddii naafada aad qabto darteed aad u baahan tahay tusaale ahaan kambuyuutar gaar ah ama makiinadaha guriga, waxaad kaalmo uga heli kartaa xafiiska sooshalka ee degmadaada.
en: For example, if you need a special computer or household appliances due to your disability, you can get financial support for these from the social services office (sosiaalitoimisto) of your municipality of residence.

so: Si kastoo ay ahaato tani waa mid ka fiirsasho ku xiran, yacni helitaanka kaalmadu ma ahan mid la hubo.
en: However, this is discretionary support, in other words, it is not necessarily granted.

so: Maktabadda dadka aragga naafada ka ah ee Celia waxaad ka amaahan kartaa buugaag cod ah, buugaagta qoraal dhibceedka leh, buugaag elekterkoonik ah iyo sawiro kor u soo baxsan.
en: From the Celia library for the visually impaired (Näkövammaisten kirjasto Celia), you can borrow talking books, Braille books, e-books and relief pictures.

so: Maktabaddu waxey sidoo kale soo saartaa buugaag waxbarasho oo ay dugsilayda indhaha naafada ka ah iyo ardaydu ay u baahan yihiin.
en: The library also produces school books needed by visually impaired schoolchildren and students.

so: Iskaashatada dadka aragga naafada ka ah waa urur yoolkiisu yahay hagaajinta derajada dadka aragga naafada ka ah ay bulshada ku dhexe leeyihiin.
en: The Finnish Federation of the Visually Impaired (Näkövammaisten keskusliitto) is an organisation that strives to improve the status of the visually impaired in society.

so: Iskaashatadu waxey sidoo kale bixisaa macluumaadyo iyo adeegyo badan oo faa'iido u leh dadka aragga naafada ka ah.
en: The Federation also provides a lot of useful information and services for visually impaired persons.

so: Dadka maqalka naafada ka ah waa dhegoolayaal ama waa kuwa uu maqalkoodu liito.
en: The hard of hearing (kuulovammainen) refers to deaf and hearing-impaired persons.

so: Qaar badan oo iyaga ka tirsan waxey dadka kula xiriiraan luqada dhegoolaha.
en: Many use sign language to communicate with others.

so: Finland waxaa laga isticmaalaa luqada dhegoolaha ee af Finnishka iyo Iswidhishka Finland.
en: Finnish and Finland-Swedish sign languages are used in Finland.

so: Dadka maqalka naafo ka ah waxey sidoo kale inta badan xirtaan qalabka maqalka.
en: Hearing-impaired persons often use hearing aids as well.

so: Dhakhtarka ayaa qiimeynaya naafada maqalkaada kaddibna waxaad qaab baxnaano daawo ah u heli kartaa qalabka caawimaadda
en: Once a doctor has assessed your hearing defect, you may be given aids and equipment to help you in your medical rehabilitation.

so: Tusaale ahaan waxaad heli kartaa dabsheegaha dadka maqalka naafada ka ah loogu talagalay iyo telefoonka qoraalka, si aad nabadgeliyo ugu deganaato gurigaada.
en: You can get, for example, a fire alarm and a text telephone for the hearing impaired so that you can live at home more safely.

so: Adeeg turjubaan ayaad heli kartaa haddii aad naafada maqalkaada darteed aad ugu baahan tahay tusaale ahaan shaqada, waxbarashada ama dan-qabsashada.
en: If you need interpreter services due to your hearing defect, you can receive them in order to manage in daily life, such as work, study and attending to matters.

so: Turjumistu waxey noqon kartaa tusaale ahaan turjumista luqada dhegoolaha ama turjumis qoraal ah.
en: Interpreting may include, for example, sign language interpreting or print interpreting.

so: Ka codso Kelada xuquuqda isticmaalista adeegga turjumaadda.
en: Apply for the right to use interpretation services from Kela.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan qalabka caawimaadda iyo adeegga turjumaadda ka aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Adeegga dadka laxaadka la'.
en: Read more on aids and equipment as well as interpretation services on the InfoFinland page Services for disabled persons.

so: Internetka waxaa laga helaa qaamuuska luqada dhegoolaha ee Finnishka oo la yiraahdo Suvi.
en: You can find Suvi, the dictionary of Finnish sign language, on the Internet.

so: Iskaashatada Maqalka iyo iskaashatada dhegoolayaashu waa ururo uu yoolkoodu yahay hagaajinta derajada dadka maqalka naafada ka ah ay bulshada ku dhexe leeyihiin.
en: The Finnish Federation of Hard of Hearing (Kuuloliitto) and the Finnish Association of the Deaf (Kuurojen liitto) are organisations that strive to improve the status of people who are hard of hearing in society.

so: Iskaashatadu waxey sidoo kale bixisaa macluumaadyo iyo adeegyo badan oo faa'iido u leh dadka maqalka naafada ka ah.
en: They also provide a lot of useful information and services for hard of hearing persons.

so: Qofka curyaanka ah kaligiis ma dhaqdhaqaaqi karo haddii uusan qalabka caawimaadda heysan.
en: Physically disabled persons (liikuntavammainen) cannot move independently or without aids and equipment.

so: Curyaannimada waxaa sababi kara cudur, shil ama sababo dhinaca hiddosidaha ah.
en: Physical disability may result from an illness, accident or genetic factors.

so: Dhakhtarka ayaa qiimeynaya curyaannimadaada kaddibna waxaad qaab baxnaano daawo ah u heli kartaa qalabka caawimaadda
en: Once a doctor has assessed your physical disability, you may be given aids and equipment to help you in your medical rehabilitation.

so: Haddii ay tahay in gurigaada laga qabto hawl wax looga beddelayo ama ay tahay in qalabka caawimaadda lagu rakibo, waxaad magdhaw uga heli kartaa degmadaada.
en: If you need alteration work in your home or some disability equipment have to be installed there, your municipality of residence may reimburse you for them.

so: Guriga waxaa laga dhigi karaa mid lagula dhex-socon karo kursi shaagle.
en: For example, your home can be changed in such a way that it is possible to get about in a wheelchair.

so: Qalabka caawimaadda ee guriga ku rakiban waa tusaale ahaan gacmo ama daab la kaalmeysto, marin ama sallax siman iyo albaabo koronto ku shaqeeya.
en: Fixed disability equipment include, for example, support handles, ramps and electric door openers.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan qalabka caawimaadda iyo hawsha wax ka beddelista ka aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Adeegga dadka laxaadka la'.
en: Read more on aids and equipment and alteration work on the InfoFinland page Services for disabled persons.

so: Naafada garaadku waxey saameyn ku yeelataa barashada iyo fahamka waxyaabaha cusub.
en: Mental disabilities (kehitysvamma) make learning and understanding new things difficult.

so: Qofka garaad ahaan naafo ka ah waxaa ku adag waxbarashada iyo xusuusashada marka loo barbardhigo dadka kale.
en: Learning and remembering things is a great deal more difficult for a person with mental disabilities than for other people.

so: Naafannimada garaadka waxaa inta badan la ogaadaa carruurnimada ama dhallinyaranimada.
en: Mental disabilities are often detected in childhood or adolescence.

so: Dadka garaad ahaan naafo ka ah waxaa loo fidiyaa adeegyo gaar ah oo kala duduwan.
en: Various types of special services are available to persons with mental disabilities.

so: Adeegyadaas waa tusaale ahaan adeegyada deegaanka, waxqabad shaqo iyo waxqabad maalmeed.
en: These include, for example, housing services, work activities and daytime activities.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan dadka garaadka naafada ka ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Adeegga dadka laxaadka la'.
en: Read more on the services for mentally disabled persons on the InfoFinland page Services for disabled persons.

so: Waxaa sidoo kale jira ururo badan oo laga helo macluumaadyo iyo kaalmooyin.
en: There are also many organisations that offer information and support.

so: Baxnaanada ay degmooyinku qabanqaabiyaan
en: Rehabilitation organised by municipalities

so: Degmooyinku waxay tusaale ahaan rugaha caafimaadka iyo cusbitaalaadka ku qabanqaabiyaan baxnaano daaweed.
en: Municipalities organise medical rehabilitation, for example in health centres and hospitals.

so: Waxaad geli kartaa baxnaada ay degmadu qabanqaabiso haddii aad Guri degmo ku leedahay Finland.
en: You may be eligible for rehabilitation organised by your municipality if you have a municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Baxnaanada ay degmooyinku qabanqaabiyaan waxaa kamid ah:
en: Rehabilitation organised by municipalities includes:

so: baaritaano lagu ogaanayo baahida baxnaanada
en: examinations aimed at finding the need for rehabilitation

so: daryeel hagaajinaya awoodda shaqo/waxqabad
en: treatment that improves work and functional capacity

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan adeegyada baxnaada waxaad ka heleysaa rugtaada caafimaadka.
en: More information on the rehabilitation services provided by your municipality is available at your health centre.

so: Baxnaada ay Keladu qabanqaabiso
en: Rehabilitation organised by Kela

so: Baxnaanada ay Kelada qabanqaabiso waxay ahaan kartaa
en: Rehabilitation provided by Kela can be:

so: Baxnaaninta xirfadeysan waxaa bixiya hay'adaha hawlgabka shaqada (työeläkelaitos) iyo xafiiska caymiska hawlgabka qaranka (Kela).
en: Vocational rehabilitation is organised by employment pension insurance institutions (työeläkelaitos) and the Social Insurance Institution of Finland (Kela).

so: Baxnaaninta xagga daaweynta ah waxaa si wada jir ah u agaasima degmooyinka iyo Kelada.
en: Medical rehabilitation is organised by municipalities and Kela.

so: Haddii aad qabto cudurada xirfadaha shaqada laga qaado ama shaqada waxyeelo kugu gaartay, waxaad baxnaanin ka heli kartaa shirkadda caymiska (vakuutusyhtiö).
en: If you are suffering from an occupational disease or you have been injured in an accident, you may be eligible to receive rehabilitation from your insurance company (vakuutusyhtiö).

so: Keladu waa ay kaalmeyn kartaa teraabiyada maskaxeed, laakiin waa inaad adigu raadsataa teraabiiste kugu haboon.
en: Kela may provide financial support for your psychotherapy, but you must find a suitable therapist yourself.

so: Baxnaaninta Kelada waxaa loogu talogalay kuwa ku jira xaydaabka caymiska jirada (sairausvakuutus) ee Finnishka.
en: Kela's rehabilitation is intended for those who are covered by Finnish national health insurance (sairausvakuutus).

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah oo la xirrira caymiska jirada waxaad ka heleysaa InfoFinland bogga Badbaada Bulshada ee Finland.
en: For more information about the Finnish national health insurance, go to the InfoFinland web page Finnish social security.

so: Baxnaanin xirfadaysan, haddii ay ku hayaan dhibaatooyin xaga caafimaadka ah, kuwaas oo adan dartood u awoodin inaad shaqayso.
en: You can be given vocational rehabilitation if you have health problems that prevent you from working.

so: Baxnaaninta waxaa la heli karaa, haddii aad khatar ugu jirtid inaad shaqada joojiso dhibaatooyin xagga caafimaadka ah awgood.
en: You can also be given rehabilitation if there is a risk that you might have to stop working because of your health problems.

so: Markii aad shaqada ku dhaawacantid kadib waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad baxnaanin hesho.
en: If you have an accident at work, you are entitled to rehabilitation.

so: Hay'adaha hawlgabka shaqada waxay shaqaalaha u abaabulaan baxnaanin xirfadeed.
en: Employment pension insurance institutions organise vocational rehabilitation for employees.

so: Baxnaanin waxaad ka dalaban kartaa hay'adaha hawlgabka shaqada, haddii aad mudo shan sano ah ama ka badan shaqeyneysey.
en: You can apply for rehabilitation at an employment pension insurance institution if you have been working for five years or more.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah waydii khuburada hay'aadada hawlgabka shaqada ee ku shaqada leh arimaha baxnaaninta ama din u soo celinta awoodii shaqada.
en: Ask for advice from the experts there who handle rehabilitation issues.

so: Keladu waxay baxnaanin xirfadaysan u abaabushaa dhalinyarada iyo dadka qaan gaarka ah ee shaqo la'aanta ah.
en: Kela organises vocational rehabilitation for young people and adults who are not working.

so: Haddii ay da'daadu ka yar tahay 65 sano, oo xanuun ama dhaawac ku soo gaaray awgiis ay dhibaatooyin waaweyn kaa haystaan xagga maareynta hawl maalmeedka, tusaale ahaan haddii socodka iyo inaad naftaada daryeesho ay dhib kugu yihiin, Kelada ayaa kuu agaasimi karta baxnaanin daweyn culus leh (vaativa lääkinnällinen kuntoutus)
en: If you are younger than 65 and experience difficulty in day-to-day life due to an illness or disability that makes it difficult for you to move or take care of yourself for example, Kela can arrange medical rehabilitation for persons with severe disabilities (vaativa lääkinnällinen kuntoutus) for you and reimburse some of its costs.

so: Baxnaaninta waxaa loo fulinayaa si adiga kugu habboon.
en: The rehabilitation is arranged in a way that is perfectly suited to you.

so: Baxnaaninta ayaad tusaale ahaan u tegi kartaa xarunta baxnaaninta (kuntoutuslaitos).
en: For example, you can attend rehabilitation at a rehabilitation centre (kuntoutuslaitos).

so: Sidoo kale gurigaaga ayaad deganaan kartaa, gurigaaga yaadna ka aadi kartaa xarunta baxnaaninta.
en: You can also live at home and visit rehabilitation provider from there.

so: Ujeedada baxnaanintu waa inay adiga iyo ehelkaaga caawiso, si aad u awoodo inaad si fir fircoon wax u qabsato.
en: The aim of rehabilitation is to help you manage better at home, at your educational establishment or at work.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah oola xiriira baxnaaninta daweynta culus leh weydii Kelada.
en: For more information on medical rehabilitation for persons with severe disabilities, please contact Kela.

so: Baxnaaninta ka baaraandegista ku xiran waxaa la heli karaa haddii ujeedadaadu ay tahay inaad sii wadato nolosha shaqada, shaqada ku laabato ama aad bilowdo shaqo.
en: You can receive discretionary rehabilitation if it is your aim to remain in employment, return to employment or begin employment.

so: Baxnaaninta ka baaraandegista ku xiran waxaad heli kartaa, haddii hay'adda daryeelka caafimaadku ay kugu xaqiijiso dhaawac ama xanuun u baahan baxnaanin.
en: You may be admitted to discretionary rehabilition if your health care service provider finds that you have a disability or illness that requires rehabilitation.

so: Baxnaanada ka baaraandegista ku xiran waxaa tusaale ahaan loo qabanqaabin karaa
en: Discretionary rehabilitation can include, for example:

so: koorasyo baxnaando oo loo qabanqaabiyo kooxo jirooyin kala duduwan
en: rehabilitation courses for different patient groups

so: Warar dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan kala duduwanaanshiyaha baxnaanooyinka la heli karo ka aqri bogagga shabakadda Kelada.
en: Read more about the different alternatives of discretionary rehabilitation on the Kela website.

so: Haddii dhibaatooyinka caafimaadka dhimirku ay daciifiyaan awoodaada shaqo ama waxbarasho waxaa suurtogal ah inaad dalbato baxnaanada terabiyada dhimirka (kuntoutuspsykoterapia).
en: If a mental health problem has weakened your ability to work or study, you can apply for rehabilitation psychotherapy (kuntoutuspsykoterapia).

so: Helitaanka baxnaanada terabiyada dhimirka waxaa shuruud u ah, in:
en: The condition for rehabilitation psychotherapy are as follows:

so: aad ugu yaraan soo qaadatay sadex bilood oo ah xagga daryeelka terabiyada dhimirka, iyo
en: you have received at least three months of psychiatric care, and

so: in dhakhtarka cilmi nafsiga oo ku daryeelay uu kuu qoray qaraar, uu uga tala bixinayo in lagu siiyo baxnaanada terabiyada dhimirka.
en: the treating psychiatrist provides you with a written statement recommending rehabilitation psychotherapy

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ee la xiriira adeegyada caafimaadka dhimirka waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinland Caafimaadka dhimirka.
en: Read more about the mental health service on the InfoFinland page Mental health.

so: Baxnaanada terabiyada dhimirku waxay ahaan kartaa terapiya shakhsiyadeed, terabiya wadareed, teraabiyada farshaxan sawireedka, terabiya qows ama terabiya lammaane.
en: Rehabilitation psychotherapy can be individual therapy, group therapy, art therapy, family therapy or pair psychotherapy.

so: Intaas waxaa dheer oo jiri kara terabiyada muusikada oo loogu talogalay dhalinyarada da'doodu u dhaxeyso 16-25 sano.
en: For persons between 16 and 25 years of age, it can also take the form of music therapy.

so: Terabiyada dhallinyarada waxaa la xiriiri kara booqashoonka waalidiinta.
en: The therapy of a young person can include visits by the parents.

so: Kaalmada terabiyada waxaa la heli karaa ugu badnaan markiiba sannad muddo sadex sano ah.
en: Support for therapy can be given for one year at a time for a maximum of three years.

so: Terabiyada ugu badnaan laga bixin karaa qofka 80 mar sannadkiiba ama saddexdii sanaba ugu badnaan 200 oo mar.
en: Therapy expenses are recompensed for a maximum of 80 sessions a year and up to 200 sessions in three years.

so: Si Keladu kaaga caawiso terabiyada dhimirka, qofka terabiyada sameenaya waa inuu xaq u leeyahay inuu isticmaalo magaca xifadeed ee dhimir daaweeyaha,waana inuu ahaado terapeutti Keladu ogolaatay.
en: Kela can only support psychotherapy if the therapist has the right to use the professional title of psychotherapist and he/she has been approved as a therapist by Kela.

so: Sidee u raadsanaysaa baxnaaninta
en: How to seek rehabilitation

so: Haddii aad u baahato baxnaanin, marka ugu horeysa waxaad u baahan tahay cadayn dhakhtar.
en: When you need rehabilitation, you are first required to get a doctor's certificate.

so: La xiriir dhakhtarkaaga, dhakhtarkaaga xarunta caafimaadka ama Kelada.
en: Contact your doctor, occupational doctor or Kela.

so: Haddii aad dalbanaysid baxnaaninta daweynta culus leh, waxaad si dheeraad ah ugu baahan tahay qorshaha baxnaaninta (kuntoutussuunnitelma).
en: If you are applying for medical rehabilitation for persons with severe disabilities, you will also need an individual rehabilitation plan (kuntoutussuunnitelma).

so: Markii aad dhakhtarka ka heshid cadaynta ama qorshaha baxnaaninta, waxa aad baxnaaninta ka dalban kartaa hay'adaada hawlgabka shaqada ama xafiiska caymiska hawlgabka qaranka.
en: After getting your doctor's certificate or individual rehabilitation plan, you can apply for rehabilitation from your employment pension insurance institution or Kela.

so: Waxaad weydiin kartaa adeegyada caafimaadka ee degmadaada, hay'adaada hawlgabka shaqada ama xafiiska hay'ada caymiska hawlgabka qaranka baxnaaninta kala gadisan oo suurtogalka ah.
en: You can inquire about different rehabilitation possibilities at the health services of your municipality, the employment pension insurance institution or

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan baxnaanooyinka Kelada waxaad sidoo kale ka heleysaa bogagga shabakadda Kelada.
en: Kela office. More information on rehabilitation organised by Kela is available on the Kela website.

so: Haddii aad dalbaneysid baxnaanita Kelada, Kelada u sooceli foomka dalabka baxnaaninta inta aysan bilaaban hawlaha baxnaanintu.
en: If you are applying for Kela rehabilitation, please return the application to Kela before the beginning of the rehabilitation.

so: Kelada ayaa ku siinaysa go'aanka baxnaaninta oo qoraal ah.
en: Kela will provide you with a written decision about the rehabilitation.

so: Waqtiga baxaaninta lagu jiro waxaad heli kartaa lacagta baxnaaninta (kuntoutusraha), haddii aad tahay 16-67 -sano oo ujeedada baxnaanintu tahay inaad iaadan dhmin awoodaada shaqo, kuna noqotid nolosha shaqada ama inaad baxnaaninta ku heshid shaqo.
en: You can receive rehabilitation allowance (kuntoutusraha) for the duration of rehabilitation if you are 16–67 years old and the aim of the rehabilitation is to maintain your ability to work, return to work or gain entry to working life.

so: Lacagta baxnaaninta si aad u heshid waxaad u baahantahay oo kale goaanka baxnaaninta (kuntoutuspäätös) oo tusaale ahaan laga heli karo Kelada ama hay'adda daryeelka caafimaadka shaqada.
en: For the rehabilitation allowance, you will also need a valid rehabilitation decision (kuntoutuspäätös), for example, by Kela or your occupational health care provider.

so: Waxaad shuruudo lamid ah ku heli kartaa lacagta baxnaanada xitaa marka ay degmadaadu qabanqaabineyso baxnaanadaada.
en: You may receive rehabilitation allowance on the same terms even if your municipality organises your rehabilitation.

so: Keladu waxay qayb ahaan magdhaw ka bixineysaa kharashka safarada ee ku baxa aadintaanka goobta baxnaaninta.
en: Kela may also partially reimburse travel to rehabilitation.

so: Haddii aad jirato ama shil shaqo kugu dhaco, xaq ayaad u leedahay inaad shaqada ka maqnaato.
en: If you fall ill or have an accident, you have the right to stay home from work.

so: Haddii aad ku jirto hayndaabka caymiska jirada ee Finnishka (sairausvakuutus), waqtiga adigu aad is dabareysid (omavastuuaika) kadib waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad ka dalbato xafiiska caymiska hawlgabka qaranka lacagta jirada (Kelan sairauspäiväraha).
en: If you are covered by Finnish national health insurance (sairausvakuutus), you have the right to apply for sickness allowance (sairauspäiväraha) from the Social Insurance Institution of Finland (Kela) after the qualifying period for benefit (omavastuuaika).

so: Sida badan waqtiga aad is dabareysid oo aad adigu kharashka oo dhan mas'uul ka tahay waa maalinta aad xanuunsan tahay oo lagu daray 9ka maalmood oo ku xigta oo ah maalmaha shaqada.
en: The qualifying period for benefit usually starts on the day when you fall ill, and continues for the following 9 weekdays.

so: Haddii xiriirka shaqadaadu uu socday wax ka badan bil, shaqo bixiyahaadu wuxuu ku siinayaa mushaar buuxa waqtiga aad isdabareysid.
en: If you have been employed at your current job for more than a month before you fell ill, your employer will pay you full salary for the qualifying period for benefit.

so: Lacagta jirada waxaa la bixiyaa ugu badnaan 300 oo maalmo shaqo ah.
en: Sickness allowance is paid for a maximum of 300 weekdays.

so: Lacagtana waa in la dalbado 2 bilood gudahooda marka laga bilaabo maalintii aad xanuunsatay.
en: You must apply for it within 2 months of falling ill.

so: Lacagta jirada waxaad dalban kartaa, haddii:
en: You can apply for sickness allowance if:

so: Aad ku jirto xayndaabka caymiska jirada (sairausvakuutus) ee Finnishka; wixii warar dheeraad ah ka akhriso InfoFinland bogga Badbaada Bulshada ee Finland
en: you are covered by Finnish national health insurance (sairausvakuutus); read more on the InfoFinland web page Finnish social security

so: Aad tahay 16-67-sano jir
en: you are between 16–67 years old

so: Aadan shaqayn karin jirada awgeed
en: you are unable to work due to an illness

so: Aad shaqeyneysey 3 bilood ka hor markii aad xanuunsatay adoo shaqaale ah, ganacsade ah ama xirfad ku shaqaytse ah ama aad ahayd arday waxbaranaayey 3 bilood intii aadan xanuunsan ka hor, aad tahay shaqo la'aan, shaqo raadiye, ama macaamiil ka ah xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada (työ- ja elinkeinotoimisto),fasax ka qaatay shaqada (sapattivapaa) ama qaatay fasax miilaysi ah, booskaaguu uu ka shaqaynayo qof shaqo la'aan horay u ahaa (vuorotteluvapaa)
en: you have worked for 3 months before falling ill as an employee, entrepreneur or self-employed person or before falling ill, you have studied full-time, been an unemployed job seeker, i.e. a customer of the Employment and Economic Development Office (työ- ja elinkeinotoimisto), or taken sabbatical leave (sapattivapaa) or job alternation leave (vuorotteluvapaa) for 3 months

so: Haddii aad mushaar qaadanaysid waqtiga jirada, shaqo-bixiyahaada ayaa lacag maalmeedka jirada codsanaya.
en: If you are being paid during the time of your illness, your employer will apply for the sickness allowance.

so: Markaas waxaa lacag maalmeedka jirada la siinayaa shaqo-bixiyahaada.
en: In this case, the sickness allowance will be paid to your employer.

so: Haddii aad waqti dheer jiran tahay oo shaqo bixiyuhu uusan mushaar ku siineyn waqtiga jirada, waxaad Kelada ka dalban kartaa lacagta jirada, markii mushaarku uu kaa joogsado.
en: If you are ill for a long time and your employer no longer pays you for the time that you are ill, you can apply for sickness allowance from Kela after your salary payments have ceased.

so: Tirada lacag maalmeedka jiradu waxay ku xiran tahay dakhligaaga.
en: The amount of sickness allowance paid depends on your income.

so: Sida badan waxaa loo xisaabiyaa ayadoo la eegayo dakhliga shaqada ee ay canshuuraadku xaqiijiyeen.
en: It is usually calculated from your taxation on the basis of your confirmed earned income.

so: Tusaale ahaan magdhawga xuquuqda sameeyaha u dhowran dheeraadyada xiriirka shaqada xisaabta laguma darayo marka la xisaabinayo tirada lacag maalmeedka.
en: Copyright reimbursements and employment options, for example, are not counted when calculating the amount of sickness allowance.

so: Haddii dhakligaagu kordhay, waxaad dalban kartaa lacagta jirada ugu dambayn 6 bilood ayadoo la cuskanaayo dakhliga shaqada.
en: If your income has grown, you can apply for sickness allowance on the basis of the earned income of the last 6 months.

so: Markaas waxaad lifaaq ahaan ugu baahantahay ogeysiiska mushaarka aad adigu heshay.
en: In this case you will need to append to your application a notification of the salary you have received.

so: Marka aad dalbanaysid lacagta jirada, dalabka ku lifaaq:
en: When you apply for sickness allowance, please attach the following:

so: shahaadada khatarka ee shaqo awoodis la'aanta
en: a doctor's certificate of your incapacity for work

so: shahaadada mushaarka ee 6 dii bilood oo ugu dambeysay, haddii dakhligaagu kordhay
en: salary certificate for the last 6 months if your income has grown

so: Macluumaadka dheeraadka ah ee la xiriira lacagta jirada waxaad ka heleysaa bogga internetka ee Kelada.
en: You can find out more about sickness allowance on Kela's website.

so: Haddii aad mudo badan jiran tahay, baar oo in baxnaanintu ay ku caawiso.
en: If your illness continues over a long period, find out whether rehabilitation might help you.

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira baxnaaninta ama ka soo kabsashada jirada waxaad ka heleysaa InfoFinland bogga Baxnaaninta ama ka soo kabsashada xanuunka.
en: You can find information about rehabilitation on the InfoFinland web page Rehabilitation.

so: Qayb ka mid ah lacagta jira (osasairauspäiväraha) waxaa loogu talogalay shaqaalaha 16-67- sano jira ama ganacsatada, kuwaas oo qabta shaqo maalinta oo dhan ah islamarkaasna kamid ah Amaanka bulshada Finland.
en: Partial sickness allowance (osasairauspäiväraha) is intended for a 16–67 year-old employee or entrepreneur who works full-time and is covered by Finnish social security.

so: Qeybta kamdika ah lacag maalmeedka jirada ujeedadeedu waa inaad sii wadi karto shaqada ama aad shaqada ku laaban karto, inkastoo aad jiratay.
en: The purpose of partial sickness allowance is that you can continue to work or return to work even though you have fallen ill.

so: Marka hore kala sheekeyso dhaqtarkaada caafimaadka shaqada iyo shaqo-bixiyahaada inaad codsan karto qeyb kamid ah lacag maalmeedka jirada.
en: Discuss the possibility of applying for partial sickness allowance first with your occupational doctor and employer.

so: Dhaqtarkaada caafimaadka shaqada ayaa qiimeynaya inaad shaqo qeyb ahaan sameyn karto mudada aad jirantahay.
en: Your occupational doctor will evaluate whether or not you will be able to work part-time during your illness.

so: Marka aad codsaneyso qeybta kamidka ah lacag maalmeedka jirada codsiga ku lifaaq:
en: When you are applying for partial sickness allowance, append to your application:

so: nuqulka heshiiska aad la gashay shaqo-bixiyahaada ee aad uga heshiiseen qeyb ahaanta shaqada ee ku meelgaarka ah.
en: a copy of an agreement you have made with your employer, specifying that you will work part-time for a fixed term.

so: Heshiiska waa inay ku qoran yihiin nidaamka waqtiga shaqada iyo mushaarka.
en: The agreement must specify your working hours and salary.

so: cadeynta mushaarkaada mudo 6 bilood ah kahor jirashadaada haddii waxa ku soo galay ay kordheen
en: a salary certificate for 6 months before falling ill, if your income has grown

so: Lacagta jiranaanta qayb ahaaneed waa in la dalbadaa 2 bilood gudohoon laga bilaabo markii ay bilaabatay shaqada saacadaha gaaban.
en: Partial sickness allowance must be applied for within 2 months of starting part-time work.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraada ah oo la xirrira lacagta qayb shaqaynta jirada waxaad ka heleysaa bogga internetka ee Kelada.
en: You can find out more about partial sickness allowance on Kela's website.

so: Dawooyinka aan warqada dhakhtarka u baahnayn (itsehoitolääke).
en: Self-care medication (itsehoitolääke) can be bought without a doctor's prescription.

so: Daawooyinka ruuxu soogadan karo bilaa dhaqtarka inta badan waa xanuun baabi'iye waxaad soo ibsan kartaa warqada dhakhtarka la'aanteed.
en: For example, most painkillers are regarded as self-care medication.

so: Badi daawooyinka waxaad u baahanaysaa in dhakhtar kuu qoro (lääkemääräys), ka hor intii aad soo iibsanin.
en: However, for many medicines you will need a prescription (lääkemääräys) before you can buy them.

so: Tusaale ahaan dawooyinka infakshinka lagu daaweeyo waxay u baahan yihiin warqad dhakhtar.
en: Antibiotics, for example, are prescription drugs.

so: Daawo waxaa qora dhakhtarka.
en: A prescription is written by a doctor.

so: Sidoo kale daawooyinka qaar kamid ah waxaa qori kara kalkaalisada caafimaadka.
en: Also part of the nurses are allowed to prescribe certain medicines.

so: Haddii aad qabto xanuunada waqtiga dheer ah, horay u qaado rajeetadii hore markii aad dhakhtarka la kulmeysid, markaas dhakhtarku wuu tixgelinayaa markii uu warqada daawada kuu qorayo.
en: If you have a long-term illness, take your old prescriptions to the doctor's surgery, and the doctor will take them into account when writing a new one.

so: Haddii uu dhakhtarku kuugu qoray dawada qaabka elektrooniga ah(sähköinen resepti). Dawooyinka waxaad doonan kartaa warqad la'aan.
en: If the doctor gives you an electronic prescription (sähköinen resepti), you can buy your medication at the pharmacy without a printed prescription.

so: Warqada daawadu waxay shaqaynaysaa labo sano, markii laga bilaabo maalintii la qoray.
en: A prescription is valid for two years from the date it was written.

so: Haddii aad haysato warqad daawo oo dalka dibadiisa lagaaga soo qoray, dalka Finland kama shaqaynayso.
en: If you have a prescription that you have acquired abroad, it is not valid in Finland.

so: Waxaa ka baxsan rijeetooyinka laga soo qoray wadan kale oo ka mid ah wadamada Waqooyiga Yurub iyo yurubiyaanka daawadey qoreen. Kuwaas Finland way ka shaqaynayaan.
en: Prescriptions that have been written in another Nordic country and EU cross-border prescriptions are an exception and are valid in Finland.

so: Daawooyinka ay yurubiyaanka qoreen waa inaad si gaar ah u weydiisaa dhakhtarka.
en: You must specifically ask for an EU cross-border prescription from your doctor.

so: Yurubiyaanka daawooyin waxaa qori kara oo keliya wadamada EU-ga ama Eta-ga ama Switzerland ku xirfadoodu tahay ama ku shaqeeya cilmiga caafimaadka heystana shatiga qorista daawooyinka.
en: Health care specialists who work in an EU or EEA country or Switzerland and are entitled to prescribe medicines are allowed to issue EU cross-border prescriptions.

so: Baakadka daawada waxaa lagu calaamadeeyey maalinta ugu dambeeya oo la isticmaali karo.
en: The product's use-by date is indicated on the medicine package.

so: Haddii daawadu ay duqowdo, lama isticmaali karo.
en: If the medicine is out-of-date, it should not be used.

so: Ha tuurin daawooyinka dhacay, balse mar walba u celi farmashiga (apteekki), sababtoo ah waa haraa dhibaato leh.
en: Do not throw away old medicines; instead, always take them to the pharmacy (apteekki), because they are hazardous waste.

so: Xagee daawooyinka laga heli karaa?
en: Where do I get medicine from?

so: Daawooyinka waxaa laga soo iibsan karaa farmashiga.
en: You can buy medicine from pharmacies.

so: Sidoo kale farmashiyeyaasha yar yar iyo baraha adeega farmashiyeyaasha iyo sidoo kale adeega internetka oo ka mid ah adeegyada farmashiga.
en: Branch pharmacies, pharmacy service points and pharmacy online services are all a part of a pharmacy's services.

so: Dalka Finland daawooyinka laguma iibin karo meelo kale.
en: In Finland, by law, medicine cannot be sold elsewhere.

so: Vitamiinada iyo dawooyinka dhirta waxaa lagu iibiyaa dukaamada.
en: Vitamins and biodynamic products are also sold in grocery shops.

so: Farmashiyeyaashu waxay sida badan furan yihiin subaxdii ilaa galabtii.
en: Pharmacies are usually open from morning until evening.

so: Magaaloyinka waaweyn waxaa dhici kara inay jiraan farmashiyeyaal furan goor dambe habeenkii.
en: In larger cities there may be pharmacies that are open later at night.

so: Bogga internetka ee Ururka farshiyeleyda (Apteekkariliitto) waxaad ka raadin kartaa macluumaadka la xiriiraa farmashiyeyaasha magaaladaada iyo waqtiyada ay furan yihiin.
en: You can find information about the pharmacies in your locality and their opening times on the website of the Association of Finnish Pharmacies (Apteekkariliitto).

so: Waxaa suurtogal ah in markii aad farmashiga tagto aad dawadii laguu soo qoray ku badalato daawo kale oo ka raqiisan, haddii labada dawo maadooyinka dawada ah oo ku jira ay isku mid yihiin.
en: At a pharmacy, you can exchange medication that has been prescribed for you for another cheaper medicine, if the effective substance is the same in both.

so: Shaqaalaha farmashiga ayaa macaamiisha u sheega haddii ay jirto dawo la mid ah oo ka qiimo jaban.
en: The pharmacy staff will tell customers if there is a cheaper option available.

so: Magdhawga ay Keladu ka bixiso dawooyinka
en: Kela reimbursements for medicine

so: Haddii aad ku jirto xayndaabka caymiska jira ee Finnishka (sairausvakuutus), xafiiska caymiska hawlgabka qaranka (Kela) ayaa bixinaya qayb kamida qiimada dawada.
en: If you are covered by Finnish national health insurance (sairausvakuutus), the Social Insurance Institution of Finland (Kela) pays a part of the price of many medicines.

so: Keladu wax magdhaw ah kama bixinayso dawooyinka aad warqad la'aanta ku iibsaneyso .
en: Reimbursement is not given for medicine that is bought without a prescription.

so: Magdhowga waxad heli kartaa kadib markaa ay kuu buuxsanto intahore ee qofku isagu ka mas'uulka yahay (alkuomavastuu) intaasi waxay buuxsamaysaa marka ad dawooyinka la magdhabayo ad ku isticmaasho 50 euro sanadkii.
en: You cannot get reimbursement until you have met the initial deductible (alkuomavastuu), in other words, you have bought reimbursable medicines worth more than EUR 50 per year.

so: Qaybta qofku ka mas'uul yahay inuu iska bixiyo ee hore ma khusayso dawooyinka dadka 18 sano ka yar.
en: The initial deductible does not apply to persons under 18 years of age.

so: Lacagta magdhawga waxaa laga jarayaa qiimaha daawada ee aad siineysid farmashiga.
en: The reimbursement is deducted from the price of the medicine at the cash desk.

so: Sidoo kale magdhawga dib ayaa foom loogu dalban karaa.
en: You can also apply for the reimbursement afterwards by filling in the appropriate form.

so: Ku lifaaq foomka dalabka xisaabta daawo iibsiga aad farmashiga ka heleysid iyo rasiidka ay ku siisay qasnadii aad lacagta ka dhiibtay.
en: Attach to the form the calculation of the medicine purchase given to you at the pharmacy and the sales receipt.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan, yaa ku jira xayndaabka caymiska jirada ee Finland, waxaad ka heleysaa InfoFinlandi bogga Badbaada Bulshada ee Finland.
en: For more information about who is covered by Finnish national health insurance, go to the InfoFinland web page Finnish social security.

so: Dawooyinka qaarkood isticmaal ahaan waad ka soo qaadan kartaa dalka Finlan dibadiisa.
en: You are allowed to bring some medicines to Finland with you from abroad for your personal use.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee keenitaanka waxaa la socda xadeymo.
en: There are, however, restrictions on the imports of medicines.

so: Xadeymahaad waxaa saameyn ku yeelanaya, dawo noocee ah ay su'aashu tahay iyo wadankee ayaad daawada kala imaanaysaa.
en: These restrictions depend on what kind of medication it is and the country from which it is brought to Finland.

so: Sidoo kale waa inaad awood u leedahay inaad ku cadayso, warqada dhakhtarka ama shahaado dhakhtar kuu soo qoray, in dawada loogu talogalay isticmaalkaaga.
en: In addition, you must be able to prove with a prescription or medical certificate, for example, that the medicine is intended for your personal use.

so: Inta aadan daawada la imaadka Finland, baar xadeynta daawada ee dalka Finland.
en: Please find out about any restrictions before bringing medicine to Finland.

so: Sidoo kale ii baar xadeynta haddii aad dooneysid inaad daawo dibada ka dalbato oo boosto ahaan laguugu soo diro dalka Finalnd.
en: You also need to find out about restrictions, if you want to order medicine by post to Finland.

so: Wadamada Aaggga Dhaqaalaha Reer Yurub waxaad kasoo qaadan kartaa intaad shakhsi ahaan u isticmaaleysid, oo u dhiganta daawada aad isticmaali kartid hal sano.
en: You are allowed to bring medication with you from an EEA member state for personal use in the amount that corresponds to one year's use.

so: Boosto ahaan waxaa wadamada aaga dhaqaalaha yurub ugu dalban kartaa qadar daawo ah oo la isticmaali karo ugu badnaan sadex bilood.
en: By post, you can order medication from countries within the EEA in the amount that corresponds to no more than three months' use.

so: Wadamada Aaga Dhaqaalaha Reer Yurub dibadooda waxaad kala imaan kartaa oo Finland la soo geli kartaa qadar daawo ah oo loogu talogalay isticmaal shakhsiyadeed, una dhiganta wax la isticmaali karo mudo sadex bilood ah.
en: From outside the EEA, you can bring with you medication to Finland for personal use in the amount that corresponds to no more than three months' use.

so: Sida uu sharcigu qabo daawo boosto ahaan loogama dalban karo meel ka baxsan Aagga Dhaqaalaha Reer Yurub.
en: The law stipulates that medicine cannot be ordered by post from outside the EEA area.

so: Haddii daawada lagu tiriyo inay tahay maado maandooriye ah, waxay leedahay xadeyn adag.
en: If a medicine has been classified as a drug, stricter restrictions apply to it.

so: Haddii aadan hubin, in daawooyinka qaar la keeni karo Finland iyo in kale, wixii warar dheeraad ah weydii kastamka ama waaxda canshuuraha xuduudaha (Tulli).
en: If you are unsure whether a medicine can be brought to Finland, ask for more information at the Customs (Tulli).

so: Haddii aad dawooyinka dibada ka dalbanaysid, dawooyinka kharashkooda kuuma celinayo xafiiska caymiska hawlgabka qaranku (Kela).
en: If you order medicines from abroad, you are not entitled to reimbursement for them from the Social Insurance Institution of Finland (Kela).

so: Wadamada ku jira ururka midowga yurub dhexdooda waxaa ka shaqeeya farmashiyeyaal xagga internetka ah, kuwaas oo aad ka iibsan kartid dawooyinka aan u baahnayn in dhakhtar kuu qoro.Si kastaba ha ahaatee tukaamada dawooyinka ee internetka intooda badan waa sharci daro.
en: There are some online pharmacies in EU countries from which you can legally buy self-care medicine. However, the majority of the medicine stores on the internet are illegal.

so: Waxay kaloo caafimaadka ku ahaan karaan khatar inaad dawooyin ka iibsato tukaamada internetka oo sharci darada ah.
en: You may also put your health at risk if you buy medicine from an illegal medicine store on the internet.

so: Saamiga uurka waxaa ka iibsan kartaa farmashiyaha.
en: You can buy a pregnancy test at a pharmacy.

so: Dukaamada cuntada ee waaweyn xittaa waa iibiyaan saamiga uurka.
en: Large grocery shops also sell pregnancy tests.

so: Marka aad uur leedahay:
en: When you are pregnant:

so: U tag dhakhtar ka hor inta bisha 4aad ee uurku aysan dhammaanin.
en: See a doctor before the end of the 4th month of pregnancy.

so: Marka aad ogaato inaad uur leedahay, la xiriir rugta la talinta hooyada ama xarunta qoyska ee degmadaada.
en: When you realise that you are pregnant, contact the maternity clinic or family centre in your municipality.

so: Adeegyada rugta la talinta iyo xarunta qoyska waad isticmaali kartaa haddii aad guri degmo ku leedahay Finland.
en: You can use the services of a maternity clinic or family centre if you have a municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinland Guri degmo ee gudaha Finland.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Dadka megangelyo-doonka ah xittaa waa isticmaali karaan adeegyada rugta la talinta hooyada.
en: Asylum seekers can also use the services of a maternity clinic.

so: Adeegyada magaalooyinka qaarkood xittaa waad isticmaali kartaa, haddii aadan Finland sharci ku joogin.
en: In some cities, you can also use the services of a maternity clinic even if you are in Finland without a residence permit.

so: Kalkaalisada caafimaadka ee rugta la talinta joogta ayaa la soconeysa caafimaadkaada iyo caafimaadka cunuggaada.
en: At the maternity clinic, a nurse will monitor your health and the baby's health.

so: Rugta la talinta ayaad ka heleysaa tilaamo loogu talagalay uur iyo dhalmo ammaan ah.
en: The maternity clinic will give you information for safety during the pregnancy and childbirth.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale ka heleysaa macluumaadyo muhiim ah oo ku saabsan adeegyada Finland ka jira ee loogu talagalay qoysaska carruurta leh.
en: You will also receive information about the services that are available for families with children in Finland.

so: Uma baahnid in aad adeegyada rugta la talinta lacag ka bixiso.
en: The services of the maternity clinic will be free of charge.

so: Labada waalid ee cunugga yar waa lagu soo dhoweynayaa rugta la talinta.
en: Both parents of the baby are welcome to the clinic.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso xittaa waxaad u soo wadan kartaa qof ku caawiya.
en: If you want, you can also invite a support person for your appointments.

so: Haddii aad turjubaad u baahan tahay, kalkaalisada rugta la talinta ayaa turjubaan u dalbeysa kulanka.
en: If you need an interpreter, the nurse can invite an interpreter to join your appointments. The interpreter must be an adult.

so: U tag dhakhtarka rugta la talinta ka hor inta aysan bisha 4aad ee uurku dhamaanin.
en: See a maternity doctor clinic before the end of the 4th month of pregnancy.

so: Inta badan waxaad dhakhtarka ballan ka samaysan kartaa adigoo soo maraya rugta talinta hooyada.
en: You can usually book an appointment with the doctor through the maternity clinic.

so: Marka aad baaritaanka dhakhtarka tagto, shahaadada uurka ayaad heleysaa.
en: When you see the doctor for an examination, you will receive a certificate of pregnancy.

so: Shahaadadan waxaad u baahantahay marka aad shaqo-bixiyahaada ka codsaneyso fasaxa hooyanimada.
en: You will need the certificate if you apply to your employer for maternity leave.

so: Shahaadada waxaad sidoo kale u baahan tahay haddii aad Kelada ka codsaneyso caawimaadda hooyanimada iyo lacagta hooyanimada.
en: You will also need the certificate if you apply for a maternity grant (äitiysavustus) and maternity allowance (äitiysraha) from the Social Insurance Institution of Finland (Kela).

so: Faahfahainta dheeraadka ah ee manfacyada ka aqri bogga InfoFinland Kaalmaynta hooyada uurka leh.
en: Find out more about these benefits on the InfoFinland page Support for pregnant women.

so: Bogga Ammaanka bulsho ee Finland waxaa lagu sheegayaa qofka xaqa u leh manfaycada Kelada.
en: The page Finnish social security explains who has a right to Kela benefits.

so: Finland waxaa xittaa ku yaal rugo la talinta hooyada ah oo gaar loo leeyahay.
en: There are also private maternity clinics in Finland.

so: Ku daro xisaabta in adeegyada caafimaadka ee gaarka loo leeyahay ay lacag yihiin.
en: Please take into account the fact that private health care services are subject to a charge.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri Adeega caafimaadka ee Finland.
en: Read more on the page Health services in Finland.

so: Gudniinka qodban iyo uurka
en: Genital mutilation and pregnancy

so: Haddii laguugu sameeyay gudbiinka qodban, waxaa laguugu sameyn karaa qalliinka furista.
en: If you have been subjected to genital mutilation, a surgical opening operation can be done for you.

so: Waxay fududeysaa baaritaanka mudada aad uurka leedahay.
en: It will ease examinations during pregnancy.

so: Waxaa sidoo kale kuu sahlan in aad dhasho.
en: It will also make it easier for you to give birth.

so: Qalliinka furista ah waxaa la sameyn karaa uurka ka hor, uurka dhexdiisa ama marka la dhalayo.
en: The opening operation can also be performed before you become pregnant, during mid-pregnancy or during childbirth.

so: Kalkaalisada caafimaadka ee rugta latalinta ayaa ku weydiinaysa in gudniinka qodban laguu sameeyay iyo in kale.
en: The maternity clinic nurse will ask you whether you have been subjected to genital mutilation.

so: Waa muhiim in aad arrintan u sheegtaan, si kalkaalisada caafimaadku ay u ogaato oo ay qalliinka furista kuugu dirto.
en: It is very important to tell her about it so that she can refer you to an opening operation.

so: Finland inta badan dumarku waxay ku dhalaan isbitaalka.
en: In Finland, women usually give birth in a hospital.

so: Weydii rugta la talinta isbitaalka aad ku dhaleyso.
en: Ask the maternity clinic which hospital you need to go to give birth.

so: Haddii aad leedahay Guri degmo ee gudaha Finland, dhalmadu kharash badan kugu noqonmeyso.
en: If you have a municipality of residence in Finland, childbirth will not cost much.

so: Waalidka kale ee ilmaha wuxuu qeyb ka noqon karaa dhalmada.
en: The other parent of the baby can be present during the birth.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso waxaad soo wadan kartaa saaxiib ama qof ehel ah.
en: If you want, you can also invite another relative or friend to join you.

so: Finland inta badan waxay hooyooyinku ka dhalaan hoos.
en: Most mothers in Finland give birth the traditional way.

so: Waa habka ugu ammaanka badan.
en: It is usually the safest way.

so: Haddii aysan sidani suurtagal aheyn, dhakhatar ayaa go'aan ka gaaraya in ilmaha lagu soo qalo.
en: If this is not possible, the doctor will make a decision about performing a C-section.

so: Haddii aad ka baqaneyso dhalmada, kala hadal rugta la talinta.
en: If you are afraid of childbirth, mention it at the maternity clinic.

so: Cabsida waxaa caawimaad looga heli karaa tusaale ahaan bolikiliinikada cabsida dhalmada.
en: Help can be given for your fear, for example, at the Fear of Childbirth Outpatient Clinic (synnytyspelkopoliklinikka).

so: Inta badan dhalmada ka dib waxaa ilmaha yar la joogeysaa isbitaalka dhowr maalmood.
en: After childbirth, you will usually spend a few days at the hospital with the baby.

so: Waalidka kale ama caawiye kale ayaa isbitaalka maalinta dhan kula joogi kara si uu kuu caawiyo.
en: The other parent or another support person can be with you at the hospital, helping you throughout the day.

so: Haddii aad dhaleyso cunuggi kuugu horeeyay caawiyahaadu wuxuu inta badan kula joogi karaa isbitaalka xittaa habeenki.
en: If you are giving birth to your first child, the support person can usually also spend the nights at the hospital with you.

so: Marka aad isbitaalka aadeyso, ilmaha yar u sii qaad dhar diiran oo aad ku huwiso inta aadan safarka guriga ku sii jirto.
en: When you go to the hospital, bring along some clothes for the baby that are warm enough for the journey home.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso in aad ilmaha guriga ku heyso baabuur, waxaad u baahan tahay in baabuurka la saaro weelka ammaanka ee ilamaha lagu qaado.
en: If you plan to take your baby home by car, you will need a baby car seat (turvakaukalo).

so: Wakhtiga saxda ah ee la dhalayo horay looma sii ogaan karo.
en: It is not possible to know the exact time of birth in advance.

so: Sidaas darteed ayeey u adag tahay in turjubaan la helo xilliga dhalmada.
en: For this reason, it may be difficult to book an interpreter for the birth.

so: Xarumaha turjubaanada qaarkood ayaa heegan ah dhammaadka todobaadka, habeenki iyo saqda dhexe.
en: Some interpreter agencies are on call at weekends, in evenings and at nights.

so: Rugta latalinta ayaad ka heleysaa macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan adeegyada turjubaanka ee degmadaada.
en: You can find out more about interpreter services in your municipality at your maternity clinic.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan adeegyada turjubaanka ka aqri bogga InfoFinland Turjubaan ma u baahan tahay?
en: Read more about interpreter services on the InfoFinland page Do you need an interpreter?

so: Marka uu ilmuhu dhasho
en: After the child is born

so: Bogga Finland markii uu ilmuhu dhasho waxaa ku jiro macluumaad muhiim ah oo ku saabsan arrimaha ay tahay in aad sameyso dhalashada cunugga ka dib.
en: The page When a child is born in Finland contains important information on practical matters that you need to handle after the child is born.

so: Bogga waxaa ku jira tusaale ahaan macluumaad ku saabsan ka diiwaangelinta cunugga nidaamka macluumaadka dadka, sharciga magaca ee Finland iyo ammaanka bulsho ee cunugga.
en: There is information about, for example, registering the children in the Population Information System, the Finnish Act on Forenames and Surnames and the child's social security.

so: Caawimaadda lagu helo ilmaha yar
en: Help with the baby

so: Haddii isu aragto in aadan caawimaad la'aan kaligaa ku filneyn ilmaha yar, waxaad xannaneynta ilmaha yar ku baran kartaa guri horaadka.
en: If you feel that you cannot cope alone with the baby, you can practise caring for the baby at a Mother and Child Home.

so: Degmadaada ayaad uga baahan tahay in ay kuu gudbiyaan guri horaadka.
en: You need a referral from your municipality for the Mother and Child Home.

so: Dalka Finland waxaa macquul ah inaad ilmaha iska soo tuurto markii uu uurku bilowga yahay ayadoo la eegayo xaaladahaan soo socda:
en: In Finland, it is possible to terminate a pregnancy in the early stages in the following situations:

so: haddii dhalmadu ay caafimaadkaaga khatar ku noqon karto
en: if childbirth would pose a danger to your health

so: haddii aad ka yar tahay 17 sano ama aad ka weyn tahay 40 sano
en: if you are younger than 17 or older than 40

so: haddii aad horay u dhashay afar carruur
en: if you have already given birth to four children

so: haddii aadn ilmaha xanaaneyn karin jiro awgeed.
en: if you are unable to take care of the child due to an illness.

so: Waxaa kaloo sabab u noqon kara ilma iska soo tuurka (abortti), in dhalmada ilmaha ama daryeelkooda ay noloshaada ku tahay culays weyn oo la dareemi karo.
en: It is sufficient reason for an abortion (abortti) if giving birth to or taking care of the child would be a considerable strain in your life situation.

so: Ficliyan sabab waxaa u iska soo tuurida waxaa sabab u noqon kara mid ka mid ah arimaha soo socda:
en: In practice, one of the following can be considered sufficient reason:

so: Dumarku ayagaa xaq u leh inay go'aan ka gaaraan inay ilmaha iska soo ridaan.
en: A woman has the right to decide herself whether she wants to ask for an abortion.

so: Lamaanuhu wuu ka qayb gali karaa go'aan gaarida haddii, ay haweeneydu dooneyso inay tixgeliso fikradiisa.
en: Her partner can participate in the decision-making, if she wants to take his opinion into account.

so: Haddii aadan qaan gaarin oo aad dooneysid inaad ilmaha iska soo rido, wax ruqsad ah ugama baahnid waalidiintaada.
en: If you are a minor and wish to ask for an abortion, you do not need your parents' permission for it.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee inta badan waxaa wanaagsan inaad waalidinta kala hadasho.
en: Nevertheless, it is often good to talk about it with your parents.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee haddii aadan dooneyn inaad sidaas samaysid, shaqaalaha daryeelka caafimaadku waa xirfadleyaal sir xajintu waajib ku tahay.
en: If you choose not to, the health care professionals are under an obligation of secrecy.

so: Haddii ay jiraan sababo culus oo in la tixgeliyo mudan waqtigaas la soo sheegay kabacdi waa la sameyn karaa soo ridida, laakiin markaas waxaad u baahantahay ruqsada gaarka ah ee hay'ada ruqsada iyo komeerka u qaabilsan qaybaha caafimaadka iyo arrimaha bulshada (Valvira).
en: If there is an extremely strong reason, it can be performed later, but a special permit granted by Valvira, the National Supervisory Authority for Welfare and Health (Valvira) is then required.

so: Ruqsada hay'ada ruqsooyinka iyo kormeerka sidoo kale waxaad u baahantahay markii soo ridida loo sameynyo jiro xun ama curyaanimo daran oo ilmaha caloosha kujira ay qabaan awgeed.
en: Valvira's permission is also required if the abortion is performed due to the serious illness or impairment of the foetus.

so: Weydii wixii dheeraad ah dhakhtarka rugtaada caafimaadka (terveysasema).
en: Ask a doctor at your health centre (terveysasema) for more information.

so: Haddii aad dooneysid inaad ilmaha iska soo rido, sida ugu dhaqsaha badan ula xiriir rugta caafimaadka ee xaafadaada, dhakhtarkana waqti ka qabso.
en: If you wish to terminate a pregnancy, contact the health centre of your own area as soon as possible and make a doctor's appointment.

so: Sidoo kale waxaad waqti ka qabsan kartaa dhakhtarka gaarka loo leeyahay, laakiin markii aad waqtiga ka qabsaneysid iska hubi in dhakhtarku haysto ruqsada hay'adda ruqsooyinka iyo kormeerida (Valvira) go'aan ka gaarida soo ridida awgeed.
en: You can also make an appointment with a private doctor, but when you make it, make sure that the doctor has a licence granted by Valvira for issuing a statement for the abortion.

so: Haddii aad dooneysid waxaad la kulanka dhakhtarka u wadan kartaa lammaanahaaga.
en: If you wish, you can take your partner along to the see the doctor.

so: Dhakhtarku wuxuu kuu qoryaa warqad uu kuugu diraayo isbitaalka soo riditaanka lagu samaynayo.
en: The doctor will write you a referral to the hospital where the abortion will be performed.

so: Kalkaaliyaasha caafimaadka iyo dhakhaatiirta ayaa isbitaalka kugula sheekaysanaya.
en: At the hospital, a nurse and doctor will discuss the matter with you.

so: Si wada jir ah ayaad go'aan uga gaareysaan qaabka uurka loo joojinayo, arintaan waxaa saameyn ku yeelanaya inta uurku uu jiray iyo adiga ra'yigaaga.
en: Together you will decide on the way that the pregnancy will be terminated. This is affected by the length of the pregnancy and your own opinion.

so: Uurka waxaa lagu joojiyaa dawo ama soo xaaqid (kaavinta).
en: Abortion is performed either with medication or by surgery (kaavinta).

so: Sida caadiga soo xaaaqida waxaa lagu sameeyaa caadi ahaan suuxin, markaas kadibna waa in isbitaalka la joogo dhawr saacadood.
en: Surgery is usually performed under anaesthesia, after which you will have to stay at the hospital for a few hours.

so: Haddii joojinta uurka daawo loo isticmaalayo, daawada waxaa laga siyaa makaanka inta u dhaxaysa 1-3 maalmood, markaas ilmogaleenku bilaabayaa inu isku soo ururo isla markaasna uu faaruqo.
en: If the abortion is performed with medication, the drugs are dosed every 1-3 days via the vagina, causing the womb to contract and shed its lining together with the foetus.

so: Usii diyaar garow inaad u baahantahay dawooyinka xanuunka baabi'iya, markii ilmagaleenku uu is qabsanayo hadba.
en: Be prepared to take some painkillers when the womb begins to contract.

so: Mar marka qaarkood daawooyinka ka sokow waxaa loo baahan yahay soo xaaqid.
en: Sometimes, in addition to drugs, surgery is also required.

so: Markii aad gaarto go'aanka aborshinka, waxaad cawinaad xagga niyada ah ka heleysaa tusaale ahaan kalkaalisada iyo dhakhtarka rugta caafimaadka.
en: When making a decision about abortion, you will be supported, for example, by the health centre's nurse or doctor.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah, oo la xiriira meelaha aad cawinaadka ka heli karto xaalada adag ee aad ku jirto awgeed waa InfoFinlandi bogga Caafimaadka dhimirka.
en: For more information about places where you can get help in a challenging situation in life, go to the InfoFinland web page Mental health.

so: Sharciga ayaa lagu xaqiijiyey adeegyada caafimaadka ee bukaanka.
en: The rights of a health service customer are protected by law.

so: Xuquuqda bukaanku waxay taabanaysaa dhamaan adeegayada caafimaad kuwa guud iyo kuwa gaarka loo leeyahay tusaale ahaan adeegyada caafimaadka ee guryaha dadka da'da ah iyo curyaamiinta.
en: These rights apply to both public and private services, as well as the health services provided by homes for the elderly and services for the disabled.

so: Haddii aad degaan rasmi ah (kotikunta) Finland ku leedahay, waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad isticmaasho adeegyada guud ee caafimaadka.
en: If you have a municipality of residence (kotikunta) in Finland, you are entitled to use public health services.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa InfoFinlandi bogga Degan Degmo ku yaalo Finland.
en: You can find more information on the InfoFinland web page Municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Haddii aad u baahan tahay daweyn ama daryeel deg deg ah, tusaale ahaan haddii aad shil gasho, Waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad haddiiba cawinaad ka heshid xarunta caafimaadka ama isbitaalka kuugu dhaw oo deeganka ah.
en: If you are in need of urgent care, for example, after being in an accident, you have the right to immediate help at the nearest health centre's or hospital's emergency clinic.

so: Haddii aadan degaan rasmi ah Finland ku lahayn, ama aadan sababo kale awgood aadan isticmaali karin adeegayada guud ee caafimaadka dalka Finland, waa inaad iska bixiso adeegyadaas caafimaad oo ku salaysan qiimaha dhabta ah.
en: If you have no municipality of residence in Finland, or you have no other grounds for the right to use public health services in Finland, you must pay the price for these health services in accordance with their actual costs.

so: Haddii aad Finland dagaan rasmi ah ku leedahay, waxaad isticmaali kartaa adeegyada caafimaad ee ay bixiso degmadaadu.
en: If you have a municipality of residence in Finland, you are entitled to use the public health services of your own municipality.

so: Maalmaha shaqada xarunta caafimaadku waa inay ka jawaabto telefoonada bukaanada ama ay furan tahay si bukaanadu ay u tagaan.
en: On weekdays during office hours, health centres must answer patients' phone calls or be open to receive patients.

so: Haddii loo baahdo, waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad tagtid rugta caamimaadka sadex maalmood oo kuwa shaqada ah gudahood laga bilaabo maalintii aad soo wacday.
en: If the situation demands it, you have the right to a visit to a health centre within three weekdays of requesting an appointment.

so: Sidoo kale rugta caafimaadku bilowdo wax ka qabashada daryeelka aan deg degta ahayn ugu dambayn sadex bilood gudahood.
en: Health centres are also obliged to begin non-urgent treatment within three months at the latest.

so: Isbitaalka waxaad ku tagi kartaa warqad uu dhakhtar kuu qoray.
en: Hospitals admit patients with a doctor's referral.

so: Isbitaalku waa inuu qiimeeyo baaahidaada daryeelka sadex usbuuc gudahood laga bilaabo markii ay gaartay warqadii dhakhtarku kuu qoray.
en: Hospitals must estimate the need for treatment within three weeks of the arrival of the doctor's referral to the hospital.

so: Haddii la xaqiijiyo in bukaanku u baahan yahay daryeel caafimaad, daryeelka ama daweynta waa in labilaabo ugu dambayn lix bilood gudahoo, laga bilaabo maalintii la qiimeeyey baahida daryeelka caafimaadka.
en: If it is discovered that the patient requires hospital care, treatment must be begun at the latest within six months from the assessment of the need for care.

so: Haddii xarunta caafimaadku ama isbitaalku uusan awoodin inuu bukaanka daryeelo ama daweeyo waqtiga loo qabtay, waa in bukaanka daryeel looga agaasimo meel kale.
en: If the patient's own health centre or hospital cannot treat the patient within the prescribed time, the health centre or hospital must arrange an opportunity for the patient to receive treatment elsewhere.

so: Bukaanka kharash dheeraad ah ugama imaan karo daryeelka loo agaasimayo.
en: No extra cost for this must be incurred for the patient.

so: Bukaanku wuxuu xaq u leeyahay:
en: The patient has the right to:

so: loola dhaqmo si wanaagsan: waa in la xushmeeyo qiimaha bini'aadanimada bukaanka, diintiisa iyo shakhsiyadkiisa
en: be treated well by the staff: the patient's human dignity, convictions and privacy must be respected

so: waxaa ka mid ha, in bukaanka luuqadiisa iyo dhaqankiisa la tixgeliyo hadba sida ay suurtogal u noqonayso
en: his/her language and culture being taken into account as far as possible

so: waxa ka mid ah, in mar walba oo macquul ah bukaanka la waydiiyo ogolaanshihiisa inta aan la bilabin daryeelka ama daaweynta
en: be asked for his/her permission whenever possible before a treatment is begun

so: loo sheego xaalada caafimaadkiisa, daweyntu inta ay la eg'tahay, waxyaabaha khatarta keeni kara iyo hababka kala duwan ee loo daweyn karo oo la kala dooran karo
en: information about his/her state of health, scope of treatment, risk factors and alternatives to the treatment

so: inuu arki karo waraaqihiisa caafimaadka iyo inuu sixi karo haddii uu khladaad ku arko
en: check his/her own details in patient reports and to correct them, when necessary

so: og yahay, waqtiga uu daryeelka helayo, haddii ay tahay in saf loo galo
en: know when he/she will receive treatment if there is a waiting list

so: inuu cabasho ka sameeyo xarunta daweynta, haddii bukaanku uusan ku qanacsanayn
en: make a complaint to the institution, if he/she is dissatisfied

so: haddii loo baahdo cawinaad ka helo wakiilka arimaha bukaanka (potilasasiamies)
en: receive help from a patient ombudsman (potilasasiamies) when necessary

so: Waa la tixgelinayaa ra'yiga caruurta bukaanka ah, haddii uu ilmuhu si wanaagsan uga koray dhanka soo bandhiga fikradiisa.
en: The opinion of a child patient will be taken into account if the child is sufficiently mature to express an opinion.

so: Arintan waxaa qiimeynaya dhakhtarka ama shaqaale xirfad u leh.
en: A doctor or another professional will make this assessment.

so: Waalidiinta ilmaha ama dadka xanaaneeya ma diidi karaan daweynta, haddii ilmaha aan qaan gaarka ahayn uu rabo daweyta.
en: A child's parents or guardians cannot refuse treatment if an underage child needs it.

so: U sinaanta adeegyada caafimaadka
en: Equality in health services

so: Sida sharciga Finland qabo, dadku waa isku qiimo sharciga hortiisa.
en: According to the Finnish Constitution, all people are equal in the eyes of the law.

so: Qofna lama gelin karo sababo aan la aqbali karin la'aantood derajo ka duwan kuwa kale jinsi, da', asal, luqad, diin, caqiiqdo, fikrad, xaalad caafimaad, naafanimo ama sababo kale oo qofka la xiriiro dartood.
en: Without acceptable grounds, nobody can be placed in a different position based on their gender, age, origin, language, religion, beliefs, opinions, health, disability or other personal reason.

so: Finland waxaa sidoo kale ka jira sharciga isku qiimo ahaanshaha.
en: The Non-Discrimination Act is also in force in Finland.

so: Sharciga waxaa lagu dabaqaa waxyaabaha ay ka midka yihiin takoorka ku saleysan asalka meesha laga soo jeedo ee ka dhaca adeegyada guud iyo kuwa gaarka ah ee caafimaadka iyo sooshaalka.
en: The Act is applied to discrimination on the basis of origin in public and private social and health services, for example.

so: Wakiiladda sinaanta u dooda iyo gudiga takoorka iyo gudiga sinaanta u dooda ayaa ilaaliya inaan dadka loo takoorin asal ahaan meeshi ay ka soo jeedeen darteed.
en: The Non-Discrimination Ombudsman and the National Discrimination and Equality Tribunal ensure that nobody is discriminated against because of his or her ethnic background.

so: Dhamaan macaamiisha adeegyada caafimaadku waxay xaq u leeyihiin in si isku qiimo ah loola macaamilo takoor la'aan.
en: All health service clients have the right to equal treatment without discrimination.

so: Haddii aadan xaq u laheyn inaad isticmasho adeegyada caafimaadka shacabka waxaad xaq u leedahay in si isku qiimo ah laguugula macaamilo adeegyada caafimaadka gaarka loo leeyahay.
en: If you are not entitled to use public health services, you have the right to equal treatment in private health services.

so: Faquuqida iyo si xun ula dhaqanka adeegyada caafimaadka
en: Discrimination and unfair treatment in health services

so: Haddii aad dareemeysid, in si xun laguula dhaqmay adeegyada daryeelka caafimaadka, waxaad la xiriiri kartaa wakiilka arimaha bukaanka (potilasasiamies).
en: If you feel that you have been treated unfairly within health services, please contact the patient ombudsman (potilasasiamies).

so: Cawinaadka wakiilka arimaha bukaanka waxaa laga heli karaan dhamaan goobaha laga bixiyo adeegyada caafimaadka, tusaale ahaan xarumaha caafimaadka, isbitaalada, rugaha dhakhaatiirta ee gaarka loo leeyahay, guryaha dadka da'da ah iyo xarumaha dadka curyaaminnta ah lagu xanaaneeyo.
en: The help of the patient ombudsman is offered in all the places where health services are provided, for example at health centres, in hospitals, at private clinics, in homes for the elderly and institutions for the disabled.

so: Adeegayda waliilka arimaha bukaanku waa bilaash, Weydii telefanka ama cinwaanka wakiilka arimaha bukaanka armiha qaybta caafimaad eed markaas la macaamishay.
en: The services of a patient ombudsman are free. Ask for the contact information of the patient ombudsman responsible in the unit where you have been treated.

so: Wakiilka arimaha bukaanada wuxuu bukaanada ka caawiyaa xalinta arimaha muranada, sidoo kale wuxuu bixiyaa la talin iyo caawin, haddii aad rabtid inaad sameyso cabsho ama magdhaw ka dalbato waxyeelada bukaanka.
en: A patient ombudsman helps to resolve disputes and advises and assists if you want to make a complaint or apply for compensation for injury received during treatment.

so: Wakiilka arimaha bukaanadu wuxuu sidoo kale ogeysiyaa dhinacyada ay khuseyo xuquuqda uu leeyhay bukaanku wuxuuna kor u qaadaa meel marintooda.
en: The ombudsman also informs patients about their rights and promotes their implementation.

so: Haddii aad ka shakisan tahay in lagugu takooray adeegyada caafimaadka ee guud ama gaarka loo leeyahay sababo la xiriira asalkaaga awgoog, waxaad la xiriiri kartaa sidoo kale Wakiiladda sinaanta u dooda (yhdenvertaisuusvaltuutettu).
en: If you suspect that you have been discriminated against in public or private health services due to your ethnic background, please don't hesitate to contact the Non-Discrimination Ombudsman (yhdenvertaisuusvaltuutettu).

so: Adeegyada caafimaadka waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad ku hesho luuqadaha Finnishka iyo Swedishka.
en: You have the right to be served in Finnish and Swedish in health services.

so: Haddii aadan ku hadlin luuqadahaas aan soo sheeganay, dalka Finland gudihiisa waxaa suurtogal ah inaad hesho adeegyada turjumaanka oo luuqado faro ban oo kala duwan ah.
en: If you do not speak either of these languages, it is possible to receive interpreter services in very many different languages in Finland.

so: Xaaladaha qaarkood waxaa suurtogal ah in shaqaalaha xafiisyada dowladu ay turjumaan kuu dalbaan isla markaasna bixiyaan kharashka turjumaanka. Tani mar walba suurogal ma ahan.
en: In some situations, the authorities can book you an interpreter and pay for it, but this is not always possible.

so: Arintan horay u siiweydii shaqaalaha xafiisyada dawlada.
en: Ask your local authority about this beforehand.

so: Turjumaanka waxaa sidoo kale lagu sameyn karaa telefoon.
en: Interpretation can also be arranged over the phone.

so: Turjumaanku waa inuu ahaado qaan gaar, sidaas darteed ilmahaaga aan qaangaarin looma isticmaali karo turjumaan ahaan.
en: The interpreter must be an adult and therefore you cannot use your own child as interpreter, if he or she is a minor.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heli kartaa InfoFinlandi bogga Turjumaan ma u baahan tahay?
en: For more information, go to the InfoFinland web page Do you need an interpreter?.

so: Dalka Finland waxaa ku yaal ururo bukaaneed oo faro badan, kuwaas siiya macluumaad iyo la talin, dadka qaba cuduro cayiman.
en: There are many patient associations in Finland that offer information and advice for people with a specific illness.

so: Ururadaas bukaanka waxaad sidoo kale ka heli kartaa cawinaada dadka kale oo qaba cuduradaas iyo is dhaafiga ra'yiga.
en: You can also find peer support through these associations.

so: Daryeelka caafimaadka dadweynaha iyo kan gaarka loo leeyahay ee Finland waxaa laga bixiyaa adeegyo la xiriira ka hortagga uurka, cudurada haweenka, helitaanka marxaladda hore ee kansarka, caafimaadka galmada ee ragga, madhaleysnimada iyo cudurada galmada.
en: In Finland, both public and private health care provide services connected to contraception, gynaecology, early detection of cancer, male sexual health, infertility and sexually transmitted diseases.

so: Xaq miyaad u leedahay adeegyada caafimaadka dadweynaha?
en: Do you have a right to public health services?

so: Cinjirka waxaad ka gadan kartaa dukaamada, kaalimaha shidaalka, dukaamada sigaarka iibiya iyo farmashiyayaasha.
en: You can buy condoms in shops, petrol stations, kiosks and pharmacies.

so: Uma baahnid warqadda dhakhtarku qoro si aad u hesho.
en: A prescription is not needed.

so: Si aad u hesho ka hortagga uurka ee hormaaniga ah waxaad u baahan tahay in dhakhtar kuu qoro.
en: For hormonal contraceptives, you need a prescription from a doctor.

so: Qalabkan uurka looga hortago waa tusaale ahaan kaniiniyada e iyo kaniiniyada yaryar.
en: Such contraceptives include, for example, the pill and the minipill.

so: Farmashiyayaasha ayaa lagu iibiyaa.
en: They are sold at pharmacies.

so: Rugta caafimaadka ama xarunta dhakhtarka ee gaarka loo leeyahay ayaad ballan ka qabsan kartaa.
en: You can make an appointment at a health centre or a private clinic.

so: Dadka aan qaangaarin xittaa waxay ballan ka qabsan karaan dhakhtarka si ay u helaan daawooyinka ka hortagga uurka.
en: Underage persons can also make a doctor's appointment and get a prescription for contraceptives.

so: Waalidkaa ruqsad ugama baahnid si aad hesho hesho warqadda dhakhtarka.
en: You do not need parental permission for a prescription.

so: Degmooyinka qaarkood lacag la'aan ayeey dhallinyaradu ku helaan ka hortagga uurka.
en: In some municipalities, contraceptives are free for young people.

so: Rugta caafimaadka ayaad arrintan weydiin kartaa ama kalkaalisada caafimaadka ee dugsigaada.
en: You can ask your health centre or school nurse about it.

so: Haddii uu ka hortagga uurku shaqeyn waayo ama aad hilmaantay in aad ka hortag isticmaasho, waxaad farmashiyaha warqad dhatar la'aan ka gadan kartaa kaniiniga ka hortagga uurka galmada kaddib.
en: If your contraception fails or you forgot to use it, you can buy an emergency contraception pill from a pharmacy without a prescription.

so: Qaado kaniiniga sida ugu dhakhsaha badan galmada kaddib, ugu dambeyn 72 saacadood ka dib.
en: Take it as soon as possible after intercourse, at the latest after 72 hours.

so: Kaniiniyada qaarkood waxaa la qaadan karaa 120 saacadood galmada ka dib.
en: Some products can be taken within 120 hours of the intercourse.

so: Dhammaan dhakhaatiirka jooga rugta caafimaadku waxay sameeyaan baaritaanka cudurada haweenka.
en: All doctors at health centres can perform gynaecological examinations.

so: Weydii warar dheeraad ah rugtaada caafimaadka.
en: Ask for more information at your health centre.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso in ay dhakhtar dumar ah ku qaabisho, sheeg marka aad ballanta qabsaneyso.
en: If you want to see a female doctor, mention it when booking your appointment.

so: Haddii loo baahdo dhakhatarku wuxuu kuu qori karaa warqad uu kuugu gudbinayo bolikiliinikada dhakhtarka ku takhasuusan cudurada haweenka.
en: When necessary, the health centre doctor will give you a referral to a specialist at a gynaecology clinic.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale ballan ka qabsan kartaa dhakhtarka cudurada haweenka ee gaarka ah.
en: You can also make an appointment with a private gynaecologist.

so: Markaas adiga ayaa dooran kara dhakhtarka ku qaabilaya.
en: In that case, you can choose your doctor yourself.

so: Adeegyada dhakhaatiirka gaarka ah waxay macaamilka ugu kacaan lacag aad uga badan tan kale.
en: However, the services of private doctors are much more expensive for customers.

so: Finland waxaa dumarka jira da' cayiman oo la og yahay lagu sameeyaa baaritaan wadareed joogto ah.
en: In Finland, regular screenings are organised for women of a certain age.

so: Waxaa la isku dayayaa in wakhti hore la helo kansarka naasaha iyo kansarka marinka ilmaggaleenka.
en: The purpose is to find breast cancer and cervical cancer in the early stages.

so: Waxaad ballan ka qabsan kartaa dhakhtarka rugtaada caafimaadka.
en: You can make a doctor's appointment at your own health centre.

so: Waxaad codsan kartaa haddii aad dooneyso in aad hesho qaabilaadda dhakhtar nin ah.
en: You can request to see a male doctor if you wish.

so: Haddii loo baahdo dhakhatarku wuxuu kuu qori karaa warqad uu kuugu gudbinayo bolikiliinikada dhakhtarka ku takhasuusan cudurada habdhiska kaadida.
en: When necessary, the health centre doctor will give you a referral to a specialist at a urology clinic.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale ballan ka qasban kartaa xarunta dhakhtarka gaarka loo leeyahay.
en: You can also make an appointment at a private clinic.

so: Inta badan madhaleysnimada waa la daaweyn karaa.
en: Infertility is often treatable.

so: Madhaleysnimada waxaa qabi kara ninka ama naagta.
en: Infertility can be due to the man or the woman.

so: Mararka qaar looma helo sabab cilmiga caafimaadka ah.
en: Sometimes, a medical reason cannot be found for it.

so: Haddii aad joojisay ka hortagga uurka sannad kadibna aadan uur qaadin, ballan ka qabso rugta caafimaadka ama dhakhtarka cudurada haweenka ee gaarka ah.
en: If you stopped using contraception but pregnancy has not started after one year, make an appointment at a health centre or a private gynaecologist.

so: Waxaa wanaagsan in lammaanuhu ay isu raacaan qaabilaadda.
en: It is a good idea for the couple to go to the clinic together.

so: Dhakhtarka ayaa u qoraya warqadda gudbinta bolikiliinikada madhaleysnimada.
en: The doctor writes a referral for examinations at an infertility clinic.

so: Baaritaanka waxaa lagu ogaanayaa sababta uusan uurku u billaaban.
en: The examinations determine why pregnancy has not started.

so: Daaweynta madhaleysnimada waxaa bixiya kiliinikooyinka dadweynaha iyo kuwa gaarka loo leeyahay.
en: Infertility treatments are offered both by public and private clinics.

so: Xaq u lahaanshaha daaweynta madhaleysnimada ee adeegyada dadweynaha waxaa saameyn ku leh tusaale ahaan da'da naagta.
en: The right to infertility treatments in public health services depends on, for example, the woman's age.

so: Haddii aad ka shakiso in aad qabto cudurka galmada, waxaad ballan ka qabsan kartaa rugta caafimaadka ama xarunta dhakhtarka ee gaarka loo leeyahay.
en: If you suspect that you have a sexually transmitted disease, you can make a doctor's appointment at a health centre or private clinic.

so: Magaalooyinka qaarkood waxaa ku yaal bolikiliinikada cudurada galmada, halkaas oo cudurada lagu galmada lagu daweeyo.
en: Some cities have an STD clinic where sexually transmitted diseases are treated.

so: Isticmaalka cinjirka iyo waxyaabaha la isaga ilaaliyo galmada afka ayaa looga badbaadada cuduro badan oo dhinaca galmada ah.
en: Using a condom and dental dam will protect you from most sexually transmitted diseases.

so: Dadka dukumenti-laawayaasha ah iyo magangalyo-doonku xittaa waxay xaq u leeyihiin in ay daawo u helaan cudurada galmada.
en: Undocumented persons and asylum seeker also have the right to treatment for sexually transmitted diseases.

so: Haddii aad sharci la'aan ku joogto Finland waxaa laga dhici karta in aad daaweyn lacag ka bixiso.
en: However, if you are in Finland without a residence permit, you may have to pay for treatment.

so: Si fiican uga fikir in gudniinka loo baahan yahay.
en: Consider carefully whether circumcision is necessary.

so: Haddii uu wiilka jiro da' uu aragtidiisa ku sheegi karo, waa in isaga la weydiiyaa in uu doonayo gudniinka.
en: If the boy is old enough to express his opinion, he must be asked whether he consents to the operation.

so: Gudniinka lama sameyn karo haddii uu wiilku diido.
en: The circumcision must not be done if he opposes it.

so: Haddii uu wiilku leeyahay labo mas'uul, labada mas'uul waa in ay qoraal ku ogolaadaan gudniinka.
en: If the boy has two guardians, both must give written consent for the circumcision.

so: Haddii aysan jirin sabab dhinaca caafimaadka ah oo lagu sameeyo gudniinka, laguma sameyn karo gudniinka adeegyada caafimaadka ee dadweynaha.
en: If there is no medical reason for the circumcision, it cannot be done in public health services.

so: Markaas waa in aad adigu bixisaa kharashka gudniinka.
en: In that case, you must pay for the operation yourself.
