so: Dhakhtar oo kaliya ayaa gudniinka sameyn kara.
en: Only doctors can carry out circumcision.

so: Waa in lagu sameeyaa meel jeermisdilan.
en: It must be done in sterile conditions.

so: Dhakhtarku waa in uu ku dadaalaa yareynta xanuunka.
en: The doctor must provide pain relief.

so: Weydii wararka dheeraad ah oo gudniinka ku saabsan rugta latalinta, dhakhtarka rugta caafimaadka, kalkaalisada caafimaadka ee dugsiga ama dhakhtarka dugsiga.
en: You can ask for more information on circumcision from a maternity clinic, a doctor at a health centre, a school nurse or a school doctor.

so: Gudniinka qodban ee gabdhaha lagu sameeyo dembi ayuu ka yaha Finland.
en: Female genital mutilation is a crime in Finland.

so: Waxaa laga heli karaa ciqaab xabsiyeed sannado badan ah.
en: It can be punished with many years in prison.

so: Waxaa sidoo kale ah dembi in dalka dibaddiisa gabdhaha lagu soo sameeyo gudbiinka qodban.
en: It is also a crime to make a girl undergo genital mutilation abroad.

so: Haddii qalliin noocan ah laguugu sameeyay, waxaa laguugu sameyn karaa qalliinka furista.
en: If you have been through female genital mutilation, a surgical opening operation can be done for you.

so: Qalliin hagaajin ah xittaa in la sameeyo waa suurtagal.
en: Corrective surgery is also possible.

so: Goorma ayaa caawin loo baahan yahay?
en: When to seek help?

so: Cawinaada waxaa u baahan kara qof walba oo ay xaalado nololeed oo qalafsan la soo darsaan.
en: Anyone in a challenging situation in life can be in need of help.

so: Xaaladahaas oo kale waxay imaan karaan tusaale ahaan, marka wadan kale loo guuro, ay jiraan dhibaatin xagga goobta shaqada ah, shaqo la'aan dhacdo, dhibaato xagga qoyska ah ay jirto, furiin uu yimaado, geeri ehel ay timaado, jiro ama xaalado kale oo nolosha isbedel ku keenay ay jiraan.
en: Such situations may include, for example, moving to another country, problems at work, losing your job, family problems, divorce, the death of a loved one, illness or some other life change.

so: Sidoo kale arrimo aan xumeyn, sida dhalashada ilmahu, waxay nolosha u badeli kartaa si aad ah, taas oo sababta in loo baahdo cawinaad.
en: A positive event, such as the birth of a child, can also change your life so much that you need support in the new situation.

so: Mar marka qaarkood dareenka xun dib ayuu kaaga imaan karaa, kadib markii waqti ka soo wareego aragnimadii adkayd isla markaasna ay noloshu degto kadib.
en: Sometimes you only start to feel bad afterwards, when some time has passed after the difficult experience and your life has settled.

so: Wey habboon tahay inaad caawimo raadsado, markaad dareento siyaabahan:
en: You should seek help if you have the following symptoms:

so: inaadan awoodeyn shaqo inaad aado dadkana aadan la kulmin
en: you do not feel like going to work or meeting people

so: astaamo jiro jirka, oon haddana xal loogu helin cilmiga caafimaadka
en: physical symptoms with no medical reasons

so: isticmaalka mukhaadaraadka iyo qamriga ood siyaadsatey
en: your use of alcohol or other intoxicants has increased

so: Ma ahan wax aan caadi ahayn inaad caawinaad la xiriirta caafimaadka dhimirka dalbatid.
en: It is not rare for people to seek help for their mental health.

so: Finland 20% ayaa dadka mar uun noloshooda lasoo gudboonaato dhibaato walbahaar.
en: In Finland, 20 per cent of people suffer from depression at some point in their lives.

so: Xagee cawinaada laga heli karaa?
en: Where to seek help?

so: Inta badan waxaaa, isla mar ahanaatiiba wax ka geysta qoyska ama reerka. Mararka qaarse waa loo baahdaa caawimo cid kale.
en: Often it helps just to talk about things with family and friends, but sometimes more help is needed.

so: La sheekeysiga kalkaalisada caafimaadka (terveydenhoitaja), dhakhtarka (lääkäri) ama cilminasigu (psykoterapeutti) si wadajir aha waad ugala sheekeysan kartaa, kaalmo sidee ah ayaa kugu habboonaan laheyd.
en: Talking to a public health nurse (terveydenhoitaja), doctor (lääkäri) or psychotherapist (psykoterapeutti) may help. Together you can discuss what kind of support would suit you best.

so: Caawimadu inta badan waa baxnaanin, daawo ama labadaba.
en: Therapy, medication or both are often a good remedy.

so: Mararka qaar waa suurogal in loo baahdo daryeelka isbitaalka ah.
en: Sometimes hospital treatment is necessary.

so: Daryeelka isbitaalkuna wuxuu qaataa ilaa dhowr sitimaan.
en: Hospital treatment usually takes some weeks.

so: Ujeedkuna wuxuu yahay in bukaankii ku laaban karo guriga sida ugu dhaqsiyaha badan.
en: The goal is for the patient to be able to return home as soon as possible.

so: Kadibna daryeelkii lagu siiyo guriga.
en: After that, treatment will continue in an out-patient clinic.

so: Haddii aad Degan Degmo ku yaalo Finland, marka hore la xiriir rugtaada caafimaadka (terveysasema).
en: If you have a municipality of residence in Finland, contact your local health centre (terveysasema) first.

so: Wac rugta caafimaad haddiiba subaxdii waqtina ka qabso.
en: Call the health centre first thing in the morning and make an appointment.

so: Haddii aad u baahan tahay cawinaad deg deg ah, ugu sheeg telefoonka markii aad wacaysid.
en: If you need help quickly, say so on the phone.

so: Haddii loo baahdo dhakhtarka ayaa kuu qoraya warqad uu kuugu dirayo poliklinikada cudurada dhimirka (psykiatrian poliklinikka) ama isbitaal kale oo qaabilsan cudurada dhimirka.
en: When necessary, the doctor will write you a referral to the psychiatric out-patient clinic (psykiatrian poliklinikka) or another mental health unit.

so: Poliklinikada si toos ah uma aadi kartid adigoon wadan warqad uu dhakhar kuugu qoray inaad u tagto.
en: You cannot go directly to an out-patient clinic without a referral from a doctor.

so: Dhakhtartka ama daweeyaha cudurada dhimirka waxaad arimahaaga ugula hadli kartaa si aaminaad iyo kalsooni leh amaba sir ah.
en: You can talk to a doctor or psychologist in confidence, because they are bound to secrecy.

so: Waxaa waajib ku ah sir celinta. Arimahaaga uma sheegayo masuuliyiinta kale ee dawlada.
en: They will not reveal your affairs to other authorities.

so: Haddii macluumaadkaaga ay u baahado waxa kale oo xagga daryeelka caafimaadka ah, siinta macluumaadka adiga ayaa si gooni ah ruqso laguu weydiinayaa.
en: If some other health care unit needs your details, you will be asked for your permission to give them.

so: Rugtaada caafimaadka waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad sugan oo la xiriira, sida degmadaada looga heli karo adeegyada daryeelka cudurada dhimirka.
en: Your local health centre will provide you with more accurate information about the way mental health services are organised in your locality.

so: Haddii aad ka walwalsan tahay ehelkaaga inuu caawimo u baahan yahay, waad weydiin kartaa talo kalkaalisada caafimaadka ama dhkhtarka rugta daryeelka caafimaadka.
en: If you are worried about a family member and you think they might need help, you can ask, for example, a nurse or doctor at a health centre for advice.

so: Macluumaadka dheeraadka ah ee laxiriira xaaladaha kala duwan ee dhibaatada waxaad ka heli kartaa InfoFinlandi bogga Xaaladaha dhibaatada.
en: For more information about various problem situations, go to the InfoFinland web page Problem situations.

so: Adeegyada caafimaadka dhimirka ee gaarka loo leeyahay
en: Private mental health services

so: Sidoo kale waxaad waqtiga dhakhtarka dhimirka ma kan cilmunafsiga ka qabsan kartaa xarunta dhakhtarka gaarka loo leeyahay.
en: You can also make an appointment at a private clinic for a psychiatrist or psychologist.

so: Xarumaha caafimaadka ee gaarka loo leeyhaay waxaa laga yaabaa in sida badan degdeg waqti looga helo, laakiin macaamiisha aad ayuu qaali ugu yahay aaditaanka xarunta caafimaadka gaarka loo leeyahay.
en: It is sometimes possible to get an appointment there faster, but it is considerably more expensive for the customer.

so: Xafiiska caymiska hawlgabka qaranka (Kela) ayaa bixinaya qayb ka mid ah kharashka dhakhtarka gaarka loo leeyahay, haddii aad ku jirtid xayndaabka caymiska jirada ee dalka Finland.
en: The Social Insurance Institution of Finland (Kela) pays part of the expenses of private health care, if you are covered by Finnish national health insurance.

so: Magdhawga aan Kelada xaqa ugu leenahay waxaan si toos ah uga jari karnaa xisaabta aan qasnada ka bixineyno.
en: Sometimes Kela's reimbursement can be deducted directly from the sum you pay at the cash desk.

so: Horay u sii qaado shahaado cadaynaysa inaad ku jirtid xayndaabka caymiska jirrada.
en: Take along the certificate that states that you are covered by the Finnish national health insurance.

so: Sidoo kale magdhawga Kelada waxaad dib uga dalban kartaa xafiiska Kelada.
en: You can also apply for reimbursement from Kela afterwards.

so: Wixii warar dheeraad ah ka akhriso InfoFinlandi bogga Badbaada Bulshda ee Finland.
en: For more information about Finnish national health insurance, go to the InfoFinland web page Finnish social security.

so: Markii cawinaada si deg deg ah loogu baahanyahay
en: When you need help urgently

so: Haddii aad isleedahay cawinaada si deg deg ah ayaad ugu baahan tahay, waxaad la xiriiri kartaa xarunta xaafimaadka heeganka ah ee kuugu dhaw ama isbitaalka.
en: If you feel that you need help urgently, you can contact your nearest duty health centre or hospital.

so: Daryeelka caafimaadka dhimirka ee deg degta ah waxaa bixiya qaybaha heeganka ah ee isbitaalada cudurada dhimirka.
en: The emergency units of psychiatric hospitals offer urgent psychiatric hospital care.

so: Haddii ehelkaagu halis galinayo naftiisa ama cid kaleba diidana inuu la aado dhakhtar waxaad wici kartaa rugta caafimaadka ama isbitaalka.
en: If your family member is a danger to themselves or others and they refuse to see a doctor, you can call a health centre or hospital yourself.

so: Haddii caawimo degdeg ah loo baahan yahay, ugu sheeg teleefonka.
en: If help is needed fast, say so on the phone.

so: Ugu sheeg sidoo kale hadaad ka baqeyso inuu nafsadiisa waxyeeleynayo ehelkaagu.
en: If you fear that your family member will hurt themselves, mention this too.

so: Haddii qofka qaraabadaada ah ay xaaladiisa caafimaad liidato uuna u baahan yahay daryeel caafimaadka dhimirka oo degdeg ah, waxaa suurtogal ah in loo diro daryeel caaafimaad, si kasta oo uusan asagu u rabin.
en: If your family member is in very bad condition and needs acute psychiatric hospital care, they may be referred to treatment even if they do not want it themselves.

so: Tani waxay u baahantahay in dhakhtarku uu uqoro warqada daryeelka qasabka ah (pakkohoitolähete).
en: A doctor's referral to coercive treatment (pakkohoitolähete) is required for this.

so: Haddii qofka ay naftiisu khatar muuqata ku jirto, waxaad wici kartaa lambarka xaaladaha degdega ah 112.
en: If someone's life is in immediate danger, you can call the emergency number 112.

so: Ha wicin lambarka xaaladaha degdega ah, haddii aysan xaaladu deg deg ahayn.
en: Please do not call the emergency number if the situation is non-urgent.

so: Haddii xaalada uu ilmuhu ku sugan yahay ay tahay mid culeys ku haysa caafimaadka caafimaad-qabka maskaxdaada, waxaad la xiriiri kartaaa xarunta hooyada iyo dhallaanka (perheneuvola) ee degmada aad degan tahay.
en: If your child is in a situation where his/her mental health is under strain, you can contact your local Family Advice Centre (perheneuvola)

so: La talinta qoyska ee xarunta hooyada iyo dhallaanka waxaa lagu karteyaa xaalada ilmaha, si uu ilmuhu u helo cawinaada asaga ku haboon.
en: There your child's situation will be charted so that he/she can be given exactly the kind of help needed.

so: Waxaad waqti ka qabsan kartaa dhakhtarka cilmu nafsiga ee xarunta hooyada iyo dhallaanka (lastenneuvola) ama dhakhtarka rugtaada caafimaadka ee degmadaada.
en: You can also make an appointment with a psychologist at a child health clinic (lastenneuvola) or a doctor at your local health centre.

so: Haddii uu ilmuhu da'da iskuulka gaaray, waxaad la xiriiri kartaa dhakhtarka cilmunafsiga ama dhakhtarka caadiga ah ee iskuulka.
en: If your child is of school age, you can contact the school psychologist or school doctor.

so: Macluumaadka dheeraadka ah ee la xiriira cawinaad u helida carruurta xaaladaha dhibaatada waxaad ka heleysaa InfoFinlandi bogga Xagee caawimaad looga helaa dhibaatoyinka carruurta iyo dhalinyarada?
en: For more information about the kind of help provided for children in problem situations, go to the InfoFinland web page Where to find help for children's and young people's problems?

so: Haddii aad tahay dhallinyaro, waxaad arrimaha aadka u adag u sheegi kartaa tusaale ahaan kalkaalisada/kalkaaliyaha caafimaadka ee iskuulka, dhakhtarka iskuulka, dhakhtarka cilmunafsiga ee iskuulka ama macallinka iskuulka u qaabilsan arrimaha dhibaatoyinka.
en: If you are a young person, you can talk about your difficult issues, for example, with your school nurse, school doctor, school psychologist or school welfare officer.

so: Waxaad kaloo la xiriir kartaa rugtaada caafimaadka.
en: You can also contact your local health centre.

so: Dhakhtarku wuxuu kuu qori karaa warqad uu kuugu dirayo poliklinikada dhimirka ee dhalinyarada (nuorisopsykiatrian poliklinikka), haddii loo baahdo.
en: A doctor can write you a referral to a youth psychiatric clinic (nuorisopsykiatrian poliklinikka), if necessary.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ee la xiriira cawinaada dhalinyarada xaalada qasafsan ku jira waxaad ka heleysaa InfoFinlandi bogga Xagee caawimaad looga helaa dhibaatoyinka carruurta iyo dhalinyarada?
en: For more information about the help provided for young persons in problem situations, go to the InfoFinland web page Where to find help for children's and young people's problems?

so: Daryeelka caafimaadka ee Macaahida ayaa ardayda siiya adeegyada caafimaadka dhimirka.
en: The health care services of educational establishments organise mental health services for students.

so: Adeegyada caafimaadka ee shaqaalaha
en: Occupational health care services

so: Haddii aad shaqaysid, waxaad arrimaha caafimaadka dhimirka la xiririra kala hadli kartaa dhakhtarka shaqaalaha.
en: If you have a job, you can talk to an occupational doctor about things that concern your mental health.

so: Waxaa laga yabaa inay macquul tahay in daryeelka caafimaadka shaaqaluhu uu leeyahay qaabilaad ah xagga cudurada dhirmirka.
en: In occupational health care there may also be a possibility to see a psychologist.

so: Dadka soo maray xaalado uur utaalo ama gocasho leh waxay halis ugu jiraan inay ku dhacdo jirada walaac ka dhashay gocasho (traumaperäinen stressihäiriö).
en: People who have experienced traumatic situations are at risk of posttraumatic stress disorder (traumaperäinen stressihäiriö).

so: Waxyaabaha la soo maro ee sababa gocashada ama uur ku taalada waa tusaale ahaan:
en: Experiences that cause trauma include:

so: dhib u geysasho iyo kufsad
en: physical abuse and rape

so: Marka lagu jiro walaaca ka dhasha gocashada sawirada xusuusta ee uur ku taaladu waxey qasab ugu soo dhacaan maanka, waxeyna sababaan xaaladaha qaarkood ciriiri xooggan ama daran.
en: When suffering from posttraumatic stress disorder, the person affected cannot help remembering the trauma in various situations, which causes severe anxiety.

so: Xaaladda noocan oo kale ah marka lagu jiro waa muhiim in caawimaad la raadsado.
en: In these cases, it is important to get help.

so: Ka sokow qofka qaba walaaca gocashada ama uur ku taalada ka dhasha wuxuu saameeyaa ehelkiisa.
en: In addition to the actual victims, posttraumatic stress disorder affects those close to them.

so: Inta badan dadka u jirada walaaca gocashadu sababtay, waxey ku bogsoodaan isticmaalka daryee sax ah.
en: The majority of those suffering from posttraumatic stress disorder can be cured with the right treatment.

so: Xarunta baxnaaninta kuwa la soo jirdilay (Kidutettujen kuntoutuskeskus) waxay cawinaad siisaa qaxootiga iyo magangalyo-doonka wadamadooda lagu soo jirdilay.
en: The Centre for Torture Survivors in Finland (Kidutettujen kuntoutuskeskus) offers help for refugees and asylum seekers who have been tortured in their home countries.

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira cudurada dhimirka waxaad ka heleysaa internetka ayagoo luuqado kala duwan ah
en: Information about mental health online in different languages

so: sidaa aad caawinaad u raadsaneysid
en: how to come through your problems

so: Xitaa hadduusan xanuun ku aheynin ama dhib kugu hayn wey wanaagsan tahay inaad si rasmi ah inaad u tagto koontoroolka ilkaha.
en: Even if you have no pain or other symptoms, it is important to take regular dental checkups.

so: Xanuunka ilkaha waxaa ugu wanaagsan daryeelkooda, markii la daryeelo inteyna dhibtu ku bilaaban.
en: Dental illnesses are easier to treat if discovered before any symptoms occur.

so: Caafimaadka afka iyo ilkuhubaha waxay saameyaan caafimaadka jirka intiisa kale oo dhan
en: Oral and dental health affect your overall health.

so: Haddii aad dalka Finland degaan rasmi ah (kotikunta) ku leedahay. Waxaad isticmaali kartaa adeegyada daryeelka ilkaha ee degmadu bixiso.
en: If you have a municipality of residence (kotikunta) in Finland, you are entitled to use public dental care services.

so: Gargaar deg-deg ah waad heleysaa, xitaa haddaadan daganeyn ama sharci ku laheyn wadankan Finland.
en: In case of emergency, you can use municipal services even if you do not have a municipality of residence in Finland or a residence permit for Finland.

so: Kharashka daryeelka dib ayaa lagaaga soo dalacan.
en: The costs may be charged to you afterwards.

so: Luuqadaha adeega caafimaadka waa afka finnishka iyo afka swidhiska.
en: In Finland, health services are provided in Finnish and Swedish.

so: Inta badana waa suurogal haddaad balan ka qabsato inaad hesho adeeg afka ingiriiska, weydii inaad adeegsan karto turjubaan haddaadan fahmeyn luuqadahaas.
en: You can usually use English, too. When you make an appointment with a dentist, ask if you can use an interpreter if you do not speak these languages.

so: Ka aqriso xog dheeri boga InfoFinlandi Ma u baahn tahay turjubaan.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Do you need an interpreter?

so: Markii aad ballan ka qabsato adeega daryeelka ilkaha, waa muhiim inaad waqti hore oo munaasiba sii takto goobta, haddii aad baajineyso ballanta waa muhiim inaad maalin ka hor baajiso.
en: When you have made an appointment with a dentist, it is important that you arrive at the dentist in good time. If you have an appointment but cannot make it, it is very important that you cancel it in good time, normally on the previous day.

so: Haddii aadan baajin ballantii aadana immaan waqtigaad qabsatey, waxaad bixintooda ama gudeysaa kharashkii
en: If you cannot make your appointment and you have not cancelled it, you will have to pay a fee.

so: Maarkii aad rabtid inaad waqti ka qabsato rugta daryeelka ilkaha, wac xafiiska waqti qabsashada xarunta ilkaha ee degmadaada.
en: When you want to make an appointment for dental care, call the dental care appointments desk in your locality.

so: Sida badan teleefoonka ayaa lagu qiimeeyaa baahida loogabo daryeelka.
en: The need for treatment is usually estimated over the phone.

so: Haddii baahida daryeelku uusan degdeg ahayn waxaa laga yaabaa inaad sugto dhawr bilood.
en: If there is no urgent need for treatment, you may have to queue for several months.

so: Daryeelka waa inaad heshaa lix bilood gudahood.
en: However, getting dental care must take no longer than six months.

so: Markii aad dooneysid inaad waqti u qabsato daryeel deg dega ah, wac xafiiska waqti qabshashada heeganka ah (päivystysajanvaraus) ee degmadaada.
en: When you need urgent care and want to make an appointment, call the emergency dental clinic's appointments desk (päivystysajanvaraus).

so: Dhaga xanuunka, bararka ama shilka waxay ka midyihiin sababaha lagu helikaro daryeelka deg degta ah.
en: A severe ache, swelling or accident are reasons for seeking urgent care.

so: Waxyaabaha ama xaaladaha deg degta ah waxaa la qabta dhaqsaha badan.
en: Urgent cases are treated quickly.

so: Galbihii iyo sabtiga iyo axada heeganka waxaa la igugu geeyaa isbitaalada waaweyn.
en: In the evenings and at weekends, emergency care is centralised at larger units.

so: Haddii aad degentahay magaalo yar, waxaa laga yaabaa inaad ku qasbanaato inaad u soo safarto heeganka maalooyinka waaweyn ee kuu dhaw.
en: If you live in a small community, you may have to travel to the nearest town for emergency care.

so: Haddii aad u baahantahay qaliin cuus, tusaale ahaan qalitaanka ilkaha, marka hore waqti ka qabso dhakhtarka ilkaha, dhakhtarka ilkaha ayaa ku siinaya warqad uu kuugu dirayo daryeelka gaarka ah ee ilkaha, haddii loo baahdo.
en: If you need more demanding procedures, such as dental surgery, make an appointment first with a dentist. The dentist will write you a referral to a specialised dentist, if necessary.

so: Daryeelka ilkaha ee gaarka loo leeyhay
en: Private dental care services

so: Sidoo kale waqti ayaad ka qabsan kartaa dhakhtarka ilkaha ee gaarka loo leeyahay.
en: You can also make an appointment with a private dentist.

so: Daryeelka ilkaha ee gaarka loo leeyahay wuu ka qaalisanyahay daryeelka ilkaha ee degmaha ama daryeelka guud.
en: Private dental care is more expensive than public care.

so: Haddii aad ku jirto xeyndaabka Ammaanka bulshada Finland, Kelada ayaa qeyb ka bixineysa kharashka.
en: If you are covered by Finnish social security, Kela will pay a part of the fee.

so: Si kastoo ay ahaataba Keladu ma magdhabeyso tusaale ahaan daryeelka quseeya muuqaalka bannaanka.
en: Kela will not, however, compensate dental care that is purely cosmetic in nature.

so: Bogagga shabakadda Kelada ayaa ka heleysaa macmuulaad dheeraad ah.
en: More information is available on the Kela website.

so: Degmada ayaa carruurtu si joogto ah ugu qabanqaabisa koontaroolka ilkaha.
en: The municipality regularly organises dental examinations for children.

so: Carruurta kayar da'da dugsiga waxaa labadii sanaba mar lagu sameeyaa koontaroolka ilkaha.
en: Children under school-age are given dental examinations once every few years.

so: Magaalooyinka qaarkood waxaa cunuggu gurigiisa loogu diraa warqad loogu yeerayo koontaroolka ilkaha.
en: In some cities, children are sent invitations to dental examinations by letter.

so: Haddii wakhtigu uusan kugu habbooneyn, wac qabsashada ballanta oo wakhtiga beddelo.
en: If the scheduled examination time is inconvenient, call the appointment booking service to change it.

so: Magaalooyinka qaarkood waa in aad adigu ballanta ka qabsataa.
en: In some cities, you need to book the examination appointment yourself.

so: Carruurta ku jirta da'da dugsiga dhigata waxay koontaroolka ilkaha u tegayaan rugta daryeelka ilkaha ee xaafadda inta ay ku jiraan maalin-dugsiyeedka.
en: Schoolchildren have their dental examinations during the school day at the local health centre's dental clinic.

so: Koontaroolidda waxaa lagu sameeyaa fasallada 1aad, 5aad iyo 8aad.
en: Dental examinations are done during 1st, 5th and 8th grade.

so: Waxaa wanaagsan in waalidku ay u raacaan koontaroolka ilkaha, gaar ahaan cunugga ku jira fasalka 1aad.
en: Parents should come with the child to the dental examination, at least during 1st grade.

so: Daryeelka ilkaha ee rugta caafimaadku waa u lacag la'aan carruurta 18 sano kayar.
en: Dental care at health centres is free of charge for children under the age of 18.

so: Dalka Finland dumarku waxay ku umulaan isbitaalka caadiga ah.
en: In Finland, women usually give birth at a hospital.

so: Ruqta hooyada iyo dhalaanka ayaad ka heleysaa macluumaadka la xiriira isbitaalka ama isbitaalada aagaa aad degantahay ku yaal.
en: You will be given information about the hospital(s) in your area at the maternity clinic.

so: Haddii aad Degan Degmo ku yaalo Finland, daryeelka isbitaalku adiga waa kuu jabnaanayaa.
en: If you have a municipality of residence in Finland, hospital care will be cheaper for you than for those who do not.

so: Waxaa kale oo macquul ah guri ku umulida, laakiin kama mid ahan xayndaabka guud ee daryeelka caafimaadka, cidna lagulama talinaayo.
en: Home birth is also possible but it is not included in public health care services and it is not recommended.

so: Taas macnaheedu waa in waalidku ay iyagu sameeyaan qaban-qaabada umulista.
en: This means that parents have to make the arrangements for home birth themselves.

so: Sidoo kale mas'uuliyada habsami u socodka umulida waxaa iska leh waalidiinta.
en: Parents also carry the responsibility for the childbirth.

so: Sida badan aabuhu wuxuu ka qayb qaataa umulida hooyada. Caawiye waxaa kaloo noqon kara qof qaraabo ama saaxiib ah.
en: In most cases, the father accompanies the mother during the birth, but another relative or a friend can also act as a support person.

so: Haddii aad dooneysid waxaad kaloo waqtiga umulida codsan kartaa qof dumar ah oo taakuleeyso ah oo iskeed kuu taakuleynaysa soona qaadatay tababarka caawiyenimo ku shaqaynta.
en: If you wish, you can also ask for a volunteer support person to accompany you during childbirth.

so: Qofkaas oo kale waxaa loogu yeeraa doula.
en: Volunteer support persons have been trained for the task and are called 'doulas'.

so: Waxaad weydiin kartaa rugta hooyada iyo dhalaanka ee goobta aad degen tahay hawlaha wixii ku saabsan caawisada ama doulada
en: You can ask about doulas at your maternity clinic.

so: Dalka Finland hooyoyinka intooda badan waxay ka dhalaan hoosta, sida badan waa habka ugu nabadgalyo badan.
en: Most mothers in Finland give birth the traditional way. In most cases, it is the safest way.

so: Sidaan haddii aysan suurtogal ahayn qaabka ilmuhu caloosha ugu jiro awgeed, dhakhtar ayaa go'aan ka gaaraya qaliinka.
en: However, if this is not possible due to the baby's position, for example, the doctor will make a decision about performing a C-section.

so: Haddii sida kale ay wax walba caadi yihiin qaliinka horay ayaan u sii qorsheyn karnaa.
en: If everything is well otherwise, the C-section can be planned beforehand.

so: Mar marka qaar dhalmadu si caadi ah ayey u bilaabataa, laakiin badqabka ilmaha awgeed waa in la sameeyo qaliin deg deg ah.
en: Sometimes labour begins normally, but for the sake of the baby's health, an urgent C-section must be performed.

so: Haddii aad dhalmada ka baqaysid, arinta kala hadal kaaliyaha caafimaad ama takhtarka joogo rugta hooyada iyo dhalaanka.
en: If you are afraid of childbirth, talk about it with the nurse and doctor at the maternity clinic.

so: Rugaha la-talinta hooyanimada iyo cusbitaalada qaarkood waxaa lagu qabanqaabiyaa carbin qoys, taas oo ujeedada laga leeyahay ay tahay u diyaarinta ama carbinta hooyada iyo qoyska dhalmada soo socota iyo daryeelka dhallaanka dartood.
en: Maternity clinics and some maternity hospitals organise family training, which aims at preparing the mother-to-be and the entire family for the coming delivery and caring for the baby.

so: Carbinta qoyska waxaad sidoo kale ka heleysaa macluumaadka la xiriira sida ay dhalmadu u bilaabanayso iyo waqtiga ay tahay inaad isbitaalka aado.
en: Family training also gives information on how childbirth begins and when it is time to go to the hospital.

so: Haddii biyaha ilmuhu dilaacaan ama uu qabto xanuun is dabajoog ah oo isku dhaw dhaw iyo maroojin xanuun badan, wac isbitaalka, weydiina inay tahay waqtigii aad isbitaalka aadi lahayd.
en: If your amniotic fluid begins to flow or you have continual, frequent and painful contractions, call the hospital and ask if it is time to go.

so: Markii aad isbitaalka aadeysid, ilmaha u sii qaad dhar diirimaad ku filan leh, oo loo soo geliyo marka guriga loo soo noqonayo.
en: When you go to the hospital, take along some clothes for the baby that are sufficiently warm for the journey home.

so: Haddii aad rabtid inaad ilmaha gaari ku soo qaado marka aad isbitaalka ka soo baxaysaan, waxaa u baahan tahay kursiga gaariga ee caruurta lagu fariisiyo (turvakaukalo).
en: If you intend to take your baby home by car, you will need a baby car seat (turvakaukalo).

so: Waa adag tahay in turjubaan la helo waqtiga dhalmada, sababtoo ah waqtiga sugan ee dhalmada way adag tahay in horay loo sii ogaado.
en: It may be difficult to get an interpreter for childbirth, because it is hard to know the exact time for it beforehand.

so: Xarumaha turjumaanada qaarkood waxay heega yihiin dhamaadka usbuuca iyo galabtii iyo habeenkii iyo sidoo kale waqti gaaban gudohood ayaa ku diyaar garoobi karaan haddii loo baahdo.
en: Some interpreter centres are on call, when necessary, during weekends and in the evening and night time and also at short notice.

so: Waxaad kaloo shaqaalaha kala heshiin kartaa in lamaanahaaga ama saaxiibkaaga luuqada yaqaan inay dhalmada kuugu soo raacaan turjumaan ahaan.
en: You can also make arrangements with the staff for your spouse or a friend who can speak a language that the staff understand to come with you to interpret during childbirth.

so: Turjubaan isticmaalida waxaa go'aan ka gaaraya waalidiinta.
en: Parents decide whether they want an interpreter.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Turjubaan ma u baahan tahay?
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Do you need an interpreter?

so: Haddii lagu guday (ympärileikkaus) ka hor intii aaadan Finland imaan, oo aad qorshayneysid inaad uur yeelato, waxaa lagugu sameyn karaa qaliin furitaan gudniin ah (avausleikkaus).
en: If you have had a circumcision (ympärileikkaus) before your arrival in Finland, an opening operation (avausleikkaus) will be performed in connection with childbirth.

so: Qaliinka waxaa la samayn karaa inta uurku uu dhexda marayo.
en: The operation can also be carried out during mid-pregnancy.

so: Waxaa wanaagsan inaad gudniinka horay ugu sii sheegto isbitaalka dhalmada, si tixgelin loogu siiyo waqtiga dhalmada.
en: You should tell the staff at the hospital about your circumcision beforehand so that it can be taken into account during childbirth.

so: Hdii ilmahaaga uu dalka Finland guri u yahay (kotikunta), wuxuu ilmuhu xaq u leeyahay inuu isticmaalo adeegyada guud ee caafimaadka.
en: If your child has a municipality of residence (kotikunta) in Finland, he or she is entitled to public health services.

so: Haddii aad ku jirtid xayndaabka caymiska jira (sairausvakuutus) ee Finland, ilmahaaga waxaa u qaadi kartaa caymis, kaas oo daboolaya kharashaadka adegyada caafimaadka gaarka loo leeyahay.
en: If you are covered by Finnish national health insurance (sairausvakuutus), you can take out an insurance policy for your child, which covers the costs of private health care.

so: Markii uu ilmuhu xanuunsado
en: When a child falls ill

so: Ilmaha xummadeysan ama sidoodaba xanuunsan lama geyn karo goobaha lagu xanaaneeyo.
en: A feverish child or one who is otherwise ill cannot be taken to day care.

so: Haddii uu ilmuhu qufacayo ama uu durey leeyahay wuu ka qaybgeli karaa oo waa la geyn karaa xannaanada, haddii uu sida kale u caafimaad-qabo.
en: If a child has a cough or a cold but is otherwise well, he or she can go to day care.

so: Haddii ilmo da'diisu ay ka yar tahay 10 sano uu si lama filaan ah u xanuunsado, hooyada ama aabuhu guriga ayey ilmaha la joogi karaan si ay u xannaaneeyaan.
en: When a child under 10 years of age suddenly falls ill, the child's mother or father can stay at home to look after him/her.

so: Fasaxa daryeelka carruurtu wuxuu ugu badnaan socon karaa afar maalmood.
en: This type of temporary child care leave can last for up to four days.

so: Heshiiska shuruudaha shaqada ayaa looga heshiiiyey in waqtigaas mushaar la helayo iyo inkale.
en: The collective bargaining agreement states whether or not salary will be paid for this period.

so: Haddii uu ilmuhu xanuunsado asagoo iskuulka ku jira, wuxuu daryeel caafimaad ka helayaa iskuulka dhexdiisa.
en: If a child is ill and needs a doctor or a nurse, contact the health centre (terveysasema) in your municipality or a private clinic.

so: Galbihii iyo dhamaadka usbuucaba rugaha caafimaadku way xiran yihiin, markaas xanuunada degdega ah waxaa lagu daweeyaa heeganka (päivystys).
en: In the evenings and at weekends health centres are closed. At these times, acute cases and accidents are treated at emergency clinics (päivystys).

so: Haddii jirada cunuggu aysan u baahnayn daryeel degdeg ah, sug inta ay ka furmayso rugta caafimaadku marka xiga.
en: If your child's illness does not require immediate treatment, wait until the health centre opens again.

so: Intabadan heeganka carruurta iyo dhallinyaradu waxaa lagu qabtaa xarumaha ama isbitaalada ayaga gaarka u ah.
en: Emergency services for children and the young are often arranged in a separate unit.

so: Sidoo kale waxaad waqti dhakhtar ka qabsan kartaa xarunta dhakhaatiirta gaarka loo leeyahay.
en: You can also make a doctor's appointment at a private clinic.

so: Intabadan waxay furan yihiin galbihii, sidoo kale marmarka qaarkood waxaa waqti looga heli karaa si degdeg ah.
en: These are also often open in the evenings, and sometimes you can get an appointment faster there.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee adeega daryeelka caafimaadka ee gaarka loo leeyahay macaamiisha aad ayey qaali ugu yihiin marka loo eego adeegyada caafimaad ee guud ama ay dawladu bixiso.
en: However, private health services are much more expensive for the customer than public ones.

so: Haddii aad ilmaha sumow uga shakiso, waxaad talo weydiin kartaa xarunta macluumaadka sumowga (Myrkytystietokeskus).
en: If you suspect that a child has ingested poison, you can ask the Poison Information Centre (Myrkytystietokeskus) for advice.

so: Telefoonkeeda adeegu wuxuu furan yahay 24ka saac. Lambarka telefoonku waa (09) 471 977.
en: The centre's helpline is available 24 hours a day and its phone number is (09) 471 977.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa InfoFinlandi bogga Xaaladaha degdega ah.
en: You can find more information on the InfoFinland web page Emergencies.

so: Carruurta aan weli da'da iskuulka gaarin waxaa caafimaadkooda ka taxadaraya xarunta hooyada iyo dhalaanka (lastenneuvola).
en: Child health clinics (lastenneuvola) tend to the health of children under school age.

so: Xarunta dhalaanka iyo hooyadu waxay oo caawinaysaa koritaanka iyo horumarka carruurta ee xagga jirka, maskaxda iyo bulshanimada.
en: These clinics monitor and support the physical, mental and social growth and development of young children.

so: Carruurtu waxay xarunta hooyada iyo dhalaanka kula kulmaan dhakhtarka iyo kalkaaliyada caa fimaadka.
en: At a child health clinic, children visit either a doctor or a nurse.

so: Qoyska heysta cunugga hal sano kayar waxaa loogu yeeraa rugta la-talinta hooyada iyo dhallaanka ugu yaraan sagaal mar sanadki.
en: Families with a child who is less than one year old are invited to a child health clinic at least nine times.

so: Sanadka ugu horeeya kaddib waxaa rugta la-talinta hooyada iyo dhallaanka loogu yeeraa ugu yaraan lix jeer sanadki.
en: After the first year, families are invited to a child health clinic at least six times more.

so: Kalkaalisada caafimaadku waxay la soconaysaa horkaca ilmaha, way talaalaysaa waxayna siinaysaa macluumaadka la xiriira quudinta iyo nafaqada saxda ah.
en: The clinic's nurse monitors children's development, vaccinates them and provides information about healthy nutrition.

so: Kalkaalisada caafimaadku waxay sidoo kale ilmaha ugu tageysaa guriga haddiiba markii uu dhasho kadib.
en: The nurse also visits a child's home soon after birth.

so: Adeegyada xarunta hooyada iyo dhalaanka ee degmadaadu waa bilaash.
en: The child health clinic services of your own municipality are free-of-charge.

so: Waxaad isticmaali kartaa adeegyada hooyada iyo dhalaanka ee degmadaada, haddii Finland ay kuu tahay guri degaan oo rasmi ah.
en: If you have a municipality of residence in Finland, you can use these services in your own municipality.

so: Ilmuhu wuxuu xarunta hooyada iyo dhalaanka ka helyaa kaarka xarunta hooyada iyo dhalaanka (neuvolakortti).
en: Children are given their personal child welfare clinic card (neuvolakortti) at these clinics.

so: Mar walba kaarka u soo qaado xarunta hooyada iyo dhalaanka.
en: Always take the card along when you visit a child health clinic.

so: Kalkaalisadu waxay kaarka ku calaaamadaynaysaa macluumaadka caafimaadka ee ilmaha iyo talaalada.
en: The nurse will enter your child's health information and vaccinations on it.

so: Iskuul walba waxaa loo magacaabay dhakhtar iyo kalkaaliye/kalkaaliso caafimaad.
en: Every school has a doctor and a nurse assigned to it. The nurse checks the children's health at school.

so: Kalkaalisadu caafimaadka ilmaha ayey iskuulka dhexdiisa ku jeeg gareynaysaa.
en: The nurse is at the school on certain days of the week.

so: Kaalkaalisada caafimaadku iskuulka waxay joogtaa usbuuciiba maalmo cayiman.
en: Pupils can go and see the nurse themselves if they have a problem.

so: Ardaydu ayaga ayaa u tegi kara kalkaalisada caafimaadaka, haddii ay dhibaato haysato.
en: If an accident occurs at school, the child involved will be given first aid.

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira daryeelka caafimaadka ee iskuulka waxaad ka heleysaa bogga internetka ee wasaarada caaafimaadka iyo arimaha bulshada (Sosiaali- ja terveysministeriö).
en: The website of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Health (Sosiaali- ja terveysministeriö) provides information about school health care.

so: Dalka Finland ilmaha waxaa la siiyaa fursad looga talaalo (rokotus) cuduro badan oo la is-qabadsiiyo.
en: In Finland, children are offered the possibility of vaccination (rokotus) against many infectious and contagious diseases.

so: Carruurta waxaa lagu talaalaa xarunta hooyada iyo dhalaanka (lastenneuvola) iyo rugta daryeelka caafimaad ee iskuulka.
en: Vaccinations are given at child health clinics (lastenneuvola) and in schools.

so: Talaalada ka midka ah, barnaamijka talaalka qoyska waxay u yihiin bilaash.
en: Vaccinations that are a part of a vaccination programme are free of charge to the parents.

so: Dalka Finland carruurta intooda badan waxay qaataan talaalada ka midka ah barnaamijka talaalka.
en: The majority of children in Finland are given the vaccinations included in vaccination programmes.

so: U sheeg kalkaalisada caafimaadka talaalada uu cunugaadu qaatay kahor imaanshiyaha Finland.
en: Tell the nurse which vaccinations your child has been given before coming to Finland.

so: Haddii aad dooneysid, in ilmahaagu uu helo talaal aan ku jirin barnaamijka carruurta, dhakhtarka waqti ka qabso.
en: If you want your child to be given a vaccination that is not in the vaccination programme, make an appointment with a doctor.

so: Dhakhtarka ayaa kuu qori kara in ilmahaaga la talaalo, kadibna kalkaaliyaha caafimaadka ayaa talaali kara ilmahaaga.
en: The doctor can write a prescription for the vaccination, and the nurse can vaccinate your child.

so: Waa inaad adigu talaalka ka soo iibsataa farmashiyaha.
en: You must buy the vaccination yourself from a pharmacy.

so: Daryeelida xanuunka waqtiga dheer ah ama ilmo curyaan ah
en: Long-term illness or caring for a disabled child

so: Haddii aad daryeeleysid waqti dheer guriga ku daryeeleysid ilmo da'doodu ka yar tahay 16 sano oo mudo dheer xanuunsan ama curyaan ah, waxaad Kelada ka dalban kartaa lacagta daryeelka gaarka ah (erityishoitoraha).
en: If you are caring for a sick or disabled child who is under 16 years of age at home over an extended period, you can apply for special care allowance (erityishoitoraha) from Kela.

so: Kelada waxaad kaloo ka heli kartaa cawinaada baxnaaninta (kuntoutus) carruurta.
en: You may also receive support for your child's rehabilitation (kuntoutus) from Kela.

so: Kelada waxaa laga heli karaa cawinaada curyaanimada ee ilamaha 16 ka sano ka yar (alle 16-vuotiaan vammaistuki) oo jirada aadka u xun qaba ama curyaanka ah.
en: A child with a serious illness or disability may be granted a disability benefit for persons under 16 years of age (alle 16-vuotiaan vammaistuki) by Kela.

so: Cawinaada Kelada waxaa loogu talogalay dadka ku jira Badbaada bulshada ee Finland.
en: Kela's benefits are intended for people who are covered by Finnish social security.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah oo la xiriira kula noolaanshada dalka Finland ilmo curyaan ah ama dhimman waxaad ka heleysaa InfoFinlandi bogga Ilmo curyaan ah ama dhimman.
en: You can find more information about life with a disabled child in Finland on the InfoFinland web page Disabled child.

so: Gudniinku (Ympärileikkaus) waa wax marka la sameeyo anan dib loola noqon karin.
en: A circumcision (ympärileikkaus) is always an irrevocable operation.

so: Haddii loo sameeyo sabab anan caafimaad ahayn waa qaliin lagu faragalinayo wiilka jidhkiisa iyo xaqqa uu u leeyahay in uu lamataabtaan ahaado.
en: If it is performed for a non-medical reason, a boy's bodily integrity is violated.

so: Gudniinka waxa fulin kara oo kaliyaata dhakhtar sharciyaysan.
en: A circumcision may only be performed by a qualified doctor.

so: Si gudniinka loo fuliyo waa in la haystaa oggolaanshaha waalidka oo qoran.
en: A written consent from the boy's guardians is required for the circumcision.

so: Haddii ilmahu uu leeyahay labo waalid waa in la helaa labada waalidba oggolaanshohooda oo qoran.
en: If the child has two guardians, both of them must consent to the operation, or otherwise, it must not be performed.

so: Haddii la waayo lama gudi karo wiilka.
en: The boy has the right to refuse the operation.

so: Gudniinka anan loo samaynin sabab caafimaad ma aha wax xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmooyinka iyo dowladu leedahay wax lagu samayn karo, waana in uu qofku lacgta iska bixiyaa isagu.
en: A non-medical circumcision is not covered by publicly funded health care, so it cannot be performed at a public health centre, and it must be paid by the party who is having it performed.

so: Gudniinka (ympärileikkaus) gabdhuhu dalka Finland wuxuu ka yahay dambi. Waxaana lagu mutaysan karaa sanado badan oo xabsi ah.
en: A circumcision (ympärileikkaus) of a girl is a crime in Finland and can lead to several years' imprisonment.

so: Waxaa kale oo dambi ah in gabadha loo wado wadan kale, si halkaas loogu soo gudo.
en: It is also a crime to take a girl to another country to have a circumcision performed on her.

so: Haddii aad ka shakisan tahay, inaad uur leedahay, waxaad sameyn kartaa testiga uurka (raskaustesti).
en: If you think that you may be pregnant you can take a pregnancy test (raskaustesti).

so: Qalabka lagu baaro uurka waxaad ka soo iibsan kartaa farmashiga.
en: These tests can be bought, for example, at a pharmacy.

so: La xiriir rugta hooyada iyo dhalaanka (äitiysneuvola) ee magaaladaada.
en: Contact the maternity clinic (äitiysneuvola) in your own municipality.

so: Tag baaritaanka dhakhtarka ka hor inii adaan dhamaysan bisha afaraad ee uurka.
en: Have a medical examination before the end of your fourth month of pregnancy.

so: Ogeysiis qoraal ah u samee shaqabixiyahaaga ugu dambayn laba bilood ka hor intaadan aadin fasaxa hooyanimada.
en: Give your employer written notification at least two months before you begin your maternity leave.

so: Rugta hooyada iyo dhallaanka waxaad ka heleysaa hagitaano la xiriira arimaha uurka, iyo macluumaad la xiriira adeegyada kala gedisan ay bulshadu bixiso.
en: A maternity clinic will provide you with guidance in all matters related to pregnancy, and information about various services offered by the society.

so: Sidoo kale rugta hooyada iyo dhalaanka waxaa lagula socdaa xaalada caafimaad ee hooyada iyo ilmaha uurka ku jira.
en: The mother's and foetus's health are also monitored at the clinic.

so: Adeegyada ay bixiso rugta hooyada iyo dhalaanka ee degmadaadu waa bilaash.
en: The maternity clinic services of your own municipality are free.

so: Waxaad isticmaali kartaa adeegyada hooyada ee ay degmadaadu bixiso, haddii aad Finland ku leedahay degaan rasmi ah (kotikunta).
en: If you have a municipality of residence (kotikunta) in Finland, you can use the services of a maternity clinic in your own municipality.

so: Sidoo kale aabeyaashu waa lagu soo dhaweynayaa rugta hooyada iyo dhalaanka.
en: Fathers are also welcome at these clinics.

so: Rugta hooyada iyo dhalaanka waxaa looga hadlaa xiriirka qoyska iyo waalidnimada iyo weliba kaalinta aabaha iyo mas'uuliyada waalidnimada.
en: The clinic visits include discussions about the relationship between the father and mother, parenthood and the father's role and responsibility as a parent.

so: Rugta hooyada iyo dhalaanku waxay sidoo kale qabataa tababar xagga dhalmada ah iyo tababarid qoys oo la siinayo hooyada uurka leh iyo aabaha.
en: Maternity clinics also organise antenatal and family classes for expectant mothers and fathers.

so: Aabeyaasha Finnishka iyo hooyooyinku intooda badan waxay ka qaybgalaan tababarkaan.
en: Most Finnish fathers and mothers participate in these classes.

so: Kalkaalisada caafimaadka ee rugta hooyada iyo dhallaanku waxay haddii loo baahdo codsan kartaa in turjumaan uu yimaado kulmada rugta hooyada iyo dhallaanka.
en: When necessary, the clinic nurse can ask an interpreter to be with you at the maternity clinic.

so: Turjumaanku waa inuu ahaado qaangaar, sidaas darteed ilmahaaga aan qaangaarka aheyn looma isticmaali karo turjubaan ahaan.
en: The interpreter must be an adult and therefore you cannot use your own child as an interpreter, if he or she is a minor.

so: Rugta hooyada iyo dhallaanku waxay dhammaan waalidiinta ilmaha sugaya siinaysaa hageha magiciisu yahay Anaga ilmo ayaa noo dhalanaya, kaas oo ay soo saartay Hay'adda horumarinta caafimaadka iyo nolol wanaaga (Terveyden ja hyvinvoinnin laitos).
en: All parents at a maternity clinic are given the handbook 'We're having a baby', which has been produced by the National Institute for Health and Welfare (Terveyden ja hyvinvoinnin laitos).

so: Baaritaanka dhakhtarka waxaa haboon in marka ugu horeysa la tago kahor inta aysan dhamaan bisha afaraad ee uurka.
en: You should have your first medical examination before the end of your fourth month of pregnancy.

so: Markaas waxaad dhakhtarka ama rugta hooyada iyo dhalaanka ka heleysaa shahaada uurka.
en: The doctor or maternity clinic will then provide you with a certificate confirming your pregnancy.

so: Shahaadada waxaad u baahantahay markii aad xafiiska Kelada ka dalbanaysid kaalamada hooyada (Kelan äitiysavustus) iyo lacagta hooyada (äitiysraha).
en: You will need this when applying for a maternity grant (äitiysavustus) and maternity allowance (äitiysraha) from the Social Insurance Institution of Finland (Kela).

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa InfoFinlandi bogga Kaalmada la siinayo hooyada uurka leh.
en: Find out more on the InfoFinland web page Support for pregnant women.

so: Bogga internetka ee wasaarada caafimaadka iyo arimaha bulshada (Sosiaali- ja terveysministeriö) waxaa si guud loogu sheega hawlaha rugta hooyada iyo dhalaanka ee dalka Finland.
en: The website of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Health (Sosiaali- ja terveysministeriö) provides an outline of maternity and child health clinics in Finland.

so: Xanuunka iyo dhiig daadashada xiliga uurka
en: Pain and bleeding during pregnancy

so: Uurka caadiga ah wuxuu leeyahay xanuuno yar yar, markii ilmogaleenku uu fidayo.
en: A normal pregnancy includes some slight pain, caused by the growth of the womb.

so: Haddii shaki kaa galo, in xanuunka ku hayaa uu kuwaas ka mid yahay, la tasho xaruntaada hooyada iyo dhalaanka.
en: If you are unsure whether the pain you are feeling is normal, ask for advice at your own maternity clinic.

so: Haddii uu xanuunku daranyahay ama uu dhiig kaa socdo, la xiriir isbitaalka.
en: If the pain is severe or you are bleeding, contact the hospital.

so: Waxaa laguugu yeeraayaa baaritaan haddii loo baahdo.
en: You will be invited to an examination, if it is necessary.

so: Xaaladaha deg degta ah uma baahnid in dhakhtar kuu diro.
en: If the situation is urgent, you do not need a referral.

so: Haddii lagu gudey ka hor intii aadan Finland imaan, waxaa lagu sameynyaa qaliin furitaan ah (avausleikkaus) marka aad u baahato.
en: If you have had a circumcision before your arrival in Finland, an opening operation (avausleikkaus) will be performed in connection with childbirth.

so: Qaliinka furitaanka ah waxaa la sameyn karaa inta uu uurku bartamaha marayo ama uurka kahor.
en: The operation can also be performed during mid-pregnancy or before you become pregnant.

so: Qaliinka furitaanka ah wuxuu sahlayaa dhalmada iyo sidoo kale baaritaanada intaad uurka leedahay.
en: The operation will ease childbirth and the examinations performed during pregnancy.

so: Qaliinka waxaa lagu sameeyaa isbitaalada, bogsoonaanshaduna waxay qaadataa 1-2 maalmood.
en: It will be carried out at the hospital, and recovery usually takes 1-2 days.

so: Wixii dheeraad ah weydii kalkaaliyahada caafimaadka ee rugta hooyada iyo dhalaanka.
en: Ask for more information from the maternity clinic nurse.

so: Kaalamada la siinayo hooyada uurka leh
en: Support for pregnant women

so: Haddii aad ku jirtid Badbaada Bushada ee Finland, waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad hesho kaalmooyinka kaladuwan oo ay Keladu bixiso xilliga uurka iyo ka bacdiba.
en: If you are covered by Finnish social security, you are entitled to various Kela benefits during and after pregnancy.

so: Wixii warar dheeraad ah ka akhri bogga internetka InfoFinlandi ee Kaalmaynta hooyada uurka leh iyo Kaalmada dhalashada ilmaha kadib.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web pages Support for pregnant women and Benefits for a family after a child is born.

so: Maan sameynayaa haddii aanan Finland degaan rasmi ah ku lahayn?
en: What do I do if I have no municipality of residence in Finland?

so: La xiriir rugta dhakhaatiirta ee gaarka loo leeyahay.
en: Contact a private clinic.

so: Magaalooyinka waaweyn waxaa ku yaal rugo dhakhaatiir gaar loo leeyahay faro badan, magaalooyinka qaarkoodna waxay sidoo kale leeyihiin rugo hooyada iyo dhalaanka oo si gaar ah loo leeyahay.
en: The largest towns have several private doctors and some localities also have private maternity and child health clinics.

so: Ogow, in daryeelka caafimaadka ee gaarka loo leeyahay uu qaali yahay.
en: Please take into consideration the fact that private health care is expensive.

so: Caymiska shakhsiga ee Finnishka lama helaayo, haddii aadan ku jirin xayndaabka Badbaada Bushada ee Finland.
en: You cannot get a Finnish personal health insurance policy, unless you are covered by Finnish social security.

so: Ilmo ma sugeysaa adigoo kujira xaalad qalafsan ama kali ah?
en: Are you expecting a baby in a difficult situation or alone?

so: Haddii aad sugeysid inaad ilmo dhasho, oo aad dareemeysid inaadan kaligaaa ku filnayn ilmaha, waxaad la soo xiriiri kartaa guriga koowaad (ensikoti).
en: If you are expecting a baby and you feel that you cannot cope by yourself, you can contact a mother and child home (ensikoti).

so: Guri-horaadka waxaad caawimaad uga heli kartaa waalidnimada iyo maareynta nolosha.
en: Mother and child homes provide help with parenthood and life management.

so: Adeeygyada guriga koowaad waxaa loogu talogalay, dadka Finland ku leh degaan rasmi ah.
en: The services of a mother and child home are intended for those who have a municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Sidoo kale waxaad u baahantahay warqad uu kuu qorey xafiiska arimaha bulshada ee magaaladaadu.
en: You will also need a referral from your municipal Social Services Department.

so: Macluumaadka dheeraadka ah ee la xiriira xuuquuqda aad ku leedahay degmada degaanka kuu ah waxaad ka heleysaa InfoFinlandi bogga Degan Degmo ku yaalo Finland.
en: You can find more information about the right to a municipality of residence on the InfoFinland web page Municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Ma ku fakareysaa inaad uurka iska soorido?
en: Are you considering abortion?

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ka fiiri InfoFinlandi bogga Ilmo iska soo ridida.
en: For more information, go to the InfoFinland web page Abortion.

so: Adeegyadee caafimaad ayaad isticmaali kartaa?
en: What health services can you use?

so: Daryeelka caafimaadka ee muwaadinka waqooyiga Yurub
en: Health care for Nordic citizens

so: Daryeelka caafimaadka muwaadinka Midowga Yurub
en: Health care for EU citizens

so: Daryeelka caafimaadka shaqaalaha iyo ganacsadaha
en: Health care for employees and entrepreneurs

so: Daryeelka caafimaadka ee Qaxootiga iyo dadka magangelyo doonka ah
en: Health care for refugees and asylum seekers

so: Waxaad isticmaali kartaa adeegyada guud ee caafimaadka dalka Finland, haddii aad degmo Finland ka mid ah ay degaan kuu tahay (kotikunta).
en: You are entitled to use public health services in Finland if you have a municipality of residence (kotikunta) in Finland.

so: Xuquuqda helitaanka degenaanshadu waxay ku xirantahay arimahaan soo socda:
en: The right to a municipality of residence depends on the following matters:

so: Wadanka aad Finland uga soo guurtay
en: the country from which you have come to Finland

so: Waxa ay tahay sababta aad Finland u timid (tusaale. shaqo, waxbarasho)
en: your reason for coming to Finland (e.g. work, studying)

so: si rasmi ah miyaad Finland ugu soo guureysaa mise waxaad Finland u degentahay si kumeel gaar ah
en: whether you are moving to Finland permanently or staying here temporarily

so: Haddii aad Finland si ku meelgaar ah u degen tahay, intee in le'eg ayaad Finland joogtay
en: if you are staying in Finland temporarily, the length of your stay in Finland

so: Haddii aadan hubin, in Finland degaan kuu tahay, xaaladaada si dhab ah uga baar xafiiska diiwaangelinta dadka (maistraatti).
en: If you are unsure whether you have a municipality of residence in Finland, find out at the Local Register Office (maistraatti).

so: Haddii aad guri degmo ku leedahay Finlnad ama aadan Finland uga jirin ceymiska jirrada, waxaa laga yaabaa in aad sababo kale dartood xaq u leedahay daryeelka ama magdhawga Keladu bixiso.
en: If you do not have a municipality of residence in Finland or are not covered by Finnish health insurance, you may have the right to health care or reimbursements from Kela on other grounds.

so: Xuquuqdan waa qasab in si gaar ah loo codsado.
en: You must apply for this right separately.

so: Warar dheeraad ah waxaad weydiin kartaa xarunta arrimaha caalamiga ah ee Kelada.
en: Ask for more information at Kela's international situations unit.

so: Marka aad xaalad degdeg ah ku jirto waxaad daryeel ka heleysaa daryeelka caafimaadka dadweynaha haddii aadan xittaa guri-degmo ku laheyn Finland ama aadan shaqo darteed xaq u laheyn daryeel.
en: In an emergency situation, you will be treated in public health care even if you do not have a municipality of residence in Finland or you are not entitled to medical care based on your work.

so: Haddii aadan xaq u lahayn adeegyada guud ee caafimaadka, waxaad waqti ka qabsan kartaa rugta dhakhaatiirta ee gaarka loo leeyahay.
en: If you are not entitled to public health services, you can make an appointment at a private clinic.

so: Adeegyada caafimaadka gaarka loo leeyahay macaamiisha aad ayey uga qaalisan yihiin adeegayada guud ee caafimaadka ee dawladu bixiso.
en: Private health services are considerably more expensive for the customer than public ones.

so: Luuqadaha adeega daryeelka caafimaadka Finland dhexdeeda waa Finnish iyo Swedish.
en: Health services in Finland are offered in Finnish and Swedish.

so: Intabadan luuqada Ingiriiska way ka soconaysaa.
en: Often you can also get along with English.

so: Markii aad waqti ka qabsaneysid adeegyada caafimaadka, waydii suurtogalnimaada inaad adeegsato turjubaan (tulkki), haddii aadan ku hadlin luuqadaha kor lagu soo sheegay.
en: When making an appointment for health services, ask if it is possible to use an interpreter (tulkki) if you cannot speak any of the above-mentioned languages.

so: Markii aad dhakhtarka waqti ka qabsato, waxaa muhiim ah inaad waqtigaas ugu tegtid oo aadan ka daahin.
en: When you have made an appointment with a doctor it is important to be there on time.

so: Haddii aad dhakhtarka waqti ka qabsatay laakiin aadan waqtigaas tagi karin, waxaa haboon baajisid balanta dhakhtarka, sida caadiga ah maalin ka hor waqtiga balanta.
en: If you have made an appointment but cannot keep it, it is very important to cancel it in good time, usually the previous day.

so: Haddii aadan tegin ama aadan baajin balanta, waxaad ku qasbanaanaysaa inaad magdhaw bixiso.
en: If you do not arrive at the clinic and you have not cancelled your appointment, you will be charged a non-attendance fee.

so: Rugtaada caafimaadka waxaad ballan ka samaysan kartaa dhakhtarka guud ama kalkaalisada/kalkaaliyaha caafimaadka.
en: If you fall ill, first contact your own health centre (terveysasema) where you can make an appointment with a general practitioner or nurse.

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira adeegyada caafimaadka ee degmooyinka kala duwan waxaad ka helaysaa bogagga maxaliga ee InfoFinlandi ama bogagga internetka ee degmadaada.
en: You can find information about the health services of different localities on the InfoFinland websites for different areas or your own municipality's website.

so: Adeegyada rugta caafimaadku waa u jaban yahay macaamilka, sababtoo ah waxaa lagu maalgeliyaa lacagta canshuurta.
en: Health centre services are relatively cheap for clients, because they are funded through tax revenue.

so: Waqti qabsashada waxaa haboon inaad haddiiba subixii wacdid, markii rugta caafimaadka la furo.
en: To make an appointment, it is a good idea to call the health centre in the morning as soon as it opens.

so: Si degdeg ah ayaad waqti u heleysaa haddii uu ku hayo xanuun ay tahay in degdeg wax looga qabto.
en: You will be given an appointment at short notice if you have a condition that requires urgent care.

so: Haddii aadan u baahnayn daryeel degdeg ah, waqti dheer ayaad sugeysaa waqtiga dhaqtarka.
en: If you do not need urgent treatment, you will have to wait longer for a doctor's appointment.

so: Ballanta waqtiga ayaa lagaaga sheegayaa sida ugu dhaqsaha badan ee aad daryeel ku heleyso.
en: When booking your appointment, you will be told how soon you will receive treatment.

so: Ballan qabsashada waxaa lagu ogaanayaa inaad u baahan tahay la kulan dhakhtar ama kalkaaliso caafimaad maadaama ay kalkaalisadu ay daryeeli karto jirooyin badan.
en: The person making your appointment will also evaluate whether you need to see a doctor or a nurse. In Finland, nurses can treat a number of illnesses.

so: Haddii loo baahdana kalkaalisada ayaa kuu sii gudbineysa dhakhtarka.
en: If necessary, the nurse will refer you to a doctor.

so: Haddii aad haysatid kaarka caymiska qaranka (Kela-kortti), horay u qaado, markii aad rugta caafimaadka aadeyso.
en: If you have a Kela card (Kela-kortti), take it along when you go to the health centre.

so: Haddii aad u baahantahay dhaqtar takhasus gaar ah, marka hore ballan ka qabso dhaqtarka guud.
en: If you need the services of a specialist, first book an appointment with a general practitioner.

so: Haddii loo baahdo dhakhtarka rugta caafimaadku wuxuu warqad gudbin ah u dirayaa dhakhtarka khaaska ah.
en: When necessary, a health centre doctor will give you a referral to a specialist.

so: Dhakhaatiirka khaaska ah waxaa laga helaa rugaha caafimaadka qaarkood, poliklinikooyinka iyo istitaalada.
en: Some health centres, out-patient clinics and hospitals also have specialists.

so: Kalkaaliyeyaal caafimaad oo khaas ah waxaa laga helaa isbitaalada waaweyn ee xarumaha ah iyo isbitaalada jaamacadda.
en: Special health care is given at central hospitals and university hospitals.

so: Dalka Finland gudihiisa suurtogal kama aha in adigoo isticmaalaya adeegyada guud ee caafimaadka uu dhakhtarku gurigaaga kuugu yimaado.
en: In Finland, public health service doctors do not make home visits.

so: Qaar kamida xarumaha dhakhaatiirta gaarka loo leeyahay ayaa adeegyadaas oo kale bixiya.
en: Some private clinics offer such services, but a private doctor's home visit is expensive.

so: Haddii uu xanuunkaagu uu waqti dheer sii socdo, oo aadan awoodin inaad shaqo aado, bogga InfoFinlandi boggiisa Cawinaada waqtiga jirada waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad dheeraad ah oo la xiriira lacagta jirada ee ay Keladu bixiso.
en: If your illness continues for a long time and you are unable to go to work, you can find more information about Kela's sickness allowance on the InfoFinland web page Support during illness.

so: Heeganka adeega caafimaadka ee guud ama babliga ah
en: On-call public health services

so: Galbihii iyo dhamaadka usbuucaba gugaha caafimaadku way xiranyihiin, markaas xanuunada degdega ah waxaa lagu daweeyaa heeganka (päivystys).
en: Health centres are closed in the evenings and at weekends. At these times, acute cases are treated at emergency clinics (päivystys).

so: Heeganka waxaa loogu talagalay xaaladaha u baahan daryeel degdeg ah.
en: Emergency clinics are intended for situations in which the patient requires immediate treatment.

so: Haddii jiradaadu aysan u baahnayn daryeel degdeg ah, ballan ka qabso rugtaada caafimaadka marka xiga ee ay furantahay.
en: If your illness does not require immediate treatment, book an appointment at your health station the next time it is open.

so: Sida badan heeganka waxaa lagu qabtaa isbilaal dhexdiis, magaalooyinka yar yar, mar marka qaarkood waxaa lagu qabtaa magaalada ugu dhaw.
en: Duty doctor services are often provided at a hospital department reserved specifically for it and sometimes, in small localities, in a neighbouring town.

so: Waydii xaruntaada caafimaadka waqtiyada uu heeganku furanyahay ama ka raadi macluumaadka bogagga shabakadda degmadaada.
en: Ask for more information at your health centre during opening hours or look for more information on the website of your municipality.

so: Macluumaadyada xiriirka rugaha caafimaadka ee gaarka loo leeyahay waxaad ka heli kartaa tusaale ahaan internetka.
en: The contact information for private clinics can be found online, for example.

so: Waxaa dhici karta inaad waqti uga heli karto rugta caafimaadka ee gaarka loo leeyahay si ka dhaqso badan adeegyada caafimaadka ee dadweynaha.
en: It will probably be faster to get an appointment with a private clinic than public health services.

so: Adeegyada caafimaadka ee gaarka loo leeyahay si muuqata ayeey ugu qaalisan yihiin kuwa dadweynaha.
en: Private health services are considerably more expensive for the client than public ones.

so: Rugaha dhaqaatiirta ee kala duduwan waxey bixiyaan adeegyo kala gedisan.
en: Different clinics offer different services.

so: Adeegyada caafimaadka ee gaarka loo leeyahay waxaa isticmaali kara dadka oo dhan, xitaa kuwa aan guri degmo ku laheyn Finland.
en: Private health services can be used by everyone, including those who do not have a municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Kelada ayaa bixisa qayb yar oo ka mid ah kharashka ku baxa daryeelka caafimaadka gaarka loo leeyahay iyo kharashaadka daryeelka ilkaha, haddii aad ku jirtid xayndaabka caymiska jirada (sairausvakuutus) ee Finland.
en: Kela pays a small part of the expenses of private health care and dental care if you are covered by Finnish national health insurance (sairausvakuutus).

so: Sidoo kale xuquuqda magdhawga Kelada waxaa xaaladaha qaarkood heli kara qof aan ku jirin xayndaabka caymiska jirada ee Finland, wixii warar dheeraad ah weydii Kelada.
en: Sometimes a person who is not covered by Finnish national health insurance may also be entitled to Kela reimbursements. Ask for more information at Kela.

so: Horay u sii qaado Kaarka Kelada.
en: Bring along your Kela card.

so: Haddii wadan kale oo Wuqooyiga Yurub ah aad ku leedahay ceymiska jirada, waxaad xaq u leedahay Finland gudaheeda in aad hesho daryeelka jirada ee aan laga maarmin.
en: If you are covered by health insurance in another Nordic country, you are entitled to essential health care in Finland.

so: Waxaad daryeelka u heleysaa islamarkaasna adeegga uga bixineysaa si lamid ah sida ay Finnishku u bixiyaan una helaan adeegga.
en: You will receive care under the same terms and pay the same amount for the services as Finns do.

so: Horay u sii qaado aqoonsigaada marka aad isticmaaleyso adeegyada caafimaadka.
en: Bring along an official identity card when using health services.

so: Haddii aad wadan kale oo Midowgya Yurub ama, wadan ETA ah ama Switzerland ku leedahay ceymiska jirada, waxaad Finland gudaheeda xaq u leedahay in aad hesho daryeelka jirada ee aan laga maarmin.
en: If you are covered by health insurance in another EU member state, EEA member state or Switzerland, you are entitled to essential health care in Finland. In order to receive treatment, you must have a European Health Insurance Card.

so: Si aad u heli karooto daryeelkaas, waa inaad ka heysataa kaarka jirada daryeelka jiradaYurub wadanka aad ceymiska caafimaadka uga jirto.
en: You must obtain a European Health Insurance Card from the country in which you are covered by health insurance.

so: Kaarka daryeelka jirada ee Yurub wuxuu xaq kuu siinayaa daryeel haddii aad jirato ama aad shil gasho.
en: The European Health Insurance card entitles you to receive treatment if you fall ill or have an accident.

so: Daryeel waad heli kartaa xitaa haddii jiro aad mudo dheer qabtay darteed aad u baahantahay daryeel.
en: You will also receive treatment if your long-term illness requires it.

so: Kaarka waxaa kale oo aad ku heleysaa daryeelka la xiriira uurka iyo dhalmada.
en: The card also entitles you to receive treatment related to pregnancy and delivery.

so: Daryeelka waxaad ku heleysaa qiimo lamid ah dadka sida joogtada ah u deggan Finland.
en: You will pay the same amount for your treatment as permanent Finnish residents do.

so: Haddii aad Finland shaqo u timid, waxaa laga yaabaa in aad xaq u leedahay isticmaalka adeegyada caafimaadka dadweynaha.
en: If you have come to Finland to work, you may be entitled to use public health services in Finland.

so: Tani waxay ku xiran tahay dhirirka inta heshiiska shaqadaadu uu socday iyo nooca heshiiska shaqada iyo weliba wadanka aad Finland uga timid.
en: This depends on the duration and type of your contract of employment, as well as on the country from which you have come to Finland.

so: Finland, Shaqo-bixiyaha waxaa waajib ku ah in uu shaqaalihiisa ka bixiyo qarashka ku baxaya daryeelka caafimaadka kahortaga ah.
en: In Finland, employers have a duty to pay for preventive health care for their employees.

so: Ganacsadaha waxay naftooda u abaabuli karaan daryeelka caafimaadka shaqaalaha, haddii uu rabo.
en: Entrepreneurs can organise occupational health care for themselves, if they wish.

so: Qofka ganacsadaha ah qasab kuma ahan inuu naftiisa u abaabulo deryeelka caafimaadka ee shaqaalaha.
en: In other words, entrepreneurs are not under an obligation to arrange occupational health care for themselves.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaado ganacsaduhu waa inuu daryeelka caafimaadka shaqaalaha u abaabulo shaqaalihiisa, asaga u shaqeeya.
en: An entrepreneur is, however, required to organise occupational health care for any employees working for them.

so: Daryeelka caafimaadka shaqada waxaa qabanqaabin kara rugta caafimaadka ee deegaanka ama tusaale ahaan xarunta dhaqaatiirta ee gaarka ah.
en: Occupational health care can be arranged at a local health centre or, for example, private clinic.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeri ah waxaad ka heli kartaa InfoFinlandi bogga Daryeelka Caafimaadka Shaqaalaha iyo bogga internetka ee wasaarada arimaha bulshada iyo caafimaadka.
en: You can find more information on the InfoFinland web page Occupational health care and on the website of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Health.

so: Haddii aad Finland ardaynimo ku imaaneysid adigoo ka imaanaya wadamo kale, sida wadan ka tirsan Midowga Yurub, wadan ETA ka tirsan ama Switzerland waxaad sida badan wadankaaga uga baahan tahay inaad ka soo qaadatid kaarka caymiska jirada oo wax walba daboolaya, ka hor inta aadan qaadan deganaanshada Finland.
en: If you come to study in Finland from a country other than a EU member state, EEA member state or Switzerland, you will usually need a comprehensive national health insurance policy from your home country before you can get a residence permit for Finland.

so: Haddii waxbarashadaadu inta ay soconayso lagu qiyaaso ugu yaraan labo sano, sida badan Finland waxaad ka heleysaa magaalo degaan kuu noqota waxaadna u gudbeysaa xayndabda adeegayda caafimaadka ee ay degmadu bixiso.
en: If the estimated duration of your studies is no less than two years, you will usually be granted a municipality of residence in Finland and will thus be covered by municipal health services.

so: Markaas waxaa kugu filan, in caymiskaagu uu ugu horeyn daboolo kharashka dawooyinka.
en: In that case, it is enough that your insurance policy primarily covers medical costs.

so: Haddii aadan hubin, inaad magaalo degaan aad Finland xaq ugu leedahay arrinta ka soo hubi xafiiska diiwaangelinta dadka.
en: If you are unsure whether you have the right to a municipality of residence in Finland, check the matter at a Local Register Office.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ee la xiriira meesha qofku degen yahay oo ka diiwaangashan yahay waxaad ka heleysaa InfoFinlandi bogga Degan Degmo ku yaalo Finland.
en: You can find more information about municipality of residence on the InfoFinland web page Municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ee la xiriira ruqsada deganaanshada ee ardayda iyo caymiska jirada, kaas oo ruqsada awgeed aad u baahan tahay, waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga internetka ee xafiiska dadka wadanka u soo guurey (Maahanmuuttovirasto).
en: The website of the Finnish Immigration Service (Maahanmuuttovirasto) provides additional information about residence permits for studies and national health insurance, which you will need for the permit.

so: Ardayda dugsiyada tacliinta sare ee Finland waxey ka tirsan yihiin xeyndaabka daryeelka caafimaadka waxbarashada.
en: In Finland, students in higher education are covered by the student health care system.

so: Wixii warar dheeraad ah weydii machadkaaga.
en: Ask for more information at your educational establishment.

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira daryeelka caafimaadka waxbarashada waxaad ka heli kartaa Hay'adda daryeelka caafimaadka ardayda jaamacadaha (YTHS) iyo bogga internetka ee Wasaarada Caafimaadka iyo Arrimaha Bulshada (Sosiaali- ja terveysministeriö).
en: To find out more about student health care, go to the websites of FSHS (YTHS) and the Ministry of Social Affairs and Health (Sosiaali- ja terveysministeriö).

so: Haddii dalka Finland qaxooti ahaan laguugu soo qaatay, waxaad guri degaan ku leedahay Finland, waxaadna isticmaali kartaa adeegyada caafimaadka ee dawladu bixiso.
en: If you have come to Finland as a quota refugee, you have a municipality of residence in Finland and you are entitled to use public health services.

so: Haddii aad magangalyodoon tahay welina codsigaaga aan goaan laga gaarin, xafiiska dad-dhigista isagama diiwaangelin kartid sida qof wadanka degen oo kale, sidoo kalena ma isticmaali kartid adeegyada caafimaadka ee ay degmadu bixiso.
en: If you are an asylum seeker and your application has not been processed yet, you cannot register as a resident of the municipality at the Local Register Office, nor use municipal health services.

so: Wixii dheeraad ah weydii xarunta qaabilaada ee aad degentahay.
en: Ask for more information at your reception centre.

so: Haddii aad heshay sharciga degenaanshda oo ku salaysan sababo badbaadin, xuquuqda degenaanshada degmadana aad ka heshid Finland, waxaad isticmaali kartaa adeegyada caafimaadka ee degmadaada.
en: If you have gained a residence permit on the basis of a need for protection and are given the right to a municipality of residence in Finland, you are entitled to use the health services of your own municipality.

so: Ka akhriso macluumaadka dheeriga ah ee la xiriira xuquuqda degmo kulahaanshada Finland bogga InfoFinlandi boggiisa Degan Degmo ku yaalo Finland.
en: You can find more information about the right to a municipality of residence in Finland on the InfoFinland web page Municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Global Clinic waa kiliinikada, taasood ka heli kaaro caawimo iyo talosiin dhakhtar ama kalkaalisada caacimaadka, haddaad ku nooshahay Finland adoon u heysan wax ogolaansho ah adeegyada Global clinic waxaad ka heleysaa degmooyinkan
en: If you are in Finland without a residence permit, you can get medical assistance and advice from the Global Clinic. Global Clinic operates in the following cities:

so: Telefoonka xaaladaha dhibaatada ee Ururka caafimaadka dhimirka ee Finland (Suomen Mielenterveysseura) wuxuu dadka xaaladaha dhibaatada ku jira siiyaa cawinaad wada sheekaysi oo xagga telefoonka ah.
en: The Crisis Helpline of the Finnish Association for Mental Health (Suomen Mielenterveysseura) offers help in the form of discussion for those in a crisis situation.

so: Waad wici kartaa xitaa teleefonka masiibooyinka, hadaad markaa ka wallaacsan tahay ehelkaaga.
en: You can also call the Crisis Helpline if you are worried about a family member.

so: Ururka caafimaadka dhimirka ee Finland boggooda waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad faro-badan.
en: On the website of the Finnish Association for Mental Health you can find information about:

so: Macluumaadku waxay ku qoranyihiin luuqadaha Finnishka, Ingiriis, Kurdi (Sorani), Ruush iyo Soomaali.
en: Information is provided in Finnish, English, Kurdish (Sorani), Russian and Somali.

so: Uurka waxaa kaloo looga hortagi karaa dareeraha shahwada waxtarka ka qaada, tusaale ahaan xoorta la mariyo xubnaha tartanka ee dukarka (emätinvaahto) ama sunboosada la galiyo xubnaha taranka ee dumarka (emätinpuikko), laakiin kuwaan oo dhan waxtar xooleh ma lahan.
en: Pregnancy can also be prevented with spermicides, for example, vaginal contraceptive foam (emätinvaahto) or pessaries (emätinpuikko), but these are not very effective.

so: Isticmaalka kondomka ama cinjirku wuxuu kaa badbaadiyaa cuduro badan oo ku dhaca habdhiska galmada.
en: Using a condom will protect you from most sexually transmitted diseases.

so: Cinjirka galmada waxaad ka iibsan kartaa tukaamada, shidaalada baansiinka, dabakaayooyinka iyo farmashiyeyaasha. Soo iibsigooda loogama baahna warqad dhakhtar.
en: Condoms can be bought from grocery shops, service stations, kiosks and pharmacies, and they can be bought without prescription.

so: Qaar ka mid ah dareereyaasha shahwada raga waxtarka ka qaada waxaad ka iibsan kartaa farmashiyaha warqad dhakhtar la'aanteed.
en: Some spermicides can also be bought from pharmacies without prescription.

so: Isticmaalka dawooyinka ka hortaga uurka ee hormonka ah waxaad u baahan tahay warqad dhakhtar, tusaale ahaan xarunta caaafimaadka (terveysasema) ee xaafadaada ama dhakhtarka gynekologiga ee khaaska ah.
en: For hormonal contraceptives you will need a prescription from a doctor, for example, from a health centre (terveysasema), or a private gynaecologist.

so: Waxaad waqti ka qabsan kartaa la talinta ka hortaga uurka (ehkäisyneuvonta) kaligaa ama adiga iyo lammaanahaaga oo wada socda.
en: You can also make an appointment at a family planning clinic (ehkäisyneuvonta) and go alone or together with your partner.

so: Inta badan wax waraaq dhakhtar ah ugama baahnid dib uga hortagida.
en: Usually no prescription is needed for emergency contraception.

so: Kaniiniyada ka hortagga uurka, kaniiniga yar yar iyo sharootooyinka ka hortagida uurka iyo faraantiyada ka hortagida uurka waxaad farmashiyeyaasha uga iibsan kartaa adigoo isticmaalaya waraaq dhakhtarku kuu qoray.
en: Contraceptive pills, mini-pills, contraceptive patches and vaginal contraceptive rings can be bought from a pharmacy with a doctor's prescription.

so: Faraantiga kupariga ah iyo faraantiga hormoniga ah waxaa imlo galeenka galiya dhakhtar.
en: A copper contraceptive coil or hormone coil is fitted in place by a doctor.

so: Faaraantigu wuxuu ku haboon yahay dumarka horay u soo dhalay.
en: Contraceptive coils are best suited for women who have given birth.

so: Sidoo kale dhalinyaraduna dhakhtarka waqti way ka qabsan karaan si dhakhtarku ugu qoro qalabka ka hortaga dhalmada.
en: Young persons can also make a doctor's appointment and get a prescription for contraceptives.

so: Ruqsada walidiinta looma baahna.
en: Parents' permission is not required.

so: Kalkaalida caafimaadka ee iskuulka ayaad kala sheekaysan kartaa ka hortaga, magaalooyinka qaarkoodna kaalkaalida caafimaadka ee iskuulka ayaa bixin karta baakadka bilaabida ka hortaga uurka.
en: Young persons can talk about contraception with their school nurse, and in some municipalities, the school nurse can give them a starter pack.

so: Haddii dhibaato ka timaado ka hortaga ama aad hilmaantid inaad isticmaasho ka hortaga, waxaad farmashiga ka iibsan kartaa kaniiniga dib uga hortagida uurka (jälkiehkäisypilleri).
en: If you have problems with contraception or you have forgotten to use it, you can buy an emergency contraception pill (jälkiehkäisypilleri) from a pharmacy.

so: Waa in la isticmaalo sida ugu dhaqsaha badan galmada kadib, ugu dambayn 72 saacadood kadib.
en: It must be taken as soon as possible after intercourse, at the latest 72 hours after it.

so: Dhalinyarada da'doodu ka sareyso 15 sano waxay iibsan karaan kaniiniga dib ka hortagida ayagoon wadan wax warqad dhakhtar ah.
en: Persons over 15 years of age can buy a emergency contraception pill without prescription.

so: Dhalinyarada ka yar 15 ka sano waxay u baahan yihiin warqad dhakhtar.
en: Persons under 15 years of age need a doctor's prescription.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan qalabka ka hortaga uurka waxaad ka heleysaa bogga internetka ee uururka diiwaanka dadka (Väestöliitto).
en: The website of the Family Federation of Finland (Väestöliitto) offers information about different kinds of contraceptives.

so: Carruurta waxaa loogu soo dirayaa ballanta daryeelka ilkaha guriga.
en: Children will be invited to a dental checkup by letter sent to their home address.

so: Carruurtana waxaa si joogto ah loogu yeeraa koontoroolka ilkaha.Daryeelka dadweynaha ee caafimaadka ilkaha waa u lacag la'aan ilmaha ka yar da'da 18–jir
en: Dental checkups are arranged for children on a regular basis. Public dental care is free of charge for children under the age of 18.

so: Haddii aad shahaado ka soo qaadatay dal kale, waxaad u baahan kartaa go'aanka aqoonsashada shahaadada, si aad Finland uga shaqeyso ama wax uga barato.
en: If you have completed a degree in another country, you may need a decision of recognition of the degree to be able to work or study in Finland.

so: Xaalado badan marka lagu jiro, shaqo-bixiyaha goobta waxbarashada ama dugsiga tacliinta sare ayaa qiimeynaya nooca aqoon iyo xirfadeed ee ay shahaadadaada dibaddu ku siisay.
en: In most situations, the employer, educational institute or university assesses the qualifications and competence that your foreign diploma or degree has provided.

so: Waxaad u baahan tahay go'aanka aqoonsashada Maamulka waxbarashada ama hay'ad kale, haddii aad dooneyso in aad ka shaqeyso xirfadda la xeeray ama shaqo looga baahan yahay shahaadada tacliinta sare oo leh heer la og yahay.
en: You need a recognition decision from the Finnish National Agency for Education or another authority if you want to work in a regulated profession or a position that requires a higher education degree at a specific level.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso in aad Finland waxbarasho ka sii wadato
en: If you want to continue studies in Finland

so: Dugsiyada tacliinta sare iyo goobaha waxbarashadu iyaga go'aan ka gaara xulashada ardayga.
en: Universities and educational institutes decide on student admission.
