so: Waxaa ay sidoo kale go'aan ka gaaraan in waxbarashada aad dibadda ku soo qaadaya iyo aqoontaada kale loo aqbalo in ay qeyb ka noqdaan waxbarashada aad Finland ku qaadaneyso.
en: They also decide whether foreign studies and your other competence can be accepted as a part of the degree you complete in Finland.

so: Haddii aad waxbarasho tacliin sare ah ku soo qaadatay dibadda aadna dooneyso in aad waxbarashada ka sii wadato Finland, macluumaad iyo hagitaan waxaad adeegyada ardayda ee dugsiyada tacliinta sare iyo adeegyada SIMHE.
en: If you have completed higher education courses abroad and want to continue your studies in Finland, you can get information and guidance from the student services and SIMHE services of higher education institutes.

so: Hawlaha aan u baahneyn aqoon gaar ah
en: Jobs that do not require specific training

so: Sida uu qabo sharciga Finland, shaqooyinka oo dhan uma baahna aqoon gaar ah ama heer shahaado oo gaar ah.
en: Not all jobs require specific training or degree level according to Finnish law.

so: Tusaale ahaan shaqo-bixiyaha laamaha gaarka ah ayaa inta badan qiimeynaya in shahaadada dibaddu ay qofka siineyso aqoon shaqada ku filan.
en: For example, a private sector employer usually assesses independently whether a foreign diploma or degree provides sufficient qualifications for the job.

so: Is-barbardhigga heerka shahaadada dugsiga tacliinta sare
en: Comparability of higher education degree levels

so: Shaqooyinka qeybaha guud (dowladda iyo degmooyinka) waxaa inta badan laga doonayaa shahaadada dugsiga tacliinta sare oo heer la og yahay ah, tusaale ahaan shahaadada sare ee dugsiga tacliinta sare.
en: Public sector (municipal or state) positions usually require a higher education degree at a specific level, such as a master's degree.

so: Haddii aad dibadda ka soo qaadatay shahaado tacliinta sare ah, waxaad Maamulka waxbarashada ka codsan kartaa go'aanka isbarbardhigga heerka shahaadadaada.
en: If you have completed a higher education degree abroad, you can apply to the Finnish National Agency for Education for a decision to recognise your degree as comparable to a certain level.

so: Marka heerka shahaadadaada la barbadhigo shahaadada tacliinta sare ee Finnishka, waxaad codsan kartaa shaqooyinka looga baahan yahay heer waxbarasho oo la mid ah kaaga.
en: Once your degree level has been recognised as comparable to a Finnish higher education degree, you can apply for jobs that require that level of higher education.

so: Finland, xirfadaha qaarkood waa kuwa la xeeriyay.
en: Some professions are regulated in Finland.

so: Xirfadahaan waa tusaale ahaan fiisiyoteraabiistaha, dhakhtarka, dhakhtarka ilkaha, farmashiistaha, kalkaalisada caafimaadka, qareenka, xisaabiyaha, macallinka fasalka madduul sifeeyaha.
en: This means that the education and training required for them is specified in law. Such jobs include, for example, physiotherapist, doctor, dentist, pharmacist, nurse, attorney, auditor, class teacher and chimney sweeper.

so: Hay'adaha laamaha kala qaabilsan ayaa go'aaminaya xaqa loo leeyahay ku shaqeynta xirfadda xeeran ama isticmaalka magaca xirfadda.
en: The authorities for each sector make decisions on the right to carry out a regulated profession or use the professional title.

so: Tusaale ahaan laamaha daryeelka bulshada iyo caafimaadka waxaa go'aan ka gaara Valvira laanta waxbarashadana Maamulka waxbarashada.
en: For example, in the social and health care sector, the decision is made by Valvira National Supervisory Authority for Welfare and Health, and in the education sector, it is made by the Finnish National Agency for Education.

so: Bogagga shabakadda Maamulka waxbarashada waxaad ka heleysaa liiska xirfadaha la xeeray iyo hay'adaha go'aanka ka gaara.
en: The website of the Finnish National Agency for Education has a list of regulated professions and the decision-making authorities.

so: Xirfdaha la xeeriyay iyo shahaadada wadanka kale oo Midowga Yurub ah
en: Regulated professions and a degree from another EU country

so: aad tahay muwaadin wadan Midowga Yurub ah, wadan ETA ah ama muwaadin u dhashay Switzerland
en: you are a citizen of an EU member state, EEA member state or Switzerland, and

so: aad ka qaadatay wadan Midowga Yurub ah, wadan ETA ah ama muwaadin u dhashay Switzerland aqoonta xirfad Finland ka xeersan,
en: you have qualified in another EU country, EEA country or Switzerland for a profession that is regulated in Finland,

so: waxaad xirfaddan ha'adda qaabilsan uga codsan kartaa aqoonsashada aqoonta xirfadda.
en: you can apply for the recognition of professional qualifications from the authority responsible for the sector.

so: Haddii waxbarashadaadu ay aad uga duwan yahay waxbarashada Finland looga baahan yahay, waxaa laga yaabaa in aad sameyso wakhtiga la qabsashada ama imtixaanka ku habboonaanta.
en: If your education and training is very different from the education and training required in Finland, you may have to complete an adjustment period or qualification test.

so: Haddii aad shahaado xirfadeed ka soo qaadatay dibadda, waxaad bayaan uga codsan kartaa Maamulka waxbarashada.
en: If you have completed a vocational degree abroad, you can apply to the Finnish National Agency for Education for a statement on your degree.

so: Bayaanka waxaa lagu sharraxayaa heerka shahaadada iyo waxyaabaha ka kooban tahay iyo shaqooyinka ay shahaadadu kuu siineyso aqoon ahaan si aad uga shaqeyso wadanka aad ka soo qaadatay.
en: The statement describes the level and contents of the degree and the positions that the degree qualifies you for in the country where you completed it.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee bayaanku kuma siinayo aqoon aad uga shaqeyso Finland xirfad la xeeray.
en: However, the statement does not qualify you to act in a regulated profession in Finland.

so: Haddii luqada asalka ah ee shahaadadu aysan aheyn Finnish, Iswidhish ama Ingiriis, waxaad inta badan u baahan tahay turjumaadda rasmiga ah ee dukumentiyada, taas oo uu sameeyay turjubaan qoraal oo rasmi ah.
en: If the original language of your certificate is not Finnish, Swedish or English, you usually need an authorised translation of the documents done by an authorised translator.

so: Hay'adaha qaarkood waxay aqbalaan dukumentiyada ku qoran luqadaha kale ee reer Yurub,
en: Some authorities also accept documents in some other European languages.

so: Si taxadir ah u akhri tilmaamaha codsiga ee hay'adaha laamaha kala qaabilsan.
en: Read the application instructions of the authority responsible for the sector carefully.

so: Haddii aad rabto macluumaad ama cawinaad la xiriirta arimaha caafimaadka galmada, waxaad la xiriiri kartaa xaruntaada caafimaadka (terveysasema).
en: If you want information or help in matters relating to sexual health, contact your local health centre (terveysasema).

so: Waxaad talo weydiin kartaa kalkaaliyaha caafimaadka (terveydenhoitaja) ama dhkhtarka (lääkäri) ayaad waqti ka qabsan kartaa.
en: You can ask a nurse (terveydenhoitaja) for advice or make an appointment with a doctor (lääkäri).

so: Tusaale kaniinida ka hortaga uurka awgiis waxaad u baahantahay rajeeto uu dhakhtarka oo keliya uu qori karo.
en: For contraceptive pills, for example, you need a prescription that only a doctor can give you.

so: Adeegyada xarunta caafimaadka waxaad xaq u leedahay haddii aad Degan Degmo ku yaalo Finland.
en: You are entitled to health centre services if you have a municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Baaritaanada gynekologiga ah waxaa sameeya qaar ka mid ah dhakhaatiirta dawlada ayadoo la adeegsanaayo adeegyada guud ee caafimaadka.
en: It may be necessary for you to have a gynaecological examination, and some doctors in public health care make them.

so: Adeegyada guud ee caafimaadka xaq ayaad u leedahay haddii aad Degan Degmo ku yaalo Finland.
en: You can request to see a female doctor if you wish.

so: Dhkhaatiirta khaaska ah aad ayey qaali ugu yihiin macaamiisha.
en: However, the services of private doctors are considerably more expensive for customers.

so: Dalka Finland dumarka waxaa loo sameeyaa baaritaan xagga kansarka ah (seulontatutkimus), kaas oo la isku dayo in waqti hore la helo kansarka naasaha iyo ilmo galeenka.
en: In Finland, screenings (seulontatutkimus) are arranged for women with the aim of discovering breast cancer and cervical cancer at an early stage.

so: Baarintaanka kansarka naasaha waxaa lagu sameeyaa dumarka da'doodu u dhaxayso 50-69 sano qiyaastii labadii sanoba hal mar, baaritaanka luqunta ilmogaleenka waxaa lagu sameeyaa dumarka da'doodu u dhaxayso 30-60 sano shantii sanoba mar.
en: Breast cancer screenings are performed on 50-69 year-old women approximately every two years, and cervical cancer screenings on 30-60 year-old women every five years.

so: Haddii aad Degan Degmo ku yaalo Finland. xaq ayaad u leedahay baaritaanadaas.
en: If you have a municipality of residence in Finland, you are entitled to these screenings.

so: Haddii aad Degan Degmo ku yaalo Finland, waxaad baaritaan xaaga cudurada ragga ah ka heli kartaa xaruntaada caafimaadka. Waxaad codsan kartaa inuu ku qaabilo dhakhtar nin ah.
en: If you have a municipality of residence in Finland, you can make an appointment for a urological examination at your health centre, and you can request to see a male doctor if you prefer this.

so: Dhakhtarka ayaa warqad uu kuugu dirayo dhakhtarka gaarka ah kuugu qori kara poliklinikada cudurada ragga, haddii loo baahdo.
en: When necessary, a health centre doctor will give you a referral to a specialist at a urology clinic.

so: Qalabka ka hortaga uurka waxaa lagu iibiyaa farmashiyaha.
en: Contraceptives are sold at pharmacies.

so: Sikoo dale cinjirka galmada waxaa lagu iibiyaa tusaale ahaan dukaamada cuntada.
en: Condoms are also sold, for example, in grocery stores.

so: Si aad u heshid kaniiniyada ka hortaga uurku waxaad u baahantahay in dhakhtar kuu qoro, tusaale ahaan xarunta caafimaadka ama dhakhtar gaar ah oo ku takhasusay gynekologiyada.
en: For hormonal contraceptives you will need a prescription from a doctor, for example, at a health centre, or from a private gynaecologist.

so: Sidoo kale waxaad waqti ka qabsan kartaa la talin ka hortaga uurka (ehkäisyneuvonta).
en: You can also make an appointment at a family planning clinic (ehkäisyneuvonta).

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa InfoFinlandi bogga Ka hortaga uurka.
en: For more information, go to InfoFinland web page Contraception.

so: Bogga internetka ee ururka dad dhigida ayaa laga heli karaa macluumaad kaladuwan oo ka hadlaaya qalabka ka hortagida uurka.
en: The website of the Family Federation of Finland offers information about different kinds of contraceptives.

so: Macaluumaadka la xiriira iska sooridida ilmaha waxaad ka heli kartaa InfoFinlandi bogga Iska sooridida ilmaha.
en: For information on abortions, go to the InfoFinland web page Abortion.

so: Cawinaad ah xagga helitaanka ilmaha
en: Help with having a baby

so: Haddii uusan uurku si iskiis ah u bilaaban mudo sannad gudihiis ah, markii la joojiyey cunitaanka kaniiniyada ka hortaga uurka, arinta waa baari karnaa.
en: If you wish to have a child, and you and your partner have not conceived a child within a year after the use of contraceptives has been stopped, the matter can be looked into.

so: Inta badan heletaanka ilmaha cawinaad ayaa loo heli karaa.
en: The problem can often be solved.

so: Waxaad waqti baaritaan ka qabsan kartaa xarunta caafimaadka (terveysasema), dhakhtarka gynekologiga ama dhakhtar gaar ah ee klinikada carruur la'aanta (lapsettomuusklinikka).
en: You can make an appointment for examinations at a health centre (terveysasema), with a gynaecologist, or at a private fertility clinic (lapsettomuusklinikka).

so: Baarintaanka waxaa lagu baarayaa sababta ilmo la'aanta keentay.
en: The examinations are aimed at finding the reason for infertility.

so: Haddii aad ka shakisantahay inaad qabto cudur galmada lagu kala qaado, waxaad waqti ka qabsan kartaa dhakhtarka rugta caafimaadka ama kan xarunta caafimaadka ee gaar loo leeyahay.
en: If you suspect that you have a sexually transmitted disease, you can make a doctor's appointment either at a health centre or private clinic.

so: Magaalooyinka waaweyn cudurada galmada waxaa si gooni ah lagu daaweyaa poliklinikada cudurada galmada (sukupuolitautien poliklinikka).
en: In larger cities, such diseases can be treated at a sexually transmitted disease clinic (sukupuolitautien poliklinikka).

so: Jabtada iyo cudurka gonorrheada waxaa lagu daweyn karaa atibiyotiga.
en: Chlamydia and gonorrhoea are treated with antibiotics.

so: Cudurada viruska sida biijada iyo honqoraha ka soobaxa xubnaha taranka, daawo laguma bogsiin karo gabi ahaan, laakiin daawadu way caawinaysaa.
en: Viral diseases, such as herpes and condyloma, cannot be cured with medication, but the symptoms can be alleviated.

so: Cudurka HIV faafkiisa waxaa ku yareyn karnaa daweyn.
en: The progression of HIV infection can be slowed down with medication.

so: Daawada waa in la bilaabo waqtiga ugu horeya oo macquulka ah.
en: Medication should be started as early as possible.

so: Haddii lagu guday ka hor intii aaadan Finland imaan, oo aad qorshayneysid inaad uur yeelato, waxaa lagugu sameyn karaa qaliin furitaan guniin ah (avausleikkaus).
en: If you were circumcised before you came to Finland and you are planning a pregnancy, an opening operation (avausleikkaus) can be performed to facilitate pregnancy and childbirth.

so: Qaliinka waxaa ugu fufud in la sameeyo inta uusan uurku bilaaban, lakiin waa la samayn karaa inta aad uurka leedahay dhexdeeda.
en: The operation is easiest to do before pregnancy, but it can also be performed during mid-pregnancy.

so: Qaliinka furitaanka gudniinku wuxuu fududaynyaa dhalmada iyo baaritaanada inta aad uurka leedahay.
en: The operation will ease childbirth and examinations during pregnancy.

so: Qaliinka waxaa lagu sameeyaa isbitaalada, inta badan ka bogsoonta qaliinku waxay qaadataa 1- 2 maalmood.
en: The operation is performed in hospital, and recovery usually takes 1-2 days.

so: Finland waxbaad ka baran kartaa adigoo arday bedel ah ama waxaad ku baran kartaa waxbarasho dhameystiran.
en: In Finland, you can study as an exchange student or complete an entire degree.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso inaad shaqo ka hesho Finland waa muhiin inaad barato luqada Finnishka ama Iswidishka.
en: If you would like to find a job in Finland, it is important that you study the Finnish or Swedish language.

so: Waa adag tahay inta badan in Finland shaqo laga helo haddii aan la aqoonin Finnishka ama Iswidishka.
en: It is often difficult to find employment in Finland if you do not know Finnish or Swedish.

so: Waad ku imaan kartaa Finland sidii arday bedel ah oo kale.
en: You can come to Finland as an exchange student.

so: Sida caadiga ah waxaad Finland wax ka baraneysaa sanad barkiis ama sanad.
en: Your studies in Finland will usually last from six months to a year.

so: Waxaad bedel waxbarasho ku samayn kartaa barnaamijyo kala duduwan.
en: You can become an exchange student through various programmes.

so: Tusaale ahaan Erasmus, Nordplus, FIRST iyo Fulbright ayaa waxay bixiyaan boosaska bedelka waxbarasho.
en: For example, Erasmus, Nordplus, FIRST and Fulbright offer exchange positions.

so: Sidoo kale iskaa waad u aadi kartaa bedelka.
en: You can also seek an exchange position independently.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso inaad Finland bedel arday ku timaado, la xiriir goobtaada waxbarashada qeybta arrimaha caalamiga ah qaabilsan ama tusaale ahaan xafiiska waxbarashada.
en: If you would like to study as an exchange student in Finland, contact the international affairs department of your school or your student office.

so: Liiska xusuusta ee ardayga cusub
en: Checklist for new students

so: Hubi inaad heysto dhamaan kuwan marka aad Finland u imaaneyso waxbarasho:
en: When coming to Finland for studies, ensure that you have all of the following:

so: Waad codsan kartaa waxbarasho xirfadeedka sare ama jaamacad xiliga dalbashada tacliimaha sare.
en: You can apply to universities and universities of applied sciences via the universities' joint application process (korkeakoulujen yhteishaku).

so: Ka aqriso faahfaahin dheeriya Dalbashada waxbarashada.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Applying for education and training.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan iskuul xirfadeedka sare waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Iskuul xirfadeedyada sare.
en: Read more on universities of applied sciences on the InfoFinland page Universities of Applied Sciences.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan iskuulaadka tacliinta sare waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Jaamacadaha.
en: Find out more on institutes of higher education on the InfoFinland page Universities.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale jaamacadda ama iskuul xirfadeedka sare ee Finland ka baran kartaa waxbarashada sii-socota.
en: In Finland, you can also complete postgraduate studies at universities or universities of applied sciences.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan waxbarashada sii-socta ka aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Jaamacadaha iyo Iskuul xirfadeedka sare.
en: More information on postgraduate studies is available on the InfoFinland pages Universities and Universities of applied sciences.

so: Marka aad Finland waxbarasho u imaaneyso, baahida ogolaanshaha joogitaanka dalku wuxuu ku xiran dalka aad u dhalatay.
en: When you are planning to come to Finland to study, your need for a residence permit depends on the country of which you are a citizen.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ka aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Arday.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Student.

so: Ardayda ajaaniibta ahi inta badan ma helaan kaalmada waxbarashada.
en: Foreign students are normally not eligible for student financial aid.

so: Sidaas darteed waa inaad leedahay qorshe ku saabsan sida aad waxbarashadaada Finland ku maalgashaneyso.
en: Therefore, you must have a plan as to how you intend to finance your studies in Finland.

so: Si aad u hesho ogolaansha joogitaanka ee ardayga waa in aad muujisaa inaad heysato lacag kugu filan ku noolaansha Finland.
en: In order to obtain a student residence permit, you must indicate that you have enough money to live in Finland.

so: Faahfaahin dheeriya waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Arday.
en: More information is available on the InfoFinland page Student.

so: Ardayda ajnabiga ah waxey caawimaadyo lacageed oo kala duwan u codsan karaan jaamacadaha Finland.
en: Foreign students can apply for different grants to Finnish higher education institutions.

so: Jaamacad kasta waxey gooni u leedahay nidaam caawimaad lacageed oo loogu talagalay ardadya ka timaada meelaha ka baxsan Aagaha Midowga Yurub/ ETA ee loo ogolaaday in uu waxbarashada shahaadada koowaad ee jaamacadda ama shahaadada labaad ku qaato afka Ingiriiska.
en: Each Finnish higher education institution has its own grant system for students who come from outside the EU/EEA area and who have been accepted to complete a bachelor's or master's degree in the English language.

so: Helitaanka caawimaadda lacageed waxey kun xiran tahay horumarka aad waxbaraashada ka sameysay.
en: The grant may be dependent, for example, on your study success.

so: Caawimaadda lacageed waxey kaa daabooli kartaa dhammaan kharashka waxbarasho-xilliyeedka ama qeyb kamid ah.
en: The grant may cover the whole tuition fee or a part thereof.

so: Caawimaadaha lacageed qaarkood waxey kaa dabooli karaan kharashaadka kale.
en: Some grants may also cover other costs.

so: Mararka qaar caawimaadda lacageed waxey ku xiran tahay si aad horumar uga sameyso waxbarashadaada.
en: In some cases, the grant is tied to a certain level of success in your studies.

so: Caawimaadda lacageed waxaad codsan kartaa isla marka aad codsaneyso waxbarashada.
en: Usually, you can apply for a grant at the same time you apply for a study place.

so: Barnaamijka gaarka ah ee Erasmus-Mundus ee shahaada labaad ee jaamacaddu wuxuu leeyahay nidaam caawimaad lacageed oo u gaar ah.
en: The special Erasmus Mundus master's degree programmes also have their own grant systems.

so: Hoggaanka waxbarashada wuxuu leeyahay barnaamij deeq waxbarasheed ah oo u gaar u ah ardayda tacliinta sii wadaneysa ee Finland u yimaada in ay qaataan shahaadada doktoreetka.
en: The Finnish National Agency for Education has scholarship programmes for postgraduates who come to Finland to complete their doctoral thesis.

so: Ardayda Mareykanka ah waxey codsan karaan deeq-waxbarasheedka Fullbright.
en: American students can apply for the Fulbright scholarship.

so: Faah-faahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan caawimaadaha lacageed iyo deeqaha waxbarasho ka sii aqri bogagga adeegga ee Studyinfinland.fi.
en: Read more about grants and scholarships at Studyinfinland.fi.

so: Deganaanshaha, shaqo qabasho iyo ceymis
en: Housing, working and insurance

so: In guri la helo waa adkaan kartaa, sababtoo ah dalabka guryaha ee magaalooyinka waa weyn ayaa ka badan guryaha la hayo.
en: It may be difficult to obtain housing as the demand for dwellings exceeds the supply in larger cities in particular.

so: Inta aadan u soo guurin Finland raadi guri.
en: You should find housing well before moving to Finland.

so: Waxaad guri ka ijaaran kartaa suuqa xorta ah.
en: You can rent a dwelling on the open market.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale raadsan kartaa guri adigoo sii maraya Guryaha ardayda ee Finland (Suomen Opiskelija-asunnot) (SOA).
en: You can also look for housing through the Finnish Student Housing Association (Suomen Opiskelija-asunnot, SOA).

so: Guri degistu waa qaali Finland.
en: Housing is expensive in Finland.

so: Guryaha ardaydu waa ka jaban yihiin guryaha suuqa xorta ah.
en: Student housing is usually cheaper than housing available on the open market.

so: Haddii waxbarashada aad shaqo ku dhex wado, waqtigaada shaqadu waa xadidan yahay.
en: If you work alongside your studies, your working hours are limited.

so: Sida caadiga ah waxaad todobaadkii shaqeyn kartaa ugu badnaan 25 saacadood.
en: Usually, you can work a maximum of 25 hours a week.

so: Tan waxay ku tiirsan tahay dalka aad ka soo jeedo.
en: However, this depends on your country of origin.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale shaqaadada dhamaadka ah ku sameyn kartaa shirkad ama waxaad ka qeybqaadan kartaa tababar shaqo.
en: You can also complete your thesis in a company or take part in practical training.

so: Kuwaas waqtiyadooda shaqadu ma xadidna.
en: In these contexts, the working hours are not limited.

so: Baaxadda ceymisku wuxuu ku xiran yahay dalka aad ka soo jeedo iyo waqtiga ay qaadaneyso waxbarashadaadu.
en: The scope of the insurance depends on your country of origin and the duration of your studies.

so: Aad ayeey muhiim u tahay in mudada aad joogto Finland uu mar walba ceymiskaadu shaqeynayo.
en: It is extremely important that you maintain the validity of the insurance for the entire duration of your stay in Finland.

so: Haddii anad ahayn muwaadin ka tirsa wadamada midowga Europe ama anad ahayn muwaadin ka tirsan wadamada ETA ama anad ahayn qof ka tirsan qoyska dad muwaadiniin wadamadaas ka ah anad timaado Finland si ad wax uga barato bisha sideedaad ee 2017 ama kadib, waa inaad ka bixisaa waxbarashadaada lacagta sanaddugsiyeedka.
en: If you are not a citizen of a EU member state or EEA member state, or a family member of a citizen of these countries, and you come to study in Finland in August 2017 or later, you must pay a tuition for your studies.

so: Lacagtaas waxa laga bixiyaa tacliinta digriiga hoose iyo ka sare ee ku baxa luqada ingiriiska.
en: The tuition applies to higher education degrees in English both at the Bachelor's and Master's level.

so: Waxaad wax kaga baran kartaa Finland luqada Finnishka, Iswidishka iyo mararka qaar ingiriisi.
en: In Finland, you can study in Finnish, Swedish and, in some cases, in English.

so: Iskuulaadka tacliinta sare qaarkood waxay qabanqaabiyaan barnaamijyo waxbarasho oo ku baxaya luqada ingiriiska.
en: Institutes of higher education include courses in English in some of their study programmes.

so: Laakiin inta badan waxbarashada waxaa lagu qaadanayaa luqada finnshka ama Iswidishka.
en: However, the majority of education is provided in Finnish or Swedish.

so: Finland waxaa ka jira ururo arday oo firfircoon.
en: Finland has many active student associations.

so: Waxay xitaa waxqabadyo u sameeyaan ardayda ajaaniibta ah.
en: They also organise activities for foreign students.

so: Ururada ardayada waxaad ku baraneysaa dad cusub.
en: In student associations, you can meet new people.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso inaad shaqo ka hesho Finland, baro luqada Finnishka ama Iswidishka.
en: If you would like to find a job in Finland, study the Finnish or Swedish language.

so: Inkastoo afka ingiriiska lagu maareyn karo marxalado nololeed badan, inta badan shaqo bixiyayaasho waxay doonayaan aqoonta luqada Finnishka ama Iswidishka.
en: Even though English is sufficient in many day-to-day situations, most employers require proficiency in Finnish or Swedish.

so: Luqada waxaa sidoo kale laga baran karaa shabakadda.Faahfaahin dheeraad ka aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Luqada Finnishka iyo Iswidishka.
en: More information is available on the InfoFinland page Finnish and Swedish language.

so: Haddii aadan waqti u helin in qeybtaada waxbarashada aad ka barato luqada Finnishka, qeyb waxbarasheedyada kale ayaa qabanqaabiya koorasyada luqada Finnishka.
en: If you cannot study the Finnish language at your own school, many educational institutes provide Finnish language courses. You can also study Finnish online.

so: Waa muhiim sidoo kale inaad barato dadka iyo nolosha shaqo ee Finnishka inta aad ardayga tahay.
en: It is also important to familiarise yourself with Finnish people and working life during your studies.

so: Waxay taasi kaa caawineysaa adiga helitaanka asxaab, waxayna sidoo kale kuu fududeyneysaa shaqo raadintaada.
en: This will help you to make friends and find employment.

so: Tusaale ahaan tababarka shaqo (työharjoittelu), hiwaayadaha iyo ururadu waa qaababfiican oo aad ku baran karto bulshada Finnishka.
en: Practical training (työharjoittelu), hobbies and organisations, for example, are a good way to get to know Finnish society.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ka aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Waqtiga firaaqada.
en: For more information, go to the InfoFinland web page Leisure.

so: Haddii aad Finland shaqo u timid, waxaa laga yabaa in aad xaq u leedahay daryeelka caafimaadka, haddii aadan xittaa guri-degmo ku laheyn Finland.
en: If you come to work in Finland, you may have a right for public health care even if you do not have a municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Sida aad ku maalgelineyso waxbarashadaada Finland, waxey ku xiran tahay xaaladdaada.
en: Financing your studies in Finland is dependent on your individual situation.

so: Boggan waxaa lagu sheegayaa kaalmooyinka Kelada ee ardayda, caawimaadda lacageed iyo deeqaha waxbarasho.
en: This page includes information about the support provided by Kela to students as well as grants and scholarships.

so: Waxaad ka heli kartaa Kelada kaalamada waxbarashada (opintotuki) haddii aad
en: You are eligible to receive student financial aid (opintotuki) from Kela if:

so: heysato ogolaanshaha joogista (oleskelulupa) ee loo baahan yahay iyo
en: you have the necessary residence permit (oleskelulupa) and

so: haddii sababta joogsitaada Finland ay tahay wax ka bedelan waxbarasho.
en: your reason for being in Finland is something other than studies.

so: Haddii Finland u soo guurtay si aad waxbarato ma heli kartid kaalmada waxbarashada.
en: If you move to Finland for studies, you cannot receive student financial aid.

so: Tusaale ahaan ardayga bedelka ah Finland kama helayo kaalmada waxbarashada.
en: Exchange students, for example, will not receive Finnish student financial aid.

so: Kaalamda waxbarashadu waxey ka kooban tahay lacagta waxbarashada iyo deynta waxbarashada ee ay dowladdu dammaanad-qaaddo.
en: The student financial aid comprises the study grant and government guarantee for a student loan.

so: Waad heli kartaa kaalmada waxbarashada haddii
en: You can receive student financial aid if:

so: aad dugsi sare ku jirto
en: you are studying in an upper secondary school.

so: aad wax ka baraneyso iskuul xirfadeed ama aad baraneyso maadooyin xirfadeed oo dheeraad ah
en: you are studying in a university of applied sciences or completing vocational continuing education.

so: aad wax ka baraneyso iskuulka tacliinta sare
en: you are studying in an institute of higher learning.

so: Waad heli kartaa lacagta waxbarashada haddii aad ka weyn tahay 17 sano.
en: You are eligible for the study grant if you are over 17 years old.

so: Waxbarashadaadu waa in ay ahaataa waxa ugu weyn ee aad qabato.
en: The studies must be full-time.

so: Waxqabadka ugu weyn waxaa loola jeedaa in waxbarashadaadu ahaato shaqadaada ugu weyn.
en: This means that studies are currently your primary task.

so: Waxbarashada adigoo wata ayaad shaqeyn kartaa.
en: You can work alongside your studies.

so: Mushaarka aad ka hesho shaqadaas wuxuu yareyn karaa tirada kaalmada waxbarashadaada.
en: The pay you receive for your work may reduce the amount of student financial aid you receive.

so: Lacagta waxbarashada iyo amaahda waxbarashada ee ay dowladdu damaan qaado waxaa laga codsadaa Kelada.
en: The study grant and government guarantee for student loans must be applied for from Kela.

so: Keladu waxay bil kasta kuugu soo shubeysaa xisaabaadka bangigaada lacagta waxbarashada.
en: Kela pays the study grant into your bank account on a monthly basis.

so: Waxyaabo badan ayaa saameyn ku leh tirada lacagta waxbarashada.
en: Many factors affect the size of the study grant.

so: Tirada kaalmada waxyaabaha saameeya waxaa kamid ah da'da qofka kaalmada helaya, haddii uu kaligiis si iskiis ah u noolyahay ama uu waalidkiis la deggan yahay. Bogga internetka ama xafiiska Kelada ka hubso tirada lacagta waxbarashadaada.
en: The size of the grant is determined, among other things, by how old you are, whether you live independently or with a parent, are married and have children who are minors.You can confirm the size of your study grant on the Kela website or at a Kela office.

so: Amaahda waxbarashadu qasab ma ahan.
en: A student loan is not mandatory.

so: Waxaad qaadan kartaa ugu badnaan tiro cayiman.
en: You can only take out a certain maximum amount.

so: Adiga ayaa iskaa u dooranaya tirada amaahda waxbarasho ee aad dooneyso.
en: You can choose the amount of student loan you wish to take out.

so: Amaahda waxbarashadu waa amaah ay ardayga ka damaanad qaadeyso dowladda Finland.
en: The loan is guaranteed for the student by the Finnish government.

so: Ka dalbo bangiga amaahda waxbarashada marka aad Kelada ka hesho go'aanka damaanadqaadka dowladda.
en: Apply for a loan at a bank after receiving a decision on the government guarantee from Kela.

so: Waa inaad amaahda dib u bixisaa marka aad waxbarashada dhameyso.
en: You must pay back the student loan once you have finished your studies.

so: Waad heli kartaa sidoo kale amaahda waxbarashada marka adigoo weyn aad baraneyso dhameystirka waxbarashada (täydennyskoulutus).
en: You can also apply for student loan when you are completing continuing education (täydennyskoulutus) as an adult.

so: Xaaladaha qaarkood marka aad ku jirto waxaad heli karaa dheeraadka kirada, tusaale ahaan haddii aad qeybta lacagta ah ee machadka dadweynaha wax ka barato islamarkaasna aad deggan tahay guryaha machadka.
en: In some cases, you may also receive housing supplement, for example if you study at a folk high school in a field of study that is subject to a charge and you live in the student halls of residence.

so: Faah-faahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogagga Kelada.
en: Read more on the pages of Kela.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi Kaalmda ijaarka waxaa lagu sharraxaa kaalmada kirada ee guud.
en: InfoFinland page Housing allowance provides information about the general housing allowance of Kela.

so: Waad heli kartaa kaalmada safarka iskuulka (koulumatkatuki) haddii aad deggan tahay Finland islamarkaasna aad wax ka baraneyso dugsi sare ama machad xirfadeed.
en: You are eligible for school transport subsidy (koulumatkatuki) if you are living in Finland and studying in an upper secondary school or vocational institute.

so: Safarka iskuulkaadu waa in uu noqdaan ugu yaraan 10 kiilomitir qarashka safarkuna waa in uu ka badnaadaa 54 Yuuro bishii.
en: Your school trip must be at least 10 kilometres and the travel expenses must exceed 54 euros a month.

so: Haddii aad wax ka baraneyso iskuulka tacliinta sare waxaad sidoo kale heleysaa kaalmada raashinka (ateriatuki).
en: If you are studying at an institute of higher education, you can also receive meal subsidy (ateriatuki).

so: Kaalmada raashinka waxaa laga heli karaa maqaayadaha goobta waxbarashadu ay leedahay.
en: Meal subsidy is only available in the cafeterias of educational institutes.

so: Taas waxaa loola jeedayaa, ardaygu wuxuu cuntada ka bixinayaa lacag ka yar tan ay macaamiisha kale bixiyaan.
en: It means that students pay less for the meals than other customers.

so: Kaalmada raashinka uma baahna in gooni loo dalbado, waxay ku jirtaa qiimaha raashinka ee maqaayadda.
en: You do not need to separately apply for the meal subsidy; it is deducted from the price of the meal.

so: Waa inaad tustaa oo kaliya kaarkaada ardaynimo marka aad lacagta bixineyso.
en: You simply need to present your student card when paying for your meal.

so: Xaq uma lihid kaalmada raashinka haddii aad u joogto sameynta tabara shaqo (työharjoittelu) oo la xiriira shahaado ama waxbarasho dibadda ah.
en: You are not eligible for meal subsidy if you are in Finland for practical training (työharjoittelu) related to a foreign study programme.

so: Waxbarashadu ma ahan oo kaliya xirfad barasho.
en: Studying is more than just learning a new profession.

so: Waxbarashadu waxay adiga kuu noqon kartaa hiwaayad aad xiiseeyso.
en: Studying can also be a hobby.

so: Waxbarashadu inta badan waa lacag.
en: Studies are usually subject to a charge.

so: Goobahan waxbarasho badankood waxay dadka dalka u soo guuray u fidiyaan barashada luqada Finnishka iyo iswiidhishka.
en: Many of these institutes provide Finnish and Swedish language training for immigrants.

so: Ka aqriso dheeri boga InfoFinlandi Luuqada finnishka iyo iswiidishka.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Finnish and Swedish.

so: Sidoo kale waad baran kartaa luuqado kaloo badan sida ingiriiska iyo faransiiska.
en: You can also study many other languages, such as English or French.

so: Machadka bulshada waxaad sidoo kale ku baran kartaa aqoon xirfadeed.
en: You can also complete vocational qualifications in folk high schools.

so: Jaamacadda furan iyo iskuul xirfadeedka sare ee furan
en: Open university and open university of applied sciences

so: Jaamacadda furan (avoin yliopisto) iyo iskuula xirfadeedka sare ee furan (avoin ammattikorkeakoulu) waxay bixiyaan koorasyada jaamacadda iyo iskuul xifadeedka sare.
en: The open university (avoin yliopisto) and open university of applied sciences (avoin ammattikorkeakoulu) provide access to courses available at universities and universities of applied sciences.

so: Qof kasta ayaa wax ka baran kara iskuulaadka taclinnta sare ee furan.
en: Anyone can study in the open institutes of higher education.

so: iskuulaadka tacliinta sare ee furan waad ka baran kartaa haddii aadan xitaa heysan wax shahaado ah.
en: You can study in these institutes even without any kind of degree or qualification.

so: Waxaad wax ka baran kartaa iskuulaadka tacliinta sare:
en: You can study in an open institute of higher education

so: haddii aad dooneyso inaad hiwaayad ka dhigato waxbarashada
en: if you want to take up studying as a hobby.

so: haddii aad dooneyso inaad u gudubto iskuulka tacliinta sare si aad maado gaar ah uga barato
en: if you want to be admitted into an institute of higher education to study a particular subject.

so: haddii aad rabto inaad balaariso aqoontaada xirfadeed
en: if you want to broaden your professional expertise and knowledge.

so: Iskuulaad tacliinta sare ee furan ma lahan imtixaan gelitaan.
en: There are no entrance exams for open institutes of higher education.

so: Waxaad iska qori kartaa koorasyada guga sanadka bilowgiisa, koorasyada deyrtana dhamaadka xagaaga.
en: You can enrol for spring courses at the beginning of the year, whereas applications for autumn courses are accepted at the end of summer.

so: Toos isaga diiwaangeli kooras cayiman.
en: Enrol for a particular course directly.

so: Waad baran kartaa koorasyo kalikali ah ama waxbarasho dhameystiran.
en: You can take individual courses or complete larger study programmes.

so: Waxbarashada iskuulaadka tacliinta sare ee furan waa mid la bedbedeli karo.
en: In open institutes of higher education, studying is flexible.

so: Waxaad koorasyada qaadan kartaa maalinta, galabta ama dhamaadka todbaadka.
en: You can attend courses during the day, in the evening and at weekends.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale ka baran kartaa internetka.
en: You can also study online.

so: Waxyaabaha laga barto iskuulaadka tacliinta sare ee furan waa kuwa faa'iido u leh waxbarashada.
en: Studies completed at an open institute of higher education are useful for other studies.

so: Marka aad u gudubto iskuul xirfadeedka tacliinta sare uma baahnid inaad dib u barato koorasyadii aad ku soo baratay iskuul xirfadeedka tacliinta sare ee furan.
en: If you are accepted into a university of applied sciences, you no longer need to take the courses you have already completed at the open university of applied sciences.

so: Haddii aad wax ka baratay jaamacadda furan islamarkaasna aad dooneyso inaad jaamacadda gasho waxaad ka qeybqaadaneysaa codsi gaar ah (erillinen haku).
en: If you have studied at an open university and apply to a university, you must participate in the separate application process (erillinen haku).

so: Koorasyada jaamacadda xagaaga (kesäyliopisto) waa kuwa aad ugu dhow kuwa jaamacadda furan.
en: Courses at summer university (kesäyliopisto) are very similar to those at open university.

so: Jaamacadda xagaaga waxaad wax ka baran kartaa waqtiyada kale ee aan xagaaga aheyn.
en: You can also take summer university courses in other seasons besides summer.

so: Koorasyada jaamacadda waxaa dheer oo ay jaamacadaha xagaagu qabaqaabiyaan waxbarashooyin kale, tusaale ahaan:
en: In addition to university courses, summer universities organise other education, such as:

so: koorasyada abi (abikurssi) ee ardayada dugsiyada, ardaydaas oo u diyaargaroobaya qoraalka shahaada sare
en: pre-matriculation courses (abikurssi) for upper secondary students preparing for the matriculation examination

so: koorasyada luqada Finnishka ee ajnabiga loogu talagalay
en: Finnish language courses for immigrants

so: Helitaanka koorasyadu waa kuwa isbedbedelaya.
en: The course selection varies.

so: Weydii wararka waxbarashada rasmiga ah ee jaamacadda xagaaga ee kuu dhow.
en: For more information, contact your nearest summer university.

so: Jaamacadda dadka da'da ah
en: University of the third age

so: Jaamacadda dadka da'da ah (ikäihmisten yliopisto) waxaa loogu talagalay dadka ka weyn 60 sano.
en: The university of the third age (ikäihmisten yliopisto) is intended for persons over 60 years of age.

so: Waxbarashada jaamacadda dadka da'da ah waa qeyb kamid ah hawlaha jaamacadda furan.
en: The education activities of the university of the third age are part of the open university operations.

so: Jaamacadda dadka da'da ah waxay qabanqaabisaa muxaadarooyin isku xiriirsan iyo koorasyo safaro waxbarasho.
en: The university of the third age organises lecture series, courses and study trips.

so: Weydii faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan jaamacadda dadka da'da ah xafiiska jaamacadda xagaaga.
en: For more information on the university of the third age, contact your nearest open university office.

so: Waxyaabaha aad kuwaas ka baran karto waxaa ka mid luqadaha, shaqooyinka gacmaha, jimicsiga, farshaxanka iyo cunto karinta.
en: In them, you can study, for example, languages, handicrafts, physical education, visual art and cooking.

so: Machadyada bulshada iyo machadyada dadka shaqeeya waxay bixiyaan waxbarasho dhinaca hiwaayadda ah.
en: Adult education centres provide hobby courses.

so: Iyaga laguma baran karo waxbarashada xirfadda.
en: You cannot complete vocation studies in them.

so: Machadyada bulshada iyo machadyada dadka shaqeeya waxay koorasyada lagu barto luqada Finnishka u qabanqaabiyaa dadka dalka u soo guuray.
en: Adult education centres provide Finnish language courses for immigrants.

so: Qaababka loo codsado waa kuwa isbedbedela.
en: The application practices vary.

so: Guud ahaan waxbarashada guga waxaa la codsadaa sanadka bilowgiisa, waxbarashada deyrtana sanadka dhamaadkiisa.
en: Normally, you can apply for spring courses early in the year and autumn course at the end of the summer.

so: Weydii xafiiska waxbarashada ee machadka bulshada iyo machadka dadka shaqeeya waqtiyada codsiga.
en: For more information on the application periods, contact the student office of the desired adult education centre.

so: Machadyada dadku (kansanopisto) waxay bixiyaan waxbarasho xirfadeed iyo mid hiwaayadeed.
en: Folk high schools (kansanopisto) provide hobby courses and vocation education.

so: Machadka dadka waxaa gadaal ka taagnaan kara urur ama wuxuu ahaan karaa machad madaxbanaan.
en: The schools can be maintained by an organisation or they can be independent.

so: Waxaad machadka dadka ka baran kartaa xirfad.
en: At folk high schools, you can obtain a vocational qualification.

so: Machadka dadka waxaad ka baran kartaa tusaale ahaan daryeelista xayawaanka ama masaajeynta.
en: Folk high schools allow you to train yourself as an animal nurse or masseur, for example.

so: Machadyada dadku waxay dadka dalka u soo guuray u qabanqaabiyaan waxbarashooyin badan.
en: Folk high schools organise a great deal of education for immigrants.

so: Waxaad machadka dadka ka baran kartaa luqada Finnishka ama waxaad ka dhigan kartaa waxbarashada diyaarinta ah.
en: In these schools, you can study Finnish or attend preparatory education.

so: Machadyada dadku waxay guud ahaan qabanqaabiyaan laba waxbarasho oo kala duduwan, koorasyo gaagaaban (lyhytkurssi) iyo leyman waxbarasho oo dhaadheer (pitkä opintolinja).
en: Folk high schools normally provide education in two forms: short courses (lyhytkurssi) and long study programmes (pitkä opintolinja).

so: Koorasyada gaagaaban dadka oo dhan ayeey u furan yihiin umana baahna in la codsado.
en: The short courses are open to all and require no application.

so: Is-ogeysiin oo kaliya ayaa ku filan.
en: All you have to do is enrol.

so: Leymanka waxbarasho ee dhaadheer waa kuwa inta badan waxbarashooyinka xirfadeed ah.
en: The long study programmes are often vocational studies.

so: Waxay inta badan qaataan laga bilaabo sanad barkiis ilaa sanad.
en: They usually last from six months to a year.

so: Leymanka dhaadheer waa in gooni loo codsado.
en: You must apply separately for the study programmes.

so: Qaababka codsashada iyo waqtiyada codsiga ee machadka dadku waa kuwa isbedbedela.
en: The application practices and periods of folk high schools vary.

so: Weydii xafiiska waxbarashada ee machadka dadka codsiga ardayga.
en: For more information on the application process, contact the student office of your desired folk high school.

so: Haddii aad xanuunsatid, la xiriir rugta caafimaadka (terveysasema) ee aagaaga ku taala.
en: If you fall ill, contact your local health centre (terveysasema).

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Adeega caafimaadka ee Finland.
en: For more information, go to the InfoFinland web page Health services in Finland.

so: Macluumaadka dawooyinka la xiriira waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Dawooyinka.
en: You can find more information about medicines on the InfoFinland web page Medication.

so: Macluumaad ku saabsan adeegyada fududeeya nololmaalmeedka dadka da'da ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Dadka da'da ah.
en: More information on services that facilitate the day-to-day lives of the elderly is provided on the InfoFinland page Elderly.

so: Haddii aad ku xanaaneyneyso ehelkaaga guriga, ka aqriso macluumaad dheeriya bogga InfoFinlandi Dadka da'da ah.
en: If you take care of a family member at home, read more on the InfoFinland page Elderly.

so: Dadka ka weyn 65 sano saddexdii qofba hal qof ayaa qaba calaamado dhinaca xusuusta ah.
en: One in every three people older than 65 has symptoms involving memory problems.

so: Markasta ma sababaan jirooyin dhinaca xusuusta ah. Mararka qaar waxaa sababi kara jiro, taas oo la daweyn karo.
en: These do not always result from a memory condition, but often there may be an illness behind it which can be treated.

so: Haddii aad ogoaato in adiga ama ehelkaada ay sidii hore si ka adag ugu adagtahay in uu xusuusto waxyaabaha, la xiriir rugta caafimaadka ee soonahaada islamarkaasna ballanso dhaqtar.
en: If you notice that it is more difficult than before for you or a close family member to remember things, contact the health centre in your area and book a doctor's appointment.

so: Dhaqtarku wuxuu dhibaatooyinka xusuusta kala sheekeysanayaa bukaanka iyo haddii ay suurtagal tahay ehelkiisa, wuxuuna sameynayaa baaritaan fudud oo dhinaca xusuusta ah.
en: The doctor will discuss the memory problems with the patient and possibly also with his/her close family and will conduct a simple memory test.

so: Dhaqtarku wuxuu u sii gudbinayaa baaritaano dheeraad ah haddii loo baahdo.
en: If necessary, the doctor will write a referral for more detailed examinations.

so: Nooca 2aad ee cudurka sokortu (diabetes) wuxuu ku bilaaban karaa da' walba, laakiin inta badan da'da hawlgabka.
en: Type 2 diabetes (diabetes) can begin at any age, but it often begins at retirement age.

so: Calaamada cudurka sokorta lagu yaqaan waxaa ka mid ah daalka gaar ahaan markii cunto la cuno kadib, oon, rabitaan kaadi badan, xanaaq, isku buuqid, caatoobid, lugo xanuun, aragtida oo daciifta iyo infekshinka si sahlan uu qaado.
en: Possible symptoms of diabetes include tiredness especially after a meal, thirst, the need to urinate often, depression, irritability, weight loss, aching feet, deterioration of eyesight and getting inflammations more easily than before.

so: Cudurka sokorta waxaa lagu daweyn karaa insuliinka iyo cunto sax ah.
en: Diabetes can be treated with insulin and correct diet.

so: Haddii aad ka shaki qabto inaad cudurka sokorta qabto, waqti ka qabso dhakhtarka rugta caafimaadka ee xaafadaada ama xarunta caafimaadka ee gaarka loo leeyhay.
en: If you suspect that you have diabetes, make a doctor's appointment at your health centre or a private clinic.

so: Wixii dheeraad ah ee la xiriira cudurka sokorta waxaad ka heleysaa Xarunta horumarinta caafimaadka iyo nolol wanaaga (Terveyden ja hyvinvoinnin laitos) iyo bogga internetka ururada ku bahoobay cudurka sokorta (Diabetesliitto).
en: For more information, go to the websites of the National Institute for Health and Welfare (Terveyden ja hyvinvoinnin laitos) and the Finnish Diabetes Association (Diabetesliitto).

so: Araga iyo maqalku dad badan waa ka xumaadaan da'da darteed.
en: For many people, their eyesight and hearing deteriorate with age.

so: Si joogto ah u tag baaritaanka dhakhtarka indhaha, si jirooyinka indhaha oo ay macquulka tahay inay kugu dhacaan loo helo goor hore inta ay xaaladu wax ka qabadka leedahay.
en: Visit an eye specialist regularly for examinations, so that possible eye diseases can be discovered at an early stage.

so: Haddii aad dreento in maqalkaado daciifay, waqti ka qabso baaritaanka maqalka ee rugta caafimaadka soonahaada ama dhaqtarka gaarka ah Baaritaanka bilowga ah kadib waxaad warqad baaritaan dheeraad ah laguugu dirayo ka heleysaa dhakhtarka, haddii loo baahdo.
en: If you notice that your hearing has deteriorated, make an appointment for a hearing examination at the health centre in your area or a private clinic. After a preliminary examination, you will be given, if necessary, a referral for further examinations.

so: Ka akhriso macluumaad dheeraad ah qofka lixaadka aragtida la' iyo qofka lixaadka maqalka la' qalabka caawimaadka ah ee uu isticmaali karo Lixaad la'aanta.
en: Read more about aids for the visually-impaired and the hearing-impaired on the InfoFinland page Disabled persons.

so: Waxbrasho xirfadeedka suuqa shaqadu wuxuu adiga kaa caawinayaa helitaanka shaqada.
en: Vocational labour market training can help you find employment.

so: Waxaad baran kartaa xirfado cusub amaba xittaa mihnad cusub.
en: You can learn new skills or even a new profession.

so: Tababarku wuu ku hagi karaa marka aad ku jirto shaqo raadinta.
en: The training also instructs you in the job seeking process.

so: Waxbarasho xirfadeedka suuqa shaqadu waa lacag la'aan.
en: Vocational labour market training is free of charge.

so: Xafiiska shaqada (TE-toimisto) ayaa qabanqaabiya waxbarasho xirfadeedka suuqa shaqada.
en: Employment and Economic Development Offices (TE-toimisto) organise vocational labour market training.

so: Waqtiga aad waxbarashada ku jirto waxaad heleysaa manfaca shaqo la'aanta.
en: You will receive unemployment benefit for the duration of the training.

so: Yaa loogu talagalay waxbarasho xirfadeedka suuqa shaqada?
en: Who is vocational labour market training intended for?

so: Waad ka qeybgeli kartaa waxbarasho xirfadeedka suuqa shaqada, haddii
en: You can participate in vocational labour market training if

so: aad ka weyn tahay 20 sano o
en: you are over 20 years old.

so: aad shaqo la'aan tahay ama ay shaqo la'aan kugu dhici rabto
en: you are unemployed or about to become unemployed.

so: aad xaq u leedahay isticmaalka adeegyada Xafiiska shaqada
en: you are entitled to use the services of the Employment and Economic Development Office.

so: Xaq ayaad u leedahay isticmaalka adeegyada Xafiiska shaqada haddii lagu siiyay ogolaanshaha joogitaanka sii socda (A) ama ogolaanshaha joogitaanka joogtada ah (P).
en: You are entitled to use the services of the Employment and Economic Development Office if you have been granted a continuous residence permit (jatkuva oleskelulupa) (A) or permanent residence permit (pysyväoleskelulupa) (P).

so: Sidee u codsanayaa waxbarasho xirfadeedka suuqa shaqada?
en: How do I apply for vocational labour market training?

so: Waxaad codsi waxbarasho xirfadeedka suuqa shaqada ka samayn kartaa Xafiiska shaqada ama foomka elekterikaalka ah ee internetka ku jira.
en: You can apply for vocational labour market training either at an Employment and Economic Development Office or online with an electronic form.

so: Codsiga waa in aad ku sheegtaa sababta ay tahay in adiga laguu xusho waxbarashada.
en: In the application, you must justify why you should be selected for the training.

so: Si fiican uga fikir sababaha.
en: Consider the grounds carefully.

so: Sababuhu waxey saameyn ku yeeshaan xulashada ardayga.
en: The justifications affect the student selection.

so: Xafiiska shaqada ayaa ardayda u xulanaya waxbarasho xirfadeedka suuqa shaqada.
en: The Employment and Economic Development Office decides who is accepted for vocational labour market training.

so: Waxyaabaha ku jira waxbarasho xirfadeedka suuqa shaqadu aad ayeey isu beddelaaan.
en: The content of vocational labour market training varies greatly.

so: Waa kuwan tusaalooyinka qaar ka mid ah waxbarasho xirfadeedka suuqa shaqada:
en: Here are some examples of vocational labour market training:

so: Waxaad ku baran kartaa xirfad xusub ama qeyb ka mid ah.
en: You can study a new profession or complete a part of a qualification.

so: Waxaad ku baran kartaa Finnish ama Iswidhis.
en: You can study Finnish or Swedish.

so: Waxaad carbin u heli kartaa shaqo raadinta.
en: You can receive training for job searching.

so: Aqoon kororsi ayaad aqoontaada u heli kartaa ama waxbarasho dhameystir ah.
en: You can gain further training in your own field or receive continuing education.

so: Waxaad carbin u heli kartaa shirkadnimada ama tababar ganacsi.
en: You can receive coaching for entrepreneurship or entrepreneurship training.

so: Waxbarasho xirfadeedka suuqa shaqadu waa noocee?
en: What is vocational labour market training like?

so: Xafiiska shaqadu wuxuu machadyo iyo shirkado kala duwan ka iibsadaa waxbarasho xirfadeedka suuqa shaqada.
en: Employment and Economic Development Offices purchase vocational labour market training from educational institutes and companies.

so: Waxey ka dhigan tahay in aadan wax ku baraneyn gudaha Xafiiska shaqada ee waxaad wax ku baraneysaa machad, kaas oo qabanqaabinaya kooraska.
en: In other words, you will not study at an Employment and Economic Development Office but at the institute that organises the course.

so: Xafiiska shaqadu wuxuu sidoo kale shaqo bixiyayaasha la hirgeliyaa waxbarashooyinka.
en: Employment and Economic Development Offices also organise trainings together with employers.

so: Machadyada qaarkood waxey qabanqaabiyaan waxbarasho xirfadeedka suuqa shaqada oo si gaar ah loogu talagalay dadka muhaajiriinta ah.
en: Some institutes organise vocational labour market training that is directed especially at immigrants.

so: Waxbarashadaan waxuu noqon karaa barashada afka Finnishka ama waxbarasho xirfadeed.
en: This training can be Finnish language studies or vocational training, for example.

so: Koorasyada qaarkood waxaad ku qaadan kartaa aqoon aad Finland xirafaddaada kugula shaqeysato.
en: Some courses allow you to obtain a qualification to practise your profession in Finland.

so: Tusaale ahaan kalkaaliyayaasha caafimaadku waa in ay qaataan waxbarasho dheeraad ah si ay shaqada Finland uga qabtaan shaqada kalkaaliyanimada caafimaadka.
en: For example, nurses must complete further studies in order to be allowed to work as nurses in Finland.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Shahaadooyinka dibadda ee Finland.
en: More information is available on the InfoFinland page Foreign Degrees in Finland.

so: Kaalmada dhaqaale ee xilliga waxbarasho xirfadeedka suuqa shaqada
en: Financial support during vocational labour market training

so: Inta lagu jiro xilliga waxbarasho xirfadeedka suuqa shaqada waxaa lagu siinayaa manfac la mid ah kan marka aad tahay shaqo la'aan.
en: During vocational labour market training, you will receive the same benefit as you would if you were unemployed.

so: Haddii aad qorshaha shaqaaloobista ku gashay heshiis ku saabsan waxbarasho xirfadeedka suuqa shaqada, waxaad heli kartaa macfaca shaqo la'aanta oo la kordhiyay.
en: If you have made an agreement on attending vocational labour market training in your employment plan, you may receive increased unemployment benefit.

so: Waxaa adiga lagu siinayaa manfac shaqo la'aaneed yara badan.
en: This means you may receive a slightly higher unemployment benefit.

so: Bixinta qeybta kordhinta waxaa go'aan ka gaaraya bixiyaha manfaca shaqo la'aanta, yacni kaasada shaqo la'aanta ama Kela.
en: The decision on the payment of the increase will be made by the party paying the unemployment benefit; in other words, the unemployment fund or Kela.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale maalmaha ka qeybgalka waxbarashada heli kartaa magdhow qarash, oo lagu magdhabo qarashka safarka.
en: You may also receive an expense allowance for the days you participate in training to cover your travel expenses.

so: Haddii aadan ka helin lacagtaas bixiyaha manfaca shaqo la'aanta, xaaladaha qaarkood marka lagu jiro Xafiiska shaqada ayaa ku siin kara.
en: If you are not entitled to expense allowance from the party paying you unemployment benefit, the Employment and Economic Development Office may in some situations pay you expense allowance.

so: Waxbarashada iskaa ah oo lagu kaalmeynayo manfaca shaqo la'aanta
en: Self-motivated education supported by unemployment benefit

so: Waxaad heli kartaa kaalmada shaqo la'aanta xittaa mudada waxbarashooyinka kale, haddii uu Xafiiska shaqadu u arko in aad u waxbarasho u baahan tahay.
en: You may also receive unemployment benefit for the duration of your other studies, if the Employment and Economic Development Office evaluates that you are in need of training.

so: Xafiiska shaqadu ma keeno waxbarasho u mana xusho ardayda waxbarashada sida waxbarashada suuqa shaqada.
en: The Employment and Economic Development Office does not acquire the training or make student selections for the training as it does for labour market training.

so: Adiga ayaa toos uga codsanaya machadka booska waxbarashada.
en: You will apply for a study place directly from the institute.

so: Waa in aad waxabarashada kala heshiisaa Xafiiska shaqada ka hor int aadan billaabin waxbarashada.
en: You must make an agreement with the Employment and Economic Development Office regarding your education before you begin your studies.

so: Waad heli kartaa manfaca shaqo la'aanta mudada aad wax baraneyso haddii
en: You may be eligible to receive unemployment benefit for the duration of your studies if

so: aad isaga diiwaangelisay Xafiiska shaqada shaqo raadiye, shaqo raadintaaduna ay shaqeyneyso.
en: you have registered as a job seeker at the Employment and Economic Development Office and your job search is valid.

so: aad jirto ugu yaraan 25 sano.
en: you are at least 25 years old.

so: uu Xafiiska shaqadu u arko in waxbarasho ay hagaajineyso aqoontaada xirfadeed ama ay kaa caawineyso helitaanka shaqo.
en: the Employment and Economic Development Office estimates that the education will improve your professional skills or help you find employment.

so: aad Xafiiska shaqada ugala heshiisay waxbarashada qorshaha shaqaaloobista.
en: you have made an agreement with the Employment and Economic Development Office on attending the education in your employment plan.

so: Waxbarashooyinkee ayaa lagu heli karaa manfaca shaqo la'aanta?
en: What type of studies can you receive unemployment benefit for?

so: Manfaca shaqo la'aanta waxaa lagu kaalmeeyaa waxbarashada rasmiga ah oo kaliya.
en: Only full-time study can be supported with unemployment benefit.

so: Waxbarashooyinkan soo socda ayaa ah kuwa rasmiga ah:
en: The following studies are considered full-time:

so: waxbarashooyinka dugsiga sare; ama
en: upper secondary school studies or

so: waxbarashooyinka baaxaddoodu ay u dhiganto waxbarashada rasmiga ah, tusaale ahaa 5 dhibco waxbarasho bishii ama 25 saacadood oo waxbarasho ah todobaadki.
en: studies with an extent corresponding to full-time study, for example 5 credits per month or 25 hours of study per week.

so: Waxbarashooyinku waa in lagu gaaraa
en: The studies must lead to

so: shahaadada xirfadeedka aasaasiga ah, shahaado xirfadeed ama shahaado xirfadeed takhasus ah
en: a vocational qualification, further vocational qualification or specialist vocational qualification

so: shahaada jaamacdeedka ama tacliinta sare ee koowaad ama labaad
en: a Bachelor's or Master's degree at a university or other higher education institution

so: qeybo ka mid ah shahaadooyinka kor lagu xusay.
en: a completion of modules of these degrees.

so: Waxbarashooyinku waxaa laga yaabaa iney noqdaan waxbarasho dheeraad ah, waxbarasho dhameystir ah ama wax ka barashada jaamacadda ama dugsi-xirfadeedka sare.
en: The studies may also be further training, continuing education or university or university of applied sciences studies.

so: Waad dalban kartaa heerka labaad ee dugsiga sare waqtiga la dalbado iskuullada Febaraayo–Maarso.
en: Apply for upper secondary school via the upper secondary level joint application process (yhteishaku) in February-March.

so: Waad codsan kartaa dugsiga sare, haddii aad soo dhameysey dugsiga hoose maadooyinkiisa ama xiisadahiisa, taasoo dhameystireysa aqoonta dugsiga hoose.
en: You can apply for upper secondary school if you have completed the basic education syllabus or a syllabus corresponding to basic education.

so: Ardeyda waxaa lagu dortaa dugsiga sare dhibcaha uu heysto shahaadadda dugsiga hoose.
en: Students are normally accepted into upper secondary schools on the basis of the grades displayed on their comprehensive school-leaving certificate.

so: Haddii aaad rabto dugsiga sare ee dadka waaweyn, waxaad toos ula xiriirtaa iskuulka.
en: If you would like to attend an upper secondary school for adults, contact the school directly.

so: Iskuulka dadka waaweyn isaga ma codan kartid xiliga dalbashada iskuullada.
en: You cannot apply for an upper secondary school for adults via the joint application process (yhteishaku).

so: Markaad iskuulka dadka waaweyn dalbaneyso celceliska dhibcaha shahaaddaada muhiim ma aha.
en: When you apply for an upper secondary school for adults, your grade average does not matter.

so: Haddii aad rabto inaad kordhiso aqoontaada afka finnishka, intaadan dalban dugsiga sare, waxaad codsataa iskuulka u diyaarinta waxbarashada dugsiga sare.
en: If you would like to improve your skills in the Finnish language before applying for upper secondary school, you can apply for preparatory education for upper secondary school.

so: Ka aqriso wixii dheeri ah bogga InfoFinlandi Iskuulka u diyaarinta dugsiga sare.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Preparatory education for upper secondary school.

so: Aqoonta aasaasiga eed wadato ayuu ku xiran tahay, waxbarashada dugsiga farsamada eed codsan karto iyo sida codsiga loo sameenayo.
en: The type of vocational education and training for which you can apply, and the application procedure, depends on your existing education.

so: Waad ku codsan kartaa waxbarashada aasaasiga dugsiga farsamada, haddaad soo dhameysatey maadooyinka iyo xiisadaha waxbarashadda aasaasiga ah, taasoo u dhiganta tacliinta aasaasiga.
en: You can apply for comprehensive school-based vocational education and training if you have completed the basic education syllabus or a syllabus corresponding to basic education.

so: Waad ku codsan kartaa waxbarashada dugsiga sare waxbarashada dugsiga farsamada, haddaad ka soo baxdey dugsi sare.
en: You can apply for upper secondary school-based vocational education and training if you have completed upper secondary school.

so: Isuulladaan waxaad dalban kartaa codsiyada joogtada u socda ee sanadka oo dhan ama heerka tacliinta labaad ee xiliga dalbashada iskuullada.
en: You can apply for the above-mentioned education and training via the continuous application process throughout the year or via the upper secondary level joint application process (yhteishaku).

so: Xiliga dalbashoyinka iskuullada waa inta u dhexeysa Febaraayo–Maarso.
en: The joint application process is normally held in February-March.

so: Ka buuxso foomka adeega Opintopolku.fi.
en: Fill in an application form via the Studyinfo.fi service.

so: Haddaad heysto shahaado dugsiga farsanada ama waxbarsho xirfadeed sare, ma dalban kartid xiliga dalbashada dugsiyada farsamada.
en: If you have already completed a vocational qualification or a university degree, you cannot apply via the joint application process.

so: Markaas waxaad waxbarashada ku codsan kartaa codsiga joogtada ah.
en: In that case, you can apply via the continuous application process.

so: Codsiga joogtada ah ku codso waxbarashada xittaa marka aad noloshada shaqada ku jirto aadna dooneyso inaad laanta beddelato, ama haddii aad dooneyso in aad codsato heshiiska waxbarashada.
en: You should also apply via the continuous application process if you are employed and want to switch fields or if you want to apply for apprenticeship training.

so: Haddii aadan xittaa boos waxbarasho ku helin codsiga wadajir ah, waxbarashada waxaad ku codsan kartaa codsiga joogtada ah.
en: You can also apply via the continuous application process if you did not receive a study place in the joint application process.

so: Waxbarashadu waxay ku xiran yahay, habka iyo sababta ardeyda lagu dooranayo.
en: Student admission criteria vary depending on the education or training for which you apply.

so: Badi waxaa lagu doortaa dhibcaha ay heleen, taasoo ku xiran shahaadaada dhibcaha ku yaala.
en: Admission is typically based on points, which depend on the applicant's school certificate grades, among other things.

so: Iskuullada badankood waxay qaadaan imtixaan ama imtixaan kale oo ah inuu qafku u qalmo.
en: Many education and training providers also arrange an entrance exam or aptitude test.

so: Laamaha waxbarasahda qaarkood waxay leeyihiin shuruudo caafimaadka la xiriira.
en: Some fields also have health requirements.

so: Goobta waxbarahadu waxay tijaabin kartaa in aqoontaada luqadeed ay ku filantahay waxbarashooyinka, Warar dheeraa ah weydii goobta waxbarashada, marka aad codsaneyso.
en: The educational institute may check whether your language skills are sufficient for the training. For more information, contact the educational institute that you are applying to.

so: Haddii aad rabto inaad kordhiso aqoontaada sanco iyo garashadaada, intaadan dalban dugsiga farsamada, waxaad codsataa waxbarashada VALMA sidoo kale waxaad kordhin kartaa aqoontaada luuqada finnishka.
en: If you would like to acquire more knowledge and skills before applying for vocational education and training, you can apply for VALMA education. At VALMA education, you can also improve your skills in the Finnish language.

so: Ka aqriso xog dheeriya bogga InfoFinlandi Waxbarashada u diyaargarowga iskuulka farsamada.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Preparatory vocational education.

so: Haddaad u baahan tahay kaalmo qaas ah ee dhanka barashada dhigashada iskuulka tusaale ahaan naafonimo ama adkaansho dhanka waxbarashada, codso iskuulka xiliga la dalbado waxbarista qaaska ah.
en: If you need special support for your vocational education and training due to, for example, a disability or learning difficulties, apply during the application period for special needs education.

so: Haddaad wado shahaado wadan kale
en: If you have a foreign school certificate

so: Haddaad iskuulka hoose dhexe ama sare ku soo baxdey wadan kale, waxaa laguugu qaadan karaa iskuullada farsamada si ka fiirsasho ah.
en: If you have completed comprehensive school or upper secondary school abroad, you may be selected for vocational education and training on discretionary grounds.

so: qiimeynta, sida aad uga bixi karto waxbarashadaan
en: your ability to successfully complete the studies.

so: Codsiga waxbarasho xirfadeedka dadka waaweyn
en: Applying for vocational adult education and training

so: Waad codsan kartaa waxbarasho xirfadeedka dadka waaweyn, haddaad rabto adoo shaqeynaya inaad waxbarato.
en: If you want to complete a qualification alongside your job, you can apply for vocational adult education and training.

so: Waxbarashadda dadka waaweyn waxaad sameyneysaa soo bandhig aqoontaada xirfadeed eed ku heleyso shahaadada.
en: In adult education and training, you will complete a vocational qualification as a competence-based qualification (näyttötutkinto).

so: Waad codsan kartaa sidoo kale waxbarasho xirfadeedka dadka waaweyn, haddii aad soo dhameysay iskuulka farsamada ama aad heysato shahaado waxbarasho xirfadeed sare.
en: You can also apply for vocational adult education and training if you have completed a vocational qualification or a university degree.

so: Markii aad codsaneyso waxbarasho xirfadeedka dadka waaweyn, waa inaad leedahay khibrad shaqo waqti dheer ah.
en: When you apply for vocational adult education and training, you must have sufficient work experience.

so: Lama codsado waxbarasho xirfadeedka dadka waaweyn xiliga dalbashada iskuullada.
en: You cannot apply for vocational adult education and training via the joint application process (yhteishaku).

so: Ka xaqiijiso adeega Opintopolku.fi ama iskuulka ayaad ka xaqiijin kartaa sida loo dalbado.
en: Please check the Studyinfo.fi service or the educational institution for information on how to apply.

so: Codsiga waxbarasho xirfadeedka sare
en: Applying to a university of applied sciences

so: Waad codsan kartaa waxbarasho xirfadeedka sare inaad wax ka barato, haddii aad ka soo baxadey.
en: You can apply to a university of applied sciences to complete a university of applied sciences degree if you have completed, for example, one of the following:

so: tacliin sare ama waxbarasho u dhiganta
en: matriculation examination or equivalent in some other country

so: Warbixin dheeri ah waxaad ka heleysaa adeega Opintopolku.fi.
en: Read more on Studyinfo.fi website.

so: Xiliga dalbashada iskuullada waa labo jeer sanadkii, Gu'ga iyo Deyrta.
en: The joint application process takes place twice a year, in the spring and autumn.

so: Ka buuxso codsiga adeega Opintopolku.fi.
en: Fill in an application via the Studyinfo.fi service.

so: Waxbarashaduna waxay ku xiran tahay, hadba sidii ardeyga lagu doorto.
en: Student admission criteria vary depending on the education or training for which you are applying.

so: Doorashaduna way ahaan kartaa mid lagu qiimeyey imtixaankii laga qaadey ama khibrada shaqo eed leedahay.
en: The criteria may include your school certificate grades, an entrance test and your work experience.

so: Sidoo kale cilmigaad horey u soo baratayna lagu qiimeeyo.
en: Your previous studies may also affect whether you will be admitted.

so: Takhasus waxbarasho xirfadeedka sare
en: Higher university of applied sciences degrees

so: Takhasus waxbarasho xirfadeedka sare (ylempi AMK-tutkinto) waad codsan kartaa, markii aad heysato
en: You can apply for a higher university of applied sciences degree if you have

so: mid u qalanta waxbarasho xirfadeedka sare ama shahaado tacliin sare iyo
en: a suitable university of applied sciences degree or other suitable university degree, and

so: ugu yaraan saddex sano khibrad shaqo xirfada aad soo baratey ah, haddii aad khibradaas shaqo aad heshey, kadib markaad waxbarashada soo dhameysatey.
en: at least three years' work experience in the same field as your degree and have acquired your work experience after you completed your degree.

so: Codso takhasuska waxbarasho xirfadeedka sare (ylempi AMK-tutkinto).
en: Apply for a higher university of applied sciences degree via the universities' joint application process in spring or autumn.

so: Iskuullada badi waxaa la codsan karaa oo keliya Gu'ga.
en: Many universities of applied sciences accept applications only in the spring.

so: Luuqadaha khalaad ee takhasus waxbarasho xirfadeedka sare (ylempi AMK-tutkinto) si gooni ayaad u dalban kartaa.
en: You can apply for higher university of applied sciences degrees provided in foreign languages during a separate application process (erillishaku).

so: Foomka codsiga waxaad ka heleysaa, markii aad iskuulka ka raadisid Opintopolku.fi.
en: Further information and application forms are available via the Studyinfo.fi service.

so: Codso jaamacada xiliga dalbashada tacliinta sare ama ku codso codsiyada khaaska ee iskuulka ood gooni u dalnabeyso.
en: Apply to a university either through the universities' joint application process (korkeakoulujen yhteishaku) or during the separate application process (erillishaku) of a specific study programme.

so: Inta baddan waxbarashada jaamacada waad codsan kartaa xiliga dalbashada iskuullada tacliinta sare.
en: You can apply for most university studies via the universities' joint application process.

so: Xiliguna waa Gu'ga iyo Deyrta.
en: This takes place in spring and in autumn.

so: Gu'ga waxaad heysataa fursado badan, iskuullada qaarkood waxaa la codsadaa Janaayo.
en: In spring, the range of available alternatives is much higher.

so: Waad codsan kartaa jaamacad, haddii aad wadato shahaadooyinka mid kamid ah
en: You can apply to a university if you hold e.g. one of the following qualifications or certificates:

so: shahaado dugsi sare shahaado ugu yaraan saddex sano waxbarasho xirfadeed.
en: vocational upper secondary qualification based on at least three years of study

so: shahaado wadan kale, taasoo la qiimo ah heerka aqoonta jaamacada wadankaas aad wax ku soo baratey.
en: foreign qualification providing eligibility for university studies in the country in which you obtained the qualification

so: Ka xaqiiqso xafiiska tacliinta sare, haddii ay tahay mid laguu qiimeynayo shahaadadaada inaad ku dalban karto jaamacada.
en: Check at the student affairs office (opintotoimisto) of the desired university whether or not your qualification will enable you to apply.

so: Faahfaahin dheeri waxaad ka heleysaa adeega Opintoploku.fi.
en: Further information is also available from the Studyinfo.fi service.

so: Markii aad dalbaneyso jaamacada, waxaad ku heleysaa dhibcaha shahaadaada dugsiga sare iyo imtixaanka lagaa qaadey.
en: When you apply to a university, you will be awarded points on the basis of your matriculation examination and an entrance exam.

so: Waa muhiim inaad si taxadar ah ugu diyaar garowdo imtixaanka.
en: Prepare well for the entrance exam.

so: Taasoo soo codsayaasha laga qaadanayo tiro yar.
en: Some study programmes accept only a small proportion of the applicants.

so: Imtixaanada qaar waxaa jira leylisyo leysku diro.
en: Some entrance exams include advance assignments.

so: Jaamacadaha qaarkood si gooni ah ayaa loo codsadaa.
en: Some university study programmes apply a separate application process.

so: haddii aad rabto master digrii
en: if you apply to a Master's degree programme;

so: haddii aad ka soo badalaneyso u soo badalaneyso iskuul kale; ama
en: if you transfer from one institution of higher education to another; or

so: haddaad maadooyinkaaga ku soo qaadatey jaamacada furan ood taas ku dalbaneyso jaamacada.
en: if you have completed studies at an open university and apply to a university on the basis of them.

so: Haddaad ku dalbaneyso waxbarashado, luuqad taasoon aheyn afka finnishka iyo swiidhishka midkood, sida loo codsanayo waxay ku xiran tahay iskuulka.
en: If you apply to a study programme whose language is neither Finnish nor Swedish, the application process will depend on the study programme.

so: Iskuulaadka wax lagu barto luuqadaha kale iyagu si gooni ah ayaa loo dalbadaa, kuwasoo la dalbado xiliga dalbashada iskuulka ee Janaayo.
en: Some foreign language study programmes apply a separate application process, while others accept students through the joint application process in January.

so: Faahfaahin dheeri ah waxaad ka heleysaa adeega Opintopolku.fi.
en: More information is available via the Studyinfo.fi service.

so: Haddaad rabto inaad ka sii siyaadsato cilmiga jaamacada, toos ula xiriir jaamacada.
en: If you wish to take a postgraduate degree at a university, contact the desired university directly.

so: Aqbalida booska lagu siiyey
en: Accepting a study place

so: Iskuulka ayaa waxay kugu soo wargelinayaan qoraal, haddii markaa lagu qaatey iskuulka.
en: The educational institution will inform you by letter if you have been accepted as a student.

so: Haddii laguu qaatey ardeynimo, waa inaad wargelisaa sida ugu dhaqsiyaha baddan iskuulkii inaad aqbashey booska lagu siiyey.
en: If you have been accepted, you must notify the educational institution as soon as possible of whether you will accept the study place offered to you.

so: Qoraalka laguu soo dirayo ayey ku cad yihiin waxaad yeeli laheyd iyo sidaad u soo wargelin laheyd, haddaadan waqti hore soo wargelin inaad booskaaga qaadaneyso, waxaad waayeysaa booskii.
en: The educational institution's letter includes instructions for accepting the study place and registering as a student. If you do not accept the study place in time, you will lose it.

so: Markaad aqbasho booskiii waxbarashadana, waxaad ballan qaadeysaa inaad waxbarashada ka bilaabeyso iskuulkaas.
en: When you accept a study place, you commit yourself to beginning studies at the educational institution.

so: Waaxd codsan kartaa xiliga dalbashada iskuullada iskuulo badan oo kala duwan.
en: You can apply to several educational institutions via the joint application process.

so: Waxaadsa aqbali kartaa oo keliya hal iskuul.
en: However, you can only accept one study place.

so: Finland waxaa lagu baran karaa tacliinta iskuulaadka sare, iskuul xirfadeedyada tacliinta sare iyo jaamacadaha.
en: In Finland, you can complete higher education studies both in universities of applied sciences and in universities.

so: Ka aqri faahfaahin dheeraad oo ku saabsan Iskuul xirfadeedyada tacliinta sare bogga InfoFinlandi Iskuul xirfadeedyada tacliinta sare.
en: Read more about university of applied sciences on the InfoFinland page University of Applied Sciences.

so: Waad codsan kartaa jaamacad, haddii aad heysato shahaadadda dugsiga sare finnish ah, ama shahaado u dhiganta shisheeye, ama shahaado dugsiga farsamada. Waxaad codsataa waqtiga dalbashada iskuullada tacliinta sare.
en: You can apply to a university if you hold a certificate for completing a Finnish matriculation examination (ylioppilastutkinto), a foreign certificate that corresponds to the Finnish matriculation examination certificate, or a vocational qualification.

so: Xirfadee ayaa la baran karaa?
en: What are the professions in which you can graduate?

so: Jaamacadaha waxay leeyihiin majaaladyo waxbarasho oo fara badan.
en: Universities feature many fields of study.

so: Ardayada ka soo qalinjebisay jaamacadaha iyo iskuulaada tacliinta sare waxay ka shaqeeyaan shaqooyin kala badan.
en: Students who graduate from an institute of higher education or university can work in a variety of positions.

so: Qeybo kamid ah waxbarshada jaamacadu waxay toos u noqdaan xirfado cayiman, tusaale ahaan:
en: Some university studies lead directly to specific profession. Such professions include the following:

so: Qeybo kamid ah waxyaabaha laga barto jaacamaduhu toos uma noqdaan xirfado cayiman.
en: However, some university studies do not lead to any particular profession.

so: Tusaale ahaan ardayda cilmiga bulshada ama kuliyadda adabta ka soo baxay toos uma yeeshaan xirfad cayiman.
en: For example, students of social sciences or humanities may not graduate in a specific profession.

so: Dadkaan waxay ka shaqeeyaan shaqooyinka soo socda:
en: These people can work in the following positions, for example:

so: Iskuulaadka tacliinta sare qaarkood shahaadooyinku waxay leeyihiin magacyo kala duduwan.
en: Some institutes of higher education have different names for the degrees.

so: Tusaale ahaan iskuulaadka tacliinta sare ee farsamada shahaadada takhasuska jaamacadda waxaa u dhigma shahaadada dibloomada injineerka (diplomi-insinööri).
en: For example, in universities of technology, the equivalent of a master's degree is the Master of Science in Engineering (diplomi-insinööri) degree.

so: Marka aad u gudubto waxbarashada waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad labada shahaado ee kala sareysa qaadato.
en: When you are accepted into an institute of higher education, you receive the right to complete both degrees.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale ku joojin kartaa waxbarashada shahaadada koobaad ee iskuulka tacliinta sare.
en: You can also end your studies after the lower university degree.

so: Waxbarashada shahaadada koobaad ee jaamacaddu waxay qaataan qiyaastii sadex sano, waxbarashada shahaadada takhasuska ahna waxay qaataan qiyaastii laba sano.
en: The bachelor's degree studies take about three years whereas the master's degree studies take about two years.

so: Dedejinta waxbarashadu waa mid adiga ku gu xiran.
en: The progression rate of the studies depends on you.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale codsan kartaa takhasuska barnaamij waxbarasheed kale.
en: You can also apply for separate master's degree programme.

so: Barnaamijka masteriga waxaa loola jeedaa barnaamij waxbarasho oo lagu gaarayo shahaadada iskuulka tacliinta sare.
en: A master's degree programme is an education programme that leads to a higher academic degree.

so: Si aad u barato barnaamijka masteriga waa inaad heysataa shahaada iskuulaadka tacliinta sare ee hoose.
