en: In order to be eligible to study in a master's programme, you must have earned a lower academic degree.

so: Barnaamijyada masterigu waxay qaataan qiyaastoo labo sano.
en: These programmes last about two years.

so: Waxaa inta badan barta dad majaalooyinka kala duduwan ka socda.
en: They often include students from many disciplines.

so: Marka ay waxbarashadaadu dhamaaday waxaa qaadaneysaa shaahaada koobaad ee jaamacadda ama tan takhasuska.
en: When your studies are complete, you will graduate and receive a bachelor's or master's degree.

so: Haddii aad rabto inaad sii wadato waxbarashada shahaada mastarka.
en: If you wish, you can apply for postgraduate studies after receiving your master's degree.

so: Jaamacadda furan waxaad ka heleysaa koorsooyin maadooyinka jaamcadda.
en: An open university offers university courses.

so: Qof walbaa wax ka baran kara jaamacadda furan.
en: Anyone can study at an open university.

so: Jaamacadda waxaad wax kabaran kartaa xitaa haddaadan horey shahaado u wadan.
en: You can study at an open university, even if you do not have a degree or qualification of any kind.

so: Ka aqriso wixii dheeri ah bogga InfoFinlandi Waxbarashadda hiwaayada ah.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Studying as a hobby.

so: Waxbarasho cilmiyeedka sii socota ee jaamacadda
en: Scientific postgraduate education in universities

so: Waxbarasho cilmiyeedka sii socota ee jaamacadaha lagu qaato waa waxbarasho lagu gaarayo tacliin sare.
en: Scientific postgraduate education provided by universities is postgraduate education that leads to a degree.

so: Waxbarashadan noocan ah waxay adiga kuu diyaarinaysaa tusaale anaan shaqada cilmi-baaraha.
en: This kind of education prepares you for research work, for example.

so: Waxaad jaamacadda ku soo qaadan kartaa fasaxa aqoonta (lisensiaatti) ama doktoreytka (tohtori).
en: At universities, you can complete a licentiate's (lisensiaatti) or doctoral (tohtori) degree.

so: Inta badan ardayda waxbarashada sii wata waxay soo bartaan doktoreytnimo.
en: The majority of postgraduate students complete a doctorate.

so: Waxaa suurtagal ah in dhowr jeer sanadkii jaamacadda laga codsado sii wadashada waxbarashada.
en: Application for university postgraduate studies is available a few times a year.

so: Jaamacaddaha iyo qeybaha waxbarashadu waa ku kala duwan yihiin waqtiyada codsashada.
en: The application periods vary between universities and departments.

so: Ka hubso waqtiyada codsashada qeybta aad dooneyso in aad ka sii wadato waxbarashadaada.
en: Check the application periods with the department where you would like complete your postgraduate studies.

so: Finland ardayda waxbarashada sii wadanaya waa inay maalgelintooda qabanqaabsadaan.
en: In Finland, postgraduate students often need to arrange their own funding.

so: Waxaad lacago kaalmo ah ka codsan kartaa mu'asasooyin (säätiö) kala duduwan.
en: You can apply for grants from various foundations (säätiö).

so: Hagitaanka dugsiyada tacliinta sare
en: Guidance for higher education

en: You can use the SIMHE services of higher education institutes to seek help and information about Finnish higher education and how to apply for higher education.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale heli kartaa macluumaadyada fursadaha kale ee waxbarashada ee loogu talagalay dadka dhameeyay waxbarashada dugsiga tacliinta sare.
en: They can also provide information about other educational opportunities for people who have already completed higher education courses.

so: Adeegyada SIMHE waxaad ka heli kartaa hagitaan, haddii
en: You are entitled to guidance in SIMHE services if

so: aad u soo guurtay Finlnad;

so: aad xiiseynayso waxbarashooyinka dugsiyada tacliinta sare; iyo
en: you are interested in higher education; and

so: haddii aad dhameysay waxbarashada tacliintada sare ama dibadda ka soo qaaday shahaahada tacliinta sare.
en: you have completed higher education courses or a higher education degree abroad.

so: Hagitaanku wuxuu noqon karaa mid shakhsi ah ama mid kooxeed.
en: The guidance can be individual or group guidance.

so: Waxbarashada iskuul xirfadeedka sare (ammattikorkeakoulu) waa gacan ka qabad ah.
en: Studies at universities of applied sciences (ammattikorkeakoulu) are practical.

so: Haddii aad ka soo qalinjebiso iskuul xirfadeedka sare waxaad inta badan naftaada u heshay aqoon xirfadeed.
en: Upon graduating from a university of applied sciences you will usually have a profession.

so: Iskuul xirafdeedka sare waxaad ku baraneysaa luqada Finnishka ama Iswidishka ama ingiriis.
en: In universities of applied sciences, you can study in Finnish, Swedish or English.

so: Iskuul xirfadeedyo badan waxaa laga helaa barnaamijyo waxbarasho oo ku baxaya luqada ingiriiska.
en: Many universities of applied sciences provide education programmes in English.

so: Waad codsan kartaa iskuul xirfadeedka sare marka aad dhameyso iskuulka xirfadda ama dugsiga sare Finland ama wadamadda kale.
en: You can apply to a university of applied sciences once you have completed vocational school, upper secondary school or a matriculation examination in Finland or some other country.

so: Iskuul xirfadeedyada sarsare waxaad ku baran kartaa aqoon xirfadeedyo badan.
en: At universities of applied sciences, you can study many fields.
