en: Examples of professions in which you can qualify are provided in brackets for each field:

so: ilaha dhaqaalaha ee daciiciga ah iyo cilmiga bii'ada (injineerka dhaqaalaha keynta, naqshadeeyaha dhulka)
en: Natural resources and the environment (forestry engineer, landscape architect)

so: waxbarshada maadiga ah iyo barbaarinta (turjubaanka luqada dhegoolaha)
en: Humanities and education (sign language interpreter)

so: safarka, nafaqeynta iyo cilmiga dhaqaalaha (mas'uul baar, shaqaale hoteel)
en: Tourism and catering (head waiter, hotel worker)

so: sooshalka, caafimaadka iyo jimicsiga (umuliso, fiisiyoteraabiiste kalkaaliso caafimaad)
en: Social services, health and sports (midwife, physiotherapist, nurse)

so: cilmiga bulshada, cilmiga maamulka iyo maareynta dhaqaalaha (wada-xaajoodaha iibka, kaaliyaha suuq-geynta)
en: Social sciences, business and administration (sales negotiator, marketing assistant)

so: cilmiga farsamada iyo socodka gaadiidka (injineerka baabuurta, madaxa mashiinka ee markabka)
en: Technology, communications and transport (automotive engineer, marine engineer)

so: Waxbarashada maalintii oo dhan ah waxay qaadataa qiyaastii afar sano.
en: Full-time studies last about four years.

so: Waqtiga waxbarashadu wuxuu ku xiran yahay barnaamijka waxbarashada iyo habsami socodka waxbarashada qofka.
en: The duration of the studies depends on the study programme and your own pace.

so: Waxbarashooyinka waxaa ka mid ah leylis waxqabadyo badan.
en: The studies include plenty of practical exercises.

so: Waxbarashada waxaa ku jira sidoo kale shaqo ku tababarasho.
en: The studies also include a practical training period.

so: Waxbarashada diyaarinta ah ee dadka dalka u soo guuray
en: Preparatory education for immigrants

so: Iskuul xirfadeedku wuxuu dadka dalka u soo guuray u qabanqaabin karaa waxbarasho lacag la'aan ah, taas oo yoolkeedu yahay in ardayga la siiyo aqoon luqadeed ku filan iyo diyaargarowyada kale waxbarashada iskuul xirfadeedka tacliinta sare dartood.
en: Universities of applied sciences may organise free-of-charge preparatory education for immigrants aimed at providing students with language skills and other abilities necessary to study at a university of applied sciences.

so: Waxbarashooyinka waxaa lagu layliyaa luqada finnishka, aqrinta qidcadaha qoran iyo xirfadda barashada.
en: During this education, students practise their Finnish skills, learn how to read expository texts and polish their study skills.

so: Intaas waxaa dheer oo ay ardaydu helayaan macluumaadka majaladaha waxbarashada, fursadaha shaqo iyo waxbarashooyinka shahaadada lagu gaaro.
en: The students also receive information on their field of study, employment opportunities and studies leading to a degree.

so: Waxbarashada diyaarinta ah dadka codsadanaya waxaa inta badan looga baahan aqoonta luqada finnishka heerka B1 ama B2.
en: Preparatory education applicants are often required to have Finnish skill level B1 or B2.

so: Iskuul xirfadeedka sare ee furan
en: Open university of applied sciences

so: Iskuul xirfadeedka sare ee furan waxaad ka heleysaa koorsooyin maadooyinka iskuul xirfadeedka sare.
en: An open university of applied sciences provides access to courses available at universities of applied sciences.

so: Qof walbaa wax ka baran kara iskuul xirfadeedka sare ee furan.
en: Anyone can study in open universities of applied sciences.

so: iskuul xirfadeedka sare ee furan waxaad wax kabaran kartaa xitaa haddaadan horey shahaado u wadan.
en: You can study in an open university of applies sciences, even if you do not have a degree or qualification of any kind.

so: Sii wadashada waxbarashada ee iskuul xirfadeedka
en: Postgraduate studies in universities of applied sciences

so: Haddii aad dooneyso inaad sii qota-dheereyso aqoontaada xirfadeed waxaad sameyn kartaa shahaadada takhasuska ee iskuul xirfadeedka sare (ylempi ammattikorkeakoulututkinto).
en: If you would like to deepen your professional expertise, you can complete a higher university of applied sciences degree (ylempi ammattikorkeakoulututkinto).

so: Waxaa loogu talagalay dadka ka qalin-jebiya iskuul xirfadeedka sare islamarkaasna shaqeeya.
en: It is intended for people who have graduated, for example, from a university of applied sciences and who are already employed.

so: Waxaad codsan kartaa sameynta shahaadada takhasuska ee iskuul xirfadeedka sare haddii aad heysato
en: You can apply for the opportunity to complete a higher university of applied sciences degree if you have

so: shahaadada iskuulka tacliinta sare
en: a degree from another institute of higher education

so: aad ugu yaraan leedahay saddex sano waayo-aragnimo ah oo majaladan lagu dabaqi karo
en: at least three years of work experience from a suitable field

so: Codso shahaadada waxbarashada shahaadada takhasuska ee iskuul xirfadeedka sare inta lagu jiro codsashada wadajirka ah.
en: You can apply for the higher university of applied sciences degree in the joint application (yhteishaku) period.

so: Codsashada wadajirka ahi waa laba jeer sanadkii, guga iyo deyrta.
en: This is held twice a year in the spring and autumn.

so: Baaxadda waxbarashaduna waa qiyaastii 60 ama 90 dhibco-cashareed.
en: The scope of the studies is about 60 or 90 credits.

so: Waxbarashooyinka takhasuska ee iskuul xirfadeedka sare waxay qoto-dheereeyaan oo ballaariyaan aqoonta xirfadaada.
en: The further studies deepen and expand your knowledge in your own professional field.

so: Kalkaaliyayaasha caafimaadku tusaale ahaan waxay baran karaan takhasuska iskuul xirfadeedka sare, waxbarashadaas oo ku saabsan baxnaanada.
en: Nurses can complete a higher degree in rehabilitation, for example.

so: Waxaad xitaa dooran kartaa waxbarasho ku baxeysa luqada Ingiriiska.
en: You can also choose a degree programme conducted in English.

so: Haddii aad shahaado ka soo qaadatay dibadda, waxaa adiga faa'iido kuu lahaan kara isbarbardhiga shahaadada, aqoonsashada aqoonta xirfadeed, helitaanka xuquuqda ku shaqeysashada xirfadda ama shahaadada muujinta aqoonta.
en: If you have completed a foreign degree, you might benefit from having the degree compared to a Finnish degree, having your professional qualification recognised, acquiring a right to practice your profession or completing a competence-based qualification.

so: Isu dhiganka iyo aqoonsashada shahaadada
en: Equivalence and recognition of degrees

so: Aqoonsashada shahaadada waxaa loola jeedaa go'aanka sida shahaado dibadda laga soo qaatay ay loogu helikaro waxbarasho ama shaqo loogu raadsan karo.
en: Recognition of a degree is a decision about which qualifications a degree completed in a foreign country gives you to work or apply for a student position in Finland.

so: Aqoonsashada shahaadadu waa lacag waxaana laga codsadaa Maamulka Waxbarashada.
en: Recognition of a degree is subject to a charge and is requested from the Finnish National Board of Education.

so: Marka aad codsaneyso boos waxbarasho, aqoonsashada shahaadada qasab looguma baahna.
en: When you are applying for a student position, recognition of a degree is not necessarily needed.

so: Aqoonsasada xirfadeed iyo xuquuqda ku shaqeynta xirfadda
en: Professional recognition and the right to practise a profession

so: Shaqooyinka qeybaha guud (dowladda iyo degmooyinka) dadka codsanaya waa inay inta badan buuxiyaan waxyaabaha la iska doonayo ee xirfadda la xiriira.
en: Persons applying for positions in the public sector (the state and municipalities) often need to meet certain educational qualification requirements.

so: Marka qof dibadda wax ku soo bartay uu codsanayo shaqooyinkan wuxuu inta badan u baahan yahay go'aanka Maamulka waxbarashada ee shahaadado xilka xafiiseed ee ay buuxineyso.
en: When a person who has completed his or her studies abroad applies for such position, he or she usually needs a decision issued by the Finnish National Board of Education stating that his or her degree qualifies for the position.

so: Xirfadda la xeeray waxaa loola jeeda shaqada qofka codsanaya laga doonayo in uu heysto shahaado ama waxbarashooyin cayiman oo uu sharcigu dejiyay.
en: The applicants of a position in a regulated profession must hold a certain degree stipulated in legislation or certain studies.

so: Xirfadaha la xeeray waxaa ku jira shaqooyin qeybaha guud ah iyo xirfado loogu baahan yahay xuquuqda ku shaqeynta xirfadda.
en: Regulated professions include some public sector jobs and positions that require a right to practise that profession.

so: Xuquuqda ku shaqeynta xirfadda waxaa loogu baahan yahay tusaale ahaan xirfadaha daryeelka caafimaadka iyo badmaaxa.
en: The right to practise a profession is required for example in health care and seafaring positions.

so: Haddii aad heysato shahaado aad dibadda ka soo qaadatay oo Finland uga jirta xirfadaha la xeeray , waxaad u baahantahay go'aan saraakiisha ee u dhigma xirfada kahor inta aadan xirfadda ku sameyn Finland.
en: If you have a foreign degree in a profession that is regulated in Finland, you need to get an equivalence decision from a competent authority before you can practise your profession in Finland.

so: Bogagga shabakadda Wasaaradda waxbarashada waxaa ku jira liiska xirfadaha la xeeray iyo saraakiisha ka mas'uulka ah.
en: The Finnish National Board of Education website contains a list of regulated professions and competent authorities for each of them.

so: Shaqo bixiyaha qeybta waxbarashada ee gaarka ah ayaa iskiis u qiimeynaya in uu aqbalayo shahaadada dibadda laga soo qaatay.
en: Private sector employers evaluate independently whether they will accept an employee's foreign degree.

so: Qeybta gaarka ah la isagama baahna go'aanka aqoonsashada, laakiin waxay faa'iido u noqon kartaa raadsashada shaqada.
en: Recognition decisions are not required in the private sector, but they may be useful when applying for a position.

so: Maamulka waxbarashadu waxaa kale oo uu bayaan aqooneed ka bixiyaa shahaadooyinka xirfadda ee dibadda laga soo qaatay.
en: The Finnish National Board of Education also issues expert statements on foreign vocational degrees.

so: Bayaanku shahaadada Finland kuma siinayo inay ay ka shaqeyso.
en: These statements, however, do not grant eligibility for civil service posts.

so: Si kastoo ay ahaataba waxay kaa caawin kartaa raadinta shaqada ama booska waxbarashada, sababtoo ah waxaa bayaankaas lagu sawirayaa heerka iyo waxyaabaha lagu bartay shahaadada dibadda laga soo qaatay.
en: They may, nevertheless, be helpful when looking for a job or a place to study, as they describe the content and level of education received abroad.

so: Haddii aad doon inaad waxbarashadaada ka sii wadato Finland, maadooyinka dibadda lagu soo qaatay waxaa xisaabta lagula daran karaa iyadoo la kaalmeysanayo aqoonsashada akadeemiga ah.
en: If you wish to continue your studies in Finland, the studies you have completed abroad may be taken into consideration through academic recognition.

so: Aqoonsashada akadeemiga ah ee shahaadooyinka waxaa loola jeedaa
en: Academic recognition of degrees entails

so: codsashada waxbarasho iyadoo lagu saleynayo shahaado dibadda laga soo qaatay
en: seeking a place of study on the basis of foreign education

so: qeyb ahaan u qaadashada waxbarashada Finland lagu qaadanayo maadooyinka dibadda lagu soo qaatay
en: Recognition of studies completed abroad towards a degree to be completed in Finland.

so: Qeybaha waxbarashadu iyaga ayaa go'aansanaya xulashada ardaydooda iyo u aqabalayaan maadooyinka dibadda lagu soo qaatay qeyb ahaan waxbarashada Finland lagu qaadanayo.
en: Educational institutions make independent decisions on their student selections and also on whether or not they accept studies completed abroad as a part of a Finnish degree.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah toos u weydii qeybta waxbarashada ee aad dooneyso inaad wax ka barato.
en: Ask for more information directly from the institution you would like to study at.

so: Markaad codsato waxbarashada LUVA, waxaad u baahan tahay shahaadada dugsiga hoose dhexe.
en: When you apply for LUVA education, you need a comprehensive school-leaving certificate or the equivalent knowledge and skills.

so: Waana inaad leedahay aqoon kugu filan ood wax ku baran karto kulana socon karto barashada u diyaarinta dugsiga sare laguna dhiganayo afka finnishka iyo iswiidhishka.
en: You must be able to speak and understand Finnish or Swedish sufficiently well to be able to follow the instruction provided in preparatory education.

so: Iskuulka qabanqaabinaya waxbarashada u diyaarinta dugsiga sare ayaa qiimeynaya, iney luuqadaadu tahay mid kugu filan.
en: The educational institution providing LUVA will assess whether your language skills are sufficient.

so: Waxbarashada LUVA waxay qaadaneysaa sanad.
en: LUVA education takes one year.

so: Muddo sanad ah waxaad baraneysaa afka finnishka ama iswiidhishka iyo weliba sida aad wax u baran laheyd.
en: During this year, you will study Finnish or Swedish, as well as studying skills.

so: Waxaa kaloo suurogal ahaan waxbarashada wehliya barashada luuqado kale iyo koorsooyinka dugsiga sare.
en: The study programme may also include other language studies and some upper secondary school courses.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale heleysaa tusmo la xiriirta waxbarashada
en: You will also receive study guidance.

so: Codsi waxbarashada dhalinyarada ee LUVA inta u dhexeysa bilaha Juun-Juulaay.
en: Apply for young persons' LUVA education in June–July.

so: Iskuulka LUVA kadib waxaad dalban kartaa dugsi sare.
en: After LUVA education, you can apply to upper secondary school.

so: Dugsiga aasaasiga ah (peruskoulu), waxbarashada aasaasiga ah kadib ardaydu waxay u gudbaan goobaha waxbarashada ee heerka labaad (toisen asteen oppilaitos).
en: After comprehensive school (peruskoulu), students enter upper secondary institutes (toisen asteen oppilaitos).

so: Goobaha waxbarashada ee heerka labaad waa tusaale ahaan goobaha waxbarashada ee dugsiga sare iyo xirfadda.
en: Upper secondary institutes include upper secondary school and vocational institutes.

so: Ka sii aqri macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan machadyada xirfadaha bogga InfoFinlandi Waxbarasho xirfadeedka.
en: More information on vocational institutes is available on the InfoFinland page Vocational education.

so: Waxbarashada dugsiga sare waa ka qoraal badan tahay tan waxbarashada xirfadeed.
en: Upper secondary school studies are more theoretical in nature than vocational education.

so: Waxyaabaha la baranayo waa kuwa aqooneed: waxay xoogga saaraan maadooyinka maadiga ah iyo culuunta dabiiciga ah.
en: The studies provide all-round education: they are primarily focused on natural sciences and humanities.

so: Dugsiyada sare qaarkood waxaa laga bartaa maadooyinka farshaxan oo fara badan.
en: Some upper secondary schools also feature plenty of education in arts.

so: Dugsiyada sare qaarkood waa dugsiyo sare oo gaar ah.
en: Some upper secondary schools are specialised.

so: Waxay tusaale ahaan xoogga saaraan muusikada, jimicsiga ama culuunta dabiiciga ah.
en: They are focused on music, physical education or natural sciences, for example.

so: Dugsiyada sare ee gaarka ah waa ku aad loo jecelyahay.
en: Specialised upper secondary schools are very popular.

so: Waxaa laga yaabaa inay adkaato in waxbarashadooda loo gudbo.
en: It may be difficult to get accepted into one.

so: Dugsigu wuxuu kuu diyaarinayaa tusaale ahaan iskuul xurfadeedka sare iyo jaamacadda.
en: Upper secondary school prepares you for a university of applied sciences or a university, for example.

so: Dugsiga waxaad dhigan kartaa adigoo dhalinyaro ama qof weyn ah.
en: Young people and adults can study in upper secondary schools.

so: Dhalinyaradu waxay wax ka bartaan dugsiga sare ee maalintii (päivälukio) ama dugsiga sare ee aan la joojin (etälukio), dadka waa weyna waxay inta badan wax ka bartaan dugsiga sare ee dadka waa weyn (aikuislukio).
en: Young people study in full-time upper secondary schools (päivälukio) or distance upper secondary schools (etälukio) while adults often study in upper secondary schools for adults (aikuislukio).

so: Codso dugsi sare heerka labaad ee codsashada tacliimaha.
en: Apply for upper secondary school via the upper secondary level joint application process (yhteishaku).

so: Wax ka barashada dugsiga sare
en: Studying in an upper secondary school

so: Waxbarashada dugsiga sare waxay guud ahaan qaadataa sadex sano.
en: Upper secondary school studies usually last three years.

so: Dugsiga sare waxaa sidoo kale lagu dhameyn karaa laba sano ama afar sano.
en: Upper secondary school can also be completed in two or four years.

so: Waxbarashada dugsiga sare waxaa ku jira waxbaayo badan oo la kala doordooran karo.
en: Upper secondary schools provide plenty to choose from in terms of studies.

so: Waxaad dooran kartaa maadooyinka qasabka ah kadib maadooyin badan oo kale, kuwaas oo adiga kugu haboon.
en: In addition to obligatory courses, you can select a variety of courses that suit your preferences.

so: Adiga ayaa saameyn ku leh waxyaabaha aad baraneyso iyo degdeta waxbarashada dugsiga sare.
en: In upper secondary school, you can affect the content and progression of your studies.

so: Dugsiga sare ma lahan lacagta sanad dugisyeedka la bixiyo.
en: Upper secondary schools do not have tuition fees.

so: Waxbarashadu waa lacag la'aan.
en: In other words, education is free.

so: Laakiin waa in adigu keensataa buugaagta dugsiga sare.
en: However, you must obtain the school books yourself.

so: Buugaagtu waa qaali inta badan.
en: The books are often expensive.

so: Buugaagta dugsiga sare waxaad keensa kartaa iyagoo horay loo soo isticmaalay.
en: Upper secondary school books are also available second-hand.

so: Waa in aad sidoo kale keensataa kambuyuutarka la qaato.
en: You also need to obtain a laptop computer.

so: Haddii aad leedahay hiwaayad dhib badan ama aad mudo dheer jiran tahay, waxaad dugsiga ku dhameyn kartaa sidii dugsi sare oo fog.
en: If you have a demanding hobby or you fall ill for an extended period of time, for example, you can complete upper secondary school by means of distance studies.

so: Weydii macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan waxbarashada fog dugsigaada sare.
en: Ask for more information on distance studies from your upper secondary school.

so: Waxbarashada dugsiga sare waxaa lagu hiigsanayaa shahaadada imtixaanka sare (ylioppilastutkinto).
en: Upper secondary school studies are aimed at the matriculation examination (ylioppilastutkinto).

so: Intixaanka shahaadada sare wuxuu ka kooban yahay imtixaanaad maadooyin kala duduwan ah.
en: The matriculation examination comprises exams on various different subjects.

so: Imtixaanaadka shahaadada sare (ylioppilaskoe) waxaa inta badan la qaadaa dhamaadka waxbarashada.
en: The matriculation exams (ylioppilaskoe) are usually taken near the end of the studies.

so: Imtixaanka afka hooyo waa ku qasab shahaadada imtixaanka sare.
en: The national language test is obligatory in the matriculation examination.

so: Imtixaanka luqad hooyo ahaan waxaad ku geli kartaa luqada Finnishka, Iswidishka ama saame, waxaad imtixaanka Finnishka ama Iswidishka u geli kartaa sidii luqad labaad oo kale.
en: You can take the test in Finnish, Swedish or Sami. If your native language is not Finnish, Swedish or Sami, you can take the test for Finnish or Swedish as a second language.

so: Imtixaanka afka hooyo waxaa dheer oo ay qasab tahay inaad ku guuleystaa ugu yaraan sadex maado oo kale imtixaankood.
en: In addition to the national language test, you must complete tests in at least three other subjects.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso, ka badan ayaad imtixaan u geli kartaa.
en: If you want, you can also take more tests.

so: Afka hooyo waxaa dheer oo aad imtixaankooda ka qeybgeli kartaa maadooyinka soo socda:
en: In addition to the national language test, you can take tests in the following subjects:

so: luqada labaad ee dalka (Finnish ama Iswidish)
en: Second national language (Finnish or Swedish)

so: luqad qalaad: Ingiriis, Jarmal, Ruush, Faransiis, Talyaani, Isbanish, Burtaqiis, Laatiin
en: Foreign language: English, German, Russian, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese and Latin

so: waaqici (reaali), maadooyinka aqrinta sida taariikhda, diinta, fiisikiska, kiimikada, bayoolojiga, saykoolojiga, falsafada
en: Sciences and humanities (reaali) i.e. general studies, such as history, religion, physics, chemistry, biology, psychology and philosophy

so: Imtixaanada sare waxaa la qabtaa guga iyo deyrta.
en: Matriculation exams are held in the spring and autumn.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso waxaad imtixaanadaas qeyb kamid ah geli kartaa deyrta qeybta kalana guga.
en: If you want, you can take some of the tests in the autumn and some in the spring.

so: Waa inaad imtixaanaadka ku soo bandhigtaa ugu badnaan sadex waqti imtixaan.
en: The total number of consecutive exam times used to complete the entire examination must not exceed three.

so: Dugsiga sare ee dadka waa weyn
en: Upper secondary school for adults

so: Dugsiga sare ee dadka waa weyn waxaa loogu talagalay ugu horeyn wixii 18 sano ka weyn.
en: Upper secondary schools for adults are mainly intended for persons over 18 years of age.

so: Waxbarashada dugsiga sare ee dadka waa weyn waa mid la bedbedeli karo.
en: In upper secondary schools for adults, studying is flexible.

so: Waxaad baran kartaa dhamaan waxbarashada imtixaanka shahaadada sare ama waxaad baran kartaa hal maado oo kali ah.
en: You can complete the entire matriculation examination or simply study a single subject.

so: Waxaad ku baraneysaa xawaaraha adiga kugu haboon.
en: You can study at your own pace.

so: Inta badan waxbarashadu waa gelinka dambe.
en: The classes are normally held in the evening.

so: Dugsiyada sare ee dadka waa weyn qaar badan oo kamid ah waxay koorasyada luqada Finnishka u fidiyaan dadka dalka u soo guuray.
en: Many upper secondary schools for adults provide Finnish language courses for immigrants.

so: Toos u weydii dugsiga sare ee dadka waa weyn koorasyadaas.
en: Ask about the courses directly from the schools.

so: Waxbarashada VALMA waxay qaadataa hal sanad-dugsiyeed.
en: VALMA education takes approximately one school year.

so: Waxaad ku ogaaneysaa iskuulka fursadaha waxbarasho ee kala duwan, waxaanad ka fikiri kartaa waxa aad rabi laheyd inad barato.
en: During the education, you will have the opportunity to familiarise yourself with various fields and consider what you would like to study.

so: Waxaad booqan goobo kala duwan oo shaqo iyo inaad ka qeybqaato shaqoojinkaa.
en: You will also visit workplaces and participate in workshops.

so: Billowga horeba iskuulka waxaa laguu sameynayaa qorshe waxbaris kuu qaas ah.
en: At the beginning of the education, an individual study plan will be drawn up for you.

so: Waxaana la qorayaa qaabka iyo sidaad wax u baran laheyd.
en: The plan specifies which studies you will take and in which form.

so: Waxbarashada VALMA waxaad heleysaa sahaado.
en: Once completed, you will obtain a certificate of your VALMA education.

so: Waxaad heleysaa dhibco dheeriya, markaad dalbaneyso xiliga codsashada iskuulada farsamada.
en: When you later apply for upper secondary vocational education through the joint application system, you can get extra points for completed preparatory education.

so: Waxbarashada VILMA inta badan wax lacag ah kuma aha ardeyga.
en: VALMA education is normally free of charge for students.

so: Waxbarashada VALMA waad codsan kartaa, haddii aad horey u soo dhigatey dugsiga dhexe ama waxbarasho u dhiganta dugsiga dhexe, haddii markaa iskuulku u arkaan inaad qaadan karto waxbarashadaas inaad hesho booska waxbarashada xitaa haddaan heysan shahaadada dugsiga dhexe.
en: You can apply for VALMA education if you have completed comprehensive school or comparable education. If the educational institution is of the opinion that you can successfully complete your VALMA education, you can be accepted as a student even if you do not have a basic education certificate.

so: Codso waxbarashada VALMA xiliga dalbashada iskuullada kadib bilowga xagaaga, haddaad caawimaad u baahan tahay tusaale naafanimo darteed, codso iskuulka inta ka horeysa xagaaga ee codsashada waxbarista qaaska ah.
en: Apply for VALMA education in early summer, after the actual joint application procedure is over. If you need special support due to a disability, for example, apply for VALMA education in the spring, during the application period for special needs education.

so: Xog muhiima waxaad ka heleysaa adeega Opintopolku.fi.ka buuxso foomka adeega Opintopolku.fi.
en: For further information on application periods, see the Studyinfo.fi service. Fill in the application form in the Studyinfo.fi service.

so: Waxbarashada aasaasiga ah xirfadeedku waxay ardayga ka dhigeysaa mid si gaar ah aqoon ugu leh xirfad.
en: Vocational basic education qualifies the student for a particular vocation.

so: Sidas darteed ayeey waxbarashadan u tahay mid gacanta laga qabto.
en: Therefore, the training is very practically-oriented.

so: Waad dalban kartaa waxbarasho xirfadeed markaad so dhameysato maadooyinka tacliinta aasaasiga.
en: You can apply for vocational education after you have completed the comprehensive school syllabus.

so: Sidoo kale dadka waa waaweyn waxay naf ahaantooda u baran karaan xirfad cusub ama waxay dhameystiran karaan aqoontoodi hore.
en: Adults can also study a new profession or supplement their expertise.

so: Waxbarashadaada aasaasiga ayey ku xiran tahay, waxbarashada xirfadeed eed dalban karto, iyo sidaad u dalbaneyso.
en: The type of vocational education and training you can apply for, and how you can apply, depends on your basic education.

so: Haddii aad baraneyso maadooyinka dugsiga hoosedhexe , waad codsan kartaa waxbarashada hoose dhexe ee dugsiga farsamada (peruskoulupohjainen ammatillinen koulutus).
en: If you have completed the comprehensive school syllabus, you can apply for comprehensive school-based vocational education and training (peruskoulupohjainen ammatillinen koulutus).

so: Haddii aad baraneyso maadooyinka dugsiga sare, waad codsan kartaa waxbarashada dugsiga sare ee farsamada( lukiopohjainen ammatillinen koulutus).
en: If you have completed upper secondary school, you can apply for upper secondary school-based vocational education and training (lukiopohjainen ammatillinen koulutus).

so: Haddii aad qaadaneyso shahaado, waad codsan kartaa iskuulka farsamada dadka waaweyn (ammatillinen aikuiskoulutus).
en: If you wish to complete a vocational qualification alongside your job, you can apply for vocational adult education and training (ammatillinen aikuiskoulutus).

so: Marka aad dhameysato waxbarasho xirfadeedka aasaasiga ah waxaad codsan kartaa waxbarashada dheeraadka ah ee xirfadda, iskuul xirfadeedyda tacliinta sare iyo jaamacadaha.
en: When you have completed vocational upper secondary qualification, you can apply to continue your studies at further vocational education, universities of applied sciences and universities.

so: Shahaado xirfadeedka aasaasiga ah
en: Vocational upper secondary qualification

so: Shahaado xirfadeedka aasaasiga ah waxaad ku baran kartaa:
en: You can complete a vocational upper secondary qualification in the following ways:

so: waxbarashada aasaasiga ah (dhalinyarada iyo ardayda qaangaarka ah)
en: in upper secondary education (young people and adult students)

so: heshiiska waxbarashada (oppisopimuskoulutus) (dhalinyarada iyo ardayda qaangaarka ah)
en: in apprenticeship training (oppisopimuskoulutus) (young people and adult students)

so: Shahaado xirfadeedka aasaasiga ah waxaad ka heleysaa aqoonta xirfad gaar ah.
en: A vocational upper secondary qualification gives you the basic skills needed in a particular profession.

so: Waxbarashada xirfadeed ee aasaasiga waxay qaadataa ilaa saddex sano.
en: Completing a comprehensive school-based qualification takes roughly three years.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale isku waqti ku baran kartaa xirfad iyo dugsi sare.
en: You can also study at a vocational institute and upper secondary school at the same time.

so: Markaas waxaad dhameysan kartaa laba shahaado (kaksoistutkinto).
en: This allows you to obtain a double degree (kaksoistutkinto).

so: Iskuulada farsamooyinka waxay leeyihiin xirfado badan oo laga barto:
en: Vocational institutes provide many fields of study that you can choose from.

so: laamaha cilmiga aadaabta iyo farshaxanka
en: humanities and the arts

so: Qorshaha horumarinta aqoonta shaqsiyeed
en: Personal competence development plan

so: Qorshaha horumarinta aqoonta gaar ahaaneed (HOKS) waxaa loo dejiyaa arday kasta.
en: The personal competence development plan (HOKS) is drawn up for every student.

so: Waxaa qorshaha lagu qoraa aqoonta aad horay u soo hanatay, iyadoona laga heshiinayo waxbarashada aad qaadaneyso.
en: The plan includes a list of the competence you have previously acquired and an agreement on the studies you will now complete.

so: Karaankaada ayaad waxbarashooyinka ku dhameyn kartaa waxaadna sidoo kale shaqada gacanta laga qabanayo ee goobaha shaqada ku muujin kartaa wax aad taqaan.
en: You can complete studies at your own pace and demonstrate your skills in practical tasks at work.

so: Heshiis tababar waa wax ku barashada shaqada.
en: Education agreement is on-the-job learning.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso in aad goobta shaqada ka hesho aqoon waxqabad ku saleysan, heshiiska tababarka ayaa beddel wanaagsan u ah heshiiska waxbarashada.
en: If you would like to gain practical skills while working, education agreement is a good alternative to apprenticeship training.

so: Mushaar lagama bixiyo mudada tababarka.
en: No salary is paid for the education.

so: Heshiiska tababarka waxaa lagu xiriirin karaa heshiiska waxbarashada.
en: You can also combine education agreement with apprenticeship training.

so: Iskuulka farsamadda dugsiga sare kadib
en: Vocational education and training after upper secondary school

so: Haddii aad soo dhameysey dugsi sare, waxaad qaadaneysaa shahaadadda dugsiga sare, markaasna shahaadadda dusiga sare ayaad ku dalban kartaa waxbarasho xirfadeed.
en: If you have completed general upper secondary school or a matriculation examination, you can apply for upper secondary school-based vocational education and training.

so: Ma dalban kartid markaa waxbarashada xirfadeed ee aasaasiga ah.
en: In such a case, you cannot apply for comprehensive school-based vocational education and training.

so: Waxbarashada xirfadeed ee dadka waaweyn
en: Vocational adult education and training

so: Haddii aad shaqeyso, waxaad si la sahley aad shahaado aqoon farsamo adigoo shaqeynaya iskuullada farsamada dadka waaweyn waa:
en: If you have a job, you can work towards a vocational qualification flexibly alongside your job. Vocational adult education and training include:

so: waxbarasho xirfadeed shahaadadda aasaasiga ah
en: vocational upper secondary qualifications

so: Waxbarashadaasna waxaa laguu tixgelin doonaa waxyaabahaad horey u soo baratey, kuwaasood ku hehey shaqaad horey usoo qabatey ama aad ganacsade aheyd.
en: In your training, account is taken of previous education and training or skills acquired at work or as an entrepreneur.

so: Xog dheeriya, sidaad ku dalban laheyd waxbarashada farsamada dadka waaweyn, waxaad ka heleysaa boga InfoFinlandi Dalbashada waxbarashada.
en: More information on how to apply for vocational adult education and training is available on the InfoFinland page Applying for education and training.

so: Shahaadada heshiiska shaqobarasho iyadoo la shaqeynayo
en: Apprenticeship: completing a qualification while working

so: Heshiiska waxbarasho (oppisopimus) waa shaqada wax ku barasho.
en: Apprenticeship (oppisopimus) means learning through working.

so: Waxaad ka shaqeyneysaa xirfadda aad baraneyso meesha looga shaqeeyo, waxaadna shaqada ku dhinac diyaarineysaa waxbarashada.
en: You are employed in your field and complete the qualification while working.

so: Waxaad ku dhameysan kartaa waxbarashada heshiiska shaqo tacliin la mid ah kuwa machadka xirfadda lagu barto sida:
en: Apprenticeship training allows you to complete the same qualifications as vocational institutes:

so: Waxaad u baahan tahay goob shaqo heshiiska waxbarashada dartiis.
en: In order to be eligible for apprenticeship training, you need a job.

so: Waa inaad iskaa u raadsataa qof shaqo aad mushaar ku qaadato ku siiya.
en: You must independently find an employer that is willing to hire you.

so: Ma bilaabi kartid heshiiska waxbarashada haddii aadan heysan meel aad ka shaqeyso.
en: You cannot begin apprenticeship training if you do not have a job.

so: Xafiiska shaqada (TE-toimisto) ayaa kaa caawin kara raadsashada shaqada.
en: The Employment and Economic Development Office (TE-toimisto) can help you to find a job.

so: Goobta heshiiska waxbarashadu waxay noqon kartaa goobta aad hadda ka shaqeyso.
en: You can also complete the apprenticeship training in your current job.

so: Marka aad heysato goob shaqo, la xiriir xafiiska heshiiska waxbarashada (oppisopimustoimisto) ee deegaankaada.
en: Once you have a job, contact your regional apprenticeship office (oppisopimustoimisto).

so: Waxaad sidoo kale la xiriiri kartaa machadka waxbarashada heshiiska waxbarashada bixinaya.
en: You can also contact an educational institute that provides apprenticeship education.

so: Tusaale ahaan xarumaha waxbarasho ee dadka waa weyn (aikuiskoulutuskeskus) ayaa laga helaa waxbarashada heshiiska waxbarasho.
en: Many adult education centres (aikuiskoulutuskeskus), for example, provide apprenticeship training.

so: Qofka shaqada ku siiyay ayaa adiga ku siinaya inta lagu jiro waxbarashada heshiiska waxbarasho mushaar dhan ugu yaraan mushaarka tababarka Haddii qofka shaqada ku siiyay uusan mushaar kaa siinin mudada barashada qoraalka, waxaad xaq u yeelan kartaa in aad cosato lacag-maalmeedka, magdhow safari iyo kaalmo qoys, haddii aad ku jirto xeyndaabka Ammaanka bulsho Finnishka.
en: For the duration of the apprenticeship training, the employer will pay you salary that must be at least equal to training salary. If your employer does not pay salary for the period of theoretical studies, you may be entitled to apply for daily allowance, travel allowance and family allowance, if you are covered by Finnish social security.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah weydii machadkaada.
en: Ask more from your own educational establishment.

so: Muujinta caddeynta aqoonta xirfadeed
en: Proving your professional skill with a demonstration

so: Aqoontaada xirfadeed waxaad ku caddeyn kartaa muujin.
en: You can prove your professional skill with a demonstration.

so: Waxaad markaas sameynaysaa shaqooyin rasmi ah oo aad qabaneyso adigoo goobta shaqada ku sameynaya xaalad shaqo oo dhab ah.
en: This means doing practical work assignments in real work situations at a workplace.

so: Qabanqaabiyaha waxbarashada ayaa magacaabaya labo qiimeeye oo qiimeynaya aqoontaada.
en: The education provider will appoint two assessors to assess your competence.

so: Waxbarasho xirfadeedyada ay qabanqaabiyaan shaqo-bixiyayaasha
en: Vocational education provided by employers

so: Shaqo-bixiyayaasha qaarkood waxay dadka u tababaraan shaqooyinkooda.
en: Some employers also train people for their own jobs.

so: Shaqo-bixiyayaashani waxay leeyihiin damaanad qaad boos shaqo.
en: These employers have a job guarantee.

so: Taas waxaa laga wadaa, qofka waxbarashada dhameeya wuxuu shaqo-bixiyaha ka helayaa shaqo.
en: This means that a person who completes the training will receive a job from the employer.

so: Waxaad yacni heleysaa aqoon xirfadeed iyo shaqo.
en: In other words, you get vocational training and a job.

so: Tusaale ahaan shirkado badan oo dhinaca gaadiidka ah iyo wakaalada jidka xadiidka ee dowladu (VR) waxay shaqooyinkooda u tababaraan dad badan.
en: For example, many traffic companies and VR train people to work for them.

so: Dhamaan carruurta sida rasmiga ah u deggan Finland waxaa saaran waajibka waxbarashada, waa inay helaan waxbarashada aasaasiga ah.
en: All children residing in Finland permanently are subject to compulsory education, in other words, they must receive basic education.

so: Waajibka waxbarashadu wuxuu ku qeexan yahay sharciga.
en: Compulsory education is stipulated by law.

so: wuxuu dhamaadaa marka, cadada waxbarashada aasaasiga ah la guto ama ugu dambeyn marka billaabashada waajibka waxbarashada ay ka soo wareegtay 10 sano
en: ends when the syllabus for basic education is completed or at latest after 10 years of starting compulsory education.

so: Waajibka waxbarashada sida guud waxaa lagu gutaa dugsiga hoose dhexe.
en: Compulsory education is usually completed in comprehensive school.

so: Dugsiga aasaasiga ahi wuxuu ka koobmaa dugsi hoose (alakoulu) iyo dugsi dhexe (yläkoulu).
en: Comprehensive school consists of primary school (alakoulu) and secondary school (yläkoulu).

so: Dugsiga aasaasiga ahi waa lacag la'aan.
en: Comprehensive school is free.

so: Waalidiinta ayaa iskuulka soo ogeysiinaya cunugooda.
en: Children must be enrolled into school by their parents.

so: Magaaladu waxay sanadka bilowgiisa u dirtaa guryaha ogeysiiska waajibka waxbarashada (oppivelvollisuusilmoitus).
en: The municipality sends a compulsory education notice (oppivelvollisuusilmoitus) to appropriate homes at the beginning of each year.

so: Waxaa ogeysiiskaas ku calaamadeysay iskuulka ugu dhow (lähikoulu).
en: The notice lists each child's local school (lähikoulu).

so: Iskuulka inta badan guriga ugu dhow.
en: The local school is usually the school that is closest to home.

so: Waalidku waxay u dooran karaan cunugooda karaa iskuul kale oo aan aheyn kan u dhow.
en: Parents can also choose to send their child to a school other than the local school.

so: Waa suurogal inaan mar walba laga helin boos iskuulada kale.
en: However, it is not always possible to get your child a place in any other than the local school.

so: Ogeysiiska iskuulka kuu dhow ee cunugaada waad sameyn kartaa.
en: You can complete the school enrolment at your child's local school.

so: Degmooyinka qaarkood waxaad ogeysiiska ka sameyn kartaa internetka.
en: In some municipalities, you can also submit the enrolment online.

so: Waqtiga ogeysiintu waa bilowga sanadka, inta badan bisha Janaayo.
en: The enrolment time is at the beginning of the year, usually in January.

so: Cunuggu wuxuu sidoo kale aadi karaa iskuul arrin gaar ah ku takhasusay.
en: Your child may also attend a school that is specialised in a certain subject.

so: Mararka qaar iskuulaadkan waa kuwa gaar loo leeyahay.
en: Sometimes these schools are private schools.

so: Iskuulku wuxuu ku takhasusi karaa tusaale ahaan arrimaha soo socda:
en: A school may specialise, among others, in the following things:

so: caalaminimo (tusaale ahaan iskuulka Yurub)
en: Internationality (for example European Schools)

so: Finland waxaa ku yaal dhowr iskuul oo caalami ah.
en: Finland has a number of international schools.

so: Iskuulaadka qaarkood luqada waxbarashadu waa kuwa ka duwan afka Finnishka.
en: Some of these schools use some other language instead of Finnish.

so: Tusaale ahaan iskuulka Jarmalka waxaa lagu bartaa afka Jarmalka.
en: For example, in German Schools education is provided in German.

so: Iskuulaadka qalaad waxay ku yaalaan magaalada Helsinki.
en: Foreign language schools are available in larger cities.

so: Iskuulaadka caadiga ah qaarkood waxaa laga heli karaa qeyb ahaan fasalo lagu barto luqado qalaad.
en: Foreign language classes may also be available in regular comprehensive schools.

so: Waxbarashada iyo maalinta iskuulka
en: School day and studying

so: Iskuulku wuxuu bilowdaa bisha Agoosta wuxuuna dhamaadaa dhamaadka bisha Maajo ama bilowga bisha, Juun iyo Luulyo waa fasaxa xagaaga.
en: School begins in August and ends in late May or early June. School is out for the summer during June and July.

so: Dhirirka maalmaha iskuulku waa kuwa kala duduwan.
en: The length of school days varies between grades.

so: Maalmaha fasalada hoose waa ka gaaban yihiin maalmaha fasalada dhexe.
en: In primary school, the days are shorter than in secondary school.

so: Casharadu waxay inta badan qaataan 45 daqiiqo.
en: Individual classes usually take 45 minutes.

so: Todobaadka iskuulku waa qiyaastii 20 cashar saacadeed.
en: A school week usually comprises approximately 20 classes.

so: Carruurtu waxay iskuulka ku cunaan hal cunto oo kulul.
en: Children have a single hot meal in school.

so: Haddii cunugaadu cuntooyin gaar ah cuno u sheeg macalimada.
en: If your child has a special diet, please inform a teacher.

so: Carruurtu waxay ku bartaan dugsiga aasaasiga ah maadooyin badan oo qasab ah.
en: In comprehensive school, children study many compulsory subjects.

so: Fasalada ugu dambeeya ee dugsiga hoose iyo dugsiga dhexe waxay sidoo kale dooran karaan maadooyinka la doorto.
en: In the final grades of primary school and in secondary school, they can also choose optional subjects.

so: Cunug kasta wuxuu iskuulkiisa ku heli karaa barashada diintiisa ama falsafada.
en: In school, all children can receive education in their own religion or in ethics.

so: Barashada diinta waa in la qabanqaabiyaa marka ugu yaraan sadex cunug oo isku diin ah ay joogaan degmada.
en: Education in a particular religion must be arranged when a municipality contains at least three children of that religion.

so: Iskuulaadka qaarkood waxaa ku yaal fasalo gaar u ah ardayda aadka ugu fiican tusaale ahaan farshaxanka iyo sawir gacmeedka loogu talagalay.
en: Some schools have separate classes for students with talent in music or visual arts, for example.

so: Inta badan fasaladan waxaa loo codsadaa si gaar ah.
en: These classes normally require separate application.

so: Cunugga ama da'yarku wuxuu waxbarashada aasaasiga ah u heli karaa waxbarasho diyaarin ah, taasoo inta uu ku jiro uu baranayo luqada finnishka (ama iswidishka) iyo maadooyin kale.
en: A child or young person may receive preparatory education for basic education, during which he or she will study Finnish (or Swedish) and some other subjects.

so: Waxbarashada diyaarinta ah waxaa loogu talagalay dhamaan carruurta dalka u soo guurtay oo aqoontoodu aysan weli ku filnayn wax ku barashada kooxda waxbarashada aasaasiga ah.
en: Preparatory education is intended for all immigrant children whose skills are not yet good enough to attend basic education in a group.

so: Waxbarashada diyaarinta ah waxay inta badan qaadataa sanad.
en: Preparatory education usually takes one year.

so: Markaas kadib ardaygu wuxuu u wareegayaa fasalka caadiga ah.
en: After this, the student is transferred to a normal class.

so: Haddii cunuga afkiisa hooyo uusan aheyn Finnish ama Iswidish, degmadu way u qabanqaabin kartaa barashada afkiisa hooyo.
en: If the child's native language is not Finnish or Swedish, the municipality can arrange for education in the language in question.

so: u baranayaa sidii luqad labaad haddii aysan aqoontiisa luqada finnishka ama iswidishku aysan aheyn heerka afka hooyo.
en: A student will study Finnish (or Swedish) as a second language, if his or her Finnish or Swedish skills are not at a native level.

so: Dugsiyada sare ee dadka waaweyn waxay dadka qaangaarka ah ee dalka u soo guuray u qabanqaabiyaan waxbarshada aasaasiga ah, dadkaas oo aan shahaadada dugsiga dhexe aan ka soo qaadan dalkooda.
en: Upper secondary schools for adults organise basic education for adult immigrants who do not have a comprehensive school leaving certificate from their native country.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah weydii adeegyada latalinta ee degmadaada ama dugsiga sare ee dadka waaweyn ee kuugu dhow.
en: Ask for more information at the counselling services of your municipality or at the nearest upper secondary school for adults.

so: Macluumaadyda xiriirka ee dugsiyada sare ee dadka waaweyn waxaa laga raadsan karaa mashiinada wax raadinta ee internetka.
en: You can search for the contact information of upper secondary schools for adults through online search engines.

so: Farriimaha u dhexeeya guriga iyo dugsiga
en: Messages between the home and school

so: Degmooyin badan waxey dugsiyadu arrimaha muhiimka ah ku soo gudbiyaan adeegga Wilma oo shabakadda ku shaqeeya.
en: In many municipalities, the school uses the Wilma online service to communicate about important matters.

so: Dugsiga ayaa waalidka cunugga siiya aqoonsiyada lagu galo adeegga.
en: The school gives the child's parents a username and password for the service.

so: Adigoo Wilmada isticmaalaya ayaa waxaad la xiriiri kartaa macallimiinta, waxaadna macluumaad ka heli kartaa waxbarashada cunugga, imtixaanaada iyo maqnaanshada iyo weliba dhacdooyinka iyo fasaxyada dugsiga.
en: Through Wilma, you can stay in touch with your child's teachers and receive information about your child's learning, exams and absences as well as school events and holidays.

so: Haddii uu cunugaadu ka maqan yahay dugsiga tusaale ahaan jirro darteed, dugsiga u soo sheeg subaxdi adigoo isticmaalaya Wilma.
en: If your child must be absent from school, for example due to illness, inform the school through Wilma that morning.

so: Waa muhiim in Wilmada si joogto ah loola socdo.
en: It is important to monitor Wilma regularly.

so: Haddii aad isticmaalka Wilmada u baahan tahay in lagaa caawiyo, dugsiga ka codso hagitaan.
en: If you need help with using Wilma, ask the school for guidance.

so: Magaalada Kerava ayaa waxey soo daabacday tilmaamo ku saabsan isticmaalka Wilmada oo luqado kala duduwan ku qoran.
en: The City of Kerava has published instructions in different languages on how to use Wilma.

so: Ogsoonow in cinwaanada laga galo wilmada ay ku kala duwan yihiin magaalooyinka.
en: Please note that the login address for Wilma is different in different cities.

so: Kaalmada waxbarashada iyo fasalka tobanaad
en: Student support and tenth grade

so: Ardayada dugsiyada aasaasiga ah waxay kaalmo u heli karaan waxbarashadooda.
en: Comprehensive school students are supported in their school work.

so: La-taliyayaasha waxbarashada ayaa sheegaya qaababka waxbarasho ee kala duduwan iyo waxbarashada sii-socota.
en: Student counsellors talk to students about study methods and further education.

so: Waxay sidoo kale bixinayaan hagitaan la xiriira kala doorashada xirfadaha.
en: They also provide career selection guidance.

so: Cilmu-nafsi yaqaanada waxbarashada iyo kuraatoriga iskuulka ayaa caawimaad looga helaa marxaladaha dhibaatada leh.
en: Student psychologists and school social workers help students in problematic situations.

so: Macalimadu waxay cunuga siin kartaa kaalmo waxbarasho oo waqti gaaban ah.
en: Teachers can provide children with short-term remedial education.

so: Cunugu wuxuu helayaa waxbarasho gaar ah haddii uu dhib ku qabo waxbarashada ama xoog saarida waxbarashada.
en: Children who have difficulty learning and concentrating receive special needs education.

so: Kooxaha waxbarashada gaarka ah waa ka yar yihiin fasalada caadiga ah.
en: Special needs groups are smaller than regular classes.

so: Macalimiinta waxay la xiriiraan waalidiinta.
en: Teachers maintain contact with parents.

so: Waxay qabanqaabiyaan kulamo ay la qaadanayaan waalidiinta, waxayna u sheegaan waalidiinta waxbarashada cunugooda.
en: They arrange meetings with parents and give parents information on their children's studies.

so: Iskuulaad badan waxay waalidiinta kula xiriiraan adeegyada shabakadda.
en: Many schools keep in contact with parents through online systems.

so: Iskuulaadka waxaa kale oo laga heli karaa waxbarasho dheeraad ah, waa kuwa loogu yeero fasalka tobanaad (kymppiluokka).
en: Schools may also provide additional education, i.e. the so-called tenth grade (kymppiluokka).

so: Waxay fasaladaas ardaydu sare ugu qaadaan dhibcohooda, sidoo kale waxay uga fekeraan waxyaabaha waxbarashada ahaan xiisa-geliya.
en: These give students the chance to improve their grades and determine which field of study interests them.

so: Waxaad codsan kartaa fasalka tobanaad marka aad hesho shahaado dugsiga dhexe ama aasaasiga ah.
en: You can apply for the tenth grade once you have received your certificate for completing comprehensive school.

so: Fasalka tobanaad wuxuu inta badan qaataa hal sano.
en: The tenth grade usually lasts one year.

so: Xiliga dalbashoyinka iskuullada waa inta u dhexeysa Febaraayo–Maarso iyo Agoosto–Oktoobar.
en: The joint application process is normally held in February-March and September-October.

so: Markaas waxa kuu banaan inaad ka qaybqaadato doorashada dheeraadka ah ee loogu talo galay dadka xirfadaas hore u qaatay.
en: In that case, you can apply directly to the educational institution through a separate application process intended for those who have already completed a qualification or degree.

so: Waxa kale oo ad dalban kartaa iskoolaadka dadka da'da ka baxay ee lagu qaato xirfad.
en: You can also apply for vocational adult education and training.

so: Haddii luuqadaadu aheyn tan wax lagu baranayo, waxaad u baahan tahay shahaado inaad taqaano luuqadii.
en: If your mother tongue is other than the language of instruction, you will need a certificate of language proficiency.

so: Waxa uu noqon karaa tusaale ahaan shahaadada dugsiga dhexe ee Finland.
en: This can be, for example, a comprehensive school leaving certificate from Finland.

so: Waxaad faahfaahin dheeri ah ka heleysaa adeega Opintopolku.fi, taasoot ku caddeyn karto aqoontaada luuqadeed.
en: The Studyinfo.fi service provides further information on the certificates with which you can prove your language proficiency.

so: Haddaadan heysan shahaado luuqada ah, waxaa laguugu yeerayaa inaad imtixaan gasho.
en: If you do not have a certificate of language proficiency, you will be invited to a language test.

so: Laakiin waa in ardaygu uu isagu keensadaa buugaagta dugsiga sare.
en: However, students must obtain the school books themselves.

so: Sida uu qabo sharciga dalka Finland dhexdiisa ilmuhu waa inay ka qaybgalaan waxbarasho-horaadka (esiopetus) ama wax qabad kale oo u dhigma, sannad ka hor inta aysan bilaababanin waxbarashada aasaasiga ama qasabka ahi.
en: According to the law, children must attend preschool education or other similar activities for one year before compulsory education begins.

so: Waxbarasho-horaadku (esiopetus) waxay cunuga u diyaarisaa iskuulka hoose dhexe.
en: Preschool education (esiopetus) prepares children for comprehensive school.

so: Waalidiintu waxay waxbarasho-horaadka carruurtooda u dalbaan inta badan Janaayo ama Febraayo.
en: Parents normally enrol their children in preschool education in January or February.

so: Waqti hore ka hubso waxqabadka iskuulka (koulutoimi) ama waxbaqadka waxbarashada (sivistystoimi) ee degmadaada.
en: Check the time well in advance with your local school services (koulutoimi) or education services (sivistystoimi).

so: Degmooyinka ayaa qabanqaabiya waxbarasho-horaadyada.
en: Municipalities organise preschool education.

so: Degmooyinku waxay sidoo kale ka iibsan karaan adeegyada waxbarasho-horaadka xanaanooyinka gaarka loo leeyahay.
en: Municipalities can also purchase preschool education services from private day care centres, for example.

so: Waxbarasho-horaadku waa lacag la'aan.
en: Preschool education is free-of-charge.

so: Cunugu wuxuu helayaa maalintii cunto lacag la'aan ah.
en: During the day, the child will receive a free meal.

so: Haddii cunug degan yahay meel ka fog goobta waxbarashada (ka badan 5 KM) wuxuu helayaa gaadiid qaada oo lacag la'aan ah.
en: If the child lives far away (over 5 km) or the route is difficult, he or she will receive free transport.

so: Waxbarasho-horaadka ka sokow, cunuggu wuxuu ka qeybqaadan karaa barbaarin-horaadka, haddii ay waalidku shaqeynayaan ama ay wax baranayaan.
en: In addition to preschool education, the child can also attend early education if the parents are working or studying.

so: Maalinta iskuul-horaadku waxay qaadataa qiyaastii afar saacadood.
en: Preschool days last about four hours.

so: Carruurtu waxay dhigtaan iskuul-horaadyada ku yaal xanaanada ama iskuulka.
en: Children often attend preschool on the premises of a day care centre or school.

so: Carruurtu waxay ku bartaan iskuul-horaadka waxyaabaha ay ka midka yihiin xisaabta, deegaanka iyo cilmiga bii'ada, dhaqanka iyo farshaxanka.
en: In preschool, children learn mathematics, environmental and natural awareness as well as art and culture.

so: Waxyaabaha cusub waxay ku bartaan iyadoo qaab ciyaareed la adeegsanayo.
en: They pick up new things through play.

so: Waalidiintu waxay door muhiim ah ku leeyihiin iskuul-horaadka.
en: Parents have an important role in preschool education.

so: Waxay cunugooda ka kaalmeynayaan waxbarashada.
en: They support their child's learning.

so: Macalliimiinta waxay cunug walba u sameynayaan qorshe waxbarasho oo u gaar ah.
en: The teachers prepare an individual curriculum for each child.

so: Waalidiintu waxay horjoogayashaa ka caawin karaan sameynta qorshahaas.
en: Parents can assist the instructors in the preparation of the plan.

so: Luqadaha iyo dhaqamada ee waxbarasho-horaadka
en: Languages and cultures in preschool education

so: Cunuga afkiisa hooyo uusan aheyn Finnish ama Iswidish wuxuu Finnishka ama Iswidishka u baranayaa sidii luqad labaad oo kale.
en: Children whose native language is something other than Finnish or Swedish will study Finnish or Swedish as a foreign language.

so: Taas waxaa sii dheer oo uu baran karaa afkiisa hooyo haddii degmadu qabanqaabiso barashada luqadaas.
en: In addition, they can study their own native language if the municipality organises such education.

so: Cunugu wuxuu iskuulka-horaadka gudihiisa ka heli karaa waxbarashada diintiisa ama falsafada.
en: In preschool, children can receive education in their own religion or in ethics.

so: Carruurtu waxay ka bartaan gudaha iskuul-horaadka qiimeynta luqadooda iyo dhaqankooda.
en: Preschool education teaches children to value their native language and culture.

so: Imtixaanka shahaadadda aqoonta xirfadeed
en: Demonstrating your professional skill with a competence-based qualification

so: Bandhiga aqoontu (näyttötutkinto) waa qaab ka mid ah qaababka aad aqoontaada ku soo bandhigi karto.
en: A competence-based qualification (näyttötutkinto) is one way to demonstrate your professional skill.

so: Waxaad bandhigga aqoonta ku qaadan kartaa
en: You can obtain the following through a competence-based qualification:

so: Aqoonta xirfadda iyo aqoonta xirfadda ee gaarka ah waxay xirfad gaar ah kuu siinayaan aqoon.
en: The further vocational qualification and specialised vocational qualification qualify you for a certain profession.

so: Waxaa inta badan lagu sameyaa bindhigyadan aqoontada soo bandhigista aqoonta.
en: These qualifications must always be completed as competence-based qualifications.

so: Bandhiga aqoontu wuxuu sidoo kale haboon yahay marka aad wadan kale ka soo qaadatay shahaadada xirfadda islamarkaasna aad dooneyso inaad la meel dhigto shahaadada Finnishka.
en: A competence-based qualification is also viable when you have completed a vocational qualification in another country and would like it to be considered comparable to a Finnish degree.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso inaad soo bandhigto aqoontaada, toos ula xiriir machadka.
en: If you wish to complete a competence-based qualification, contact an educational institute directly.

so: Bandhiga aqoonta waxaa bixiya machadyaada xirfadaha iyo dadka waa weyn.
en: Competence-based qualifications are provided by vocational institutes and adult education centres.

so: Waqti cayiman ma lahan bandhigista aqoontu.
en: There is no particular application period for competence-based qualifications.

so: Waxaad ku sameyneysaa bandhiga aqoonta munaasabadda imtixaanka (tutkintotilanne), munaasabadaas oo uu qof ka wakiilka ah machadku ku cadeynayo aqoontaada xirfadeed.
en: You complete the competence-based qualification at a qualification event (tutkintotilanne) where a representative of the educational institute witnesses your professional competence.

so: Markaas kadib waxaa lagu calaamadeynayaa aqoontaada buuga xirfadda.
en: After this, you will receive a vocational certificate as proof of your competence.

so: Waxbarashada Finland waa mid heerkeedu sareeyo.
en: Finnish education is of high quality.

so: Farqiyada natoojinka waxbarasho ee u dhexeeya dugsiyada kala duwan waa kuwa yar, ku dhowaad dadka oo dhanna waxey dugsiga dhexe ku dhameeyay waqtiga loogu talagalay.
en: Differences in the learning results of different schools are small and nearly all students complete comprehensive school within target time.

so: Waxbarasho-horaadka, waxbarashada aasaasiga ah iyo waxbarashada heerka labaad waa lacag la'aan, xittaa markaas kaddib waxbarashadu inta badan waa lacag la'aan.
en: Preschool education, comprehensive education and upper secondary education is free of charge and also higher education is for the most part free of charge.

so: Ujeedadu waa in dadka oo dhan ay fursad u helaan waxbarasho tayo leh oo aan ku xirneyn dakhliga qoyska iyo in in loo barbaaro sidii muwaadin firfircoon.
en: The goal is for everyone to have an equal opportunity to receive high quality education regardless of the family's income and to grow up to become active citizens.

so: Nidaamka waxbarashada waxaa ku jira barbaarin-horaad, waxbarasho-horaad, waxbarashada heerka labaad, waxbarashada sare.
en: The education system includes early childhood education, preschool education, comprehensive education, upper secondary education and higher education.

so: Waxbarashada dadka waaweyn waxaa loogu talagalay dadka waaweyn waxaana ku jira fursado kala duduwan oo ka billowga tan aasaasiga ah illaa iyio atcliinta sare.
en: Adult education is intended for adults and it includes a multitude of alternatives from comprehensive to higher education.

so: Barbaarin-horaad ayuu cunugu xaq u leeyahay ka hor da'da dugsiga.
en: In Finland, children are entitled to receive early childhood education before they reach school age.

so: Barbaarin-horaadka waxaa lagu qabanqaabiyaa xanaano-maalmeedyada iyo xanaanno-maalmeeyda qoyska.
en: Early childhood education is organised in day care centres and family day care.

so: Cunuggu wuxuu sidoo kale barbaarin-horaadka waalidkiisa ugala qeybgali karaa jardiinada ciyaarta.
en: Children may also participate in early education together with a parent in a playground.

so: Cunugu wuxuu barbaarin-horaadka heli karaa ugu yaraan 20 saacadood todobaadki ama wakhti ka dheer haddii ay waalidku shaqeeyaan ama wax bartaan.
en: Children may receive at least 20 hours of early childhood education per week, or more if the parents are working or studying.

so: Yoolku waa in la kaalmeeyo horumarka iyo hufnaanta cunuga.
en: The goal is to support children's development and well-being.

so: Cunugu wuxuu baranayaa waxyaabaha ay kamidka yihiin xirfado bulsho iyo kuwa gacmeed iyo weliba aqoon kala gedisan.
en: They learn, for example, social and manual skills and gain different types of information.

so: Waxaa kale oo uu cunugu baranaa xirfado isaga ka caawinaya in wax kale barto.
en: Children also acquire skills that help them learn more.

so: Waxaa maalmaha ku jira ciyaar iyo bannaan socosho badan.
en: A lot of playtime and outdoor activities are included.

so: Haddii afka hooyo ee cunugu uu yahay wax aan aheyn Finnish ama Iswidhis, wuxuu kaalmo u helayaa barashada afka Finnishka ama Iswidhiska.
en: If the child's native language is not Finnish or Swedish, he or she will receive support in learning Finnish or Swedish.

so: Finland, degmooyinka ayaa qabanqaabiya barbaarin-horaadka.
en: In Finland, municipalities organise early childhood education.

so: Waxaa lagu maalgeliyaa lacagta canshuuraha, sababtaas ayuuna qoyska ugu qiimo jaban yahay.
en: It is tax funded and therefore more affordable to families.

so: Waxaa intaas dheer in Finland ay ka jiraan barbaarin-horaadyo gaar loo leeyahay.
en: There is also private early childhood education available in Finland.

so: Waxaa carruurta la shaqeeya macallimiin barbaarin-horaad iyo xannaaneeyayaasha carruurta oo tababaran.
en: Trained early education teachers and child nurses work with children.

so: Warar dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan barbaarin-horaadka ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi ee Barbaarin-horaadka.
en: Read more about early childhood education on the InfoFinland page Early childhood education.

so: Cunugu waa in uu ka qeybqaataa waxbarasho-horaad muddo hal sano ah ka hor inta uusan waajibka waxbarashadu billaaban.
en: In Finland, children must attend preschool education for one year before compulsory education begins.

so: Waxbarasho-horaadku wuxuu sida guud billowdaa sanadka uu cunugu buuxiyo lix sano.
en: Preschool education usually starts during the year when the child turns six.

so: Degmooyinka ayaa waxbarasho-horaadka qabanqaabiya, qoyskana waa u lacag la'aan.
en: Municipalities organise preschool education and it is free of charge for families.

so: Waxaa dhiga macallimiin barbaarin-horaad oo ka soo baxday jaamacad.
en: Preschool education is given by early education teachers who have graduated from a university.

so: Waxbarasho-horaadku waxey dhacdaa Isniinta illaa iyo Jimcaha afar saacadood maalinti.
en: Preschool education is usually organised from Monday to Friday, four hours a day.

so: Mudada sanadka ah wuxuu cunugu baranayaa xirfado uu ka faa'iideysanayo marka uu dugsiga dhiganayo sida xarfaha.
en: During the preschool year, children learn skills that are useful in school, such as letters.

so: Wax aqrin weli lama baranayo.
en: They are not, however, taught how to read.

so: Maalinta waxaa sidoo kale ku jira ciyaar iyo banaan socosho.
en: A preschool day also includes playtime and outdoor activities.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Waxbarasho-horaadka.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Preschool education.

so: Waxbarashada aasaasiga ah waxey billaabataa sanadka uu cunugu todoba sanad buuxiyo.
en: In Finland, comprehensive education normally starts during the year when the child turns seven.

so: Dhammaan carruurta sida rasmiga ah u deggan Finland waa in ay dhigtaan waxbarashada aasaasiga ah.
en: All children residing in Finland permanently must attend comprehensive education.

so: Dugsiga dhexe waa sagaal fasal.
en: Comprehensive school comprises of nine grades.

so: Waajibka waxbarashadu wuxuu dhamaanayaa marka uu cunugu dhameysto tirada waxbarashada aasaasiga ah, ama marka ay toban sanadood ka soo wareegto marka uu billowday waajibka waxbarashadu.
en: Compulsory education ends when the child has completed the entire comprehensive education syllabus or when ten years has passed since the beginning of compulsory education.

so: Finland waxbarashada aasaasiga ah waxaa haga sharci degsan.
en: Finnish legislation guides comprehensive education.

so: Waxaa kale oo la isticmaalaa aasaasyada qorshe waxbarasheedka dalka oo dhan iyo qorshe waxbarasheedyo deegaan ah.
en: National curriculum bases and local curriculums are also in use.

so: Degmooyinka ayaa waxbarashada aasaasiga ah qabanqaabiya.
en: Municipalities organise comprehensive education.

so: Waxaa lagu maalgeliyaa lacagta canshuuraha, sababtaas ayeeyna qoyska u tahay lacag la'aan.
en: It is tax funded and therefore free-of-charge for families.

so: Fasallada hoose waxey waxbarashadu qaadataa qiyaas ahaan 20 saacadood todobaadki, tiraduna waxey badaneysaa marka la gaaro fasallada sare.
en: There is about 20 hours of tuition per week for lower grades and more for higher grades.

so: Finland dhammaan macallimiinta dugsiga dhexe waxey heystaan shahaadada derajada labaad ee jaamacadda.
en: All comprehensive school teachers in Finland have a Master's degree.

so: Macallimiinta fasalka dugsiga ee wax u dhiga fasalka 1-6 waxey ku takhasuseen cilmiga barbaarinta.
en: Comprehensive school class teachers, who teach grades 1–6, are specialised in pedagogy.

so: Macallimiinta fasallada 7-9 waxey ku takhasuseen maadooyin ay iyagu dhigaan.
en: Grade 7–9 teachers are specialised in the subjects they teach.

so: Macallimiintu waxey heystaan xorriyad ballaaran oo ay si xornimo leh ku qabanqaabin karaan waxbarashada iyagoo ku saleynaya qorshaha waxbarashada qaranka iyo deegaanka.
en: Teachers are at liberty to plan their tuition independently based on the national and local curricula.

so: Muddooyinku u dambeeyay qorshaha waxbarashada waxaa xoogga lagu saaray waxyaabo ay ka mid yihiin maadooyinka dhan oo ballaaran, baaritaanka ififaalooyinka nolol-maalmeedka, iyo farsamada aqoonta teknikada iyo war tekniikada isgaarsiinta.
en: Recently, curricula have emphasised, for example, entities that cover several subjects, investigating daily phenomena and information and communications technology.

so: Ilmuhu waxey inta badan heystaan macallin isku mid ah lixda sano ee ugu horeysa.
en: Children often have the same teacher for the first six years.

so: Wuxuu si wanaagsan u baranayaa ardaydiisa isagoo aqoon u yeelanaya horumarinta waxbarasho iyagu ku haboon.
en: The teacher gets to know the students well and is able to develop the tuition to suit their needs.

so: Halka yool ee muhiimka ah waa in ardaydu ay bartaan u fikiridda si madaxbaan iyo in ay mas'uuliyadda waxbarashada qaataan.
en: One important goal is that the students learn how to think for themselves and assume responsibility over their own learning.

so: Macallimadda waxey dugsiga ku qiimeynaysaa horumarka ardayda.
en: The teacher evaluates the students' progress in school.

so: Dhammaan dhibcaha waxbarashada aasaasiga ah waxaa bixiya macallimadda.
en: In comprehensive education, all grades are given by the teacher.

so: Imitixaano rasmi ah oo dalka oo dhan ma jiraan.
en: There are no national examinations as such.

so: Taas beddelkeeda waxaa lala socdaa qiimeyn qeyb ka soo qaadasho ku saleysa.
en: Instead, learning results are being monitored with sample-based evaluations.

so: Waxaa kuwaas la qabanqaabiyaa inta badan fasalka sagaalaad.
en: These are usually organised in the ninth grade.

so: Haddii cunugga ama da'yarku uu dhowaan u soo guuray Finland, wuxuu heli karaa waxbarashada loogu diyaarinayo waxbarashada aasaasiga ah.
en: If the child or young person has only recently moved to Finland, he or she may receive preparatory education for comprehensive education.

so: Taas kaddibna wuxuu ardaygu sidii luqad labaad u sii baran karaan Finnishka ama Iswidhishka, ama luqad S2 ah, haddii asaga ama ayada uu baahan yihiin in barashada luqada lagu kaalmeeyo.
en: After it, the student may continue to study Finnish or Swedish as a second language, or an S2 language, if he or she needs support in learning the language.

so: Muhaajiriinta qaangaarka ah ee aan dalkoodi ka soo qaadan shahaadada dugsiga dhexe waxey dugsiga sare ee dadka waaweyn ku baran karaan dugsiga.
en: Adult immigrants who have no comprehensive school leaving certificate from their native country may complete comprehensive school in upper secondary schools for adults.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ku saabsan waxbarashada aasaasiga ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Waxbarashada aasaasiga ah.
en: Read more about comprehensive education on the InfoFinland page Comprehensive education.

so: Waxbarashada aasaasiga ah kaddib waxyaabaha inta badan la kala doortaa waa dugsiga sare iyo waxbarashada xirfadda.
en: The most common options after comprehensive school are upper secondary school and vocational education.

so: Waxey yihiin waxbarashada heerka labaad.
en: They are considered upper secondary education.

so: Inta badan waxbarashada heerka labaad waa u lacag la'aan ardayga.
en: Upper secondary education is usually free-of-charge for the students.

so: Hase-yeeshee waa in buugaagta iyo qalabka kale ee waxbarashada soo iibsadaan.
en: However, they must purchase their own books and other learning materials.

so: Dugsiga sare waa waxbarasho aqoon guud ah, mana laga barto wax xirfad ah.
en: Upper secondary schools provide all-round education which does not lead to any profession.

so: Dugsiga sare waxaa lagu bartaa maadooyin la mid ah kuwa dugsiga dhexe, laakiin waxbarashadu waa mid ka adag tan hore kana madaxnaan.
en: The same subjects are studied in upper secondary schools as in comprehensive school, but the studies are more demanding and independent.

so: Ardayda waxey inta badan dhammaadka qaataan shahaadada ardayga sare.
en: At the end, students usually take the matriculation examination.

so: Ardayga ayeey ku xiran tahay, laakiin dugsiga sare wuxuu qaataa 2-4 sano.
en: Upper secondary school takes 2–4 years, depending on the student.

so: Markaas kaddib waxaa la isku dayi karaa jaamacadda, dugsi xirfadeedka sare ama waxbarasho xirfadeed ku saleysan dugsiga sare.
en: After finishing, students are eligible to apply to universities, universities of applied sciences or upper secondary school based vocational education.

so: Dugsiyada sare intooda badan luqada wax laga baro waa Finnish ama Iswidhish.
en: Most upper secondary schools provide education in Finnish or Swedish language.

so: Magaalooyinka waaweyn waxaa wax looga bartaa luqad kale, tusaale ahaan Ingiriis ama Faransiis.
en: Larger cities have some upper secondary schools that provide tuition in other languages, such as English or French.

so: Dadka waaweyn waxey maadooyinka dugsiga sare ka baran karaan dugsiga sare ee dadka waaweyn.
en: Adults may take upper secondary school studies in upper secondary schools for adults.

so: Waxaa suurtagal in halkaas laga qaato koorasyo gaargaar ah ama in laga qaato dhammaan tirada maadooyinka dugsiga sare iyo shahaadada ardayga sare.Waxbarashada waxaa ku jiri kara waxbarasho dugsiga lagu qaadanayo, mid aqoon-dirsad ah, mid shabakadda lagu baranayo iyo waxbarasho madaxbanaan.
en: There, it is possible to either take separate courses or complete the entire upper secondary school syllabus and take the matriculation examination. Tuition may include contact teaching, distance education, online education and independent studies.

so: Warar dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan waxbarashada dugsiga sare ka aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Dugsiga sare.
en: Read more about upper secondary school studies on the InfoFinland page Upper secondary school.

so: Waxbarashada u diyaarinta dugsiga sare
en: Preparatory education for upper secondary school

so: Dugsiga sare waxaa loogu baahan yahay aqoon luqadeed wanaagsan.
en: Good language skills are necessary in upper secondary school.

so: Haddii afka hooyo ee ardaygu uu yahay mid ka duwan Finnish ama Iswidhish aqoontiisa luqaduna aysan weli ugu filneyn wax ka barashada dugsiga sare wuxuu fursad u heystaa in uu codsado waxbarashada diyaarinta ah ee dugsiga sare. (LUVA).
en: If the student's native language is some other than Finnish or Swedish and his or her language skills are not yet at the level required for upper secondary school studies, he or she can apply to preparatory education for upper secondary school (LUVA).

so: Waxbarasho xirfadeedku waa ka waxqabad badan tahay tan dugsiga sare.
en: Vocational education is more practice-oriented than upper secondary school education.

so: Waxbarashada xirfadda aasaasiga ah waxaa lagu baran karaa qiyaas ahaan saddex sano.
en: Completing a vocational qualification takes about three years.

so: Markaas ka dib waxbarashada waa la sii wadi karaa illaa iyo xirfadda ama xirfadda takhasus ah laga gaaro.
en: After this, students can continue their studies to complete a further vocational qualification or a specialised vocational degree.

so: Waxbarashada la sameeyo qeyb ahaan waa wax ku barashada goobta shaqada.
en: On-the-job learning is an essential part of the qualification.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso waxaad waxbarashada xirfadeed kaddib u gudbi kartaa illaa iyo waxbarashada sare.
en: If students so choose, they can progress from vocational education to higher education.

so: Waxaa sidoo kale suurtagal in qaab aqoon muujin ah loo sameyn karo shahaadada xirfadda ama takhasuska xirfadda.
en: Further vocational qualification or a specialised vocational degree can also be completed as competence-based qualifications if the student has already acquired the skills required for the qualification.

so: Waxbarashada xirfadeedka waxaa sidoo kale lagu qaadan karaa heshiis waxbarasho.
en: Vocational qualification can also be obtained through apprenticeship training.

so: Markaas wuxuu ardaygu ka shaqeeya goob shaqo oo laga qabto mihnaddiisa, wuxuu shaqada ka helayaa ugu yaraan mushaar u dhigma mushaarka shaqo ku tababarashada isagoo islamarkaasna qaadanaya waxbarashada.
en: In this case, students work in jobs within their own field, receive a salary that is at least equal to training salary and complete their studies at the same time.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Waxbarasho xirfadeed.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Vocational education and training.

so: Haddii aqoonta luqadeed ama aqoonta waxbarasho aysan ku filneyn barashada xirfadda, waxaad iyada ka hor codsan kartaa waxbarashada diyaarinta ee waxbarashada xirfadda (VALMA).
en: If your language or study skills are not adequate for vocational education, you can apply for preparatory vocational education (VALMA).

so: Tacliinta heerka labaad kaddib waxaa la sii wadan karaa tacliinta.
en: After finishing your upper secondary studies, you can progress to higher education.

so: Tacliinta sare waxaa Finland ka bixiya dugsi xirfadeedyada sare iyo jaamacadaha.
en: In Finland, higher education is provided by universities and universities of applied sciences.

so: Dugsiga tacliinta sare waxey waxbarashadiisu ardayga u noqon kartaa lacag la'aan ama lacag.
en: Studying in an institute of higher education may be free or subject to a charge.

so: Lacag sanad-dugsiyeedka waa in la bixiyaa, haddii aan la aheyn Muwaadin Midowga Yurub ama wadamada ETA ama xubin ka tirsan qoysaska muwaadiniintaas islamarkaasna aad qaadaneyso waxbarashada shahaadada kowaad ama labaad ee jaamacadda oo afka Ingiriiska ku baxaya.
en: You will be charged tuition fees if you are not an EU or EEA citizen or a family member of an EU or EEA citizen and are studying towards a Bachelor's or Master's degree in an English-language degree programme.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Ardayga ajnabiga ah ee jooga Finland.
en: More information is available on the InfoFinland page Foreign students in Finland.

so: Waxbarashada dugsi xirfadeedka tacliinta sare waa ka waxqabad badan tahay tan jaamacadda.
en: The education provided by universities of applied sciences is more practice-oriented than that offered by universities.

so: Waxbarashada waxaa sidoo kale ku jira wax ku barashada shaqada.
en: Tuition also includes on-the-job learning.

so: Waxbarashada dugsi xirfadeedka tacliinta sare waxaa lagu dhameyn karaa 3,5-4,5 sano.
en: Completing a Bachelor's degree in a university of applied sciences takes 3.5–4.5 years.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogagga InfoFinlandi Iskuul xirfadeedka sare.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Universities of applied sciences.

so: Waxbarashada jaamacaddu waxey ku saleysan tahay baaritaan cilmiyeed.
en: University tuition is based on scientific research.

so: Jaamacadda waxaa lagu qaadan karaa shahaadada koowaad ee jaamacadda qiyaas ahaan saddex sano kaddibna qiyaas ahaan labo sano ayaad ku qaadan kartaa shahaadada darajada labaad ee jaamacadda.
en: Completing a Bachelor's degree in a university takes about three years and Master's degree about two more years.

so: Jaamacaduhu waxey sidoo kale qabanqaabiyaan barnaamijyo waxbarasheedyo lagu sameeyo afka Ingiriiska.
en: Universities organise English language tuition in some of their degree programmes.

so: Baarnaamijyada waxbarashada badankood waxey ku baxaan afka finnishka ama iswidhishka.
en: However, the teaching language of most degree programmes is either Finnish or Swedish.

so: Marka aad dhameyso waxbarashada mastareedka, waxaad codsan kartaa sii wadista waxbarashada si aad u qaadato shahaadada ruqsadda macalllinnimada jaamcadda ama doktoreydka.
en: Once you have completed a Master's degree, you can apply for a right to complete further studies and earn a Licentiate's or Doctoral degree.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Jaamacadaha.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Universities.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi ee Dalbashada waxbarashada waxaa ku jira macluumaad ku saabsan sida loo codsan karo waxbarashada heerka labaad iyo waxbarashada tacliinta sare ee Finland.
en: InfoFinland page Applying for education and training includes information on applying to upper secondary and higher education in Finland.

so: Haddii aad qorsheynasyo wax ku barashada Finland, warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogagga InfoFinlandi ee Ardayga ajnabiga ah ee jooga Finland iyo Arday
en: If you are planning to study in Finland, more information is also available on the InfoFinland pages Foreign students in Finland and Student.

so: Finland waxaa sidoo kale ka jira machadyo bixiya tacliin aan shahaado laga qaadan oo loogu talagalay dadka oo dhan da' kasta oo ay jiraan.
en: In Finland, there are also many educational institutions offering persons of all ages studies which do not lead to a degree.

so: Waxbarashooyinka badankood waxaa loogu talagalay dadka waaweyn.
en: Most of these studies are intended for adults.

so: Machadyadan waa machadyada dadka waaweyn, kulleejooyin, jaamacadaha xagaaga, xarumaha waxbarista iyo xarumaha waxbarashada isboortiga.
en: These institutions include adult education centres, summer universities, study centres and sports training centres.

so: Waxbarashooyinka waa aqoon guud.
en: The studies provide all-round education.

so: Waxaad baran kartaa tusaale ahaan luqado, maadooyin farshaxaneed, shaqo gacmeedyo iyo isgaarsiinta.
en: You can study languages, arts, crafts and communications, for instance.

so: Waxbarashadu inta badan lacag yar ayeey u tahay ardayga.
en: Normally the student has to cover some of the expenses of the education.

so: Xaaldaha qaarkood marka lagu jiro waxbarashada machadyadu waxey noqon kartaa lacag la'aan.
en: However, in certain situations studying at these institutions may be free of charge.

so: Tusaale ahaan haddii waxbarashada wax qoris akhrinta ah ama waxbarasho luqadeed kale lagu daray qorshahaada la qabsashada, wax lacag ah lagaama qaadayo.
en: Education is non-chargeable if, for example, education in reading and writing and other language training have been approved as parts of your integration plan.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso in aad barato afka Finnishka ama Iswidhiska, warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Luqada Finnishka iyo Iswidishka.
en: If you would like to study Finnish or Swedish, read more on the InfoFinland page Finnish and Swedish language.

so: Caadiyen waa inaad qashinka ku soo kala soocdaa guriga inta anad keenin bannaanka qashinqubka.
en: At home, you normally need to sort your waste before taking it out to waste containers.

so: Marka si hagaagsan loo kala sooco alaabta qashinka la keenayo dib ayaa looga samayn karaa alaab cusub.
en: When you sort your waste correctly, the material can be reused to make new products.
