en: Recycling instructions may vary a little in different parts of Finland.

so: Haka tuurin qashinka daaqada hana ku tuurin qashin kaymaha ama dariiqyada.
en: Do not throw rubbish out of the window or into the street or forest.

so: Alaabta anan jabnayn ma aha qashin.
en: Undamaged goods are not waste.

so: Alaabta waxad gaysan kartaa suuqyada alaabta la soo isticmaalay oo ad ku gadan kartaa, waxad galin kartaa internetka si lagaaga gato ama waxad gayn kartaa xarumaha alaabta lagu wareejiyo.
en: You can sell them at a flea market or through the Internet, or donate them to charity or recycling centres.

so: Finland waa caadi in uu qofku iibsado alaab la soo isticmaalay, si fudud baana loo helaa alaab fiican oo la soo isticmaalo.
en: In Finland, it is commonplace to buy second-hand (used) goods, and it is easy to find good-quality used articles.

so: Sidee qashinka loo kala soocaa
en: How to sort your waste?

so: Alaabta waxa lagu kala soocaa waxa ay ka samaysanyihiin.
en: Sort waste according to its material.

so: Haku ridin bullaacadaha ama musqusha qashin, cunto ama kemikaalo dheeraad ah.
en: Do not flush rubbish, food or unneeded chemicals down the toilet.

so: Qashinka halista ah mar kasta gee meelaha qashinka lagu kala sooco ee loogu talo galay.
en: Always take hazardous waste to a proper collection point.

so: Dhismayaasha oo dhan markasta lama dhigin alaabta lagu tuuro qashinka la kala soocay.
en: Not all housing companies provide all of the necessary recycling containers.

so: Bogga kierratys.info waxad ka heli kartaa meelo qashinka lagu tuuri karo oo dadka oo dhan ka dhexeeya.
en: You can find the location of shared recycling points at the kierratys.info website.

so: Qashinka meelaha lagu tuuro ee dhismayaasha ama guryaha kale ha gaynin qashinkaaga.
en: You are not allowed to take your rubbish to another housing company's waste containers.

so: Sidoo kale ha keenin qashinqubka gurigaaga qashin ad meel kale ka keentay sida ganacsigaaga.
en: Do not bring rubbish from elsewhere – for example, from your company – to the housing company's waste containers.

so: Weelka alaabta lagu sooco ee badanaa laga helo guryaha
en: Most housing companies provide the following sorting containers

en: YES: food waste, including food that has gone bad, coffee grounds, kitchen paper, fruit peels etc.

so: Degmooyinka qaarkood waxay ka saaraan marka hore gaas laga heli karo koronto iyo diirimaad.
en: Some municipalities first extract biogas from biowaste, which is then converted into heat and electricity.

en: Mixed waste (Sekajäte) or miscellaneous waste

en: YES: All waste that you cannot or do not want to sort.

en: Mixed waste is usually burned in a waste-to-energy plant, in other words, it is turned into heat and electricity.

en: The metal from batteries is recycled and all hazardous materials are processed safely.

en: YES: all electric or battery-powered devices and toys

en: WHERE: small devices to stores that sell electronics, big devices to electronic waste collection points, see the kierratys.info website.

so: Macdanta ama birta alaabta korontada ku shaqeeya (sida dahabka) waa la soocaa.
en: The metals from electrical equipment (such as gold) are recycled.

so: Finland biyaha qasabaddu waa biyo badbaado ah oo fiican.
en: Drink tap water, it is good and safe in Finland.

so: Waxad iibsataa oo kaliya alaab ad u baahantahay.
en: Only buy items that you really need.

so: Haddii ad hadhoow damacdo inaad iibiso, waxad ka heli kartaa lacag.
en: You can earn some money by selling them later.

so: Iibso oo iibi alaabta la soo isticmaalo.
en: Buy and sell used goods.

so: Alaabtaada si hagaagsan u kaydso adiga oo tixraacaya qoraalka kaydintooda lagaga hadlayo ee ad ku soo iibsatay.
en: Take good care of your goods and store them according to the instructions.

so: Haddii gurigaaga uu dab qabsado.
en: A smoke detector can save your life.

so: Dab kadiguhu wuxuu bixinayaa cod aad u dheer, markaas waxaad ka gaari karaysaa inaad guriga dibadda uga baxdo.
en: If a fire breaks out in your home, a smoke detector emits a loud alarm sound so that you can evacuate the premises in time.

so: Ka taxadar in gurigaagu uu leeyahay dab ka digeyaal badan oo ku filan (palovaroitin).
en: Ensure that your home is equipped with a sufficient number of smoke detectors.

so: Dab ka digeyaasha waxaa lagu gadaa dukaamada caadiga ah iyo kuwa qalabka dhismaha.
en: Smoke detectors are sold in department stores and hardware shops.

so: Hal dab kadige wuxuu marwalba ku filan yahay ilaa 60 mitir oo iskuweer ah.
en: One smoke detector can cover up to 60 square metres.

so: Haddii uu gurigaagu yahay mid ka badan hal dabaq, markaas dabaq walba baaxaddiisa u xisaabi si gooni ah.
en: If your home has more than one floor, calculate the floor area of each floor separately.

so: Dabaq walba waa inuu leeyahay dab kadige u gooni ah.
en: There must be a smoke detector on every floor.

so: Si joogto ah u hubi inuu dab kadigu shaqaynayo.
en: Check regularly that the smoke detector functions properly.

so: Bateriga ka badel haddii loo baahdo, sida wanaagsan sannadkiiba hal mar.
en: Replace the batteries, if necessary – preferably once a year.

so: Adigaa mas'uul ka ah dab kadigaha, xattaa haddii aad degan tahay guri kiro ah. Guryaha
en: You are responsible for the smoke detectors even if you are living in a rental dwelling.

so: Finnishu waxay inta badan leeyihiin sauna.
en: Finnish dwellings often have a sauna.

so: Xattaa haddii aadan isticmaaleyn saunada dhagxaanta kululeysa dushooda waligaa ha saarin wax alaab ah, haddii kale dab ayaa ka kici kara.
en: Never place anything above the sauna heater even if you are not using the sauna, as this may cause a fire.

so: Tusaale ahaan dhar ha ku qalajin dhagxaanta saunada dushooda ama agtooda.
en: For example, do not dry laundry above the sauna heater or near it.

so: Isticmaalka kadib mar walba demi ama bakhtii saunada korontada ah.
en: Always switch off an electric sauna heater after use.

so: Markii aad guriga ka baxaysid, xasuuso inaad hubisid, in makiinadda cuntada lagu kariyo, dhagxaanta saunada iyo feerada dharkuba ay dansan yihiin.
en: When leaving your home, remember to check that the stove, sauna heater and iron, for example, have been switched off.

so: Waxaa wanaagsan in guriga uu yaalo bad damiye.
en: It is also a good idea to have a fire extinguisher in your home.

so: Cimaaradaha dhaareed qaarkood marinkooda jaranjarada wuxuu leeyahay dab damiye (palosammutin).
en: Some blocks of flats also have a fire extinguisher in the stairway.

so: Sii ogow meesha uu yaalo dab damiyaha kuugu dhaw.
en: Find out where the nearest fire extinguisher is located.

so: Ka taxadar, in gurigaaga uu yaalo bustaha dabka lagu demiyo.
en: Ensure that you have a fire blanket in your home.

so: Bustaha dabka lagu damiyo waxaa wanaagsan in aad ku xafido makiinadda cuntada lagu kariyo agteeda.
en: It is advisable to keep it near the stove, for example.

so: Cunto ha uga tegin makiinada cuntada lagu kariyo oo kulul dusheeda iyadoo aan la dul joogin.
en: Do not leave food on a hot stove unattended.

so: Si gaar ah uga feejignoow haddii aad habeenkii cunto karineysid.
en: Be particularly careful when cooking at night.

so: Ha karin cunto haddii aad sarqaansantahay.
en: Do not cook food when intoxicated.

so: Ha ku xafin wax alaab ah makiinadda cuntada lagu kariyo dusheeda.
en: Do not store items on the stove.

so: Carruurta, xayawaanaadka gurijoogta ah ama taabasho aan ula kac ahayn ayaa si aan ula kac ahayn u daari kara makiinadda cuntada.
en: Children, pets or inadvertent contact may accidentally switch on the stove.

so: Markaas alaabada sallaxa makiinadda cuntada dusheeda saaran ayaa guban kara.
en: This may ignite the items on the stove.

so: Haddii uu duffanku gubto markii aad cuntada karineysid, ku bakhtii dabka daboolka digsiga ama daboolka birtaawada ama bustaha dabka lagu demiyo.
en: If the grease catches fire when you are cooking, smother the flames with the lid of a pot or frying pan, or a fire blanket.

so: Ha isticmaalin wax biyo ah.
en: Do not use water.

so: Xasuuso inaad demiso aaladaha korontada ah isticmaalka kadib.
en: Remember to switch off electrical devices after use.

so: Sidoo kale makiinadda dharka lagu feereeyo waa inaad bareeska korontada ka saarto isticmaalka kadib.
en: An iron must also be disconnected from the power socket.

so: Ha isticmaalin aaladaha korontada ah oo aan sida wanaagsan u shaqeyneyn ama xarigooda korontadu uu cilladeysan yahay.
en: Do not use electrical devices that are in poor conditions or whose cable is faulty.

so: Haddii aaladda korontada ah uu dab ka kaco, daminteeda ha u isticmaalin wax biyo ah.
en: If an electrical device catches fire, do not use water.

so: Ku demi tusaale ahaan aaladda dabdemiska ee xoorta leh.
en: Put out the fire with a fire extinguisher, for example.

so: Haddii uu gurigaagu leeyahay qalab kul siin koronto ah ama kululeeyeyaal kale, dushoooda ha saarin wax dun, dhar ama wax kaleba ah.
en: If you have electric radiators or other heaters in your home, do not place fabrics, clothes or any other items on them.

so: U bannee isbeys agagaarka telefishinka, mikrada, qaboojiyaha iyo freezerka.
en: Leave enough space around your television, microwave oven, refrigerator and freezer.

so: Ha daboolin aaladahaan aan soo sheegnay.
en: Do not cover them.

so: Waxaa habboon haddii ay suurtogal tahay in sannadkiiba hal mar boorka tusaale ahaan huufarka la mariyo qaboojiyaha iyo freezer gadaashooda.
en: The rear grate of the freezer and refrigerator should be cleaned of dust once a year with a vacuum, for example, if this is possible.

so: Gudaha ha ku cabin sigaar.
en: Do not smoke indoors.

so: Ha ka tegin shumaca oo shidan ayadoo aan la fiirineyn.
en: Do not leave candles burning unattended.

so: Shumaca oo shidan ha saarin daaha agtiisa, xattaa haddii aad adigu joogtid goobta.
en: Do not burn candles near curtains even when you are present in the room.

so: Haddii ii dab kaco, wac lambarka xaaladaha deg degga ah 112.
en: If a fire breaks out, call the emergency number 112.

so: Markii aad guriga ka baxaysid, ha ka tegin qasaaladda dharka iyo mashinka maacunta lagu dhaqo oo shidan.
en: Do not leave a washing machine or dishwasher on when leaving the home.

so: Si joogto ah hubi ama koontarool, in tubooyinka gurigaagu aysan biyo daadeneyn iyo in makiinadaha gurigu aysan biyo dhulka ku daadineyn.
en: Regularly check the water pipes in your home for leaks and ensure that water does not leak on the floor from any appliances.

so: Haddii aadan isticmaaleyn, mar walba ha xirnaadeen qasabadaha qasaaladda dharka iyo mashinka maacunta lagu dhaqo.
en: Keep the washing machine and dishwasher valves closed when not using the machines.

so: Waa in qaboojiyaha, freezerka iyo mashinka maacunta hoostooda la dhigo bac godan oo weel ah oo biyaha ka celisa dhulka.
en: A plastic leak pan is required under the refrigerator, freezer and dishwasher.

so: Waxaa loo xiraa sida aaladahan loo xiro oo kale.
en: It is installed at the same time as the device.

so: Lama ogola inaad adigu xirtid mashinka maacuunta lagu dhaqo, balse waxaa sameeya qof xirfad u leh.
en: Do not install a dishwasher yourself – leave it to a professional.

so: Haddii gurigaaga ay waxyeelo biyo ka dhacdo, isku day inaad meesha biyuhu ka daadanayaan aad ka xirto rubuneetada tubada.
en: If there is a water leak in your home, try to close off the water line with the shut-off valve.

so: Haddii aad degentahay guri dabaq ama saf ah, haddiiba ogeysii qubashada biyaha lambarka heeganka ee shirkadda ku shuqulka leh dayactirka guriga.
en: If you live in a block of flats or terraced house, immediately report leaks to the housing company's on-call number.

so: Haddii aad degen tahay gurigaaga kuu goonida ah, ogeysii heeganka shirkadda qasabadaha biyaha.
en: If you live in a detached house, notify an on-call plumbing firm.

so: Finland waxay leedahay koronto shabakada quwaddeedu ay tahay 230 volti.
en: The mains voltage in Finland is 230 V.

so: Shaqooyinka korontada oo caadiga ah dalka Finland dhexdiisa waxaa sameyn kara dadka korontada xirfadda u leh.
en: In Finland, actual electrical work may only be conducted by professional electricians.

so: Waad sameyn kartaa adigu shaqooyin yar yar oo koronto ah, haddii aad taqaanid.
en: You may carry out some minor electrical work, if you have the requisite skills.

so: ku xiri kartaa nal bareeska saqafka
en: connect a light fixture to the terminal in the ceiling

so: ka badeli kartaa aaladda koronta xarigga korontada oo hal weji (guwadiisu tahay 230V), sidoo kale waxaad bedeli kartaa madaxa bareeska, haddii kii hore uu xumaaday.
en: replace a broken single-phase connection cord (voltage 230 V) and plug with a new functional one.

so: Qufulka badbaadadu wuxuu kaa ilaalinayaa tuugada
en: A security lock protects against thieves

so: Haddii gurigaagu uu leeyahay qufulka badbaada, mar walba ha xirnaado haddii aad guriga ka maqan tahay.
en: If your home has a security lock, keep it closed whenever you are away.

so: Ha xirin qufulka badbaadada, haddii aad guriga joogtid.
en: Do not close the security lock when you are at home.

so: Haddii gurigaaga la jabsado, wac lambarka xaaladaha deg degga ah 112.
en: If someone breaks into your home, call the emergency number 112.

so: Maxaan sameynaysaa, haddii guriga uu dab ka kaco
en: I do if there is a fire at my home

so: Haddii aad videyowga su'aalo ka qabtid, waxaa kula gudboon inaad arrimaha wax ka weydiiso dadka arrimahaan ku xeel dheer.
en: If you have any questions about the video, it is a good idea to ask experts.

so: Ma heli karo guri kiro oo raqiis ah.
en: I cannot find an affordable rental dwelling.

so: Guryaha kirada ah ee bannaan oo ku yaal magaalooyinka waa weyn waa yar yihiin.
en: There are not many rental dwellings available in the largest cities.

so: Guryaha u dhow bartamaha magaaladu waa ka qaalisan yihiin kuwa kale.
en: Dwellings are more expensive near the city centre.

so: Waana sababta ay Finnish badan u deggan yihiin guryo yaryar.
en: Therefore, many Finns live in quite small dwellings.

so: Qaar badan oo kalena waxey deggan yihiin meelo ka fog bartamaha magaalada ama degmooyinka kale oo u dhow iyagoo safar dheer u soo gala shaqada.
en: Many also live far from the city centre or in some other adjacent municipality so they have a longer commute to work.

so: Haddii aadan guri raqiis ah ka helin meesha aad dooneyso, ka fikir, in aad degi karto guri yar ama meel ka fog bartamaha.
en: If you cannot find an affordable dwelling in the area you like, consider the possibility of living in a smaller dwelling or further away from the city centre.

so: Deegaanno yaryar oo badan waxaa laga helaa guryo badan oo bannaan, qiimuhuna waa ka jaban yihiin.
en: Many smaller cities have plenty of available dwellings and the prices are more affordable.

so: Haddii aad qorsheynayso in aad deegaan yar uga soo guurto magaalo weyn, guri horay u raadi.
en: If you are planning to move from a small town to a large city, look for a dwelling in advance.

so: Ka aqriso wixi dheeri ah bogga InfoFinlandi Guri kiro.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Rental dwelling.

so: Waxaan diray codsiga guryaha kirada ah ee degmada, laakiin ma helin guri, inkastoo uu waqti ka soo wareegay.
en: I submitted an application for a municipal rental dwelling, but I have not received one even though much time has elapsed.

so: Guryaha degmadu kuma filna dhammaan dadka codsada.
en: The number of municipal dwellings does not allow their allocation to all applicants.

so: Waxaa wanaagsan in guriga laga raadsado meelo badan.
en: It is recommended to apply for a dwelling from many different places.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale la socotaa guryaha kirada ee gaarka loo leeyahay.
en: Also keep an eye on the supply of private rental dwellings.

so: Xusuusnow in aad waqtiga la jimeyso codsigaada, inta uu weli shaqeynayo. Haddii kale codsigu wuu dhacayaa.
en: Remember to update your application while it is still valid, otherwise the application will expire.

so: Waxaan ka shakisanahay in lay takooray marki aan guriga raadinayay.
en: I suspect that I have been discriminated against when I have looked for a dwelling.

so: Halkeen caawimaad ka helaa?
en: From where can I get help?

so: Sida sharcigu qabo laga kireystayaashu cidna kuma takoori karaan marka ay xulanayaan qofka ay gurigooda ka kireysanayaan tusaale ahaan asalkiisa, diintiisa ama jinsiyaddiiisa darteed.
en: According to the law, lessors are not allowed to discriminate against anybody, for example due to ethnic origin, religion or nationality, when selecting tenants.

so: Si kastoo ay ahaatee laga kireystaha gaarka ah wuxuu xaq u leeyahay in uu isagu doorto qofka uu guriga ka kireysanayo, qasabna kuma ahan in uu sababeeyo xulashadiisa.
en: A private lessor, however, is entitled to select the tenant of the dwelling without any need to justify the selection.

so: Haddii shaki kaa galo in lagu takooray, waxaad talo weydiin kartaa tusaale ahaan adeegga macaamiisha ee Wakiilka Sinnaanta.
en: If you suspect that you have been discriminated against, you can ask for advice, for example, from the customer service of the Non-Discrimination Ombudsman.

so: Ma qasab in aan dallaalka siiyo lacagta dallaalka, marka aan guri kireysanayo?
en: Do I have to pay a commission to the agent when I rent a dwelling?

so: Lacagta dallaalka waxaa inta badan bixiya laga kireystaha.
en: The commission is usually paid by the lessor.

so: Marka kaliya ee aad lacagta dallaalka adigu iska bixineyso waa marka aad heshiis qoraal ah oo guri-raadin la gasho dallaalka.
en: You yourself have to pay the commission only in the case where you have concluded in advance a written commission agreement with the agent.

so: Haddii heshiis shaqo u dirasho oo qoraal ah aadan sameynin, dallaalku lacagta dallaalka kaama dooni karo.
en: If you have not concluded a written commission agreement, the agent is not entitled to demand commission from you.

so: Haddii uu isku dayo dacwad ayaad ka gudbin kartaa.
en: If he/she tries to do so, you can file a notice of a crime.

so: Ka aqriso wixi dheeri ah bogga InfoFinlandi Dembiyada.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Crimes.

so: Dallaalku wuxuu doonayaa in aan lacag siiyo si aan guriga u arko.
en: The agent demands a payment for seeing the dwelling.

so: In aan bixiyo miyaa?
en: Do I have to pay?

so: Waxaad xaq u leedahay in aad horay u soo aragto guriga , dallaalkuna lacag kaama dalban karo.
en: You are entitled to see the dwelling in advance and the agent cannot demand payment for it.

so: Haddii ay ku heysato dhibaato la xiriirka dallaalka, waxaad la xiriir kartaa Talo-bixinta quutayaasha.
en: If you have problems regarding the commission, you can contact the Consumer Advisory Service.

so: Dallaalku wuxuu doonayaan in aan lacag xajisasho ah ka bixiyo guriga kirada ah.
en: The agent demands that I pay a reservation fee on the rental dwelling.

so: Finland kama jirto lacagta xajinta guriga.
en: There is no such thing as a dwelling reservation fee in Finland.

so: Waxba ha bixinin illaa iyo inta aad ka heleyso heshiiska qoraalka ah ee kirada guriga.
en: Do not pay anything until you have a written tenancy agreement on the dwelling.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan bixinta lacagaha kirada, tusaale ahaan dabaajiga kirada, ka eeg bogga InfoFinlandi Heshiiska kirada.
en: Read more about the rental dwelling fees, such as the rental security deposit, on the InfoFinland page Tenancy agreement.

so: Laga kireystuhu wuxuu doonayaa in aan galo ceymiska guriga.
en: The lessor requires that I take home insurance.

so: Halkeen ka helayaa ceymiska guriga?
en: Where can I take out home insurance?

so: Miyaan ka bixi karaa ceymiska hadhow?
en: Can I cancel it later?

so: Ceymiska guryaha waxaa dalkan Finland iibiya shirkado ceymis oo badan.
en: Home insurance is sold by many insurance companies in Finland.

so: Ka aqriso wixi dheeri ah bogga InfoFinlandi Nolol maalmeedka dalka Finland.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Everyday life in Finland.

so: Waxaa wanaagsan in la galo ceymiska guriga, xittaa haddii aan lagu dalban heshiiska kirada.
en: It is recommended to take out home insurance, even if it is not required in the tenancy agreement.

so: Ma wanaagsana in aad ceymiska guriga ka baxdo inta aad guriga deggan tahay.
en: You are not recommended to cancel the home insurance while you live in the dwelling.

so: Haddii tusaale ahaan aad sababto qasaare-biyood aadanna ku jirin ceymiska guriga, waxaa qasab kugu noqonaya in aad adigu bixiso dhammaan qarashka dayactirka.
en: If, for example, you cause water damage and you do not have a home insurance, you have to pay all the repair costs yourself.

so: Biilku wuxuu noqon karaa tobaneeye kun oo yuuro.
en: The total amount can be tens of thousands of euros.

so: Maxey tahay in aan maanka geliyo ka hor inta aanan saxiixin heshiiska kirada?
en: What should I take into account before signing a tenancy agreement?

so: Soo fiiri guriga, inta aadan kireysan.
en: Take a good look at the dwelling before renting it.

so: Hubi, in gurigu uu yahay wax jira, yacni in cinwaanka gurigu uu la mid yahay kan ku qoran heshiiska guriga.
en: Check that the dwelling actually exists, i.e. the address of the dwelling matches the one indicated on the agreement.

so: Xaqiiji sidoo kale in xaaladda gurigu ay tahay sidi laguugu sheegay.
en: Also ensure that the dwelling is in the condition described to you.

so: Hubi, in waxyaabaha heshiiska ku qoran sida shuruudaha iyo waqtiga fasixidda guriga.
en: Check from the tenancy agreement, for example, the terms and conditions of the tenancy and the period of notice.

so: Waxaa kale oo wanaagsan in milkiilaha guriga ama wakiilkiisa lala qoro guriga iyo cilladaha jiri kara.
en: You are also recommended to go over the dwelling and its possible defects with the owner or his/her representative.

so: Ka aqriso wixi dheeri ah bogga InfoFinlandi Heshiiska kirada.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Tenancy agreement.

so: Goormee ayeey tahay in la bixiyo dabaajiga guriga?
en: When does the rental security deposit have to be paid?

so: Bixi lacagta dabaajiga ah marka aad hesho heshiiska kirada oo qoraal ah.
en: Do not pay the rental security deposit, until you have a written tenancy agreement.

so: Laga kireystahu wuxuu u qarriri karaa lambar akoon, oo aad ku shubeyso lacagta dabaajiga.
en: The lessor can assign a bank account for paying the rental security deposit.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale akoon gaar ah bangiga uga furan kartaan dabaajiga kirada.
en: You can also open a separate account for the rental security deposit at a bank.

so: Laga kireystuhu wuxuu soo jeediyay, in aan heshiiska kirada u galno af ahaan.
en: The lessor suggested that we could conclude an oral tenancy agreement.

so: Heshiiska afku ma ku filan yahay?
en: Is an oral agreement sufficient?

so: Heshiiska kirada markasta ka dhig mid qoraal ah.
en: Always conclude the tenancy agreement in writing.

so: Waxaad sidan ku caddeyn kartaa waxyaabaha aad ku heshiiseen haddii dhibaato ka timaado.
en: This way you can prove what you have agreed in case of problems.

so: Si wanaagsan u xafid heshiiska kirada.
en: Keep the tenancy agreement in a safe place.

so: Cillado xoogaa ah ayuu gurigu leeyahay.
en: There are a few defects in the rental dwelling.

so: Laga kireystuhu dib miyuu iiga dalban karaa in aan dayactiro cillado aanan sababin.
en: Can the lessor demand afterwards that I should compensate for the defects that I have not caused?

so: Waxaa kuu wanaagsan in aad la qorto cilladaha guriga laga kireystaha, marka uu xiriirka kiradu billowdo.
en: You are recommended to write down the defects of the dwelling together with the lessor at the beginning of the tenancy.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale qaadi kartaa sawirro ay ka muuqdaan cilladahan.
en: You can also take photos of the defects.

so: Sidan waxaad uga badbaadi kartaa in aysan qasab kugu noqon in aad qaaddo mas'uuliyadda cillado aadan sababin.
en: This way you can ensure that you will not be held responsible for the defects you did not cause.

so: Waxaan fasaxay guriga, laakiin laga kireystuhu wuxuu dalbanayaa in aan bixiyo kirada illaa iyo inta uu ka helayo kireyste cusub.
en: I gave notice on my rental dwelling, but the lessor demands that I pay rent until he/she can find a new tenant.

so: Haddii aad heysato heshiiska kirada oo shaqeynaya waqti aan cayineyn, waqtiga aad guriga fasixi karto waa hal bil oo buuxda.
en: If you have a non-fixed-term tenancy agreement, the period of notice is usually one calendar month.

so: Waqtigu wuxuu ka billaabanayaa dhammaadka bisha aad guriga fasaxday.
en: The period begins from the end of the month you gave notice in.

so: Marka waqtiga fasixiddu uu dhamaado laga kireystuhu kaama dalban karo kiro.
en: Once the period of notice has expired, the lessor cannot demand rent from you.

so: Heshiiska kirada ee waqtiga cayiman kama bixi kartid inta uu shaqeynayo.
en: You cannot give notice when a fixed-term tenancy agreement is valid.

so: Haddii loo baahdo waxaad isku dayi kartaa in aad wadaxaajood ka gasho dhamaanshaha heshiiska kirada waqti hore.
en: If necessary, you can try to negotiate an earlier termination of the tenancy agreement.

so: Waxaan heystaa heshiis aan waqtigiisu cayinnayn.
en: I have a non-fixed-term tenancy agreement.

so: Waxaan fasaxay guriga 2da Juunyo Laga kireystuhu wuxuu iga dalbaday in aan bixiyo xittaa kirada bisha Luulyo.
en: I gave notice on 2 June. The lessor demands that I also pay rent in July.

so: Haddii heshiiskaada kirada wax kale ku qorneyn, waqtiga fasixidda waxaa sida sharcigu qabo laga xisaabinayaa dhamaadka bil buuxda oo inti lagu jiray bishaas aad guriga fasaxday.
en: If your tenancy agreement does not state otherwise, the period of notice is calculated according to the law from the end of the calendar month you give notice in.

so: Haddii aad fasaxday guriga 2da Juunyo, waqtiga fasixiddu waa 30ka Juunyo, wuxuuna soconayaa hal bil.
en: If you give notice on 2 June, the period of notice will begin on 30 June and last for one month.

so: Yacni waa in aad bixisaa kirada bisha Luulyo.
en: Therefore, you must pay rent for July.

so: Ma heysto lacag aan kirada ku bixiyo.
en: I do not have money to pay rent.

so: Sida ugu dhaqsaha badan ula xiriir laga kireystaha kalana xaajoow waqti dheeraad ah oo aad lacagta ku bixiso.
en: Contact your lessor as soon as possible and try to negotiate more time.

so: Soo ogow, in aad dib u dhigi karto bixinta biilasha kale, si aad kirada isaga bixiso.
en: Determine whether you can postpone other payments in order to be able to pay your rent.

so: La xiriir sidoo kale bangigaada oo ka ogow, in aad deyn ka heli karto, si aad kirada isaga bixiso.
en: Also, contact your bank and find out whether your bank can grant you a loan so that you are able to pay your rent.

so: Ka ogow KELA'da in aad xaq u leedahay kaalmada kirada ama kaalmooyin kale.
en: Find out from KELA whether you are entitled to receive housing allowance or some other allowance.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale talo iyo caawimaad weydiisan kartaa talo-bixinta deynta, xafiiska sooshalka iyo la taliyaha degitaanka ee degmada ama shrikadda guriga kirada ama ururka ama tusaale ahaan Mu'asasada Damiinta.
en: You can also ask for advice and help from the municipal debt counselling, social welfare office or a housing counsellor of the municipality, tenement building company or associations or, for example, from the Guarantee Foundation.

so: Ka aqriso wixi dheeri ah bogga InfoFinlandi Dhibaatooyinka dhaqaale.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Financial problems.

so: Furriin dhacay dartiis waa in aan ka guuro gurigeyga.
en: I have to move out of my dwelling due to divorce.

so: Waxaan sidoo kale ka baqanayaa, in aan lumiyo ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka dalka.
en: I am also afraid that I will lose my residence permit.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi Guri kiro waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad ku saabsan, sida aad u raadsan karto guri cusub.
en: You can find information on the InfoFinland page Rental dwelling on how to look for a new dwelling.

so: Furriinku wuxuu saameyn ku yeelan karaa ogolaanshaha joogitaankaada, haddii aad heysatay sharci ku meelgaarka ah oo aad ku qaadatay xiriir qoys.
en: A divorce may impact your residence permit, if you have a fixed-term residence permit due to family ties.

so: Xaaladaha qaar marka lagu jiro waxaa suurtagal in laguu sii wado sharciga, haddii aad xiriir adag ku leedahay Finland, sida shaqo.
en: In some situations, however, the permit may be extended, if you still have fixed ties to Finland, such as a job.

so: Ka aqriso wixi dheeri ah bogga InfoFinlandi Miyaan weyn karaa ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Can I lose my residence permit.

so: Laga kireystuhu wuxuu iigu hanjabay, in guriga layga saarayo buuq dartiis.
en: The lessor threatened to evict me from my rental dwelling due to noise issues.

so: Haddii aad si joogto ah u jebiso xeerarka nidaamka ee guriga, laga kireystuhu wuxuu xaq u leeyahay in uu heshiiska burriyo.
en: If you keep violating the housing rules and regulations, the lessor is entitled to cancel the tenancy agreement.

so: Isku day in aad arrinta kala heshiiso laga kireystaha ka hor inta aan heshiiska la burrin.
en: Try to reconcile the matter with the lessor before the cancellation.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale la xiriiri kartaa tusaale ahaan xarunta Heshiisiinta Deriska.
en: You may also contact, for example, the Community Mediation Centre.

so: Waa in aan ka guuraa guriga, mana helin guri cusub.
en: I had to move out of my dwelling and I have not found a new one.

so: Degmooyinka Finland waxey adeegyo u fidiyaan dadka guryo la'aanta ah.
en: In Finland, the municipalities offer services to the homeless.

so: Adeegyadan waxaa loogu talagalay dadka ku leh Guri degmo ee gudaha Finland.
en: These services are targeted at those who have a municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Haddii aad guri la'aan noqoto, la xiriir xafiiska sooshalka degmadaada ama xarunta sooshalka.
en: If you find yourself without a dwelling, contact the social welfare office or centre of your municipality of residence.

so: Ka aqriso wixi dheeri ah bogga InfoFinlandi Guri la'aanta.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Homelessness.

so: Deriskaadu qeylo ma sababi karaan tusaale ahaan habeeni saqda dhexe.
en: You neighbours cannot make noise, for example, during the night.

so: Haddii deriskaadu uu marar badan aad u jebiyo xeerarka nidaamka, waxaad la xiriir kartaa maareeyaha guriga ama laga kireystaha.
en: If your neighbour violates the housing rules and regulations often and in a gross manner, you can contact the building manager or lessor.

so: Deriskaygu wuxuu si joogto ah iiga cawdaa qeylo.
en: My neighbour keeps complaining to me about noise.

so: Cod noocee ah ayaa loo ogol yahay guriga dabaqa?
en: What kind of noise is allowed?

so: Xeeerarka nidaamka ee shirkadda guriga waxaa lagu sheegaa waqtiga loo baahan yahay in la yareeyo buuqa guriga.
en: The housing rules and regulations state the time period when there must be silence in the building.

so: Inta badan waxaa xeerarka nidaamka laga helaa guryaha dabaqa ah meesha laga soo galo.
en: In a block of flats, you can usually find the housing rules and regulations in the staircase.

so: Intii lagu jiro saacadaha buuqa la yareeyo lama sameyn karo cod dheer, tusaale ahaan lama garaaci qalabka muusikada ama lama dhegeysan karo muusik cod dheer, laakiin nolosha caadiga ah waa la ogol yahay.
en: During the silent hours, it is forbidden to make loud noises, for example play an instrument or listen to loud music, but normal living is allowed.

so: Halkee ayaan caawimaad uga helayaa murannadda deriska igala dhexeeya?
en: From where can I get help in disputes with my neighbour?

so: Haddii uu muran dhex maro adiga iyo deriskaada, oo aadan dhexdiina ka xallin karin, waxaad caawimaad ka raadsan kartaa xarunta Heshiisiinta Deriska ama maareeyaha guriga.
en: If you and your neighbour have a dispute that you are unable to resolve by yourselves, you can seek for help from the Community Mediation Centre or the building manager.

so: Heshiisiinta deriska waxaa loola jeedaa, deriska oo wada hadlaya iyo wada hadalka oo uu dhex-dhexaadinayo dhex-dhexaadiye madaxbanaan.
en: Community mediation means that the neighbours discuss with each other and the discussion is led by an external mediator.

so: Waxaa kulanka looga heshiin karaa sida arrinta loo xallinayo.
en: The parties may come to an agreement on how to resolve the situation during the meeting.

so: Heshiisiintu waa lacag la'aan.
en: The mediation process is free of charge.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogagga xarunta Heshiisiinta Deriska.
en: Read more at the Community Mediation Centre website.

so: Maxaan sameynayaa, haddii aan furaha guriga ku hilmaamo?
en: What do I do if I forget my key at home?

so: Inta badan shirkadaha guryuhu waxey shirkadda dayactirka ama maareeyaha guriga ku keydiiyaan nuqulka furayaasha waxeyna guriga kaaga furayaan lacag.
en: Usually, in a building management company the building maintenance company or building manager keeps copies of the keys and opens the door for a fee.

so: Albaabka guryaha dabaqa ah agtiisa waxaa ku qoran lambar telefoon, oo aad wacan karto marki xaaladdan oo kale ay kugu dhacdo.
en: There is a telephone number near the front door of blocks of flats that you can call in such a situation.

so: Sideen u habeyn karaa qashinka?
en: How do I sort my waste correctly?

so: Finland qashinka waa la kala habeeyaa tusaale ahaan qashinka cuntada, baakadda, dhalada, birta, qashinka halista ah iyo qashinka isku daran.
en: In Finland, biowaste, cardboard, glass, metal, hazardous waste and mixed waste are sorted separately.

so: Ka aqriso wixi dheeri ah bogga InfoFinlandi Daryeelka qashinka iyo dib-u-warshadeynta.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Waste management and recycling.

so: Maxey tahay in aan ku xisaabtamo, marka aan isticmaalayo sawnada gurigayga?
en: What should be taken into account when I use the sauna in my dwelling?

so: Waxba ha dul saarin waligaa dabka sawnada hana u isticmaalin bakhaar ahaan sawnada ama meel dharka lagu qallajiyo, haddii kale dab ayaa ka kici kara.
en: Never hang or place anything above the sauna stove and do not use the sauna as a storage space or for drying laundry due to the risk of fire.

so: Dami marwalba dabka sawnada ee korontada ku shaqeeya isticmaalka ka dib.
en: Always switch off an electric sauna stove after use.

so: Ka aqriso wixi dheeri ah bogga InfoFinlandi Nabadgelyada guriga.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Safety at home.

so: Maxaan sameynayaa, haddii tubada biyuhu ay biyo deyneyso?
en: What do I do if a water tap leaks?

so: Wac shirkadda dayactirka ee ay shirkadda gurigaadu heshiiska kula leedahay.
en: Call the building maintenance company that has an agreement with your building management company.

so: Shirkadda dayactirku waxey sameyn kartaa dayactiro yaryar, sida dayactirka tubada biyaha ama furitaanka biyo-mareenka.
en: The building maintenance company can perform minor repairs, such as water tap repairs or unclogging a drain.

so: Gurigayga waxaa ka jira dhibaatooyin qoyaan ama cillado kale.
en: There are problems with damp or other defects in my dwelling.

so: Sideen wax u qabtaa?
en: What do I do?

so: Horay kala xiriir shirkadda dayactirka, maareeyaha guriga ama laga kireystaha.
en: Contact the building maintenance company, building manager or lessor immediately.

so: Waa muhiim in cilladaha deg deg laguo hagaajiyo inta aysan sii xumaanin.
en: It is important to repair such defects quickly before they escalate.

so: Marka aan cuntada karineyno, jikada waxaa soo gala qoyaan badan.
en: When we cook, a lot of condensation collects in the kitchen.

so: Haddii uusan gurigaadu laheyn hawo-beddel mashiin ku shaqeeya, fur daaqadaha kaddibana hawada ka saar.
en: If your home does not have mechanical ventilation, open windows for ventilation purposes.

so: Muhiimad gaar ah ayeey tani leedahay, haddii aad ogaato, in marka aad cuntada karineyso ay daaqadaha hawo biyo wadata ama qoyaan uu ku aruuro.
en: This is especially important, if you notice that water vapour or condensation forms on the windows when you cook.

so: Isticmaal hawo-saarka dhardhaarada, marka aad cuntada karineyso.
en: Use the exhaust hood when cooking.

so: Hubi, in waalasha hawo-saarku ay furan yihiin.
en: Check that the exhaust vents are open.

so: Haddii aad qasaare u geysato guriga, waa in aad magdhowdaa qasaaraha.
en: If you cause damage to the dwelling, you must pay for it.

so: Ka aqriso wixi dheeri ah bogga InfoFinlandi Xuquuqda iyo waajibaadka deganaha.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Rights and obligations of occupants.

so: Halkee ayaan caawimaad iyo talooyin uga helayaa arrimaha deegaanka?
en: From where can I get help and advice on housing matters?

so: Waxaa jira goobo badan oo aad caawimaad uga heli karto arrimaha deegaanka.
en: There are many places you can ask for advice on housing matters.

so: cilmiga bulshada, cilmiga maamulka iyo maareynta dhaqaalaha

en: Tourism, catering and domestic services

so: Boggaan waxaa la isugu keenay xuquuqda iyo waajibaadka ugu muhiimsan ee deganaha Finland.
en: This page presents the essential rights and obligations of occupants in Finland.

so: Waxaa waajib kugu ah
en: You are obligated to

so: in aad u hoggaansatid xeerarka nidaamka ee shirkadda gurigaada, haddii aad deggan tahay guri dabaq ah ama guryaha dhinaca isku haaya.
en: observe the housing rules and regulations of your building management company, if you live in a block of flats or terraced house.

so: Xeerarka nidaamka waxaa ahaan sida caadiga ah ku qoran tusaale waqtiga ay tahay in buuqa la yaraayo.
en: The housing rules and regulations usually include, for example, at what time you must be silent.

so: Waxaa sidoo kale inta badan ku jira tilmaamaha sida loo isticmaalayo goobaha dadka ka dhaxeeya uu gurigu leeyahay.
en: They often also include instructions for the use of the shared spaces.

so: Inta badan waxaa xeerarka nidaamka laga helaa guryaha dabaqa ah meesha laga soo galo ee albaabka bannaanka u dhow.
en: In a block of flats, you can usually find the housing rules and regulations in the staircase in the vicinity of the front door.

so: in aad ka taxadirto in xittaa martidaadu ay u hoggaansamaan xeerarka nidaamka.
en: ensure that also your guests observe the housing rules and regulations.

so: in aad guriga u isticmaasho oo kaliya wixi loogu talagalay.
en: use the dwelling only for its intended purpose.

so: Haddii guriga loogu talgalay in la dego,meel kale ma degi kartid iyo guriga kama dhigi kartid goob ganacsi.
en: If the dwelling is intended for housing, you cannot live elsewhere and use the dwelling for business.

so: Waxaad xaq u leedahay
en: You have the right to

so: in aad nolol caadi ah ugu noolaato gurigaada.
en: normal life in your home.

so: Shirkadda gurigu ma soo saari karto amarro ka soo horjeeda sharciga, ama aad u xadidaya nolosha caadiga ah.
en: The building management company cannot set such housing rules and regulations that are in conflict with the law or restrict normal living excessively.

so: Deriskaadu tusaale ahaan qeylo badan habeenki saqda dhexe kuma qashqashaadi karaan deganaanshaha guriga.
en: Your neighbours cannot disturb your domestic peace, for example, by making loud noise during the night.

so: Haddii uu deriskaadu marar badan aad u jebiyo xeerarka nidaamka, marka hore deriskaada kala hadal arrinta.
en: If your neighbour violates the housing rules and regulations often and in a gross manner, talk with your neighbour first.

so: Haddii tani ay waxba caawin weyso, waxaad la xiriir kartaa odayga guriga ama laga kiresytaha.
en: If this does not help, you can contact the building manager or lessor.

so: Nabadda guriga waxaa loola jeedaa sidoo kale in aad leedahay go'aanka cidda gurigaada imaan karta.
en: Domestic peace also means that you are primarily entitled to decide who may enter your home.

so: Xuquuqda iyo waajibaadka kireystaha
en: Rights and obligations of tenants

so: in aad kirada waqtigeeda ku bixiso.
en: pay rent in time.

so: Caddadka kiradu waxuu ku qoran tahay heshiiska kirada.
en: The rent amount is stated in the tenancy agreement.

so: Laga kireystuhu wuxuu kirada guriga ku qaaliyeen karaa hab waafaqsan waxa lagu heshiiyay ee heshiiska kirada ku qoran.
en: The lessor is entitled to increase the rent according to what has been agreed in the tenancy agreement.

so: in aad ka taxadirto in xaaladda gurigu wanaagsanaato.
en: ensure that the rental dwelling remains in good condition.

so: in aad u hoggaansato shuruudaha heshiiska kirada.
en: observe the terms and conditions of the tenancy agreement.

so: Haddii tusaale ahaan xeshiiska kirada lagu mamnuucayo in gudaha sigaar lagu cabo, markaas sigaar kuma cabi kartid gudaha gurigaada.
en: If the tenancy agreement forbids, for example, smoking inside the dwelling, you cannot smoke in your home.

so: Haddii heshiiska kirada lagu dalbanayo caymiska guriga, waa in aad markaas gashaa ceymiska.
en: If the tenancy agreement requires you to have home insurance, you must take it out.

so: in aad weydiisato ogolaansho haddii aad dooneyso in aad wax ka bedesho guriga, tusaale ahaan haddii aad derbi rinjiyeynayso.
en: ask permission from the lessor, if you want to make changes in the dwelling, for example paint a wall.

so: Ogolaanshiyo la'aan waxba kama bedeli kartid guriga, haddii aad xittaa adigu bixineyso kharashka dayactirka.
en: You cannot make any changes without permission, even if you pay for it yourself.

so: Weydiiso ogolaansho qoraal ah.
en: Ask the permission in writing.

so: in aad u megto laga kireystaha, haddii aad guriga qasaare u geysatay.
en: compensate the lessor for any damage caused to the dwelling.

so: in aad ogeysiiso laga kireystaha, haddii aad guriga ku aragto cillado, uu laga kireystaha mas'uul ka yahay.
en: report to the lessor any such defects in the dwellings that are the responsibility of the lessor.

so: Tusaale ahaan laga kireystuhu wuxuu mas'uul ka yahay qalabka guriga ku dhisan iyo qalabka dhulka.
en: The lessor is responsible, for example, for all fixtures and surface materials of the dwelling.

so: in aad ogeysiiso shirkadda dayactirka guriga cilladaha imaan kara sida tubo biyo deyneysa oo kale.
en: report all possible defects to the building maintenance company, such as a leaking water tap.

so: in guriga aad kireysatay ku deganaato si waafaqsan heshiiska kirada.
en: live in the rental dwelling according to the tenancy agreement.

so: Laga kireystuhu wuxuu guriga ku imaan karaa oo kaliiya xaalado gaar ah marka ay dhacaan, tusaale ahaan isagoo ilaalinaya dayactir guriga ka socda ama isagoo soo tusaya qof guriga ka iibsaneysa.
en: The lessor can enter the dwelling in a few exceptional cases only, for example, to oversee repair work or to show the dwelling to potential buyers.

so: Markaas xittaa waa in uu adiga arrinta horay kaagala heshiiyaa.
en: The lessor must, however, agree on the matter with you in advance.

so: in aad horay u hesho ogeysiis qoraal ah, haddii ay kiradu kaceyso.
en: a written advance notification, if the rent will be increased.

so: Ogeysiiska waa in ay ku qoran tahay, waqtiga ay kiradu kaceyso iyo inta ku kordheysa, iyo sababta loo cuskaday kicinta kirada.
en: The notification must state how much and when the rent will be increased as well as the grounds for the increase.

so: waqtiga ka bixista heshiiska kirada ee uu sharcigu dhigayo.
en: a period of notice accordant with the law.

so: in aad islamarkiiba heshiiska kirada ka baxdo, haddii deganaanshaha gurigu ay halis ku tahay caafimaadka.
en: cancel the tenancy agreement immediately, if living in the dwelling is dangerous to heath.

so: in aad qeyb guriga ka mid ah qof kale ka kireysato, haddii aysan dhib ku aheyn laga kireystaha.
en: rent out a part of the dwelling to another person, if it causes no harm to the lessor.

so: in aad horay u hesho ogeysiiska dayactirka guriga.
en: receive an advance notification of all repairs.

so: Dayactirka yar waa in lagu soo ogeysiyaa 14 maalmood ka hor kuwa weynna 6 bilood ka hor.
en: Small repairs must be notified 14 days in advance and all major repairs 6 months in advance.

so: Si kastoo ay ahaatee dayactirrada degdegga ah ogeysiis la'aan ayaa la sameyn karaa.
en: However, urgent repairs can be performed without notification.

so: Haddii ay adag tahay ama aysan suurtagal aheyn in guriga la deganaado inta dayactirku socdo, waxaad xaq u leedahay in aad ka baxdo heshiiska kirada ama aad hesho qiimo-dhimista kirada.
en: If it is difficult or impossible to live in the dwelling during the repairs, you are entitled to cancel the tenancy agreement or to receive a reduction in rent.

so: Si kastoo ay ahaatee waa in aad arrintan mar walba kala heshiisaa laga kireystaha.
en: You must, however, always agree on such matters with the lessor.

so: Xuquuqda iyo waajibaadka guryaha la leeyahay
en: Rights and obligations in an owner-occupied dwelling

so: Waxaa waajib kaa saaran yahay shirkadda maamulka guriga
en: In the building management company, you are obligated to

so: in aad bixiso lacagta magdhowga shirkadda maamulka guriga iyo magdhowga deynta shirkadda maamulka guriga ee laga yaabo in laguugu leeyahay.
en: pay maintenance charges to the building management company and possibly also loan payments on the building management company loan.

so: Lacagahan waxaa lagu maareeya shirkadda maamulka guriga, tusaale ahaan waxaa lagu hagaajiyaa dhismaha iyo bannaanka guriga.
en: The maintenance charges are used for taking care of the building management company, for example for maintaining the buildings and yard areas.

so: in aad ka taxadirto, in gurigaadu ahaado mid wanaagsan.
en: ensure that your dwelling stays in good condition.

so: in aad horay qoraal ugu ogeysiiso maareeyaha guriga ama guddiga shirkadda maamulka dhismaha, haddii aad guriga ku sameynayso isbeddel saameyn ku yeelan kara dhismaha uu gurigu ku taagan yahay, tubooyinka biyaha, fiilooyinka korontada ama hab-dhiska hawo-beddelka.
en: notify the building manager or board of the building management company in writing in advance, if you are planning to perform such a change in the dwelling that may impact the load-bearing structures, water pipes, waterproofing, electric wiring or ventilation system of the building.

so: Tusaale ahaan waa in marwalba horay loo soo sheegaa dayactirka musqusha qubeyska.
en: A bathroom renovation, for example, always requires advance notification.

so: in aad dayactirka u sameyso qaab aan dhib ka soo gaareyn dhismaha.
en: perform renovations in a manner that causes no damage to the building.

so: Tusaale ahaan dalka Finland waxaa ka jira sharci adag ee quseeyaa sida la doonayo in uu noqdo qoyaan-dhowrka musqusha qubeyska.
en: There are strict regulations in Finland, for example, on what kind of waterproofing is required in bathrooms.

so: in aad ogeysiiso shirkadda maamulka guriga ama maareeyaha guriga ugu horeyn sida caadiga ah shirkadda maamulka guriga, haddii uu gurigu qabo cillad ay tahay in shirkadda maamulka gurigu ay dayactirto.
en: report to the building management company or building manager, in practice usually first to the building maintenance company, if there is such a defect in your dwelling that must be repaired by the building management company.

so: Shirkadda maamulka guriga waxaad xaq ugu leedahay
en: In the building management company, you have the right to

so: in aad maamusho guriga aad saamigiisa leedahay.
en: manage the dwelling the shares of which you own.

so: Waxaad isbeddel ku sameyn kartaa gudaha gurigaada.
en: You can make changes inside your dwelling.

so: Ku xisaabtan in dayactirku uusan dhib ku noqon shirkadda maamulka guriga ama saamileyda.
en: Take into consideration that the renovation must not cause harm to the building management company or the other shareholders.

so: in aad ka kireysto gebi ahaan gurigaada ama qeyb ka mid ah qof kale.
en: rent out your dwelling or a part thereof to another person.

so: in aad ka qeybgasho shirarka shirkadda oo aad saameyn ku yeelato arrimaha shirkadda guriga.
en: attend shareholders' meetings and through them influence the matters of the building management company.

so: Codkaada ayaad ka dhiiban kartaa arrimaha shirka looga hadlayo waxaadna sidoo kale dalban kartaa in arrimaha qaar looga baaraandego shirka.
en: You can vote at the meetings and demand that an issue be dealt with at the meeting.

so: Shirkadda maamulka gurigu waxey ka shaqeyneysaa in dhismaha daarta, dhowrayaasha, hab-dhiska kululeynta, fiilooyinka korontada, tubooyinka biyaha iyo bullaacadaha iyo weliba agagaarka bannaanka gurigu ay hagaagsanaadaan.
en: The building management company ensures that the structures, insulations, heating system, electrical wiring, water pipes and drains as well as yard areas of the building stay in good condition.

so: Shirarka shirkadda ayaa lagu go'aaminaya dayactirada noocan ah.
en: Such repairs are decided at the shareholders' meetings.

so: Shirkadaha guryaha qaarkood waxey go'aansadeen in mas'uuliyadda hab kale loo qeybiyo.
en: In some building management companies, it has been decided to divide the responsibility in some other manner.

so: Markaas nidaamka shirkadda ayaa waxaa lagu qoray, qolo walba waxa ay qaabilsan tahay.
en: In such cases, the company's articles include the division of responsibilities.

so: Kaalmada ijaarka (asumistuki) ee Kelada waxaa loogu talogaley kharashka kaaga baxa guriga.
en: The housing allowance (asumistuki) granted by Kela (the Social Insurance Institution of Finland), is meant for housing-related costs.

so: Kaalmada kirada ee Kelada wuxuu daboolayaa uun qeyb kamid ah kharashka kirada.
en: Kela's housing allowance covers the housing costs only partly.

so: Kaalmada ijaarka waxaad heli kartaa, haddii dakhligaagu yar yahay isla markaasna aad si rasmi ah u degan tahay dalka Finland.
en: You are eligible to receive housing allowance if you have low income and you live in Finland permanently.

so: Rasmi u deganaanshada Finland waxaa looga jeedaa, inaad Finland ku leedahay guri rasmi ah aadana inta badan ku nooshahay Finland.
en: Living in Finland permanently means that you have an actual home in Finland and that you mainly live in Finland.

so: Si aad u hesho kaalmada kirada waa inaad sidoo kale ku jirtaa xeyndaabka ammaanka bulshada Finland.
en: In order to receive housing allowance, you must be covered by Finnish social security.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Ammaanka bulsho ee Finland.
en: More information is available on InfoFinland webpage Finnish social security.

so: Kaalmada ijaarka ee Keladu waa:
en: Kela's housing-related benefits include:

so: kaalamada ijaarka ee dadka qaata lacagta hawlgabka
en: housing allowance for pensioners

so: cawinaada ijaarka ee cawinaada askarta ee askarta tababarka ku jira iyo qofka adeegga bulshada ku jira
en: housing assistance for conscripts and civil service men

so: Haddii lacaguhu aysan ku filnayn kharshaadka degaanka, aadba heshid kaalmada ijaarkee, waxaad Kelada ka dalban karaa lacagta kaalmada nolosha.
en: If your income is not enough for you to live on even though you receive a housing allowance, you can apply to Kela for income support.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ka akhri bogga InfoFinlandi Dhibaatooyinka dhaqaale.
en: Read more about income support on InfoFinland webpage Financial problems.

so: Kaalmada guud ee ijaarka
en: Kela's general housing allowance

so: Kaalmada waxaa la siin karaa hal qof ama qoys ahaan (ruokakunta).
en: The allowance is available either for an individual person or a household (ruokakunta).

so: Dadka sida joogtada ah wadajir ugu wada nool isku guri waxay iskula jiraan koox isku cunto ah.
en: People permanently living in the same dwelling belong to the same household.

so: Dadka si rasmi ah guriga u wada degen waxaa loo xisaaba sida qoys. Caadi ahan qoys wuxuu ka kooban yahay labo qofood oo is qaba, lammaano isla degan ama qoys.
en: Normally, a household refers to a married couple, an unmarried couple living together or a family.

so: Sidoo kale hal qof kaliya waxuu heli karaa kaalmada sida qoyska.
en: A single person may also constitute a household.

so: Waxaa kaalmada guud ee ijaarka qoys loo siiyaa si wada jir ah, ayadoo la cuskanayo hal codsi.
en: Housing allowance is granted to a household jointly, based on a single application.

so: Ogsoonow, in haddii aad guri la degggan tahay tusaale ahaan saaxiibkaa isla markaasna uu heshiiska kiradu idinka dhexeeyo, waxaa markaas la idiin arkayaa in aad isku –dheri tihiin.
en: Take into consideration that if you live in the same dwelling, for example with your friend, and you have a joint tenancy agreement, you will be considered as belonging to the same household.

so: Laakiin bedelkeeda haddii uu qof guriga kireystay kan kalena uu ka sii hoos kireystay, islamarkaasna aadan aheyd qaraabo isu dhow, waxaa la idiin arkayaa in aadan isku dheri aheyn.
en: Instead, if one of you is the main tenant and the other one is a subtenant, and you are not immediate family, you will be considered as belonging to different households.

so: Kaalmada guud ee ijaarka waxaa heli kara:
en: General housing allowance is available to

so: dadka is-qaba iyo kuwa loo diiwaangeliyey xiriirka wada noolaanshada
en: married couples and those in registered partnership

so: labada isla degen laakiin aan weli is-qabin

so: qofka kaligi nool ama
en: those living alone or

so: dadka wada jirka u wadanool sida dhallinyarada saaxiibada ah
en: those living in a community

so: Kharash guriyeyn noocee ah ayaa la aqbalayaa?
en: What kinds of housing costs are accepted?

so: Taakulaynta ijaarka waxa lagu bixin karaa guri joogto ah oo Finland ku yaalla.
en: Housing allowance can be granted for a permanent dwelling in Finland.

so: Sharciga ayaa qoondaynaya lacagto loo aqbali karo in ay ku baxayso kirada marka taakulaynta la xisaabinayo.
en: The law stipulates which housing costs can be accepted when calculating housing allowance.

so: Gurigu wuxuu ahaan karaa:
en: The dwelling can be

so: Kaalmada la baxsho waa kharashaadka ijaarka, magdhawga iyo daryeelka guriga.
en: Benefit is granted for the rent, charge for use and the dwelling upkeep costs.

so: Kharashaadka daryeelka waxaa ah tusaale ahaan caddadka kululeynta iyo biyaha ee guriga.
en: Such upkeep costs contain, for example, heating costs and water rates.

so: Waxaa sidoo kale xisaabta lagu daranayaa dulsaaryada deynta guriga.
en: Also a part of mortgage interest is considered when calculating the housing allowance.

so: Kaalmada ijaarka waxaa lagu bixiyaa kharashaadka degaanka ee macquulka ah.
en: Housing allowance is granted for reasonable housing costs.

so: Magaalooyinka waa weyn waxaa la ogol yahay in kharashka degaanku uu ka sareeya kan magaalooyinka yar-yar.
en: In big towns, higher housing costs are accepted than in smaller ones.

so: Keladu bixin mayso dhammaan kharashaadka degaanka
en: Kela will not pay for all housing costs

so: Qayb ka mida kharashka degaanka waa inaad adiguu bixisaa.
en: You need to pay part of your housing costs yourself.

so: Inta aad adigu bixineysana waxay ku xiran tahay:
en: The amount of the basic deductible depends on

so: tirada inta khaangaarkaiyo carruurta ku nool guriga
en: the number of adults and children belonging to the household

so: wadarta guud ee dakhliga dadka guriga ku nool (dakhliga ka hor inta aadan canshuuraha la bixin)
en: the combined gross income in the household (income before taxes)

so: Haddii dakhligu uu aad u yar yahay, markaas ma jirto qayb qofku ay tahay inuu bixiyo.
en: With very low incomes, no basic deductible needs to be paid.

so: Marka la xisaabinayo kaalmada ijaarka, waxaan laguu xisaabineyn 300 euro mushaarka bishii, cadaddaasna ma aha mid saameyn ku yeelaneysa inta aad kaalmo ijaar ku heli laheyd Taas ayaana loo yaqaan ka dhimista mushaarka (ansiotulovähennys).
en: When the amount of your housing allowance is calculated, EUR 300 of your earned income per month is excluded from the calculation. This amount does not affect the amount of your housing allowance.

so: Waxaa loo ogolaadaa oo kaliya kaalmada ijaarka kharashaadka ku baxa guriga ee macqullka ah.
en: Housing allowance is only granted for reasonable housing costs.

so: Markii la qiyaaso kharashaadka macquulka ah ee guriyeynta, waxaa tixgelin la siiyaa
en: When assessing reasonable housing costs, the following is taken into consideration:

so: magaalada uu gurigu ku yaal
en: the municipality in which the dwelling is located

so: Haddii gurigu uu ka qaalisan yahay sida waa faqsan sharciga guud ahaan kaalmada ijaarka, qeybtaa siyaadeysa ee kharashka ku baxaya guriga, taasoo loo baahan yahay inaad adigu iska bixiso.
en: If your home is more expensive than the limit specified in the Housing Allowance Act, you will have to pay a greater share of your housing costs.

so: Ugu danbeynta waxaa loo xisaabiyaa kaalmada ijaarka sidatan:
en: The final housing allowance is calculated as follows:

so: Kharashka guriga ayaa waxaa laga jaraa marka hore inta aad iska bixineyso.
en: The basic deductible is first deducted from your housing costs.

so: Kaalamada ijaarku waa 80 % qiimaha ijaarka, taasoo ah inta soo hareysa.
en: The housing allowance is 80 per cent of the remainder.

so: Wixii is-bedel ah la socodsii xafiiska Kelada
en: Notify Kela of changes

so: Haddii dakhligaaga, xaalada degaankaaga, xaalada qoyskaaga ama xaaladaada wax iska bedelaan, si dhaqso ah u la socodsii isbedelka dhacay xafiiska Kelada.
en: If there are changes to your income, living arrangement, family situation or other circumstances, notify Kela about these changes without delay.

so: Go'aanka Kelada waxaa si cad loogu sheegay, arrimaha ay tahay inaad is-bedelkooda la socodsiiso Kelada.
en: Kela's decision provides detailed information on which changes to notify.

so: Kaalmada ijaarka guud waxaa laga codsadaa Kelada ayadoo la isticmaalayo foomka dalabka kaalmada ijaarka (AT1).
en: You can apply for general housing allowance with the Kela form Application for Housing Allowance (AT1).

so: Waxaad kirada kaalmada ku codsan kartaa xitaa shabakadda.
en: You can also apply for general housing allowance online.

so: Foomka dalabka waa in lagu lifaaqaa:
en: You also need to enclose

so: koobiga heshiiska ijaarka, iyo cadayn inta uu la'eg yahay ijaarku (guriga kirada ah)
en: a copy of your tenancy agreement and a document showing the amount of your rent (for rental dwellings)

so: cadeyn caddadka lacagta daryeelka guriga iyo lacagta deynta guriga (guriga la leeyahay)
en: documentation on maintenance charges and mortgage (for owner-occupied dwellings)

so: cadeynta mushaarka ama shaxda xisaabta mushaarka ee uu bixiyey shaqo-bixiyuhu
en: paycheck, i.e., a payslip from your employer

so: haddii aad dad kale wada nooshihiin, waxaa damaanada dadka kale oo qoraal ah, laguna cadaynayo inaad wakiil uga tahay dalabka kaalmada ijaarka
en: if you live in a community, authorisation (proxy) from other residents for applying for housing allowance on everyone's behalf.

so: Codsiga u dir xafiiska Kelada ama adigu ka sameyso codsiga shabakadda.
en: Send the application to Kela's office or fill in the application online.

so: Keladu waxay macaamiisheeda ugu adeegtaa, xafiisyada, telefoonada iyo boostada iyo weliba ayadoo la adeegsanayo bogga adeega Internetka.
en: Kela serves its customers in local offices, by telephone, by mail and through online services.

so: Markii aad xaafiiska Kelada ka fushanaysid arimaha adiga kuu khaaska ah, waxaad u baahan tahay inaad soo qaadato warqadahaaga aqoonsiga, ama tusaale ahaan baasaboor.
en: When running your personal errands in Kela's office, you need to present a proof of identity, for example your passport.

so: Dalka Finland waxay dadka u baahan yihiin in la siiyo guriyeynta taageersan (tukiasuminen) iyo guriyeynta adeeg leh (palveluasuminen), haddii ay u bahan yihiin in laga taageero xagga degenaanshada xorta ah.
en: In Finland, supported housing (tukiasuminen) and service housing (palveluasuminen) are available to those in need of support in living independently.

so: Guriyeynta adeeg leh iyo kuwa taageersan waxaa heli kara:
en: Supported and service housing are available to

so: dadka waayeelka ah, curyaamiinta,
en: the elderly the disabled

so: dadka kasoo bogsoonaya cudurada dhimirka iyo dhibaatoyinka maandooriyaha.
en: those recovering from mental and drug abuse problems.

so: Guriyeynta adeeg leh iyo kuwa taageersan waxaa bixiya degmooyinka, ururada iyo shirkadaha gaarka loo leeyahay.
en: Supported and service housing are offered by municipalities, organisations and private entrepreneurs.

so: Guriyeynta adeeg leh iyo kuwa taageersan helitaankeeda waxaa laga codsadaa xafiiska arimaha bulshada (sosiaalivirasto) ee degmadaada.
en: To apply for supported and service housing, contact your local social services (sosiaalivirasto).

so: Qof ku nool guriyeyn taageersan wuxuu hawlihiisa inta badan u qabsadaa si xor ah.
en: A person living in supported housing copes with everyday tasks almost independently.

so: Cawinaada ama taageerida la siinayo wuxuu ku xiran yahay baahida taageerid uu deganaha leeyahay.
en: The amount of support depends on the needs of the resident.

so: Waxay noqon kartaa u tegid maalin walba ah ama u tagid usbuuc walba ah.
en: It may vary from everyday to weekly visits.

so: Guriyeynta taageersan wuxuu ahaan karaa karaa guri uu qof si gaar ah u leeyahay, guri ijaar ah, ama guri nooc kale ah.
en: Supported housing may refer to a dwelling owned by the resident, a rental dwelling or some other housing type.

so: Dhererka guriyeynta taageersan wuxuu ku xiran yahay hadba xaalada nololeed ee qofka iyo baahida uu u qabo adeegga.
en: The duration of supported housing depends on the resident's own needs and situation in life.

so: Ujeedada laga leeyahay guriyeynta taageersan waa in dadku xaalada noloshooda si wanaagsan u maareeyaan, si ay ugu suurtogasho inay awoodaan inay u wareegaan degaan ay si xor ah kaligood ugu noolaan karaan.
en: The purpose is for the residents to organise their lives during supported housing well enough to be able to transfer to independent living.

so: Guriyeynta adeeg leh waa nooc ka mid ah guriyeynta, kaas oo loogu talogalay dadka sida joogtada ah cawinaad u baahan, laakiin aan u baahnayn daryeelka xarumaha dadka lagu hayo.
en: Service housing is a housing type meant for people who need constant help but not institutional care.

so: Guriyeynta adeeg leh wuxuu ka kooban yahay guri iyo adeegyada la xiriira deganaanshada.
en: Service housing contains both the dwelling and housing-related services.

so: Qofku asaga ayaa mas'uul ka ah kharashaadka guriga.
en: The resident accounts for the costs of housing him/herself.

so: Guriyeynta adeeg leh waxaa lagu bixin karaa guryaha caadiga ah, xarumaha dadka ay ku jiraan oo loogu adeego, guryaha adeega wadareed ama nooc kale.
en: Service housing can be organised in regular dwellings, service homes, service blocks or other housing forms.

so: Taas macnaheedu waa in dadku leeyihiin guryo u gaar ah, kuwaas daganaanshahooda adeeg ku helayo.
en: A resident will live in his/her own dwelling and receive services for being able to live there.

so: Adeegyadu waxay noqon karaan tusaale ahaan cawinaada daryeelka guriga, adeeg cunto, adeegyo ah xagga fayadhowrka shakhsiyadeed, adeegyo kala duwan oo xagga nabadgalyada iyo daryeelka caafimaadka ah.
en: Such services may include, for example, domestic aid, meal service, services related to personal hygiene, various security services and health care services.

so: Kharashka adeegga deganaanshadu wuxuu ku xiran yahay cidda bixinaysa adeegga.
en: The costs of service housing depend on who provides the service.

so: Adeegga guriyeynta waxa bixiya degmooyinka iyo shirkadaha gaarka loo leeyahay.
en: Service housing is offered both by municipalities and private companies.

so: Qiimaha iyo adeegyadu aad ayey u kala duwan yihiin.
en: There is great variation in the prices and services.

so: Markii aad dalbanaysid guriyeynta deganaanshada, waxaa haboon inaad si taxadar leh u ogaatid, inta uu yahay qiimaha adeegu.
en: When applying for service housing, find out what exactly it costs.

so: Waxaa kula gubnoon inaad is bar-bar-dhigto qiimeyaasha xarumaha adeegga degmada iyo kuwa shirkada gaarka loo leeyahay ay leeyihiin.
en: It is advisable to compare service homes owned by the municipality and those in private ownership.

so: Qofka adeega isticmaalaya ayaa iska bixinaya kharashaadka degaanka iyo adeegaba, haddii uu awoodo.
en: The resident pays for the accommodation and services him/herself if able to do so.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaate degmadu waa inay hubiso, in qofku uu leeyahay hanti uu ku daganaan karo guriga adeega, haddii uu u baahan yahay adeegga deganaanshada.
en: However, the municipality must ensure that the resident can afford living in a service home in cases where this service is needed.

so: Si aad u ogaato dariiqooyinka degaanka mida kugu habboon, waxaad cawinaad ka heli kartaa xafiiska arrimaha bulshada ee degmada.
en: In order to find out more about the different housing types, contact your local social services.

so: Dadka waayeelka ah oo u baahan cawinaada iyo taageerada dibada oo maalinlaha ah, waxay xaq u leeyihiin adeega deganaashada.
en: Senior citizens in need of daily outside help and support are eligible for service housing.

so: Adiga ayaa kala dooran kara, inta uu la'eg yahay adeega deganaansho ee lagu siinayo.
en: The resident can him/herself decide how much help the service housing contains.

so: Adeega degaanka waxaa loo abaabulaa dadka curyaamiinta ah, kuwaas oo cawinaad u baahan dhaawacdooda ama jiradooda awgeed si ay u maareeyaan hawlaha nolol maalmeedkooda.
en: Service housing is organised for such a disabled person who, due to his/her disability or illness, needs help in coping with everyday tasks.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi Adeegga dadka laxaadka la' waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan adeegyada loogu talagalay dadka naafadda ah.
en: InfoFinland webpage Services for disabled persons contains more information on services available to disabled people.

so: Dadka kasoo bogsoonaya cudurada dhimirka iyo dhibaatoyinka maandooriyaha
en: People recovering from drug abuse or mental problems

so: Dadka kasoo bogsoonaya isticmaalka maandooriyeyaasha ama dhibaatoyinka caafimaadka dhimirka waxaa suurto gal u ah inay helaan guriyeynta taageersan.
en: People recovering from drug abuse or mental problems are eligible to apply for supported housing.

so: Ayadoo la isticmaalayo cawinaada degaanka waxaa la baranaaaa xor u degenaanshada iyo noloshada, waxaana la helayaa taageero si looga soo bogsado dhibaatoyinkii hore.
en: Supported housing provides help for learning to live independently and support for recovering from the problems.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi Dhibaatooyinka mukhaadaraadka waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaadka meesha aad ka heleyso caawimaad haddii adiga ama ehelkaada ay dhibaato dhinaca maandooriyaha ah qabaan.
en: InfoFinland webpage Intoxicant abuse contains more information on where you can get help if you, your friend or your family member is having problems with intoxicants.

so: Haddii anad lahayn guri joogto ah anadna ahayn qof guri u kiraysanhay waxad noqonaysaa qof bilaa guri ah.
en: If you do not have permanent housing, and you are not officially a tenant or a subtenant, you are considered homeless.

so: Finland degmooyinku waxay u fidiyaan adeegyo dadka anan guryaha lahayn.
en: In Finland, municipalities offer services for the homeless.

so: Adeegyadaas waxa loogu talo galay dadka ku leh degmo Finland.
en: These services are intended for those who have a municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Haddii ad noqoto qof bilaa guri ah, waxad la xidhiidhaa xaafiiska adeega bulshada ama xarunta adeegga bulshada ee degmadaada.
en: If you become homeless, contact the social services office or social clinic of your municipality of residence.

so: Halkaas waxad ka heli kartaa caawimaad markaad raadsanayso guri ama meel ad hoy ka dhigato mudo gaaban.
en: They will help you when you are looking for a flat or temporary housing.

so: Hoyga muddada kooban waxay noqon karaan guryo u gaar ah dadka noqday bilaa guri.
en: Temporary housing could be in a dorm, a night shelter or a flat intended for the homeless.

so: Xaaladaada u faahfaahi shaqaalahaaga adeegga bulshada oo kala hadal inta ad kiro ama ijaar bixin karto iyo in aad caawimaad ka heli karto ku wajahan bixinta kirada.
en: Go over your situation with a social worker: how much rent you are able to pay, and whether you are eligible for any financial aid for your rent.

so: Waxad sidoo kale talo waydiisan kartaa xafiiska adeegga la talinta dadka dalsoogaleetika ah ee ku yaala dagmadaada.
en: You can also ask for advice from the guidance service for immigrants provided by your municipality of residence.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi Guri kiro waxad ka heli kartaa macluumaad ku saabsan sida ad u heli karto guri kiro ah.
en: You can find information on finding rental accommodation on the InfoFinland page Rental dwelling.

so: Xaaladda helidda guryaha kiradu way ku kala duwantahay degmooyinka.
en: The housing situation varies greatly depending on the location.

so: Tusaale ahaan degmooyin badan oo yaryar ayaa laga heli karaa guryo kiro ah.
en: For example, there are vacant flats in many of the smaller municipalities around Finland.

so: Caasimadda iyo nawaaxigeeda waxa dhici karta in ay adkaato sida guri looga helaa.
en: It may be difficult to find a flat in the metropolitan area.

so: Waxad sidoo kale talo iyo caawimaad waydiisan kartaa ururka la yidhaahdo Vailla vakinaista asuntoa ry (urur caawiya dadka guri la'aantu ku dhacday).
en: You can also ask for advice and assistance from the association called Vailla vakinaista asuntoa.

so: Ururkaas waxa laga heli karaa talo, garabsiin iyo hagitaan ku saabsan arrimaha guri helida ku saabsan waana urur iskudayay in uu horumariyo xaaladaha dadkagui la'aantu qabsatay.
en: It is an association that offers advice, support and guidance in housing-related matters and aims to improve the status of the homeless in society.

so: Meelaha dadka lagu hago, ee la yidhaahdo Ohjaamo, waxad ka heli kartaa la talin iyo hagitaan ku socda dhalinyarta bilaa guryaha ah.
en: Ohjaamo guidance centres offer advice and guidance for young homeless people.

so: Haddii anad si joogto ah ugu dagganayn Finland
en: If you do not live in Finland permanently

so: Haddii anad Finland u dagganayn si joogto ah, anad noqoto qof bilaa guri ah, waxad la xidhiidhaa safaaradda wadankaaga ee ku taala Finland.
en: If you do not live in Finland permanently and you become homeless, please contact the embassy of your country in Finland.

so: Ka sii aqri faah-faahin dheeraad ah bogga InfoFinlandi Safaaradaha Finland jooga.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Embassies in Finland.

so: Ururka Vailla vakinaista asuntoa ry waxay leeyihiin xarun habeenkii shaqaysa oo la yidhaahdo Kalkkers. Waxad goobtaas ka heli kartaa hoy diirran wakhtiga dayrta ilaa wakhtiga gu'ga.
en: Vailla vakinaista asuntoa maintains a night café called Kalkkers that offers a warm place to spend the night for the homeless from the autumn to the spring.

so: Xaruntu ma laha meelo la seexdo mana aha meel ka faaruq ah balwadaha kala duwan.
en: There are no places for sleeping at the centre, and it is not an alcohol and drug-free facility.

so: Xaruntaas laguguma waydiinayo in aad sharci leedahay.
en: They will not ask you whether you have a residence permit or not.

so: Xaruntu waxay ku taallaa Helsinki ciwaankeeduna waxa weeyaan Vaasankatu 5 tilifoonkeeduna waa 050 443 1068.
en: The centre is located in Helsinki at Vaasankatu 5, and the telephone number is 050 443 1068.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi Joogista Finland ogolaansho la'aan ayaad ka heli kartaa macluumaad faahfaahsan oo loogu talo galay dadka bilaa sharciyada ah.
en: InfoFinland page In Finland without a residence permit contains more information for those without official documents.

so: Haddii uu gurigaagu wax kaa noqdo
en: If your home is damaged

so: Haddii ad leedahay caymiska guryaha, gurigaaguna uu wax kaaga noqdo dab ama ay biyo galaan, sida ugu dhakhsiyaha badan ula xidhiidh shirkadaada caymiska.
en: If you have home insurance and your home is damaged as a result of a fire or water damage, for example, contact your insurance company immediately.

so: Waxa suuro gal ah in shirkada caymisku ay kaa bixiso kirada guriga ku meel gaadhka ah.
en: Home insurance may cover the rent for a temporary flat.

so: Ka akhriso macluumaad faahfaahsan oo ku saabsan ku noolaanshaha guryaha ku meel gaadhka ah, ka sii aqri faah-faahin dheeraad ah bogga InfoFinlandi Dagaan ku meel-gaar ah.
en: You can find more information on short-term housing on the InfoFinland page Temporary housing.

so: Haddii ad awoodi waydo in aad bixiso kiradaada
en: If you are unable to pay your rent

so: Haddii ay ku haystaan dhibaatooyin dhaqaale, waxa markasta laguu qaatay inaad bixiso marka hore kiraadada markaas kadib ad bixiso biilashaada kale.
en: If you have financial problems, you should always pay your rent first and then other payments and debts.

so: Haddii ad awoodi waydo in aad kiradaada bixiso la hadal shirkada ama shaqsiga guriga kaa kireeyay, kana codso wakhti siyaado ah oo ad ku bixin karto kiradaada.
en: If you are unable to pay the rent, contact the lessor and try to agree on an extended payment schedule.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi Kaalmada ijaarka waxad ka heli kartaa macluumaad faahfaahsan oo ku saabsan taakulaynta kirada ee Kelada.
en: Information on the housing allowance granted by Kela is available on the InfoFinland page Housing allowance.

so: Waxaan warcelintaada kaga soo jawaabeynaa luuqadaha finnish, swiidhish iyo ingiriis.
en: We respond to feedback submitted in Finnish, Swedish or English.

so: Nasiib daro kaagama soo jawaabi karno warcelintaada, haddey markaa ku qoran tahay luuqad kale.
en: Unfortunately we cannot reply to feedback written in other languages.

so: Waxaan ka jawaabeynaa oo keliya warcelinada naloogu soo diro boga InfoFinland.
en: We will only respond to feedback concerning the InfoFinland website.

so: Ogsoonow in, aannan markaasna lagu qoreyn talooyin u gaara qabshada danahaga gaarka.
en: Please understand that we do not provide advice or counselling on the management of your affairs.

so: adeega talosiinta waxaad ka heleysaa boga InfoFinland Wac oo talo weydii.
en: Counselling services are listed on the InfoFinland page Call and ask for advice.

so: HAA: bacaha, bacaha raashinka lagu xidho ama lagu rido, caagadaha iyo alaabta kale ee caag ka samaysan.
en: YES: bags, films, boxes, wrappings and other plastic packages

so: MAYA: caagga PVC (calaamaddiisa 03), alaabta lagu ciyaaro, maacuunta caagga ah, alaabta caagga ka samaysayn
en: NO: PVC plastic (symbol 03), plastic toys, plastic dishes and other plastic products

so: Haddii aad tahay arday waxaad codsan kartaa guryaha la kireysto ee loogu talagalay gaar ahaan ardayda.
en: If you are a student, you can apply for rental housing that is particularly intended for students.

so: Guryaha la kireysto ee ardaydu sida caadiga ah waa kuwo ka raqiisan guryaha kale.
en: The rent of student housing is usually cheaper than other rental housing.

so: Guryaha ardayda waxaa kireeya mu'asasooyinka guryaha ardayda, gudiyada ardayda sare ee jaamacadaha, naadiyada ardayda iyo mu'asasooyinka qaarkood.
en: Student housing are leased by student housing foundations, student unions, student associations and some other foundations. Some institutes also have their own student halls.

so: Machadyada waxbarashada qaarkood waxay leeyihiin guryo u gaar ah.
en: Ask from your own institute where you can apply for student housing.

so: Waxaad codsan kartaa guri islamarka aad hesho boos waxbarasho.
en: You can apply for student housing as soon as you have received a study place.

so: Magaalooyinka waa weyn guri ka helidoodu waxay qaadan kartaa dhowr todobaad ama bilood.
en: In the larger cities it may take several weeks or months before you receive student housing.

so: Haddii aad hesho guri arday, waxaad inta badan deganaan kartaa mudada waxbarashada oo dhan.
en: If you are granted student housing, you can usually live there throughout your studies.

so: Si kastoo ay ahaataba waxaa lagaa doonayaa inaad inta badan waxbarato, waxbarashadaaduna horay u socoto.
en: You must, however, be a fulltime student and make progress in your studies.

so: Kireeyuhu wuxuu kaaga bixi karaa kirada haddii aadan sameynin waxbarashooyin kugu filan.
en: Your lessor may terminate your tenancy agreement if you have not completed enough courses.

so: Haddii aad ku jirto xeyndaabka ammaanka bulshada Finland, waxaad Kelada kaalmo uga codsan kartaa kharashka kirada ku baxa.
en: If you are covered by Finnish social security, you can apply for a housing allowance from Kela to cover your housing costs.

so: Faah-faahin dheeraad oo ku saabsan kaalmada kirada ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Kaalmada ijaarka.
en: Read more about the housing allowance on the InfoFinland page Housing allowance.

so: Haddii sababta kaliya ee aad Finland u joogto ay tahay waxbarasho, si ku meel-gaar ah u joogto Finland iyo aadan ku jirin xeyndaabka ammaanka bulshada Finland.
en: If your only reason for being in Finland is studying, you are residing in Finland temporarily and are not covered by Finnish social security.

so: Haddii aad sababo kale ku joogto Finland, tusaale ahaan sabab shaqo, waxaa laga yaabaa in aad ku jirto xeyndaabka ammaanka bulshada Finland.
en: If you have other reasons for residing in Finland, such as a job, you may be covered by Finnish social security.

so: Warar dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Ammaanka bulsho ee Finland.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Finnish social security.

so: Guryaha ijaarka ah oo qalabaysan iyo qolalka hoteel ahaan loo ijaaro
en: Furnished rental dwellings and apartment hotels

so: Xafiisyada guryaha dilaala iyo shakhsiyaadka gaarka ah ayaa ijaara guryaha xitaa waqtiyo gaaban.
en: Real estate agencies and private persons also rent out dwellings for short periods of time.

so: Waqtiga daganaanshadu wuxuu ahaan karaa inta u dhaxaysa hal maalin ilaa dhawr bilood.
en: The term of housing may be anything from a day to several months.

so: Inta badan guryaha waqtiyada gaa-gaaban la ijaartaa waa guryo qalabaysan.
en: Short-term rental dwellings are usually furnished.

so: Guryaha ijaarkooda inta uu le'eg yahay waxaa u dhexeeya farqi, kaas oo ku xiran meesha uu gurigu ku yaal.
en: The amount of rent varies according to the location of the dwelling.

so: Qiimayaasha magaalada bartamaheedu aad ayey u sareeyaan.
en: Prices will be higher in the central areas of towns.

so: Waxaa kaloo jira hoteelo sida guryaha oo kale ah, kuwaas oo tusaale ahaan leh jikadooda.
en: Homelike apartment hotels with their own kitchens, for example, are also available.

so: Qolalka qiimahoodu dhexe caadi ahaan waa 100 euro afar iyo labaatankii saac.
en: The average price of such an apartment is usually 100 euros a day.

so: Haddii aad qolka daganaaneysid waqti dheer, tusaale ahaan dhawr usbuuc, qiimuhu wuxuu ahaan karaa mid intaas ka hooseeya.
en: If you live in the apartment longer, for several weeks, for example, the price may be lower.

so: Daganaanshada hoteelada dalka Finland xoogaa way ka qaali santahay wadamada Yurub intooda badan.
en: Living in a hotel is somewhat more expensive in Finland than it is in most European countries.

so: Sidoo kale qiimaha hoteeladu in badan ayey ku kala duwan yihiin xilliyada iyo meesha ay ku yaalaan marka loo eego.
en: The prices of hotels also vary a lot depending on the season and the location of the hotel.
