so: Qiimaha qol hal ama laba qof ahi qiyaastii waa inta u dhaxaysa 60-100 euro afar iyo labaatankii saac.
en: On average, a single or double hotel room costs 60–100 euros a day.

so: Hosteelku caadi ahaan waa dariiq ka jaban hoteelka, lakiin heerka tayada adeega hosteeladu wuu ka hooseeyaa kan hoteelada, mar kastana suurtogal kuuma noqon doono inaad hesho qol kuu gaar ah.
en: Accommodation in a hostel is cheaper than in a hotel, but the service level is more modest and it is not always possible to get your own room.

so: Qiimaha jiifka hal habeen qiyaastii waa inta u dhaxaysa 20-50 euro.
en: The price for a night is approximately 20–50 euros.

so: Tan ugu jaban waa inaad seexato qol wadaag ah oo dad kale kula dagan yihiin.
en: It is cheapest to stay in a shared room.

so: Sidoo kale waxaad marti ahaan u degi kartaa guri caadi ah oo ka mid ah guryaha Finnishka.
en: You can also stay at regular Finns' homes as their guest.

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira guri dejinka waxaad ka helaysaa Internetka.
en: You can find information on home accommodation online.

so: Inta badan waqtiga daganaanshadu waa dhawr maalmood ama dhawr usbuuc.
en: The duration of accommodation is usually a few days or weeks.

so: Qiimaha waxaa go'aan ka gaara qofka guriga iska leh.
en: The owner of the dwelling determines the prices.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee daganaanshadu xoogaa way ka jaban tahay daganaanshada guriga hoteelka oo kale ah.
en: However, accommodation is usually somewhat cheaper than in hotels.

so: Haddii aad Finland u timaado arday ahaan, waxaad heli kartaa guri arday, kaas oo aad ku noolaan kartid ilaa inta ay waxbarashada dalka Finland kuu socoto.
en: If you come to Finland to study, you are eligible to receive a student dwelling where you can live for as long as your studies in Finland last.

so: Haddii aad tahay arday waxaa kula gudboon inaad codsato guri arday, sababtoo ah sida caadiga ah way ka jaban yihiin guryaha kale oo ijaarka ah.
en: If you are a student, it is advisable to apply for student housing, as they are usually cheaper than other rental housing.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ka akhriso bogga InfoFinlandi Degista ardayda.
en: Read more on InfoFinland webpage Student housing.

so: Qeyb-lahaanshaha guriga (osaomistusasunto) waa qaab wanaagsan oo aad ku iibsan karto guri aad leedahay, haddii aadan awoodin in aad si toos ah u iibsato guri.
en: A shared-ownership dwelling (osaomistusasunto) is a good way of obtaining your own dwelling if you cannot afford to buy one right away.

so: Waxaad marka hore qeyb ka iibsaneysaa guriga adigoo kiro kusii degnaanaya guriga.
en: You will only own part of the dwelling at first and pay rent.

so: Kadibna guriga dib ayaad ka wada iibsan kartaa milkiyadiisa oo dhan.
en: Afterwards, it is possible to buy the whole dwelling for yourself.

so: Marka aad u guureysid guri aad qeyb ahaan leedahay, waxaad marka hore bixineysaa 10-20 boqolkiiba qiimaha guriga.
en: When you move into a shared-ownership dwelling, you first pay approximately 10–20 per cent of the price of the dwelling.

so: Waxaad deyn ka dalban kartaa bangiga si aad u bixiso lacagtaan.
en: You can apply for a bank loan to pay this fee.

so: Markaas kadib waxaad guriga ku dagnaaneysaa kiro waxaadna bil weliba bixineysaa kirada guriga.
en: After this, you will live in the dwelling as a tenant and pay rent every month.

so: Caadi ahaan waqtiga kiro bixinta waa 5-12 sano.
en: The tenancy period normally lasts around 5–12 years.

so: Waxaad isla mudadaasi sidoo kale iibsan kartaa qeybo lahaansho oo dheeri ah, haddii aad sidaasi kula heshiisay cidda guriga dhistay.
en: Meanwhile, you may be able to buy additional shares in the dwelling if you have agreed this with the constructor.

so: Xiliga kiro bixinta marka ay dhamaato waxaad iibsan kartaa milkiyadda guriga oo idil.
en: Once the tenancy period comes to an end, you can buy the dwelling for yourself.

so: Markaas kadib waxaad leedahay guri caadi ah oo ka mid shirkadda saamileyda guryaha.
en: After this, you will have a normal owner-occupied dwelling in a housing company.

so: Guryaha qeyb ahaan la leeyahay waxaa lagu dhisay kaalmada dowladda.
en: Some shared-ownership dwellings are built based on a state subsidy.

so: Markaas tusaale ahaan sharcigu wuxuu go'aminayaa mudada guriga lagu deganaan karo kiro, iyo sida looga noqon karo lahaanshaha giriga.
en: In such a case, the law will determine, for example, the length of the tenancy period and the procedures for giving up the dwelling.

so: Markaasi dowladdu wax kalmo ah oo ay ka geysatay dhismaha guryahaasi ma jirto.
en: The construction of these dwellings is not subsidised by the state.

so: Hadii aad iibsaneyseyd qeyb-lahaansho ku dhisan maalgashi madaxbanaan, sharcigu ma go'aaminayo markaasi mudada guriga lagu degnaan karo kiro ama shuruudo kale oo heshiiska hoos imaanaya.
en: If you buy a privately financed shared-ownership dwelling, the tenancy period or other contractual terms are not regulated by law.

so: Sidee loo heli karaa guriga qayb ahaan la yeelanayo?
en: How can I get a shared-ownership dwelling?

so: Bulshooyinka hantiwadaaga ah ama shirkadaha dhisaya guryaha qeyb ahaan loo yeelanayo waxay wargeliyaan guryaha cusub iyo kuwa soo banaanaanaya.
en: Communities and companies that order the construction of shared-ownership dwellings provide information on new and vacant dwellings.

so: Waxaad macluumaadkaasi sidoo kale ka heleysaa xafiiska guryaha ee degmada.
en: You can also obtain information on such dwellings from the municipal housing office.

so: Waxaad ku dalban kartaa guryaha qeyb ahaan loo leeyahay adigoo codsi dalab ah u qora qoloda guriga iska leh.
en: You can apply for a shared-ownership dwelling from its constructor.

so: Hadii guriga qeyb ahaan loo yeelanayo lagu dhisay kaalmada dowladda, waad heli kartaa guriga, haddii
en: If a shared-ownership dwelling is constructed with a state subsidy, you can acquire it if

so: dhaqaalahaaga uusan aheyn mid buuran, iyo
en: your income is not too high; and

so: in aadan haysan hanti aad u badan.
en: you are not too wealthy.

so: Haddii aad dalbaneysid guryaha sida gaarka ah loo maalgelinayo, dhaqaalahaaga iyo hantidaada midna lama xisaabinayo.
en: If you apply for a privately financed shared-ownership dwelling, your income and wealth are not taken into account.

so: Waad degenaan kartaa guri xaquuqda daganaanshaha la leeyahay markii aad bixiso lacagta xaquuqda daganaansha (asumisoikeusmaksu).
en: You have the right to live in a right-of-occupancy dwelling when you first pay a right-of-occupancy payment (asumisoikeusasunto) for it.

so: Lacagta la bixinayana waa boqolkiiba 15 qiimaha guriga.
en: The payment is approximately 15 per cent of the price of the dwelling.

so: Haddii aad awoodin bixinta lacagta xaquuqda daganaanshaha, waxaad ka deynsan kartaa bankiga.
en: If you cannot afford the right-of-occupancy payment yourself, you can obtain a loan from a bank.

so: Canshuurta ayaad ka goosan kartaa lacagta dulsaarka.
en: You can deduct the loan interest from your taxation.

so: Markaad bil walba aad bixiso qiimihii leyska rabey kharashka isticmaalka (käyttövastike).
en: After that, you will pay a certain amount each month as a charge for use (käyttövastike).

so: Kharashka isticmaalka wuxuu ku xiran yahay guriga iyo degmada.
en: The charge for use varies according to the dwelling and its location.

so: Kharashka isticmaalka kama badan karo qiimaha kirada guryaha nawaaxigaas.
en: Under law, the charge for use may not exceed the level of rent paid for similar dwellings in the same area.

so: Haddii daqliga kusoo galo uu yar yahay, waxaad codsan kartaa kaalmada ijaarka kharashka isticmaalka.
en: If you have a low income, you can apply for housing allowance in order to pay the charge for use.

so: Ka aqriso xog dheeri ah bogga InfoFinlandi Kaalmada ijaarka.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Housing allowance.

so: Guri xaquuqda daganaanshaha la leeyahay uma gadan kartid milki ahaan.
en: You cannot buy a right-of-occupancy dwelling for yourself.

so: Sababta guri xaquuqda daganaanshaha la leeyahay?
en: Why choose a right-of-occupancy dwelling?

so: Guri xaquuq deganaanshaha la leeyahay malaha khatar dhan dhaqaale.
en: A right-of-occupancy dwelling does not involve financial risks.

so: Sidaa darteed ayey khatar la'aan ku tahay inaad ku degenaato.
en: It is therefore a safer option than owner-occupied housing.

so: Deyn badan uma baahnid helista guri xaquuqda daganaanshaha la leeyahay.
en: You do not need a large loan for a right-of-occupancy dwelling.

so: Markaad rabto inaad ka guurto, uma baahnid inaad iibiso.
en: When you want to move out, you do not have to sell the dwelling.

so: Waad degenaan kartaa guri xaquuqda daganaansha la leeyahay ilaa intaad rabto.
en: You can live in a right-of-occupancy dwelling for as long as you want.

so: Guri xaquuqda daganaanshaha lagaama saari karo guriga.
en: The house owner cannot terminate the right-of-occupancy contract.

so: Daganaansha gurigaasna waa mid abadiyan markii loo fiiriyo guryaha kirada ah.
en: This means that a right-of-occupancy dwelling is more permanent than a rental one.

so: Waad u bixin kartaa guei xaquuqda daganaanshaha la leeyahay dhaxal ahaan.
en: You can also pass on your right of occupancy through inheritance.

so: Haddii aad leedahay guri xaquuqda daganaanshaha, waa inaad si rasmi ah u dagan tahay.
en: If you have a right-of-occupancy dwelling, you must use it as your own permanent dwelling.

so: Qof kale waad ka kireyn kartaa ugu badnaan labo sano.
en: You can only rent it out to another person for two years at the most.

so: Waxaadse u baahan tahay ogolaansho milkiilaha guriga.
en: However, you need the permission of the house owner to do so.

so: Yaa heli kara guri xaquuqda daganaanshaha la leeyahay?
en: Who can get a right-of-occupancy dwelling?

so: Haddii aannan laga dhisin guriga kaalmo hantida dowlada, milkiilaha ayaa dooranaya qofka degaya.
en: If the right-of-occupancy dwelling has not been constructed with a state subsidy, the house owner can choose the residents him/herself.

so: Haddii guriga laga dhisey hantida dowlada, waad dalban kartaa, haddii
en: If the dwelling has been constructed with a state subsidy, you can apply to stay there if

so: Haddii aadan ku laheyn guri nawaaxigaas iyo
en: you do not own a dwelling in the same area

so: Aadan awoodin inaad guri ka hesho nawaaxigaas
en: you do not have the funds to buy a dwelling in the same area.

so: Hantidaada cidana kuu qimeyn meyso, haddii aad tahay 55-jir ka weyn ama haddii aad uga guurto guri xaquuqda daganaanshaha la leeyahay mid kale.
en: However, your wealth is not taken into account if you are over 55 years of age or you are moving from one right-of-occupancy dwelling into another.

so: Mararka qaar waxaa jiri kara sharuudahan kale.
en: Sometimes, there can also be other conditions.

so: Sidee lagu codsadaa guri xaquuqda daganaanshaha la leeyahay?
en: How to apply for a right-of-occupancy dwelling?

so: Degmooyin badab ayaa jira ooy ku yaalaan guri xaquuqda daganaanshaha la leeyahay.
en: Right-of-occupancy dwellings are available in the biggest Finnish municipalities.

so: Haddii aad rabto gurii xaquuqda daganaansha la leeyahay waxaad qaadataa lambarka safka ee dagmada.
en: If you want a right-of-occupancy dwelling, you need to get a queue number from the housing office of the municipality.

so: Lambarkana waxaad ka qaadan kartaa degmooyin kala duwan.
en: You can get queue numbers from several municipalities.

so: Lambarka safka waa lacag la'aan.
en: Getting a queue number will not cost you anything.

so: Haddaad heysto lambar heysto, uma baahnid inaad codsato gurigii.
en: You are not obliged to apply for a dwelling even if you have a queue number.

so: Dooro sarta aad ka rabto guri xaquuqda dagnaanshaha la leeyahay.
en: Next, you need to choose the house from which you want a right-of-occupancy dwelling.

so: U sheeg sidoo kale nuuca guriga aad raadineyso.
en: Let him/her also know what kind of dwelling you are looking for.

so: Saro badan ayaad ka codsan kartaa guriga.
en: You can apply for right-of-occupancy dwellings from several house owners.

so: Waa suurogal inaad waqti dheer sugto guri.
en: You may have to wait a long time for the dwelling to become vacant.

so: Markaad hesho guri, lagal heshiis qoraal ah heshiiska xaquuq guriyeedka (asumisoikeussopimus).
en: When you get a dwelling, you must sign a written right-of-occupancy contract (asumisoikeussopimus) with the house owner.

so: Heshiiskaas waxaa ku qoran qiimaha, kharshka isticmaalka iyo sharuudaha kale.
en: The right-of-occupancy contract will state the amount of the right-of-occupancy payment, the charge for use and other possible terms.

so: Waad u guuri kartaa guri xaquuqda daganaanshaha la leeyahay, markii aad bixiso lacagta xaquuq guriyeedka.
en: You can move in once you have signed the right-of-occupancy contract and paid the right-of-occupancy payment.

so: Markii aad ka guureyso gurigii, waa inaad wargelisaa milkiilaha sarta wargelin ka bixis (luopumisilmoitus).
en: If you want to give up your dwelling, you need to deliver a corresponding notification (luopumisilmoitus) to the house owner.

so: Waxaa laguu soo celin lacagtii xaquuq guriyeedka markaad ka baxdo gurigii.
en: Once you have given up the dwelling, the right-of-occupancy payment will be refunded to you.

so: Guriga milkida ah waaka raqiisan yahay waqti dheer kadib midka kirada ah.
en: Owner-occupied dwelling is often cheaper than rental dwelling in the long-term.

so: Badi finnishku waxay degan yihiin guri milki u ah.
en: Most Finns live in dwellings they own.

so: Waxaa jira fursado kale oon aheyn guri kiro ama milki ah.
en: There are other alternatives, in addition to owner-occupied dwelling and rental dwelling.

so: Ka aqriso xog dheeriya bogga InfoFinland Guri xuquuqada daganaanshaha la leeyahay iyo Guri qayb ahaan la leeyahay.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland pages Right-of-occupancy home and Shared-ownership home.

so: Sheer guri iyo shirkad guri
en: Housing share and real estate

so: Markaad guri gadaneyso waxaad ka iibsan labo midood shirkad sheer guri (asunto-osake) ama shirkad guryo (kiinteistö).
en: When you buy a dwelling, you either purchase a housing share (asunto-osake) or real estate (kiinteistö).

so: Guryaha dabaqa iyo guryaha gaagaaban waa guryaha sheerka ah.
en: Housing shares are dwellings in either blocks of flats or terraced houses.

so: Waxay sheer ku yihiin shirkada sheer guriyeedka.
en: These houses are owned by housing companies.

so: Markaad iibsaneyso guri filo ah, waxaad ka iibsaneysaa shirkad guriyo.
en: When you buy a detached house, you buy real estate.

so: Shir guryaha waxay gadaan waa guryaha filoda iyo sakkada.
en: Real estate usually comprises a detached house and the related plot.

so: Sideen ku helaa guri milki ah?
en: Where to find owner-occupied housing?

so: Markaa raadsaneyso guri, ku talogal waqti ka badan mudo bilo ah.
en: When looking for a dwelling, you should prepare for up to several months of searching.

so: Guryaha waxaa iibiya shaqsiyaad, shirkad dalaaleyda guryaha iyo shirkadaha dhisa Inta badana waxay guryaha iibka ah ogeysiiskooda soo geliyaan internetka iyo wargeys-yada.
en: Dwellings are sold by private persons, real estate agencies and housing constructors. Adverts for available dwellings can be found online and in newspapers, for example.

so: Markaad hesho guri, kaasood xiiseyneyso, waxaad kula heshiin kartaa gadaha guriga xiliga aad soo arki karto guriga.
en: Once you find a dwelling that interests you, book a time with the seller to go and see it.

so: Mararka qaar wargelinta gadida guriga ayaa lagu qoraa xiliga lasoo arki karo.
en: Sometimes the adverts indicate a time when you can go and see the dwelling.

so: Markaa uma baahna inaad balan gooni u qabsato.
en: In such cases, you do not need to book a time in advance.

so: Iska hubi guriga iyo waxyaabaha ka haleysan
en: Find out about the condition of the dwelling and other matters

so: Markii aad hesho guri, kaasood jecleysatey si ka xaqiiji wax ala wixii la xiriira guriga.
en: Once you have found a dwelling that you like, gather all of the relevant information on it.

so: Haddaad iibsaneyso guri sheyr ah, iska xaqiiji dib u habeynta kusoo socota ama dayactirkii lagu sameeyey iyo khiimaha ku baxaya.
en: If you are about to buy a housing share, find out if any renovations are planned in the housing company, and if yes, what the related costs will be.

so: Tusaale dib habeynta tubooyinka milkiilaha guriga waxay ku noqon kartaa toboneeyo kun euro.
en: For example, a plumbing renovation can cost the owner-occupier tens of thousands of euros.

so: Wixii laga qabtey oo dibu habeyn ah guriga waxaad ka ogaan kartaa shirkada masuulka guriga.
en: You can obtain information on forthcoming renovations from the house manager.

so: Masuuliyada gadista guriga ee gadaha iyo laga gadaha
en: Responsibilities of seller and buyer in dwelling sales

so: Intii waqti ah gadista kadib wixii khaladaad xaga guriga waxaa ka masuul ah gadaha guriga.
en: The seller of a dwelling is held responsible for any defects in the dwelling for some time after the sale.

so: Guriga laga gato shirkada sheer guriga waxay wixii khalad ee ka yimaada guriga leeyihiin intii mudo labo sano ah.
en: The seller's responsibility for defects usually lasts for two years in the case of housing shares.

so: Shirkada guryaha midka ay gadaana waxay masuuliyadeeda leeyihiin wixii khalad ah mudo shan sano ah.
en: In the case of real estate, the seller's responsibility lasts for five years.

so: Sida sharciga waafaqsan gadaha guriga waa inuu sheegaa hadey jiraan wax ka khaldan guriga, hadey tahay mid uu ku og yahay.
en: By law, the seller of a dwelling must notify the buyer of any known defects in the dwelling before the sale.

so: Haddii la ogaado, in gaduhu xogogaal u ahaa cilada guriga balse uusan u sheegin gataha, wuxuu magayaa gataihii guriga kharashka cilada guriga.
en: If it is clear that the seller has known about a defect in the dwelling, but has failed to inform the buyer of it, the seller may be obliged to pay compensation to the buyer.

so: Inta aadan iibsan guriga iska xaqiiji inuu leeyahay wax cilado ah.
en: Before you buy a dwelling, inspect it for any defects.

so: Hadhow dib ugama dacwoon kartid magdhow kharashka ciladaha, haddii
en: You cannot demand compensation for a defect afterwards if

so: Ay tahay mid la arki karey markaad iska xaqiijineysey ama guriga.
en: you should have noticed the defect when inspecting the dwelling; or

so: Aad ku ogeyd cilada markaad guriga gadaneysey.
en: you were aware of the defect before buying the dwelling.

so: Guriga waa jiri karaan cilado qarsoon.
en: The dwelling may also have hidden defects.

so: Waxay ahaan karaan cilado aan cidna ogeyn inta badan ciladaha qarsoon waxay ahaan karaan dhibaatooyinka qoyaanka gala guriga.
en: This refers to damage of which no one is aware. Hidden defects often include water damage, for example.

so: Haddii cilada guriga tahay mid weyn taasoo saameyn ku yeelan laheyd gadista guriga, haddii la ogan lahaa, gadaha gurigu markaa waa inuu magaa cilada guriga.
en: If the dwelling has a serious defect which, if known, would have affected the sale of the dwelling, the seller is obliged to pay compensation to the buyer.

so: Badi dadku guriga waxay ku qaataan deyn guri (asuntolaina).
en: Most people finance their dwelling purchases with a mortgage (asuntolaina).

so: Deynta guriga qof walba wuxuu ka codsan karaa bankiga, si aad u heysho deynta guriga waa iney jirto mushaar kuu soo dhaca ood ka gudi kartid deynta guriga dhib la'aan.
en: Anyone can apply for a mortgage from a bank. In order to be granted a mortgage, your income needs to be at a level that allows you to repay the loan without problems.

so: Bogga internetka bankiga ayaad ka heli kartaa shaxda xisaabinta deynta.
en: Many banks have mortgage calculators on their website.

so: Waxaad ku sii qiimeyn kartaa, inaad awoodeyso inaad gudo deynta.
en: These allow you to make advance assessments of whether or not you would be able to repay the mortgage.

so: Haddii aadan hubin, in bankigu kuu ogolaanayo deyn, waxaa habboon inaad takto bankiga kalana tashato deynta waqti hore intaadan iibsan guriga.
en: If you are unsure about whether a bank will grant you a mortgage, it is advisable to visit a bank and negotiate the loan well before buying a dwelling.

so: Deynta waxaa loo gudaa adigoo bishiiba qeyb bixinaya.
en: Mortgages are repaid, i.e., instalments are paid off, once a month.

so: Waxaa intaa dheer ood bankiga u shubeysa dulsaar (korko).
en: In addition, you must pay the bank interest (korko) on the loan.

so: Waxaad weydiisaa dhowr banki deynta kadibna is barbardhig midii kuu raqiisan.
en: You can ask for offers from several banks and compare them.

so: Markaad ka fikireyso wey wanaagsan tahay inaad isweydiiso deynta aad qaadaneyso
en: When you consider different mortgage alternatives, take account of the following:

so: Cadadda aad bixineyso bishiiba intey tahay.
en: What is the amount that you must pay back every month?

so: Inta sano eed gudeyso deynta.
en: How many years will it take to pay off your mortgage?

so: Ogsoonow, in haddii dulsaarku kaco iney deyntuna kordeyso, qiimihii aad bixineysey bishuna kordhaayo intii sano eed ku bixineysana ay kordhayo.
en: Bear in mind that if interest rates rise, the cost of your mortgage will also increase. In that event, the monthly payment to the bank will increase or the loan period will extend.

so: Qeyb kamid ah dulsaarka deynta guriga waxaad ku dhimi kartaa canshuurta.
en: You can have some of the mortgage interest deducted against tax.

so: Damiinta iyo debaajiga deynta guriga
en: Mortgage collaterals and securities

so: Deynta guriga inta badan waxaa layska rabaa debaaji (vakuus).
en: A mortgage usually requires collateral (vakuus).

so: Guriga, aad iibsato ayaa qeyb ka ah debaaji ilaa boqolkiiba 70.
en: The dwelling that you will buy usually covers about 70 per cent of the mortgage.

so: Inta dhimman deynta ayaad u baahan tahay debaaji.
en: In addition to that, you need collateral for the remaining amount of the mortgage.

so: Waad yeeli kartaa debaajiga tusaale, in
en: You can arrange collateral by, for example,

so: Inaad bankiga ka hesho damiin dowlada (valtiontakaus).
en: Taking out a state guarantee (valtiontakaus) through your bank.

so: Damiinta dowlada waxay noqon kartaa ugu badnaan boqolkiiba 20 ama ugu badnaan 50 000 euro.
en: The state guarantee covers up to 20 per cent of the mortgage and not more than 50,000 euros in total.

so: Inaad ehelkaaga, qaraabadaada iyo saaxiibada damiin kaa noqdaan deynta haddii aad adigu awoodi weyso qofka kaa damiinta ah ayaa bixinaya, intuu balan qaadey.
en: Asking one of your relatives or friends to secure the loan. If you are unable to repay the mortgage to the bank, the guarantor will have to pay the amount of mortgage he/she has secured.

so: Uma baahnid damiin haddii aad horey dhaqaalo meel ugu dhigtey gadashada guriga qiimahiisa, ama aad haysatey milki kale, taasoo debaaji ahaan u noqon karta deynta guriga.
en: However, you will not need guarantors for your loan if you have saved up part of the price of the dwelling in advance, or if you have property that can be accepted as collateral for the mortgage.

so: Dowlada ayaa kuu ogolaan karta kaalmo dulsaarka (korkotuki) deynta guriga.
en: The state grants interest subsidy (korkotuki) on mortgages.

so: Kaalmada dulsaarka waxaa loo ogolaado dhalinyarada, kuwaasoo gurigii ugu horeeyey yahay waxa ay qaadanayaan.
en: Interest subsidy is granted to young people buying their first dwelling.

so: Sidoo kale waxaa loo ogolaadaa, kuwa iibsanaya guri filo ama dhisanaya guri.
en: It is also granted to those buying or building a detached house.

so: Ka aqriso xog dheeri ah bogga wasaaradda deegaanka.
en: Read more on the Ministry of the Environment's website.

so: Markaad iibsato guri, waa inaad bixisaa canshuurta wareejinta milkida (varainsiirtovero).
en: When buying a dwelling, you also need to pay transfer tax (varainsiirtovero).

so: Haddii aad ka iibsato shirkada sheerka guriga canshuurta wareejinta milkidu waa boqolkiiba 2 qiimaha guriga inta aan deynta aheyn.
en: If you buy a housing share, the transfer tax is 2 per cent of the debt-free price of the dwelling.

so: Haddii aad guriga ka iibsato shirkada guryaha, canshuurta waxay noqoneysaa boqolkiiba 4 qiimaha guriga inta aan deynta aheyn.
en: If you buy real estate, the transfer tax is 4 per cent of the debt-free price of the dwelling.

so: Lagaagama baahna inaad bixiso canshuurta wareejinta milkida, haddaad buuxiso dhammaan sharuudaha hoose.
en: However, you will not need to pay transfer tax if all of the following conditions are met:

so: Inaad tahay inta u dhexeysa 18–39-jir.
en: you are 18–39 years old

so: Inaadan horey ugu yeelan hanti guri Finland ama wadamo kale.
en: you have not previously owned a dwelling in Finland or another country

so: Aad leedahay hantida guriga ugu yaraan 50 %.
en: you own at least 50 per cent of the dwelling

so: Aad si rasmi ah u degan tahay guriga.
en: you use the dwelling as your own permanent home.

so: Markaad hubsato, in aad rabto ood gadan karto gurigii, ayaad kula gorgortami kartaa gurigii, gorgortankana wixii lagu heshiiyana in aad ku hesho qoraal.
en: When you are sure that you want and can buy a dwelling, you can make a bid for it. It is advisable to make the bid in writing.

so: Gorgortankuna wuu ahaan karaa in lagaa dhimo qiimihii guriga 5-10 boqolkiiba.
en: The bidding price can be, for example, 5–10 per cent less than the seller is asking for the dwelling.

so: Waa laga yaabaa in gaduhu uusan rabin inuu ku gado gurigii qiimo jaban.
en: However, the seller may not always be willing to lower the price that he/she has asked for.

so: Heshiiska gorgortunka waa ballan.
en: A bid is binding.

so: Ujeedaduna waa inaadan ka bixin heshiiska gorgortan.
en: This means that you cannot cancel your bid.

so: Haddii aad ka baxdo, waxaa suurogal inaad gadihii aad siiso ganaax ama lacag horumaris ah.
en: If you cancel a bid, you may need to pay a fine or the down payment to the seller.

so: Qiimahaasna wuxuu ahaan karaa boqolkiiba xooga qiimaha guriga.
en: The amount usually equals a few per cent of the price of the dwelling.

so: Haddii gadaha guriga aqbalo gorgortankaaga, iibsigu wuxuu ka dhacayaa bankiga gataha guriga.
en: If the seller of the dwelling accepts the bid, the agreement is signed in the buyer's bank.

so: Inta badan halkaa waxaa yimaada gataha guriga, gadaha iyo dalaalka, haddii markaa dalaal loo isticmaaley.
en: Those present usually include the buyer, the seller and the real estate agent if one was used.

so: Heshiiska iibsiga, taasooy ku qoran yihiin tusaale qiimaha guriga, cabirka guriga, wanaaga guriga iyo maalinta gataha lagu wareejinayo gurigii.
en: A sales contract is an agreement specifying, for example, the size, price and condition of the dwelling as well as the day on which the buyer gains possession of the dwelling.

so: Inta badan heshiiska iibsiga guriga waxaa sameeya bankiga ama shirkada dalaalka.
en: The sales contract is usually prepared by the bank or the real estate agent.

so: Gataha guriga wuxuu xaq u leeyahay intaan heshiiska lakala gelin in iska aqriyo heshiiska.
en: The buyer has the right to familiarise him/herself with the contents of the sales contract before the signing date.

so: Bankiga wuxuu lacagta deeminayo waa gataha guriga lacagtana waxaa lagu wareejinayaa akoonka gadaha.
en: The bank grants a mortgage to the buyer and the mortgage amount is transferred to the seller's bank account.

so: Lacagta horumariska (käsiraha) waa lacagta horumarinta laga bixinayo guriga.
en: A down payment (käsiraha) is an advance payment on the dwelling.

so: Gataha wuxuu siin karaa lacagta horumariska iibiyaha guriga markaa heshiiska lakala galayo.
en: The buyer can pay a down payment to the seller at the sale preparation stage.

so: Lacagta horumariskana waa caadiyan boqolkiiba saddex qiimaha guriga.
en: A down payment is usually around three per cent of the price of the dwelling.

so: Haddii aadan awoodin lacagta aad dhigaalsatey inaad ka bixiso lacagta horumariska, waxaad kaga qaadan kartaa deyn bankiga deyn guri.
en: If your own savings are insufficient for making the down payment, you can borrow it from the bank as part of your mortgage.

so: Waxaa kamida kharashka guriga milkida
en: Your cost of living depends on the following:

so: Halka gurigu ku yaala.
en: the location of your dwelling.

so: Haddii gurigu yahay guri sheer, waxaad bixineysaa
en: If you own a housing share, you usually pay

so: Bixinta deynta iyo dulsaarkeeda
en: repayments and interest on your mortgage

so: Kharashka deynta shirkada (rahoitusvastike), haddii shirkadu qabto deyn
en: charge for financial costs (rahoitusvastike) if the housing company holds debt

so: Haddii aad leedahay guri, waxaad bixineysaa
en: If you own real estate, you usually pay

so: Dalka Finland dhexdiisa, qashinka guriga waa in la kala sooco oo lagu shubo mid walba weelka qashinka ee u gaarka ah.
en: In Finland, domestic waster has to be sorted into different waste bins.

so: Heshiiska kiradu waa ahaan karaa
en: There are two kinds of tenancy agreements:

so: Toistaiseksi voimassa oleva vuokrasopimus waxaa uu jirayaa inta uu kireeyaha ama kireystahu uu heshiiska ka noqonayo.
en: A tenancy agreement that is valid until further notice (toistaiseksi voimassa oleva vuokrasopimus) will only end once either the tenant or the landlord terminates it.

so: Haddaadan horey u ogeyn, mudadda aad dagenaaneyso guriga heshiiskaas ayaa ah midka kugu habboon.
en: If you do not know in advance how long you will stay in the dwelling, this kind of agreement is a good alternative.

so: Määräaikainen vuokrasopimus waxaa loola jeedaa, in kireystaha iyo kireeyaha ay ku heshiiyaan markiiba, goorta heshiisku ku eg yahay.
en: A fixed-term tenancy agreement (määräaikainen vuokrasopimus) means that the tenant and the landlord agree upon conclusion of the tenancy agreement when the agreement will end.

so: Xiliga heshiiska kiraduna wuxuu ku eg yahay taariikhda markaa lagu heshiiyey, iyadoon u baahneyn wax heshiis kabax kale.
en: A fixed-term tenancy agreement will automatically end on the date specified in the agreement without separate notice.

so: Haddii aad rabto inaad sii degenaato gurigii waxaad u baahan tahay heshiis kiro cusub.
en: If you wish to continue staying in the dwelling after this, you need to make a new tenancy agreement.

so: Heshiiska waqtiga caddadan kama bixi kartid xiligaas aad ku heshiiseen ee heshiiskuna shaqeynayo.
en: A fixed-term tenancy agreement cannot be terminated during its validity period.

so: Taasina waa mid ah iney dhowraan kireeyaha iyo laga kireeyahaba.
en: This applies to both the tenant and the landlord.

so: Haddaad markaas og tahay waqti ciyam inaad u baahan tahay guri, heshiiskaas waqtiga caddadan ayaa ah midka kugu habboon.
en: If you know in advance that you will only need the dwelling for a specific period of time, a fixed-term tenancy agreement is a good alternative.

so: Ijaarka guriga waa inaad bishii mar bixisaa.
en: Rents are usually paid once a month.

so: Ijaarkana waa inaad ku bixisaa waqtiga lagu heshiiyey ugu danbeyn.
en: The rent must be paid by the latest on the due date.

so: Waqtiguna wuxuu ku qoran yahay heshiiska guriga.
en: The due date is specified in the tenancy agreement.

so: Ijaarka kuma bixin kartid kaar kareedhid ah.
en: You cannot pay rent with a credit card.

so: Markaad galeyso heshiis kiro guri Finland , had iyo goor waxaa la bixiyaa lacag carbuun kirada ah.
en: In Finland, almost all tenancy agreements require that you pay a rent security deposit.

so: U shub kireeyaha guriga lacagta carbuunta guriga ugu danbeyn maalintaad kula heshiisey ee ku qoran heshiiska guriga.
en: Pay the rent security deposit to the landlord by the date agreed in the tenancy agreement.

so: Inta baddan waxa furaha guriga heleysaa markii aad bixiso lacagta carbuunta guriga.
en: Usually, you get keys to the dwelling once you have paid the rent security deposit.

so: Markuu dhamaado heshiiskii guriga, guriga ayaa lagaa koontorooli markaasna waxaa laguu soo celin lacagtii carbuuntoo dhan, haddii
en: Once the tenancy agreement ends, a final inspection is made in the dwelling. The landlord will return the whole rent security deposit to you if

so: aad guriga waxyeeleyn ood daryeeshey
en: you have kept the dwelling in good condition and

so: ood bixisey dhammaan ijaarkii, taasood kula heshiisey kireeyaha guriga.
en: you have made all the payments agreed with the landlord.

so: Haddii aad wax ka jabisey guriga ama aadan bixin ijaarkii oo dhan, markaa heli meysid lacagtii carbuuntoo dhan.
en: If, however, you have broken something in the dwelling or failed to pay enough rent, the landlord will not return the whole rent security deposit.

so: Carbuunta guriga uma isticmaali kartid ijaarka guriga bilaha ugu danbeeya.
en: The rent security deposit cannot be used to pay the last months rents.

so: U heyso ijaarka kadib lacag kharashaadka kale.
en: In addition to rent, you should reserve money for other expenses, too.

so: Guryaha inta badan waxaa la bixiyaa kharash biyo.
en: The tenant is usually required to pay a water rate.

so: Ugu shub kireeyaha ama shirkada guriga kharashka biyaha akoonkooda markaad bixineyso ijaarka.
en: Pay the water rate in connection with the rent, either to the landlord or the housing company.

so: Kharashka biyuhu waxay ku xiran yihiin inta qof ee degan guriga.
en: The water rate is often determined according to the number of residents in the dwelling.

so: Haddii gurigu ku yaalo mitirka biyaha, kharashka biyuhu waxay ku xiran yihiin hadba inta aad isticmaashey.
en: If the dwelling has a water meter, the amount of water rate depends on how much water you use.

so: Heshiiska korontada guriga adiga ayaa soo galaya.
en: You will usually need to sign an electricity contract with an electricity provider yourself.

so: Waxaanad heshiiska ku geli kartaa markaad wacdo shirkada korontada ood u sheegto magacaaga iyo ciiwaankaaga cusub.
en: You can obtain an electricity contract by calling an electricity company and supplying them with your name and new address.

so: Waxaad is barbardhigi kartaa qiimayaasha, haddii aad hesho shirkad jaban.
en: You can compare the prices offered by different electricity companies if you wish to find the cheapest one.

so: Haddii gurigu uu leeyahay hiitarka ka dhexeeya guriga inta badan waxay ku jirtaa kirada.
en: If the dwelling has central heating, it is usually included in the rent.

so: Haddii gurigu yahay hiitarkiisa mid ku shaqeeya olyada ama uu yahay mid koronto ku shaqeeya, waa inaad gooni u bixisaa.
en: If the dwelling has oil or electric heating, it sometimes needs to be paid separately.

so: Sawnada, qasaalada iyo baarkinka baabuurta
en: Sauna, laundry room and parking space

so: Haddii aad rabto inaad isticmaasho shirkada sawnadeeda, qasaaladeeda iyo baarkinkaba inta badan waa lacag.
en: If you wish to use the housing company's sauna, laundry room or parking space, this is usually subject to a fee.

so: Kharashaadkaasna waxaa loo shubaa toos shirkada guryaha.
en: These fees are usually paid directly to the housing company.

so: Haddii aad ku degan tahay kiro guri filo ah, inta badan adiga ayaa bixinaya kharashka hiitarka iyo qaadista qashinka.
en: If you are a tenant in a detached house, you often have to pay for the heating and waste management, too.

so: Ka bixista heshiiska kirada
en: Termination of tenancy agreement

so: Waqtiga ka bixista heshiiska kirada waxaa laga wadaa, inta weli heshiisku sii socdo kadib markii laga baxo heshiiska.
en: The notice period refers to the period of time in which the agreement remains in force after a notice of termination has been given.

so: Ka bixista heshiiska kirada waxay khuseysaa heshiiska ah intii la doono.
en: The notice period applies to a tenancy agreement that is valid until further notice.

so: Kireystaha inta uu heshiiska kaga bixi karo waa muddo bil kalendar kahor ah.
en: For a tenant, the notice period is always one calendar month.

so: Ogow oo maanka ku hay, sida ka bixitaanka heshiiska kirada loo xisaabinayo.
en: Remember to consider how the notice period is calculated.

so: Sida badan heshiis ka bixista kiradu waxay bilaabanaysaa kadib marka ay dhamaato bishaas la rabo in heshiiska laga baxo.
en: Usually, the notice period does not begin until the end of the month during which the notice has been given.

so: Ka samee qoraal heshiis ka bixistaada.
en: Always make the notice of termination in writing.

so: Waa shardi inaad heysato caddeyn, inaad u sameysey kireeyaha guriga wargelin inaad ka baxeyso heshiiski.
en: You must be able to prove that you have given the notice to the landlord.

so: Kiireyaha guriga xiliga heshiis ka bixistiisa waxay ku xiran tahay hadba. Inta aad ijaarka ugu jirtey.
en: For a landlord, the length of the notice period depends on how long the tenancy agreement has been in force.

so: Haddii heshiiskaagu ahaa sanad ka yar. Hashiis ka bixista waa inuu sameysaa saddex billood kahor.
en: If the tenancy agreement has been in effect for less than a year, the notice period is three months.

so: haddii heshiiska ahaa sanad ka baddan. Heshiis ka bixista waa inuu sameeyaa lix billood kahor.
en: If the tenancy agreement has been in effect for more than a year, the notice period is six months.

so: Sii kireynta waxaa laga wadaa markii kireystihii guriga uu ka sii kireeyo qeyb ruux kale.
en: Sub-leasing means that a tenant rents out part of the dwelling to another person.

so: Kireystuhu waa yeeli karaa sidaas, haduusan wax dhib ah u arag kireeyihii hore laga kireystey guriga.
en: The tenant has the right to do so if this does not cause significant harm to the dwelling's actual landlord.

so: Intaadan u guurin laga sii kareeye ahaan, iska xaqiiji marka hore kaa kireeyaha inuu xaq u leeyahay, inuu sii kireyn karo qeyb guriga.
en: When planning sub-tenancy, make sure that the primary tenant has the right to take sub-tenants.

so: Sidoo kale laga sii kireeye waad u ahaan kartaa kireeyaha asalka guriga, markaad qeyb keliya ka kireysato kireeyaha guriguna dhinac ka dagen yahay.
en: You are also considered a sub-tenant in case you have only rented part of a dwelling and the owner him/herself lives in the same dwelling.

so: Laga sii kireeyaha guriga waqtiga uu heshiiska kaga baxayo waxay ka yar tahay kireystaha caadiga.
en: A sub-tenant's notice period is shorter than that of the primary tenant.

so: Kasii kireeye waxaa laga wadaa markii laga kireeyaha guriga uu gebi kasii kireeyo kireyste kale gurigii oo dhan.
en: Secondary leasing means that a tenant leases an entire dwelling to another person.

so: Taasna waxaa loo baahan yahay inuu ogolaansho ka heysto kireeyihii guriga ka kireeyey isaga.
en: This always requires permission from the landlord.

so: Ka bixista heshiiskuna wuxuu noqonayaa sida ka bixista heshiiska caadiga mid la mida.
en: A secondary tenant has the same termination procedure as the primary tenant.

so: Finland badi dadku waxay deggan yihiin guryo kiro ah.
en: In Finland, many people live in rental housing.

so: Guriga kirada waxyaabuhuu ku wanaagsan yahay waa in, markaad rabto guriga inaad ka guurto ood badelato way sahlan tahay, sababtoo ah uma baahnid inaad iibiso gurigii si aad mid kale u iibsato.
en: The upside of renting is that switching flats is easy, as you do not have to sell your old home and buy a new one.

so: Waxaa suurotagal ah inuu kaa kireeyaha guriga ku yiraahdo waa inaad iiga baxdaa guriga, haddii uu wato sababeyn la aqbali karo.
en: On the other hand, your landlord may decide to terminate your lease if he or she has an acceptable reason for doing so.

so: Waa inaad ka guurtaa gurigii, xitaa haddaadan rabin inaad guurto.
en: In such an eventuality, you will be forced to move out of your flat even if you would not wish to.

so: Bogga InfoFinland ee Heshiiska kirada waxaa ku qoran macluumaad muhiim ah oo la xirrira ka bixidda heshiiska kirada, bixinta kirada, dibaajiga kirada iyo kharashaadka kale ee la xiriira guryaha kirada ah.
en: There is important information on the InfoFinland page Tenancy agreement about giving notice, paying rent, the deposit and other costs in a rental dwelling.

so: Magaalooyinka ugu waaweyn wey adag tahay si looga helo guri kiro kugu habboon. Sidoo kalena kirooyinkuna waa qaali.
en: It is often difficult to find a suitable flat for rent in the largest cities, where the rents are also higher.

so: Waqti dheer kahor u diyaar garow raadsashada guri kiro ah.
en: Reserve enough time for finding a flat.

so: Meelaha qaar waa meelo dadku wada jecel yihiin adagna sida lagu helo.
en: Some areas are extremely popular and any vacant flats are rented very quickly.

so: Markii aad hesho guri kiro kugu habboon, waxaa wanaagsan inaad dhaqso go'aanka ku gaarto, inaad qaadaneyso gurigaas.
en: When you have found a suitable place, you should quickly decide whether to rent it or not.

so: Marka shaqsiga ama shirkada guri kiraynaysaa ay dooranayso cida ay guriga ka kiraynayso uguma kala eexan karto dadka guriga soo dalbaday diin, dhalasho, jinsiyad iyo waxyaabaha la midka ah. Arinkaasi waa qodob sharciga ku yaala.
en: According to Finnish law, a landlord choosing a tenant must not discriminate against anyone on the basis of factors such as ethnic origin, religion or nationality.

so: Ka akhriso warbixin faahfaahsan bogga InfoFinland qaybtiisa Takooridda iyo midab-takoorka.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Discrimination and racism.

so: Sideen ku raadsadaa guri kiro ah?
en: How can I get a rental flat?

so: Markaad raafadsaneyo guri kiro ah waxaad wixii ka heli kartaa tusaale internetka.
en: You can look for advertisements online.

so: Xitaa xogta wargelinta guryaha waxaad ka heli kartaa wargeysyada magaalada.
en: Flats are also often advertised in local newspapers.

so: Guryaha kirada ee shaqsiga waxaad inta baddan lagu helaa dhaqso markii loo fiiriyo guryaha kirada ee degmada.
en: You can usually find a privately rented flat quicker than a municipal one, but the rent will generally be higher.

so: Uma baahnid inaad isticmaasho dallaal marka aad guriga raadineyso.
en: You do not need to use an agent to look for a flat.

so: Adiga nafsad ahaantaada ayaa raadsan kara macluumaadka la xiriira guryaha bannaan.
en: You can look for information on vacant flats yourself.

so: Hadaad saas yeesho hadhow lagaama rabo inaad bixiso mushaarka dallaalka (välityspalkkio).
en: In that case you do not need to pay a commission (välityspalkkio).

so: Waad ka raadsan kartaa guryaha kirada ee shaqsiyaadka internetka iyo wargeysyada magaalada.
en: You can look for private rental flats online and in local newspapers.

so: Sidoo kale waad ku baahin kartaa internetka inaad u baahan tahay guri.
en: You can also publish your own wanted ad.

so: Haddii aad rabto inaad guri ka kireysato shaqsi, waxaad toos ula xiriirtaa kireeyaha guriga.
en: If you wish to rent a private flat, contact the landlord to agree on a date to inspect the flat.

so: Sidoo kale waxaa halkaa lagugu siin foomkaad ku codsan laheyd guriga.
en: At the showing, you will be given an application form.

so: Buuxso foomka haddaad rabtid markaa inaad degto gurigaas.
en: Complete the form if you are interested in renting the flat.

so: Hadii aad dooneyso in dallaaka guryuhu uu kuu raadiyo guri-kiro ah oo adiga kugu haboon, waxaa kugu waajib ah inaad la gasho dallaaka heshiis qaab qoraal ah oo arinkaas ku saabsan (toimeksiantosopimus).
en: If you wish to have an agent look for a suitable rental flat, you must make an assignment agreement (toimeksiantosopimus) in writing with the agent.

so: Waxaana markaa lagaa doonayaa inaad bixiso lacagta mushaarka qofka dallaalka ah.
en: In this case you will have to pay a commission to the agent.

so: Mushaarka aad siineyso hore ugala heeshii isagoo qaab qoraal ah.
en: Agree on the commission in writing in advance.

so: Tusaale ahaan mushaarkaa dallaalka wuxuu noqon karaa mid le'eg qiimaha kirada guriga ee hal bil.
en: The commission could be, for example, a month's rent.

so: Hore isugu sii bar-bardhig qiimaha ay qaatan xafiisyada kala duwan ee dallaalada.
en: Compare the commissions of various agencies in advance.

so: Markaad ka kireysaneyso shaqsi guri, waxaad la gashaa heshiis kireeyaha.
en: If you rent a private flat, sign a lease with the landlord.

so: Ka aqriso faahfaahin dheeri ah boga shabakada InfoFinland Heshiiska kirada.
en: More information is available on the InfoFinland page Rental agreements.

so: Degmooyinka badi iyagaa leh guryaha kirada. Inta badana waa ka qiimo jaban yihiin guryaha kale ee kirada.
en: Many municipalities own rental flats, and these are often more affordable than privately rented ones.

so: Waxad dalban kartaa guri kiro ah oo ah kuwa ay dowladu taakulayso haddii ad haysato mid ka mid ah waxyaabahan xiga:
en: You can apply for state-subsidised rental housing if you have one of the following:

so: xaq dagganaansho oo la diwaangeliyay;
en: a registered right of residence;

so: sharciga dagganaanshaha ee ardayga.
en: a student's residence permit.

so: Markii aad rabto inaad degmada guri kiro ah ka dalbato, ka buuxso foomka codsiga guryaha xafiiska guryaha ee degmadaada.
en: If you would like to apply for a municipal rental flat, complete the application form at your municipality's housing agency.

so: Inta baddan waad ka buuxsan kartaa foomka shabakada degmada.
en: Many municipalities also offer online forms on their websites.

so: Magaalooyinka qaarkood waxaa suurogal ah iney codsadayaal badan jiraan ooy intaad ka heleyso guri qaadato waqti aad u badan.
en: In some municipalities, rental flats are so sought-after that you will be forced to wait a very long time for a home.

so: Tusaale ahaan caasimadda iyo nawaaxigeeda (Helsinki, Espoo ja Vantaa) guryaha safaf aad u dhaadheer ayaa loogu jiraa.
en: For example, in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area (Helsinki, Espoo and Vantaa), housing queues are long.

so: Halka degmooyin badan oo ka yaryar kuna yaalla dacalaaa Finland ay guryo uga banaanyihiin.
en: Meanwhile, many smaller municipalities in various parts of Finland have vacant apartments.

so: Finland waxaa jira meelo baddan oo bulshada u dan ah, kuwaasoo qiimaha kirada ay tahay raqiis.
en: Many non-profit organisations offer affordable rental housing in Finland.

so: Haddaad tahay ardey, waxaad codsan kartaa guryaha gaar ahaan loogu talogaley ardeyda.
en: Students can apply for student housing, which is normally cheaper than other alternatives.

so: Codsiga guriga iyo lifaaqyada
en: The housing application and its appendices

so: Markaad codsiga guri geyneyso, waxaa suurogal ah inaad u baahato dikumiintayaal kale oo lagu lifaaqayo codsiga. Waxayna ku xiran tahay, halka aad ka codsaneyso guriga.
en: When you file a housing application, you may be required to enclose other documents with it, depending on the party offering the flat.

so: Lifaaqyadaasna waxay noqon karaan kuwan:
en: The following appendices may be required:

so: koobiga go'aanka canshuurta, taasooy ku muuqato hantidaada
en: a copy of your taxation decision, indicating your assets

so: koobiga sharciga degenaanshaha ama baasaboorka, haddaadan heysan jinsiyada MY/EU.
en: a copy of your residence permit or passport if you are not a citizen of the EU

so: Qalabaynta guryaha kirada ah
en: Furnishings in rental dwellings

so: Sida caadiga ah qalabka guryaha lagu kireeyo waxaa ka mid ah armaajoyinka jikada, qaboojiyaha iyo makiinada cuntada lagu karsado.
en: The equipment of a rental dwelling almost always includes kitchen cupboards, a refrigerator and a stove.

so: Sidoo kale armaajada dharka iyo armaajada daarada waxay kamid yihiin qalabka guriga lagu kireeyey.
en: Furthermore, wardrobes and hall cabinets usually belong to the equipment of a dwelling.

so: Qubayska, qasabadaha biyaha iyo suuligu waxay ka mid yihiin mar walba qalabka joogtada ah ee guriga.
en: A shower, faucets and a toilet are always part of the furnishings.

so: Badi agabka guriga kama mid ah qalabka guriga lagu kireeyo.
en: However, some dwellings are also rented with furnishings.

so: Finland guryaha qaarna waxaa lagu kireeyaa ayagoo qalabaysan.
en: The equipment included in a furnished dwelling varies.

so: Waxayaabaha lagu qalabeeyey guriga inta badan waxaad ka xaqiiqsan kartaa kaa kireeyaha guriga.
en: Always check with the landlord what exactly the equipment includes.

so: Ma rabi laheyd inaad hesho talosiin la xiriirta kireysiga guriga?
en: Do you need advice on renting a flat?

so: Ururka macaamiisha Finland /Kuluttajaliitto waxaad ka heleysaa talosiin iyo tusmooyin ku aadan kireystaha iyo laga kireystaha.
en: The Consumers' Union of Finland offers advice and guidance for both tenants and landlords.

so: Waad wici kartaa teleefonka waddanka Finland oo dhan qiimuhiisuna waa midka degmadaada dhexdeeda aad ka wacaneyso oo kale.
en: The service is available everywhere in Finland for a local call charge.

so: Wixii talosiin ah waad ku weydiisan kartaa sidoo kale shabakada internetka, markaad buuxiso foomka.
en: The Consumers' Union also has an online form for submitting your questions, which will be answered by email.

so: Talosiinta degaanka ajaaniibta waxaad ka heleysaa sidoo kale Marttaliitto iyo Suomen Pakolaisapu.
en: Housing advice for immigrants is also provided by the Martha Organization and the Finnish Refugee Council.

so: Markaad guri ka guurto ee aad guri kale u guurto Finland dhexdeeda:
en: When you are moving house in Finland:

so: Ogeysiiska guuritaanka waxaad samayn kartaa ugu horeyn hal bil maalinta guuritaanka ka hor, laakiin ugu dambayn hal usbuuc kabacdi.
en: You can submit it one month before you move at the earliest, but you must submit it one week after your move at the latest.

so: Ogeysiiska guuritaanka waa in mar walba laga sameeyo xafiiska diiwaangelinta (maistraatti).
en: You must always make a notification of move to your local register office (maistraatti).

so: Ogeysiiska waxaa loo samayn karaa
en: You can submit the notification

so: adigoo buuxinaya foomka ogeysiinta guuritaanka oo laga helo boostada iyo xafiiska diiwaangelinta.
en: by a form available at post offices and local register offices.

so: Haddii aad dagan tahay guri dabaq ah ama guryaha safka u sasamaysan, xasuuso inaad guuritaankaaga ogeysiisid shirkada guriga qaabilsan (isännöitsijä).
en: If you live in a block of flats or in a terraced house, always remember to also notify the house manager (isännöitsijä) about your move.

so: Cinwaankaaga cusub la socodsii dhammaan dhinacyada aad boostada ka heshid oo dhan.
en: Notify your new address to everyone who sends you mail.

so: Waxaa laga yaabaa in shirkadaha iyo ururada qaarkood ay cinwaankaaga ka helaan xafiiska diiwaangelinta.
en: Some organisations and companies will receive your new address directly from the population register.

so: Si kastaba aha ahaatee adigaa masuul ka ah in, biilashaada loo soo gudbiyo ciwaankaaga saxda ah laguna bixiyo waqtigooda.
en: However, you are also responsible, for your own part, for receiving bills in the correct address and paying them in time.

so: Haddii aaad dagan tahay guri jiro ah, xasuuso inaad sii dayso gurigii hore waqti ku filan ka hor.
en: If you live in a rental dwelling, remember to give notice well in advance.

so: Waxaa haboon inaad sii daynta guriga qoraal ahaan ku gudbisid.
en: It is advisable to give the notice in writing.

so: Hubi waa intee waqtiga siideynta gurigu.
en: Check the term of notice for your dwelling.

so: Haddii aad carruur leedahay u qabanqaabi goobaha xanaanada iyo iskuuladaba.
en: If you have children, take care of their new day care and school arrangements.

so: Xanaanada iyo iskuulkaba waa inaad ogeysiiso markii ilmuhu ay ka tagayaan qoobahaas.
en: You need to notify the day care and school about the time your children will stop attending.

so: Sidoo kale waxaa haboon inaad ogeysiis siiso goobaha cusub ee xanaanada iyo iskuulka ee ilmuhu bilaabayaan guuritaanka kabacdi.
en: While doing so, it is also advisable to enrol the children to their new day care and school.

so: Xasuuso inaad waqti fiican raadsatid cawinaada guuritaanka oo suurtogalka ah inaad heshid.
en: Remember to reserve possible moving help well in advance.

so: Intabadan shirkadaha wax rara waxay ugu mashquul badan yihiin bisha dhammaadkeeda iyo dhammaadka usbuuca (viikonloput).
en: Turn of the month and weekends, among others, are always busy times for moving firms.

so: Laynka internetka iyo telefoonka laguu wareejinayo waxaa wanaagsan inaad qolada aad ka soo furatay wakhti fiican ka hor kala heshiiso, si aysan adeegga ugu imaan wax kala go' ah.
en: Make arrangements with your service provider well in advance for moving your Internet connection in order to prevent interruptions in the service.

so: Siidaa heshiiskii hore ee korontada inta aadan guurin heshiis cusubna sameey.
en: Terminate your old electricity contract before you move and make a new one.

so: Waxaa haboon inaad is barbar dhigto qiimayaasha shirkadaha korontada, si aad u heshid kan kuugu jaban.
en: It is advisable to compare the prices offered by different electricity companies in order to find the cheapest one.

so: Haddii aad u guuraysid guri aad adigu leedahay, xasuuso sidoo kale inaad samaysid heshiisyada kale, sida heshiiska biyaha iyo heshiiska daryeelka qashinka.
en: If you move into a detached house, remember to also make other contracts, such as a water connection contract and a waste management contract.

so: Haddii gurigu leeyahay olyada wax lagu kululeeyo, xasuuso inaad koontaroosho cadadda olyada.
en: In case the house is heated with oil, remember to check the amount of oil.

so: Koontarool, in heshiisyadaada caymisku, sida kan gurigu, ay sidoo kale ku filan yihiin guriga cusub.
en: Check if your current insurances, such as home insurance, also have sufficient coverage for the new dwelling.

so: Haddii aad ka soo guureysid guri dabaq ah una soo guureysid guri aad si gaar ah u leedahay, sida muuqata waxaad u baahan yahay caymis ka duwan kaagii hore.
en: If you move from a block of flats into a detached house, for example, you are likely to need different kind of insurance.

so: Guriga aad ka guureyso waa inaad nadiifisaa inta aadan ka guurin waana inaad faaruqisaa meelaha alaabada lagu kaydsado oo dhan iyo garaashka baabuurta.
en: Clean up your old dwelling before moving and make sure to also empty the attic, cellar and garage.

so: Haddii aad guri kiro ah dagan tahay, dhamman furayaashii gurigaagii hore u dhiib qofka iska leh guriga ama shirkada guryaha maamusha.
en: If you live in a rental dwelling, hand over all the keys to your previous dwelling to the owner or house manager.

so: Markaad u soo guurayso Finland
en: When you move to Finland

so: Hadii aad qorshaynayso inaad Finland u soo guurto, waxaad ka helaysaa macluumaad bogga InfoFinland U soo guurista Finland.
en: If you are planning to move to Finland, you can find information on the InfoFinland page Moving to Finland.

so: Hadii aad rabtid xogta aad ku hawl galaysid ee la xidhiidha arimaha u soo guutista Finland, ka akhri bogani Liiska xusuusta ee u soo guuraha Finland.
en: If you want information on practical issues related to moving to Finland, read more on page Checklist for a person who is moving to Finland.

so: Hadii aad imika u soo guurtay Finland, waxaa waajib kugu ah inaad isku diwaangeliso daganaansho.
en: If you have just moved to Finland, you must register as a resident.

so: Ka akhri xogo dheeraada bogga InfoFinland Isu diiwaangelin degene.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Registering as a resident.

so: Ma waxaad dooneysaa inaad Finland dal kale uga guurto?
en: Are you moving to another country from Finland?

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ka akhriso bogga InfoFinland Ka guuridda Finland.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Moving away from Finland.

so: Ma fahmin, ma iigu soo celin kartaa?
en: I don't understand, could you please repeat what you said?

so: Kuma hadlo afka Finnishka.
en: I don't speak Finnish.

so: Waxaan ku hadlaa oo kaliya in yar oo Finnish ah.
en: I only speak a little Finnish.

so: Ma ku hadashaa Ingiriis/Iswidish?
en: Do you speak English/Swedish?

so: Telefoon nambarkaadu waa maxay / emailkaada?
en: What's your phone number/e-mail address?

so: Waa xagee dukaanku / farmashiyuhu / iskuulku / xanaanada carruurtu / maxadada basasku / maxadada metroogu?
en: Where is the shop/pharmacy/school/day-care centre/bus station/metro station?

so: Finland waa dal laba luqadoodle ah
en: Finland is a bilingual country

so: Finland waxaa ka jira laba luqadood oo dowli ah, Finnish iyo Iswidish.
en: Finland has two official languages, Finnish and Swedish.

so: Luqadahaan waxay dhaxal fog ku leeyihiin Finland.
en: Both these languages have a long history in Finland.

so: Afka Finnishka waxaa luqad hooyo ahaan ugu hadla boqolkiiba 90, Iswidishka waxaa luqad hooyo ahaan ugu hadla qiyaastii boqolkiiba 5 oo dadka Finnishka ah.
en: Approximately 90 per cent of Finns speak Finnish as their first language and roughly 5 per cent speak Swedish.

so: Luqadahaan kii aad doonto ayaad isticmaali kartaa marka aad arrimo ka fushaneyso saraakiisha dowladda, tusaale ahaan xafiiska shaqada (työ- ja elinkeinotoimisto).
en: You can use either language when dealing with government officials, for example, at the Employment and Economic Development Office (työ- ja elinkeinotoimisto).

so: Afka Iswidishka waxaa looga hadlaa intiisa badan galbeedka iyo xeebta koonfureed ee Finland.
en: Swedish is spoken the most on Finland's western and southern coast.

so: Dhowr degmo waxaa afka Iswidishka looga hadlaa si ka badan luqada Finnishka.
en: In a few localities, Swedish is spoken more commonly than Finnish.

so: Hubi luqada guud ee degmadaada.
en: Find out which is the most common language in your locality.

so: Haddii degmadu ay laba luqadle tahay waxaad isticmaali kartaa Finnishka ama Iswidshka marka aad arrimo ka fushaneyso shaqaalaha degmada, tusaale ahaan xafiiska sooshaalka (sosiaalitoimisto).
en: If the municipality is bilingual, you can use either Finnish or Swedish when dealing with municipal employees, for example, at the Social Welfare Office (sosiaalitoimisto).

so: Shaqooyinka qaar waa inaad afka Finnishka iyo Iswidishka taqaanaa.
en: Some jobs require both Finnish and Swedish skills.

so: Dugsiyada Finnishka waxaa lagu bartaa afka Finnishka iyo Iswidhishka.
en: In Finnish schools, both Finnish and Swedish are studied.

so: Ardayda afkooda hooyo uu Finnish yahay waxay iskuulka ku bartaan afka Iswidishka.
en: Pupils whose first language is Finnish study Swedish at school.

so: Ardayada afkooda hooyo uu Iswidish yahay waxay iskuulka ku bartaa afka Finnishka.
en: Pupils whose first language is Swedish study Finnish.

so: Haddii cunugga dalka u soo guuray uu ku jiro iskuulka wax lagu barto luqadda Finnishka wuxuu isna ardayda kale ee luqadoodu Finnishka tahay la baranayaa Iswdishka.
en: If an immigrant child goes to a school where the teaching language is Finnish, they will also study Swedish as a foreign language together with the Finnish children.

so: Waa noocee luqada Finnishku?
en: What kind of a language is Finnish?

so: Afka Finnishku waa luqada Finnish-Ungari.
en: Finnish is a Finno-Ugric language.

so: Luqadaha la ehelka ah waa tusaale ahaan Istooni iyo Ungari.
en: Its kindred languages include, for example, Estonian and Hungarian.

so: Luqada Finnishka waxaa ku jira dhalan rogyo badan, tusaale ahaan boosaska magacyada, ficilada qaab qofeedka iyo xilliyada.
en: Finnish has a high number of inflected forms, for example, the cases of nouns, adjectives, numerals and pronouns, as well as the persons and tenses of verbs.

so: Meeleeyayaashu waa ka yar yihiin tusaale ahaan luqada Indo-Yurub.
en: There are fewer prepositions than in Indo-European languages, for example.

so: Luqada Finnishka waxaa ku jira ereyada ka daba mara ereyga ay u taliyaan.
en: Finnish also has some postpositions.

so: Hababka ereyadu isugu xigaan marka luqado badan loo fiiriyo waa ka salaxan yihiin.
en: Word order is freer than in many other languages.

so: Finnishka waxaa ku jira erayo badan oo laga soo amaahday tusaale ahaan Iswidhiska, Jarmalka, Ruushka iyo Ingiriiska.
en: Finnish also has many loanwords, for example, from Swedish, German, Russian and English.

so: Habka dhawaaqa ee luqada Finnishku waa mid si fiican loo sugay.
en: Finnish pronunciation is very regular.

so: Carab ku dhejinta eryadu mar walba waa higaada qeybta hore ee ereyga.
en: Words are always stressed on the first syllable.

so: Finland sida badan dadka ”adiga” ayaa loogu yeeraa.
en: In Finland, it is common to be on first-name terms with other people.

so: Marmarka qaar ”adinka” in loogu yeero qofka waa xushmad.
en: Sometimes it may be polite to address someone more formally.

so: Tusaale ahaan inta badan macaamilka waayeelka ah waxaa loogu yeeraa ”idinka”.
en: For example, customers or elderly persons are often addressed with the Finnish plural form of you, 'te'.

so: Waa noocee luqada Iswidishku?
en: What kind of a language is Swedish?

so: Iswidishku waa luqad Indo-Yurub, waxay ku abtirsataa luqadaha waqooyi ee Jermaanic loo yaqaan.
en: Swedish is an Indo-European language and belongs in the group of North Germanic languages.

so: Luqadaha la ehelka ah waa tusaale ahaan, Norwjijaanka, Danishka iyo Jarmalka.
en: Its kindred languages include, for example, Norwegian, Danish and German.

so: Isiwidishka waxaa ku jira erayo badan oo laga soo amaahday tusaale ahaan faransiiska.
en: Swedish also has a great number of loanwords, for example, from French.

so: Ficilada luqada iswidishku waxay isu bedelaan waqtiyo kala duduwan.
en: In Swedish, verbs inflect for different tenses.

so: Magac-u-yaaladu waxay u qeybsamaan laba isir.
en: Nouns are divided into two genders.

so: Afka Iswidishka waxaa la isticmaa meeleeyayaal badan, hababka ereyadanu waa kuwa aad loo dejiyay.
en: Swedish uses a large number of prepositions and its word order is very regular.

so: Iswidishka looga hadlo Finland waxaa loogu yeeraa Iswidishka Finland.
en: The Swedish spoken in Finland is called Finland Swedish.

so: Habka loogu dhawaaqo waa mid ka yara duwan Iswidishka looga hadlo Sweden.
en: It is pronounced somewhat differently from the Swedish spoken in Sweden.

so: Dhawaaqa Iswidishku waa mid dejisan.
en: Swedish pronunciation in both countries is fairly regular.

so: Finnishka iyo Iswidishka ka sokoow luqado kale ayaa looga hadlaa Finland.
en: In addition to Finnish and Swedish, Finland has also some other domestic languages.

so: Luqadaha sami waa luqadaha asalka ah ee Finland.
en: Sami languages are the indigenous languages of Finland.

so: Finland waxaa looga hadlaa saddex luqadood oo sami ah.
en: Three Sami languages are spoken here.

so: Waxay ku abtirsadaan luqadaha Finnish-Ungari.
en: They belong in the group of Finno-Ugric languages.

so: Luqada Romaaniga ee Finland waxay ku abtirsataa luqadaha Indo-Yurub.
en: The Romani language spoken in Finland is an Indo-European language.

so: Finland waxay leedahay sidoo kale luqad dhegoolayaasha oo u gaar ah.
en: Finland also has its own sign language.

so: Macluumaad ku saabsan luqadaha waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga xarunta baaritaanka luqadaha dalka.
en: You can find out more about these languages on the website of the Research Institute for the Languages of Finland.

so: Dalka Finland dhexdiisa waxaa luuqadda Finnishka afkooda hooyo ahaan ugu hadla qiyaastii 90% ka mid ah dadka Finnishka.
en: Approximately 90% of Finns speak Finnish as their native language.

so: Iswidishka waxaa afkooda hooyo ahaan ugu hadla qiyaastii 5% ka mid ah dadka Finnishka.
en: Approximately 5% of Finns speak Swedish as their native language.

so: Luuqadda Iswidishka ee Finland looga hadlo waa Iswidishka Finnishka (suomenruotsia).
en: The Swedish spoken in Finland is called Finland Swedish (suomenruotsi).

so: Haddii aad dooneyso in aad codsato jinsiyadda Finland, waxaad u baahan tahay shahaadada aqoon kugu filan ee afka Finnishka ama Iswidhiska.
en: If you apply for Finnish citizenship, you need a certificate of sufficient proficiency in the Finnish or Swedish language.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Shahaadada rasmiga ah ee aqoonta luqada.
en: For more information, see the InfoFinland page Official certificate of language proficiency.

so: Waxaad luuqadda Iswidhishka u adeegsan kartaa hawlwadeenada dawlada, tusaale ahaan Kelada ama Xaafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada.
en: You can use Swedish with government authorities, such as Kela or the TE Office.

so: Ogeysii luuqada aad adeegsaneyso xafiiska dad dhigidda, makii aad isku diiwaangelineysid degaanka.
en: When you register as a resident, inform the local register office of the language in which you want to use services.

so: Sidoo kale dib ayaad ka badeli kartaa luuqadda aad isticmaaleysid oo arrimahaaga fushaneysid.
en: You can also change the language later.

so: Degmooyinka Finland intooda badan luuqadoodu waa Finnish.
en: Most of the municipalities in Finland are Finnish-speaking.

so: Degmooyinka labada luuqadood leh waxay ku yaallaan xeebaha galbeed iyo kuwa koofureed.
en: There are bilingual municipalities on the southern and western coasts.

so: Haddii degmadaadu ay labo luuqadood leedahay, markaas waxaad sidoo kale adeegyada degmada u isticmaali kartaa luuqadda Iswidishka, tusaale ahaan xarunta caafimaadka.
en: If your municipality of residence is bilingual, you can also use Swedish with municipal services, such as the health centre.

so: Waxaa laga yaabaa inay adiga kuu tahay fursad wanaagsan dal kula qabshashda luuqadda Iswidishku tusaale ahaan haddii:
en: Swedish-language integration may be a good choice for you, if:

so: Aad degantahay aag, ay degan yihiin dad badan oo luuqadda Iswidishka ku hadla.
en: You live in an area with many Swedish speakers.

so: Ay jiraan xubno qoyskaaga ka mid ah oo Iswidish ku hadla ama qaraabo kale.
en: You have family members or relatives who speak Swedish.

so: Aad xoogaa ka taqaano luuqadda Iswidishka.
en: You already speak some Swedish.

so: Waxaa laga yaabaa in luuqadda Iswidishku ay faa'iido kuu leedahay markii aad raadineyso shaqo.
en: Swedish language skills could be useful when you look for work.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee la soco, in goobaha shaqada intooda badan looga baahan yahay aqoonta luuqadda Finnishka.
en: However, please note that most jobs require proficiency in Finnish.

so: Haddii xitaa aad luuqadda dal laqabsiga u dooratid luuqadda Iswidishka, waxaa kula gudboon inaad mar uun sidoo kale aad baradid luuqadda Finnishka.
en: Even if you choose Swedish-language integration training, you should also study Finnish at some point.

so: Degmooyinka qaarkood waxaad ka qayb geli kartaa waxbarashada dal la qabsiga oo luuqadda Iswidishka ku baxaysa.
en: In some municipalities, you can participate in Swedish-language integration training.

so: Haddii aad heliweyso waxbarashda dal laqabsiga oo luuqadda Iswidishka ah, markaas xaaladaha qaarkood waxaa suurtogal ah in lagaa kaalmeeyo barashada luuqadda Iswidishka ee aad adigu iskaa u raadsatay, haddii arintaan horay loogu heshiiyey markii la sameynayey qorshahaaga dal laqabsiga iyo shaqada.
en: If you cannot get into Swedish-language integration training, in some cases you can still get support for independent Swedish studies if it is agreed on in your integration or employment plan.

so: Weydii dal la qabsiga luuqadda Iswidishka, marka adiga laguu sameynayo kaarteynta hore iyo qorshaha dal la qabsiga.
en: Ask about Swedish-language integration when your preliminary assessment and integration plan is being prepared.

so: Sharcigu siduu qabo waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad luuqad dal la qabsi u dooradit Finnish ama Iswidish.
en: According to law, you have the right to choose Finnish or Swedish as your integration language.

so: Wixii dheeraaad ah oo ku saabsan adeegyada dal laqabsiga ka akhriso bogga InfoFinland: La-qabsashada Finland.
en: Read more about integration services on the InfoFinland page: Integration into Finland.

so: Barashada luqadaha oo ah waxbarashada xoogga shaqada
en: Language studies as labour market training

so: Waxaad afka Iswidhiska ka baran kartaa waxbarashada xoogga shaqada, haddii aad tahay macaamilka xafiiska shaqada iyo quudka.
en: You can also study Swedish as labour market training, if you are a customer of the Employment and Economic Development Office.

so: Waxbarashada xoogga shaqada waxaa loogu talagalay shaqo laawayaasha shaqo doonka ah.
en: Labour market training is intended for unemployed jobseekers.

so: Ka aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Adeegyada xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada, shuruudaha aad kaga ku geli karto macaamiisha Xafiiska shaqada iyo quudka.
en: On the InfoFinland page Services provided by the Employment and Economic Development Office, you can find the conditions for becoming a customer of the office.

so: Waxbarashada xoogga shaqadu waa kuu lacag la'aan.
en: Labour market training is free of charge.

so: Weydii faahfaahinta koorasyada afka Iswidhiska Xafiiskaada shaqada iyo quudka.
en: Ask for more information about Swedish courses at your local TE Office.

so: Xannaano maalmeedka caruurta iyo waxbarashada
en: Children's day care and education

so: Dalka Finland waxbarashada xanaano maalmeedka, waxbarashada iskuulka ka horeysa iyo waxbarashada aasaasiga ah intuba sida badan waxay ku baxaan luuqadaha Finnishka ama Iswidishka.
en: In Finland, the language of day care, pre-primary education and comprehensive education is usually Finnish or Swedish.

so: Haddii aad dooneysid in ilmahaadu uu aado xanaano maalmeed Iswidish ah, waxbarashda iskuulka ka horeysa ama iskuul Iswidish ah, degmadaada waydii suurtogalnimada arintan.
en: If you want your child to attend Swedish-language day care, pre-primary education or comprehensive education, ask your municipality about the possibility.

so: Degmooyinka qaarkood waxay ardayda waxbarashada aasisiga ah dhigata oo aqoonta luuqadoodu aysan ku filanayn waxbarashada caadiga ah u abaabulaan waxbarashada u diyaarinta waxbarashda aasaasiga ah.
en: Some municipalities organise preparatory education for comprehensive education for pupils whose language skills are not yet good enough for normal education.

so: Weydii degmadaada inay abaabusho waxbarashada iskuul u diyaarinta oo Iswidisha ah.
en: Ask your municipality whether they organise preparatory education in Swedish.

so: Haddii ilmaha luuqadiisa afka hooyo ay tahay mid aan ahayn Finnish ama Iswidish, markaas degmada ayaa u abaabuli karta ilmaha barashada luuqadiisa hooyo.
en: If the child's native language is something other than Finnish or Swedish, the municipality may organise native language education in the child's own native language.

so: Haddii ilmuhu uu aado iskuul luuqadda Iswidishka wax looga barto, wuxuu Iswidishka u baran karaa luuqad labaaad ahaan.
en: If the child attends a Swedish-language school, he or she can study Swedish as a second language.

so: Wixii dheeraad ah oo la xiriira xanaano maalmeedka carruurta, waxbarashada iskuulka ka horeysa iyo waxbarashada aasaasiga ah ka akhriso bogga InfoFinland: Nidaamka waxbarashada ee Finnishka.
en: Read more about day care, pre-primary education and comprehensive education on the InfoFinland page The Finnish education system.

so: Dugsiga sare iyo macaahidda xirfadaha shaqada
en: Upper secondary school and vocational school

so: Dugsiga hoose dhexe kadib waxaad wax ka baran kartaa dugsiga sare ama machadka xirfadda.
en: After comprehensive school, young people can study at upper secondary school or vocational school.

so: Macaahidda xiradaha iyo dusiyada sare ee luuqadda Iswidishka ah wax looga barto waxay ku yaalaan degmooyinka labada luuqadood looga hadlo iyo weliba degmooyinka luuqadda Finnishka oo kaliya looga hadlo kuwo ka mid ah.
en: There are Swedish-language vocational schools and upper secondary schools in Swedish-speaking municipalities, bilingual municipalities and some Finnish-speaking municipalities.

so: Qaar ka mid macaahidda xirfadaha iyo dugsiyada sare waxay qaban-qaabiyaan waxbarashada iskuul isku diyaarinta.
en: Some vocational schools and upper secondary schools organise preparatory training for studies.

so: Waxbarashada iskuul isku diyaarinta ah waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaadka iyo aqoonta aad uga baahantahay oo kaa caawinaya sii wadashada waxarashada.Waxaad kaloo sare u qaadi kartaa heerka aqoontaada luuqadda.
en: Preparatory training gives you knowledge and skills that you will need in further studies. You can also improve your language skills.

so: Waxaad adeegga Opintopolku.fi ka raadin kartaa macaahidda xirfadaha iyo dugsiyada sare ee luuqadda iswidishka ah iyo sidoo kale waxbarashooyinkooda la xiriira iskuul isku diyaarinta.
en: You can search for Swedish-language vocational and upper secondary education and their preparatory training in the Opintopolku.fi service.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ka akhriso bogga InfoFinland: Waxbarashada aasaasiga ah kadib.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page: After comprehensive school.

so: Finland waxaa ku yaalla macaahid sare oo xirfadaha iyo jaamacado luuqadda Iswidishka ah wax looga barto.
en: There are Swedish-language universities and universities of applied sciences in Finland.

so: Intaas waxaa dheer oo jira dhawr jaamacadood oo labada luuqadood isticmaalo, kuwaas oo luuqadda Iswidishka wax looga baran karo.
en: There are also a few bilingual universities where you can study in Swedish.

so: Waxaad adeegga Opintopolku.fi ka raadin kartaa jaamacadaha ama macaahidda waxabarashada sare ee luuqadda Iswidishka wax looga barto.
en: You can search for Swedish-language higher education in the Opintopolku.fi service.

so: Xagee ayaan ka baran karaa luuqadda Iswidishka?
en: Where can I study Swedish?

so: Luuqadda Iswidishka waxaad ka baran kartaa tusaale ahaan macaahidda bulshada, macaahidda ururada shaqaalaha iyo jaamacadaha xagaaga.
en: You can study Swedish at adult education centres, workers' institutes and university summer courses.

so: Macluumaad la xiriira barashada luuqadda Iswidishka weydii xaafiiska waxbarashada ee degmadaada, hagaha waxbarshada ee macaahidda ama barta adeegga la talinta dadka wadanka u soo guurey.
en: Ask your local education department, the study counsellors of educational institutes or counselling services for immigrants about Swedish studies.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ka akhriso bogga InfoFinland: Waxbarashada hiwaayadda ah.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page: Studying as a hobby.

so: Luuqadda Iswidishka waxaad ka baran kartaa barnaamjyada internetka, kaas oo aad ku soo dagsan kartid teleefankaaga ama tabletkaaga.
en: You can learn Swedish language from applications that you can download onto your mobile phone or tablet.

so: Dukaankaaga barnaamjyada ka raadi barnaamij (app) luuqadda Iswidishka ah (tusaale Google Play ja App Store) adigoo isticmaalaya xaraf raadinta ah ”learn Swedish”, ”Swedish language”, ”lär dig svenska” ama ”svenska”.
en: Search for Swedish language applications in your app store (such as Google Play or App Store) with search terms “learn Swedish”, “Swedish language”, “lär dig svenska” or “svenska”.

so: Barnaamjyada qaarkood waa lacag.
en: Some of the applications are subject to a charge.

so: Baaraatiko iyo koorsooyin xagga internetka ah
en: Exercises and courses online

so: Internetka waxaad ka heleysaa koorsooyin heerarkoodu ay kala duwan yihiin oo Iswidish ah.
en: You can find Swedish courses on various levels of difficulty online.

so: Internetka waxaa suurtogal kuu ah tusaale ahaan inaad ka sameysid baaraatiik (tababar) iyo inaad geymam xagga barashada luuqadda ah ku ciyaartid, kana baratid naxwaha iyo erayoyinka, sidoo kalena aad ka akhrisato qoraalada.
en: You can do things like complete exercises or play games, study grammar and vocabulary and read texts online.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso in aad codsato jinsiyadda Finland, waxaad u baahan tahay shahaadada rasmiga ah ee aqoonta afka Finnishka ama Iswidhishka.
en: If you want to apply for Finnish citizenship, you will need an official certificate of your skills in Finnish or Swedish.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale shahaadada u baahan kartaa marka aad shaqo raadsaneyso shaqo ama waxbarasho.
en: You may also need the certificate when applying for a job or study place.

so: Aqoonta luqada waxaad ku muujin kartaa:
en: You can prove your language skills with the following:

so: Imtixaanka guud ee luqada (YKI) oo tijaabo luqadeed oo loogu talagalay dadka waaweyn.
en: The National Certificate of Language Proficiency test is intended for adults.

so: Imtixaanka guud ee luqadda waxaad ku muujin kartaa aqoontaada luqadda Finnishka ama Iswidishka.
en: With it you can prove your proficiency in Finnish or Swedish.

so: Imtixaanka luqada waa saddex heer: heer aasaasi ah, heer dhexdhexaad ah iyo heerka ugu sareeya.
en: After the test, you will receive a certificate stating the level of your language proficiency.

so: Heerka aasaasiga ah waxaa loogu talagalay dadka luqada u isticmaali kari arrimaha nolol maalmeedka, kuwa ay heerka aqoontoodu tahay
en: The basic level is for those who are able to use the language in question in everyday situations, i.e. whose proficiency level is

so: Heerka dhexe waxaa loogu talagalay dadka luqada si iska fiican u yaqaan, kuwa ay heerka aqoontoodu tahay 3–4.
en: The intermediate level is for those who can speak the language quite well, i.e. whose proficiency level is 3–4.

so: Heerka ugu sareeya waxaa loogu talagalay dadka luqada si aad u fiican u yaqaan, kuwa ay heerka aqoontoodu tahay 5–6.
en: The advanced level is for those who speak the language extremely well, i.e. whose proficiency level is 5–6.

so: Ka sii aqri sawirada rasmiga ah ee heerarka aqooneedka kala duduwan bogagga Xafiiska waxbarashada.
en: More detailed descriptions of the proficiency levels are provided on the website of the Finnish National Agency for Education.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso inaad codsato dhalashada (kansalaisuus) Finland waxaad muujin kartaa aqoonta luqada Finnishka ama Iswidishka ee kugu filan marka aad ku baasto imtixaanka guud ee luqada qeybta hadalka iyo qoraalka ugu yaraan heerka aqoonta 3.
en: If you want to apply for Finnish citizenship (kansalaisuus), you will need to prove that you have a satisfactory level of Finnish or Swedish, which means passing the written and oral part of the National Certificate of Language Proficiency at the minimum level of 3.

so: Imtixaanka luqadu wuxuu qaataa 3–6 saacadood.
en: The language test takes 3-6 hours.

so: Mowduucyada waxyaabaha imtixaanka ku jira waxay la xiriiraan nolol maalmeedka joogtada ah, sida waqtiyada firaaqada, waxbarashada iyo xaaladaha shaqooyinka ee caadiga ah.
en: The subject matters in the assignments are linked to everyday life, such as leisure time, training and the most common work situations.

so: Imtixaanka waxaa ku jira shaqooyin kala duduwan, kuwaas oo aad u baahan si aad ugu baasto xirfadaha soo socoda:
en: The test consists of different kinds of questions which require the following skills:

so: Imtixaanka waxaad ku geli kartaa dhinacyo kala duduwan oo dalka Finland ku yaal.
en: The test can be taken in different parts of Finland.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan is-diiwaangelinta waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga Maamulka waxbarashada (Opetushallitus).
en: You can find out more about enrolment on the website of the Finnish National Agency for Education (Opetushallitus).

so: Imtixaanaadka sida koorasyada oo kale ayaa waxaa lagu halbeegaa derejooyin kala duduwan.
en: The tests are classified according to a different scale than the courses.
