so: Haddii aad soo dhameysay kooras luqadeed lagu halbeegay sida uu qabo fareymka tixraaca Yurub, kooraskaas waxyaabaha ku jiray qiyaas ahaan waxay u dhigmayaan heerka imtixaanka guud ee luqada qiyaastii sida soo socota:
en: If you have completed a language course that has been classified according to the Common European Framework of Reference, the course content corresponds to the level of the National Certificate of Language Proficiency roughly in the following way:

so: Ka hor inta aadan isu-diiwaangelin imtixaanka, si fiican u baro heerarka imtixaanka ee la iska doonayo.
en: Before you enrol for a test, please read about the requirements for the different levels carefully.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale talo weydiisan kartaa macalimaddaada/macalinkaada luqada Finnishka.
en: You can also ask your Finnish or Swedish teacher for advice.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan imtixaanka guud ee luqada waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga Maamulka waxbarashada.
en: You can find out more about the National Certificate of Language Proficiency on the website of the Finnish National Agency for Education.

so: Haddii aad rabto inaad ka shaqeyso maamulada shacabka waxaad sida caadiga ah u baahan tahay shahaadada aqoonta luqada Finnishka ama Iswidishka .
en: If you want to work in public administration, you will usually need a certificate of your skills in Finnish or Swedish.

so: Imtixaanka luqada ee dowliga ah ayaad ku soo bandhigi kartaa aqoontaada luqada Finnishka ama Iswidishka .
en: You can prove your ability in one of these languages with a Civil Service Language Proficiency Certificate.

so: Weydii qofka shaqada ku siiyay heerka aqoonta luqada ee goobta shaqada aad ka codsaneyso looga baahan yahay.
en: Ask your employer what the language proficiency requirements are for the job you want to apply for.

so: Imtixaanku waa saddex heer: ku-filan, fiican iyo aad u fiican.
en: The test has three levels: satisfactory, good and excellent.

so: Goobta shaqada ama waxbarashada ayeey ku xiran tahay heerka lagaa doonayo inaad ku baasto.
en: The test level that you need to pass depends on the job or study place in question.

so: Dhalashada Finland waxaad ugu yaraan u baahan tahay shahaadada heerka aqoonta luqada ee ku-filan.
en: To be granted Finnish citizenship, you will require a certificate of at least satisfactory skills.

so: Imtixaanka heerka ku-filan iyo fiican waxaad ku geli kartaa qebo badan oo Finland ku yaal.
en: Satisfactory or good level tests can be taken in different parts of Finland.

so: Bogagga Maamulka waxbarashada waxaad ka heleysaa jadwal ay ku taxan yihiin magaalooyinka imtixaanka lagu geli karo.
en: The website of the Finnish National Agency for Education has a list of the towns where the test can be taken.

so: Imtixaanka heerka ama darajada aad u fiican waxaad ku geli kartaa Helsinki oo kaliya.
en: The test demonstrating excellent skills can only be taken in Helsinki.

so: Imtixaanku wuxuu ka kooban yahay tijaabooyin kala duduwan. Qoraalo ayaa la akhrinayaa, la dhegeysanayaa su'aalana waa laga jawaabayaa.
en: The test is composed of various kinds of questions which involve reading and listening to texts and answering questions.

so: Waxaa intaas dheer oo imtixaanka ku jira shaqooyin wareysi, shaqooyin sheekeysi iyo shaqooyin qoraal ah.
en: It also includes interview, discussion and writing assignments.

so: Imtixaanka maamulka dowliga ah waxaad kaga kaaftoomi kartaa haddii aad ku soo baastay maadooyin gaar ah.
en: The Civil Service Language Proficiency Certificate can be substituted with specific completed studies.

so: Tusaale ahaan heerka fiican ee imtixaanka luqada ee maamulka dowliga ah wuxuu u dhigmaa iskuulka-sare ee heer jaamacadeedka ah tijaabadiisa biseylka (kypsyysnäyte) ee aad ku soo dhigatay afka Finnishka ama Iswidishka.
en: For example, a B.A. / M.A. maturity exam (kypsyysnäyte) taken at a university in Finnish or Swedish corresponds to the Civil Service Language Proficiency Certificate's 'good' level.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysa bogagga Maamulka waxbarashada.
en: For more information, go to the website of the Finnish National Agency for Education.

so: Shahaadada aqoonta luqada ee maadooyinka lagu saleeyay
en: Certificate of language proficiency on the basis of studies

so: Haddii aad rabto inaad codsato dhalashada Finland waxaad aqoontaada luqada Finnishka ama Iswidishka sidoo kale haddii ku soo bandhigi kartaa aad heysato mid ka mid ah kuwa soo socda:
en: If you want to apply for Finnish citizenship, you can also prove your proficiency in Finnish or Swedish if you have one of the following:

so: shahaado dugsi dhexe oo afka hooyo ama luqada labaad ay yihiin Finnish ama Iswidish, taas oo ay ku jiraan dhibcaha la aqbalay.
en: basic education certificate with a pass in Finnish or Swedish as a first or second language

so: shahaado dugsi sare oo afka hooyo ama luqada labaad ay yihiin Finnish ama Iswidish, taas oo ay ku jiraan dhibcaha la aqbalay
en: general upper secondary school certificate with a pass in Finnish or Swedish as a first or second language

so: shahaadada imtixaanka sare ee ardayga oo Finnish ama Iswidish ah, taas oo ay ku jiraan dhibcaha la aqbalay
en: Finnish or Swedish matriculation examination with a pass in Finnish or Swedish as a first or second language

so: shahaado aqoonta sarkaal shacbi Finnish ama Iswidish ah oo aad ka soo qaadatay jaamacadda ama iskuulaadka heerka jaamacadeed ah
en: a certificate of civil service Finnish or Swedish studies which you have taken at a university

so: shahaadada tijaabada biseylka, taas aad u luqada Finnishka ama Iswidishka ah islamarkaasna aad ugu talagashay shahaadada jaamacadda ama iskuulaadka xirfadaha ee jaamacadda u dhigma
en: a certificate of a B.A./M.A. maturity exam which you have taken in Finnish or Swedish for a university degree or university of applied sciences degree

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysa bogagga Xafiiska dal u soo guuridda (Maahanmuuttovirasto).
en: You can find out more on the website of the Finnish Immigration Service (Maahanmuuttovirasto).

so: Internetka waxaad ka heleysaa koorasyo afka Finnishka ah oo heerarkoodu ay kala duduwan yihiin.
en: There are many Finnish courses of different levels online.

so: Waxaa sidoo kale suurtagal ah inaad internetka leylisyo ku sameyso, ku ciyaarto ciyaaro, naxwaha luqada iyo ereyo aad ku barato iyo in aad qormooyin ku akhriso.
en: You can do exercises, play games, study grammar and vocabulary online, as well as read texts.

so: Intooda badan luqada koorasyada internetka waa Finnish ama Ingiriis, kuwa kalena waa jiraan.
en: The teaching language of most online courses is Finnish or English, but other alternatives are also available.

so: Habab kala duduwan ayaa lagu sawiraa heerarka koorasyada luqada.
en: In Finland, there are different ways to describe the level of a language course.

so: Inta badan waxaa la isticmaalaa qiimeynta darajada fareymka tixraaca Yurub (Eurooppalainen viitekehys, EVK).
en: Often the rating scale of the Common European Framework of Reference (CEF) (eurooppalainen viitekehys, EVK) is used.

so: Darajadan waxay ka kooban tahay sida soo socota:
en: This scale contains the following levels:

so: Heerarku waxay u sii kala qeybsamaan heerar hoose.
en: These levels are further divided into sublevels.

so: Tusaale ahaan heerka A1 waxay ka kooban tahay koorasyada kala ah A1.1, A1.2 iyo A1.3, heerka A2 isna wuxuu ka kooban yahay koorasyada A2.1 iyo A2.2.
en: For example, level A1 comprises courses A1.1, A1.2 and A1.3, and level A2 courses A2.1 and A2.2.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan heerarka kala gedisan noocyada aqooneed ee ay u taagan yihiin waxaad ka heli kartaa bogga Maamulka waxbarashada (Opetushallitus).
en: The Finnish National Agency for Education's (Opetushallitus) website offers more information about what the different levels mean in practice.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale si toos ah u weydiin kartaa machadyada waxbarashada.
en: You can also ask directly at an educational establishment.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi Shahaadada rasmiga ah ee aqoonta luqadda waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad la xiriira sida aad u barbardhigi karto heerarka koorsooyinka heerka imtixaanka luqada guud (yleinen kielitutkinto).
en: The InfoFinland web page Official certificate of language proficiency provides information about how to compare course levels to the level of the National Certificate of Language Proficiency test (yleinen kielitutkinto).

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ka akhriso bogga InfoFinland: Waxbarashada sare.
en: Read more about higher education on the InfoFinland page: Higher education.

so: Finland waxaa ka jira fursado badan oo kala duwan oo lagu barto afka Finnishka.
en: There are a lot of different possibilities to study Finnish in Finland.

so: Koorasyo kala duwan ayaa loo qaban-qaabiyaa carruurta iyo dadka waaweyn.
en: Various courses are organised for both children and adults.

so: Barista afka Finnishka dadka waaweyn
en: Finnish lessons for adults

so: Waxaad macluumaad ku saabsan koorasyada afka Finnishka ka heleysaa tusaale ahaan machadyada dadweynaha, machadyada dadka shaqeeya, jaamacadaha iyo jaamacadaha xagaaga.
en: You can find information about Finnish language courses, for example, at community colleges, adult education centres, universities and summer universities.

so: Weydii faahfaahinta dheeraadka ah adeegyada la-talinta dadka soo-galootiga ah, saraakiisha hawlaha waxbarashada ee degmadaada ama hagaha waxbarashada ee qeybta waxbarashada deegaanka.
en: Ask the guidance services for immigrants, the authorities at your locality's Department of Education or the student counsellors of local educational establishments for more information.

so: Macluumaadyada koorasyada waxaa la isugu keenay deegaanada qaarkood hal meel.
en: For some areas, the course information has been collected into one site.

so: Tusaale, macluumaadka koorasyada afka Finnishka ee soonayaasha Helsinki, Tampere iyo Turku waxaad ka heleysaa adeegga Finnishcourses.fi
en: For example, information on Finnish courses held in the Helsinki, Tampere and Turku regions is available at the Finnishcourses.fi service.

so: Koorasyadu waxey inta badan qeybaha waxbarashada ka billowdaan Agoosto ama Sebtembar iyo Janaayo.
en: Courses at educational establishments usually begin in August or September as well as in January.

so: Koorasyada luqaddu inta badan way buuxsamaan.
en: Language courses are often very full.

so: Sidaas darteed ayeey muhiim u tahay in koorasyada la iska diiwaangeliyo waqti hore.
en: That is why it is important to enrol well before the course starts.

so: Waxbarashooyinka afka oo qeyb ka ah waxbarasho kale
en: Language studies as part of a study programme

so: Waxaad sidoo kale afka Finnishka ku baran kartaa waxbarashada xafiiska shaqada iyo Waxbarashada u diyaargarowga iskuulka farsamada (VALMA) ama Waxbarashada u diyaarinta dugsiga sare (LUVA)
en: You can also study Finnish as part of labour market training and preparatory vocational education (VALMA) or preparatory education for upper secondary school (LUVA).

so: Haddii aad macaamiil ka tahay xafiiska shaqada iyo quudka, waxaad geli kartaa koorasyada afka adigoo Xafiiska shaqada soo maraya.
en: If you are a customer of the Employment and Economic Development Office, you can get to Finnish language courses through the TE Office.

so: Nooca barashada luqadeed ee aad u baahan tahay waxaa lagu qiimeynayaa Xafiiska shaqada iyo quudka, marka laguu sameynayo qorshaha la-qabsashada ama shaqaaloobista.
en: The type of language education you need is assessed at the TE Office in connection with preparing your integration or employment plan.

so: Waxaad afka Finnishka u baran kartaa sidii waxbarashada xoogga shaqada.
en: You can study Finnish as labour market training.

so: Waxbarashada xoogga shaqadu waa ugu horeyn waxbarasho loogu talagalay dadka shaqo la'aanta ah ee shaqo doonka ah.
en: Labour market training is mainly intended for unemployed jobseekers.

so: Waxbarashadu waa u lacag la'aan qofka ka qeybgelayaasha.
en: The training is free of charge.

so: Weydii koorasyada afka Finnishka Xafiiskaada shaqada.
en: Ask for more information about Finnish courses at your local TE Office.

so: Afka Finnishka ee goobta shaqada
en: Finnish language at the workplace

so: Shaqo-bixiyayaasha qaarkood waxey shaqaalahooda u qabanqaabiyaan barashada afka Finnishka.
en: Some employers organise Finnish language lessons for their employees.

so: Weydii shaqo-bixiyahaada, in aad goobta shaqada ku baran karto Finnishka.
en: Ask your employer if you can study Finnish at your workplace.

so: Shaqo-bixiyuhu wuxuu kaalmo u codsan karaa isagoo soo maraya adeegyada Xafiiska shaqada iyo quudka barista afka Finnishka ee shaqaalaha.
en: Your employer can apply to TE services for support for employees' Finnish lessons.

so: Barista afka Finnishka ee carruurta
en: Finnish lessons for children

so: Carruurtu degdeg ayeey u bartaan luqadaha cusub, inkastoo ay marka u muuqan karto wax adag.
en: Children learn new languages quickly, although it may seem difficult at first.

so: Barashada afka Finnishka waxey ka dhacdaa xannaano-maalmeedka, dugsi-horaadka iyo dugsiga.
en: They can be taught Finnish at their day-care centre, preschool and school.

so: Waxbarashadan waa waxbarashada afka Finnishka oo sidii luqad labaad oo kale ah, waa waxbarashada S2.
en: This tuition is called Finnish as a second language, i.e. S2 teaching.

so: Cunuggu ama da'yarku wuxuu xittaa ka qeybqaadan karaa waxbarashada diyaarinta ah.
en: A child or young person may also participate in preparatory education.

so: Waxaa loogu talagalay ardayda aan weli si fiican u aqoonin Finnishka.
en: It is intended for pupils who do not know much Finnish yet.

so: Inta lagu jiro waxbarashada diyaarinta ah cunuggu ama da'yarku wuxuu baranayaa afka Finnishka iyo maadooyinka kale.
en: During preparatory education, the child or young person studies Finnish and some other subjects.

so: Waxbarashada diyaarinta ah waxaa loogu talagalay 7-16 sano jiryada.
en: Preparatory education is intended for children between 7 and 16 years of age.

so: Markaad ka fikiraysid, ma ii dan baa inaan barto luuqada finishka ama iswidhishka, waxaad ku darsataa qorshaha luuqada ay ku hadlaan dadka dagan meesha aad dagan tahay iyo deegaanada kugu hareeraysan ama xeeran.
en: When you are considering whether to study Finnish or Swedish, take the language that is spoken in your place of residence and neighbourhood into consideration.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso in aad codsato jinsiyadda Finland, waa in aad taqaanaa Finnish, Iswidhish ama luqada dhegoolaha ee Finnishka.
en: If you want to apply for Finnish citizenship, you must be able to speak Finnish or Swedish or to use Finnish sign language.

so: Marka aad codsaneyso jinsiyadda, ku lifaaq shahaada aqoontaada luqadeed.
en: When you apply for citizenship, you need to attach a certificate of your language proficiency.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan shuruudda luqada ka aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Shahaadada rasmiga ah ee aqoonta luqada.
en: For more information on language skill requirements, see the InfoFinland page Official certificate of language proficiency.

so: Goobaha shaqo badankood waxaan laga maarmin aqoonta Finnishka.
en: At most jobs, you need to know Finnish.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso in aad wax ka barato Finland, waa iska caddahay in aad u baahan tahay aqoonta afka Finnishka.
en: If you want to study in Finland, you will probably need Finnish language skills.

so: Waxaa haboon in aad barato Finnishka ama Iswidishka haddii aadan ku fekersaneyn xitaa inaad dalka deganaato mudo dheer.
en: It is worthwhile studying Finnish or Swedish even if you do not intend on staying in the country for long.

so: Inkastoo afka Ingiriiska Finland ku dhowaad si fiican looga yaqaan, hadana aqoonta afka Finnishka ama Iswidishka ayaa wax badan kaaga faa'iido badan.
en: Even though Finns generally speak English quite well, knowing Finnish or Swedish will be very useful for you nonetheless.

so: Marka aad taqaano luqada waa kuu sahlan tahay in aad ku raaxeysato islamarkaasna la qabsato Finland.
en: When you speak the language, you will become acclimatised more easily and will be more at home in Finland.

so: Waxaa kuu sahlan in arrimahaada aad ka dhameysato saraakiisha, la socoto wararka, dad barasho iyo in aad saaxiibo hesho.
en: It will be easier to attend to your affairs with authorities, keep abreast of the news, get to know people and make friends.

so: Sida ugu fiican ee aad luqad ku baraneysaa waa inaad ku dhiirato ku hadalkeeda.
en: The best way to learn a language is to take every opportunity to speak it.

so: Mar kasta uma baahnid inaad fahamto dhammaan, waxaa kugu filan inaad fahamto arrimaha ugu muhiimsan.
en: You don't always have to understand every word; it is enough to understand the most important things.

so: Si geesinimo leh u gal goobaha aad ku hadli karto afka Finnishka ama Iswidishka.
en: So be bold and enter situations where you can speak Finnish or Swedish.

so: Wargelinta shaqada dhexdeeda ah
en: Internal communication at the workplace

so: Inta dabdan dhacdooyinka soo socda iyo wixii is bedelo cusub ah waxaa lagu sheegaa shirarka shaqada.
en: Usually information about forthcoming events and changes at a workplace is given at meetings.

so: Haddii aad shirarka ka qayb gashid, waxaad saamayn ku yeelan karta aarimaha la xiriira shaqada, waxaad soo jeedin kartaa in is bedelo iyo horumarin lagu sameeyo goobtaada shaqada.
en: Attending meetings gives you a chance to influence matters, suggest changes and develop your work.

so: Sidoo kale goob shaqo kastaa waxay leedahay kanaalo wargalineed oo daakhili ah, horayna loogu heshiiyey, looxa ogeysiisyada, e-mailada ama qaanado boostada loogu rido shaqaalaha.
en: Every workplace also has other appointed channels of internal communication, such as notice boards, e-mail or mail boxes assigned for employees.

so: La soco Wargelinta goobtaada shaqada.
en: Follow the communications at your workplace.

so: Heshiiska shaqada waxaa inta badan ku qoran, goorma iyo intee le'eg oo biririf ayaa maalintii la qaadanayaa inta shaqada lagu jiro.
en: Often a contract of employment gives information about when breaks occur during a working day and how long they are.

so: Inta badan subixii waxaa la qaataa biririf kafee oo gaaban. Duhurkiina biririfka qadada iyo galabtii oo la qaato biririfta labaad ee kafeega.
en: Often there is a short coffee break in the morning, a lunch break in the middle of the day and another coffee break in the afternoon.

so: Dhirirka biririfta la qato waxay ku xiran tahay hadba goobta shaqada.
en: The length of a lunch break varies according to workplace.

so: Biririfaha dhirirkooda waa inaad horay u sii weydiisaa qofka madaxda kuu ah.
en: It is a good idea to check the length of the breaks with your supervisor.

so: Meelaha shaqaaluhu ka cunteeyaan waxaa loo abaabulaa siyaabo kala duwan kuna hadba goobta shaqada:
en: Eating during breaks is arranged in different ways at different workplaces:

so: Goobaha shaqooyinka qaarkood waxay leeyihiin meelo laga cunteeyo oo shaqaalaha u gaara, qaarna shaqaalaha ayaa gurigooda ka soo qaata cuntada.
en: some have their own canteen, while at others employees bring their own food from home.

so: Meelaha qaarkoodna shaqaalaha waxaa la siiyaa tigidho ay qiimo jaban wax uga cunaan meelaha laga cunteeyo ee u dhaw goobaha shaqada.
en: At some workplaces, employees can buy affordable lunch vouchers that can be used at restaurants close to the workplace.

so: Inta badan shaqo lama qabto waqtiga qadada.
en: People do not usually work during lunch.

so: Qabsashada hawlaha kuu gaarka ah inta laguda jiro waqtiga shaqada
en: Taking care of personal business during a working day

so: Inta waqtiga shaqada lagu guda jiro lama qabsan karo wax adiga kuu gaar ah, ee waa'inaad qabsataa waqtiyada ka baxsan waqtiga shaqada.
en: It is not permitted to take care of personal affairs during working hours; instead, they have to be dealt with outside working hours.

so: Heshiiska shaqada cadada saacadaha lagu heshiiyey maalintii in shaqo la qabto waa waajib in la dhawro mudan, sidaas darteed saacadihii lagu heshiiyey waa in la sameeyaa.
en: The number of working hours agreed upon in the contract of employment is binding and the agreed-upon hours have to be performed.

so: Waa suurtagal in waqtiga nasashada la qabsado tusaale ahaan telefoonada muhiimka ah.
en: During a break, you can make, for example, important personal calls.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale codsan kartaa fasaxa mushaar la'aan ah haddii ay xaaladdu dooneyso in waqti dheer laga maqnaado goobta shaqada.
en: You can also apply for unpaid time off, if the situation requires a longer absence from work.

so: Haddii sababo jira awgood aad tusaale ahaan dhakhtarka waqti kale oo ka baxsan waqtiyada shaqada ka weydo, kala hadal maqnaanshaha aaditaanka dhaktarka qofka madaxda kuu ah kalana heshii sidii aad dib uga gudi lahayd.
en: If for some reason you cannot, for example, get a doctor's appointment outside working hours, negotiate with your supervisor about your absence and make an agreement about a way to compensate for the time you will be at the doctor's.

so: Daryeelka caafimaadka shaqada waxaad tegi kartaa xilliga shaqada.
en: You can visit occupational health care during working hours.

so: Inkastoo qofka shaqaalaha ahi markuu shaqada imaanayey uu lahaa xirfadii iyo waxbarashadii looga baahnaa shaqada, hadana shaqobixiyayaal farabadan waxay shaqaalaha ku dhiirageliyaan inay waxbarasho dheeraad ah qaataan.
en: Even if an employee already has the required training for the occupation when they start work, many employers encourage their employees to acquire additional training.

so: Inta badan waxaa tababarka la tagaa waqtiga shaqada, shaqo-bixiyuhuna lacag ayuu ka bixin karaa tababarka.
en: Often it is possible to attend training programmes during working hours, and an employer may pay for the training.

so: Shaqobixiyaasha intooda badan aad ayey u qiimeeyaan in qofka shaqaalaha ah uu horumariyo xirfadiisa shaqo uuna barto waxyaabo cusub intii uusan bilaabin.
en: Most employers appreciate their employee's desire to advance in their occupation and to learn new skills.

so: Sida caadiga ah goobaha shaqada la iskuma siiyo hadiyadaha.
en: Usually presents are not given at the workplace.

so: Laakiin waxaa jira maalmo muhiim ah (maalinta dhalashada, guurka, malinta hawlabag gelida) sida badan maalmahaas asxaabta shaqada iyo shaqo-bixiyuhu waxay qofka maalintaas u dabaadagay ku xasuustaan oo siiyaan hadiyad yar ama xirmo ubax ah.
en: However, on special days (birthdays, marriage, retirement) workmates and the employer usually give a small present or bouquet of flowers to the person whose special day it is.

so: Waqtiga shaqada iyo fasaxyada
en: Working hours and holidays

so: Shaqo-maalmeedka caadiga ah waxey inta badan qaadataa siddeed saacadood.
en: A normal working day usually lasts eight hours.

so: Shaqaaluhu wuxuu sidoo kale shaqo-bixiyaha kula heshiin karaa waqti shaqo oo nooc kale ah.
en: An employee can also agree with their employer on different working hours.

so: Finland waxey ka tahay wax caadi ah in shaqaaluhu aysan shaqo dheeraad ah sameynin.
en: In Finland, employees usually do not work a lot of overtime.

so: Shaqada la qabto waa tan ku qoran heshiiska shaqada.
en: People work the hours agreed on in their employment contract.

so: Dalka Finland xiliga fasaxyadu waxay bilowdaan bisha May bilowgeeda.
en: In Finland, the holiday season begins at the beginning of May.

so: Fasaxa uu qofka shaqaalaha ah helayo wuxuu ku xiran yahay hadba inta sano uu shaqaynayey iyo waqtiga heshiiska shaqadu uu bilowday.
en: The number of holidays an employee is entitled to depends on the number of years the employee has worked and when the contract of employment has started.

so: Fasaxa mushaariga ah ka sokow waxaad codsan kartaa fasax mushaar la'aan ah.
en: In addition to paid holidays, you can apply for unpaid leave.

so: Waqtiyada fasaxa ee Finland waa kuwo dheer marka loo barbardhigo wadamada kale.
en: In Finland, holidays are long compared to many other countries.

so: Fiicnaanshada iyo waxyaabaha lagu raaxeysto goobta shaqada
en: Well-being at work and work-related recreation

so: Goobo badan oo shaqada waxaa shaqaalaha laga caawiyaa sidii ay shaqada u awoodi lahaayeen uguna raaxaysan lahaayeen goobta shaqada, sidaas darteed waxaa loo qabtaa maalmo gooni ah oo la siiyo nashaadaad kala duwan iyo haflado loo qabto.
en: Many workplaces want to support their employees' well-being and happiness at work by arranging different kinds of recreational days and workplace celebrations.An employer may also offer employees various opportunities for leisure activities.

so: Finland waxaa ka jira maalmo cayiman oo fasax ah.
en: Some days are public holidays in Finland.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan maalmahan ka sii aqri bogga Xafladaha ciidda ee Finnishka.
en: Read more about these days on the InfoFinland page Finnish holidays.

so: Goobaha shaqooyinka qaarkood sida isbitaalada waxaa laga shaqeeyaa maalmaha ciidaha.
en: At some work places, hospitals for example, these public holidays are also working days.

so: Waqtiyada ciidaha waxaa shaqaalaha laga siiyaa mushaar la dalacay.
en: Employees are paid a higher salary for the holidays during which they work.

so: Ka hubi shuruudda heshiiska shaqadaada magdhawga.
en: Check from your collective agreement what the compensation for working during the holidays is.

so: Finland waxaa aad looga qadariyaa daacadnimada, ku imaanshaha waqtiga iyo sinnaanta.
en: Honesty, punctuality and equality are appreciated in Finland.

so: Kani waxaa lagu arkaa dhammaan dhaqamada Finnishka, xittaa noloshada shaqada.
en: This shows in all Finnish culture, including working life.

so: Boggan waxaa lagu sheegayaa dhaqanka shaqada Finnishka.
en: This page describes Finnish working culture.

so: Sharciyada iyo heshiisyada nolosha shaqada
en: Laws and agreements on working life

so: Nolosha shaqada ee Finnishka waxaa ku jira xeerar badan, kuwaas oo ay qasab tahay in shaqaalaha iyo shaqo-bixiyuhuba ay u hoggaansamaan.
en: Finnish working life has many rules that the employee and employer must follow.

so: Sharciga degsan iyo heshiiska shuruudaha shaqada ayaa qeexaya tusaale ahaan mushaarka ugu hooseeya, wakhtiyada shaqada, fasaxyada, mushaaraadka wakhtiga jirrada iyo shuruudaha ruqsaynta ama shaqo ka eryidda.
en: The legislation and collective agreements determine, for example, minimum wages, working hours, holidays, sick pay and the terms of dismissal.

so: Shaqo-bixiyuhu wuxuu mararka qaar shaqaalaha ka codsan karaa in uu qabto shaqo dheeraad ah.
en: Sometimes, the employer may ask the employee to work overtime.

so: Sida u sharcigu qabo, shaqo-bixiyuhu waa in uu mushaar la kordhiyay ka bixiyaa shaqada dheeraadka ah.
en: According to law, the employer must pay supplemented wages for overtime.

so: Magdhow ahaan waxaad sidoo kale u helaa kartaa fasax.
en: You can also get compensated as time off work.

so: Xaq ayaad u leedahay in aad diiddo shaqada dheeraadka ah.
en: You have the right to refuse to work overtime.

so: Macluumaadka xuquuqda iyo waajibaadka shaqaalaha ee Finland waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga InfoFinland Xuquuqda iyo waajibaadka shaqaalaha.
en: More information on the rights and obligations of employees in Finland is available on the InfoFinland page Employee's rights and obligations.

so: Aqoontaada luqadeed waxaad ku horumarin kartaa dhigashada koorasyada ama shaqada.
en: You can improve your language skills in courses or on the job.

so: Ku dhiiro in aad asxaabtaada kula hadasho Finnish ama Iswidhish.
en: Do not hesitate to speak Finnish or Swedish with your co-workers.

so: Warar dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan barashada luqada ka sii akhri qeybta InfoFinland Luqada Finnishka iyo Iswidishka.
en: Read more about studying languages on the InfoFinland page Finnish and Swedish.

so: Sinnaanta iyo caddaalada shaqada
en: Equality and equal opportunities in working life

so: Sida uu qabo sharciga Finland, nooc kasta oo takoor ah waa ka mamnuuc goobaha shaqada.
en: According to Finnish law, all kinds of discrimination at workplaces is prohibited.

so: Shaqo-bixiyuhu waa in uu ka taxadiraa in cadaaladda iyo sinnaanta jinsiyadu ay ka hirgalaan goobta shaqada.
en: Employers must ensure that there is equality and equal opportunities for men and women at the workplace.

so: Goobaha shaqada ee Finnishka shaqobixiyuhu marwalba ma koontaroolo shaqo qabashada qof shaqaale ah.
en: At Finnish workplaces, supervisors do not monitor their employees' work continually.

so: Shaqaalaha waxaa la weydiiyaa aragtidood, aragtidoodana waxaa lagu dartaa xisaabta marka shaqada la qorsheynayo.
en: Employers ask for their employees' opinions and these are taken into account in job planning.

so: Sida badan qaybsiga shaqada waxaa looga heshiiyaa shirarka guud wixii lagu heshiiyeyna waa in la fuliyaa.
en: Work is usually arranged and agreed on at common meetings and jointly agreed matters are adhered to.

so: Qofka madaxda ahi wuxuu shaqaalaha u dhiibaa shaqooyinka, qaabkii uu u qaban lahaana waxaa loo daayaa oo go'aan ka qaata qofka shaqaalaha ah.
en: A supervisor gives an employee their tasks and expects the employee to decide on the details of the work independently.

so: Haddii uu qofku aqoon waayo sidii uu shaqada u qaban lahaa ama uu qaban kari waayo wuxuu si toos ah hagitaan waydiisaan karaa shaqaalaha kale ama madaxdiisa.
en: If an employee does not know how to perform the given task or cannot do it, they ask their co-workers or the supervisor directly for instructions.

so: Aaminaada iyo dhawrida jadwalka shaqada
en: Reliability and observing timetables

so: Dhaqanka shaqada ee Finnishka waxaa muhiim ah in la ilaaliyo wixii lagu heshiiyey.
en: In Finnish working culture, it is important to adhere to the things that have been agreed upon.

so: Haddii waxa la wada go'aansado, shaqaalaha iyo shaqo-bixiyuhuba waxay u qaadanayaan in qof kastaa qabanayo wixii lagu heshiiyey.
en: When something has been decided together, the employees and employer assume that everyone will do what has been decided.

so: Finlad waxaa muhiim ah in la ilaaliyo waqtiga.
en: Observing timetables is also important in Finland.

so: Shaqada waa in la yimaadaa waqtigii lagu heshiiyey oo go'an.
en: You must arrive at work promptly at the agreed-upon time.

so: Daahidu waa ixtiraam la'aan, sababtoo ah dadka kale waxay ku qasban yihiin inay sugaan qofka soo daahay.
en: Being late is impolite because other people have to wait for the one who is late.

so: Haddii aad og tahay inaad soo daahayso u sii sheeg daahidaada qofka madaxda kuu ah.
en: If you know that you will be late for work, tell your supervisor about it.

so: Shaqooyin badan ayaa waxay leeyihiin waqti soo gelid shaqo oo u dhaxaysa 7–9 iyo ka bixid shaqo 15–17 inta u dhaxaysa.
en: Many workplaces have adopted flexible working hours which means that you can come to work, for example, between 7 and 9 and leave between 15 and 17.

so: Haddii shaqadaadu ay sidaan dambe oo kale tahay, qofka shaqaalaha ah asagaa si fiican ugu taxadaraya inuu shaqeeyo waqtigii loogu talogalay oo ku waafaqsan heshiiska shaqada.
en: If a workplace uses flexible working hours, employees themselves have to make sure that they work for the length of time that has been agreed upon.

so: Finnishku si toos ah ayey u hadlaan, toos u hadliduna maaha xushmad daro.
en: Finns usually speak out, and speaking out is not considered impolite in Finland.

so: Hadalka tooska ah waa ka caadi goobaha shaqada ee Finnishka.
en: Saying what you mean is also normal in working life.

so: Haddii tusaale ahaan waqtigu uusan ku filnayn in shaqada lagu dhameeyo, waxaa wanaagsan in si toos ah loogu sheego qofka madaxda ah.
en: For example, if you do not have enough time to complete a task, it is best to say so to your supervisor.

so: Shirarka iyo wada tashiyada waxaa si toos ah loo abaaraa ajandaha marka la is nabdeeyo kadib.
en: At meetings, the usual procedure is to get straight to the point after greeting everybody.

so: Habka la isula hadlo ee dhaqanka shaqada ee Finnishku waa mid aan rasmi aheyn.Goobo shaqo oo badan waxey dhammaan shaqaaluhu isugu yeeraan magaca koowaad iyagoo aan eegeyn derajada.
en: In Finnish working culture, the form of address is very informal. At most workplaces, all employees address each other using first names regardless of their position.

so: Saamaynta diintu ay ku leedahay shaqada
en: The effect of religion on working life

so: Dad badan oo Finnish ah waa Kirishtaan laakiin ma ahan dad aad diinta ugu dheggan.
en: However, many Christian customs are still observed in Finnish culture.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Xaflad-ciideedyada Finland.
en: Read more on InfoFinland page Finnish holidays.

so: Caadooyinka iyo dhaqamada diiniga ah shaqo kuma leh goobaha shaqaga ee dalkan Finland.Goobaha shaqada qaarkood waxaa laga sameeyaa meelo lagu tukado, haddii shaqaaluhu ay sidaas dalbadaan.
en: Religious customs or rituals do not belong at a Finnish workplace. Some places of work have arranged a place for praying, if employees have asked for one.

so: Laakiin arin guud ahaaneed maaha.
en: However, most workplaces do not provide for such practices.

so: Haddii qofka shaqaalaha ahi doono tusaale ahaan inuu waqtiga shaqada dhexdiisa tukado, waa inuu tukadaa waqtiyada biririfta.
en: If an employee wants to take a moment, for example, for prayer in the middle of a working day, this must take place in connection with the agreed-upon breaks.

so: Calaamadaha kore oo sheegaya diimaha sida marax daboolida waa la ogol yahay, laakiin waa in la ilaaliyaa sharciga goobta shaqada u yaal dhar xirashada.
en: Signs of religions in outward appearance, such as head scarves, are permitted in Finland, but operative rules on working clothes have to be observed.

so: Tan waxaa sabab u ah sharciyada la xiriira nabadgelyada shaqada iyo fayadhowrka.
en: This is due to task-related work safety and hygiene decrees.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan qiyamyada iyo caadooyinka Finnishka bogga Hab-dhaqanka Finnishka.
en: You can read more about the values and customers of Finnish society on the page Finnish customs.

so: Wixii dheeraad ah oo la xiriira xanaano maalmeedka carruurta, waxbarashada iskuulka ka horeysa iyo waxbarashada aasaasiga ah ka akhriso bogga InfoFinland: Waxbarashada carruurta.
en: Read more about day care, pre-primary education and comprehensive education on the InfoFinland page Child education.

so: Nidaamka hawlgabka ee Finland
en: The Finnish pension system

so: Waddanka Finland waxaa ka jira laba nidaam oo hawlgab ah oo sharciga ku salaysan oo midba midka kale dhammaystiro:
en: Finland has two pension systems which complement each other:

so: Hawlgabka shaqada (työeläkkeet) hawlgabka noocan ah qofku wuxuu ku heli karaa inuu ka shaqeeyo shaqooyin mushaar lagu qaato ama uu ganacsade yahay.
en: Earnings-related pension is earned by your paid work and entrepreneurial activities.

so: Shaqo-bixiyaha waxaa waajib ku ah inuu shaqaalihiisa oo dhan geliyo caymiska hawlgabka, uuna bixiyo kharashka caymiska.
en: It is the responsibility of an employer to take out a retirement pension insurance policy for all their employees and to pay the insurance premiums.

so: Hawlgabka qaranka iyo kan damaanada (kansaneläkkeet ja takuueläke) waxaa loogu talagalay dadka hawlgabka ah ee aan lahayn hawlgabka shaqada ama caddadka hawlgabkooda shaqadu yar yahay.
en: An entrepreneur takes care of their own insurance premiums. National pensions and guarantee pensions are meant for those pensioners who have no earnings-related pension or whose pension is very small.

so: Labada nidaam ee hawlgabkuba waxay leeyihiin nooca hawlgabka waayeelka iyo nooca hawlgabka awood la'aanta shaqo.
en: Both pension systems include old-age pension and disability pension.

so: Waxaad heli kartaa hawlgabka bulshada, haddi aad buuxisay 65 sano.
en: You will be eligible to receive a national pension once you have turned 65.

so: Da'da aad jirto markaad lacagta hawlgabka heleysid waxay ku xirantahay hadba sannadka aad dhalatay.
en: The age at which you can receive earnings-related pension depends on your year of birth.

so: Ka fiiri da'da hawlgabkaaga nuqulka waraaqaha hawlgabka shaqada ama xafiiskaaga arrimaha hawlgabka.
en: Check your pension age in your pension record or with your pension institution.

so: Qofka aan shaqada awoodin xanuun awgiis wuxuu heli karaa hawlgabka awood la'aanta shaqo kan hawlgabka waayeelnimada ka hor.
en: A person who is incapable of work may receive disability pension before their old-age pension begins.

so: Qofka hawlgabka ah wuxuu sameyn karaa shaqo haddii uu doonayo.
en: A pensioner can also work, if he/she so chooses to do.

so: Haddii aad ku jirto hawlgabka waayeelka, shaqada waxa kaa soo gala saameyn kuma lahan cadada lacagta hawlgabka ee lagu siiyo.
en: If you are on old-age pension, your earned income will not have an effect on the amount of pension you receive.

so: Finland lacagta hawglabka waxaa laga bixiyaa Canshuur.
en: In Finland pensions are taxable income.

so: Shaqo-bixiyayaasha iyo shaqaaluhuba waxay wadajir u maalgelinayaan ammaanka hawlgabka shaqada.
en: The employer collects their employees' contribution from their pay and renders this and their own share of the insurance fee to the pension institution.

so: Caddadka uu le'eg yahay hawlgabka shaqadu wuxuu ku xiran yahay, hadba dhirirka waqtiga aad shaqayneysay in uu le'eg yahay iyo sidoo kale caddadka mushaarka aad qaadatay inta uu le'eg yahay.
en: The amount of earnings-related pension depends on how long you have worked and how high your salary has been.

so: Shirkadaha caymiska hawlgabka shaqada, qasnadaha hawlgabka iyo mu'asassooyinka ayaa maamula hawlaha caymiska hawlgabka shaqada.
en: Earnings-related pension companies, pension funds and pension foundations manage earning-related pensions.

so: Xarunta badbaadada hawlgabka (Etk) waxay si gooni ah u qabataa arrimaha la xiriira hawlaha badbaadada hawlgabka.
en: The Finnish Centre for Pensions (ETK) takes care of issues related to pension security in a centralised manner.

so: Hawlgabka kuu aruuray ka fiiri nuqulka waraaqaha hawlgabka shaqada
en: Check your accumulated pension from your pension record

so: Hay'addaada hawlgabka ayaa hadba waqti cayiman gudihiis kuu soo diraysa macluumaadka hawlgabka kuu aruuray.
en: Your pension institution will send you a pension record at regular intervals.

so: Macluumaadka ku qoran waraaqda hawlgabka shaqada ayaad ka arki karaysaa qiyaastii hawlgabka kuu aruuray inta uu le'eg yahay.
en: The record presents an estimate of how much pension you have accumulated.

so: Sidoo kale waxaad xaafiiskaaga hawlgabka shaqada ama xarunta badbaadada hawlgabka ka dalban kastaa inuu kuu soo diro nuqulka waraaqaha hawlgabka shaqada.
en: You can also order a pension record from your pension institution or the Finnish Centre for Pensions.

so: Adigu nuqulka waraaqaha hawlgabka kala soco in halgabka kuu aruuray loo xisaabiyey si sax ah.
en: Keep an eye on the accumulated pension in your pension record to ensure that it has been calculated correctly.

so: Haddii macluumaadka ay ku jiraan wax khalad ah, la xiriir xaafiiskaaga hawlgabka shaqada ama xarunta badbaadada hawlgabka.
en: If there is an error in the information, contact your pension institution or the Finnish Centre for Pensions.

so: U xafid shahaadooyinka shaqada wax kahubin awgeed.
en: Keep any testimonials of service for verification.

so: Dakhliga howlgabka bulshada iyo dakhliga howlgabka guud
en: National pension and guarantee pension

so: Waxad dalban kartaa dakhliga howlgabka marka aynan kaaga ururin shaqadaada lacag ku filan dakhli howlgab, ama haddii lacagta kuu ururtay ay aad u yartahay.
en: You can apply for national pension if you have not accumulated earnings-related pension or if it is very small.The amount of national pension is affected by how long you have lived or worked in Finland.

so: Kelada ayaa maamusha hawlgabka bulshada iyo damaanad-qaadyada hawlgabka.
en: Kela handles national pensions and guarantee pensions.

so: Waad codsan kartaa kawlgabka iyo damaanad-qaadka hawlgabka, haddii aad ku jirto xayndaabka Ammaanka bulshada ee Finlanduomen aadana Finland deganeyn ugu yaraan 3 sano kadib markii aad buuxisay 16 sano.
en: You can apply for national pension and guarantee pension if you are covered by Finnish social security and have resided in Finland for at least 3 years since you turned 16.

so: Sidoo kale waqtigii, aad ku nooleyd wadan kale oo wadamada EU:da- ama ETA:da ka tirsan,waa la tixgelinayaa qayb ahaan.
en: The time you have lived in another EU or EEC country may also be partially considered.

so: Damaanad-qaadka hawlgabku wuxuu qofka hawlagbka ah u damaanadqaadayaa inta ugu yar ee lagu noolaado.
en: Guarantee pension provides pensioners with minimum livelihood.

so: Damaanad-qaadka hawlgabka waxaa laga bixiyaa marka la kala jaro hawlgabyada kale ee ku soo gala iyo damaanad-qaadka hawlgabka.
en: The amount of guarantee pension you will receive is the difference between the other pensions you might receive and the full guarantee pension.

so: Haddii hawlgabyadaada kale marka la isku xisaabiyo ay ka badan yihiin cadada damaanad-qaadka hawlgabka, ma heli kartid damaanad-qaadka hawlgabka.
en: If the sum total of your other pensions is more that the full guarantee pension, you are not eligible for guarantee pension.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan damaanad-qaadka hawlgabka waxaad ka heleysaa Kelada.
en: More information on guarantee pension is available at Kela.

so: Xaaladaha qaarkood waxaad sidoo kale hawlgabka qaranka heli kartaa ka hor inta aadan buuxin 65 sano.
en: In some cases, you can also receive a national pension before turning 65.

so: Kelada ayaad ka heleysaa wixii macluumaad dheeri ah ee la xiriira hawlgabka qaranka ee la soo hormariyey iyo maalmaha dheeraadka ah ee hawlgabka qaranka.
en: More information on early national pension and additional days related to national pension can be obtained from Kela.

so: Dakhliyada howlgabka oo dhan waa in la dalbadaa.
en: All pensions must be applied for.

so: Waxad ka isla dalab ku dalban kartaa dakhliga howlgabka ee guud iyo ka bulshada.
en: You can apply for earnings-related and national pension with the same application form.

so: Waxad ku buuxin kartaa dalabka internetka waxanad gayn kartaa xafiis kasta oo ay Keladu leedahay, goob kasta oo shaqo oo ay ka tirsan carunta shaqo gabista ama Xarunta Ammaanka Shaqogabista.
en: You can fill in the form online or deliver it to any Kela office, the service point of an authorised pension provider or to the Finnish Centre for Pensions.

so: Goobaha adeegyadaas iyo shabakada internetka ayaad ka heli kartaa warqadaha dalabka dakhliyadaas.
en: Application forms are available in the service points and on the websites of the same.

so: Dakhliga howlgabka ee guud waxad ka dalban kartaa adeegga shabakada internetka ee Kelada ama xafiiska Kelada.
en: You can apply for guarantee pension using the online service of Kela or by visiting a Kela office.

so: Dakhliga howlgabka waayeelnimada ee Kelada iyo dakhliga howlgabka ee guud waxad sidoo kale ku dalban kartaa taleefan.
en: You can also apply for old-age pension and guarantee pension by calling Kela.

so: Lambarka u adeegga arrimaha howlgabnimada ee Keladu waa 020 692 202.
en: Kela's customer service number for pension matters is 020 692 202.

so: Haddii aad deganeyd ama aad ka shaqeyn jirtay Finland ka sokoow wadamo kale oo Midowga Yurub ah ama wadamada ay Finland la leedahay heshiishka ammaanka bulshada, waxaad xaq u yeelan kartaa inaad ka hesho lacagtahawlgab kuwaas.
en: If you have resided or worked in other EU countries or in countries with which Finland has a social security agreement, you might be eligible to receive pension from these countries.

so: Wadamadan waxaad ka codsan kartaa hawlgabka islamarka aad codsaneyso hawglabka shaqada ama dadka ee Finnishka.
en: You can apply for pension from these countries at the same time as you apply for Finnish earnings-related or national pension.

so: Ku lifaaq codsigaada foomka goonida ee Degista iyo ka shaqeynta dibadda.
en: Attach to your application a separate form Residence and Employment Abroad.

so: Foomka waxaad ka daabacan kartaa bogagga shabakadda Kelada ama kan Xarunta badbaadada hawlgabka.
en: You can print the form at the website of Kela or the Finnish Centre for Pensions.

so: Haddii aad ka shaqeysay wadamo aysan Finland la laheyn heshiiska ammaanka bulshada, waa inaad adigu cadeysaa inaad ka heli karto wadamadaas hawlgabka.
en: If you have worked in a country with which Finland does not have a social security agreement, you must find out for yourself if you are eligible to receive pension from that country.

so: Haddii helitaanka hawlgabku uu suurtagal yahay waa inaad adigu codsataa.
en: If you are entitled to receive pension, you must apply for it yourself.

so: Xarunta ammaanka hawlgabka ayaa talo kaa siineysa haddii aad dibadda hawlgabka ka codsaneyso.
en: The Finnish Centre for Pension will give you advice for applying for pension abroad.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogagga shabakadda Xarunta ammaanka hawlgabka.
en: Read more on the website of the Finnish Centre for Pension.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale talo weydiin kartaa Kelada.
en: You can also ask for advice at Kela.

so: Hawlgabka shaqada ee dibadda
en: Earnings-related pension paid abroad

so: Haddii ad ka guurto Finland, waxa lagu siinayaa lacagta kuuga ururtay mishaarkaaga ee loogu talogalay wakhtiga howlgabka, marka ad da'daas gaadho.
en: If you leave Finland, you will be paid earnings-related pension accrued in Finland when you reach retirement age.

so: Lacagtaas waxa lagugu siin karaa waddan kasta oo ad joogto.
en: Earnings-related pension can be paid to any country.

so: Waxa muhiim ah inaad shahaado shaqo ka haysato dhamman shaqooyinkii aad Finland ka soo qabatay.
en: It is important that you have a testimonial of service for each contract of employment you have had in Finland.

so: Sida aad u lacagta hawlgabka dibadda uga dalbaneysid, waxay ku xirantahay hadba wadanka aad markaas ku nooshahay.
en: The way in which you should apply for pension to be paid abroad depends on your country of residence.

so: Waxaad talooyin weydiin kartaa xaruntaada hawlgabka ama Xarunta badbaadada hawlgabka.
en: You can contact your pension institution or the Finnish Centre for Pensions for advice.

so: Inta aadan dalban lacagta hawlgabka weydiiso xaruntaada hawlgabka ama Xarunta badbaadaada hawlgabka nuqulka waraagaha hawlgabka shaqada.
en: Before applying for pension, request a pension record from your pension institution or the Finnish Centre for Pensions.

so: Nuqulka waraaqaha hawlgabka shaqada waxaad ka arkeysaa, inta hawlgabka Finland kaaga aruuray uu dhan yahay.
en: The pension record indicates how much pension you have accumulated in Finland.

so: Hawlgabka Kelada ee dibadda lagu bixiyo
en: Kela pensions paid abroad

so: Ogeysii markasta Kelada haddii aad si joogto ah dibadda ugu guureyso ama aad joogeyso dibadda wax kabadan saddex bilood.
en: Always notify Kela if you move abroad permanently or reside in a foreign country for more than three months.

so: Haddii aad dibadda si ku meelgaar ah u joogeyso, yacni wax kayar sanad, Keladu inta badan si caadi ah ayeey u bixineysaa hawlgabkaada.
en: If your residence abroad is temporary, i.e. less than one year, Kela will usually continue to pay your pension normally.

so: Xaaladaha qaarkood marka lagu jiro Keladu waxay ku bixisaa tusaale ahaan hawlgabka qoyska iyo waayeelka wadamada qaarkood xitaa haddii halkaas aad u guurto wax sanad ka badan.
en: In some cases Kela may continue to pay for example old-age and family pension to some countries even if you move there for more than a year.

so: Wadamadaas waa tusaale ahaan wadamada kale ee Midowga Yurub, ETA iyo wadamada ay Finland la gashay heshiiska ammaanka bulshada.
en: These countries include for example other EU and EEA member states and some of the countries with which Finland has a social security agreement.

so: Damaanad-qaadka hawlgabka lama bixiyo haddii aad dibadda u guurto wax ka badan sanad.
en: Guarantee pension will not be paid if you move abroad for more than a year.

so: Bogagga shabakadda Kelada waxaa ku jira macluumaad ka hadlaya marka aad hawlgabka Kelada dibadda ku heli karto.
en: Kela website contains further information on incidences when you can receive Kela pensions abroad.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale xafiiska Kelada ama adeegga telefoonka weydiin kartaa xaaladaada.
en: You can also ask about your situation at a Kela office or telephone service.

so: Hawlgabk da'da ee qayb ahaanta la soo hormariyey
en: Partial early old-age pension

so: Haddii aad buuxisey 61 sano, waxaad qayb ahaan noqon kartaa hawlgab ka hor inta aadan gaarin da'da ugu hooseysa ee hawlgabka da'da lagu noqon karo.
en: If you have turned 61, you can enter partial retirement before your minimum old-age pension age.

so: Tan waxaa loogu yeeraa da'da hawlgabka oo qayb ahaan la soo hormariyey.
en: This arrangement is called partial early old-age pension.

so: Adiga ayaa go'aan ka gaaraya in lacagta hawlgabka bishiiba laagaa siinayo 25 % ama 50 % .
en: You can choose whether to receive 25% of 50% of your monthly earning-related pension amount.

so: Haddii aad dooneysid, waxaad si caadi ah u sii wadi kartaa shaqada oo maalintii oo dhan ah ama shaqo bixiyahaaga ayaad heshiin kartaa inaad waqti gaab shaqayso.
en: If you wish, you can continue working full-time or agree upon shorter working hours with your employer.

so: Sidoo kale shaqada waad iska joojin kartaa.
en: You can also stop working altogether.

so: Ogow, in hawlgabka da'da ee qayb ahaanta la soo hormariyey uu si rasmi ah u yareynayo caddadka hawlgabka shaqadaada.
en: Please note that the partial early old-age pension will permanently reduce the ultimate amount of your old-age pension.

so: Wixii dheeraad ah weydii xaruntaada hawlgabka.
en: Ask your pension institution for more information.

so: Haddii ad muddo dheer xanuunsato, waxad sida caadiga ah helaysaa sanadka ugu horeeya lacagta nololmaalmeedka xanuunka.
en: If you are ill for a long time, you will normally receive sickness allowance for about a year.

so: Haddii xanuunka ama jiisnimo owgeed anad ugu noqon karin shaqo, waxad dalbankartaa dakhliga howlgabka ee qofka awood beel shaqo ay ku dhacday (työkyvyttömyyseläke) ama dakhliga qofka shaqo beelay laakiin dib loo toobabarayo (kuntoutustuki).
en: If you cannot return to work due to an illness or injury, you can apply for disability pension (työkyvyttömyyseläke) or rehabilitation subsidy ( kuntoutustuki).

so: Dakhliga qofka awood shaqo beelay laakiin dib loo toobabarayo waa dakhli kamid ah dakhliyada awood beelka shaqo, waana mid wakhti cayiman ah.
en: Rehabilitation subsidy is a fixed-term disability pension. Apply for disability pension with a form available from Kela.

so: Dalabkaaga waa in aad ku lifaaqdaa warbixin dhakhtar oo ah nooca B. Kelada iyo xarunta dakhliyada shaqogabka ayaa cabiraya un ad awooddo in aad shaqayso iyo in ad haysato caawimaad kugu filana oo kaa saacidaya dib u toobabar.
en: Kela and your authorised pension provider will evaluate whether you are fit for work and whether you would benefit from rehabilitation.

so: Warbixin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan dakhliga qofka awood beel shaqo ay ku dhacday iyo dakhliga qofka dib u toobobar ay ku socotaba waxad ka heli kartaa Kelada, hay'addaada hawlgabka shaqada ama daryeelka caafimaad ee goobtaada shaqada.
en: Further information on disability pension and rehabilitation subsidy is available from Kela, your pension institution or from your occupational health care provider.

so: Haddii ad qaadanayso dakhliga qofka ay ku dhacday awood beel shaqo, mishaarkaagaa dakhligaas saamaynaya.
en: If you are on disability pension, your earned income will affect the amount of pension you receive.

so: U sheeg Kelada iyo xarunta dakhliyada shaqogabka haddii ad shaqotagto.
en: Notify Kela and your authorised pension provider if you go to work.

so: Haddii mishaarkaagu uu yahay mid kuus ah bishii, waxad nasin kartaa dakhliga awoodgabka.
en: If your earned income per month is sufficiently large, you can let your pension lie.

so: Taasi micneheedu waxa weeyaan in aad muddo ka qaadanayso fasax ah oo anad lacagtaas qaadanayn.
en: This means that you can take a break from collecting your pension.

so: Muddadaasi waxay noqon kartaa ugu yaraan saddex bilood ama ugu badnaan labo sano.
en: The break can be at least three months and at most two years long.

so: Muddada ad dakhligaas nasinayso ma waayaysid xaqqa ad ku helayso dakhliga awoodbeelka shaqada.
en: You will not lose your right to receive disability pension during the time that you let your pension lie.

so: Manfacyada kale ee hawlgabka la siiyo
en: Other benefits for pensioners

so: Waxaa hawlgabka dheer oo ay Keladu siin kartaa kuwa dakhligoodu yaryahay ee hawlgabka qaada kaalmada ijaarka.
en: In addition to pension, Kela may pay pensioners with low income housing allowance for pensioners.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan kaalmada ijraarka Kelada ee kuwa hawlgabka qaata kala soco bogagga shabakadda Kelada.
en: More information on housing allowance for pensioners is available on the Kela website.

so: Qofka waqti dheer jiran ama naafo ah waxay Keladu siin kartaa kaalmada daryeelka ee qofka hawlgabka qaata.
en: Kela may pay care allowance for pensioners for individuals with long-term illness or disabled people.

so: Markii aad hawlgab noqotid, waxaad heli kartaa qiimo-dhimista hawlgabka tusaale ahaan tareemada, diyaaraha iyo basaska dalka Finland.
en: After you have retired, you can receive pensioner discounts, for example, for train, plane and bus fares in Finland.

so: Xafiiska tigidhada ka hubi shuruudaha qiimo dhimista hawlgabka.
en: Check the conditions of pensioner discounts from a ticket office.

so: Waxad qiimo dhimis ka heli kartaa tusaale ahaan adeegyada jimicsiga iyo meelaha bandhigyada dhaqameed iyo wax lamid ah lagu qabto.
en: You can also receive pensioner discounts, for example, for recreational sports and cultural activities.

en: When you go to the TE Office take along

so: Dhammaan shahaadooyinka shaqada iyo waxbarashada
en: all your testimonials of service and study certificates

so: baasaboor ay ku taalo ruqsada daganaanshada dalka
en: a passport which shows your residence permit

so: Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada (TE-toimisto) wuxuu baarayaa macluumaadka aad siisay.
en: The TE Office will examine the information you have provided.

so: Lacagta badbaadada shaqo la'aanta waxaa lagu heli karaa shuruudo cayiman xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada ayaana baaraya in aad shuuruudaha buuxisay.
en: The unemployment benefit is subject to certain conditions, and the TE Office will determine whether the conditions are met in your situation.

so: Markaas kadibna Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada ayaa arinta qaraar ka soo saaraya una gudbinaya xaafiika bixinaya gunnada, sida qasnadda shaqo la'aanta ama Kelada.
en: The TE Office will then issue a statement about the matter to the authority paying the benefit, i.e. the unemployment fund or Kela.

so: Wixii talooyin ah oo la xiriira arimaha lacagta badbaadada shaqo la'aanta waxaad weydiinkartaa Xafiiskaaga shaqada iyo xoogsashada.
en: You can ask for advice on matters relating to unemployment benefit at your own TE Office.

so: Sidoo kele waxaad wici kartaa adeegga la talinta badbaadada shaqo la'aanta ee Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada:
en: You can also call the unemployment counselling services of the TE services:

so: Ka aqriso sidoo kale bogga InfoFinlandi: Kaalmada shaqo laawaha
en: Read also the InfoFinland web page: Unemployment benefit

so: Dalxiisidda, waxbarashada ama shaqada wakhtiga lagu jiro shaqo la'aanta
en: Holidaymaking, studying or working during unemployment

so: Haddii aad bilowdo shaqo ama waxbarasho adigoo shaqo la'aan ahaa, ogeysii Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada.
en: If you start working or studying while you are unemployed, please notify the TE Office.

so: Halkaas ayaa lagaaga sheegayaa siday waxyaabahaasi u saamayn karaan lacagtaada shaqo la'aanta.
en: They will advise you on how this will affect your unemployment benefit.

so: Haddii aad ku safrayso gudaha dalka ama dibadda ka taxadir in lagu heli karo.
en: If you travel in Finland or abroad, make sure you can be reached at all times.

so: Tusaale ahaan nambar telefoon ama cinwaan uga tag xafiiska shaqada una sheeg waqtiga aad fasaxa ku maqnaaneyso.
en: Leave, for example, your phone number and address at the TE Office and tell the staff how long you plan to stay at your travel destination.

so: Safar dibadda aad u aadeyso dartiis uma diidi kartid shaqo laguu fidiyay.
en: A trip abroad is not, however, an acceptable reason for turning down a job offered to you.

so: Haddii aad billowdo hawl ganacsi adigoo shaqo la'aan ah, waxaad 4ta bilood ee ugu horeysa heli kartaa manfaca shaqo la'aanta.
en: If you start business activities while you are unemployed, you may receive unemployment benefit for the first 4 months.

so: Waqti cayiman ayaad weyn kartaa xuquuqda helitaanka lacagta shaqo la'aanta, haddii shaqo la'aantaada ay sabab u tahay sabab aad adigu keentay.
en: You may lose your right to daily unemployment allowance for a prescribed time if your unemployment is due to a self-inflicted reason.

so: Karensi ayaad geli kartaa tusaale ahaan haddii:
en: This can happen, for example, if:

so: aadan dalban shaqo uu Xaafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashadu uu adiga kuu diray inaad dalbato
en: you do not apply for a job proposed to you by the TE Office

so: aadan qaadan shaqo lagu siiyey
en: you do not accept a job that is offered to you

so: aad shaqadaada uga tagtid sababo aan cuslayn
en: you resign from you work yourself without a solid reason.

so: Waqtiga karensigu wuxuu u dhexeeyaa 15 maalmood iyo 90 maalmood.
en: The qualifying period length varies from 15 to 90 days.

so: Dhirirka karensigu wuxuu ku xiran yahay hadba sababta karesiga keentay.
en: The length depends on the cause of the qualifying period.

so: Xaaladaha qaarkood waxaad ku weyn kartaa xuquuqda helitaanka lacagta badbaadada shaqo la'aanta ilaa waqti aan la cayimin.
en: In some cases, you may lose your right to unemployment benefit for the time being.

so: Shaqobixiyuhu wuxuu xuquuq u leeyahay:
en: An employer has the right to:

so: inuu hogaamiyo shaqada iyo inuu bixiyo hagitaano iyo awaamiir la xiriirta xagga hogaaminta shaqada
en: manage work and give instructions and regulations relating to work management

so: Inuu shaqada ka eryo shaqaalaha iyo inuu heshiiska shaqada burburiyo asagoon raacaayo sharciga heshiiska shaqada
en: dismiss and dissolve a contract of employment within the limits provided by law

so: inuu ilaaliyo sharciga iyo heshiisyada
en: observe the law, contracts and agreements

so: inuu ula dhaqmo shaqaala si sinnaan iyo caddaalad ah, asagoo aan u fiirineyn meesha ay ka soo jeedaan dhalasho ahaan, diintooda, jinsiyadooda lab ama dhadig mindna, da'dooda ama aragtida siyaasadooda dhanka ay u janjeerto
en: treat employees equally regardless of their origin, religion, sex, age or political views

so: inuu ka taxadaro nabadgelyada iyo caafimaadka shaqaalaha
en: look after their employees' safety and occupational health

so: inuu siiyo shaqaalaha qoraal cadaynaya shuruudaha ugu muhiimsan shaqadooda
en: provide their employees with a written account of the central conditions of work

so: inuu ka shaqeeyo hagaajinta jawiga goobta shaqada, sidii qofka shaqaalaha ahi uu shaqadiisa uga soo dhalaalilahaa una horumarin lahaa xirfadiisa shaqo
en: promote a good working environment, boost employees' performance in their work and contribute to their occupational development

so: Shaqobixiyuhu waa inuu ilaaliyaa shuruudaha heshiiska shaqada.
en: An employer must observe the collective agreement.

so: Tusaale ahaan ma bixin karo mushaar ka hooseeya kan lagu qeexay shuruudaha heshiiska shaqada.
en: For example, they cannot pay less remuneration than the agreement specifies.

so: Diiwaanka dakhligu waa kayd macluumaad oo ay shaqo-bixiyayaashu ku soo gudbiyaan mushaaraadka ay siiyeen shaqaalahooda.
en: The Incomes Register is a database in which employers report the salaries paid for their employees.

so: Wargelinta waa in la sameeyay ugu dambeyn shan maalmood kaddib bixinta mushaarka.
en: The information must be reported no later than five days after salary payment.

so: Macluumaadka waa in qaab elekterikaal ah diiwaanka dakhliga loogu diraa:
en: The information must be submitted to the Incomes Register electronically:

so: toos iyadoo la sii marayo nidaamka mushaarbixinta, haddii lagu dhisay iskuxir farsamo oo toos ugu gudbinaya diiwaanka dakhliga; ama
en: directly through the payment system if it has a built-in technical connection to the Incomes Register, or

so: adeegga danqabsashada ee diiwaanka dakhliga dhexdiisa, kaas oo aad ku geleysa aqoonsiga bangiga shabakadda ama agabyada kale ee la isugu caddeeyo qaab elekterikaal ah.
en: through the Incomes Register online service, which you can access using your online banking credentials or other means of electronic authentication.

so: Macluumaadka mushaarka waxaa foomka warqadda ah lagu soo gudbi karaa oo kaliya marka ay jirto xaalad gaar ah.
en: Salary information can be reported on a paper form only in special cases.

so: Warar dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan diiwaanka dakhliga iyo sameynta ogeysiinta ka aqri bogagga Diiwaanka dakhliga.
en: Read more about the Incomes Register and how to submit a report on the Incomes Register website.

so: Shaqobixiyuhu waa inuu shaqaalihiisa geliyaa caymiska shilalka shaqada (tapaturmavakuutus).
en: An employer must take out an accident insurance policy (tapaturmavakuutus) for their employees.

so: Waa in markasta oo heshiis shaqo la bilaabayo la sameeyo caymiska.
en: This must be done every time an employment contract begins.

so: Qofka shaqaalaha ahi wuxuu helayaa magdaw haddii shil ku dhaco asagoo shaqaynaya.
en: An employee may obtain compensation when an accident at work has taken place.

so: Magdhawgu wuxuu noqon karaa in laga bixiyo kharashka daryeelka caafimaadka ku baxa iyo in la siiyo lacag maalmeed u badsha lacagtii shaqada ee shilka awgiis uga baaqatay, hawlagabka shilalku sababaan, magdhaw laga dhaawca shilka awgiis, dib u soo kabashada (kuntoutus) ama haddii shilka shaqada dhimasho ka timaado in qoyskiisa la siiyo lacagta hawlgabka qoyska.
en: This compensation may occur as daily allowance for medical treatment expenses and loss of earnings, workers' compensation pension, compensation for an injury caused by the accident, rehabilitation or, in fatal cases, survivors' pension for relatives.

so: Marka laga reebo caymisyada qasabka ku ah shaqobixiyaha, wuxuu shaqabixiyuhu shaqaalihiisa u qaadi karaa caymisyo dheeraad ah oo an qasab ku ahayn asaga.
en: In addition to statutory insurance policies, an employer may also take out various voluntary insurance policies for their employees.

so: Waxaa wanaagsan in shaqobixiyaha la weydiiyo caymisyo noocee ah ayuu shaqaalihiisa u qaaday.
en: It is a good idea to discuss with your employer what kinds of insurance policies they have taken out for their employees.

so: Marka xiriirka shaqada ee shaqaaluhu dhamaado wuxuu xaq u leeyahay in uu shaqo-bixiyaha ka helo shahaadada shaqada oo qoraal ah.
en: When an employee's contract of employment expires they are entitled to a written testimonial of service from their employer.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Shahaadada shaqada.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Testimonial of service.

so: Waxad heli kartaa ogaysiinta cashuurta (veroilmoitus) oo la sii buuxbuuxiyay iyada oo boostada kuugu soo dhacaysa bisha sadexaad ama bisha afraad.
en: You will receive a pre-completed tax return (veroilmoitus) by post in March or April. The tax return contains information on the income, taxes and deductions of the previous year.

so: Xaqiiji ogaysiinta cashuurta macluumaadkaaga ku yaalla.
en: Check the information in the tax return.

so: Cashuurtaada ugu dambaysa waxay ku imanaysaa ogaysiinta cashuurta macluumaadka ku qoran.
en: The final taxation is made on the basis of the information in the tax return.

so: Haddii macluumaadkaaga oo dhan ay sax yihiin, waxbana aynan ka maqnayn, kuma khasbanid inaad wax samayso.
en: If all the information is correct and nothing is missing, you do not need to do anything.

so: Haddii ay macluumaadku khaldanyihiin ama ay wax ka maqanyihiin, adeegga shabakadda OmaVero ku sax ama buuxi waxa ka maqan ogaysiinta cashuurta.
en: If the information is not correct or something is missing, complete and correct the tax return in the MyTax online service.

so: Waxad isticmaali kartaa adeegga internetka haddii macluumaadka adeegyada bangiga ee internetka ama xaqiijinta mobaylka ad haysato.
en: You can use the online service if you have Finnish online banking credentials or the Mobile Certificate.

so: Haddii aadan sixitaanka ka sameynin adeegga shabakadda MyTax, ka soo qaado foomamka sixitaanka ee gaarka ah bogagga shabakadda Maamulka canshuuraha ama xafiiska canshuurta.
en: If you do not make corrections in the MyTax online service, get separate correction forms from the Tax Administration website or tax office.

so: Xasuuso inaad jeegarayso ogaysiinta cashuurka anad samayso waxyaabaha loo baahanyahay in laga badal, ugu dambayn maalinta ugu dambayso ee la celinayo.
en: Remember to check the tax return and make any necessary changes by the last return date.

so: Maalinta la celinayo waxay ku cadahay kaadhka cashuurta.
en: The return date is marked on the front page of the tax return.

so: Waxa adiga mishaarkaaga ama dakhligaaga kale lagaaga goostay cashuur lambarka cashuurta ee ku yaalla kaadhkaaga cashuurta.
en: Taxes have been withheld from your salary or other income on the basis of your tax card.

so: Taas waxa la yidhaahdaa cashuurta hore loo goosto (ennakonpidätys).
en: This is called withholding tax (ennakonpidätys).

so: Cashuurta hore loo goosto qiimaheedu waxay ku salaysantahay cabirka dakhligaaga.
en: The amount of withholding tax is based on your estimate of your income.

so: Qiimaha cashuurta dib ayaa laga jeegaraynayaa, yada oo lagu salaynayo dakhligaaga iyo lacagaha lagaa goostay.
en: The amount of tax is checked afterwards on the basis of your actual income and deductions.

so: Waxad ku heli kartaa ogaysiinta cashuurta ee hore loo sii buuxiyay go'aanka cashuurta isaga oo kuula socda.
en: You will receive a tax decision together with a pre-completed tax return.

so: Hadii ad saxi waydo ogaysiintaas, go'aankaas ayaa la fulinayaa.
en: If you do not make any changes to the tax return, the tax decision will remain in effect.

so: Haddii ad saxdo ogaysiinta cashuurta waxad helaysaa go'aanka cashuurta ee cusub wakhti dambe.
en: If you make changes to the tax return, you will receive a new tax decision later.

so: Xasuuso inaad jeegarayso go'aanka cashuurta ee cusub.
en: Remember also to check the new tax decision.

so: Xajiso go'aanka cashuurta iyo qaybtiisa lagu qeexayo, ee ad helayso xagaaga isaga oo la sacdo ogaysiintaada cashuurta.
en: Retain the tax decision and the specification section which you will receive in the spring with your tax return.

so: Haddii ad dalbato qaybta lagu qeexayo oo cusub waa in aad lacag ka bixisaa.
en: If you order a new specification section, it will be subject to a fee.

so: Waxad caddaysan kartaa waxyaabaha kuu suuro galinaya in ay cashuurtaadu yaraato (vähennys).
en: Deductions (vähennys) in your taxation will reduce the amount of tax you must pay.

so: Maamulka cashuurta ayaa waxyaabahaas qayb ahaan toos u samaynaya, laakiin waxyaabaha qaarkood waa in aad adigu dalbataa.
en: The Tax Administration makes some of the deductions automatically but some of them you must claim yourself.

so: Waxyaabaha yaraynaya cashuurta waxay noqon karaan:
en: Deductions may include the following, for example:

so: Yaraynta kharashaadka gurigaaga ku baxaya
en: tax credit for domestic help or household expenses

so: yaraynta ka imanaysa gurigaaga iyo shaqadaada safarada u dhaxeeya kharashaadkooda
en: deduction for commuting expenses, i.e. daily travel from home to work

so: Waxa kuu suuro gal ah in aad dulsaarka dayntaada guriga kaga yaraysato cashuurta, haddii ad daynta u qaadatay guriga ad si joogto ah ugu nooshahay.
en: You can deduct the interest on your mortgage when you have taken the mortgage for your permanent home.

so: Waxa kuu suuro gal ah inaad cashuurtaada ku yaraysato guri ad ku leedahay dibadda anad si joogto ah ugu nooshahay.
en: You can also deduct the interest on your mortgage if your permanent home is located abroad.

so: Haddii ad daynta gurigaaga ka qaadatay bangi finish ah toos ayaa loo helayaa lagaagana yaraynayaa cashuurta.
en: If you have a mortgage from a Finnish bank, the Tax Administration will receive information on the mortgage directly from the bank.

so: Hadii ad cashuurta ka qaadatay bangi ajinabi ah soo ogaysii macluumaadka daynta xafiiska cashuurta.
en: If you have a mortgage from a foreign bank, you must report the information on the mortgage to the Tax Administration yourself.

so: Waxyaabaha cashuurta lagaaga yaraynaayo waxad ogaysiin kartaa marka ad dalbanayso kaadh cashuur oo cusub.
en: You can report any deductions when you order a new tax card.

so: Markaas waxyaabaha cashuurta lagaaga yaraynayo waxa lagu darayaa brosentajka cashuurta.
en: In that case, the deductions will be taken into account in your tax percentage.

so: Waxa sidoo kale kuu suuro gal ah in cashuurta waxyaabaha yaraynaya ad dib u dalbato.
en: You can also claim deductions afterwards using a tax return.

so: Waxyaabahaas ad ogaysiisay cashuurta kaaga soo noqonaysa waxad markaas ka helaysaa dib yada oo laguu soo raacinayo cashuurta lasoo celinayo.
en: In that case, you will receive the deductions in arrears as tax refunds.

so: Canshuur soo celinta iyo canshuurta kugu baaqatay
en: Tax refund and back tax

so: Go'aanka cashuurta waxad ka arkaysaa, in aad cashuurta in sax ah bixisay iyo in kale.
en: The tax decision indicates whether the correct amount of taxes has been withheld from your salary.

so: Haddii ad cashuur kaa badan bixisay waxad helaysoo cashuurta la soo celiyo (veronpalautus).
en: If you have paid too much tax, you will receive a tax refund (veronpalautus).

so: Haddii ad cashuur yar bixisay oo lagugu yeesho cashuur waxa lagugu soo dalacayaa cashuurta kugu hadhay (jäännösvero).
en: If you have paid too little tax, you will have to pay back tax (jäännösvero).

so: Cashuurta soo noqonaysa waxa toos loogu soo celinayaa bangigaaga.
en: A tax refund will be paid directly to your bank account.

so: Lambaka akawntkaaga u sheeg Maamulka cashuurta adiga oo ugu gudbinaya adeegga internetka ama warqadda gaar loogu ogaysiiyo ku qoraya.
en: Report your bank account number to the Tax Administration either in the online service or using a paper form.

so: Cashuurtaada waxa kuu suuro gal ah in laguugu soo celiyo ama akawnkaaga finishka ag ama akawnkaaga dibadda ah.
en: You can receive the tax refund to a Finnish or a foreign bank account.

so: Haddii cashuur lagugu yeesho, waxa go'aanka laguu soo raacinayaa biilka ad ku bixin karto.
en: If you have to pay back tax, you will receive a bank transfer form along with the tax decision.

so: Biilkaas waxad ka arkaysaa inta lagugu leeyahay cashuur, akawnka ad ku bixinayso iyo lambarka ad ku bixinayso.
en: The bank transfer form contains the amount of back tax, a bank account number, a due date and a reference number.

so: Cashuurtaada lagugu yeesho waxay kugu noqonaysaa in aad ka bixiso dulsaar muddo kadib.
en: You also have to pay interest on the back tax after a certain period.

so: Waxad u baahantahay kaadhka cashuurta (verokortti), haddii ad Finland ku qaadato mishaar ama takhliyo kale.
en: You need to have a tax card (verokortti) if you receive a salary or other income in Finland.

so: Kaadhkaaga cashuurta waxa lagu calaamadiyay brosentajka cashuurta (veroprosentti).
en: The tax card shows your tax rate (veroprosentti).

so: Kaas waa ka uu ku ogaanayo shaqo bixiyahaagu inta ay tahay in cashuur mishaarkaaga laga bixiyo.
en: The employer will then know how much tax to withhold from your salary.

so: Tirada inta bqolkiiba laga goynayo waxey ku xirantahay inta uu dakhligaadu dhan yahay.
en: Your tax rate depends on the amount of your income.

so: Haddii ad dhawaan u soo guurtay Finland, waxad ka heli kartaa kaadhka cashuurta xafiiska cashuuta (verotoimisto).
en: If you have just moved to Finland, you can receive a tax card from a tax office (verotoimisto).

so: Si ad kaadhka ashuurta u hesho waa in aad cabirtaa inta takhli ku soo galaya sanadka oo dhan.
en: For the tax card, you need to estimate the amount of income you will receive during the whole year.

so: Waxanad u baahantahay lambarka aqoonsiga ee Finland.
en: You also need to have a Finnish personal identity code.

so: Waxad heli kartaa lambarka aqoonsiga marka ad iska diwaangaliso xafiiska diwaanka.
en: You will receive a personal identity code when you register as a resident at the Local Register Office.

so: Sidoo kale lambarka aqoonsiga waxad ka heli kartaa xafiiska cashuurta.
en: You can also receive a personal identity code from a tax office.

so: Ka akhriso macluumaad faahfaahsan bogga
en: Read more on the page Registering as a resident.

so: Marka ad si joogto ah ugu nooshahay Finland xafiiska cashuurta ayaa sanad kasta bisha koowaad kuu soo diraya kaadhkaaga cashuurta.
en: When you live permanently in Finland, the Tax Administration will send you a new tax card each year in January.

so: Waxa lagu salaynayaa cashuurtaada intii ad sanadkii ka horeeyay shaqaysay.
en: The Tax Administration will calculate an appropriate tax rate for you on the basis of how much you have earned in the previous year.

so: Tus kaarkaada canshuurta shaqo bixiyahaada.
en: Show the tax card to your employer.

so: Haddii aadan tusin shaqo bixiyahaada kaarka canshuurta, shaqo bixiyuhu wuxuu mushaarkaada ka reebi karaa 60% oo cashuur ah.
en: If you do not show the tax card to your employer, they will deduct 60% of your salary as taxes.

so: Hadii takhligaagu siyaado ama hoos u dhaco sanad gudihiisa dalbo kaadh cashuur oo cusub.
en: If your income decreases or increases during the year, order a new tax card.

so: Waxad ka heli kartaa kaadhkaaga cashuurta:
en: You can receive a new tax card:

so: Adeegga internetka OmaVero ee Maamulka cashuurta
en: from the MyTax online service of the Tax Administration

so: Kaarka canshuurta waxaad ka dalban kartaa xittaa adeegga telefoonka ee Maamulka canshuurta:
en: You can also order a tax card from the Tax Administration's telephone service:

so: Markaad dalbanayso kaadhka cashuurta ee cusub waxad u baahanaysaa macluumaadkan:
en: When you apply for a new tax card, you need the following information:

so: cabir ah inta ad dakhli helayso sanadkan oo dhan
en: an estimate of how much income you will receive during the whole year in question

so: takhliga ku soo galay sanadka bilowgiisa marka laga soo bilaabo
en: the amount of income you have received since the start of the year

so: cashuurta ad ka bixisay takhligaaga sanadka bilowgiisa ilaa imika
en: the amount of taxes that has been withheld from your income since the start of the year

so: macluumaadka ku saabsan waxyaabaha ay cashuurtu kaaga yaraanayso sanadkan
en: information on deductions that you will include in the taxation for the year in question

so: Haddii ad cashuur badan bixiso, laguu soo celinayaa, haddii cashuurtaadu yartahayna sanadka dambe ayaa lagugu soo dalacayaa.
en: If you pay too much tax, you will receive a tax refund (veronpalautus). If you pay too little tax, you will have to pay back tax (jäännösvero).

so: Haddii ad leedahay shaqo bixiyeyaal badan
en: If you have several employers

so: Haddii aad leedahay shaqo bixiyayaal badan, tus dhammaantood kaarkaada canshuurta.
en: If you have several employers, show your tax card to all of them.

so: Hal kaar oo canshuurta ah ayeey dhammaantood qaadanayaan.
en: The same tax card is intended for all employers.

so: Shaqooyinka oo dhan waxaad ka bixineysaa canshuur isle'eg.
en: You will pay the same amount of tax on all your income.

so: Kaarkaada canshuurta waxaa ku qoran xad dakhliyeed oo xisaabinta boqolkiiba inta loo jarayo canshuur ahaa lagu saleeyo.
en: The tax card has an income limit according to which the tax rate is calculated.

so: Xusuunow in aad ilaaliso xadka dakhligaada.
en: Be sure to keep track of your income.

so: Haddii aad hesho mushaar ka badan inti aad gudbisay, xadka dakhligaada waad dhaafeysaa.
en: If you receive more income than you have reported, you will exceed your income limit.

so: Haddii uu dakhligaadu dhaafo xadkiisa, dalbo kaarka canshuurta oo cusub.
en: If you exceed your income limit, order a new tax card.

so: Waxad u baahantahay lambarka cashuurta(veronumero), haddii ad ka shaqaynayso Finland dhul dhismo ama rakibaad ay socoto.
en: You need to have a tax number (veronumero), if you work at a construction or installation site in Finland.

so: Lambarka cashuurta waxa loo isticmaalaa in lagula socdo in ay shaqaalaha oo dhan ka diwaangashanyihiin diwaanka Maamulka cashuurta.
en: The tax number is used to check that all workers are registered with the Finnish Tax Administration.

so: Lambarka cashuurtu waa in uu ka muuqdaa kaahkaaga aqoonsiga ah ee sawirka leh ee uu ku siinayo shaqobixiyahaagu.
en: Your tax number must be listed on your name tag with your photo, which will be provided for you by your employer.

so: Aqoonsigaas la'aantii kama shaqayn kartid dhulka dhismaha.
en: You are not allowed to work on a construction site without this tag.

so: Lambarka cashuurta waxad ka helaysaa xafiiska cashuurta marka ad dalbanayso kaadhka cashuurta.
en: You will receive the tax number from the tax office at the same time that you collect a tax card.

so: Haddii ad aqoonsi Finish ah leedahay, waxad ka heli kartaa lambarkaaga aqoonsiga kaadhkaaga cashuurta.
en: If you already have a Finnish personal identity code and a tax card, you will find the tax number in your tax card.

so: Cashuurta Finland waxaa laga qaadaa dadka shaqeeya cashuurta dakhliga (tulovero).
en: In Finland, you pay income tax (tulovero) on your salary.

so: Sidoo kale cashuurta waxaa laga qaadaa dadka hela noocyadan dakhliga ah, tusaale ahaan:
en: You must also pay taxes on the following income:

so: Cashuurta waxay dawlada iyo dawladaha hoose ku bixiyaan:
en: With tax money, the state and municipalities pay for the following, for example:

so: Cashuurta Finland waxay korodhaa.
en: In Finland, taxation is progressive.

so: Taasi waxaa looga jeedaa, in dadka qaata lacagta badan bixiyaan xaddi badan oo cashuura marka loo eego kuwa qaata lacagta yar.
en: This means that the tax rate (the share of taxes) is larger for a larger salary than for a smaller salary.

so: Beersantaydhka cashuurta (veroprosentti) boqolkiiba inta qofkasta laga qaadayaa waa mid gooni u ah isaga/iyada.
en: A withholding tax percentage (veroprosentti) is calculated separately for each person in Finland.

so: Xaaskaagu saamayn kuma laha cashuurta boqolkiiba inta lagaa qaadayo.
en: The spouse's income does not affect your withholding tax percentage.

so: Waad qiimayn kartaa cashuurta boqolkiiba inta aad bixinayso adiga oo isticmaalaya qaab xisaabeedka xafiiska cashuuraha.
en: You can estimate your own tax percentage using the Tax Administration's calculator.

so: Shaqo bixiyuhu isaga ayaa cashuurta toos u bixiya.
en: For that purpose, the employer must have your tax card.
