so: Xafiiska cashuurtu wuxuu xisaabiyaa sanad ka dib, ma bixiyey cashuur u dhiganta dakhliga soo gala.Hadii aad cashuur badan bixisay,waxaa kuu noqonaysa cashuurtii dheerka ahayd (veronpalautus).
en: If you have paid too much in tax, you will receive a tax refund (veronpalautus).

so: hadii aad cashuur yar aad bixisay, Waxaa ku khasban inaad bixiso cashuurtii kugu hadhay (jäännösvero).
en: If you have not paid enough in tax, you will have to pay back tax (jäännösvero).

so: Ka akhri macluumad dheeriya halkan: Ogaysiinta cashuurta iyo go'aanka cashuurta.
en: Further information: Tax return and tax decision.

so: Ka hubi tusmada mushaarka iyo ogaysiinta xafiiska cashuurta (veroilmoitus), in uu shaqo bixiyuhu ka bixiyey mushaarkaaga cashuurtii.
en: Check your salary slip and tax return (veroilmoitus) to ensure that your employer has withheld taxes from your salary.

so: Kaydso juwanka ama tusmada mushaarkaaga.
en: Retain your salary slips.

so: Hadii aanan la bixinin cashuurta, waxaa khasab noqonaysa in la bixiyo wakhti ka dib.
en: If the tax has not been withheld, you will have to pay it in arrears.

so: Shaqo bixiyuhu ka sokow cashuurta, waxa kale ee uu bixinayaa caymiska shaqo la'aanta iyo xanuunsashada.
en: In addition to taxes, your employer will withhold insurance payments from your salary for unemployment and sickness, for example.

so: Cashuurista, marka aad shaqo u timaadid Finland
en: Taxation when you come to work in Finland

so: Hadii aad u timaadid Finland shaqo, cashuurtaadu waxay ku xidhnaanaysaa, intee in leeg baad ogolaansho u haysataa joogista Finland.Sidoo kale waxaa cashuurta saamaynaya shaqo bixiyahaagu ma shirkad finish ah baa mise waa mid dibada laga leeyahay.
en: If you come from abroad to work in Finland, your taxation depends on how long you will stay in Finland. Taxation also depends on whether your employer is a Finnish or a foreign company.

so: Hadii aad Finland joogayso mudo ka badan lix bilood, waxaa waajib kugu ah inaad ku bixisid cashuurta Finland.
en: If you reside in Finland for more than six months, you must usually pay taxes on your salary in Finland.

so: Sidoo kale waxaa waajib ah inaad ku bixiso Finland caymisyada khasabka ah.
en: Usually, you must also pay the obligatory insurance payments in Finland.

so: Waxaad u baahan tahay afarta lamber ee finishka ah iyo kaadhka cashuurta.
en: You need a Finnish personal identity code and a tax card.

so: Cashuurta boqolkiiba inta lagaa qaadayo waxaa lagu salaynayaa dakhligaaga sanadka oo dhan.Waxaad sidoo kale helaysaa cashuur dhimis la mid ah kuwa kale, ee Finland u degan sida joogtada ah.
en: The tax rate is calculated on the basis of the income for the whole year. You will be granted tax deductions on the same basis as everyone else who lives permanently in Finland.

so: Hadii aad joogaysid Finland ugu badnaan lix bilood shaqo bixiyahaaguna yahay shirkad dibad laga leeyahay, cashuur inaad bixiso kuguma waajib aha.
en: If you reside in Finland for six months at the most and your employer is a foreign company, you do not usually need to pay taxes in Finland.

so: Hadii uu yahay shaqo bixiyahaagu shirkad finish ah ama shirkad ajaanib ah laakiin goobta shirkadu ka shaqayso ay tahay Finland, cashuurta waxaad ku bixinaysaa Finland.
en: If your employer is Finnish or your foreign employer has an office in Finland, you will pay taxes in Finland.

so: Waxaad dalban kartaa cashuurta mishaarka la korodha, hadii aad dagan tahay wadamada yurub iyo kuwa kale ee heshiis cashuureed ka dhaxeeyo Finland.
en: You can apply for progressive taxation if you live in a country that belongs to the European Economic Area or a country with which Finland has a tax agreement.

so: Xaaladaha kale waxaa lagaa jarayaa mushaarkaaga cashuur dhan 35 % oo ah (lähdevero) waxanad u baahanaysaa kaadhka cashuurta ee loogu talo galay takhliga ilaha (lähdeverokortin).
en: Otherwise, you will pay 35% tax at source (lähdevero) on your salary and you must have a tax-at-source card.

so: Kaarka canshuurta mushaarka laga jaro waa in lagu codsadaa foom warqad ah.
en: You must apply for a tax-at-source card using a paper form.

so: Kaas waxad ka heli kartaa xafiiska cashuurta.
en: You can obtain it from a tax office.

so: Waxa sidoo kale kuu banaan in dib ka dalbato dalbato cashuurta mishaarka la kordhaysa.
en: You can also apply for progressive taxation afterwards.

so: Waxad sidoo kale ku khasbantahay inaad bixiso lacago caymis ah, haddii anad ku haysanin caymis waddanka ad sida joogtada ah ugu nooshahay.
en: You will also have to pay insurance payments if you are not insured in the country in which you reside permanently.

so: Haddii ad caymis ku haysato waddanka ad sida joogtada ah ugu nooshahay waxad u baahantahay caddaynta caymiska ee A1/E101.
en: If you already have an insurance cover from another country, you need to have a certificate of the insurance (A1/E101).

so: Marka ad ka guurayso Finland xasuuso inaad samayso ogaysiinta guuritaanka.
en: When you move away from Finland, remember to submit a notification of the move to the Local Register Office.

so: Taas waxay kuu sahlaysaa in ogaysiinta cashuurta ad ku hesho ciwaanka saxda ah.
en: This will ensure that your tax return will be sent to the correct address.

so: Markaad Finland soo dagayso waxad ka heli kartaa macluumaad faahfaahfan, qeybta Usoo guurista Finland.
en: When you are moving to Finland, you can find more information in the section Moving to Finland.

so: Ilaalinta danaha iyo talobixinta ganacsatada
en: Supervision of the interests of entrepreneurs and counselling

so: Daryeelka caafimaadka shaqada ee ganacsadaha
en: Entrepreneur's occupational health care (työterveyshuolto)

so: Ururka dhexe ee nolosha xoogsashada ee magaciisa markii la soo gaabiyo loo yaqaano EK wuxuu wakiil ka yahay dhammaan qaybaha ganacsiga ee aan dowliga ahayn haddii ay ahaan lahaayeen shirkadaha yar yar ama kuwo waaweyn intaba.
en: The Confederation of Finnish Industries EK represents all private branches of business and companies of all sizes.

so: Ururada qaybaha ganacsigu waxay ilaaliyaan danaha shirkadaha ka shaqeeya dhammaan qaybaha kala duwan ee ganacsiga.
en: Industry federations are company lobbying organisations for enterprises operating in different fields.

so: Waxay inta badan shirkadaha xubnaha ka ah siiyaan adeegyo kala duwan sida tusaale ahaan talooyin xagga ganacsiga ah iyo markaas shirkada ay la talinayaan qaybaha gancsiga arimo la xiriira.
en: They often also offer their member companies various kinds of additional services, such as advice on entrepreneurship and on issues concerning the line of business in question.

so: Ururka Ganacsata Finland (Suomen Yrittäjät) waa urur ilaaliya danaha ganacsatada, kaasoo sidoo kale xubnihiisa u soo saara adeegyo kala duwan tusaale ahaan la talin lacag la'aan oo xagga telefoonka ah ah lana xiriirta arimaha ganacsiga.
en: The Federation of Finnish Enterprises (Suomen Yrittäjät) is a lobbying organisation for entrepreneurs which also produces various services for its members, for example, free telephone service offering advice on matters relating to entrepreneurship.

so: Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsasha waxaa laga heli karaa adeegyo kaabaya horumarinta hawlaha ganacsiga.
en: The TE Office provides services in support of the development of business activities.

so: Sidoo kale Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada adoo maraya waxaad ka raadin kartaa qof kaala wareega ganacsigaaga oo siiwada ama kugula shirkooba.
en: You can also seek for a person to continue your business operations, or for a partner for your company through the TE Office.

so: Xarumaha shirkadaha cusub waxay talobixin ganacsi oo lacag la'aan ah ku bixiyaan dhinacyo badan oo Finland ku yaal.
en: Finnish Enterprise Agencies offer business advice free-of-charge in different parts of Finland.

so: Talobixinta gnacsiga waxaa waxaad caawimaad uga heleysaa arrimaha la xiriira waxqabadka shirkadda ama horumarinteeda.
en: Business advice can help you in matters concerning your company's operations or development.

so: Hay'adda Yritys-Suomi ayaa bixisa adeegyo la talineed xagga telefoonka ah oo lacag la'aan ah, kuwaas aad ka heli kartid talooyinka khabiirada oo wax ku ool ah, haddii shirkadaada ay haysato dhibaatooyin xagga dhaqaalaha ah.
en: Enterprise Finland provides a free phone service that provides expert counselling if a company is facing financial difficulties.

so: Talooyinka waxaa lagugu siinayaa luuqadaha Finnishka iyo Swidishka.
en: Counselling is available in Finnish and Swedish.

so: La talinta caawimaadda dhaqaalaha
en: Financial Aid counselling service

so: Adeegaan wuxuu furan yahay isniin ilaa jimce saacadaha u dhexeeya 9.00–16.00.
en: The service is available from Monday to Friday 9:00–16:00.

so: Ganacsahu wuxuu xaq u leeyahay inuu helo lacagta shaqo la'aanta.
en: An entrepreneur is also entitled to unemployment benefit.

so: Ganacsaduhu waa shaqo la'aan haddii uu joojiyo hawlaha ganacsiga ama uu iibiyo saamigiisa ganacsi.
en: An entrepreneur is unemployed when they have ended their business activities or sold their share of the company.

so: Ganasigu wuxuu ku dhammaan karaa sii iibinta shirkadda, baa bi'inta shirkada, musalafida shirkadda, xaalad baaaritaan lageliyo ama furiin qoys awgiis.
en: Entrepreneurship can end in selling or dissolving the company, in bankruptcy, liquidation, or because of a divorce.

so: Waxaa kaloo ganacsadaha loo arkaa shaqo la'aan, haddii hawlaha ganacsigu ay istaagnaayeen ugu yaraan afar bilood.
en: An entrepreneur is also considered unemployed if business operations have been suspended for at least four months.

so: Haddii aad joojiso hawlaha ganacsiga, dhaqso ula xiriir xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada iskaga diiwaangeli inaad tahay shaqalaawe shaqo raadis ah.
en: If you need to close down your business, you should immediately register yourself as unemployed in the TE Office online service.

so: Waxaad heli kartaa lacagta shaqo la'aanta laga bilaabo maalinta aad ogeysiisay xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada.
en: You are entitled to unemployment benefit starting from the day you registered your unemployment at the TE Office.

so: Haddii aad dooneysid lacagta badbaada shaqo la'aanta oo ku xiran dakhliga shaqada, ku biir oo xubin ka noqo qasnadda shaqa la'aanta ganacsatada (yrittäjien työttömyyskassa).
en: If you want to be entitled to earnings-related unemployment allowance, you must join the unemployment fund for entrepreneurs (yrittäjien työttömyyskassa).

so: Haddii hawlahaaga ganacsigu ay dhamaadaan, waxaad qasnadda shaqa la'aanta ka codsan kartaa lacag maalmeedka qofka shaqayn jiray ama ganacsadaha ahaa (ansiosidonnainen päiväraha).
en: If your business operations end, you may then apply for earnings-related daily allowance (ansiosidonnainen päiväraha) from the unemployment fund.

so: Lacag maalmeedka shaqa la'aanta ee shaqada ama ganacsiga ku xiran waxaad ka heli kartaa qasnadda shaqa la'aan ganacsatada, haddii aad ahayd ganacsade oo aad waqti dheer oo ku filan xubin ka ahayd qasnadda ka hor intii aadan shaqo la'aan noqonin.
en: To receive earnings-related daily allowance from the unemployment fund, you must have been an entrepreneur and a member of the fund for a required time period before becoming unemployed.

so: Lacag maalmeedka shaqa la'aanta ee shaqada ama ganacsiga ku xiran, way ka badan tahay lacag maaalmeedka caadiga ah ama tan kaalmada suuqa shaqada.
en: Earnings-related unemployment allowance is larger than basic unemployment allowance or labour market subsidy.

so: Lacag maalmeedka cadadeedu intay le'egtahay waxay ku xiran tahay, hadba intii uu le'ekaa dakhliga shaqada kaa soo galay oo aad ogeysiisay caymiska shaqala'aanta.
en: Its size depends on the amount of earned income you have registered in the entrepreneur's retirement pension insurance.

so: Kela ayaa siin karta lacagta shaqo la'aanta caadiga ah (peruspäiväraha) ganacsadaha shaqo la'aanta ah oo aan ka tirsanayn wax qasnad ah.
en: Kela can pay basic unemployment allowance (peruspäiväraha) to an unemployed entrepreneur who is not a member of an unemployment fund.

so: Waad heli kartaa lacag maalmeedka aasaasiga ah haddii aad buuxiso shuruudaha ka shaqeynta shirkadlaha islamarkaasna aad ku jirto xeyndaabka Amaanka bulshada Finland.
en: You may receive basic unemployment allowance, if you meet an entrepreneur's condition regarding previous employment and are covered by Finnish social security.

so: Bogagga shabakadda Kelada waxaa ku jira xisaabiye, kaas oo aad ku qiimeyn karto in shuruudaha ka shaqeynta shirkadda ay dhinacaaga buuxsan tahay.
en: The Kela website includes a calculator that can be used to estimate if you meet an entrepreneur's condition regarding previous employment.

so: Haddii aadan xaq u laheyn lacag maalmeedka aasaasiga ah ama lacag maalmeedka qofka shaqayn jiray, laakiin aad ku jirto Amaanka bulshada Finland waxaad codsan kartaa kaalmada suuqa shaqada.
en: If you are not eligible to receive basic unemployment allowance, but are covered by Finnish social security you can apply for labour market subsidy.

so: Kaalmada suuqa shaqadu waa laga baaraandegaa baahidiisa, waxaa loola jeedaa dakhliyada kale iyo xaaladaada guud ayaa saameyn ku leh tirada kaalmada suuqa shaqada.
en: Labour market subsidy is a means-tested benefit, meaning that any other income and your overall situation will influence the amount of labour market subsidy you receive.

so: Ganacsadaha iyo qof kale shaqaysanayaaba waxay naftooda u samaysan karaan daryeelka caafimaadka, haddii ay rabaan.
en: An entrepreneur and other persons working for themselves can organise occupational health care for themselves if they like.

so: Ganacsadaha qasab kuma aha inuu naftiisa daryeel caafimaad shaqo u samaysto.
en: An entrepreneur is not obliged to arrange occupational health care for themselves.

so: Laakiin ganacsaduhu waa inuu shaqaalihiisa u sameeyo daryeel caafimaad.
en: However, an entrepreneur must organise occupational health care for their employees.

so: Daryeelka caafimaadka shaqada waxaa laga samayn karaa xarumaha caafimaadka (terveyskeskus) ee agagaarka ku yaal ama tusaale ahaan xarumaha dhakhaatiirta gaarka ah leeyihiin.
en: This can be arranged at the local health centre (terveyskeskus) or, for example, a private clinic.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ka akhri bogga InfoFinlandi Daryeelka caafimaadka ganacsadaha.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Occupational health care.

so: Haddii aad xanuusatid, waxaad Kela ka heli kartaa lacagta jirada (sairauspäiväraha), taasoo mag dhaw u aha lacagta kugu dhaaftay jirada awgeed, haddii awood la'aanta shaqadu ay socoto mudo sannad ka yar.
en: If you fall ill, Kela may pay you sickness allowance (sairauspäiväraha) which compensates for the loss of earnings due to incapacity for work if this incapacity continues for less than a year.

so: Lacagta shaqo la'aanta waxaa lagu siinayaa markii uu dhamaado waqtiga is-dabarida (omavastuuaika).
en: Payments of daily allowance begin after the qualifying period for benefit (omavastuuaika).

so: Waqtiga jirada ee ganacsaduhu isagu is-dabarayo waa maalinta uu xanuusaday iyo sadexda maalin shaqo ee ka dambaysa.
en: An entrepreneur's qualifying period for benefit is usually the first day of illness plus the following three weekdays.

so: Shaqo fahamsiinta iyo ammaanka shaqaalaha
en: Responsibility for the orientation of employees and for their safety

so: Markii aad hawlo ganacsi bilowdid, waxaa ku saaran waajibaadyo faro-badan.
en: When you start business operations, you have many duties.

so: Waa in aad diiwaangelisaa shirkadda, canshuur bixisaa islamarkaasna qabanqaabisaa xisaabhayn.
en: You must, for example, register the company, pay taxes and organise bookkeeping.

so: Finland waxaa laga samaysan karaa xoogsasho ku salaysan sharciga iyo caadooyinka wanaagsan, ayadoo aan hay'adaha dawlada looga baahan wax ruqsad ah.
en: In Finland it is possible to be engaged in a lawful trade that is in accordance with good practice without a permit granted by authorities.

so: Haddii aad leedahay tusaale ahaan goob ganacsi oo lagu iibiyo waxyaabaha la isku qurxiyo ama shirkad iibisa cuntada, goobaha waa in la koontaroolaa.
en: For example, if you have a beauty salon or a business that sells food products, the premises must be inspected.

so: Ka codso hay'adda caafimaadka degmada ruqsad kahor inta aan goobaha lagu billaabin shaqada.
en: Apply for a permit from the municipal health authority before starting to use the premises.

so: Ka hor intaadan bilaabin hawlaha ganacsiga, hubi, inaad ganacsiga awgiis u baahantahay ruqsad ama inay tahay inaad u baahantahay inaad ogeysiiyo hay'adaha dawladda.
en: Before starting business activities, check whether a permit is required or whether authorities need to notified of the new business.

so: Waxaad ka hubin kartaa hay'adda maamulka degaanka (aluehallintovirasto) ama bogagga shabakadda Yritys-Suomi in ganacsigaaga looga baahan yahay ruqsad iyo in kale.
en: You can find out whether a permit is required for your business by contacting a Regional State Administrative Agency or by visiting the Enterprise Finland website.

so: Aasaasidda shirkadda waxaad hal foom ku ogeysiin kartaa maamulka Diiwaangelinta ganacsiga iyo shatiga iyo Maamulka canshuuraha.
en: The same form can be used to notify both the National Board of Patents and Registration in Finland and the Tax Administration of starting a business.

so: Caymiska hawlgabka ganacsaduhu wuxuu badbaado u yahay lacagta nolosha ee ganacsadaha, haddii hawsha ganacsigu ay u dhamaato sababo la xiriira shaqo awoodid la'aan ama gabow dartood waxayna qayska ganacsadahu helayaan badbaada hawlgabka goyska markii uu dhinto ganacsaduhu kadib.
en: A retirement pension insurance secures an entrepreneur's livelihood when business activities end due to incapacity for work or old age and provides the entrepreneur's family with a survivors' pension after the death of the entrepreneur.

so: Caymiska hawlgabka waxaa laga qaadan karaa shirkadaha caymiska ama qasnadda hawlgabka (eläkekassa).
en: Retirement pension insurance policies can be obtained either from an insurance company or pension fund (eläkekassa).

so: Gal caymiska hawlgabka ugu dambayn lix bilood marka hawlaha ganacsiga bilowdid.
en: Take out a retirement pension insurance policy at the latest when six months have passed from starting the business.

so: Ganacsadaha cusub wuxuu helayaa 22 % qiimo dhimis ah afarta sano oo ugu horaysa bixinta lacagta hawlgabka.
en: A new beginning entrepreneur receives a 22% reduction in price for the pension payments of the first four years.

so: Cadadda lacagaha caymiska iyo hawlgabku waxay ku xiran yihiin hadba inta uu le'eg yahay dakhliga ganacsadaha ka soo gala shaqada (työtulo).
en: The cost of insurance premiums and the amount of future pension payments depend on how much earned income (työtulo) the entrepreneur achieves.

so: Dakhliga cadadiisu waxay sidoo kale saameyn ku yeelanaysaa lacagaha kale oo shaqo la'aanta (ansiosidonnainen etuus) sida lacagta jirada, weynaanta.
en: The amount of earned income also affects the amount of various earnings-related benefits (ansiosidonnainen etuus), such as sickness allowance.

so: Shaqaalaha waa in la geliyaa caymiska hawlgabka (eläkevakuutus (TyEL-vakuutus)) iyo kan shilalka, kaasoo ay ku jiraan, caymis wadareedka nafta iyo caymiska shaqo la'aanta.
en: Employees must be provided with a retirement pension insurance (TyEL insurance) (eläkevakuutus, TyEL-vakuutus) and accident insurance, which includes group life insurance and unemployment insurance.

so: Shaqobixiyahu wuxuu xafiiska canshuuraha siinayaa lacagta badbaadada bulshada ee shaqaalaha ee uu jaro marka uu mushaarka shaqaalaha ka jarayo canshuurta.
en: An employer pays an employee's social security contribution to the tax authorities at the same time as the employer withholds taxes from the employee's wages.

so: Qaybaha ganacsiga qaarkood caymiskaan ka sokow waxaa qasab ku ah inay qaataan caymisyo kale oo qasab ah.
en: In some lines of business, employers are obliged also to take out other compulsory insurance policies besides the ones described here.

so: Sidoo kale waa inaad ka fakartid qaadashada caymisyo kale oo iskaa ah, sida tusaale ahaan caymiska shilalka ee ganacsadaha.
en: You should also consider taking out other voluntary insurance policies, such as the accident insurance for an entrepreneur.

so: Dalka Finland gudihiisa qof walba oo ganacsade ah waxaa saaran waajibaadka xisaab samaynta.
en: In Finland, every entrepreneur has a legal obligation to keep books.

so: Haddii aadan adigu dooneyn inaad xisaabta samaysato, waxaad adeega xisaabaadka ka iibsan kartaa xafiisyada xisaabaadka sameeya (tilitoimisto) ayagaana shirkadaada u samaynaya xisaabaadka.
en: If you don't want to take care of bookkeeping yourself, you can hire an accounting firm to handle your company's bookkeeping for you.

so: Finland shirkadaha badankoodu waxay isticmaalaan adeegyada xafiisyada xisaabaadka.
en: Many companies in Finland use the services of accounting firms.

so: Noocaha shirkada ganacsigu tahay waxay saameyn ku yeelanaysaa, habka shirkadda loo canshuurayo.
en: Company form has an effect on how a company is taxed.

so: Tan waa inaad xasuusnaataa markii aad dooranaysid nooca shirkadda aad samaynaysid.
en: It is worth taking this into account when choosing a company form.

so: Ganacsadaha bilowga ah wuxuu samayn karaa ogeysiiska horay isu-diiwaangelinta (ennakkoperintärekisteri) maamulka canshuuraha.
en: A new entrepreneur can register with the Tax Administration's prepayment register of taxpayers.

so: Ogeysiiska horay isu diiwaangelinta waxaa lala sameeyaa ogeysiiska aasaasida shirkadda (yrityksen perustamisilmoitus).
en: Registering is done by using the same notification form that is provided for founding a business (a business start-up notification) (yrityksen perustamisilmoitus).

so: Haddii Shirkadaadu ku jirto habka horay isu diiwaangelinta canshuuraha, waxaad biil u diri kartaa macaamiishaada adoon lagaa jarayn canshuurta shaqsiga.
en: If your company belongs in the prepayment register of taxpayers, you can invoice a customer without a withholding of tax.

so: Canshuurta waxaa laga bixinayaa wixii ka soo baxa ganacsiga oo u hara ganacsadaha iyo shirkadda, markii waxa la iibiyey laga jaro dhammaan kharashaadka hawlaha ganacsiga.
en: Tax is levied for the income the entrepreneur or company has left, when all the expenses of business activities have been subtracted from it.

so: Canshuuraha ganacsiga waxaa lagu bixiyaa ayadoo laga shidaal qaadanayo qiyaas horay loogu sameeyey natiijada la canshuuri karo inta ay tahay.
en: A company's taxes are paid in advance on the basis of its estimated taxable income.

so: Qiyaastu waxay salka ku haysaa cadadda la canshuuray shirkadda sannadkii la soo dhaafay.
en: This estimation is based on the taxed income of the previous year.

so: Shirkadda bilowga ah ganacsadaha ayaa isagu qiyaasaya inta ay dhantahay lacagta la canshuuraayo, wuxuuna qiyaasta ogaysiinayaa xafiiska canshuuraha.
en: With a new business, the entrepreneur must estimate the amount of taxable income and declare it to the tax authorities.

so: Canshuurta qiinmaha lagu daro (arvonlisävero) waa canshuur la isticmaalo, waxaana laga qaadaa inta badan dhammaan badeecooyinka iyo adeegyada dalka Finland.
en: Value added tax (arvonlisävero) is a consumption tax which is collected for almost all goods and services in Finland.

so: Shirkadaha iibiya badeecooyinka iyo adeegyada ee dalka Finland waxaa xil ka saaran yahay inay bixiyaan canshuurta qiimaha lagu daro (arvonlisävero).
en: Entrepreneurs who sell goods and services in Finland are obliged to pay value added tax.

so: Haddii waxa ka soo baxa iibinta badeecooyinka iyo adeegayada ay noqdaan wax ka yar 10 000 euro sannadkii, taas lagama rabo in laga bixiyo wax canshuurta qiimaha lagu daro ah.
en: If the income obtained from selling goods and services is less than 10,000 euros per year, value added tax does not need to be paid.

so: Nooca shirkadu wax saamayn ah kuma leh cadadda canshuurta qiimaha lagu daro.
en: Company form has no bearing on the amount of value added tax.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee canshuurta qiimaha lagu daro waxay isku bedeshaa hadba noocyada kala duwan ee badeecadaha.
en: However, the amount of value added tax of different products varies.

so: Ganacsade ahaan waxaa xil kaa saaran yahay inaad shaqaalahaaga bartid hawlaha ay qabanayaan iyo siday u qabanayaan.
en: As an entrepreneur you are responsible for familiarising your employees with their tasks.

so: Shaqobixiyuhu waa inuu shaqaalihiisa la socodsiiyaa xaaladaha ka jira goobta shaqada iyo habka shaqada oo saxda ah.
en: An employer must familiarise the employees with the conditions of the workplace and the correct working methods.

so: Shaqobixiyaha waxaa kaloo waajib ka saaranyahay inuu ka taxadaro nabadgelyada iyo caacimaadka shaqaalihiisa goobta shaqada dhexdeeda.
en: An employer is also obliged to take care of employees' safety and health at work.

so: Shaqobixiyuhu waa inuu qorshe u dejiyaa barnaamijka badbaadada shaqaalaha (työsuojelun toimintaohjelma), kaasoo ay ka muuqanayaa khataraha nabadgelyada iyo caafimaadka ee la xiriira goobta shaqada iyo sida looga baaqsanayo khatarahaas.
en: An employer must prepare a strategy for the protection of workers (työsuojelun toimintaohjelma) which defines the risks to health and safety involved in the job and workplace, and describes how these risks can be avoided.

so: Warar dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan u shaqeynta sidi shaqobixiye ka aqri bogga InfoFinland Xuquuda iyo waajibaadka shaqobixiyaha.
en: Read more about acting as an employer on the InfoFinland page Employer's rights and obligations.

so: Markii aad aasaasaysid ganacsi, waa inaad doorataa nooca shirkada iyo magaca shirkadda waana inaad caddaysaa qaybta ganacsiga (toimiala) aad bilaabaysid.
en: When establishing a business, the company form, the name of the company and choice of the field of activity have to be chosen.

so: Doorashada nooca shirkadda waaxaa saamaynaya tusaale ahaan cadadda dadka shirkadda samaynaya, baahida lacagta aasaaska, qaybsiga masuuliyadda iyo awoodda go'aan gaarida, maalgelinta iyo habka canshuuraha.
en: Factors influencing the choice of company form include the number of founders, capital requirement, division of responsibility and decision-making, financing and taxation.

so: Markii aad ka fakaraysid doorashda nooca shirkadda aad samaynaysid, waxaa lagama maarmaan ah inaad la xiriirtid Talo-siinta ganacsiga.
en: When you are considering the choice of company form, it is strongly advised that you contact an establishment offering Business advice.

so: Waa nooca ugu sahlan looguna jecel yahay marka la bilaabayo ganacsi waa inuu qofku noqdo qof iskiis noloshiisa ula soo baa oo ganacsade ah oo magaciisa ku shaqaysta.
en: The simplest and most popular way to start in business is to operate as a private entrepreneur using a company name.

so: Go'aanka arrimaha ganacsiga ku saabsan iyo mas'uuliyadaba waxaa iska leh adiga ganacsadaha ah, shirkaduna shaqaale way shaqaalayn kartaa, sida shirkadaha kale. Inta badan, haddii aad shaqo caadi ah ka shaqayso oo wakhtiga firaaqada ah aad iskaa u ganacsato waxaa wanaagsan inaad ganacsigaaga ku bilowdo nooca magac ku shaqaysashada.
en: Decision-making and responsibility in the company belong with the entrepreneur, and the company may employ workers as in other forms of business.

so: Shirkad saamiyeedku waa nooc shirkadeed ee badanaa la isticmaalo.
en: Limited company is the most common company form in Finland.

so: Shirkad saamiyeedku waxay ku habboon tahay nooc kasta oo waxqabad ganacsi.
en: A limited company is suitable for all kinds of business operations.

so: Kaligaa ama saamiley kale ayaad la sameysan kartaa shirkad saamiyeedka.
en: You can start a limited company alone or with other shareholders.

so: Awoodda codka ee saamilaha, faa'iidooyinka iyo mas'uuliyadda shirkaddu waxay ku xiran yihiin inta ay dhan yihiin saamiyada uu qofku leeyahay.
en: A shareholder's voting power, profit and liability depend on how many shares they own.

so: Shirkad furan waa shirkadan shakhsiyaadku leeyihiin waxay samaysantaa haddii laba qof ama dad badan ay ku heshiiyaan inay shirkad samaystaan oo ay sameeyaan heshiiska shirkadda oo qoraal ah.
en: A partnership is formed when two or more individuals agree to it by signing a partnership agreement.

so: Dadka shirkaddu ka dhaxaysaa way u siman yihiin arrimaha shirkadda oo dhan, si wadajir ah bayna shakhsi ahaan mas'uul uga yihiin go'aamada arrimaha shirkadda ku saabsan, waajibaadka shirkadda saaran iyo deymanka shirkadda lagu leeyahay.
en: The partners have equal status in all the company's operations and are personally responsible for company decisions, liabilities and debts.

so: Waa shirkad dad shakhsiyaad ah leeyihiin, laakiin waxay shirkadda furan kaga duwan tahay, shirkadda noocan ahi waxay leedahay hal ama dhowr qof oo mas'uuliyadda shirkaddu saaran tahay, waxay kaloo leedahay ugu yaraan hal qof oo shirkadda wax ku leh, laakiin aan cod ka dhiiban arrimaha shirkadda (äänetön yhtiömies), macnaheedu waa qof shirkadda uga tirsan si maalgeliye ahaan ah oo keliya.
en: A limited partnership differs from an ordinary partnership in that in addition to one or more accountable partners there is at least one sleeping partner, i.e. a participant in the company who generally acts as an investor.

so: Iskaashatadu waxaa shirkad ay leeyihiin dadka xubnaha ka ah.
en: Cooperative association is a company owned by its members.

so: Iskaashatada waxaa xubin ka noqon kara hal ilaa dhawr xubnood.
en: There can be one or several members.

so: Qof walba oo xubin ah iskaashatada hal cod ayuu ku leeyahay shirarka shirkadda iskaashatada.
en: Each member has one vote in cooperative association meetings.

so: Tusaale ahaan deymaha iskaashatadu gasho, xubnaha iskaashatada waxaa xil ka saaran yahay in le'eg hantida ay iskaashada geliyeen oo keliya.
en: The liability of the members for the cooperative association's obligations (for example, debts) is limited to their investment of share capital.

so: Sharci degenaansho mise diiwaangelinta xaqa joogitaanka?
en: Residence permit or registration of right of residence?

so: Samee qorshaha waxqabadka ganacsiga
en: Make a business plan

so: Talow weydii talo-bixinta ganacsiga
en: Ask for advice from Business advice

so: Shirkad waad ka samaysan kartaa Finland kumana xirna jinsiyaddaada.
en: You can start a company in Finland regardless of your nationality.

so: Muhiimaddu waa in aad heysato xaqa joogitaanka Finland, aqoonta xirfadeed ee loo baahan yahay iyo aqoon afka Finnishka ah oo kugu filan.
en: It is important that you have a right of residence in Finland, the necessary professional skills and sufficient Finnish language skills.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin wadan Waquuyiga Yurub ah aad Finland u soo guurto, iska diiwaangeli xafiiska diiwaangelinta.
en: If you are a Nordic citizen and you move to Finland, register at the Local Registry Office.

so: Uma baahnid sharciga degenaanshaha Finland.
en: You do not need a separate residence permit for Finland.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinland Muwaadiniinta u dhashay wuqooyiga Yurub.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Nordic citizens.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin wadan Midowga Yurub, Liechtenstein ama Switzerland aadna Finland joogto ugu soo guureyso, iska diiwaangeli Hoggaanka socdaalka iyo xafiiska diiwaangelinta.
en: If you are a citizen of an EU member state, Liechtenstein or Switzerland and you move to Finland, register at the Finnish Immigration Service and Local Registry Office.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii akhri bogga InfoFinland Muwaadiniinta Midowga Yurub.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page EU citizens.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin wadan Midowga Yurub aadna u soo guureyso Finland waxaad u baahan tahay sharciga degenaanshaha ganacsadaha, sharciga degenaanshaha shaqaalaha ama sharciga degenaanshaha Startup.
en: If you are a citizen of a country that is not an EU member state and you move to Finland as an entrepreneur, you need either an entrepreneur's residence permit, employee's residence permit or startup residence permit.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii akhri bogga InfoFinland Ku imaanshaha Finland ganacsade ahaan.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Moving to Finland as an entrepreneur.

so: Habsami-socodka aasaasidda shirkaddu wuxuu la mid yahay kan muwaadin Finnish ah.
en: The process of starting a business is the same as for Finnish citizens.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso in aad shirkad samaysato, si fiican uga fikir in aad heysato fikrad ganacsi oo wanaagsan.
en: If you want to establish a business, consider carefully whether your business idea is a good one.

so: Waa muhiim in aad si aad u fiican taqaan laanta aad ka shaqeynayso iyo sharciga quseeya.
en: Consider too, whether you have sufficient professional skill and experience.

so: Waxaa kale muhiim ah aqoonta macaamiishaada iyo hababka iibka.
en: It is also important to know your customers and sales methods.

so: Xusuusnow, in ganacsigu uu halistiisa leeyahay.
en: Don't forget that there are also risks involved in entrepreneurship.

so: Maalgelin ku filan iyo qorshe laga taxadiray ayaa ah waxa aan laga maarmin.
en: Adequate financing and careful planning are essential.

so: Qorshaha ganacsiga waxaad uga fikireysaa awooddaa aqooneed iyo waxyaabaha aad ku liidato iyo waxyaabaha uu leeyahay waxa aad iibineyso, alaabta ama adeegga.
en: In a business plan, you analyse the strengths and weaknesses of your skills as well as the properties of the product, goods or service you will offer.

so: Ka fikir dadka macaamiishaada ah iyo rajooyinka ay qabaan.
en: Consider who your customers are and what kinds of wishes they have.

so: Ka fikir sidoo kale dadka suuqa kugula tartamaya nooca ay yihiin iyo nooca waxyaabaha ay iibinayaan iyo hababkooda waxqabadka.
en: Also consider who your competitors are and what kind of products and operating methods they have.

so: Qeybta ugu muhiimsan qorshaha ganacsigu waa qorshaha waxqabadka shirkadaada.
en: The most important part of a business plan is the operation plan of your company.

so: Si fiican uga fikir sida ay shirkaddaadu u shaqeynayso iyo meelaha ay shirkaddaadu ku shaqeynayso nooca ay yihiin.
en: Consider carefully how, where and on what kind of premises your company will operate.

so: ka fikir, qalabka wax soo saarka iyo shaqaalaha aad u baahan tahay.
en: Consider the production equipment or labour you will need.

so: Iyo qalabka xayeesiinta ee aad u isticmaaleyso horumarinta iibintaada.
en: What kind of advertising media will you use to promote sales?

so: Soo ogow sidoo kale in ceymisku uu daboolayo halista waxqabadka.
en: You must also find out whether insurance covers the operational risks.

so: Ka fikir sidoo kale sida aad qaban-qaabineyso xisaabaynta una qorsheynayso dhaqaalaha.
en: Also consider how you will organise bookkeeping and plan finances.

so: Sidee ayaad dooneysaa inaad ula socoto, sidee ayeey qorshahaadu u hirgelayaan?
en: How will you monitor the realisation of your plans?

so: Arrimahan oo dhan ku qor qorshahaada waxqabadka ganacsiga.
en: Write down all these things in your business plan.

so: Caawimaadda sameynta qorshaha ganacsiga
en: Help in making a business plan

so: Talooyin rasmi ah waxaad dejinta qorshaha waxqabadka ganacsiga uga heleysaa xarumaha talobixinta ganacsi.
en: More detailed advice on producing a business plan can be obtained from the various business advice centres.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale bogaggooda ka rogan kartaa hagitaannada ganacsadaha oo ku qoran Finnish iyo Ingiriis.
en: You can also download entrepreneur guides in at least Finnish and English from their websites.

so: Waxaad halkaas sidoo kale helesaa saballo ama tusaalooyinka qorshaha waxqabadka ganacsiga iyo samballada dukumentiyo kale.
en: You can also find a business plan template and other document templates there.

so: Finland, qofkasta wuxuu xaq u leeyahay in uu helo talobixin ganacsi oo lacag la'aan ah.
en: Free business advice is available to everyone in Finland.

so: Talobixinta waxaa bixiya tusaale ahaan:
en: Advice is offered, for example, by:

so: Ganacsi Finland ( Bogagga internetka iyo telefoonka)
en: Enterprise Finland (Yritys-Suomi) (through its website and by phone)

so: Marka aad hesho aragti ganacsi oo wanaagsan, la xiriir xarunta adeegga shirkadaha ee kuugu dhow.
en: If you have a good business idea, contact your nearest business development agency.

so: Khubrada halkaas joogta ayaa kaa caawinaya horumarinta fikradda ganacsiga, baaritaanka suuqa, xisaabinta faa'iido lahaanshaha iyo sahminta maalgelinta.
en: There, experts will help you develop your business idea, do market research, calculate profitability and survey financing.

so: Kaalmo ayaad sidoo kale ka heleysaa marka aad ka fikireyso sameysashada shirkad.
en: You can also get support for considering whether to start a company.

so: Talobixinta ganacsiga waxaad ku heleysaa afka Finnishka iyo Iswidhishka magaalooyinka waaweynna waxaad ku heleysaa af Ingiis.
en: Business advice is given in Finnish and Swedish and, at least in larger towns, also in English.

so: Mararka qaad waxaa suurtagal ah in xittaa talobixinta lagu helo luqado kale.
en: Sometimes, it may even be possible to get business advice in other languages.

so: Dhinacyo kala gedisan ayaa qabanqaabiya koorasyada ganacsadaha iyo madal-wareedyo, kuwaas oo uu faa'iidooyin badan ka helayo qofka shirkad samaysanaya.
en: Different establishments organise courses and information events for entrepreneurs, and these are very useful for people who are starting a business.

so: Waxyaabaha koorasyada looga baaraandegayo waa tusaale ahaan sameynta qorshaha waxqabadka ganacsiga, billaabista shaqada shirkadda, xisaabhaynta, canshuurta shirkadda, arrimaha sharciga, suuqgeynta, adeegga iibinta iyo macaamiisha.
en: The subjects covered in the courses include, for example, how to make a business plan, launching business activities, bookkeeping, company taxation, legal matters, marketing, sales and customer service.

so: Intaadan shirkadda aasaasin ka hor si taxader leh uga fikir maalgelinta shirkadda.
en: Financing of the company must be carefully planned before you start a company.

so: Waa muhiim in aad billowga hore heysato raasal-maal kugu filan.
en: It is important for there to be sufficient capital at the outset.

so: Maalgelinta shirkaddu waxay qeyb ahaan noqon kartaa lacag hadiyad ama deyn ah.
en: Company financing may also be partly in the form of donations or loans.

so: Marka aad deynta codsaneyso waa in aad heysataa qorshaha waxqabada ganacsiga oo wanaagsan.
en: When you apply for financing, you must have a sound business plan ready.

so: Bangiyada iyo Finnvera ayaa ganacsatada shirkado sameysanaya deyn siiya.
en: Banks and Finnvera grant loans to entrepreneurs who start a company.

so: Finnvera waa shirkad maalgelineed oo ay dowladda Finland leedahay.
en: Finnvera is a financing company owned by the state of Finland.

so: Waxay deyn siisaa shirkadaha cusub iyo shirkadaha shaqeynaya.
en: It grants loans to new companies and to companies that are already running.

so: Haddii ay shirkadaadu heysato waxqabadka faa'iido leh, laakiin aadan heysan lacag badan ama ceymis aad bangiga deyn uga qaadan karto, weydii Finnvera in deyn ama damiinta deynta ka helo iyo in kale.
en: If your company has the preconditions for profitable operations but you do not have enough capital or securities to get a loan from a bank, ask whether Finnvera could give you a loan or sponsor your loan.

so: Markii aad ganacsi bilowdid waxaa lagu siin karaa lacagta bilowga gancsiga (starttiraha) si aad u heshid lacagta baadbaada nolosha inta hawlaha ganacsigu ay bilowga yihiin.
en: When you become an entrepreneur, you can receive a start-up grant to ensure your livelihood during the beginning of your business operation.

so: Ka codso lacagta billaabista xafiiska shaqada ee aad macaamiisha ka tahay.
en: Apply for a start-up grant to your local Employment and Economic Office.

so: Markii aad dalbanaysid lacagta bilowga, Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashadu wuxuu baarayaa, in ganacsigu uu yahay doorasho adiga kugu habboon.
en: When you apply for a start-up grant, the Employment and Economic Office will determine if entrepreneurship is a suitable employment alternative for you.

so: Waad heli kartaa lacagta billowga, haddii
en: You are eligible for the grant if:

so: aadan aheyn shaqo laawe, balse aad gebi ahaanba isu beddeleysid ganacsade tusaale ahaan adigoo joojinaya shaqada mushaariga ah, ardaynimada ama shaqada guriga
en: you are not unemployed but about to transition into full-time entrepreneurship after having a job, studying or working from home.

so: uu ganasigu kuu yahay shaqo labaad aadna dooneyso inaad waxqabadka ganacsiga ka dhigto mid shaqa koowaad
en: you are a part-time entrepreneur and expand your entrepreneurial activities to full-time.

so: Shuruudaha lacagta bilowga ganacsigu tusaale ahaan waa:
en: Prerequisites for getting a start-up grant:

so: lahaanshada aqoon ganacsi oo ku filan, lahaanshada xirfad iyo imkaaniyaadka looga baahan yahay hawlaha ganacsiga aad qorsheyneysid.
en: knowledge, skillset and resources required for the planned entrepreneurship

so: Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada ayaa qiimeynaya, in hawlaha ganacsigu ay noqon karaan kuwo faa'iido leh
en: potential to run a profitable business, as evaluated by the Employment and Economic Development Office

so: inay cagta bilowga ganacsigu tahay mid daruuri ah marka laga eego xagga dakhliga nolosha ee qofka ganacsiga bilaabaya
en: the start-up grant is needed for the entrepreneur to make a living

so: in hawsha ganacsiga la bilaabayo kadib, marka la ogolaado lacagta kaalmada
en: business operations will be started only after the decision on your start-up grant has been made

so: Haddii aad ku fekereyso inaad codsato lacagta billaabista, la xiriir wakhti hore Xafiiska shaqada iyo dhaqaalaha.
en: If you are going to apply for a start-up grant, contact your Employment and Economic Development office as soon as possible.

so: Sidoo kale waxaa jira kaalmooyin ka duwan oo loogu talogalay in la siiyo ganacsadaha bilowga ah.
en: Other forms of support for an entrepreneur are also available.

so: Ganacsi-Finland (Yritys-Suomi) ayaa ku siinaya wixii macluumaad ah oo la xiriira wadiiqooyinka kala duwan ee maalgelinta.
en: Enterprise Finland gives information on different financing options.

so: Marka aad aasaasaysid shirkad, waa inaad doorataa nooca shirkada iyo magaca shirkadda waana inaad caddaysaa qaybta ganacsiga aad bilaabaysid.
en: When establishing a business, the company form, name of the company and choice of field of activity have to be chosen.

so: Marka aad dooraneyso nooca shirkadda, xisaabta ku daro waxyaabaha ay kamidka yihiin cadadda dadka shirkadda samaynaya, baahida raasal-maalka, qaybsiga mas'uuliyadda iyo awoodda go'aan gaarida, maalgelinta iyo canshuurta.
en: When choosing the company form, you must consider, for example, the number of founders, capital requirement, division of responsibility and decision-making, financing and taxation.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinland Noocyada shirkadaha.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Company forms.

so: Halkeen caawimaad uga helaa dhibaatooyinka nolosha shaqada?
en: Where can I get help for problems in working life?

so: Marka hore kala hadal madaxdaada.
en: Discuss with your supervisor first.

so: Haddii ay waxba caawin weydo, la xiriir wakiilka badbaadada ee goobta shaqada ama qofka loo wakiishay arrimahaas.
en: If that does not help, contact the shop steward of the workplace.

so: Haddii aysan goobta shaqadu laheyn qof la wakiishay islamarkaasna aad xubin ka tahay iskaashatada xirfadleyda, la xiriir iskaashatadaada xirfadleyda.
en: If there is no shop steward at the workplace and you are a member of a trade union, contact your trade union.

so: Xiriirka guud ee iskaashatooyinka xirfadleyda Finland SAK waxey si lacag la'aan ah ku bixisaa talo bixinta xiriirka shaqada.
en: The Central Organisation of Finnish Trade Unions (SAK) provides free employment counselling.

so: Sharciyaqaanadu waxey su'aalahaada uga jawaabayaan af Finnish iyo Ingiriis.
en: Lawyers answer your questions in Finnish and English.

so: Talo-bixinta waxaad ku heleysaa telefoon iyo emayl:
en: Counselling is available by both telephone and e-mail:

so: Waxaad sidoo kale wici kartaa telefoonka talo-bixinta dalka oo dhan ee hay'adda badbaadada shaqaalaha:
en: You can also call the national counselling service of occupational safety and health authorities:

so: Mar dhow ayuu dhamaanayaa xiriirkayga shaqadu.
en: My employment ends soon.

so: Sidee ayeey saameyn ugu yeelan kartaa sharcigayga degenaanshaha?
en: How does it affect my residence permit?

so: Xaaladdu waxey ku xiran tahay sharciga degenaanshaha ee aad heysato nooca uu yahay.
en: The situation depends on what kind of residence permit you have.

so: Haddii sharcigaaada degenaanshuhu uu quseeyo shaqo-bixiye cayiman oo kaliya, codso sharciga degenaanshaha shaqaalaha oo cusub.
en: If your residence permit concerns only a certain employer, apply for a new residence permit for an employee.

so: Si aad u codsato sharciga degenaanshaha oo cusub waa in aad shaqo cusub heysataa.
en: You must have a new workplace in order to apply for a new residence permit for an employee.

so: Sharciga degenaanshaha waxaad sidoo kale ku codsan kartaa sababo kale.
en: You can also apply for a residence permit on some other grounds.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan sababaha sharciga degenaanshaha ka aqri qeybta InfoFinlandi Aan aheyn muwaadin EU.
en: Read more about the grounds for a residence permit in the InfoFinland section Non-EU citizens.

so: Haddii uu xiriirkaada shaqo dhamaanayo ka hor inta uusan dhicin sharciga degenaanshuhu, qoraal ahaan u ogeysii Hay'adda socdaalka.
en: If your employment ends before the end of the residence permit, notify the Finnish Immigration Service in writing.

so: Shaqo-bixiyahaada ayaa ogeysiiska sameyn kara.
en: Your employee can also submit the notification.

so: Haddii sharcigada degenaanshaha laguugu siiyay xirfad cayiman darteed, waxaad booska shaqada ku beddelan kartaa isla xirfadda dhexdeeda.
en: If your residence permit has been granted for a certain professional field, you may change workplaces within the field.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan ka codsashada Finland shaqo ka aqri bogga Halkee laga heli karaa shaqo?
en: Read more about looking for work in Finland on the page Where to find work?

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan codsashada magdhowga shaqo la'aanta waxaad ka heleysaa bogga Gargaarka shaqo la'aanta.
en: You can find more information on applying for unemployment benefit on the page Unemployment benefit.

so: Waxaa aniga la i siiyay mushaar aad u yar.
en: I have been underpaid.

so: Ka hubi markasta xisaabta mushaarka in aad heshay mushaar cadadkiisu sax yahay.
en: Always check your payslip to ensure that you have received the right amount of salary.

so: Haddii aad heshay mushaar aad u yar, ka codso shaqo-bixiyaha in uu saxo xisaabta mushaarka.
en: If you have received too little, ask the employer for a correction of salary payment.

so: Haddii uu shaqo-bixiyuhu ku siin waayo mushaar sax ah, talo weydiiso badbaadada shaqaalaha ee waaxda maamulka gobolka ama iskaashatadaada xirfadleyda.
en: If the employer does not pay the correct amount, ask for advice at occupational safety and health at the Regional State Administrative Agencies or at your own trade union.

so: Haddii aadan shaqo-bixiyahaada kala heshiin karin bixinta mushaarka, arrinta waa in lagu xalliyaa maxkamad.
en: If you cannot agree on salary payment with your employer, the matter must be resolved at court.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatase tani waa xalka ugu dambeeya.
en: However, that is the final option.

so: Shaqo-bixiyaheygu wuxuu doonayaa in uu mushaarka caddaan ku bixiyo.
en: My employer only wants to pay my salary in cash.

so: Shaqo-bixiyuhu waa in uu mushaarka ku soo shubaa akoonkaada bangiga.
en: Your employer should pay your salary to your bank account.

so: Mushaarka waxaa kaash ahaan loo bixin karaa oo kaliya haddii wax kale oo suurtagali kara aysan jirin.
en: The salary may only be paid in cash when there are no other options available.

so: Sidan waxaa la sameeyaa tusaale ahaan, marka aadan laheyn akoon bangi.
en: This can be done, for example, if you do not have a bank account.

so: Haddii mushaarka gacanta laga siiyo, waa in aad bixinta mushaarka ka siisaa shaqo-bixiyahaada caddeyn saxiixan.
en: If your salary is paid in cash, you must give your employer a signed certificate of salary payment.

so: Sidan waxaa lagu caddeyn karaa in mushaarka si dhab ah laguu siiyay.
en: This way, it can be proven that that the salary has really been paid to you.

so: Xiriirkaygi shaqo ee ku meel gaarka ahaa waa dhamaatay, laakiin la ima siinin mushaarkaygi ugu dambeeyay.
en: My fixed-term employment ended but I was not paid my last salary.

so: Maxey tahay in aan sameeyo?
en: What should I do?

so: Weydii shaqo-bixiyaha sababta uu mushaarku u soo daahay.
en: Ask the employer for the reason for the delay in payment.

so: Ka dalbo shaqo-bixiyaha in uu mushaarka bixiyo.
en: Demand that the employer pay your salary.

so: Qoraal ahaan dalabka ugu gudbi.
en: Present the demand in writing.

so: Haddii aad xubin ka tahay iskaashato xirfadeed, waxaad caawimaad weydiisan kartaa iskaashatadaada.
en: If you are a trade union member, you can ask for help at your union.

so: Haddii aadan ka tirsaneyn iskaashato xirfadeed, la xiriir tusaale ahaan hay'adda badbaadada shaqaalaha.
en: If you are not a trade union member, contact the occupational safety and health authorities, for example.

so: Waxaan joojiyay shaqadi aan ka hayay booskaygi hore ee shaqada, laakiin ma helin shahaadada shaqada.
en: I ended my job at my previous workplace but did not receive a testimonial of service.

so: Sideen ku helayaa shahaadada shaqada?
en: How do I get the testimonial of service?

so: Shaqo-bixiyaha loogama baahna in uu iskiis kuu siiyo shahaadada shaqada.
en: The employer does not have to give you a testimonial of service on its own initiative.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso shahaado shaqo, codso.
en: If you want a testimonial of service, ask for it.

so: Shahaadada waa in laguugu soo diraa sida ugu macquulsan uguna dhakhsaha badan.
en: The testimonial must be submitted to you as soon as possible.

so: Haddii aad codsatay shahaadada shaqada balse aadan helin, la xiriir hay'adda badbaadada shaqada.
en: If you have asked for a testimonial of service but have not received it, contact the occupational safety and health authorities.

so: Waxaan dareensanahay in booska shaqada laygula dhaqo si aan munaasib aheyn.
en: I feel that I am treated inappropriately at my workplace.

so: Shaqaalaha oo dhan waa in loola dhaqmaa sinnaan iyo si isku qiimo ah.
en: All employees must be treated equally.

so: Sida uu sharcigu qabo qofna laguma takoori karo tusaale ahaan sababaha soo socda:
en: According to the law, no one must be discriminated against because of these reasons, for example:

so: Takooridda waxaa dheer oo goobaha shaqada lagu arki karaa hab-dhaqanno kale oo aan munaasib aheyn, sida dhibista ama qashqashaad galmeed.
en: In addition to discrimination, other inappropriate treatment may also occur at workplaces, such as bullying or sexual harassment.

so: Marka hore arrinta kala hadal madaxdaada.
en: Talk to your supervisor first.

so: Haddii aadan isaga caawimaad ka helin, la xiriir wakiilka badbaadada ee goobta shaqada ama qofka loo wakiishay arrimahaas.
en: If he or she cannot help you, contact the occupational safety officer or shop steward at your workplace.

so: Haddii arrintu ay ku xallismi weyso goobta shaqada, la xiriir hay'adda badbaadada shaqaalaha ama iskaashatadaada xirfadleyda.
en: If the issue cannot be resolved at the workplace, contact the occupational safety and health authorities or your trade union.

so: Haddii uu madaxdaadu kuula macaamilo si aan munaasib aheyn, ogeysii hay'adda badbaadada shaqaalaha.
en: If your supervisor treats you inappropriately, report it to the occupational safety and health authorities.

so: Ogeysiiska waxaad sameyn karto adigoo magacaada sheegaya ama adigoo magacaada qarinaya.
en: You can submit the report using your name or anonymously.

so: Waxaa aniga la igu qasbay shaqo aan mushaar la iga siin.
en: I am forced to work with no salary.

so: Rabshad ayuu sidoo kale iigu hanjabayaa shaqo-bixiyaheygu.
en: My employer also threatens me with violence.

so: Xageen caawimaad ka helayaa?
en: Where can I get help?

so: Waxaad xaq u leedahay in aad hesho caawimaad iyo badbaado.
en: You have the right to get help and protection.

so: Sida uu sharciga Finland qabo, shaqaalaha waa in si fiican loola macaamilaa mushaarna la siiyaa.
en: According to Finnish law, employees must be treated well and they must be paid salary.

so: Ka ganacsiga dadku Finland waa ka dembi.
en: Human trafficking is a crime in Finland.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Ka ganacsiga dadka iyo ku shaqaysiga qasabka ah.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Human trafficking and forced labour.

so: Macluumaadka xuquuqda iyo waajibaadka shaqaalaha ee Finland waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga InfoFinlandi Xuquuqda iyo waajibaadka shaqaalaha.
en: More information on the rights of employees in Finland is available on the InfoFinland page Employee's rights and obligations.

so: Qofka shaqaalaha ahi wuxuu xaq u leeyahay inuu helo shahaadada shaqada markii heshiiska shaqodu uu dhamaado, haddii uu codsado.Shahaadada shaqodu waa waraaq muhiim ah, taasoo ay ku cad yihiin inta ay shaqodu socotay iyo hawsha la qabtay intii shaqodu socotey.
en: An employee is entitled to receive, on request, a testimonial of service from their employer at the end of the contract of employment. A testimonial of service is an important document specifying the duration of the contract of employment and the employee's tasks.

so: Sidoo kale shaqaaluhu wuxuu codsan karaa in shahaada lagu qoro sababaha heshiiska shaqadu u dhamaaday iyo sidoo kale qiimeynta xirfada shaqo iyo hab dhaqanka qofka shaqaalaha ah.
en: The employee can also ask that the reason why the contract of employment ended and an estimation of the employee's skills and behaviour are included in the testimonial.

so: Shaqa-bixiyaha waxaa waajib kasaaranyahay inuu shahaadada shaqada bixiyo ilaa laga gaarayo mudo toban sano ah laga bilaabo markii shaqadu dhamaatay iyo toban sano kadibba, haddii aysan shaqa-bixiyaha dhibaato ku ahayn.
en: Even ten years after the contract of employment has ended, the employer is obliged to provide a testimonial of service and, after this, only if it does not cause the employer unreasonable inconvenience.

so: Haddii qofka shaqaalaha ahi uu rabo inuu qiimayn la xiriirta xirfada shaqada iyo hab-dhaqankiisa la siiyo, shaqo bixiyuhu wuxuu ku qasban yahay inuu siiyo inta ay shan sano ka soo wareegayso xiligii heshiiska shaqodu dhamaaday.
en: If the employee wishes to have an estimation of their skills and behaviour included in the testimonial, the employer shall deliver it to the employee on their request up to five years after the contract of employment has ended.

so: Shaqo bixiyeyaashu waa inay shahaado cusub siiyaan shaqaalaha, haddii shahaadada shaqadu ka lunto ama ay ka xumaato.
en: The employer shall also give the employee a new testimonial of service if the employee's testimonial is lost or gets ruined.

so: Shaqa-bixiyaha si kas ah ama taxadar la'aan ah awgeed aan u siin shahaadada shaqada wuxuu jabiyey sharciga heshiiska shaqada.
en: An employer who knowingly or out of carelessness fails to provide a testimonial of service is in breach of the Employment Contracts Act.

so: soo wac lambarka 029 497 000 (luqadaha adeegga: finish, ingiriis, swidish)
en: by calling 029 497 000 (the service is available in Finnish, Swedish and English)

so: Markii ay qoyska ilmo u dhashaan, waalidiintu waxay xaq u leeyihiin inay qaataan fasaxa qoyska, ayna ilmaha guriga ku haystaan.
en: When a child is born to a family, the parents are entitled to family leave, i.e. to stay at home and look after the child.

so: Horay u ogeysii shaqo-bixiyahaada ugu yaraan labo bilood fasax qoyska.
en: Notify your employer of your family leave at least two months in advance.

so: Fasaxyada qoysku inta badan waa fasaxyo mushaar la'aan ah.
en: Family leave is usually unpaid vacation.

so: In mushaar lagaa siiyo waqtiga fasaxa qoysku wuxuu ku xiranyahay heshiiska shuruudaha shaqadaada.
en: Whether or not you will be paid for your family leave depends on your collective agreement.

so: Arrinta ka hubso shaqo-bixiyahaada.
en: Check the matter from your employer.

so: Keladu waxey bixineysaa inta lagu jiro fasaxyada qoyska manfacyada qoyska, yacni lacagta gunno maalmeedka waalidka iyo kaalmada guri ku heynta.
en: Kela pays family allowance for the time of family leave, i.e. parental allowance and home care allowance.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan shuruudaha manfacyada qoyska ka sii aqri bogagga InfoFinlandi Kaalmada dhalashada ilmaha kadib iyo Kaalmada guri ku xanaaneynta ilmaha.
en: Read about the conditions of family allowance on the InfoFinland pages Benefits for a family after a child is born and Benefits for looking after a child at home.

so: Markii fasaxyada waaliku dhamaadaan, qofka shaqaalaha ah wuxuu xaq u leeyahay inuu ku noqdo shaqadiisii hore ama shaqo u dhiganta isla meeshii hore oo uu ka shaqeyn jiray.
en: When the family leave has ended, the employee has the right to return to their own work or to comparable work in their old workplace.

so: Hooyada uurka leh heshiiska shaqadeeda lama burin karo, lagumana takoori karo uurkeeda awgiis.
en: The contract of employment of a pregnant woman cannot be dissolved, nor can she be discriminated against because of her pregnancy.

so: Dalka Finland shaqo-bixiyeyaasha iyo shaqaaluhuba way yaqaanaan fasaxyada qoyska wayna isticmaalaan fasaxyadaas sida badan.
en: Employers and employees in Finland are very familiar with these family leaves and they are commonly utilised.

so: Fasaxa hooyanimadu wuxuu dhan yahay 105 maalin shaqo.
en: The duration of maternity leave is 105 weekdays.

so: Fasaxa hooyanimada inta lagu jiro shaqada waa la ogol yahay, haddii aysan dhibaataynayn nabadgelyada hooyada, ilmaha uurka ama kuwa kale.
en: Working is allowed during maternity leave if it can take place without endangering the safety of the mother, foetus or child.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee hooyadu wax shaqo ah ma qaban karto inta lagu jiro labada usbuuc oo ka horeeya waqtiga dhalmada loo qabtay, sidoo kale hooyadu wax shaqo ah ma qaban karto labada usbuuc oo dhalmada ka dambaysa.
en: However, the mother cannot work while on maternity leave during the two weeks before the expected date of delivery, nor during the two weeks after giving birth.

so: Fasaxa aabuhu waa qeyb kamid ah fasaxa waalidka oo loogu talagalay in uu aabuhu qaato.
en: Paternity leave is the part of parental leave intended for the father.

so: Tirada fasaxa aabuhu waa marka la isugu geeyo 54 maalmood oo maalamaha shaqada ah.
en: The length of paternity leave is 54 weekdays.

so: Waxaad qaadan kartaa ugu badnaan 18 maalmood oo maalmaha fasaxa aabaha ah islawaqtiga ay hooyada cunuggu ku jirto fasaxa hooyanimada ama waalidka.
en: You can take a maximum of 18 days of paternity leave at the same time as the mother of your child is on maternity or parental leave.

so: Maalmahan waxaad u qeybin kartaa ugu badnaan afar qeybood.
en: You can divide these days into up to four periods.

so: 36 maalmood ee haray waxaad ugu badnaan u qeybin kartaa labo xilli.
en: The remaining 36 days can be divided into up to two periods.

so: Ujeedadu waa in uu aabuhu cunugga xannaaneeyo.
en: The intention is that the father will look after the child.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale hooyada la qaadan kartaa gebi ahaan 54 maalmood waqtiyo kala duduwan.
en: You can also take all 54 days of paternity leave at a different time than the mother.

so: diga ayaa go'aan ka gaari kara inaad fasaxa aabaha wada qaadaneyso iyo inaad qeyb ka qaadaneyso.
en: You can decide for yourself if you want to have all paternity leave days or only some of them.

so: Maalmaha fasaxa aabaha waxaa loo isticmaali karaa oo kali ah xannaaneynta cunugga kayar 2 sano.
en: Paternity leave can only be used to take care of a child who is under 2 years of age.

so: Fasaxa hooyanimada ka dib hooyada ama aabuhu waxay joogi karaan guriga ayagoo qaadanaya fasaxa waalidka, si ay ilmaha yar guriga ugu xanaaneeyaan. Fasaxa waalidku waa 158 maalmood oo ah maalamaha shaqada.
en: After the period of maternity leave, either the mother or father can stay at home to look after the baby on parental leave which is 158 weekdays long.

so: Labada waalid hal mar fasaxa waalidnimada islama qaadan karaan.
en: Both parents cannot take parental leave at the same time.

so: Fasaxa waalidka waxaa loo qeybsan karaa sidoo kale in hooyada iyo aabuhu ay si kaltan ah cunugga guriga ugu xannaaneeyaan.
en: Parental leave can, however, be divided so that the father and the mother take turns in staying home with the child.

so: Fasaxa waalidka kadib hooyada ama aabaha ayaa geli kara fasaxa xannaaneynta oo mushaar la'aan ah inta uu cunuggu ka buuxinayo 3 sano.
en: After the parental leave period is over, the father or mother can take unpaid child care leave to look after their child until the child turns 3.

so: Waxey ku xiran tahay in hooyada ama aabuhu ay hal shaqo-bixiye ugu yaraan 6 bilood u shaqeynayeen sanadki la soo dhaafay.
en: This requires that the mother or father has been working for the same employer for at least 6 months during the past year.

so: Inta lagu jiro fasaxa xanaanada, Kelada ayaa bixineysa kaalmada guri ku xanaaneynta.
en: During the child care leave, Kela pays the parent home care allowance.

so: Shuruudaha guri ku xanaaneynta ka fiiri bogga InfoFinlandi Kaalmada guri ku xanaaneynta ilmaha.
en: Read more about the conditions for home care allowance at the InfoFinland page Benefits for looking after a child at home.

so: Markaas waxaad sameyneysaa waqti shaqo oo gaaban adigoo helaya mushaar kayar kii hore.
en: This means working shorter hours and being paid correspondingly less.

so: Sido o kale labada waalid waxay qaadan faasaxa waalid nimada oo qabyada ah, tusaale ahaan midkood wuxuu yareynaya saacadaha subixii uu shaqeeyo kan kalena saacadaha galabtii ayuu yaraynayaa.
en: It is also possible for both parents to take partial child care leave, for example, so that one works in the morning and the other in the afternoon.

so: Waxaad ku jiri kartaa fasaxa xannaaneynta ee barka ah inta uu cunugaadu ka dhameynayo fasalka labaad ee iskuulka.
en: You can stay on partial child care leave until your child completes his/her second school grade.

so: Waxaad Kelada uga codsan kartaa lacagta xannaaneynta cunugga 3 sano kayar iyo xannaaneynta cunugga fasalka 1aad iyo 2aad ku jira haddii aad Guri degmo ku leedahay Finland.
en: You can apply for partial child care allowance from Kela for looking after a child who is under the age of 3 or in grade 1 or 2 of school if you have a municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Lacagta xanaaneynta ee qeybta laguma heli karo xannaaneynta cunugga buuxiyay saddex sano ee aan weli iskuulka gelin.
en: Partial child care allowance is not granted for looking after a child who is three years old or over, but not yet in school.

so: Warar dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan lacagta xanaanada ee qeybta ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Kaalmada guri ku xanaaneynta ilmaha.
en: Read more about partial child care allowance on the InfoFinland web page Benefits for looking after a child at home.

so: Shaqo-bixiyaha waxaa waajib ku ah in uu waqtiga jirada mushaar kaa siiyo.
en: Your employer is responsible for paying you salary during your sick leave.

so: Haddii xiriirkaada shaqadu uu socday wax ka badan bil jirashada kahor, waxaad heleysaa muhaar buuxa ugu yaraan laga bilaabo maalinta jirashada iyo sagaal maalmood waqtiga maalinta jirashada ka dambeeya.
en: If your employment has continued for more than a month before you fall ill, you will receive full salary for at least the day you fell ill and for nine days after the day you fell ill.

so: Haddii taas kadib xitaa aadan ku noqon karin shaqada waxaad Kelada ka codsaneysaa lacag maalmeedka jirada (sairauspäiväraha), haddii aad ku jirto xeyndaabka caymiska jirashada ee Finland.
en: If you are unable to return to work after these ten days, you can apply for sickness allowance (sairauspäiväraha) from Kela, if you are covered by the Finnish social security.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Ammaanka bulshada Finnishka.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Finnish social security.

so: Waxaa laga yaabaa in heshiiska shuruurdaha shaqada shuruudo kale lagu heshiiyay islamarkaasna aad mushaar hesho waqti intaas ka dheer.
en: Your employment contract may also list other conditions and you will be paid salary for a longer period of time.

so: Shaqo-bixiyuhu wuxuu xaq u leeyahay in uu kaa dalbado cadeynta dhaqtarka ee cadeyneysa inaad jirantahay.
en: Your employer is entitled to ask you to provide a doctor's certificate about your illness.

so: Haddii aad jirato oo aadan shaqada aadi karin, islamarkaasba ogeysii madaxdaada.
en: If you fall ill and cannot come to work, notify your supervisor of this immediately.

so: Madaxdaada ayaa kuu sheegaya inaad u baahantahay cadeynta jirada ee dhaqtarka islamarkaas ama maalinta afaraad marka laga soo bilaabo maalinta jirashada.
en: Your supervisor will tell you whether you need to get a doctor's certificate immediately or only on the fourth day of your sick leave.

so: Ku maqnaanshaha jiradu ma ahan fasax, waxaa loo ogaalaadaa ka soo raysashada jirada darteed, sidaas darteed bogsoonaanshahaada halis ma gelin kartid adigu.
en: Sick leave is not a vacation. It is granted so that your body can heal, so during sick leave you cannot endanger the healing process through your own activities.

so: Hawlaha ganacsiga iyo horumarintooda waxyaabaha la xiriira waxaad weydiin kartaa adeegga la talinta shirkadaha ganacsiga.
en: If you need advice in matters concerning your company's operations or development, contact one of the establishments offering business advice.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah ka akhriso bogga InfoFinlandi Talo-siinta ganacsiga.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Business advice.

so: Ilaalinta danaha (edunvalvonta) ganacsatada iyo adeegyo kale
en: Supervision of the interests (edunvalvonta) of entrepreneurs and other services

so: Shabakada taakulaynta ganacsadaha (Yrittäjän tukiverkko) waa adeeg shabakadeed lacag la'aan ah oo ah xagga internetka lana siiyo ganacsatada Finnishka, kaasoo faa'iidooyin badan oo xagga macluumaadka ah u leh ganacsatada.
en: The support network for entrepreneurs (Yrittäjän tukiverkko) is the Federation of Finnish Enterprises' free online service which offers entrepreneurs a great deal of useful information.

so: Adeegu wuxuu ku shaqeeyaa luuqadaha Finnishka iyo Swidishka.
en: The service is offered in Finnish and Swedish.

so: Daryeelka caafimaadka shaqada waxaa xaq u leh dhammaan
en: Everybody has a right to occupational health care

so: Sidoo kale shaqo-bixiyaha waxaa suurtogal ah inuu shaqaalihiisa u habeeyo adeegyada daryeelka jirada.
en: An employer may also arrange for nursing services for their employees.

so: Daryeelka caafimaadka shaqaalaha waxaa suurtogal ah inaad hesho adeega kalkaaliyaha caafimaadka, kan dhakhtarka caafimaadka shaqaalaha iyo adeegyada caafimaadka shaqaalaha ee dhakhtarka cilmi-nafsiga.
en: In occupational health care, it is possible to receive the services of a nurse, occupational doctor and occupational psychologist.

so: Sida badan halkaas waxaa sidoo kale ka shaqeeya masaajotoore.
en: Often there are also physiotherapists.

so: Adeegyada dhakhaatiirta khaaska ah sida badan kuma jiraan daryeelka caafimaadka shaqaalaha.
en: Occupational health care does not usually include the services of specialists.

so: Waydii shaqo-bixiyahaaga, waxa uu ka kooban yahay daryeelka caafimaadka shaqaalaha ee goobtaada shaqadu.
en: Ask your employer what is included in occupational health care at your workplace.

so: Xuquuqda adeegyada daryeelka caafimaadka shaqaaluhu ma taabanayso qoyska qofka shaqaalaha ah.
en: The right to occupational health care does not extend to the employee's family.

so: Daryeelka caafimaadka ujeedadiisu waa horumarinta caafimaadka iyo awoodida shaqada iyo wada shaqaynta goobta caafimaadka.
en: The target of occupational health care is to promote health, working capacity and teamwork at workplaces.

so: Shaqaalaha daryeelka caafimaadka shaqada waxaa saaran waajibka ilaalinta sirta.
en: Occupational health care staff are bound to professional secrecy.

so: Uma sheegayaan arrimahaada shaqo-bixiyahaada haddii aadan adigu ogolaanshiyo u siinin.
en: They will not share your information with your employer unless you specifically give them permission to do so.

so: Si kastoo ay ahaataba daryeelka caafimaadka shaqadu waxay shaqo-bixiyahaada siin karaan qiimeyn ku saabsan inaad shaqada sii wadi karto caafimaadkaada dartiis iyo inkale.
en: Occupational health care can, however, give your employer an evaluation on whether or not your health allows you to continue to work.

so: Kela ayaa qayb ka mid ah kharashka kaga baxa daryeelka caafimaadka shaqaalaha u soo celineysa shaqo-bixiyaha iyo ganacsadaha, haddii ay lagama maarmaan yihiin kharashkuna uu caqligal yahay.
en: Kela compensates a part of the expenses of occupational health care to the employer and entrepreneur if they are necessary and reasonable.

so: Markii aad hawlo ganacsi bilowdid, waxaa ku saaran waajibaadyo faro-badan, sida diiwaangelinta shirkadaada ganacsi, canshuurta iyo abaabulida habka xisaabaadka.
en: When you go into business you have many obligations, including company registration and organising taxation and bookkeeping.

so: Tusaale ahaan shirkadaha iibiya cuntada ama ganacsiyada waxyaabaha aysku qurxiyo goobaha ay ku shaqeeyaan waa in lagu sameeyo kormeer waana in shaqaalaha dawlada laga codsado ruqsad inta aan goobta loo isticmaalin ganacsi.
en: An inspection of the premises of, for example, companies selling foodstuffs, or a beauty salon, must be carried out and a licence obtained from the municipal health authorities, before such premises can be utilised.

so: Ceymiska halwgabka ee ganacsadaha (YEL-vakuutus) y waa qasab haddii ganacsaduhu uu u dhexeeyo 18- 68 sano islamarkaasna uu waxbqadkiisa ganacsi ka helo ugu yaraan dakhli shaqo oo gaaraya sanad gudihiis 7 645,25 yuuro (xaaladda sanadka 2018).
en: Self-employed persons' pension insurance (YEL-vakuutus) is mandatory, if the self-employed person is between the age of 18 and 68 and receives at least 7 645.25 euros (situation in 2018) of income per year from his or her business.

so: Qolada caymiska bixinaysa iyo ganacsadaha ayaa isla meel dhigaya inta uu le'eg yahay dakhliga shaqada ee ganacsaduhu, markii ganacsaduhu uu galayo caymiska hawlgabka ganacsadaha.
en: The insurer and the entrepreneur agree on a suitable amount of earned income when the entrepreneur takes out a pension insurance policy for a self-employed person.

so: Dakhlliga shaqadu waa inuu noqdo isku celcelis la'aan inta uu noqon lahaa mushaarka ganacsaduhu, haddii uu shaqo tan la mid ah meel kale ka qaban lahaa.
en: The earned income must be approximately the same as the entrepreneur's pay would be on average, if they were performing a similar job in someone else's employment.

so: Shirkadda shakhsiga magaciisa ku furan waa nooca ugu badan noocyada ganacsiga, taasoo la sameeyo ganacsiga ayadoo aanay jirin shirkad kale oo la sameeyey.
en: Proprietorship is the most common company form in which business activities are carried on without a separately founded company.

so: Qofka ganacsigu maciisa ku furan yahay ayaa la canshuuraa, ayadoo la canshuurayo wixii ka soo baxa dakhliga ganacsiga soo galay iyo kharashka ganacsiga ku baxay.
en: The holder of proprietorship is taxed in such a way that all the income that remains after subtracting business expenses is taxable income.

so: Ganacsaduhu maleh mushaar bixin gooni ah.
en: Therefore there is no separate salary payment for the entrepreneur.

so: Waxaa la canshuurayaa dakhliga soo baxada ayadoo hantida shirkadda loo eegayo inay tahay wax ka soo baxay maalgelinta (pääomatulo) ama dakhli shaqo (ansiotulo).
en: Income is taxed according to the wealth existing in the business as income from capital (pääomatulo) or earned income (ansiotulo).

so: Waxa ka sooo baxa maalgelinta waxaa mar walba lagu canshuuraa boqoley isku mid ah.
en: Income from capital is always taxed by the same tax rate.

so: Canshuurta dakhliga shaqadu waa mid sii korhdaayo ama mid boqolleydiisu kororto markii dakhligu kordho.
en: Earned income is taxed progressively; in other words, the greater the income, the more tax is paid on it.

so: Caafimaadka iyo Hawlaha badbaada shaqaalaha ee goobta shaqada
en: Health and safety activities at the workplace

so: Dalka Finland muhiimad weyn ayaa la siiyaa nabadgelyada shaqada.
en: A lot of attention is paid to safety at work in Finland.

so: Shaqa-bixiyaha ayaa ka taxadara sidii shaqaaluhu ay shaqadooda u qabsan lahaayeen si nabadgalyo leh.
en: Employers are responsible for everyone's safety while they work.

so: Shaqa-bixiyaha waxaa xil ka saaran yahay inuu shaqaalaha cusub inta aysan shaqada bilaabin uu u sheego dhamaan waxyaabaha ku saabsan shaqada, goobta shaqada iyo xuquuqdiisaba.
en: An employer must organise induction to the workplace for a new employee.

so: Shaqa-bixiyaha waxaa xil ka saaran yahay inuu shaqaalaha baro waxayaabaha khuseeya nabadgelyada shaqada uuna baro habka saxda ah ee shaqada.
en: An employer is also obliged to familiarise employees with the safety instructions of a workplace and to teach them correct work methods.

so: Sidoo kale shaqaalaha waxaa ku waajiba inay ka taxadaraan nabadgelyada shaqada.
en: Employees must also look after safety at work themselves.

so: Shaqada waa in loo qabtaa si waafaqsan tilmaaha la siiyey shaqaalaha.
en: The work must be performed according to instructions.

so: Haddii ay shaqado si cad khatar u tahay, qofka shaqaalaha wuxuu xaq u leeyahay inuu diido shaqada qabashadeeda.
en: If the work is clearly dangerous, an employee can refuse to do it.

so: Goobta shaqada waa inay joogaan dad ku filan oo loo tababaray gargaarka hore iyo qalabka gargaarka hore iyo tusmooyinka wax qabadka ee xaaladaha shilalka.
en: Workplaces must have a sufficient number of persons with first aid skills and first aid equipment and instructions must be provided on how to act in emergency situations.

so: Shaqo-bixiyeyaashu waxay shaqaalahooda u abaabulaan koorsooyinka gargaarka hore (ensiapu).
en: Employers organise first aid training for their staff at work.

so: Wakiilka badbaadada shaqaaluhu wuxuu u kuurgalayaa arimaha badbaada shaqaalaha ee khuseeya goobtiisa shaqada wuxuuna ka qayb galayaa kormeerida badbaadada shaqaalaha ee goobta shaqada wuxuuna shaqaalaha la socodsiinaya xaaladaha arimaha la xiriira nabadgelyada iyo caafimaadkaba ee goobta shaqada.
en: The safety officer familiarises themselves with the work safety issues that are relevant for the workplace, participates in workplace safety inspections and informs employees of matters relating to work safety and health.

so: Shaqo-bixiyahu wuxuu goob kasta oo shaqo u magacaabayaa madax badbaado shaqo, kaasoo shaqa-bixiyaha ka caawinayaa wada-shaqaynta kala dhaxaysa shaqaalaha iyo madaxda dowlada u qaabilsan badbaadada shaqaalaha.
en: For each workplace, the employer nominates a workplace safety manager who assists the employer in cooperation with the employees and health and safety authorities.

so: Shaqaalaha dawlada ee u xilsaaran badbaadada shaqaalaha
en: Health and safety authorities

so: Finland waxaa ka jira Hay'adda Maamulka Aagga (Aluehallintovirasto) waxaana hoos-yimaada shan aag oo ka mid ah qaybaha hoosyimaada badbaadada shaqaalaha.
en: Under the Regional State Administrative Agencies there are five occupational health and safety divisions.

so: Waxay ilaaliyaan in goobaha shaqada laga dhawro tusmooyinka badbaada shaqaalaha si sharciga waafaqasan.
en: These monitor that work safety instructions are observed at workplaces in accordance with the law.

so: Qaybta caafimaadka iyo badbaadada shaqaaluhu waxay talooyin ka siiyaan shaqaalaha iyo shaqo-bixiyeyaashaba waxyaabaha la xiriira nabad-gelyada shaqada, caafimaadka iyo heshiiska shuruudaha shaqada.
en: The health and safety divisions provide guidance for both employees and employers on work safety and health, as well as in matters related to the conditions of the contract of employment.

so: Kormeereyaasha badbaadada shaqaaluhu waxay kormeeraan goobaha shaqada.
en: Work safety inspectors conduct inspections at workplaces.

so: Waxayna fiiriyaan in goobta shaqada laga ilaaliyo waajibaadka badbaadada shaqaalaha, in barida iyo tusida ka horeysa shaqo bilaabida si fiican ma loo sameeyey iyo in xaalada shaqada iyo heshiiskooda shuruudaha shaqada ee shaqaalaha ajnabiga ay yihiin kuwo waafaqsan sharciga iyo heshiiska shuruudaha shaqada ee dalka Finland.
en: Among other things, they inspect whether safety regulations are being observed at the workplace, whether sufficient induction to the work has been carried out and whether foreign workers' working conditions and conditions of employment comply with Finnish laws and agreements.

so: Kormeereyaasha badbaada shaqaalluhu waxay xaq u leeyihiin inay tagaan goob kasta oo shaqo ayna arkaan dhamman waraaqaha muhiimka u ah ilaalinta badbaadada shaqaalaha.
en: A work safety inspector is entitled to access every workplace and to see the documents that are necessary for work safety surveillance.

so: Shaqalaaha dawlada ee u xilsaaran arimaha badbaada shaqaaluhu waxay ku amri karaan shaqa-bixiyaha inuu saxo khaladaadka soo baxa ama ay arkaan markii ay kormeerka sameeyaan ka dib.
en: A health and safety authority may oblige an employer to fix any deficiencies discovered in work safety at the workplace.

so: Ma u baahantahay ruqsad ganacsi awgiis?
en: Do I need a permit to start a business?

so: Caymisyo caynkee ah ayaan qaadanayaa?
en: What kinds of insurance do I need?

so: Ka akhriso bogga InfoFinlandi arimahaan iyo kuwo kale oo ganacsadaha muhiim u ah Waajibaadka ganacsadaha.
en: Read more about these topics and other important issues for entrepreneurs on InfoFinland page Obligations of the entrepreneur.

so: Yaa qabta hawlaha ilaalinta danaha ganacsatada dalka Finland gudihiisa?
en: Who represents entrepreneurs' rights in Finland?

so: Waa sidee caymiska shaqa la'aanta ganacsaduhu?
en: Are entrepreneurs entitled to unemployment benefits?

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ka akhriso bogga InfoFinlandi Kaalmaynta ganacsadaha.
en: Read more on InfoFinland page Support for the entrepreneur.

so: Haddii aad dooneysid inaad ganacsigaaga Finland ku guuleysato, waxaa muhiim ah inaad taqaano dhaqanka ganacsiga Finnishka.
en: Knowledge about Finland's enterprise culture is key to running a successful business in Finland.

so: Markii aad aqoonsatid waxyaabaha aasaaska u ah dhaqanka ganacsiga Finnishka, ayaad si wanaagsan ugu adeegi kartaa macaamiishaada.
en: By recognising the main characteristics of Finnish enterprise culture you'll be able to better serve your customers and know what they expect of you.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ka akhriso bogga InfoFinlandi Dhaqanka Finnishka.
en: Read more on InfoFinland page Finnish working culture.

so: Macluumaad guud oo la xiriira ururada shaqaalaha
