en: General information about trade unions

so: Dalka Finland sharciga ayaa ilaaliya xuquuqda shaqaalaha iyo inay ku biiri karaan ururada shaqaalaha (ammattiliitto).
en: Finnish legislation secures an employee's right to be a member of a trade union (ammattiliitto).

so: Xuquuqdaan laguma xakamayn karo sinnaba wax heshiis ah.
en: This right cannot be restricted by any agreements.

so: Ku takoorida shaqaalaha ku biiritaankooda urur shaqaale awgiis waa dambi ciqaab lagu mutaysanayo.
en: Discrimination of employees due to their membership in a trade organisation is a punishable offence.

so: Inta badab dadka Finnishku waxay ka tirsan yihiin urur ka mid ah ururada shaqaalaha.
en: Most Finns are members of some trade union.

so: Ururada shaqaaluhu waxay higsanayaan inay ilaaliyaa danaha iyo xuquuqda shaqaalaha xubnaha ka ah, waxay isku dayaan hagaajiyaan mushaarada iyo badbaadada heshiiska shaqada iyo inay horumariyaan tayada nolosha shaqada.
en: Trade unions strive to secure their members' benefits and rights, work to improve wages and job security and to develop the quality of working life.

so: Ururada shaqaaluhu waxay ku kala biireen oo hoostagaan xarumaha dhexe ee sadex urur shaqaale.
en: Employees' associations have unionised under three employees' central organisations.

so: Waxayna kala yihiin, Ururka dhexe ee ururada shaqaalaha ee Finland SAK, Ururka dhexee shaqaalaha xafiisyada STTK iyo Ururka dhexe shaqaalaha tacliinta sare leh (Akava).
en: These are SAK, the Central Organisation of Finnish Trade Unions; STTK, the Finnish Confederation of Professionals and Akava, the Confederation of Unions for Professional and Managerial Staff in Finland.

so: Lacagta xubin ka noqoshada urur shaqaale
en: Joining a trade union and the membership fee

so: Waxaad ku biiri kartaa ururka shaqaalaha ee qaybtaada shaqada, haddii aad dooneysid.
en: You can join a trade union in your own sector, if you like.

so: Markii add ku biireysid ururka shaqaalaha waxaad la xiriiraysaa wakiilka ururka shaqaalaha ee goobtaada shaqada ama si toos ah ururka shaqaalaha.
en: You can join one by contacting a shop steward at your workplace or contacting a trade union directly.

so: Inta badan codsiga ku biirida waxaa laga buuxiyaa bogga internetka ee ururka shaqaalaha.
en: Most trade unions can be joined also by filling in an application form on the union's website.

so: Dadka xubnaha ka aha ururada shaqaalaha waxay ururka siiyaan lacagta xubinnimada, taas oo inta badan ka ah mushaarka ah 1–2 boqolkiiba.
en: The members of a trade union pay the union a membership fee which is usually about 1-2% of their pay.

so: Lacagta xubinimada waxaa laga jari karaa canshuur celinta.
en: You can deduct the membership fee from your taxes.

so: Xubnaha ururada shaqaaluhu waxay ka qayb geli karaan waxbarashada iyo nashaadaadka waqtiga firaaqada ay abaabulaan ururada shaqadu.
en: The members of a trade union can participate in training and leisure activities organised by the union.

so: Waxay sidoo kale caawinaad ka heli karaan wakiilka ururka haddii is af-garawaa ka dhasho shaqada.
en: They also receive support from the union's shop steward in conflict situations at work.

so: Haddii loo baadho ururka shaqaalaha waa laga heli karaa talooyin ama caawinaad xagga ka wada xaajoodka arrimaha shaqada.
en: When needed, the union also provides advice and help in negotiations.

so: Finland waxaa ka jira habka qasnada shaqo la'aanta.
en: In Finland, we have a voluntary unemployment fund system.

so: Qofka xubinta ka ah qasnada shaqo la'aanta wuxuu bixinayaa inta uu shaqaynayo lacagta xubinnimada ee qasnadda shaqo la'aanta.
en: An employee who is a member of an unemployment fund pays a membership fee to the unemployment fund while working.

so: Haddii shaqadu ka dhamaato oo uu shaqo la'aan noqdo waxaad lacagta ka codsan kartaa qasnadda shaqo la'aanta lacag maalmeedka shaqo la'aanta ee qofka shaqeyn jiray xubinna ka ahaa qasnada loogu talogalay (ansiosidonnainen työttömyyspäiväraha).
en: If the work finishes and they become unemployed, they can apply to the unemployment fund for earnings-related daily unemployment allowance.

so: Way kuu fiican tahay inaad ku biirto qasnadda shaqa la'aanta, sababtuna waa, haddii shaqa la'aani kugu dhacdo, qasnadda shaqa la'aanta ayaad ka helaysaa lacag maalmeedka shaqa la'aanta oo ku xiran mushaarkii ku soo geli jirey, lacagtaasina way ka badan tahay gunnada maalmeedka caadiga ah ee shaqa la'aanta.
en: It pays to join an unemployment fund because the earnings-related daily allowance is greater than ordinary unemployment benefit.

so: Markaad ku biirto ururka shaqaalaha (ammattiliitto) waxaad isla markaas ku biiri kartaa qasnadda shaqa la'aanta ee ururka shaqaalaha (ammattiliiton työttömyyskassa).
en: When you join a trade union you can join the union's unemployment fund.

so: Hase-yeeshe ururka shaqalaha iyo qasnadda shaqo la'aantu waa labo hab oo kala duwan.
en: However, the trade union and unemployment fund are separate systems.

so: Waxaa kaloo suurtagal ah, in adigoon ku biirin ururka shaqaalaha oo xubin ka noqon, aad ku biiri karto qasnadda shaqa la'aanta.
en: There are also some unemployment funds which you can join without being a member of any trade union.

so: Shuruudahaas sii ogow hadiiba inta aadan ku biirin qasnadda shaqo la'aanta.
en: Find out about these conditions immediately when you join an unemployment fund.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ka akhriso bogga InfoFinlandi ee Gunnada shaqo-la'aanta.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Unemployment benefit.

so: Wakiilka ururka shaqaalaha ee goobta shaqada
en: Representative of a trade union at the workplace

so: Goobta shaqada waxaa ururka shaqaalaha iyo xubnaheedaba matalaya wakiilka ururka shaqaalaha (luottamusmies).
en: At workplaces, a trade union and its member workers are represented by a shop steward.

so: Shaqaalaha ayaana dhexdooda ka doorta wakiilka shaqada.
en: The shop steward is elected by the workers.

so: Wakiilka shaqadiisu waa wadaxaajood, dhex-dhexaadin iyo u kala gudbinta macluumaadka shaqa-bixiyaha iyo shaqaalaha.
en: The shop steward acts as a negotiator, arbitrator and means of communication between the employer and employees.

so: Wakiilka ururka shaqaalaha waxaa la waydiin karaa tusaale ahaan arimaha ku saabsan heshiiska shuruudaha shaqada (työehtosopimus).
en: You can also ask a shop steward, for example, about issues related to the collective agreement.

so: Hantida saamigaha ahna waxaa loo qaybiyaa saami ahaan:
en: The share capital is divided into shares.

so: Heshiiska shaqada waxaa laga sameeya labo koobi, mid waxaa leh qofka shaqaalaha ah midda kalena shaqo-bixiyaha.
en: A contract of employment is made in two identical copies, one for the employee and the other for the employer.

so: Sida caadiga ah heshiiska shaqada waxaa ugu yaraan lagu qoraa arimaha soo socda:
en: At least the following matters are generally recorded in the contract of employment:

so: Shaqa-bixiyaha iyo shaqaaluhu waxay sixiixaan heshiiska shaqada.
en: Both the employer and employee sign the contract of employment.

so: Taariikhda ay shaqadu bilaabanayso
en: The date of commencement of work

so: Haddii ay shaqadu tahay mid joogto ah ama mid waqti gaaban
en: Whether the contract is valid for the present or fixed-term

so: Heshiiska shaqada watiga dheer ah ayaa ah mid guud.
en: A contract of employment that is valid for the present is the principal rule.

so: Macnihiisu waa shaqo soconaysa ilaa shaqaaluhu uu isaga tago shaqada ama shaqo bixiyuhu ka cayriyo.
en: It means that work will continue until the employee resigns or the employer dismisses the employee.

so: Shaqo-bixiyuhu waa inuu haystaa sabab uu wax ku eryi karo.
en: An employer must have a justified reason for dismissing an employee.

so: Sababaha la ogol yahay waxay ku cad yihiin sharciga heshiiska shaqada.
en: Acceptable reasons for dismissal are specified in the Employment Contracts Act.

so: Haddii heshiiska shaqadu uu yahay mid ah ilaa waqti dambe, markaas qofka shaqaalaha ahi wuxuu haystaa shaqo joogto ah.
en: If a contract of employment is valid for the present it means that the employee has a steady or permanent job.

so: Heshiiska shaqada oo waqtiga ku xadidan macnihiisu waa in lagu heshiiyey bilowga iyo dhamaadka shaqada.
en: A fixed-term work contract means that the time of commencement and ending of work have been agreed upon.

so: Heshiiska shaqada waxaa laga dhigi karaa waqti qaaban, haddii sababo loo helo.
en: A contract of employment can be made for a fixed-term if there are justifiable grounds for it.

so: Qawaaniinta iyo shuruudaha sharciga shaqada ayaa si taxader leh u dejija una qeexa, goorma ayaa la isticmaali karaa heshiisyada gaa-gaaban.
en: Acts and collective agreements determine exactly when fixed-term contracts of employment can be used.

so: Heshiiska shaqadu wuxuu ahaan karaa mid waqtigiisa xadidan haddii sababaha yihiin tusaale ahaan.
en: A contract of employment may be fixed-term, for example, for the following reasons:

so: shaqaale dheeri ah oo xilli cayiman loo baahdo
en: peak demand or period

so: Haddii waqtiga heshiiska shaqadu xadidan yahay, labada dhinac waxay ilaalinayaan waqtigaas, haddii aan lagu heshiin ka tegida shaqada.
en: If a contract of employment is fixed-term, it is binding on both parties for the agreed term unless the possibility of dismissal has been agreed upon.

so: Shaqada xadidan waxaa layskaga eryi karaa oo keliya haddii ay jiraan sababo aad u culus oo qof shaqada looga eryi karo.
en: A fixed-term contract can be dissolved only for very weighty reasons.

so: Waqtiga tijaabada iyo dhirirkiisa
en: Probationary period and its duration

so: Bilowga heshiiska shaqada waxaa lagu heshiin karaa waqtiga tijaabada.
en: A probationary period can be agreed upon at the beginning of the contract of employment.

so: Waqtiga tijaabadu wuxuu noqon karaa ugu badnaan lix bilood.
en: The probationary period cannot exceed six months.

so: Waqtiga tijaabada ee Xiriirka shaqada waqtiga cayiman wuxuu noqon karaa ugu badnaan kala bar mudada heshiiska shaqada.
en: In fixed-term employment, the probationary period cannot exceed half of the employment contract duration.

so: Waqtiga tijaabada qofka shaqaalaha ahi wuxuu qiimayn karaa in shaqadu ku haboon tahay iyo in kale, shaqo-bixiyuhuna wuxuu qiimayn karaa in qofku ku haboon yahay shaqada.
en: During this period, the employee can assess whether the work is suitable for them, and the employer can assess whether the employee is suitable for the task.

so: Inta lagu gudajiro waqtiga tijaabada labada dhinac way bur-burin karaan heshiiska shaqada waqti la'aan.
en: During the probationary period, the employee and the employer can dissolve the contract of employment without a period of notice.

so: Burburinta heshiisku waqtiga tijaabada inta lagu jiro ma noqon karo mid takoorid ku salaysan.
en: The grounds for dissolving the contract of employment during the probationary period must not be discriminating.

so: Qofka shaqaalaha ahi wuxuu qaadanayaa mushaar caadi ah waqtiga tijaabada.
en: During the probationary period, the employee is paid normal remuneration.

so: Mushaarka iyo mushaar bixinta
en: Remuneration and its method of payment

so: Mushaarku wuxuu ku salaysan yahay heshiiska shuruudaha shaqada.
en: Remuneration is determined according to the collective agreement.

so: Haddii aysan lahayn wax heshiis shuruudaha shaqada ah, shaqaaluhu waxay xaq u leeyihiin inay helaan mushaar macquul ah.
en: If there is no collective agreement in the sector of work, employees are entitled to reasonable remuneration.

so: Shaqo-bixiyuhu ma dhiibi karo mushaar ka yar kan ku qoran heshiiska shuruudaha shaqada.
en: An employer must not pay remuneration that is less than stipulated in the collective agreement.

so: Mushaarka waxaa ku jiri kara gunnooyin dheeraad ah.
en: Remuneration can contain various bonuses.

so: Gunnooyinka Finlad caadi ka ka ah waxaa ka mida ah gunnada da'da, tan saacada dheeriga ah iyo tan shaqooyinka xiliyadoodu is bed-bedelo.
en: Typical bonuses to remuneration in Finland include experience bonus, overtime pay and extra compensation for shift work.

so: Maalinta mushaarku inta badan waa hal mar ama laba mar bishiiba.
en: Payday is usually once or twice a month.

so: Shaqo-bixiyuhu mushaarka wuxuu ku shubayaa koontada bangiga.
en: Employers pay remuneration to the employee's bank account.

so: Shaqaaluhu wuxuu xaq u leeyahay inuu helo sharaxaad ku saabsan mushaharka oo ay ka muuqato, qaybaha uu mushaarku ka kooban yahay.
en: Employees are entitled to receive a payslip that shows the different parts which form the remuneration.

so: Marka laga hadlayo mushaarka jumlo ah (bruttopalkka), waxaa loola jeedaa mushaarka oo aan laga jarin canshuurta, markii canshuuraha laga jaro waxaa qofka shaqaalaha ah u haraya mushaar saafi ah (nettopalkka).
en: When remuneration is discussed in Finland, what is usually meant is gross salary (bruttopalkka) from which tax, employee and employer's contributions are deducted. The amount that remains for the employee is net salary (nettopalkka).

so: Heshiiska waa in lagu qeexo waqtiga shaqada oo joogtada ah.
en: The contract must specify regular working hours.

so: Waqtiga shaqadu waa inuu waafaqsan yahay sharciga shaqada iyo heshiiska shuruudaha shaqada.
en: Working hours must comply with the Working Hours Act and the collective agreement.

so: Fasaxa sannadka iyo lacagta fasaxa
en: Annual holidays and holiday pay

so: Shaqaaluhu wuxuu xaq u leeyahay inuu helo waqtiga fasaxa mushaar la mida ah mushaarka marka uu shaqaynayo.
en: An employee is entitled to the same remuneration for the holiday period as when working.

so: Waxaa u dheer lacagta fasaxa.
en: In addition, an employee is paid holiday pay.

so: Bixinta lacagta fasaxu waxaa loo cuskanayaa heshiiska shuruudaha shaqada.
en: The payment of holiday pay is based on the collective agreement.

so: Markii heshiiska shaqadu dhamaado, shaqaaluhu wuxuu xaq u leeyahay in la siiyo magdhowga fasaxa oo ku salaysan maalmihii uu shaqaynayey oo uusan fasaxooda ama mag-dhawgooda horay u qaadan.
en: When the contract of employment expires the employee is entitled to holiday compensation for those days for which they have not received holiday or holiday compensation by the end of the contract of employment.

so: Heshiiska shaqada joogtada ah wuxuu dhamaadaa ka dib markii shaqa-bixiyaha ama shaqeeyuhu uu shaqada joojiyo ama heshiiskii ka baxo.
en: A contract of employment that is valid for the present expires after either the employee's or employer's period of notice.

so: Waqtiga shaqo ka tegidu waa waqtiga, qofka shaqaalaha ah uu waajibku ka saaran yahay inuu shaqada sii wado inta ay shaqadu ka dhamaanayso.
en: The period of notice signifies the time for the duration of which an employee is obliged to work before the work ends.

so: Inta lagu guda jiro waqtigan qofka shaqaalaha wuxuu leeyahay xuquuqda shaqaalaha sidoo kale waxaa saaran waajibaadka shaqada, wuxuuna qaadanayaa mushaar caadi ah.
en: During the period of notice, all the normal employees' rights and obligations apply to the employee and they receive normal remuneration.

so: Haddii shaqo-bixiyuhu shaqaalaha eryo, waa inuu sheego sababta.
en: If an employer dismisses an employee, they must provide the reason for it.

so: Sharciga shaqada ayaa sheegaya sababaha la aqbali karo oo shaqaalaha lagu eryi karo.
en: The Employment Contracts Act specifies acceptable reasons for dismissal.

so: Xusid, waxyaaba sharciga shaqadu ka tixgeliyo heshiiska shuruudaha shaqada
en: Mention of the collective agreement that the contract of employment observes

so: Intaadan shirkadda ganacsiga bilaabin ka hor waa inaad si taxader leh uga fekertaa oo u qorshaysaa sidaad ku heli lahayd maalgelinta shirkaddu u baahan tahay.
en: Financing of the company must be carefully planned before the company is founded.

so: Markaad ganacsi furanayso, waxaad u baahan tahay lacag, sidaa darteed waa muhiim, inaad bilowga hore haysato lacag kugu filan.
en: It is important that there is sufficient capital at the outset.

so: Si aad maalgelin u dalbadid waa inaad haysataa qorshe waxqabadka ganacsiga ah oo aad u wanaagsan.
en: Company financing may also be partly in the form of donations or loans, for which a sound business plan will be required.

so: Lacagaha deynta ah oo ay bixiyaan bangiga ama Finnvera waa maalgelinta sida badan ay helaan dadka ganacsiga cusub bilaaba.
en: Loans granted by a bank or Finnvera are a common source of financing for a new entrepreneur.

so: Finnvera waa shirkad maalgelineed oo khaas ah, waxayna siisaa deyn iyo damaanad-qaad intaba shirkadaha bilowga ah iyo weliba kuwii horay u jiray, waxaana iska leh dawlada Finland.
en: Finnvera is a specialised financing company owned by the State of Finland.

so: Shirkada ay suurto gal u tahay inay gacagsigooda ka helaan faa'iido ku filan, laakiin aan haysan qaybta lacageed ee bangigu ku xiray inay haystaan si uu deyn u siiyo ama aan haysan wax dibaaji ah si ay bangiga u dhigaan damaanad ahaan waxay deyn ama damaanadqaadka deynta ka heli karaan Finnverra.
en: It provides loans and guarantees to beginning or already operating businesses. Businesses that have the prerequisite to maintain profitable operations, but do not have the down payment or collateral required by banks may be granted a loan or a security by Finnvera.

so: Xafiiska Shaqada iyo Dhaqaalaha ka hubso, inaad kaalmo u heli karto shirkad sameysashada.
en: Also find out from the TE Office whether or not you are eligible to receive a grant for establishing a business.

so: Lacagta bilowga waxaa bixiya Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada ee aad macaamiisha ka tahay.
en: Start-up grant is allocated by your local Employment and Economic Office.

so: Lacagtan waxaa la bixin karaa ugu badnaan mudo 12 bilood ah.
en: It can be granted for a maximum period of 12 months.

so: Markii aad dalbanaysid lacagta bilowga ganacsiga, Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashadu wuxuu baarayaa, in ganacsigu uu yahay doorasho shakhsi ahaan adiga kugu habboon.
en: When applying for a start-up grant, the Employment and Economic Office will determine if entrepreneurship is a suitable employment alternative for you.

so: shaqo laawe shaqo raadis ah aad tahay
en: you are registered as unemployed

so: inay cagata bilowga ganacsigu tahay mid daruuri ah marka laga eego xagga dakhliga nolosha ee qofka ganacsiga bilaabaya
en: start-up grant is needed for the entrepreneur to make a living

so: Wadankan Finland xuuquuqda qofka shaalaha ahi waxuu ku qeexan yahay sharciga shaqada iyo heshiiska shuruuda shaqada (työehtosopimus).
en: In Finland, an employee's rights are determined according to labour legislation and collective agreements (työehtosopimus).

so: Kuwaasna waxaa lagu qeexaa tusaale ahaan mushaarka ugu hooseeya, waqtiyada shaqada, fasaxyada, mushaarka xiliyada jirada iyo shuruudaha dhamaadka shaqada.
en: These specify, for example, minimum wages, working hours, holidays, sick pay and the conditions of terminating a contract of employment.

so: Arrimahaan waxaa ka wada hadla oo isla meel dhiga ururada shaqo-bixiyeyaasha iyo ururada shaqaalaha ayago si wada jir ah uga heshiinaya shuruudaha shaqada ee dhinacyada kala duwan ee shaqada.
en: Employers' associations and employees' associations work together to agree on the working conditions in a certain field.

so: Kani wuxuu markaa keena heshiisyo loo wada dhan yahay.
en: This leads to the creation of collective agreements (TES).

so: Qaybaha dowlada (markii uu shaqa-bixiyaha yahay xukumada ama dowlada hooseshaqa-bixiye) waxaa la waafajiyaa shuruudaha heshiiska booska/jagada (VES) ama shuruudda heshiska shaqada iyo jagada ee heer degmo.
en: In the public sector (with the state or a municipality as an employer) a collective bargaining contract on civil servant salaries (VES) or a general municipal collective bargaining contract (KVTES) is agreed upon.

so: Waxyaabaha lagu heshiiyo marka la samaynayo heshiiska shuruudaha shaqadu waa xuquuqaha ugu hooseeya oo aan laga hoos mari karin (vähimmäisetu).
en: The agreed upon benefits in a collective agreement are always minimum benefits.

so: Lagama hoos mari karo marka heshiiska shaqada la samaynayo.
en: They cannot be less in the contract of employment.

so: Tusaale ahaan mushaarku kama hoosayn karo midka lagu shiiyey markii la sameynayey heshiiska shuruudaha shaqada.
en: For example, remuneration cannot be smaller than that which has been agreed upon in the collective agreement.

so: Laakiin shaqo-bixiyaha iyo qofka shaqaalaha ahi way ku heshiin karaan mushaar ka fiican kan ku qoran heshiiska shuruudaha shaqada.
en: However, an employer and employee can agree on better conditions in the contract of employment than those stipulated in the collective agreement.

so: Marka la samaynayo heshiiska shuruudaha shaqada waxaa lagu heshiiyaa waqti cayiman, sida badan sannad ama labo sano ama waqti ka dheer.
en: Collective agreements are concluded for a fixed period of time, usually for a year or two or even longer.

so: Heshiiska shuruudaha shaqada iyo jagaduba waxay labada urur shaqaale ee shaqa-bixiyaha iyo shaqaalaha iyo xubnahoodaba ku xakamaynaysaa inay u hogaan samaan heshiiska.
en: A collective agreement and a collective bargaining contract on civil servant salaries are binding to the employees' and employers' associations and their members.

so: Heshiiska shuruudaha shaqadu wuxuu noqon karaa mid xakameeya dhammaan.
en: A collective agreement can also be generally binding.

so: Markaas shaqo-bixiyeyaasha aan ku jirin urur shaqaale waxaa ku waajiba inay ilaaliyaan iyo shaqaalahoodana waafajiyaan heshiiska shuruudaha shaqada ee khuseeya hadba waxa ay ka shaqeeyaan.
en: In such a case, also employers who are not members of an employers' association have to comply with the agreement and apply it to their employees.

so: Codsiga shaqada iyo heshiiska shaqada waxaa ku qornaan kara ”palkkaus TES:in mukainen” (mushaar ku waafaqsan heshiiska shuruudaha shaqada).
en: Job advertisements and contracts of employment may read: “palkkaus TES:in mukainen” (“remuneration according to collective agreement”).

so: Waxaa wanaagsan inaad ogaatid inta uu la eg yahay mushaarka qaybta xirfadaada.
en: It makes sense to find out the size of remuneration within your own field in Finland.

so: Waxaa muhiim ah inaad taqaanid heshiiska shuruudaha shaqada, sababtoo ah tusaale ahaan Finland ma leh sharci sheegaya mushaarka ugu hooseeya inta uu noqon karo, balse a oo lagu sheegaa mushaarka ugu hooseeya waxay ku qeexan yihiin heshiiska shuruudaha shaqada.
en: It is important to know the collective agreement because in Finland there is no act on minimum wage, for example; instead, minimum wages are always determined according to the collective agreement.

so: Shaqo-bixiyuhu wuxuu heshiis cusub la samaynayaa shaqaalaha cusub sida badan heshiiska shaqadu waa qoraal.
en: An employer usually makes a written contract of employment with a new employee.

so: Heshiiska shaqada waxaa ku qoran shaqada la qabanayo, mushaarka iyo waxyaabaha kale ee shaqada la xiriira ee faa'iida u leh shaqaalaha sida kaarka gaadiidka lagu raaco.
en: The contract of employment states the employee's tasks and remuneration and other benefits and conditions related to work.

so: Heshiiska shaqadu wuxuu ahaan karaa mid oorah ah.
en: This contract can also be verbal.

so: Haddii aan la samayn heshiis qoraal ah, shaqo-bixiyuhu waa inuu siiyaa qofka shaqaalaha ah si codsi la'aan ah shuruudaha shaqo qabashada u ah oo qoraal ah.
en: If no written contract of employment has been made, the employer shall, without a specific request, provide a written account of the central conditions of work.

so: Waxaa mar walba wanaagsan heshiiska qoraalka ah.
en: It is advisable to make a written contract of employment.

so: Haddii heshiisku qoraal yahay, shaqa-bixiyaha iyo qofka shaqaalaha ah labaduba waxay iska hubin karaan heshiiska iyo waxay wada jirka ugu heshiiyeen.
en: When matters have been written down, both employee and employer can check the contract for what has been jointly agreed upon.

so: Tani waxay dhinacyada ka caawinaysaa haddii muran yimaado.
en: This will help in cases of conflict at work.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan samaynta heshiiska shaqada ka akhriso bogga InfoFinlandi ee Waxyaabaha uu ka kooban yahay heshiiska shaqada.
en: Read more about making a contract of employment on the InfoFinland web page Contents of a contract of employment.

so: Heshiis qoraal ah oo ku saabsan shuruudaha bartame u ah qabashada shaqada
en: Written agreement on the central conditions of work

so: Shaqo-bixiyuhu waa inuu siiyaa qofka shaqaalaha ah si codsi la'aan ah shuruudaha bartame u ah qabashada shaqada oo qoraal ah, haddii shaqadu ay tahay abadiyan ama shaqo aan dhamaadkeedu waqti ku xadidnayn iyo shaqooyinka bil ka badan soconaya.
en: An employer shall give an employee a written account of the central conditions of work in employment contracts that are valid for the present and in employment contracts whose duration is longer than a month.

so: Sharaxaada uu bixinayo shaqo-bixiyuhu waa in ugu yaraan ku qornaadaa:
en: The written account must provide at least

so: shaqa-bixiyaha iyo shaqaalaha meesha ay dagan yihiin ama goobta ganacsiga
en: the employer's and employee's place of residence or place of business

so: Waqtiga ay shaqadu bilaabanayso
en: the work commencement time

so: inta ay soconayso shaqada waqtiga ku xadidan iyo sababta loo xadiday
en: the duration of a fixed-term work contract and the reason for its fixed-term nature

so: shuruuda heshiiska shaqo oo la ilaalinayo
en: the collective agreement applicable to the work

so: Mushaarka qaabka lagu siinayo iyo waqtiga mushaarka la bixinayo
en: the basis for remuneration and other compensation and the pay period

so: fasaxa sanadka iyo sida loo helo
en: the way annual holiday is determined

so: waqtiga shaqo ka eryida iyo kan ka tegida ama qaabka ay ku imaan karto shaqo ka eryidu ama ka tegidu
en: period of notice or the basis for its determination

so: Haddii shaqo-bixiyuhu uunan siin shaqaalihiisa wax sharaxaad ah oo ku saabsan shuruudaha bartame u ah qabashada shaqada, waxaa lagu xukumi karaa inuu bixiyo ganaax.
en: If an employer does not deliver an account of the central conditions for work to the employee, they may be ordered to pay a fine.

so: Ka fakar dadka macaamiisha kuu noqonaya iyo waxyaabaha ay macaamiishu u baahan yihiin. Sidoo kale ka fakar waa kuwoma ganacsatada kula tartamaysaa, waa maxay ay ka ganacsanayaan iyo qaababka ay u shaqeeyaan ama u ganacsadaan.
en: With a business plan a potential entrepreneur analyses the strengths and weaknesses of their own capabilities, the quality of their products or services, their customers and their customers' needs, and their competitors and their competitors' products and business methods.

so: Qorshaha waxqabadka ganacsiga waxaa xudun u ah qorshaha waxqabadka ee shirkadaada. Si taxadar leh uga fakar, qaabaka ay shirkadaadu u shaqaynayso iyo sidoo kale waa xagee waana sidhee dhismaha shirkadaadu ay ku shaqaynayso, waa maxay qalabka wax soo saarka ama shaqaalaha aad u baahan tahay, xayaysiis sidee ah baad isticimaalaysaa, si aad iibkaaga u kordhiso, sidoo kale sii ogow, in caymiskaagu daboolayo khasaarooyinka ka imaan kara hawlaha ganacsiga, inuu debbero khasaaraha ganacsiga ka imaan kara.
en: The core of the business plan is the enterprise's operating plan, in which careful thought is given as to how the business will operate, the type of company premises and where they will be situated, what production tools or workforce will be required, and what use will be made of advertising media and promotional activities.

so: Sidoo kale waa inaad ku sheegtaa qorshaha shaqada ganacsiga, sida aad doonaysid inaad u samaysid xisaabaadka iyo qorshaynta dhaqaalaha aandna ula soconaysid hirgelida qorsheyaalkaaga.
en: The business plan must also include the organisation of bookkeeping and economic planning, and monitoring of planning implementation.

so: Xarumahaas boggagooda internetka waxaad ka koobiyeysan kartaa talooyin oo ganacsadayaasha loogu talagalay oo af Finnish iyo af Ingiriis ah, iyo qorshe waxqabadka ganacsiga oo tusaale ah iyo dukumeentiyo kale oo tusaale ah.
en: Guides for entrepreneurs can be downloaded from their web pages in at least Finnish and English, plus various example documents and a model business plan.

so: Sinnantu waa qodob ku qoran sharciga Finland
en: Equality has been written into the Finnish law

so: Sinnaanta kula dhaqmida daka oo dhan waxaa lagu balan qaaday qaanunka aasaasiga ah ee Finland.
en: Equal treatment of all people is guaranteed by Finland's constitution.

so: Sinnaan (yhdenvertaisuus) waxaa loola jeedaa in dadkoo dhan ay siman yihiin ayadoon loo eegeyn, labkooda iyo dheddigooda, da'dooda, aasaskooda jinsi ama dhalasho, luuqada, diin ama citiqaad, naafonimo, ra'yi, xaaladda caafimaadka, jihada galmada u janjeerto, ama waxyaabaha kale ee qofka la xiriira.
en: Equality (yhdenvertaisuus) means that all people are equal regardless of their sex, age, ethnic or national origin, nationality, language, religion or beliefs, opinion, disability, health, sexual orientation or any other circumstance connected to the person.

so: Sinnaanta xaga shaqada ah waxaa la waafajiyaa Xeerka Sinnaanta iyo Xeerka Heshiiska Shaqada.
en: Issues on equality in working life are enacted in the Equality Act and Employment Contracts Act.

so: Sida ay sheegayaan sharciyadaan qofka shaqaalaha ah waa in loola dhaqmo si sinnaan ah marka loo eego shaqada, xaalada shaqada, shuruudaha shaqada, tababarka shaqaalaha iyo dalacaada.
en: They state that employees must be treated equally as regards employment, working conditions, conditions of employment, staff training and career advancement.

so: Xeerka sinaantu (yhdenvertaisuuslaki) wuxuu sheegayaa in shaqaalaha marka shaqada loo qaadanayo loola dhaqmo si sinnaan ah.
en: The Equality Act (yhdenvertaisuuslaki) provides that job seekers are treated equally.

so: Shaqo-bixiyuhu waa inuu qaataa qofka shaqada ugu haboon marka loo eego xirfadiisa iyo waayo aragnimadiisa.
en: An employer shall choose the most distinguished applicant for the task.

so: Shaqo-bixiyuhu waa inuu cadayn karo in doorashadu tahay mid ku salaysan tayada shaqada qofka loo doortay, oo aaan doorashada loo samayn si takoorid ah.
en: The employer must also be able to prove that the choice is justified on acceptable grounds related to the nature of the work and that the choice was not made on discriminatory bases.

so: Qofka shaqaalaha laguma xiri karo shuruudo aan muhiim u ahayn qabasha shaqada.
en: Qualities that are not necessary for the performance of the tasks must not be required of job seekers.

so: Shaqo-bixiyuhu ma takoori karo shaqaalaha, markii uu samaynayo go'aan uu shaqada ku qaybinayo, bixinaayo dalacsiin ama markuu gaarayo go'aanka eryida ama ruqsaynta shaqaalaha.
en: An employer shall not discriminate against employees when making decisions about the distribution of tasks, offering advancement opportunities or terminating a contract of employment.

so: Haddii aad u malaynaysid in lagu takooray, waxaad la xiriiri kartaa shaqaalaha dhowrida xuquuqda shaqada ama urur shaqaalaha oo aad ka tirsan tahay (ammattiliitto).
en: If you suspect that you have been the object of discrimination at work, you can contact the occupational safety and health authorities or your own trade union.

so: Xaaladaha dhibaatada waxaad talo waydiin kartaa wakiilka badbaada shaqaalaha ama kan la aaminay (luottamusmies).
en: In problem situations, you can ask a safety officer or shop steward for advice.

so: Sinnaanta (tasa-arvo) ka dhaxaysa ragga iyo dumarka
en: Equality (tasa-arvo) between men and women

so: Siduu sharciga Finland dhigayo ragga iyo dumarku waxay leeyihiin xuquuq isku mid ah.
en: According to Finnish law, men and women are equal.

so: Ragga iyo dumarkana waa in loola dhaqmo si isku mid ah, marka shaqada loo qaadanayo, ay shaqaynayaan, mushaar loo qorayo.
en: Men and women must be treated equally in employment, working conditions and remuneration.

so: Shaqaalaha laguma takoori karo uur ama waayeelnimo awgeed.
en: An employee must not be set in an unequal position in working life due to pregnancy or parenthood.

so: Xeerka Finlad ee Sinnaanta ka dhexeeyo Ragga iyo Dumarka wuxuu dhigaya in shaqo-bixiyuhu uu kormeero inay sharciga sinnaantu meel-maray iyo inaan qofna lagu takoorin goobta shaqada.
en: The Finnish Act on Equality between Women and Men stipulates that an employer shall supervise that sexual equality is realised and that nobody is discriminated against at the workplace.

so: Wakiilka sinnaanta (tasa-arvovaltuutettu) ayaa ilaaliya dhowrida Xeerka loo sameeyay sinnaanta ka dhaxaysa ragga iyo dumarka.
en: An Equality Ombudsman monitors that the Act on Equality between Women and Men is observed.

so: Haddii aad ka shakisan tahay in shaqo-bixiyuhu kugu takooray jinsigaaga rag ama dumar awgiis, waxaad talooyin iyo tusaalayn iyo caawinaad in arinta la baaro ka dalban kartaa wakiilka sinnaanta.
en: If you suspect that your employer has discriminated against you because of your sex, you can ask an Equality Ombudsman for advice and guidance and help in solving the issue.

so: Yritys-Suomi (Shirkad-Finland) (adoo isticmaalaya bogga internetka iyo telefoonkaba)
en: Enterprise Finland (Yritys-Suomi) (through their website and by phone)

so: Xaafiisyadan kor ku xusan waxay hagaan dhammaan dadka xiisaynaya ganacsiga ee ku nool dhammaan daafaha dalka Finland.
en: These establishments provide guidance to people interested in entrepreneurship all over Finland.

so: Halkaas waxaad ka helaysaa shaqaale khibrad u leh arimaha ganacsiga oo kaa caawinaya horumarinta fikradaada ganacsi ee cusub. Waxaa lagaa caawinayaa inaad samaysid suuq baarid bilow ah, xisaabinta faa'iidada, kaartaynta meelaha maalgelinta laga heli karo.
en: Experts there will help you shape your business idea, conduct preliminary market research, make profitability calculations and chart the availability of financing.

so: Waxaad kaloo ka helaysaa la talin la xiriirta xagga samaynta qorshaha waxqabadka gancsiga iyo dhiirogelin la xiriirta go'aankaaga samaynta ganacsiga cusub.
en: You will also receive advice on making a business plan and support for your decision to establish a business.

so: La talinta ganacsiga waxaa lagu heli karaa luuqadaha Finnishka iyo Swidishka iyo sida badan magaalooyinka waaweyn luuqada Ingiriiska iyo luuqado kale.
en: Business advice is given in Finnish and Swedish and, at least in larger towns, also in English and other languages.

so: Yritys-Suomi wuxuu la talinta ganacsiga ku dhiibaa luuqada Finnishka iyo Swidishka.
en: Enterprise Finland provides business counselling over the phone in Finnish and Swedish.

so: Lambarada taleefanada la talinta ee Yritys-Suomi waa sidaan:
en: The number of the Enterprise Finland telephone service is:

so: Haddii aad talobixinta ku dooneyso af Ingiriis, su'aashaada u dir adigoo sii maraya bogagga shabakadda luqada Ingiriiska ee Yritys-Suomi.
en: If you would like to receive counselling in English, send your question through the English-language website of Enterprise Finland.

so: Markaas kadibna la talinta ayaa kula soo xiriireysa.
en: You will be contacted by the service staff.

so: Adeegayada telefoonadu waxay furan yihiin isniin ilaa jimce saacadaha u dhexeeya 9.00–16.15.
en: Telephone service is available from Monday to Friday 9:00–16:15.

so: Finland dhexdeeda shaqaaluhu wuxuu leeyahay xuquuq:
en: In Finland an employee has the right to:

so: inuu helo mushaar waafaqsan heshiiska shuruudaha shaqada iyo shuruudaha kale ee ugu hooseeya
en: remuneration in accordance with the collective agreement and other minimum provisions

so: inuu badbaado ka helo sharciyada iyo heshiisyada
en: the protection provided by acts and contracts

so: inuu helo deegaan shaqa oo caafimaad iyo nabadgelyo leh
en: a healthy and safe working environment

so: Shaqaalahana waxaa saaran waajibaad:
en: An employee has the obligation to:

so: inuu shaqada si taxader leh u guto
en: perform their work carefully

so: inuu ilaaliyo waqtiyada shaqada ee lagu heshiiyey
en: observe the agreed-upon working hours

so: inuu raaco waxyaabaha ay madaxda shaqadu faraan
en: follow the instructions of the management

so: inuu diido dhinacyada tartanka kula jira shaqa-bixiyihiisa
en: decline from activities which compete with those of the employer

so: inuu xafido sirta ganacsiga iyo xirfadda
en: keep business and trade secrets

so: inuu tixgeliyo waxa ay danta shaqabixiyuhu ku jirto
en: take into account the employer's interests

so: Shuruucda iyo heshiisyadu waxay badbaadinayaan xuquuqda shaqaalaha
en: Acts and contracts secure employees' rights

so: Sharci-dejinta shaqada iyo heshiiska shuruucda shaqadu waxay nidaamiyaan xuquuqda iyo waajibaadka shaqaaluhu.
en: Labour legislation and collective agreements regulate employees' rights and obligations.

so: Ururada shaqaalaha iyo kuwa shaqa-bixiyeyaasha ayaa ka wada hadla dhexdooda heshiiska shuruucda shaqada.
en: Employees' and employers' associations negotiate with each other on field-specific collective agreements.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ka akhriso bogga InfoFinlandi ee Ka heshiinta shuruudaha shaqada iyo Waxyaabaha heshiiska shaqadu ka koobanyahay.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web pages Agreeing on the terms of employment and Content of the employment contract.

so: Qof kasta oo shaqaale ah wuxuu xaq u leeyahay sinnaan iyo takoor la'aan markuu shaqa dalbanayo iyo markuu shaqaynayaba.
en: Every employee has a right to equality and non-discrimination in applying for a job and at the workplace.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah kala xiriir bogga InfoFinlandi ee Sinnaanta iyo fursadaha siman ee nolosha shaqada.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Equality and equal opportunities in working life.

so: Heshiiska shaqadu wuxuu dhashaa, markii qofka shaqaalaha ah iyo shaqa-bixiyuhu ay ku heshiiyaan qabashada shaqada iyo mushaarka laga siinayo shaqada, sidoo kale gunnooyinka iyo shuruudaha shaqada.
en: A contract of employment is created when an employee and employer agree on the work the employee will perform and on the remuneration to be paid for it and other benefits and conditions.

so: Shuruudaha shaqadu waxay waafaqsan yihiin oo ku qeexan yihiin sharciga shaqada iyo heshiiska shuruucda shaqada.
en: The conditions of a contract of employment are determined in accordance with the labour legislation and collective agreement.

so: Heshiiska shaqadu wuxuu xakamaynayaa labada dhinacba.
en: The contract of employment binds both parties.

so: Ku biirida urur xirfadeedka dalka Finland gudihiisa waa wax iska caadi ah lamana cadaadiyo dadka sida firfircoon ulala shaqeeya ururada xirfadaha.
en: Unionisation is common in Finland and persons who serve actively in trade unions are not persecuted in this country.

so: Waxaad ku biiri kartaa ururada shaqada oo xirfadaada ah.
en: You can join a trade union in your own field.

so: Ururka shaqaaluhu wuxuu doonayaa inuu ilaaliyo danaha dadka xubnaha ka ah ee shaqeeya.
en: A trade union strives to secure the interests of its members in working life.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ka akhriso bogga InfoFinlandi ee Ururada shaqaalaha.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Trade unions.

so: Caafimaadka iyo badbaadada shaqaalaha
en: Health and safety at work

so: Shaqa-bixiyaha waxaa waajib ka saaran inuu ka taxadaro nabadgalyada shaqaalihiisa.
en: It is the duty of an employer to take care of their employees' safety.

so: Maamulka badbaadada shaqaalaha waxay ilaaliyaan, in goobta shaqada laga ilaaliyo loogana dhaqmo tusmooyinka sharciga badbaadada shaqaalaha.
en: The Occupational Safety and Health Administration monitors that industrial safety instructions are observed at workplaces in accordance with the law.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ka akhriso bogga InfoFinlandi ee Caafimaadka iyo badbaadada shaqaalaha.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Health and safety at work.

so: Markii uu shaqa la'aan noqdo qof si joogto ah u degan Finland, wuxuu xaq u leeyahay inuu helo gargaarka shaqo la'aanta (nooc cayr).
en: When a person who lives in Finland permanently becomes unemployed they are entitled to unemployment benefit.

so: Qof dalka u soo guurey, oo mudo dheer oo ku filan Finland deganaa, wuxuu lacagta hawlgabka ku heli karaa da'diisa oo weyn ama awood la'aan shaqo awgeed.
en: An immigrant who has lived in Finland for a sufficiently long time can receive pension due to old age or incapacity for work.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ka akhriso bogga InfoFinlandi ee Howlgab.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Pension.

so: Haddii aad Finland gudeheeda ka shaqaynaysid, waa inaad bixisaa canshuur.
en: When you work in Finland you are required to pay tax.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ka akhriso bogga InfoFinlandi ee Canshuurta.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Taxation.

so: Shaqa-bixiye kasta waxaa waajib ku ah inuu shaqaalihiisa oo dhan u qaban-qaabiyo daryeel xagga caafimaadka oo ka hortag ah.
en: Every employer is obliged to organise preventive occupational health care for their employees.

so: Markii qoyska ilmo u dhashaan, hooyada ama aabaha wuxuu sharcigu u ogal yahay inay fasax waalid qaataan oo ilmaha guriga ku xanaaneeyaan.
en: When a child is born to a family the mother or father can, by law, stay at home to look after the child.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ka akhriso bogga InfoFinlandi ee Fasaxyada qoyska.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Family leave.

so: Sideen shirkad ganacsi u samaynayaa?
en: How do I start a business?

so: Bogagga InfoFinlandi waxaad ka helaysaa macluumaad aasaasi ah oo la xiriira ka samaynta shirkad gancsi dalka Finland.
en: Here on the InfoFinland website you will find the basic information you need about establishing a business in Finland.

so: Heererka bilaabidda shirkad ganacsi oo la soo koobay:
en: The basic stages of starting a business:

so: Hel fikrad ganacsi oo fiican
en: Come up with a good business idea

so: Soo ogoow, ruqasadaha aad u baahantahay
en: Find out which permits you will need

so: Ogeysii rajistareeshinka ganacsiga iyo maamulka canshuuraha
en: Notify the Trade Register and the tax authorities of your company

so: Ganacsadenimadu waxay u baahan tahay aqoon xirfadeed iyo waxbarasho. Waxaa muhiim ah inaad aad u taqaanid qaybta ganacsigaagu yahay (toimiala) iyo shuruucda la xiriirta ganacsiga.
en: Entrepreneurship requires professional expertise, training, knowledge of one's own line of business and local business legislation and experience of customers and sales channels.

so: Waxaa lagama maarmaan ah in la helo maalgelin ku filan ganacsiga iyo qorshe si taxadar leh loo dejiyey.
en: Adequate finance and careful planning are essential.

so: Ganacsiga si fiican ugu diyaargarow adigoo si wanaagsan u adeegsanaya aqoontaada iyo xirfadaada, sababtoo ah ganacsiga bilaabidiisa adigoon lahayn aqoon kugu filan iyo luuqad midna waa khatar.
en: In entrepreneurship it is most important to be as well prepared as possible as regards knowledge and skill, since starting a business with insufficient expertise and language ability is extremely risky.

so: Markii aad doonaysid inaad shirkad ganacsi samaysatid, si wanaagsan uga fakar, ma haysataa fikrad wanaagsan oo ganacsi, Sidoo kale ka fakar ma leedahay xirfad iyo waayo-aragnimo kugu filan sidoo kale qorshee sidaad maalgalin u heli lahayd.
en: If you want to establish a business, consider carefully whether your business idea is a good one. Consider too, whether you have sufficient professional skill and experience, and how you will arrange the financing.

so: Waxaad cawinaad la xiriirta samaynta shirkada cusub waydiisan kartaa xarunta ganacsiga cusub (uusyrityskeskus).
en: In matters relating to starting a business, you can ask for help and guidance from New Enterprise Centres.

so: Sidoo kale xasuusnow, in sixiixu yahay heshiis ku qabanaya ama dhaqangal ah. Si taxadar leh u akhri dhammaan dukumintiyada inta aanad waxba sixiixin.
en: Remember too, that a signature makes an agreement binding, so read all documents carefully before putting your name to any contracts.

so: Si taxaddir leh u aqri ogeysiiska booska shaqada
en: Read job advertisements carefully

so: Ka hor inta aadan qorin codsiga shaqada, si taxaddar leh u aqri ogeysiiska booska shaqada kana fikir nooca aqoon iyo xirfadeed uu shaqo-bixiyuhu raadinayo.
en: Before you write a job application, read the job advertisement carefully and think about the kinds of skills and competence the employer is looking for.

so: Ka fikir sida ay aqoontaadu ugu habboon tahay filashooyinka iyo shuruudaha shaqo-bixiyaha.
en: Think of how your competence corresponds to the employer's wishes and requirements.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale la xiriiri kartaaa shaqo-bixiyaha islamarkaasna weydiin kartaa macluumaad dheeraad ah, haddii aad qabto su'aal uusan ogeysiisku ka jawaabin.
en: You can also contact the employer and ask for more information if you have a question that the advertisement does not answer.

so: Wac shaqo-bixiyaha haddii aad dooneyso in aad booska shaqada ka weydiiso wax la taaban karo.
en: Call the employer only when you want to ask something concrete about the job.

so: Inta badan marka aad codsaneyso boos shaqo waxaad shaqo-bixiyaha u direysaa codsi shaqo iyo CV, yacni qoraalka qof ka warranka.
en: Usually when you apply for a job, you send a job application and a CV (curriculum vitae) to the employer.

so: Codsiga shaqadu wuxuu mararka qaar noqon karaa fiidiyow, boortofooliyo ama tusaale ahaan bog-shabakadeed.
en: Sometimes the job application can be a video, a portfolio or, for example, a web page.

so: Ku qor codsiga iyo CV'ga isla luqadda uu ogeysiiska booska shaqadu ku qoran yahay.
en: Write the application and CV in the same language that was used in the job advertisement.

so: Mar kasta oo aad shaqo cusub codsaneyso qor codsi cusub CV'gaadana waqtiga la jimee.
en: Write a new application and update your CV every time you apply for a new job.

so: Toos ayaad codsiga ugu qori kartaa emaylka ama waxaad qoraalka qof ka warranka lifaaq ahaan kula diri kartaa emaylka.
en: You can type the application into an email message or add it as an email attachment with the CV.

so: Mar kasta ka dhig lifaaqyada aad ku dareyso PDF.
en: Always add attachments in the PDF format.

so: Waxaad inta badan codsiga iyo CV'ga ka dhex-diri kartaa bogagga shabakadda shaqo-bixiyaha.
en: You can often send the application and CV through the employer's website.

so: Ujeeddada codsiga shaqadu waa kicinta xiisaha shaqo-bixiyaha si aad ugu gudubto wareysiga shaqada.
en: The purpose of a job application is to arouse the employer's interest so that they will invite you to an interview.

so: Codsigu waa jawaabta ogeysiiska booska shaqada.
en: The application is a reply to the job advertisement.

so: Ka jawaab filashooyinka iyo shuruudaha lagu xusay ama sheegay ogeysiiska booska shaqada.
en: Respond to the wishes and requirements that were mentioned in the job advertisement.

so: Carabka ku adkee arrimaha muhiimka u ah shaqada.
en: Emphasise the things that are important for the task.

so: Sheeg tusaalooyin la taaban karo oo aqoontaada ku saabsan.
en: Give concrete examples of your competence.

so: Ku qanci ama ka dhaadhici shaqo-bixiyaha sida aad ugu habboon tahay shaqadan.
en: Assure the employer that you are suitable for the task.

so: Codsiga shaqadu waa mid inta badan wax yar ka yar hal bog.
en: A job application is usually a little under one page long.

so: Codso in codsigaada uu qof kaa aqriyo kaana hubiyo.
en: Ask someone to read and check your application.

so: Codsiga waa in inta badan lagu daro mushaarka la rajeynayo.
en: You often have to add a desired salary to applications.

so: Waa adag tahay in inta badan la qiimeeyo, cadadka lacageed ee ku haboon.
en: It is often difficult to estimate the correct amount.

so: Mushaarka la rajeynayo ma ahan in uu ahaado mid aad u sareeya ama dhinaca kale aad u hooseeya.
en: The desired salary must not be too high but not too low either.

so: Ururada xirfadlayaasha ayaa waxaa laga heli karaa macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan heerarka mushaar ee noocyada shaqooyin kala duduwan.
en: Trade unions may provide more information on the wage levels in different fields.

so: Aqoonsashada awood-xirfadeedkaaga waxey faa'iido leedahay marka shaqo la raadsanayo.
en: In seeking employment, it is useful to recognise your competence.

so: Wada eeg waxbarashadaada iyo waayo-aragnimadaada shaqo, kana fikir xirfadaha aad kuwaas ka baratay.
en: Go over your education and work experience and think about what skills they have taught you.

so: Aqoon xirfadeed noocee ah ayaad leedahay?
en: What professional skills do you have?

so: Maxaad ku wanaagsan tahay?
en: What are your strengths?

so: Ka fikir sidoo kale xirfadaha aad ka heshay hiwaayadaha iyo waayo-aragnimooyinka kale.
en: Also think about what skills you have from hobbies or other experiences.

so: Shahaadooyinka oo waqtiga la socda
en: Are your certificates up to date?

so: Keydso shahaadooyinka aad ka heshay meelihi hore ee aad ka soo shaqeysay iyo waxbarashooyinkaadiba.
en: Keep certificates from your previous workplaces and studies.

so: Xusuusnow in aad mar kasta codsato in shahaado lagaa siiyo marka aad meel shaqo u joogtay, tababar u joogtay ama aad wax ka baratay.
en: Always remember to ask for a certificate when you have been working, training or studying.

so: Shaqo-bixiyaha waxaa waajib ku ah in uu shahaado shaqo ku siiyo xittaa toban sano ka dib dhamaanshihi xiriirka shaqada.
en: Even ten years after the contract of employment has ended, the employer is obliged to provide a testimonial of service.

so: Inta badan looma baahna in shahaadooyinka shaqada horay loogu sii diro shaqo-bixiyaha, laakiin waxaa wanaagsan in horay loo sii qaato marka wareysiga shaqada la aadayo, si aad u tusto haddii uu shaqo-bixiyuhu u baahdo.
en: There is usually no need to send testimonials of service to the employer in advance, but it is good idea to take them to the job interview in case the employer wants to see them.

so: Waxaa wanaagsan in shahaadooyinka dibadda lagala yimid dhammaantood loo turjumo af Finnish ama Iswidhis.
en: It would be good if all your references and certificates obtained abroad were translated into Finnish or Swedish.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo mowduuca ku saabsan waxey ku jiraa bogga InfoFinlandi Shahaado shaqo.
en: More information is available on the InfoFinland web page Testimonial of service.

so: Aqoonsashada shahaadoyinka dibadda ee dugsiga iyo jaamacadda
en: Recognition of foreign diplomas and degrees

so: Codsashada shaqadu waa fududaaneysaa haddii aad taqaano sida shahaadada aad dibadda ka soo qaaday ay ugu dhigmeyso shahaadada Finland.
en: Job hunting is easier if you know how a degree or diploma gained abroad corresponds to a Finnish one.

so: Guddiga Qaranka ee Waxbarashada Finnishka ayaad ka codsan kartaa aqoonsashada shahaadada aad dibadda ka soo heshey.
en: You can apply to the Finnish National Agency for Education for recognition of your diploma or degree which has been completed abroad.

so: Aqoonsiga shahaado waa lacag.
en: Recognition of a degree is subject to a charge.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo mowduuca ku saabsan waxey ku jiraa bogga InfoFinlandi Shahaadooyinka ajnabiga markii la keeno Finland.
en: More information is available on the InfoFinland web page Foreign diploma or degree in Finland.

so: Toos ayaad ula xiriira kartaa booska shaqada aad xiiseeneyso.
en: You can contact an interesting employer directly.

so: Codsi shaqo oo furan ayaad u diri kartaa ama waad wici kartaa shaqo-bixiyaha, haddii xitaa aysan jirin shaqo banaan.
en: You can send an open job application or call the employer even if they are not advertising vacancies at the time.

so: Ku sheeg codsiga shaqada furan waxa aad taqaan iyo shaqooyinka aad xiiseyneyso inaad sameyso.
en: In the open job application, describe your skills and the kinds of tasks you would be interested in doing.

so: Ku lifaaq arjigaada qoraalka qof ka warranka, yacni CV.
en: Add a curriculum vitae or CV to your application.

so: Qoraalka qof ka warranku, yacni CV wuxuu qaab fasiix ah oo kooban meel isugu keenayaa awood-xirfadeedkaada, waayo-aragnimadaada shaqo iyo waxbarashadaada.
en: A curriculum vitae or CV includes your competence, work experience and education in a dense and clear format.

so: Sambalada CV'yadi waa badan kala duduwan yihiin.
en: There are different CV models.

so: CV'yadi soo jireenka ahaa waxaad qaab alifbeeto oo akle ah ugu liis-gareyn kartaa awood-xirfadeedkaaga.
en: In a traditional CV, you can list your competence chronologically.

so: CV'ga aqoon ku saleysan waxyaabaha aad aqoonta u leedahay ayaad ku kala sooci kartaa.
en: In a competence-based CV, you can group your skills into different competence areas.

so: CV'gu wuxuu sidoo kale noqon karaa fiidiyow, boortofooliyo ama bog shabakadeed.
en: The CV can also be a video, portfolio or web page.

so: Baro sambalada kala duduwan ee CV'ga kaddibna sameyso qoraalka qof ka warran ee adiga kugu habboon.
en: Explore different CV models and build a curriculum vitae that suits you.

so: Inta badna CV'gu waa 1-2 bog.
en: A CV is usually 1–2 pages long.

so: Xusuusnow in aad waqtiga la jimeyso CV'ga codsi kasta oo cusub marka aad sameyneyso.
en: Remember to revise your CV for each new application.

so: Muxuu CV'gu ka kooban yahay?
en: What does a CV include?

so: Magaca iyo macluumaadyada xiriirka – Cinwaanka, emaylka, lambarka telefoonka
en: Name and contact information – Address, e-mail address, telephone number.

so: Arji shaqo – Liisgaree goobahaadi hore ee shaqo, ugu horeysii kii ugu dambeeyay.
en: Work experience – List your previous jobs, starting with the most recent one.

so: Sheeg sidoo kale waqtiga uu socday xiriirka shaqadu.
en: Also specify the duration of the employment.

so: Sawir ka bixi shaqooyinkaadi iyo xirfadaha aad shaqada ka baratay.
en: Describe your tasks and the skills you have learned in the work.

so: U liisgaree shahaadooyinkaada sida ay u kala horeeyay, ugu horeysii tii ugu dabneysay.
en: List your degrees chronologically, starting with the most recent one.

so: Ku dar magaca shahaadada, magaca barnaamijka waxbarashada, magaca machadka iyo waqtiga qalinjebinta. Koorasyada –
en: Include the name of the degree, the name of the study programme, the name of the educational institute and the time of graduation.

so: Ku liisgaree cinwaan u gaar ah hoostiisa koorasyada afka Finnishka iyo koorasyada kale ee aad soo dhigatay.
en: Courses – List under one heading the Finnish language courses and other courses that you have completed.

so: Awood-xirfadeed kale – Aqoonta afka, aqoonta IT, kaararka ruqsadaha, tusaale ahan baasaboorka nadaafadda
en: Other competence – Language skills, IT skills, licences such as a hygiene pass.

so: Daabacaadyo ama bandhigyo shaqeedyo kale –
en: Publications and other demonstrations of skill –

so: Waxaad ku dari kartaa haddii aad dooneyso daabacaadyadaada ama bandhigyadaada shaqo.
en: If you want, you can list your own publications or demonstrations of skill.

so: Hiwaayado, xilal kalsooniyeedyo – Waxaad sidoo kale soo bandhigi kartaa waxyaabaha aad xiiseyso.
en: Hobbies, positions of trust – You can also share your own interests.

so: Soo-jeediyayaal – Waxaad ku dari kartaa magacyada dadka kuu ballanqaaday in ay shaqada kaaga warbixnayaan.
en: References – You can add the names of people who have promised to recommend you for the job.

so: Ku dar macluumaadyada xiriirka soo-jeediyayaasha.
en: Add the contact information of the references.

so: Xusuusnow in aad fasax weydiisato soo-jeediyayaasha.
en: Remember to ask the reference for permission.

so: Waxaad billowga hore ee CV'ga ku dari kartaa soo-koobis ama muuqaal aad ku sawireyso taariikhdaada iyo aqoontaada gaarka ah adigoo isticmaalaya hor jumladood.
en: At the beginning of the CV, you can add a summary or a profile describing your background and core competence with a few sentences.

so: Waxaad sheegi kartaa hiigsiyadaada codsigaada shaqo iyo awood-xirfadeedkaada gaarka ah.
en: You can describe the goals of your job search or your special competence.

so: Sawirkaada ayaa sidoo kale ku dari kartaa codsiga.
en: You can also include a photograph of yourself.

so: CV awood-xirfadeed ku saleysan wuxuu si fiican xoogga u soo saarayaa awood-xirfadeedkaada, xirfadahaada iyo waayo-aragnimadaada.
en: A competence-based CV highlights your competence, skills and experience.

so: Xulo dhowr meelood oo aad aqoon u leedahay kaddibna cinwaano hoostooda sawir uga bixi waayo-aragnimaadaada, aqoontaada iyo waxyaabihi aad ku guuleysatay ee arrimahaas la xiriira.
en: Select a few competence areas and describe your related experiences, skills and accomplishments under the headings.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale ku dari kartaa aqoonta aad ka baratay tusaale ahaan shaqo mutadawanimo ah, hiwaayadaha ama waxbarashooyinka.
en: You can also add competence you have acquired, for example, in voluntary work, hobbies and studies.

so: Waxaa kale oo aad ku sii dari kartaa waayo-ragnimaaada shaqo iyo waxbarashooyinka oo waqti ahaan isuku xigxiga.
en: In addition to this, you can list your work experience and education chronologically.

so: Waxaad sheegi kartaa hiigsiyadaada codsigaada shaqo iyo aqoonta gaarka ah ee aad leedahay.
en: You can describe the goals of your job seeking or your special competence.

so: CV u gaar ah u samee booska kasta ee shaqo.
en: Make an individual CV for each job.

so: Carabka ku adkee aqoontada shaqada loogu baahan yahay.
en: Highlight the skills that are needed in the job.

so: Ka fikir aqoonta iyo xirfadda aad leedahay ee ay muhiim tahay in uu shaqo-bixiyuhu ogaado.
en: Think of what the employer should know about your skills and competence.

so: Shan dukumenti ayuu ka kooban yahay, kuwaas oo ujeeddada laga leeyahay ay tahay in ay shaqaalaha iyo ardayda ka caawiyaan ku soo bandhigista aqoontooda gudaha Yurub.
en: It consists of five documents whose purpose is to help employees and students to prove their competence in Europe.

so: Dukumentiyada waxaa laga isticmaalaa dhammaan wadamada Midowga Yuruba/ETA.
en: The documents are used in all EU/EEA countries.

so: Baasaboorka Yurub waxaad u isticmaali kartaa raadinta shaqada iyo waxbarashada.
en: You can use the Europass when looking for a job or a place to study.

so: Baasboorka Yurub faa'iido gaar ah ayuu kuu leeyahay, haddii aad Finland ka codsaneyso shaqo ama waxbarasho adigoo ka imaanaya wadan kale oo Yurub ah.
en: The Europass is especially useful if you apply for work or education in Finland from another EU country.

so: U diyaargarow wareysiga shaqada
en: Prepare for the job interview

so: Horay u sii baro shaqo-bixiyaha tusaale ahaan adigoo ka sii baranaya bogagga shabakadda.
en: Read about the employer beforehand, for example, through their website.

so: Ka fikir sida aad u soo bandhigi karto awood-xirfadeedkaada iyo ku habboonaanshahaada shaqada.
en: Think of how to bring out your competence and suitability for the task.

so: Ku sii tababaro in aad dhowr jumladood ku sawirto taariikhdaada iyo aqoontaada xirfadeed.
en: Learn to describe your background and professional competence in a few sentences.

so: Horay uga sii fikir su'aalaha uu shaqo-bixiyuhu ku weydiin karo.
en: Think beforehand about what questions the employer might ask you.

so: Ku sii tababaro ka jawaabista su'aalaha guud ee wareysiga shaqada.
en: Practise answering common job interview questions.

so: Shaqo-bixiyuhu waxba kaama weydiin karo qoyskaada, diinta aad heysato iyo aad siyaasadda ku jirto.
en: The employer may not ask you about your family, what religion you practise or whether you are politically active.

so: Muuji in aad horay u soo baratay ururka shaqo-bixiyaha iyo shaqada iyo in aad si dhab ah shaqada u xiiseyneyso.
en: Let the employer see that you have familiarised yourself with its organisation and the task beforehand and that you are genuinely interested in this particular job.

so: Ka fikir sidoo kale waxa aad adigu dooneyso in aad shaqo-bixiyaha weydiiso.
en: Think also about what you would like to ask the employer.

so: Markasta samee heshis shaqo oo qoraal ah ka hor inta aadan billaabin shaqada cusub.
en: Always make a written contract of employment before you start a new job.

so: Kala heshii shaqo-bixiyaha waxyaabaha ku qoran heshiiska shaqada.
en: Agree on the content of the contract of employment with the employer.

so: Si taxaddar leh u aqri heshiiska ka hor inta aadan saxiixin.
en: Read the contract carefully before signing it.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Ka heshiinta shuruudaha heshiiska shaqada.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Agreeing on the conditions of employment.

so: Marka aad billaabeyso shaqo cusub, u gee shaqo-bixiyaha kaarka canshuurta.
en: When you start a new job, submit a tax card to the employer.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Kaadhka cashuurta.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Tax card.

so: Ka raadi boosaska shaqooyinka bannaan bogagga boosaska shaqada, jaraa'idyada iyo adeegyada warbaahinta bulshada (tusaale Facebook iyo Linkedlin).
en: Search for vacancies on employment service websites, newspapers or social media services (for example, Facebook and LinkedIn).

so: Bogagga boosaska shaqada waxaad heleysaa marka aad mashiinka xog-raadinta khaanaddiisa qoraalka ku qorto "avoimet työpaikat" (boosaska shaqooyinka bannaan).
en: To find web pages for jobs, write “avoimet työpaikat” (vacancies) in the search engine's text field.

so: Sameyso shabakado aqoontaadana sii wado
en: Create networks and maintain your competence

so: Shabakaduhu waxey faa'iido u leeyihiin shaqo raadinta.
en: Networks are useful in seeking employment.

so: Aqoonso oo ka faa'iideyso shabakaddaada.
en: Recognise and utilise your own network.

so: Macallimiinta, saaxiibada waxbarashada, dadka aad istaqaanaan, dadki aad horay isula soo shaqeyseenba waxey qeyb ka noqon karaa shabakaddaada.
en: Teachers, fellow students, acquaintances, ex-colleagues and supervisors may also be part of your network.

so: Weydiiso dadka kale talooyinka shaqo-raadinta ama caawimaadda codsiga shaqada.
en: Ask other people for tips on job hunting or help for writing your job application.

so: Ka fikir sidoo kale in aad shabakaddaada ka heli karto qof kuu sheegi kara fursadaha shaqo ama kuu talin kara.
en: Also consider whether there is a person in your own network who could tell you about employment opportunities or recommend you.

so: Xajiso xirfaddaada, la soco dhacdooyinka iyo wararka laantaada aqooneed, ka qeybqaado waxbarashooyinka dhameystirka ah horumarina aqoontaadi hore.
en: Be active. Maintain your skills, follow the events and news of your own field, participate in further training and develop your previous competence.

so: Heyso oo ballaari shabakaddaada.
en: Maintain and expand your network.

so: Xiriir shaqo ama tababar shaqo oo gaaban waxey kaa caawin karaan ballaarinta shabakaddaada.
en: Even short employment or practical training can help you expand your network.

so: Aad dhacdooyinka xirfadeed ee laantaada aqooneed, samee shaqooyin mutadawacnimo ah ama ku biir waxqabadka hagitaanka shaqooyinka.
en: Visit professional events of your own field, engage in voluntary work or apply for mentoring activities.

so: Ku daro xisaabta in qabashada shaqooyinka mutadawcnimada ah ay saameyn ku yeelan karto faa'iidoyinka shaqo la'aanta.
en: Bear in mind that voluntary work may affect your unemployment benefit.

so: Faahfaahinta dheeraadka ah ee shaqada iskaa ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Shaqada iskaa wax u qabsho.
en: Read more about voluntary work on the InfoFinland web page Voluntary work.

so: Marka aad luqada taqaano, waxaa kuu sahlan in aad shaqo hesho islamarkaasna aad hawlahaada ka qabsato bulshada Finniska ah dhexdeeeda.
en: When you know the language, it is easier to find work and handle matters in Finnish society.

so: Waxaad finnishka ama iswidhishka ka baran kartaa koorasyo kala duduwan ama si iskaa ah internetka.
en: You can study Finnish and Swedish in various courses or independently on the Internet.

so: Uga faa'iideyso warbaahinta bulshada shaqo raadinta
en: Utilise social media in job hunting

so: Adeeygada dadka ee Internetka sida Facebook iyo Linkedlin waa qalabka ku wanaagsan shaqo raadinta.
en: Social networking services such as Facebook and LinkedIn are good tools for seeking employment.

so: Shaqo-bixiyayaal badan waxaa kale oo ay warbaahin ahaan u isticmaalaan Twitterka.
en: Many employers also use Twitter as a communication channel.

so: Adeegyada waxaad ka raadsan kartaa macluumaadyada boosaska shaqooyinka bannaan, waxaad sidoo kale ka sameysan kartaa shabakado xirfadeed.
en: In these services, you can search for information on vacancies and build professional networks.

so: Waxaad heli kartaa macluumaadyo muhiim ah oo ku saabsan waxqabadka ururo kala duduwan iyo arrimaha cusub ee laamo xirfadeedyo kala duduwan ama waxaad ka qeybqaadan kartaa wada-sheekeysiyada.
en: You can receive important information on the operation of different organisations and topical matters in different fields or participate in discussions.

so: Toos ayaad ula xiriiri kartaa ururada aad xiiseynayso islamarkaasna weydiin kartaa haddii ay haayaan shaqooyin bannaan.
en: You can contact interesting organisations directly and ask if they have vacancies.

so: Shaqooyinka bannaan intooda badan waa kuwa boosaska shaqooyinka bannaan ee qarsoon.
en: A large number of vacancies are hidden jobs.

so: Boosaskan shaqo lama soo geliyo codsiyada furan ee shaqo-bixiyayaashu waxey shaqaalaha ka raadsadaan shabakadahooda dhexdooda.
en: These vacancies are not advertised publicly; employers look for employees through their own networks.

so: Waxaad toos u wici kartaa shaqo-bixiyaha ama waxaad emayl ugu diri kartaa codsi shaqo oo furan.
en: You can call the employer directly or send an open job application by email.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale inta badan codsiga furan ugu diri kartaa bogagga shabakadda shirkadda.
en: Many companies also offer online open job application forms on their websites.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale shaqo ka raadsan kartaa shirkadaha bixiyaha adeegyada shaqaaleynta.
en: You can also seek employment through companies that offer employment services.

so: Shaqadu waxey ahaan kartaa mid waqti gaaban socota laakiin waxaad ka heli kartaa waayo-aragnimo faa'iido leh adigoo ballaarinaya shabakadaada.
en: The work may be short-term, but it can give you useful experience and expand your networks.

so: Waxaad heshiis la geleysaa shirkad shaqo kuugu direysaa shaqo-bixiye kale.
en: You make a contract with the company, which sends you to work at another employer.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale shaqo joogto ah ku heli kartaa soo marista shirkaddan oo kale.
en: You can also find permanent employment through a company like this.

so: Isu shaqaalee firiilaanserinimo ama ganacsade
en: Employ yourself as a freelancer or an entrepreneur

so: Shaqada firiilaanserka waxaa loola jeedaa shaqo aad xiriir shaqo oo aan joogto aheyn ugu qabaneyso shaqo bixiyaal badan.
en: Freelance work means that you work for several clients without permanent employment based on a contract.

so: Firiilaanserku waa in uu iskiis uga taxaddiraa arrimaha canshuuraha iyo lacagta hawlgabka.
en: As a freelancer, you must take care of tax matters and pension payments yourself.

so: Adeegyada sameynta qaansheegga adigoo isticmaalaya ayaad qaansheeg ku dallacan kartaa adigoo aan shirkad sameysan.
en: You can invoice your work though an invoicing service without establishing your own company.

so: Waxaa lagu magacaabaa ganacsi fudud.
en: This is called light entrepreneurship.

so: Waxad sidoo kale aasaasan kartaa shirkad.
en: You can also start your own business.

so: Macluumaad ku saabsan sameysashada shirkad waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Samaynta shirkad ganacsi.
en: Find out more about starting a business on the InfoFinland web page Starting a business.

so: Xisaabta ku daro in ku shaqeynta firiilaansernimada ama ganacsadenimo in ay saameyn ku yeelan karto faa'iidoyinkaada shaqo la'aanta.
en: Bear in mind that working as a freelancer or an entrepreneur may affect your unemployment benefit.

so: Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada wuxuu kaalmeeyaa shaqo raadinta
en: The Employment and Economic Development Office gives support when job hunting

so: Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashadu, ee Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada (TE-toimisto) waxaad hagitaan uga heleysaa shaqo raadinta iyo macluumaad ku saabsan boosaska bannaan ee shaqooyinka iyo waxbarashada.
en: The Employment and Economic Development Office or TE office (TE-toimisto) provides you with guidance on employment seeking and information on vacancies and trainings.

so: Haddii aadan shaqo heysan ama aad shaqo la'aan noqoto, iska diiwaangeli Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada ugu dambeyn maalinta shaqo la'aanta ugu horeysa.
en: If you do not have a job or become unemployed, register at the TE Office no later than on your first day of unemployment.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Haddii aad shaqo la'aan noqotid.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page If you become unemployed.

so: Isu diiwaangelinta sidi qof macaamiil ah
en: Registering as a customer

so: Waxaad macaamiilnimadaada xafiiska shaqada ka diiwaangelin kartaa Xafiiska shaqada ee deegaanka ama bogagga shabakadda ee Xafiiska shaqada.
en: You can register as a customer of the TE Office either at the local TE Office or on the TE Office website.

so: Haddii aad tahay shaqo laawe shaqo raadis ah waxaa lagula sameynayaa qorshaha la qabsashada ama qorshaha shaqaaloobista.
en: If you are an unemployed job seeker, an integration or employment plan is prepared for you.

so: Haddii aad sameyso shaqo saacado yar ah ama shaqo yar, Xafiiska shaqada ayaa qiimeynaya in aad sidoo kale heli karto manfaca shaqo la'aanta.
en: If you work part time or have little work, the TE Office assesses whether you can receive unemployment benefit at the same time.

so: Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashadu wuxuu qabanqaabiyaa
en: The TE Office organises

so: hagitaanka doorashada xirfadda iyo hagitaanka mihnadda
en: vocational guidance and career guidance

so: Haddii mar dhow u soo guurtay Finland aadna kaalmo ugu baahantahay la qabasashada, waxaad Xafiiska shaqada ka soo geli kartaa waxbarashada la qabsashada.
en: If you have only recently moved to Finland and need support for integration, you can get to integration training through the TE Office.

so: Waxbarashada la qabsashada waxaa ku jiri kara barashada afka Finnishka, waxbarashooyin kale ama shaqo tijaabin.
en: The integration training can include Finnish language studies, other education or work try-out.

so: Adiga ayaa sidoo kale raadsan kara waxbarasho.
en: You can also seek training yourself.

so: Waa inaad kala heshiisaa Xafiiska shaqada ka hor inta aadan billaabin.
en: You must make an agreement with the TE Office regarding your training before starting it.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi La-qabsashada Finland.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Integration into Finland.

so: Kaalmada shaqo raadinta waxey dadka 30 sano ka yar ka helayaan Ohjaamo
en: Support for job hunting for under 30-year-olds from Ohjaamo

so: Haddii aad 30 sano ka yar tahay waxaad macluumaad ku saabsan shaqada, waxbarashada iyo arrimaha kale ee nolol-maalmeedka la xiriira ka heli kartaa Ohjaamo.
en: If you are under 30 years of age, you can get information on work, training and other everyday matters in Ohjaamo.

so: Markii heshiiska shaqadu uu dhamaado, qofka shaqaalaha ahi wuxuu xaq u leeyahay inuu shaqo-bixiyaha ka helo warbixin-shakhsiyadeed shaqo oo qoraal ah.
en: When an employee's contract of employment expires they are entitled to a written testimonial of service from their employer. Read more on the InfoFinland web page Testimonial of service.

so: Marka aad dibadda uga guureyso Finland waa in aad xafiiska diiwaangelinta (maistraatti) ogeysiisaa guurista.
en: When moving abroad from Finland, you must notify your Local Register Office (maistraatti) of your move.

so: Waxaad ogeysiiska guurista ku sameyn kartaa foom aad internetka ka heleyso, boostada ama xafiiska diiwaangelinta.
en: You can complete the notice of move online or with a form available at Local Register Offices and post offices.

so: Haddii aad si joogta ah uga guurto Finland ama aad dibadda joogeyso laba sano oo xiriir ah, ogolaanshaha joogistaada waa lagaala laabanayaa.
en: If you permanently move away from Finland or reside abroad for a continuous period of two years, your residence permit will be revoked.

so: Waxaad ka codsan kartaa Xafiiska dal u soo guurida (Maahanmuuttovirasto) in aan lagaala laaban ogolaanashaha joogistaada.
en: You can lodge an application with the Finnish Immigration Service (Maahanmuuttovirasto) to prevent the cancellation of the residence permit.

so: Codisgaas waa inaad sameysaa ka hor inta aadan labo sano dibadda joogin.
en: The application must be submitted before you have resided abroad for two years.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan arrintan waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Ma lumin karaa ogolaanshaha joogista?.
en: More information on the matter is available on the InfoFinland page Can I lose my residence permit?

so: U guurista dibadda iyo ammaanka bulshada
en: Moving abroad and social security

so: Marka aad dibadda u guurto si aad u degto, waa in ogeysiisaa Kelada, haddii aad Kelada ka hesho manfacyo ama aad heysato kaarka daryeelka jirrada ee Yurub.
en: When you move to live abroad, you need to inform Kela if you are receiving Kela benefits or if you have a European Health Insurance Card.

so: Markaas waxaa joogistaada dibadda loo qaadanayaa mid ku meel gaar ah, mana ahan qasab in Kelada la ogeysiiyo.
en: In that case, your stay abroad is considered temporary and you do not have to inform Kela.

so: Haddii joogistaada dibaddu ay qaadaneyso 3-6 bilood, waxaa kuu wanaagsan in aad Kelada ogeysiiso haddii
en: If you stay abroad for 3–6 months, you should inform Kela if

so: aad Kelada ka hesho kaalmada ijaarka;
en: you are receiving general housing allowance;

so: kaalmada ilmo haynta; ama
en: you are receiving child care allowance; or

so: Marka xaq uma lihid manfacyada Kelada.
en: In that case, you will not have the right to Kela benefits.

so: Xaqa aad u leedahay manfacyada Keladu wuxuu dhammaanayaa markaas wakhtiga aad guureyso.
en: In that case, your right to Kela subsidies ends when you move.

so: Haddii aad dibadda joogto xaqna aad u leedahay manfacyada Kelada, markasta ku wargeli Kelada haddii xaaladdaadu ay is-beddesho.
en: When you are abroad and have the right to Kela benefits, you must always inform Kela if your circumstances change.

so: Tusaale ahaan haddii xiriirka qoyska uu is-beddelo ama aad shaqo billowdo waxay saameyn ku yeelan karaan xaqa aad manfacyada u leedahay.
en: For example, if your family relationships change or if you start working, that may affect your right to Kela benefits.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan ammaanka bulshada Finland waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga internetka ee Kelada iyo bogga InfoFinlandi Ammaanka bulsho ee Finland.
en: More information on social security in Finland is available on the InfoFinland page Finnish social security.

so: Dib u laabashada iskaa ah ee qaxootiga, magangelyo doonka iyo muhaajiriinta
en: Voluntary return of refugees, asylum seekers and immigrants

so: aad tahay magangelyo codsade iyo go aankii codsiga oo wali lagaarin
en: you are an asylum seeker and your application is being processed

so: Wadamo badan waxay wakiilo ku leeyihiin Finland.
en: Many countries have a diplomatic mission in Finland.

so: Wakiilku wuxuu noqon karaa safaarad ama qunsuliyad.
en: The mission can be either an embassy or consulate.

so: Safaaraduhu waxay ku yaalaan Helsinki.
en: The embassies are located in Helsinki.

so: Wadamada qaar waxay ku qunsuliyado ku leeyihiin magaalooyin kale.
en: Some countries also have consulates in other cities.

so: La xiriir wakiilkaada haddii aad dooneyso inaad arrimo ka dhameysato saraakiisha dalkaada.
en: Contact your country's diplomatic mission if you need to take care of matters with officials of your native country.

so: Safaaradda waxaad ka dhameysan kartaa arrimaha soo socda:
en: Among other things, the following matters can be handled through diplomatic missions:

so: codsashada dhalashada dalkaada haddii aad lumisay ama aad iska dhiibtay
en: Applying for citizenship in your home country if you have lost or relinquished it

so: ogeysiinta dhalashada carruurtaada saraakiisha dalkaada, haddii cunug kuugu dhasho Finland
en: Notifying the authorities of your native country of a new child if the child was born in Finland

so: dhalasho u codsashada cunugaada haddii uu ku dhashay Finland
en: Applying for citizenship in your native country for your child if the child was born in Finland

so: ka diiwaangelinta dalkaada guurkaada, haddii aad ku guursatay Finland
en: Registering your marriage in your native country if you married in Finland

so: Ogsoonoow in wakiilada oo dhan aysan bixin adeegyo isku mid ah.
en: Please note that not all diplomatic missions offer the same services.

so: Dhammaan arrimaha kor lagu xusay suurtagal ma ahan in laga helo wakiilada oo dhan.
en: Handling all of the matters listed above may not be possible in all diplomatic missions.

so: Adeegyada uu wakiilka dalkaadu sameeyo waxay ku xiran yihiin sharciyada dalkaada.
en: The available services depend on the legislation of your home country.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa wakiilka dalkaada.
en: For additional information, contact the diplomatic mission of your native country.

so: Dalalka oo dhan wakiilo kuma lahan Finland.
en: Not all countries have diplomatic missions in Finland.

so: Xaaladahan marka lagu jiro waxaa kuu adeegaya wakiilka ku yaal dowladaha Finland deriska la ah.
en: In these cases you are often served by your native country's diplomatic mission in one Finland's neighbouring countries.

so: Bogga internetka ee wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda waxaa ku taxan wakiilada wadamada kale ee Finland.
en: The website of the Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Finland features a list of the diplomatic missions of other countries in Finland.

so: Waxaad bogaas sidoo kale ka heleysaa meesha lagala xiriiro wakiilada.
en: In the list, you can find the contact information of the various missions.

so: Muwaadinnimada Finlnad waxaa la xiriira waajibaadyo iyo xuuqyo aysan ajaaniibta degan Finland laheyn.
en: Finnish citizenship entails a number of rights and obligations that do not apply to foreigners living in Finland.

so: xaq u lahaanshaha helitaanka baasaboorka Finland
en: The right to obtain a Finnish passport

so: xaq u lahaanshaha imaanshaha Finland iyo diidista in dal kale laguu dhiibo
en: The right to arrive in Finland and refuse extradition to another country

so: xaq u lahaanshaha codeynta doorashada madaxweynaha, doorashada baarlamaanka iyo aftida shacabka, haddii uu buuxiyay 18 sano
en: The right to vote in presidential elections, parliamentary elections and referenda if the person is 18 or older

so: xaq u lahaanshaha isu soo taagista doorashada baarlamaanka, haddii uu buuxiyay 18 sano
en: The right to stand in parliamentary elections if the person is 18 or older

so: suurtagalnimada in laguu doorto xilalka dowladda ee dhalashada Finland ku xiran
en: The opportunity to be appointed to state positions that require Finnish citizenship
