so: Xuquuqyada muwaadiniinta Midowga Yurub, sida dhaqdhaqaaqa xornimada leh iyo xornimada shaqada ee deegaanka Midowga Yurub iyo xaq u lahaanshaha codeynta iyo isu soo taagista doorashooyinka Midowga Yurub
en: The rights of EU citizens, such as the right to freely travel and work within the EU and the right to vote and stand in EU elections

so: waajibka ka qeybqaadashada difaaca dalka ama gacan siintiisa.
en: The obligation to participate in national defence or assist in the cause.

so: Ugu yaraan raga 18 sano jiryada ah waxaa saaran waajib ciidan (asevelvollisuus).
en: Compulsory conscription (asevelvollisuus) applies to all men over 18 years of age.

so: waajibka u hogaansanaanta sharciga Finland haddii meel kale oo aan Finland aheyn xitaa la joogo.
en: The responsibility to observe Finnish laws even when outside Finland.

so: Muwaadinka Finnishka ah waxaa lagu xukumi karaa dembi uu dibadda ku galay.
en: A Finnish citizen can be convicted in Finland for an offence committed abroad.

so: Ogsoonoow, in kuwaani ay yihiin xuquuqyo iyo waajibaadyo la xiriira muwaadinnimada Finland.
en: Please note that these are rights and responsibilities related to Finnish citizenship.

so: Xuquuqyada iyo waajibaadya dadka Finland degan oo dhan quseeya waxaad warar ku saabsan ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinland Xuquuqdaada iyo waajibaadyadaada Finland.
en: Information on rights and obligations that apply to all Finnish residents is available on the InfoFinland page Your rights and obligations in Finland.

so: Codis ku helitaanka dhalashada Finland waxay u baahan tahay in
en: Obtaining Finnish citizenship through an application requires the following:

so: aad shaqsiyadaada si la aamini karo u cadeyn karto
en: You can reliably verify your identity.

so: aad jirto ugu yaraan 18 sano ama xaas tahay
en: You are at least 18 year old or married.

so: aad Finland deganeyd waqti dheer , xaaladda ayuu ku xiran yahay waqti deganaanshaha ee la iska doonayo.
en: You have lived in Finland for a sufficiently long period.

so: aadan bixin diidin tusaale ahaan cashuurta, ganaaxyada, lacagta masruufka ama lacagta
en: You have not neglected to pay, for example, taxes, fines, child support or hospital fees.

so: aad awoodo inaad cadeyso sida aad Finland noloshaada uga soo saaran karto
en: You can confirm how you will obtain your livelihood in Finland.

so: aad luqada Finnishka ama Iswidishka ama luqada dhagoolaha ee Finnishka ama Iswidishka aad si lagu qanci karo u taqaano.
en: You have at least satisfactory skills in Finnish or Swedish, or in Finnish or Finnish-Swedish sign language.

so: Ka aqri faahfaahin dheeraad caddeynta luqadeed boga InfoFinland Shahaadada rasmiga ah ee aqoonta luuqada.
en: For more information on how to proof your language skills, see the InfoFinland page Official certificate of language proficiency.

so: Luuqadaha finnishka iyo iswiidhishka xogta barashadooda waxaad ka heleysaaboga InfoFinland Luuqada finnishka iyo iswiidhishka.
en: More information on studying Finnish and Swedish is available on the InfoFinland page Finnish and Swedish.

so: Codsiga dhalashada waxaad ka sameyn kartaa adeegga internetka ee Enter Finland.
en: You can apply for citizenship online through the Enter Finland service.

so: Codsiga ka buuxi adeegga kuna dar lifaaqyada.
en: Fill in the application in the service and attach the appendices.

so: Codsiga awgiis waxaad ugu yaraan u baahan tahay dukumiintiyada soo socda:
en: You need at least the following documents for the application:

so: Cadeyn xagga aqoonta luuqadda Finnishka ah
en: An account of your language skills

so: Cadeyn xagga dakhliga ah
en: An account of your income.

so: Sidoo kale bixi lacagta goaan ka gaarista codsiga.
en: You need to pay the application processing fee at that time.

so: Markii aad codsiga adeegga ka buuxiso, waxaad haystaa mudo sadex bilood ah oo aad ku tagto barta adeegga si waraaqahaaga aqoonsiga loo xaqiijiyo.
en: After you have filled in an application in the service, you have three months to go and prove your identity.

so: Waqti ka qabso barta adeegga ee Xaafiiska dal u soo guurista adigoo isticmaalaya adeegga internerka Xaafiiska dal u soo guurista.
en: Make an appointment for a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service on their website.

so: Markii aad iska soo xaqiijineyso xaafiiska, horay u sii qaado waraaqahaaga aqoonsiga iyo nuqulka lifaaqyada codsiga oo asal ah.
en: When you go to prove your identity, bring a personal identification document and the original copies of the application appendices.

so: Haddii aad sidoo kale dhalashada u dalbeysid carruurtaada, sidoo kale waa inay kula socdaan si aqoonsigooda loo xaqiijiyo.
en: If you are also applying for citizenship for your child, your child must also come and prove their identity.

so: Markii aad buuxiso codsiga, xasuusnow inaad la socoto adeegga koontadaada Enter Finland.
en: After you submit the application, remember to monitor your Enter Finland account.

so: Haddii Xaafiiska dal u soo guuristu uu codsigaaga xal ka gaaristiisa awgeed kaaga baahdo faah faahin dheeraad ah, akhbaarta waxaa laguugu soo dirayaa akoonkaaga adeegga Enter Finland.
en: If the Finnish Immigration Service needs additional clarifications, you will be informed through the Enter Finland service.

so: Codsiga waa la diidi karaa haddii aadan faah faahinta dheeraadka ah ee lagaaga baahan yahay ku soo gubin waqtigii laguu qabtay.
en: Your application may be rejected if you do not submit additional clarifications in time.

so: Markii go'aanka la gaaro, waxaad heleysaa ogeysiiska go'aanka.
en: When the decision has been made, you will be informed.

so: Haddii aadan awoodin ama aadan aqoon u lahayn inaad codsiga dhalashada internetka ka buuxiso, waxaad sidoo kale foomka codsiga ku buuxin kartaa waraaq ahaan.
en: If you are unable to apply for citizenship online, you can also apply using a paper form.

so: Foomka ka soo daabaco bogga internetka ee Xaafiiska dal u soo guurista, kadibna horay u soo buuxi.
en: Print out the form from the Finnish Immigration Service website and fill it in advance.

so: Codsiga oo la buuxiyey iyo lifaaqyadisaba si shakhsiyan ah u gey barta adeegga ee Xaafiiska dal u soo guurista.
en: Bring the filled-in application and its appendices personally to a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan codsashada dhalashada iyo arrimaha kale ee la xiriira dhalashada waxaad ka heleysaa bogga Xafiiska dal u soo guurida.
en: More information on applying for citizenship and on other matters related to citizenship is available on the Finnish Immigration Service's website.

so: Dhalashada Finland waa wax ka duwan sharciga deganaanshada.
en: Finnish citizenship differs from a residence permit.

so: Haddii aad hadda qorsheyneysin inaad Finland u guurto, wixii macluumaad dheeri ah ka akhri bogga InfoFinland U soo guurista Finland.
en: If you are only just planning moving to Finland, read more on the InfoFinland page Moving to Finland.

so: Dhalashada Finland waxaa lagu heli karaa
en: You can receive Finnish citizenship

so: waalid heysta dhalashada Finland
en: from a parent who is a Finnish citizen,

so: codsiga dhalashada Finland ama ogeysiin
en: through a citizenship application or notification.

so: Intaas waxaa dheer xaalado dhif ah oo lagu heli karo dhalashada sababo ku dhalasho awgood.
en: In addition, in some exceptional cases citizenship can be granted based on being born in Finland.

so: Waxaad dhalashada Finnishka codsan kartaa, markii aad buuxiso 18 sano, aad Finland si rasmi ah u deganayd muddo dheer oo ku filan, aad luuqadda Finnishka ama tan Iswidishka ugu hadli karto ama u qori karto si lagu qanci karo ama si la mid ah uu yahay heerka aqoontaada luuqadda dhagooleyaasha Finnishka ama tan Iswidhish, iyo in qofka aad tahay loo xaqiijiyey si la aamini karo.
en: You can apply for Finnish citizenship once you have turned 18, you have lived permanently in Finland the required number of years, you have a satisfactory oral and written command of Finnish or Swedish language or a command of the corresponding level in Finnish or Swedish Sign Language and your identity has been proven in a reliable manner.

so: Intaas waxaa dheer shuruudo kale; Tusaale ahaan waa inaad cadeysaa meesha ay lacagta noloshu kaa soo gasho.
en: In addition, there are other conditions; you have to report, for example, your source of income.

so: Dhalashada waxaad sidoo kale u codsan kartaa carruurta aan qaangaarka ahayn oo aad adigu mas'uul ka tahay.
en: At the same time, you can also apply for citizenship for your underage child living under your care.

so: Haddii aad wax dembi ah gashay ama tusaale ahaan aadan bixin canshuurahaaga, tani waxay caqabad ku noqon kartaa helitaanka dhalashda Finland.
en: If you have committed a crime or if you have not, for example, paid your taxes, this can be an obstacle to receiving Finnish citizenship.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeri ah ka akhri bogga InfoFinland Sidee loo codsan karaa dhalashada Finland?
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page How to apply for Finnish citizenship?

so: Isla marka aad adigu codsaneysid dhalashada Finland, waxaad dhalashada u codsan kartaa ilmaha aan weli qaan gaarin, oo aad adigu mas'uul ka tahay.
en: At the same time as applying for Finnish citizenship for yourself, you can apply for it for your underage child living under your care.

so: Ilmuhu markii uu dhasho wuxuu si toos ah u qaadanayaa dhalashada Finland, haddii:
en: A child is automatically granted Finnish citizenship at birth, if:

so: hooyada ilmaha dhashay ay leedahay dhalashada Finland.
en: the child's mother is a Finnish citizen.

so: Wax macno ah ku fadhiso meesha uu ilmuhu ku dhalanayo.
en: It makes no difference in which country the child is born.

so: aabaha ilmaha dhalay uu laakiin hooyadu maya, iyo inay waalidku is qabaan.
en: the child's father is a Finnish citizen and the mother is not, but the parents are married to each other.

so: Haddii waalidiintu aysan is qabin, markaas ilmuhu aabihiis ayuu la qaadanayaa dhalashada Finland:
en: If, however, the parents are not married, the child is granted Finnish citizenship through the father:

so: markuu dhasho, haddii uu Finland ku dhasho lana xaqiijiyo aabenimada.
en: at birth when the child is born in Finland and paternity is confirmed.

so: ogeysiiska dhalashada, haddii uu ku dhasho wadan kale lana xaqiijiyo aabenimada.
en: via a citizenship notification when the child is born in some other country and paternity has been confirmed.

so: Dhalashada Finland waxaa sidoo kale heli kara ilmaha waalidiintiisu ay yihiin ajaanib, oo ku dhasha Finland, haddii uusan waalidiintiisa ka helin wax dhalasho wadan kale ah.
en: Finnish citizenship can also be granted to a child born in Finland to foreign parents, if the child is not granted any other citizenship through the parents.

so: Bogga InfoFinland ee ah Finland markii uu ilmuhu dhaso waxaa ku qoran macluumaad loogu talo galay waalidiinta uu ilmahoodu ku dhasho Finland.
en: There is more information on the InfoFinland page When a child is born in Finland to parents whose child is born in Finland.

so: Dhalashada Finland waxaa ogeysiiska dhalashada (kansalaisuusilmoitus) ku heli kara
en: The following people can receive Finnish citizenship by means of a citizenship notification (kansalaisuusilmoitus):

so: ajnabi uu aabihiis Finish u dhashay
en: Foreign persons with a father who is a Finnish citizen

so: 18–22 sano qofka jira oo sanado badan deganaa Finland
en: Persons between 18 and 22 year of age who have lived in Finland for several years

so: cunug 12–17 sano jir ah oo uu soo qaatay muwaadin Finnish ah
en: Adopted children of Finnish citizens between 12 and 17 years of age

so: muwaadin Nordik ah oo deganaa Finland shanti sano ee la soo dhaafay
en: Citizens of a Nordic Country who have lived in Finland for the past five years

so: Ogeysiiska dhalashada waxaad ka sameyn kartaa internetka.
en: You can submit a citizenship notification online.

so: Foomka codsiga ka buuxi adeegga Enter Finland.
en: Fill in the form in the Enter Finland service.

so: Lifaaqyada ku dar codsiga.
en: Attach the application appendices.

so: Markii aad buuxiso ogeysiiska, xusuuso inaad koontadaada kala socoto adeegga Enter Finland.
en: After you submit the notification, remember to monitor your Enter Finland account.

so: Markii aad foomka codsiga ka buuxiso adeegga Enter Finland waxaad haystaa mudo sadex bilood ah oo aad ku tagto barta adeegga si waraaqahaaga aqoonsiga loo xaqiijiyo.
en: After filling in the form in the Enter Finland service, you have three months to go and prove your identity.

so: Waxaad iska xaqiijin kartaa barta adeegga ee Xaafiiska dal u soo guurista ama safaarada Finland ee dibada.
en: You can prove your identity at a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service or, abroad, at a Finnish diplomatic mission.

so: Wasaaradda arima dibadda ka hubso safaaradda aad iska xaqiijineysid meesha ay ku taalo.
en: You can find out from the Ministry for Foreign Affairs which diplomatic missions you can visit to prove your identity.

so: Waqti horay u sii qabso.
en: Make an appointment in advance.

so: Horay u sii qaado waraaqahaaga aqoonsiga iyo nuqulka lifaaqyada codsiga oo asal ah.
en: Bring a personal identification document and the original copies of the application appendices.

so: Haddii aadan awoodin ama aadan aqoon u lahayn inaad ogeysiiska dhalashada ka buuxiso internetka, waxaad sidoo kale foomka ogeysiiska ku buuxin kartaa waraaq ahaan.
en: If you are unable to submit a citizenship notification online, you can also do it using a paper form.

so: Bogagga internetka ee Xafiiska dal u soo guurida waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan sida loo sameeyo ogeysiiska dhalashada.
en: More information on lodging a citizenship notification can be found on the website of the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Finland waxay ogoshahay jinsiyadaha badan, waxaa loola jeedaa inaad heysato dhalashada Finland iyo dhalashada dal labaad.
en: Finland allows multiple citizenship, i.e. that you are a citizen of another country in addition to being a Finnish citizen.

so: Dowladaha oo dhan ma wada ogola jinsiyadaha badan.
en: However, not all countries allow multiple citizenship.

so: Ka hor inta aadan codsan dhalashada Finland waxaa wannaagsan inaad hubsato in jinsiyado badan laga ogol yahay dalka aad u dhalatay.
en: Before applying for Finnish citizenship, it is advisable to find out whether or not multi-nationality is permitted in the country where you have citizenship.

so: Haddii dowladaadu aysan ogoleyn jinsiyadaha badan waxaad weyn kartaa dhalashada aad hadda heysato marka aad hesho dhalashada Finland.
en: If the country in question does not allow multiple citizenship, you may lose your status as a citizen of that country when you obtain Finnish citizenship.

so: Jinsiyadaha badan waxay noqon karaan faa'iido laakiin sidoo kale dhibaato.
en: Multiple citizenship can be useful but also disadvantageous.

so: Tusaale ahaan waxaan wannaagsan inaad iska hubiso inaad dhowr dowladood ee aad dhalashada ka heysato inaad ka sameyso waajibka ciidamada iyo inay kugu filan tahay shahaadada uu hal dal kaa siiyay fulinta waajibaadka ciidanka.
en: For example, you should check whether you are liable to go into military service in more than one country of citizenship or whether it is sufficient to have a certificate of completed military service from one country.

so: Jinsiyadaha badan waxay faa'iido ku yihiin tusaale ahaan ka guurista dal iyo u guurista dalka kale ama shaqo raadinta.
en: Multiple citizenship can prove useful, for example, when moving from one country to another or seeking employment.

so: Xafiiska dal u soo guurista ayaa ka talo bixiya la xiriira jinsiyadda:
en: The Finnish Immigration Service advises on questions about nationality:

so: Jinsiyadda badan ee cunugga
en: A child's multiple citizenship

so: Cunuggu wuxuu heysan karaa dhalashada Finland iyo mid dal kale.
en: A child can be a citizen of both Finland and another country.

so: Tani waxay ku xiran tahay in dalka uu aqbalo jinsiyadaha badan ee ilmaha.
en: This depends on whether the other country accepts the child's multiple citizenships (monikansalaisuus).

so: Arrinta wax ka weydii wakiilka dalkaada.
en: Ask about it at your own country's Diplomatic Mission.

so: Ma la lumin karaa dhalashada Finland?
en: Can you lose Finnish citizenship?

so: Dhalashada Finland waxaa lumin kara
en: Finnish citizenship can be lost in the following cases:

so: qof 22 jir ah oo heysta dhalashada dalka kale, xiriir fiicanna aan la laheyn Finland
en: The person is 22 or older, holds citizenship in another country and does not have adequate contact to Finland.

so: qofka macluumaad qalad ah ku qoray codsiga dhalashada ama ogeysiiska dhalashada
en: The person has provided false information in the citizenship application or notification.

so: qofka dhalashada Finland ku helay jinsiyada aabe dartiis, aabanimadiina laga laabtay
en: The person has received Finnish citizenship based on the father's nationality and the relationship of paternity is disproved.

so: Boggan waxaa lagu sheegayaa ammaanka bulshada ee sababta looga dhigay dhinaca degista, kuwaas oo ay Keladu mas'uulka ka tahay.
en: This page contains information about the residence-based social security provided by Kela.

so: Bogga waxaa ku jira macluumaadka ku saabsan xaaladda laga eegayo inaad ku jirto xeyndaabka ammaanka bulshada ee ku saleysan degista.
en: The page indicates the situations in which you are considered to be covered by social security that is based on residence.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi Ammaanka shaqo la'aanta waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan qofka xaqa u leh ammaanka shaqo la'aanta.
en: The InfoFinland page Unemployment benefit contains more information about who is entitled to unemployment security.

so: Nidaamka hawlgabka Finland macluumaad ku saabsan waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Hawlgab.
en: More information about the Finnish pension system can be found on the InfoFinland page Pension.

so: Keladu waxybaaha ay mas'uulka ka tahay waxaa ka mid ah hawlgabka dadka, dheeraadka carruurta, ammaanka shaqo la'aanta ee aasaasiga ah, lacagta jiro maalmeedka iyo waalidka, lacagta kaalmada nolosha iyo baxnaanada.
en: Kela manages social security services and benefits, such as the national pension, child benefit, basic unemployment security, sickness and parenthood allowance, income support and rehabilitation.

so: Keladu waxaa ay sidoo kale mas'uul ka tahay magdhawga daryeelka caafimaadka ee lagu bixiyo daryeelka caafimaadka gaarka loo leeyahay.
en: Kela also provides health care benefits paid for private health care.

so: Haddii Finland lagaa geliyay ceymiska jirada, waxaad heleysaa kaarka Kelada.
en: If you are covered by Finnish health insurance, you will receive a Kela card.

so: Sharciga ayaa lagu qeexay maalmooyinka Kelada sababaha lagu bixiyo.
en: The grounds for Kela benefits are defined by law.

so: Kmarka aad codsato manfacyada, Kela ayaa soo baaraysaa in aad manfacyada xaq u leedahay.
en: When you apply for a Kela benefit, Kela checks whether you have a right to receive Kela benefits.

so: Tan waxaa saameyn ku leeyahay degitaanka joogtada ah iyo ka shaqeynta Finland.
en: It may be affected by permanent residence and working in Finland.

so: Marka ay Keladu go'aamineyso kaalmo, codsada kasta waxaa si shaqsi ah looga baaraandegayaa xaaladdiisa nololeed.
en: When deciding on a benefit, Kela reviews the life situation of each applicant individually.

so: Xaaladaha nololeed iyo baahida kaalmo ee codsashadayaashu waa kuwa inta badan kala duduwan.
en: The situations in life and needs for benefit often vary greatly between applicants.

so: Sidaas ayeeyna tirada kaalmooyinka iyo sababahooduba u kala bedelan yihiin.
en: Therefore, the amounts and grounds of the benefits also vary.

so: Xaaldaada si gaar ah u cadee marwalba.
en: Always clarify your own situation separately.

so: Adeegyada caafimaadka dadweynaha iyo adeegyada sooshalka ee Finland waxaa mas'uul ka ah degmooyinka.
en: In Finland, public health services and social services are the responsibility of municipalities.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Adeega caafimaadka ee Finland.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Health services in Finland.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan xuquuqda degmadaada waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Guri-degmo Finland.
en: You can find more information about the right to a municipality of residence on the InfoFinland page Municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Xaqa u lahaanshaha anfacyada Kelada
en: Right to Kela benefits

so: Xeerka ugu horeeya waa in haddii aad Finland si joogto ah u deggan tahay, aad heli karto mafacyada Kelada.
en: As a general rule, if you live permanently in Finland, you can receive Kela benefits.

so: Sharciga ayaa qeexaya waxa loola jeedo joogto u degananaashaha.
en: The law defines what is meant by permanent residence.

so: Sidoo kale ka shaqeynta Finland ayaa xaq kuu siin karta manfacyada Kelada.
en: Working in Finland may also give you a right to Kela benefits.

so: Xaq ma u leedahay manfacyada?
en: Do you have a right to benefits?

so: Arrinta waxaa saameyn ku leh, inaad uga soo guureyso
en: This is affected by whether you are moving to Finland

so: wadan Midowga Yurub (EU) ka tirsan ama wadan ka tirsan Soonaha dhaqaalaha Yurub (ETA) ama Switzerland
en: from a country belonging to the European Union (EU) or the European Economic Area (EEA) or Switzerland;

so: wadan ay Finland wada leeyihiin heshiiska ammaanka bulshada; ama
en: from a country with which Finland has a social security agreement; or

so: Wadamada ETA waa wadamada Midowga Yurub, Norway, Iceland iyo Liechtenstein
en: The EEA countries include the EU countries, along with Norway, Iceland and Liechtenstein.

so: Waxa kale oo intaas dheer oo saameyn ku leh in aad heleyso manfacyada, in aad Finland ugu soo guureyso tusaale ahaan
en: Your right to benefits is also affected by the capacity in which you are moving to Finland, for example:

so: Finland waxay heshiis saameeya ammaanka bulshada la gashay dalal.
en: Finland has made agreements regarding social security with a number of countries.

so: Wadamadaas waxay yihiin wadamada Waqooyiga ama Nordikada Mareykanka, Kanada iyo Quebec, Chile, Israa'iil, Hindiya, Shiinaha, Kuuriyada Koonfureed iyo Austraaliya.
en: They include the Nordic countries, USA, Canada and Quebec, Chile, Israel, India, China, South Korea and Australia.

so: Heshiiyadu waxay saameeyaan ugu dhowaan hawlgabka.
en: The agreements primarily apply to pensions.

so: Heshiisyada qaarkood waxaa kale oo ay saameeyaan daryeelka caafimaadka.
en: Some of them also concern health care.

so: Haddii aad ka timaado dalalkaas midkood Kelada ka hubso in heshiisyadu saameyn ku yeelanayaan ammaankaada bulsho.
en: If you are coming from one of these countries, check with Kela whether or not these agreements affect your social security.

so: Joogto ugu soo guurista Finland iyo joogto u deganaanshaha Finland
en: Moving to Finland permanently and living in Finland permanently

so: Marka aad Finland u soo guurto, Kelada ayaa qiimeyneysa markasta inaad Finland ugu soo guurtay degis joogto ah oo ka duwan sida uu dhigayo sharciga ammaanka bulshada.
en: When you move to Finland, Kela always first assesses whether or not you are moving to live in the country permanently, as defined by the social security legislation.

so: Haddii aan loo arko in u soo guuristaada Finland aysan aheyn mid joogto waxaad xaq u yeelan karaysaa inaad shaqadaada darteed ku hesho xaqa manfacyada Kelada.
en: If Kela considers your move to Finland as not permanent, you may still have a right to Kela benefits based on your work.

so: Waxaa qiimeyn lagu sameyn karaa, in tusaale ahaan waxaad Finland ugu soo guuri kartaa si joogto arrimaha soo socda:
en: You may be considered to be moving to Finland permanently in the following cases, for example:

so: waxaad tahay dib u soo guure, yacni waxaad ka soo laabatay dibadda si aad u degto Finland
en: You are a returnee, i.e. you are returning to Finland from abroad.

so: waxaad heysataa heshiis shaqo oo joogto ah ama wax u dhigma oo aad Finland ku sameyneyso
en: You have a permanent employment contract, or similar agreement, regarding work you will be doing in Finland.

so: waxaad is qabtaan ama si kale xiriir qoys ula leedahay qof kasoo, si joogto ah u deggan Finland
en: You are married to or in an otherwise close family relationship with a person who is already a permanent resident of Finland.

so: Waxaa kale oo inta badan la doonayaa in ogolaanshaha joogitaanka uu shaqeynayo, haddii ay waajib kugu tahay inaad qaadato ogolaanshaha joogitaanka.
en: In addition, if you are obliged to obtain a residence permit, it is usually required that your permit is valid.

so: Qiimeyn guud ayaa xaaladda lagu sameynayaa.
en: An overall assessment of the situation will be prepared.

so: Iyadoo taas lagu saleynayana waxaa la eegayaa in degenaashuhu yahay mid joogto ah iyo in uusan aheyn.
en: Based on this, it will be considered whether or not your residence is permanent.

so: Haddii aad Finland si ku meelgaar ah ugu soo guurtay inta badan xaq uma lihid manfacyada Kelada.
en: If you are moving to Finland temporarily, you are not entitled to Kela benefits.

so: Marka la sameeyo go'aan ah inaad joogto u deggan tahay Finland waxaa laguu aqoonsanayaa qof Finland joogto u deggan ilaa aad:
en: Once the ruling has been made that you are a permanent resident of Finland, you will be regarded as such for as long as:

so: guri rasmi ah ku leedahay halkan; islamarkaasna aad inta badan joogto halkan
en: you have your primary residence and home in the country, and you spend most of your time in Finland

so: aad si rasmi ah ugu joogtid sababo awgood, tusaale ahaan xiriir eheltinimo ama shaqo
en: you have some other reason for your permanent residence in Finland, such as a family tie or work.

so: Haddiise aad shaqo ka bilowdo wadan kale ama aad dibadda lix bilood wax ka badan ku maqnaato, xaqaadi manfactada Keladu waa ay dhammaan karaan.
en: However, if you begin work in another country or go abroad for more than six months, your right to Kela benefits may be terminated.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan xaaladan waxaad ka heleysaa Kelada.
en: More information about these situations is available from Kela.

so: Waxaa kale oo jiro kaalmooyin kale oo aadan heli karin haddii aadan Finland hadda ama horay ugu deganeyn joogto.
en: There are also benefits that you cannot receive if you are not, or have not previously been, a permanent resident of Finland.

so: Tusaale ahaan lacago maalmeedka waalidka ayaa waalidku heli karaan oo kaliya haddii ay deganaayeen Finland 180 maalmood kahor waqtiga loo qabtay dhalista cunugga.
en: For example, parents can only receive parenthood allowance if they have lived in Finland for at least 180 days directly before the child's expected date of delivery.

so: Haddii aad ka timid wadan kale oo Midowga Yurub ka tirsan waxaad xaaladaha qaarkood uga faa'iideysan kartaa inta aad ku jirto xilliga caymiskaada ee kuugu uruuriya wadan kale oo Midowga Yurub ka tirsan.
en: If you are coming from another EU country, however, you can in some cases utilise the insurance periods you have accumulated in the other EU country.

so: Weydii xarunta arrimaha caalamiga ah ee Kelada:
en: Ask for more information at Kela's international situations unit:

so: Shaqeynta waxaad ugu yaraan qeyb ahaan ku geleysaa xeyndaabka ammaanka bulshada
en: Working gives you rights to at least partial Finnish social security

so: Wadamada Miodwga Yurub, wadamada ETA iyo Switzerland
en: EU countries, EEA countries and Switzerland

so: Haddii aad Finland uga soo guureyso shaqo darteed, waxaad inta badan mudada xiriirkaada shaqada heleysaa manfacyada Kelada haddii aad xittaa heysato heshiis shaqo oo wakhti gaaban ah.
en: If you move to Finland for work, you will usually get a right to Kela benefits for the duration of your employment contract even if you have a short contract.

so: Haddii uu mushaarkaadu yahay ugu yaraan 696,60 € bishi, waxaad xaq u yeelanaysaa manfacyada Kelada oo badan.
en: If your wage amounts to at least €696.60 per month, you have a right to most Kela benefits.

so: Wax saameyn ah ma lahan, inta saacadood ee aad todobaadki ka shaqeyso ama xiriirkaada shaqadu inta uu gaarayo.
en: It does not matter how many hours you work per week or how long your employment contract is.

so: Magangelyo codsadayaashu xaq uma laha ceyminta bulshada ee Finland.
en: Asylum seekers are not entitled to social security in Finland.

so: Taasi macnaheedu waa ineysan heleyn kaalmooyinka Kelada.
en: This means that they cannot obtain social security benefits from Kela.

so: Xarumaha kaamka ayaa laga siinayaa lacagta qaabilaada.
en: The reception centre pays asylum seekers a reception allowance.

so: Lacagtaasna waxaa la siinayaa ilaa iyo inta codsigiisa magangelyo laga gaarayo go'aan.
en: The allowance is paid until the asylum application has been processed.

so: Cadadda lacagta qaabilaadu wey yartahay, waxaana loogu talo galey iney ka kaafiso kharashaadka waxyaabaha daruuriga ah.
en: The reception allowance is a small amount of money intended for necessary expenses.

so: Haddii magangelyo codsaduhu helo sharci daganaansha ah si rasmi ahna u degan yahay Finland markaa xaq ayuu u leeyahay ceyminta bulshada Finland.
en: Asylum seekers who are granted a residence permit and who live permanently in Finland are entitled to social security in Finland.

so: Ku cayminta bulshada Finland waa in laga codsadaa Kelada kadib markii sharciga deganaansha la siiye.
en: Persons who have been granted a residence permit can apply for coverage under the Finnish social security system from Kela.

so: Muwaadiniinta Midowga Yurub ee deegaan ku leh Finland waxay codkooda ka dhiiban karaan doorashooyinka baarlamaanka Yurub ee Finland, haddii ay iska diiwaangeliyaan diiwaanka xuquuqda codka (äänioikeusrekisteri).
en: EU citizens with a municipality of residence in Finland can vote in the European Parliament elections if they have been registered into the voting register (äänioikeusrekisteri).

so: Muwaadiniinta Midowga Yurub ee ka diiwaangashay diiwaanka xuquuqda codka waxay sidoo kale isu soo sharrixi karaan doorashooyinka baarlamaanka Yurub ee Finland.
en: EU country citizens included in the Finnish voting register can also stand in the Finnish European Parliament elections.

so: Ka aqri macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan xuquuqda codeynta ee ajaaniibta bogga InfoFinlandi Doorashooyinka Finland.
en: Read more about foreigners' voting rights in Finland on the InfoFinland web page Elections in Finland.

so: Qiyaas ahaan 7- 17 sano inta u dhexeysa waxaa saaran waajib waxbarasho (oppivelvollisuus), waa waajib in uu waxbarashada aasaasiga ah (peruskoulu) soo dhameeyo.
en: The obligation for compulsory education applies to persons between approximately 7 and 17 years of age, i.e. they must complete the comprehensive school curriculum.

so: Ka aqri faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan canshuurista Finland bogga InfoFinlandi Canshuuris.
en: Read more on taxation in Finland on the InfoFinland web page Taxation.

so: Ka aqri macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan xuquuqda iyo waajibaadka muwaadinka Finnishka ah bogga InfoFinlandi Muwaadinka Finland.
en: Read more on the rights and obligations of Finnish citizens on the InfoFinland web page Finnish citizenship.

so: Haddii ay qasab kugu tahay inaad la macaamisho saraakiisha Finnishka islamarkaasna aadan aqoonin Finnish ama Iswidish sidoo kale adiga iyo sarkaalkuna aadan isku luqad wada aqoonin waxaad dhacdooyinka qaarkoodkooda marka lagu jiro xaq u leedahay inaad turjumis.
en: If you need to deal with Finnish authorities and you do not speak Finnish or Swedish and have no other common language with the authority, you are sometimes entitled to interpreting services.

so: Markaas sarkaalka ayaa turjubaanka dalbaya turjumistana bixinaya.
en: In these cases, the authorities will book you an interpreter and pay for the services.

so: Sarkaalku wuxuu qabanqaabin karaa turjumaadda islamarkaasna bixinayaa kharashka turjumista marka arrinta laga hadlayo ay tahay fulinta arrin ay bilowgeedi hore lahaayeen saraakiisha dowladu.
en: Authorities can arrange and pay for interpretation when the processing of the matter in question has been initiated by the said authorities.

so: Mar walba tani ma ahan mid suurtagal ah.
en: However, this is not always possible.

so: Haddii aad turjubaan u baahan tahay sameynta la-qabsashada iyo qiimeynta bilowga dartood waxaa markaas waajibka dalbista turjubaanku wuxuu saaran yahay sarkaalka.
en: If you need an interpreter for the initial assessment and integration plan, it is the responsibility of the authority to book one.

so: Arrimta waxaad horay u sii weydiin kartaa sarkaalka.
en: You can ask about the matter from the authorities in advance.

so: Haddii aad Finland ka codsato magangelyo waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad turjumis u hesho arrimaha la xiriira ka baaraandegga codsiga magangelyada.
en: If you are seeking asylum in Finland, you are entitled to interpretation in matters related to the processing of your asylum application.

so: Markaas waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad macluumaadka quseeya go'aankaada ku hesho luqadaada hooyo ama luqada aad fahmi karto.
en: You are entitled to receive information about decisions concerning you in your native language or a language that you understand.

so: Macluumaadka ku saabsan go'aanka waxaa qofka lagu ogeysiiyay qaab turjumis ah ama qoraal turjuman ah.
en: Information on decisions is provided through interpretation or translation.

so: Haddii aad dalbaneyso turjumaan islamarkaasna aad adigu iska bixineyso waxaad isticmaali kartaa turjubaan markasta oo aad u baahato.
en: If you book and pay for an interpreter yourself, you can use an interpreter whenever you want.

so: Turjubaanku wuxuu goob joog ka yahay kulanka adiga iyo saraakiisha.
en: An interpreter will accompany you to meetings with authorities.

so: Wuxuu turjumayaa hadalka adiga iyo saraakiisha.
en: He or she will interpret the discussion between you and the authority.

so: Turjumidu waxay u dhacdaa in turjumaanku goobta joogo ama uu telefoon ama fiidiyoow ku turjumo.
en: The interpreter will either be present or the interpretation services will be provided via a telephone or video connection.

so: Shaqada turjubaanku waa in uu turjumaa hadalada adiga iyo saraakiisha.
en: The task of the interpreter is to interpret the discussion between you and the authority.

so: Turjumaad wax aan aheyn turjumida kama qabto.
en: The interpreter will not handle any tasks other than interpretation.

so: Sidaas darteed arrimo kale adiga kaama caawin karo.
en: Therefore, he or she cannot assist you in any other matters.

so: Turjubaanku waa dhexdhexaad dhinacaada ama dhinaca saraakiishana ma jiryo.
en: The interpreter is an impartial third party; he or she will not take your or the authority's side.

so: Turjubaanka waxaa saaran waajib ah in uu xafido sirta, dadka kale arrintaada uma sheegi karyo.
en: Interpreters are sworn to secrecy, which means that they cannot disclose information about your affairs to others.

so: Xagee turjumaan laga dalban karaa?
en: Where to book an interpreter?

so: Finland waxaa ka jira sideed xarumo turjubaaneed heer degmo ah, kuwaas oo ay degmooyinku socodsiiyaan.
en: There are eight interpreting centres (tulkkikeskus) in Finland, which are maintained by municipalities.

so: Adeegyada xarunta turjumaanka ee agagaarka Helsinki waxaa ugu horeyn loogu talagalay saraakiisha la shaqeeysa dadka dalka u soo guuray.
en: The services of interpreting centres are primarily intended for authorities that work with immigrants.

so: Waxaad u baahan tahay bangi akawn si aad ku maamushid lacagtaada.Si hadaba taasi kuugu suuro gasho waxaa wanaagsan inaad is barbar dhig ku samaysid bangiyada iyo adeegyada ay bixinayaan, si aad u kala dooran kartid ka dani kuugu jirto iyo ka kale.
en: You need a bank account in order to handle your finances. It's a good idea to compare the services and prices of different banks so that you will find the most advantageous option for you.

so: Markaad furanaysid bangi akawn, waxaad u baahan tahay baasaboor, kaarka aqoonsiga ee ajaanibta ama aqoonsi kale oo rasmi ah.
en: When opening a bank account, you need a passport, identity card for foreign citizens or some other official identity card.

so: Hadii aanad haysanin baasaboorti ama kaarka aqoonsiga ee ajaanibta, waxaa wanaagsan inaad hubiso nooca aqoonsi ee ay aqbali karaan bangiyadu.Mararka qaar bangiyadu waxay aqbalaan baasaboorka ajaanibka ee ay bixisay dawlada Finland, waraaqadaha safarka ee qaxootiga, ama aqoonsi kale oo safar kuu suuro galin karta.
en: If you do not have a passport or identity card for foreign citizens, it is a good idea to check what kind of proof of identity the bank accepts. Some banks accept an alien's passport granted by a Finnish authority, a refugee travel document or other proof of identity which can be accepted as travel document.

so: Xaalada qaarkood bangigu wuxuu kaaga baahan karaa cadaymo kale, hadii baasaboorkaaga ama aqoonsigaaga uu ku qoran yahay, in aan lagu cadayn karin qofkaa tahay.
en: In some cases, the bank may also require other proof of identity if your document states that your identity could not be verified.

so: Liisanka baabuurku kuuma noqon karo cadayn aqoonsi.
en: You cannot prove your identity with a driving licence.

so: Markaad furanaysid akawn bangi, sida sharciga ah bangigu wuxuu ku waydiinayaa inaad cadayso arimahani, maxaad rabtaa inaad u isticmaasho akawnkaaga.
en: According to law, when you open a bank account, the bank must ask you to clarify for what purpose you intend to use your bank account.

so: Bangigu sidoo kale wuxuu hubin karaa taariikhdaada amaaheed.
en: The bank also has the right to check your credit history.

so: Bangigu wuxuu kaaga baahan yahay arimahani soo socda:
en: The bank needs the following information from you:

so: cinwaankaaga ama adareeskaaga Finland ama wadan kale
en: address in Finland or abroad

so: Hadii aad cashuur ka bixisid meel aan ahayn Finland, cinwaanka wadankaasi kale
en: if you pay taxes to a country other than Finland, your address in that other country

so: Macluumaadka dadka xaqa u leh inay isticmaalaan akawnkaasi.
en: the same information on persons entitled to use the bank account.

so: Markaad furanaysid akawn, waxaa dan kuu ah inaad dalbatid sidoo kale lambarka lagu galo internetka ee bangiga.
en: It is a good idea to also acquire online banking credentials when opening a bank account.

so: Furitaanka laguu furayo lambarka internetka waxaad ku dhamaysan kartaa arimaha kale ee xafiisyada.Sikastaba ahaatee helida lumbarkani waxay maraysaa xeer adag si la mida akawnka oo kale.
en: With online banking credentials you can, for example, attend to many official matters online. However, the requirements for obtaining online banking credentials are stricter than those for opening a bank account.

so: Xaaladaha qaar ma heli kartid lambarka bangiga ee internerka, xataa adiga oo le akawn.
en: Thus, in some cases, you cannot get online banking credentials even if you have a bank account.

so: Hadii rabto talo ku sahabsan arimaha banigaga, waxaad wici kartaa caymiska-iyo la talin maalgalinta (Fine).
en: If you want to ask for advice on banking matters, you can call the Finnish Financial Ombudsman Bureau (FINE).

so: Adeegu waa u lacag la'aan macaamiisha, kaliya waxaad bixinaysaa qiimaha telefanka aad wacayso.
en: The service is free of charge, in other words, you only pay the price of the phone call.

so: Haddii lagu aqoonsado islamarkaasna si la aamini karo loo xaqiijiyay aqoonsigaada, boolisku waxey kuu ogolaan karaan aqoonsiga ajnabiga.
en: The police can issue you with a foreigner's identity card if you have been identified and your identity has been reliably verified.

so: Aqoonsigaada waxaa laga xaqiijin karaa dukumenti tilmaamaya aqoonsigaada qof ahaaneed.
en: Your identity can be verified from a document that proves your identity.

so: Haddii aadan heysan dukumenti noocaas ah, waxaa la isbarbar-dhigi karaa farahaada iyo faraha lagu keydiyay kaarka sharciga degitaanka ama kaarka joogitaanka.
en: If you do not have such a document, your fingerprints can be compared to the fingerprints stored on your residence permit card or residence card.

so: Waxaa kale oo lagaaga baahan yahay in aad:
en: Other requirements that must be met:

so: heysato sharciga degitaanka ama kaarka degitaanka oo shaqeynaya ama xuquuqdaada joogitaankaada oo la diiwaangeliyay;
en: you have a valid residence permit or residence card, or your right to reside has been registered;

so: deegaan degmo ku leedahay Finland; iyo
en: you have a municipality of residence in Finland;

so: in macluumaadkaaga lagu keydiyay nidaamka macluumaadka dadka.
en: your information has been saved in the Finnish Population Information System.

so: Kaarka aqoonsiga ee ajnabiga waxaad ku caddeyn kartaa marka aad joogto Finland aqoonsigaada.
en: You can use a foreigner's identity card to prove your identity in Finland.

so: Waxaad isticmaali kartaa isaga, tusaale ahaan marka aad Finland ka furaneyso xisaabaad ama akoon bangi.
en: You can use it for example when opening a bank account in Finland.

so: Si kastoo ay ahaataba uma isticmaali kartid kaarka sidi dukumenti safar oo kale marka aad u safreyso dibadda.
en: However, you cannot use it as a travel document when travelling abroad.

so: Degaanka dartiis waxaa dan kuu ah inaad qaadato caymiska guriga.
en: It is recommendable to take out home insurance.

so: Caymiska gurigu wuxuu kaa ka bayaa tusaale ahaan shilalka guriga ka dhaca, sida alaabta guriga la dhigto oo jabta iyo alaabahaaga kaleba.
en: Home insurance covers, for example, damage to your furniture and other articles.

so: Caymiska guriga waxaa iibiya shirkada caymiska.
en: Home insurance policies are sold by insurance companies.

so: Hadii aad isticmaasho baabuur aad leedahay, wuxuu sharcigu waajib kaaga dhigayaa inaad qaadato caymiska gaadiidka.
en: According to law, you must take out motor insurance if you use your own car.

so: Hadii aad rabtid inaad ka qaadato caymiska shakhsiga ah shirkadaha finishka ah, caadi ahaan waxay kaaga baahan yihiin kaadhka-keelada.
en: If you want to take out a motor insurance policy from a Finnish insurance company, you normally need a Finnish personal health insurance card, the Kela card.

so: Tusaale ahaan caymiska shakhsigu waa caymiska shilka qofka soo gaadhsiiya dhaawac, caymiska kharashaadka daryeelka iyo caymiska nolosha.
en: Insurance of the person include, for example, accident insurance, medical expenses insurance and life insurance.

so: Markaad ka iibsatid Finland khadka felefoonka, waxaad helaysaa namber finish ah.
en: When you buy a telephone subscription in Finland, you get a Finnish phone number.

so: Khadka telefoonka waxaa bixiya shirkado badan.
en: Many companies sell telephone subscriptions.

so: Markaad furanaysid khadka telefoonka, waxaad u baahan tahay, nambarka shakhsiga ee Finland, iyo waa inaad cinwaan ku leedahay Finland.
en: When you take out a telephone subscription, you must have a Finnish personal identity code and an address in Finland.

so: Waxaa waajib kugu ah inaad soo bandhigto macluumaadkaaga biil bixinta, inaad bixisay biilkaagii, sidoo kale inaanad lahayn calaamada aamindarada.
en: Normally, you must also provide information on your payment behaviour, in other words, that you have paid your bills and that you don't have a payment default entry recorded in your credit history.

so: Wayna ahayn waxaa waajib kugu ah si aad khadka u furato inaad bixiso deebaaji ama lacag horumarin ah.
en: Otherwise, you need to make an advance payment for the subscription.

so: Sidoo kale waxaad iibsan kartaa khadka ku shubashada.
en: You can also buy a pre-paid subscription.

so: Markaa kaagama baahna numberka aqoonsiga shakhsiga ee finland iyo inaad cinwaan ku leedahay Finland toona.
en: In this case, you don't need a Finnish personal identity code or an address in Finland.

so: Khadka ku shubashada waxaad ka iibsan kartaa tusaale ahaan R-kioskiga, Subermaarkidada ama internetka.
en: Pre-paid subscriptions are sold, for example, at R-kiosks, some supermarkets or over the internet.

so: Markaad wacaysid dibada, waxaa dan kuu ah inaad hubiso, nambarkeebaa kuu jaban.
en: When calling abroad by phone, it's wise to check which international dialling codes are the most affordable.

so: Shirkado badan ayaa siiya macaamiishoda nambar jaban.
en: Many companies offer affordable international dialling codes.

so: Finland arimo badan waxaad ku dhamaysan kartaa adeegsiga internetka.
en: In Finland many matters can be dealt with over the internet.

so: Inta badan hay 'adaha dawliga ah iyo shirkaduhuba wadajir ahaan waad ku dhamaysan kartaa arimaha bogaga ayay ku leeyihiin internerka.
en: You can often attend to your matters with authorities or businesses via their websites.

so: Waxaa dan kuu ah inaad hesho xidhiidhka internet sida ugu macquulsan uguna deg-dega badan markaad timaado Finland.
en: It is worthwhile getting an internet connection as soon as possible after moving to Finland.

so: Gurigaaga xidhiidhka internerka waad heli kartaa, markaad heshiis la gashid adeeg bixiyayaasha.
en: You can acquire an internet connection in your home by making a contract with an internet service provider.

so: Qiimaha adeeg bixiyayaasha waa kuu dan inaad is barbar dhigtaa, ka hor intaadan heshiis galin.Finland waxaa ka shaqeeya shirkado badan, kuwaasi oo bixiya adeegyo kala duwan oo xidhiidhka internetka ah.
en: It pays to compare prices before making a contract. There is a large number of companies providing a wide variety of internet connections in Finland.

so: Shirkadahan waxaad ka heleysaa tusaale ahaan mashiinada wax raadintae e shabakadda marka aad ku qorto barta qoraalka ee ”internetliittymä”.
en: You can find such companies, for example, using Internet search engines and typing “internetliittymä” in the search engine's search field.

so: Farqiga qiimayaasha xidhiidhinta internetku wuu badan yahay.
en: Internet connection prices vary a lot.

so: Si lacag la'aan ah internetka sidoo kale waxaad ka isticmaali kartaa meelaha laybareeriyada akhriska.
en: You can also use the internet for free in libraries if you have a library card.

so: Kaadhka-laybareeriga waxaad si lacag la'aan ah uga heli kartaa isla laybareeriga.
en: You can get a library card free of charge from a library.

so: Ka akhri macluumaad dheeri ah bogga InfoFinland safxadiisa laybareeriyada Maktabadaha.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Libraries.

so: Sidoo kale maakhaayadaha qaar macmiilkooda waxaa u suuro gal ah inuu istimaalo internetka.
en: Some cafés also offer customers the possibility to use the internet.

so: Finland heerka sicirku wuu sareeyaa.
en: The general price level in Finland is high.

so: Tusaale ahaan cuntada iyo adeegyada kaleba celcelis ahaan qiimo sare ayaa lagu iibiyaa marka la barbar dhigo wadamada kale ee yurub.
en: For example, food and many services are more expensive than the European average.

so: Sicirka guryuhu way kala duwan yihiin in badan.
en: The cost of housing varies a lot.

so: Magaalooyinka waawayn way ka qaalisan yihiin in badan tuulooyinka yaryar.
en: Housing in major cities is much more expensive than in small municipalities.

so: Wax iibsiga iyo xuquuqda quutaha
en: Buying and consumer rights

so: Sharciga quutuhu wuxuu ilaaliyaa xuquuqda quutaha ee Finland.
en: The Consumer Protection Act protects the rights of consumers in Finland.

so: Hadii aad iibsato alaab, kuwaasi oo ay wax ka si yihiin ama ay xun yihiin oo aanad ogayn waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad hesho lacagtaadii ama laguu badelo alaabta.
en: You are entitled to compensation, for example, when an item you have purchased has faults that you have not caused yourself. You can receive a flawless item as a replacement or your money back, for example.

so: Gadiidka dadwaynuhu si wanaagsan bay u shaqeeyaan Finland.
en: Public transportation in Finland works well.

so: Tareenka iyo basaskaba waad ugu wada safri kartaa ku dhawaad dhamaan wadanka gudihiisa.
en: You can travel almost everywhere in Finland by bus or by train.

so: Magaalooyin badan waxaad ku tagi kartaa diyaarad.
en: You can also fly to many cities.

so: Magaalooyinka waawayn iyo kuwa u dhawiba si wanaagsan bay uga shaqeeyaan gaadiidka maxaliga ahi.
en: In larger cities and areas surrounding them, local public transport is also very efficient.

so: Gaadiidka maxaliga ahi waa basas caadi ah.
en: Local public transport is usually organised by buses.

so: Ka akhri macluumaad dheeri ah bogga InfoFinland Gaadiidka Finland Gaadiidka gudaha Finland.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Traffic in Finland.

so: Hadii aad ku haysatay liisanka baabuur wadida wadan kale, xaalada ay ku xidhan tahay, sida kuu danta ah ee uu kuugu shaqayn lahaa.
en: If you have a driving licence issued in some other country, the best way to act depends on the situation.

so: Ka akhri macluumad dheeri ah bogga InfoFinland Cimilada Cimilada Finland.
en: Read more about the climate in Finland on the InfoFinland page Finnish climate.

so: Finland ku dhawaad 200 jaraa'id baa kasoo baxa.Finland waxaa laga daawadaa afar telefeshan oo dawli ah iyo qaarkaloo badan oo ganacsi ah.
en: Nearly 200 newspapers are published in Finland. Four public television channels and many commercial television channels operate in Finland.

so: Ka akhri macluumaad dheeri ah bogga InfoFinland saxaafada Finland Saxaafadda gudaha Finland.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Media in Finland.

so: Macluumaad ku sahabsan dhaqanka dadka finishka waxaad ka helaysaa bogga InfoFinland dhaqanka dadka finishka ah Hab-dhaqanka finnishka iyo dhaqanka dadka finishka ee shaqada Dhaqanka Finnishka.
en: Information on the Finnish culture is available on the InfoFinland pages Finnish customs and Finnish working culture.

so: La qabsashada (kotoutuminen) macnaheedu waa inaad nagaato kana barato aqoon iyo xirfad, taasood ugu baahanaan doontid ku dhex noolaanshaha bulshadda finnishka.
en: Integration (kotoutuminen) means that you settle in Finland and acquire knowledge and skills that you need in Finnish society.

so: Inaad hesho shaqo ama waxbarasho,
en: finding a job or student position

so: Waxaad helaysaa xiriiro aad la yeelato bulshadda finnishka
en: forming contacts within Finnish society.

so: Finland waxaa ka jira adeegyo kala duwan, kuwaasoo kaa caawinaya la qabsashadda wadanka, shaqaaloobista iyo barashada luqada.
en: In Finland, you can obtain services that facilitate integration, employment and learning the language.

so: Waxaa macquul ah in ay xaq u leeyihiin xubnaha qoyskaaga adeegyadaas, haddii aad wada timaadeen mar Finland.
en: If your family members move to Finland with you, they may also be entitled to these services.

so: Waa muhiim in aad adigu naf ahaantaada si firfircooni leh u horumarisaa laqabsashadaada.
en: It is important that you also actively promote your own integration.

so: Adeegyada, kuwaasoo kaa caawinaya la qabsashada wadanka
en: Services that facilitate integration

so: Dhammaan dadka u soo guura Finland ayaa xaq u leh in ay helaan warbiximaha aasaasiga ah.
en: All immigrants are entitled to receive basic information about Finland.

so: Marka aad hesho sharciga ama laguu diwaan galsho inaad joogitaan xaq u leedahay, waxaad isla markaas helaysaa qoraal warbixineed
en: Upon receiving a residence permit or registering your right to reside in the country, you are provided with written information concerning

so: nolasha bulshadda finnishka iyo shaqada,
en: Finnish society and working life,

so: adeegyada, kugu caawinaya la qabsashada.
en: services that can assist your integration.

so: Iyagaa kaa caawin doona la qabshadda Finland.
en: They can help you to integrate into Finnish society.

so: Talosiiiyaha ayaad ka helaysaa warbixin dheeri ah tusaale
en: These advisors can provide information on the following, for example:

so: la qabsashadda iyo adeegyada, kuwa kaa taageeraya la qabsashada
en: integration and related services

so: Qeymeynta hore waxaa lagu qeymeeyaa, adeegyadda kaa caawin kara la qabsahsda wadanka.
en: The purpose of the initial assessment is to assess the services you need to support your integration.

so: Qeymenta hore waxaa lagu ogaadaa tusaale waxaad soo baratay, waxaad ka soo shaqaysay, iyo aqoontaada luuqadeed.
en: The initial assessment collects information on your education, work experience and language skills, for example.

so: Waxaa qeymenta hore lagu sameeya xaafiiska shaqadda iyo shaqaaleynta ama degmada.
en: The initial assessment is conducted at an Employment and Economic Development Office (työ- ja elinkeinotoimisto) or in your municipality.

so: Waana lagu qaban karaa meelo kale, sida iskoollada.
en: The assessment can also be conducted in another location, such as an educational institute.

so: Taas waxay ku xiran tahay hadba degmada aad degan tahay.
en: This depends on how the initial assessment has been organised in your municipality of residence.

so: Waxaad ka codsan kartaa xaafiiska shaqadda iyo shaqaaleynta ama xaafiiska arrimaha bulshadda ee degmada, in laguu sameeyo qeymeynta hore.
en: You can request the initial assessment from the Employment and Economic Development Office or your local Social Office, for example.

so: Waxaad ka heli kartaa faahfaahin dheeraad ah talosiiyaasha ajaaniibta, sidii laguugu qabanqaabin lahaa degmadaada.
en: Immigrant advisors can provide more information on the initial assessment and how it is organised in your municipality of residence.

so: Hadii aad u baahantahay taageero la qabsashada, qeymeynta hore ka dib ayaa laguu sameynayaa qorshaha la qabsashada.
en: If you require support for integration, an integration plan will be prepared for you after the initial assessment.

so: Markaas ayaa laguu sameynayaa qorsheynta la qabsashada, haddii
en: The integration plan is always prepared if you

so: aad tahay shaqo la'aan shaqo doon ah'ama
en: are an unemployed job seeker, or

so: ama qaato kaalmada shaqo la'aanta ama
en: you receive income support, or

so: aad ka yartahay 18 jir Finland uusan kuu joogin waalid.
en: you are under 18 years old and do not have a guardian in Finland.

so: Qorsheynta la qabsashada waxaa lagu qorayaa arrimaha kaa caawinaya laqabshada.
en: An integration plan is a plan detailing measures that will aid your integration.

so: Qorshaha waxaa ka mid ahaan kara, tusaale, barashadda luuqada, ama waxbarasho kale ama tababar shaqo.
en: The integration plan can include Finnish language studies, other education or practical training, for example.

so: Waxaa kula sameyn kara qorshaha la qabsashada talobixiyaha xaafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada, yacni Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada (TE-toimisto) ama shaqaalaha arrimaha bulshadda xaafiiskoodda.
en: You can prepare the plan together with a job counsellor at an Employment and Economic Development Office or TE office (TE toimisto) or with a social worker at a Social Office.

so: Qorsheynta la qabsashada waxaa u sida caadiga ah socdaa muddo ugu badnaan saddex sano ah.
en: Normally, the maximum duration for an integration plan is three years.

so: Xaaladaha aan caadiga ahyn wuxuu socon karaa shan sano.
en: In some special cases, the plan can be extended to five years.

so: Marka laguu sameeyo qorshaha laqabsashada, waa muhiim in aad u hoggaansantaa.
en: Once your integration plan has been prepared, it is important that you adhere to it.

so: Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada ama degmada ayaa haddii loo baahdo kugu hagaya waxbarashada laqabsashada.
en: Your TE office or municipality will guide you to integration training, if necessary.

so: Waxbarashada waxaa qeyb ka ah barashada afka finnishka ama iswidhishka iyo barashada bulshada Finnishka, dhaqanka iyo nolosha shaqada.
en: The training usually includes Finnish or Swedish language studies as well as an introduction to Finnish society, culture and working life.

so: Waxaa intaas dheer oo ku jiri kara waxbarashooyin kale ama tababaro shaqo.
en: In addition, the training may include other education or practical training.

so: Xafiiska shaqada iyo xoogsashada, Kela ama degmada ayaa soo caddeynaya xaqa aad u leedahay in aad hesho mudada qorshaha laqabsashada manfacyada shaqo la'aanta ama lacagta kaalmada nolosha.
en: The TE office, Kela or municipality will determine your right to receive unemployment benefit or income support for the time of your integration plan.

so: Haddii aad shaqo haysato, waxaa marmarka qaar macquul ah in in uu kugu caawiyo shaqo siiyahaagu la qabsashada.
en: If you have a job, your employer can sometimes help you in the integration process.

so: Shaqo bixiyuhu wuxuu bixin karaa tusaale qarashka koorsada luuqada.
en: For example, the employer can pay for your Finnish language course, for example.

so: Shaqo bixiyuhu wuxuu kale oo kaa caawin karaa, waxaayaalaha u baahan wax qabashada, tusaale in uu kula raadiyo guri.
en: Employers can also sometimes help you to take care of various practical things, such as obtaining housing.

so: Warbixin dheeraad ah weydii shaqo bixiyahaaga.
en: For more information, ask your employer.

so: waxaana lagugu barayaa sidoo kale, bulshadda finishka, dhaqanka, shaqa.
en: The integration training usually includes Finnish or Swedish studies as well as introductions to Finnish society, culture and working life.

so: Barashadda luuqadaha finnishka iyo iswiidishka
en: Finnish and Swedish studies

so: Boga InfoFinlandi Luqada Finnishka iyo Iswidishka ayaad uga heli kartaa warbixin ku saabsan barashadda luuqadahaha finnishka iyo iswiidishka
en: The InfoFinland page Finnish and Swedish contains information on the possibilities for studying Finnish or Swedish.

so: Dhaqanka usoo guurayaasha Finland
en: An immigrant's native culture in Finland

so: Finland waxaad ku dhowran kartaa dhaqankaaga, luuqadaada iyo diinta ee muhiimka kuu ah.
en: Even though you move to Finland and are integrated into the society, your own culture, language and religion can still remain an important part of your life.

so: Jaaliyado soo guurayaasha ayaa waxay kaa caawin karaan sidii aad ku xafidan lahayd ama u hormarin lahayd dhaqankaaga.
en: An immigrant association can help you to maintain and develop you native culture.

so: Finlaand waxaa ka shaq gala Jaaliyado baddan.
en: There are many immigrant associations operating in Finland.

so: Faahfaahin dheeriya jaaliyadaha waxaad ka heleysaa boga InfoFinlandi Ururada.
en: More information on the associations is available on the InfoFinland page Associations.

so: Carruuraha isoo guurayaasha wadanka waxay heli karaan barashada afkooda hooyo.
en: Children from immigrant backgrounds have the opportunity to study their own language.

so: Faahfaahin dheeriya boga InfoFinlandi Waxbarashada aasaasiga ah.
en: More information is available on the InfoFinland page Comprehensive education.

so: Faahfaahin dheeriya cibaadeysiga diinta Finland waxaad ka heleysaa boga InfoFinlandi Dhaqamada iyo diimaha ka jira Finland.
en: More information on practising your own religion is available on the InfoFinland page Cultures and religions in Finland.

so: Barashada luuqadda finnishka ah
en: Studying the Finnish language

so: Guurka iyo wada degenaanshaha
en: Marriage and common-law relationship

so: Adeegga qoysaska leh caruurta
en: Services for families with children

so: Haddii aadan aheyn muwaadin u dhashay wadamada wuqooyi, EU ama muwaadin u dhashay EU oo xubin qoys ah, waxaad u baahan yahay sharciga degenaanshaha.
en: If you are not a citizen of a Nordic country or an EU member state or the family member of an EU citizen living in Finland, you will need a residence permit.

so: Ka aqriso macluumaad dheeri ah bogga InfoFinlandi ee U imaansha reerka Finland.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Moving to Finland as a family member.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin EU ah, uma baahnid sharciga degenaanshaha ee Finland.
en: If you are an EU citizen, you do not need a residence permit for Finland.

so: Haddii aad muddo saddex bilood ka badan joogeysid Finland waxaad u baahan tahay shahaadada diiwaangelinta degenaansho ee midowga yurub (Unionin kansalaisen rekisteröintitodistus).
en: If your stay in Finland exceeds three months, you will need a certificate of registration of the right of residence of a Union citizen (Unionin kansalaisen rekisteröintitodistus).

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin EU ah, laakiin xubin ka tirsan qoyskaadu oo deggan Finland yahay muwaadin u dhashay EU, waxaad u baahan tahay kaarka degenaanshaha ee xubinimada qoyska (perheenjäsenen oleskelukortti).
en: If you are not an EU citizen but your family member residing in Finland is an EU citizen, you will need a residence card for a family member of an EU citizen (perheenjäsenen oleskelukortti).

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin u dhashay wadamada Wuqooyi, uma baahnid sharciga degenaanshaha ee Finnishka.
en: If you are a citizen of a Nordic country, you do not need a residence permit for Finland. Read more on the InfoFinland page Nordic citizens.

so: Ka aqri macluumaad dheeri ah bogga InfoFinlandi ee Muwaadiniinta u dhashay wuqooyiga Yurub.
en: On the InfoFinland page Moving to Finland checklist, you can find useful information on the things you need to do when moving to Finland.

so: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta waxaad ka heli kartaa sumadda aqoonsiga Finnishka, helin, marki lagu siinayay ogolaanshaha deganaansha ama la diiwaangelinayay xuquuqdaada joogitaanka ee muwaadinka Midowga Yurub.
en: You can also receive a Finnish personal identity code from the Local Register Office if you did not receive one when you were granted a residence permit or when your EU citizen's right of residence was registered at the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta waxaa uu sidoo kale eegayaa in deegaan ahaan lagaaga diiwaan gelin karo Finland.
en: The Local Register Office also decides whether a Finnish municipality of residence (kotikunta) can be entered for you.

so: Marka aad haysato meel aad degan tahay, waxaad isticmaali kartaa adeegyada degmada, sida tusaale ahaan adeegyada caafimaadka.
en: When you have a municipality of residence, you can use municipal services, such as health services.

so: Haddii aad haysato sharciga degenaanshaha, xasuusnoow in aad waqti fiican dalbato muddo kordhinta shariga degenaanshaha ka hor inta uusan kaa dhicin sharciga.
en: If you have a residence permit for Finland, remember to apply for a residence permit extension in good time before the expiry of your first residence permit.

so: Ka dalbo muddo kordhinta sharcigaaga adeegga internetka ee Enter Finland ama baeta adeegga ee Xaafiiska dal u soo guurista.
en: Apply for the extension online in the Enter Finland service or at a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Go'aanka ku saabsan ogolaanshaha waa mid lacag ah.
en: A permit decision is subject to a charge.

so: Waa in aad sidoo kale bixisaa lacag marka aad dalbaneyso muddo kordhinta sharciga.
en: The fee must be paid upon applying for a residence permit extension.

so: Macluumaad dheeri ah oo la xiriira dalbashada sharci kordhinta waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi ee Ogolaanshaha sii-socda.
en: Further information on the application process can be found on the InfoFinland page Residence permit extension.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin u dhashay EU, waxaad dalban kartaa xuquuqda degenaanshaha joogtada ah marka aad muddo shan sano ah degan tahay Finland.
en: If you are an EU citizen, you can apply for a right of permanent residence when you have lived in Finland for five years.

so: Macluumaad la xiriira barashada luuqadda finnish-ka ah waxaad ka heli kartaa bogga InfoFinlandi ee Luuqadda finnish-ka iyo iswiidhishka.
en: Information on studying the Finnish language is available on the InfoFinland page Finnish and Swedish.

so: Haddii aad agagaarka Helsinki, agagaarka Tampere ama agagaarka Turku, waxaad shaqsiyan ka raadsan kartaa koorsooyin luuqada Finnish-ka ah oo kugu haboon adeegga Finnishcourses.fi
en: If you live in the Helsinki, Tampere or Turku region, you can search for a Finnish language course that suits you through the Finnishcourses.fi service.

so: Haddii aad haysato sharciga degenaansho oo ku saleysan xiriir qoys, waxaad xaq u leedahay in aad ka shaqeysato waxna ka barato Finland.
en: If you have a residence permit for Finland based on family ties, you have the right to work and study in Finland.

so: Sidoo kale muwaadinijnta iyo xubnaha kale ee qoysaskooda ee wadamada EU iyo Wuqooyiga Yurub waxaa ay xaq u leeyihiin in ay shaqeysan karaan isla markaasina wax baran karaan.
en: In addition, citizens of Nordic countries and EU member states and their family members have the right to work and study in Finland.

so: Ogsoonoow, haddii aad sharciga degenaanshaha ugu horeeya aad ka dalbato Finland, in aadan xaq u yeelaneynin shaqo inta lagaaga ogolaanayo sharciga.
en: Please note that if you have applied for your first residence permit in Finland, you do not have the right to work before the permit is granted.

so: waxaan ka heleysaa macluumaad ka xiriira sida shaqo looga dalbado Finland.
en: you can find information on looking for a job in Finland.

so: Hadii aad xiiseyneysid in aad sameysatid shirkad aad adigu leedahay, eeg bogga InfoFinlandi ee Samaynta shirkad ganacsi.
en: If you are interested in starting your own business, see the InfoFinland page Starting a business.

so: Macluumaad la xiriira waxbarashada Finland waxaa laga helayaa bogga InfoFinlandi ee Waxbarashada.
en: Information on studying in Finland is available on the InfoFinland page Education.

so: Haddii aad rabtid in aad ku guursato Finland, waxaad macluumaad faa'ido leh ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi ee Guurka.
en: If you are getting married in Finland, you can find useful information on the InfoFinland page Marriage.

so: Macluumaad la xiriira wada degenaanshaha Finland waxaa laga heli karaa bogga InfoFinlandi ee Wada degenaanshaha.
en: Information on living in a common-law relationship is available on the InfoFinland page Common-law relationship.

so: Macluumaad la xiriira furiinka waxaa laga heli karaa bogga InfoFinlandi Furiinka.
en: Information on divorce is available on the InfoFinland page Divorce.

so: Ogsoonoow, haddii aad leedahay sharciga degenaanshaha ee ku saleysan xiriir qoys, isbadalka ku imaanaya xiriir qoys, sida tusaale ahaan furiinka, waxay saameyn ku yeelan karaan sharcigaaga degenaansho.
en: Please note that if you have a residence permit for Finland based on family ties, any changes in your family relations, such as divorce, may affect your residence permit.

so: Ka aqri macuumaad dheeri ah bogga InfoFinlandi ee Miyaan weyn karaa ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka?
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Can I lose my residence permit?

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi ee Dhibaatooyinka isqabida iyo xiriirka lammaanaha waxaad ka heli kartaa macluumaad la xiriira halka laga heli karo caawimaad la xiriirta xagga dhibaatooyinka xiriirka.
en: On the InfoFinland page Problems in marriage and relationships, you can find information on where to find help with relationship problems.

so: Manfacyada Keladu bixiso intooda badan waa kuwa aad xaq u yeelan karto, haddii aad Finland si rasmi ah ugu soo guurto.
en: The majority of Kela benefits require you to move to Finland permanently to be entitled to them.

so: Macluumaad dheeri ah oo la xiriira adeegga bulshada ee Finland waxaad ka heli kartaa bogga InfoFinlandi ee Ammaanka bulsho ee Finland.
en: Further information on Finnish social security is available on the InfoFinland page Finnish social security.

so: Macluumaad la xiriira kaalmada bulsho iyo adeegyada kala duwan ee qoysaska leh caruurta waxaad ka heli kartaa bogga InfoFinlandi ee Kaalmada dhaqaale ee qoysaska iyo Daryeelka caruurta.
en: Information on public benefits and services for families with children is available on the InfoFinland page Financial support for families and Taking care of a child.

so: Finland waxaa ka jira adeegyada caafimaadka ee dadweynaha iyo gaarka loo leeyahay.
en: Both public and private health services are available in Finland.

so: Adeegyada caafimaadka ee dadweynaha waxay ka jaban yihiin kuwa gaarka loo leeyahay.
en: Public health services are less expensive than private ones.

so: Haddii aad deegaan ku leedahay Finland, waxaad isticmaali kartaa adeegyada caafimaad ee dadweynaha.
en: If you have a municipality of residence in Finland, you can use public health services.

so: Haddii aad ugu soo guurto Finland sababo la xiriira xagga qoyska, waxaad caadi ahaan deegaan ka heleysaa Finland.
en: If you move to Finland for family reasons, you are normally granted a municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Go'aanka diiwaangelinta deegaanka waxaa sameynaya xafiiska diiwaangelinta.
en: The decision on your official municipality of residence is made by your Local Register Office.

so: Ka aqriso macluumaad dheeri ah bogga InfoFinlandi ee Adeega caafimaadka ee Finland iyo Guri degmo ee gudaha Finland.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Health services in Finland and Municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Xaqa joogista ee magangelyo doonka
en: An asylum seeker's right of residence

so: Magangelyo-doonku waa qof ka codsanaya dowlad shisheeye badbaado iyo xuquuq joogitaan.
en: An asylum seeker is a person who seeks protection and right of residence in a different country.

so: Badbaadinta caalamiga ah waxaa la heli, haddii la hayo sababo caddeynaya in qofku loo raadsanayo (asalkiisa, diintiisa, jinsiyadiisa, ka mid ahaanshihiis koox bulshada ka tirsan oo la yaqaan ama aragtdiisa siyaasadeed darteed) ama uu dalkiisi ama dalka uu sida joogtada ah u degan yahay ku geli karo halis muuqata.
en: International protection can be given to a person who has a justified reason to fear persecution (due to origin, religion, nationality, membership in a specific group or political opinion) or who would otherwise be in real danger in their home country or country of permanent residence.

so: Magangelyo-doonku ma ahan qaxooti.
en: This means that an asylum seeker is not a refugee.

so: Haddii magangelyo doonaha la siiyo darajada qaxootiga ama ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka u baahnaansho badbaado darteed ama sababo kale, wuxuu joogi karaa Finland.
en: If an asylum seeker is granted refugee status or a residence permit based on protection or on other grounds, they can stay in Finland.

so: Waad joogi kartaa Finland haddii lagu siiyo magangelyo ama ogolaanshiyaha joogista ee sababo kale lagúugu siiyay.
en: You can stay in Finland if you are granted asylum or a residence permit on other grounds.

so: Haddii daruufaha dalkaadu ay yihiin kuwa aadan magangelyo caalami ah uga baahneyn islamarkaasna aan sababo kale oo laguugu siiyo ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka laheyn, codsigaada waa la diidayaa adigana waxaa lagaa celinayaa Finland.
en: If the conditions in your home country are such that you do not need asylum and there are no other grounds for granting a residence permit, your application will be rejected, and you will be expelled from Finland.

so: Haddii go'aan diidma ah lagaa siiyay codsigaadi magangelyo doon ama codsigaada ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka, waxaad fursad u heysataa inaad racfaan ka qaadato go'aanka.
en: If your asylum application or residence permit application is rejected, you can appeal the decision.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Magangelyo doonimo ku imaanshaha Finland.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Asylum in Finland.

so: Dadka magangelyo doonka ah xaq uma lahan isu keenista qoyska.
en: Asylum seekers are not entitled to family reunification arrangements.

so: Xubnaha qoyskaadu ma helin karaan ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka Finland sababo xiriir qoys ah dartood.
en: Your family members cannot receive a residence permit for Finland based on a family tie.

so: Haddii aad hesho ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka Finland, xubnaha qoyskaadu waxay codsan karaan ogolaanshiyaha sababo xiriir qoyska ah dartood.
en: If you receive a residence permit for Finland, your family members can apply for a permit on the basis of a family tie.

so: Dadka magangaliyo doonka ah caadiyen si toos ah uma isticmaali karaan adeegyada caafimaadka ee caamka ah, sida xarumaha caafimaadka.
en: Asylum seekers cannot normally use public health services, such as health centres, directly.

so: Xarumada qaabilaadda qaxootiga ama kaamaka ayaa ku shaqo leh in ay u qabanqaabiyaan dadka magangaliyo doonka ah adeegyadadooda caafimaadka.
en: Instead, the reception centre arranges health services for them.

so: Kalkaalisada kaamka ayaa ku hagaysa qofka magangaliyo doonka ah daryeelka caafimaadka ee uu u baahanyahay.
en: The reception centre's public health nurse refers the asylum seeker to medical care.

so: Warbixin dheeri ah haddii ad u baahantahay waydii shaqaalaha jooga kaamkaaga.
en: More information is available at your reception centre.

so: Haddii ad ka hesho sharci iyo degmo ad dagto Finland, waxad isticmaali kartaa adeegga caafimaadka ee ay isticmaalaan dadka kale ee dagmada ku nool.
en: If you are granted a residence permit and have a municipality of residence in Finland, you are entitled to use the public health services of your municipality, similarly to all citizens of your municipality.

so: Haddii aad dibadda u guurto si aad u degto ama aad waqti ka dheer fasax gaaban ka maqnaaneyso Finland waa inaad u sheegtaa sidoo kale Kelada (Kela).
en: When you move abroad or leave Finland for a period longer than a short holiday, you must also notify the Social Insurance Institution of Finland (Kela).

so: Haddii aad ku jirto xeyndaabka ammaanka bulsho ee Finland dibadana aad aado ugu badnaan sanad, xuquuqdaada amaanka bulsho ee Finland waa sii sugnaaneysaa mudada aad xitaa dibadda joogto.
en: If you are covered by Finnish social security and leave the country for no longer than a year, you will usually retain your entitlement to Finnish social security during your stay abroad.

so: Haddii aad shaqo u aado dal Midowga Yurub ama ETA ah, ammaanka bulsho wuxuu u wareegayaa dalkaas haddii xitaa mudada shaqadu ay ka yar tahay sanad.
en: If you relocate to an EU or EEA country for work, you will be covered by the social security system in the country where you work even if your stay is shorter than one year.

so: Markaas kuma jiri kartid xeyndaabka ammaanka bulsho ee Finland.
en: If this is the case, you are no longer eligible for Finnish social security.

so: Haddii aad dibadda u guurto sanad ka badan, guuritaanka waxaa loo arkayaa mid joogto ah, Markaas xaqaada ammaanka bulsho wuxuu dhamaanayaa marka aad Finland ka guurto.
en: If you move abroad for a period exceeding a year, your move is considered permanent. This ends your entitlement to Finnish social security upon your moving away from Finland.

so: Xaaladaha qaarkood waxaad heysan kartaa xuquuqdaada ammaanka ee bulsho haddii aad xitaa sanad ka badan dibadda joogto.
en: However, in some cases you can maintain your right to Finnish social security even if you stay abroad for more than a year.

so: Fursadahan waxay quseeyaan tusaale ahaan ardayda.
en: This option is available to students, for example.

so: Waxaa kale ay quseeyaan shaqaalaha uu shaqo siiye Finnish ahi dibadda shaqo ugu diray.
en: It also applies to workers who a Finnish employer has assigned abroad.

so: Waxaa la isaga baahan yahay inaad codsiga arrintaas quseeya aad keentay sanad gudihiis marka aad dibadda aadeyso.
en: The requirement is that you have submitted an application regarding the matter within a year of going abroad.

so: Haddii aad ugu guurto wadan Midowga Yurub ama ETA ah Switzerland sidii shaqaale la diray oo kale, (lähetetty työntekijä), shaqo bixiyahaada ayaa shahaadada E101/A1 kaaga codsanaya Xarunta ammaanka hawlgabka.
en: If you move to an EU or EEA country or Switzerland as a seconded employee (lähetetty työntekijä), your employer must apply for the E101/A1 certificate for you from the Finnish Centre for Pensions.

so: Waa in la codsadaa kahor inta aadan dibadda aadin.
en: It must be applied for before you leave the country.

so: Shahaadada waxaad ku cadeyn kartaa inaad ku jirto xeyndaabka ammaanka bulshada Finland inkastoo aad dibadda ka shaqeyneyso.
en: This certificate enables you to indicate that you are covered by Finnish social security even though you are working abroad.

so: Marka aad dibadda joogto, ammaanka bulsho wuxuu saameyn karaa tusaale ahaan waxbarashada iyo bilaabista shaqo.
en: When abroad, your social security can be affected by beginning studies or employment, for example.

so: Mar walba Kelada soo ogeysii isbedelka xaaladaha.
en: Always notify Kela of any changes in your circumstances.

so: Baafinta ehelka la waayay
en: Tracing a lost relative

so: Qaxooti waa qofka hesyta derajada qaxootiga.
en: A refugee is a person with refugee status.

so: Derajada qaxootiga waxaa hela, dadka laga siiyo Finland magangelyo ama kuwa Finland ay u soo qaadato sidii qaxooti qawiman.
en: This status is granted to those who gain asylum in Finland or are accepted into the country in the refugee quota.

so: Qaxootinimada qawiman (kiintiöpakolainen) lama codsan karo iyadoo la soo maraya ha'adaha Finnishka.
en: You cannot apply to become a quota refugee (kiintiöpakolainen) through Finnish officials.

so: Sidoo kale suurtagal ma ahan in qofka talo ahaan laga soo jeediyo in uu noqdo qaxooti qawiman, tusaale ahaan qof qaraabo ama saaxiib ah.
en: Nor is it possible to suggest another person, such as a friend or a relative, as a quota refugee.

so: Finland waxay qaxooti qawiman u qaadataa dadka ay Hay'adda Qaxootiga Quruumaha Midoobay ay u aqoonsatay qaxooti UNHCR.
en: Finland accepts as quota refugees persons who are considered refugees by the UN Refugee Agency UNHCR.

so: Qaxootiyada qawiman waxaa laga xushaa kooxda dadka ah ay UNHCR Finland u soo bandhigtay.
en: Quota refugees are selected from among the persons proposed to Finland by the UNHCR.

so: Saraakiisha Finnishka ayaa qaxootiga UNHCR ay soo bandhigtay wareysta waxayna ka doortaan dadka ay Finland qaadaneyso iyagoo wareysiga laga qaaday ku saleynaya.
en: Finnish authorities interview the refugees proposed by the UNHCR and, on the basis of these interviews, select the persons who will be admitted to Finland.

so: Wareysiyada waxaa lagu qabtaa inta badan wadamada ay joogaan qaxootiyadu ama goobaha UNHCR.
en: The interviews are performed in the refugees' countries of residence, usually in refugee camps or the UNHCR's premises.

so: Xulashada qaxootiga qawiman waxaa saameyn ku leh tusaale ahaan arrimaha soo socda:
en: For example, the following issues influence the selection of quota refugees:

so: qaxootiga wuxuu u baahan yahay badbaado caalami ah
en: a refugee requires international protection

so: xuquuqda qaxootigu kuma hirgeleyso wadanka uu joogo
en: a refugee's human rights are not realised in the country where they are residing

so: qaxootigu halis kuma ahan ammaanka Finland
en: a refugee is not a threat to Finland's security

so: qaxootiga oo leh waxyaabo uu kula qabsan karo Finland
en: a refugee has the requirements to become integrated into Finnish society.

so: Qaxootiyada qaarkood xulashadooda waxaa lagu sababeeyaa dokumentiyada UNHCR wareysi la'aan.
en: Some of the refugees are selected without an interview on the basis of UNHCR's documents.

so: Kuwan sida caadiga ah waa kuwa ku jira xaaladda degdegga ah, qaxootiga sida degdegga ah ugu baahan magangelyo tusaale sababo caafimaad ama siyaasadeed dartood.
en: They are usually urgent cases, i.e. refugees who need asylum urgently, for example, for political or health-related reasons.

so: Baarlaamka Finland ayaa go'aaminaya tirada qaxootiga ee dalku soo qaadanayo.
