en: The Parliament of Finland decides how many refugees are accepted into the country.

so: Laga soo bilaabo sanadkii 2001dii qaxootiga qawiman ee Finland wuxuu ahaa 750 qofood sanadkiiba.
en: From 2001, Finland's refugee quota has been 750 persons per year.

so: Wasaaradda arrimaha gudaha ayaa go'aamineysa wadamada laga soo qaadanayo qaxootiyada qawiman.
en: The Ministry of the Interior decides on the countries from which quota refugees are accepted.

so: Siinta darajada qaxootiga dadka magangelyo doonka ah
en: Granting refugee status to asylum seekers

so: Darajada qaxootiga waa la heli karaa haddii xitaa magangelyo la weydiisto Finland.
en: You can also receive refugee status if you apply for asylum in Finland.

so: Magangelyo doonka waxaa la siin karaa darajada qaxootiga haddii uu sabab u heysto ka cabsashada in dalkiisa lagu raadceysanayo ama raadjoogo asalkiisa, diintiisa, jinsiyaddiisa, ka mid ahaanshaha koox bulshadeed cayiman ama aragtidiisa siyaasadeed darteed islamarkaasna uusan ku laaban karin dalkiisi arrimahaas dartood.
en: An asylum seeker can be granted refugee status if they have a well-founded fear of being persecuted in their native country for reasons of origin, religion, nationality, belonging to a certain social group or having a political opinion and, for this reason, are unable to return to their native country.

so: Magangelyo doonka aan helin darajada qaxootiga wuxuu si kastoo ay ahaataba heli karaa ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka Finland sababo kale dartood.
en: An asylum seeker who is not granted a refugee status can, however, receive a residence permit for Finland on some other grounds.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinland Magangelyo doonnimo ku imaanshaha Finland.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Coming to Finland as an asylum seeker.

so: Xubnaha qoyska ee qofka qaxootiga ah xitaa waa ay heli karaan ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka ee Finland.
en: The family members of a refugee can also receive a residence permit for Finland.

so: Sharciga ayaa qeexaya dadka ah xubnaha qoyska.
en: The law defines the eligible family members.

so: Xubnahan qoyska oo kali ah ayaa heli kara ogolaanshiyaha joogitanka xiriir qoys dartiis.
en: Only these family members can receive a residence permit based on a family tie.

so: Xubna qoys waxaa Finland looga yaqaanaa
en: In Finland, the following are considered family members:

so: nin iyo naag wada deggan
en: common-law husband or wife

so: cunugga ka yar 18 sano ee aan xaas laheyn
en: a child under the age of 18 who is not married

so: mas'uulka cunugga ka yar 18 sano
en: the guardian of a child under the age of 18

so: Xaaladaha qaarkood qofka qaxootiga ah waxaa laga rabaa ama laga doonayaa inuu haysto ama soo galo dakhli ku filan si uu xubnaha qoyskiisa ah ugu quudiyo Finland, si xubnaha qoyskiisu u helaan ruqsada daganaanshada.
en: In some cases, a refugee is required to have sufficient income to support his or her family members in Finland for those family members to receive a residence permit.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ee ku saabsan isu keenida qoyska waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinland U imaansha reerka Finland.
en: More information on family reunification can be found on the InfoFinland page Moving to Finland to be with a family member.

so: Kaalmada isku keenista qoyska
en: Assistance for family reunification

so: Haddii aad Qaxooti qawiman ku timid Finland, Xafiiska dal u soo guurista ayaa mag-dhabi kara kharashka ka dhashay safarka ay dalka ku imaanayaan xubnaha qoyskaadu.
en: If you have come to Finland as a quota refugee, the Finnish Immigration Service may reimburse the costs caused by your family member's trip to the country.

so: Kharashaadka waxaa la mag-dhabayaa oo kali ah haddii xiriirka qoyska uu jiray kahor markii aad heshay ogolaanshiyahaada joogitaanka Finland ee ugu horeeyay.
en: However, the costs are reimbursed only if the family tie existed before you received your first residence permit for Finland.

so: Kharashka kale ee ku baxa ehelka kale lama mag-dhabayo.
en: The travel costs of other family members will not be reimbursed.

so: Kuwa kale ee aan aheyn qaxootiga qawiman ma heli karaa mag-dhawga kharashka safarka ee ku baxa xubnaha qoyskooda.
en: Refugees outside the quota cannot receive compensation for the travel costs of their family members.

so: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Finland ayaa gacan ka geysata qaban-qaabada safarka qaxootiga qawiman
en: The Finnish Red Cross assists quota refugees in travel arrangements

so: Xafiiska dal u soo guuristu wuxuu kharashka safarka mag-dhabaa oo kaliya marka xubinta qoyska ka midka ahi uu ku safrayo safar ay qaban qaabinayaan Laanqeyrta Cas ee Finland iyo Hay'adda Socdaalka ee Caalamiga ah.
en: The Finnish Immigration Service will only reimburse the travel expenses in the event that the family member in question travels to Finland by means organised by the Finnish Red Cross or the International Organisation for Migration.

so: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Finland waxay gacan ka geysataa qaban qaabada safarka ay ku imaanayaan Finland xubnaha qoyska ee qofka qaxootiga qawiman ah marka ay helaan ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka Finland.
en: The Finnish Red Cross assists in organising the journey of the family members of a quota refugee to Finland once the family members have been granted a residence permit.

so: Laanqeyrta Cas waxaa kale oo ay talo ka bixisaa xeerarka isu-keenista qoyska iyo waxa ay tahay in la sameeyo marka la codsanayo isu-keenista qoyska.
en: The Red Cross also provides counselling on matters relating to the rules of family reunification and what family members need to do in order to apply for family reunification.

so: Marka Xafiiska dal u soo guuristu uu go'aan ogolaanshiyo ah ka gaaro codsigii xiriirka qoyska islamarkaasna ay u aragto in dowladdu ay mag-dhabi karto safarka xubnaha qoyskaada, waxay nuqulka ama koobiga go'aanka ay u direysaa Laanqeyrta Cas ee Finland.
en: When the Finnish Immigration Service has made a positive decision on your application based on family ties and has resolved that the state can finance your family members' journey, it supplies a copy of the decision to the Red Cross.

so: Haddii aad Finland timid adigoo qaxooti qawiman ah aadna dooneyso in dowladda Finland ay bixiso safarka xubnaha qoyskaada, la xiriir qeybta heeganka ee Laanqeyrta Cas ee Finland, kuwaas oo billaabaya qaban qaabinta safarka.
en: If you arrived in Finland as a quota refugee and you want the Finnish state to finance your family members' journey, contact the Red Cross' preparedness unit and they will begin to organise the journey.

so: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Finland ma bixin karto caawimaadda lacageed ee kharashka ku baxa diyaaradda iyo safarrada kale.
en: The Finnish Red Cross cannot provide financial assistance for family members' plane tickets or other travel costs.

so: Haddii aad doonaysid inaad la xiriirto qaraabadaada aad la'dahay, waxaad cawinaad waydiisan kartaa Laanqayrta Cas ee Finland qaybta dad baafinta Laanqeyrta Cas waxay caawisaa qoysaska ku kala irdhoobay xasaradaha iyo masiibooyinka kala duduwan.
en: If you want to make contact with a lost relative, you can ask the Finnish Red Cross's Tracing Services for help. The Red Cross helps families separated by catastrophes or crisis situations.

so: Laanqeyrta cas waxay raadisaa ehelka lumay, sidoo kale waxay fariimaha u kala gudbisaa deegaanada xasaradaha.
en: The Red Cross searches for lost relatives and delivers messages in crisis areas.

so: Qaxootiga iyo magangelyo doonkuba waxay la-talin iyo caawimaad dhinaca sharciga ah weydiisan karaan meelaha ay ka midka yihiin ururka La-talinta qaxootiga ama xafiisyada caawimaadda sharciga.
en: Refugees and asylum seekers can find help and guidance in legal questions, for example, at the Refugee Advice Centre or Legal Aid Offices (oikeusaputoimisto).

so: La-talinta qaxootigu wuxuu bilowga hore ee habsami socodka magangelyada siiyaa dadka magangelyo doonka ah talooyin.
en: The Refugee Advice Centre provides asylum seekers with legal aid at the initial stage of the asylum process.

so: Intaas waxaa dheer in La-talinta qaxootigu uu siiyo ajaaniibta kale talo bixin guud oo dhinaca sharciga ah.
en: It also gives general legal advice to other foreigners.

so: Xafiisyada caawimaadda sharcigu waxay dadka deggan Finland caawimaad khabiirnimo ka siisaa hawlaha sharciga dhameysashadooda.
en: The Legal Aid Offices provide persons living in Finland with expert help in dealing with legal matters.

so: Dhameysashada arrimaha sharciga dartood waxaad waqtiga oo dhan ama qeyb ahaan heli kartaa kaaliye dhinaca sharciga ah iyadoo ay dowladu lacagta kaa bixineyso.
en: In managing legal matters, it is possible to get a legal adviser funded partly or completely by public funds.

so: Ururka Caawinta qaxootigu waa urur ku dadaala horumarinta xuquuqda aasaasiga ah ee qaxootiga.
en: The Finnish Refugee Council (Suomen Pakolaisapu ry) is an organisation that strives to promote refugees' basic rights.

so: Ururku wuxuu ka sameeyaa Finland wargelin, tababaro iyo hawlo bulsho.
en: This organisation performs communication, educational and social work in Finland.

so: Caawinta qaxootigu wuxuu ka caawiyaa qaxootiga iyo dadka dalka u soo guuray tusaale ahaan la qabsashada, degista iyo arrimaha la xiriira aasaasashada ururo iyaga u gaar ah.
en: The Refugee Council helps refugees and immigrants, for example, in matters relating to integration, housing and founding their own organisations.

so: Shahaadada dibadda laga soo qaaday ee gudaha Finland
en: Foreign degree in Finland

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin u dhashay wadan Waqooyiga Yurub, Midowga Yurub, ETA ama Switzerland oo aad Finland u timid waxbarasho, waa iin aad diiwaangelisaa xuquuqdaada joogitaanka.
en: If you are a citizen of a Nordic country, EU member state, EEA member state or Switzerland and you come to Finland to study, you must register your right of residence.

so: Ka sii aqri faahfaahin dheeraad ah bogga InfoFinlandi Muwaadiniinta Midowga Yurub ama Muwaadiniinta u dhashay wuqooyiga Yurub.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page EU citizens or Nordic citizens.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin u dhashay wadan kale, waxaad u baahan tahay ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka ardayga.
en: If you are a citizen of another country, you will need a residence permit for studies.

so: Haddii wax ka barashadaada Finland ay ugu badnaan qaadaneyso saddex bilood uma baahnid ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka arrintaas darteed.
en: If your studies in Finland continue for less than three months, you do not need a residence permit.

so: Waxaadse u baahan kartaa dal kugal.
en: However, you may require a visa.

so: Ka sii aqri faahfaahin dheeraad ah bogga InfoFinlandi Waxbarasho u imaanshada Finland.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Study in Finland.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso in aad Finland ku timaado arday beddel ah, la xiriir tusaale ahaan xafiiska waxbarashada ee machadkaada ama qeybta caalamiga ah.
en: If you would like to study as an exchange student in Finland, contact the student office or the international affairs department of your school.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi Dalbashada waxbarashada waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaadka ku saabsan sida aad ardaynimo uga codsan karto dugsi sare, iskuul xirfadeedka ama dugsiga tacliinta sare.
en: You can find more information on how to apply as a degree student for a Finnish upper secondary school, vocational school or a higher education institution on the InfoFinland page Applying for education and training.

so: Finland waxaad wax uga baran kartaa af finnish, iswidhish iyo mararka qaar afka ingiriiska.
en: In Finland, you can study in Finnish, Swedish and, occasionally, English.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Ardayga ajnabiga ah ee jooga Finland.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Foreign students in Finland.

so: Guryaha ardayda waxaa kireeya mu'asasooyinka guryaha ardayda, gudoonka tacliinta sare ee jaamacadaha, ururka ardayda iyo mu'asasooyin kale.
en: Student housing are leased by student housing foundations, student unions, student associations and some other foundations.

so: Qeybo waxbarasheedyada qaarkood waxay leeyihiin guryo wadareed iyaga u gaar ah.
en: Some institutes also have their own student halls.

so: Qeybta Dagganaanshaha ee InfoFinland waxad ka heli kartaa warbixin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan helidda guri iyo waxyaabaha kale ee ku saabsan degganaanshaha.
en: You can find more information on applying for housing and other housing-related issues in the InfoFinland section Housing.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin u dhashay wadan Midowga Yurub ah, ETA ah, Switzerland ama muwaadin Waqwooyiga Yurub u dhashay waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad si xad la'aan ah u sameyso shaqo mudada waxbarashadaada, taas darteedna uma baahnid ruqsad.
en: If you are a citizen of an EU or EEA country, Switzerland or Nordic country, you have the right to work without limitations during your studentship without needing a permit.

so: Shaqo sameyntu waxay xaq kuu siin kartaa inaad hesho ammaanka bulshada Finland.
en: Working may give you the right to Finnish social security.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin u dhashay wadan kale, waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad si xadidan shaqo ugu sameyso ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka ardayga, haddii shaqadu ay tahay
en: If you are a citizen of another country, your residence permit for studies provides you with the right to work with certain limitations, if the work:

so: shaqo ku tababarasho waxbarashada la xiriirta ama qalin-jebinta amaba
en: consists of practical training included in the studies, or a final project

so: shaqo bar ah, ugu badnaan 25 saacadood todobaadki inta lagu jiro simistarka
en: is part-time work, no more than an average of 25 hours per week during the term

so: shaqo buuxda marka qeybta waxbarashada aan waxbarasho ka qabanqaabsaneyn, sida guud fasaxyada xagaaga iyo ciidul-masiixiga.
en: is full-time work during the time when there is no teaching at your educational establishment, usually during summer and Christmas holidays.

so: Halkee laga heli karaa shaqo? ayaad ka helaysaa macluumaad faahfaahsan oo ku saabsan shaqo helidda Finland.
en: You can find information on finding a job in Finland on the InfoFinland page Where to find work?

so: Haddii aad Finland u timid inaad wax ka barato adigoo ka imaanaya wadan kale oo Waqooyiga Yurub ah, waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad hesho daryeelka caafimaadka Finland.
en: If you come from another Nordic country to study in Finland, you are entitled to health care here.

so: Haddii aad Finland u timid inaad wax ka barato adigoo ka imaanaya wadan Midowga Yurub, ETA ama Switzerland waxaad xaq u leedahay in kaarka daryeelka caafimaadka ee Yurub aad ku hesho daryeelka caafimaadka ee aan laga maarmin.
en: If you come to study in Finland from an EU member state, EEA member state or Switzerland, you are entitled to essential health care, for which you need a European Health Insurance Card.

so: Samayso kaadh caafimaad oo Europian ah inta anad imanin Finland.
en: You must obtain a European Health Insurance Card from your country of residence before coming to Finland.

so: Haddii aad wadan kale Finland uga timid si aad wax u barato waxaad u baahan tahay caymiska jirada ee buuxa kahor inta lagu siinin ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka Finland.
en: If you come to study in Finland from some other country, you will usually need a comprehensive health insurance policy before you can get a residence permit for Finland.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka ardayga iyo caymiska jirada ee ogolaanshiyaha dartiis u baahan waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Waxbarasho u imaanshada Finland bogagga Xafiiska dal u soo guurista.
en: The InfoFinland page Study in Finland or the website of the Finnish Immigration Service provides additional information about residence permits for studies and health insurance, which you will need for the permit.

so: Macluumaad ku saabsan adeegyada caafimaadka ee Finland waxad ka heli kartaa bogga Caafimaadka ee InfoFinlandi.
en: You can find information on health services available in Finland in the InfoFinland section Health.

so: Ardayga ka imaanaya meel ka baxsan Midowga Yurub ama Soonaha ETA wuxuu xaq u yeelan karaa xoogaa manfacyada Kelada ah, sida manfacyada ceymiska jirrada.
en: A student from outside the EU and EEA area may have a right to some Kela benefits, such as health insurance benefits.

so: Shahaadooyinka ajnabiga ee gudaha Finland lagu heysto
en: Foreign degrees in Finland

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi Shahaadooyinka dibadda ee Finland waxa ku qoran macluumaad ku saabsan in shahaadadaa laguugu aqoonsado Finland.
en: The InfoFinland page Foreign degrees in Finland contains information on how you can get your degree or studies recognised in Finland.

so: Shaqo ku sameynta iyo shirkadleynta ama ganacsiga Finland
en: Working and entrepreneurship in Finland

so: Luqada Finnishka iyo Iswidishka
en: Finnish and Swedish language

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin u dhashay dal Waqooyiga Yurub ah, Midowga Yurub, ETA ama Switzerland islamarkaasna aad shaqo u timid Finland, uma baahnid ogolaanshaha joogitaanka.
en: If you are a citizen of a Nordic country, EU member state, EEA member state or Switzerland and you come to work in Finland, you do not need a residence permit.

so: Iyadoo ku xiran jinsiyadaada waxaad faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqrisaa bogagga InfoFinlandi Muwaadiniinta u dhashay wuqooyiga Yurub ama Muwaadiniinta Midowga Yurub.
en: Depending on your citizenship, read more on the InfoFinland page Nordic citizens or EU-citizens.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin wadan kale, waxaad u baahan tahay ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka ee sababo shaqo.
en: If you are a citizen of another country, you will need a residence permit for an employed person.

so: Haddii aad horay ugu joogtay Finland sababo kale, waxaa laga yaabaa inaad xaq u leedahay inaad shaqeyso inkastoo aadan ku codsan ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka shaqo darteed.
en: If you are already in Finland on some other grounds, you may have a right to work even if you have not applied for a residence permit based on employment.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Shaqo u imaanshaha Finland.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page Coming to work in Finland.

so: Haddii aadan aheyn muwaadin u dhashay wadan xubin ka ah Midowga Yurub, wadmada ETA ama Switzerland aadna dooneyso in aad ganacsade ahaan uga shaqeyso Finland waxaad u baahantahay sharciga degenaanshaha ganacsadaha.
en: If you are not a citizen of a European Union member state, EEA member state or Switzerland and you want to engage in entrepreneurship in Finland, you will need a residence permit for an entrepreneur.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka ee ganacsadaha waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi U imaanshiyaha Finland sidii ganacsade.
en: More information on the residence permit for entrepreneurs can be found on the InfoFinland page Becoming an entrepreneur in Finland.

so: Sharciga degganaanshaha ah ee sii soconaya ka dalbo adeegga internetka ee Enter Finland ama barta aadeegga ee Xaafiiska dal u soo guuridda.
en: Apply for the permit extension online in the Enter Finland service or at a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Dalabka samee inta uunsan kaa dhicin sharcigaagii degganaanshaha ee hore.
en: Submit the application before your current residence permit expires.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah ku saabsan sharciga degganaanshaha ah ee la sii wadayo waxad ka heli kartaa bogga InfoFinlandi Ogolaanshaha sii-socda.
en: More information on applying for a permit extension is available on the InfoFinland page Residence permit extension.

so: Qeybta Shaqo iyo ganacsashada ee InfoFinland waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad badan oo ku saabsan nolosha shaqo iyo ka ganacsiga ee Finland.
en: On the InfoFinland page Employment and entrepreneurship you can find a wealth of information on employment and entrepreneurship in Finland.

so: Shaqo-bixiyayaasha qaarkood waxay shaqaalahooda u qabanqaabiyaan barashada luqada Finnishka.
en: Some employers organise Finnish language training for their employees.

so: Weydii shaqo-bixiyahaada inay goobtaada shaqada ku qaban-qaabinayaan barashada luqada Finnishka.
en: Ask your employer whether or not Finnish language courses are held at your workplace.

so: Macluumaadka fursadaha kale ee lagu baran karo luqada Finnishka ama Iswidishka waxaad ka heleysaa qeybta Luqada Finnishka iyo Iswidishka ee InfoFinlandi.
en: The InfoFinland page Finnish and Swedish language contains information on other the possibilities for studying Finnish or Swedish.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso inaad naftaada u barato tacliin ama aad dooneyso inaad kororsato aqoontaada xirfadeed, waxaad ka qeyb-qaadan kartaa waxbarashada dhameystirka ah.
en: If you would like to obtain a qualification or improve your professional expertise, you can take part in continuing education.

so: Waxbarashada dhameystirka ah waxaa qaban-qaabiya goobaha ay ka midka yihiin qeybaha waxbarashada, ururada xirfadda iyo Qeybta horumarinta xirfadda.
en: Continuing education is provided by educational institutes, trade organisations and the Institute for Occupational Advancement, among other organisations.

so: Sidoo kale goobo shaqo oo badan ayaa tababara shaqaalahooda, tusaale ahaan isticmaalka qalabyada cusub iyo barnaamijyada.
en: Many employers also train their own employees in the use of new equipment or software, for example.

so: Ammaanka bulshada Finnishka waxaad ku geli kartaa sabab deegaan oo rasmi ah ama shaqo.
en: You can be covered by Finnish social security based on either permanent residence or work.

so: Intaas waxaa u dheer, waa inaad buuxisaa shuruudaha laga doonayo dadka degan Finland marka ay doonayaan inay helaan manfacyadaas.
en: In addition, you must meet the same requirements for benefits as other residents of Finland.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan ammaanka bulshada Finland waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi: Ammaanka bulshada Finland.
en: You can find more information about Finnish social security on the InfoFinland page: Finnish social security.

so: Haddii ad ka shaqayso Finland, waxa ay faa'ido kuugu jirtaa inaad gasho ururadda xubinta laga noqdo marka la shaqaynayo ee qofka taakuleeya hadday shaqo la'aan ku dhacdo.
en: If you work in Finland, it is recommended to become a member of a Finnish unemployment fund.

so: Haddii ad xubin ka tahay ururadaas waxad heli kartaa taakulayn maalinleh ah oo laguugu xisaabinao mishaarkaagu inta uu ahaa, hadday shaqo la'aan kugu dhacdo.
en: If you are a member of an unemployment fund, you can receive earnings-related daily unemployment allowance, if you become unemployed.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Ururada shaqaalaha iyo Gargaarka shaqo la'aanta.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland pages Trade unions and Unemployment benefit.

so: Waxaad codsan kartaa in Keladu ay soo caddeyso xaqaada adeegyada caafimaadka dadweynaha.
en: You can ask Kela to determine whether you are entitled to public health services.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan daryeelka caafimaadka waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Adeega caafimaadka ee Finland.
en: More information on public health care can be found on the InfoFinland web page Health services in Finland.

so: Haddii aad dhibaato kula kulanto goobta shaqada, la xiriir marka hore madaxdaa.
en: If you face problems at your workplace, contact your supervisor first.

so: Haddii arrintu ku xallismi weyso goobta shaqada, la xiriir xafiiska badbaadada shaqaalaha ee deegaankaada ama iskaashatada xirfadleydaada.
en: If the issue cannot be resolved at the workplace, contact your local occupational safety district or your trade union.

so: Macluumaadyada iyo hagitaanada ku saabsan meesha aad caawimaad uga heli karto dhibaatooyinka kala duwan ee nolosha shaqada waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Dhibaatooyinka nolosha shaqada.
en: Information and instructions on how to get help for various problems in working life can be found on the InfoFinland page Problems in working life.

so: Haddii aad tahay shaqaale, shirkadle, arday, qaxooti, magangelyo doon ama xubinta qoyska ee qofka deggan Finland, waxaad bogagan InfoFinland ka heleysaa macluumaad si gaar ah ugu haboon xaaladaada nololeed.
en: If you are an employee, entrepreneur, student, refugee, asylum seeker or family member of a person living in Finland, you will find information particularly suited to your situation in life on these InfoFinland webpages.

so: Adigoo bogagan u sii maraya waxaad macluumaadyada aad u baahan tahay ku heleysaa si degdeg ah oo qaab la soo koobay ah.
en: From these webpage, you will find the information you need quickly and in a concise form.

so: Kahor u soo guurista Finland
en: Before moving to Finland

so: U soo guurista Finland kaddib
en: After moving to Finland

so: Kahor inta aadan soo guurin baro waxyaabaha ku jiro InfoFinland.
en: Before moving to Finland, read the InfoFinland contents.

so: Waxaad InfoFinland ka heleysaa macluumaad ku qoran afkaada oo ku saabsan u soo guurista Finland, nolosha shaqada, deegaanka, barashada afka finnishka iyo iswidhishka, waxbarashada, ammaanka bulshada, adeegyada caafimaadka, adeegyada qoysaska, xaaladaha dhibka iyo waqtiga firaaqada.
en: InfoFinland is a source of reliable information in your own language about moving to Finland, working life, housing, Finnish and Swedish studies, education, social security, health services, services for families, problem situations and leisure activities.

so: Bogagga waxaa ku jira hagitaano waxqabad ah oo faa'iido leh, macluumaadyo xiriir iyo linkiyada macluumaadka dheeraadka ah.
en: The pages contain useful practical instructions, contact information and links to additional information.

so: Adigoo doorashada magaalooyinka kaalmeysanaya ayaad waxaad geleysaa macluumaadka degmada aad xiiseynayso.
en: With the help of the Cities menu, you can access information regarding a municipality that interests you.

so: Dhammaan luqadaha InfoFinland waa kuwa iskumid ah ama isu dhigma.
en: All of the InfoFinland language versions are identical in content.

so: Ujeedada liiska xusuusta ee u soo guuraha Finland waa in ay adiga kaa caawiso arrimaha waxqabad ee muhiimka ah, kuwaas oo la xiriira guurista.
en: Moving to Finland checklist is intended to help you with the most important practical issues related to moving.

so: Ogsoonow in liiska aan lagu sheegin dhammaan arrimaha ay tahay in aad sameyso marka aad Finland u soo guurto.
en: Please note that the list does not necessarily include all of the things you must take care of when moving to Finland.

so: Haddii aad Finland imaaneyso wax ka badan muddo 90 maalmood islamarkaasna aad tahay muwaadin Midowga Yurub, waa in aad diiwaangelisaa xaqaada joogitaanka.
en: If you are coming to Finland for more than 90 days and you are an EU citizen, you must register your right of residence.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin wadan kale, waa in aad ogolaanshaha joogitaanka Finland codsataa.
en: If you are a citizen of some other country, you must apply for a residence permit in Finland.

so: Iyadoo ku xiran jinsiyadaada waxaad faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqrisaa bogagga InfoFinlandi Muwaadiniinta Midowga Yurub ama Aan aheyn muwaadin EU.
en: Depending on your citizenship, read more on the InfoFinland page EU citizens or Non-EU citizens.

so: Marka aad codsaneyso ogolaanshaha joogitaanka ama diiwaangelinta xaqaada joogitaanka, waa in aad caddeysaa in dhaqaalahaada nolosha ee Finland uu dammaanad-qaadan yahay.
en: When applying for a residence permit or registration of right of residence, you must be able to prove that your livelihood in Finland is ensured.

so: Haddii aad Finland u imaanaysid arrimo la xiriira shaqo ama ganacsi waa inaad caddaysid in shaqada ama ganacsiga ay kaa soo galayso lacag noloshaada ku filan.
en: If you come to Finland to work or to engage in entrepreneurship, you must prove that your work or business provides you with an adequate income.

so: Haddii aad u soo guurto xubin qoyskaad kamid ah oo jooga Finland, inta badan waxaa sidoo kale qofka Finland deggan looga baahanyahay in uu heysto hanti ku filan isaga iyo xubinta qoyskiisa ee Finland u soo guureysa.
en: If you are moving to Finland to live with a family member, the person living in Finland is often also required to have sufficient resources to support him/herself and the family member moving to Finland.

so: Alaabada lagala soo guuro midowga Yurub dhexdiisa
en: Removal goods from the EU area

so: Haddii aad Finland uga soo guureysid wadan ka mid ah wadamada Midowga Yurud, lagaagama baahna inaad alaabadaada khaaska kuu ah oo aad soo qaadanaysid ka bixiso canshuuraha kastamka ama canshuuraha qiimaha la socda.
en: If you move to Finland from another EU member state, you do not usually have to pay duties or value-added tax for your removal goods, i.e. the personal property you bring with you.

so: Sidoo kale lagaagama baahna inaad ogeysiis la xiriira alaabadaada siiso kastamka (tulli).
en: Nor do you have to declare your removal goods to customs (tulli).

so: Ogow, in khamriga iyo sigaarku aysan ku jirin alaabada lala soo guuro oo canshuur la'aanta ah.
en: Please note that the exemption from duty and tax of removal goods does not concern alcohol or tobacco.

so: Keenida khamiriga iyo sigaarka waxaa loo sameeyey xadayn gooni ah.
en: Separate restrictions apply to the import of these.

so: Macluumaad ah waaxda talo-bixinta kastamka oo telefoonkeedu yahay + 358 (0)295 5201 ama bogga internetka ee kastamka.
en: For more information, contact the Customs Information Service at +358 (0)295 5201 or go to the Finnish Custom's website.

so: Talo-bixinta kastamku wuxuu ku adeegayaa luuqadaha Finnishka, Swidishka iyo Ingiriiska.
en: The Customs Information Service provides assistance in Finnish, Swedish and English.

so: Alaabta lagala soo guuray meelaha ka baxsan Midowga Yurub
en: Removal goods from outside the EU

so: Haddii aad ka soo guureysid meel ka baxsan Midowga Yururb, lagaagama baahna inaad alaabadaada khaaska kuu ah oo aad soo qaadanaysid ka bixiso canshuuraha kastamka ama canshuuraha qiimaha la socda.
en: If you move to Finland from outside the EU, you do not usually have to pay duties or value-added tax for your removal goods, i.e. the personal property you bring with you.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee waa inaad alaabadaada ogaysiis ka siisaa shaqaalaha kastamka ee dalka Finland.
en: However, you do have to declare your removal goods to the customs authorities in Finland.

so: Alaabaha lala soo guuro waxaa loo arkaa tusaale ahaan:
en: For example, the following are regarded as removal goods:

so: qalabyada guriga iyo alaabaha guriga
en: furniture and other domestic goods

so: baabuurta sida gaarka ah loo isticmaalayo iyo rimoorada
en: cars and trailers intended for private use

so: Keenista gawaarida sidii alaab lala soo guuray oo kale
en: Bringing a car to Finland as removal goods

so: Marka aad baabuur sidii alaab lala soo guuray oo kale u keeneyso Finland waa inaad ogeysiisaa kastamka.
en: When bringing a car to Finland as removal goods, you must declare it to customs.

so: Haddii aad keeneyso baabuurkaada Finland waa inaad rajistereysaa islamarkaasna aad ka bixisaa canshuurta baabuurta (autovero), ka hor inta aadan ku isticmaalin waddooyinka.
en: If you bring your car to Finland, you must register it and pay a car tax (autovero) before you can use it in traffic.

so: Waxaa macquul ah in gaariga loo isticmaalo si ku meel-gaar ah, ka hor inta aan canshuurta gawaarida la bixin.
en: It is possible to use the car temporarily before car tax has been paid.

so: Laakiin tan waxaa shardi u ah, inaad Maamulka canshuurta sii ogaysiiso istimaalka gaariga (auton käyttöönottoilmoitus).
en: This requires that a commissioning notification (auton käyttöönottoilmoitus) for the car is made to the Tax Administration.

so: Sidoo kale gaarigaagu waa inuu leeyahay caymislka waddooyinka (liiknnnevakuutus) dalka Finland oo shaqaynaya.
en: Your car must also have a motor insurance policy (liikennevakuutus) valid in Finland.

so: Haddii gaariga laga keenay meel ka baxsan wadamada Aagga Dhaqaalaha reer Yurub, waxaad sidoo kale u baahan tahay ruqsada meel ka qaadiga gaariga kahor inta aadan gaariga isticmaalin.
en: If you bring a car from outside the EEA area, you will also need a transfer permit before you can use it.

so: Ruqsada meel ka qaadiga gaariga waxaa bixiya qaar kamid ah goobaha shaqada ee kastamka iyo xarumaha gawaarida jeeg gareeya.
en: Transfer permits are granted by inspection stations and certain customs offices.

so: Gaarigaaga dalka Finland kuma isticmaali kartid ilaa inta aad ka samaynaysid ogaysiiska isticmaalka aadna ka soo qaadanaysid ruqsada meel ka qaadiga gaariga.
en: You are not allowed to use your car in Finland until you have made a commissioning notification and acquired a transfer permit.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso in aad weydiiso talo ku saabsan canshuurta baabuurta iyo geysiiska isticmaalista baabuurka, waxaad wici kartaa adeegga telefoonka ee Maamulka canshuurta:
en: If you have questions regarding car tax and commissioning notification, you can call the Tax Administration telephone service:

so: Haddii aad doonaysid inaad Finland u soo qaadato xayawaan gurijoog ah, waa inaad horay u sii ogaataa sharciyada la xiriira keenida xayawaanada. Inta badan xayawaananada waxaa laga rabaa tusaale ahaan talaalo la cayimay.
en: If you want to bring a pet with you to Finland, you should find out beforehand about the rules for importing animals Often, certain vaccinations, for example, are required for animals.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ee la xiriira shucuucda keenista xayawaanada dalka Finland, waxaad ka helaysaa Hay'adda cuntada (Ruokavirasto).
en: The Finnish Food Safety Authority (Ruokavirasto) provides more information about the rules applicable in Finland.

so: Shirkadaha bixiya adeegyada guurinka qaarkood waxay bixiyaan adeegyo guuritaan oo wadan ka wadan ah.
en: Some companies offering removal services also tend to removals between countries.

so: Shirkadahaas ayaad kireysan kartaa sidii ay alaabtaada kuu qaadaan wadan ka wadan sidoo kale haddii aad doonaysid waxaad ka codsan kartaa adeega xir-xirista iyo baakadaynta iyo waliba qalabka wax lagu baakadeeyo.
en: You can hire these companies to transport your goods from one country to another and even buy packing services and have them pack your goods.

so: Kharashka guuritaanku wuxuu ku xiran yahay hadba, meesha aad ka soo guureysid iyo alaabtaadu inta ay le'eg tahay.
en: The cost of moving depends on where you are moving from and the volume of goods you are transferring.

so: Waxaa laga yaabaa in farqi wayn u dhexeeyo qiimaha shirkadaha guuritaanka ee kala duwan, sidaas awgeed waxaa haboon inaad is barbar dhig ku sameysid qiimahooda.
en: There can be significant differences in the services and prices of different removal companies and therefore it is a good idea to compare prices.

so: Waxaa liiskan la isugu ururiyay arrimaha guud ee ay tahay in aad wax ka qabato marka aad Finland timaado.
en: This list contains the most common things you must take care of once you have arrived in Finland.

so: Guriga iyo caymiska guriga
en: Housing and home insurance

so: Inta badan dadka wadanka u soo guurey waxay bilowga degaan guryo kiro ah.
en: Most immigrants living in Finland live initially in rented flats.

so: Waxaa haboon in raadinta guryaha kirada ah waqti loo qabsado, ugu yaraan hal bil.
en: It's a good idea to allow yourself at least a month to find a flat to rent.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ka akhriso bogga InfoFinlandi:
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Housing.

so: Markii aad guri heshid waxaa habboon inaad gashid caymiska guryaha (kotivakuutus).
en: Once you have a flat, it is worthwhile taking out a home insurance policy (kotivakuutus).

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah waxad ka heli kartaa bogga bangiga macluumaadka qaybtiisa Nolol maalmeedka dalka Finland.
en: You can find information on insurance on the InfoFinland page Everyday life in Finland.

so: Summada aqoonsi ee finnishka
en: Finnish personal identity code

so: Haddii lagu siiyo ogolaanshaha degitaanka ee Finland, waxaa si otomaatig ah laguugu diiwaangelinayaa nidaamka macluumaadka dadka.
en: If you are granted a residence permit for Finland, you will be automatically registered in the Finnish Population Information System.

so: Waxaad islamarkaas heleysaa aqoonsiga shakhsiyeed ee Finnishka.
en: You will receive a Finnish personal identity code at the same time.

so: Aqoonsiga shakhsiyeed waxaad sidoo kale gudaha Finland ka heli kartaa xafiiska rajistareeshinka ee degamadaada ama xafiiska canshuuraha.
en: You can also get a personal identity code at the Local Register Office or Tax Office of your place of residence in Finland.

so: Haddaad u soo guurto Finland si rasmi ah, waxaa laguugu diiwaan gelinyaa in degaankaagu yahay Finland.
en: If you move permanently to Finland, your municipality of residence (kotikunta) will be registered as being in Finland.

so: Deegaankaaguna wuxuu noqonayaa degmada, aad ku nooshahay.
en: Your municipality of residence is the municipality in which you live.

so: Mar haddii degan tahay degmadaasna, waxaad xaq u leedahay adeegyada ay bixiso degmadaas, sida tusaale adeega daryeelka caafimaad ee dadweynaha.
en: When you have a municipality of residence in Finland, you have the right to use the services provided by the municipality, such as public health services.

so: Waxaad ka ogaan kartaa degmadaada waaxda diiwaangelinta, in lagugu diiwan gelin karo degaankaaga inuu noqdo Finland.
en: You can ask from the Local Register Office of your place of residence whether your municipality of residence can be registered as being in Finland.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan ammaanka bulshada Finland wuxuu ku jira bogga InfoFinlandi Ammaanka bulshada Finland.
en: More information on social security in Finland is available on the InfoFinland web page Finnish social security.

so: Waxaad u baahan tahay koonto bangi si aad u xalisatid arimaha lacagaha la xiriira.
en: You will need a bank account in order to handle your day-to-day finances.

so: Markii aad furanaysid koontada bangiga, waxaad u baahan tahay baasaboor ama waraaqo kale oo cadayn ah.
en: When opening a bank account, you need a passport or some other official identity card.

so: Waxaa haboon inaad is barbar dhigtaa adeegyada bangiyada kala duwan ay bixinayaan iyo qiimaha, si aad u heshid wadiiqo adiga kuu raqiisan.
en: It's a good idea to compare the services and prices of different banks so that you will find the most advantageous option for you.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan furidda akawnka bangiga waxad ka heli kartaa bogga bangiga macluumaadka qaybtiisa Nolol maalmeedka dalka Finland.
en: Read more on opening a bank account on the InfoFinland page Everyday life in Finland.

so: Haddii aad shaqeyso oo aad mushaar hesho ama aad tahay ganacsade, waxaad u baahan tahay kaarka canshuurta (verokortti)
en: If you are working and receiving pay, or if you are an entrepreneur, you need a Finnish tax card (verokortti).

so: Haddaad degan tahay maagalada shardi ma aha inaad yeelato gaari.
en: If you live in a town or city in Finland, it is not necessary to own a car.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka eeg bogga InfoFinlandi Gaadiidka gudaha Finland.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Traffic in Finland.

so: Bogga bangiga macluumaadka qaybtiisa Nolol maalmeedka dalka Finland waxad ka heli kartaa macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan furashada internetka.
en: More information on acquiring an internet connection is available on the InfoFinland page Everyday life in Finland.

so: Finland waxay leedahay adeegyo caafimaadka dadweynaha.
en: Finland provides both public and private health services.

so: Adeegyada caafimaadka dadweynaha waad adeegsan kartaa, haddii aad ku tahay Guri degmo ee gudaha Finland.
en: You can use public health services if you have a municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Daryeelka caafimaadka dadweynaha waa rugta caafimaadka degmada waana ka qiimo jaban tahay rugaha caafimaadka ay shaqsiyaadku leeyihiin.
en: Public health services include, for example, health centres. Public services are much less expensive than private ones.

so: Haddaad rabto inaad dhakhtar ka qabsatid balan, la xiriir rugta daryeelka caafimaadka.
en: If you want to book an appointment with a doctor, contact a health centre.

so: Haddaadan xaq u laheyn adeega daryeelka caafimaadka dadweynaha, waxaad la xiriiri kartaa dhakharada bareefadka ah.
en: If you are not entitled to use public health services, you can visit a private medical clinic.

so: Faahfaahin dheeriya oo Daryeelka caacimaadka Finland waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Caafimaadka.
en: Further information on Finnish health care is available on the InfoFinland page Health.

so: Luuqadaha Finnishka iyo Swidishku waa luuqadaha rasmiga ah ee dalka Finland.
en: Finnish and Swedish are Finland's official languages.

so: Aqoontooda waxay kaa caawinaysaa inaad fahamtid bulshada cusub, waxayna kuu sahlaysaa xalinta arrimaha.
en: Language proficiency will help you to understand the new society and make it easier for you to handle your affairs.

so: Barashada luuqada Finnishka ama Swidisku waxay ku xiran tahay, labada luuqadood hadba midda looga hadlo magaalada aad degan tahay.
en: Whether you should study Finnish or Swedish depends on which language is spoken in your place of residence.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Luqada Finnishka iyo Swidishka.
en: More information is available on the InfoFinland web page Finnish and Swedish language.

so: Xafiiska shaqada iyo dhaqaalaha ayaad caawimaad uga heleysaa shaqo raadinta.
en: The Employment and Economic Development Office provides help with your job hunting.

so: Shaqada waxaad ka raadsan kartaa internetka iyo joornaalada.
en: You can look for jobs online and in newspapers.

so: Sidoo kale shaqo waxaad ku heli kartaa adigoo si toos ah ula xiriira shaqo bixiyaha aad xiisaynaysid.
en: You can also find a job if you personally contact employers that interest you.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan shaqo ka raadinta Finland InfoFinlandi Xagee shaqo?.
en: Read more about how to look for work in Finland on the InfoFinland web page Where to find work?

so: Macluumaadka la xiriira suurto galnimada waqtiyada firaaqada iyo hiwaayadaha waxaad ka helaysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Waqtiga firaaqada.
en: You will find information about possible hobbies on the InfoFinland web page Leisure.

so: Haddii aad ku jirto ceymiska jirada ee Finnishka, waxaad heleysaa kaarka Kelada.
en: If you are covered by the Finnish national health insurance, you will receive a Kela card.

so: Qeyb ka ahaanshada ammaanka bulshada Finland waa in gooni loo codsadaa.
en: You must apply separately to be covered by Finnish social security.

so: Sidoo kale kaalmo kastana waa in goonideeda loo codsadaa.
en: Each benefit must also be applied for separately.

so: Ka mid ahaanshaha ammaanka bulshada Finland
en: Being covered by Finnish social security

so: Xeerka ugu horeeya waa in aad Finland si joogto ah u deggan tahay, waxaad qeyb ka tahay ammaanka bulshada Finland waadna heli kartaa manfacyada Kelada.
en: As a general rule, if you reside permanently in Finland, you are covered by Finnish social security and can receive Kela benefits.

so: Sidoo kale ka shaqeynta Finland ayaa ku keeni kartaa adiga xeyndaabka ammaanka bulshada Finland.
en: Working in Finland can also result in your being covered by Finnish social security.

so: Ma ku jirtaa ammaanka bulshada Finland oo ma heshaa kaalmooyin?
en: Are you covered by social security and are you entitled to benefits?

so: wadan Midowga Yurub (EU) ka tirsan ama wadan ka tirsan Soonaha dhaqaalaha Yurub (ETA) ama Switzerland ama
en: a country belonging to the European Union (EU) or the European Economic Area (EEA), Switzerland or

so: wadan ay Finland wada leeyihiin heshiiska ammaanka bulshada.
en: a country with which Finland has a social security agreement.

so: Waxa kale oo intaas dheer oo saameyn ku leh ka mid ahaanshaha ammaanka bulshada iyo helitaanka kaalmooyinka inaad Finland u soo guurtay tusaale ahaan
en: Your eligibility for social security and benefits is also affected by the capacity in which you are moving to Finland, for example:

so: Wadamadaas waxay yihiin wadamada Waqooyiga ama Nordikada (Sweden, Danmark, Norway iyo Iceland), Mareykanka, Kanada iyo Quebec, Chile, Israa'iil, Hindiya iyo Austraaliya.
en: These countries are the Nordic countries (Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Iceland), The United States, Canada and Quebec, Chile, Israel, India and Australia.

so: Marka aad Finland u soo guurto, Kelada ayaa qiimeyneysa markasta inaad Finland ugu soo guurtay degis joogto ah oo waafaqsan sharciga ammaanka bulshada.
en: When you move to Finland, Kela always first assesses whether or not you are moving to the country permanently, as defined by the social security legislation.

so: Waxaa wannaagsan in la ogaado in joogto u deganaanshaha sharciyo kala duduwan loogu qeexay habab kala duduwan.
en: It is good to be aware that permanent residence is defined differently between acts.

so: Halkan waxaan uga hadleynaa sharciyada ammaanka bulshada.
en: In this context, the social security legislation is covered.

so: Haddii aan loo arag in aad Finland joogto ugu soo guurtay, waxaad xaq u yeelan kareysaa inaad qeyb ahaan gasho ammaanka bulshada shaqadaada darteed.
en: If you are not deemed to be moving to Finland for permanent residence, you may still be entitled to coverage by the Finnish social security based on your work.

so: waxaad heysataa heshiis shaqo ah ama wax u dhigma oo aad Finland ku sameyneyso
en: You have an employment contract, or similar agreement, regarding work you will be conducting in Finland.

so: Haddii aad Finland si ku meelgaar ah ugu soo guurtay inta badan xaq uma lihid ammaanka bulshada Finland.
en: If you are moving to Finland temporarily, you are not entitled to Finnish social security.

so: Tusaale ahaan ardaygu Finland ku joogaa si ku meelgaar ah haddii sababta joogista dalku ay tahay uun waxbarasho.
en: For example, students are considered to reside in Finland temporarily when their only reason for being in the country is studying.

so: Marka la sameeyo go'aanka ah inaad joogto u deggan tahay Finland waxaa laguu aqoonsanayaa qof Finland joogto u deggan ilaa aad:
en: Once the decision has been made that you are a permanent resident of Finland, you will be regarded as such for as long as:

so: Haddiise aad shaqo ka bilowdo wadan kale ama aad dibadda sanad wax ka badan ku maqnaato xaqaadi ammaanka bulshada Finland wuxuu dhammaan karaa.
en: However, if you begin work in another country or go abroad for more than a year, your entitlement to Finnish social security may be terminated.

so: Haddii aad Finland uga soo guureyso shaqo darteed soonaha Midowga Yurub ama wadanka kale oo ETA ah ama Switzerland, waxaad inta badan mudada xiriirkaada shaqada geleysaa haddii aad xittaa heysato heshiis shaqo oo waqti gaaban ah.
en: If you are moving to Finland for work from within the European Union, an EEA country or Switzerland, you are normally entitled to coverage by Finnish social security for the duration of your employment, even if you have a short employment contract.

so: Haddii Finland uga imaaneyso meel kale oo aan aheyn Midowga Yurub, soonaha ETA iyo Switzerland shaqo darteed arrimaha soo socda ayaa saameyn ku leh ammaankaada bulshada:
en: If you are coming to Finland for work from a country other than Switzerland outside the EU or EEA region, the following factors affect your social security:

so: inta ay shaqadu qaadaneyso
en: The length of your employment

so: wadanka aad Finland uga soo guureyso
en: The country from which you are moving to Finland

so: Waqtiga aad shaqeyneyso iyo mushaarkuna iney ahaadaan kuwo kugu filan.
en: Your employment must last at least four months and your working hours and salary must be sufficient.

so: Waxaa intaa dheer ood u baahan tahay sharci degenaansho, kaasoo wata shatiga ogolaanshaha shaqada
en: In addition, you must have a residence permit which includes the right to work.

so: Waqtiga shaqada ee ugu yarna waa 18 saacadood todobaadkii.
en: The minimum requirement for working hours is usually 18 hours a week.

so: Degmooyinka waxay dadka siiyaan adeegyo badan.
en: Municipalities offer their residents a range of services.

so: Adeegyada degmada waxaa tusaale ahaan ka mid ah daryeelka caafimaadka iyo xanaanada caruurta.
en: For example, municipal services include health care and day care for children.

so: Haddii aad deegaan (kotikunta) ku leedahay Finland, waxaad caadi ahaan xaq u yeelaneysaa isticmaalka adeegyada degmada oo dhan.
en: If you have a municipality of residence (kotikunta) in Finland, in most cases you are entitled to use the services provided by the municipality.

so: Waa in aad xaqiijisaa in adiga iyo xubnaha kale ee reerkaada aad leedihiin xaqa deegaanimo Finland.
en: You should find out if you and your family members are entitled to a municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Xaqa deegaanimo ee Finland waxaa lagu saleeyaa sida uu qabo sharciga deegaanka.
en: In Finland, the right to a municipality of residence is determined by the Municipality of Residence Act.

so: Waxaad ka xaqiijin kartaa xafiiska isdiiwaangelinta (maistraatti) in aad leedahay xaqa deegaanimo ee Finland.
en: At the Local Register Office (maistraatti) of your place of residence, you can find out if you are entitled to a municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Sidee baad deegaan uga heli kartaa Finland
en: How to obtain a municipality of residence in Finland

so: Si aad deegaan uga hesho Finland, waa in aad usoo guurtaa Finland si rasmi ah.
en: In order to have a municipality of residence in Finland, you must move to Finland permanently.

so: Haddii aad si ku-meelgaar ah u degan tahay Finland, tusaale ahaan aad ugu soo guurto Finland waxbarasho ama shaqo darteed ugu badnaan muddo sanad ah, kama heleysid caadi ahaan deegaan Finland.
en: If you are residing in Finland temporarily, for example to work or study for no longer than one year, in most cases you are not entitled to register a municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Waxaa macquul ah in aad deegaan ka hesho Finland haddii:
en: Your municipality of residence can be in Finland if:

so: tahay muwaadin finnish ah
en: you are a Finnish citizen

so: tahay muwaadin u dhashay wadamada Wuqooyiga Yurub
en: you are a citizen of a Nordic country

so: tahay muwaadin u dhashay dalalka EU, Switzerland ama Liechtenstein aadna sharcigaaga degenaanshaha ka diiwaagelisay Finland.
en: you are a resident of an EU country, Switzerland or Lichtenstein and have registered your right of residence in Finland

so: aad haysato sharciga abadiya ah (P) ama joogtada ah (A) oo shaqeynaya
en: you have a valid permanent (P) or continuous (A) residence permit

so: ama aad tahay qof xubin ka ah qoys deggan Finland.
en: you are a family member of a person who has a municipality of residence in Finland

so: Haddii aad haysato sharciga ku-meel-gaarka ah (sharciga B), kaaso o shaqeynaya, waxaad heli kartaa deegaan haddii aad muujin karto in ujeedadaadu tahay in aad si rasmi ah ugu noolaato dalka Finland.
en: If you have a valid temporary residence permit (B), you may have a Finnish municipality of residence, but only if you can demonstrate that you intend to live in Finland permanently.

so: Degenaanshaha rasmiga ah waxaad ku muujin kartaa tusaale ahaan qaababka soo socda:
en: The following factors among others can demonstrate permanent residence:

so: in aad goob shaqo ku haysato Finland iyo in heshiiskaada uu yahay mid ugu yaraan shaqeynaya labo sano.
en: you have a job in Finland and your employment contract is valid for at least two years

so: in aad wax ka baraneyso Finland iyo in waxbarashadaadu qaadaneyso ugu yaraan labo sano.
en: you are studying in Finland and your studies will take at least two years

so: in aad tahay asal ahaan muwaadin finnish ah.
en: you are of Finnish origin

so: in aad horay u deegan ugu aheyd Finland.
en: you have previously had a municipality of residence in Finland

so: in aad degeneyd Finland ugu yaraan muddo sanad xiriir ah.
en: you have continuously resided in Finland for at least one year

so: Degmadaada caadi ahaan waa degmada aad degan tahay.
en: Your municipality of residence is usually the municipality in which you live.

so: Haddii aadan guri ku laheyn ama aad guryo ku leedahay agagaarka degmada, degmadaadu waa degmada aad adigu shaqsiyan doorbideyso taas oo aad ku leedahay xiriir joogto ah tusaale ahaan xiriir qoys ama mid shaqo.
en: If you have no accommodation or have accommodation in several municipalities, your municipality of residence is the municipality you yourself consider your municipality of residence and to which you have a close connection, for example through your family ties or job.

so: Marka aad u soo guurto Finland, waa in aad aadaa xafiiska diiwaan gelinta deegaankaada si aad degane ahaan isaga diiwaangeliso.
en: When you have moved to Finland, you must visit the Local Register Office (maistraatti) of your place of residence to register as a resident.

so: Ka hor inta aadan imaanin xafiiska diiwaangelinta, waxaad buuxin kartaa ogeysiiska diiwaangelinta ajnabiga oo laga helo bogagga maistraatti.fi.
en: Before visiting the Local Register Office, you can fill in the Registration Information of a Foreigner form on the maistraatti.fi website.

so: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta ayaad sidoo kale ku buuxin kartaa.
en: You can also fill in the form at the Local Register Office.

so: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta waxa uu macluumaadkaada ka diiwaan gelinayaa hay'adda tirakoobka bulshada ee Finland.
en: The Local Register Office will enter your basic data into the Finnish Population Information System.

so: Macluumaadyadan waa tusaale ahaan magaca, taariikhda dhalashada, jinsiyadda, jinsiga iyo cinwaanka.
en: Such information includes your name, date of birth, citizenship, sex and address.

so: Haddii aad Finland u soo guurtay si aad joogto u degto sannad ama wakhti ka badan, waxaad xaq u yeelan kartaa guri degmo oo Finland ku yaal.
en: If you move to live permanently in Finland for a year or more, you may have the right to a municipality of residence in Finland.

so: Guri degmo ayaad u baahan tahay si aad u isticmaasho adeegyada magaalada ama degmada, sida daryeelka caafimaadka iyo xannaano-maalmeedka.
en: You need a municipality of residence to use city or municipal services, such as health care and children's day care.

so: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta ayaa lagu gurfeynayaa in guri degmo laguu diiwaangelin karo.
en: The Local Register Office decides whether a Finnish municipality of residence (kotikunta) can be entered for you.

so: Marka aad aadeysid xafiiska diiwaangelinta, horay u soo qaado ugu yaraan dokumiintiyada soo socda:
en: When visiting the Local Register Office, please bring along at least the following documents:

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin dal Midowga Yurub ama Waqooyiga Yurub ah:
en: If you are an EU or Nordic citizen:

so: baasaboor shaqeynaya ama aqoonsi kale oo ay ka muuqato jinsiyaddu
en: a valid passport or other identity document indicating your citizenship

so: shaqada, shahaadada waxbarashada ama cadeyn kale oo ay diiwaangelintu u baahan tahay (haddii aad tahay muwaadin Midowga Yurub welina aadan Hoggaanka socdaalka ka diiwaangelin xaqaada joogitaanka dalka)
en: an employment contract, a certificate of studies or another proof of the need to register (if you are an EU citizen and have not yet registered your right of residence at the Immigration Service)

so: shahaadada guurka ee asalka ah (haddii aad guursatay)
en: the original marriage certificate (if you are married)

so: shahaadooyinka asalka ah ee dhalashada carruurta (haddii aad leedahay carruur 18 sano ka yar, kuwaas oo Finland u soo guuraya)
en: the original birth certificates of your children (if you have children under 18 years old who are moving to Finland)

so: ogow in lagaa rabo in aad shaciyeyso dukumentiyada ay bixisay hay'ad kale oo aan ka tirsaneyn dal Midowga Yurub ama Waqooyiga Yurub ah.
en: Please note that you need to legalise any documents provided by parties other than EU or Nordic authorities.

so: Tusaale ahaan haddii aad heysato shahaadada guurka ee lagaa siiyay Mareykanka.
en: For example, if your marriage certificate was issued in the Unites States.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin wadan kale:
en: If you are a citizen of another country:

so: sharciga degenaanshaha (haddii sharciga degenaanshaha aad Finland ugu baahan tahay)
en: a residence permit (if you need a residence permit for Finland)

so: haddii loo baahdo caddeynta shaqada Finland laga qabanayo ama waxbarashada ( tus. heshiiska shaqada ama shahaadada joogitaanka ee ay goobta waxbarashadu bixisay) ama caddeyn kale oo lagu sababeynayo diiwaangelinta
en: if necessary, proof of work or studies in Finland (such as an employment contract or certificate of attendance from your educational institute) or another account of the reasons for registering

so: shahaadada guurka ee asalka ah oo la sharciyeeyay (haddii aad guursatay)
en: the original legalised marriage certificate (if you are married)

so: shahaadooyinka asalka ah ee dhalashada carruurta oo la sharciyeeyay (haddii aad leedahay carruur 18 sano ka yar, kuwaas oo Finland u soo guuraya)
en: the original legalised birth certificates of your children (if you have children under 18 years of age who are moving to Finland)

so: Waa in xafiiska diiwaangelinta tustaa dukumentiga asalka ah ama nuqulkiisa oo si lagu kalsoonaan karo loo caddeeyay saxnimadiisa.
en: You need to provide the Local Registry Office with the original document or a copy that has been reliably certified as a true copy.

so: Nuqulka waxaa saxnimadiisa si lagu kalsoonaan karo u caddeyn kara hay'adda bixisay dukumentiga ama nootaayada guud ee dalkaas.
en: A copy can be reliably certified as a true copy by the authority that issued the document or by a public notary of the same country.

so: Si xafiiska diiwaangelintu uu ugu qoro macluumaadkaada nidaamka macluumaadka dadka, dukumentigu waa in uu ahaadaa mid la shirciyeeyay.
en: The document must be legalised or the Local Registry Office cannot enter your information in the Population Information System.

so: Haddii uu dalkaadu ku biiray heshiiska caalamiga ah ee Hague, u samee dukumentigaada shahaadaa Apostille.
en: If your country has joined the Hague Convention, you need to get an Apostille certificate for your document.

so: Uma baahnid shahaadada Apostille, haddii aad heysato dukumenti guud oo ay bixisay hay'ad ka tirsan wadan Midowga Yurub ah.
en: You do not need an Apostille certificate if you have a public document issued by an authority of an EU country.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee waxaad dokumentiga guud in aad ku lifaaqdo u baahan kartaa foomamka istaandarka ah ee loo kaalmeysto turjumaadda.
en: However, you may need to fill in a standard form used for translation aid and submit it with the public document.

so: Foomamkan istaandarka ah waxaa weydiin kartaa hay'adaha dowliga ah ee dalkaada oo aad caddeynta ka codsaneyso.
en: For more details about such standard forms, contact the authorities of the country from which you apply for the certificate.

so: Waxaa kale oo beddelkeeda la sameyn karaa in dukumentiga uu turjumo turjubaan ka sharciyeysan wadan Midowga Yurub ah.
en: Another option is to have the document translated by an authorised translator who has been approved by an EU country.

so: Ogow in dukumentigu uu ku qornaado luqada Finnishka, Iswidhishka ama Ingiriis.
en: Please note that documents must be in Finnish, Swedish or English.

so: Haddii uu dukumentigaadu ku qoran luqad kale, waa in aad ku dadaashaa in loo turjumo Finnish, Iswidhish ama Ingiriis.
en: If your document is in another language, you must have it translated into Finnish, Swedish or English.

so: Dukumentiga waxaa turjumi kara turjubaan qoraal oo rasmi ah.
en: The document can be translated by an authorised translator.

so: Haddii turjumista lagu sameeyay dibadda, turjumaadda xittaa waa in la sharciyeeyaa.
en: If the translation is done abroad, the translation must also be legalised.

so: Haddii aad u baahan tahay macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan sida aad u sharciyeyn karto dukumentiga, la xiriir xafiiska diiwaangelinta ama wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda ee dalkaada.
en: For more information on how to legalise documents, please contact the Local Register Office or the Ministry for Foreign Affairs of your own country.

so: Sumadda aqoonsiga waxaad ka heleysaa Hoggaanka socdaalka, marka lagu siiyo sharciga degenaansha Finland ama marka la diiwaangeliyo xaqaada joogitaanka muwaadinka Midowga Yurub.
en: You will receive a personal identity code from the Immigration Service when you are granted a residence permit for Finland or when your EU citizen's right of residence is registered.

so: Sumadda aqoonsiga Finnishka waxaad sidoo kale ka heli kartaa:
en: You can also get a Finnish personal identity code at:

so: xafiiska canshuuraha, haddii aad canshuur darteed u baahan tahay sumadda
en: the Tax Office if you need a personal identity code for tax purposes

so: Sumadda aqoonsiga Finnishku waa taxane dheer oo ka kooban 11 nambar kaaso o ka sameysma taariikhda dhalashadaada iyo jinsigaaga.
en: A Finnish personal identity code (henkilötunnus) is a number sequence with 11 characters, formed on the basis of your date of birth and gender.

so: Sumadda aqoonsiga waxaad ugu baahnaan kartaa tusaale ahaan shaqo-bixiyahaada ama machadkaada waxbarashada.
en: You need a personal identity code for your employer or educational institution, for example.

so: Wuxuu sidoo kale fududeeyaa ka arimeysiga kala duwan ee hay'adaha dowladda.
en: It will also make it easier for you to attend to issues involving the authorities.

so: Haddii aad sumadda aqoonsiga ka heshay meel aan aheyn xafiiska diiwaangelinta islamarkaasna aad u baahan tahay guri degmo, waa in aad mar kasta tagtaa xafiiska diiwaangelinta.
en: If you received your personal identity code through an authority other than the Local Registry Office and you want a municipality of residence, you need to visit the Local Registry Office.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin u dhashay mid ka mid ah wadamada wuqooyiga Yurub, uma baahnid in aad sharci kusoo degto Finland.
en: If you are a citizen of a Nordic country, you do not need a residence permit for Finland.

so: Waxaad xag u leedahay in aad ka shaqeysatid, ka ganacsatid iyo in aad wax ka barato Finland.
en: You have the right to work, study and engage in entrepreneurship in Finland.

so: Marka aad usoo guurto Finland, waa in aad sameysaa wargelinta geediga isla markaana aad iska diiwaangeliso xafiiska is-diiwaangelinta ee degmadaada (maistraatti).
en: When you move to Finland, you must make a notification of move and register at the Local Register Office (maistraatti) of your place of residence.

so: Ogsoonoow in aad u baahan tahay in aad tagto xafiiska is-diiwaangelinta shaqsi ahaan.
en: Please note that you must personally visit the Local Register Office.

so: Samee wargelinta geediga ugu dambeyn muddo isbuuc gudihiisa ah laga bilaabo maalinta aad geediga noqotay.
en: Make the notification of move one week after your move at the latest.

so: Is-diiwaangelinta waxaad u baahan tahay aqoonsi sharci ah oo ay ka muuqato jinsiyadda ama baasaboor kaas oo ah mid shaqeynaya.
en: For registration, you will need an official identity card indicating your citizenship or a valid passport.

so: Xubnaha qoyska ee muwaadiniinta u dhashay wuqooyiga Yurub
en: Family members of a Nordic citizen

so: Haddii xubin ka tirsan qoyskaada kaas oo kugula soo guurayo Finland uusan aheyn muwaadin u dhashay dalalka wuqooyiga Yurub, wuxuu u baahnaan karaa ogolaansho sharci ama shahaadada diiwaangelinta degenaansho ee midowga yurub.
en: If a family member who is not a Nordic citizen moves to Finland with you, he or she may need a residence permit or the certificate of registration of the right of residence of a Union citizen.

so: Ka aqri macluumaad dheeraad ah mareegaha InfoFinland Muwaadiyiinta Yurubiyanka ama
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page EU citizens or Non-EU citizens.

so: Marka aad tagto xafiiska is-diiwaangelinta si aad isku diiwaangeliso, waxaad isla markaas heli kartaa sumadda aqoonsiga finnishka (henkilötunnus).
en: When you register at the Local Register Office, you can obtain a Finnish personal identity code (henkilötunnus)at the same time.

so: Sumadda aqoonsiga waxaad u baahan tahay marka aad la macaamileyso shaqaalaha dowladda iyo sidoo kale waxay kuu fududeeneysaa in aan ka arinsato tusaale ahaan bangiyadda iyo shaqo-bixiyahaaga.
en: You will need a personal identity code when dealing with the authorities, which will also make dealing with a bank or your employer easier.

so: Marka aad usoo guurto Finland, aad xafiiska diiwaangelinta (maistraatti) deegaanka aad degan tahay.
en: When you move to Finland, visit the Local Register Office (maistraatti)of your place of residence.

so: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta waxaad ka heli kartaa sumadda aqoonsiga Finnishka, haddii aadan dalbanin aqoonsigaasi kolkii aad degenaanshaha dalbaneysay.
en: At the Local Register Office, you can obtain a Finnish personal identity code, if you did not apply for one when obtaining a residence permit.

so: Haddii aad ugu soo guurto Finland arimo la xiriiro qoyskaada aawadeed, waxaad sida cadiga ah ku biireysaa siistamka adeegga bulshada.
en: If you move to live in Finland for family reasons, you are normally entitled to Finnish social security.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, tani ma ahan had iyo jeer sidaasi ahaaneysa.
en: However, this is not always the case.

so: haddii anad mudadaas anad daganayn wadan kale oo dibadda ah labo sano mudo ka dheer iyo
en: you have not lived abroad for more than two years during this period, and

so: haddii sababihii ad ku heshay sharciyadii hore ay wai jiraan
en: the grounds for the previous permits are still valid.

so: A markii ad imanaysay Finland, mudada afarta sano waxa lagaaga soo tirinayaa maalintii ad timiday Finland. Haddii ad Finland ku qaadatay sharciga
en: If you had an A permit when you came to Finland, the four year period is considered to begin on the day of your arrival in Finland.

so: A muddadaas afarta sano waxa lagaaga soo xisaabinayaa maalintii sharciga A laguu oggolaaday.
en: If you received the A permit in Finland, the four year period is considered to begin on the day the first A permit came into effect.

so: Haddii ad Finland ka heshay magangaliyo caalami ah muddada afarta sano waxa lagaaga soo bilaabayaa maalintii ad Finland soo gashay.
en: If you have received international protection in Finland, the four year period is considered to begin on the day of your arrival in Finland.

so: Sharciga joogtada ah waa laguu diidi karaa haddii:
en: A permanent residence permit can be denied in the following cases:

so: ad gashay fal dambi ah oo ciqaab xabsi ah lagu heli karo
en: You have committed an offence for which you can be sentenced to prison

so: haddii lagaaga shikisanyahay fal dambi ah oo lagu heli karo ciqaab xabsi ah
en: You are suspected of committing an offence for which you can be sentenced to imprisonment

so: haddii ad gashay labo fal oo dambi ah ama ka badan
en: You have committed two or more offences

so: haddii lagaaga shikisanyahay labo fal oo dambi ah ama ka badan
en: You are suspected of two or more offences

so: Sharciga joogtada ah waxa uu shaqaynayaa muddo anan la cayimin.
en: The permanent residence permit is valid until further notice.

so: Sharciga waa lagaala noqon karaa haddii ad si joogto ah uga guurto Finland ama ad wadan dibadda ah labo sano oo isdaba jog ah muddo ka dheer joogto ama ad warbixin beena bixisay wakhtigii sharciga lagu siinayay.
en: However, the permit can be cancelled if you move permanently away from Finland or live continuously abroad for more than two years, or if you submitted false information when applying for the permit.

so: Qof muddo dheer joogay waddanka oo haysta dhalasho wadan saddexaad sida uu u helayo sharciga EU- da
en: EU residence permit for third-country nationals with long-term EU resident status

so: Qofka haysta dhalasho waddan saddexaad waa qof anan ahayn muwaadin Wadamada waqooyiga, Wadamada midowga Yurub, Liechtenstein ama Swizerland.
en: A third-country national is a citizen of a country other than one of the Nordic or EU countries, Liechtenstein or Switzerland.

so: Waxad heli kartaa sharciga EU-da (midowga Yurub) (P-EU) ee qofka haysta dhalashada waddan saddexaad, haddii:
en: You can receive a third-country national's EU residence permit (P-EU) if:

so: haddii ad dagantahay Finland ugu yaraan shan sano adiga oo haysta sharciga A
en: you have lived in Finland at least five years with an A permit,

so: P-EU sharciga la yidhaahdo waxa loo dalbadaa qaabka loo dalbado sharciga joogtada ah.
en: A P-EU permit is applied for in the same way as a permanent residence permit.

so: P-EU sharciga la yidhaahdo waa mid shaqaynaya muddo anan cayimnayn.
en: The P-EU permit is valid until further notice.

so: P-EU sharciga la yidhaahdo waxa lagu diidi karaa sababo lamid ah kuwa lagu diidi karo sharciga joogtada ah.
en: P-EU permits can be denied for the same reasons as in the case of permanent residence permits.

so: Sharciga degenaanshaha ee joogtada ah waxaad ka codsan kartaa shabakadda adeegga Enter Finland.
en: You can apply for a permanent residence permit online through the Enter Finland service.

so: Marka aad codsiga sameyso waa in aad tagtaa goobta adeegga ee Hay'adda socdaalka si aad aqoonsigaada u caddeyso.
en: After submitting the application, you must visit a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service to prove your identity.

so: Horay u sii qaado aqoonsigaada iyo lifaaqyada asalka ah ee codsigaada.
en: Bring your identification and the original copies of the application appendices.

so: Waxaa wanaagsan in Hay'adda socdaalka ballan horay looga sii qabsado.
en: You should book an appointment in advance to visit the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Ballanta waxaad ka qabsan kartaa adeegga ballanta waqtiga ee Hay'adda socdaalka.
en: You can book the appointment in the electronic appointment booking service of the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Haddii aad codsiga ka sameysay shabakadda, xusuusnow in aad si joogto ah u fiiriso akoonkaada Enter Finland.
en: If you submitted your application online, remember to check your Enter Finland account regularly.

so: Haddii codsigaada looga baahdo caddeyn dheeraad ah waxaa laguugu soo sheegayaa akoonkaada Enter Finland.
en: If further clarifications are needed, you will be informed through your Enter Finland account.

so: Haddii aadan awoodin ama aadan aqoon sida codsiga looga sameeyo shabakadda, waxaad foomka codsiga ee warqadda ah uga codsan kartaa ruqsadda goobta adeegga ee Hay'adda socdaalka.
en: If you are unable to apply online, you can also apply using a paper form at a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Bogagga shabakadda ee Hay'adda socdaalka ayaad ka daabacan kartaa foomka codsiga.
en: You can print out the form from the Finnish Immigration Service website.

so: Ballan ka qabso goobta adeegga horayna u sii qaado codsiga oo aad buuxisay, lifaaqyada iyo aqoonsigaada.
en: Make an appointment for the service point, and bring the filled-in application form, the appendices and your identification.

so: Ka baaraandegista ruqsaddu waa lacag.
en: Processing the permit application is subject to a fee.

so: Waa in lacagta la bixiyaa marka ruqsadda la codsanayo.
en: You must pay the fee when applying for the permit.

so: Adeegga Enter Finland ayaad lacagta ku bixin kartaa adigoo isticmaalaya aqoonsiga shabakadda ee bangi Finnish ah ama kaarka amaah-iibsiga.
en: In the Enter Finland service, you can pay with the online banking credentials of a Finnish bank or with a credit card.

so: Shaqo sameynta ayaa waxay qeyb ahaan xuquuq kuu siin kartaa ammaanka bulshada.
en: Working may give you a partial right to Finnish social security.

so: Haddii aad heysato ogolaanshaha joogtada ah ee waqtigeedu cayiman yahay (Ogolaansha A ama B) sababtii joogistaada Finlandina ay isbedeshay, waa inaad sababo kale dartood ku codsataa ogolaanshaha joogista.
en: If you have a fixed-term residence permit (A or B permit) and the reason for your stay in Finland changes, you must apply for a new residence permit on new grounds.

so: Haddii aad heysato ogolaanshaha joogista joogtada ah uma baahnid inaad codsataa ogolaanshaha sababta joogistaadi haddii ay xitaa isbedeshay.
en: If you have a permanent residence permit (P) in Finland, you do not need to change the grounds for your permit even when the reason for your stay changes.

so: Ogolaanshaha joogista waxaad ku codsan kartaa sababaha soo socda dartood:
en: A residence permit can be applied for on one of the following grounds:

so: Waxaa wannaagsan in la xusuustaa in sababaha joogistaada Finland ay saameyn ku yeelan karaan xuquuqda aad Finland ku leedahay.
en: You should bear in mind that the grounds for a residence permit can affect your rights in Finland.

so: Tusaale ahaan ogolaanshaha joogista ee xiriir qoys waxaa ku jira xaq u lahaansho shaqo oo ka ballaaran ogolaanshaha joogista ee sababo waxbarasho lagu ogolaaday.
en: For example, a residence permit granted based on a family tie includes a more extensive right to work than a permit granted based on studies.

so: Sideen ogolaanshaha joogista ku meelgaarka ah ugu bedeli karaa ogolaansho sii-socda?
en: How to change a temporary residence permit into a continuous one?

so: Haddii aad heysato ogolaashaha joogista ee ku meelgaarka ah (ogolaanshaha B) waxaad codsan kartaa ogolaanshaha sii-socda (ogolaanshaha A) haddii sababta joogistaada Finland ay iska bedesho ku meelgaarnimadi isuna bedesho joogto.
en: If you have a temporary residence permit (B permit), you can apply for a continuous permit (A permit) if the reason for your stay in Finland changes from temporary to continuous.

so: Haddii aad heysato ogolaanshaha joogista ee ku meelgaarka ah oo aad ku heshay xiriir qoys waxaad codsan kartaa ogolaansha sii-socda marka ay xubnaha qoyskaadu codsanayaa ogolaanshaha sii-socda.
en: If you have been granted a temporary residence permit based on a family tie, you can apply for a continuous residence permit when the family member in question applies for one.

so: Sababo kale ayaad ku codsan kartaa ogolaansha joogista sii-socota haddii sababtu tahay mid ah sii-socota.
en: You can also apply for a continuous permit on other grounds if they are continuous.

so: Haddii aad heysato ogolaansho ku meelgaar ah oo aad ku heshay sababo waxbarasho waxaad heli kartaa ogolaanshaha joogista sii-socoda haddii sababtii aad Finland ku joogtay ay isbedesho oo kaliya.
en: If you have a temporary residence permit based on studies, you can only receive a continuous permit if the basis for your stay in Finland changes.

so: Waxbarasho darteed laguma heli karo ogolaanshaha sii-socda.
en: It is not possible to obtain a continuous permit based on studies.

so: Sababta joogistaada Finland waxay bedelmi kartaa marka aad Finland shaqo ka hesho ama aad ku guursato qofka u dhashay Finland ama qof heysta ogolaanshaha joogista Finland ee joogtada ah.
en: The grounds for your stay can change, for example, if you obtain a job in Finland or marry a Finnish citizen or a person with a permanent or continuous residence permit for Finland.

so: Haddii aad heysato ogolaanshaha joogista ee ku meelgaarka ah oo aad ku qaaday shaqo ama shirkad aad leedahay darteed waxaad codsan kartaa joogista sii-socota marka aad Finland joogto laba sano oo xiriir ah.
en: If you have a temporary residence permit for the purpose of working or entrepreneurial activities, you can apply for a continuous residence permit when you have resided in Finland for a continuous period of two years.

so: Sideen sababo cusub ugu codsan karaa ogolaanshaha joogista?
en: How do I apply for residence permit on new grounds?

so: Dooro foomka codsiga oo ku haboon, hadba sababta aad u dalbaneysid ruqsada cusub.
en: Choose the application form based on the grounds under which you are applying for a new permit.

so: Codsiga ku reeb adeegga enternetka ee Enter Finland ama barta adeegga Xaafiiska dal u soo guurista.
en: Submit your application online in the Enter Finland service or at a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Wixii faah faahin dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Ogolaanshaha sii-socda.
en: You can find more information about applying on the InfoFinland page Residence permit extension.

so: Arday shaqaale isu bedelay
en: From a student to an employee

so: Haddii waxbarashadaada aad ku dhameysatay Finland waxaad heli kartaa ogolaanshaha joogista, shaqo raadsasho darteed.
en: If you have completed a degree in Finland, you can receive a residence permit for job application.

so: Marka aad waxbarashadaada dhameysato, ogolaanshihii joogista ee waxbarashaduna uu kaa dhamaaday waxaad codsan kartaa shaqo raadin darteed ogolaansha sii-socda (jatkolupa).
en: Once you complete your studies and your student residence permit ends, you can apply for a permit extension (jatkolupa) for job application.

so: Ogolaanshaha waxaad heli kartaa hal mar, dibna looma cusbooneysiin karo.
en: The permit can only be granted once and cannot be renewed.

so: Marka aad shaqo hesho waxaad codsan kartaa ogolaanshaha joogista sabab shaqo darteed.
en: Once you find a job, you can apply for a residence permit based on employment.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin u dhashay dal Waqooyiga Yurub ah, Midowga Yurub, ETA ama Switzerland islamarkaasna aad shaqo ama ama ganacsade u timid Finland, waa in aad diiwaangelisaa xuquuqdaada joogitaanka.
en: If you are a citizen of a Nordic country, EU member state, EEA member state or Switzerland and you come to work or to engage in entrepreneurship in Finland, you must register your right of residence.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Muwaadiniinta Midowga Yurub.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page EU-citizens.

so: Haddii aad soonaha Midowga Yurub Finland shaqo darteed ugu soo guurto ama wadan ka mid ah wadamada ETA ama Switzerland, waxaad inta badan qeyb ahaan geleysaa xeyndaabka ammaanka bulshad Finland, marka aad heysato heshiis waqti gaaban.
en: If you are moving to Finland for work from within the European Union, an EEA country or Switzerland, you are normally entitled to partial coverage by Finnish social security, even when you have a short employment contract.

so: Haddii aadan Finland si joogto ah ugu soo guurin, waxaad si kastoo ay ahaataba aad qeyb ahaan geli kartaa xeyndaabka ammaanka bulshada Finland inta aad shaqeyneyso, shuruuddu waa uun in waqtiga shaqadaada iyo mushaaraadkaadu ay ahaadaan kuwa kugu filan.
en: Even if you are not moving to Finland permanently, you can, in some cases, be entitled to partial coverage by Finnish social security for the duration of your employment. The requirement is that your working hours and salary are sufficient.

so: Waa muhiim in aad cusboonaysiisataa sharciga dagganaanshaha intuuna kaa dhicin kiii hore.
en: It is important that you apply for a residence permit extension before the expiry of your previous residence permit.

so: Haddii sharcigaagu uu kaa dhaco adiga oo laguu falanqaynayo dalabkaaga, waxa kuu banaan inaad ku noolaato sida caadiga ahna ad ka shaqaysato wadanka inta falanqayntu kuu socoto.
en: If your previous residence permit expires during the application's processing, you are allowed to reside in Finland. Normally, you also have the right to work when your application is being processed.
