so: Haddii ad dalbato cusboonaysiinta sharcigaaga daganaanshaha adigoo kaagii hore kaa dhacayba, waxa kuu bannaan inaad dalka joogto laakiin kuuma banaana inaad dalka ka shaqaysato illaa ad hesho sharciga la cusboonaysiiyay.
en: If you apply for a residence permit extension only after your previous permit has expired, you are allowed to reside in Finland during the application's processing but you are not allowed to work before you get a new residence permit.

so: Shabakadda adeegga Enter Finland ayaad ku codsan kartaa ogolaanshaha.
en: You can apply for a permit online through the Enter Finland service.

so: Waa in aad tagtaa goobta adeegga saddex bilood gudohood laga soo billaabo marki aad codsiga sameysay.
en: You must visit a service point within three months of submitting the application.

so: Sii qaado baasaboor, sawir baasaboor iyo asalka dukumentiyada aad ku lifaaqday codsigaada.
en: Bring your passport, a passport photo and the original copies of the application appendices.

so: Haddii aad codsigaada ka sameysatay shabakadda, xusuusnow in aad joogto u kormeerto akoonka aad ku leedahay Enter Finland.
en: If you submitted your application online, remember to check your Enter Finland account regularly. If further clarifications are needed, you will be informed through your account.

so: Ka daabaco foomka bogagga shabakadda ee Hay'adda Socdaalka kaddibna buuxi foomka.
en: Print out the form from the Finnish Immigration Service website and fill it in.

so: Ballan ka qabso goobta adeegga.
en: Make an appointment for the service point.

so: Marka aad aadeyso goobta adeegga horay u sii qaado codsiga aad buuxisay, lifaaqyada, iyo nuqulka lifaaqyada, baasaboor iyo sawir baasaboor.
en: When you go to the service point, bring a filled-in application form, the appendices and copies of the appendices, your passport and a passport photo.

so: Hay'adda Socdaalku waxey kuu oggolaanaysaa sharciga cusboonaysiintiisa haddii sababtii d ku heshay sharcigii hore ay wali sidii u jirto.
en: The Finnish Immigration Service will grant you a residence permit extension if the grounds on which you received your first permit are still valid.

so: Sharciga cusub waxa kuu bannaan xataa in aad ku dalbato sabab ka duwan tii hore ee ad sharcigii hore ku dalbatay.
en: You can also apply for a residence permit extension on different grounds to the first permit.

so: Falanqaynta dalabka sharcigu waa lacag. Lacagta waa in la bixiyaa wakhtiga la doonanayo sharciga.
en: The processing of the permit application is subject to a charge, which must be paid upon applying for a permit.

so: Finlad waxay ka tirsan tahay wadamada Aagga Schengen.
en: Finland is a part of the Schengen area.

so: Wadamada ka tirsan aagga Schengen waxay leeyihiin shuruudo isku mid ah oo ah xagga codsiga fiisooyinka, dadka doonaya inay Finland safar gaaban ku yimaadaan, tusaale ahaan safarka fasaxa, safar ganacsi ama u soo booqdaan saaxiibo ama qaraabo, waxay u baahan yihiin fiiso, haddii aysan ahayn muwaadiniin u dhashay wadamada aan fiisada looga baahnayn.
en: Countries belonging to the Schengen area have analogous visa requirements. Foreigners who want to travel to Finland for a short period of time, for example, to take a holiday, make a business trip or visit their relatives, will need a visa unless they are citizens of a visa-exempt country.

so: Fiisadu waa ruqso dal kugal ah oo gaaban ama daganaansho ku meel gaar ah, taasoo ugu badnaan shaqaynaysa saddex bilood.
en: A visa is an entry permit for a short-term and temporary stay, lasting no more than three months.

so: Waxaad ka hubin kartaa shabakada internetka ee wasaarada arrimaha dibada ama safaarada kuugu dhaw ee Finland, inaad fiiso ugu baahan tahay soonaha Schengen.
en: You can visit the website of the Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Finland or a Finnish Diplomatic Mission nearest to you, to find out whether you need a visa to travel to Finland or another country in the Schengen area.

so: Macluumaad loogu talagalay dadka aan dal ku galka u baahneyn
en: Information for persons who are exempt from the visa requirement

so: Waxaad u soo safri kartaa Finland iyo wadamada kale ee Schengen, haddii aad leedahay baasaboor aan dhacsanayn ama waraaqo kale oo safar oo Finland laga aqoonsan yahay .
en: You can travel to Finland or another Schengen country if you have a valid passport or another travel document approved by the Finnish authorities.

so: Waxaad ku noolaan kartaa Finland iyo wadamada kale ee Schengen ugu badnaan saddex bilood mudo lix bilood gudahooda, oo ka bilaabanaysa maalinta aad timid soonaha Schengen.
en: You can stay in Finland or another country in the Schengen area for no longer than three months within a six month period, beginning from the day you arrive in the Schengen area.

so: Macluumaad loogu talagalay dadka dal ku gal laga doonayo
en: Information for persons who are required to carry a visa

so: Waa inaad mar walba haysataa fiiso, markii aad soo galaysid Finland ama wadamada kale ee Schengen.
en: You must always have a visa when arriving in Finland or another country in the Schengen area.

so: Waxaad daganaan kartaa ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka la'aantiis Finland ama wadamada kale Schengen inta fiisadaadu ay shaqaynayso.
en: You can stay in Finland or another country in the Schengen area without a residence permit for the length of your visa's validity.

so: Haddii aad haysatid fiiso ama daganaanshada wadan kale oo Schengen ka tirsan, waxaad ku safri kartaa wadamada kale oo Schengen dhexdooda, adigoon dalbanayn wax fiiso ah oo kale.
en: If you have a visa or residence permit for a Schengen country, you can travel within the Schengen area without a separate visa for the other countries in the area.

so: Sidan ayaad u codsaneysaa dal ku galka Schengen
en: How to apply for a Schengen visa

so: Fiisada ka codso safaarada Finniska ama xarunta fiisooyinka ee kuugu dhaw.
en: Apply for a visa at the nearest Finnish Diplomatic Mission or visa application centre.

so: Waa inaad si sharci ahaan ah ugu u degantahy wadanka ay ku taalo saafada aad safaarada aa fiisada ka dalbanaysid.
en: You must be legally residing in the country in which you are applying for a visa.

so: Wadama aysan safaarada Finland ku oolin waxaa laga yaabaa in wadan kale uu waliil uga yahay Finland arimaha fiisooyinka.
en: In countries that do not have a Finnish Diplomatic Mission, another country can represent Finland in matters regarding visas.

so: Markaas waxaad fiisada ka codsanaysaa safaarada wadanka wakiilka u ah Finland.
en: In this case, you can apply for a visa at a Diplomatic Mission of this country.

so: Bogga internetka ee wasaarada arimaha dibada ayaa laga helikaraa liiska wadamada Finland ay wakiilka uga yihiin wadamada kale xagga arimaha fiisooyinka.
en: The website of the Finnish Ministry of Foreign Affairs hosts a list of the countries in which another country represents Finland in matters regarding visas.

so: Fiisada waa inaad ku dalbataa foomka codsiga fiisooyinka.
en: The visa must be applied for using the visa application form.

so: Foomamka waxaa laga heli karaa shabakada internetka ee wasaarada arrimaha dibada Finland iyo safaaradaha wadamada Schengen.
en: These forms are available on the website of the Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Finland and the Diplomatic Missions of Schengen countries.

so: Waxaa laga yaabaa inay is bedbadalaan cadadda lifaaqyada looga baahan yahay codsiga fiisada, taasina waxay ku xiran tahay hadba wadanka aad fiisada ka codsanaysid.
en: The number of enclosures required for the visa application may vary depending on the country of application.

so: Safaaradda ayaad ka hubin kartaa lifaaqyada looga baahan yahay foomkaaga codsiga fiisada.
en: You can ask what enclosures are required for your visa application at a Diplomatic Mission.

so: Codsiga waa in la geeyaa safaaradda Finland ama xarunta viisooyinka ee markaas aad ka codsaneyso dal ku galka.
en: The application must be submitted to the Finnish Diplomatic Mission or visa application centre at which you apply for the visa.

so: Booliska ayaa dheerayn kara waqtiga fiisadaada ama waqtiga ay shaqaynayso fiisadu, haddii aad sababo la aqbali karo awgood wadanka Finland uga bixi wayday markii ay fiisadaadu dhacaysay.
en: The police may extend the residence time marked in your visa or the visa's validity, if you are unable to leave Finland for a justifiable reason when your visa expires.

so: Sababaha la aqbali karo oo fiisada laguugu dheerayn karo waxaa ka mid ah tusaale ahaan:
en: Justifiable reasons for a visa extension include, for example:

so: xanuun khatar ah oo kadis ah, oo kaa hor istaaga safarka
en: unexpected serious illness that prevents travelling

so: Qof qaraabadaada ah oo Finland dagan oo si kadis ah xanuun halis ah ku dhaco ama geeriyooda
en: the unexpected serious illness or death of a relative living in Finland

so: in la tirtiro duulimaadkii shaqo joojin ama cimilada awgeed
en: cancellation of a flight due to a strike or bad weather

so: inay wadahadalo ganacsi oo muhiim ah sii socdaan waqti ka dheer waqtigii lagu talo galay
en: the continuation of important business negotiations for a longer period than expected

so: Macluumaad Caawimada xaalada gargaarka deg-dega
en: Help in case of an emergency

so: Wakiilada ajnabiga ayaa caawiya muwaadiniintooda xaalad degdeg ku gala Finland.
en: Diplomatic missions aid the citizens of their countries who encounter emergencies in Finland.

so: Waxay ku caawin karaa adiga tusaale ahaan haddii aad shil gasho, jirato ama aad dhibbane dembi noqoto.
en: They can assist you if you are involved in an accident, succumb to an illness or fall victim to an offence, for example.

so: Wakiilka ama safaaraddu waxay ku siin kartaa baasaboor cusub haddii baasaboorka lagaa xaday ama uu kaa lumay.
en: A mission can provide you with a new passport if you have lost your passport or if it has been stolen.

so: Haddii Finland safar ku joogto islamarkaasna aad xaalad adag gasho, la xiiir wakiilka wadankaada.
en: If you are in Finland as a tourist and you encounter a difficult situation, contact your country's diplomatic mission.

so: Haddii aad doonaysid inaad Finland u soo qaadato xayawaan gurijoog ah, waa inaad horay u sii ogaataa sharciyada la xiriira keenida xayawaanada.
en: If you want to bring a pet with you to Finland, you should find out beforehand about the rules for importing animals.

so: Inta badan xayawaananada waxaa laga rabaa tusaale ahaan talaalo la cayimay.
en: Often certain vaccinations, for example, are required for animals.

so: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah ee la xiriira shucuucda keenista xayawaanada dalka Finland, waxaad ka helaysaa Hay'adda nababgalyada cuntooyinka Evira.
en: The Finnish Food Safety Authority Evira provides more information about the rules applicable in Finland.

so: Marka ugu horeysa eed codsaneyso sharciga degenaansha Finland ama xaqa diiwaangelinta muwaadinka Midowga Yurub waxaad sidoo kale codsan kartaa summada aqoonsi ee finnishka.
en: When you apply for your first residence permit in Finland or registration of an EU citizen's right of residence, you can apply for a Finnish personal identity code at the same time.

so: Summada aqoonsi waxaad sidoo kale ka codsan kartaa xafiiska diiwaangelinta (maistraatti) ee degmadaada ama xafiiska canshuuraha.
en: You can also apply for a Finnish personal identity code at the Local Register Office or tax office of your place of residence in Finland.

so: Faahfaahin dheeriya waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Isu diiwaangelin degene.
en: Further information is available on the InfoFinland page Registering as a resident.

so: Waxaad xaq u yeelan kartaa in lagugu caymiyo bulshada Finland, haddaad tahay qof ka shaqeeya Finland.
en: If you work in Finland, you may also be entitled to Finnish social security.

so: Ammaanka bulshada si kastoo ay ahaataba waxaa saameyn ku leh arrimo kale, tusaale ahaan wadanka aad ka timid.
en: Other things also play a role in whether or not you are entitled to social security, for example your country of origin.

so: Ad daggantahay Finland ugu yaraan afar sano adiga oo ku dagan sharciga
en: you have lived in Finland at least four years with an A permit, and

so: Haddii aad fir ahaan ka soo jeedid Finniska ama xiriir qaraabonimo oo dhaw la leedahay Finnishka, ayadoo kuwaas laguu tixgelinayo waxaad Finland ka heli kartaa ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka.
en: If you have Finnish ancestry or a close connection with Finland, you may be granted a residence permit in Finland on this basis.

so: Markaas waxaa tahay dib u soo guure (paluumuuttaja).
en: This means that you are considered a returnee (paluumuuttaja).

so: Helitaanka ruqsada daganaanshada waxaa saamayn ku leh, sida ay yihiin xooga iyo dhawaanshada qaraabonimo ee aad Finland ku leedahay.
en: Receiving a residence permit depends on the directness and closeness of your Finnish ancestry.

so: Helitaanka ruqsada loogama baahna sababo kale, sida tusaale ahaan shaqo ama waxbarasho.
en: No other reason, such as work or study, is required in order to receive the permit.

so: Dadka aan waligood noqon muwaadiniin Finnish ah, laakiin waalidkood ama awoowayaashood ay yihiin ama ahaayeen dhalasho ahaan muwaadiniin Finnish ah, waxaa loo arkaa inay yihiin dad asal ahaan Finnish ah oo dib u soo guuraya (paluumuuttaja).
en: Persons who themselves have never been Finnish citizens but whose parent or grandparent is or has been a native Finnish citizen, are considered returnees (paluumuuttaja) of Finnish origin.

so: Sidoo kale dadka markii hore dhalashada Finnishka haystay waxaa loo arkaa dib u soo guureyaal.
en: Former Finnish citizens are also considered returnees.

so: Faracyada muwaadiniinta u dhashay Finland
en: Descendants of native Finnish citizens

so: Waxaad heli kartaa daganaanshaha Finland, haddii ugu yaraan mid ka mid ah waalidiintaada ama awooweyaashaa/ayeeyooyinkaa ay yihiin ama ahaayeen asal ahaan muwaadiniin Finnish ah.
en: You can obtain a residence permit in Finland if at least one of your parents or grandparents is or has been a native Finnish citizen.

so: Muwaadin u dhashay Finland waxaa loola jeeda qofka helay jinsiyadda Finland markii uu dhashay.
en: A native Finnish citizen is a person who has received Finnish citizenship at birth.

so: Markii aad codsanaysid sharciga waa inaad bixisaa macluumaad sax ah oo cadaynaya inaad farac ku leeday asal ahaan dalka Finnishka, sida tusaale ahaan shahaadada dhalashada rasmiga ah ee waalidiinta ama awooweyaashaa/ayeeyoyaashaa iyo cadayn sheegaysa inaad ehel tihiin.
en: When applying, you must give a reliable report of your origin, such as your parent's or grandparent's original birth certificate and a certificate which proves that you are related.

so: Lagaagama baahna cadaynta dhaqaalaha.
en: You are not required to present a report on your livelihood.

so: Haddii aad ahaan jirtay muwaadin Finnish ah, sababtaa darteed waxaad ku heli kartaa Daganaanshada Dalka Finland.
en: If you are a former Finnish citizen, you can obtain a residence permit in Finland on this basis.

so: Shardi ma aha in asalkaagii Finnish ahaa, laakiin waxaad dhalashada Finniska ku heli kartay codsi.
en: You are not required to be a Finnish citizen by birth; instead, you may have obtained Finnish citizenship by application.

so: Haddii aad ahaan jirtay muwaadin Finnish ah, waxaad dib u heli kartaa dhalashadaadii adigoo samaynaya ogeysiiska dhalashada (kansalaisuusilmoitus).
en: If you are a former Finnish citizen, you can regain your Finnish citizenship by submitting an application for Finnish citizenship or a declaration of Finnish citizenship (kansalaisuusilmoitus).

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Dhalashada Finland.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland web page Finnish citizenship.

so: Waad ka soo codsan kartaa sharciga degenaanshaha safaarada Finland ee kuugu dhow intaadan imaan wadanka.
en: You can apply for a residence permit either abroad before arriving in Finland or when already in Finland.

so: Finland dhexdeeeda waxaad ka codsan kartaa barta adeegga ee Xaafiiska dal u soo guurista.
en: In Finland, you can apply for a permit at a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Waa inaad shaqsiyan u tagtaa goobta aad geysaneyso codsiga sharciga degenaanshaha.
en: You must submit your residence permit application in person.

so: Horey u soo qaado wax walboo lifaaq ood ku dareyso codsigaaga asliyan, markii aad codsigaaga geyneyso safaarada ama barta adeegga ee Xaafiiska dal u soo guurista.
en: Take the originals of the required attachments to the application with you when you go to the mission or a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Markaad codsaneydo sharciga degenaanshaha waa inaad horey usoo qaadato aqoonsi baasaboor cadeynaya ruuxaad tahay.
en: When applying for a residence permit, you must bring along your passport as proof of identity.

so: Markaad sharciga codsaneysana waxaa lagaa qaadaya astaanta faraha iyo biometerka lagu sameynayo kaarka sharciga.
en: When applying for the permit, your fingerprints will be taken for a biometric residence permit card.

so: Codsiga sharciga degenaanshaa waa lacag, lacagtana waa inaad dhiibtaa markaad dhiibeyso codsiga sharciga.
en: Processing of a residence permit application is subject to a fee. You must pay this fee when you submit your application.

so: Bogan waxaad ka heleysaa xog qaxootiga lasoo qaato.
en: This page provides information for quota refugees.

so: Xog la xiriirta codsshada magangelyada bogga InfoFinlandi Ku imaanshaha Finland magangalyodoonimo.
en: You can find information on applying for asylum on the InfoFinland page Coming to Finland as an asylum seeker.

so: Finland waxay qaxooti ahaan u soo qaadaa dadka ku jira hay'ada qaxootinimada Qaramada Midoobey UNCHR ay u aragtey inuu yahay qaxooti.
en: As quota refugees, Finland accepts persons who are considered refugees by the UN Refugee Agency UNHCR.

so: Masuuliyiinta finnishka ayaa wareysanaya qaxootigaas. Wareysigaas ayaana lagu go'aaminayaa cidey markaas soo qaadaneyso.
en: The Finnish authorities interview the refugees proposed by the UNHCR and, on the basis of these interviews, select the persons who will be admitted to Finland.

so: Wareysigana waxaa lagu qadaa xeryaha qaxootiga ee uu markaas qaxootigu joogo ama goobaha UNCHR ka.
en: Such interviews are performed in the refugees' countries of residence, usually in refugee camps or the UNHCR's premises.

so: Waxaad xog badan oo la xiriirta qaxootiga la keeno iyo nolosha Finland ka heleysaa bogga movingtofinland.fi
en: The Movingtofinland.fi website provides a range of information for quota refugees on moving to and living in Finland.

so: Laanqeyrta case e Finland (SPR) ayaa caawisa markii qaxootiga loosoo qaato Finland.
en: The Finnish Red Cross helps quota refugees who move to Finland.

so: Markii qaxootigu yimaado Finland shaqaalaha laanqeyrta cas ayaa uga hortaga garoonka diyaarada oo ku qaabila halkaas.
en: When refugees arrive in Finland, a Red Cross worker will meet them at the airport.

so: Shaqaalaha iskaa wax uqabso ee laanqeyrta cas ayaa ka caawiya qaxootiga sidey ula qabsan lahaayeen uguna naggaan lahaayeen Finland.
en: Red Cross volunteer workers also help refugees in settling down and integrating into Finnish society.

so: Qaxootiga waxay kaalmo iyo caawimoba weydiisan karaan su'aalaha la xiriira dastuurka Pakolaisneuvonta ry ama xafiiska qareemada dadweynaha.
en: Refugees can find help and guidance on legal issues from sources of information such as the Refugee Advice Centre (Pakolaisneuvonta ry) or Legal Aid Offices (oikeusaputoimisto).

so: Hay'adaas waxay Finland ka qabataa wargelin, cashiro iyo howlaha arrimaha bulshadda.
en: This organisation performs communications, educational and social work in Finland.

so: Pakalaisapu waxay ka caawisaa qaxootiga iyo ajaaniibta tusaale ahaan u fududeynta la qabsiga wadanka, degenaansha iyo qorsheynta aasaasitaanka urrurada wixii la xiriira.
en: The Refugee Council helps refugees and immigrants with issues such as integration, housing and founding their own organisations.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi Qaxooti waxaad ka heleysaa xog dheeri ah oo loogu talogaley qaxootiga.
en: You can find more information for refugees on the InfoFinland page Refugee.

so: Marka aad usoo guurto Finland, waa in aad aadaa xafiiska diiwaan gelinta (maistraatti).
en: When you have moved to Finland, you must visit the Local Register Office (maistraatti) of your place of residence.

so: Kahor inta aadan imaanin xafiiska diiwaangelinta, waxaad buuxinta kartaa ogeysiiska diiwaangelinta oo laga helo bogagga maistraatti.fi.
en: Before visiting the Local Register Office, you can fill in the registration form on the maistraatti.fi website.

so: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta waxaad sidoo kale ka heli kartaa haddii aad shuruudaha buuxiso sumadda aqoonsiga Finnishka, haddii aadan helin marki lagu siinayay ogolaanshaha joogitaanka dalka ama marki Xafiiska dal u soo guurista laga diiwaangelinayay xuquuqdaada joogitaanka ee muwaadinka Midowga Yurub.
en: When certain conditions are met, you can also receive a Finnish personal identity code from the Local Register Office if you did not receive one when you were granted a residence permit or when your EU citizen's right of residence was registered at the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Haddii aad shaqada darteed u baahantahay sumadda aqoonsiga, waxaad xittaa sumadda aqoonsiga ka heli kartaa xafiiska canshuurta.
en: If you need a personal identity code for work, you can get a personal identity code from a tax office as well.

so: Aqoonsi kale oo ay ka muuqato jinsiyadaada (haddii aad tahay muwaadin u dhashay wadamada EU-da ama muwaadiniinta wuqooyiga Yurub)
en: other identity document indicating your citizenship (if you are a citizen of an EU country or the Nordic countries)

so: Shahaadada guurka la sharciyeeyay (haddii aad guursatay)
en: a legalised marriage certificate (if you are married),

so: Shahaadooyinka dhalasho ee caruurta la sharciyeeyay (haddii aad leedahay caruur ka yar da'da 18-ka sano)
en: children's legalised birth certificates (if you have children who are under 18 moving to Finland),

so: Sharciga degenaanshaha (haddii aad u baahan tahay sharciga degenaanshaha Finland)
en: a residence permit (if you need a residence permit for Finland),

so: Shahaadada diiwaangelinta deegaanka ee muwaadiniinta EU (haddii aad tahay muwaadin EU ah iyo haddii aad u baahantahay diiwaangelin)
en: certificate of registration of an EU citizen's right to reside (if you are an EU citizen and you need registration),

so: Heshiiska shaqada, haddii ama shahaadada waxbarashada (haddii aadan heysan diiwaangelinta xaqa joogitaanka ee muwaadinka Midowga Yurub)
en: a contract of employment or a certificate of studies (unless you have registered your EU citizen's right to reside)

so: Ogsoonoow waa in dokumiintiyada ajnabiga ah ay yihiin kuwa sharci ah si looga tixraaco diiwaangelintaada tirakoobka bulshada.
en: Please note that any documents brought from abroad must be legalised in order for personal data based on them to be entered into the Population Information System.

so: Dokumiintiyada waa in soo kale loo tarjumaa luuqadda Finnish-ka, Swedish-ka ama luugadda English-ka, haddii ay yihiin kuwa luuqad kale ku qoran.
en: Documents must also be translated into Finnish, Swedish or English if they are in some other language.

so: Haddii aad u baahantahay macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan sharcinimada dukumentiyada, la xiriir xafiiska diiwaangelinta ama wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda ee dalkaada.
en: For further information on the legalisation of documents, please contact the Local Register Office or the Ministry for Foreign Affairs of your own country.

so: Sumadda aqoonsiga (henkilötunnus) waa taxane dheer oo ka kooban 11 nambar kaaso o isugu jira taariikhda dhalashadaada iyo jinsigaaga.
en: A personal identity code (henkilötunnus) is a number sequence with 11 characters, formed on the basis of your date of birth and gender.

so: Si aad u heshid sumadda qoonsiga finnishka, macluumaadkaada waa in laga diiwaangeliyaa hay'adda tirakoobka bulshada.
en: To obtain a Finnish personal identity code, you must register your data in the Finnish Population Information System.

so: Waxaa loola jeedaa in macluumaadkaada aasaasiga ah la gelinayo tirakoobka bulshada.
en: This means that any basic information on you must be entered in the Population Information System.

so: Macluumaadkaasi waxaa ka mid ah tusaale ahaan magaca, waqtiga dhalashada, jinsiyadaada dhalasho, jinsiga, iyo cinwaanka.
en: Such information includes your name, date of birth, citizenship, gender and address.

so: Marka aad dalbaneysid sharciga degenaanshaha, waxaad isla markaasi dalban kartaa sumadda aqoonsiga marka aad dalbaneysid diiwaangelinta xaq-u-yeelashada degenaanshaha.
en: When you apply for a residence permit, you can apply for a Finnish personal identity code at the same time. In such a case, in your residence permit application you should request registration in the Finnish Population Information System.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin Midowga Yurub ah, waxaad sumadda aqoonsiga codsan kartaa islamarka aad codsaneyso diiwaangelinta xaqaada joogitaanka.
en: If you are an EU citizen, you can apply for a personal identity code at the same time as applying for registration of your right of residence.

so: Foomka diiwaangelinta waxaa ku taala bar taas oo aad ku codsan karto in macluumaadkaada laga diiwaan geliyo hay'adda tirakoobka bulshada.
en: You can request registration in the Finnish Population Information System by ticking the appropriate box on the registration form.

so: Caawimaadda sharciga ee magangalyodoonka
en: Legal assistance for asylum seeker

so: Xaqa shaqo sameynta ee magalgalyodoonka
en: Asylum seeker's right to work

so: Finland waxaad ka codsan kartaa magangalyo haddii aad heysato sababo aad uga baqaneyso in wadankaada laguugu cadaadinayo.
en: You can apply for asylum in Finland if you have a justified reason to fear persecution in your home country.

so: Sababaha cadaadisku waxey noqon karaan asalka, diinta, jinsiyadda, ka mid ahaanshaha koox bulsheed gaar ah ama aragti siyaasadeed.
en: Reasons for the persecution can include origin, religion, nationality, membership of a particular social group or political opinions.

so: Xafiiska dal u soo guurista ayaa baaraya in magangalyada sabab loo heysto go'aanna ka gaareysa.
en: The Finnish Immigration Service investigates whether there are grounds for asylum and makes the decision.

so: Naftaada oo kaliya ayaad magangalyo u codsan kartaa.
en: You can only apply for asylum for yourself.

so: Finland waxaad magangalyo uga codsan kartaa soonaha dowladda Finland dhexdeeda oo kaliya.
en: You can apply for asylum in Finland only inside Finnish borders.

so: Ma jiro foom gaar ah oo loogu talagalay codsashada magangalyada, kaas oo aad horay u sii buuxin karto.
en: There is not a special asylum application form that you can submit in advance.

so: Marka aad timaado Finland ogeysii sarkaalka ilaalada xuduudaha ama booliska in aad dooneyso in aad codsaneyso magangalyo.
en: When you arrive in Finland, immediately tell the border control authority or police that you want to seek asylum.

so: Sarkaalka ilaalada xuduudaha ama booliska ayaa kuu diiwaangelinaya in aad tahay magangalyodoon, qoraya macluumaadkaada aasaasiga ah kaddibna raadka faraha kaa qaadaya.
en: The border control authority or police will register you as an asylum seeker, record your basic information and take your fingerprints.

so: Marka uu sarkaalku kaa qaabilo codsigaada magangalyada, waxaa laguugu hagayaa xarunta qaabilaadda.
en: Once an official has received your asylum application, you will be taken to a reception centre.

so: Halkaas waxaad deganaan kartaa inta uu Xafiiska dal u soo guuristu ka baaraandegayo codsigaada.
en: You can live there while the Immigration Service processes your application.

so: Waxaad deganaan kartaa xittaa meel kale oo aan aheyn xarunta qaabilaadda, laakiin markaas adiga ayaa kharashka deegaanka iska bixinaya.
en: You can also live somewhere other than at the reception centre but you must pay for your housing yourself.

so: Soonaha wadamada Midowga Yurub (iyo Switzerland, Norway, Iceland iyo Liechtenstein), magangalyada waa in laga codsadaa isla dowladda marka ugu horeysa soonaheeda la soo galo.
en: In EU countries (and Switzerland, Norway, Iceland and Liechtenstein), you must apply for asylum in the first country that you enter.

so: Haddii aad magangalyo ka codsatay ama aad joogtay wadan ku yaal Midowga Yurub (ama Switzerland, Norway, Iceland iyo Liechtenstein), kahor inta aadan imaanin Finland, codsigaada loogama baaraandegayo Finland.
en: If you applied for asylum or resided in another EU country (or Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein) before coming to Finland, your application will not be processed in Finland.

so: Xaaladdaas marka ay jirto waxaa dib laguugu celinayaa wadanki aad joogtay ka hor inta aandan imaanin Finland.
en: Instead, you will be turned back to the country you were in before coming to Finland.

so: Tan waxaa loogu yeeraa nidaamka Dublin.
en: This is called the Dublin procedure.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin u dhashay wadan xubin ka ah Midowga Yurub, kama heleysid magangalyo Finland.
en: If you are a citizen of a European Union member state, you will probably not receive asylum in Finland.

so: Finland waxay wadamada Midowga Yurub dhammaantood u aragtaa kuwa nabad u ah muwaadiniintooda.
en: Finland considers all EU countries safe for their citizens.

so: Si kasaba ha ahaatee dhammaan codsiyada muwaadiniinta Midowga Yurub waa la baarayaa.
en: However, all applications of EU citizens are still investigated.

so: Bogga InfoFinland Muwaadiniinta Midowga Yurub waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad ku saabsan sida aad Finland ugu soo guuri karto sababo kale oo aan magangalyodoonnimo aheyn dartood.
en: You can find information on how to move to Finland for reasons other than as an asylum seeker on the InfoFinland page EU citizens.

so: Haddii aad tahay magangalyodoon kayar 18 sanno aadna Finland timaado mas'uul la'aan, waxaa laguu sameynayaa wakiil.
en: If you are an asylum seeker, under 18 years old and enter Finland without a parent or guardian, a representative will be appointed for you.

so: Wakiilku waa qof qaangaar ah oo aamin ah oo kaa caawinaya qabsashada arrimahaada inta ay Xafiiska dal u soo guuristu uu ka baaraandegayo codsigaada.
en: The representative is a trustworthy adult who manages your affairs while the Finnish Immigration Service processes your application.

so: Wakiilku wuu kuu raacayaa marka ay qasab tahay in aad saraakiisha dowladda la hadasho.
en: The representative comes with you when you need to speak with the authorities.

so: Wakiilku wuxuu sidoo kale baarayaa in aad qoyskaadi ku biiri karto.
en: Your representative also investigates whether you can be reunited with your family.

so: Waxaad xaq u leedahay deegaan, cunto iyo daryeel caafimaad.
en: You have a right to accommodation, food and health care.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale xaq u leedahay in aad iskuul dhigato.
en: You also have a right to go to school.

so: Xafiiska dal u soo guurista ayaa ka baaraandegaya islamarkaasna go'aan ka gaaraya codsigaada.
en: The Finnish Immigration Service will process your application and make the decision.

so: Xafiiska dal u soo guuristu wuxuu baarayaa aqoonsigaada iyo safarka aad Finland ku timid meelaha aad ku soo martay wuxuuna qiimeynayaa in aad magangalyo ka heli karto Finland iyo in kale.
en: The Finnish Immigration Service will verify your identity and the route through which you travelled to Finland and assess whether you can receive asylum in Finland.

so: Waa wax iska caadi ah in ka baaraandegista codsigu ay qaadato bilo badan.
en: It is common for the processing to take several months.

so: Marka aad magangalyo codsato, waxaad xaq u leedahay in aad joogto Finland inta ay ka baaraandegista codsigaadu qaadaneyso.
en: Once you have applied for asylum, you have the right to stay in Finland for as long as it takes to process your application.

so: Wakhtigaas dibadda uma safri kartid.
en: During that time, you cannot leave the country.

so: Haddii aad safarto, saraakiisha dowladdu waxey go'aamin karaan in codsigaadu uusan sii shaqeynayn.
en: If you leave the country, the authorities may decide that your application is no longer valid.

so: Xafiiska dal u soo guuristu wuxuu kuugu yeerayaa wareysiga magangalyada.
en: The Finnish Immigration Service will send you an invitation to an asylum interview.

so: Warqadda casuumaadda waxaa ku qoran luqada laguugu turjumayo, cinwaanka rasmiga ah ee goobta laguugu wareysanayo iyo saacadda.
en: The invitation will state the language to which the interview will be interpreted, the exact address of the interview location and the time and date of the interview.

so: Wareysiga magangalyadu (turvapaikkapuhuttelu) waa dhacdada ugu muhiimsan marka laga baaraandegayo codsigaada.
en: The asylum interview (turvapaikkapuhuttelu) is the most important event during the processing of your application.

so: Wareysiga waxaa laguugu weydiinayaa dhacdooyinki iyo sababihi aad dartood uga soo tgtay dalkaada.
en: During the interview, you will be asked about the events and reasons why you had to leave your home country.

so: Waa muhiim in aad sida ugu sugan u sheegto wixi dhacay.
en: It is important to give as much detail as possible about what happened.

so: Xafiiska dal u soo guuristu wuxuu go'aaminayaa isagoo ku saleynayaan hadalkaada, in aad Finland magangalyo ka heleyso iyo in kale.
en: Based on what you say, the Finnish Immigration Service will decide whether you will be granted asylum in Finland.

so: Waxaad xaq u leedahay magangalyodoon ahaan in aad wareysiga u isticmaasho caawiye dhinaca sharciga ah.
en: As an asylum seeker, you have the right to have a legal aid attorney in the interview.

so: Caawiyuhu wuxuu wareysiga magangalyada uga qeybqaadanayaa si waafaqsan ka fiirsashadiisa.
en: The attorney will participate in the asylum interview at their own discretion.

so: Haddii aad turjubaan u baahantahay, Xafiiska dal u soo guurista ayaa keenaya turjubaan.
en: If you need an interpreter, the Finnish Immigration Service will get one for you.

so: Maganlgayo ayaa Finland lagaa siin karaa, haddii saraakiisha dowladdu ay u arkaan in laguugu cadaadinayo dalkaada sababo dhinaca
en: You can be granted asylum in Finland if the authorities think that you will be persecuted in your home country due to

so: ka mid ahaanshaha koox bulsheed gaar ah ama
en: membership in a specific social group, or

so: Haddii aadan helin magangalyo, waxaad xaaladaha qaarkood marka aad ku jirto heli kartaa badbaadada derajada labaad.
en: If you are not granted asylum, in some cases you can be granted a residence permit based on subsidiary protection.

so: Badbaadada derajada labaad waxaad ku heli kartaa ogolaanshaha joogitaanka, haddii aad halis ugu jirto:
en: You can be granted a residence permit based on subsidiary protection if you are at risk of:

so: xukun dil ah ama toogasho;
en: death penalty or execution;

so: jirdil ama habdhaqan bani'aadminimada ka baxsan ama ciqaab; ama
en: torture or other inhumane treatment or punishment; or

so: halis daran oo shakhsi ah oo ka dhalaneysa khilaaf hub loo adeegsanayo.
en: serious personal danger due to an armed conflict.

so: Marka aad codsato magalgalyo, Xafiiska dal u soo guurista ayaa isla arrintan dhexdeeda ku baaraya in aad sababo kale ku heli karto ogolaanshaha joogitaanka iyo in kale.
en: When you apply for asylum, the Finnish Immigration Service also investigates whether you could be granted a residence permit on other grounds.

so: Haddii aadan helin magangalyo ama aadan sababo kale ku helin ogolaanshaha joogitaanka, waxaa lagaa celinayaa Finland.
en: If you are not granted asylum or a residence permit on other grounds, you will be turned away from Finland.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale fursad u heysataa in aad go'aanka diidmada ah racfaan uga qaadato maxkamadda maamulka.
en: You can also appeal a negative decision to the administrative court.

so: Go'aanka waxaa ku lifaaqan tilmaamaha sida aad racfaanka u sameyn karto.
en: Appeal instructions are provided with the decision.

so: Bogga InfoFinland Go'aanka diidmada ah ee ogolaanshaha degitaanka waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaadka waxa aad sameyn karto haddii aad hesho go'aan diidmo ah.
en: You can find information on what to do if you receive a negative decision on the InfoFinland page Negative residence permit decision.

so: Inti lagu jiro mudada ka baaraandegista codsigaada waxaad talobixin iyo caawimaad sharciyeed ka heli kartaa xafiiska caawimaadda arrimaha sharciga ee dadweynaha.
en: During the processing of your application, you can receive advice and legal assistance from a public legal aid office.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso caawiye dhinaca sharciga ah, la xiriir xafiiska caawimaadda arrimaha sharciga.
en: If you want a legal aid attorney, contact the legal aid office.

so: Xarunta qaabilaadda ayaa haddii loo baahdo ku caawinaysa.
en: The reception centre can help you, if necessary.

so: Xafiiska caawimaadda arrimaha sharciga (oikeusaputoimisto) ayaa kugu hagi kara qareen gaar ah ama xafiis sharciyeed gaar loo leeyahay.
en: The legal aid office (oikeusaputoimisto) can also refer you to a private attorney or private law firm.

so: Waxaa sidoo kale talobixin ka heli kartaa Ururka la-talinta qaxootiga (Pakolaisneuvonta ry).
en: You can also receive advice from the Refugee Advice Centre (Pakolaisneuvonta ry).

so: La-talinta qaxootigu waxey xittaa talobixin siisaa dadka sharci la'aanta ku jooga Finland.
en: The Refugee Advice Centre also gives advice to people who are in Finland without a residence permit.

so: Waad ka shaqeyn kartaa Finland haddii dhigashada codsigaada magangalyodoonka ay ka soo wareegtay saddex bilood islamarkaasna aad heysato baasaboor shaqeynaya ama dukumenti safar oo kale oo aad markaas tustay saraakiisha dowladda.
en: You have the right to take up gainful work in Finland after three months have passed since you submitted your asylum application and if you have a valid passport or other travel document, which you showed to the authorities at the time.

so: Haddii aadan saraakiisha dowladda tusin dukumenti safar oo shaqeynaya marki aad dhiganeysay codsigaada magangalyada, waxaad shaqo ka sameyn kartaa Finland marka ay dhigashada codsigaada ka soo wareegto lix bilood.
en: If you did not show a valid travel document to the authorities when you submitted your asylum application, you can take up gainful work in Finland after six three months have passed since you submitted your application.

so: Xaqa sameynta shaqadu wuu sii soconayaa illaa iyo inta aad codsigaada magangalyada ka heleyso go'aan dhaqangalay.
en: Your right to work will continue until you receive a non-appealable decision to your asylum application.

so: Haddii uu xafiiska dal u soo guuristu codsigaada magangalyada ka gaaro go'aan ogolaansho ah, waxaad heleysaa ogolaanshaha joogitaanka.
en: If the Finnish Immigration Service accepts your asylum application, you receive a residence permit.

so: Waxaa ku dhowaad mar walba ku jira sharcigan xaqa sameynta shaqada.
en: This almost always includes the right to work.

so: Haddii uu Xafiiska dal u soo guuristu ka gaaro codsigaada magangalyada go'aan diidmo ah, waxaad xaq u leedahay in aad shaqeyso inta lagu jiro mudada laga baaraandegayo racfaankaadaa suurtagalka ah.
en: If the Finnish Immigration Service rejects your asylum application, you have the right to work during the processing of your appeal, if you make one.

so: Waxaa sameynta shaqada ugu baahantahay kaarka canshuurta.
en: To be able to work, you need a Finnish tax card.

so: Ka codso Xafiiska canshuurta ee kuugu dhow kaddibna u gee shaqo-bixiyahaada.
en: Get a tax card (verokortti) at the nearest tax office (Verotoimisto) and give it to your employer.

so: Haddii shaqadaadu ay joogto tahay, waxaad Finland ka codsan kartaa sharciga ogolaanshaha joogitaanka oo shaqo ku saleysan.
en: If your work is continuous, you can also apply for a residence permit in Finland based on work.

so: Bogga InfoFinland Shaqo u imaanshaha Finland waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan ogolaanshaha joogitaanka shaqaalaha.
en: You can find more information on residence permits for employees on the InfoFinland page Work in Finland.

so: Sidoo kale muwaadiniinta finnishka ehelka kale aan ka aheyn lamaanaha, waalidka carruurta da'da yar ama da' yarta, waxaa suurogal ah siyaabo qaarkood iney ku helaan sharci qoys ahaan.
en: In some cases, a Finnish citizen's family members other than spouses, common-law spouses, parents of a minor or minors themselves may also be eligible for a residence permit in Finland based on family ties.

so: Sidoo kale waxaa sharciga degenaansha la siin karaa ehelka kale, kaasoo haysta sharciga degenaansha kuna heley badbaadadda caalami ah.
en: The permit can also be granted to other family members of a person who has a residence permit based on international protection.

so: Haddii sharciga degenaansha yahay mid kale oon aheyn badbaado caalami ah, ehelka kale looguma ogolaanayo sharci degenaansho.
en: If the basis of your residence permit is something other than international protection, your family members are not eligible for a residence permit.

so: Ehelka kale wuu ku heli karaa sharci degenaansho ah, haddii uusan markaa ka maarmi karin qofka u jooga Finland.
en: Other family members may be eligible for a residence permit, if they are entirely dependent on the family member residing in Finland.

so: Sharcigaas waxaa la siin karaa ilmaha qaangaarka ah (18-jir) waalidkiis.
en: On this basis, a permit can be granted for example to the parents of a person who has reached the age of majority (who has turned 18).

so: Dhaqaalo yarida iyo caafimaad darada ma aha mid buuxineysa sharuudaha lagu bixiyo sharciga degenaansha.
en: Financial dependency alone or poor health, however, are not considered grounds for granting a residence permit.

so: Ehelka kale wuu ku heli karaa sharciga degenaanshaha hadduu si rasmi ula qaatey qoyska nolol xiriir ah intuusan imaanin Finland, waxaana laga rabaa sidoo kale iney tahay arrin cad waxa kala geeyey nolosha qoyska tusaale qaxitaan qaxootinimo.
en: Another family member may also be granted a residence permit if he or she has led a stable family life with a family member residing in Finland before the family member arrived in Finland. Another requirement is that this family life was interrupted for a serious reason, such as taking refuge.

so: Waa inaad soo codsataa sharciga ugu horeeya intaadan imaan Finland.
en: Usually, you must apply for the first residence permit before you come to Finland.

so: Shaciga ka soo codso wadankaaga ama wadanka kale oo aad markaas sida sharciga ah ugu nooshahay.
en: Apply for the permit in your home country or another country where you are residing legally.

so: Markii aad sameysid codsiga waa inaad u tagtaa safaarada Finland ee kuugu dhow ama barta adeegga ee Xaafiiska socdaalka, si aad u caddeyso ama aad u geyso aqoonsigaaga iyo codsiga warqaaha asli ahaantooda.
en: After applying, you must visit the closest Finnish diplomatic mission or a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service to prove your identity, and present original copies of the application appendices.

so: Waa inaad safaarada ku tagto sadex bilood gudohoon laga bilaabo taariikhdii aad codsiga internetka ka xaraysay.
en: You must visit a Finnish diplomatic mission or service point within three months of submitting the application online.

so: Xal ka gaarista sharcigaaga waxaa la bilaabayaa kadib, markaad u tagto safaarada ama barta adeegga.
en: The application cannot be processed until you have visited the Finnish diplomatic mission or service point.

so: Caadi ahaan waa inaad safaarada ama barta adeegga horay waqti uga sii qabsato.
en: You usually need to make an appointment in advance to visit a diplomatic mission or service point.

so: Xusuusnow inaad si joogto ah u fiiriso akoonkaaga Enter Finland.
en: Remember to check your Enter Finland account regularly.

so: Haddii codsigaaga xal ka gaaristiisa awgeed lagaaga baahdo faaf faahin dheeraad ah, akhbaarta waxaa laguugu soo dirayaa akoonkaaga.
en: If further clarifications are needed, you will be informed through your account.

en: A child born in Finland also needs a residence permit in Finland. The permit must be applied for within three months of the birth.

en: The parent residing in Finland must have guardianship over that child for the child to be eligible for a residence permit. If both parents are the child's guardians, the other parent must also give his or her consent for the child to move to Finland.

en: In order for a child to receive residence permit, his or her livelihood in Finland must be secured, for example through the parent's earnings.

en: However, the child's parent is not required to have sufficient income if the child has been born before the parent's arrival in Finland and the parent holds refugee status in Finland.

en: You may be eligible for a residence permit based on family ties if your child resides in Finland.

so: Si aad u hesho sharci degenaansho waa inaad tahay masuulka ilmahaas.
en: In order for you to receive a residence permit based on family ties, you must be your child's guardian.

so: Inta badan masuulku waa hooyada iyo aabaha dhaley ilmaha.

en: The guardian can, however, also be someone else, a grandparent for example.

en: If the child's guardian is someone other than his or her mother or father, and this person is applying for a residence permit, he or she will have to prove his or her guardianship, for example by presenting a court's decision on the matter.

en: In order for you to receive a residence permit, you must have sufficient funds to secure your livelihood in Finland.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee adiga lagaagama baahna hanti kugu filan, hadii ilmuhu uu haysto dhalashada finnishka.
en: However, you will not be required to have sufficient funds if your child is a Finnish citizen.

en: Sufficient funds are also not required if you have been the child's guardian before his or her arrival in Finland and the child holds refugee status in Finland.

so: Sharciga ugu horeeya waxaad sidoo kale ka dalban kartaa Finland dhexdeeda, haddii xubin qoyskaaga yahay muwaadin finnish ah adiguna aad tahay muwaadin u dhashay wadan aan fiiso looga baahnayn, tan macneheedu waa inaadan fiiso u baahnayn markii aad Finland imaaneysid.
en: You can also apply for the first residence residence permit in Finland if your family member is a Finnish citizen and you are a citizen of a visa-free country, i.e. you do not need a visa to come to Finland.

en: If you are married to a Finnish citizen who lives in Finland, you may be eligible to receive a residence permit in Finland based on family ties.

en: If you live in a common-law relationship (avoliitto) with a Finnish citizen who lives in Finland, you may be eligible to receive a residence permit in Finland based on family ties.

en: there is another important reason why you should be granted the permit.

en: You and your common-law spouse must be able to prove you have lived together for two years, if this is the basis of your permit application.

en: This can be demonstrated, for example, by a register of occupants or a rental agreement bearing both of your names.

en: If you and your common-law spouse have domiciles in different countries, living together during periods such as holidays is not considered adequate grounds for granting a residence permit.

so: Lamaanahaagu islama noolaan karaan lamaane kale.
en: You and your common-law spouse cannot be married to third parties.

en: You are not required to have a guaranteed livelihood if you are a family member of a Finnish citizen.

en: If your spouse has a residence permit in Finland and he or she lives in Finland, you may be eligible to receive a residence permit in Finland based on family ties.

en: This can be demonstrated by, for example, a register of occupants or a rental agreement with both your names on it.

en: In order to receive a residence permit in Finland, you or your spouse must also have sufficient income to guarantee your livelihood.

en: If your spouse has gained a residence permit based on international protection but he or she does not hold refugee status, the requirement for sufficient income applies to you.

en: However, in certain situations, an exception can be made to the income requirement if there are particularly strong grounds or it is in the best interest of a child.

en: If your spouse has a residence permit in Finland based on international protection and he or she holds refugee status, you may be eligible to receive a residence permit in Finland based on family ties.

en: In order to obtain a residence permit, you must have sufficient funds to secure your income. These funds must be at your free disposal, for example in a bank account under your own name.

en: Apply for the permit in your home country or another country where you are residing legally.You can also apply for a residence permit in Finland if your spouse is a Finnish citizen and you are a citizen of a visa-free country, i.e. you do not need a visa to come to Finland.

en: The permit can also be refused if Finnish officials deem the spouses to have entered into matrimony purely for the sake of the residence permit with no intention of leading a family life together.

en: Officials may suspect that you have married purely for the sake of a residence permit, for example if you married after a short courtship, there is a large age difference between you or one of you has had several short marriages.

en: If you want to move to Finland to live with a member of your family who is already residing in this country, you will require a residence permit.

en: Normally, a residence permit can be granted to the spouse, common-law spouse or minor children of a person residing in Finland, and to the parents of a minor child residing in Finland.

so: Haddii aad Finland u soo guureyso si aad wax uga barato waa in aad wax ka qabataa tallaabooyinkan soo socda:
en: If you are moving to Finland to study, you need to complete the following steps:

so: Ka hor inta aadan codsan sharciga deganaashaha waa in aad Finland ka heshaa boos waxbarasho.
en: Before you can apply for a residence permit, you need to get a study place in Finland.

so: Machadyada waxbarasho ee la aqbalo waa machadyada waxbarasho ee dugsiga hoose-dhexe ka dambeeya, kuwaas oo ah tusaale ahaan jaamcadaha, dugsiyada tacliinta sare iyo machadyo xirfadeedyada.
en: Approved educational institutes include those that come after comprehensive school, such as universities, universities of applied sciences and vocational colleges.

so: Booska waxbarashadu waa in uu ka soo baxaa shuruudaha soo socda midkood:
en: The study place must meet one of the following conditions:

so: waxbarashadaadu waa mid ku gaarsiineysa xirfad ama shahaado
en: Your studies will lead to a vocation or degree.

so: waxaad ka qeybqaadaneysaa barnaamij arday kala beddelasho oo u dhexeeyo machadyo ama wax kale
en: You will participate in an exchange programme with an educational institute or another type of exchange programme.

so: waxaad baraneysaa waxbarasho dhameystir ah oo shahaadadaada la xiriirta ama waxbarasho takhasus ah
en: You will complete supplementary training or specialising training connected to your degree.

so: Booska waxbarashada waxaad codsan kartaa marka lagu jiro codsiga wadajirka dugsiyada ee guga ama deyrta.
en: You can apply for a study place in the spring or autumn through the general joint application process of educational institutes.

so: Codsiga wadajirka (yhteishaku) ah ee waxbarashooyinka kale qaarkood wuxuu dhacaa Janaayo.
en: For certain studies, the joint application process (yhteishaku) takes place in January.

so: Waqti hore sii ogow waqtiga aad booska waxbarashada codsan karto.
en: Find out about the application period in good time.

so: Bogagga InfoFinlandi ee Dalbashada waxbarashada waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad ku saabsan waqtiga aad Finland ka codsan karto boos waxbarasho.
en: You can find more information about how to apply for a study place in Finland on the InfoFinland page Applying for education and training.

so: Maadaama aad arday tahay haddii aad ku jirrato Finland adiga ayaa kharashka daryeelka iska bixinaya.
en: As a student, you will need to pay for your own medical costs yourself if you fall ill in Finland.

so: Waxaad sharciga deganaanshaha ugu baahan tahay ceymis gaar ah oo daboola kharashka jirrada iyo daawada.
en: In order to get a residence permit, you need to have private insurance that covers your medical and medicine costs.

so: Ceymiska waxaad ka iibsan kartaa shirkad ceymis oo dalkaada ku taal ama waxaad shirkadaha ceymiska ee caalamiga ah soo weydiin kartaa ceymiska kugu habboon.
en: You can take out an insurance policy from an insurance company in your home country or ask international insurance companies about a suitable insurance policy.

so: Dhammaan ceymsiyadu waa in ay buuxiyaan shuruudaha soo socda:
en: All insurance policies must meet the following terms:

so: Ceymisku waa in uu shaqeynayo inta aad Finland joogto oo dhan
en: The policy must be valid throughout your time in Finland.

so: Ceymiskaadu waa in uu shaqeynayo marka aad Finland imaaneyso
en: The policy must be valid when you arrive in Finland.

so: Ceymisku waa in uusan aheyn ceymiska safarka ee caadiga ah
en: The policy cannot be ordinary travel insurance.

so: Adiga ayaa bixin doona kharashka dhakhtarka iyo isbitaalka haddii aad jirrato.
en: You will have to pay the doctor and hospital yourself if you fall ill.

so: Baaxadda kharashka daryeelka ee ay tahay in uu ceymisku bixiyo waxey ku xiran tahay inta ay waxbarashadaadu soconeyso.
en: The amount of medical costs the insurance must cover depends on the duration of your studies.

so: Tusaale ahaan, haddii waxbarashadaada Finland ay qaadaneyso wax ka yar labo sano, ceymisku waa in uu ugu yaraan daboolaa kharashka daryeelka jirrada illaa iyo 120,000 oo Yuuro.
en: For example, if your studies in Finland last for less than two years, the insurance policy must, at a minimum, cover medical costs up to €120,000.

so: Haddii aad heysato kaarka daryeelka jirrada ee Yurub (European Health Insurance Card, EHIC), uma baahnid ceymis gooni ah.
en: If you have a European Health Insurance Card, EHIC, you do not need separate insurance.

so: Kaarka daryeelka jirradu waa in uu shaqeynayo mudada aad Finland joogto oo dhan.
en: The European Health Insurance Card must be valid throughout your time in Finland.

so: Waa in aad adigu noloshaada Finland ka mas'uul ahaataa.
en: You will also be responsible for your living expenses in Finland.

so: Waxaad u baahan tahay bil kasta ugu yaraan 560 yuuro, si aad u bixiso kharashka deegaankaada, cuntadaada ama kharashkaada kale.
en: You will need to have at least €560 per month to be able to cover your housing, food and other expenses.

so: Shardiga lacagta nolosha ku xiran waa laga gudbi karaa.
en: There may be exceptions to the income requirement.

so: Tusaale ahaan, haddii machadku uu adiga kuu qabanqaabiyo guri lacag la'aan ah iyo cunto lacag la'aan ah, markaas waxaad u baahan tahay lacag aad isticmaasho oo ka yar tii hore.
en: For example, if your educational institute organises free housing and free meals for you, less money will be required.

so: Haddii waxbarashadaadu ay tahay lacag waa in aad ka taxadirtaa in aad heysato lacag ku filan nolosha marka aad lacagta sanad-dugsiyeedka bixiso ka dib.
en: If your studies are subject to a charge, you also need to ensure that you have enough money to live on after paying the tuition fees.

so: Waa in aad akoonkaada bangiga ku heysataa lacagta lagaa rabo ama aad heysataa caddeynta caawimaadda lacageed ee ay ku siisay hay'ad rasmi ah.
en: You need to have the required sum in your bank account or a certificate of a grant from an official source.

so: Kuwaan waa tusaale ahaan deeq waxbarasho oo ay bixiyaan dowlad, machadyo ama ururo.
en: Such grants can be scholarships from the state, educational institutes or organisations, for example.

so: Ballanqaadyo kafaaloqaad ama bayaan xisaabeed bangi oo shakhsi ah sida qaraabo, dad aad istaqaan ama shaqo-bixiye lama aqbalayo.
en: Promises of sponsorship or account statements from private persons, such as relatives, acquaintances or employers are not admissible.

so: Markii aad sameysid codsiga waa inaad u tagtaa safaarada Finland ee kuugu dhow, si aad u caddeyso ama aad u geyso aqoonsigaaga iyo codsiga warqaaha asli ahaantooda.
en: After applying, you must visit the closest Finnish diplomatic mission to prove your identity, and present original copies of the application appendices.

so: Xal ka gaarista sharcigaaga waxaa la bilaabayaa kadib, markaad u tagto safaarada.
en: The application cannot be processed until you have visited the Finnish diplomatic mission.

so: Caadi ahaan waa inaad safaarada waqti horay uga sii qabsato.
en: You usually need to make an appointment in advance to visit a Finnish diplomatic mission.

so: Haddii codsigaaga xal ka gaaristiisa awgeed lagaaga baahdo faah faahin dheeraad ah, akhbaarta waxaa laguugu soo dirayaa akoonkaaga.
en: If further clarifications are needed for your application, you will be informed through your account.

so: Lacagta waa in la bixiyaa marka aad keeneyso codsigaaga.
en: You must pay the fee when you submit your permit application.

so: Dukumentiyadan soo coda ayaad u baahan tahay in aad ku lifaaqdo codsiga sharciga deganaanshaha ardayga:
en: You need to submit the following documents with your student residence permit application:

so: sawir baasaboor (tilmaamaha sawirka waxaad ka heleysaa bogga Hay'adda socdaalka)
en: passport photo (you can find the requirements for the photo on the Finnish Immigration Service website)

so: caddeynta joogitaanka (caddeynta in aad arday ka tahay machad Finland laga aqoonsan yahay)
en: certificate of attendance (proof that you are a student at an approved educational institution in Finland)

so: caddeynta in aad heysato lacagta aad nolosha ugu baahan tahay
en: an accounting that you have enough funds to live on

so: caddeynta shahaadada ceymiska ama nuqulka kaarka daryeelka jirrada ee Yurub
en: an insurance certificate or a copy of your European Health Insurance Card

so: caddeynta lacagta la bixiyay ee sanad-dugsiyeedka ama deeqda waxbarasho
en: an accounting of paid tuition fees or scholarship

so: shahaadooyinki hore (haddii aadan aheyn arday shahaado ama kala beddelasho)
en: previous degree certificates (if you are not a degree programme student or exchange student)

so: shahaadooyinka shaqo ee la heli karo (haddii aadan aheyn arday shahaado ama kala beddelasho)
en: any certificates of employment (if you are not a degree programme student or exchange student)

so: Uma baahnid sharciga degenaansha Finland, haddii aad heysato ogolaansho joogitaan oo wadan kale oo Midowga Yurub ah lagaa siiyay, haddii aad wax ka baraneyso dugsiga tacliinta sare.
en: You do not need a residence permit for Finland if you have a residence permit granted in another EU country and are studying in an institute of higher learning.

so: Intaas waxaa dheer, waa in waxbarashadaadu ay:
en: In addition, your studies must:

so: ku jirto dhaqdhaqaaqa caalamiga ah ee barnaamijka Midowga ama barnaamijka noocyada badan; ama
en: include international mobility in an EU programme or multiform programme; or

so: ay qeyb ka tahay heshiis u dhexeeya labo dugsiyada tacliinta sare ah ama wax ka badan.
en: be included in an agreement between two or more institutes of higher learning.

so: Markaas waa in aad Hoggaanka socdaalka u dirtaa wargelinta dhaqdhaqaaqa.
en: In such cases, you must submit a mobility notification to the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Waxaad Finland wax ka baran kartaa ugu badnaan muddo 360 maalmood ah, marka aad sameyso wargelinta dhaqdhaqaaqa.
en: When you submit a mobility notification, you can study in Finland for up to 360 days.

so: Sharciga deganaanshaha ee ardayga waxaa la bixiyaa ugu badnaan halkii marba labo sanadood.
en: A student residence permit is granted for a maximum of two years at a time.

so: Haddii ay waxbarashadaadu sii socoto laakiin waqtiga uu sharcigaadu shaqeynayo uu dhamaanayo, codso ogolaansho siisocda.
en: If your studies continue but your residence permit is about to expire, apply for an extension.

so: Xusuusnow in aad codsato sharciga sii socda waqti hore, kahor inta uusan dhicin sharciga ogolaanshaha ee ugu horeeya.
en: Remember to apply for a student residence permit extension in good time before the first permit expires.

so: Ogsoonow, in ay sidoo kale Maahanmuuttovirasto hubineyso in sababta aad Finland ku joogtay ay xaqiiqo ahaan aheyd waxbarasho.
en: Note that the Finnish Immigration Service (Maahanmuuttovirasto) will check whether your residence in Finland has actually been based on studies.

so: Haddii aad wax ka barato tusaale ahaan jaamacad, dugsiga tacliinta sare ama dugsi xirfadeedka sare waa in aad dhameysaa 45 dhibco-waxbarashadeed inta sanad-dugsiyeedka lagu jiro, si aad u buuxiso shuruudaha helitaanka ogolaanshaha sii-socda.
en: For example, if you are studying towards a basic degree at a university or university of applied sciences, you should complete 45 credits per school year in order to meet the requirements for receiving a residence permit extension.

so: Waa in aad codsiga sharciga sii socda ku lifaaqdaa dhambalka diiwaanka waxbarashada.
en: You must submit a transcript of your academic records with the residence permit extension application.

so: Haddii aad waxbarashadaada ku dhameysay Finland, waxaad heli kartaa shaqo raadinta darteed ogolaanshiyo joogitaan oo ku meelgaar ah.
en: If you have completed your degree in Finland, you can receive a temporary residence permit for job application.

so: Haddii aad shaqo hesho, horay ayaad shaqada ka bilaabi kartaa.
en: If you find a job, you can begin working right away.

so: Si kastoo ay ahaataba waxaa qasab kugu ah inaad codsato ogolaashiyaha joogitaanka cusub ee shaqada darteed kahor inta aysan kaa dhicin ogolaanshiyihii joogitaanka ee laguu siiyay shaqo raadinta awgeed.
en: However, you must apply for a new residence permit on the grounds of employment before the expiry of the residence permit you were granted for job- seeking.

so: Haddii aad dibadda wax ku baraneyso aadna dooneyso inaad Finland u timaado shaqo ku tababarasho, waa inaad codsataa ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka shaqo ku tabarasho darteed.
en: If you are studying abroad and would like to come to Finland for practical training, you need to apply for a residence permit for training.

so: Macluumaad dheeraad ah waxaad ka heleysaa bogagga shabakadda Xafiiska dal u soo guurista.
en: More information is available on the website of the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi Ardayga ajnabiga ah ee jooga Finland waxaad ka heleysaa xog dheeri ah oo la xiriirta waxbarashada Finland.
en: Important information on living as a student in Finland is available on the InfoFinland page Foreign students in Finland.

so: Finland waxaa ganacsi ka sameysan kara qof kasta oo deegaan rasmi ah ku leh wadan ka tirsan Soonaha Dhaqaalaha ee Yurub (ETA).
en: In Finland, anyone with a permanent residence in a country belonging to the European Economic Area (EEA) can start a business.

so: U baahnaanshaha ruqsaddu kuma xirna jinsiyadaada ee wuxuu ku xiran yahay meesha uu deegaankaadu ku yaal.
en: The need for a permit is not dependent on nationality but instead your place of residence.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin u dhashay wadan Midowga Yurub ah, Wadan ETA ah, wadan, Waqooyiga Yurub ku yaal ama Switzerland aadna dooneyso in aad Finland u soo guurto si aad shirkad u sameysato, uma baahnid sharciga degenaanshaha.
en: If you are a citizen of an EU country, EEA country, Nordic country or Switzerland and wish to move to Finland to start a business, you do not require a residence permit.

so: Haddii aadan deganeyn soonaha ETA islamarkaasna aad tahay muwaadin wadanka kale oo aan aheyn wadamada xubnaha ka ah Midowga Yurub, ETA ama Switzerland waxaad u baahan tahay sharciga degenaanshaha si aad Finland ganacsade ahaan uga shaqeyso.
en: If you do not live in the EEA area and are a citizen of a country other than a Member State of the European Union, an EEA country or Switzerland, you will need a residence permit to become an entrepreneur in Finland.

so: Waxqabadka ganacsigaadu waa inuu noqdaa mid faa'iido leh dakhliga kaa soo gala ganacsigaadanu waa in uu daboolaa noloshaada.
en: Your business operations must be profitable, and your livelihood must be ensured by earnings from these activities.

so: Ka hor inta aadan Finland imaanin waa in aad codsataa sharciga degenaanshaha ee ugu horeeya.
en: You must apply for the first residence permit before you come to Finland.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso in aad Finland uga shaqeyso ganacsade ahaan, waxaad u baahan tahay sharciga degenaanshaha ganacsadaha.
en: If you want to work as an entrepreneur in Finland, you will need an entrepreneur's residence permit.

so: Ganacsade waxaa loo arkaa:
en: The following are regarded as entrepreneurs:

so: ganacsade gaar ah, kan loo yaqaan magac ganacsi
en: sole proprietor, an individually-owned business

so: saamilaha shirkad saami ee furan
en: partner in a general partnership

so: ganacsade mas'uul ka ah shirkad xadidan
en: active partner in a limited partnership

so: qof iskaashato xubin ka ah oo ay saaran tahay waajibka bixinta lacag dheeraadka ah oo aan xad laheyn
en: member of a cooperative who has an unlimited obligation to contribute

so: saamile xil hoggaamineed ka haya shirkad saamiyeed (agaasime ama xubin maamul) ama qof urur shirkadeed ka haaya xil hoggaamineed
en: partner in an executive position in a limited company (managing director or board member) or some other corporation

so: Si aad u hesho sharciga degenaanshaha ganacsadaha waa in aad adigu ka shaqeysaa shirkaddaada Finland ku taal.
en: In order to be eligible for a residence permit, you must personally work at your company in Finland.

so: Haddii aadan deegaan rasmi ah ku laheyn Finland ama soonaha ETA waa in aad diiwaanka ganacsiga ee maamulka rajistareeshinka iyo batantaha ka diiwaangelisaa ganacsigaada ka hor inta aadan codsan sharciga degenaanshaha ganacsadaha.
en: If you do not have a permanent residence in Finland or elsewhere in the EEA area, you must register your business operations in the Trade Register of the Finnish Patent and Registration Office before applying for an entrepreneur's residence permit.

so: Haddii aad si rasmi ah ugu soo guureyso Finland ama soonaha ETA, uma baahnid ruqsadda maamulka rajistareeshinka iyo batantaha si aad u aasaasto shirkaddaada.
en: If you move to Finland or the EEA area permanently, you will not require permission from the Finnish Patent and Registration Office to set up a business.

so: Yacni ruqsaddu kuma xirna jinsiyadaada ee waxey ku xiran tahay meesha aad sida rasmiga ah u deggan tahay.
en: In other words, the permit is not dependent on your nationality but instead your place of permanent residence.

so: Ka baaraandegista codsiga sharciga degenaanshuhu waa labo marxaladood.
en: The processing of the residence permit application involves two phases.

so: Marka kowaad Xarunta ELY (Xarunta deegaanka, gaadiidka iyo shaqooyinka) ayaa qiimeyneysa faa'iidada shirkaddaada iyadoo qiimeynta ku saleynaysa qorshaha ganacsi iyo maalgelinta.
en: First, the ELY Centre (Centre for Economic Development, Transport and the Environment) assesses the profitability of your company based on your business plan and financing, among other things.

so: Markaas kaddib ayeey Hay'adda socdaalku go'aan ka gaareysaa sharciga degenaanshaha.
en: Then, the Finnish Immigration Service issues its decision on the residence permit.

so: Bogagga Hay'adda socdaalka ayaad ka heleysaa macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan shuruudaha codsashada sharciga degenaanshaha ganacsadaha.
en: The web pages of the Finnish Immigration Service provide more information on the preconditions for applying for an entrepreneur's residence permit.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso in aad Finland ka aasaasto shirkad Startup ah, waxaad codsan kartaa sharciga degenaanshaha Startup ee loogu talagalay ganacsatada koritaanka.
en: If you would like to establish a start-up company in Finland, you can apply for a start-up residence permit intended for start-up entrepreneurs.

so: Si aad u hesho sharciga degennaanshaha ee startup waa in aad heysataa qorshe ganacsi ee la taaban karo.
en: In order to gain a start-up residence permit, you must have a concrete business plan.

so: Codsashada sharciga degenaanshaha Starup wuxuu maraa labo marxaladood:
en: The process of applying for a start-up residence permit involves two phases:

so: Waxaad u baahan tahay bayaanka taageerada ee Business Finland ee u shaqeynta ganacsade koraaya oo kale;
en: You need an eligibility statement from Business Finland to serve as a start-up entrepreneur.

so: Codso sharciga degenaanshaha ee Startup kaddibna tag si aad isu caddeyso safaaradda Finland ama goobta adeegga ee Hay'adda socdaalka.
en: Apply for a start-up residence permit and visit a Finnish diplomatic mission or a Finnish Immigration Service office to establish your identity.

so: Hannaanku waa mid aad degdeg ah oo si fiican u socda.
en: The process is very fast and smooth.

so: Marka hore waa in xarunta Hindisaha cusub ee Business Finland ka heshaa bayaan ogolaansho ah.
en: First, you need a favourable eligibility statement from the Business Finland innovation centre.

so: Business Finland oo caawisa shirkadaha waxey qiimeynaysaa tusaalaha ganacsiga ee shirkaddaada, aqoonta iyo awoodda aad ku kordhin karto ganacsigaada.
en: Business Finland, which provides support to businesses, will evaluate your company's business model, competence and capability of growing its operations.

so: Macluumaadka qorshaha ganacsigaada iyo dukumentiyada loo baahannyahay waxaad qaab elekterikaal ah ugu diri kartaa Business Finland.
en: You can send the information regarding your business plan and the requisite documents to Business Finland electronically.

so: Marka aad Business Finland ka hesho bayaan ogolaansho ah, waxaad Hay'adda socdaalka ka codsan kartaa sharciga degenaanshaha ee Startup.
en: Once you have received a favourable assessment from Business Finland, you can apply for a start-up residence permit from the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Bayaanka Business Finland wuxuu shaqeynayaa labo bilood.
en: Business Finland's statement will remain valid for two months.

so: U gee Hay'adda socdaalka isagoo ku lifaaqan codsiga sharciga degenaanshaha ee Startup.
en: Deliver the statement to the Finnish Immigration Service as an appendix to your start-up residence permit application.

so: Kama heli kartid Finland sharciga degenaanshaha Startup haddii aadan bayaan ogolaansho ah ka heysan Business Finland.
en: You cannot receive a start-up residence permit for Finland without a favourable assessment from Business Finland.

so: Bogagga Hay'adda socdaalka iyo Business Finland waxaad ka heleysaa tilmaamo iyo macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan codsashada sharciga degenaanshaha ganacsadaha koraya.
en: The web pages of the Finnish Immigration Service and Business Finland provide instructions and more information on applying for the residence permit for start-up entrepreneurs.

so: Sharciga degenaanshaha ganacsadaha ama sharciga degenaanshaha Startup waxaad ku dalban kartaa adeegga shabakadda Enter Finland.
en: You can apply for an entrepreneur's residence permit or start-up residence permit online through the Enter Finland service.

so: Waa in aad safaaradda tagtaa saddex bilood gudohood laga soo billaabo marka aad codsiga ka sameysay shabakadda.
en: You must visit a Finnish diplomatic mission within three months of submitting the application online.

so: Haddii aadan awoodin ama aadan aqoon sida codsiga looga sameysto shabakadda, waxaad foomka codsiga ee warqadda ah iyo lifaaqyadiisa geyn kartaa safaaradda Finland ee kuugu dhow.
en: If you are unable to apply online, you can bring a paper form and its appendices to the closest Finnish diplomatic mission.

so: Waa in aad lacagta bixisaa marka aad xareyneyso codsiga ruqsadda.
en: You must pay the fee when you submit the permit application.

so: Ka aqri warbixin ku saabsan sameysashada shirkad bogga InfoFinlandi Shirkad ganacsi ku samaynta Finland.
en: Read more about starting a business on the InfoFinland page Starting a business in Finland.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi Shaqo iyo ganacsi waxaad ka heleysaa xog dheeri ah oo la xiriirta ganacsiga iyo shaqada.
en: More information for employees and entrepreneurs is available on the InfoFinland page Work and Enterprise.

so: Sharciyada kale ee degenaanshaha ee shaqo mushaari ah loogu talagala
en: Other residence permits for working

so: Sharciga degenaanshaha ee shaqaale xilliyeedka
en: Seasonal worker's residence permit

so: Ku shaqeynta sharciyada kale
en: Working based on another residence permit

so: Haddii aad Finland shahahaado ka qaada
en: If you have completed a degree in Finland

so: Shaqeynta sharciga degenaashaha la'aantiis
en: Working without a residence permit

so: Shaqaalanimo ku jooga Finland
en: Being an employee in Finland

so: Haddaad u imaaneyso Finland shaqo, waxaad u baahan tahay sharci degenaansho.
en: If you come to work in Finland, you need a residence permit.

so: Intaan laguu ogaal sharci degenaanshana, waa inaad ka heshaa goob shaqo Finland.
en: Before a residence permit can be granted to you, you must find a job in Finland.

so: Markii aad hesho goobtii shaqadana, waad codsan kartaa sharciga degenaanshaha.
en: When you have found a job, you can apply for a residence permit.

so: Sharciga degenaanshahana waa inaad soo codsataa intaadan imaan Finland.
en: You must apply for a residence permit before you come to Finland.

so: Si aad u shaqeyso waxaad u baahan tahay sharci, hadduu ahaan lahaa sharci degenaansho shaqo ama sharci aad ku shaqeysan karto.
en: To work in Finland, you normally need either a residence permit for an employed person or some other residence permit entitling you to work.

so: Nooca sharciguna wuxuu ku xiran yahay hadba shaqada aad qabaneyso.
en: The type of permit depends on what kind of work you will be doing.

so: Waxaad u baahan tahay sharci aad ku shaqeysato, haddii aadan ku shaqeysan karin sharci kale ama sharci la'aan.
en: You will need a residence permit for an employed person (työntekijän oleskelulupa), if you are not permitted to work on the basis of another residence permit or without one.

so: Dhammaan qabashada shaqo uma baahna sharci aad ku shaqeyso.
en: A residence permit for employed persons is not necessary for all jobs.

so: Waxaad ka xaqiijisan kartaa bogga shabakada Hogaanka socdaalka nuuca shatiga shaqo eed u baahan tahay.
en: At the website of the Finnish Immigration Service, you can check on what kind of residence permit you need.

so: Hogaanka socdaalka ayaa gaaraya go'aanka iney kuu ogolaanayaan sharci.
en: The Finnish Immigration Service decides on whether or not you will be granted a residence permit.

en: For some jobs, you will not need a residence permit for an employed person, but will need a residence permit for a specific job.

en: For a residence permit, you do not need a decision issued by the Employment and Economic Development Office (TE Office).

so: Haddii aad Finland u imaaneyso in aad sameyso shaqo xilliyeed, waxaad u baahantahay ruqsadda shaqo xilliyeedka.
en: If you come to Finland for seasonal work, you need a seasonal work permit.

en: If you are coming to work for less than three months from a country whose citizens are required to have a visa, you must apply for a seasonal work visa from a Finnish embassy.

so: Haddii ay shaqadaadu qaadaneyso wax ka badan saddex bilood, ka codso Hay'adda socdaalka sharciga degenaanshaha ee shaqo xilliyeedka.
en: If your work will last over three months, apply to the Finnish Immigration Service for a seasonal work residence permit.

so: Haddaad heysto Finland sharci siyaabo kale lagugu siiyey, sida sharciga middeynta qoyska, waxaad heystaa suurogal sharci aad kaga shaqeysan karto Finland.
en: If you already have a residence permit for Finland based on some other grounds, such as family ties, you may have the right to work.

so: Markaa uma baahnid ogolaansho kale si aad ugu shaqeysato.
en: In this case you will not need a specific residence permit for working.

so: Waxaanad ka xaqiijisan kartaa kaarka sharciga ama go'aanka sharciga, in aad ka shaqeysan karto Finland.
en: You can check from your residence permit card and your residence permit decision whether you have the right to work in Finland.

so: Dalbo inta uusan kaa dhamaan sharciga ardeynimada.
en: Apply for an extension before your student residence permit expires.

so: Waxaa laguu ogolaan karaa ugu badnaan sharci sanad ah.
