so: Haddaad hesho shaqo, horey waad ka bilaabi kartaa shaqadii.
en: If you find employment, you can begin working immediately.

so: Waana inaad codsataa sharci degenaansho shaqada awgeed inteysan kaa dhicin tii laguugu cusbooneysiiyey ee raadsashada shaqada aheyd.
en: You must, however, apply for a new work-based residence permit before your residence permit for job application expires.

so: Haddaad Finland shahaado tacliin sare ka qaadatey, golaansho kale oo gaara ugama baahnid xafiiska shaqada iyo shaqaalaha
en: If you have completed a degree in Finland, you do not need a partial decision from the Employment and Economic Development Office (TE Office).

so: Xal ka gaarista sharcigu waa lacag.
en: Processing of the residence permit application is subject to a fee.

so: Lacagtana waa inaad bixisaa markaas, aad keeneyso codsigaaga.
en: You must pay this fee when you submit your application.

so: Lifaaq ahaan waxaa codsiga ogolaansha joogitaanka qofka shaqaalaha loogu baahan yahay foomka TEM054, kaas oo uu shaqo-bixiyuhu buuxinayo kaddibna saxiixayo.
en: The TEM054 form, filled in and signed by the employer, must be appended to the residence permit application of an employee.

so: Shaqo-bixiyuhu wuxuu macluumaadka shaqada iyo shirkaddiisa ku soo diri karaa islamarkaasna uu kala socon karaa sida uu codsigu u socdo adeegga-Enter Finland.
en: The employer may submit the information about the job and company by itself and monitor the progression of the application directly via the Enter Finland service.

so: Shaqo-bixiyuhu wuxuu sidoo kale ka bixin karaa shaqaalaha lacagta ka baaraandegista codsiga.
en: The employer may also pay the processing fee on behalf of the employee.

so: Weydii shaqo-bixiyahaada in uu isticmaalo adeegga- Enter Finland ee shaqo-bixiyaha.
en: Ask your employer whether the employer's Enter Finland service is being used.

so: Ogsoonow, in si kastoo ay ahaataba uusan shaqo-bixiyuhu kuu codsan karin adiga ogolaanshaha deganaashaha, ee wuxuu adeegga- Enter Finland ka buuxinayaa codsigaada qeybta isaga ka quseysa.
en: However, remember that you employer cannot apply for a residence permit on your behalf; your employer can only supplement your application in the Enter Finland service.

so: Inta codsigaaga ugu horeeya ee dagenaanshada goaankiisa aan la gaarin ee wali gacanta lagu hayo, wax shaqo ah inaad qabo xaq uma lihid.
en: While the processing of your first residence permit is ongoing, you do not have the right to work.

so: Hadii aad dibada ka soo codsatid sharciga dagenaanshada, ma imaan kartid Finland ilaa sharciga laguu ogolaado.
en: If you have applied for a residence permit abroad, you cannot enter Finland before the permit has been granted.

so: Codsiga sharciga degenaanshaha ee khabiirka gaarka ah
en: Applying for a special expert's residence permit

so: Haddii aad Finland u imaaneysid hawolo khabiir gaar ahaaneed, waxaad Finland sidoo kale imaan kartaa sharci degenaansho la'aantiis.
en: If you are coming to Finland to work as a special expert, you can enter Finland without a residence permit.

so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee waa inaad haysato fiiso ama aad xaq u leedahay inaad Finland degenaato fiiso la'aan mudo sadex bilood ah.
en: However, you must have a visa or the right to stay in Finland for three months without a visa.

so: Sidoo kale waa inaad haysato goob shaqo oo buuxineysa shuruudaha lagaaga baahanyahay.
en: You must also have a job that meets the requirements.

so: Waa inaad sameyso codsiga degenaanshaha, haddii aad Finland ka shaqayneysid muddo sadex bilood ka badan.
en: You must apply for a residence permit if you work in Finland for longer than three months.

so: Codeysiga waad ka sameysan kartaa internetka adigoo isticmaalaya bogga adeegga internetka ee Enter Finland ama barta adeegga ee Xafiiska dal u soo guurista.
en: You can apply for a permit online through the Enter Finland service or at a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Wadan walbood u dhalateyba, waad ka shaqeyn kartaa shaqooyin qaas ah Finland sharci la'aan.
en: Regardless of your nationality, in some cases you may be able to work in Finland without a residence permit.

so: Laakiin waa inaad wadataa fiiso, haddaad markaa fiiso u baahantahay joogista Finland.
en: You must, however, have a valid visa, if you need a visa to reside in Finland.

so: Waad ka shaqeyn kartaa Finland sharci la'aan tusaale:
en: You can work in Finland without a residence permit if, for example:

so: Aad ku imaaneyso Finland casuumaad ama heshiis turjubaanimo, macalinimo, khabiirnimo ama garsoore ciyaar ugu badnaan muddo saddex bilood ah.
en: you come to Finland on the basis of an invitation or contract to work as an interpreter, teacher, expert or a sports referee for a maximum of three months

so: Waxaad shaqaale joogto ah ka tahay shirkad ka shaqeysa dowlad kale oo ka tirsan Midowga Yurub/ETA waxaadna Finland u imaaneysaa in ka qabo shaqo qandaraas ama qandaraas hoosaad ah shaqadaaduna waxey qaadaneysaa wax ka badan saddex bilood.
en: you are a permanent employee of a company operating in an EU/EEA state and are coming to Finland to perform temporary purchasing or subcontracting work, and your work will not take more than three months

so: Aad ku timid Finland qaxootinimada xadkana aad soo gashey adigoon wadan aqoonsi dal kugelis.
en: you are residing in Finland as an asylum seeker and have valid travel documents entitling you to cross the border.

so: Waxaad wadanka ka shaqeysan kartaa sharci la'aan markii ay ka soo wareegto maalintii aad codsatey magangelyada muddo lix bilood.
en: You can work without a residence permit when three months have passed since you submitted your asylum application

so: Aad ku timid Finland qaxootinimada xadkana aad soo gashey adigoo wata aqoonsi dal kugelis.
en: you are residing in Finland as an asylum seeker and you have no valid travel documents entitling you to cross the border.

so: Waxaad wadanka ka shaqeysan kartaa sharci la'aan markii aad joogto wadanka muddo saddex bilood.
en: You can work without a residence permit when you have resided in the country for six months

so: Ka xaqiiqso bogga shabakada Hogaanka socdaalka, inaad ka shaqeyn karto Finland sharci la'aan.
en: You can check at the Finnish Immigration Service website whether you can work in Finland without a residence permit.

so: Macluumaad dheeriya oo la xiriira habka looga helo shaqo Finland waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi
en: Information on how to find a job in Finland is available on the InfoFinland page Where to find work?

so: Sidee ayaan u codsanayaa?
en: How do I apply?

so: Diiwaangelinta maxaa loogu baahan yahay?
en: What is needed for registration?

so: Ma lumin karaa xaqa joogitaanka?
en: Can I lose my right of residence?

so: Diiwaangelinta xaqa joogitaanka ee muwaadinka Midowga Yurub ma ahan wax iskeed isaga timaada.
en: The registration of an EU citizen's right of residence is not automatic.

so: Waxaad codsan kartaa diiwaangelinta xaqa joogitaanka haddii noloshaada Finland la damaanad-qaaday.
en: You can apply for registration of your right of residence if your livelihood in Finland is ensured.

so: Wuxuu ku salaysnaan karaa shaqo, waxbarasho, shaqo shirkadeed, xiriir qoys ama hanti kugu filan.
en: It can be based on work, studying, entrepreneurship, family ties or sufficient resources.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso in aad degnaato Finland wax ka badan saddex bilood, waa inaad ka diiwaangelisaa Hay'adda Socdaalka Finland (Maahanmuuttovirasto) xaqa joogitaankada.
en: If you plan to stay in Finland for more than three months, you must register your right of residence at the Finnish Immigration Service (Maahanmuuttovirasto).

so: Codsiga waa in la xareeyaa saddex bilood gudohood laga billaabo maalinta imaanshaha dalka.
en: The application must be submitted within three months of the day of arrival.

so: Uma baahnid in aad joogitaanka ka diiwaangeliso Hay'adda Socdaalka haddii aad Finland si xiriir ah u joogeyso wax ka yar saddex bilood.
en: You do not need to register your residence at the Finnish Immigration Service if you reside in Finland for a continuous period of less than three months.

so: Joogitaanka saddexda bilood waxaa laga soo tirinayaa markasta oo aad tagto meel ka baxsan xuduudaha Finland.
en: The three months' residence is always counted from the time when you have last been outside the borders of Finland.

so: Faahfaahinta dheeraadka ah ee shuruudaha ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Muwaadiniinta Midowga Yurub.
en: Read more about the requirements on the page EU citizens.

so: Ka baaraandegista codsiga diiwaangelinta xaqa joogitaanku waa lacag.
en: Processing the application for registration of the right of residence is subject to a fee.

so: Lacagta waa in aad bixisaa marka aad codsiga xareynayso.
en: You must pay the fee when you submit the application.

so: Ka codso diiwaangelinta xaqa joogitaanka muwaadinka Midowga Yurub adeegga Enter Finland:
en: Apply for a registration of an EU citizen's right of residence through the Enter Finland service:

so: Buuxi foomka codsiga kuna dar lifaaqyada loo baahan yahay.
en: Fill in the application form and include the required appendices.

so: Tag goobta adeegga ee Hay'adda socdaalka, sababtoo ah waa in aad caddeysaa qofka aad tahay islamarkaasna aad tustaa lifaaqyada asalka ah ee codsigaada.
en: You should go to a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service because you must prove your identity and present the original copies of the appendices to your application.

so: Horay u sii qaado kaar aqoonsi ama baasaboor shaqeynaya.
en: Take with you a valid identity card or passport.

so: Waxaa wanaagsan in horay ballan laga sameysto goobta adeegga.
en: You should book an appointment in advance to visit the service point.

so: Ballan ka sameyso adigoo u maraayaa adeegga ballan-qabsashada elekteroonikada ee Hay'adda Socdaalka.
en: Book the appointment in the electronic appointment booking service of the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Waxaad sidoo kale ka heleysaa ogeysiiska marka go'aanka la gaaro.
en: You will be informed when the decision has been made.

so: Haddii aadan awoodin ama aqoonin in aad shabakadda ka sameyso diiwaangelinta:
en: If you are unable to register online:

so: Ku samee codsi warqad ah codsiga diiwaangelinta, waxaad xittaa ku sameyn kartaa goobta adeegga ee Hay'adda socdaalka.
en: Apply for registration by filling in the paper application form. You can also do it in person at a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Codsiga ku samey saddex bilood gudahood laga billaabo maalinta imaanshaha dalka.
en: Submit the application within three months of the day of arrival.

so: Foomka diiwaangelinta ka daabaco bogagga shabakadda Hay'adda Socdaalka kaddibna buuxi.
en: Print out the registration form from the Finnish Immigration Service website and fill it in advance.

so: Codsiga waa in si taxadar ah loo buuxiyaa.
en: The application must be filled in carefully.

so: Codsi si qaldan loo buuxiyay lama qabanayo.
en: Incorrectly filled applications will not be accepted.

so: Sii qaado foomka diiwaangelinta oo aad buuxisay, kaar aqoonsi ama baasaboor shaqeynaya iyo lifaaqyda loo baahan yahay.
en: Take with you the filled-in registration form, a valid identity card or passport and the necessary appendices.

so: Haddii aad buuxiso shuruudaha iyo sababaha joogitaankaada Finland, waxaad Hay'adda socdaalka ka heli kartaa shahaadada diiwaangelinta ee xaqa joogitaanka muwaadinka Midowga Yurub.
en: If the grounds for your residence in Finland and the requirements are met, you can get a certificate of registration of an EU citizen's right of residence from the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Marka aad si sharci ah islamarkaasna xiriir ah ku deganeyd Finland shan sano, waxaad xaq u leedahay ogolaanshaha joogitaanka joogtada ah ee Finland.
en: When you have lived in Finland legally and continuously for five years, you have the right for permanent residence in Finland.

so: Xaqa joogitaanka joogtada ah ee muwaadinka Midowga Yurub waa in si gaar ah looga codsadaa Hay'adda socdaalka.
en: EU citizen's right of permanent residence must be applied for separately at the Finnish Immigration Service.

so: Haddii Hay'adda socdaalku ay diiwaangeliso xuquuqdaa joogitaanka, macluumaadkaada shakhsiyeed waxaa si otomaatig ah loogu diiwaangelinayaa nidaanmka macluumaadka dadka.
en: If the Finnish Immigration Service registers your right of residence, your personal data is automatically also registered in the Population Information System.

so: Haddii aad Finland waqti sanad ama wax ka badan ah u soo guurto waa inaad tagtaa iyo iska diiwaangeliso xafiiska diiwaangelinta deegaankaada.
en: If you move to Finland for a year or more, you must also register at the local register office.

so: Bogga InfoFinland ee Liiska xusuusta ee u soo guuraha Finland waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaadyo faa'iido leh oo ku saabsan waxyaabaha kale ee ay tahay in aad qabato marka aad u soo guureyso Finland.
en: The InfoFinland page Moving to Finland checklist contains useful information on other things you have to attend to when moving to Finland.

so: Xaqaada joogitaan waa la diiwaangelin karaa, haddii aad Finland ku heysato shaqo ama shirkad.
en: Your right of residence can be registered if you have a job or a business in Finland.

so: Waxaad u baahan tahay dukumentiyadan soo socda:
en: You need the following documents:

so: kaar aqoonsi ama baasaboor shaqeynaya
en: valid identity card or passport

so: heshiiska shaqada (haddii aad heysato shaqo)
en: contract of employment (if you have a job)

so: caddeynta shaqada shirkadda (haddii aad ganacsade tahay)
en: account on business activities (if you are an entrepreneur)

so: Xaqaada joogitaan waa la diiwaangelin karaa, haddii aad wax ka barato machad laga aqoonsan yahay Finland.
en: Your right of residence can be registered if you study at an approved educational institution in Finland.

so: aad heysato ammaanka ceymiska jirada (tusaale, kaarka bukaanka ee yurubiyaanka)
en: certificate of health insurance (for example, a European Health Insurance card)

so: caddeynta dhaqaalahaada nololeed ee Finland
en: account of your income in Finland

so: Xubin qoys ee qof deggan Finland
en: Family member of a person living in Finland

so: Xaqaada joogitaan waa la diiwaangelin karaa, haddii aad leedahay xubin qoyskaada ka tirsan uu si rasmi ah u deggan Finland.
en: Your right of residence can be registered if you have a family member living permanently in Finland.

so: shahaadada guurka ama xiriirka lamaane diiwaangashan
en: certificate of marriage or registered partnership

so: caddeynta labo sano oo wada-degaanasho ah ama cunugga aad mas'uul ka wada tihiin, haddii aad ku jirto wada-noolaasho
en: account on living together for two years or on a child in joint custody, if you are in a common-law relationship

so: shaahadada dhalashada cunugga, haddii aad leedahay cunug aad mas'uul ka tahay
en: birth certificate of the child, if you have a child in your custody

so: caddeynta sababta uu Finland ku joogo isu-keenaha qoysku
en: account on the grounds of the sponsor's residence in Finland

so: Kaarka joogitaanka ee xubinta qoys ee muwaadinka Midowga Yurub
en: Residence card for an EU citizen's family member

so: Haddii aadan aheyn muwaadin Midowga Yurub ah, laakiin xubin qoyskaada ka tirsan ee Finland deggan uu yahay muwaadin Midowga Yurub waa in aad codsataa kaadhka joogitaanka ee xubinta qoyska muwaadinta Midowga Yurub.
en: If you are not a citizen of an EU country, Liechtenstein or Switzerland but you are moving to Finland to live with a family member who is an EU citizen, you must apply for a residence card for an EU citizen's family member.

so: Waxaad kaadhkka joogitaanka si elekteroonikada ka codsan kartaa adeegga Enter Finland ama goobta Hay'adda Socdaalka Finland (Maahanmuuttovirasto).
en: You can apply for a residence card online through the Enter Finland service or at a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service (Maahanmuuttovirasto).

so: Ka baaraandegista codsiga joogitaanku waa lacag.
en: Processing the application for a residence card is subject to a fee.

so: caddeynta diiwaangelinta muwaadinka Midowga Yurub ee aad Finland la timid
en: registering certificate of the EU citizen you come to Finland with

so: caddeynta xiriirka qaraabo (carruurta muwaadinka Midowga Yurub ama ehelka kale ee aad mas'uulka ka tahay)
en: account of relationship (children or other dependent relatives of an EU citizen)

so: caddeynta wada-deganaashaha (haddii aad muwaadin Midowga Yurub u tahay lamaane xiriir furan islamarkaasna aysan jirin carruur aad mas'uul ka wada tihiin)
en: account on living together (if you are a common-law spouse of an EU citizen and you do not have children in joint custody)

so: Kaarka joogitaanka ee xubinta qoyska muwaadinka Midowga Yurub waxaa la bixiyaa shan sano ama waqti ka yar, haddii deganaashaha Finland ay qaadaneyso wax ka yar shan sano.
en: The residence card for an EU citizen's family member is granted for five years or a shorter time if the duration of living in Finland is less than five years.

so: Haddii xaqaada joogitaanka aan lagu diiwaangelin karin sababaha kor lagu xusay mid ka mid ah, waad codsan kartaa diiwaangelinta haddii aad heysato hanti kuugu filan ku noolaashaha Finland.
en: If your right of residence cannot be registered on any of the grounds stated above, you can apply for registration if you have sufficient resources for living in Finland.

so: Hanti kugu filan xittaa waa sabab.
en: Sufficient resources are grounds for registration.

so: caddeynta in aad heysato hanti kuugu filan ku noolaanshaha Finland.
en: explanation that you have sufficient resources for living in Finland

so: Diiwaangelinta xaqa joogitaanka ee muwaadinka Midowga Yurub ama kaarka joogitaanka xubinta qoyska muwaadinka Midowga Yurub waa lala noqon karaa ama waa buri kartaa haddii:
en: Registration of an EU citizen's right of residence and residence card for an EU citizen's family member may be cancelled or it may expire if:

so: aad bixisay macluumaadyo khalad ah marki aad codsaneysay diiwaangelinta ama kaarka joogitaanka xubinta qoyska muwaadinka Midowga Yurub
en: you have given false information when applying for the registration or residence card for an EU citizen's family member

so: aad qarisay arrin celin kartay sameynta diiwaangelinta ama bixinta kaarka joogitaanka
en: you have withheld a factor that could have prevented you from being registered or receiving the residence card

so: aad heleyso dhalashada Finland
en: you are granted Finnish citizenship.

so: Kudaro xisaabta in xaaladdaada nololeed haddii ay isbeddesho ay saameyn ku yeelan karto xaqaada joogitaanka.
en: Bear in mind that, if your situation in life changes, this may affect your right of residence.

so: Haddii diiwaangelinta xaqaada joogitaanku ay ku saleysneyd shaqo, shirkad shaqeyneysa, boos waxbarasho, xiriir qoys ama lacag kugu filan islamarkaasna aysan sababtaa hadda jirin, diwaangelinta waa la ceshan karaa.
en: If your right of residence has been registered based on work, business operations, study place, family ties or sufficient funds and this reason no longer exists, your registration may be cancelled.

so: Ha'adda socdaalka ayaa go'aamisa kala laabashada xaqa joogitaanka ama buritaankeeda.
en: The Finnish Immigration Service makes decisions on cancelling or expiring rights of residence.

so: Haddii aadan dooneyn in lagaala laabto xaqaada joogitaanka ama kaarkaada joogitaanka, Hay'adda socdaalka ayaad arrintaas ka codsan kartaa ugu dambeyn labo sano gudohood marka aad dibadd au guurto.
en: If you do not want your right of residence or residence card to be cancelled, you can submit an application to the Finnish Immigration Service at the latest within two years of moving abroad.

so: Shaqo u imaanshaha Finland
en: The Finnish Immigration Service:

so: Ku imaanshaha Finland ganacsade ahaan
en: Presentation of the Enter Finland e-service

so: Waxbarasho u imaanshada Finland
en: Moving to Finland as an entrepreneur

so: U imaansha reerka Finland
en: Moving to Finland as a family member

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin dal Mdowga Yurub ka tirsan, Liechtenstein ama Switzerland uma baahnid ogolaanshaha joogitaanka ama fiisaha Finland.
en: If you are a citizen of an EU member state, Liechtenstein or Switzerland, you do not need a residence permit or visa for Finland.

so: Waad imaan kartaa Finland haddii aad heysato kaarka aqoonsiga ama baasaboor.
en: You can arrive in Finland if you have a valid identity card or passport.

so: Waxaad xaq u leedahay in Finland ka shaqeyso, ganacsade ka noqoto ama wax uga barato si la mid ah muwaadiniinta Finland.
en: You have the right to work, run a business and study in Finland equally with Finnish citizens.

so: Waa in aad noloshaada Finland is-dabartaa.
en: You must ensure your livelihood in Finland yourself.

so: Ka muwaadin Midowga Yurub ahaan waxaad si xiriir ah u joogi kartaa ugu badnaan saddex bilood Finland adigoo aan diiwaangelin xaqa joogitaankaada.
en: As an EU citizen, you can reside in Finland for a continuous period of three months at most without registering your right of residence.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso in aad joogto Finland isuna diiwaangeliso sidi degane oo kale, waa in aad heysataa shaqo ama shirkad shaqeysa, goob waxbarasho, xiriir qoys oo waqti dheer ah ama hanti kugu filan.
en: If you want to stay in Finland and register as a resident, you must have a job, an operating company, a study place, long time family ties or sufficient resources.

so: Haddii aad dooneyso in aad degnaato Finland wax ka badan saddex bilood, waa in aad ka codsataa Hay'adda Socdaalka Finland Diiwaangelinta xaqa joogitaanka muwaadinka Midowga Yurub.
en: If you are planning on staying in Finland for more than three months, you must apply to the Finnish Immigration Service for a registration of an EU citizen's right of residence.

so: Codsiga waa in la sameeyaa ugu dambeyn saddex bilood gudohood laga soo billaabo maalinta soo gelitaanka dalka.
en: The application must be submitted within three months of the day of arrival at the latest.

so: Haddii aad Finland ugu soo guurto si aa du degnaato rasmi ahaan sanad ama waqti ka badan, waa in tagtaa xafiiska diiwaangelinta deegaankaada iyo iska diiwaangelisaa.
en: If you move to live permanently in Finland for a year or more, you must also register at the local register office.

so: Haddii aad si xiriir ah u joogeyso Finland wax ka yar saddex bilood, uma baahnid in aad codsato diiwaangelinta xaqa joogitaanka.
en: If you reside in Finland for a continuous period of less than three months, you don't need to apply for registration of your right of residence.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin Midowga Yurub Finland uguma baahnid ruqsad shaqo.
en: As an EU citizen, you do not need a work permit in Finland.

so: Horay ayaad shaqo ka billaabi kartaa marka aad dalka timaado.
en: You are allowed to start working as soon as you arrive in the country.

so: Haddii aad Finland ugu soo guureyso si aad u degto rasmi ahaan ugu yaraan sanad, tag xafiiska diiwangelinta deegaanka (maistraatti) oo isu diiwaangeli degane ahaan.
en: If you move to live permanently in Finland for at least a year, register as a resident at the local register office (maistraatti) as well.

so: Haddii aad dibadda uga timid Finland si aad uga shaqeyso waxaad u baahan tahay aqoonsiga qofka (henkilötunnus) ee Finnishka.
en: If you come from abroad to work in Finland, you need a Finnish personal identity code (henkilötunnus).

so: Kaar aqoonsiga ama baasaboor shaqeynaya
en: a valid identity card or passport

so: Aqoonsiga shakhsiyeed ee Finnishka waxaad sidoo kale ka heli kartaa Hay'adda socdaalka, marka aad diiwaangashaneyso xuquuqdaa joogitaanka ee muwaadinka Midowga Yurub.
en: You can also get a Finnish personal identity code at the Immigration Service during the registration of your EU citizen's right of residence.

so: Kaadhka canshuurta iyo lambarka canshuurta
en: Tax card and tax number

so: Dhammaan dadka ka shaqeynaya Finland waa in ay heystaan kaadhka canshuurta.
en: All people working in Finland need to have a tax card.

so: Shaqo-bixiyahaada ayaa wuxuu ugu baahan yahay mushaar bixinta iyo canshuurista.
en: Your employer needs it for salary payment and taxation.

so: Haddii aad ka shaqeyso dhismaha waxaad sidoo kale u baahan tahay lambarka canshuurta (veronumeron).
en: If you work in construction, you also need a tax number (veronumero).

so: Kaadhka canshuurta iyo lambarka canshuurta waxaad ka heli kartaa xafiiska canshuurta ee kuugu dhow.
en: You can get the tax card and tax number at the nearest tax office.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi Shaqaale ama ganacsade waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad dheeraad ah oo loogu talagalay shaqaalaha Finland u soo guuraya.
en: On the InfoFinland page Employee or entrepreneur, you can find more information intended for employees moving to Finland.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin Midowga Yurub ah, waad imaan kartaa Finland si aad shaqo uga raadsato waqti macluul ah.
en: If you are an EU citizen, you can come to Finland to look for work for a reasonable time.

so: Shaqo raadin darteed isagama diiwaangelin kartid Finland sidii degane oo kale mana codsan kartid diiwaangelinta xaqa joogitaanka.
en: On the basis of job searching, you cannot register as a resident in Finland or apply for registration of your right of residence.

so: Si aad u degnaato Finland, waa in aad heysataa shaqo ama sabab kale ee kor lagu soo sheegay iyo dhaqaale kuugu filan nolosha.
en: To be able to stay and live in Finland, you must have a job or another reason mentioned hereinabove and sufficient resources for living.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi ee Halkee laga heli karaa shaqo?
en: The InfoFinland page Where to find work?

so: waxaa ku jira macluumaadka ku saabsan sida aad Finland shaqo uga heli karto.
en: provides information on how to find a job in Finland.

so: Haddii aad wadankaada ku heysatay xaqa magdhowga shaqo la'aanta, waxaa si ku meelgaar ah laguugu soo diri karaa Finland.
en: If you are entitled to unemployment benefit in your home country, it can temporarily be paid to you in Finland as well.

so: Magdhowga shaqo la'aanta si Finland laguugu soo diro waxaad ku codsan kartaa foomka E303 ama U2. Foomka waxaad ka heleysaa saraakiisha xoogga shaqada ee dalkaada.
en: You can apply for payment of unemployment benefit in Finland with form E303 or U2. You can get the form from employment authorities of your home country.

so: Haddii aad Finland u timaado shaqo raadin, sida caadiga ah Finland kama heli kartid magdhowga shaqo la'aanta.
en: If you come to Finland to look for work, you are normally not entitled to unemployment benefit in Finland.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin Midowga Yurub ah Finland waad ka aasaasan kartaa shirkad, haddii aad deegaan rasmi ah ku leedahay wadan ka tirsan Soonaha Dhaqaalaha Yurub (ETA).
en: As an EU citizen, you can start a business in Finland if you have permanent residence in a country belonging to the European Economic Area (EEA).

so: Shirkad ajnabi ah waxey xittaa Finland ka billaabi kartaa shaqo shirkadeed.
en: A foreign company can also start business activities in Finland.

so: Haddii aad Finland ugu soo guureyso si aad u degto rasmi ahaan ugu yaraan sanad, tag xafiiska diiwaangelinta dadka oo isu diiwaangeli degane ahaan.
en: If you move to live permanently in Finland for at least a year, register as a resident at the local register office as well.

so: Marka ugu horeysa ee aad diiwaangelinayso shirkadaada, waa in aad buuxisaa ogeysiiska aasaasidda shirkadda, islamarkaasna aad geysaa lifaaqyada loo baahan yahay.
en: When you register your business for the first time, you must fill in the start-up notification and submit the required appendices.

so: Macluumaadka shirkadda waxaad foomka oo kaliya ku ogeysiin kartaa Diiwaanka ganacsiga ee Maamulka diiwaanka iyo ruqsadaha (Patentti- ja rekisterihallituksen kaupparekisteri) iyo diiwaanada Maamulka canshuurta (Verohallinto).
en: You can report the information of the business to the Trade Register of the Finnish Patent and Registration Office (Patentti- ja rekisterihallituksen kaupparekisteri) and the registers of the Tax Administration (Verohallinto) with a single Y form.

so: Waxaa kale ogeysiiska aasaasidda in lagu lifaaqo loo baahan karaa dhambal ay bixiyeen saraakiisha dowladdaada oo u dhigma dhambalka diiwaanka ganacsiga ee Finnishka.
en: An extract equivalent to a Finnish Trade Register Extract, provided by an authority in the home country, may also be needed as an appendix to the start-up notification.

so: Qeybta InfoFinlandi Shaqo iyo ganacsi waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad badan oo ku saabsan nolosha shaqada iyo ka ganacsiga Finland.
en: The InfoFinland section Work and Enterprise includes lots of information on working and being an entrepreneur in Finland.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin Midowga Yurub waad codsan kartaa in aad wax ka barato machad Finland laga aqbalsan yahay.
en: As an EU citizen, you can apply for studies at an approved educational institution in Finland.

so: Haddii joogitaankaada Finland uu si xiriir ah u qaadanayo wax ka badan saddex bilood, waa in aad ka codsataa adeegga Enter Finland ama Hay'adda Socdaalka Finland (Maahanmuuttovirasto) diiwaangelinta xaqa joogitaanka muwaadinka Midowga Yurub.
en: If your residence in Finland lasts for more than three months, you must apply for a registration of an EU citizen's right of residence through the Enter Finland service or at a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service (Maahanmuuttovirasto).

so: Xeerkan wuxuu quseeya tusaale ahaan ardayga beddelka ah ee Finland wax ku baranaya muddo gaaban oo kaliya (tusaale afar bilood).
en: This rule applies, for example, to an exchange student who studies in Finland only for a short time (for example, four months).

so: Haddii aad mararka qaar ka baxdo Finland oo aadan si xiriir ah u joogin wadanka saddex bilood, markaas uma baahnid in aad codsato diiwaangelinta xaqa joogitaanka.
en: If you leave Finland during your residence and do not stay in the country for a continuous period of three months, you do not need to apply for registration of your right of residence.

so: Marka ay sidan tahay naftaada u raadso aqoonsiga qofka ee finnishka islamarkaasna ogeysii xafiiska diiwangelinta deegaanka (maistraatti) macluumaadka cinwaankaada.
en: In this case, apply for a Finnish personal identity code and report your address information to the the local register office (maistraatti).

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi Arday waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad loogu talagalay ardayda u soo guureysa Finland.
en: On the InfoFinland page Student, you can find more information intended for students moving to Finland.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin Midowga Yurub ah aadna Finland ugu soo guureyso si aad ula degti xubin qoyskaada kamid ah, waa in aad diiwaangelinta xaqa joogitaanka ee muwaadinka Midowga Yurub uga codsataa xiriir qoys adeegga Enter Finland ama goobta adeegga ee Maahanmuuttovirasto.
en: If you are an EU citizen and you move to Finland to live with a family member, you must apply for a registration of an EU citizen's right of residence due to family ties through the Enter Finland service or at a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service (Maahanmuuttovirasto).

so: Haddii aadan aheyn muwaadin Midowga Yurub ah, laakiin xubinta qoyskaada ka tirsan ee Finland deggan uu yahay muwaadin Midowga Yurub waxaad u baahan tahay kaarka joogitaanka ee xubinta qoyska muwaadinta Midowga Yurub.
en: If you are not an EU citizen but your family member living in Finland is an EU citizen, you need a residence card for an EU citizen's family member.

so: Waxaa kaarka laga codsadaa adeegga Enter Finland ama goobta Adeegga Hijrada Finland (Maahanmuuttovirasto).
en: You can apply for it through the Enter Finland service or at a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service (Maahanmuuttovirasto).

so: Haddii Finland si aad u degto aad rasmi ahaan u soo guurto, tag xafiiska diiwangelinta deegaanka (maistraatti) oo isu diiwaangeli degane ahaan.
en: If you move to live permanently in Finland, register as a resident at the local register office (maistraatti) as well.

so: Si loo diiwaangeliyo xubinta qoys ee muwaadinka Midowga Yurub waxaa loo baahan yahay in qofka deggan Finland uu heysto hanti ku filan masruufidda naftiisa iyo xubinta qoyskiisa ee Finland u soo guuraya.
en: For a family member of an EU citizen to register, the person living in Finland is also required to have sufficient resources to support him/herself and the family member moving to Finland.

so: Xubin qoys ama ehel kale waxaa noqon kara:
en: The family member or other relative may be:

so: qof aad isqabtaan ama rafiiq ku jira diiwaanka xiriirka lammaanaha
en: a spouse or partner in registered partnership

so: qof aad guur furan ku jirtaan oo aad wada-nooleydeen ugu yaraan labo sano ama uu idinka dhexeeyo cunug aad mas'uul ka wada tihiin
en: a common-law spouse who you have lived with for at least two years or who you have a child in joint custody with

so: cunug aad mas'uul ka tahay oo ka yar 21 sano, cunugaada cunugiisa
en: a child or grandchild under 21 years of age in your custody

so: cunug ay qofka aad is-qabtaan mas'uul ka tahay oo ka yar 21 sano, cunugeeda cunugiisa waalid/waalidka
en: a child or grandchild under 21 years of age in custody of the spouse

so: waalidkiis oo aad mas'uul ka tahay
en: a dependent parent or grandparent

so: waalidkiis ee ay mas'uul ka tahay qofka aad is-qabtaan
en: a dependent parent or grandparent of the spouse

so: waalidka cunugga ka yar 21 sano
en: a parent of a child under 21 years of age

so: Xittaa cunugga ku dhasha Finland ee noqonaya muwaadin wadan ka tirsan Midowga Yurub, Liechtenstein ama Switzerland waa in loo codsadaa diiwaangelinta xaqa joogitaanka.
en: You must also apply for registration of the right of residence for a child born in Finland who becomes a citizen of an EU country, Liechtenstein or Switzerland.

so: Diiwaangelinta waa in la codsadaa saddex bilood gudahood laga soo billaabo dhalashada cunugga.
en: The registration must be applied for within three months of the child's birth.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo mowduuca ku saabsan ka sii aqri bogga InfoFinlandi Finland markii uu ilmuhu dhaso.
en: Read more on the InfoFinland page When a child is born in Finland.

so: Marka aad sababo xiriir qoys ah ugu soo guureyso Finland waxaad heysataa xaqa shaqo sameynta oo aan xad laheyn iyo xaq aad wax uga baran karto Finland.
en: When you move to Finland on the basis of family ties, you have an unlimited right to work and study in Finland.

so: Bogga InfoFinlandi ee Xubin qoys waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaad loogu talagalay dadka sababo qoys ugu soo guuraya Finland.
en: On the InfoFinland page Family member, you can find more information intended for people moving to Finland on the basis of family ties.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin Midowga Yurub ah waad imaan kartaa Finland haddii aad heysato baasaboor ama kaar aqoonsi islamarkaasna aan lagaa mamnuucin imaanshaha dalka.
en: As an EU citizen, you can arrive in Finland if you have a passport or identity card and you are not banned from entering the country.

so: Haddii aad u joogeyso Finland si ku meel gaar ah, waxaad heli kartaa aqoonsiga qofka ee Finnishka, haddii aad ugu baahantahay tusaale ahaan shaqo darteed.
en: If you are residing in Finland temporarily, you can get a Finnish personal identity code if you need it for work, for example.

so: Waxaad ka codsan kartaa aqoonsiga qofka islamarkaasna degitaanka ku meel gaarka ah ka diiwaangelin kartaa xafiiska diiwangelinta deegaanka (maistraatti) ee kuugu dhow ama Xafiiska Canshuurta (verotoimisto).
en: You can apply for a personal identity code and register temporary residence at at the local register office (maistraatti) or tax office (verotoimisto).

so: Haddii joogitaankaada ku meel gaarka ah uu si xiriir ah u soconayo wax ka badan saddex bilood, waxaad sidoo kale u baahantahay shahaadada diiwaangelinta ee xaqa joogitaanka muwaadinka Midowga Yurub.
en: If your temporary residence lasts for a continuous period of more than three months, you also need a certificate of registration of an EU citizen's right of residence.

so: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo mowduuca ka saabsaan ka sii aqri: Diiwaangelinta xaqa joogitaanka muwaadinka Midowga Yurub.
en: Further information: Registration of an EU citizen's right of residence.

so: Haddii aad si ku meel gaar ah u deggan tahay Finland, guri degmo si toos ah kuuguma diiwaangeleyso mana heysatid xuquuq la mid ah kuwa uu heysto qofka sida rasmiga ah u deggan Finland.
en: If you live in Finland temporarily, no municipality of residence in Finland is registered for you and you do not have the same rights as a person living permanently in Finland.

so: Haddii aad tahay muwaadin u dhashay Midowga Yurub, Liechtenstein ama Switzerland aadna dooneyso in aad safar ku timaado Finland waqti gaaban, tusaale ahaan safar fasax, safar ganacsi ama aad booqasho ugu imaaneyso qaraabadaada, uma baahnid fiiso.
en: If you are a citizen of an EU country, Liechtenstein or Switzerland and you want to travel to Finland for a short time, for example, make a holiday trip, business trip or visit to relatives, you do not need a visa.

so: Haddii aad Finland ku joogto musaafur aadna gasho xaalad adag, la xiriir safaaradda dalkaada.
en: If you are in Finland as a traveller and you get into a difficult situation, contact your home country's diplomatic mission.

so: Safaaraddu wey ku caawin kartaa adiga haddii aad shil gashay, jirato ama aad noqoto dhibane dembi.
en: The diplomatic mission can help you if you have been in an accident, fallen ill or become the victim of a crime.

so: Safaaraddu waxey sidoo kale ku siin kartaa baasaboor cusub haddii uu baasaboorkaadu kaa lumo ama lagaa xado.
en: The diplomatic mission can also grant you a new passport if your passport has been lost or stolen.

so: Markaad ka codsaneyso sharciga degenaanshaha ugu horeeyo Finland, waxaad ka codsan kartaa in laguugu diiwan geliyo Finland waxaada diiwaangelinta.
en: When you apply for your first residence permit for Finland, you can ask to be registered in the Finnish Population Information System.

so: Markaa ayaa lagu siinayaa summada aqoonsiga finnishka, markii aad hesho sharci degenaansho ah.
en: This means that you will be given a Finnish personal identity code at the same time as your residence permit.

so: Faahfaahin dheeriya ah oo summada aqoonsiga finnishka waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi Isu diiwaangelin degene.
en: Further information on the Finnish personal identity code is available on the InfoFinland page Registering as a resident.

so: Bogagga Infopankki waxaad ka heleysaa macluumaadyo fara badan oo ku saabsan adeegyada deegaano kala duduwan.
en: Infopankki webpages contain a lot of information on services offered in various localities.

so: Markaa ayaa lagu siinayaa summada aqoonsiga finnishka, markii aad hesho sharciga degenaanshaha.
en: You will then receive a Finnish personal ID code when you get your residence permit.

so: Wixii faahfaahin dheeri ah oo la xiriira summada aqoonsiga finnishka waxaad ka heleysaa bogga InfoFinlandi
en: You can find more information about the personal ID code on the InfoFinland page Registering as a resident.

so: Tusaale ahaan, haddii waxbarashadaada Finland ay qaadaneyso wax ka yar labo sano, ceymisku waa in uu ugu yaraan daboolaa kharashka daryeelka jirrada illaa iyo 100,000 oo Yuuro.
en: For example, if your studies in Finland last for less than two years, the insurance policy must, at a minimum, cover medical costs up to €100,000.

so: Ka aqri warbixin ku saabsan sameysashada shirkad bogga InfoFinlandi Sameynta shirkad ganacsi.
en: Read more about starting a business on the InfoFinland page Starting a business.

so: Marka aad codsaneyso diiwaangelinta xaqa joogitaankaada waxaad isla foomkaas ku dari kartaa codsi aad ku heleyso aqoonsiga shakhsiyeed ee Finnishka.
en: When you apply for registration of the right of residence, you can use the same form to submit a request for a Finnish personal identity code.

so: Markaas waxaa nidaamka macluumaadka dadka ee Finland lagu keydinayaa macluumaadkaada shakhsiyeed, cinwaankada, afkaada hooyo iyo xirfaddaada.
en: Your personal data, address, native language and profession will be saved in the Finnish Population Information System.

so: Aqoonsiga shakhsiyeed waxaad u baahan tahay marka aad arrimo ka dhameysaneyso saraakiisha dowladda.
en: You need a personal identity code when dealing with the authorities.

so: Waxaa kale oo intaas dheer oo uu kuu fududeynayaa tusaale ahaan arrimo ka dhameysashada bangiyada iyo shaqo-bixiyahaada.
en: It also makes it easier to attend to matters with banks and your employer.

so: Aqoonsiga shakhsiyeed waxaad sidoo kale ka codsan kartaa xafiiska diiwangelinta deegaanka (maistraatti) ama xafiiska canshuurta (verotoimisto) ee deegaankaada.
en: You can also apply for a personal identity code at your local register office (maistraatti) or tax office (verotoimisto).

so: Waxaad sidoo kale Hay'adda Socdaalka dhigan kartaa codsi aad ku heleyso aqoonsiga qofka isla marka aad codsaneyso diiwaangelinta xaqa joogitaanka ee muwaadinka Midowga Yurub.
en: You can also leave a request for a personal identity code at the Finnish Immigration Service while you apply for a registration of an EU citizen's right of residence.

so: Kaalay oo wax ka dhis Infopankiga mustaqbalka!
en: Come and build the InfoFinland of the future!

so: Haddii aad xubin ka noqotid wadasheekaysiga xaggga internetka ah ee Infopankiga waxaad saameyn ku yeelan kartaa, sidii loo hormarin lahaa adeegga shabakada Infopankiga ee luuqadaha badan lagu turjumay.
en: InfoFinland is a service that is translated into many languages. As an online user panel member, you can influence how the service will develop in future.

so: Wadasheekaysiga xaggga internetka ah (Verkkopaneeli) wuxuu u furan yahay dhammaan kuwa xiiseynaya Infopankiga arimaha la xiriira.
en: The online user panel is open to everyone who is interested in InfoFinland.

so: Waxaan rajeyneynaa inay ka soo qayb galaan xubno leh luuqado iyo da'a kala duwan oo ka socda Finland iyo wadamo kale intaba.
en: We hope that people speaking different languages and of various ages from Finland and other countries will participate.

so: Uga biir halkaan wadasheekaysiga xagga internetka ah.
en: Join InfoFinland's online user panel here:

so: Sideebuu wadasheekaysiga internetku u shaqaynayaa?
en: How does the online user panel work?

so: Wadasheekaysiga xagga internetka ah awgiis waxaan u baahannahay cinwaanka e-mailkaaga.
en: To join the online user panel, you need to give your e-mail address.

so: Ugu badnaan bil dhaaf ayaan internetka kuugu soo diraynaa su'aalo gaa gaaban, kuwaas oo la xiriira waxyaabaha ku qoran Infopankiga, qaab dhismeedka bogga internetka ama macluumaad gudbinta.
en: We will send you short web surveys no more often than every other month regarding InfoFinland contents, the website or its communications.

so: E-mailkaaga looma adeegsanayo ujeedooyin kale.
en: Your e-mail address will not be used for any other purpose.

so: Su'aaluhu inta badan waxay ku qoran yihiin luuqadda ingiriiska, sidoo kale mar marka qaarkood luuqadoo kale.
en: The surveys are usually in English and sometimes in other languages.

so: Sannadkiiba dhawr mar ayaan abaalmarin bakhtiyo nasiib ah u qabanaynaa dadka su'aalaha ka soo jawaabay dhexdooda.
en: A few times a year, we raffle off prizes between those who participate in surveys.

so: Ku biiridda wadasheekaysigu waxba kugu waajibinmeyso.
en: Joining the panel does not bind you in any way.

so: Sidoo kale wadasheekaysiga xagga internetka ah waxaad ka bixi kartaa mar walba oo aad dooneyso.
en: You can also leave the panel any time.

so: Tilmaamaha diiwaanka Infopankki waxaa laga helaa bogagga magaalada Helsinki.
en: The file description of InfoFinland is available at the City of Helsinki website.

so: Adeegga InfoFinland.fi waxaa maamula magaalada Helsinki.
en: The InfoFinland.fi service is maintained by the City of Helsinki.

so: Magaaladu waxey qawlqaaday ilaalinta arrimaha gaarka u ah dadka isticmaala adeegyada shabakadaheeda.
en: The city is committed to protect the privacy of the users of its online services.

so: Si otomaatig ah ayaan ula soconaa booqdayaasha macluumaadkana waxaan u isticmaalnaa horumarinta bogga.
en: We automatically monitor the visitors of the service and use the data to develop the website.

so: La-socoshada waxaan ku ogaanaa tusaale ahaan:
en: With the help of monitoring, we know, for example:

so: tirada dadka booqda bogga
en: how much different pages are used

so: inta ay dhantahay sida loo isticmaalo bogagga kala duwan
en: in what languages the website is used

so: luqadda bogga lagu isticmaalo
en: for how long the pages are used

so: inta ay dhantahay mudada la isticmaalayay bogga
en: how the website is navigated

so: sida bogga loogu dhaqdhaqaaqo
en: in what country the users are

so: wadanka ay isticaamalayaashu joogaan
en: what devices and browsers the pages are used on

so: Bogagga waxaa loo isticmaalaa kookiyiin (cookies).
en: The website uses cookies.

so: Bog-furis ayaan kula soconaa bogagga, laakiin ma uruurino macluumaadyo qofka ku xiriirsami kara.
en: We monitor browsing the website, but we do not collect data that could be connected to a person.

so: Isticmaaluhu wuxuu isticmaalka kookiyooyinka uga hortagi karaa beddelista habka bog-furihiisa.
en: The user may prevent the use of cookies by changing the settings of the browser.

so: Isbeddelku wuxuu saameyn karaa shaqada bogga.
en: The change may affect the functionality of the site.

so: Bogagga waxaa ku jira waxyaabo hoos la geliyay oo ay dadka soo saareen.
